/-! Complete owned semantic sample function: selected mask, coefficient extra,
actual retained zero-claim terminal, eta multiplication and both additions.
The retained terminal's public-preparation/source binding remains explicit. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitOracle55
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitTerminalZero55 (Statement publicModel)
open ProverCommitSuccessorPoint49 (decoded)

def run (s : Statement) (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) :
    Result (core.result.Result field.QM31 AspisR1.CompositionPartsTail.Error) := do
  let mask ← ProverCommitMaskRead51.run (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p)
    (ProverCommitMaskColumns51.columns c) (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize (c 27))
  let extra ← ProverCommitExtraCaller51.run (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize (c 28))
    (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source (p 8)) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source (p 9))
  let combined ← field.QM31.add mask extra
  let terminal ← ProverCommitTerminalZero55.run s sem p
  match terminal with
  | .Err error => ok (.Err error)
  | .Ok (terminal,_,_,_) => do
    let prod ← field.QM31.mul (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source (sem 14))
      (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source (ProverCommitTerminalCarrier55.fromSelected terminal))
    let out ← field.QM31.add combined prod
    ok (.Ok out)

theorem zero_claims (p : Fin 10 → QM31Exact) :
    R0P.SemSource.honestClaims (0 : R0P.Trace QM31Exact) p=fun _ _ => 0 := by
  funext r l
  simp only [R0P.SemSource.honestClaims,AspisR0.LinearDual.dot,
    Pi.zero_apply,mul_zero,Finset.sum_const_zero]

attribute [local irreducible] R0P.SemSource.honestClaims R0Z.PayloadSplit.maskLinear
  R0P.Mask.maskValue ProverCommitQBasis51.basis ProverCommitClaims53.trace
  ProverCommitTerminalZero55.publicModel R0P.SemSource.terminalValue

theorem exact_result (s : Statement) (sem p : Nat → Old.Q)
    (hs : ∀ i, i<25 → Canonical (sem i)) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (hc : ∀ l, l<29 → ∀ i, i<1024 → Canonical (c l i))
    (template : R0Z.HonestView.Challenges QM31Exact)
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (hash : H) (c1 : Array U8 32#usize)
    (transcript : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (hprep : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.public_transcript D
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s) hash c1=ok (.Ok transcript)) :
    ∃ out : Old.Q, run s sem p c=ok (.Ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source out)) ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out=ProverCommitSemanticModel55.oracle AspisR1.rowEquiv (publicModel s)
        ProverCommitQBasis51.basis (ProverCommitChallengePrefix55.withSemantic template sem)
        (ProverCommitClaims53.trace c) (decoded p) := by
  obtain ⟨mask,hmask,hcmask,hdmask⟩ := ProverCommitConcreteMask51.exact_result p hp c hc
    (ProverCommitClaims53.trace c) (by intro l i;unfold ProverCommitClaims53.trace;rfl)
  obtain ⟨extra,hextra,hcextra,hdextra⟩ := ProverCommitExtraCaller51.exact_result (c 28) p
    (hc 28 (by decide)) hp (ProverCommitClaims53.trace c) (by intro i;unfold ProverCommitClaims53.trace;rfl)
  obtain ⟨combined,hcombined,hccombined,hdcombined⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add mask extra hcmask hcextra
  obtain ⟨z,mo,g,terminal,hterminal,hcterminal,hdterminal⟩ :=
    ProverCommitTerminalZero55.exact_result s sem p hs hp D hash c1 transcript hprep
  obtain ⟨prod,hprod,hcprod,hdprod⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul (sem 14)
    (ProverCommitTerminalCarrier55.fromSelected terminal) (hs 14 (by decide)) hcterminal
  obtain ⟨out,hout,hcout,hdout⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add combined prod hccombined hcprod
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcout,?_⟩
  · simp only [run,hmask,hextra,hcombined,hterminal,hprod,hout,bind_tc_ok]
  · have hdecoded : (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (p i.val))=decoded p := rfl
    rw [hdecoded] at hdmask hdextra
    have hmasklinear : decode mask+decode extra=R0Z.PayloadSplit.maskLinear AspisR1.rowEquiv
        ProverCommitQBasis51.basis (decoded p) (ProverCommitClaims53.trace c) := by
      rw [hdmask,hdextra,R0Z.PayloadSplit.maskLinear_apply]
    rw [hdout,hdcombined,hdprod,hmasklinear,hdterminal]
    have hzc : R0Z.HonestView.zc (ProverCommitChallengePrefix55.withSemantic template sem)=
        (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (sem (3+i.val))) := rfl
    simp only [ProverCommitSemanticModel55.oracle,R0Z.Shift.fOrig,zero_claims]
    rw [hzc]
    rfl

#print axioms zero_claims
#print axioms exact_result
end R1Z.ProverCommitOracle55

def publicModel (s : Statement) := AspisR1.SemanticCompositionCoefficients.exactPublic (copyFromStatement s)
def zeroClaims := array 84#usize (fun _ => zero)
def zc (sem : Nat → Old.Q) := array 10#usize (fun i => sem (3+i))
def run (s : Statement) (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) :=
  ProverCommitTerminalQName55.run (copyFromStatement s) zeroClaims (array 10#usize p)
    (toSelected (sem 0)) (toSelected (sem 1)) (toSelected (sem 2)) (zc sem) (toSelected (sem 13))

theorem claims_zero : AspisR1.TerminalClaimModel53.claims zeroClaims=fun _ _ => (0 : QM31Exact) := by
  funext r c
  unfold AspisR1.TerminalClaimModel53.claims
  split
  · simp only [zeroClaims,array,ProverCommitArray49.array,List.getElem_ofFn,decode_to,zero_decode]
  · rfl

theorem exact_result (s : Statement) (sem p : Nat → Old.Q)
    (hs : ∀ i, i<25 → Canonical (sem i)) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (hash : H) (c1 : Array U8 32#usize)
    (transcript : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (hprep : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.public_transcript D
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s) hash c1=ok (.Ok transcript)) :
    ∃ (z : Array Selected 16#usize) (mask : Array Selected 10#usize) (g terminal : Selected),
      run s sem p=ok (.Ok (terminal,z,mask,g)) ∧ Canonical (fromSelected terminal) ∧
      decode (fromSelected terminal)=R0P.SemSource.terminalValue (publicModel s)
        (decode (sem 0)) (decode (sem 1)) (decode (sem 2)) (decode (sem 13))
        (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (sem (3+i.val))) ProverCommitQBasis51.basis
        (fun _ _ => 0) (ProverCommitSuccessorPoint49.decoded p) := by
  have hzero : AspisR1.SemanticCompositionCoefficients.CanonicalArray zeroClaims :=
    array_canonical 84#usize (fun _ => zero) (fun _ _ => zero_canonical)
  have hzc : AspisR1.SemanticCompositionCoefficients.CanonicalArray (zc sem) :=
    array_canonical 10#usize (fun i => sem (3+i)) (by intro i hi;apply hs;change 3+i<25;change i<10 at hi;omega)
  obtain ⟨z,mask,g,terminal,hrun,hcan,hvalue⟩ := ProverCommitTerminalQName55.source_success
    (array 10#usize p) (zc sem) s zeroClaims
    (toSelected (sem 0)) (toSelected (sem 1)) (toSelected (sem 2)) (toSelected (sem 13))
    (array_canonical 10#usize p hp) hzc hzero
    (canonical_to _ (hs 0 (by decide))) (canonical_to _ (hs 1 (by decide)))
    (canonical_to _ (hs 2 (by decide))) (canonical_to _ (hs 13 (by decide)))
    D hash c1 transcript hprep
  refine ⟨z,mask,g,terminal,hrun,canonical_from terminal hcan,?_⟩
  rw [decode_from]
  rw [claims_zero,point_model] at hvalue
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode terminal=R0P.SemSource.terminalValue (publicModel s)
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (toSelected (sem 0)))
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (toSelected (sem 1)))
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (toSelected (sem 2)))
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (toSelected (sem 13)))
    (AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint (zc sem)) ProverCommitQBasis51.basis
    (fun _ _ => 0) (ProverCommitSuccessorPoint49.decoded p) at hvalue
  have hzcpoint : AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint (zc sem)=
      (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (sem (3+i.val))) := point_model (fun i => sem (3+i))
  rw [hzcpoint] at hvalue
  simpa only [decode_to] using hvalue

#print axioms claims_zero
#print axioms exact_result
end R1Z.ProverCommitTerminalZero55

/-! Exact four-word transport between the encoder-owner and retained terminal

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTerminalCarrier55
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
abbrev Selected := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31

def toSelected (q : Old.Q) : Selected :=
  {c0:={a:=q.c0.a,b:=q.c0.b},c1:={a:=q.c1.a,b:=q.c1.b}}
def fromSelected (q : Selected) : Old.Q :=
  {c0:={a:=q.c0.a,b:=q.c0.b},c1:={a:=q.c1.a,b:=q.c1.b}}

theorem from_to (q : Old.Q) : fromSelected (toSelected q)=q := by cases q; rfl

theorem to_from (q : Selected) : toSelected (fromSelected q)=q := by cases q; rfl

theorem canonical_to (q : Old.Q) (h : Canonical q) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (toSelected q) := h

theorem canonical_from (q : Selected) (h : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM q) :
    Canonical (fromSelected q) := h

theorem decode_to (q : Old.Q) : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (toSelected q)=decode q := rfl

theorem decode_from (q : Selected) : decode (fromSelected q)=AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q := rfl

def array (n : Usize) (q : Nat → Old.Q) : Array Selected n :=
  ProverCommitArray49.array n (fun i => toSelected (q i))

theorem array_canonical (n : Usize) (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ i, i<n.val → Canonical (q i)) :
    AspisR1.SemanticCompositionCoefficients.CanonicalArray (array n q) := by
  intro i
  simp only [array,ProverCommitArray49.array,List.getElem_ofFn]
  exact canonical_to (q i.val) (hq i.val i.isLt)

theorem point_model (q : Nat → Old.Q) :
    AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint (array 10#usize q)=ProverCommitSuccessorPoint49.decoded q := by
  funext i
  simp only [AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint,AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.exactPoint,
    array,ProverCommitArray49.array,List.getElem_ofFn]
  split
  · exact decode_to (q i.val)
  · rename_i hi
    exact (hi i.isLt).elim

#print axioms to_from
#print axioms canonical_to
#print axioms canonical_from
#print axioms decode_to
#print axioms decode_from
#print axioms array_canonical
#print axioms point_model
end R1Z.ProverCommitTerminalCarrier55

    (hprep : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.public_transcript D

        (AspisR1.TerminalClaimModel53.claims claims) (AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint point) := by

    point zc s claims lambda chi theta mu hpoint hzc hclaims hlambda hchi htheta hmu
    D hash c1 outTranscript hprep
  refine ⟨z,mask,g,terminal,?_,hcan,hvalue⟩

import PoseidonLeadingPairExact
import PoseidonInterpolatedFullPairExact
import PoseidonCandidateProjectedScalarResidualFromBoxedV4

/-! Callable contract for the retained source cut. This discharges the leading
and full branch success/model premises. The cut's Rust/extraction provenance
remains the explicit boundary recorded by the imported wrapper module. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonCallable53
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Point := Array QM 10#usize
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev Packed := Array QM 4#usize
abbrev Exact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) : Prop :=
  AspisR1.SumHighInnerLoop.CanonicalArray a
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev cell := AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
abbrev decodedOpenings := AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointResidualModel.decodedOpenings
abbrev lane := AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedModel.lane
abbrev iBasis := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.iBasis
abbrev uBasis := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.uBasis

def source (openings : Openings) (selectors : Selectors) : Result Packed := do
  let prepared ← AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.source selectors
  AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_projected_source openings prepared

def model (point : Point) (openings : Openings) (_selectors : Selectors) (g : Fin 4) : Exact :=
  R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun j =>
    R0P.poseidonScalarResidual (decodedOpenings openings)
      (R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 (by omega))
      (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) (lane g j))

/-- Every output image and both packed branch calls are conclusions, rather
than hypotheses. Canonical point and three canonical opening arrays suffice. -/
theorem source_success
    (openings : Openings) (point : Point) (selectors : Selectors)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z) (hsucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hxor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ out : Packed, source openings selectors = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧ ∀ g : Fin 4, decode (cell out g) = model point openings selectors g := by
  obtain ⟨prepared,hprepared,_,hlocal,hlocalEq,_,hlow⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.boxed_success point selectors hpoint hbox
  have hlowCan : CanonicalArray selectors.low := by
    rw [hlocalEq] at hlocal
    exact hlocal
  have hlowModel : AspisR1.PoseidonInterpolatedFullPairExact.decodedState selectors.low =
      R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) := by
    funext i
    have hi : i.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using i.isLt
    have h := hlow i
    rw [hlocalEq] at h
    dsimp only [AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray,
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedAt] at h
    rw [dif_pos hi] at h
    exact h
  obtain ⟨leading,hleading,hleadingCan,hleadingModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonLeadingPairExact.source_success openings hz hxor
  obtain ⟨full,hfull,hfullCan,hfullModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInterpolatedFullPairExact.qm_source_success openings.z selectors.low hz hlowCan
  have hfullValue : ∀ g : Fin 4, decode (cell full g) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun j =>
        R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair (decodedOpenings openings).z
          (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) (lane g j)) := by
    intro g

PoseidonLeadingAbsorb:
import PoseidonFullRoundLoopModel

/-! Actual leading absorption: a fixed input array is added to distinct
state cells over the checked source range. The invariant is symbolic. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonLeadingAbsorb
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

def addStep (a state : State) (lane : Usize) : Result State := do
  let x ← Array.index_usize state lane
  let y ← Array.index_usize a lane
  let value ← field.QM31.add x y
  Array.update state lane value

def addModel (a state : State) (lane : Fin 16) : Exact :=
  Decode (cell state lane) + Decode (cell a lane)

theorem addStep_success (a state : State) (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 16)
    (ha : CanonicalState a) (hs : CanonicalState state) :
    ∃ value : QM, addStep a state lane = .ok (state.set lane value) ∧
      CanonicalState (state.set lane value) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell (state.set lane value) j) =
        if j.val = lane.val then addModel a state ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩ else Decode (cell state j) := by
  let index : Fin 16 := ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩
  let x := cell state index
  let y := cell a index
  have hb : lane.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using hlane
  have hx : Array.index_usize state lane = .ok x := by
    simpa only [x,index,cell] using
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok state lane hb
  have hy : Array.index_usize a lane = .ok y := by
    simpa only [y,index,cell] using
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok a lane hb
  obtain ⟨value,hadd,hcan,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact x y (hs index) (ha index)
  obtain ⟨out,hupdate,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec state lane value (by simpa [state.property] using hb))
  have hwrite : Array.update state lane value = .ok (state.set lane value) := by
    rw [hupdate,hset]
  refine ⟨value,?_,set_canonical state lane value hs hcan,?_⟩
  · simp only [addStep,hx,hy,bind_tc_ok,hadd,hwrite]
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = lane.val
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      exact hmodel
    · simp only [if_neg hj]

theorem generated_loop_step (iter : Range) (a state : State) :
    state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop iter a state = (do
      let (o,iter1) ← core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
      match o with
      | none => .ok state
      | some lane =>
        let state1 ← addStep a state lane
        state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop iter1 a state1) := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop.eq_def]
  simp only [addStep,bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

theorem loop_success_fuel (a state : State) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val ≤ 16) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = iter.end.val)
    (ha : CanonicalState a) (hs : CanonicalState state) :
    ∃ out : State, state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop iter a state = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) =
        if iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val then addModel a state j
        else Decode (cell state j) := by
  induction fuel generalizing state iter with
  | zero =>
    have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
    refine ⟨state,?_,hs,?_⟩
    · rw [generated_loop_step,hnext]
      change Result.ok state = Result.ok state
      rfl
    · intro j
      have hn : ¬ (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
      rw [if_neg hn]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    have hidx : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨iter1,hnext,hinc,hend1,_⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
    have hend' : iter1.end.val ≤ 16 := by rw [hend1]; exact hend
    have hspan' : iter1.start.val + fuel = iter1.end.val := by rw [hend1]; omega
    obtain ⟨value,hstep,hstate1,hcells⟩ := addStep_success a state iter.start hidx ha hs
    let state1 := state.set iter.start value
    obtain ⟨out,hrec,hcan,hmodel⟩ := ih state1 iter1 hend' hspan' hstate1
    refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
    · rw [generated_loop_step,hnext]
      change (do
        let nextState ← addStep a state iter.start
        state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop iter1 a nextState) = .ok out
      rw [hstep]
      change state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop iter1 a state1 = .ok out
      exact hrec
    · intro j
      have hv := hmodel j
      rw [hinc,hend1] at hv
      rw [hv]
      by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
      · have hafter : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        have hinside : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val := by omega
        rw [if_neg hafter,if_pos hinside]
        have hcell := hcells j
        rw [if_pos hj] at hcell
        have hindex : (⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ : Fin 16) = j := Fin.ext hj.symm
        change Decode (cell state1 j) = addModel a state ⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ at hcell
        exact hcell.trans (congrArg (addModel a state) hindex)
      · have hcell : Decode (cell state1 j) = Decode (cell state j) := by
          have h := hcells j
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact h
        unfold addModel
        rw [hcell]
        have hrange : (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) ↔
            (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        by_cases hin : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val
        · rw [if_pos (hrange.mpr hin),if_pos hin]
        · have hn : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) :=
            fun h => hin (hrange.mp h)
          rw [if_neg hn,if_neg hin]

theorem source_success (a state : State) (ha : CanonicalState a) (hs : CanonicalState state) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed_loop
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := poseidon2.RATE } a state = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) =
        if j.val < 8 then addModel a state j else Decode (cell state j) := by
  have hrate : poseidon2.RATE = 8#usize := by unfold poseidon2.RATE; rfl
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcan,hmodel⟩ := loop_success_fuel a state
    { start := 0#usize, «end» := 8#usize } 8 (by decide) (by decide) ha hs
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · rw [hrate]
    exact hrun
  · intro j
    have h := hmodel j
    have hzero : (0#usize).val ≤ j.val := Nat.zero_le _
    have height : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
    simpa only [hzero,true_and,height] using h

#print axioms addStep_success
#print axioms generated_loop_step
#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonLeadingAbsorb

import PoseidonFullRoundLoopSource

/-! Symbolic traversal of both actual nonlinear full-round loops. Fuel is a
proof measure for the source range, not an evaluated 16-cell recurrence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundLoopModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundLoopSource

def laneModel (state : State) (constants1 : Constants) (i : Fin 16) : Exact :=
  R0P.poseidonPow5 (Decode (cell state i) + ((cell constants1 i).val : Exact))

theorem loop_success_fuel (packed : Bool) (state : State) (constants1 : Constants)
    (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val ≤ 16) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = iter.end.val)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hconstants : CanonicalConstants constants1) :
    ∃ out : State, loop packed iter state constants1 = .ok out ∧ CanonicalState out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) =
        if iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val then laneModel state constants1 j
        else Decode (cell state j) := by
  induction fuel generalizing state iter with
  | zero =>
    have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
    refine ⟨state,?_,hstate,?_⟩
    · rw [generated_loop_step]
      rw [hnext]
      change Result.ok state = Result.ok state
      rfl
    · intro j
      have hnot : ¬ (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
      rw [if_neg hnot]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    have hidx : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨iter1,hnext,hinc,hend1,_⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
    have hend' : iter1.end.val ≤ 16 := by rw [hend1]; exact hend
    have hspan' : iter1.start.val + fuel = iter1.end.val := by rw [hend1]; omega
    obtain ⟨value,hstep,hvalueCan,hstate1Can,hstepModel,hstepCells⟩ :=
      runStep_success state constants1 iter.start hidx hstate hconstants
    let state1 := state.set iter.start value
    obtain ⟨out,hrec,houtCan,houtModel⟩ := ih state1 iter1 hend' hspan' hstate1Can
    refine ⟨out,?_,houtCan,?_⟩
    · rw [generated_loop_step]
      rw [hnext]
      change (do
        let nextState ← runStep state constants1 iter.start
        loop packed iter1 nextState constants1) = .ok out
      rw [hstep]
      change loop packed iter1 state1 constants1 = .ok out
      exact hrec
    · intro j
      have hv := houtModel j
      rw [hinc,hend1] at hv
      rw [hv]
      by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
      · have hafter : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        have hinside : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val := by omega
        rw [if_neg hafter,if_pos hinside]
        have hcell := hstepCells j
        rw [if_pos hj] at hcell
        have hindex : (⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ : Fin 16) = j := Fin.ext hj.symm
        change Decode (cell state1 j) = laneModel state constants1 ⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ at hcell
        exact hcell.trans (congrArg (laneModel state constants1) hindex)
      · have hcell : Decode (cell state1 j) = Decode (cell state j) := by
          have h := hstepCells j
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact h
        unfold laneModel
        rw [hcell]
        have hrange : (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) ↔
            (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        by_cases hin : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val
        · rw [if_pos (hrange.mpr hin),if_pos hin]
        · have hn : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) :=
            fun h => hin (hrange.mp h)
          rw [if_neg hn,if_neg hin]

/-- The exact width-16 source range computes every nonlinear round cell and
preserves canonicality, for either generated full-round variant. -/
theorem all_cells_success (packed : Bool) (state : State) (constants1 : Constants)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hconstants : CanonicalConstants constants1) :
    ∃ out : State,
      loop packed { start := 0#usize, «end» := poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH } state constants1 = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) = laneModel state constants1 j := by
  have hwidth : poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH = 16#usize := by
    unfold poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH
    rfl
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcan,hmodel⟩ := loop_success_fuel packed state constants1
    { start := 0#usize, «end» := 16#usize } 16 (by decide) (by decide) hstate hconstants
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · rw [hwidth]
    exact hrun
  · intro j
    have h := hmodel j
    have hj : (0#usize).val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < (16#usize).val := by
      have := j.isLt
      scalar_tac
    rw [if_pos hj] at h
    exact h

#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms all_cells_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundLoopModel

import AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
import OccupancyRangeTraversal

/-! One exact body equation shared by the two generated nonlinear loops.
Only their recursive names differ; no iterations are unfolded here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundLoopSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

def loop (packed : Bool) (iter : Range) (state : State) (constants1 : Constants) : Result State :=
  if packed then state_only_poseidon.full_round_m31_constants_packed_loop iter state constants1
  else state_only_poseidon.full_round_m31_constants_loop iter state constants1


/-- Moving the final continuation inside the checked mutable-index tuple
match is symbolic bind congruence; the source arithmetic is kept opaque. -/
theorem runStep_bind {α : Type} (state : State) (constants1 : Constants) (lane : Usize)
    (next : State → Result α) :
    (do let state1 ← runStep state constants1 lane; next state1) = (do
      let q ← Array.index_usize state lane
      let c ← Array.index_usize constants1 lane
      let m ← field.M31.add q.c0.a c
      let (q1,back) ← Array.index_mut_usize state lane
      let state1 := back (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q1 m)
      let q2 ← Array.index_usize state1 lane
      let q3 ← state_only_poseidon.pow5 q2
      let state2 ← Array.update state1 lane q3
      next state2) := by
  simp only [runStep,bind_assoc_eq]
  congr 1
  funext q
  congr 1
  funext c
  congr 1
  funext m
  congr 1
  funext pair
  rcases pair with ⟨q1,back⟩
  change (do
    let state1 ← (do
      let q2 ← Array.index_usize (back (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q1 m)) lane
      let q3 ← state_only_poseidon.pow5 q2
      Array.update (back (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q1 m)) lane q3)
    next state1) = (do
      let q2 ← Array.index_usize (back (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q1 m)) lane
      let q3 ← state_only_poseidon.pow5 q2
      let state2 ← Array.update (back (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q1 m)) lane q3
      next state2)
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq]


theorem generated_loop_step (packed : Bool) (iter : Range) (state : State) (constants1 : Constants) :
    loop packed iter state constants1 = (do
      let (o,iter1) ← core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
      match o with
      | none => .ok state
      | some lane =>
        let state1 ← runStep state constants1 lane
        loop packed iter1 state1 constants1) := by
  cases packed
  · simp only [loop,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
    rw [state_only_poseidon.full_round_m31_constants_loop.eq_def]
    simp only [runStep_bind,AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated]
    rfl
  · simp only [loop,ite_true]
    rw [state_only_poseidon.full_round_m31_constants_packed_loop.eq_def]
    simp only [runStep_bind,AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated]
    rfl

#print axioms runStep_bind

#print axioms generated_loop_step
end AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundLoopSource
AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep:
import PoseidonLeadingSourceDeclarationsV5
import AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5
import ExtractedMaskHornerStep

/-! Actual per-index source body of both M31-constant full-round loops.
The checked mutable-index closure and second write are not assumed to equal
an abstract update: they are derived from the Aeneas array specifications. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Exact := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev P := AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.P
abbrev State := Array QM 16#usize
abbrev Constants := Array U32 16#usize

def cell {α : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array α N) (i : Fin N.val) : α :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)
def CanonicalState (a : State) : Prop := ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (cell a i)
def CanonicalConstants (a : Constants) : Prop := ∀ i : Fin 16, (cell a i).val < P

def runStep (state : State) (constants1 : Constants) (lane : Usize) : Result State := do
  let q ← Array.index_usize state lane
  let i ← Array.index_usize constants1 lane
  let m ← field.M31.add q.c0.a i
  let (q1, back) ← Array.index_mut_usize state lane
  let state1 := back (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q1 m)
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize state1 lane
  let q3 ← state_only_poseidon.pow5 q2
  Array.update state1 lane q3

theorem cell_set {α : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array α N) (i : Usize)
    (x : α) (j : Fin N.val) :
    cell (a.set i x) j = if j.val = i.val then x else cell a j := by
  unfold cell
  by_cases heq : j.val = i.val
  · simp [heq,Array.set_val_eq]
  · have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := Ne.symm heq

  simp only [Array.set_val_eq,List.set_set]

      Decode value = R0P.poseidonPow5
        (Decode (cell state ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩) + ((cell constants1 ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩).val : Exact)) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell (state.set lane value) j) =
        if j.val = lane.val then R0P.poseidonPow5

  have hread : Array.index_usize state lane = .ok q := by
    simpa only [q,cell,index] using
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok state lane hb
  have hconstant : Array.index_usize constants1 lane = .ok c := by
    simpa only [c,cell,index] using
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok constants1 lane hb
  obtain ⟨value,hcell,hvalueCan,hvalueDec⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.source_success q c (hstate index) (hconstants index)
  obtain ⟨m,hm,hpow⟩ : ∃ m : field.M31, field.M31.add q.c0.a c = .ok m ∧
      state_only_poseidon.pow5 (AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q m) = .ok value := by
    cases hm : field.M31.add q.c0.a c with
    | ok m =>
      refine ⟨m,rfl,?_⟩
      simpa only [AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.source,hm,bind_tc_ok] using hcell
    | fail e =>
      simp only [AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.source,hm,bind_tc_fail] at hcell
      cases hcell
    | div =>
      simp only [AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.source,hm,bind_tc_div] at hcell
      cases hcell
  have hmut : Array.index_mut_usize state lane = .ok (q, fun x => state.set lane x) := by
    simp only [Array.index_mut_usize,hread,bind_tc_ok]
  let updatedQ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31ConstantPow5.updated q m
  let state1 := state.set lane updatedQ
  have hreadAgain : Array.index_usize state1 lane = .ok updatedQ := by
    rw [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok state1 lane hb]
    congr 1
    change (state.val.set lane.val updatedQ)[lane.val]'_ = updatedQ
    exact List.getElem_set_self (by simpa [state.property] using hb)
  obtain ⟨out,hupdate,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec state1 lane value (by simpa [state1,state.property] using hb))
  have hupdate' : Array.update state1 lane value = .ok (state.set lane value) := by
    rw [hupdate,hset]
    change Result.ok ((state.set lane updatedQ).set lane value) = Result.ok (state.set lane value)
    rw [set_overwrite]
  have hstep : runStep state constants1 lane = .ok (state.set lane value) := by
    simp only [runStep,hread,hconstant,bind_tc_ok,hm,hmut]
    change (do
      let q2 ← Array.index_usize state1 lane
      let q3 ← state_only_poseidon.pow5 q2
      Array.update state1 lane q3) = _
    simp only [hreadAgain,bind_tc_ok,updatedQ,hpow,hupdate']
  change Decode value = R0P.poseidonPow5 (Decode q + (c.val : Exact)) at hvalueDec
  dsimp only [q,c,index] at hvalueDec
  refine ⟨value,hstep,hvalueCan,set_canonical state lane value hstate hvalueCan,hvalueDec,?_⟩
  intro j
  rw [cell_set]
  by_cases hj : j.val = lane.val
  · simp only [if_pos hj]
    exact hvalueDec
  · simp only [if_neg hj]

/-! Aeneas discriminant readers with enum-qualified instance names for import unions.
The pinned generator supplies both commands; only its anonymous instance name
is changed. Scalar types, explicit tags, generic binders and reader bodies are
preserved. This adapter must be rebuilt when the Aeneas generator is repinned. -/
open Lean Elab Term Meta
open Lean.Parser.Term Lean.Parser.Command

namespace ImportUnionNamedDiscriminant

syntax (name := namedDiscriminant) "import_union_discriminant" ident ("["num,*"]")? : attr

initialize namedDiscriminantAttribute : AttributeImpl ← do
  let attrImpl : AttributeImpl := {
    «name» := `namedDiscriminant,
    descr := "Emit the Aeneas reader with an enum-qualified instance name",
    add := fun declName stx _ => do
      let (ty, values) ← match stx with
        | `(attr| import_union_discriminant $ty) =>
          pure (← Aeneas.Discriminant.elabTypeToken ty, none)
        | `(attr| import_union_discriminant $ty [$xs,*]) =>
          pure (← Aeneas.Discriminant.elabTypeToken ty,
            some ((xs.getElems.toList.map Syntax.isNatLit?).map Option.get!))
        | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
      liftCommandElabM do
        let cmds ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM
          (Aeneas.Discriminant.generateReadDiscriminantCmds declName ty values)
        Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand cmds[0]!
        let instName := mkIdent (declName ++ `instDiscriminant)
        let id ← `(Parser.Command.declId| $instName:ident)
        let inst := cmds[1]!.rewriteBottomUp fun node => Id.run do
          if node.isOfKind ``Lean.Parser.Command.instance then
            return node.setArg 3 (mkNullNode #[id.raw])
          return node
        if inst == cmds[1]! then
          throwError "Pinned Aeneas generator no longer emits an instance command"
        Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand inst
  }
  registerBuiltinAttribute attrImpl
  pure attrImpl

theorem shift_success {ty : UScalarTy} (x : UScalar ty) (s : Nat)

  refine ⟨UScalar.ofNatCore n h, ?_, rfl⟩

/-! Reuses the prior GeneratedMulByR and GeneratedQM31Products proof routes
for current extracted functions. This proves canonical modular word formulas,
not the verifier caller or the decoded exact-field correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul

open Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev P : Nat := ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P
abbrev WordPair := Nat × Nat

def addWords (x y : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  ((x.1 + y.1) % P, (x.2 + y.2) % P)

def subWords (x y : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  ((x.1 + P - y.1) % P, (x.2 + P - y.2) % P)

def mulWords (x y : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  (((x.1 * y.1) % P + P - (x.2 * y.2) % P) % P,
   ((((x.1 + x.2) * (y.1 + y.2)) % P + P -
       (x.1 * y.1) % P) % P + P - (x.2 * y.2) % P) % P)

def rWords (x : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  (((x.1 + x.1) % P + P - x.2) % P,
   (x.1 + (x.2 + x.2) % P) % P)

def qmMulWords (x y : WordPair × WordPair) :=
  let m0 := mulWords x.1 y.1
  let m1 := mulWords x.2 y.2
  (addWords m0 (rWords m1),
   subWords (subWords (mulWords (addWords x.1 x.2)
     (addWords y.1 y.2)) m0) m1)

private def wordsCM (x : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31) : WordPair :=
  (x.a.val, x.b.val)

def wordsQM (x : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31) :
    WordPair × WordPair :=
  (wordsCM x.c0, wordsCM x.c1)

private theorem cm_add_words
    (x y : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.add x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = addWords (wordsCM x) (wordsCM y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ez, cz, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_add_mod x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, ez, cz, Prod.ext va vb⟩

private theorem cm_sub_words
    (x y : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.sub x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = subWords (wordsCM x) (wordsCM y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ez, cz, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_sub_mod x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, ez, cz, Prod.ext va vb⟩

private theorem cm_mul_words
    (x y : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = mulWords (wordsCM x) (wordsCM y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ez, cz, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCM31Mul.current_mul_words x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, ez, cz, Prod.ext va vb⟩

private theorem cm_r_words
    (x : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.mul_by_r x = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = rWords (wordsCM x) := by
  obtain ⟨a2, ea2, va2, ca2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a x.a hx.1 hx.1
  obtain ⟨a, ea, va, ca⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod a2 x.b ca2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b2, eb2, vb2, cb2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.b x.b hx.2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b, eb, vb, cb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a b2 hx.1 cb2
  refine ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ?_, ⟨ca, cb⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.mul_by_r,
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.double,
      ea2, ea, eb2, eb, bind_tc_ok]
  · change (a.val, b.val) = rWords (wordsCM x)
    simp only [rWords, wordsCM]
    exact Prod.ext (by simpa only [va2] using va)
      (by simpa only [vb2] using vb)

theorem current_qm_mul_words
    (x y : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM z ∧
      wordsQM z = qmMulWords (wordsQM x) (wordsQM y) := by
  obtain ⟨m0, e0, c0, v0⟩ := cm_mul_words x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨m1, e1, c1, v1⟩ := cm_mul_words x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  obtain ⟨a, ea, ca, va⟩ := cm_add_words x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b, eb, cb, vb⟩ := cm_add_words y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨m2, e2, c2, v2⟩ := cm_mul_words a b ca cb
  obtain ⟨r, er, cr, vr⟩ := cm_r_words m1 c1
  obtain ⟨lo, el, cl, vl⟩ := cm_add_words m0 r c0 cr
  obtain ⟨d, ed, cd, vd⟩ := cm_sub_words m2 m0 c2 c0
  obtain ⟨hi, eh, ch, vh⟩ := cm_sub_words d m1 cd c1
  refine ⟨⟨lo, hi⟩, ?_, ⟨cl, ch⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.mul,
      e0, e1, ea, eb, e2, er, el, ed, eh, bind_tc_ok]
  · change (wordsCM lo, wordsCM hi) = _
    rw [vl, vh, vd, vr, v2, va, vb, v0, v1]
    rfl

#print axioms current_qm_mul_words

/-!
Symbolic port of the old CM31 cross-operand and current multiplication proof to
freshly extracted field functions using the full Aeneas runtime.  No projected
runtime declarations are imported or introduced here.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCM31Mul

open Aeneas.Std Result Error
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd

abbrev CM := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31
abbrev M31 := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31

def realWord (a b c d : Nat) := ((a*c)%P + P - (b*d)%P)%P

def imagWord (a b c d : Nat) :=
  ((((a+b)*(c+d))%P + P - (a*c)%P)%P + P - (b*d)%P)%P

theorem widen_value (x : M31) :
    (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x).val = x.val := by
  change (x.bv.setWidth 64).toNat = x.bv.toNat
  apply BitVec.toNat_setWidth_of_le
  decide

def crossOperand (a b c d : M31) : Result U64 := do
  let left ← UScalar.add (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a)
    (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b)
  let right ← UScalar.add (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c)
    (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from d)
  UScalar.mul left right

theorem crossOperand_success (a b c d : M31)
    (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647)
    (hc : c.val < 2147483647) (hd : d.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ product : U64, crossOperand a b c d = .ok product ∧
      product.val = (a.val+b.val)*(c.val+d.val) := by
  have hab : a.val + b.val < 2^32 := by omega
  have hcd : c.val + d.val < 2^32 := by omega
  have hleft :
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a).val +
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [widen_value, widen_value]
    omega
  have hright :
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c).val +
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from d).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [widen_value, widen_value]
    omega
  obtain ⟨left, hl, hvl⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.add_success _ _ hleft
  obtain ⟨right, hr, hvr⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.add_success _ _ hright
  rw [widen_value, widen_value] at hvl hvr
  have hprod : left.val * right.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hvl, hvr]
    calc
      (a.val + b.val) * (c.val + d.val) < (2^32) * (2^32) :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hab hcd
      _ = 2^64 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨product, hp, hvp⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.mul_success left right hprod
  refine ⟨product, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [crossOperand, hl, hr, bind_tc_ok, hp]
  · simpa only [hvl, hvr] using hvp

/-- The source-shaped cross-operand fragment used by current `field.CM31.mul`.
The surrounding two M31 products and following reductions remain separate. -/
def generatedCrossFragment (self rhs : CM) : Result U64 := do
  let i := self.a
  let i1 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i4 ← i1 + i3
  let i5 := rhs.a
  let i6 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i5)
  let i7 := rhs.b
  let i8 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i7)
  let i9 ← i6 + i8
  let i10 ← i4 * i9
  .ok i10

private theorem bind_return_word (r : Result U64) :
    (do let x ← r; .ok x) = r := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem generatedCrossFragment_eq (self rhs : CM) :
    generatedCrossFragment self rhs = crossOperand self.a self.b rhs.a rhs.b := by
  simp only [generatedCrossFragment, crossOperand, Aeneas.Std.lift,
    bind_tc_ok, bind_return_word]
  rfl

theorem generatedCrossFragment_success (self rhs : CM)
    (ha : self.a.val < 2147483647) (hb : self.b.val < 2147483647)
    (hc : rhs.a.val < 2147483647) (hd : rhs.b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ product : U64, generatedCrossFragment self rhs = .ok product ∧
      product.val = (self.a.val+self.b.val)*(rhs.a.val+rhs.b.val) := by
  rw [generatedCrossFragment_eq]
  exact crossOperand_success _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd

theorem generated_mul_graph (x y : CM) :
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.mul x y = (do
      let m0 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.mul x.a y.a
      let m1 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.mul x.b y.b
      let product ← generatedCrossFragment x y
      let m2 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.reduce_u64 product
      let low ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.sub m0 m1
      let high0 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.sub m2 m0
      let high ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.sub high0 m1
      Result.ok ⟨low, high⟩) := by
  simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.mul,
    generatedCrossFragment, lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq]

theorem current_mul_words (x y : CM)
    (hx : CanonicalCM x) (hy : CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z : CM,
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.CM31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      CanonicalCM z ∧
      z.a.val = realWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val ∧
      z.b.val = imagWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val := by
  obtain ⟨m0, h0, hv0, hc0⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_mul_mod x.a y.a
  obtain ⟨m1, h1, hv1, hc1⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_mul_mod x.b y.b
  obtain ⟨product, hp, hvp⟩ := generatedCrossFragment_success x y hx.1 hx.2 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨m2, h2, hv2, hc2⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_wrapper_mod product
  rw [hvp] at hv2
  obtain ⟨low, hl, hvl, hcl⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m0 m1 hc0 hc1
  obtain ⟨high0, hh0, hvh0, hch0⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m2 m0 hc2 hc0
  obtain ⟨high, hh, hvh, hch⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod high0 m1 hch0 hc1
  refine ⟨⟨low, high⟩, ?_, ⟨hcl, hch⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [generated_mul_graph]
    simp only [h0, h1, hp, h2, hl, hh0, hh, bind_tc_ok]
  · simpa only [realWord, hv0, hv1] using hvl
  · simpa only [imagWord, hvh0, hv2, hv0, hv1] using hvh

#print axioms widen_value
#print axioms crossOperand_success
#print axioms generatedCrossFragment_eq
#print axioms generatedCrossFragment_success

#print axioms current_mul_words

/-! Reuses the symbolic reducer execution proof over the actual full Aeneas
runtime, then identifies it with freshly extracted current Rust functions.
No source caller canonicality or whole-verifier refinement is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer
open Aeneas.Std ExtractedMaskReducerOps AspisV8R17.RawReducer

def mask32 : U32 := UScalar.ofNatCore P (by decide)
def mask64 : U64 := UScalar.cast .U64 mask32

theorem mask32_value : mask32.val = P := rfl
theorem mask64_value : mask64.val = P := rfl

def foldExecution (x : U64) : Result U64 := do
  let high ← UScalar.shiftRight x 31
  UScalar.add (UScalar.and x mask64) high

theorem foldExecution_success (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U64, foldExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = foldBits x.val := by
  obtain ⟨high, hs, hv⟩ := shift_success x 31 (by decide)
  have hand : (UScalar.and x mask64).val = x.val &&& P := by
    rw [and_value, mask64_value]
  have hsum : (UScalar.and x mask64).val + high.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hand, hv]
    have bound := first_fold_lt x.val x.bv.isLt
    change (x.val &&& P) + (x.val >>> 31) < 10737418240 at bound
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := add_success _ _ hsum
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [foldExecution, hs, bind_tc_ok, hy]
  · simpa only [hand, hv, foldBits] using hyv

def reduceExecution (x : U64) : Result U32 := do
  let first ← foldExecution x
  let second ← foldExecution first
  let narrowed := UScalar.cast .U32 second
  if P ≤ narrowed.val then UScalar.sub narrowed mask32 else .ok narrowed

theorem reduceExecution_success (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U32, reduceExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = rawReduceU64 x.val := by
  obtain ⟨first, hf, hfv⟩ := foldExecution_success x
  obtain ⟨second, hs, hsv⟩ := foldExecution_success first
  rw [hfv] at hsv
  have narrow : (UScalar.cast .U32 second).val = foldBits (foldBits x.val) := by
    rw [narrow_exact, hsv]
    rw [hsv]
    exact second_fold_lt_two_pow32 x.val x.bv.isLt
  have raw : rawReduceU64 x.val = condSubP (foldBits (foldBits x.val)) := by
    rw [rawReduceU64, second_fold_cast_exact x.val x.bv.isLt]
  by_cases h : P ≤ (UScalar.cast .U32 second).val
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := sub_success (UScalar.cast .U32 second) mask32
      (by simpa only [mask32_value] using h)
    refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [reduceExecution, hf, hs, bind_tc_ok, h, if_pos, hy]
    · rw [raw, condSubP, ← narrow, if_pos h]
      simpa only [mask32_value] using hyv
  · refine ⟨UScalar.cast .U32 second, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [reduceExecution, hf, hs, bind_tc_ok, h, if_false]
    · rw [raw, condSubP, ← narrow, if_neg h]

theorem reduceExecution_canonical (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U32, reduceExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = rawReduceU64 x.val ∧ y.val < P := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hv⟩ := reduceExecution_success x
  refine ⟨y, hy, hv, ?_⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact rawReduceU64_canonical x.val x.bv.isLt

#print axioms foldExecution_success
theorem reduceExecution_mod (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U32, reduceExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = x.val % P ∧ y.val < P := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hv, hc⟩ := reduceExecution_canonical x
  exact ⟨y, hy, hv.trans (rawReduceU64_eq_mod_nat x.val x.bv.isLt), hc⟩

#print axioms reduceExecution_success
#print axioms reduceExecution_canonical
#print axioms reduceExecution_mod


/-- Actual extracted current reducer equals the symbolic execution above. -/
theorem current_reducer_eq (x : U64) :
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.reduce_u64 x = reduceExecution x := by
  simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.reduce_u64,
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.P, reduceExecution,
    foldExecution, mask64, mask32, lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

theorem current_reduce_mod (x : U64) :
    ∃ z : U32, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.reduce_u64 x = .ok z ∧
      z.val = x.val % P ∧ z.val < P := by
  rw [current_reducer_eq]
  exact reduceExecution_mod x

theorem cast_widen_value (x : U32) : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by
  rw [cast_value]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h := x.bv.isLt
  change x.val < 2^32 at h
  change x.val < 2^64
  omega

/-- Every pair of stored U32 inputs fits the widening product; no canonical
input premise is needed for multiplication itself. -/
theorem current_mul_mod (x y : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31) :
    ∃ z : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31,
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      z.val = (x.val*y.val) % P ∧ z.val < P := by
  have hproduct : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val * (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [cast_widen_value, cast_widen_value]
    have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt x.bv.isLt y.bv.isLt
    exact h
  obtain ⟨product, hp, hv⟩ := mul_success _ _ hproduct
  rw [cast_widen_value, cast_widen_value] at hv
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzm, hzc⟩ := current_reduce_mod product
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, hzc⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.mul, lift, bind_tc_ok]
    change (do
      let p ← UScalar.mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y)
      let r ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.reduce_u64 p
      Result.ok r) = Result.ok z
    simp only [hp, bind_tc_ok, hz]
  · simpa only [hv] using hzm

theorem current_wrapper_mod (x : U64) :
    ∃ z : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31,

   subWords (subWords (mulWords (addWords x.1 x.2) (addWords y.1 y.2)) m0) m1)
def qmSquareWords (x : WordPair × WordPair) :=
  (addWords (mulWords x.1 x.1) (rWords (mulWords x.2 x.2)),
   addWords (mulWords x.1 x.2) (mulWords x.1 x.2))
end AspisV8R17.GeneratedQM31Products

AspisV8R17.QuadraticTowerOperations:
module
public import Mathlib.Algebra.QuadraticAlgebra.Defs
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Basic

/-! The retained explicit tower arithmetic, generalized over the base ring
to keep concrete ZMod/runtime dependencies out of this algebra leaf. These
are ring identities only; no field/nonresidue assumption is introduced. -/
@[expose] public section
namespace AspisV8R17.QuadraticTowerOperations
variable {F : Type*} [CommRing F]
abbrev C (F : Type*) [CommRing F] := QuadraticAlgebra F (-1) 0
def r : C F := ⟨2,1⟩
abbrev Q (F : Type*) [CommRing F] := QuadraticAlgebra (C F) r 0

def cmul (x y : C F) : C F :=
  ⟨x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im,(x.re+x.im)*(y.re+y.im)-x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im⟩
def cr (x : C F) : C F := ⟨x.re+x.re-x.im,x.re+(x.im+x.im)⟩

theorem cmul_eq (x y : C F) : cmul x y = x*y := by
  ext <;> simp [cmul] <;> ring

theorem cr_eq (x : C F) : cr x = r*x := by
  ext <;> simp [cr, r] <;> ring

def qmul (x y : Q F) : Q F :=
  let m0 := cmul x.re y.re
  let m1 := cmul x.im y.im
  ⟨m0+cr m1,cmul (x.re+x.im) (y.re+y.im)-m0-m1⟩
def qsquare (x : Q F) : Q F :=
  ⟨cmul x.re x.re+cr (cmul x.im x.im),cmul x.re x.im+cmul x.re x.im⟩

theorem qmul_eq (x y : Q F) : qmul x y = x*y := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · simp [qmul, cmul_eq, cr_eq, mul_comm]
    ring
  · simp [qmul, cmul_eq, cr_eq]
    ring

theorem qsquare_eq (x : Q F) : qsquare x = x*x := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · simp [qsquare, cmul_eq, cr_eq, mul_comm]
    ring
  · simp [qsquare, cmul_eq]
    ring

#print axioms cmul_eq
#print axioms cr_eq
#print axioms qmul_eq
#print axioms qsquare_eq
end AspisV8R17.QuadraticTowerOperations

import Mathlib.Algebra.QuadraticAlgebra.Basic
import Mathlib.NumberTheory.LegendreSymbol.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum.Prime

/-! Minimal retained tower, extracted verbatim from declarations in
AspisFormal/V5ComponentCQM31TowerExact.lean (SHA-256
75404d16b5a71f67146b91ca35739b111f81bb730beb77432267f2b5385cebe5).
Only namespace/imports change; the existing 30-step certificate is reused.
No sampler or probability capstone imports are needed for circle algebra. -/
set_option maxRecDepth 20000
namespace AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
abbrev P : Nat := 2147483647

instance m31PrimeFact : Fact P.Prime := ⟨by norm_num [P]⟩

/-- The exact mathematical M31 field. -/
abbrev M31Exact := ZMod P

/-- `-1` is not a square modulo the deployed Mersenne prime. -/
theorem m31_neg_one_not_isSquare : ¬ IsSquare (-1 : M31Exact) := by
  rw [ZMod.exists_sq_eq_neg_one_iff]
  norm_num [P]

/-- One square-and-multiply step for the exponent recurrence
`e_(k+1)=2*e_k+1`. -/
def fivePowStep (z : M31Exact) : M31Exact := z * z * 5

/-- Thirty iterations compute exponent `2^30-1`, using only thirty concrete
field squarings/multiplications in the kernel. -/
theorem fivePowStep_iterate (k : Nat) :
    fivePowStep^[k] 1 = (5 : M31Exact) ^ (2 ^ k - 1) := by
  induction k with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [Function.iterate_succ', Function.comp_apply, ih]
      unfold fivePowStep
      calc
        (5 : M31Exact) ^ (2 ^ n - 1) * 5 ^ (2 ^ n - 1) * 5 =
            5 ^ ((2 ^ n - 1) + (2 ^ n - 1)) * 5 := by rw [pow_add]
        _ = 5 ^ ((2 ^ n - 1) + (2 ^ n - 1) + 1) := by
          simpa using
            (pow_add (5 : M31Exact)
              ((2 ^ n - 1) + (2 ^ n - 1)) 1).symm
        _ = 5 ^ (2 ^ (n + 1) - 1) := by
          congr 1
          rw [pow_succ]
          have hp : 1 ≤ 2 ^ n := Nat.one_le_two_pow
          omega

/-- The concrete Euler certificate: `5^(P/2) != 1`. -/
theorem five_euler_certificate : (5 : M31Exact) ^ (P / 2) ≠ 1 := by
  rw [show P / 2 = 2 ^ 30 - 1 by norm_num [P], ← fivePowStep_iterate 30]
  decide

/-- `5` is not a square modulo `P`, by Euler's criterion and the kernel-checked
30-step certificate above. -/
theorem m31_five_not_isSquare : ¬ IsSquare (5 : M31Exact) := by
  rw [ZMod.euler_criterion P (by decide)]
  exact five_euler_certificate

/-- Exact deployed complex extension: `i^2 = -1`. -/
abbrev CM31Exact := QuadraticAlgebra M31Exact (-1) 0

instance cm31Rootless : Fact
    (∀ r : M31Exact, r ^ 2 ≠ (-1 : M31Exact) + 0 * r) := ⟨by
  intro r hr
  apply m31_neg_one_not_isSquare
  refine ⟨r, ?_⟩
  simpa [pow_two] using hr.symm
⟩

/-- The literal non-residue `R = 2+i` from the Rust source. -/
def qm31R : CM31Exact := ⟨2, 1⟩

@[simp] theorem qm31R_re : qm31R.re = 2 := rfl
@[simp] theorem qm31R_im : qm31R.im = 1 := rfl

theorem cm31_norm_qm31R : QuadraticAlgebra.norm qm31R = (5 : M31Exact) := by
  norm_num [qm31R, QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]

/-- `2+i` is a nonsquare in CM31: the norm of a square is a square, while
`Norm(2+i)=5` is a nonsquare in M31. -/
theorem cm31_qm31R_not_isSquare : ¬ IsSquare qm31R := by
  rintro ⟨z, hz⟩
  apply m31_five_not_isSquare
  refine ⟨QuadraticAlgebra.norm z, ?_⟩
  calc
    (5 : M31Exact) = QuadraticAlgebra.norm qm31R := cm31_norm_qm31R.symm
    _ = QuadraticAlgebra.norm (z * z) := congrArg QuadraticAlgebra.norm hz
    _ = QuadraticAlgebra.norm z * QuadraticAlgebra.norm z :=
      QuadraticAlgebra.norm.map_mul z z

instance qm31Rootless : Fact
    (∀ z : CM31Exact, z ^ 2 ≠ qm31R + 0 * z) := ⟨by
  intro z hz
  apply cm31_qm31R_not_isSquare
  refine ⟨z, ?_⟩
  simpa [pow_two] using hz.symm
⟩

/-- Exact deployed quartic extension: `u^2 = 2+i`. -/
abbrev QM31Exact := QuadraticAlgebra CM31Exact qm31R 0

#print axioms cm31_qm31R_not_isSquare
end AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

/-! Actual selected-selector expansion contracts.  The model below is the
literal descending two-store recurrence from `SelectedSelectorExpansion`, but
the theorems in this file connect its individual stores to the generated
Aeneas loop.  No caller-supplied success/output equality is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedMul
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev ReverseRange := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.ReverseRange
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM

def decode (x : QM) : ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x

def canonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin n.val, Canonical (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt))

def decodedAt {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if h : i < n.val then decode (a.val[i]'(by simpa [a.property] using h)) else 0

def selectorFactor (x : ExactQM) (odd : Bool) : ExactQM :=
  if odd then x else 1 - x

/-- One source iteration reads the parent before either of its two writes. -/
def selectorWrite (x : ExactQM) (i : Nat) (w : Nat → ExactQM) : Nat → ExactQM :=
  let parent := w i
  let right := x * parent
  Function.update (Function.update w (2*i) (parent - right)) (2*i+1) right

def selectorDescending (x : ExactQM) : Nat → (Nat → ExactQM) → Nat → ExactQM
  | 0, w, j => w j
  | n+1, w, j => selectorDescending x n (selectorWrite x n w) j

theorem selectorWrite_below (x : ExactQM) (i j : Nat)
    (h : j < i) (w : Nat → ExactQM) : selectorWrite x i w j = w j := by
  have h0 : j ≠ 2*i := by omega
  have h1 : j ≠ 2*i+1 := by omega
  simp [selectorWrite, h0, h1]

private theorem array_index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem array_update_success {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ out : Array α n, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  exact ⟨out, hr, hs⟩

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : canonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : canonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hj : j.val < (a.set i x).val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hj0 : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj0
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hj0 := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

def decodedArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) : Nat → ExactQM := decodedAt a

private theorem decodedArray_set {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize)
    (x : QM) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    decodedArray (a.set i x) =
      Function.update (decodedArray a) i.val (decode x) := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j < n.val
  · by_cases heq : i.val = j
    · subst j
      have hjSet : i.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hi
      have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[i.val]'hjSet = x := by
        exact List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
          (by simpa using hi)
      simp only [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.set_val_eq, dif_pos hj]
      rw [hcell]
      simp [Function.update]
    · have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj
      have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j]'hjSet = a.val[j]'(by simpa [a.property] using hj) := by
        exact List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j) heq
          (by simpa [a.property] using hjSet)
      simp only [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.set_val_eq, dif_pos hj]
      rw [hcell]
      have hji : j ≠ i.val := by omega
      simp [decodedAt, hj, Function.update, hji]
  · have hji : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.set_val_eq, hj, Function.update, hji]

private theorem usize_mul2 (i : Usize) (hi : 2*i.val < 2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits) :
    ∃ twice : Usize, UScalar.mul 2#usize i = .ok twice ∧ twice.val = 2*i.val := by
  obtain ⟨twice, hmul, hval⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.tryMk_success (2*i.val) hi
  exact ⟨twice, by simpa [UScalar.mul] using hmul, hval⟩

private theorem usize_add1 (i : Usize) (hi : i.val+1 < 2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits) :
    ∃ next : Usize, UScalar.add i 1#usize = .ok next ∧ next.val = i.val+1 := by
  obtain ⟨next, hadd, hval⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.tryMk_success (i.val+1) hi
  exact ⟨next, by simpa [UScalar.add] using hadd, hval⟩

private theorem source_inner_step
    {N : Usize} (iter : ReverseRange) (weights : Array QM N) (prepared : Prepared)
    (x : QM) (n : Nat)
    (hstart : iter.iter.start.val = 0) (hend : iter.iter.end.val = n+1)
    (hn : 2*(n+1) ≤ N.val)
    (hweights : canonicalArray weights) (hx : Canonical x)
    (hprepared : PreparedFor prepared x) :
    ∃ iter1 : ReverseRange, ∃ out : Array QM N,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0 iter weights prepared =
        pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0 iter1 out prepared ∧
      iter1.iter.start.val = 0 ∧ iter1.iter.end.val = n ∧
      canonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin N.val,
        decodedArray out j.val =
          selectorWrite (decode x) n (decodedArray weights) j.val := by
  have hstep : iter.iter.start.val < iter.iter.end.val := by omega
  have hendpos : 1 ≤ iter.iter.end.val := by omega
  have hindexVal : (Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize).val = n := by
    rw [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.wrapping_sub_one_val _ hendpos]
    omega
  let index := Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize
  have hi : index.val < N.val := by rw [hindexVal]; omega
  let parent := weights.val[index.val]'(by simpa [weights.property] using hi)
  have hread : Array.index_usize weights index = .ok parent := by
    exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok weights index hi
  have hparent : Canonical parent := by
    have hp := hweights ⟨index.val, by simpa [weights.property] using hi⟩
    simpa [parent] using hp
  obtain ⟨right, hright, hrightCanon, hrightValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedMul.prepared_mul_exact prepared x parent
      hx hparent hprepared
  obtain ⟨left, hleft, hleftCanon, hleftValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact parent right hparent hrightCanon
  have hleftBound : 2*n < N.val := by omega
  have hrightBound : 2*n+1 < N.val := by omega
  let iter1 : ReverseRange :=
    ⟨{iter.iter with «end» := Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize}⟩
  have hNbound : N.val < 2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := N.hBounds
  have hleftValueSize : 2*n < 2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by omega
  have hrightValueSize : 2*n+1 < 2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by omega
  let leftIndex : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore (2*n) hleftValueSize
  have hleftIndexVal : leftIndex.val = 2*n := by simp [leftIndex]
  have hleftIndex' : UScalar.mul 2#usize index = .ok leftIndex := by
    obtain ⟨twice, hmul, hv⟩ := usize_mul2 index (by rw [hindexVal]; omega)
    have hval' : twice.val = leftIndex.val := by
      calc
        twice.val = 2 * index.val := hv
        _ = 2*n := by rw [hindexVal]
        _ = leftIndex.val := by simp [leftIndex]
    have heq : twice = leftIndex := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hval'
    exact hmul.trans (congrArg Result.ok heq)
  let rightIndex : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore (2*n+1) hrightValueSize
  have hrightIndexVal : rightIndex.val = 2*n+1 := by simp [rightIndex]
  have hrightIndex' : UScalar.add leftIndex 1#usize = .ok rightIndex := by
    obtain ⟨next, hadd, hv⟩ := usize_add1 leftIndex (by omega)
    have hval' : next.val = rightIndex.val := by
      calc
        next.val = leftIndex.val + 1 := hv
        _ = 2*n+1 := by rw [hleftIndexVal]
        _ = rightIndex.val := by simp [rightIndex]
    have heq : next = rightIndex := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hval'
    exact hadd.trans (congrArg Result.ok heq)
  obtain ⟨out1, hupdate1, hset1⟩ :=
    array_update_success weights leftIndex left (by simpa [hleftIndexVal] using hleftBound)
  obtain ⟨out, hupdate2, hset2⟩ :=
    array_update_success out1 rightIndex right (by simpa [hrightIndexVal] using hrightBound)
  have hcanonical1 : canonicalArray out1 := by
    rw [hset1]
    exact set_canonical weights leftIndex left hweights hleftCanon
  have hcanonical : canonicalArray out := by
    rw [hset2]
    exact set_canonical out1 rightIndex right hcanonical1 hrightCanon
  have hleftIndexSource :
      (2#usize * Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok leftIndex := by
    change UScalar.mul 2#usize (Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize) = .ok leftIndex
    exact hleftIndex'
  have hrightIndexSource :
      (leftIndex + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok rightIndex := by
    change UScalar.add leftIndex 1#usize = .ok rightIndex
    exact hrightIndex'
  have hrec :
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0 iter weights prepared =
        pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0 iter1 out prepared := by
    rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0.eq_def]
    dsimp only
    simp only [reverse_next_step iter hstep, bind_tc_ok, index, parent,
      hread, hright, hleft, hleftIndexSource, hupdate1, hrightIndexSource,
      hupdate2, iter1, bind_tc_ok]
  have hstart1 : iter1.iter.start.val = 0 := by simpa [iter1] using hstart
  have hend1 : iter1.iter.end.val = n := by
    dsimp [iter1]
    rw [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.wrapping_sub_one_val _ hendpos]
    omega
  refine ⟨iter1, out, hrec, hstart1, hend1, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  intro j
  have hfun1 : decodedArray out1 =
      Function.update (decodedArray weights) (2*n) (decode left) := by
    simpa [leftIndex, hleftIndexVal, hset1] using
      decodedArray_set weights leftIndex left (by simpa [hleftIndexVal] using hleftBound)
  have hfun2 : decodedArray out =
      Function.update (decodedArray out1) (2*n+1) (decode right) := by
    simpa [rightIndex, hrightIndexVal, hset2] using
      decodedArray_set out1 rightIndex right (by simpa [hrightIndexVal] using hrightBound)
  have hparentValue : decodedArray weights index.val = decode parent := by
    simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, hi, parent]
  have hparentN : decodedArray weights n = decode parent := by
    rw [← hindexVal]
    exact hparentValue
  have hleftValue' : decode left = decode parent - decode right := by
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode left =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode parent -
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode right at hleftValue
    exact hleftValue
  have hrightValue' : decode right = decode x * decode parent := by
    simpa [decode] using hrightValue
  rw [hfun2, hfun1]
  by_cases h0 : j.val = 2*n
  · have hnot : j.val ≠ 2*n+1 := by omega
    simp [Function.update, selectorWrite, h0, hnot,
      hleftValue', hrightValue', hparentN]
  · by_cases h1 : j.val = 2*n+1
    · simp [Function.update, selectorWrite, h1, h0,
        hleftValue', hrightValue', hparentN]
    · simp [Function.update, selectorWrite, h0, h1]

theorem selector_inner_loop_model
    {N : Usize} (iter : ReverseRange) (weights : Array QM N) (prepared : Prepared)
    (x : QM) (n : Nat)
    (hstart : iter.iter.start.val = 0) (hend : iter.iter.end.val = n)
    (hn : 2*n ≤ N.val)
    (hweights : canonicalArray weights) (hx : Canonical x)
    (hprepared : PreparedFor prepared x) :
    ∃ out : Array QM N,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0 iter weights prepared =
        .ok out ∧ canonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin N.val,
        decodedArray out j.val = selectorDescending (decode x) n
          (decodedArray weights) j.val := by
  induction n generalizing iter weights hstart hweights with
  | zero =>
      have hstop : iter.iter.end.val ≤ iter.iter.start.val := by omega
      refine ⟨weights, ?_, hweights, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0.eq_def]
        simp only [reverse_next_done iter hstop, bind_tc_ok]
      · intro j
        rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      obtain ⟨iter1, out1, hstep, hstart1, hend1, hcanonical1, hmodel1⟩ :=
        source_inner_step iter weights prepared x n hstart hend (by omega)
          hweights hx hprepared
      have hrec := ih iter1 out1 hstart1 hend1 (by omega) hcanonical1
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ := hrec
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanonical, ?_⟩
      · rw [hstep]
        exact hrun
      · intro j
        rw [hmodel]
        have hmodel1' : decodedArray out1 =
            selectorWrite (decode x) n (decodedArray weights) := by
          funext k
          by_cases hk : k < N.val
          · exact hmodel1 ⟨k, hk⟩
          · have hout : decodedArray out1 k = 0 := by
              simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, hk, out1.property]
            have hweights0 : decodedArray weights k = 0 := by
              simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, hk, weights.property]
            have hk0 : k ≠ 2*n := by omega
            have hk1 : k ≠ 2*n+1 := by omega
            rw [hout]
            simp [selectorWrite, Function.update, hk0, hk1, hweights0]
        rw [hmodel1']
        rfl

/-! Minimal actual-Aeneas reverse-range facts retained from
`AspisV8R19.R306BatchReverseStepExecution`.  They only characterize the
iterator arithmetic; they make no claim about the selected-mask loop body. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

abbrev ReverseRange := core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev (core.ops.range.Range Usize)

theorem wrapping_sub_one_val (n : Usize) (hn : 1 ≤ n.val) :
    (Usize.wrapping_sub n 1#usize).val = n.val - 1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have hb : n.val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
    simpa only [UScalar.size] using n.hBounds
  have h1 : (1#usize).val = 1 := by simp
  rw [h1]
  have he : n.val + (UScalar.size .Usize - 1) =
      (n.val - 1) + UScalar.size .Usize := by omega
  rw [he, Nat.add_mod, Nat.mod_self, Nat.add_zero, Nat.mod_mod]
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

theorem reverse_next_done (iter : ReverseRange)
    (hstop : iter.iter.end.val ≤ iter.iter.start.val) :
    core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next
      (core.ops.range.Range.Insts.DoubleEndedIterator core.iter.range.StepUsize) iter =
        .ok (none, iter) := by
  simp only [core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next,
    core.ops.range.Range.Insts.CoreIterTraitsDoubleEndedIterator.next_back,
    core.iter.range.StepUsize, core.iter.range.UScalarStep,
    core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize, core.cmp.impls.PartialOrdUsize.lt, bind_tc_ok]
  have h : ¬ iter.iter.start.val < iter.iter.end.val := by omega
  simp [h]

theorem reverse_next_step (iter : ReverseRange)
    (hstep : iter.iter.start.val < iter.iter.end.val) :
    core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next
      (core.ops.range.Range.Insts.DoubleEndedIterator core.iter.range.StepUsize) iter =
        .ok (some (Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize),
          ⟨{iter.iter with «end» := Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize}⟩) := by
  have he : 1 ≤ iter.iter.end.val := by omega
  simp only [core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next,
    core.ops.range.Range.Insts.CoreIterTraitsDoubleEndedIterator.next_back,
    core.iter.range.StepUsize, core.iter.range.UScalarStep,
    core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize, core.cmp.impls.PartialOrdUsize.lt, bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [hstep, decide_true, ↓reduceIte,
    core.iter.range.UScalarStep.backward_checked]
  simp only [show (1#usize).val = 1 from by simp, he, ↓reduceDIte, bind_tc_ok]
  have hp : @UScalar.ofNatCore .Usize (iter.iter.end.val - 1) (by scalar_tac) =
      Usize.wrapping_sub iter.iter.end 1#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, wrapping_sub_one_val _ he]
  rw [hp]

#print axioms wrapping_sub_one_val
#print axioms reverse_next_done
#print axioms reverse_next_step

/-! Concrete state established by the extracted prepared-multiplier constructor.
The stored arrays and sum coordinates are explicit. No caller invariant is
assumed beyond canonical input coordinates. -/

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState
open Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev M31 := field.M31
abbrev CM := field.CM31
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev Component := Aeneas.Std.Array M31 3#usize
abbrev P : Nat := ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P

def ComponentFor (a : Component) (x : CM) : Prop :=
  ∃ s : M31, a = Array.make 3#usize [x.a, x.b, s] ∧
    s.val = (x.a.val + x.b.val) % P ∧ s.val < P

def PreparedFor (p : Prepared) (x : QM) : Prop :=
  ∃ t : CM, ∃ a b c : Component,
    field.CM31.add x.c0 x.c1 = .ok t ∧ CanonicalCM t ∧
    ComponentFor a x.c0 ∧ ComponentFor b x.c1 ∧ ComponentFor c t ∧
    p.components = Array.make 3#usize [a, b, c]

theorem current_component_new (x : CM) (hx : CanonicalCM x) :
    ∃ a : Component,
      field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleCM31ArrayM313.call
        () x = .ok a ∧ ComponentFor a x := by
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hv, hc⟩ :=
    ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a x.b hx.1 hx.2
  refine ⟨Array.make 3#usize [x.a, x.b, s], ?_, s, rfl, hv, hc⟩
  simp only [field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleCM31ArrayM313.call,
    hs, bind_tc_ok]

theorem current_prepared_new (x : QM) (hx : CanonicalQM x) :
    ∃ p : Prepared, field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new x = .ok p ∧
      PreparedFor p x := by
  obtain ⟨a, ha, hpa⟩ := current_component_new x.c0 hx.1
  obtain ⟨b, hb, hpb⟩ := current_component_new x.c1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hct, _, _⟩ := current_cm_add_mod x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hpc⟩ := current_component_new t hct
  refine ⟨⟨Array.make 3#usize [a, b, c]⟩, ?_, t, a, b, c,
    ht, hct, hpa, hpb, hpc, rfl⟩
  simp only [field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new, ha, hb, ht, hc, bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms current_component_new
#print axioms current_prepared_new
end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState
