import ExtractedMaskPreparedComponent
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/-! Execution equality between the extracted prepared multiplier and ordinary
QM31 multiplication, followed by the existing exact-field interpretation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedMul
open Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open ExtractedMaskPreparedState ExtractedMaskTowerAdd ExtractedMaskArrayThree

private theorem cm_eq_of_words (x y : CM)
    (h : (x.a.val, x.b.val) = (y.a.val, y.b.val)) : x = y := by
  have ha := UScalar.val_eq_imp x.a y.a (congrArg Prod.fst h)
  have hb := UScalar.val_eq_imp x.b y.b (congrArg Prod.snd h)
  cases x with
  | mk xa xb =>
    cases y with
    | mk ya yb =>
      dsimp at ha hb
      cases ha
      cases hb
      rfl

theorem component_eq_mul (a : Component) (x y : CM)
    (hx : CanonicalCM x) (hy : CanonicalCM y) (hp : ComponentFor a x) :
    field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnPairArrayM313CM31CM31.call
      () (a, y) = field.CM31.mul x y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, _, hv⟩ :=
    ExtractedMaskPreparedComponent.current_component_mul_words a x y hx hy hp
  obtain ⟨w, hw, _, hwa, hwb⟩ := ExtractedMaskCM31Mul.current_mul_words x y hx hy
  have hwv : (w.a.val, w.b.val) = ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.mulWords
      (x.a.val, x.b.val) (y.a.val, y.b.val) := Prod.ext hwa hwb
  have hzw := cm_eq_of_words z w (hv.trans hwv.symm)
  rw [hz, hw, hzw]

theorem prepared_mul_eq (p : Prepared) (x y : QM)
    (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hy : CanonicalQM y) (hp : PreparedFor p x) :
    field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul p y = field.QM31.mul x y := by
  obtain ⟨t, a, b, c, ht, hct, ha, hb, hc, harr⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hcs, _, _⟩ := current_cm_add_mod y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  have hpa := component_eq_mul a x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1 ha
  have hpb := component_eq_mul b x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2 hb
  have hpc := component_eq_mul c t s hct hcs hc
  simp only [field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul, harr, index0, index1, index2,
    hpa, hpb, hs, hpc, bind_tc_ok, field.QM31.mul, ht]

theorem prepared_mul_exact (p : Prepared) (x y : QM)
    (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hy : CanonicalQM y) (hp : PreparedFor p x) :
    ∃ z : QM, field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul p y = .ok z ∧
      CanonicalQM z ∧ ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode z =
        ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x * ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode y := by
  rw [prepared_mul_eq p x y hx hy hp]
  exact ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact x y hx hy

theorem current_prepared_correct (x y : QM)
    (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hy : CanonicalQM y) :
    ∃ p : Prepared, ∃ z : QM,
      field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new x = .ok p ∧
      field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul p y = .ok z ∧
      CanonicalQM z ∧ ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode z =
        ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x * ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode y := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hprepared⟩ := current_prepared_new x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hc, hv⟩ := prepared_mul_exact p x y hx hy hprepared
  exact ⟨p, z, hp, hz, hc, hv⟩

#print axioms component_eq_mul
#print axioms prepared_mul_eq
#print axioms prepared_mul_exact
#print axioms current_prepared_correct
end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedMul

theorem current_component_mul_words
    (a : Component) (x y : CM)
    (hx : CanonicalCM x) (hy : CanonicalCM y) (hp : ComponentFor a x) :
    ∃ z : CM,
      field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnPairArrayM313CM31CM31.call
        () (a, y) = .ok z ∧ CanonicalCM z ∧
      (z.a.val, z.b.val) = ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.mulWords
        (x.a.val, x.b.val) (y.a.val, y.b.val) := by
  obtain ⟨s, rfl, hs, _⟩ := hp
  obtain ⟨t, ht, hvt, _⟩ :=
    ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod y.a y.b hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨m0, h0, hv0, hc0⟩ := ExtractedMaskReducer.current_mul_mod x.a y.a
  obtain ⟨m1, h1, hv1, hc1⟩ := ExtractedMaskReducer.current_mul_mod x.b y.b
  obtain ⟨m2, h2, hv2, hc2⟩ := ExtractedMaskReducer.current_mul_mod s t
  have hv2' : m2.val = ((x.a.val + x.b.val) * (y.a.val + y.b.val)) %
      ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P := by
    rw [hv2, hs, hvt]
    exact (Nat.mul_mod _ _ _).symm
  obtain ⟨low, hl, hvl, hcl⟩ :=
    ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m0 m1 hc0 hc1
  obtain ⟨high0, hh0, hvh0, hch0⟩ :=
    ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m2 m0 hc2 hc0
  obtain ⟨high, hh, hvh, hch⟩ :=
    ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod high0 m1 hch0 hc1
  refine ⟨⟨low, high⟩, ?_, ⟨hcl, hch⟩, ?_⟩
  · rw [ExtractedMaskPreparedClosure.call_eq]
    simp only [index0, index1, index2, h0, h1, ht, h2, hl, hh0, hh, bind_tc_ok]
  · apply Prod.ext
    · simpa only [ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.mulWords, hv0, hv1] using hvl
    · simpa only [ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.mulWords, hvh0, hv2', hv0, hv1] using hvh

#print axioms current_component_mul_words

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedClosure
open Aeneas.Std Result

theorem call_eq (left : Component) (right : CM) :
    field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.mul.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnPairArrayM313CM31CM31.call
      () (left, right) = (do
        let a ← Array.index_usize left 0#usize
        let m0 ← field.M31.mul a right.a
        let b ← Array.index_usize left 1#usize
        let m1 ← field.M31.mul b right.b
        let s ← Array.index_usize left 2#usize
        let t ← field.M31.add right.a right.b
        let m2 ← field.M31.mul s t
        let low ← field.M31.sub m0 m1
        let high0 ← field.M31.sub m2 m0
        let high ← field.M31.sub high0 m1
        ok ({ a := low, b := high } : CM)) := by rfl

#print axioms call_eq

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter
open Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev QM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM
abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM

def decode (x : QM) : ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x

def factor (a b : ExactQM) : ExactQM := 1 - a - b + a * b + a * b

theorem current_qm_sub_mod (x y : QM)
    (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.sub x y = .ok z ∧
      Canonical z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.wordsQM z =
        (((x.c0.a.val + AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P - y.c0.a.val) %
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P,
          (x.c0.b.val + AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P - y.c0.b.val) %
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P),
         ((x.c1.a.val + AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P - y.c1.a.val) %
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P,
          (x.c1.b.val + AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P - y.c1.b.val) %
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P)) := by
  obtain ⟨a, ea, ca, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_sub_mod x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b, eb, cb, vc, vd⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_sub_mod x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  refine ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ?_, ⟨ca, cb⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.sub, ea, eb, bind_tc_ok]
  · exact Prod.ext (Prod.ext va vb) (Prod.ext vc vd)

theorem current_qm_sub_exact (x y : QM)
    (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.sub x y = .ok z ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z = decode x - decode y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hcanon, hwords⟩ := current_qm_sub_mod x y hx hy
  refine ⟨z, hz, hcanon, ?_⟩
  change AspisV8R17.QM31WordTower.decodeQ
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM z) =
    AspisV8R17.QM31WordTower.decodeQ
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM x) -
      AspisV8R17.QM31WordTower.decodeQ
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM y)
  have hword :
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM z =
        AspisV8R17.GeneratedQM31Linear.qmSubWords
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM x)
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Mul.wordsQM y) := by
    exact hwords
  rw [hword]
  exact AspisV8R17.QM31WordTower.decode_sub _ _ (by exact hy)

/-- The extracted closure's algebraic factor, with each current operation
kept explicit in the success result and canonicality chain. -/
theorem equality_factor_call (a b : QM)
    (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) :
    ∃ z,
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnPairQM31QM31QM31.call
        () (a, b) = .ok z ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z = factor (decode a) (decode b) := by
  obtain ⟨ab, hab, habcan, habval⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact a b ha hb
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqcan, hqval⟩ :=
    current_qm_sub_exact AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.ONE a
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.one_canonical) ha
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hq1can, hq1val⟩ := current_qm_sub_exact q b hqcan hb
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hq2can, hq2val⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q1 ab hq1can habcan
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, hq3can, hq3val⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q2 ab hq2can habcan
  have hqval' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.ONE -
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode a := by
    exact hqval
  have hq1val' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q1 =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q -
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode b := by
    exact hq1val
  refine ⟨q3, ?_, hq3can, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnPairQM31QM31QM31.call,
      hab, hq, hq1, hq2, hq3, bind_tc_ok]
  · change decode q3 = factor (decode a) (decode b)
    dsimp [factor]
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q3 =
      1 - AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode a -
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode b +
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode a *
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode b +
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode a *
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode b
    rw [hq3val, hq2val, hq1val', hqval', habval,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.one_decode]

#print axioms current_qm_sub_mod
#print axioms current_qm_sub_exact
#print axioms equality_factor_call

end AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter

/-! Actual Aeneas one-step facts for the selected-mask reverse Horner loop.
This stops before an end-to-end loop induction or a pure-mask correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedMul
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev Coefficients := Aeneas.Std.Array QM 27#usize
abbrev ReverseRange := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.ReverseRange

def coefficientAt (coefficients : Coefficients) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < (27#usize : Usize).val) : QM :=
  coefficients.val[i.val]'(by simpa [coefficients.property] using hi)

def decode (x : QM) : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x

/-- Checked array access at any proof-carrying in-range Usize index. This is
copied in shape from `R616MixedLimbExecution.selected_index_ok`, specialized
only by retaining the actual Aeneas array API. -/
theorem array_index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Aeneas.Std.Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize a i =
      .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Aeneas.Std.Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)

  obtain ⟨i40, h40, v40⟩ := add_success i38 c (by rw [v38]; exact h40b)
  have hfinal : a.val + b.val + c.val + d.val < 2^64 := by
    have hbnd : a.val + b.val + c.val + d.val < 4*P := by omega
    norm_num [P] at hbnd ⊢ <;> omega
  obtain ⟨z, hz, vz⟩ := add_success i40 d (by rw [v40, v38]; exact hfinal)
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [sourceC1b, h38, h40, hz, bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [vz, v40, v38]

theorem sourceC0a_reduces (p a b c d e f : U64)
    (hp : p.val = P)
    (ha : a.val < P) (hb : b.val < P) (hc : c.val < P)
    (hd : d.val < P) (he : e.val < P) (hf : f.val < P) :
    ∃ raw : U64,
      sourceC0a p a b c d e f = .ok raw ∧
      ∃ out : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31,
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.reduce_u64 raw = .ok out ∧
        out.val = (a.val + (P-b.val) + 2*c.val + (P-d.val) +
          (P-e.val) + (2*P-2*f.val)) % P ∧ out.val < P := by
  obtain ⟨raw, hraw, hval⟩ := sourceC0a_success p a b c d e f hp ha hb hc hd he hf
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hmod, hcanonical⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_wrapper_mod raw
  refine ⟨raw, hraw, out, hout, ?_, hcanonical⟩
  calc
    out.val = raw.val % P := by simpa [P, AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P] using hmod
    _ = (a.val + (P-b.val) + 2*c.val + (P-d.val) +
        (P-e.val) + (2*P-2*f.val)) % P := by rw [hval]

/-- The actual Rust conversion closure used for every source limb is the U64
widening of the stored M31 word. -/
theorem limb_call_exact (x : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31) :

/-- Canonical QM31 inputs make each widened limb a valid source c0.a input;
the theorem retains the four-input parameterization to match the generated
function's reads without choosing a concrete Slice representation. -/
theorem sourceC0a_qm_limbs (v : Fin 4 → AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM)
    (hv : ∀ j, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (v j)) :
    ∃ raw : U64,
      sourceC0a sourceP64
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c0.a)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c0.b)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.a)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.b)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.a)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.b) = .ok raw ∧
      raw.val = (v 0).c0.a.val + (P-(v 1).c0.b.val) +
        2*(v 2).c1.a.val + (P-(v 2).c1.b.val) +
        (P-(v 3).c1.a.val) + (2*P-2*(v 3).c1.b.val) := by
  have hlimb (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 4) :
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.limb (v i) j < P :=
    limb_lt_P (v i) (hv i) j
  have h00 := hlimb 0 0
  have h11 := hlimb 1 1
  have h22 := hlimb 2 2
  have h23 := hlimb 2 3
  have h32 := hlimb 3 2
  have h33 := hlimb 3 3
  have hcast (x : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31) :
      (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.cast_widen_value x
  have h00' : (v 0).c0.a.val < P := by simpa [limb] using h00
  have h11' : (v 1).c0.b.val < P := by simpa [limb] using h11
  have h22' : (v 2).c1.a.val < P := by simpa [limb] using h22
  have h23' : (v 2).c1.b.val < P := by simpa [limb] using h23
  have h32' : (v 3).c1.a.val < P := by simpa [limb] using h32
  have h33' : (v 3).c1.b.val < P := by simpa [limb] using h33
  obtain ⟨raw, hraw, hval⟩ := sourceC0a_success sourceP64
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c0.a)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c0.b)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.a)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.b)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.a)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.b)
    sourceP64_val (by simpa [hcast] using h00') (by simpa [hcast] using h11')
    (by simpa [hcast] using h22') (by simpa [hcast] using h23')
    (by simpa [hcast] using h32') (by simpa [hcast] using h33')
  refine ⟨raw, hraw, ?_⟩
  simpa only [hcast] using hval

/-- The four source-order checked accumulator fragments succeed on four
canonical QM31 words. Their raw values are exactly the four Nat formulas
whose simultaneous field interpretation was proved above. -/
theorem source_accumulators_qm_limbs
    (v : Fin 4 → AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM)
    (hv : ∀ j, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (v j)) :
    ∃ r00 r01 r10 r11 : U64,
      sourceC0a sourceP64
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c0.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c0.b)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.b)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.b) = .ok r00 ∧
      r00.val = acc00 v ∧
      sourceC0b sourceP64
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c0.b) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c0.a)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.b)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.b) = .ok r01 ∧
      r01.val = acc01 v ∧
      sourceC1a sourceP64
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c1.b)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c0.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c0.b) = .ok r10 ∧
      r10.val = acc10 v ∧
      sourceC1b
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c1.b) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c1.a)
        (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c0.b) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c0.a) = .ok r11 ∧
      r11.val = acc11 v := by
  obtain ⟨r00, h00, v00⟩ := sourceC0a_qm_limbs v hv
  have hlimb (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 4) :
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.limb (v i) j < P :=
    limb_lt_P (v i) (hv i) j
  have hcast (x : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31) :
      (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.cast_widen_value x
  have h0 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c0.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 0 1
  have h1 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c0.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 1 0
  have h2 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 2 2
  have h3 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 2 3
  have h4 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 3 2
  have h5 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 3 3
  obtain ⟨r01, h01, v01⟩ := sourceC0b_success sourceP64
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c0.b) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c0.a)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c1.b)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c1.b)
    sourceP64_val h0 h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  have h6 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c1.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 0 2
  have h7 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c1.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 1 3
  have h8 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c0.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 2 0
  have h9 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c0.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 3 1
  obtain ⟨r10, h10, v10⟩ := sourceC1a_success sourceP64
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c1.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c1.b)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c0.a) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c0.b)
    sourceP64_val h6 h7 h8 h9
  have h11 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c1.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 0 3
  have h12 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c1.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 1 2
  have h13 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c0.b).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 2 1
  have h14 : (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c0.a).val < P := by
    rw [hcast]; exact hlimb 3 0
  obtain ⟨r11, h11s, v11⟩ := sourceC1b_success
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 0).c1.b) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 1).c1.a)
    (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 2).c0.b) (UScalar.cast .U64 (v 3).c0.a)
    h11 h12 h13 h14
  refine ⟨r00, r01, r10, r11, h00, ?_, h01, ?_, h10, ?_, h11s, ?_⟩
  · simpa [acc00, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.limb, hcast] using v00
  · simpa [acc01, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.limb, hcast] using v01
  · simpa [acc10, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.limb, hcast] using v10
  · simpa [acc11, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.limb, hcast] using v11

theorem source_accumulators_reduce
    (v : Fin 4 → AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM)
    (hv : ∀ j, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (v j)) :
    ∃ raw00 raw01 raw10 raw11 : U64,

        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31.reduce_u64 raw11 = .ok out11 ∧

  obtain ⟨raw00, raw01, raw10, raw11, h00, v00, h01, v01,

    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_wrapper_mod raw10

    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_wrapper_mod raw11

    ⟨⟨out01, r01, ?_, c01⟩,
      ⟨⟨out10, r10, ?_, c10⟩, ⟨out11, r11, ?_, c11⟩⟩⟩⟩
  · simpa [v00, P, AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P] using m00
  · simpa [v01, P, AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P] using m01
  · simpa [v10, P, AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P] using m10

/-- The four source-order checked accumulators and reducer calls assemble to a
canonical value with the exact tower basis result. This theorem composes the

theorem checked_source_coordinates_pack
    (v : Fin 4 → AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM)
    (hv : ∀ j, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM (v j)) :

      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = mathematicalPack v := by
  obtain ⟨raw00, raw01, raw10, raw11,
      ⟨out00, hr00, hv00, hc00⟩,
      ⟨out01, hr01, hv01, hc01⟩,
      ⟨out10, hr10, hv10, hc10⟩,
      ⟨out11, hr11, hv11, hc11⟩⟩ := source_accumulators_reduce v hv
  let out : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM :=
    ⟨⟨out00, out01⟩, ⟨out10, out11⟩⟩
  have hout : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM out :=
    ⟨⟨hc00, hc01⟩, ⟨hc10, hc11⟩⟩
  have hdecode : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = accumulatorPack v := by
    simpa [out] using reducedOutput_decode_eq_accumulatorPack v
      out00 out01 out10 out11 hv00 hv01 hv10 hv11
  refine ⟨out, hout, ?_⟩
  rw [hdecode, mathematicalPack_eq_accumulatorPack v hv]

ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic:
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import ExtractedMaskTowerAdd
import ExtractedMaskReducer
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

/-! Pure arithmetic contracts for the current generated `qm31_pack_base4`.
These definitions do not model the source array or function execution. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic

open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd

abbrev CurrentQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentQM
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev E := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev M := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact
abbrev P : Nat := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P

/-- The four source limbs of one stored QM31, in `(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` order. -/
def limb (x : CurrentQM) (j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  match j.val with
  | 0 => x.c0.a.val
  | 1 => x.c0.b.val
  | 2 => x.c1.a.val
  | _ => x.c1.b.val

theorem limb_lt_P (x : CurrentQM) (hx : Canonical x) (j : Fin 4) :
    limb x j < P := by
  have hx' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM x := hx
  rcases hx' with ⟨⟨h0, h1⟩, ⟨h2, h3⟩⟩
  fin_cases j <;> simp [limb] <;> assumption

/-- Actual coefficient matrix of `1,i,u,iu` in source `(a,b)` coordinates. -/
def acc00 (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM) : Nat :=
  limb (v 0) 0 + (P - limb (v 1) 1) + 2 * limb (v 2) 2 +
    (P - limb (v 2) 3) + (P - limb (v 3) 2) +
      (2 * P - 2 * limb (v 3) 3)

def acc01 (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM) : Nat :=
  limb (v 0) 1 + limb (v 1) 0 + limb (v 2) 2 +
    2 * limb (v 2) 3 + 2 * limb (v 3) 2 + (P - limb (v 3) 3)

def acc10 (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM) : Nat :=
  limb (v 0) 2 + (P - limb (v 1) 3) + limb (v 2) 0 +
    (P - limb (v 3) 1)

def acc11 (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM) : Nat :=
  limb (v 0) 3 + limb (v 1) 2 + limb (v 2) 1 + limb (v 3) 0

theorem accumulators_lt_8P (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM)
    (h : ∀ j, Canonical (v j)) :
    acc00 v < 8 * P ∧ acc01 v < 8 * P ∧
    acc10 v < 8 * P ∧ acc11 v < 8 * P := by
  have hb (i j : Fin 4) : limb (v i) j < P := limb_lt_P (v i) (h i) j
  have hp : 0 < P := by norm_num [P, AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P]
  have h00 := hb 0 0; have h01 := hb 0 1; have h02 := hb 0 2; have h03 := hb 0 3
  have h10 := hb 1 0; have h11 := hb 1 1; have h12 := hb 1 2; have h13 := hb 1 3
  have h20 := hb 2 0; have h21 := hb 2 1; have h22 := hb 2 2; have h23 := hb 2 3
  have h30 := hb 3 0; have h31 := hb 3 1; have h32 := hb 3 2; have h33 := hb 3 3
  unfold acc00 acc01 acc10 acc11
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · omega
  constructor
  · omega
  · omega

/-- Exact tower basis elements, with `i` inside CM31 and `u` as the outer
quadratic generator. -/
def iBasis : E := ⟨⟨0, 1⟩, 0⟩
def uBasis : E := ⟨0, 1⟩
def mathematicalPack (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM) : E :=
  decode (v 0) + iBasis * decode (v 1) +
    uBasis * decode (v 2) + (iBasis * uBasis) * decode (v 3)

def accumulatorPack (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM) : E :=
  ⟨⟨(acc00 v : M), (acc01 v : M)⟩,
   ⟨(acc10 v : M), (acc11 v : M)⟩⟩

theorem mathematicalPack_eq_accumulatorPack (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM)
    (h : ∀ j, Canonical (v j)) :
    mathematicalPack v = accumulatorPack v := by
  have hp : (P : M) = 0 := ZMod.natCast_self P
  have hlt (i j : Fin 4) : limb (v i) j < P := limb_lt_P (v i) (h i) j
  have cast_subP (n : Nat) (hn : n < P) : ((P - n : Nat) : M) = -(n : M) := by
    rw [Nat.cast_sub (Nat.le_of_lt hn), hp]
    simp
  have cast_sub2P (n : Nat) (hn : n < P) :
      ((2 * P - 2 * n : Nat) : M) = - (2 : M) * (n : M) := by
    have hle : 2 * n ≤ 2 * P := Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 (Nat.le_of_lt hn)
    rw [Nat.cast_sub hle, Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_mul, hp]
    ring
  have hs11 : ((P - (v 1).c0.b.val : Nat) : M) = -((v 1).c0.b.val : M) :=
    cast_subP _ (hlt 1 1)
  have hs23 : ((P - (v 2).c1.b.val : Nat) : M) = -((v 2).c1.b.val : M) :=
    cast_subP _ (hlt 2 3)
  have hs32 : ((P - (v 3).c1.a.val : Nat) : M) = -((v 3).c1.a.val : M) :=
    cast_subP _ (hlt 3 2)
  have hs33 : ((P - (v 3).c1.b.val : Nat) : M) = -((v 3).c1.b.val : M) :=
    cast_subP _ (hlt 3 3)
  have hs13 : ((P - (v 1).c1.b.val : Nat) : M) = -((v 1).c1.b.val : M) :=
    cast_subP _ (hlt 1 3)
  have hs30 : ((P - (v 3).c0.b.val : Nat) : M) = -((v 3).c0.b.val : M) :=
    cast_subP _ (hlt 3 1)
  have hs2_33 : ((2 * P - 2 * (v 3).c1.b.val : Nat) : M) =
      -(2 : M) * ((v 3).c1.b.val : M) :=
    cast_sub2P (v 3).c1.b.val (hlt 3 3)
  ext <;> simp [mathematicalPack, accumulatorPack, iBasis, uBasis,
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode, decode, acc00, acc01, acc10, acc11,
    limb, hp, hs11, hs23, hs32, hs33, hs13, hs30, hs2_33]
  all_goals ring

/-- The four source reducers' canonical representatives reconstruct the
literal exact-tower coordinate pack. This is the final-coordinate algebra
adapter; successful evaluation of the generated caller is a separate theorem. -/
theorem reducedOutput_decode_eq_accumulatorPack
    (v : Fin 4 → CurrentQM)
    (o00 o01 o10 o11 : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31)
    (h00 : o00.val = acc00 v % P)
    (h01 : o01.val = acc01 v % P)
    (h10 : o10.val = acc10 v % P)
    (h11 : o11.val = acc11 v % P) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
        (⟨⟨o00, o01⟩, ⟨o10, o11⟩⟩ : CurrentQM) = accumulatorPack v := by

import PreweightedLoopModel

/-! Closed form for the symbolic packed-group state transformer. This avoids
normalizing any concrete traversal when connecting the source loop to the
semantic lane map. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PreweightedApplyGroups
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel

theorem applyGroups_cell {N : Usize} (values : Array QM N) (start n first : Nat)
    (a : State) (j : Fin 24) :
    applyGroups values start n first a j = a j +
      (if first ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < first + n then groupValue values start j.val else 0) := by
  induction n generalizing first a with
  | zero =>
      have hempty : ¬ (first ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < first + 0) := by omega
      simp [applyGroups, hempty]
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [applyGroups, ih]
      by_cases heq : j.val = first
      · have hfuture : ¬ (first + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < first + 1 + n) := by omega
        have hcurrent : first ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < first + (n + 1) := by omega
        rw [if_neg hfuture]
        simp only [step, if_pos heq]
        rw [if_pos hcurrent]
        simp only [add_zero, heq]
      · have hsame : (first + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < first + 1 + n) ↔
            (first ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < first + (n + 1)) := by omega
        simp only [step, if_neg heq, hsame]

/-- Outside the groups touched by a nonempty source interval, all four
source-selected lanes are zero, so their packed contribution is zero. -/
theorem groupValue_outside {N : Usize} (values : Array QM N)
    (start group : Nat) (hn : 0 < N.val)
    (hout : group < start / 4 ∨ (start + N.val - 1) / 4 < group) :
    groupValue values start group = 0 := by
  have hcell (j : Fin 4) : selectedCell values start group j.val =
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.ZERO := by
    unfold selectedCell
    rw [if_neg (by rcases hout with h | h <;> omega)]
  have hfun : (fun j : Fin 4 => selectedCell values start group j.val) =
      (fun _ : Fin 4 => AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31.ZERO) := by
    funext j
    exact hcell j
  unfold groupValue
  rw [hfun]
  simp only [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.mathematicalPack,
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_decode, mul_zero, add_zero]

#print axioms groupValue_outside
#print axioms applyGroups_cell
end AspisR1.PreweightedApplyGroups

import PreweightedLoopCanonical

/-! Exact mathematical state transformer for the actual packed-group traversal.
No concrete traversal is normalized; the proof follows the symbolic group
count and consumes the checked source read/pack/add/write theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev State := Fin 24 → ExactQM

def decoded (packed : Array QM 24#usize) : State := fun j =>
  decode (packed.val[j.val]'(by simpa [packed.property] using j.isLt))

def groupValue {N : Usize} (values : Array QM N) (start group : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.mathematicalPack
    (fun j : Fin 4 => selectedCell values start group j.val)

def step {N : Usize} (values : Array QM N) (start group : Nat) (a : State) : State :=
  fun j => if j.val = group then a j + groupValue values start group else a j

def applyGroups {N : Usize} (values : Array QM N) (start : Nat) : Nat → Nat → State → State
  | 0, _, a => a
  | n + 1, group, a => applyGroups values start n (group + 1) (step values start group a)

theorem runGroup_model {N : Usize}
    (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (group start : Usize) (values : Array QM N)
    (hgroup : group.val < 24) (hinterval : start.val + N.val ≤ 96)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hvalues : CanonicalArray values) :
    ∃ updated : Array QM 24#usize,
      runGroup packed group start values = .ok updated ∧
      CanonicalArray updated ∧
      decoded updated = step values start.val group.val (decoded packed) := by
  obtain ⟨updated, hrun, hcanon, hvalue, hframe⟩ :=
    runGroup_success packed group start values hgroup hinterval hpacked hvalues
  refine ⟨updated, hrun, hcanon, ?_⟩
  funext j
  unfold decoded step
  by_cases hj : j.val = group.val
  · rw [if_pos hj]
    simpa [hj, groupValue] using hvalue
  · rw [if_neg hj, hframe j hj]

def remaining (r : core.ops.range.RangeInclusive Usize) : Nat :=
  if r.exhausted = true ∨ r.«end».val < r.start.val then 0
  else r.«end».val - r.start.val + 1

/-- The actual generated outer loop computes the symbolic packed-array state
transformer on every canonical input, including the exhausted/empty cases. -/
theorem loop_model {N : Usize}
    (r : core.ops.range.RangeInclusive Usize) (packed : Array QM 24#usize)
    (start : Usize) (values : Array QM N)
    (hend : r.«end».val < 24) (hinterval : start.val + N.val ≤ 96)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hvalues : CanonicalArray values) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      AspisR1PreweightedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_preweighted_loop
        r packed start values = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      decoded out = applyGroups values start.val (remaining r) r.start.val (decoded packed) := by
  generalize hcount : remaining r = count
  induction count using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing r packed with
  | h count ih =>
      obtain ⟨pair, hnext, hpost⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (core.ops.range.RangeInclusive.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next_Usize_spec r)
      rcases pair with ⟨o, r'⟩
      by_cases hempty : r.exhausted = true ∨ r.«end».val < r.start.val
      · simp only [if_pos hempty] at hpost
        rcases hpost with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
        have hz : count = 0 := by simpa [remaining, hempty] using hcount.symm
        refine ⟨packed, ?_, hpacked, ?_⟩
        · rw [generated_loop_step]
          simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok]
        · simp [hz, applyGroups]
      · have hstart : r.start.val ≤ r.«end».val := by omega
        have hgroup : r.start.val < 24 := by omega
        obtain ⟨updated, hupdate, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ :=
          runGroup_model packed r.start start values hgroup hinterval hpacked hvalues
        by_cases hlt : r.start.val < r.«end».val
        · simp only [if_neg hempty, if_pos hlt] at hpost
          rcases hpost with ⟨rfl, hstep, hend', hexhausted⟩
          have hremaining : remaining r' + 1 = count := by
            rw [← hcount]
            unfold remaining
            simp only [if_neg hempty, hexhausted, Bool.false_eq_true, false_or, hend']
            rw [if_neg (by omega)]
            omega
          have hdecrease : remaining r' < count := by omega
          obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanon, hdecode⟩ := ih (remaining r') hdecrease r' updated
            (by simpa [hend'] using hend) hcanonical rfl
          refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanon, ?_⟩
          · rw [generated_loop_step]
            simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, hupdate, bind_tc_ok, hrun]
          · rw [hdecode, ← hremaining, applyGroups, hmodel, hstep]
        · simp only [if_neg hempty, if_neg hlt] at hpost
          rcases hpost with ⟨rfl, hsame, hend', hexhausted⟩
          have hremaining : remaining r' = 0 := by simp [remaining, hexhausted]
          have hcountOne : count = 1 := by
            rw [← hcount]
            unfold remaining
            rw [if_neg hempty]
            omega
          obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanon, hdecode⟩ := ih 0 (by omega) r' updated
            (by simpa [hend'] using hend) hcanonical hremaining
          refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanon, ?_⟩
          · rw [generated_loop_step]
            simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, hupdate, bind_tc_ok, hrun]
          · simpa [applyGroups, hcountOne] using hdecode.trans hmodel

#print axioms runGroup_model
#print axioms loop_model
end AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel

private theorem map_iQM :
    qm31ToWide AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.iQM =
      AspisR1.ConcretePackBasis.iE := by
  rfl

private theorem map_uQM :
    qm31ToWide AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.uQM =
      AspisR1.ConcretePackBasis.uE := by
  rfl

private theorem packBasis_i : packBasis.i = AspisR1.ConcretePackBasis.iE := by
  rfl

private theorem packBasis_u : packBasis.u = AspisR1.ConcretePackBasis.uE := by
  rfl

/-- The four literal exact-tower basis elements agree with the existing
`ConcretePackBasis` elements after the `QM31Exact → WideExact` algebra map. -/

    qm31ToWide (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement j.val) =
      R0P.Mask.towerBasis packBasis j := by
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · change qm31ToWide 1 = 1
    simp [qm31ToWide]
  · change qm31ToWide AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.iQM = packBasis.i
    rw [map_iQM, packBasis_i]
  · change qm31ToWide AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.uQM = packBasis.u
    rw [map_uQM, packBasis_u]
  · change qm31ToWide
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.iQM *
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.uQM) =
      packBasis.i * packBasis.u
    rw [map_mul, map_iQM, map_uQM, packBasis_i, packBasis_u]

packing basis. -/

    (c1 : C1) (maskOnly : MaskOnly) (g : QM)
    (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hc1 : ∀ j : Fin 16, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell c1 j))
    (hmask : ∀ j : Fin 10, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell maskOnly j))
    (hpoint : ∀ i : Nat, ∀ hi : i < 10, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskLinearLoop.pointAtNat point i hi))

    packBasis qm31ToWide basisCompatible c1 maskOnly g point hc1 hmask hpoint hg

          (ih (fun j hj => hG j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

#print axioms vdeg_sum

theorem vdeg_prod {ι : Type} (s : Finset ι) {n : Nat} (d : ι → Fin n → Nat)
    (G : ι → (Fin n → K) → K) (hG : ∀ i ∈ s, VDeg n (d i) (G i)) :
    VDeg n (fun c => ∑ i ∈ s, d i c) (fun v => ∏ i ∈ s, G i v) := by
  classical
  induction s using Finset.induction_on with
  | empty => simpa only [Finset.prod_empty, Finset.sum_empty] using vdeg_const n (fun _ => 0) (1 : K)
  | @insert i s his ih =>
      simpa only [Finset.prod_insert his, Finset.sum_insert his] using
        vdeg_mul (hG i (Finset.mem_insert_self i s))
          (ih (fun j hj => hG j (Finset.mem_insert_of_mem hj)))

#print axioms vdeg_prod

theorem vdeg_mlDeg {n : Nat} {d : Fin n → Nat} {G : (Fin n → K) → K}
    (hG : VDeg n d G) {e : Nat} (he : ∀ i, d i ≤ e) : MLDeg e n G := by
  induction n with
  | zero => trivial
  | succ n ih =>
      refine ⟨fun x => ih (hG.1 x) (fun i => he i.succ), ?_⟩
      intro v
      obtain ⟨p, hp, hpe⟩ := hG.2 v
      exact ⟨p, hp.trans (he 0), hpe⟩

#print axioms vdeg_mlDeg

/-- A univariate coordinate function has no degree in any other coordinate. -/
theorem vdeg_coord {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) (f : K → K) {k : Nat}
    (hf : ∃ p : K[X], p.natDegree ≤ k ∧ ∀ x, p.eval x = f x) :
    VDeg n (Pi.single i k) (fun v => f (v i)) := by
  classical
  induction n with
  | zero => exact i.elim0
  | succ n ih =>
      cases i using Fin.cases with
      | zero =>
          refine ⟨fun x => ?_, ?_⟩
          · exact vdeg_const n _ (f x)
          · intro v
            obtain ⟨p, hp, he⟩ := hf
            exact ⟨p, by simpa using hp, fun x => by simpa using he x⟩
      | succ i =>
          refine ⟨fun x => ?_, fun v => ⟨C (f (v i)), ?_, fun _ => eval_C⟩⟩
          · have hd : Fin.tail (Pi.single i.succ k : Fin (n+1) → Nat) = (Pi.single i k : Fin n → Nat) := by
              funext j
              simp only [Fin.tail, Pi.single_apply, Fin.succ_inj]
            rw [hd]
            exact ih i
          · simp only [natDegree_C, Nat.zero_le]

#print axioms vdeg_coord

/-- A product of affine coordinate factors has degree one exactly on its support. -/
theorem vdeg_prod_coord {n : Nat} (s : Finset (Fin n)) (f : Fin n → K → K)
    (hf : ∀ i ∈ s, ∃ p : K[X], p.natDegree ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ x, p.eval x = f i x) :
    VDeg n (fun i => if i ∈ s then 1 else 0) (fun v => ∏ i ∈ s, f i (v i)) := by
  classical
  have h := vdeg_prod s (fun i => Pi.single i 1) (fun i v => f i (v i))
    (fun i hi => vdeg_coord i (f i) (hf i hi))
  simpa only [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq] using h

#print axioms vdeg_prod_coord

/-- Fixed residual lists preserve a common degree bound under summation. -/
theorem vdeg_list_foldl_add {n : Nat} {d : Fin n → Nat}
    (fs : List ((Fin n → K) → K)) (a : (Fin n → K) → K)
    (ha : VDeg n d a) (hf : ∀ f ∈ fs, VDeg n d f) :
    VDeg n d (fun v => (fs.map (fun f => f v)).foldl (· + ·) (a v)) := by
  induction fs generalizing a with
  | nil => simpa only [List.map_nil, List.foldl_nil] using ha
  | cons f fs ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, List.foldl_cons]
      apply ih (fun v => a v + f v)
      · simpa only [max_self] using vdeg_add ha (hf f (List.mem_cons_self ..))
      · intro g hg; exact hf g (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg)

#print axioms vdeg_list_foldl_add

theorem vdeg_list_getD {n : Nat} {d : Fin n → Nat}
    (fs : List ((Fin n → K) → K)) (hf : ∀ f ∈ fs, VDeg n d f) (i : Nat) :
    VDeg n d (fun v => (fs.map (fun f => f v)).getD i 0) := by
  induction fs generalizing i with
  | nil => simpa using vdeg_const n d (0 : K)
  | cons f fs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simpa using hf f (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      | succ i => simpa using ih (fun g hg => hf g (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hg)) i

#print axioms vdeg_list_getD
/-- One affine equality-weight factor. -/
def bitFactor (b : Bool) (x : K) : K := if b then x else 1-x

private theorem bitFactor_affine (b : Bool) :
    ∃ p : K[X], p.natDegree ≤ 1 ∧ ∀ x, p.eval x = bitFactor b x := by
  cases b
  · refine ⟨C 1-X, (natDegree_sub_le (C (1 : K)) X).trans (by simp), ?_⟩
    intro x; simp only [eval_sub, eval_C, eval_X, bitFactor, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  · exact ⟨X, by simp, fun _ => eval_X⟩

#print axioms bitFactor_affine

theorem vdeg_bitFactor {n : Nat} {d : Fin n → Nat} {G : (Fin n → K) → K}
    (b : Bool) (hG : VDeg n d G) : VDeg n d (fun v => bitFactor b (G v)) := by
  cases b
  · simpa only [bitFactor, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, Nat.zero_max] using
      vdeg_sub (vdeg_const n (fun _ => 0) (1 : K)) hG
  · exact hG

#print axioms vdeg_bitFactor

/-- Equality weights with the source's MSB-first coordinate ordering. -/
def bitWeight (n : Nat) (v : Fin n → K) (r : Nat) : K :=
  ∏ c : Fin n, bitFactor (r.testBit (n-1-c.val)) (v c)

theorem vdeg_bitWeight (n r : Nat) : VDeg n (fun _ => 1) (fun v : Fin n → K => bitWeight n v r) := by
  simpa only [bitWeight, Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using
    vdeg_prod_coord Finset.univ (fun c => bitFactor (r.testBit (n-1-c.val)))
      (fun c _ => bitFactor_affine _)

#print axioms vdeg_bitWeight

private theorem eqFactor_testBit (m k : Nat) (x : K) :
    (if m/2^k%2 = 0 then 1-x else x) = bitFactor (m.testBit k) x := by
  rcases Nat.mod_two_eq_zero_or_one (m/2^k) with h | h <;>
    simp [Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq, bitFactor, h]

#print axioms eqFactor_testBit

/-- Reversing the ten coordinate indices matches the literal R0 weights. -/
theorem selAt_eq_bitWeight (v : Fin 10 → K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    selAt v r = bitWeight 10 v r.val := by
  simp only [selAt, AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight, toR0, eqFactor_testBit, bitWeight]
  apply Fintype.prod_equiv (Fin.revPerm : Equiv.Perm (Fin 10))
  intro k
  have hr : (Fin.revPerm k : Fin 10) = ⟨9-k.val, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp only [Fin.revPerm_apply, Fin.val_rev]
    omega
  rw [hr]
  change bitFactor (r.val.testBit k.val) (v ⟨9-k.val, by omega⟩) =
    bitFactor (r.val.testBit (9-(9-k.val))) (v ⟨9-k.val, by omega⟩)
  rw [show 9-(9-k.val) = k.val by omega]

#print axioms selAt_eq_bitWeight

theorem vdeg_selAt (r : Fin 1024) : VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun v : Fin 10 → K => selAt v r) := by
  simp only [selAt_eq_bitWeight]
  exact vdeg_bitWeight 10 r.val

#print axioms vdeg_selAt

/-- The symbolic big-endian row code is a bijection in every dimension. -/
def rowCodeEquiv (n : Nat) : (Fin n → Bool) ≃ Fin (2^n) where
  toFun b := ⟨rowCode n b, rowCode_lt n b⟩
  invFun r := fun c => r.val.testBit (n-1-c.val)
  left_inv b := by funext c; exact rowCode_testBit n b c
  right_inv r := by
    apply Fin.ext
    apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
    intro k
    by_cases hk : k < n
    · have hb := rowCode_testBit n (fun c => r.val.testBit (n-1-c.val))
        ⟨n-1-k, by omega⟩
      simpa only [show n-1-(n-1-k) = k by omega] using hb
    · have hp : (2 : Nat)^n ≤ 2^k := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
      rw [Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le (rowCode_lt n _) hp),
        Nat.testBit_eq_false_of_lt (lt_of_lt_of_le r.isLt hp)]

#print axioms rowCodeEquiv

/-- Equality weights form a partition of unity, proved by a cube bijection
and product-of-sums identity rather than expanding the row sum. -/
theorem bitWeight_sum (n : Nat) (v : Fin n → K) :
    (∑ r : Fin (2^n), bitWeight n v r.val) = 1 := by
  rw [← (rowCodeEquiv n).sum_comp (fun r => bitWeight n v r.val)]
  change (∑ b : Fin n → Bool, ∏ c : Fin n,
    bitFactor ((rowCode n b).testBit (n-1-c.val)) (v c)) = 1
  simp only [rowCode_testBit]
  rw [← Fintype.prod_sum (fun c (b : Bool) => bitFactor b (v c))]
  apply Finset.prod_eq_one
  intro c _
  simp only [Fintype.sum_bool, bitFactor, if_true, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
  ring

#print axioms bitWeight_sum

/-- An injective selection of coordinates preserves the affine support bound. -/
theorem vdeg_bitWeight_comp {n m : Nat} (ι : Fin m → Fin n) (hi : Function.Injective ι)
    (d : Fin n → Nat) (hd : ∀ i, 1 ≤ d (ι i)) (r : Nat) :
    VDeg n d (fun v : Fin n → K => bitWeight m (fun i => v (ι i)) r) := by
  classical
  apply vdeg_mono (vdeg_prod Finset.univ (fun i => Pi.single (ι i) 1)
    (fun i v => bitFactor (r.testBit (m-1-i.val)) (v (ι i)))
    (fun i _ => vdeg_coord (ι i) _ (bitFactor_affine _)))
  intro c
  by_cases hc : ∃ i, ι i = c
  · obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := hc
    simpa only [Pi.single_apply, hi.eq_iff, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using hd i
  · have hn (i : Fin m) : c ≠ ι i := fun h => hc ⟨i, h.symm⟩
    simp only [Pi.single_apply, hn, if_false, Finset.sum_const_zero, Nat.zero_le]

#print axioms vdeg_bitWeight_comp

/-- High and low factors use disjoint source coordinates. -/
def eqHigh (v : Fin 10 → K) (h : Fin 64) : K := bitWeight 6 (fun c => v (c.castAdd 4)) h.val

def eqLow (v : Fin 10 → K) (l : Fin 16) : K := bitWeight 4 (fun c => v (c.natAdd 6)) l.val

def highDeg (c : Fin 10) : Nat := if c.val < 6 then 1 else 0

def lowDeg (c : Fin 10) : Nat := if c.val < 6 then 0 else 1

/-- `g2Row` has the verified layout 16*h+l, so its weight factors at bit 4. -/
theorem selAt_g2Row (v : Fin 10 → K) (h : Fin 64) (l : Fin 16) :
    selAt v (g2Row h l) = eqHigh v h * eqLow v l := by
  rw [selAt_eq_bitWeight]
  change (∏ c : Fin (6+4), bitFactor ((16*h.val+l.val).testBit (9-c.val)) (v c)) = _
  rw [Fin.prod_univ_add]
  congr 1
  · unfold eqHigh bitWeight
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro c _
    have hb := Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add h.val (b := l.val) (i := 4) l.isLt (9-c.val)
    simp only [show (2 : Nat)^4 = 16 by norm_num, if_neg (show ¬ 9-c.val < 4 by omega),
      show 9-c.val-4 = 5-c.val by omega] at hb
    change bitFactor ((16*h.val+l.val).testBit (9-c.val)) (v (c.castAdd 4)) = _
    rw [hb]
  · unfold eqLow bitWeight
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro c _
    have hb := Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add h.val (b := l.val) (i := 4) l.isLt (9-(6+c.val))
    simp only [show (2 : Nat)^4 = 16 by norm_num, if_pos (show 3-c.val < 4 by omega),
      show 9-(6+c.val) = 3-c.val by omega] at hb
    change bitFactor ((16*h.val+l.val).testBit (9-(6+c.val))) (v (c.natAdd 6)) = _
    rw [show 9-(6+c.val) = 3-c.val by omega, hb]

#print axioms selAt_g2Row

theorem eqHigh_sum (v : Fin 10 → K) : (∑ h, eqHigh v h) = 1 :=
  bitWeight_sum 6 (fun c => v (c.castAdd 4))

theorem eqLow_sum (v : Fin 10 → K) : (∑ l, eqLow v l) = 1 :=
  bitWeight_sum 4 (fun c => v (c.natAdd 6))

#print axioms eqHigh_sum
#print axioms eqLow_sum

theorem g2High_selAt (v : Fin 10 → K) (h : Fin 64) : g2High (selAt v) h = eqHigh v h := by
  simp only [g2High, selAt_g2Row, ← Finset.mul_sum, eqLow_sum, mul_one]

theorem g2Low_selAt (v : Fin 10 → K) (l : Fin 16) : g2Low (selAt v) l = eqLow v l := by
  simp only [g2Low, selAt_g2Row, ← Finset.sum_mul, eqHigh_sum, one_mul]

#print axioms g2High_selAt
#print axioms g2Low_selAt

theorem vdeg_eqHigh (h : Fin 64) : VDeg 10 highDeg (fun v : Fin 10 → K => eqHigh v h) := by
  apply vdeg_bitWeight_comp (fun c : Fin 6 => c.castAdd 4)
  · intro a b hab; exact Fin.ext (congrArg (fun q : Fin 10 => q.val) hab)
  · intro c; simp only [highDeg, Fin.val_castAdd, if_pos c.isLt, le_refl]

theorem vdeg_eqLow (l : Fin 16) : VDeg 10 lowDeg (fun v : Fin 10 → K => eqLow v l) := by
  apply vdeg_bitWeight_comp (fun c : Fin 4 => c.natAdd 6)
  · intro a b hab; apply Fin.ext; have := congrArg Fin.val hab; change 6+a.val = 6+b.val at this; omega
  · intro c; simp only [lowDeg, Fin.val_natAdd, if_neg (show ¬ 6+c.val < 6 by omega), le_refl]

#print axioms vdeg_eqHigh
#print axioms vdeg_eqLow

theorem vdeg_g2High (h : Fin 64) : VDeg 10 highDeg (fun v : Fin 10 → K => g2High (selAt v) h) := by
  simp only [g2High_selAt]; exact vdeg_eqHigh h

theorem vdeg_g2Low (l : Fin 16) : VDeg 10 lowDeg (fun v : Fin 10 → K => g2Low (selAt v) l) := by
  simp only [g2Low_selAt]; exact vdeg_eqLow l

#print axioms vdeg_g2High
#print axioms vdeg_g2Low

theorem vdeg_g2SumHigh (s c : Nat) (h : s+c ≤ 64) :
    VDeg 10 highDeg (fun v : Fin 10 → K => g2SumHigh (selAt v) s c h) := by
  simp only [g2SumHigh, g2_fold_add, zero_add, List.sum_ofFn]
  exact vdeg_sum Finset.univ _ (fun _ _ => vdeg_g2High _)

#print axioms vdeg_g2SumHigh

/-- A coordinate projection has degree one only at its own coordinate. -/
theorem vdeg_proj {n : Nat} (i : Fin n) :
    VDeg n (Pi.single i 1) (fun v : Fin n → K => v i) :=
  vdeg_coord i id ⟨X, by simp, fun _ => eval_X⟩

#print axioms vdeg_proj

/-- Composing equality factors adds the coordinate degree vectors. -/
theorem vdeg_bitWeight_inputs {n m : Nat} (d : Fin m → Fin n → Nat)
    (p : (Fin n → K) → Fin m → K) (hp : ∀ i, VDeg n (d i) (fun v => p v i)) (r : Nat) :
    VDeg n (fun c => ∑ i, d i c) (fun v => bitWeight m (p v) r) :=
  vdeg_prod Finset.univ d _ (fun i _ => vdeg_bitFactor _ (hp i))

#print axioms vdeg_bitWeight_inputs

/-- Carry after k low bits has degree one on precisely those low coordinates. -/
theorem vdeg_succCarry (k : Nat) (hk : k ≤ 10) :
    VDeg 10 (fun c => if 10-k ≤ c.val then 1 else 0) (fun v : Fin 10 → K => succCarry v k) := by
  classical
  induction k with
  | zero => exact vdeg_const 10 _ (1 : K)
  | succ k ih =>
      let i : Fin 10 := ⟨9-k, by omega⟩
      have h := vdeg_mul (vdeg_proj (K := K) i) (ih (by omega))
      simp only [succCarry, dif_pos (show k < 10 by omega)]
      apply vdeg_mono h
      intro c
      simp only [Pi.single_apply]
      split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Fin.ext_iff] <;> dsimp [i] at * <;> omega

#print axioms vdeg_succCarry

/-- Successor coordinate c depends affinely on each coordinate c..9. -/
theorem vdeg_successorPoint (c : Fin 10) :
    VDeg 10 (fun j => if c.val ≤ j.val then 1 else 0)
      (fun v : Fin 10 → K => successorPoint v c) := by
  classical
  have hc := vdeg_succCarry (K := K) (9-c.val) (by omega)
  have hp := vdeg_proj (K := K) c
  have hm := vdeg_mul hp hc
  apply vdeg_mono (vdeg_sub (vdeg_add hp hc) (vdeg_add hm hm))
  intro j
  simp only [Pi.single_apply]
  split_ifs <;> simp_all only [Fin.ext_iff] <;> omega

#print axioms vdeg_successorPoint

theorem vdeg_xor12Point (c : Fin 10) :
    VDeg 10 (Pi.single c 1) (fun v : Fin 10 → K => xor12Point v c) := by
  by_cases hc : c.val = 7 ∨ c.val = 6
  · simpa only [xor12Point, if_pos hc, bitFactor, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] using
      vdeg_bitFactor false (vdeg_proj (K := K) c)
  · simpa only [xor12Point, if_neg hc] using vdeg_proj (K := K) c

#print axioms vdeg_xor12Point

theorem vdeg_selAt_successor (r : Fin 1024) :
    VDeg 10 (fun c => c.val+1) (fun v : Fin 10 → K => selAt (successorPoint v) r) := by
  simp only [selAt_eq_bitWeight]
  apply vdeg_mono (vdeg_bitWeight_inputs _ successorPoint vdeg_successorPoint r.val)
  intro c
  have hs : Finset.univ.filter (fun i : Fin 10 => i.val ≤ c.val) = Finset.Iic c := by
    ext i
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Finset.mem_Iic]
    rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_boole, hs, Fin.card_Iic]
  simp

#print axioms vdeg_selAt_successor

theorem vdeg_selAt_xor12 (r : Fin 1024) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun v : Fin 10 → K => selAt (xor12Point v) r) := by
  simp only [selAt_eq_bitWeight]
  have h := vdeg_bitWeight_inputs (K := K) (fun c => Pi.single c 1) xor12Point vdeg_xor12Point r.val
  simpa only [Pi.single_apply, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, if_true] using h

#print axioms vdeg_selAt_xor12

theorem vdeg_honestClaims_zero (t : Trace K) (l : Fin 29) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun v => honestClaims t v 0 l) := by
  change VDeg 10 _ (fun v => AspisR0.LinearDual.dot (selAt v) (t l))
  unfold AspisR0.LinearDual.dot
  apply vdeg_sum Finset.univ
  intro r _
  simpa only [mul_comm] using vdeg_smul (t l r) (vdeg_selAt r)

#print axioms vdeg_honestClaims_zero

theorem vdeg_honestClaims_one (t : Trace K) (l : Fin 29) :
    VDeg 10 (fun c => c.val+1) (fun v => honestClaims t v 1 l) := by
  change VDeg 10 _ (fun v => AspisR0.LinearDual.dot (selAt (successorPoint v)) (t l))
  unfold AspisR0.LinearDual.dot
  apply vdeg_sum Finset.univ
  intro r _
  simpa only [mul_comm] using vdeg_smul (t l r) (vdeg_selAt_successor r)

#print axioms vdeg_honestClaims_one

theorem vdeg_honestClaims_two (t : Trace K) (l : Fin 29) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun v => honestClaims t v 2 l) := by
  change VDeg 10 _ (fun v => AspisR0.LinearDual.dot (selAt (xor12Point v)) (t l))
  unfold AspisR0.LinearDual.dot
  apply vdeg_sum Finset.univ
  intro r _
  simpa only [mul_comm] using vdeg_smul (t l r) (vdeg_selAt_xor12 r)

#print axioms vdeg_honestClaims_two

theorem vdeg_eqValue (zc : Fin 10 → K) :
    VDeg 10 (fun _ => 1) (fun v => eqValue zc v) := by
  unfold eqValue
  apply (vdeg_prod_coord Finset.univ (fun c x => 1-zc c-x+zc c*x+zc c*x) ?_)
  intro c _
  refine ⟨C (1-zc c) + C (zc c+zc c-1)*X, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (natDegree_add_le _ _).trans
    apply max_le
    · simp only [natDegree_C]; omega
    · apply natDegree_mul_le.trans
      simp only [natDegree_C, natDegree_X]; omega
  · intro x
    simp only [eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X]
    ring

#print axioms vdeg_eqValue

theorem vdeg_pack4 {n : Nat} {d : Fin n → Nat} {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F)
    (v : (Fin n → K) → Fin 4 → K) (hv : ∀ i, VDeg n d (fun x => v x i)) :
    VDeg n d (fun x => pack4 B (v x)) := by
  simpa only [pack4, max_self] using
    vdeg_add (vdeg_add (vdeg_add (hv 0) (vdeg_smul B.i (hv 1)))
      (vdeg_smul B.u (hv 2))) (vdeg_smul (B.i*B.u) (hv 3))

#print axioms vdeg_pack4

end R0P.SemDegree

R0P.SemD3:
import R0P.SemDecision
import R0P.SemRounds
import R0P.SemClosed

/-! Lead: the D3 core for the semantic rounds.

For a candidate trace t with honest claims, the virtual polynomial is the
terminal at the honest claims; the B2 round classifier is G13′'s
`semRoundBad` for some candidate of `Lambda x.W`. `d3_core`: if the parsed
semantic transcript passes `sumcheckChecks` with honest claims for a
candidate t of the typed words, and no semantic round is bad for t, then
t satisfies every production family and the links balance, hence the
payment witness exists. The three bridge facts of G14′ (honest terminal at
Boolean rows, weighted-degree bound, and the round checks as `accept`) are
named hypotheses. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.SemSource
open FS FS2 R0C.SemStatement Polynomial Sumcheck
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisR0.Chord AspisR0.ChordGeometry AspisR0.Opening AspisR0.ListsResponses AspisR0.LinearDual

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}

/-- Honest claims of a trace at the three opening points of `v`. -/
def honestClaims (t : Trace K) (v : Fin 10 → K) : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K :=
  fun j l => dot (eqWeight (openingPoints v j)) (t l)

/-- The 14 pre-sumcheck challenges: λ, χ, θ, zc₀..zc₉, μ. -/
def preZc (pre : Fin 14 → K) : Fin 10 → K := fun j => pre ⟨3 + j.val, by omega⟩

/-- The virtual polynomial of candidate t: the terminal at its honest claims. -/
def virtualPoly (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (pre : Fin 14 → K) : (Fin 10 → K) → K :=
  fun v => terminalValue pub (pre 0) (pre 1) (pre 2) (pre 13) (preZc pre) B (honestClaims t v) v

/-- G14′ item 4: at a Boolean row the honest terminal is the batched row value. -/
def HonestRows (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∀ (pre : Fin 14 → K) (b : Fin 10 → Bool),
    virtualPoly pub B t pre (ofBool b) =
      eqwB 10 (preZc pre) b * lanesComp (pre 2) (laneOf t pub (pre 0) (pre 1) B) b +
      pre 13 * t 26 (rowOf b) +
      (pre 13) ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b))

/-- G14′ item 5: weighted individual degree ≤ 27. -/
def VirtualDeg (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∀ pre : Fin 14 → K, IndDeg 27 10 (virtualPoly pub B t pre)

/-- G14′ item 6: the round checks with honest final claims are `accept`,
for the challenge vector `r` (λ, χ, θ, zc, μ at 0–13; α at 14–23). -/
def ChecksAccept (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∀ (r : Fin 24 → K) (polys : Fin 10 → K[X]),
    sumcheckChecks pub B (List.ofFn r) List.length_ofFn polys (honestClaims t (semSlice r 14 10)) →
      accept 27 10 (virtualPoly pub B t (semSlice r 0 14)) 0 polys (semSlice r 14 10)

/-- The prover's polynomials as a constant strategy (the transcript is fixed). -/
def fixedStrat (polys : Fin 10 → K[X]) :
    (Fin 14 → K) → (j : Fin 10) → (Fin j.val → K) → K[X] :=
  fun _ j _ => polys j

/-- G13′'s classifier for one candidate, over the 24 challenges `r`. -/
def candidateRoundBad (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (polys : Fin 10 → K[X]) (r : Fin 24 → K) (i : Fin 24) : Prop :=
  semRoundBad t pub B (fun pre => virtualPoly pub B t pre) (fixedStrat polys) i (semPrefix r i) (r i)

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem strategyPolys_fixed (polys : Fin 10 → K[X]) (pre : Fin 14 → K) (α : Fin 10 → K) :
    SemBadSets.strategyPolys (fixedStrat polys pre) α = polys := by
  funext j
  rfl

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem semSlice_zero_apply (r : Fin 24 → K) (j : Fin 14) :
    semSlice r 0 14 j = r ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ := by
  simp only [semSlice, semPrefixVal, Nat.zero_add]
  rw [dif_pos (by omega)]

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem preZc_semSlice (r : Fin 24 → K) : preZc (semSlice r 0 14) = semSlice r 3 10 := by
  funext j
  simp only [preZc, semSlice, semPrefixVal, Nat.zero_add]

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
/-- The D3 core. -/
theorem d3_core (P : Nat) [CharP K P] (hP : P = 2 ^ 31 - 1)
    (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (B : PackBasis x.F) (t : Trace K)
    (hA : BaseTyped x.F t)
    (hrows : HonestRows x.pub B t) (hdeg : VirtualDeg x.pub B t) (hchk : ChecksAccept x.pub B t)
    (r : Fin 24 → K) (polys : Fin 10 → K[X])
    (hsum : sumcheckChecks x.pub B (List.ofFn r) List.length_ofFn polys
      (honestClaims t (semSlice r 14 10)))
    (hgood : ∀ i : Fin 24, ¬ candidateRoundBad x.pub B t polys r i) :
    ProductionHolds x.pub (r 0) (r 1) t ∧ CopyLinkBalance x.pub t := by
  have hacc := hchk r polys hsum
  have hacc' : accept 27 10 (virtualPoly x.pub B t (semSlice r 0 14)) 0
      (SemBadSets.strategyPolys (fixedStrat polys (semSlice r 0 14)) (semSlice r 14 10))
      (semSlice r 14 10) := by
    rw [strategyPolys_fixed]
    exact hacc
  have hG : ∀ b, virtualPoly x.pub B t (semSlice r 0 14) (ofBool b) =
      eqwB 10 (semSlice r 3 10) b * lanesComp (r 2) (laneOf t x.pub (r 0) (r 1) B) b +
      r 13 * t 26 (rowOf b) +
      (r 13) ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) * t 26 (rowOf b)) := by
    intro b
    rw [hrows, preZc_semSlice, semSlice_zero_apply, semSlice_zero_apply, semSlice_zero_apply,
      semSlice_zero_apply]
    rfl
  exact semantic_sound_rounds P hP x.F B x.pub t hA x.pubBase r (fun pre => virtualPoly x.pub B t pre)
    (fixedStrat polys) hG (hdeg _) hacc' hgood

#print axioms strategyPolys_fixed
#print axioms d3_core
end
end R0P.SemSource

import R0P.SemView
import R0P.LaneMap

/-! Lead: the terminal at an arbitrary point and the B2 `decision`.

The ported families take openings and a selector vector; at a Boolean row
these are `rowOpenings`/`rowSel`, at a general point the claims and the
multilinear selector weights (`Selectors::boxed_at_point`). `laneAt` is the
θ-lane vector at (openings, h1, selector); `laneOf` is its Boolean-row
instance (`laneOf_eq_laneAt`, by unfolding). `terminalValue` is
`terminal_parts(...).0` (T:1285–1310): `eq(zc, point)·Σθⁱ laneᵢ + μ·h1 +
μ²·(1 − active)·h1`. `decision` checks the ten sumcheck rounds against
claim 0 with the terminal as the final value, then the opening decision
through `openingView`, with the q22 cardinality guard of the close job's
`decisionQ` (`R0C.V3.DQ.cardOK`). -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.SemSource
open FS FS2 R0C.SemStatement Polynomial Sumcheck
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisR0.Chord AspisR0.ChordGeometry AspisR0.Opening

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}

/-- `scalarLaneRow` with explicit openings and selector. -/
def scalarLaneAt (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K) (i : Nat) : K :=
  if i < 12 then
    (scheduleFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD i 0 +
      (occupancyFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD i 0
  else if i < 32 then (scheduleFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD i 0
  else if i < 49 then (pathFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD (i - 32) 0
  else if i < 84 then (valueFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD (i - 49) 0
  else if i < 92 then (digestFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD (i - 84) 0
  else if i < 94 then (assetFamily.residuals pub o sel).getD (i - 92) 0
  else 0

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem scalarLaneRow_eq_at (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (b : Fin 1024) (i : Nat) :
    scalarLaneRow pub t b i = scalarLaneAt pub (rowOpenings t b) (rowSel b) i := rfl

/-- The 29 θ-lanes at (openings, h1, selector), in `laneOf`'s order. -/
def laneAt (pub : Public K) (lam chi : K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F)
    (o : Openings K) (h1 : K) (sel : Sel K) : Fin 29 → K := fun i =>
  if i.val < 4 then ((poseidonPackedFamily B).residuals pub o sel).getD i.val 0
  else if i.val < 28 then pack4 B (fun j => scalarLaneAt pub o sel (4 * (i.val - 4) + j.val))
  else (copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi o h1 sel).getD 0 0

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem laneOf_eq_laneAt (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (lam chi : K) {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (i : Fin 29) (bits : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    laneOf t pub lam chi B i bits =
      laneAt pub lam chi B (rowOpenings t (rowOf bits)) (t 26 (rowOf bits)) (rowSel (rowOf bits)) i := by
  unfold laneOf laneAt semanticPackedLane
  split
  · rfl
  · split
    · rfl
    · rfl

/-- T:1201–1213, `equality_value`. -/
def eqValue (left right : Fin 10 → K) : K :=
  ∏ c : Fin 10, (1 - left c - right c + left c * right c + left c * right c)

/-- The selector vector at a point: R0's `eqWeight` on the R0-ordered point. -/
def selAt (α : Fin 10 → K) : Sel K := eqWeight (toR0 α)

/-- The copy-active selector at the point (T:1303, `copy_active`). -/
def activeAt (α : Fin 10 → K) : K := copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (selAt α))

/-- T:1285–1310: `terminal_parts(...).0` at claims `y` and point `α`. -/
def terminalValue (pub : Public K) (lam chi θ μ : K) (zc : Fin 10 → K) {F : Subfield K}
    (B : PackBasis F) (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) (α : Fin 10 → K) : K :=
  let o : Openings K := ⟨fun c => y 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c), fun c => y 1 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c),
    fun c => y 2 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c)⟩
  let h1 := y 0 26
  eqValue zc α * (∑ i : Fin 29, θ ^ i.val * laneAt pub lam chi B o h1 (selAt α) i) +
    μ * h1 + μ * μ * ((1 - activeAt α) * h1)

/-- The ten sumcheck rounds of a parsed transcript: round polynomials from
the messages at rounds 14–23, challenges α. Boundary checks from claim 0,
degree ≤ 27, final value equal to the terminal at the claims. -/
def sumcheckChecks (pub : Public K) {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F)
    (cs : List K) (hcs : cs.length = 24) (polys : Fin 10 → K[X])
    (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) : Prop :=
  let lam := cs[0]'(by omega)
  let chi := cs[1]'(by omega)
  let θ := cs[2]'(by omega)
  let zc : Fin 10 → K := fun j => cs[3 + j.val]'(by omega)
  let μ := cs[13]'(by omega)
  let α : Fin 10 → K := fun j => cs[14 + j.val]'(by omega)
  (∀ j : Fin 10, (polys j).natDegree ≤ 27) ∧
  (polys 0).eval 0 + (polys 0).eval 1 = 0 ∧
  (∀ j : Fin 9, (polys j.succ).eval 0 + (polys j.succ).eval 1 =
    (polys j.castSucc).eval (α j.castSucc)) ∧
  (polys 9).eval (α 9) = terminalValue pub lam chi θ μ zc B y α

/-- Round polynomials of the 24 semantic rounds (rounds 14–23). -/
def semPolys : List (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K) → Option (Fin 10 → K[X])
  | rounds =>
    if h : rounds.length = 24 then
      let get : Fin 10 → Option K[X] := fun j =>
        match (rounds[14 + j.val]'(by omega)).1 with
        | .semantic (.roundPoly p) => some p
        | _ => Option.none
      if hall : ∀ j, (get j).isSome then some (fun j => (get j).get (hall j)) else Option.none
    else Option.none

/-- The q22 round's set has 22 fibres (close job `R0C.V3.DQ.cardOK`, generic field). -/
def cardOK (Q : FS.Prefix (R0FS.Stmt K Sfield) (R0FS.Msg K) (R0FS.Chal K)) : Bool :=
  match Q.rounds.getLast? with
  | some (_, .set S) => S.card == 22
  | _ => false

/-- B2's `decision`: the semantic checks and the opening decision. -/
def decision {F : Subfield K} (B : PackBasis F)
    (P : Prefix K K (TypedContext K Sfield) (SemMsg K)) (m : Msg K K (SemMsg K)) : Bool := by
  classical
  exact decide (∃ (Q : FS.Prefix (R0FS.Stmt K Sfield) (R0FS.Msg K) (R0FS.Chal K))
    (cs : List K) (hcs : cs.length = 24) (polys : Fin 10 → K[X]) (om : R0FS.Msg K),
    openingView P = some Q ∧ semChals (P.rounds.take 24) = some cs ∧
    semPolys (P.rounds.take 24) = some polys ∧
    sumcheckChecks P.statement.pub B cs hcs polys Q.statement.pointClaims ∧
    m = .opening om ∧ R0FS.decision Q om = true ∧ cardOK Q = true)

#print axioms laneOf_eq_laneAt
#print axioms decision
end
end R0P.SemSource

/-! Lead: the pair-forest semantic messages and the opening view.

Semantic message per round (aspis-core state_only_sumcheck.rs:96–105, 241;
aspis-prover v6_onefold_prover.rs:596–612): nothing before λ, χ, the ten
zerocheck coordinates and μ; the H1 commitment before θ; a round
polynomial before each α_j. The point claims follow α₁₀ and ride on B2's
`beforeZ0` message. The C2 commitment (state_only_candidate_prefix.rs:521,
the words `(h1, G)`, lanes 26 and 27) is the message of round 2: the
opening statement's words are the context's with lanes 26/27 replaced by
the parsed C2 words, so the λ/χ rounds precede the C2 choice. The parsers
require the `.semantic` message tag at every semantic round. The three opening points are α, its polynomial binary
successor and its bit-2/3 toggle (state_only_poseidon.rs:95–117), written
in the source's MSB-first coordinate order; R0's `eqWeight` reads bits
LSB-first, so the view reverses coordinates. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.SemSource
open FS FS2 R0C.SemStatement Polynomial
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisR0.Chord AspisR0.ChordGeometry AspisWide.InitialEncoder

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

section Transport
variable {K : Type} [Field K]
open AspisR0.Opening AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7

/-- Semantic rows reindexed as commitment coefficients. -/
def coeffsOf (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (t : Trace K) : Fin 29 → InitialMessage K :=
  fun c j => t c (π.symm j)

def rowsOf (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (m : Fin 29 → InitialMessage K) : Trace K :=
  fun c r => m c (π r)

@[simp] theorem rowsOf_coeffsOf (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (t : Trace K) :
    rowsOf π (coeffsOf π t) = t := by
  funext c r
  simp only [rowsOf, coeffsOf, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

@[simp] theorem coeffsOf_rowsOf (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (m : Fin 29 → InitialMessage K) :
    coeffsOf π (rowsOf π m) = m := by
  funext c j
  simp only [rowsOf, coeffsOf, Equiv.apply_symm_apply]

def rowsEquiv (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) : (Fin 29 → InitialMessage K) ≃ Trace K where
  toFun := rowsOf π
  invFun := coeffsOf π
  left_inv := coeffsOf_rowsOf π
  right_inv := rowsOf_coeffsOf π

/-- The pre-C2 trace, with the two not-yet-committed message lanes zeroed. -/
def padC2Trace (t : Trace K) : Trace K :=
  Function.update (Function.update t 26 0) 27 0

theorem coeffsOf_padC2Trace (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (t : Trace K) :
    coeffsOf π (padC2Trace t) = padC2Trace (coeffsOf π t) := by
  funext c j
  simp only [coeffsOf, padC2Trace, Function.update_apply]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

/-- Coefficient-indexed Libra row, shared with the later masked protocol. -/
def libraWeight (alpha : Fin 10 → K) : InitialMessage K := fun j =>
  if j.val < 28 then alpha 8 ^ j.val
  else if j.val < 56 then alpha 9 ^ (j.val - 28) else 0
end Transport

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}

open AspisR0.Opening AspisR0.ListsResponses AspisR0.RoundNormalization
attribute [local irreducible] Lambda

theorem dot_coeffWeight_coeffsOf (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (w : InitialMessage K)
    (t : Trace K) (c : Fin 29) :
    dot (coeffWeight π w) (coeffsOf π t c) = dot w (t c) := by
  rw [dot_coeffWeight_left]
  simp only [coeffsOf, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]

def LambdaRows (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K) : Finset (Trace K) :=
  (Lambda W).map (rowsEquiv π).toEmbedding

@[simp] theorem mem_LambdaRows (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K)
    (t : Trace K) : t ∈ LambdaRows π W ↔ coeffsOf π t ∈ Lambda W := by
  change t ∈ (Lambda W).map (rowsEquiv π).toEmbedding ↔ coeffsOf π t ∈ Lambda W
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨m, hm, he⟩ := Finset.mem_map.mp h
    change rowsOf π m = t at he
    rw [← he, coeffsOf_rowsOf]
    exact hm
  · intro h
    exact Finset.mem_map.mpr ⟨coeffsOf π t, h, rowsOf_coeffsOf π t⟩

theorem card_LambdaRows (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K) :
    (LambdaRows π W).card = (Lambda W).card := Finset.card_map _

theorem LambdaRows_card (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K) :
    (LambdaRows π W).card ≤ 100 := by
  rw [card_LambdaRows]
  exact Lambda_card W

inductive SemMsg (K : Type) [Field K]
  | none
  /-- the C2 commitment: the words of lanes 26 (H1) and 27 (G) -/
  | h1 (h g : InitialWord K)
  | roundPoly (p : K[X])

/-- state_only_poseidon.rs:95–105: carry after processing k coordinates
from the right (coordinate 9 is the row's least significant bit). -/
def succCarry (p : Fin 10 → K) : Nat → K
  | 0 => 1
  | k+1 => (if h : k < 10 then p ⟨9 - k, by omega⟩ else 0) * succCarry p k

def successorPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (c : Fin 10) : K :=
  let carry := succCarry p (9 - c.val)
  p c + carry - (p c * carry + p c * carry)

/-- state_only_poseidon.rs:109–117: toggle row bits 2 and 3 (coordinates 7, 6). -/
def xor12Point (p : Fin 10 → K) (c : Fin 10) : K :=
  if c.val = 7 ∨ c.val = 6 then 1 - p c else p c

/-- Source MSB-first coordinates to R0's LSB-first `eqWeight` bits. -/
def toR0 (p : Fin 10 → K) : Fin 10 → K := fun b => p ⟨9 - b.val, by omega⟩

def openingPoints (α : Fin 10 → K) : Fin 3 → Fin 10 → K
  | 0 => toR0 α
  | 1 => toR0 (successorPoint α)
  | 2 => toR0 (xor12Point α)

/-- The committed words with their subfield typing. -/
structure TypedContext (K : Type) [Field K] (Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K) where
  pub : Public K
  transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024
  extraClaims : Fin 29 → K
  W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K
  base : ∀ l i, W l i ∈ Sfield l
  /-- the common field of definition of the C1 lanes (M31 in the source) -/
  F : Subfield K
  lanesF : ∀ l : Fin 29, l.val < 26 → Sfield l = F
  /-- the public fields are M31 values (CoreExt.PublicBase) -/
  pubBase : PublicBase F pub

/-- The codeword of the zero message: the lane-26/27 placeholder before C2. -/
def padWord : InitialWord K := exactInitialEncoder (fun _ => 0)

/-- The context's words with the C2 words at lanes 26 and 27. -/
def c2Words (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (h g : InitialWord K) : Fin 29 → InitialWord K :=
  Function.update (Function.update x.W 26 h) 27 g

/-- The C2 words are committed in their lanes' fields. -/
def c2Base (Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K) (h g : InitialWord K) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, h i ∈ Sfield 26) ∧ (∀ i, g i ∈ Sfield 27)

omit [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] in
theorem c2Words_base (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (h g : InitialWord K)
    (hb : c2Base Sfield h g) : ∀ l i, c2Words x h g l i ∈ Sfield l := by
  intro l i
  simp only [c2Words, Function.update_apply]
  split_ifs with h27 h26
  · subst h27; exact hb.2 i
  · subst h26; exact hb.1 i
  · exact x.base l i

/-- The C2 words of a semantic round list: the message of round 2. -/
def c2Of (rounds : List (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K)) : Option (InitialWord K × InitialWord K) :=
  match (rounds[2]? : Option (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K)) with
  | some (Msg.semantic (SemMsg.h1 h g), _) => some (h, g)
  | _ => Option.none

/-- Challenges of a semantic round list, all scalar, with semantic messages. -/
def semChals : List (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K) → Option (List K)
  | [] => some []
  | (.semantic _, .semantic c) :: rest => (semChals rest).map (c :: ·)
  | _ => Option.none

/-- The opening rounds, all of the opening kind. -/
def openingRounds : List (Msg K K (SemMsg K) × Chal K K) →
    Option (List (R0FS.Msg K × R0FS.Chal K))
  | [] => some []
  | (.opening om, .opening oc) :: rest => (openingRounds rest).map ((om, oc) :: ·)
  | _ => Option.none

/-- The opening statement for a parsed semantic transcript. `semantic` is
`True`: the semantic phase is now explicit in the prefix. -/
def openingStmt (x : TypedContext K Sfield) (h g : InitialWord K) (hb : c2Base Sfield h g)
    (α : Fin 10 → K) (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K)
    (z0 z1 : Point K) (hne : z0 ≠ z1) (h0 : ¬ BaseRational z0) (h1 : ¬ BaseRational z1) :
    R0FS.Stmt K Sfield :=
  { W := c2Words x h g, base := c2Words_base x h g hb, z0 := z0, z1 := z1, hne := hne, h0 := h0, h1 := h1,
    points := openingPoints α, pointClaims := y, inactive := copyInactiveRows, transport := x.transport,
    extraWeight := libraWeight α, extraClaims := x.extraClaims, semantic := True }

/-- B2's `openingView`: 24 semantic rounds, the two circle rounds, then the
opening rounds. Malformed prefixes have no view. -/
def openingView (P : Prefix K K (TypedContext K Sfield) (SemMsg K)) :
    Option (FS.Prefix (R0FS.Stmt K Sfield) (R0FS.Msg K) (R0FS.Chal K)) :=
  match P.rounds.splitAt 24 with
  | (sem, (.beforeZ0 y, .circle z0) :: (.beforeZ1 _, .circle z1) :: opening) =>
    match semChals sem, c2Of sem, openingRounds opening with
    | some cs, some (hw, gw), some os =>
      if h : cs.length = 24 ∧ c2Base Sfield hw gw ∧ z0 ≠ z1 ∧ ¬ BaseRational z0 ∧
          ¬ BaseRational z1 then
        some ⟨openingStmt P.statement hw gw h.2.1
          (fun j => cs[14 + j.val]'(by omega)) y z0 z1 h.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.1 h.2.2.2.2, os⟩
      else Option.none
    | _, _, _ => Option.none
  | _ => Option.none

#print axioms c2Words_base
#print axioms openingView

end
end R0P.SemSource

/-! Lead: the pair-forest instance of the B2 semantic extension, part 1.

`R0C.SemStatement.SourceData` was left as open data in the close job. The
fields fixed by the SEM work are supplied here: the public context carries
the pair-forest public input and the committed words; the payment witness
is `InputNoteExtracted` for a candidate trace of the committed words. The
round classifier `semanticBad` (24 rounds, G13′) and `openingView` are the

`doomed` at the empty prefix. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.SemSource
open FS FS2 R0C.SemStatement
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound AspisV8PairedCommitment

noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}

/-- The public initial context: the pair-forest public input and the
committed words (whose candidate list `Lambda W` the semantic rounds
quantify over). -/
structure Context (K : Type) [Field K] where
  pub : Public K
  W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K

/-- The payment witness: a candidate trace with an extracted input note. -/
def paymentWitness (x : Context K) (t : Trace K) : Prop := InputNoteExtracted x.pub t

/-- D1 for every semantic `SourceData`: no witness means doomed at the empty
prefix, since no round has been played. -/
theorem d1_of_sourceData {X SM W Pf I A : Type} [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A] [Fintype A]
    (s : SourceData (K := K) (E := K) X SM W Sfield)
    (msg : Pf → Nat → Msg K K SM)
    (samp : Nat → Prefix K K X SM → Msg K K SM → FS2.Sampler I A (Chal K K))
    (decode : I → Table I A →
      Option (FS2.Sampler I A (Prefix K K X SM × Msg K K SM × Chal K K))) :
    FS2.D1 (protocol s msg samp decode) (stateRows s) := by
  intro x T hx
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hw
    change R0C.SemStatement.extract s x T = none at hx
    unfold R0C.SemStatement.extract at hx
    split at hx
    · exact Option.some_ne_none _ hx
    · rename_i hno
      exact (hno hw).elim
  · intro h
    exact h

#print axioms d1_of_sourceData
end
