  unfold P AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P at *
  simp only [Nat.mul_sub_left_distrib, Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add,
    Nat.mul_comm b a]
  omega

def imagWord (a b c d : Nat) :=
  ((((a + b) * (c + d)) % P + P - (a * c) % P) % P + P -
    (b * d) % P) % P

theorem imagWord_mod (a b c d : Nat) :
    imagWord a b c d = (a * d + b * c) % P := by
  unfold imagWord P AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P
  simp only [Nat.add_mul, Nat.mul_add]
  omega

/-- Pure specialization of the retained GeneratedCM31Normalized.realWord_int
proof body; the old generated runtime is not imported. -/
theorem mul_self_real_int (a b : Nat) :
    ((((a * a) % P + P - (b * b) % P) % P : Nat) : Int) =
      ((a : Int) * a - (b : Int) * b) % (P : Int) := by
  rw [← Int.natCast_mul, ← Int.natCast_mul]
  unfold P AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P
  omega

theorem square_real_word_eq_mul_self_real (a b : Nat)
    (ha : a < P) (hb : b < P) :
    ((a + b) * (a + P - b)) % P =
      ((a * a) % P + P - (b * b) % P) % P := by
  have hleft := square_real_int a b hb
  have hright := mul_self_real_int a b
  omega

#print axioms square_real_int
#print axioms imagWord_mod
#print axioms mul_self_real_int
#print axioms square_real_word_eq_mul_self_real

end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskSquareArithmetic
ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoopMeaning:
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientWriteMeaning
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1

/-! Draft only: pointwise invariants for the two symbolic coefficient-write
folds. The induction follows the actual forward iterator but does not unroll
its 16 or 10 iterations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoopMeaning

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientArray
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev C1 := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.C1
abbrev MaskOnly := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.MaskOnly
abbrev Coefficients := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.Coefficients
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.CanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.CanonicalArray
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

def c1Meaning (c1 : C1) (j : Fin 16) : ExactQM :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement (j.val % 4) *
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell c1 j)

def maskMeaning (maskOnly : MaskOnly) (j : Fin 10) : ExactQM :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement (j.val % 4) *
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell maskOnly j)

/-- Interval invariant for the first source schedule. Every destination whose
column has already been consumed contains its exact transformed source value;
all coefficients outside the consumed schedule remain at their initial value. -/
theorem loop0_model_interval
    (c1 : C1) (initial : Coefficients) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val = 16) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = 16)
    (hsource : ∀ j : Fin 16, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell c1 j)) :
    (∀ j : Fin 16, iter.start.val ≤ j.val → j.val < 16 →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeModel0 c1 initial iter fuel)
          (c1Exponent j) = c1Meaning c1 j) ∧
    (∀ e : Fin 27,
      (∀ j : Fin 16, iter.start.val ≤ j.val → j.val < 16 → c1Exponent j ≠ e) →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeModel0 c1 initial iter fuel) e =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients initial e) := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter initial with
  | zero =>
      have hstart : iter.start.val = 16 := by omega
      constructor
      · intro j hlow hhigh
        omega
      · intro e houtside
        simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeModel0]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hstartlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
      obtain ⟨iter1, hnext, hinc, hend1, _⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskForwardRange.next_step iter hstartlt
      have hcolumn : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
      have hend1' : iter1.end.val = 16 := by rw [hend1, hend]
      have hspan1 : iter1.start.val + fuel = 16 := by omega
      have hstart1 : iter1.start.val = iter.start.val + 1 := hinc
      have hnext' :
          core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
            .ok (some iter.start, iter1) := hnext
      have hwrite :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientWriteMeaning.decoded_writeAt0
          c1 initial iter.start hcolumn (by simpa using hsource ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩)
      let after := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeAt0
        c1 initial iter.start hcolumn
      have hmodel :
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeModel0 c1 initial iter (fuel + 1) =
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeModel0 c1 after iter1 fuel := by
        simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeModel0,
          hnext', hcolumn, after]
      have hih := ih after iter1 hend1' hspan1
      constructor
      · intro j hlow hhigh
        rw [hmodel]
        by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
        · have hji : j = ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩ := Fin.ext hj
          have hnoFuture : ∀ k : Fin 16,
              iter1.start.val ≤ k.val → k.val < 16 → c1Exponent k ≠ c1Exponent j := by
            intro k hklo hkhigh heq
            have hkj : k.val = j.val := congrArg Fin.val (factor_schedule_injective heq)
            have hjv : j.val = iter.start.val := by simp [hji]
            omega
          have hkeep := hih.2 (c1Exponent j) hnoFuture
          rw [hji, hwrite, Function.update_self] at hkeep
          simpa [c1Meaning, hji] using hkeep
        · have hjlo : iter1.start.val ≤ j.val := by omega
          exact hih.1 j hjlo hhigh
      · intro e houtside
        rw [hmodel]
        have hfirst : c1Exponent ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩ ≠ e := by
          exact houtside ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩ (Nat.le_refl _) hcolumn
        have hnoFuture : ∀ j : Fin 16,
            iter1.start.val ≤ j.val → j.val < 16 → c1Exponent j ≠ e := by
          intro j hjlo hjhi
          exact houtside j (by omega) hjhi
        have hkeep := hih.2 e hnoFuture
        rw [hwrite, Function.update_of_ne hfirst.symm] at hkeep
        exact hkeep

/-- Full-range actual loop-0 output inherits the pointwise schedule meaning.
The initial array needs canonical cells only for the extracted loop's checked
body operations; the pointwise model theorem itself has no such premise. -/
theorem loop0_full_range
    (c1 : C1) (initial : Coefficients)
    (hsource : ∀ j : Fin 16, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell c1 j))
    (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial) :
    ∃ out : Coefficients,
      state_only_hiding.state_only_selected_mask_value_loop0
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := 16#usize } c1 initial = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 16,
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients out
          (c1Exponent j) = c1Meaning c1 j) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin 27,
        (∀ j : Fin 16, c1Exponent j ≠ e) →
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients out e =
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients initial e) := by
  let iter : Range := { start := 0#usize, «end» := 16#usize }
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.loop0_exec c1 iter initial 16 rfl (by rfl)
      hsource hinitial
  have hmeaning := loop0_model_interval c1 initial iter 16 rfl (by rfl) hsource
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanonical, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [iter] using hrun
  · intro j
    have hj := hmeaning.1 j (Nat.zero_le _) j.isLt
    rw [hmodel]
    simpa [iter] using hj
  · intro e houtside
    have h := hmeaning.2 e (by
      intro j _ _
      exact houtside j)
    rw [hmodel]
    simpa [iter] using h

/-- Interval invariant for the second source schedule. Earlier C1 writes are
represented by the supplied initial array and are preserved at every cell not
in the consumed mask-only schedule. -/
theorem loop1_model_interval
    (maskOnly : MaskOnly) (initial : Coefficients) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val = 10) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = 10)
    (hsource : ∀ j : Fin 10, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell maskOnly j)) :
    (∀ j : Fin 10, iter.start.val ≤ j.val → j.val < 10 →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeModel1 maskOnly initial iter fuel)
          (maskExponent j) = maskMeaning maskOnly j) ∧
    (∀ e : Fin 27,
      (∀ j : Fin 10, iter.start.val ≤ j.val → j.val < 10 → maskExponent j ≠ e) →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeModel1 maskOnly initial iter fuel) e =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients initial e) := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter initial with
  | zero =>
      have hstart : iter.start.val = 10 := by omega
      constructor
      · intro j hlow hhigh
        omega
      · intro e houtside
        simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeModel1]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hstartlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
      obtain ⟨iter1, hnext, hinc, hend1, _⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskForwardRange.next_step iter hstartlt
      have hcolumn : iter.start.val < 10 := by omega
      have hend1' : iter1.end.val = 10 := by rw [hend1, hend]
      have hspan1 : iter1.start.val + fuel = 10 := by omega
      have hstart1 : iter1.start.val = iter.start.val + 1 := hinc
      have hnext' :
          core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
            .ok (some iter.start, iter1) := hnext
      have hwrite :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientWriteMeaning.decoded_writeAt1
          maskOnly initial iter.start hcolumn (by simpa using hsource ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩)
      let after := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeAt1
        maskOnly initial iter.start hcolumn
      have hmodel :
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeModel1 maskOnly initial iter (fuel + 1) =
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeModel1 maskOnly after iter1 fuel := by
        simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeModel1,
          hnext', hcolumn, after]
      have hih := ih after iter1 hend1' hspan1
      constructor
      · intro j hlow hhigh
        rw [hmodel]
        by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
        · have hji : j = ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩ := Fin.ext hj
          have hnoFuture : ∀ k : Fin 10,
              iter1.start.val ≤ k.val → k.val < 10 → maskExponent k ≠ maskExponent j := by
            intro k hklo hkhigh heq
            have hkj : k.val = j.val := congrArg Fin.val (mask_schedule_injective heq)
            have hjv : j.val = iter.start.val := by simp [hji]
            omega
          have hkeep := hih.2 (maskExponent j) hnoFuture
          rw [hji, hwrite, Function.update_self] at hkeep
          simpa [maskMeaning, hji] using hkeep
        · have hjlo : iter1.start.val ≤ j.val := by omega
          exact hih.1 j hjlo hhigh
      · intro e houtside
        rw [hmodel]
        have hfirst : maskExponent ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩ ≠ e := by
          exact houtside ⟨iter.start.val, hcolumn⟩ (Nat.le_refl _) hcolumn
        have hnoFuture : ∀ j : Fin 10,
            iter1.start.val ≤ j.val → j.val < 10 → maskExponent j ≠ e := by
          intro j hjlo hjhi
          exact houtside j (by omega) hjhi
        have hkeep := hih.2 e hnoFuture
        rw [hwrite, Function.update_of_ne hfirst.symm] at hkeep
        exact hkeep

/-- Full-range actual loop-1 output inherits the mask-only schedule meaning.
Its initial array can contain the completed loop-0 cells; every coefficient
outside the ten mask-only destinations is preserved exactly. -/
theorem loop1_full_range
    (maskOnly : MaskOnly) (initial : Coefficients)
    (hsource : ∀ j : Fin 10, CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell maskOnly j))
    (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial) :
    ∃ out : Coefficients,
      state_only_hiding.state_only_selected_mask_value_loop1
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := 10#usize } maskOnly initial = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 10,
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients out
          (maskExponent j) = maskMeaning maskOnly j) ∧
      (∀ e : Fin 27,
        (∀ j : Fin 10, maskExponent j ≠ e) →
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients out e =
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients initial e) := by
  let iter : Range := { start := 0#usize, «end» := 10#usize }
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.loop1_exec maskOnly iter initial 10 rfl (by rfl)
      hsource hinitial
  have hmeaning := loop1_model_interval maskOnly initial iter 10 rfl (by rfl) hsource
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanonical, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [iter] using hrun
  · intro j
    have hj := hmeaning.1 j (Nat.zero_le _) j.isLt
    rw [hmodel]
    simpa [iter] using hj
  · intro e houtside
    have h := hmeaning.2 e (by
      intro j _ _
      exact houtside j)
    rw [hmodel]
    simpa [iter] using h

#print axioms loop0_model_interval

#print axioms loop1_full_range

ExtractedMaskCoefficientWriteMeaning:
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1

/-! Draft only: connect each actual generated coefficient-body model write to a
single decoded finite-field `Function.update`. Inputs must be canonical only
because the extracted basis multiplication correctness theorem requires that
source-cell condition; no invariant on the other coefficient cells is needed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientWriteMeaning

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientArray
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev C1 := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.C1
abbrev MaskOnly := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.MaskOnly
abbrev Coefficients := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.Coefficients
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.CanonicalQM
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

/-- One C1 write changes the decoded coefficient function at exactly the
C1 schedule destination, with the exact basis-transformed source value. -/
theorem decoded_writeAt0
    (c1 : C1) (coefficients : Coefficients) (column : Usize)
    (hcolumn : column.val < 16)
    (hsource : CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell c1
        ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩)) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeAt0
          c1 coefficients column hcolumn) =
      Function.update
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients coefficients)
        (c1Exponent ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩)
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement (column.val % 4) *
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
            (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell c1
              ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩)) := by
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩
  let q : QM := c1.val[column.val]'(by simpa [c1.property] using hcolumn)
  have hq : CanonicalQM q := by
    simpa [q, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell, j] using hsource
  let coordinate := column &&& 3#usize
  have hcoord : coordinate.val < 4 := by
    rw [column_and_three_eq_mod_four column hcolumn]
    exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z, hmul, _hzcanonical, hzvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.current_mul_tower_basis_exact
      q coordinate hq hcoord
  have hzvalue' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode z =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement (column.val % 4) *
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q := by
    simpa [coordinate, column_and_three_eq_mod_four column hcolumn] using hzvalue
  let destination := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from
    (state_only_hiding.FACTOR_EXPONENTS.val[column.val]'
      (by simpa [state_only_hiding.FACTOR_EXPONENTS.property] using hcolumn))
  have hdestination : destination.val = (c1Exponent j).val := by
    simpa [destination, core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from_val_eq] using
      factor_table_cell j
  have hset :
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeAt0
        c1 coefficients column hcolumn = coefficients.set destination z := by
    simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop0.writeAt0,
      q, coordinate, destination, hmul]
  have hbound : destination.val < 27 := by
    rw [hdestination]
    exact (c1Exponent j).isLt
  have hfin : (⟨destination.val, hbound⟩ : Fin 27) = c1Exponent j :=
    Fin.ext hdestination
  rw [hset, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients_set
    coefficients destination z hbound, hfin, hzvalue']
  simp [j, q, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.c1Cell]

/-- One mask-only write changes the decoded coefficient function at exactly
the mask-only schedule destination, with the exact basis-transformed source. -/
theorem decoded_writeAt1
    (maskOnly : MaskOnly) (coefficients : Coefficients) (column : Usize)
    (hcolumn : column.val < 10)
    (hsource : CanonicalQM
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell maskOnly
        ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩)) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeAt1
          maskOnly coefficients column hcolumn) =
      Function.update
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients coefficients)
        (maskExponent ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩)
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement (column.val % 4) *
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
            (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell maskOnly
              ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩)) := by
  let j : Fin 10 := ⟨column.val, hcolumn⟩
  let q : QM := maskOnly.val[column.val]'(by simpa [maskOnly.property] using hcolumn)
  have hq : CanonicalQM q := by
    simpa [q, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell, j] using hsource
  let coordinate := column &&& 3#usize
  have hcoord : coordinate.val < 4 := by
    rw [column_and_three_eq_mod_four column (by omega : column.val < 16)]
    exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z, hmul, _hzcanonical, hzvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.current_mul_tower_basis_exact
      q coordinate hq hcoord
  have hzvalue' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode z =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement (column.val % 4) *
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q := by
    simpa [coordinate,
      column_and_three_eq_mod_four column (by omega : column.val < 16)] using hzvalue
  let destination := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from
    (state_only_hiding.MASK_ONLY_FACTOR_EXPONENTS.val[column.val]'
      (by simpa [state_only_hiding.MASK_ONLY_FACTOR_EXPONENTS.property] using hcolumn))
  have hdestination : destination.val = (maskExponent j).val := by
    simpa [destination, core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from_val_eq] using
      mask_factor_table_cell j
  have hset :
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeAt1
        maskOnly coefficients column hcolumn = coefficients.set destination z := by
    simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientLoop1.writeAt1,
      q, coordinate, destination, hmul]
  have hbound : destination.val < 27 := by
    rw [hdestination]
    exact (maskExponent j).isLt
  have hfin : (⟨destination.val, hbound⟩ : Fin 27) = maskExponent j :=
    Fin.ext hdestination
  rw [hset, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode.decodedCoefficients_set
    coefficients destination z hbound, hfin, hzvalue']
  simp [j, q, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.maskCell]

#print axioms decoded_writeAt0
#print axioms decoded_writeAt1

end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientWriteMeaning
ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode:
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/-! Draft only: transport one actual Aeneas `Array.set` coefficient write to
its decoded finite-field coefficient function. No canonicality is needed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

abbrev QM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.QM
abbrev Coefficients := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.Coefficients
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

def decodedCoefficients (a : Coefficients) : Fin 27 → ExactQM :=
  fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientStep.coefficientCell a i)

/-- An in-bounds write to the actual 27-cell coefficient array decodes to the
corresponding functional `Function.update`. The destination is represented by
its `Fin 27` value, with its bound supplied explicitly. -/
theorem decodedCoefficients_set
    (a : Coefficients) (destination : Usize) (transformed : QM)
    (hbound : destination.val < 27) :
    decodedCoefficients (a.set destination transformed) =
      Function.update (decodedCoefficients a)
        ⟨destination.val, hbound⟩
        (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode transformed) := by
  funext j
  have hj : j.val < (a.set destination transformed).length := by
    simpa using j.isLt
  by_cases heq : destination.val = j.val
  · have hcell :=
      Array.getElem_Nat_set_eq a destination j.val transformed hj heq
    have hfin : (⟨destination.val, hbound⟩ : Fin 27) = j := Fin.ext heq
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
      ((a.set destination transformed)[j.val]) = _
    rw [hcell]
    simp [hfin]
  · have hcell :=
      Array.getElem_Nat_set_ne a destination j.val transformed hj heq
    have hfin : (⟨destination.val, hbound⟩ : Fin 27) ≠ j := by
      intro h
      exact heq (congrArg Fin.val h)
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
      ((a.set destination transformed)[j.val]) = _
    rw [hcell]
    rw [Function.update_of_ne (Ne.symm hfin)]
    rfl

#print axioms decodedCoefficients_set

end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientDecode
ExtractedMaskCoefficientScheduledSum:
import ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

/-! Draft only: reindex a length-27 polynomial coefficient evaluation by the
actual two disjoint sparse schedules. The proof uses a finite equivalence and
symbolic sums; it does not expand coefficients or evaluate a recurrence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientScheduledSum

open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientArray
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule

abbrev ScheduleIndex := (Fin 16 ⊕ Fin 10) ⊕ PUnit

def exceptionIndex : Fin 27 := ⟨23, by omega⟩

def scheduleIndex : ScheduleIndex → Fin 27
  | Sum.inl (Sum.inl j) => c1Exponent j
  | Sum.inl (Sum.inr j) => maskExponent j
  | Sum.inr _ => exceptionIndex

private theorem c1_ne_exception (j : Fin 16) :
    c1Exponent j ≠ exceptionIndex := by
  intro h
  have hne := (schedules_cover_except_23 (c1Exponent j)).mp
    (Or.inl ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  exact hne (by simpa [exceptionIndex] using hv)

private theorem mask_ne_exception (j : Fin 10) :
    maskExponent j ≠ exceptionIndex := by
  intro h
  have hne := (schedules_cover_except_23 (maskExponent j)).mp
    (Or.inr ⟨j, rfl⟩)
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val h
  exact hne (by simpa [exceptionIndex] using hv)

private theorem scheduleIndex_injective : Function.Injective scheduleIndex := by
  intro a b hab
  cases a with
  | inl a =>
    cases a with
    | inl i =>
      cases b with
      | inl b =>
        cases b with
        | inl j =>
          change c1Exponent i = c1Exponent j at hab
          have hij := factor_schedule_injective hab
          exact congrArg Sum.inl (congrArg Sum.inl hij)
        | inr j => exact False.elim (schedules_disjoint i j hab)
      | inr unit => exact False.elim (c1_ne_exception i hab)
    | inr i =>
      cases b with
      | inl b =>
        cases b with
        | inl j => exact False.elim (schedules_disjoint j i hab.symm)
        | inr j =>
          change maskExponent i = maskExponent j at hab
          have hij := mask_schedule_injective hab
          exact congrArg Sum.inl (congrArg Sum.inr hij)
      | inr unit => exact False.elim (mask_ne_exception i hab)
  | inr unit =>
    cases b with
    | inl b =>
      cases b with
      | inl j => exact False.elim (c1_ne_exception j hab.symm)
      | inr j => exact False.elim (mask_ne_exception j hab.symm)
    | inr unit2 =>
      have : unit = unit2 := Subsingleton.elim _ _
      subst unit2
      rfl

private theorem scheduleIndex_surjective : Function.Surjective scheduleIndex := by
  intro e
  by_cases he : e.val = 23
  · refine ⟨Sum.inr PUnit.unit, ?_⟩
    apply Fin.ext
    simpa [scheduleIndex, exceptionIndex] using he.symm
  · have hc := (schedules_cover_except_23 e).mpr he
    rcases hc with ⟨j, hj⟩ | ⟨j, hj⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inl j), by simpa [scheduleIndex] using hj⟩
    · exact ⟨Sum.inl (Sum.inr j), by simpa [scheduleIndex] using hj⟩

/-- The source schedule, together with the exceptional zero cell 23, is a
bijection with all 27 coefficient positions. -/
noncomputable def scheduleEquiv : ScheduleIndex ≃ Fin 27 :=
  Equiv.ofBijective scheduleIndex ⟨scheduleIndex_injective, scheduleIndex_surjective⟩

/-- Reindexing a weighted coefficient evaluation by the exact 16+10 schedule.
The only coefficient assumption is that the unfilled cell 23 is zero; `h₁`
and `h₂` identify values at the actual table destinations. -/
theorem weightedCoefficientSum_eq_scheduled
    {E : Type} [CommSemiring E]
    (coefficients : Fin 27 → E) (x : E)
    (c1Values : Fin 16 → E) (maskValues : Fin 10 → E)
    (h1 : ∀ j, coefficients (c1Exponent j) = c1Values j)
    (h2 : ∀ j, coefficients (maskExponent j) = maskValues j)
    (hzero : coefficients exceptionIndex = 0) :
    (∑ e : Fin 27, coefficients e * x ^ e.val) =
      (∑ j : Fin 16, c1Values j * x ^ (c1Exponent j).val) +
      ∑ j : Fin 10, maskValues j * x ^ (maskExponent j).val := by
  classical
  let term : Fin 27 → E := fun e => coefficients e * x ^ e.val
  calc
    (∑ e : Fin 27, coefficients e * x ^ e.val) =
        ∑ d : ScheduleIndex.{0}, term (scheduleIndex d) := by
      simpa [term, scheduleEquiv] using
        (Equiv.sum_comp scheduleEquiv term).symm
    _ =
      (∑ j : Fin 16, c1Values j * x ^ (c1Exponent j).val) +
        ∑ j : Fin 10, maskValues j * x ^ (maskExponent j).val := by
      have h23 : coefficients (23 : Fin 27) = 0 := by
        simpa [exceptionIndex] using hzero
      simp [term, scheduleIndex, exceptionIndex, h1, h2, h23]

#print axioms weightedCoefficientSum_eq_scheduled

end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientScheduledSum

import R1ExactBaseProjection
import R1GenericPackBasis

/-! A concrete mathematical basis for the four-coordinate packing map in the
exact retained tower. This is algebraic basis plumbing only; it does not
refine the optimized Rust limb implementation. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ConcretePackBasis

open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower

abbrev E := WideExact
abbrev F := AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed.fieldRange

/-- The image of the CM31 generator in the exact wide tower. -/
def iE : E :=
  (algebraMap QM31Exact WideExact)
    ((algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact) AspisWideTower.cm31I)

/-- The image of the QM31 generator in the exact wide tower. -/
def uE : E :=
  (algebraMap QM31Exact WideExact) AspisWideTower.wideU

/-- In these nested quadratic coordinates, the four packed coefficients are
exactly the first four coordinates of WideExact. -/
theorem packing_coordinates (a b c d : M31Exact) :
    AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed a +
        iE * AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed b +
        uE * AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed c +
        iE * uE * AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed d =
      (⟨⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨c, d⟩⟩, 0⟩ : WideExact) := by
  ext <;> simp [iE, uE, AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed,
    AspisWideTower.cm31I, AspisWideTower.wideU, mul_add, add_mul,
    mul_assoc, add_assoc]

/-- The concrete coordinate identity implies independence before passing to
coefficients in the embedded field range. -/
theorem independent (a b c d : M31Exact)
    (h : AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed a +
        iE * AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed b +
        uE * AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed c +
        iE * uE * AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed d = 0) :
    a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 ∧ d = 0 := by
  have hz : (⟨⟨⟨a, b⟩, ⟨c, d⟩⟩, 0⟩ : WideExact) = 0 :=
    (packing_coordinates a b c d).symm.trans h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.re.re) hz
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.re.im) hz
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.im.re) hz
  · simpa using congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.im.im) hz

/-- `{1, i, u, i*u}` is independent over the embedded M31 base. -/
noncomputable def basis : R0P.PackBasis F := by
  refine GenericPackBasis.ofEmbedding AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed iE uE ?_
  intro a b c d h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [iE, uE, AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed,
      AspisWideTower.cm31I, AspisWideTower.wideU] using
      congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.re.re) h
  · simpa [iE, uE, AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed,
      AspisWideTower.cm31I, AspisWideTower.wideU] using
      congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.re.im) h
  · simpa [iE, uE, AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed,
      AspisWideTower.cm31I, AspisWideTower.wideU] using
      congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.im.re) h
  · simpa [iE, uE, AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection.embed,
      AspisWideTower.cm31I, AspisWideTower.wideU] using
      congrArg (fun z : WideExact => z.re.im.im) h

#print axioms packing_coordinates
#print axioms independent
#print axioms basis

end AspisR1.ConcretePackBasis
R1ExactBaseProjection:
import WideTower

/-! An explicit coordinate projection from the exact wide tower to its prime
field base.  The projection is only a left inverse on the embedded base;
it is not asserted to preserve field operations on arbitrary wide values. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection

open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower

/-- The canonical prime-field embedding into the full exact tower. -/
def embed : M31Exact →+* WideExact :=
  (algebraMap QM31Exact WideExact).comp
    ((algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact).comp
      (algebraMap M31Exact CM31Exact))

/-- Select the three nested real coordinates. -/
def project (x : WideExact) : M31Exact := x.re.re.re

/-- On an embedded prime-field value, the coordinate projection is exact. -/
theorem project_embed (x : M31Exact) : project (embed x) = x := by
  simp [project, embed]

/-- Every point in the embedding's field range is recovered by embedding its
explicit coordinate projection. -/
theorem embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange {x : WideExact}
    (hx : x ∈ embed.fieldRange) : embed (project x) = x := by
  obtain ⟨a, rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hx
  simp [project_embed]

/-- Membership in the embedded base is exactly agreement with the canonical
embedding of the extracted coordinate. -/
theorem mem_fieldRange_iff_project (x : WideExact) :
    x ∈ embed.fieldRange ↔ embed (project x) = x := by
  constructor
  · exact embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange
  · intro hx
    rw [← hx]
    exact RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mpr ⟨project x, rfl⟩

#print axioms project_embed
#print axioms embed_project_of_mem_fieldRange
#print axioms mem_fieldRange_iff_project

end AspisR1.ExactBaseProjection
R1GenericPackBasis:
import R0P.CoreExt

/-! Construct a `PackBasis` over the range of a field embedding from a
four-coordinate independence statement in the source field. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.GenericPackBasis

def ofEmbedding {K E : Type} [Field K] [Field E]
    (e : K →+* E) (i u : E)
    (h_ind : ∀ a b c d : K,
      e a + i * e b + u * e c + i * u * e d = 0 →
        a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 ∧ d = 0) :
    R0P.PackBasis e.fieldRange := by
  refine ⟨i, u, ?_⟩
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hsum
  obtain ⟨a₀, ha₀⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp ha
  obtain ⟨b₀, hb₀⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hb
  obtain ⟨c₀, hc₀⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hc
  obtain ⟨d₀, hd₀⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hd
  have hcoeff := h_ind a₀ b₀ c₀ d₀ (by
    rw [ha₀, hb₀, hc₀, hd₀]
    exact hsum)
  rcases hcoeff with ⟨ha₀zero, hb₀zero, hc₀zero, hd₀zero⟩
  constructor
  · calc
      a = e a₀ := ha₀.symm
      _ = e 0 := by rw [ha₀zero]
      _ = 0 := map_zero _
  constructor
  · calc
      b = e b₀ := hb₀.symm
      _ = e 0 := by rw [hb₀zero]
      _ = 0 := map_zero _
  constructor
  · calc
      c = e c₀ := hc₀.symm
      _ = e 0 := by rw [hc₀zero]
      _ = 0 := map_zero _
  · calc
      d = e d₀ := hd₀.symm
      _ = e 0 := by rw [hd₀zero]
      _ = 0 := map_zero _

#print axioms ofEmbedding

end AspisR1.GenericPackBasis

import SelectorArrayMapRuntimeSlice

/-! Focused success rule for the dependent match in the extracted array map.
The successful discriminant is identified by Result injection before the
length-certificate proof is compared. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace Aeneas.Std
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

theorem core.array.Array.map_success
    {T U F : Type} {N : Usize}
    (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F T U) (self : Array T N) (f : F)
    (ys : List U) (last : F)
    (hstate : mapState callback.call_mut self.val f = .ok (ys, last)) :
    core.array.Array.map callback self f =
      .ok ⟨ys, (mapState_length _ _ _ _ _ hstate).trans self.property⟩ := by
  unfold core.array.Array.map
  split
  · rename_i ys' last' heq
    have hpair : (ys', last') = (ys, last) := Result.ok.inj (heq.symm.trans hstate)
    cases hpair
    rfl
  · rename_i error heq
    have hbad : Result.fail error = Result.ok (ys, last) := heq.symm.trans hstate
    cases hbad
  · rename_i heq
    have hbad : Result.div = Result.ok (ys, last) := heq.symm.trans hstate
    cases hbad

#print axioms core.array.Array.map_success

end Aeneas.Std

import Aeneas.Std.Array.Array
import Aeneas.Std.Core.Ops

/-! Minimal exact declaration slice from AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime for
state-threaded array mapping. The definitions are retained verbatim; the
unrelated quartic-field import and traversal models are omitted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def mapState {T U F : Type} (call : F → T → Result (U × F)) :
    List T → F → Result (List U × F)
  | [], state => .ok ([],state)
  | x::xs, state => do
    let (y,state') ← call state x
    let (ys,state'') ← mapState call xs state'
    .ok (y::ys,state'')

theorem mapState_length {T U F : Type} (call : F → T → Result (U × F))
    (xs : List T) (state : F) (ys : List U) (last : F)
    (h : mapState call xs state = .ok (ys,last)) : ys.length = xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing state ys last with
  | nil => simp [mapState] at h; rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [mapState] at h
    cases hc : call state x with
    | fail e => simp [hc] at h
    | div => simp [hc] at h
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨y,state'⟩
      cases hm : mapState call xs state' with
      | fail e => simp [hc,hm] at h
      | div => simp [hc,hm] at h
      | ok pair =>
        rcases pair with ⟨tail,state''⟩
        simp only [hc,hm,bind_tc_ok,Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq] at h
        rcases h with ⟨rfl,rfl⟩
        simp only [List.length_cons,ih _ _ _ hm]

end AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

namespace Aeneas.Std
open Result AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

def core.array.Array.map {T F U : Type} {N : Usize}
    (callback : core.ops.function.FnMut F T U) (self : Array T N) (f : F) :
    Result (Array U N) :=
  match h : mapState callback.call_mut self.val f with
  | .ok (ys,_last) => .ok ⟨ys,(mapState_length _ _ _ _ _ h).trans self.property⟩
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

end Aeneas.Std

/-! Component contract for the exact generated width-four row wrapper. It
composes the generated from_fn copy wrapper with the already-proved four-lane

terminal theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowWrapper

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalAllRows
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExtensionWords
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd

abbrev Input := AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowClosure.Input

private theorem small_nat_usize (n : Nat) (hn : n < 4) :
    n < 2 ^ Std.UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
  have hpow : 4 < 2 ^ Std.UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [Std.UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  omega

private def toUsize4 (i : Fin 4) : Usize :=
  Usize.ofNatCore i.val (small_nat_usize i.val i.isLt)

private theorem toUsize4_val (i : Fin 4) : (toUsize4 i).val = i.val := by
  simp [toUsize4, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]

private theorem toUsize4_eq (i : Fin 4) (x : Usize) (hx : x.val = i.val) :
    toUsize4 i = x := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  simp [toUsize4_val, hx]

/-- The exact Nat row formula used by G's callback at one input limb. -/
def rawRowFormula (input : Input) (output : Fin 4) (limb : Usize)
    (hlimb : limb.val < 4) : Nat :=
  RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat
    (fun r : Fin 4 => (RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.limbValue input r limb hlimb).val)
    output

theorem rawRowFormula_bound (input : Input) (output : Fin 4)
    (limb : Usize) (hlimb : limb.val < 4) :
    rawRowFormula input output limb hlimb < 2^35 := by
  apply RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat_lt_two_pow_35
  intro r
  exact (RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.limbValue input r limb hlimb).bv.isLt

private theorem callback_value
    (input : Input) (output : Fin 4) (limb : Usize) (hlimb : limb.val < 4) :
    ∃ z : U64,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64.call_mut
        (input, toUsize4 output) limb = .ok (z, (input, toUsize4 output)) ∧
      z.val = rawRowFormula input output limb hlimb := by
  obtain ⟨z0, z1, z2, z3, hc0, hv0, hc1, hv1, hc2, hv2, hc3, hv3⟩ :=
    call_mut_all_lanes_of_array_bounds input limb hlimb
  fin_cases output
  · have ho : toUsize4 (⟨0, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 0#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [toUsize4_val]
    refine ⟨z0, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ho]
      exact hc0
    · simpa [rawRowFormula, RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat,
      RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.rawRowNat] using hv0
  · have ho : toUsize4 (⟨1, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 1#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [toUsize4_val]
    refine ⟨z1, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ho]
      exact hc1
    · simpa [rawRowFormula, RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat,
      RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.rawRowNat] using hv1
  · have ho : toUsize4 (⟨2, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 2#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [toUsize4_val]
    refine ⟨z2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ho]
      exact hc2
    · simpa [rawRowFormula, RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat,
      RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.rawRowNat] using hv2
  · have ho : toUsize4 (⟨3, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 3#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      simp [toUsize4_val]
    refine ⟨z3, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [ho]
      exact hc3
    · simpa [rawRowFormula, RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat,
      RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.rawRowNat] using hv3

private def callbackValue (input : Input) (output : Fin 4) (n : Nat) : U64 :=
  if hn : n < 4 then
    let limb := toUsize4 ⟨n, hn⟩
    let hl : limb.val < 4 := by simpa [limb, toUsize4_val] using hn
    U64.ofNatCore (rawRowFormula input output limb hl) (by
      have h := rawRowFormula_bound input output limb hl
      simp only [UScalarTy.U64_numBits_eq]
      omega)
  else 0#u64

theorem external_linear_lazy_row_words
    (input : Input) (output : Fin 4) :
    ∃ raw : Array U64 4#usize, ∃ q : field.QM31,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input (toUsize4 output) = .ok q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM q ∧
      wordsQM q =
        (((raw.val[0]'(by simpa [raw.property] using (show 0 < 4 by decide))).val % P,
           (raw.val[1]'(by simpa [raw.property] using (show 1 < 4 by decide))).val % P),
          ((raw.val[2]'(by simpa [raw.property] using (show 2 < 4 by decide))).val % P,
           (raw.val[3]'(by simpa [raw.property] using (show 3 < 4 by decide))).val % P)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 4,
        (raw.val[j.val]'(by simpa [raw.property] using j.isLt)).val =
          rawRowFormula input output (toUsize4 j)
            (show (toUsize4 j).val < 4 by simpa [toUsize4_val] using j.isLt)) := by
  let inst := state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
  let value : Nat → U64 := callbackValue input output
  have hstable : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < 4 →
      inst.call_mut (input, toUsize4 output) i =
        .ok (value i.val, (input, toUsize4 output)) := by
    intro i hi
    let ix : Fin 4 := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
    have hix : toUsize4 ix = i := toUsize4_eq ix i rfl
    obtain ⟨z, hcall, hz⟩ := callback_value input output i hi
    have hv : value i.val = z := by
      dsimp [value, callbackValue]
      rw [dif_pos hi]
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      have hz' : rawRowFormula input output (toUsize4 ix)
          (by simpa [toUsize4_val] using hi) = z.val := by
        simpa only [hix] using hz.symm
      simpa only [U64.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hz'
    simpa [inst, hv] using hcall
  obtain ⟨raw, hrun, hcells⟩ :=
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.array_from_fn_copy_stable

      z.val = 2*a.val + 3*b.val + c.val + d.val := by
  have h5 : (2#u64).val * a.val < 2^64 := by
    change 2 * a.val < 2^64
    omega
  obtain ⟨i5, hi5, hv5⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.mul_success (2#u64) a h5
  have h6 : (3#u64).val * b.val < 2^64 := by
    change 3 * b.val < 2^64
    omega
  obtain ⟨i6, hi6, hv6⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.mul_success (3#u64) b h6
  rw [show (2#u64).val = 2 by decide] at hv5
  rw [show (3#u64).val = 3 by decide] at hv6
  have h7 : i5.val + i6.val < 2^64 := by rw [hv5, hv6]; omega
  obtain ⟨i7, hi7, hv7⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.add_success i5 i6 h7
  have h8 : i7.val + c.val < 2^64 := by rw [hv7]; omega
  obtain ⟨i8, hi8, hv8⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.add_success i7 c h8
  have h9 : i8.val + d.val < 2^64 := by rw [hv8]; omega
  obtain ⟨i9, hi9, hv9⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.add_success i8 d h9
  refine ⟨i9, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (do
      let i5 ← UScalar.mul (2#u64) a
      let i6 ← UScalar.mul (3#u64) b
      let i7 ← UScalar.add i5 i6
      let i8 ← UScalar.add i7 c
      let i9 ← UScalar.add i8 d
      Result.ok i9) = Result.ok i9
    change UScalar.mul (2#u64) a = Result.ok i5 at hi5
    change UScalar.mul (3#u64) b = Result.ok i6 at hi6
    change UScalar.add i5 i6 = Result.ok i7 at hi7
    change UScalar.add i7 c = Result.ok i8 at hi8
    change UScalar.add i8 d = Result.ok i9 at hi9
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, hi5, hi6, hi7, hi8, hi9]
  · simpa only [hv5, hv6, hv7, hv8] using hv9

/-- The generated output-0 branch after its four indexed reads. The helper
keeps the exact conversion and operation order of G's `call_mut` body. -/
def row0FromU32 (a b c d : Std.U32) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let a64 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a)
  let b64 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b)
  let c64 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c)

theorem row0FromU32_success (a b c d : Std.U32) :
    ∃ z : Std.U64, row0FromU32 a b c d = .ok z ∧
      z.val = 2*a.val + 3*b.val + c.val + d.val := by
  have ha : a.val < 2^32 := by exact a.bv.isLt
  have hb : b.val < 2^32 := by exact b.bv.isLt
  have hc : c.val < 2^32 := by exact c.bv.isLt
  have hd : d.val < 2^32 := by exact d.bv.isLt
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hv⟩ := row0FromWide_success
    (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a)
    (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b)
    (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c)
    (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from d)
    (by rw [widen_value]; exact ha) (by rw [widen_value]; exact hb)
    (by rw [widen_value]; exact hc) (by rw [widen_value]; exact hd)
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [row0FromU32, row0FromWide, Aeneas.Std.lift, bind_tc_ok,
      hz]
  · simpa only [widen_value] using hv

/-- Output-lane 0 of the generated G closure call. The four indexed reads are
explicit; `hlimb` records the dynamic inner-array index range. -/
theorem call_mut_output0
    (input : Input) (limb : Std.Usize)
    (r0 r1 r2 r3 : Array Std.U32 4#usize)
    (x0 x1 x2 x3 : Std.U32)
    (hr0 : Array.index_usize input 0#usize = .ok r0)
    (hr1 : Array.index_usize input 1#usize = .ok r1)
    (hr2 : Array.index_usize input 2#usize = .ok r2)
    (hr3 : Array.index_usize input 3#usize = .ok r3)
    (hx0 : Array.index_usize r0 limb = .ok x0)
    (hx1 : Array.index_usize r1 limb = .ok x1)
    (hx2 : Array.index_usize r2 limb = .ok x2)
    (hx3 : Array.index_usize r3 limb = .ok x3)
    (hlimb : limb.val < 4) :
    ∃ z : Std.U64,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64.call_mut
        (input, 0#usize) limb = .ok (z, (input, 0#usize)) ∧
      z.val = 2*x0.val + 3*x1.val + x2.val + x3.val := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hv⟩ := row0FromU32_success x0 x1 x2 x3
  refine ⟨z, ?_, hv⟩
  have hidx : (0#usize).val = 0 := by decide
  have hz' : (do
      let out ← row0FromU32 x0 x1 x2 x3
      (Result.ok (out, (input, 0#usize)) :
        Result (Std.U64 × state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row.closure))) =
      (Result.ok (z, (input, 0#usize)) :
        Result (Std.U64 × state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row.closure)) := by
    simp [hz, bind_tc_ok]
  simpa only [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64.call_mut,
    hr0, hr1, hr2, hr3, hx0, hx1, hx2, hx3, hidx,
    row0FromU32, row0FromWide, Aeneas.Std.lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq] using hz'

RawPoseidonExternalRows:
import R0P.Poseidon

/-!
Model algebra for the four raw row formulas in the isolated `external_linear_lazy_row`
helper.  These lemmas are not a refinement theorem for its generated Rust/Aeneas
body. In particular, reduction of its `u64` limbs is a separate step.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def rowFormula (v : Fin 4 → K) (r : Fin 4) : K :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => 2 * v 0 + 3 * v 1 + v 2 + v 3
  | 1 => v 0 + 2 * v 1 + 3 * v 2 + v 3
  | 2 => v 0 + v 1 + 2 * v 2 + 3 * v 3
  | _ => 3 * v 0 + v 1 + v 2 + 2 * v 3

theorem rowFormula_eq_poseidonMat4 (v : Fin 4 → K) (r : Fin 4) :
    rowFormula v r = poseidonMat4 v r := by
  fin_cases r <;> simp [rowFormula, poseidonMat4] <;> ring

/-- The raw integer formulas used before reduction. -/
def rawRowNat (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (r : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  match r.val with
  | 0 => 2 * v 0 + 3 * v 1 + v 2 + v 3
  | 1 => v 0 + 2 * v 1 + 3 * v 2 + v 3
  | 2 => v 0 + v 1 + 2 * v 2 + 3 * v 3
  | _ => 3 * v 0 + v 1 + v 2 + 2 * v 3

theorem rawRowNat_lt_two_pow_35
    (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (r : Fin 4)
    (h : ∀ i, v i < 2^32) : rawRowNat v r < 2^35 := by
  fin_cases r <;> simp [rawRowNat] <;> have h0 := h 0 <;> have h1 := h 1 <;>
    have h2 := h 2 <;> have h3 := h 3 <;> omega

theorem rawRowNat_lt_two_pow_62
    (v : Fin 4 → Nat) (r : Fin 4)
    (h : ∀ i, v i < 2^32) : rawRowNat v r < 2^62 := by
  have hsmall := rawRowNat_lt_two_pow_35 v r h
  omega

end AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows

#print axioms AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat_lt_two_pow_35
#print axioms AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat_lt_two_pow_62

/-!
Proof drafts for generated G callback lanes 1–3. These retain the generated
operation order and depend on the lane-0 helper module; they do not prove the
`from_fn` row or the parent `Array.map`.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowLanes

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowClosure

/-- Generated lane 1 arithmetic after widening its four U32 reads. -/
def row1FromWide (a b c d : Std.U64) : Result Std.U64 := do
  let i5 ← 2#u64 * b
  let i6 ← a + i5
  let i7 ← 3#u64 * c
  let i8 ← i6 + i7
  let i9 ← i8 + d
  ok i9

theorem row1FromWide_success (a b c d : Std.U64)
    (ha : a.val < 2^32) (hb : b.val < 2^32)
    (hc : c.val < 2^32) (hd : d.val < 2^32) :
    ∃ z : Std.U64, row1FromWide a b c d = .ok z ∧
      z.val = a.val + 2*b.val + 3*c.val + d.val := by
  have h5 : (2#u64).val * b.val < 2^64 := by
    change 2 * b.val < 2^64
    omega
  obtain ⟨i5, hi5, hv5⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.mul_success (2#u64) b h5
  change UScalar.mul (2#u64) b = Result.ok i5 at hi5
  rw [show (2#u64).val = 2 by rfl] at hv5
  have h6 : a.val + i5.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv5]
    omega
  obtain ⟨i6, hi6, hv6⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.add_success a i5 h6
  change UScalar.add a i5 = Result.ok i6 at hi6
  have h7 : (3#u64).val * c.val < 2^64 := by
    change 3 * c.val < 2^64
    omega
  obtain ⟨i7, hi7, hv7⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.mul_success (3#u64) c h7

import Aeneas.Std.RangeIter

/-! Focused reuse of the already-checked Aeneas forward-range WP proofs from
`ExtractedMaskForwardRange`: the occupancy literal loop consumes precisely
these `Range Usize` step/termination facts. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

/-- At or beyond the end, the actual forward iterator returns `none` and the
unchanged range. Reused verbatim from ExtractedMaskForwardRange.next_done. -/
theorem next_done (iter : Range) (hge : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val) :
    core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
      .ok (none, iter) := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hspec⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_none_spec
      (partialOrdInst := core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize) (by intros; rfl) iter hge)
  rcases out with ⟨opt, iter1⟩
  rcases hspec with ⟨hopt, hiter⟩
  cases hopt
  cases hiter
  exact hrun

/-- Below the end, the iterator yields its old start and an incremented range.
Reused verbatim from ExtractedMaskForwardRange.next_step. -/
theorem next_step (iter : Range) (hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val) :
    ∃ iter1 : Range,
      core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter =
        .ok (some iter.start, iter1) ∧
      iter1.start.val = iter.start.val + 1 ∧
      iter1.end = iter.end ∧
      iter.start.val + 1 ≤ Usize.max := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hspec⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Aeneas.Std.core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next_UScalar_some_spec
      (cloneInst := core.clone.CloneUsize)
      (partialOrdInst := core.cmp.PartialOrdUsize)
      (by intros; rfl) (by intros; rfl) iter hlt)
  rcases out with ⟨opt, iter1⟩
  rcases hspec with ⟨hopt, hstart, hend⟩
  cases hopt
  have hbound : iter.start.val + 1 ≤ Usize.max := by
    have hb : iter.start.val + 1 < 2 ^ System.Platform.numBits := by
      simpa [Usize.numBits, UScalarTy.numBits, hstart] using iter1.start.hBounds
    have hb' : iter.start.val + 1 ≤ 2 ^ System.Platform.numBits - 1 := by omega
    simpa [Usize.max, Usize.numBits, UScalarTy.numBits] using hb'
  exact ⟨iter1, hrun, hstart, hend, hbound⟩

#print axioms next_done
#print axioms next_step
end AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal

      (cell16 stage g column) =
      R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (cell16 input g k)) column := by
    simpa [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Reassembly.Decode, Decode] using hmat g column
  rw [hm 0, hm 1, hm 2, hm 3]
  simp only [zero_add]

private def decodeState (s : State) : Fin 16 → Exact := fun i => Decode (cell s i)

private theorem input_group_cell (input : State) (g j : Fin 4) :
    Decode (cell16 input g j) = decodeState input ⟨4*g.val+j.val, by
      have := g.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩ := by
  change Decode (cell input (⟨4*g.val+j.val, by
    have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
    have := g.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 16)) =
      Decode (cell input ⟨4*g.val+j.val, by
        have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
        have := g.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega⟩)
  rfl

theorem external_linear_lazy_success (input : State)
    (hinput : CanonicalState input) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy input = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, Decode (cell out i) =
        R0P.poseidonExternalLinear (decodeState input) i := by
  obtain ⟨stage,hloop0,hgroupModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopFuel.loop0_all_groups input
  obtain ⟨stageCan,hloop0Can,hstageCan⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopCanonical.loop0_success_canonical_fuel
      input 0#usize 4 (by decide) hinput
  have hstageEq : stageCan = stage := Result.ok.inj (hloop0Can.symm.trans hloop0)
  subst stageCan
  obtain ⟨sums,hsumsRun,hcolumns,hsumsBound⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSums.source_success stage
  have hcolumns' : ∀ i j : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnArrayCall.columnTotal stage
        (UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)) (by scalar_tac) j
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSums.sumWordAt sums i j) := by
    intro i j
    simpa [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSums.sumWordAt,
      AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell] using hcolumns i j
  have hcolumnModel (column : Fin 4) :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSumField.source_column_decode
      stage sums hcolumns' column
  have hsumBound : ∀ i j : Fin 4,
      (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Call.sumWordAt sums i j).val < 2^34 := by
    intro i j
    simpa [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Call.sumWordAt,
      AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSums.sumWordAt,
      AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell] using hsumsBound i j
  have hinvariant : AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.loopModel stage stage sums 0 := by
    intro i
    simp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.loopModel]
  obtain ⟨out,hloop1,houtCan,hloop1Model⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.loop1_success_fuel
      stage stage sums 0#usize 16 (by decide) hinvariant hstageCan hsumBound
  have hsource : state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy input = .ok out := by
    simp [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy,hloop0,hsumsRun,bind_tc_ok,hloop1]
  have hmat : ∀ g j : Fin 4,
      Decode (cell16 stage g j) =
        R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (cell16 input g k)) j := by
    intro g j
    have h := hgroupModel g j
    rw [← cell16_eq_cellAt stage g j] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨out,hsource,houtCan,?_⟩
  intro i
  have hvalue := hloop1Model i
  simp only [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.loopModel, if_pos i.isLt] at hvalue
  let group : Fin 4 := ⟨i.val / 4, by omega⟩
  let column : Fin 4 := ⟨i.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
  have hindex : (⟨4*group.val+column.val, by
      have := group.isLt; have := column.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 16) = i := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [group,column]
    omega
  have hlocal : Decode (cell stage i) =
      R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (cell16 input group k)) column := by
    have hm := hmat group column
    have hcell : cell16 stage group column = cell stage i := by
      rw [← hindex]
      exact cell16_eq_cell stage group column
    rw [hcell] at hm
    exact hm
  have hinc : AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.incrementAt sums i =
      AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSumField.fieldColumnSum stage column := by
    dsimp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.incrementAt]
    have hcol := hcolumnModel column
    have hfin : (⟨i.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ : Fin 4) = column := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [column]
    rw [hfin]
    exact hcol
  have hfield := field_column_model input stage column hmat
  have hmodelRhs : Decode (cell stage i) +
      AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel.incrementAt sums i =
      R0P.poseidonExternalLinear (decodeState input) i := by
    rw [hlocal,hinc,hfield]
    simp [R0P.poseidonExternalLinear,decodeState,group,column,input_group_cell]
  exact hvalue.trans hmodelRhs

#print axioms external_linear_lazy_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLinearExact

import PoseidonExternalLoopStep
import Aeneas.Std.WP
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopCanonical
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupBlockCanonical
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize

theorem loop0_success_canonical_fuel (current : State) (group : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : group.val + fuel = 4) (hcanonical : CanonicalState current) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 current group = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out := by
  induction fuel generalizing current group with
  | zero =>
      have hgroup : group.val = 4 := by omega
      have hstop : ¬ group < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
      exact ⟨current, by rw [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0.eq_def, if_neg hstop], hcanonical⟩
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hgroup : group.val < 4 := by omega
      obtain ⟨out,group1,hstep,hinc,_⟩ := loop0_step current group hgroup
      obtain ⟨blockOut,hblock,hblockCan⟩ :=
        AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupBlockCanonical.group_block_canonical current group hgroup hcanonical
      have hplusSpec : (group + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = group.val + 1⦄ := by
        apply UScalar.add_spec
        scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨z,hplus,hplusval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplusSpec
      have hz : z = group1 := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; omega
      subst z
      have hspan' : group1.val + fuel = 4 := by rw [hinc]; omega
      obtain ⟨final,hrec,hfinalCan⟩ := ih blockOut group1 hspan' hblockCan
      refine ⟨final, ?_, hfinalCan⟩
      have hstep' := hstep
      simp only [hblock, hplus, bind_tc_ok] at hstep'
      rw [hstep']
      exact hrec

#print axioms loop0_success_canonical_fuel
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopCanonical
AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopFuel:
import PoseidonExternalLoopStep
import PoseidonExternalGroupBlockFrame
import PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells
import AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel
import Aeneas.Std.WP
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopFuel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupBlockFrame
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells
open AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel
abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

def groupModel (original current : State) (limit : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ g : Fin 4, ∀ j : Fin 4,
    if g.val < limit then
      Decode (cellAt current (4 * g.val + j.val)) =
        R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (cell16 original g k)) j
    else
      Decode (cellAt current (4 * g.val + j.val)) =
        Decode (cellAt original (4 * g.val + j.val))

private theorem cell16_eq_cellAt (a : State) (g j : Fin 4) :
    cell16 a g j = cellAt a (4 * g.val + j.val) := by
  have hidx : 4 * g.val + j.val < 16 := by have := g.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega
  simp [cell16, cellAt, hidx]

theorem loop0_success_fuel (original current : State) (group : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : group.val + fuel = 4)
    (hinvariant : groupModel original current group.val) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 current group = .ok out ∧
      groupModel original out 4 := by
  induction fuel generalizing current group with
  | zero =>
      have hgroup : group.val = 4 := by omega
      have hstop : ¬ group < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
      refine ⟨current, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0.eq_def, if_neg hstop]
      · intro g j
        simpa [groupModel, hgroup] using hinvariant g j
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hgroup : group.val < 4 := by omega
      obtain ⟨out, group1, hstep, hinc, _⟩ := loop0_step current group hgroup
      obtain ⟨outBlock, hblock, hframe⟩ :=
        AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupBlockFrame.group_block_frame current group hgroup
      obtain ⟨outBody, hbody, hbodyModel⟩ :=
        AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopGroupBody.group_body_success current group hgroup
      have hblockBody : groupBlock current group = .ok outBody := by
        simpa only [groupBlock] using hbody
      have houts : outBody = outBlock := Result.ok.inj (hblockBody.symm.trans hblock)
      have hplusSpec : (group + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = group.val + 1⦄ := by
        apply UScalar.add_spec
        scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨z,hplus,hplusval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplusSpec
      have hz : z = group1 := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; omega
      subst z
      have hspan' : group1.val + fuel = 4 := by rw [hinc]; omega
      have hinvBlock : groupModel original outBlock group1.val := by
        intro g j
        by_cases heq : g.val = group.val
        · have hgEq : g = (⟨group.val,hgroup⟩ : Fin 4) := Fin.ext heq
          subst g
          have hnot : ¬ group.val < group.val := by omega
          have hin : ∀ k : Fin 4, Decode (cell16 current ⟨group.val,hgroup⟩ k) =
              Decode (cell16 original ⟨group.val,hgroup⟩ k) := by
            intro k
            have hc := hinvariant (⟨group.val,hgroup⟩ : Fin 4) k
            rw [if_neg hnot] at hc
            change Decode (cellAt current (4 * group.val + k.val)) =
              Decode (cellAt original (4 * group.val + k.val)) at hc
            simpa only [cell16_eq_cellAt] using hc
          have hm := hbodyModel j
          rw [houts] at hm
          have hfun : (fun k => Decode (cell16 current ⟨group.val,hgroup⟩ k)) =
              (fun k => Decode (cell16 original ⟨group.val,hgroup⟩ k)) := by
            funext k
            exact hin k
          rw [hfun] at hm
          simpa [groupModel, heq, hinc, hgroup] using hm
        · have hidxLt : 4 * g.val + j.val < 16 := by have := g.isLt; have := j.isLt; omega
          let ix : Fin 16 := ⟨4 * g.val + j.val, hidxLt⟩
          have hnotFrame : ∀ r : Fin 4, ix.val ≠ 4 * group.val + r.val := by
            intro r
            have hr := r.isLt
            simp [ix]
            omega
          have hfr := hframe ix hnotFrame
          have hdecodeFrame : Decode (cellAt outBlock ix.val) = Decode (cellAt current ix.val) :=
            congrArg Decode hfr
          have hprev := hinvariant g j
          by_cases hproc : g.val < group.val
          · rw [if_pos hproc] at hprev
            have hltNext : g.val < group1.val := by rw [hinc]; omega
            simp only [groupModel, if_pos hltNext]
            simpa [ix] using hdecodeFrame.trans hprev
          · have hfuture : group.val < g.val := by omega
            rw [if_neg hproc] at hprev
            have hgeNext : ¬ g.val < group1.val := by rw [hinc]; omega
            simp only [groupModel, if_neg hgeNext]
            simpa [ix] using hdecodeFrame.trans hprev
      obtain ⟨final,hrec,hmodel⟩ := ih outBlock group1 hspan' hinvBlock
      refine ⟨final, ?_, hmodel⟩
      have hrun : state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 current group =
          state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 outBlock group1 := by
        rw [hstep]
        simp only [hblock, hplus, bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hrun]
      exact hrec

theorem loop0_all_groups (state : State) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 state 0#usize = .ok out ∧
      ∀ g : Fin 4, ∀ j : Fin 4,
        Decode (cellAt out (4 * g.val + j.val)) =
          R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (cell16 state g k)) j := by
  have hinv : groupModel state state 0 := by
    intro g j
    simp [groupModel]
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hmodel⟩ := loop0_success_fuel state state 0#usize 4 (by decide) hinv
  refine ⟨out,hrun,?_⟩
  intro g j
  simpa [groupModel] using hmodel g j

#print axioms loop0_success_fuel
#print axioms loop0_all_groups
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopFuel

import PoseidonExternalLoopGroupBody
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

def groupBlock (state : State) (group : Usize) : Result State := do
  let start ← 4#usize * group
  let q ← Array.index_usize state start
  let i ← start + 1#usize
  let q1 ← Array.index_usize state i
  let i1 ← start + 2#usize
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize state i1
  let i2 ← start + 3#usize
  let q3 ← Array.index_usize state i2
  let input ← core.array.Array.map
    (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
    (Array.make 4#usize [q,q1,q2,q3]) state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
  let q4 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 0#usize
  let state1 ← Array.update state start q4
  let q5 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 1#usize
  let state2 ← state1.update i q5
  let q6 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 2#usize
  let state3 ← state2.update i1 q6
  let q7 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 3#usize
  state3.update i2 q7

theorem loop0_step (state : State) (group : Usize) (hg : group.val < 4) :
  ∃ out : State, ∃ group1 : Usize,
    state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 state group =
      (do let out ← groupBlock state group
          let group1 ← group + 1#usize
          state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 out group1) ∧
    group1.val = group.val + 1 ∧
    ∀ j : Fin 4,
      Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells.cellAt out (4 * group.val + j.val)) =
        R0P.poseidonMat4
          (fun k => Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.cell16 state ⟨group.val,hg⟩ k)) j := by
  obtain ⟨out,hbody,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopGroupBody.group_body_success state group hg
  have hplusSpec : (group + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = group.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨group1,hplus,hgroup1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplusSpec
  refine ⟨out,group1,?_,hgroup1,hmodel⟩
  have hbody' : groupBlock state group = .ok out := by
    simpa only [groupBlock] using hbody
  have hcont :
      (do let out ← groupBlock state group
          let group1 ← group + 1#usize
          state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 out group1) =
        state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0 out group1 := by
    simp only [hbody', hplus, bind_tc_ok]
  have hcontFlat := hcont
  simp only [groupBlock, bind_assoc_eq] at hcontFlat
  rw [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop0.eq_def]
  have hlt : group < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
  rw [if_pos hlt]
  conv_rhs => simp only [hbody', hplus, bind_tc_ok]
  exact hcontFlat

#print axioms loop0_step
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopStep

import PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells

import Aeneas.Std.WP
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoopGroupBody
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

theorem group_body_success (state : State) (group : Usize) (hg : group.val < 4) :
  ∃ out : State,
    (do
      let start ← 4#usize * group
      let q ← Array.index_usize state start
      let i ← start + 1#usize
      let q1 ← Array.index_usize state i
      let i1 ← start + 2#usize
      let q2 ← Array.index_usize state i1
      let i2 ← start + 3#usize
      let q3 ← Array.index_usize state i2
      let input ← core.array.Array.map
        (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
        (Array.make 4#usize [q,q1,q2,q3]) state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
      let q4 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 0#usize
      let state1 ← Array.update state start q4
      let q5 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 1#usize
      let state2 ← Array.update state1 i q5
      let q6 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 2#usize
      let state3 ← Array.update state2 i1 q6
      let q7 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 3#usize
      Array.update state3 i2 q7) = .ok out ∧
    ∀ j : Fin 4,
      Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells.cellAt out (4 * group.val + j.val)) =
        R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.cell16 state ⟨group.val,hg⟩ k)) j := by
  obtain ⟨start, finish, hrange, hstart, hfinish, hbound⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2GroupRange.group_range_success group hg
  have hmul : (4#usize * group : Result Usize) = .ok start := by
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    have hspec : (4#usize * group : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = 4 * group.val⦄ := by
      apply UScalar.mul_spec
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
    have hz' : z = start := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      omega
    simpa [hz'] using hz
  have hstartBound : start.val < 16 := by rw [hstart]; omega
  have hadd1Spec : (start + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = start.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i, hiRun, hiVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hadd1Spec
  have hadd2Spec : (start + 2#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = start.val + 2⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i1, hi1Run, hi1Val⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hadd2Spec
  have hadd3Spec : (start + 3#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = start.val + 3⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i2, hi2Run, hi2Val⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hadd3Spec
  have hidx0 : start.val = 4 * group.val := hstart
  have hidx1 : i.val = 4 * group.val + 1 := by rw [hiVal,hstart]
  have hidx2 : i1.val = 4 * group.val + 2 := by rw [hi1Val,hstart]
  have hidx3 : i2.val = 4 * group.val + 3 := by rw [hi2Val,hstart]
  have hiBound : i.val < 16 := by rw [hidx1]; omega
  have hi1Bound : i1.val < 16 := by rw [hidx2]; omega
  have hi2Bound : i2.val < 16 := by rw [hidx3]; omega
  let q0 := state.val[start.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using hstartBound)
  let q1 := state.val[i.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using hiBound)
  let q2 := state.val[i1.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using hi1Bound)
  let q3 := state.val[i2.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using hi2Bound)
  have hread0 : Array.index_usize state start = .ok q0 :=
    AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok state start hstartBound
  have hread1 : Array.index_usize state i = .ok q1 :=
    AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok state i hiBound
  have hread2 : Array.index_usize state i1 = .ok q2 :=
    AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok state i1 hi1Bound
  have hread3 : Array.index_usize state i2 = .ok q3 :=
    AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok state i2 hi2Bound
  obtain ⟨out, hupdate, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells.group_step_cell_values
      state ⟨group.val,hg⟩ q0 q1 q2 q3 start i i1 i2
      hread0 hread1 hread2 hread3 hidx0 hidx1 hidx2 hidx3
      hstartBound hiBound hi1Bound hi2Bound
  have hupdate' :
      (do
        let input ← core.array.Array.map
          (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
          (Array.make 4#usize [q0,q1,q2,q3]) state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
        let q4 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 0#usize
        let state1 ← Array.update state start q4
        let q5 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 1#usize
        let state2 ← state1.update i q5

        Array.update state3 i2 q7) = .ok out := by

import PoseidonExternalLinearGroupModelV6

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLinearGroupModel
open AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev State := Array QM 16#usize
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

def cellAt (a : State) (j : Nat) : QM :=
  if h : j < 16 then a.val[j]'(by simpa [a.property] using h) else field.QM31.ZERO

private theorem cellAt_set (a : State) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 16) (j : Nat) :
    cellAt (a.set i x) j = if j = i.val then x else cellAt a j := by
  by_cases hj : j < 16
  · by_cases heq : j = i.val
    · subst j
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq]
    · have hne : i.val ≠ j := Ne.symm heq
      have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hjA : j < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hcell := List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val)
        (j := j) hne hjSet
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, heq, hcell, hjA]
  · have hne : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hne]

theorem group_step_cell_values
    (state : State) (group : Fin 4) (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM)
    (i0 i1 i2 i3 : Usize)
    (hread0 : Array.index_usize state i0 = .ok q0)
    (hread1 : Array.index_usize state i1 = .ok q1)
    (hread2 : Array.index_usize state i2 = .ok q2)
    (hread3 : Array.index_usize state i3 = .ok q3)
    (hindex0 : i0.val = 4 * group.val)
    (hindex1 : i1.val = 4 * group.val + 1)
    (hindex2 : i2.val = 4 * group.val + 2)
    (hindex3 : i3.val = 4 * group.val + 3)
    (hi0 : i0.val < 16) (hi1 : i1.val < 16)
    (hi2 : i2.val < 16) (hi3 : i3.val < 16) :
    ∃ out : State,
      (do
        let x0 ← Array.index_usize state i0
        let x1 ← Array.index_usize state i1
        let x2 ← Array.index_usize state i2
        let x3 ← Array.index_usize state i3
        let input ← core.array.Array.map
          (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
          (Array.make 4#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3])
          state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
        let o0 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 0#usize
        let a0 ← Array.update state i0 o0
        let o1 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 1#usize
        let a1 ← Array.update a0 i1 o1
        let o2 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 2#usize
        let a2 ← Array.update a1 i2 o2
        let o3 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 3#usize
        Array.update a2 i3 o3) = .ok out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4,
        Decode (cellAt out (4 * group.val + j.val)) =
          R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun k => Decode (cell16 state group k)) j := by
  obtain ⟨v0,v1,v2,v3,s1,s2,s3,s4,hrun,hs1,hs2,hs3,hs4,hmodel⟩ :=
    group_step_model state group q0 q1 q2 q3 i0 i1 i2 i3
      hread0 hread1 hread2 hread3 hindex0 hindex1 hindex2 hindex3
      hi0 hi1 hi2 hi3
  have hget0 : cellAt s4 (4 * group.val) = v0 := by
    rw [hs4]
    rw [cellAt_set s3 i3 v3 hi3 (4 * group.val)]
    rw [hs3]
    rw [cellAt_set s2 i2 v2 hi2 (4 * group.val)]
    rw [hs2]
    rw [cellAt_set s1 i1 v1 hi1 (4 * group.val)]
    rw [hs1]
    rw [cellAt_set state i0 v0 hi0 (4 * group.val)]
    rw [hindex0, hindex1, hindex2, hindex3]
    simp <;> omega
  have hget1 : cellAt s4 (4 * group.val + 1) = v1 := by
    rw [hs4]
    rw [cellAt_set s3 i3 v3 hi3 (4 * group.val + 1)]
    rw [hs3]
    rw [cellAt_set s2 i2 v2 hi2 (4 * group.val + 1)]
    rw [hs2]
    rw [cellAt_set s1 i1 v1 hi1 (4 * group.val + 1)]
    rw [hs1]
    rw [cellAt_set state i0 v0 hi0 (4 * group.val + 1)]
    rw [hindex0, hindex1, hindex2, hindex3]
    simp <;> omega
  have hget2 : cellAt s4 (4 * group.val + 2) = v2 := by
    rw [hs4]
    rw [cellAt_set s3 i3 v3 hi3 (4 * group.val + 2)]
    rw [hs3]
    rw [cellAt_set s2 i2 v2 hi2 (4 * group.val + 2)]
    rw [hs2]
    rw [cellAt_set s1 i1 v1 hi1 (4 * group.val + 2)]
    rw [hs1]
    rw [cellAt_set state i0 v0 hi0 (4 * group.val + 2)]
    rw [hindex0, hindex1, hindex2, hindex3]
    simp <;> omega
  have hget3 : cellAt s4 (4 * group.val + 3) = v3 := by
    rw [hs4]
    rw [cellAt_set s3 i3 v3 hi3 (4 * group.val + 3)]
    rw [hs3]
    rw [cellAt_set s2 i2 v2 hi2 (4 * group.val + 3)]
    rw [hs2]
    rw [cellAt_set s1 i1 v1 hi1 (4 * group.val + 3)]
    rw [hs1]
    rw [cellAt_set state i0 v0 hi0 (4 * group.val + 3)]
    rw [hindex0, hindex1, hindex2, hindex3]
    simp <;> omega
  refine ⟨s4, hrun, ?_⟩
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · simpa [hget0] using hmodel (0 : Fin 4)
  · simpa [hget1] using hmodel (1 : Fin 4)
  · simpa [hget2] using hmodel (2 : Fin 4)
  · simpa [hget3] using hmodel (3 : Fin 4)

#print axioms group_step_cell_values
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalGroupUpdateCells
