open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLinearGroupStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev State := Array QM 16#usize
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

private theorem read_value (state : State) (i : Usize) (q : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 16)
    (hread : Array.index_usize state i = .ok q) :
    q = state.val[i.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using hi) := by
  have hget : Array.index_usize state i =
      .ok (state.val[i.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using hi)) := by
    exact AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok state i hi
  exact Result.ok.inj (hread.symm.trans hget)

theorem group_step_model
    (state : State) (group : Fin 4) (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM)
    (i0 i1 i2 i3 : Usize)
    (hread0 : Array.index_usize state i0 = .ok q0)
    (hread1 : Array.index_usize state i1 = .ok q1)
    (hread2 : Array.index_usize state i2 = .ok q2)
    (hread3 : Array.index_usize state i3 = .ok q3)
    (hindex0 : i0.val = 4 * group.val)
    (hindex1 : i1.val = 4 * group.val + 1)
    (hindex2 : i2.val = 4 * group.val + 2)
    (hindex3 : i3.val = 4 * group.val + 3)
    (hi0 : i0.val < 16) (hi1 : i1.val < 16)
    (hi2 : i2.val < 16) (hi3 : i3.val < 16) :
    ∃ v0 v1 v2 v3 : QM, ∃ s1 s2 s3 s4 : State,
      (do
        let x0 ← Array.index_usize state i0
        let x1 ← Array.index_usize state i1
        let x2 ← Array.index_usize state i2
        let x3 ← Array.index_usize state i3
        let input ← core.array.Array.map
          (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
          (Array.make 4#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3])
          state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
        let o0 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 0#usize
        let a0 ← Array.update state i0 o0
        let o1 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 1#usize
        let a1 ← Array.update a0 i1 o1
        let o2 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 2#usize
        let a2 ← Array.update a1 i2 o2
        let o3 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 3#usize
        Array.update a2 i3 o3) = .ok s4 ∧
      s1 = state.set i0 v0 ∧ s2 = s1.set i1 v1 ∧
      s3 = s2.set i2 v2 ∧ s4 = s3.set i3 v3 ∧
      (∀ r : Fin 4, Decode (match r.val with
        | 0 => v0 | 1 => v1 | 2 => v2 | _ => v3) =
        R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun j => Decode (cell16 state group j)) r) := by
  obtain ⟨v0,v1,v2,v3,s1,s2,s3,s4,hv0,hv1,hv2,hv3,hrun,hs1,hs2,hs3,hs4⟩ :=
    group_step_after_reads state q0 q1 q2 q3 i0 i1 i2 i3
      hread0 hread1 hread2 hread3 hi0 hi1 hi2 hi3
  have hq0 := read_value state i0 q0 hi0 hread0
  have hq1 := read_value state i1 q1 hi1 hread1
  have hq2 := read_value state i2 q2 hi2 hread2
  have hq3 := read_value state i3 q3 hi3 hread3
  have hc : ∀ j : Fin 4, groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 j = cell16 state group j := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [groupCell, groupInput, Array.make, cell16,
      hq0, hq1, hq2, hq3,
      hindex0, hindex1, hindex2, hindex3]
  have hv0model : Decode v0 = R0P.poseidonMat4
      (fun j => Decode (groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 j)) (0 : Fin 4) := by
    obtain ⟨w, hcall, _, hmodel⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 0#usize (by decide)
    have heq : w = v0 := Result.ok.inj (hcall.symm.trans hv0)
    have hfin : (⟨(0#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = (0 : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    simpa [heq, hfin] using hmodel
  have hv1model : Decode v1 = R0P.poseidonMat4
      (fun j => Decode (groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 j)) (1 : Fin 4) := by
    obtain ⟨w, hcall, _, hmodel⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 1#usize (by decide)
    have heq : w = v1 := Result.ok.inj (hcall.symm.trans hv1)
    have hfin : (⟨(1#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = (1 : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    simpa [heq, hfin] using hmodel
  have hv2model : Decode v2 = R0P.poseidonMat4
      (fun j => Decode (groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 j)) (2 : Fin 4) := by
    obtain ⟨w, hcall, _, hmodel⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 2#usize (by decide)
    have heq : w = v2 := Result.ok.inj (hcall.symm.trans hv2)
    have hfin : (⟨(2#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = (2 : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    simpa [heq, hfin] using hmodel
  have hv3model : Decode v3 = R0P.poseidonMat4
      (fun j => Decode (groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 j)) (3 : Fin 4) := by
    obtain ⟨w, hcall, _, hmodel⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 3#usize (by decide)
    have heq : w = v3 := Result.ok.inj (hcall.symm.trans hv3)
    have hfin : (⟨(3#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = (3 : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    simpa [heq, hfin] using hmodel
  refine ⟨v0,v1,v2,v3,s1,s2,s3,s4,hrun,hs1,hs2,hs3,hs4,?_⟩
  intro r
  fin_cases r
  · have hrow : (0 : Fin 4) = (⟨0, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hrow] at hv0model
    simpa only [hc] using hv0model
  · have hrow : (1 : Fin 4) = (⟨1, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hrow] at hv1model
    simpa only [hc] using hv1model
  · have hrow : (2 : Fin 4) = (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hrow] at hv2model
    simpa only [hc] using hv2model
  · have hrow : (3 : Fin 4) = (⟨3, by omega⟩ : Fin 4) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    rw [hrow] at hv3model
    simpa only [hc] using hv3model

import Aeneas
import PoseidonExternalLazySourceCut
import AspisR1.PoseidonExternalRowExtensionMap

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLinearGroupStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalRowExtensionMap

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev State := Array QM 16#usize

private theorem update_success (a : State) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 16) :
    ∃ out : State, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  exact ⟨out, hr, hs⟩

/-- The source continuation for one external-linear group, after its four
successful state reads. It consumes the actual extension-limb `Array.map`,
the four generated row calls, and four checked in-place updates. The read
equations are explicit so the loop invariant can instantiate them from its
checked index operations without introducing a model premise. -/
theorem group_step_after_reads
    (state : State) (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) (i0 i1 i2 i3 : Usize)
    (hread0 : Array.index_usize state i0 = .ok q0)
    (hread1 : Array.index_usize state i1 = .ok q1)
    (hread2 : Array.index_usize state i2 = .ok q2)
    (hread3 : Array.index_usize state i3 = .ok q3)
    (hi0 : i0.val < 16) (hi1 : i1.val < 16)
    (hi2 : i2.val < 16) (hi3 : i3.val < 16) :
    ∃ v0 v1 v2 v3 : QM, ∃ s1 s2 s3 s4 : State,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row
        (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) 0#usize = .ok v0 ∧
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row
        (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) 1#usize = .ok v1 ∧
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row
        (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) 2#usize = .ok v2 ∧
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row
        (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) 3#usize = .ok v3 ∧
      (do
        let x0 ← Array.index_usize state i0
        let x1 ← Array.index_usize state i1
        let x2 ← Array.index_usize state i2
        let x3 ← Array.index_usize state i3
        let input ← core.array.Array.map
          (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
          (Array.make 4#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3])
          state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
        let o0 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 0#usize
        let a0 ← Array.update state i0 o0
        let o1 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 1#usize
        let a1 ← Array.update a0 i1 o1
        let o2 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 2#usize
        let a2 ← Array.update a1 i2 o2
        let o3 ← state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_row input 3#usize
        Array.update a2 i3 o3) = .ok s4 ∧
      s1 = state.set i0 v0 ∧ s2 = s1.set i1 v1 ∧
      s3 = s2.set i2 v2 ∧ s4 = s3.set i3 v3 := by
  have hmap := group_extension_limbs_map q0 q1 q2 q3
  have hmap' : core.array.Array.map
      (BuiltinFnMut QM (Array Std.U32 4#usize))
      (Array.make 4#usize [q0,q1,q2,q3])
      state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs = .ok (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) := by
    simpa only [groupInput] using hmap
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0, _, _⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 0#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨v1, hv1, _, _⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 1#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨v2, hv2, _, _⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 2#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨v3, hv3, _, _⟩ := group_row_success q0 q1 q2 q3 3#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨s1, hs1, hs1set⟩ := update_success state i0 v0 hi0
  obtain ⟨s2, hs2, hs2set⟩ := update_success s1 i1 v1 hi1
  obtain ⟨s3, hs3, hs3set⟩ := update_success s2 i2 v2 hi2
  obtain ⟨s4, hs4, hs4set⟩ := update_success s3 i3 v3 hi3
  refine ⟨v0,v1,v2,v3,s1,s2,s3,s4,hv0,hv1,hv2,hv3,?_,hs1set,hs2set,hs3set,hs4set⟩
  simp only [hread0, hread1, hread2, hread3, hmap',
    hv0, hs1, hv1, hs2, hv2, hs3, hv3, hs4,
    bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms group_step_after_reads
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLinearGroupStep

import Aeneas
import RawPoseidonExtensionWords
import RawPoseidonExternalRowExact
import RawPoseidonRowField
import EmptyRootExecution

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalRowExtensionMap
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Limbs := Array Std.U32 4#usize
abbrev Group := Array QM 4#usize
abbrev Input := AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowWrapper.Input

def limbs (q : QM) : Limbs := Array.make 4#usize [q.c0.a, q.c0.b, q.c1.a, q.c1.b]

def groupInput (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) : Group := Array.make 4#usize [q0,q1,q2,q3]

def groupWords (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) : Input :=
  ⟨(groupInput q0 q1 q2 q3).val.map limbs, by
    simp [groupInput, Array.make, limbs]⟩

def groupCell (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) (i : Fin 4) : QM :=
  (groupInput q0 q1 q2 q3).val[i.val]'(by
    simpa [groupInput] using i.isLt)

theorem groupCell_eq (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) (i : Fin 4) :
    groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 i =
      if i.val = 0 then q0 else if i.val = 1 then q1 else if i.val = 2 then q2 else q3 := by
  fin_cases i <;> rfl

theorem groupWords_decode (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) (i : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField.decodeWords
      (fun j => AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowExact.inputWords
        (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) i j) =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (groupCell q0 q1 q2 q3 i) := by
  fin_cases i <;>
    simp [AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField.decodeWords,
      AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowExact.inputWords,
      AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.rowValue,
      groupWords, groupCell, groupInput, limbs, Array.make,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode]

theorem extension_map_state (qs : List QM) :
    mapState (BuiltinFnMut QM Limbs).call_mut qs state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs =
      .ok (qs.map limbs, state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs) := by
  induction qs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q qs ih =>
      have hcall : ∀ x : QM,
          (BuiltinFnMut QM Limbs).call_mut state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs x =
            .ok (limbs x, state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs) := by
        intro x
        simp only [BuiltinFnMut, Function.comp_apply]
        rw [AspisR1.RawPoseidonExtensionWords.extension_limbs_words]
        rfl
      simp only [mapState, hcall, bind_tc_ok, List.map_cons, ih]

theorem group_extension_limbs_map (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) :
    core.array.Array.map (BuiltinFnMut QM Limbs)
      (groupInput q0 q1 q2 q3) state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs =
      .ok (groupWords q0 q1 q2 q3) := by
  have hstate := core.array.Array.map_success
    (BuiltinFnMut QM Limbs) (groupInput q0 q1 q2 q3)
    state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
    ((groupInput q0 q1 q2 q3).val.map limbs)
    state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs
    (extension_map_state (groupInput q0 q1 q2 q3).val)
  simpa [groupWords] using hstate

/-- The generated row call on the four actual QM limbs returns the checked
row and its exact R0P matrix value. The row formula is expressed through the
actual extension-limb input consumed by the generated wrapper. -/
theorem group_row_success (q0 q1 q2 q3 : QM) (row : Usize)

private theorem cellAt_set (a : State) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 16) (j : Nat) :
    cellAt (a.set i x) j = if j = i.val then x else cellAt a j := by
  by_cases hj : j < 16
  · by_cases heq : j = i.val
    · subst j
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq]
    · have hne : i.val ≠ j := Ne.symm heq
      have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hjA : j < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hcell := List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val)
        (j := j) hne hjSet
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, heq, hcell, hjA]
  · have hne : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hne]

theorem four_updates_frame
    (state s1 s2 s3 s4 : State) (group : Fin 4)
    (v0 v1 v2 v3 : QM) (i0 i1 i2 i3 : Usize)
    (hs1 : s1 = state.set i0 v0) (hs2 : s2 = s1.set i1 v1)
    (hs3 : s3 = s2.set i2 v2) (hs4 : s4 = s3.set i3 v3)
    (hindex0 : i0.val = 4 * group.val)
    (hindex1 : i1.val = 4 * group.val + 1)
    (hindex2 : i2.val = 4 * group.val + 2)
    (hindex3 : i3.val = 4 * group.val + 3)
    (hi0 : i0.val < 16) (hi1 : i1.val < 16)
    (hi2 : i2.val < 16) (hi3 : i3.val < 16)
    (j : Fin 16)
    (hframe : ∀ r : Fin 4, j.val ≠ 4 * group.val + r.val) :
    cellAt s4 j.val = cellAt state j.val := by
  rw [hs4]
  rw [cellAt_set s3 i3 v3 hi3 j.val]
  rw [hs3]
  rw [cellAt_set s2 i2 v2 hi2 j.val]
  rw [hs2]
  rw [cellAt_set s1 i1 v1 hi1 j.val]
  rw [hs1]
  rw [cellAt_set state i0 v0 hi0 j.val]
  rw [hindex0, hindex1, hindex2, hindex3]
  have h0 : j.val ≠ 4 * group.val := hframe 0
  have h1 : j.val ≠ 4 * group.val + 1 := by simpa using hframe 1
  have h2 : j.val ≠ 4 * group.val + 2 := by simpa using hframe 2
  have h3 : j.val ≠ 4 * group.val + 3 := by simpa using hframe 3
  simp [h0, h1, h2, h3]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps AspisV8R17.RawReducer

abbrev wide (x : U32) : U64 := core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x

theorem wide_value (x : U32) : (wide x).val = x.val := by
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.cast_widen_value x

theorem source_success (w0 w1 w2 c0 c1 c2 : U32)
    (hw0 : w0.val < P) (hw1 : w1.val < P) (hw2 : w2.val < P)
    (hc0 : c0.val < P) (hc1 : c1.val < P) (hc2 : c2.val < P) :
    ∃ out : field.M31,
      state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_limb w0 w1 w2 c0 c1 c2 = .ok out ∧
      out.val < P ∧ out.val = (w0.val*c0.val+w1.val*c1.val+w2.val*c2.val) % P := by
  have hp0 : w0.val*c0.val < P*P := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hw0 hc0
  have hp1 : w1.val*c1.val < P*P := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hw1 hc1
  have hp2 : w2.val*c2.val < P*P := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hw2 hc2
  have hbudget : 3*(P*P) < 2^64 := by norm_num [P]
  have hb0 : (wide w0).val*(wide c0).val < 2^64 := by rw [wide_value,wide_value]; omega
  have hb1 : (wide w1).val*(wide c1).val < 2^64 := by rw [wide_value,wide_value]; omega
  have hb2 : (wide w2).val*(wide c2).val < 2^64 := by rw [wide_value,wide_value]; omega
  obtain ⟨p0,hp0run,hp0val⟩ := mul_success (wide w0) (wide c0) hb0
  obtain ⟨p1,hp1run,hp1val⟩ := mul_success (wide w1) (wide c1) hb1
  obtain ⟨p2,hp2run,hp2val⟩ := mul_success (wide w2) (wide c2) hb2
  rw [wide_value,wide_value] at hp0val hp1val hp2val
  have hs01 : p0.val+p1.val < 2^64 := by rw [hp0val,hp1val]; omega
  obtain ⟨s01,hs01run,hs01val⟩ := add_success p0 p1 hs01
  have hstotal : s01.val+p2.val < 2^64 := by rw [hs01val,hp0val,hp1val,hp2val]; omega
  obtain ⟨total,htotalrun,htotalval⟩ := add_success s01 p2 hstotal
  obtain ⟨out,hreduce,hmod,hcanon⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_wrapper_mod total
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcanon,?_⟩
  · change (do
      let p0 ← UScalar.mul (wide w0) (wide c0)
      let p1 ← UScalar.mul (wide w1) (wide c1)
      let s01 ← UScalar.add p0 p1
      let p2 ← UScalar.mul (wide w2) (wide c2)
      let total ← UScalar.add s01 p2
      field.M31.reduce_u64 total) = .ok out
    simp only [hp0run,hp1run,hs01run,hp2run,htotalrun,hreduce,bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [hmod,htotalval,hs01val,hp0val,hp1val,hp2val]

abbrev M := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact

theorem source_model (w0 w1 w2 c0 c1 c2 : U32)
    (hw0 : w0.val < P) (hw1 : w1.val < P) (hw2 : w2.val < P)
    (hc0 : c0.val < P) (hc1 : c1.val < P) (hc2 : c2.val < P) :
    ∃ out : field.M31,
      state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_limb w0 w1 w2 c0 c1 c2 = .ok out ∧
      out.val < P ∧ (out.val : M) =
        (w0.val : M)*(c0.val : M)+(w1.val : M)*(c1.val : M)+(w2.val : M)*(c2.val : M) := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcanon,hmod⟩ := source_success w0 w1 w2 c0 c1 c2 hw0 hw1 hw2 hc0 hc1 hc2
  refine ⟨out,hrun,hcanon,?_⟩
  rw [hmod]
  simp only [ZMod.natCast_mod,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul]

#print axioms source_model
#print axioms wide_value
#print axioms source_success

/-! Reuse the proved source Copy constructor with four stable scalar
callbacks, retaining an arbitrary property of each actual output limb. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonRaw4Constructor
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)

theorem source_success {C : Type} (inst : core.ops.function.FnMut C Usize U64)
    (c : C) (R : Fin 4 → U64 → Prop)
    (hcall : ∀ (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4), ∃ v : U64,
      inst.call_mut c i = .ok (v,c) ∧ R ⟨i.val,hi⟩ v) :
    ∃ out : Array U64 4#usize,
      array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 inst 0#u64 c = .ok out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, R j (cell out j) := by
  classical
  have hc : ∀ j : Fin 4, ∃ v : U64,
      inst.call_mut c (UScalar.ofNatCore j.val (by scalar_tac)) = .ok (v,c) ∧ R j v := by
    intro j
    let idx : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore j.val (by scalar_tac)
    have hidx : idx.val = j.val := by scalar_tac
    have hb : idx.val < 4 := by rw [hidx]; exact j.isLt
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hr⟩ := hcall idx hb
    have hfin : (⟨idx.val,hb⟩ : Fin 4) = j := Fin.ext hidx
    rw [hfin] at hr
    exact ⟨v,hv,hr⟩
  choose values hvalues hprops using hc
  let value : Nat → U64 := fun n => if h : n < 4 then values ⟨n,h⟩ else 0#u64
  have hstable : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < (4#usize).val →
      inst.call_mut c i = .ok (value i.val,c) := by
    intro i hi
    have hb : i.val < 4 := by simpa using hi
    let j : Fin 4 := ⟨i.val,hb⟩
    have hj := hvalues j
    have hidx : (UScalar.ofNatCore j.val (by scalar_tac) : Usize) = i := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      scalar_tac
    rw [hidx] at hj
    simpa only [value,dif_pos hb] using hj
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hout⟩ := array_from_fn_copy_stable 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 inst
    0#u64 c value hstable
  refine ⟨out,hrun,?_⟩
  intro j
  have hb : j.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hj := hout j.val hb
  have hcell : cell out j = values j := by
    simpa only [cell,value,dif_pos j.isLt] using hj
  rw [hcell]
  exact hprops j

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonRaw4Constructor

    (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnCall.limbAt q

    state.val[(UScalar.ofNatCore column.val (by scalar_tac) : Usize).val]'(by have := column.isLt; scalar_tac) = cell16 state 0 column ∧
    state.val[4+(UScalar.ofNatCore column.val (by scalar_tac) : Usize).val]'(by have := column.isLt; scalar_tac) = cell16 state 1 column ∧
    state.val[8+(UScalar.ofNatCore column.val (by scalar_tac) : Usize).val]'(by have := column.isLt; scalar_tac) = cell16 state 2 column ∧
    state.val[12+(UScalar.ofNatCore column.val (by scalar_tac) : Usize).val]'(by have := column.isLt; scalar_tac) = cell16 state 3 column := by
  constructor
  · simp [cell16]
  constructor
  · simp [cell16]
  constructor
  · simp [cell16]
  · simp [cell16]

theorem source_column_decode (state : State) (sums : Sums)
    (hcolumns : ∀ i j : Fin 4,

        (UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)) (by scalar_tac) j
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSums.sumWordAt sums i j))
    (column : Fin 4) :
    decodeWords (sumWords sums column) = fieldColumnSum state column := by
  have ⟨hr0,hr1,hr2,hr3⟩ := state_column_rows state column
  have hwords : sumWords sums column = fun j =>
      rowWordsAt state 0 column j + rowWordsAt state 1 column j +
      rowWordsAt state 2 column j + rowWordsAt state 3 column j := by
    funext j
    have hc := hcolumns column j
    have hj0 := limb_words (cell16 state 0 column) j
    have hj1 := limb_words (cell16 state 1 column) j
    have hj2 := limb_words (cell16 state 2 column) j
    have hj3 := limb_words (cell16 state 3 column) j
    dsimp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnArrayCall.columnTotal,
      AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnCall.sumFour] at hc
    rw [hr0,hr1,hr2,hr3,hj0,hj1,hj2,hj3] at hc
    change sumWords sums column j = _
    simpa [sumWords, AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumnSums.sumWordAt,
      AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell, rowWordsAt] using hc
  rw [hwords]
  simp only [decodeWords_add, fieldColumnSum]

symbolic decodeWords_mod theorem; no field multiplication is expanded. -/

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonRawLimbReassembly

      Canonical out ∧ Decode out = decodeWords (fun j => (limbAt xs j).val) := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcanonical,hwords⟩ := extension_from_raw_limbs_words xs
  have h0 := congrArg (fun w : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => w.1.1) hwords
  have h1 := congrArg (fun w : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => w.1.2) hwords
  have h2 := congrArg (fun w : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => w.2.1) hwords
  have h3 := congrArg (fun w : (Nat × Nat) × (Nat × Nat) => w.2.2) hwords
  change out.c0.a.val = (limbAt xs 0).val % AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P at h0
  change out.c0.b.val = (limbAt xs 1).val % AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P at h1

  change out.c1.b.val = (limbAt xs 3).val % AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P at h3
  have hdecode : Decode out = decodeWords
      (fun j => (limbAt xs j).val % AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) := by
    ext <;> simp only [Decode,AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode,decodeWords,h0,h1,h2,h3]

abbrev Exact := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact

abbrev Index := Fin (↑(16#usize))
def narrow (i : Index) : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by
  have hlen : (↑(16#usize) : Nat) = 16 := by decide
  omega
⟩
theorem cell_narrow_eq (a : State) (i : Index) : cell a i = cell a (narrow i) := by rfl

def incrementAt (sums : Sums) (lane : Index) : Exact :=
  AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField.decodeWords
    (sumWords sums ⟨lane.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩)

def loopModel (original current : State) (sums : Sums) (processed : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Index,
    if j.val < processed then
      Decode (cell current j) = Decode (cell original j) + incrementAt sums j
    else Decode (cell current j) = Decode (cell original j)

theorem loop1_success_fuel (original current : State) (sums : Sums)
    (lane : Usize) (fuel : Nat) (hspan : lane.val + fuel = 16)
    (hinvariant : loopModel original current sums lane.val)
    (hcurrent : CanonicalState current)
    (hsums : ∀ i j : Fin 4,
      (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Call.sumWordAt sums i j).val < 2^34) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop1 current sums lane = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ loopModel original out sums 16 := by
  induction fuel generalizing current lane with
  | zero =>
      have hlane : lane.val = 16 := by omega
      have hwidth : poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH.val = 16 := by simp [poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH]
      have hstop : ¬ lane < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH := by
        change ¬ lane.val < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH.val
        rw [hwidth]
        omega
      refine ⟨current, ?_, hcurrent, ?_⟩
      · rw [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source.generated_loop1_step, if_neg hstop]
      · intro j
        have hprocessed := hinvariant j
        have hj : j.val < lane.val := by rw [hlane]; exact j.isLt
        simpa [loopModel, hlane, hj] using hprocessed
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hlane : lane.val < 16 := by omega
      have hwidth : poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH.val = 16 := by simp [poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH]
      have hcontinue : lane < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH := by
        change lane.val < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH.val
        rw [hwidth]
        exact hlane
      obtain ⟨value,lane1,hstep,hinc,hcanonical,hnextCanonical,hvalue,hpoint⟩ :=
        AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Step.loop1_step_success
          current sums lane hlane hcurrent hsums
      have hspan' : lane1.val + fuel = 16 := by rw [hinc]; omega
      let index : Index := ⟨lane.val, by
        have hlen : (↑(16#usize) : Nat) = 16 := by decide
        omega
      ⟩
      have hvalue' : Decode value = Decode (cell current index) + incrementAt sums index := by
        have hval := hvalue
        change Decode value = Decode (cell current (narrow index)) + laneIncrement sums lane at hval
        rw [← cell_narrow_eq (a := current) index] at hval
        simpa [index, incrementAt, laneIncrement] using hval
      have hinvariant' : loopModel original (current.set lane value) sums lane1.val := by
        intro j
        have hnextLane : lane1.val = lane.val + 1 := hinc
        by_cases heq : j.val = lane.val
        · have hj : j = index := Fin.ext heq
          subst j
          have hprev : Decode (cell current index) = Decode (cell original index) := by
            have h := hinvariant index
            have hnot : ¬ index.val < lane.val := by simp [index]
            simpa [loopModel, hnot] using h
          have hset := hpoint (narrow index)
          change Decode (cell (current.set lane value) (narrow index)) =
            (if (narrow index).val = lane.val then Decode (cell current (narrow index)) + laneIncrement sums lane
             else Decode (cell current (narrow index))) at hset
          have hidx16 : (narrow index).val = lane.val := by simp [narrow, index]
          rw [if_pos hidx16] at hset
          rw [← cell_narrow_eq (a := current.set lane value) index, ← cell_narrow_eq (a := current) index] at hset
          rw [hprev] at hset
          have hnext : index.val < lane1.val := by rw [hinc]; simp [index]
          simp only [loopModel, if_pos hnext]
          simpa [index, incrementAt, laneIncrement] using hset
        · have hpoint' := hpoint (narrow j)
          change Decode (cell (current.set lane value) (narrow j)) =
            (if (narrow j).val = lane.val then Decode (cell current ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩) + laneIncrement sums lane
             else Decode (cell current (narrow j))) at hpoint'
          rw [← cell_narrow_eq (a := current.set lane value) j, ← cell_narrow_eq (a := current) j] at hpoint'
          have hneq16 : (narrow j).val ≠ lane.val := by simpa [narrow] using heq
          simp only [if_neg hneq16] at hpoint'
          by_cases hbefore : j.val < lane.val
          · have hprev := hinvariant j
            simp only [loopModel, if_pos hbefore] at hprev
            have hnext : j.val < lane1.val := by rw [hinc]; omega
            simpa [loopModel, hnext] using hpoint'.trans hprev
          · have hafter : ¬ j.val < lane1.val := by rw [hinc]; omega
            have hprev := hinvariant j
            simp only [loopModel, if_neg hbefore] at hprev
            simpa [loopModel, hafter] using hpoint'.trans hprev
      obtain ⟨out,hrec,hcan,hmodel⟩ := ih (current.set lane value) lane1 hspan'
        hinvariant' hnextCanonical
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hcan, hmodel⟩
      rw [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source.generated_loop1_step]
      simp only [if_pos hcontinue, hstep, bind_tc_ok]
      exact hrec

#print axioms loop1_success_fuel
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Fuel

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Step
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Reassembly (sumWords)
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep

abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Sums := Array (Array Std.U64 4#usize) 4#usize
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev Exact := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact

def laneIncrement (sums : Sums) (lane : Usize) : Exact :=
  AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField.decodeWords
    (sumWords sums ⟨lane.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩)

theorem loop1_step_success (state : State) (sums : Sums) (lane : Usize)
    (hlane : lane.val < 16) (hstate : CanonicalState state)
    (hsums : ∀ i j : Fin 4,
      (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Call.sumWordAt sums i j).val < 2^34) :
    ∃ value nextLane,
      AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source.runStep state sums lane = .ok (state.set lane value,nextLane) ∧
      nextLane.val = lane.val + 1 ∧
      Canonical value ∧
      CanonicalState (state.set lane value) ∧
      Decode value = Decode (cell state ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩) + laneIncrement sums lane ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16,
        Decode (cell (state.set lane value) j) =
          if j.val = lane.val then Decode (cell state ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩) + laneIncrement sums lane
          else Decode (cell state j) := by
  let index : Fin 16 := ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩
  let q := cell state index
  have hread : Array.index_usize state lane = .ok q := by
    simpa only [q,index] using
      AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.state_source_read state lane hlane
  obtain ⟨raw,value,harray,hcanonical,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1ArrayCall.source_success q sums lane hlane hsums
  have hupdate : Array.update state lane value = .ok (state.set lane value) := by
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Array.update_spec state lane value (by simpa [state.property] using hlane))
    simpa only [hset] using hrun
  have hincSpec : (lane + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = lane.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨nextLane,hinc,hincVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hincSpec
  have hq : q = cell state ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩ := by rfl
  have hmodel' : Decode value = Decode q + laneIncrement sums lane := by
    change Decode value = Decode q + laneIncrement sums lane at hmodel
    exact hmodel
  let pairAction : Result (Array U64 4#usize × QM) := do
    let limbs ← state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q
    let raw ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
      0#u64 (limbs,sums,lane)
    let out ← state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs raw
    ok (raw,out)
  have hpair : pairAction = .ok (raw,value) := by simpa [pairAction] using harray
  have hcontinued : (do
      let pair ← pairAction
      let state1 ← Array.update state lane pair.2
      ok (state1,nextLane)) = .ok (state.set lane value,nextLane) := by
    simp only [hpair, hupdate, bind_tc_ok]
  have hflatten : (do
      let limbs ← state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q
      let raw ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64
        state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
        0#u64 (limbs,sums,lane)
      let value1 ← state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs raw
      let state1 ← Array.update state lane value1
      ok (state1,nextLane)) = (do
      let pair ← pairAction
      let state1 ← Array.update state lane pair.2
      ok (state1,nextLane)) := by
    simp [pairAction, bind_assoc_eq]
  refine ⟨value,nextLane,?_,hincVal,hcanonical,
    set_canonical state lane value hstate hcanonical,?_ ,?_⟩
  · rw [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source.runStep, hread, bind_tc_ok, hinc]
    simpa only [hflatten, bind_tc_ok] using hcontinued
  · change Decode value = Decode q + laneIncrement sums lane
    exact hmodel'
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases heq : j.val = lane.val
    · have hj : j = index := Fin.ext heq
      subst j
      rw [hq] at hmodel'
      simpa [index] using hmodel'
    · simp [heq]

#print axioms loop1_step_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Step
PoseidonExternalLoop1Source:
import PoseidonExternalLazySourceCut
import Aeneas.Std.WP

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev Sums := Array (Array Std.U64 4#usize) 4#usize
abbrev Closure1 := state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1

/-- The exact one-index body of external loop 1, including the actual source
    `array_from_fn_copy` and `extension_from_raw_limbs` calls. -/
def runStep (state : State) (sums : Sums) (index : Usize) : Result (State × Usize) := do
  let q ← Array.index_usize state index
  let limbs ← state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q
  let raw ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64
    state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
    0#u64 (limbs,sums,index)
  let q1 ← state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs raw
  let state1 ← Array.update state index q1
  let index1 ← index + 1#usize
  ok (state1,index1)

/-- Exact source equation for the generated partial-fixpoint traversal. -/
theorem generated_loop1_step (state : State) (sums : Sums) (index : Usize) :
    state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop1 state sums index = (do
      if index < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH then
        let (state1,index1) ← runStep state sums index
        state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop1 state1 sums index1
      else ok state) := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy_loop1.eq_def]
  simp only [runStep, bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

#print axioms generated_loop1_step
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLoop1Source

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1ArrayCall
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Reassembly
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExtensionWords
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev U32 := Std.U32
abbrev U64 := Std.U64
abbrev Limbs32 := Array U32 4#usize
abbrev Sums := Array (Array U64 4#usize) 4#usize
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM

def limbInputWords (limbs : Limbs32) : Fin 4 → Nat := fun j =>
  (limbs.val[j.val]'(by simpa [limbs.property] using j.isLt)).val

def column1Value (q : QM) (sums : Sums) (lane : Fin 4) (j : Fin 4) (v : U64) : Prop :=
  v.val = qWords q j + sumWords sums lane j

theorem source_success (q : QM) (sums : Sums) (lane : Usize)
    (hlane : lane.val < 16)
    (hsums : ∀ i j : Fin 4, (sumWordAt sums i j).val < 2^34) :
    ∃ raw : Array U64 4#usize, ∃ out : QM,
      (do
        let limbs ← state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q
        let raw ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64
          state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
          0#u64 (limbs,sums,lane)
        let out ← state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs raw
        ok (raw,out)) = .ok (raw,out) ∧
      Canonical out ∧
      Decode out = Decode q + decodeWords (sumWords sums ⟨lane.val % 4,
        Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩) := by
  let limbs : Limbs32 := Array.make 4#usize [q.c0.a,q.c0.b,q.c1.a,q.c1.b]
  have hlimbs : state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q = .ok limbs := by
    simpa [limbs] using RawPoseidonExtensionWords.extension_limbs_words q
  let laneFin : Fin 4 := ⟨lane.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
  let inst := state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
  let c : state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1 := (limbs,sums,lane)
  have hcall : ∀ (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4), ∃ v : U64,
      inst.call_mut c i = .ok (v,c) ∧ column1Value q sums laneFin ⟨i.val,hi⟩ v := by
    intro i hi
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hvalue⟩ := external_column1_limb_call limbs sums lane i hlane hi hsums
    let j : Fin 4 := ⟨i.val,hi⟩
    have hword : (wordAt limbs i hi).val = qWords q j := by
      have hv : i.val = 0 ∨ i.val = 1 ∨ i.val = 2 ∨ i.val = 3 := by omega
      rcases hv with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3
      · simp [wordAt, qWords, limbs, Array.make, j, h0]
      · simp [wordAt, qWords, limbs, Array.make, j, h1]
      · simp [wordAt, qWords, limbs, Array.make, j, h2]
      · simp [wordAt, qWords, limbs, Array.make, j, h3]
    have hvalue' := hvalue
    rw [hword] at hvalue'
    have hvalue'' : v.val = qWords q j + sumWords sums laneFin j := by
      simpa [j, laneFin, sumWords, sumWordAt] using hvalue'
    refine ⟨v,hv,?_⟩
    exact hvalue''
  obtain ⟨raw,hcopy,hcells⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRaw4Constructor.source_success
      inst c (column1Value q sums laneFin) hcall
  have hraw : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      (AspisR1.RawPoseidonExtensionWords.limbAt raw j).val =
        qWords q j + sumWords sums laneFin j := by
    intro j
    have hj := hcells j
    change (raw.val[j.val]'(by simpa [raw.property] using j.isLt)).val = _ at hj
    exact hj
  obtain ⟨out,hdecodeRun,hcanonical,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Reassembly.add_column_reassembly q sums laneFin raw hraw
  refine ⟨raw,out,?_ ,hcanonical,hmodel⟩
  simp [c, inst, hlimbs, hcopy, hdecodeRun, bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1ArrayCall

import ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule
import PoseidonThreeConstantLimbV4
import RawPoseidonExternalRowReads
import Aeneas.Std.WP

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Call
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule
open AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantLimb
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads

abbrev U32 := Std.U32
abbrev U64 := Std.U64
abbrev Limbs := Array U32 4#usize
abbrev Sums := Array (Array U64 4#usize) 4#usize
abbrev Closure := state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1
abbrev wide := AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantLimb.wide

def wordAt (a : Array U32 4#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4) : U32 :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)

def sumWordAt (a : Sums) (lane limb : Fin 4) : U64 :=
  let row := a.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using lane.isLt)
  row.val[limb.val]'(by simpa [row.property] using limb.isLt)

theorem external_column1_limb_call
    (limbs : Limbs) (sums : Sums) (lane limb : Usize)
    (hlane : lane.val < 16) (hlimb : limb.val < 4)
    (hsums : ∀ i j : Fin 4, (sumWordAt sums i j).val < 2^34) :
    ∃ total : U64,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64.call_mut
        (limbs,sums,lane) limb = .ok (total,(limbs,sums,lane)) ∧
      total.val = (wordAt limbs limb hlimb).val +
        (sumWordAt sums ⟨lane.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ ⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩).val := by
  have h4 : (4#usize).val = 4 := by scalar_tac
  let word := wordAt limbs limb hlimb
  have hword : Array.index_usize limbs limb = .ok word :=
    array_index_usize_ok limbs limb (by simpa [limbs.property] using hlimb)
  obtain ⟨masked,hmaskedRun,hmaskSpec⟩ :=
    WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.and_spec lane (3#usize))
  have hmaskedVal : masked.val = lane.val % 4 :=
    hmaskSpec.1.trans
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskCoefficientSchedule.column_and_three_eq_mod_four lane hlane)
  have hmaskedBound : masked.val < 4 := by rw [hmaskedVal]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  let laneFin : Fin 4 := ⟨lane.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩
  let limbFin : Fin 4 := ⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩
  have hrowbound : masked.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa [h4] using hmaskedBound
  let row : Array U64 4#usize := sums.val[masked.val]'
    (by simpa [sums.property] using hrowbound)
  have hrow : Array.index_usize sums masked = .ok row :=
    array_index_usize_ok sums masked (by simpa [sums.property] using hrowbound)
  have hrowval : row = sums.val[laneFin.val]'
      (by simpa [sums.property] using laneFin.isLt) := by
    simp [row, laneFin, hmaskedVal]
  have hlimbBound : limb.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa [h4] using hlimb
  let sumWord : U64 := row.val[limb.val]'
    (by simpa [row.property] using hlimbBound)
  have hsumRead : Array.index_usize row limb = .ok sumWord :=
    array_index_usize_ok row limb (by simpa [row.property] using hlimbBound)
  have hsumWord : sumWord = sumWordAt sums laneFin limbFin := by
    simp [sumWordAt, sumWord, hrowval, laneFin, limbFin]
  have hconverted : lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from word) =
      .ok (wide word) := by rfl
  have haddSpec : (wide word + sumWord : Result U64) ⦃z => z.val = (wide word).val + sumWord.val⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hw : (wide word).val = word.val := by exact wide_value word
    have hs : sumWord.val < 2^34 := by rw [hsumWord]; exact hsums laneFin limbFin
    have hw32 : word.val < 2^32 := by scalar_tac
    have haddBound : (wide word).val + sumWord.val < 2^64 := by rw [hw]; omega
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨total, hadd, htotal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists haddSpec
  have hrun : state_only_poseidon.external_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64.call_mut
      (limbs,sums,lane) limb = .ok (total,(limbs,sums,lane)) := by
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1CallEquation.source_eq]
    simp only [hword, hconverted, hmaskedRun, hrow, hsumRead, hadd, bind_tc_ok]
  refine ⟨total, hrun, ?_⟩
  rw [htotal]
  have hw : (wide word).val = word.val := wide_value word
  rw [hw, hsumWord]

#print axioms external_column1_limb_call
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalColumn1Call

/-! Source state coordinates for the internal accumulator. The Nat-indexed
view is total solely to avoid proof-indexed getters in symbolic sums; the
source read lemma binds it to the actual in-range cell. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (State QM Canonical CanonicalState cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Words4 CanonicalWords)

def wordVec (q : QM) : Words4 := Array.make 4#usize [q.c0.a,q.c0.b,q.c1.a,q.c1.b]

def wordNat (state : State) (lane : Nat) (limb : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  match state.val[lane]? with
  | none => 0
  | some q => (cell (wordVec q) limb).val

theorem wordVec_source (q : QM) : state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q = .ok (wordVec q) := rfl

theorem wordVec_canonical (q : QM) (hq : Canonical q) : CanonicalWords (wordVec q) := by
  intro j
  fin_cases j
  · exact hq.1.1
  · exact hq.1.2
  · exact hq.2.1
  · exact hq.2.2

theorem state_source_read (state : State) (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 16) :
    Array.index_usize state lane = .ok (cell state (⟨lane.val,hlane⟩ : Fin 16)) := by
  have hb : lane.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using hlane
  simpa only [cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok state lane hb

theorem wordNat_read (state : State) (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 16) (limb : Fin 4) :

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateStep
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer

def addModel (part : Raw4) (words : Words4) (j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  (cell part j).val + (cell words j).val

theorem loop_success_fuel (part : Raw4) (words : Words4) (limb : Usize) (fuel n : Nat)
    (hspan : limb.val + fuel = 4) (hbudget : n+fuel ≤ 19)
    (hp : RawBound part (n*P)) (hw : CanonicalWords words) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 part words limb = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out ((n+fuel)*P) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val =
        if limb.val ≤ j.val then addModel part words j else (cell part j).val := by

  | zero =>
    have hstop : ¬ limb < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨part,?_,by simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hp,?_⟩
    · rw [source_step,if_neg hstop]
    · intro j
      have hn : ¬ limb.val ≤ j.val := by have := j.isLt; omega
      rw [if_neg hn]

    have hi : limb.val < 4 := by omega
    have hlt : limb < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
    have hn : n ≤ 19 := by omega
    obtain ⟨value,hstep,hpart1,hcells⟩ := step_success part words limb n hi hn hp hw
    have hplusSpec : UScalar.add limb 1#usize ⦃z => z.val = limb.val+1⦄ := by
      apply UScalar.add_spec
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨limb1,hplus,hinc⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplusSpec
    have hspan1 : limb1.val + fuel = 4 := by omega
    have hbudget1 : (n+1)+fuel ≤ 19 := by omega
    let part1 := part.set limb value
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hbound,hmodel⟩ := ih part1 limb1 (n+1) hspan1 hbudget1 hpart1
    have heq : (n+1)+fuel = n+(fuel+1) := by omega
    rw [heq] at hbound
    refine ⟨out,?_,hbound,?_⟩
    · rw [source_step,if_pos hlt,hstep]
      change (do
        let limb1 ← UScalar.add limb 1#usize
        state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 part1 words limb1) = .ok out
      rw [hplus]
      change state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 part1 words limb1 = .ok out
      exact hrun
    · intro j
      have hv := hmodel j
      rw [hinc] at hv
      rw [hv]
      by_cases hj : j.val = limb.val
      · have hafter : ¬ limb.val+1 ≤ j.val := by omega
        have hinside : limb.val ≤ j.val := by omega
        rw [if_neg hafter,if_pos hinside]
        have hcell := hcells j
        rw [if_pos hj] at hcell

        change (cell part1 j).val = addModel part words ⟨limb.val,hi⟩ at hcell
        exact hcell.trans (congrArg (addModel part words) hindex)

          have h := hcells j
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact h

        rw [hcell]

        by_cases hin : limb.val ≤ j.val
        · rw [if_pos (hsame.mpr hin),if_pos hin]
        · have hn : ¬ limb.val+1 ≤ j.val := fun h => hin (hsame.mp h)
          rw [if_neg hn,if_neg hin]

theorem source_success (part : Raw4) (words : Words4)
    (hp : RawBound part (15*P)) (hw : CanonicalWords words) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 part words 0#usize = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out (16*P) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val = addModel part words j := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,_,hmodel⟩ := loop_success_fuel part words 0#usize 4 15
    (by decide) (by decide) hp hw
  have hvalues : ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val = addModel part words j := by
    intro j
    have h := hmodel j
    have hstart : (0#usize).val ≤ j.val := Nat.zero_le _
    rw [if_pos hstart] at h
    exact h

  intro j
  rw [hvalues j]
  unfold addModel

  have hlimit : 15*P+P = 16*P := by omega
  rw [hlimit] at hsum
  exact hsum

bounds are symbolic; no recurrence or field operation is evaluated. -/

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

def step (part : Raw4) (words : Words4) (limb : Usize) : Result Raw4 := do
  let word ← Array.index_usize words limb
  let old ← Array.index_usize part limb
  let added ← UScalar.add old (wide word)
  Array.update part limb added

theorem step_success (part : Raw4) (words : Words4) (limb : Usize) (n : Nat)
    (hi : limb.val < 4) (hn : n ≤ 19) (hp : RawBound part (n*P)) (hw : CanonicalWords words) :
    ∃ value : U64, step part words limb = .ok (part.set limb value) ∧
      RawBound (part.set limb value) ((n+1)*P) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell (part.set limb value) j).val =
        if j.val = limb.val then
          (cell part (⟨limb.val,hi⟩ : Fin 4)).val + (cell words (⟨limb.val,hi⟩ : Fin 4)).val
        else (cell part j).val := by
  let index : Fin 4 := ⟨limb.val,hi⟩
  let p := cell part index
  let w := cell words index
  have hb : limb.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa using hi
  have hreadP : Array.index_usize part limb = .ok p := by
    simpa only [p,cell,index] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok part limb hb
  have hreadW : Array.index_usize words limb = .ok w := by
    simpa only [w,cell,index] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok words limb hb
  have hpLocal : p.val < n*P := hp index
  have hwLocal : w.val < P := hw index
  have hnMul : n*P ≤ 19*P := Nat.mul_le_mul_right P hn
  have hsucc : (n+1)*P = n*P+P := by rw [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
  have hbound : p.val+w.val < (n+1)*P := by rw [hsucc]; omega
  have hlimit : 20*P < 2^64 := by norm_num [P]
  have hb64 : p.val+(wide w).val < 2^64 := by rw [wide_value]; omega
  obtain ⟨value,hadd,hvalue⟩ := add_success p (wide w) hb64
  rw [wide_value] at hvalue
  obtain ⟨out,hupdate,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec part limb value (by simpa [part.property] using hb))
  have hwrite : Array.update part limb value = .ok (part.set limb value) := by rw [hupdate,hset]
  refine ⟨value,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [step,hreadW,hreadP,hadd,hwrite,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = limb.val
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      rw [hvalue]
      exact hbound
    · simp only [if_neg hj]
      rw [hsucc]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hp j) (Nat.le_add_right (n*P) P)
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = limb.val
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      exact hvalue
    · simp only [if_neg hj]

theorem source_step (part : Raw4) (words : Words4) (limb : Usize) :
    state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 part words limb =
      (if limb < 4#usize then do
        let nextPart ← step part words limb
        let nextLimb ← UScalar.add limb 1#usize
        state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 nextPart words nextLimb
      else .ok part) := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0.eq_def]
  simp only [step,bind_assoc_eq,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

#print axioms step_success
#print axioms source_step

import PoseidonQMFullRoundLoopSource

/-! Symbolic traversal of both actual nonlinear full-round loops. Fuel is a
proof measure for the source range, not an evaluated 16-cell recurrence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonQMFullRoundLoopModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (State CanonicalState QM Exact Decode cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonQMFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonQMFullRoundLoopSource

def laneModel (state : State) (constants1 : State) (i : Fin 16) : Exact :=
  R0P.poseidonPow5 (Decode (cell state i) + Decode (cell constants1 i))

theorem loop_success_fuel (packed : Bool) (state : State) (constants1 : State)
    (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val ≤ 16) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = iter.end.val)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hconstants : CanonicalState constants1) :
    ∃ out : State, loop packed iter state constants1 = .ok out ∧ CanonicalState out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) =
        if iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val then laneModel state constants1 j
        else Decode (cell state j) := by
  induction fuel generalizing state iter with
  | zero =>
    have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
    refine ⟨state,?_,hstate,?_⟩
    · rw [generated_loop_step]
      rw [hnext]
      change Result.ok state = Result.ok state
      rfl
    · intro j
      have hnot : ¬ (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
      rw [if_neg hnot]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    have hidx : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨iter1,hnext,hinc,hend1,_⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
    have hend' : iter1.end.val ≤ 16 := by rw [hend1]; exact hend
    have hspan' : iter1.start.val + fuel = iter1.end.val := by rw [hend1]; omega
    obtain ⟨value,hstep,hvalueCan,hstate1Can,hstepModel,hstepCells⟩ :=
      runStep_success state constants1 iter.start hidx hstate hconstants
    let state1 := state.set iter.start value
    obtain ⟨out,hrec,houtCan,houtModel⟩ := ih state1 iter1 hend' hspan' hstate1Can
    refine ⟨out,?_,houtCan,?_⟩
    · rw [generated_loop_step]
      rw [hnext]
      change (do
        let nextState ← runStep state constants1 iter.start
        loop packed iter1 nextState constants1) = .ok out
      rw [hstep]
      change loop packed iter1 state1 constants1 = .ok out
      exact hrec
    · intro j
      have hv := houtModel j
      rw [hinc,hend1] at hv
      rw [hv]
      by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
      · have hafter : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        have hinside : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val := by omega
        rw [if_neg hafter,if_pos hinside]
        have hcell := hstepCells j
        rw [if_pos hj] at hcell
        have hindex : (⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ : Fin 16) = j := Fin.ext hj.symm
        change Decode (cell state1 j) = laneModel state constants1 ⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ at hcell
        exact hcell.trans (congrArg (laneModel state constants1) hindex)
      · have hcell : Decode (cell state1 j) = Decode (cell state j) := by
          have h := hstepCells j
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact h
        unfold laneModel
        rw [hcell]
        have hrange : (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) ↔
            (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        by_cases hin : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val
        · rw [if_pos (hrange.mpr hin),if_pos hin]
        · have hn : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) :=
            fun h => hin (hrange.mp h)
          rw [if_neg hn,if_neg hin]

/-- The exact width-16 source range computes every nonlinear round cell and
preserves canonicality, for either generated full-round variant. -/
theorem all_cells_success (packed : Bool) (state : State) (constants1 : State)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hconstants : CanonicalState constants1) :
    ∃ out : State,
      loop packed { start := 0#usize, «end» := poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH } state constants1 = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) = laneModel state constants1 j := by
  have hwidth : poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH = 16#usize := by
    unfold poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH
    rfl
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcan,hmodel⟩ := loop_success_fuel packed state constants1
    { start := 0#usize, «end» := 16#usize } 16 (by decide) (by decide) hstate hconstants
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · rw [hwidth]
    exact hrun
  · intro j
    have h := hmodel j
    have hj : (0#usize).val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < (16#usize).val := by
      have := j.isLt
      scalar_tac
    rw [if_pos hj] at h
    exact h

#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms all_cells_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonQMFullRoundLoopModel

def runStep (state constants1 : State) (lane : Usize) : Result State := do

private theorem group_step_success_of_bound (state : State) (packed : Packed)
    (group : Usize) (hgroup : group.val < 4) (hstate : CanonicalState state)
    (hpacked : packedCanonical packed) :
    ∃ packed1 : Packed, ∃ group1 : Usize,
      groupStep state packed group = .ok (packed1,group1) ∧
      packedCanonical packed1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 4, Decode (packedCell packed1 j) =
        if j.val = group.val then packedModel state ⟨group.val,hgroup⟩
        else Decode (packedCell packed j)) ∧
      group1.val = group.val + 1 := by
  let g : Fin 4 := ⟨group.val,hgroup⟩
  let group' : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore g.val (by have := g.isLt; scalar_tac)
  have heq : group' = group := by
    apply group_value_eq
    simp [group',g,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  obtain ⟨packed1,group1,hcall,hcan,hmodel,hgroup1⟩ :=
    groupStep_success state packed g hstate hpacked
  refine ⟨packed1,group1,?_,hcan,?_,?_⟩
  · change groupStep state packed group' = .ok (packed1,group1) at hcall
    rw [heq] at hcall
    exact hcall
  · intro j
    simpa [g] using hmodel j
  · simpa [g] using hgroup1

private theorem generated_loop_step (state : State) (packed : Packed) (group : Usize) :
    state_only_poseidon.external_linear_packed_loop state packed group =
      if group < 4#usize then do
        let (packed1,group1) ← groupStep state packed group
        state_only_poseidon.external_linear_packed_loop state packed1 group1
      else .ok packed := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.external_linear_packed_loop.eq_def]
  by_cases h : group < 4#usize
  · simp only [h, if_pos]
    simp only [groupStep, bind_assoc_eq, bind_tc_ok] <;> rfl
  · simp [h]

private theorem initial_packed_facts :
    let packed : Packed := Array.repeat 4#usize field.QM31.ZERO
    packedCanonical packed ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, Decode (packedCell packed j) = 0 := by
  let packed : Packed := Array.repeat 4#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  constructor
  · intro j
    fin_cases j <;>
      simpa [packedCanonical,packedCell,packed,Array.repeat_val] using
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_canonical
  · intro j
    fin_cases j <;>
      simpa [packedCell,packed,Array.repeat_val] using
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_decode

theorem loop_success_fuel (state : State) (packed : Packed) (group : Usize)
    (fuel : Nat) (hspan : group.val + fuel = 4)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hpacked : packedCanonical packed)
    (hmodel : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      Decode (packedCell packed j) =
        if j.val < group.val then packedModel state ⟨j.val,j.isLt⟩ else 0) :
    ∃ out : Packed,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_packed_loop state packed group = .ok out ∧
      packedCanonical out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, Decode (packedCell out j) =
        if j.val < 4 then packedModel state j else 0 := by
  induction fuel generalizing packed group with
  | zero =>
      have hval : group.val = 4 := by omega
      have hstop : ¬ group < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
      refine ⟨packed,?_,hpacked,?_⟩
      · rw [generated_loop_step]
        simp [hstop]
      · intro j
        have hj : j.val < group.val := by rw [hval]; exact j.isLt
        have h := hmodel j
        rw [if_pos hj] at h
        simpa [hval] using h
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hltVal : group.val < 4 := by omega
      have hlt : group < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨packed1,group1,hstep,hcan1,hmodel1,hgroup1⟩ :=
        group_step_success_of_bound state packed group hltVal hstate hpacked
      have hspan1 : group1.val + fuel = 4 := by rw [hgroup1]; omega
      have hmodel1' : ∀ j : Fin 4,
          Decode (packedCell packed1 j) =
            if j.val < group1.val then packedModel state ⟨j.val,j.isLt⟩ else 0 := by
        intro j
        have hsame : packedModel state ⟨group.val,hltVal⟩ =
            packedModel state (⟨group.val,hltVal⟩ : Fin 4) := rfl
        by_cases hj : j.val = group.val
        · have hnow := hmodel1 j
          rw [if_pos hj] at hnow
          rw [hnow]
          have hj1 : j.val < group1.val := by rw [hgroup1]; omega
          rw [if_pos hj1]
          have hidx : j = (⟨group.val,hltVal⟩ : Fin 4) := Fin.ext hj
          simpa [hidx]
        · have hnow := hmodel1 j
          rw [if_neg hj] at hnow
          rw [hmodel j] at hnow
          by_cases hbefore : j.val < group.val
          · have hafter : j.val < group1.val := by rw [hgroup1]; omega
            rw [if_pos hbefore] at hnow
            rw [if_pos hafter]
            exact hnow
          · have hafter : ¬ j.val < group1.val := by rw [hgroup1]; omega
            rw [if_neg hbefore] at hnow
            rw [if_neg hafter]
            exact hnow
      obtain ⟨out,hrec,hcanOut,hmodelOut⟩ :=
        ih packed1 group1 hspan1 hcan1 hmodel1'
      refine ⟨out,?_,hcanOut,?_⟩
      · rw [generated_loop_step]
        simp only [hlt,if_pos,hstep,bind_tc_ok]
        exact hrec
      · intro j
        have h := hmodelOut j
        have hj : j.val < 4 := j.isLt
        simpa [hj] using h

theorem loop_source_success (state : State) (hstate : CanonicalState state) :
    ∃ out : Packed,
      state_only_poseidon.external_linear_packed_loop state
        (Array.repeat 4#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize = .ok out ∧
      packedCanonical out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, Decode (packedCell out j) = packedModel state j := by
  let packed : Packed := Array.repeat 4#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  have hinit := initial_packed_facts
  have hcan : packedCanonical packed := by simpa [packed] using hinit.1
  have hdecode : ∀ j : Fin 4, Decode (packedCell packed j) = 0 := by
    simpa [packed] using hinit.2
  have hmodel : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      Decode (packedCell packed j) =
        if j.val < 0 then packedModel state ⟨j.val,j.isLt⟩ else 0 := by
    intro j
    simp [hdecode j]
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcan,hmodel⟩ :=
    loop_success_fuel state packed 0#usize 4 (by decide) hstate hcan hmodel
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · simpa [packed] using hrun
  · intro j
    have hj : j.val < 4 := j.isLt
    simpa [hj] using hmodel j

#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms loop_source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedLoopModel

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedGroupCall
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedModel
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic (iBasis uBasis)
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase (P)

abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev Packed := Array field.QM31 4#usize
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM

def packedCell (a : Packed) (j : Fin 4) : field.QM31 :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

def packedCanonical (a : Packed) : Prop := ∀ j : Fin 4, CanonicalQM (packedCell a j)

def packedModel (state : State) (g : Fin 4) : Exact :=
  R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
    (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => Decode (cell state (lane g r))))

def groupInput (state : State) (g : Fin 4) : Array field.QM31 4#usize :=
  Array.make 4#usize
    [cell state (lane g 0), cell state (lane g 1),
     cell state (lane g 2), cell state (lane g 3)]

def groupStep (state : State) (packed : Packed) (group : Usize) :
    Result (Packed × Usize) := do
  let start ← 4#usize * group
  let q0 ← Array.index_usize state start
  let i1 ← start + 1#usize
  let q1 ← Array.index_usize state i1
  let i2 ← start + 2#usize
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize state i2
  let i3 ← start + 3#usize
  let q3 ← Array.index_usize state i3
  let output ← state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed
    (Array.make 4#usize [q0,q1,q2,q3])
  let packed1 ← Array.update packed group output
  let group1 ← group + 1#usize
  ok (packed1,group1)

private theorem read_value (state : State) (index : Usize) (q : field.QM31)
    (hindex : index.val < 16) (hread : Array.index_usize state index = .ok q) :
    q = cell state ⟨index.val,hindex⟩ := by
  have hspec : Array.index_usize state index =
      .ok (cell state (⟨index.val,hindex⟩ : Fin 16)) := by
    exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok state index
      (by simpa [state.property] using hindex)
  exact Result.ok.inj (hread.symm.trans hspec)

theorem groupStep_success (state : State) (packed : Packed) (g : Fin 4)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hpacked : packedCanonical packed) :
    ∃ packed1 : Packed, ∃ group1 : Usize,
      groupStep state packed (UScalar.ofNatCore g.val (by have := g.isLt; scalar_tac)) =
        .ok (packed1,group1) ∧
      packedCanonical packed1 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 4, Decode (packedCell packed1 j) =
        if j.val = g.val then packedModel state g else Decode (packedCell packed j)) ∧
      group1.val = g.val + 1 := by
  let group : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore g.val (by have := g.isLt; scalar_tac)
  have hg : group.val = g.val := by simp [group,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  have hglt : group.val < 4 := by rw [hg]; exact g.isLt
  have hmulSpec : (4#usize * group : Result Usize)
      ⦃z => z.val = 4 * group.val⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.mul_spec
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨start,hmul,hstart⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hmulSpec
  have hstartVal : start.val = 4 * g.val := by rw [hstart,hg]
  have hplus1Spec : (start + 1#usize : Result Usize)
      ⦃z => z.val = start.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i1,hplus1,hi1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplus1Spec
  have hplus2Spec : (start + 2#usize : Result Usize)
      ⦃z => z.val = start.val + 2⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i2,hplus2,hi2⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplus2Spec
  have hplus3Spec : (start + 3#usize : Result Usize)
      ⦃z => z.val = start.val + 3⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i3,hplus3,hi3⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hplus3Spec
  have h0bound : start.val < 16 := by rw [hstartVal]; omega
  have h1bound : i1.val < 16 := by rw [hi1,hstartVal]; omega
  have h2bound : i2.val < 16 := by rw [hi2,hstartVal]; omega
  have h3bound : i3.val < 16 := by rw [hi3,hstartVal]; omega
  have hread0 : Array.index_usize state start =
      .ok (cell state (lane g 0)) := by
    have h := AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok
      state start h0bound
    have heq : (⟨start.val,h0bound⟩ : Fin 16) = lane g 0 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [lane,hstartVal]
    change Array.index_usize state start =
      .ok (cell state (⟨start.val,h0bound⟩ : Fin 16)) at h
    simpa only [heq] using h
  have hread1 : Array.index_usize state i1 =
      .ok (cell state (lane g 1)) := by
    have h := AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok
      state i1 h1bound
    have heq : (⟨i1.val,h1bound⟩ : Fin 16) = lane g 1 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [lane,hi1,hstartVal]
    change Array.index_usize state i1 =
      .ok (cell state (⟨i1.val,h1bound⟩ : Fin 16)) at h
    simpa only [heq] using h
  have hread2 : Array.index_usize state i2 =
      .ok (cell state (lane g 2)) := by
    have h := AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok
      state i2 h2bound
    have heq : (⟨i2.val,h2bound⟩ : Fin 16) = lane g 2 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [lane,hi2,hstartVal]
    change Array.index_usize state i2 =
      .ok (cell state (⟨i2.val,h2bound⟩ : Fin 16)) at h
    simpa only [heq] using h
  have hread3 : Array.index_usize state i3 =
      .ok (cell state (lane g 3)) := by
    have h := AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads.array_index_usize_ok
      state i3 h3bound
    have heq : (⟨i3.val,h3bound⟩ : Fin 16) = lane g 3 := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp [lane,hi3,hstartVal]
    change Array.index_usize state i3 =
      .ok (cell state (⟨i3.val,h3bound⟩ : Fin 16)) at h
    simpa only [heq] using h
  have hcan0 : CanonicalQM (cell state (lane g 0)) := hstate (lane g 0)
  have hcan1 : CanonicalQM (cell state (lane g 1)) := hstate (lane g 1)
  have hcan2 : CanonicalQM (cell state (lane g 2)) := hstate (lane g 2)
  have hcan3 : CanonicalQM (cell state (lane g 3)) := hstate (lane g 3)
  let input := groupInput state g
  have hinput : input = Array.make 4#usize
      [cell state (lane g 0),cell state (lane g 1),
       cell state (lane g 2),cell state (lane g 3)] := rfl
  have hinputCan : ∀ r : Fin 4, CanonicalQM (input.val[r.val]'(by
      simpa [input.property] using r.isLt)) := by
    intro r
    fin_cases r <;> simp [input,groupInput,Array.make] <;> assumption
  obtain ⟨output,hcall,houtputCan,houtputModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalPackedFieldSource.external_local_packed_source_success
      input hinputCan
  have hinputModel :
      (fun r : Fin 4 => Decode
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalPackedInputDecode.inputCell input r)) =
      (fun r : Fin 4 => Decode (cell state (lane g r))) := by
    funext r
    fin_cases r <;> rfl
  have hmodel : Decode output = packedModel state g := by
    change Decode output = R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
      (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => Decode (cell state (lane g r))))
    exact houtputModel.trans
      (congrArg (fun v : Fin 4 → Exact =>
        R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (R0P.poseidonMat4 v)) hinputModel)
  change state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed
    (Array.make 4#usize [cell state (lane g 0), cell state (lane g 1),
      cell state (lane g 2), cell state (lane g 3)]) = .ok output at hcall
  obtain ⟨packed1,hupdate,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec packed group output (by
      have : group.val < packed.val.length := by
        simpa [packed.property] using hglt
      exact this))
  have hwrite : Array.update packed group output = .ok (packed.set group output) := by
    rw [hupdate,hset]
  have hincSpec : (group + 1#usize : Result Usize)
      ⦃z => z.val = group.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨group1,hinc,hincVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hincSpec
  refine ⟨packed1,group1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change groupStep state packed group = .ok (packed1, group1)
    simp [groupStep,hmul,hread0,hplus1,hread1,hplus2,hread2,hplus3,hread3,
      hcall,hupdate,hinc,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro j
    rw [hset]
    change CanonicalQM (cell (packed.set group output) j)
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = group.val
    · simpa only [if_pos hj] using houtputCan
    · simpa only [if_neg hj, packedCell, cell] using hpacked j
  · intro j
    rw [hset]
    change Decode (cell (packed.set group output) j) = _
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell_set]
    simp only [hg]
    by_cases hj : j.val = g.val
    · simpa only [if_pos hj] using hmodel
    · simp only [if_neg hj]
      rfl
  · rw [hincVal,hg]

#print axioms groupStep_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedGroupCall

theorem external_local_packed_source_success (input : QMInput)

      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
        (input.val[i.val]'(by simpa [input.property] using i.isLt))) :
    ∃ q : field.QM31,
      state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed input = .ok q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM q ∧
      Decode q = R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
        (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => Decode (inputCell input r))) := by
  obtain ⟨raw, hrawRun, hrawValues⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalPackedRawFullSource.external_local_packed_raw_source_success
      input hcanonical
  obtain ⟨q, hconvert, hqcanonical, hqdecode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonRawLimbReassembly.source_success raw
  have hinputBound : ∀ r j, inputWord input r j < P := by
    intro r j
    exact AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalInputLimbsBound.mapped_limb_lt_P
      input hcanonical r (outputUsize j) (by simpa [outputUsize_val] using j.isLt)
  have hmodel := packed_raw_rows_decode (inputWord input) hinputBound
  have hsourceWords : sourceRawWord input =
      (fun r j => AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat
        (fun i => inputWord input i j) r) := by
    funext r j
    rfl
  have hpackedValues : (fun j =>
      (AspisR1.RawPoseidonExtensionWords.limbAt raw j).val) =
      (fun j => packedNat (7 * P) (sourceRawWord input) j) := by
    funext j
    simpa only [AspisR1.RawPoseidonExtensionWords.limbAt] using hrawValues j
  have hdecoded : Decode q =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
        (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => Decode (inputCell input r))) := by
    rw [hpackedValues] at hqdecode
    rw [hsourceWords] at hqdecode
    calc
      Decode q = decodeWords (fun j =>
          packedNat (7 * P)
            (fun r k => AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows.rawRowNat
              (fun i => inputWord input i k) r) j) := hqdecode
      _ = R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
          (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => decodeWords (fun j => inputWord input r j))) := hmodel
      _ = R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
          (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => Decode (inputCell input r))) := by
        exact congrArg
          (fun values : Fin 4 → AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact =>
            R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (R0P.poseidonMat4 values))
          (funext (fun r => input_words_decode input r))
  refine ⟨q, ?_, hqcanonical, hdecoded⟩
  unfold state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed
  simp only [hrawRun, bind_tc_ok, hconvert]

#print axioms external_local_packed_source_success

def sourceRawWord (input : QMInput) (r j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalPackedCallbackSource.rawRowFormula
    (mappedRows input) r (outputUsize j) (by simpa [outputUsize_val] using j.isLt)


/-- Source tail of the generated local packed wrapper, after the bound scan.
This fixed four-row tail is kept separate from the high-level model proof. -/
private def rawTailFromRows (rows : LocalRows) (bound : U64) : Result (Array U64 4#usize) := do
  let a1 ← Array.index_usize rows 0#usize
  let i ← Array.index_usize a1 0#usize

theorem external_local_packed_raw_source_success (input : QMInput)
    (hcanonical : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
        (input.val[i.val]'(by simpa [input.property] using i.isLt))) :
    ∃ raw : Array U64 4#usize,
      state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw input = .ok raw ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (raw.val[j.val]'(by simpa [raw.property] using j.isLt)).val =
          packedNat (7 * AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) (sourceRawWord input) j := by
  obtain ⟨rows, hrowsRun, hrowsModel⟩ :=
    outer_rows_success input hcanonical
  obtain ⟨bound, hboundRun, hboundVal⟩ := external_local_limb_bound_success
  have hscan := ignored_bound_scan_success rows
  have hwordsBound : ∀ r j, (localWord rows r j).val < bound.val := by
    intro r j
    have h := (hrowsModel r j).2
    rw [hboundVal]
    exact h
  have hwide : 8 * bound.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hboundVal]
    change 8 * (7 * 2147483647) < 2^64
    norm_num
  obtain ⟨raw, htailRun, htailValues⟩ :=
    externalLocalRawTail_success bound rows hwordsBound hwide
  have hmodelWords : (fun r j => (localWord rows r j).val) = sourceRawWord input := by
    funext r j
    simpa [sourceRawWord, localWord] using (hrowsModel r j).1
  have hP : AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalBoundSource.P =
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P := by
    norm_num [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalBoundSource.P,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P]
  have hvalues : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      (raw.val[j.val]'(by simpa [raw.property] using j.isLt)).val =
        packedNat (7 * AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) (sourceRawWord input) j := by
    intro j
    have hv := htailValues j
    rw [hboundVal, hP] at hv
    calc
      (raw.val[j.val]'(by simpa [raw.property] using j.isLt)).val =
          packedNat (7 * AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P)
            (fun r k => (localWord rows r k).val) j := hv
      _ = packedNat (7 * AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P)
            (sourceRawWord input) j := by
          exact congrArg
            (fun words : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat =>
              packedNat (7 * AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P) words j)
            hmodelWords
  refine ⟨raw, ?_, hvalues⟩
  unfold state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw
  simp only [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalInputLimbsBound.extension_limbs_map_exact,
    bind_tc_ok, hrowsRun, bind_tc_ok, hscan, bind_tc_ok, hboundRun, bind_tc_ok]
  change rawTailFromRows rows bound = .ok raw
  rw [rawTailFromRows_eq]
  exact htailRun

private def toUsize4 (i : Fin 4) : Usize :=

private theorem toUsize4_val (i : Fin 4) : (toUsize4 i).val = i.val := by
  simp [toUsize4, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]

private theorem toUsize4_eq (i : Fin 4) (x : Usize) (hx : x.val = i.val) :
    toUsize4 i = x := by

  simp [toUsize4_val, hx]

private def callbackValue (input : Input) (output : Fin 4) (n : Nat) : U64 :=
  if hn : n < 4 then
    let limb := toUsize4 ⟨n, hn⟩

    U64.ofNatCore (rawRowFormula input output limb hl) (by
      have h := rawRowFormula_bound input output limb hl
      simp only [UScalarTy.U64_numBits_eq]
      omega)

/-- Exact source `array_from_fn_copy` success for one local external row.
This is the actual U64 callback in `external_local_packed_raw`, not an
assumed result array. Each output cell retains the row formula used by the
existing raw Poseidon row theorem. -/
theorem local_row_from_fn_success (input : Input) (output : Fin 4) :
    ∃ raw : Array U64 4#usize,
      array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64
        state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
        0#u64 (input, toUsize4 output) = .ok raw ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (raw.val[j.val]'(by simpa [raw.property] using j.isLt)).val =
          rawRowFormula input output (toUsize4 j)
            (by simpa [toUsize4_val] using j.isLt) := by
  let inst := state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw.closure.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
  let value : Nat → U64 := callbackValue input output
  have hstable : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < 4 →
      inst.call_mut (input, toUsize4 output) i = .ok (value i.val, (input, toUsize4 output)) := by
    intro i hi
    let ix : Fin 4 := ⟨i.val, hi⟩
    have hix : toUsize4 ix = i := toUsize4_eq ix i rfl
    obtain ⟨z, hcall, hz⟩ := local_callback_value input output i hi
    have hv : value i.val = z := by
      dsimp [value, callbackValue]
      rw [dif_pos hi]
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      have hz' : rawRowFormula input output (toUsize4 ix)
          (by simpa [toUsize4_val] using hi) = z.val := by
        simpa only [hix] using hz.symm
      simpa only [U64.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hz'
    simpa [inst, hv] using hcall
  obtain ⟨raw, hrun, hcells⟩ :=
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.array_from_fn_copy_stable
      (4#usize) core.marker.CopyU64 inst 0#u64 (input, toUsize4 output)
      value hstable
  refine ⟨raw, hrun, ?_⟩
  intro j
  have hj : j.val < 4 := j.isLt
  have hout := hcells j.val (by simpa using hj)
  have hvalue : value j.val =
      U64.ofNatCore (rawRowFormula input output (toUsize4 j)
        (by simpa [toUsize4_val] using hj)) (by
          have h := rawRowFormula_bound input output (toUsize4 j)
            (by simpa [toUsize4_val] using hj)
          simp only [UScalarTy.U64_numBits_eq]
          omega) := by
    dsimp [value, callbackValue]
    rw [dif_pos hj]
  rw [hvalue] at hout
  have hval := congrArg UScalar.val hout
  simpa only [U64.ofNatCore_val_eq] using hval
