/-! Symbolic algebra for the actual external packed helper. The coefficient
formulas reuse the towerPackWeight matrix of V5CuArithmeticEquivalences and
the maintained raw_rows_decode_eq_poseidonMat4 theorem. Natural subtraction
follows the source order and is justified by explicit bounds. Source execution
is a separate consumer, not an assumption hidden in this arithmetic bridge. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (M Q decodeWords)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRows (rawRowNat)
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic (iBasis uBasis)
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase (P)

def packedNat (bound : Nat) (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat) (j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  match j.val with
  | 0 => ((((w 0 0 + 5 * bound - w 1 1) + 2 * w 2 2 - w 2 3) - w 3 2) - 2 * w 3 3)
  | 1 => w 0 1 + w 1 0 + w 2 2 + 2 * w 2 3 + 2 * w 3 2 + bound - w 3 3
  | 2 => (w 0 2 + 2 * bound - w 1 3) + w 2 0 - w 3 1
  | _ => w 0 3 + w 1 2 + w 2 1 + w 3 0

def packedCoordinates (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → M) (j : Fin 4) : M :=
  match j.val with
  | 0 => w 0 0 - w 1 1 + 2 * w 2 2 - w 2 3 - w 3 2 - 2 * w 3 3
  | 1 => w 0 1 + w 1 0 + w 2 2 + 2 * w 2 3 + 2 * w 3 2 - w 3 3
  | 2 => w 0 2 - w 1 3 + w 2 0 - w 3 1
  | _ => w 0 3 + w 1 2 + w 2 1 + w 3 0

def fieldWords (w : Fin 4 → M) : Q := ⟨⟨w 0,w 1⟩,⟨w 2,w 3⟩⟩

theorem packed_coordinates_eq_tower_pack (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat) :
    fieldWords (packedCoordinates (fun r j => (w r j : M))) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun r => decodeWords (w r)) := by
  ext <;> simp [fieldWords,packedCoordinates,decodeWords,
    R0P.poseidonPackingFormula,iBasis,uBasis] <;> ring

theorem packed_nat_cast (bound : Nat) (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat)
    (hb : ∀ r j, w r j < bound) (hbound : (bound : M) = 0) (j : Fin 4) :
    (packedNat bound w j : M) = packedCoordinates (fun r k => (w r k : M)) j := by
  have h11 := hb 1 1
  have h23 := hb 2 3
  have h32 := hb 3 2
  have h33 := hb 3 3
  have h13 := hb 1 3
  have h31 := hb 3 1
  fin_cases j
  · change (((((w 0 0 + 5 * bound - w 1 1) + 2 * w 2 2 - w 2 3) - w 3 2) - 2 * w 3 3 : Nat) : M) = _
    have hfirst : w 1 1 ≤ w 0 0 + 5 * bound := by omega
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm hfirst]
    rw [Nat.sub_sub,Nat.sub_sub,Nat.sub_sub]
    have htotal : w 1 1 + (w 2 3 + (w 3 2 + 2 * w 3 3)) ≤ w 0 0 + 5 * bound + 2 * w 2 2 := by omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub htotal]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,hbound]
    change _ = (w 0 0 : M) - (w 1 1 : M) + 2 * (w 2 2 : M) - (w 2 3 : M) - (w 3 2 : M) - 2 * (w 3 3 : M)
    ring
  · change (((w 0 1 + w 1 0 + w 2 2 + 2 * w 2 3 + 2 * w 3 2 + bound - w 3 3 : Nat) : M)) = _
    have htotal : w 3 3 ≤ w 0 1 + w 1 0 + w 2 2 + 2 * w 2 3 + 2 * w 3 2 + bound := by omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub htotal]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,hbound]
    change _ = (w 0 1 : M) + (w 1 0 : M) + (w 2 2 : M) + 2 * (w 2 3 : M) + 2 * (w 3 2 : M) - (w 3 3 : M)
    ring
  · change ((((w 0 2 + 2 * bound - w 1 3) + w 2 0 - w 3 1 : Nat) : M)) = _
    have hfirst : w 1 3 ≤ w 0 2 + 2 * bound := by omega
    rw [← Nat.sub_add_comm hfirst,Nat.sub_sub]
    have htotal : w 1 3 + w 3 1 ≤ w 0 2 + 2 * bound + w 2 0 := by omega
    rw [Nat.cast_sub htotal]
    simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat,hbound]
    change _ = (w 0 2 : M) - (w 1 3 : M) + (w 2 0 : M) - (w 3 1 : M)
    ring
  · change (((w 0 3 + w 1 2 + w 2 1 + w 3 0 : Nat) : M)) = _
    simp only [Nat.cast_add]
    rfl

theorem packed_nat_decode (bound : Nat) (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat)
    (hb : ∀ r j, w r j < bound) (hbound : (bound : M) = 0) :
    decodeWords (packedNat bound w) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun r => decodeWords (w r)) := by
  have hcast : (fun j => (packedNat bound w j : M)) =
      packedCoordinates (fun r j => (w r j : M)) := funext (packed_nat_cast bound w hb hbound)
  change fieldWords (fun j => (packedNat bound w j : M)) = _
  rw [hcast,packed_coordinates_eq_tower_pack]

theorem packed_nat_lt_eight_bound (bound : Nat) (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat)
    (hb : ∀ r j, w r j < bound) (j : Fin 4) : packedNat bound w j < 8 * bound := by
  have h00 := hb 0 0; have h01 := hb 0 1; have h02 := hb 0 2; have h03 := hb 0 3
  have h10 := hb 1 0; have h11 := hb 1 1; have h12 := hb 1 2; have h13 := hb 1 3
  have h20 := hb 2 0; have h21 := hb 2 1; have h22 := hb 2 2; have h23 := hb 2 3
  have h30 := hb 3 0; have h31 := hb 3 1; have h32 := hb 3 2; have h33 := hb 3 3
  fin_cases j <;> simp only [packedNat] <;> omega

theorem raw_rows_lt_seven_P (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat)
    (hw : ∀ r j, w r j < P) (r j : Fin 4) :
    rawRowNat (fun i => w i j) r < 7 * P := by
  have h0 := hw 0 j; have h1 := hw 1 j; have h2 := hw 2 j; have h3 := hw 3 j
  fin_cases r <;> simp only [rawRowNat] <;> omega

theorem packed_raw_rows_decode (w : Fin 4 → Fin 4 → Nat)
    (hw : ∀ r j, w r j < P) :
    decodeWords (packedNat (7 * P) (fun r j => rawRowNat (fun i => w i j) r)) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
        (R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun r => decodeWords (w r))) := by
  have hb : ((7 * P : Nat) : M) = 0 := by
    rw [Nat.cast_mul,ZMod.natCast_self]
    ring
  rw [packed_nat_decode (7 * P) _ (raw_rows_lt_seven_P w hw) hb]
  exact congrArg (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis)
    (funext (fun r => AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField.raw_rows_decode_eq_poseidonMat4 w r))

theorem external_local_limb_bound_success :
    ∃ bound : U64,

    rw [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.cast_value]
    rw [field.P]

abbrev LocalRows := Array (Array U64 4#usize) 4#usize

private theorem inner_loop_success_fuel (local1 : LocalRows) (bounded : Bool)
    (output limb : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (houtput : output.val < 4) (hspan : limb.val + fuel = 4) :
    ∃ result : Bool,
      state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0_loop0
        local1 bounded output limb = .ok result := by
  induction fuel generalizing limb bounded with
  | zero =>
      have hstop : ¬ limb < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
      refine ⟨bounded, ?_⟩
      rw [state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0_loop0.eq_def,
        if_neg hstop]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hlimb : limb.val < 4 := by omega
      have hrow := array_index_usize_ok local1 output (by simpa using houtput)
      let row : Array U64 4#usize := local1.val[output.val]'(by
        simpa [local1.property] using houtput)
      have hrow' : Array.index_usize local1 output = .ok row := by
        simpa [row] using hrow
      have hcell := array_index_usize_ok row limb (by simpa using hlimb)
      obtain ⟨bound, hbound, _⟩ := external_local_limb_bound_success
      let bounded1 : Bool := bounded && decide
        ((row.val[limb.val]'(by simpa [row.property] using hlimb)).val < bound.val)
      have hincSpec : (limb + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = limb.val + 1⦄ := by
        apply UScalar.add_spec
        have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
        scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨limb1, hinc, hincVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hincSpec
      have hspan' : limb1.val + fuel = 4 := by rw [hincVal]; omega
      obtain ⟨bounded2, hrec⟩ := ih (bounded := bounded1) (limb := limb1) hspan'
      have hfour : (4#usize).val = 4 := by scalar_tac
      rw [state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0_loop0.eq_def,
        if_pos (by scalar_tac)]
      simp only [UScalar.lt_equiv, hfour, hlimb, hrow', bind_tc_ok,
        hcell, bind_tc_ok, hbound, bind_tc_ok, bounded1, hinc, bind_tc_ok, hrec]
      exact ⟨bounded2, rfl⟩

theorem ignored_bound_loop_success (local1 : LocalRows) (bounded : Bool)
    (output : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : output.val + fuel = 4) :
    state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0 local1 bounded output = .ok () := by
  induction fuel generalizing output bounded with
  | zero =>
      have hstop : ¬ output < 4#usize := by scalar_tac
      rw [state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0.eq_def, if_neg hstop]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have houtput : output.val < 4 := by omega
      obtain ⟨bounded1, hinner⟩ := inner_loop_success_fuel local1 bounded output 0#usize 4
        houtput (by simp)
      have hincSpec : (output + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = output.val + 1⦄ := by
        apply UScalar.add_spec
        have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
        scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨output1, hinc, hincVal⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hincSpec
      have hspan' : output1.val + fuel = 4 := by rw [hincVal]; omega
      have hfour : (4#usize).val = 4 := by scalar_tac
      rw [state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0.eq_def,
        if_pos (by scalar_tac)]
      simp only [UScalar.lt_equiv, hfour, houtput, hinner, bind_tc_ok,
        hinc, bind_tc_ok]
      exact ih (bounded := bounded1) (output := output1) hspan'

/-- The generated nested bound scan succeeds for every fixed-shape row table.
Its accumulated boolean is deliberately not constrained: the source discards
it and returns Unit. -/
theorem ignored_bound_scan_success (local1 : LocalRows) :
    state_only_poseidon.external_local_packed_raw_loop0 local1 true 0#usize = .ok () :=
  ignored_bound_loop_success local1 true 0#usize 4 (by decide)

#print axioms inner_loop_success_fuel
#print axioms ignored_bound_loop_success
#print axioms ignored_bound_scan_success

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedRawReads

abbrev LocalRows := Array (Array U64 4#usize) 4#usize

def localWord (rows : LocalRows) (r j : Fin 4) : U64 :=
  (rows.val[r.val]'(by simpa [rows.property] using r.isLt)).val[j.val]'(by
    simpa [(rows.val[r.val]'(by simpa [rows.property] using r.isLt)).property] using j.isLt)

private theorem small_nat_usize (n : Nat) (hn : n < 4) :
    n < 2 ^ Std.UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
  have hpow : 4 < 2 ^ Std.UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [Std.UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  omega

private def u4 (i : Fin 4) : Usize :=
  Usize.ofNatCore i.val (small_nat_usize i.val i.isLt)

private theorem u4_val (i : Fin 4) : (u4 i).val = i.val := by
  simp [u4, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]


/-- The exact two checked reads used to obtain one local packed limb. -/
def readWord (rows : LocalRows) (r j : Fin 4) : Result U64 := do
  let row ← Array.index_usize rows (u4 r)
  Array.index_usize row (u4 j)

theorem readWord_success (rows : LocalRows) (r j : Fin 4) :
    ∃ word, readWord rows r j = .ok word ∧ word = localWord rows r j := by
  have hbOuter : (u4 r).val < rows.length := by
    simpa [rows.property, u4_val] using r.isLt
  obtain ⟨row, hOuter, hvOuter⟩ :=
    WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec rows (u4 r) hbOuter)
  have hRow : row = rows.val[r.val]'(by simpa [rows.property] using r.isLt) := by
    simpa [u4_val] using hvOuter
  have hbInner : (u4 j).val < row.length := by
    simpa [row.property, u4_val] using j.isLt
  obtain ⟨word, hInner, hvInner⟩ :=
    WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec row (u4 j) hbInner)
  have hvInner' : word = localWord rows r j := by
    have hvInner1 : word = row.val[j.val]'(by simpa [row.property] using j.isLt) := by
      simpa [u4_val] using hvInner
    calc
      word = row.val[j.val]'(by simpa [row.property] using j.isLt) := hvInner1
      _ = (rows.val[r.val]'(by simpa [rows.property] using r.isLt)).val[j.val]'(by
            simpa [(rows.val[r.val]'(by simpa [rows.property] using r.isLt)).property] using j.isLt) :=
        congrArg (fun x : Array U64 4#usize =>
          x.val[j.val]'(by simpa [x.property] using j.isLt)) hRow
      _ = localWord rows r j := rfl
  refine ⟨word, ?_, hvInner'⟩
  simp only [readWord, hOuter, bind_tc_ok, hInner]

private def f0 : Fin 4 := ⟨0, by decide⟩
private def f1 : Fin 4 := ⟨1, by decide⟩
private def f2 : Fin 4 := ⟨2, by decide⟩
private def f3 : Fin 4 := ⟨3, by decide⟩

private theorem nat1_eq_f1 : (1 : Fin 4) = f1 := Fin.ext rfl
private theorem nat2_eq_f2 : (2 : Fin 4) = f2 := Fin.ext rfl
private theorem nat3_eq_f3 : (3 : Fin 4) = f3 := Fin.ext rfl

  let x11 ← readWord rows f1 f1
  let i4 ← i2 - x11
  let x22 ← readWord rows f2 f2
  let i6 ← 2#u64 * x22
  let i7 ← i4 + i6
  let x23 ← readWord rows f2 f3
  let i9 ← i7 - x23
  let x32 ← readWord rows f3 f2
  let i11 ← i9 - x32
  let x33 ← readWord rows f3 f3
  let i13 ← 2#u64 * x33
  let i14 ← i11 - i13
  ok i14

theorem component0ReadOps_eq (bound : U64) (rows : LocalRows) :

  simp only [f0, f1, f2, f3] at h00 h11 h22 h23 h32 h33 hv00 hv11 hv22 hv23 hv32 hv33
  simp only [component0ReadOps, f0, f1, f2, f3, h00, h11, h22, h23, h32, h33,

  let x10 ← readWord rows f1 f0
  let i17 ← x01 + x10

  let i19 ← i17 + x22

  let i21 ← 2#u64 * x23

  let i26 ← i25 + bound

  let x21 ← readWord rows f2 f1
  let i42 ← i40 + x21

  let i11 ← i9 - w 3 2
  let i13 ← 2#u64 * (w 3 3)

  let i19 ← i17 + w 2 2
  let i21 ← 2#u64 * (w 2 3)

  let i44 ← i42 + w 3 0

  let x1 ← component1Ops bound w
  let x2 ← component2Ops bound w
  let x3 ← component3Ops w

theorem component0Ops_success (bound : U64) (w : Words)
    (hbound : ∀ r j, (w r j).val < bound.val)
    (hwide : 8 * bound.val < 2^64) :
    ∃ out : U64,
      component0Ops bound w = .ok out ∧
      out.val = AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat
        bound.val (fun r j => (w r j).val) 0 := by
  have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
  have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
  have h1 : (5#u64).val * bound.val < 2^64 := by
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide

  rw [h5] at hv1
  have h2 : (w 0 0).val + i1.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv1]
    have hw := hbound 0 0
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
    omega
  obtain ⟨i2, hi2, hv2⟩ := add_success (w 0 0) i1 h2
  have h4 : (w 1 1).val ≤ i2.val := by
    rw [hv2, hv1]
    have hw0 := hbound 0 0
    have hw1 := hbound 1 1
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
    omega
  obtain ⟨i4, hi4, hv4⟩ := sub_success i2 (w 1 1) h4
  have h6 : (2#u64).val * (w 2 2).val < 2^64 := by
    have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
    rw [h2c]
    have hw := hbound 2 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i6, hi6, hv6⟩ := mul_success (2#u64) (w 2 2) h6
  rw [h2c] at hv6
  have h7 : i4.val + i6.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv4, hv6]
    have hw0 := hbound 0 0
    have hw1 := hbound 1 1
    have hw2 := hbound 2 2
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
    have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
    omega
  obtain ⟨i7, hi7, hv7⟩ := add_success i4 i6 h7
  have h9 : (w 2 3).val ≤ i7.val := by
    rw [hv7, hv4, hv2, hv1]
    have hw00 := hbound 0 0
    have hw11 := hbound 1 1
    have hw22 := hbound 2 2
    have hw23 := hbound 2 3
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
    have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
    omega
  obtain ⟨i9, hi9, hv9⟩ := sub_success i7 (w 2 3) h9
  have h11 : (w 3 2).val ≤ i9.val := by
    rw [hv9, hv7, hv4, hv2, hv1]
    have hw00 := hbound 0 0
    have hw11 := hbound 1 1
    have hw22 := hbound 2 2
    have hw23 := hbound 2 3
    have hw32 := hbound 3 2
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
    have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
    omega
  obtain ⟨i11, hi11, hv11⟩ := sub_success i9 (w 3 2) h11
  have h13 : (2#u64).val * (w 3 3).val < 2^64 := by
    have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
    rw [h2c]
    have hw := hbound 3 3
    omega
  obtain ⟨i13, hi13, hv13⟩ := mul_success (2#u64) (w 3 3) h13
  rw [h2c] at hv13
  have h14 : i13.val ≤ i11.val := by
    rw [hv13, hv11, hv9, hv7, hv4, hv2, hv1]
    have hw00 := hbound 0 0
    have hw11 := hbound 1 1
    have hw22 := hbound 2 2
    have hw23 := hbound 2 3
    have hw32 := hbound 3 2
    have hw33 := hbound 3 3
    have h5 : (5#u64).val = 5 := by decide
    have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
    omega
  obtain ⟨i14, hi14, hv14⟩ := sub_success i11 i13 h14
  change UScalar.mul (5#u64) bound = Result.ok i1 at hi1
  change UScalar.add (w 0 0) i1 = Result.ok i2 at hi2
  change UScalar.sub i2 (w 1 1) = Result.ok i4 at hi4
  change UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 2 2) = Result.ok i6 at hi6
  change UScalar.add i4 i6 = Result.ok i7 at hi7
  change UScalar.sub i7 (w 2 3) = Result.ok i9 at hi9
  change UScalar.sub i9 (w 3 2) = Result.ok i11 at hi11
  change UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 3 3) = Result.ok i13 at hi13
  change UScalar.sub i11 i13 = Result.ok i14 at hi14
  refine ⟨i14, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (do
      let i1 ← UScalar.mul (5#u64) bound
      let i2 ← UScalar.add (w 0 0) i1
      let i4 ← UScalar.sub i2 (w 1 1)
      let i6 ← UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 2 2)
      let i7 ← UScalar.add i4 i6
      let i9 ← UScalar.sub i7 (w 2 3)
      let i11 ← UScalar.sub i9 (w 3 2)
      let i13 ← UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 3 3)
      let i14 ← UScalar.sub i11 i13
      Result.ok i14) = Result.ok i14
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, hi1, hi2, hi4, hi6, hi7, hi9, hi11, hi13, hi14]
  · rw [hv14, hv13, hv11, hv9, hv7, hv6, hv4, hv2, hv1]
    simp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat]

theorem component1Ops_success (bound : U64) (w : Words)
    (hbound : ∀ r j, (w r j).val < bound.val)
    (hwide : 8 * bound.val < 2^64) :
    ∃ out : U64,
      component1Ops bound w = .ok out ∧
      out.val = AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat
        bound.val (fun r j => (w r j).val) 1 := by
  have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
  have h17 : (w 0 1).val + (w 1 0).val < 2^64 := by
    have h01 := hbound 0 1; have h10 := hbound 1 0
    omega
  obtain ⟨i17, hi17, hv17⟩ := add_success (w 0 1) (w 1 0) h17
  have h19 : i17.val + (w 2 2).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv17]
    have h01 := hbound 0 1; have h10 := hbound 1 0
    have h22 := hbound 2 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i19, hi19, hv19⟩ := add_success i17 (w 2 2) h19
  have h21 : (2#u64).val * (w 2 3).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [h2c]
    have h23 := hbound 2 3
    omega
  obtain ⟨i21, hi21, hv21⟩ := mul_success (2#u64) (w 2 3) h21
  rw [h2c] at hv21
  have h22' : i19.val + i21.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv19, hv21, hv17]
    have h01 := hbound 0 1; have h10 := hbound 1 0
    have h22 := hbound 2 2; have h23 := hbound 2 3
    omega
  obtain ⟨i22, hi22, hv22⟩ := add_success i19 i21 h22'
  have h24 : (2#u64).val * (w 3 2).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [h2c]
    have h32 := hbound 3 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i24, hi24, hv24⟩ := mul_success (2#u64) (w 3 2) h24
  rw [h2c] at hv24
  have h25 : i22.val + i24.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv22, hv24, hv21, hv19, hv17]
    have h01 := hbound 0 1; have h10 := hbound 1 0
    have h22 := hbound 2 2; have h23 := hbound 2 3
    have h32 := hbound 3 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i25, hi25, hv25⟩ := add_success i22 i24 h25
  have h26 : i25.val + bound.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv25, hv22, hv24, hv21, hv19, hv17]
    have h01 := hbound 0 1; have h10 := hbound 1 0
    have h22 := hbound 2 2; have h23 := hbound 2 3
    have h32 := hbound 3 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i26, hi26, hv26⟩ := add_success i25 bound h26
  have h28 : (w 3 3).val ≤ i26.val := by
    rw [hv26, hv25, hv22, hv24, hv21, hv19, hv17]
    have h01 := hbound 0 1; have h10 := hbound 1 0
    have h22 := hbound 2 2; have h23 := hbound 2 3
    have h32 := hbound 3 2; have h33 := hbound 3 3
    omega
  obtain ⟨i28, hi28, hv28⟩ := sub_success i26 (w 3 3) h28
  change UScalar.add (w 0 1) (w 1 0) = Result.ok i17 at hi17
  change UScalar.add i17 (w 2 2) = Result.ok i19 at hi19
  change UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 2 3) = Result.ok i21 at hi21
  change UScalar.add i19 i21 = Result.ok i22 at hi22
  change UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 3 2) = Result.ok i24 at hi24
  change UScalar.add i22 i24 = Result.ok i25 at hi25
  change UScalar.add i25 bound = Result.ok i26 at hi26
  change UScalar.sub i26 (w 3 3) = Result.ok i28 at hi28
  refine ⟨i28, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (do
      let i17 ← UScalar.add (w 0 1) (w 1 0)
      let i19 ← UScalar.add i17 (w 2 2)
      let i21 ← UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 2 3)
      let i22 ← UScalar.add i19 i21
      let i24 ← UScalar.mul (2#u64) (w 3 2)
      let i25 ← UScalar.add i22 i24
      let i26 ← UScalar.add i25 bound
      let i28 ← UScalar.sub i26 (w 3 3)
      Result.ok i28) = Result.ok i28
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, hi17, hi19, hi21, hi22, hi24, hi25, hi26, hi28]
  · rw [hv28, hv26, hv25, hv24, hv22, hv21, hv19, hv17]
    simp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat]

theorem component2Ops_success (bound : U64) (w : Words)
    (hbound : ∀ r j, (w r j).val < bound.val)
    (hwide : 8 * bound.val < 2^64) :
    ∃ out : U64,
      component2Ops bound w = .ok out ∧
      out.val = AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat
        bound.val (fun r j => (w r j).val) 2 := by
  have h2c : (2#u64).val = 2 := by decide
  have h30 : (2#u64).val * bound.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [h2c]
    omega
  obtain ⟨i30, hi30, hv30⟩ := mul_success (2#u64) bound h30
  rw [h2c] at hv30
  have h31 : (w 0 2).val + i30.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv30]
    have h02 := hbound 0 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i31, hi31, hv31⟩ := add_success (w 0 2) i30 h31
  have h33 : (w 1 3).val ≤ i31.val := by
    rw [hv31, hv30]
    have h02 := hbound 0 2; have h13 := hbound 1 3
    omega
  obtain ⟨i33, hi33, hv33⟩ := sub_success i31 (w 1 3) h33
  have h35 : i33.val + (w 2 0).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv33, hv31, hv30]
    have h02 := hbound 0 2; have h13 := hbound 1 3
    have h20 := hbound 2 0
    omega
  obtain ⟨i35, hi35, hv35⟩ := add_success i33 (w 2 0) h35
  have h37 : (w 3 1).val ≤ i35.val := by
    rw [hv35, hv33, hv31, hv30]
    have h02 := hbound 0 2; have h13 := hbound 1 3
    have h20 := hbound 2 0; have h31 := hbound 3 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨i37, hi37, hv37⟩ := sub_success i35 (w 3 1) h37
  change UScalar.mul (2#u64) bound = Result.ok i30 at hi30
  change UScalar.add (w 0 2) i30 = Result.ok i31 at hi31
  change UScalar.sub i31 (w 1 3) = Result.ok i33 at hi33
  change UScalar.add i33 (w 2 0) = Result.ok i35 at hi35
  change UScalar.sub i35 (w 3 1) = Result.ok i37 at hi37
  refine ⟨i37, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (do
      let i30 ← UScalar.mul (2#u64) bound
      let i31 ← UScalar.add (w 0 2) i30
      let i33 ← UScalar.sub i31 (w 1 3)
      let i35 ← UScalar.add i33 (w 2 0)
      let i37 ← UScalar.sub i35 (w 3 1)
      Result.ok i37) = Result.ok i37
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, hi30, hi31, hi33, hi35, hi37]
  · rw [hv37, hv35, hv33, hv31, hv30]
    simp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat]

theorem component3Ops_success (bound : U64) (w : Words)
    (hbound : ∀ r j, (w r j).val < bound.val)
    (hwide : 8 * bound.val < 2^64) :
    ∃ out : U64,
      component3Ops w = .ok out ∧
      out.val = AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat
        bound.val (fun r j => (w r j).val) 3 := by
  have h40 : (w 0 3).val + (w 1 2).val < 2^64 := by
    have h03 := hbound 0 3; have h12 := hbound 1 2
    omega
  obtain ⟨i40, hi40, hv40⟩ := add_success (w 0 3) (w 1 2) h40
  have h42 : i40.val + (w 2 1).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv40]
    have h03 := hbound 0 3; have h12 := hbound 1 2
    have h21 := hbound 2 1
    omega
  obtain ⟨i42, hi42, hv42⟩ := add_success i40 (w 2 1) h42
  have h44 : i42.val + (w 3 0).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hv42, hv40]
    have h03 := hbound 0 3; have h12 := hbound 1 2
    have h21 := hbound 2 1; have h30 := hbound 3 0
    omega
  obtain ⟨i44, hi44, hv44⟩ := add_success i42 (w 3 0) h44
  change UScalar.add (w 0 3) (w 1 2) = Result.ok i40 at hi40
  change UScalar.add i40 (w 2 1) = Result.ok i42 at hi42
  change UScalar.add i42 (w 3 0) = Result.ok i44 at hi44
  refine ⟨i44, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (do
      let i40 ← UScalar.add (w 0 3) (w 1 2)
      let i42 ← UScalar.add i40 (w 2 1)
      let i44 ← UScalar.add i42 (w 3 0)
      Result.ok i44) = Result.ok i44
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, hi40, hi42, hi44]
  · rw [hv44, hv42, hv40]
    simp [AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat]

theorem packedComponentsOps_success (bound : U64) (w : Words)
    (hbound : ∀ r j, (w r j).val < bound.val)
    (hwide : 8 * bound.val < 2^64) :
    ∃ out : Array U64 4#usize,
      packedComponentsOps bound w = .ok out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4,
        out.val[j.val]'(by simpa using j.isLt) =
          AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra.packedNat
            bound.val (fun r k => (w r k).val) j := by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hv0⟩ := component0Ops_success bound w hbound hwide
  obtain ⟨x1, hx1, hv1⟩ := component1Ops_success bound w hbound hwide
  obtain ⟨x2, hx2, hv2⟩ := component2Ops_success bound w hbound hwide
  obtain ⟨x3, hx3, hv3⟩ := component3Ops_success bound w hbound hwide
  refine ⟨Array.make 4#usize [x0, x1, x2, x3], ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp [packedComponentsOps, hx0, hx1, hx2, hx3]
  · intro j
    fin_cases j <;> simp [Array.make, hv0, hv1, hv2, hv3]

#print axioms component0Ops_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedRawOps

import Aeneas
import PoseidonLeadingSourceDeclarationsV5
import PoseidonExternalLocalInputLimbsBoundV12
import PoseidonRawLimbReassembly
import PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra
import RawPoseidonRowField
import RawPoseidonExternalRowReads
import PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel
import PoseidonInternalStateWords
import ExtractedMaskTowerAdd
import R0P.Poseidon

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option maxHeartbeats 1000000
set_option maxRecDepth 2048
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalPackedInputDecode
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalInputLimbsBound
open AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedAlgebra
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonExternalRowReads
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField

open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase (P)

abbrev QMInput := Array field.QM31 4#usize
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

def inputCell (input : QMInput) (r : Fin 4) : field.QM31 :=
  input.val[r.val]'(by simpa [input.property] using r.isLt)

private theorem small_nat_usize (n : Nat) (hn : n < 4) :
    n < 2 ^ Std.UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
  have hpow : 4 < 2 ^ Std.UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [Std.UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  omega

def outputUsize (j : Fin 4) : Usize :=
  Usize.ofNatCore j.val (small_nat_usize j.val j.isLt)

theorem outputUsize_val (j : Fin 4) : (outputUsize j).val = j.val := by
  simp [outputUsize, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]

def inputWord (input : QMInput) (r j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  (limbValue (mappedRows input) r (outputUsize j)
    (by simpa [outputUsize_val] using j.isLt)).val

theorem input_words_decode (input : QMInput) (r : Fin 4) :
    decodeWords (fun j => inputWord input r j) = Decode (inputCell input r) := by
  have hrow : rowValue (mappedRows input) r = wordVec (inputCell input r) := by
    simp [rowValue, mappedRows, limbsOf, inputCell, wordVec]
  have hwords : (fun j => inputWord input r j) =
      (fun j => (AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell
        (wordVec (inputCell input r)) j).val) := by
    funext j
    simp [inputWord, limbValue, hrow, outputUsize_val,
      AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell]
  rw [hwords]
  exact AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel.wordVec_decode (inputCell input r)

#print axioms input_words_decode
end AspisR1.PoseidonExternalLocalPackedInputDecode
PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel:
import PoseidonInternalAccumulateState
import RawPoseidonRowField
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/-! Symbolic interpretation of the actual nonzero-lane accumulator. The
four-coordinate decoder is additive; no concrete fifteen-lane term or tower
multiplication is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (State QM Exact Decode cell CanonicalState)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords decodeWords_add)
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

theorem wordVec_decode (q : QM) :
    decodeWords (fun j => (cell (wordVec q) j).val) = Decode q := by
  rfl

theorem wordNat_decode (state : State) (lane : Fin 16) :
    decodeWords (fun j => wordNat state lane.val j) = Decode (cell state lane) := by
  have hwords : (fun j : Fin 4 => wordNat state lane.val j) =
      (fun j => (cell (wordVec (cell state lane)) j).val) := by
    funext j
    unfold wordNat
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by simpa [state.property] using lane.isLt)]
    rfl
  rw [hwords]
  exact wordVec_decode (cell state lane)

theorem remaining_decode_eq_sum (state : State) (start fuel : Nat) :
    decodeWords (fun j => remaining state start fuel j) =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin fuel =>
        decodeWords (fun j => wordNat state (start+i.val) j))).sum := by
  induction fuel generalizing start with
  | zero =>
    change decodeWords (fun _ => 0) = _
    simp only [List.ofFn_zero,List.sum_nil]
    ext <;> simp [decodeWords]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    change decodeWords (fun j => wordNat state start j + remaining state (start+1) fuel j) = _
    rw [decodeWords_add,ih,List.ofFn_succ,List.sum_cons]
    have htail : (fun i : Fin fuel => decodeWords (fun j => wordNat state (start+1+i.val) j)) =
        (fun i : Fin fuel => decodeWords (fun j => wordNat state (start+i.succ.val) j)) := by
      funext i
      have hi : start+1+i.val = start+i.succ.val := by
        change start+1+i.val = start+(i.val+1)
        omega
      rw [hi]
    simpa only [Fin.val_zero,Nat.add_zero,htail]

def partSum (state : State) : Exact :=
  (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 15 => Decode (cell state i.succ))).foldl (· + ·) 0

theorem source_success (state : State) (hstate : CanonicalState state) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0 state
        AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero 1#usize = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out (15*P) ∧
      decodeWords (fun j => (cell out j).val) = partSum state := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hbound,hvalues⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.source_success state hstate
  refine ⟨out,hrun,hbound,?_⟩
  have hfun : (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell out j).val) =
      (fun j => remaining state 1 15 j) := funext hvalues
  rw [hfun,remaining_decode_eq_sum]
  have hterms : (fun i : Fin 15 => decodeWords (fun j => wordNat state (1+i.val) j)) =
      (fun i : Fin 15 => Decode (cell state i.succ)) := by
    funext i
    have hi : 1+i.val = i.succ.val := by
      change 1+i.val = i.val+1
      omega
    rw [hi,wordNat_decode]
  rw [hterms,List.sum_eq_foldl]
  rfl

#print axioms wordVec_decode
#print axioms wordNat_decode
#print axioms remaining_decode_eq_sum
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel
PoseidonInternalAccumulateState:
import PoseidonInternalStateWords

/-! Actual accumulation over the fifteen nonzero state lanes. The budget
tracks processed canonical words; the remaining sum stays symbolic. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (State CanonicalState cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer

theorem source_loop_eq (state : State) (part : Raw4) (lane : Usize) :
    state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0 state part lane =
      (if lane < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH then do
        let q ← Array.index_usize state lane
        let words ← state_only_poseidon.extension_limbs q
        let nextPart ← state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0_loop0 part words 0#usize
        let nextLane ← UScalar.add lane 1#usize
        state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0 state nextPart nextLane
      else .ok part) := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0.eq_def]
  rfl

theorem loop_success_fuel (state : State) (part : Raw4) (lane : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hlane : 1 ≤ lane.val) (hspan : lane.val+fuel=16)
    (hbudget : ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell part j).val ≤ (lane.val-1)*(P-1)) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0 state part lane = .ok out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val ≤ 15*(P-1)) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val = (cell part j).val + remaining state lane.val fuel j := by
  have hwidth : poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH = 16#usize := by unfold poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH; rfl
  induction fuel generalizing part lane with
  | zero =>
    have hlane16 : lane.val = 16 := by omega
    have hstop : ¬ lane < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH := by rw [hwidth]; scalar_tac
    refine ⟨part,?_,?_,?_⟩

import R0P.Poseidon

/-! Symbolic distribution of the existing R0P external layer through the
literal four-lane pack. Matrix evaluation stays opaque. This is the model
boundary for the actual packed implementation's per-group map and total sum. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonExternalPackedModel
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def lane (group column : Fin 4) : Fin 16 :=
  ⟨4 * group.val + column.val,by have := group.isLt; have := column.isLt; omega⟩

def localCell (state : Fin 16 → K) (group column : Fin 4) : K :=
  R0P.poseidonMat4 (fun j => state (lane group j)) column

def localPacked (state : Fin 16 → K) (i u : K) (group : Fin 4) : K :=
  R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (localCell state group)

theorem external_cell (state : Fin 16 → K) (group column : Fin 4) :
    R0P.poseidonExternalLinear state (lane group column) =
      localCell state group column +
        ((((0 + localCell state 0 column) + localCell state 1 column) +
          localCell state 2 column) + localCell state 3 column) := by
  let gi : Fin 4 := ⟨(4 * group.val + column.val) / 4,by
    have := group.isLt; have := column.isLt; omega⟩
  let ci : Fin 4 := ⟨(4 * group.val + column.val) % 4,Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩
  have hg : gi = group := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change (4 * group.val + column.val) / 4 = group.val
    have := column.isLt
    omega
  have hc : ci = column := by
    apply Fin.ext
    change (4 * group.val + column.val) % 4 = column.val
    have := column.isLt
    omega
  change localCell state gi ci +
      ((((0 + localCell state 0 ci) + localCell state 1 ci) +
        localCell state 2 ci) + localCell state 3 ci) = _
  rw [hg,hc]

theorem packed_external_eq (state : Fin 16 → K) (i u : K) (group : Fin 4) :
    R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonExternalLinear state (lane group j)) =
      localPacked state i u group +
        ((((0 + localPacked state i u 0) + localPacked state i u 1) +
          localPacked state i u 2) + localPacked state i u 3) := by
  simp only [localPacked,R0P.poseidonPackingFormula,external_cell]
  ring

theorem packed_external_eq_pack4 {F : Subfield K} (B : R0P.PackBasis F)
    (state : Fin 16 → K) (group : Fin 4) :
    R0P.pack4 B (fun j => R0P.poseidonExternalLinear state (lane group j)) =
      localPacked state B.i B.u group +
        ((((0 + localPacked state B.i B.u 0) + localPacked state B.i B.u 1) +
          localPacked state B.i B.u 2) + localPacked state B.i B.u 3) := by
  simpa only [R0P.pack4,R0P.poseidonPackingFormula] using
    packed_external_eq state B.i B.u group

  have hoddState : decodedState odd =

    change Decode (cell state1 i) =
      R0P.poseidonFullRound (decodedState state) (decodedState even) i at h
    rw [hevenState] at h
    exact h
  have hinterpModel : R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair
      (decodedState state) (decodedState local1) =

          (fun j => AspisR1.PoseidonInterpolatedFullInputs.evenModel local1 j) k)
        (fun j => AspisR1.PoseidonInterpolatedFullInputs.oddModel local1 j) i) := by
    funext i

  · rw [AspisR1.PoseidonInterpolatedFullInputs.wrapper_factor]
    rw [hprepare]
    rw [bind_ok_pair]
    rw [hfirst]
    rw [bind_ok]
    rw [hsecond]

    have h := hsecondModel group
    change Decode (packedCell out group) = R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis
      (fun j => R0P.poseidonFullRound (decodedState state1) (decodedState odd)
        (lane group j)) at h
    rw [hstate1Model, hoddState] at h
    simpa only [hinterpModel] using h

/-! Bind each interpolated constant cell to actual weight and column reads,
then to the actual output-array update. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantColumnStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
abbrev Weights := Array QM 3#usize

def CanonicalWeights (weights : Weights) : Prop := ∀ i : Fin 3, Canonical (cell weights i)
def model (weights : Weights) (c0 c1 c2 : Constants) (lane : Fin 16) : Exact :=
  Decode (cell weights (0 : Fin 3)) * ((cell c0 lane).val : Exact) +
  Decode (cell weights (1 : Fin 3)) * ((cell c1 lane).val : Exact) +
  Decode (cell weights (2 : Fin 3)) * ((cell c2 lane).val : Exact)

def sourceStep (weights : Weights) (c0 c1 c2 : Constants) (out : State) (lane : Usize) : Result State := do
  let w0 ← Array.index_usize weights 0#usize
  let w1 ← Array.index_usize weights 1#usize
  let w2 ← Array.index_usize weights 2#usize
  let k0 ← Array.index_usize c0 lane
  let k1 ← Array.index_usize c1 lane
  let k2 ← Array.index_usize c2 lane
  let value ← AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantCell.source w0 w1 w2 k0 k1 k2
  Array.update out lane value

theorem sourceStep_success (weights : Weights) (c0 c1 c2 : Constants) (out : State)
    (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 16) (hw : CanonicalWeights weights)
    (hc0 : CanonicalConstants c0) (hc1 : CanonicalConstants c1) (hc2 : CanonicalConstants c2)
    (hout : CanonicalState out) :
    ∃ value : QM, sourceStep weights c0 c1 c2 out lane = .ok (out.set lane value) ∧
      CanonicalState (out.set lane value) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16,
      Decode (cell (out.set lane value) j) =
        if j.val = lane.val then model weights c0 c1 c2 ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩ else Decode (cell out j) := by
  let index : Fin 16 := ⟨lane.val,hlane⟩
  let w0 := cell weights (0 : Fin 3)
  let w1 := cell weights (1 : Fin 3)
  let w2 := cell weights (2 : Fin 3)
  let k0 := cell c0 index
  let k1 := cell c1 index
  let k2 := cell c2 index
  have hr0 : Array.index_usize weights 0#usize = .ok w0 := by
    have hread := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok weights 0#usize (by decide)
    change Array.index_usize weights 0#usize = .ok (weights.val[0]'(by simpa [weights.property] using (by decide : 0 < 3))) at hread
    change Array.index_usize weights 0#usize = .ok (weights.val[0]'(by simpa [weights.property] using (by decide : 0 < 3)))
    exact hread
  have hr1 : Array.index_usize weights 1#usize = .ok w1 := by
    have hread := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok weights 1#usize (by decide)
    change Array.index_usize weights 1#usize = .ok (weights.val[1]'(by simpa [weights.property] using (by decide : 1 < 3))) at hread
    change Array.index_usize weights 1#usize = .ok (weights.val[1]'(by simpa [weights.property] using (by decide : 1 < 3)))
    exact hread
  have hr2 : Array.index_usize weights 2#usize = .ok w2 := by
    have hread := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok weights 2#usize (by decide)
    change Array.index_usize weights 2#usize = .ok (weights.val[2]'(by simpa [weights.property] using (by decide : 2 < 3))) at hread
    change Array.index_usize weights 2#usize = .ok (weights.val[2]'(by simpa [weights.property] using (by decide : 2 < 3)))
    exact hread
  have hb : lane.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using hlane
  have hc0read : Array.index_usize c0 lane = .ok k0 := by
    simpa only [k0,index,cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok c0 lane hb
  have hc1read : Array.index_usize c1 lane = .ok k1 := by
    simpa only [k1,index,cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok c1 lane hb
  have hc2read : Array.index_usize c2 lane = .ok k2 := by
    simpa only [k2,index,cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok c2 lane hb
  obtain ⟨value,hvalue,hcan,hmodel⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantCell.source_success
    w0 w1 w2 k0 k1 k2 (hw 0) (hw 1) (hw 2) (hc0 index) (hc1 index) (hc2 index)
  change Decode value = model weights c0 c1 c2 index at hmodel
  obtain ⟨updated,hupdate,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec out lane value (by simpa [out.property] using hb))
  have hwrite : Array.update out lane value = .ok (out.set lane value) := by rw [hupdate,hset]
  refine ⟨value,?_,set_canonical out lane value hout hcan,?_⟩
  · simp only [sourceStep,hr0,hr1,hr2,hc0read,hc1read,hc2read,hvalue,hwrite,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = lane.val
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      exact hmodel
    · simp only [if_neg hj]

theorem generated_loop_step (weights : Weights) (c0 c1 c2 : Constants) (out : State) (lane : Usize) :
    state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_columns_loop weights c0 c1 c2 out lane =
      (if lane < poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH then do
        let nextState ← sourceStep weights c0 c1 c2 out lane
        let lane1 ← lane + 1#usize
        state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_columns_loop weights c0 c1 c2 nextState lane1
      else .ok out) := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_columns_loop.eq_def]
  simp only [sourceStep,AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantCell.source,bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

import AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep

/-! The four exact scalar source calls in an interpolated constant cell.
Array read/write binding belongs to the enclosing columns loop. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantCell
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Canonical Decode Exact P)

def source (w0 w1 w2 : QM) (c0 c1 c2 : U32) : Result QM := do
  let m0 ← state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_limb w0.c0.a w1.c0.a w2.c0.a c0 c1 c2
  let m1 ← state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_limb w0.c0.b w1.c0.b w2.c0.b c0 c1 c2
  let real ← field.CM31.new m0 m1
  let m2 ← state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_limb w0.c1.a w1.c1.a w2.c1.a c0 c1 c2
  let m3 ← state_only_poseidon.interpolate_three_constant_limb w0.c1.b w1.c1.b w2.c1.b c0 c1 c2
  let imag ← field.CM31.new m2 m3
  pure ({c0 := real,c1 := imag} : QM)

theorem source_success (w0 w1 w2 : QM) (c0 c1 c2 : U32)
    (hw0 : Canonical w0) (hw1 : Canonical w1) (hw2 : Canonical w2)
    (hc0 : c0.val < P) (hc1 : c1.val < P) (hc2 : c2.val < P) :
    ∃ out : QM, source w0 w1 w2 c0 c1 c2 = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      Decode out = Decode w0 * (c0.val : Exact) + Decode w1 * (c1.val : Exact) +
        Decode w2 * (c2.val : Exact) := by
  obtain ⟨m0,h0,hcan0,hmodel0⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantLimb.source_model
    w0.c0.a w1.c0.a w2.c0.a c0 c1 c2 hw0.1.1 hw1.1.1 hw2.1.1 hc0 hc1 hc2
  obtain ⟨m1,h1,hcan1,hmodel1⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantLimb.source_model
    w0.c0.b w1.c0.b w2.c0.b c0 c1 c2 hw0.1.2 hw1.1.2 hw2.1.2 hc0 hc1 hc2
  obtain ⟨m2,h2,hcan2,hmodel2⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantLimb.source_model
    w0.c1.a w1.c1.a w2.c1.a c0 c1 c2 hw0.2.1 hw1.2.1 hw2.2.1 hc0 hc1 hc2
  obtain ⟨m3,h3,hcan3,hmodel3⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantLimb.source_model
    w0.c1.b w1.c1.b w2.c1.b c0 c1 c2 hw0.2.2 hw1.2.2 hw2.2.2 hc0 hc1 hc2
  let out : QM := ⟨⟨m0,m1⟩,⟨m2,m3⟩⟩
  refine ⟨out,?_,⟨⟨hcan0,hcan1⟩,⟨hcan2,hcan3⟩⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [source,h0,h1,h2,h3,field.CM31.new,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  · ext <;> simp [Decode,AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode,out,
      hmodel0,hmodel1,hmodel2,hmodel3]

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonThreeConstantCell

import CopyEndpointSource

/-! Actual Copy endpoint update: shared selector-row execution, existing
field arithmetic and generic checked update/frame facts are composed here.
The source slot/pattern/tag bounds are explicit generated-registry obligations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Endpoint := AspisR1CopyEndpointCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CompiledPoolV1PairForestEndpoint
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

def decodedCells {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) : Fin n.val → ExactQM :=
  fun i => decode (cells a i)

def modelEndpoint (e : Endpoint) (hr : e.row.val < 1024)
    (hs : e.slot.val < 2) (hp : e.pattern.val < 14) : R0P.CopyEndpoint :=
  { row := ⟨e.row.val, hr⟩, slot := ⟨e.slot.val, hs⟩,
    pattern := ⟨e.pattern.val, hp⟩ }

def modelSelectors (s : Selectors) : R0P.CopySelectors ExactQM :=
  { high := fun i => AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray s.high i.val,
    low := fun i => AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray s.low i.val }

private theorem decoded_update {n : Usize} (a b : Array QM n)
    (i : Fin n.val) (q : QM)
    (h : cells b = Function.update (cells a) i q) :
    decodedCells b = Function.update (decodedCells a) i (decode q) := by
  funext j
  change decode (cells b j) = _
  rw [h]
  by_cases he : j = i
  · subst j; simp [decodedCells]
  · simp [Function.update, he, decodedCells]

/-- Every actual endpoint read, arithmetic operation and store succeeds.
The returned arrays are canonical and equal the retained model's two updates. -/
theorem endpoint_success
    (values weights : Array QM 2#usize) (endpoint : Endpoint)
    (tag : U32) (weight : field.M31) (patterns : Array QM 14#usize)
    (selectors : Selectors)
    (hvalues : CanonicalArray values) (hweights : CanonicalArray weights)
    (hpatterns : CanonicalArray patterns)
    (hhigh : CanonicalArray selectors.high) (hlow : CanonicalArray selectors.low)
    (hrow : endpoint.row.val < 1024) (hslot : endpoint.slot.val < 2)
    (hpattern : endpoint.pattern.val < 14)
    (htag : tag.val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P) :
    ∃ valuesOut weightsOut,
      AspisR1CopyEndpointCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.accumulate_endpoint
        values weights endpoint tag weight patterns selectors = .ok (valuesOut, weightsOut) ∧
      CanonicalArray valuesOut ∧ CanonicalArray weightsOut ∧
      (decodedCells valuesOut, decodedCells weightsOut) =
        R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint (decodedCells values) (decodedCells weights)
          (modelEndpoint endpoint hrow hslot hpattern) tag.val
          (weight.val : ExactQM) (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors) := by
  let rowIndex := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU16.from endpoint.row
  let slot := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from endpoint.slot
  let patternIndex := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from endpoint.pattern
  let slotFin : Fin 2 := ⟨endpoint.slot.val, hslot⟩
  let patternFin : Fin 14 := ⟨endpoint.pattern.val, hpattern⟩
  have hrowValue : rowIndex.val = endpoint.row.val := by
    exact core.convert.num.FromUsizeU16.from_val_eq endpoint.row
  have hslotValue : slot.val = endpoint.slot.val := by
    exact core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from_val_eq endpoint.slot
  have hpatternValue : patternIndex.val = endpoint.pattern.val := by
    exact core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from_val_eq endpoint.pattern
  have hslotBound : slot.val < (2#usize).val := by simpa [hslotValue] using hslot
  have hpatternBound : patternIndex.val < (14#usize).val := by
    simpa [hpatternValue] using hpattern
  obtain ⟨selector, hrowRun, hselectorCan, hselectorValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorRowCall.row_success_of_canonical selectors rowIndex
      (by rw [hrowValue]; exact hrow) hhigh hlow
  have hselector : decode selector =
      R0P.copySelectorRow (modelSelectors selectors)
        (modelEndpoint endpoint hrow hslot hpattern).row := by
    change decode selector =
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray selectors.high
        (endpoint.row.val / 16) *
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray selectors.low
        (endpoint.row.val % 16)
    simpa [hrowValue] using hselectorValue
  let oldWeight := cells weights slotFin
  let oldValue := cells values slotFin
  let patternValue := cells patterns patternFin
  have hreadWeight : Array.index_usize weights slot = .ok oldWeight := by
    simpa [oldWeight, cells, slotFin, hslotValue] using

open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd

abbrev QM := field.QM31

def rowIndex (row : Usize) : Nat := row.val / 16
def columnIndex (row : Usize) : Nat := row.val % 16

private theorem array_index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds

private theorem shift4_success (row : Usize) :
    ∃ i : Usize, row >>> 4#i32 = .ok i ∧ i.val = row.val / 16 := by
  have hy0 : 0 ≤ (4#i32).val := by norm_num
  have hy1 : (4#i32).val < UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    cases System.Platform.numBits_eq <;>
      norm_num [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, *]
  have hspec := UScalar.ShiftRight_IScalar_spec row (4#i32) hy0 hy1
  obtain ⟨i, hrun, ⟨hval, _⟩⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
  refine ⟨i, hrun, ?_⟩
  rw [hval]
  simp [IScalar.toNat, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

private theorem mask15_success (row : Usize) :
    ∃ i : Usize, lift (row &&& 15#usize) = .ok i ∧ i.val = row.val % 16 := by
  obtain ⟨i, hrun, hspec⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.and_spec row (15#usize))
  refine ⟨i, hrun, ?_⟩
  have h15 : (15#usize).val = 15 := by rfl
  have hval : (row &&& 15#usize).val = row.val % 16 := by
    rw [UScalar.val_and, h15]
    simpa only [show (16 : Nat) = 2 ^ 4 by norm_num] using
      (Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod row.val 4)
  exact hspec.1.trans hval

theorem row_success_of_canonical
    (selectors : Selectors) (row : Usize) (hrow : row.val < 1024)
    (hhigh : canonicalArray selectors.high) (hlow : canonicalArray selectors.low) :
    ∃ out : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors row = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out =
        decodedArray selectors.high (row.val / 16) *
          decodedArray selectors.low (row.val % 16) := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hiv⟩ := shift4_success row
  obtain ⟨i1, hi1, hi1v⟩ := mask15_success row
  have hquot : row.val / 16 < 64 := by omega
  have hrem : row.val % 16 < 16 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h64 : (64#usize).val = 64 := by scalar_tac
  have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
  have hiFinBound : i.val < 64 := by rw [hiv]; exact hquot
  have hi1FinBound : i1.val < 16 := by rw [hi1v]; exact hrem
  have hiBound : i.val < (64#usize).val := by rw [h64]; exact hiFinBound
  have hi1Bound : i1.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [h16]; exact hi1FinBound
  have hreadHigh : Array.index_usize selectors.high i =
      .ok (selectors.high.val[i.val]'(by simpa [selectors.high.property] using hiBound)) :=
    array_index_usize_ok selectors.high i hiBound
  have hreadLow : Array.index_usize selectors.low i1 =
      .ok (selectors.low.val[i1.val]'(by simpa [selectors.low.property] using hi1Bound)) :=
    array_index_usize_ok selectors.low i1 hi1Bound
  let x := selectors.high.val[i.val]'(by simpa [selectors.high.property] using hiBound)
  let y := selectors.low.val[i1.val]'(by simpa [selectors.low.property] using hi1Bound)
  have hx : CanonicalQM x := hhigh ⟨i.val, hiFinBound⟩
  have hy : CanonicalQM y := hlow ⟨i1.val, hi1FinBound⟩
  obtain ⟨out, hmul, hout, hdecode⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact x y hx hy
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hout, ?_⟩
  · unfold pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row
    simp only [hi, bind_tc_ok, hreadHigh, bind_tc_ok, hi1, bind_tc_ok,
      hreadLow, bind_tc_ok]
    change x.mul y = .ok out
    exact hmul
  · rw [hdecode]
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x * AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode y = _
    simp [x, y, decodedArray, decodedAt, hiv, hi1v, hquot, hrem,
      SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decode]

/-- Composition with the actual `boxed_at_point` output: the generated row
method succeeds, is canonical, and decodes to the ten-factor row weight. -/
theorem boxed_row_matches_ten_factor
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (hpoint : canonicalArray point)
    (row : Usize) (hrow : row.val < 1024) :
    ∃ selectors : Selectors, ∃ out : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors row = .ok out ∧ CanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
        (exactPoint point) 10 row.val := by
  obtain ⟨selectors, hbox, hhigh, hlow, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorRowSemantic.boxed_row_products point hpoint
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanon, hdecode⟩ :=
    row_success_of_canonical selectors row hrow hhigh hlow
  refine ⟨selectors, out, hbox, hrun, hcanon, ?_⟩
  have ⟨hshift, hmask⟩ :=
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selected_index_arithmetic row.val
  have hmodelRow := hmodel ⟨row.val, hrow⟩
  calc
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = decodedArray selectors.high (row.val / 16) *
        decodedArray selectors.low (row.val % 16) := hdecode
    _ = decodedArray selectors.high (row.val >>> 4) *
        decodedArray selectors.low (row.val &&& 15) := by rw [hshift, hmask]
    _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selectedSelector (exactPoint point) row.val := hmodelRow.1
    _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 10 row.val :=
      AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selected_selector_product
        (exactPoint point) row.val hrow

#print axioms row_success_of_canonical
#print axioms boxed_row_matches_ten_factor
end AspisR1.SelectorRowCall

namespace AspisR1.SelectorRowSemantic

open Aeneas.Std

/-- The actual boxed selector outputs give the old 10-coordinate selected

theorem boxed_row_products (point : Array (AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.QM) 10#usize)
    (hpoint : canonicalArray point) :
    ∃ selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
      canonicalArray selectors.high ∧ canonicalArray selectors.low ∧
      ∀ row : Fin 1024,
        (decodedArray selectors.high (row.val >>> 4) *
          decodedArray selectors.low (row.val &&& 15) =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selectedSelector
            (exactPoint point) row.val) ∧
        (decodedArray selectors.high (row.val >>> 4) *
          decodedArray selectors.low (row.val &&& 15) =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 10 row.val) := by
  obtain ⟨selectors, hrun, hhighCanon, hlowCanon, hhigh, hlow⟩ :=
    boxed_at_point_products point hpoint
  refine ⟨selectors, hrun, hhighCanon, hlowCanon, ?_⟩
  intro row
  let n := row.val
  have hn : n < 1024 := row.isLt
  have hhighN : n / 16 < 64 := by omega
  have hlowN : n % 16 < 16 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hhighPow : n / 16 < 2 ^ 6 := by
    simpa only [show (2 ^ 6 : Nat) = 64 by norm_num] using hhighN
  have hlowPow : n % 16 < 2 ^ 4 := by
    simpa only [show (2 ^ 4 : Nat) = 16 by norm_num] using hlowN
  have ⟨hshift, hmask⟩ :=
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selected_index_arithmetic n
  have hhighTensor :
      decodedArray selectors.high (n / 16) =
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 6 (n / 16) :=
    hhigh ⟨n / 16, by simpa using hhighN⟩
  have hlowTensor :
      decodedArray selectors.low (n % 16) =
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 (n % 16) :=
    hlow ⟨n % 16, by simpa using hlowN⟩
  have hselected :
      decodedArray selectors.high (n >>> 4) * decodedArray selectors.low (n &&& 15) =
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selectedSelector (exactPoint point) n := by
    calc
      decodedArray selectors.high (n >>> 4) * decodedArray selectors.low (n &&& 15) =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 6 (n / 16) *
            AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
              (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 (n % 16) := by
            rw [hshift, hmask, hhighTensor, hlowTensor]
      _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selectedSelector (exactPoint point) n := by
        unfold AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selectedSelector
        rw [hshift, hmask]
        have hhighExpand := AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand_product
          (exactPoint point) 6 (n / 16) hhighPow
        have hlowExpand := AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand_product
          (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 (n % 16) hlowPow
        rw [← hhighExpand, ← hlowExpand]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa [n] using hselected
  · calc
      decodedArray selectors.high (row.val >>> 4) * decodedArray selectors.low (row.val &&& 15) =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.selectedSelector (exactPoint point) row.val := by
        simpa [n] using hselected
      _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 10 row.val :=

open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness
open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionOuter
