abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM

def exactPoint (point : Array QM 10#usize) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if h : i < 10 then decode (point.val[i]'(by simpa [point.property] using h)) else 0

def prefixSlice (point : Array QM 10#usize) : Slice QM :=
  ⟨point.val.slice 0 6, by
    have hmax : 4294967295 ≤ Usize.max := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    rw [List.slice_length]
    simp [point.property]
    omega⟩

def suffixSlice (point : Array QM 10#usize) : Slice QM :=
  ⟨point.val.drop 6, by
    have hmax : 4294967295 ≤ Usize.max := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    simp [point.property]
    omega⟩

private theorem prefix_read (point : Array QM 10#usize) :
    core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice QM)) point
      ({ «end» := 6#usize } : core.ops.range.RangeTo Usize) = .ok (prefixSlice point) := by
  rw [Array.index_SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice]
  simp [core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index,
    Array.to_slice, Slice.length, prefixSlice, List.slice_length,
    point.property]

private theorem suffix_read (point : Array QM 10#usize) :
    core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice QM)) point
      ({ start := 6#usize } : core.ops.range.RangeFrom Usize) = .ok (suffixSlice point) := by
  rw [Array.index_SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice]
  simp [core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice.index,
    Array.to_slice, Slice.length, Slice.drop, suffixSlice, point.property]

private theorem prefix_coordinates_canonical (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hpoint : canonicalArray point) :
    ∀ x ∈ (prefixSlice point).val, Canonical x := by
  have hlen : (prefixSlice point).val.length = 6 := by
    simp [prefixSlice, List.slice_length, point.property]
  have h10val : (10#usize).val = 10 := by scalar_tac
  have hpointLen : point.val.length = 10 := by simpa [h10val] using point.property
  intro x hx
  rcases List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hx with ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
  rw [← hxi]
  have hi6 : i < 6 := by simpa [hlen] using hi
  have hidx10 : i < (10#usize).val := by simpa [h10val] using (show i < 10 by omega)
  have hidxPoint : i < point.val.length := by
    rw [hpointLen]
    simpa [h10val] using hidx10
  have hs : (prefixSlice point).val[i] = point.val[i] := by
    change (point.val.slice 0 6)[i] = point.val[i]
    calc
      (point.val.slice 0 6)[i] = point.val[0+i] :=
        List.getElem_slice 0 6 i point.val (by constructor <;> omega)
      _ = point.val[i] := by simp
  rw [hs]
  exact hpoint ⟨i, hidx10⟩

private theorem suffix_coordinates_canonical (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hpoint : canonicalArray point) :
    ∀ x ∈ (suffixSlice point).val, Canonical x := by
  have hlen : (suffixSlice point).val.length = 4 := by
    simp [suffixSlice, point.property]
  have h10val : (10#usize).val = 10 := by scalar_tac
  have hpointLen : point.val.length = 10 := by simpa [h10val] using point.property
  intro x hx
  rcases List.mem_iff_getElem.mp hx with ⟨i, hi, hxi⟩
  rw [← hxi]
  have hi4 : i < 4 := by simpa [hlen] using hi
  have hidx : 6+i < 10 := by omega
  have hidxFin : 6+i < (10#usize).val := by simpa [h10val] using hidx
  have hidxPoint : 6+i < point.val.length := by
    rw [hpointLen]
    simpa [h10val] using hidxFin
  have hs : (suffixSlice point).val[i] = point.val[6+i] := by
    change (point.val.drop 6)[i] = point.val[6+i]
    exact List.getElem_drop
  rw [hs]
  exact hpoint ⟨6+i, hidxFin⟩

private theorem prefix_exactCoordinates (point : Array QM 10#usize) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < 6) : exactCoordinates (prefixSlice point).val i = exactPoint point i := by
  have hpoint : i < 10 := by omega
  have h10val : (10#usize).val = 10 := by scalar_tac
  have hpointLen : point.val.length = 10 := by simpa [h10val] using point.property
  simp [exactCoordinates, exactPoint, prefixSlice, hi, hpoint, List.getElem_slice,
    point.property]

private theorem suffix_exactCoordinates (point : Array QM 10#usize) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < 4) : exactCoordinates (suffixSlice point).val i = exactPoint point (6+i) := by
  have hpoint : 6+i < 10 := by omega
  have h10val : (10#usize).val = 10 := by scalar_tac
  have hpointLen : point.val.length = 10 := by simpa [h10val] using point.property
  simp [exactCoordinates, exactPoint, suffixSlice, hi, hpoint,
    List.getElem_drop, point.property]

private theorem tensor_prefix (point : Array QM 10#usize) (row : Nat) :
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
      (exactCoordinates (prefixSlice point).val) 6 row =
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 6 row := by
  unfold AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hii : i < 6 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  rw [prefix_exactCoordinates point i hii]

private theorem tensor_suffix (point : Array QM 10#usize) (row : Nat) :
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
      (fun i => exactCoordinates (suffixSlice point).val i) 4 row =
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
      (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 row := by
  unfold AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hii : i < 4 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
  apply congrArg (fun x : ExactQM =>
    AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.factor x (row.testBit (4 - 1 - i)))
  exact suffix_exactCoordinates point i hii

/-- The actual generated `Selectors::at_point` succeeds from one canonical
10-cell point and its two outputs realize the corresponding 6/4 products. -/
theorem at_point_products (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hpoint : canonicalArray point) :
    ∃ selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
      canonicalArray selectors.high ∧ canonicalArray selectors.low ∧
      (∀ row : Fin 64,
        decodedArray selectors.high row.val =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 6 row.val) ∧
      (∀ row : Fin 16,
        decodedArray selectors.low row.val =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
            (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 row.val) := by
  let pre := prefixSlice point
  let post := suffixSlice point
  have hpre : core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice QM)) point
      ({ «end» := 6#usize } : core.ops.range.RangeTo Usize) = .ok pre := by
    simpa [pre] using prefix_read point
  have hpost : core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice QM)) point
      ({ start := 6#usize } : core.ops.range.RangeFrom Usize) = .ok post := by
    simpa [post] using suffix_read point
  obtain ⟨high, hhighRun, hhighCanon, hhighModel⟩ :=
    expand_model 64#usize pre
      (by
        have hmax : 4294967295 ≤ Usize.max := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
        simp [pre, prefixSlice, point.property, List.slice_length])
      (prefix_coordinates_canonical point hpoint)
  obtain ⟨low, hlowRun, hlowCanon, hlowModel⟩ :=
    expand_model 16#usize post
      (by
        have hmax : 4294967295 ≤ Usize.max := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
        simp [post, suffixSlice, point.property])
      (suffix_coordinates_canonical point hpoint)
  refine ⟨⟨high, low⟩, ?_, hhighCanon, hlowCanon, ?_, ?_⟩
  · unfold pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.at_point
    simp only [hpre, bind_tc_ok, hhighRun, bind_tc_ok,
      hpost, bind_tc_ok, hlowRun, bind_tc_ok]
  · intro row
    have hrowN : row.val < (64#usize).val := by simpa using row.isLt
    have hrowPower : row.val < 2 ^ pre.val.length := by
      simpa [pre, prefixSlice, point.property, List.slice_length] using row.isLt
    calc
      decodedArray high row.val =
          expandListModel pre.val 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) row.val :=
        hhighModel ⟨row.val, hrowN⟩
      _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (exactCoordinates pre.val) pre.val.length row.val :=
        generated_expand_product pre.val row.val hrowPower
      _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (exactPoint point) 6 row.val := by
        simpa [pre, prefixSlice, point.property, List.slice_length] using
          tensor_prefix point row.val
  · intro row
    have hrowN : row.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using row.isLt
    have hrowPower : row.val < 2 ^ post.val.length := by
      simpa [post, suffixSlice, point.property] using row.isLt
    calc
      decodedArray low row.val =
          expandListModel post.val 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) row.val :=
        hlowModel ⟨row.val, hrowN⟩
      _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (exactCoordinates post.val) post.val.length row.val :=
        generated_expand_product post.val row.val hrowPower
      _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 row.val := by
        simpa [post, suffixSlice, point.property] using tensor_suffix point row.val

/-- `boxed_at_point` is the generated thin wrapper around the proved actual
`at_point`; no additional source precondition is introduced. -/
theorem boxed_at_point_products (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hpoint : canonicalArray point) :
    ∃ selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
      canonicalArray selectors.high ∧ canonicalArray selectors.low ∧
      (∀ row : Fin 64,
        decodedArray selectors.high row.val =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactPoint point) 6 row.val) ∧
      (∀ row : Fin 16,
        decodedArray selectors.low row.val =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
            (fun i => exactPoint point (6+i)) 4 row.val) := by
  obtain ⟨selectors, hr, hh, hl, hhm, hlm⟩ := at_point_products point hpoint
  refine ⟨selectors, ?_, hh, hl, hhm, hlm⟩
  simpa [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point] using hr

#print axioms at_point_products
#print axioms boxed_at_point_products
end AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel
SelectorExpansionOldAdapter:
import SelectorExpansionOuter
import SelectedSelectorExpansionCore

/-! Adapter from the mechanically proved Aeneas expansion loop to the old
pure `SelectedSelectorExpansion` recurrence. The product theorem itself is
reused from that module. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorExpansionOldAdapter

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness
open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionOuter
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd

abbrev QM := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM

/-- The generated two-store update is the same total-function update as the
old pure source-store model. -/
theorem selectorWrite_eq_sourceStores (x : ExactQM) (i : Nat)
    (w : Nat → ExactQM) :
    selectorWrite x i w = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.sourceStores w x i := by
  rfl

/-- The actual-loop recurrence is definitionally the old descending source
pass after the two-store adapter. -/
theorem selectorWrite_eq_writePair (x : ExactQM) (i : Nat)
    (w : Nat → ExactQM) :
    selectorWrite x i w = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.writePair w x i := by
  calc
    selectorWrite x i w = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.sourceStores w x i :=
      selectorWrite_eq_sourceStores x i w
    _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.writePair w x i :=
      AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.sourceStores_eq w x i

theorem selectorDescending_eq (x : ExactQM) (n : Nat) (w : Nat → ExactQM) :
    selectorDescending x n w = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.descendingPass x n w := by
  induction n generalizing w with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      change selectorDescending x n (selectorWrite x n w) =
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.descendingPass x n
          (AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.writePair w x n)
      rw [ih, selectorWrite_eq_writePair]

/-- Reuse the prior exact pointwise expansion theorem for every array cell. -/
theorem selectorDescending_lookup (x : ExactQM) (n : Nat) (w : Nat → ExactQM)
    (j : Nat) (hj : j < 2*n) :
    selectorDescending x n w j =
      w (j/2) * selectorFactor x (j.testBit 0) := by
  rw [selectorDescending_eq]
  simpa [selectorFactor, AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.factor] using
    (AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.descendingPass_lookup x n w j hj)

/-- Exact decoded coordinate list, with zero outside its finite range. -/
def exactCoordinates (xs : List QM) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if h : i < xs.length then decode (xs[i]'h) else 0

/-- Exact-field version of the list fold used by the generated-array proof. -/
def expandExactListModel : List ExactQM → Nat → (Nat → ExactQM) → Nat → ExactQM
  | [], _, w, j => w j
  | x :: xs, level, w, j =>
      expandExactListModel xs (level + 1)
        (AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.descendingPass x (2 ^ level) w) j

private theorem expandListModel_to_exact (xs : List QM) (level : Nat)
    (w : Nat → ExactQM) (j : Nat) :
    expandListModel xs level w j =
      expandExactListModel (xs.map decode) level w j := by
  induction xs generalizing level w with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [expandListModel, List.map_cons]
      rw [selectorDescending_eq]
      exact ih (level + 1) _

/-- General alignment lemma: a finite coordinate list starting at `level`
implements the old recursively-defined expansion up to its final length. -/
theorem expandExactListModel_eq_expand
    (xs : List ExactQM) (level : Nat) (z : Nat → ExactQM)
    (w : Nat → ExactQM) (j : Nat)
    (hinit : ∀ k, w k = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand z level k)
    (hcoords : ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < xs.length),
      xs[i]'hi = z (level+i)) :
    expandExactListModel xs level w j =
      AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand z (level + xs.length) j := by
  induction xs generalizing level w with
  | nil =>
      exact hinit j
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hzero : 0 < (x :: xs).length := by simp
      have hx : x = z level := by simpa using hcoords 0 hzero
      have hnext :
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.descendingPass x (2 ^ level) w =
          AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand z (level+1) := by
        have hw : w = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand z level := funext hinit
        rw [hw, hx]
        simp only [AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand]
        rw [← AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.sourcePass_eq]
      have htailCoords : ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < xs.length),
          xs[i]'hi = z (level+1+i) := by
        intro i hi
        have hsucc : i+1 < (x :: xs).length := by simp; omega
        have h := hcoords (i+1) hsucc
        have hlevel : level + (i+1) = level + 1 + i := by omega
        simp only [List.getElem_cons_succ] at h
        rw [hlevel] at h
        exact h
      simp only [expandExactListModel]
      rw [hnext]
      have hend : level + 1 + xs.length = level + (x :: xs).length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons]
        omega
      rw [← hend]
      exact ih (level+1) (AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand z (level+1))
        (by intro k; rfl) htailCoords

/-- The old recursively-defined expansion for the decoded list uses the
same one-hot initial state as the generated wrapper. -/
theorem expandListModel_eq_expand
    (xs : List QM) (j : Nat) :
    expandListModel xs 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) j =
      AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand
        (exactCoordinates xs) xs.length j := by
  rw [expandListModel_to_exact]
  simpa only [List.length_map, Nat.zero_add] using
    (expandExactListModel_eq_expand (xs.map decode) 0 (exactCoordinates xs)
      (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) j
      (by intro k; simp [AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand])
      (by
        intro i hi
        have hi' : i < xs.length := by simpa using hi
        simp [exactCoordinates, hi']))

/-- The old product theorem is the endpoint; no product proof is repeated. -/
theorem generated_expand_product
    (xs : List QM) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 2 ^ xs.length) :
    expandListModel xs 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) j =
      AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct (exactCoordinates xs) xs.length j := by
  rw [expandListModel_eq_expand]
  exact AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.expand_product
    (exactCoordinates xs) xs.length j hj

/-- The generated mutable-array loop exposes the reused pure product at every
in-range row, with canonicality inherited from the actual prepared arithmetic. -/
theorem expand_model_product
    (N : Usize) (coordinates : Slice QM)
    (hcapacity : 2 ^ coordinates.val.length ≤ N.val)
    (hcoords : ∀ x ∈ coordinates.val, Canonical x)
    (j : Nat) (hj : j < 2 ^ coordinates.val.length) :
    ∃ out : Array QM N,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand N coordinates = .ok out ∧
      canonicalArray out ∧
      decodedArray out j =
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (exactCoordinates coordinates.val) coordinates.val.length j := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ :=
    expand_model N coordinates hcapacity hcoords
  have hjN : j < N.val := lt_of_lt_of_le hj hcapacity
  refine ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  calc
    decodedArray out j =
        expandListModel coordinates.val 0 (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) j :=
      hmodel ⟨j, hjN⟩
    _ = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (exactCoordinates coordinates.val) coordinates.val.length j :=
      generated_expand_product coordinates.val j hj

#print axioms selectorWrite_eq_sourceStores
#print axioms selectorDescending_eq
#print axioms selectorDescending_lookup
#print axioms expandExactListModel_eq_expand
#print axioms expandListModel_eq_expand
#print axioms generated_expand_product
#print axioms expand_model_product
end AspisR1.SelectorExpansionOldAdapter
SelectorExpansionOuter:
import SelectorExpansionCorrectness
import ExtractedMaskPreparedState
import ExtractedMaskReducerOps
import ExtractedMaskConstants

/-! Forward slice traversal for the generated selected-selector expansion.
The pointwise model is a symbolic list fold; no finite expansion is unfolded. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorExpansionOuter

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM

def expandListModel : List QM → Nat → (Nat → ExactQM) → Nat → ExactQM
  | [], _, w, j => w j
  | x :: xs, level, w, j =>
      expandListModel xs (level + 1)
        (selectorDescending (decode x) (2 ^ level) w) j

private theorem list_drop_split {α : Type} (ys : List α) (i : Nat)
    (hi : i < ys.length) : ys.drop i = ys[i] :: ys.drop (i+1) := by
  induction ys generalizing i with
  | nil => simp at hi
  | cons y ys ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp
      | succ i =>
          have hi' : i < ys.length := by simpa using hi
          simpa using ih i hi'

private theorem slice_next_step (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter QM) (x : QM)
    (xs : List QM) (hdrop : iter.slice.val.drop iter.i = x :: xs) :
    core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next iter =
      .ok (some x, {iter with i := iter.i + 1}) := by
  have hstep : iter.i < iter.slice.val.length := by
    have hlen := congrArg List.length hdrop
    rw [List.length_drop] at hlen
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen
    omega
  have hvalue : iter.slice.val[iter.i] = x := by
    have hsplit := list_drop_split iter.slice.val iter.i hstep
    rw [hdrop] at hsplit
    have hh := congrArg List.head? hsplit
    change some x = some (iter.slice.val[iter.i]) at hh
    exact (Option.some.inj hh).symm
  calc
    core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next iter =
        .ok (some iter.slice.val[iter.i], {iter with i := iter.i + 1}) := by
      simp only [core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next, Slice.len_val, hstep,
        ↓reduceDIte]
      rfl
    _ = .ok (some x, {iter with i := iter.i + 1}) := by rw [hvalue]

private theorem slice_drop_step (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter QM) (x : QM)
    (xs : List QM) (hdrop : iter.slice.val.drop iter.i = x :: xs) :
    iter.slice.val.drop (iter.i + 1) = xs := by
  have hstep : iter.i < iter.slice.val.length := by
    have hlen := congrArg List.length hdrop
    rw [List.length_drop] at hlen
    simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hlen
    omega
  have hsplit := list_drop_split iter.slice.val iter.i hstep
  rw [hdrop] at hsplit
  have ht := congrArg List.tail hsplit
  simpa using ht.symm

private theorem selectorWrite_outside (x : ExactQM) (i : Nat)
    (w : Nat → ExactQM) (j : Nat) (hj : 2*i+1 < j) :
    selectorWrite x i w j = w j := by
  unfold selectorWrite
  simp [Function.update, show j ≠ 2*i+1 by omega,
    show j ≠ 2*i by omega]

private theorem selectorDescending_outside (x : ExactQM) :
    ∀ n (w : Nat → ExactQM) (j N : Nat),
      2*n ≤ N → N ≤ j → selectorDescending x n w j = w j
  | 0, w, j, N, _, _ => rfl
  | n+1, w, j, N, hcap, hj => by
      have hstep : 2*n+1 < j := by omega
      simp only [selectorDescending]
      rw [selectorDescending_outside x n (selectorWrite x n w) j N (by omega) hj]
      exact selectorWrite_outside x n w j hstep

private theorem usize_double (len : Usize) (k : Nat)
    (hlen : len.val = 2 ^ k) (hbound : len.val * 2 < UScalar.size .Usize) :
    ∃ len1 : Usize, (len * 2#usize : Result Usize) = .ok len1 ∧ len1.val = 2 ^ (k+1) := by
  obtain ⟨len1, hmul, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.mul_spec (x := len) (y := 2#usize) (by
      have hmaxplus : Usize.max + 1 = UScalar.size UScalarTy.Usize := by
          rw [UScalar.size_UScalarTyUsize]
          exact Usize.size_scalarTac_eq.1.symm
      have hlt : len.val * 2 < Nat.succ Usize.max := by
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, ← hmaxplus] using hbound
      exact Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hlt))
  refine ⟨len1, hmul, ?_⟩
  have hv : len1.val = len.val * 2 := by simpa using hval
  rw [hv, hlen, pow_succ]

private theorem range_rev_ok (len : Usize) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.rev.trait_default
      (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize)
      (core.ops.range.Range.Insts.DoubleEndedIterator core.iter.range.StepUsize)
      ({ start := 0#usize, «end» := len } : core.ops.range.Range Usize) =
        .ok (⟨{ start := 0#usize, «end» := len }⟩ :
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.ReverseRange) := rfl

private theorem array_update_success {α : Type} {N : Usize}
    (a : Array α N) (i : Usize) (x : α) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    ∃ out : Array α N, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  exact ⟨out, hrun, hset⟩

private theorem set_canonical {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : canonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    canonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hj : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hj := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem decodedArray_set_outer {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Usize)
    (x : QM) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    decodedArray (a.set i x) = Function.update (decodedArray a) i.val (decode x) := by
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j < N.val
  · by_cases heq : i.val = j
    · subst j
      have hjSet : i.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hi
      have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[i.val]'hjSet = x := by
        exact List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
          (by simpa using hi)
      simp only [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.set_val_eq, dif_pos hj]
      rw [hcell]
      simp [Function.update]
    · have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj
      have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j]'hjSet = a.val[j]'(by simpa [a.property] using hj) := by
        exact List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j) heq
          (by simpa [a.property] using hjSet)
      simp only [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.set_val_eq, dif_pos hj]
      rw [hcell]
      have hji : j ≠ i.val := by omega
      simp [decodedAt, hj, Function.update, hji]
  · have hji : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.set_val_eq, hj, Function.update, hji]

/-- The generated outer loop processes each slice element once and runs the
actual reverse expansion loop at the current power-of-two width. -/
theorem expand_loop_model
    {N : Usize} (iter : core.slice.iter.Iter QM) (weights : Array QM N)
    (len : Usize) (level : Nat) (xs : List QM)
    (hdrop : iter.slice.val.drop iter.i = xs)
    (hlen : len.val = 2 ^ level)
    (hcapacity : 2 ^ (level + xs.length) ≤ N.val)
    (hweights : canonicalArray weights)
    (hcoords : ∀ x ∈ xs, Canonical x) :
    ∃ out : Array QM N,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0 iter weights len =
        .ok out ∧ canonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin N.val,
        decodedArray out j.val =
          expandListModel xs level (decodedArray weights) j.val := by
  induction xs generalizing iter weights len level with
  | nil =>
      have hdropLe : iter.slice.val.length ≤ iter.i := by
        have hlen := congrArg List.length hdrop
        rw [List.length_drop] at hlen
        simp only [List.length_nil] at hlen
        have hzero : iter.slice.val.length - iter.i = 0 := by simpa using hlen
        exact (Nat.sub_eq_zero_iff_le.mp hzero)
      have hdone : ¬ iter.i < iter.slice.val.length := by omega
      refine ⟨weights, ?_, hweights, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0.eq_def]
        dsimp only
        simp only [core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next, Slice.len_val,
          hdone, ↓reduceDIte, bind_tc_ok]
      · intro j
        rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      have hdropLength : (iter.slice.val.drop iter.i).length = xs.length + 1 := by
        rw [hdrop]
        simp
      have hstep : iter.i < iter.slice.val.length := by
        have := congrArg List.length hdrop
        simp at this
        omega
      have hnext := slice_next_step iter x xs hdrop
      have hdrop1 := slice_drop_step iter x xs hdrop
      have hx : Canonical x := hcoords x (by simp)
      have hprep := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.current_prepared_new x hx
      obtain ⟨prepared, hprepRun, hprepCanon⟩ := hprep
      have hdouble : 2 ^ level * 2 = 2 ^ (level + 1) := by
        rw [pow_succ]
      have hinnerCap : 2 * len.val ≤ N.val := by
        have hmono : 2 ^ (level + 1) ≤ 2 ^ (level + 1 + xs.length) :=
          Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) (by omega)
        calc
          2 * len.val = 2 ^ (level + 1) := by
            rw [hlen, ← hdouble]
            omega
          _ ≤ 2 ^ (level + 1 + xs.length) := hmono
          _ ≤ N.val := by
            simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hcapacity
      have hdoubleBound : len.val * 2 < UScalar.size .Usize := by
        have hpowCap : 2 ^ (level + 1) ≤ N.val := by
          calc
            2 ^ (level + 1) = 2 * len.val := by rw [hlen, ← hdouble]; ring
            _ ≤ N.val := hinnerCap
        have hN : N.val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
          simpa only [UScalar.size] using N.hBounds
        rw [hlen]
        rw [hdouble]
        exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hpowCap hN
      obtain ⟨len1, hlenmul, hlen1⟩ := usize_double len level hlen hdoubleBound
      let innerRange : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.ReverseRange :=
        ⟨{ start := 0#usize, «end» := len }⟩
      have hrange := range_rev_ok len
      obtain ⟨weights1, hinnerRun, hinnerCanon, hinnerModel⟩ :=
        selector_inner_loop_model innerRange weights prepared x len.val
          (by rfl) (by rfl) hinnerCap
          hweights hx hprepCanon
      have hinnerRun' :
          pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0_loop0
            ⟨{ start := 0#usize, «end» := len }⟩ weights prepared = .ok weights1 := by
        simpa [innerRange] using hinnerRun
      have htaildrop : ({iter with i := iter.i + 1}).slice.val.drop
          ({iter with i := iter.i + 1}).i = xs := by
        simpa using hdrop1
      have htailCapacity : 2 ^ (level + 1 + xs.length) ≤ N.val := by
        simpa [Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm] using hcapacity
      have htailCoords : ∀ y ∈ xs, Canonical y := by
        intro y hy
        exact hcoords y (by simp [hy])
      have htail := ih {iter with i := iter.i + 1} weights1 len1 (level+1)
        htaildrop (by simpa [hlen1, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm, Nat.add_left_comm])
        htailCapacity hinnerCanon htailCoords
      obtain ⟨out, htailRun, htailCanon, htailModel⟩ := htail
      refine ⟨out, ?_, htailCanon, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand_loop0.eq_def]
        dsimp only
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, hprepRun, bind_tc_ok, hrange,
          bind_tc_ok, hinnerRun', bind_tc_ok, hlenmul, bind_tc_ok]
        exact htailRun
      · intro j
        rw [htailModel]
        have hinnerFun : decodedArray weights1 =
            selectorDescending (decode x) (2 ^ level) (decodedArray weights) := by
          funext k
          by_cases hk : k < N.val
          · simpa [hlen] using hinnerModel ⟨k, hk⟩
          · have hleft : decodedArray weights1 k = 0 := by
              simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, hk, weights1.property]
            have hright : selectorDescending (decode x) (2 ^ level)
                (decodedArray weights) k = 0 := by
              rw [selectorDescending_outside (decode x) (2 ^ level)
                (decodedArray weights) k N.val (by simpa [hlen] using hinnerCap)
                (by omega)]
              simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, hk, weights.property]
            rw [hleft, hright]
        rw [hinnerFun]
        rfl

private theorem initial_array_canonical {N : Usize} :
    canonicalArray (Array.repeat N field.QM31.ZERO) := by
  intro i
  simpa [Array.repeat_val] using zero_canonical

private theorem initial_decoded {N : Usize} :
    decodedArray (Array.repeat N field.QM31.ZERO) = fun _ => 0 := by
  have hz : decode field.QM31.ZERO = (0 : ExactQM) := by
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode field.QM31.ZERO = (0 : ExactQM)
    exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_decode
  funext j
  by_cases hj : j < N.val
  · simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, Array.repeat_val, hj, hz]
  · simp [decodedArray, decodedAt, hj]

/-- The generated `expand` wrapper succeeds and agrees with the list-level
symbolic expansion whenever every source coordinate is canonical and the
requested output capacity covers the power-of-two expansion. -/
theorem expand_model
    (N : Usize) (coordinates : Slice QM)
    (hcapacity : 2 ^ coordinates.val.length ≤ N.val)
    (hcoords : ∀ x ∈ coordinates.val, Canonical x) :
    ∃ out : Array QM N,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand N coordinates = .ok out ∧
      canonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin N.val,
        decodedArray out j.val =
          expandListModel coordinates.val 0
            (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) j.val := by
  have hN : 1 ≤ N.val := by
    have hpow : 0 < 2 ^ coordinates.val.length := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
    omega
  have hNpos : 0 < N.val := by omega
  let base : Array QM N := Array.repeat N field.QM31.ZERO
  obtain ⟨a, hupdate, hset⟩ :=
    array_update_success base 0#usize field.QM31.ONE (by simpa using hNpos)
  have hbaseCanonical : canonicalArray base := initial_array_canonical
  have honeCanonical : Canonical field.QM31.ONE := one_canonical
  have haCanonical : canonicalArray a := by
    simpa [hset] using set_canonical base 0#usize field.QM31.ONE
      hbaseCanonical honeCanonical (by simpa using hNpos)
  have hbaseDecode : decodedArray base = fun _ => 0 := initial_decoded
  have honeDecode' : decode field.QM31.ONE = (1 : ExactQM) := by
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode field.QM31.ONE = (1 : ExactQM)
    exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.one_decode
  have hinit : decodedArray a = Function.update (fun _ => 0) 0 1 := by
    rw [hset, decodedArray_set_outer base 0#usize field.QM31.ONE
      (by simpa using hNpos), hbaseDecode]
    have hzeroIndex : (0#usize).val = 0 := rfl
    simp only [honeDecode', hzeroIndex]
  have hiter : SharedSlice.Insts.CoreIterTraitsCollectIntoIteratorSharedIter.into_iter
      coordinates = .ok (⟨coordinates, 0⟩ : core.slice.iter.Iter QM) := rfl
  have hupdate' : Array.update (Array.repeat N field.QM31.ZERO)
      0#usize field.QM31.ONE = .ok a := by
    simpa [base] using hupdate
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtCanonical, houtModel⟩ :=
    expand_loop_model (⟨coordinates, 0⟩ : core.slice.iter.Iter QM) a 1#usize
      0 coordinates.val (by simp) rfl (by simpa using hcapacity) haCanonical hcoords
  refine ⟨out, ?_, houtCanonical, ?_⟩
  · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.expand]
    simp only [hupdate', bind_tc_ok, hiter, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hrun
  · intro j
    have hstate : decodedArray a = (fun i => if i = 0 then 1 else 0) := by
      funext i
      rw [hinit]
      by_cases hz : i = 0 <;> simp [Function.update, hz]
    have hmodelInit := congrArg
      (fun w => expandListModel coordinates.val 0 w j.val) hstate
    rw [houtModel, hmodelInit]

#print axioms expand_loop_model
#print axioms expand_model
end AspisR1.SelectorExpansionOuter
SelectedSelectorExpansionCore:
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bitwise
import Mathlib.Tactic

/- Pure source-selector recurrence, reduced from SelectedSelectorExpansion.lean
   without its PositivePackBinding import cone. Declarations retain the same
   names and bodies for direct reuse. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion
open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type*} [CommRing K]

def writePair (w : Nat → K) (x : K) (i j : Nat) : K :=
  if j=2*i then w i-x*w i else if j=2*i+1 then x*w i else w j

def sourceStores (w : Nat → K) (x : K) (i : Nat) : Nat → K :=
  let parent:=w i
  let right:=x*parent
  Function.update (Function.update w (2*i) (parent-right)) (2*i+1) right

theorem sourceStores_eq (w : Nat → K) (x : K) (i : Nat) :
    sourceStores w x i=writePair w x i := by
  funext j
  by_cases h0 : j=2*i
  · subst j
    simp [sourceStores,writePair]
  · by_cases h1 : j=2*i+1
    · subst j
      simp [sourceStores,writePair]
    · simp [sourceStores,writePair,h0,h1]

theorem writePair_below (w : Nat → K) (x : K) (i j : Nat) (h : j < i) :
    writePair w x i j=w j := by
  have h0 : j≠2*i := by omega
  have h1 : j≠2*i+1 := by omega
  simp only [writePair,h0,h1,if_false]

def descendingPass (x : K) : Nat → (Nat → K) → (Nat → K)
  | 0,w=>w
  | m+1,w=>descendingPass x m (writePair w x m)

def sourcePass (x : K) : Nat → (Nat → K) → (Nat → K)
  | 0,w=>w
  | m+1,w=>sourcePass x m (sourceStores w x m)

theorem sourcePass_eq (x : K) (m : Nat) (w : Nat → K) :
    sourcePass x m w=descendingPass x m w := by
  induction m generalizing w with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih => rw [sourcePass,descendingPass,sourceStores_eq,ih]

theorem descendingPass_above (x : K) (m : Nat) (w : Nat → K)
    (j : Nat) (h : 2*m≤j) : descendingPass x m w j=w j := by
  induction m generalizing w with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ m ih =>
    rw [descendingPass,ih _ (by omega)]
    have h0 : j≠2*m := by omega
    have h1 : j≠2*m+1 := by omega
    simp only [writePair,h0,h1,if_false]

def factor (x : K) (b : Bool) : K := if b then x else 1-x

theorem descendingPass_lookup (x : K) (m : Nat) (w : Nat → K)
    (j : Nat) (h : j<2*m) :
    descendingPass x m w j=w (j/2)*factor x (j.testBit 0) := by
  induction m generalizing w j with
  | zero => omega
  | succ m ih =>
    by_cases low : j<2*m
    · have hp : j/2 < m := by omega
      rw [descendingPass,ih _ _ low,writePair_below w x m (j/2) hp]
    · have branches : j=2*m ∨ j=2*m+1 := by omega
      rcases branches with hzero|hone
      · subst j
        change descendingPass x m (writePair w x m) (2*m) =
          w ((2*m)/2) * factor x ((2*m).testBit 0)
        rw [descendingPass_above _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
        simp [writePair,factor,Nat.testBit_zero]
        ring
      · subst j
        change descendingPass x m (writePair w x m) (2*m+1) =
          w ((2*m+1)/2) * factor x ((2*m+1).testBit 0)
        rw [descendingPass_above _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
        have hd : (2*m+1)/2=m := by omega
        simp [writePair,factor,Nat.testBit_zero,hd]
        ring

def expand (z : Nat → K) : Nat → (Nat → K)
  | 0=>fun row=>if row=0 then 1 else 0
  | n+1=>sourcePass (z n) (2^n) (expand z n)

def tensorProduct (z : Nat → K) (n row : Nat) : K :=
  ∏ i ∈ Finset.range n,factor (z i) (row.testBit (n-1-i))

theorem expand_product (z : Nat → K) (n row : Nat) (h : row<2^n) :
    expand z n row=tensorProduct z n row := by
  induction n generalizing row with
  | zero =>
    have hr : row=0 := by simpa using h
    subst row
    simp [expand,tensorProduct]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hb : row<2*(2^n) := by simpa [pow_succ,mul_comm] using h
    have hp : row/2<2^n := by omega
    rw [expand,sourcePass_eq,descendingPass_lookup _ _ _ _ hb,ih _ hp]
    unfold tensorProduct
    rw [Finset.prod_range_succ]
    simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel,Nat.sub_self]
    congr 1
    apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i < n := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    rw [Nat.testBit_div_two]
    congr 2
    omega

theorem selected_index_arithmetic (row : Nat) :
    row >>> 4=row/16 ∧ row &&& 15=row%16 := by
  constructor
  · simp [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  · simpa using Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod row 4

def selectedSelector (z : Nat → K) (row : Nat) : K :=
  expand z 6 (row >>> 4)*expand (fun i=>z (6+i)) 4 (row &&& 15)

theorem selected_selector_product (z : Nat → K) (row : Nat) (h : row<1024) :
    selectedSelector z row=tensorProduct z 10 row := by
  rcases selected_index_arithmetic row with ⟨hh,hl⟩
  unfold selectedSelector
  have hrow : row < 1024 := h
  have hhigh0 : row/16 < 64 := by omega
  have hlow0 : row%16 < 16 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hhigh : row/16 < 2^6 := by
    simpa only [show (2^6 : Nat) = 64 by norm_num] using hhigh0
  have hlow : row%16 < 2^4 := by
    simpa only [show (2^4 : Nat) = 16 by norm_num] using hlow0
  rw [hh,hl,expand_product z 6 (row/16) hhigh,
    expand_product (fun i=>z (6+i)) 4 (row%16) hlow]
  change (∏ i ∈ Finset.range 6,factor (z i) ((row/16).testBit (5-i))) *
      (∏ i ∈ Finset.range 4,factor (z (6+i)) ((row%16).testBit (3-i)))=
    ∏ i ∈ Finset.range (6+4),factor (z i) (row.testBit (9-i))
  rw [Finset.prod_range_add]
  congr 1
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i<6 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hb : (row/16).testBit (5-i)=row.testBit (9-i) := by
      rw [show (16 : Nat)=2^4 by decide,Nat.testBit_div_two_pow]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [hb]
  · apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    have hi' : i<4 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
    have hb : (row%16).testBit (3-i)=row.testBit (9-(6+i)) := by
      rw [show (16 : Nat)=2^4 by decide,Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
      have hj : 3-i<4 := by omega
      simp only [hj,decide_true,Bool.true_and]
      congr 1
      omega
    rw [hb]

#print axioms sourceStores_eq
#print axioms descendingPass_lookup
#print axioms expand_product
#print axioms selected_selector_product
end AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion
SelectorValueLaneModelComposition:
import SelectorValueLaneMap
import R0P.Value

/-! This final arithmetic layer identifies the actual generated `[0,2,4]`
selector sum with the coefficient used by the retained `R0P.valueFamily`
model, at an arbitrary point. It does not claim the later 33-cell iterator. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

def pointSelector (point : Array QM 10#usize) (row : Fin 1024) : ExactQM :=
  AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
    (AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.exactPoint point) 10 row.val

def valueFamilyCoefficientFor {K : Type} [Field K] (sel : R0P.Sel K) : K :=
  (((0 + sel 1008) + sel 1010) + sel 1012)

def valueFamilyRangeCoefficient (point : Array QM 10#usize) : ExactQM :=
  valueFamilyCoefficientFor (pointSelector point)

theorem generated_value_selector_is_valueFamily_coefficient
    (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hpoint : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray point) :
    ∃ selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors,
      ∃ q0 q2 q4 sum : QM,
        pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
        pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
          selectors 0#usize = .ok (q0, selectors) ∧
        pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
          selectors 2#usize = .ok (q2, selectors) ∧
        pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
          selectors 4#usize = .ok (q4, selectors) ∧
        core.array.Array.map
          pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31
          AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneMap.selectorIndices selectors =
            .ok ⟨[q0, q2, q4], by rfl⟩ ∧
        (do
          let q1 ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ZERO q0
          let q3 ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
          field.QM31.add q3 q4) = .ok sum ∧
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM sum ∧
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode sum = valueFamilyRangeCoefficient point := by
  obtain ⟨selectors, q0, q2, q4, sum, hbox, hcall0, hcall2, hcall4,
    hmap, hadd, hcanon, hdecode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneMap.boxed_value_lane_map_then_two_adds point hpoint
  refine ⟨selectors, q0, q2, q4, sum, hbox, hcall0, hcall2, hcall4,
    hmap, hadd, hcanon, ?_⟩
  calc
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode sum =
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.exactPoint point) 10 1008 +
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.exactPoint point) 10 1010 +
        AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
          (AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.exactPoint point) 10 1012 := hdecode
    _ = valueFamilyRangeCoefficient point := by
      simp [valueFamilyRangeCoefficient, valueFamilyCoefficientFor, pointSelector]

/-- At a general selector function, the pure value-family multiplier is the
same left-to-right `[0,2,4]` coefficient used by the extracted source. -/
theorem valueFamily_uses_rangeCoefficient_for
    {K : Type} [Field K] (sel : R0P.Sel K) (pub : R0P.Public K)
    (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.valueFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel =
      (R0P.valueRange o).map
        (fun r => valueFamilyCoefficientFor sel * r) ++
        [sel 1014 * ((o.z 0 - o.z 1) - o.z 2),
         sel 1014 * (o.succ 0 - o.succ 1)] := by
  rfl

theorem valueFamily_uses_rangeCoefficient
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM)
    (o : R0P.Openings ExactQM) :
    (R0P.valueFamily (K := ExactQM)).residuals pub o
      (pointSelector point) =
      (R0P.valueRange o).map
        (fun r => valueFamilyRangeCoefficient point * r) ++
        [pointSelector point 1014 *
            ((o.z 0 - o.z 1) - o.z 2),
         pointSelector point 1014 * (o.succ 0 - o.succ 1)] := by
  change (R0P.valueFamily (K := ExactQM)).residuals pub o
      (pointSelector point) =
    (R0P.valueRange o).map
      (fun r => valueFamilyCoefficientFor (pointSelector point) * r) ++
      [pointSelector point 1014 * ((o.z 0 - o.z 1) - o.z 2),
       pointSelector point 1014 * (o.succ 0 - o.succ 1)]
  exact valueFamily_uses_rangeCoefficient_for
    (sel := pointSelector point) pub o

#print axioms generated_value_selector_is_valueFamily_coefficient
#print axioms valueFamily_uses_rangeCoefficient_for
#print axioms valueFamily_uses_rangeCoefficient
end AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition

import SelectorValueLaneCall
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import ExtractedMaskConstants
import SelectorArrayMapRuntimeSlice
import SelectorArrayMapSuccess

/-! The first three source value selectors are mapped at indices [0,2,4]
with a state-preserving callback. We prove the generated map result and the
subsequent field-addition chain symbolically; no enclosing lane loop is claimed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneMap

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneCall
open AspisR1.SelectorRowCall
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev CallMut := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut

private theorem usize_add_eq_ok (a b out : Usize)
    (hval : a.val + b.val = out.val)
    (hbound : a.val + b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    UScalar.add a b = .ok out := by
  have hchecked : (a + b : Result Usize) ⦃ x => x.val = a.val + b.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hbound
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxval⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  change (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok out
  rw [hx]
  congr 1
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [hxval]
  exact hval

private theorem smallUsize_bound (n : Nat) (hn : n < 1024) :
    n < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
  rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
  have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
  omega

private theorem fixed_offset_success (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 16) :
    ∃ out : Usize, (1008#usize + i : Result Usize) = .ok out ∧
      out.val = 1008 + i.val := by
  have hb : 1008 + i.val < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by

namespace AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev nullifier := AspisR1ScheduleDomainCandidate.spend.DOMAIN_NULLIFIER

theorem scalarEmbedding_nat (s : field.M31) :
    scalarEmbedding s = (s.val : ExactQM) := by
  ext <;> simp only [scalarEmbedding, AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact,
    AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact, QuadraticAlgebra.re_natCast,
    QuadraticAlgebra.im_natCast, QuadraticAlgebra.re_zero, QuadraticAlgebra.im_zero]

def run (h0 h1 h25 h30 transfer : QM) : Result (QM × QM) := do
  let q13 ← field.QM31.add h1 h30
  let first ← field.QM31.add q13 transfer
  let q14 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 h0 owner
  let q15 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 first note
  let q16 ← field.QM31.add q14 q15
  let q17 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 h25 nullifier
  let domain ← field.QM31.add q16 q17
  let q18 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 h0 8#u32
  let q19 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 first 18#u32
  let q20 ← field.QM31.add q18 q19
  let q21 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 h25 16#u32
  let length ← field.QM31.add q20 q21
  .ok (domain, length)

theorem source_success (h0 h1 h25 h30 transfer : QM)
    (hc1 : Canonical h1) (hc30 : Canonical h30) (hct : Canonical transfer) :
    ∃ domain length, run h0 h1 h25 h30 transfer = .ok (domain, length) ∧
      Canonical domain ∧ Canonical length ∧
      decode domain = (decode h0 * scalarEmbedding owner +
        ((decode h1 + decode h30) + decode transfer) * scalarEmbedding note) +
          decode h25 * scalarEmbedding nullifier ∧
      decode length = (decode h0 * scalarEmbedding 8#u32 +
        ((decode h1 + decode h30) + decode transfer) * scalarEmbedding 18#u32) +
          decode h25 * scalarEmbedding 16#u32 := by
  obtain ⟨q13, hr13, hc13, hv13⟩ := current_qm_add_exact h1 h30 hc1 hc30
  obtain ⟨first, hrfirst, hcfirst, hvfirst⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q13 transfer hc13 hct
  obtain ⟨q14, hr14, hc14, hv14⟩ := current_qm_mul_m31_exact h0 owner
  obtain ⟨q15, hr15, hc15, hv15⟩ := current_qm_mul_m31_exact first note
  obtain ⟨q16, hr16, hc16, hv16⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q14 q15 hc14 hc15
  obtain ⟨q17, hr17, hc17, hv17⟩ := current_qm_mul_m31_exact h25 nullifier
  obtain ⟨domain, hrdomain, hcdomain, hvdomain⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q16 q17 hc16 hc17
  obtain ⟨q18, hr18, hc18, hv18⟩ := current_qm_mul_m31_exact h0 8#u32
  obtain ⟨q19, hr19, hc19, hv19⟩ := current_qm_mul_m31_exact first 18#u32
  obtain ⟨q20, hr20, hc20, hv20⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q18 q19 hc18 hc19
  obtain ⟨q21, hr21, hc21, hv21⟩ := current_qm_mul_m31_exact h25 16#u32
  obtain ⟨length, hrlength, hclength, hvlength⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q20 q21 hc20 hc21
  refine ⟨domain, length, ?_, hcdomain, hclength, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, hr13, bind_tc_ok, hrfirst, hr14, hr15, hr16, hr17,
      hrdomain, hr18, hr19, hr20, hr21, hrlength]
  · rw [hvdomain, hv16, hv14, hv15, hv17, hvfirst, hv13]
  · rw [hvlength, hv20, hv18, hv19, hv21, hvfirst, hv13]

import SelectorExpansionCorrectness

/-! Reuse the symbolic update proof shape of SelectorExpansionCorrectness
(set_canonical and decodedArray_set), exposing the raw cell frame for callers.
No array contents or concrete finite-field terms are evaluated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a

def cells {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Fin n.val) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

/-- Actual checked update, canonicality, and the complete pointwise frame.
The input and updated cell are the only canonicality premises. -/
theorem update_success {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : CanonicalQM x) :
    ∃ out, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      cells out = Function.update (cells a) ⟨i.val, hi⟩ x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  have hcell : ∀ j : Fin n.val,
      cells out j = if j.val = i.val then x else cells a j := by
    intro j
    cases hs
    have hj0 : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt
    have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj0
    change (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = _
    by_cases he : i.val = j.val
    · rw [if_pos he.symm]
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [he] using hj0)
      simpa [he] using hself
    · rw [if_neg (Ne.symm he)]
      exact List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val) he hjSet
  refine ⟨out, hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro j
    change CanonicalQM (cells out j)
    rw [hcell]
    split
    · exact hx
    · exact ha j
  · funext j
    rw [hcell]
    by_cases he : j = (⟨i.val, hi⟩ : Fin n.val)
    · subst j
      simp
    · have hv : j.val ≠ i.val := by
        intro h
        exact he (Fin.ext h)
      simp [Function.update, he, hv]

#print axioms update_success
end AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact

  have hvlen : (Array.to_slice (constants parity)).val.length = 7 := (constants parity).property

          omega⟩) *
        R0P.poseidonInternalConstants (⟨2*i.val+parity,by have hi := i.isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 14) := by

          (fun i => Decode (cell state i)) (fun i => Decode (cell local1 i)) j := by
  obtain ⟨even,heven,hceven,hmeven⟩ := dot_source local1 hlocal 0 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨odd,hodd,hcodd,hmodd⟩ := dot_source local1 hlocal 1 (by decide)
  obtain ⟨middle,hmiddle,hcmiddle,hmmiddle⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRoundExact.source_success state even hstate hceven
  obtain ⟨out,hout,hcout,hmout⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRoundExact.source_success middle odd hcmiddle hcodd

  · have hmid : (fun i : Fin 16 => Decode (cell middle i)) =

          (fun k : Fin 16 => Decode (cell state k)) (Decode even) i) := by
      funext i

    change Decode (cell out j) = R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair

    · rw [if_neg hz] at h hc
      change Decode (cell out j) = rawDecode full + Decode (cell state1 j) * diagonal j at h
      have hm : Decode (cell out j) =
          (partSum state + Decode (cell state (0 : Fin 16))) + Decode (cell state j) * diagonal j := by
        rw [hfullModel,hc] at h
        exact h
      simp only [R0P.poseidonInternalLinear,dif_neg hz,if_neg hz]
      exact hm

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLinearExact
PoseidonInternalPrepare:
import PoseidonInternalLaneLoop

/-! Derive the actual internal-linear prefix: nonzero-lane accumulator,
full-sum array, reconstructed zero lane and checked zero-lane update. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalPrepare
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords (wordVec wordVec_source wordVec_canonical)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel (partSum wordVec_decode)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly (rawDecode zeroRun)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays (FullCallback)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords decodeWords_add)

def prepare (state : State) : Result (State × Raw4) := do
  let old ← Array.index_usize state 0#usize
  let part ← state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop0 state
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero 1#usize
  let full ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 FullCallback 0#u64 (part,wordVec old)
  let value ← zeroRun part old
  let state1 ← Array.update state 0#usize value
  .ok (state1,full)

theorem wrapper_factor (state : State) :
    state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy state = (do
      let (state1,full) ← prepare state
      state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1
        { start := 1#usize, «end» := poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH } state1 full) := by
  simp only [state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy,prepare,zeroRun,wordVec_source,
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  all_goals rfl

theorem source_success (state : State) (hs : CanonicalState state) :
    ∃ state1 : State, ∃ full : Raw4, prepare state = .ok (state1,full) ∧
      CanonicalState state1 ∧ RawBound full (16*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P) ∧
      rawDecode full = partSum state + Decode (cell state (0 : Fin 16)) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell state1 j) =
        if j.val = 0 then partSum state - Decode (cell state (0 : Fin 16)) else Decode (cell state j) := by
  let old := cell state (0 : Fin 16)
  have hread : Array.index_usize state 0#usize = .ok old :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.state_source_read state 0#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨part,hpart,hpartBound,hpartModel⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel.source_success state hs
  change rawDecode part = partSum state at hpartModel
  have hwords := wordVec_canonical old (hs 0)
  obtain ⟨full,hfull,hfullBound,hfullValues⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays.full_source part (wordVec old) hpartBound hwords
  have hpart16 : RawBound part (16*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P) := by
    intro j
    have hb : 15*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P < 16*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P := by
      norm_num [AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P]
    exact Nat.lt_trans (hpartBound j) hb
  obtain ⟨value,hzero,hvalueCan,hvalueModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly.zero_source part old hpart16 (hs 0)
  have hupdate : Array.update state 0#usize value = .ok (state.set 0#usize value) := by
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec state 0#usize value (by simp))
    simpa only [hset] using hrun
  have hfun : (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell full j).val) =
      (fun j => (cell part j).val + (cell (wordVec old) j).val) := funext hfullValues
  have hsum : rawDecode full = rawDecode part + Decode old :=
    (congrArg decodeWords hfun).trans
      ((decodeWords_add (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell part j).val)
        (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell (wordVec old) j).val)).trans
        (congrArg (rawDecode part + ·) (wordVec_decode old)))
  have hfullModel : rawDecode full = partSum state + Decode old :=
    hsum.trans (congrArg (· + Decode old) hpartModel)
  have hzeroModel : Decode value = partSum state - Decode old :=
    hvalueModel.trans (congrArg (· - Decode old) hpartModel)
  refine ⟨state.set 0#usize value,full,?_,set_canonical state 0#usize value hs hvalueCan,
    hfullBound,hfullModel,?_⟩
  · simp only [prepare,hread,hpart,hfull,hzero,hupdate,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    have h0 : (0#usize).val = 0 := by decide
    rw [h0]
    by_cases hz : j.val = 0
    · rw [if_pos hz,if_pos hz]
      exact hzeroModel
    · rw [if_neg hz,if_neg hz]

#print axioms wrapper_factor
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalPrepare
PoseidonInternalLaneLoop:
import PoseidonInternalLaneStep

/-! Symbolic execution of the final fifteen-lane update loop. Earlier lanes
are framed, and no concrete fifteen-iteration source term is normalized. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneStep
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

theorem loop_success_fuel (state : State) (full : Raw4) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hstart : 1 ≤ iter.start.val) (hend : iter.end.val ≤ 16)
    (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = iter.end.val)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hfull : RawBound full (16*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P)) :
    ∃ out : State, state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1 iter state full = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) =
        if iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val then laneModel full state j
        else Decode (cell state j) := by
  induction fuel generalizing state iter with
  | zero =>
    have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
    refine ⟨state,?_,hstate,?_⟩
    · rw [source_loop_eq,hnext]
      rfl
    · intro j
      have hnot : ¬ (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
      rw [if_neg hnot]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    have hidx : iter.start.val < 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨iter1,hnext,hinc,hend1,_⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
    have hstart1 : 1 ≤ iter1.start.val := by omega
    have hend' : iter1.end.val ≤ 16 := by rw [hend1]; exact hend
    have hspan' : iter1.start.val + fuel = iter1.end.val := by rw [hend1]; omega
    obtain ⟨value,hstep,hvalueCan,hstate1Can,hstepModel,hstepCells⟩ :=
      step_success state full iter.start hstart hidx hstate hfull
    let state1 := state.set iter.start value
    obtain ⟨out,hrec,houtCan,houtModel⟩ := ih state1 iter1 hstart1 hend' hspan' hstate1Can
    refine ⟨out,?_,houtCan,?_⟩
    · rw [source_loop_eq,hnext]
      change (do
        let nextState ← runStep state full iter.start
        state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1 iter1 nextState full) = .ok out
      rw [hstep]
      change state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1 iter1 state1 full = .ok out
      exact hrec
    · intro j
      have hv := houtModel j
      rw [hinc,hend1] at hv
      rw [hv]
      by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
      · have hafter : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        have hinside : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val := by omega
        rw [if_neg hafter,if_pos hinside]
        have hcell := hstepCells j
        rw [if_pos hj] at hcell
        have hindex : (⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ : Fin 16) = j := Fin.ext hj.symm
        change Decode (cell state1 j) = laneModel full state ⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ at hcell
        exact hcell.trans (congrArg (laneModel full state) hindex)
      · have hcell : Decode (cell state1 j) = Decode (cell state j) := by
          have h := hstepCells j
          rw [if_neg hj] at h
          exact h
        unfold laneModel
        rw [hcell]
        have hrange : (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) ↔
            (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        by_cases hin : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val
        · rw [if_pos (hrange.mpr hin),if_pos hin]
        · have hn : ¬ (iter.start.val + 1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) :=
            fun h => hin (hrange.mp h)
          rw [if_neg hn,if_neg hin]

theorem source_success (state : State) (full : Raw4)
    (hstate : CanonicalState state) (hfull : RawBound full (16*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P)) :
    ∃ out : State,
      state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1
        { start := 1#usize, «end» := poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH } state full = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalState out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell out j) =
        if j.val = 0 then Decode (cell state j) else laneModel full state j := by
  have hwidth : poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH = 16#usize := by unfold poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH; rfl
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcan,hmodel⟩ := loop_success_fuel state full
    { start := 1#usize, «end» := 16#usize } 15 (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) hstate hfull
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · rw [hwidth]
    exact hrun
  · intro j
    have h := hmodel j
    by_cases hz : j.val = 0
    · have hnot : ¬ ((1#usize).val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < (16#usize).val) := by rw [hz]; decide
      rw [if_neg hnot] at h
      rw [if_pos hz]
      exact h
    · have hin : (1#usize).val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < (16#usize).val := by
        have hj := j.isLt
        scalar_tac
      rw [if_pos hin] at h
      rw [if_neg hz]
      exact h

#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneLoop
PoseidonInternalLaneStep:
import PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly
import OccupancyRangeTraversal

/-! Exact body equation and checked update for the remaining internal-linear
lane loop. Source limb conversion is total and is reduced only once here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly (rawDecode shiftRun)
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

def diagonal (j : Fin 16) : Exact :=
  ((1 <<< R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨j.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) : Nat) : Exact)
def laneModel (full : Raw4) (state : State) (j : Fin 16) : Exact :=
  rawDecode full + Decode (cell state j) * diagonal j

def runStep (state : State) (full : Raw4) (lane : Usize) : Result State := do
  let q ← Array.index_usize state lane
  let value ← shiftRun full q lane
  Array.update state lane value

theorem source_loop_eq (iter : Range) (state : State) (full : Raw4) :
    state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1 iter state full = (do
      let (o,iter1) ← core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
      match o with
      | none => .ok state
      | some lane =>
        let state1 ← runStep state full lane
        state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1 iter1 state1 full) := by
  rw [state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy_loop1.eq_def]
  simp only [runStep,shiftRun,AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.wordVec_source,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]
  all_goals rfl

theorem step_success (state : State) (full : Raw4) (lane : Usize)
    (hlane : 1 ≤ lane.val) (hend : lane.val < 16)
    (hs : CanonicalState state) (hf : RawBound full (16*AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P)) :
    ∃ value : QM, runStep state full lane = .ok (state.set lane value) ∧
      Canonical value ∧ CanonicalState (state.set lane value) ∧
      Decode value = laneModel full state ⟨lane.val,hend⟩ ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, Decode (cell (state.set lane value) j) =
        if j.val = lane.val then laneModel full state ⟨lane.val,hend⟩ else Decode (cell state j) := by
  let index : Fin 16 := ⟨lane.val,hend⟩
  let q := cell state index
  have hread : Array.index_usize state lane = .ok q :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.state_source_read state lane hend
  obtain ⟨value,hshift,hcan,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly.shift_source full q lane hlane hend hf (hs index)
  have hupdate : Array.update state lane value = .ok (state.set lane value) := by
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec state lane value
      (by simpa [state.property] using hend))
    simpa only [hset] using hrun
  have hmodel' : Decode value = laneModel full state index := hmodel
  refine ⟨value,?_,hcan,set_canonical state lane value hs hcan,hmodel',?_⟩
  · simp only [runStep,hread,hshift,hupdate,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    split
    · exact hmodel'
    · rfl

#print axioms source_loop_eq
#print axioms step_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneStep
PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly:
import PoseidonInternalRawArrays
import PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel
import PoseidonRawLimbReassembly

/-! Decode the actual reconstructed zero and nonzero internal-linear lanes.
Raw arithmetic is kept separate from exact-field algebra. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Exact Decode Canonical cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 Words4 RawBound CanonicalWords)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords (wordVec wordVec_canonical)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel (wordVec_decode)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

abbrev rawDecode (a : Raw4) : Exact := decodeWords (fun j => (cell a j).val)

def zeroRun (part : Raw4) (old : QM) : Result QM := do
  let a ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 ZeroCallback 0#u64 (part,wordVec old)
  state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs a

def shiftRun (full : Raw4) (q : QM) (lane : Usize) : Result QM := do
  let a ← array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 ShiftCallback 0#u64 (full,wordVec q,lane)
  state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs a

theorem zero_source (part : Raw4) (old : QM)
    (hp : RawBound part (16*P)) (ho : Canonical old) :
    ∃ out : QM, zeroRun part old = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      Decode out = rawDecode part - Decode old := by
  have hw := wordVec_canonical old ho
  obtain ⟨raw,hrun,_,hvalues⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays.zero_source part (wordVec old) hp hw
  obtain ⟨out,hreassemble,hcan,hdecode⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRawLimbReassembly.source_success raw
  change Decode out = rawDecode raw at hdecode
  have hfields : ∀ j : Fin 4,
      ((cell raw j).val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) =
        ((cell part j).val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) -
        ((cell (wordVec old) j).val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) := by
    intro j
    exact AspisR1.PoseidonInternalWordOps.zeroSubtract_model (cell part j)
      (cell (wordVec old) j) (cell raw j) (hw j) (hvalues j)
  have hmodel : rawDecode raw = rawDecode part - decodeWords (fun j => (cell (wordVec old) j).val) := by
    ext <;> first | exact hfields 0 | exact hfields 1 | exact hfields 2 | exact hfields 3
  rw [wordVec_decode] at hmodel
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,hdecode.trans hmodel⟩
  simp only [zeroRun,hrun,hreassemble,bind_tc_ok]

theorem shift_source (full : Raw4) (q : QM) (lane : Usize)
    (hlane : 1 ≤ lane.val) (hend : lane.val < 16)
    (hf : RawBound full (16*P)) (hq : Canonical q) :
    ∃ out : QM, shiftRun full q lane = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      Decode out = rawDecode full + Decode q *
        ((1 <<< R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) : Nat) : Exact) := by
  have hw := wordVec_canonical q hq
  obtain ⟨raw,hrun,_,hvalues⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays.shift_source
    full (wordVec q) lane hlane hend hf hw
  obtain ⟨out,hreassemble,hcan,hdecode⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRawLimbReassembly.source_success raw
  change Decode out = rawDecode raw at hdecode
  let n := 2 ^ R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15)
  have hfun : (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell raw j).val) =
      (fun j => (cell full j).val + n*(cell (wordVec q) j).val) := by
    funext j
    rw [hvalues j]
    exact congrArg ((cell full j).val + ·) (Nat.mul_comm _ _)
  have hmodel : rawDecode raw = rawDecode full + (n : Exact) * Decode q := by
    have ha := decodeWords_add (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell full j).val)
      (fun j : Fin 4 => n * (cell (wordVec q) j).val)
    have hm := decodeWords_nat_mul n (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell (wordVec q) j).val)
    have hqdecode := wordVec_decode q
    exact (congrArg decodeWords hfun).trans
      (ha.trans (congrArg (rawDecode full + ·)
        (hm.trans (congrArg ((n : Exact) * ·) hqdecode))))
  have hn : (1 <<< R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) : Nat) = n := by
    rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq,Nat.one_mul]
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · simp only [shiftRun,hrun,hreassemble,bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [hdecode,hmodel,hn,mul_comm (n : Exact)]

#print axioms zero_source
#print axioms shift_source
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly
PoseidonInternalRawArrays:
import PoseidonRaw4Constructor
import PoseidonInternalShiftClosure

/-! Actual stable Copy-array construction for each internal-linear callback.
All four raw output values and bounds are retained for reconstruction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

abbrev FullCallback := state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
abbrev ZeroCallback := state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64
abbrev ShiftCallback := state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy.closure_2.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64

theorem full_source (part : Raw4) (old : Words4)
    (hp : RawBound part (15*P)) (ho : CanonicalWords old) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 FullCallback 0#u64 (part,old) = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out (16*P) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (cell out j).val = (cell part j).val + (cell old j).val := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hprops⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRaw4Constructor.source_success FullCallback (part,old)
    (fun j v => v.val = (cell part j).val + (cell old j).val ∧ v.val < 16*P)
    (by intro i hi; exact full_sum_call part old i hi hp ho)
  exact ⟨out,hrun,(fun j => (hprops j).2),(fun j => (hprops j).1)⟩

theorem zero_source (part : Raw4) (old : Words4)
    (hp : RawBound part (16*P)) (ho : CanonicalWords old) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 ZeroCallback 0#u64 (part,old) = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out (17*P) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (cell out j).val = (cell part j).val + P - (cell old j).val := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hprops⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRaw4Constructor.source_success ZeroCallback (part,old)
    (fun j v => v.val = (cell part j).val + P - (cell old j).val ∧ v.val < 17*P)
    (by intro i hi; exact zero_sum_call part old i hi hp ho)
  exact ⟨out,hrun,(fun j => (hprops j).2),(fun j => (hprops j).1)⟩

theorem shift_source (full : Raw4) (words : Words4) (lane : Usize)
    (hlane : 1 ≤ lane.val) (hlaneEnd : lane.val < 16)
    (hf : RawBound full (16*P)) (hw : CanonicalWords words) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      array_from_fn_copy 4#usize core.marker.CopyU64 ShiftCallback 0#u64 (full,words,lane) = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out (2^48) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (cell out j).val = (cell full j).val + (cell words j).val *
          2 ^ R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hprops⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRaw4Constructor.source_success ShiftCallback (full,words,lane)
    (fun j v => v.val = (cell full j).val + (cell words j).val *
      2 ^ R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) ∧ v.val < 2^48)
    (by intro i hi; exact AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftClosure.source_success full words lane i hlane hlaneEnd hi hf hw)
  exact ⟨out,hrun,(fun j => (hprops j).2),(fun j => (hprops j).1)⟩

#print axioms full_source
#print axioms zero_source
#print axioms shift_source
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalRawArrays
PoseidonInternalShiftClosure:
import PoseidonInternalShiftCallEquation
import PoseidonInternalClosureSums

/-! Exact source callback for nonzero internal-linear lanes. All checked
reads, index subtraction, shift and addition are derived; capture is stable. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftClosure
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 Words4 RawBound CanonicalWords)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalWordOps (wide wide_value)
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps AspisV8R17.RawReducer

theorem source_success (full : Raw4) (words : Words4) (lane limb : Usize)
    (hlane : 1 ≤ lane.val) (hlaneEnd : lane.val < 16) (hlimb : limb.val < 4)
    (hfull : RawBound full (16*P)) (hwords : CanonicalWords words) :
    ∃ out : U64,
      state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy.closure_2.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeU64.call_mut
        (full,words,lane) limb = .ok (out,(full,words,lane)) ∧
      out.val = (cell full (⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩ : Fin 4)).val +
        (cell words (⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩ : Fin 4)).val *
          2 ^ R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) ∧ out.val < 2^48 := by
  let index : Fin 4 := ⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩
  let p := cell full index
  let w := cell words index
  have hb : limb.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa using hlimb
  have hreadP : Array.index_usize full limb = .ok p := by
    simpa only [p,cell,index] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok full limb hb
  have hreadW : Array.index_usize words limb = .ok w := by
    simpa only [w,cell,index] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok words limb hb
  have hone : (1#usize).val = 1 := by decide
  obtain ⟨offset,hsub,hoffset⟩ := sub_success lane 1#usize (by rw [hone]; exact hlane)
  rw [hone] at hoffset
  have ho : offset.val < 15 := by omega
  let shift := AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftsExact.shift (⟨offset.val,ho⟩ : Fin 15)
  have hreadShift : Array.index_usize state_only_poseidon.internal_linear_lazy.SHIFTS offset = .ok shift :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftsExact.source_read offset ho
  have hshiftBound : shift.val ≤ 16 := AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftsExact.bounded _
  have hshiftModel : shift.val = R0P.poseidonInternalShifts (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) := by
    have hm := AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftsExact.model (⟨offset.val,ho⟩ : Fin 15)
    have hindex : (⟨offset.val,ho⟩ : Fin 15) = (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) := Fin.ext hoffset
    exact hm.trans (congrArg R0P.poseidonInternalShifts hindex)
  have hw : w.val < P := hwords index
  have hp : p.val < 16*P := hfull index
  obtain ⟨shifted,hshiftRun,hshiftValue,hshiftSmall⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalWordOps.shifted_word_success w shift hw hshiftBound
  have hlimit : 16*P + 2^47 < 2^48 := by norm_num [P]
  have hsum : p.val+shifted.val < 2^48 := by omega
  obtain ⟨out,hadd,hout⟩ := add_success p shifted (by omega)
  have hvalue : out.val = p.val + w.val * 2 ^ R0P.poseidonInternalShifts
      (⟨lane.val-1,by omega⟩ : Fin 15) := by rw [hout,hshiftValue,hshiftModel]
  refine ⟨out,?_,hvalue,by rw [hout]; exact hsum⟩
  rw [AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftCallEquation.source_eq]
  simp only [hreadP,hreadW,hsub,hreadShift,hshiftRun,hadd,bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonInternalShiftClosure
