PoseidonArrayMapStable:
import EmptyRootExecution

/-! Stable callback map over the actual source Array.map implementation.
Callbacks need succeed only on values present in the input array. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonArrayMapStable
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisV8R19.TraversalRuntime

theorem mapState_stable {T U F : Type} (call : F → T → Result (U × F))
    (f : F) (g : T → U) (xs : List T) :
    (∀ x, x ∈ xs → call f x = .ok (g x,f)) →
      mapState call xs f = .ok (xs.map g,f) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => intro _; rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    intro hstable
    have hx := hstable x (by simp)
    have htail : ∀ y, y ∈ xs → call f y = .ok (g y,f) := by
      intro y hy
      exact hstable y (List.mem_cons_of_mem x hy)
    simp only [mapState,hx,bind_tc_ok,List.map_cons,ih htail]

def mapped {T U : Type} {N : Usize} (a : Array T N) (g : T → U) : Array U N :=
  ⟨a.val.map g, by simpa using a.property⟩

theorem source_success {T U F : Type} {N : Usize}
    (inst : core.ops.function.FnMut F T U) (a : Array T N) (f : F) (g : T → U)
    (hstable : ∀ x, x ∈ a.val → inst.call_mut f x = .ok (g x,f)) :
    core.array.Array.map inst a f = .ok (mapped a g) := by
  have hmap := mapState_stable inst.call_mut f g a.val hstable
  have hsource := core.array.Array.map_success inst a f (a.val.map g) f hmap
  simpa only [mapped] using hsource

#print axioms mapState_stable
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonArrayMapStable
PoseidonM31DotReads:
import PoseidonM31DotSource
import PoseidonInternalStateWords

/-! Actual input slice reads and a proof-index-free natural term view for
symbolic chunk invariants. The term view is tied to both actual reads. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Canonical cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords (wordVec)

def sliceCell {T : Type} (s : Slice T) (i : Nat) (hi : i < s.val.length) : T := s.val[i]'hi

def CanonicalWeights (weights : Slice QM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < weights.val.length), Canonical (sliceCell weights i hi)
def CanonicalValues (values : Slice U32) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Nat) (hi : i < values.val.length), (sliceCell values i hi).val < AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P

theorem source_read {T : Type} (s : Slice T) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < s.val.length) :
    Slice.index_usize s i = .ok (sliceCell s i.val hi) := by
  unfold Slice.index_usize
  change (match s.val[i.val]? with
    | none => (Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds : Result T)
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (s.val[i.val]'hi)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hi]

def term (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32) (i : Nat) (j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  match weights.val[i]?, values.val[i]? with
  | some q, some v => (cell (wordVec q) j).val * v.val
  | _, _ => 0

theorem term_read (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32) (i : Usize)
    (hw : i.val < weights.val.length) (hv : i.val < values.val.length) (j : Fin 4) :
    term weights values i.val j =
      (cell (wordVec (sliceCell weights i.val hw)) j).val * (sliceCell values i.val hv).val := by
  unfold term
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hw,List.getElem?_eq_getElem hv]
  rfl

def remaining (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32) (start fuel : Nat) (j : Fin 4) : Nat :=
  match fuel with
  | 0 => 0
  | n+1 => term weights values start j + remaining weights values (start+1) n j

#print axioms source_read
#print axioms term_read
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads

import PoseidonM31DotSevenOuter

/-! Complete actual seven-input QM31 by M31 scalar dot product, with no
execution-success or output-model premise. This is the internal-pair caller
boundary; arbitrary dot lengths are not claimed here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotSevenExact
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Exact Decode Canonical)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotSevenOuter (len_seven)

theorem source_success (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32)
    (hwlen : weights.val.length = 7) (hvlen : values.val.length = 7)
    (hw : CanonicalWeights weights) (hv : CanonicalValues values) :
    ∃ out : QM, field.qm31_m31_dot weights values = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      Decode out = (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 =>
        Decode (sliceCell weights i.val (by rw [hwlen]; exact i.isLt)) *
          ((sliceCell values i.val (by rw [hvlen]; exact i.isLt)).val : Exact))).foldl (·+·) 0 := by
  obtain ⟨raw,hrun,_,hraw⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotSevenOuter.source_success
    weights values hwlen hvlen hw hv
  obtain ⟨out,hfinish,hcanonical,hdecode⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonRawLimbReassembly.source_success raw
  have hfinish' : AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource.finish raw = .ok out := by
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource.finish_source_eq]
    exact hfinish
  have hwlen' := len_seven weights hwlen
  have hvlen' := len_seven values hvlen
  have hlength : Slice.len weights = Slice.len values := hwlen'.trans hvlen'.symm
  have hlong : ¬ Slice.len weights ≤ 4#usize := by rw [hwlen']; decide
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcanonical,?_⟩
  · rw [AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource.source_long_eq weights values hlength hlong,
      AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkIterator.initial_source]
    simp only [hrun,hfinish',bind_tc_ok]
  · change Decode out = AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly.rawDecode raw at hdecode
    exact hdecode.trans (hraw.trans
      (AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotRemainingAlgebra.decode_remaining weights values 7
        (by omega) (by omega)))

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotSevenExact
PoseidonM31DotSevenOuter:
import PoseidonM31DotOuterStep
import PoseidonM31DotRemainingAlgebra

/-! The actual seven-input internal-pair dot executes exactly two bounded
chunks. Source recursion is rewritten twice; coordinate arithmetic remains
symbolic throughout. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotSevenOuter
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly (rawDecode)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState (zero zero_value)
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords decodeWords_add)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkIterator (initial)
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

theorem len_seven {T : Type} (s : Slice T) (hs : s.val.length = 7) : Slice.len s = 7#usize := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  change s.val.length = 7
  exact hs

theorem source_success (weights : Slice field.QM31) (values : Slice U32)
    (hwlen : weights.val.length = 7) (hvlen : values.val.length = 7)
    (hw : CanonicalWeights weights) (hv : CanonicalValues values) :
    ∃ out : Raw4,
      field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 (initial (Slice.len weights)) weights values zero = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out (3*P) ∧ rawDecode out = decodeWords (remaining weights values 0 7) := by
  have hwlen' := len_seven weights hwlen
  have hz : RawBound zero (1*P) := by
    intro j
    rw [zero_value]
    norm_num [P]
  let iter0 := initial (Slice.len weights)
  have hstart0 : iter0.iter.start.val = 0 := rfl
  have hend0 : iter0.iter.end.val = 7 := by change (Slice.len weights).val = 7; rw [hwlen']; rfl
  have hiter0 : iter0.iter.start = 0#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hstart0
  have hsize4 : 8 < 2 ^ System.Platform.numBits := by
    cases System.Platform.numBits_eq <;> simp_all
  have hsize4small : 4 < 2 ^ System.Platform.numBits := by omega
  have hplus0 : UScalar.add iter0.iter.start 4#usize = .ok 4#usize := by
    rw [hiter0]
    simp [UScalar.add, UScalar.tryMk, UScalar.tryMkOpt, UScalar.check_bounds, hsize4, hsize4small]
  have hmin0 : core.cmp.min core.cmp.OrdUsize 4#usize (Slice.len weights) = .ok 4#usize := by
    rw [hwlen']
    simp [core.cmp.min, core.cmp.OrdUsize, core.cmp.impls.OrdUsize.min]
  obtain ⟨iter1,sums1,hrun0,hstart1,hend1,hstep1,hbound1,hmodel1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterStep.source_advance iter0 weights values zero 4#usize 4#usize 4 1
      (by rfl) (by rw [hstart0,hend0]; decide) hplus0 hmin0
      (by rw [hwlen]; decide) (by rw [hvlen]; decide) (by rw [hstart0]; decide)
      (by decide) hw hv (by decide) hz
  have hstart1' : iter1.iter.start.val = 4 := by rw [hstart1,hstart0,hend0]; decide
  have hend1' : iter1.iter.end.val = 7 := by rw [hend1]; exact hend0
  have hstart1eq : iter1.iter.start = 4#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hstart1'
  have hplus1 : UScalar.add iter1.iter.start 4#usize = .ok 8#usize := by
    rw [hstart1eq]
    simp [UScalar.add, UScalar.tryMk, UScalar.tryMkOpt, UScalar.check_bounds, hsize4, hsize4small]
  have hmin1 : core.cmp.min core.cmp.OrdUsize 8#usize (Slice.len weights) = .ok 7#usize := by
    rw [hwlen']
    simp [core.cmp.min, core.cmp.OrdUsize, core.cmp.impls.OrdUsize.min]
  obtain ⟨iter2,sums2,hrun1,hstart2,hend2,hstep2,hbound2,hmodel2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterStep.source_advance iter1 weights values sums1 8#usize 7#usize 3 2
      hstep1 (by rw [hstart1',hend1']; decide) hplus1 hmin1
      (by rw [hwlen]; decide) (by rw [hvlen]; decide) (by rw [hstart1']; decide)
      (by decide) hw hv (by decide) hbound1
  have hstop : iter2.iter.start.val ≥ iter2.iter.end.val := by
    rw [hstart2,hend2,hstart1',hend1']
    decide
  have hnext2 := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkIterator.next_done iter2 hstop
  have hrun2 : field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 iter2 weights values sums2 = .ok sums2 := by
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource.source_loop_eq,hnext2]
    rfl
  have hzero : rawDecode zero = 0 := by
    ext <;> simp [rawDecode,decodeWords,zero_value]
  have hsplit : decodeWords (remaining weights values 0 7) =
      decodeWords (remaining weights values 0 4) + decodeWords (remaining weights values 4 3) := by
    have hfun : remaining weights values 0 7 = (fun j : Fin 4 =>
        remaining weights values 0 4 j + remaining weights values 4 3 j) := by
      funext j
      exact AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotRemainingAlgebra.remaining_add weights values 0 4 3 j
    exact (congrArg decodeWords hfun).trans (decodeWords_add _ _)
  refine ⟨sums2,hrun0.trans (hrun1.trans hrun2),hbound2,?_⟩
  rw [hmodel2,hmodel1,hstart0,hstart1',hzero,zero_add]
  exact hsplit.symm

#print axioms len_seven
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotSevenOuter

import PoseidonM31DotOuterSource
import PoseidonM31DotChunkIterator
import PoseidonM31DotChunkModel
import PoseidonM31DotReduceLoop

/-! One checked outer chunk, preserving the actual recursive continuation.
Only the concrete checked start+4 and min operations are supplied by callers. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (Exact)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly (rawDecode)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource (Iter)
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

theorem source_advance (iter : Iter) (weights : Slice field.QM31) (values : Slice U32)
    (sums : Raw4) (plus last : Usize) (fuel n : Nat)
    (hstep : iter.step_by.val = 4) (hactive : iter.iter.start.val < iter.iter.end.val)
    (hplus : UScalar.add iter.iter.start 4#usize = .ok plus)
    (hmin : core.cmp.min core.cmp.OrdUsize plus (Slice.len weights) = .ok last)
    (hwEnd : last.val ≤ weights.val.length) (hvEnd : last.val ≤ values.val.length)
    (hspan : iter.iter.start.val+fuel=last.val) (hfuel : fuel ≤ 4)
    (hw : CanonicalWeights weights) (hv : CanonicalValues values)
    (hn : n ≤ 15) (hs : RawBound sums (n*P)) :
    ∃ (next : Iter) (sums1 : Raw4),
      field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 iter weights values sums =
        field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 next weights values sums1 ∧
      next.iter.start.val = min (iter.iter.start.val+4) iter.iter.end.val ∧
      next.iter.end = iter.iter.end ∧ next.step_by.val = 4 ∧
      RawBound sums1 ((n+1)*P) ∧
      rawDecode sums1 = rawDecode sums + decodeWords (remaining weights values iter.iter.start.val fuel) := by
  obtain ⟨next,hnext,hstart,hend,hstep1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkIterator.next_step iter hstep hactive
  obtain ⟨raw,hchunk,_,hraw⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkModel.source_success
    weights values { start := iter.iter.start, «end» := last } fuel
      hwEnd hvEnd hspan hfuel hw hv
  obtain ⟨sums1,hreduce,hbound,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceLoop.source_success sums raw n hn hs
  refine ⟨next,sums1,?_,hstart,hend,hstep1,hbound,?_⟩
  · rw [AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource.source_loop_eq,hnext]
    change (do
      let plus ← UScalar.add iter.iter.start 4#usize
      let last ← core.cmp.min core.cmp.OrdUsize plus (Slice.len weights)
      let raw ← field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop0
        { start := iter.iter.start, «end» := last } weights values
        PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero
      let sums1 ← field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize } sums raw
      field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 next weights values sums1) =
      field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 next weights values sums1
    simp only [hplus,hmin,hchunk,hreduce,bind_tc_ok]
  · have hdecode : rawDecode raw = decodeWords (remaining weights values iter.iter.start.val fuel) :=
      congrArg decodeWords (funext hraw)
    exact hmodel.trans (congrArg (rawDecode sums + ·) hdecode)

#print axioms source_advance
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterStep
PoseidonM31DotOuterSource:
import PoseidonM31DotSource
import PoseidonRawLimbReassembly

/-! Named source equations for the outer four-input traversal and its final
reassembly. The latter reuses the existing release reducer/reassembly proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotOuterSource
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4)
abbrev Iter := core.iter.adapters.step_by.StepBy (core.ops.range.Range Usize)

def finish (raw : Raw4) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let x0 ← Array.index_usize raw 0#usize
  let a ← field.M31.reduce_u64 x0
  let x1 ← Array.index_usize raw 1#usize
  let b ← field.M31.reduce_u64 x1
  let c0 ← field.CM31.new a b
  let x2 ← Array.index_usize raw 2#usize
  let c ← field.M31.reduce_u64 x2
  let x3 ← Array.index_usize raw 3#usize
  let d ← field.M31.reduce_u64 x3
  let c1 ← field.CM31.new c d
  .ok { c0, c1 }

theorem finish_source_eq (raw : Raw4) :
    finish raw = state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs raw := by
  simp only [finish,state_only_poseidon.extension_from_raw_limbs,
    field.M31.reduce_u62,field.M31.reduce_u64,bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok]

theorem source_loop_eq (iter : Iter) (weights : Slice field.QM31)
    (values : Slice U32) (sums : Raw4) :
    field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 iter weights values sums = (do
      let (o,next) ← core.iter.adapters.step_by.IteratorStepBy.next
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize) iter
      match o with
      | none => .ok sums
      | some start =>
        let plus ← UScalar.add start 4#usize
        let last ← core.cmp.min core.cmp.OrdUsize plus (Slice.len weights)
        let raw ← field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop0 { start, «end» := last }
          weights values AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero
        let sums1 ← field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1
          { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize } sums raw
        field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 next weights values sums1) := by
  rw [field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1.eq_def]
  rfl

theorem source_long_eq (weights : Slice field.QM31) (values : Slice U32)
    (heq : Slice.len weights = Slice.len values) (hlong : ¬ Slice.len weights ≤ 4#usize) :
    field.qm31_m31_dot weights values = (do
      let iter ← core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.step_by.trait_default
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize)
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := Slice.len weights } 4#usize
      let sums ← field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1 iter weights values
        AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero
      finish sums) := by
  have hm : massert (Slice.len weights = Slice.len values) = .ok () := by
    simp only [heq,massert,if_pos]
  rw [field.qm31_m31_dot,hm,bind_tc_ok,if_neg hlong]
  rfl

#print axioms finish_source_eq
#print axioms source_loop_eq

/-! Reuse the standard-library step_by specs, including the saturating last
chunk of length three at the seven-input internal-constant boundary. -/

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkIterator
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev Iter := core.iter.adapters.step_by.StepBy Range

def initial (len : Usize) : Iter :=
  { iter := { start := 0#usize, «end» := len }, step_by := 4#usize }

theorem initial_source (len : Usize) :
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.step_by.trait_default
      (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize)
      ({ start := 0#usize, «end» := len } : Range) 4#usize = .ok (initial len) := by
  have hnonzero : (4#usize).val ≠ 0 := by decide
  simp only [core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.step_by.trait_default,
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.step_by.default,if_neg hnonzero]
  rfl

theorem next_step (iter : Iter) (hstep : iter.step_by.val = 4)
    (hactive : iter.iter.start.val < iter.iter.end.val) :
    ∃ next : Iter,
      core.iter.adapters.step_by.IteratorStepBy.next
        (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize) iter =
          .ok (some iter.iter.start,next) ∧
      next.iter.start.val = min (iter.iter.start.val+4) iter.iter.end.val ∧
      next.iter.end = iter.iter.end ∧ next.step_by.val = 4 := by
  have hpositive : iter.step_by.val > 0 := by rw [hstep]; decide
  obtain ⟨pair,hrun,hpost⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.adapters.step_by.IteratorStepBy.next_Range_Usize_spec iter hpositive)
  rcases pair with ⟨o,next⟩
  have hcase := hpost.1
  rw [if_pos hactive] at hcase
  have ho := hcase.1
  have hinc := hcase.2
  rw [ho] at hrun
  rw [hstep] at hinc
  refine ⟨next,hrun,hinc,hpost.2.1,?_⟩
  exact (congrArg UScalar.val hpost.2.2).trans hstep

theorem next_done (iter : Iter) (hstop : iter.iter.start.val ≥ iter.iter.end.val) :
    core.iter.adapters.step_by.IteratorStepBy.next
      (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize) iter = .ok (none,iter) := by
  obtain ⟨pair,hrun,hpost⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (core.iter.adapters.step_by.IteratorStepBy.next_Range_Usize_none_spec iter hstop)
  rcases pair with ⟨o,next⟩
  rw [hpost.1,hpost.2] at hrun
  exact hrun

#print axioms next_done

import PoseidonM31DotChunkSource
import PoseidonM31DotReads

/-! Symbolic bounded chunk execution. Each actual input adds its four
coordinate products; the source loop is not evaluated at a concrete size. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotInput (Budget)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkSource (Range source_loop_eq)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads

theorem loop_success_fuel (weights : Slice field.QM31) (values : Slice U32)
    (raw : Raw4) (iter : Range) (fuel n : Nat)
    (hwEnd : iter.end.val ≤ weights.val.length) (hvEnd : iter.end.val ≤ values.val.length)
    (hspan : iter.start.val+fuel=iter.end.val) (hcount : n+fuel ≤ 4)
    (hw : CanonicalWeights weights) (hv : CanonicalValues values) (hb : Budget raw n) :
    ∃ out : Raw4, field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop0 iter weights values raw = .ok out ∧
      Budget out (n+fuel) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (cell out j).val = (cell raw j).val + remaining weights values iter.start.val fuel j := by
  induction fuel generalizing raw iter n with
  | zero =>
    have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
    refine ⟨raw,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [source_loop_eq,hnext]
      rfl
    · simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hb
    · intro j
      simp only [remaining,Nat.add_zero]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hactive : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    have hwidx : iter.start.val < weights.val.length := by omega
    have hvidx : iter.start.val < values.val.length := by omega
    let q := sliceCell weights iter.start.val hwidx
    let v := sliceCell values iter.start.val hvidx
    have hreadQ : Slice.index_usize weights iter.start = .ok q := source_read weights iter.start hwidx
    have hreadV : Slice.index_usize values iter.start = .ok v := source_read values iter.start hvidx
    obtain ⟨nextRaw,hinput,hnextBudget,hinputModel⟩ :=
      AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotInput.source_success raw q v n (by omega) hb
        (hw iter.start.val hwidx) (hv iter.start.val hvidx)
    obtain ⟨iter1,hnext,hinc,hend1,_⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hactive
    have hwEnd1 : iter1.end.val ≤ weights.val.length := by rw [hend1]; exact hwEnd
    have hvEnd1 : iter1.end.val ≤ values.val.length := by rw [hend1]; exact hvEnd
    have hspan1 : iter1.start.val+fuel=iter1.end.val := by rw [hend1]; omega
    have hcount1 : (n+1)+fuel ≤ 4 := by omega
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,houtBudget,houtModel⟩ :=
      ih nextRaw iter1 (n+1) hwEnd1 hvEnd1 hspan1 hcount1 hnextBudget
    refine ⟨out,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [source_loop_eq,hnext]
      change (do
        let value ← Slice.index_usize values iter.start
        let weight ← Slice.index_usize weights iter.start
        let nextRaw1 ← AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotInput.run raw weight value
        field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop0 iter1 weights values nextRaw1) = .ok out
      simp only [hreadV,hreadQ,hinput,bind_tc_ok]
      exact hrun
    · have heq : (n+1)+fuel = n+(fuel+1) := by omega
      simpa only [heq] using houtBudget
    · intro j
      have h := houtModel j
      rw [hinc,hinputModel j] at h
      have ht : term weights values iter.start.val j =
          (cell (AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.wordVec q) j).val * v.val :=
        term_read weights values iter.start hwidx hvidx j
      change (cell out j).val = (cell raw j).val +
        (term weights values iter.start.val j + remaining weights values (iter.start.val+1) fuel j)
      rw [ht,← Nat.add_assoc]
      exact h

theorem source_success (weights : Slice field.QM31) (values : Slice U32) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hwEnd : iter.end.val ≤ weights.val.length) (hvEnd : iter.end.val ≤ values.val.length)
    (hspan : iter.start.val+fuel=iter.end.val) (hsize : fuel ≤ 4)
    (hw : CanonicalWeights weights) (hv : CanonicalValues values) :
    ∃ out : Raw4, field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop0 iter weights values
        AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero = .ok out ∧
      Budget out fuel ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4,
        (cell out j).val = remaining weights values iter.start.val fuel j := by
  have hz : Budget AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero 0 := by
    intro j
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero_value]
    exact Nat.zero_le _
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hb,hm⟩ := loop_success_fuel weights values
    AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero iter fuel 0 hwEnd hvEnd hspan
    (by simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hsize) hw hv hz
  refine ⟨out,hrun,?_,?_⟩
  · simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hb
  · intro j
    have h := hm j
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulateState.zero_value,Nat.zero_add] at h
    exact h

#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotChunkModel

import PoseidonM31DotWordStep
import PoseidonInternalStateWords

/-! Exact four-coordinate body of one scalar-weight input. The coordinates
are updated independently; each uses the same processed-input budget. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotInput
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Canonical cell cell_set)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords (wordVec)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep (wide wide_value productBound step)

def Budget (raw : Raw4) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell raw j).val ≤ n*productBound

def run (raw : Raw4) (weight : QM) (value : U32) : Result Raw4 := do
  let scalar ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 value)
  let a0 ← step raw weight.c0.a scalar 0#usize
  let a1 ← step a0 weight.c0.b scalar 1#usize
  let a2 ← step a1 weight.c1.a scalar 2#usize
  step a2 weight.c1.b scalar 3#usize

private theorem read_other (raw : Raw4) (i : Usize) (value : U64) (j : Fin 4)
    (hne : j.val ≠ i.val) : cell (raw.set i value) j = cell raw j := by
  rw [cell_set,if_neg hne]

theorem source_success (raw : Raw4) (weight : QM) (value : U32) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n ≤ 3) (hb : Budget raw n) (hw : Canonical weight)
    (hv : value.val < AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P) :
    ∃ out : Raw4, run raw weight value = .ok out ∧ Budget out (n+1) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val = (cell raw j).val + (cell (wordVec weight) j).val*value.val := by
  have hscalar : (wide value).val < AspisV8R17.RawReducer.P := by rw [wide_value]; exact hv
  have hbudget0 : (cell raw (0 : Fin 4)).val ≤ n*productBound := hb 0
  obtain ⟨r0,hstep0,hvalue0,hbound0⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep.source_success
    raw weight.c0.a (wide value) 0#usize (by decide) n hn hw.1.1 hscalar hbudget0
  let a0 := raw.set 0#usize r0
  have hmodel0 : r0.val = (cell raw (0 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c0.a.val*value.val := by
    change r0.val = (cell raw (0 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c0.a.val*(wide value).val at hvalue0
    rw [wide_value] at hvalue0
    exact hvalue0
  have hread1 : cell a0 (1 : Fin 4) = cell raw (1 : Fin 4) := by
    exact read_other raw 0#usize r0 (1 : Fin 4) (by decide)
  have hbudget1 : (cell a0 (1 : Fin 4)).val ≤ n*productBound := by
    rw [hread1]
    exact hb 1
  obtain ⟨r1,hstep1,hvalue1,hbound1⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep.source_success
    a0 weight.c0.b (wide value) 1#usize (by decide) n hn hw.1.2 hscalar hbudget1
  let a1 := a0.set 1#usize r1
  have hmodel1 : r1.val = (cell raw (1 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c0.b.val*value.val := by
    change r1.val = (cell a0 (1 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c0.b.val*(wide value).val at hvalue1
    rw [wide_value,hread1] at hvalue1
    exact hvalue1
  have hread2 : cell a1 (2 : Fin 4) = cell raw (2 : Fin 4) := by
    exact (read_other a0 1#usize r1 (2 : Fin 4) (by decide)).trans
      (read_other raw 0#usize r0 (2 : Fin 4) (by decide))
  have hbudget2 : (cell a1 (2 : Fin 4)).val ≤ n*productBound := by
    rw [hread2]
    exact hb 2
  obtain ⟨r2,hstep2,hvalue2,hbound2⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep.source_success
    a1 weight.c1.a (wide value) 2#usize (by decide) n hn hw.2.1 hscalar hbudget2
  let a2 := a1.set 2#usize r2
  have hmodel2 : r2.val = (cell raw (2 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c1.a.val*value.val := by
    change r2.val = (cell a1 (2 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c1.a.val*(wide value).val at hvalue2
    rw [wide_value,hread2] at hvalue2
    exact hvalue2
  have hread3 : cell a2 (3 : Fin 4) = cell raw (3 : Fin 4) := by
    exact (read_other a1 2#usize r2 (3 : Fin 4) (by decide)).trans
      ((read_other a0 1#usize r1 (3 : Fin 4) (by decide)).trans
        (read_other raw 0#usize r0 (3 : Fin 4) (by decide)))
  have hbudget3 : (cell a2 (3 : Fin 4)).val ≤ n*productBound := by
    rw [hread3]
    exact hb 3
  obtain ⟨r3,hstep3,hvalue3,hbound3⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep.source_success
    a2 weight.c1.b (wide value) 3#usize (by decide) n hn hw.2.2 hscalar hbudget3
  let a3 := a2.set 3#usize r3
  have hmodel3 : r3.val = (cell raw (3 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c1.b.val*value.val := by
    change r3.val = (cell a2 (3 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c1.b.val*(wide value).val at hvalue3
    rw [wide_value,hread3] at hvalue3
    exact hvalue3
  have hout0 : cell a3 (0 : Fin 4) = r0 := by
    simp [a3,a2,a1,a0,cell_set]
  have hout1 : cell a3 (1 : Fin 4) = r1 := by
    simp [a3,a2,a1,a0,cell_set]
  have hout2 : cell a3 (2 : Fin 4) = r2 := by
    simp [a3,a2,a1,a0,cell_set]
  have hout3 : cell a3 (3 : Fin 4) = r3 := by
    simp [a3,a2,a1,a0,cell_set]
  refine ⟨a3, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change (do
      let b0 ← step raw weight.c0.a (wide value) 0#usize
      let b1 ← step b0 weight.c0.b (wide value) 1#usize
      let b2 ← step b1 weight.c1.a (wide value) 2#usize
      step b2 weight.c1.b (wide value) 3#usize) = .ok a3
    rw [hstep0,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do
      let b1 ← step a0 weight.c0.b (wide value) 1#usize
      let b2 ← step b1 weight.c1.a (wide value) 2#usize
      step b2 weight.c1.b (wide value) 3#usize) = .ok a3
    rw [hstep1,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do
      let b2 ← step a1 weight.c1.a (wide value) 2#usize
      step b2 weight.c1.b (wide value) 3#usize) = .ok a3
    rw [hstep2,bind_tc_ok]
    exact hstep3
  · intro j
    fin_cases j
    · change (cell a3 (0 : Fin 4)).val ≤ (n+1)*productBound
      rw [hout0]
      exact hbound0
    · change (cell a3 (1 : Fin 4)).val ≤ (n+1)*productBound
      rw [hout1]
      exact hbound1
    · change (cell a3 (2 : Fin 4)).val ≤ (n+1)*productBound
      rw [hout2]
      exact hbound2
    · change (cell a3 (3 : Fin 4)).val ≤ (n+1)*productBound
      rw [hout3]
      exact hbound3
  · intro j
    fin_cases j
    · change (cell a3 (0 : Fin 4)).val = (cell raw (0 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c0.a.val*value.val
      rw [hout0]
      exact hmodel0
    · change (cell a3 (1 : Fin 4)).val = (cell raw (1 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c0.b.val*value.val
      rw [hout1]
      exact hmodel1
    · change (cell a3 (2 : Fin 4)).val = (cell raw (2 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c1.a.val*value.val
      rw [hout2]
      exact hmodel2
    · change (cell a3 (3 : Fin 4)).val = (cell raw (3 : Fin 4)).val + weight.c1.b.val*value.val
      rw [hout3]
      exact hmodel3

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotInput
PoseidonM31DotWordStep:
import PoseidonM31DotSource
import PoseidonInternalRawArrays

/-! One actual scalar-weight dot coordinate update. A four-input chunk fits
in U64 because 4(P-1)^2 < 2^64; each coordinate's budget is independent. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4)
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

def productBound : Nat := (P-1)^2
abbrev wide (x : U32) : U64 := UScalar.cast .U64 x

theorem wide_value (x : U32) : (wide x).val = x.val := by
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.cast_widen_value x

theorem four_products_fit : 4*productBound < 2^64 := by
  norm_num [productBound,P]

def step (raw : Raw4) (word : U32) (scalar : U64) (limb : Usize) : Result Raw4 := do
  let weight ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 word)
  let product ← UScalar.mul weight scalar
  let old ← Array.index_usize raw limb
  let value ← UScalar.add old product
  Array.update raw limb value

theorem source_success (raw : Raw4) (word : U32) (scalar : U64)
    (limb : Usize) (hi : limb.val < 4) (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ 3)
    (hword : word.val < P) (hscalar : scalar.val < P)
    (hbudget : (cell raw (⟨limb.val,hi⟩ : Fin 4)).val ≤ n*productBound) :
    ∃ value : U64, step raw word scalar limb = .ok (raw.set limb value) ∧
      value.val = (cell raw (⟨limb.val,hi⟩ : Fin 4)).val + word.val*scalar.val ∧
      value.val ≤ (n+1)*productBound := by
  let index : Fin 4 := ⟨limb.val,hi⟩
  let old := cell raw index
  have hb : limb.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa using hi
  have hread : Array.index_usize raw limb = .ok old := by
    simpa only [old,index,cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok raw limb hb
  have hprod : word.val*scalar.val ≤ productBound := by
    change word.val*scalar.val ≤ (P-1)*(P-1)
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hword) (Nat.le_pred_of_lt hscalar)
  have hprod64 : (wide word).val*scalar.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [wide_value]
    have hsmall : productBound < 2^64 := by norm_num [productBound,P]
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt hprod hsmall
  obtain ⟨product,hmul,hproduct⟩ := mul_success (wide word) scalar hprod64
  rw [wide_value] at hproduct
  have hbudgetLocal : old.val ≤ n*productBound := hbudget
  have hsum : old.val+product.val ≤ (n+1)*productBound := by
    rw [hproduct,Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
    exact Nat.add_le_add hbudgetLocal hprod
  have hsum64 : old.val+product.val < 2^64 := by
    have hcount : n+1 ≤ 4 := by omega
    exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_trans hsum (Nat.mul_le_mul_right productBound hcount)) four_products_fit
  obtain ⟨value,hadd,hvalue⟩ := add_success old product hsum64
  have hupdate : Array.update raw limb value = .ok (raw.set limb value) := by
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec raw limb value (by simpa [raw.property] using hb))
    simpa only [hset] using hrun
  refine ⟨value,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [step,wide,hmul,hread,hadd,hupdate,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  · exact hvalue.trans (congrArg (old.val + ·) hproduct)
  · rw [hvalue]
    exact hsum

#print axioms wide_value
#print axioms four_products_fit
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotWordStep

import PoseidonM31DotReduceStep
import PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly
import OccupancyRangeTraversal

/-! Actual four-coordinate chunk reduction and accumulation. An initially
loose traversal budget is sharpened using the exact coordinate formula. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalLaneReassembly (rawDecode)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords decodeWords_add decodeWords_mod)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceStep (step)
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize

def addModel (sums raw : Raw4) (j : Fin 4) : Nat := (cell sums j).val + (cell raw j).val % P

theorem source_loop_eq (iter : Range) (sums raw : Raw4) :
    field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1 iter sums raw = (do
      let (o,iter1) ← core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
      match o with
      | none => .ok sums
      | some index =>
        let nextSums ← step sums raw index
        field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1 iter1 nextSums raw) := by
  rw [field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1.eq_def]
  simp only [step,bind_assoc_eq,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  all_goals rfl

theorem loop_success_fuel (sums raw : Raw4) (iter : Range) (fuel n : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val ≤ 4) (hspan : iter.start.val+fuel=iter.end.val)
    (hcount : n+fuel ≤ 19) (hs : RawBound sums (n*P)) :
    ∃ out : Raw4, field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1 iter sums raw = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out ((n+fuel)*P) ∧ ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val =
        if iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val then addModel sums raw j
        else (cell sums j).val := by
  induction fuel generalizing sums iter n with
  | zero =>
    have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
    have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
    refine ⟨sums,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [source_loop_eq,hnext]
      rfl
    · simpa only [Nat.add_zero] using hs
    · intro j
      rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hactive : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
    have hidx : iter.start.val < 4 := by omega
    obtain ⟨value,hstep,hcan,hcells⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceStep.source_success
      sums raw iter.start hidx n (by omega) hs
    let sums1 := sums.set iter.start value
    obtain ⟨iter1,hnext,hinc,hend1,_⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hactive
    have hend' : iter1.end.val ≤ 4 := by rw [hend1]; exact hend
    have hspan' : iter1.start.val+fuel=iter1.end.val := by rw [hend1]; omega
    have hcount' : (n+1)+fuel ≤ 19 := by omega
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hbound,hmodel⟩ := ih sums1 iter1 (n+1) hend' hspan' hcount' hcan
    refine ⟨out,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [source_loop_eq,hnext]
      change (do
        let nextSums ← step sums raw iter.start
        field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1 iter1 nextSums raw) = .ok out
      rw [hstep]
      exact hrun
    · have heq : (n+1)+fuel = n+(fuel+1) := by omega
      simpa only [heq] using hbound
    · intro j
      have h := hmodel j
      rw [hinc,hend1] at h
      rw [h]
      by_cases hj : j.val = iter.start.val
      · have hafter : ¬ (iter.start.val+1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        have hinside : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val := by omega
        rw [if_neg hafter,if_pos hinside]
        have hc := hcells j
        rw [if_pos hj] at hc
        have hindex : (⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ : Fin 4) = j := Fin.ext hj.symm
        change (cell sums1 j).val = addModel sums raw ⟨iter.start.val,hidx⟩ at hc
        exact hc.trans (congrArg (addModel sums raw) hindex)
      · have hc : (cell sums1 j).val = (cell sums j).val := by
          have hp := hcells j
          rw [if_neg hj] at hp
          exact hp
        unfold addModel
        rw [hc]
        have hrange : (iter.start.val+1 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) ↔
            (iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val) := by omega
        by_cases hin : iter.start.val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < iter.end.val
        · rw [if_pos (hrange.mpr hin),if_pos hin]
        · rw [if_neg (fun h => hin (hrange.mp h)),if_neg hin]

theorem source_success (sums raw : Raw4) (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ 15) (hs : RawBound sums (n*P)) :
    ∃ out : Raw4, field.qm31_m31_dot_loop1_loop1
        { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize } sums raw = .ok out ∧
      RawBound out ((n+1)*P) ∧ rawDecode out = rawDecode sums + rawDecode raw := by
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,_,hmodel⟩ := loop_success_fuel sums raw
    { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize } 4 n (by decide) (by decide) (by omega) hs
  have hvalues : ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell out j).val = addModel sums raw j := by
    intro j
    have h := hmodel j
    have hinside : (0#usize).val ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < (4#usize).val := by have := j.isLt; scalar_tac
    rw [if_pos hinside] at h
    exact h
  refine ⟨out,hrun,?_,?_⟩
  · intro j
    rw [hvalues j]
    unfold addModel
    have hs0 := hs j
    have hm : (cell raw j).val % P < P := Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num [P])
    rw [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
    omega
  · have hfun : (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell out j).val) =
        (fun j => (cell sums j).val + (cell raw j).val % P) := funext hvalues
    exact (congrArg decodeWords hfun).trans
      ((decodeWords_add (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell sums j).val)
        (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell raw j).val % P)).trans
        (congrArg (rawDecode sums + ·) (decodeWords_mod (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell raw j).val))))

#print axioms source_loop_eq
#print axioms loop_success_fuel
#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceLoop
PoseidonM31DotReduceStep:
import PoseidonM31DotSource
import PoseidonInternalClosureSums

/-! One actual chunk-reduction update. The existing unrestricted U64
reducer supplies a canonical M31 residue; only bounded addition is new. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (cell cell_set)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalClosureSums (Raw4 RawBound)
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps
open AspisV8R17.RawReducer (P)

def step (sums raw : Raw4) (limb : Usize) : Result Raw4 := do
  let input ← Array.index_usize raw limb
  let residue ← field.M31.reduce_u64 input
  let word ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 residue)
  let old ← Array.index_usize sums limb
  let value ← UScalar.add old word
  Array.update sums limb value

theorem source_success (sums raw : Raw4) (limb : Usize) (hi : limb.val < 4)
    (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ 19) (hs : RawBound sums (n*P)) :
    ∃ value : U64, step sums raw limb = .ok (sums.set limb value) ∧
      RawBound (sums.set limb value) ((n+1)*P) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 4, (cell (sums.set limb value) j).val =
        if j.val = limb.val then
          (cell sums (⟨limb.val,hi⟩ : Fin 4)).val + (cell raw (⟨limb.val,hi⟩ : Fin 4)).val % P
        else (cell sums j).val := by
  let index : Fin 4 := ⟨limb.val,hi⟩
  let input := cell raw index
  let old := cell sums index
  have hb : limb.val < (4#usize).val := by simpa using hi
  have hreadRaw : Array.index_usize raw limb = .ok input := by
    simpa only [input,index,cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok raw limb hb
  have hreadOld : Array.index_usize sums limb = .ok old := by
    simpa only [old,index,cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok sums limb hb
  obtain ⟨residue,hreduce,hmod,hcanonical⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.current_wrapper_mod input
  have hcast : (UScalar.cast .U64 residue).val = residue.val :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducer.cast_widen_value residue
  have hold : old.val < n*P := hs index
  have hlimit : 20*P < 2^64 := by norm_num [P]
  have hnBound : n*P ≤ 19*P := Nat.mul_le_mul_right P hn
  have hsum : old.val + residue.val < (n+1)*P := by
    rw [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
    omega
  have hsum64 : old.val + (UScalar.cast .U64 residue).val < 2^64 := by rw [hcast]; omega
  obtain ⟨value,hadd,hvalue⟩ := add_success old (UScalar.cast .U64 residue) hsum64
  rw [hcast] at hvalue
  have hwrite : Array.update sums limb value = .ok (sums.set limb value) := by
    obtain ⟨out,hrun,hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec sums limb value
      (by simpa [sums.property] using hb))
    simpa only [hset] using hrun
  refine ⟨value,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [step,hreadRaw,hreadOld,hreduce,hadd,hwrite,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = limb.val
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      rw [hvalue]
      exact hsum
    · simp only [if_neg hj]
      rw [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul]
      exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (hs j) (Nat.le_add_right (n*P) P)
  · intro j
    rw [cell_set]
    by_cases hj : j.val = limb.val
    · simp only [if_pos hj]
      rw [hvalue,hmod]
    · simp only [if_neg hj]

#print axioms source_success
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReduceStep
PoseidonM31DotRemainingAlgebra:
import PoseidonM31DotReads
import PoseidonM31DotFieldSum

/-! Structural sum identities for the scalar dot product. No seven-input
recurrence or finite-field multiplication is normalized. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotRemainingAlgebra
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Exact Decode)
open AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotReads
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords)

theorem remaining_add (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32)
    (start a b : Nat) (j : Fin 4) :
    remaining weights values start (a+b) j = remaining weights values start a j +
      remaining weights values (start+a) b j := by
  induction a generalizing start with
  | zero => simp only [Nat.zero_add,Nat.add_zero,remaining]
  | succ a ih =>
    rw [Nat.succ_add]
    change term weights values start j + remaining weights values (start+1) (a+b) j =
      (term weights values start j + remaining weights values (start+1) a j) +
        remaining weights values (start+(a+1)) b j
    rw [ih]
    have hshift : start+1+a = start+(a+1) := by omega
    rw [hshift,Nat.add_assoc]

theorem remaining_ofFn (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32)
    (start fuel : Nat) (j : Fin 4) :
    remaining weights values start fuel j =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin fuel => term weights values (start+i.val) j)).sum := by
  induction fuel generalizing start with
  | zero => simp only [remaining,List.ofFn_zero,List.sum_nil]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    rw [remaining,List.ofFn_succ,List.sum_cons,ih]
    apply congrArg (term weights values start j + ·)
    apply congrArg List.sum
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext i
    have hshift : start+1+i.val = start+(i.val+1) := by omega
    simp only [Fin.val_succ,hshift]

theorem decode_remaining (weights : Slice QM) (values : Slice U32) (N : Nat)
    (hw : N ≤ weights.val.length) (hv : N ≤ values.val.length) :
    decodeWords (remaining weights values 0 N) =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
        Decode (sliceCell weights i.val (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hw)) *
          ((sliceCell values i.val (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hv)).val : Exact))).foldl (·+·) 0 := by
  let w : Fin N → QM := fun i => sliceCell weights i.val (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hw)
  let v : Fin N → U32 := fun i => sliceCell values i.val (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hv)
  have hterm (i : Fin N) (j : Fin 4) :
      term weights values i.val j =
        (AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell (AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val := by
    unfold term
    rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hw),
      List.getElem?_eq_getElem (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.isLt hv)]
    rfl
  have hfun : remaining weights values 0 N = (fun j : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
        (AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep.cell (AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords.wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val)).sum) := by
    funext j
    rw [remaining_ofFn]
    apply congrArg List.sum
    apply congrArg List.ofFn
    funext i
    simpa only [Nat.zero_add] using hterm i j
  exact (congrArg decodeWords hfun).trans
    (AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotFieldSum.decode_coordinatewise_nat_weighted_sum w v)

#print axioms remaining_add
#print axioms remaining_ofFn
#print axioms decode_remaining
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotRemainingAlgebra
PoseidonM31DotFieldSum:
import RawPoseidonRowField
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep
import PoseidonInternalStateWords
import PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotFieldSum

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisR1.PoseidonFullRoundCellStep (QM Exact Decode cell)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalStateWords (wordVec)
open AspisR1.PoseidonInternalAccumulatorModel (wordVec_decode)
open AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField (decodeWords decodeWords_add decodeWords_nat_mul)

/-- Coordinatewise Nat addition commutes with the exact four-word decoder. -/
theorem decodeWords_list_coordinate_sum (xs : List (Fin 4 → Nat)) :
    decodeWords (fun j => (xs.map (fun row => row j)).sum) =
      (xs.map decodeWords).sum := by
  induction xs with
  | nil =>
      ext <;> simp [AspisR1.RawPoseidonRowField.decodeWords]
  | cons row rows ih =>
      change decodeWords (fun j => row j + (rows.map (fun tail => tail j)).sum) =
        decodeWords row + (rows.map decodeWords).sum
      rw [decodeWords_add, ih]

/-- Decode a pointwise finite sum of coordinate vectors as the sum of their
exact decoded words. This is structural in the list, with no field expansion. -/
theorem decodeWords_ofFn_coordinate_sum
    (N : Nat) (coordinate : Fin N → Fin 4 → Nat) :
    decodeWords (fun j => (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N => coordinate i j)).sum) =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N => decodeWords (coordinate i))).sum := by
  have h := decodeWords_list_coordinate_sum
    (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N => coordinate i))
  simpa only [List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using h

/-- A weighted QM31 word vector decodes to the exact-field scalar multiple
of its decoded QM31 value. -/
theorem decode_wordVec_weighted
    (q : QM) (n : U32) :
    decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 =>
      (cell (wordVec q) j).val * n.val) = Decode q * (n.val : Exact) := by
  calc
    decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell (wordVec q) j).val * n.val) =
        (n.val : Exact) * decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell (wordVec q) j).val) := by
          simpa only [Nat.mul_comm] using
            decodeWords_nat_mul n.val (fun j : Fin 4 => (cell (wordVec q) j).val)
    _ = (n.val : Exact) * Decode q := by rw [wordVec_decode]
    _ = Decode q * (n.val : Exact) := by rw [mul_comm]

/-- The root's coordinatewise Nat weighted sum is exactly the ordered sum of
its QM31 words multiplied in the exact field by their unsigned U32 weights. -/
theorem decode_coordinatewise_nat_weighted_sum
    {N : Nat} (w : Fin N → QM) (v : Fin N → U32) :
    decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
        (cell (wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val)).sum) =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
        Decode (w i) * ((v i).val : Exact))).foldl (· + ·) 0 := by
  have hterms : ∀ i : Fin N,
      decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 =>
        (cell (wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val) =
        Decode (w i) * ((v i).val : Exact) := by
    intro i
    exact decode_wordVec_weighted (w i) (v i)
  calc
    decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 =>
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
        (cell (wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val)).sum) =
        (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
          decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 =>
            (cell (wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val))).sum :=
      decodeWords_ofFn_coordinate_sum N
        (fun i j => (cell (wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val)
    _ = (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
          Decode (w i) * ((v i).val : Exact))).sum := by
      have hlists :
          List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
            decodeWords (fun j : Fin 4 =>
              (cell (wordVec (w i)) j).val * (v i).val)) =
          List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N => Decode (w i) * ((v i).val : Exact)) :=
        congrArg List.ofFn (funext hterms)
      exact congrArg List.sum hlists
    _ = (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin N =>
          Decode (w i) * ((v i).val : Exact))).foldl (· + ·) 0 := by
      rw [List.sum_eq_foldl]

#print axioms decodeWords_list_coordinate_sum
#print axioms decodeWords_ofFn_coordinate_sum
#print axioms decode_wordVec_weighted
#print axioms decode_coordinatewise_nat_weighted_sum
end AspisR1.PoseidonM31DotFieldSum
PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperSuccess:
import PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactorV8
import AspisR1.PoseidonActualPreparedWeights
import AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact
import ExtractedMaskPreparedState
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/- Successful-call adapter for the pinned candidate projected-wrapper cut.
   It assumes only that the three actual packed calls return their outputs and
   that those outputs have the exact callback-input canonicality. The separate
   wrapper-factor theorem has no success premise and preserves failure order. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperSuccess
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor
open AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedCallbackSource

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev PreparedFor := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

private def localAt (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)
private def get4 (a : Array QM 4#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)
private def get3 (a : Array QM 3#usize) (i : Fin 3) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)
private def getPrepared3 (a : Array Prepared 3#usize) (i : Fin 3) : Prepared :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

/-- The candidate wrapper succeeds and its result satisfies the existing
    closure-array model whenever each earlier packed call actually succeeds. -/
theorem success_from_component_success
    (openings : state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings)
    (selectors : state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonSelectors)
    (leading : Array QM 4#usize) (full : Array QM 4#usize)
    (internal : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hblock : Canonical selectors.block)
    (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (localAt selectors.local i))
    (hsuccessor : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical
      (openings.succ_z.val[i.val]'(by simpa [openings.succ_z.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hinternal : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical
      (internal.val[i.val]'(by simpa [internal.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hleading : ∀ (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4), Canonical (get4 leading i hi))
    (hfull : ∀ (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4), Canonical (get4 full i hi))
    (hleadingCall : state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed openings = .ok leading)
    (hfullCall : state_only_poseidon.interpolated_full_pair_packed
      openings.z selectors.local = .ok full)
    (hinternalCall : state_only_poseidon.interpolated_internal_pair
      openings.z selectors.local = .ok internal) :
    ∃ leadingLow fullLow internalLow : QM,
    ∃ weights : Array QM 3#usize, ∃ out : Array QM 4#usize,
      weights = Array.make 3#usize [leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow] ∧
      Decode leadingLow = Decode (localAt selectors.local 0) ∧
      Decode fullLow = AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow
        (fun i => Decode (localAt selectors.local i)) ∧
      Decode internalLow = AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow
        (fun i => Decode (localAt selectors.local i)) ∧
      candidate_projected_source openings selectors = .ok out ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 4, Canonical
        (out.val[i.val]'(by simpa [out.property] using i.isLt))) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 4, Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 out i) =
        AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.model openings internal selectors.block
          weights leading full i := by
  obtain ⟨fullLow, hfullLow, hfullLowCan, hfullLowDecode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonActualLowWeights.fullLow_source_success selectors.local hlocal
  obtain ⟨internalLow, hinternalLow, hinternalLowCan, hinternalLowDecode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonActualLowWeights.internalLow_source_success selectors.local hlocal
  let leadingLow : QM := localAt selectors.local 0
  have hleadingLowCan : Canonical leadingLow := hlocal 0
  have hread0 : Array.index_usize selectors.local 0#usize = .ok leadingLow := by
    simpa [leadingLow, localAt] using
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok selectors.local 0#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨p0,p1,p2,hmap,hp0,hp1,hp2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedWeightMap.prepared_map_three
      leadingLow fullLow internalLow hleadingLowCan hfullLowCan hinternalLowCan
  let weights : Array QM 3#usize := Array.make 3#usize [leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow]
  let preparedWeights : Array Prepared 3#usize := Array.make 3#usize [p0,p1,p2]
  obtain ⟨preparedBlock,hnew,hprepared⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.current_prepared_new selectors.block hblock
  have hlow : actual_low_prelude selectors.local = .ok (leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow) := by
    simp only [actual_low_prelude, hread0, hfullLow, hinternalLow, bind_tc_ok]
  have hmapExact : core.array.Array.map (BuiltinFnMut QM Prepared)
      (Array.make 3#usize [leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow])
      (field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new) = .ok preparedWeights := by
    simpa [AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedWeightMap.Callback, AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedWeightMap.New,
      preparedWeights] using hmap
  have hweightsCan : ∀ i : Fin 3, Canonical (get3 weights i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [weights, get3, Array.make] <;> assumption
  have hweightsPrepared : ∀ i : Fin 3, PreparedFor
      (getPrepared3 preparedWeights i) (get3 weights i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [preparedWeights, weights, getPrepared3, get3, Array.make] <;>
      assumption
  obtain ⟨out,hrun,hcan,hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.source_success openings internal
      preparedBlock selectors.block preparedWeights weights leading full hblock hprepared
      hweightsCan hweightsPrepared hsuccessor hinternal hleading hfull
  have hcallbackRun : candidate_array
      (openings, internal, preparedBlock, preparedWeights, leading, full) =
        AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.run openings internal preparedBlock
          preparedWeights weights leading full := by
    rfl
  refine ⟨leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow,weights,out,rfl,rfl,hfullLowDecode,hinternalLowDecode,?_,hcan,?_⟩
  · simp only [candidate_projected_source, hlow, bind_tc_ok, hleadingCall,
      hfullCall, hinternalCall]
    change (do
      let prepared_weights ← core.array.Array.map (BuiltinFnMut QM Prepared)

            AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.packedGroup internalArray ⟨idx.val,hbound⟩)) at hmodel

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic

abbrev P : Nat := 2147483647
abbrev M := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact
abbrev CMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact
abbrev M31 := field.M31
abbrev CM := field.CM31
abbrev CanonicalCM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM

def decodeM (x : M31) : M := x.val
def decodeCM (x : CM) : CMExact := ⟨decodeM x.a, decodeM x.b⟩

private theorem cast_mod (n : Nat) : ((n % P : Nat) : M) = (n : M) := by
  simp only [ZMod.natCast_mod]

private theorem cast_sub_wrap (a b : Nat) (hb : b < P) :
    (((a + P - b) % P : Nat) : M) = (a : M) - (b : M) := by
  rw [ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_sub (by omega), Nat.cast_add,
    ZMod.natCast_self, add_zero]

theorem m31_add_decode (x y : M31) (hx : x.val < P) (hy : y.val < P) :
    ∃ z, field.M31.add x y = .ok z ∧ decodeM z = decodeM x + decodeM y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hv, _⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x y hx hy
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  change (z.val : M) = (x.val : M) + (y.val : M)
  rw [hv, cast_mod]
  simp [decodeM]

theorem m31_sub_decode (x y : M31) (hx : x.val < P) (hy : y.val < P) :
    ∃ z, field.M31.sub x y = .ok z ∧ decodeM z = decodeM x - decodeM y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hv, _⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod x y hx hy
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  change (z.val : M) = (x.val : M) - (y.val : M)
  rw [hv]
  exact cast_sub_wrap x.val y.val hy

theorem cm_add_decode (x y : CM) (hx : CanonicalCM x) (hy : CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, field.CM31.add x y = .ok z ∧ decodeCM z = decodeCM x + decodeCM y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, _, ha, hb⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_add_mod x y hx hy
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [decodeCM, decodeM, ha, hb, cast_mod]

theorem cm_sub_decode (x y : CM) (hx : CanonicalCM x) (hy : CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, field.CM31.sub x y = .ok z ∧ decodeCM z = decodeCM x - decodeCM y := by
  obtain ⟨z, hz, _, ha, hb⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_sub_mod x y hx hy
  refine ⟨z, hz, ?_⟩
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · change (z.a.val : M) = (x.a.val : M) - (y.a.val : M)
    rw [ha, ZMod.natCast_mod]
    have h := cast_sub_wrap x.a.val y.a.val hy.1
    simpa [P, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P] using h
  · change (z.b.val : M) = (x.b.val : M) - (y.b.val : M)
    rw [hb, ZMod.natCast_mod]
    have h := cast_sub_wrap x.b.val y.b.val hy.2
    simpa [P, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P] using h

theorem mul_by_r_decode (x : CM) (hx : CanonicalCM x) :
    ∃ y, field.mul_by_r x = .ok y ∧ CanonicalCM y ∧
      decodeCM y = ⟨2, 1⟩ * decodeCM x := by
  obtain ⟨a2, ea2, hva2, ca2⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a x.a hx.1 hx.1
  obtain ⟨a, ea, hva, ca⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_sub_mod a2 x.b ca2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b2, eb2, hvb2, cb2⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.b x.b hx.2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b, eb, hvb, cb⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a b2 hx.1 cb2
  have hda2 : decodeM a2 = decodeM x.a + decodeM x.a := by
    change (a2.val : M) = (x.a.val : M) + (x.a.val : M)
    rw [hva2, cast_mod]
    simp [decodeM]
  have hda : decodeM a = decodeM a2 - decodeM x.b := by
    change (a.val : M) = (a2.val : M) - (x.b.val : M)
    rw [hva]
    exact cast_sub_wrap a2.val x.b.val hx.2
  have hdb2 : decodeM b2 = decodeM x.b + decodeM x.b := by
    change (b2.val : M) = (x.b.val : M) + (x.b.val : M)
    rw [hvb2, cast_mod]
    simp [decodeM]
  have hdb : decodeM b = decodeM x.a + decodeM b2 := by
    change (b.val : M) = (x.a.val : M) + (b2.val : M)
    rw [hvb, cast_mod]
    simp [decodeM]
  refine ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ?_, ⟨ca, cb⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [field.mul_by_r, field.M31.double, ea2, ea, eb2, eb, bind_tc_ok]
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change decodeM a = _
      rw [hda, hda2]
      simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul, decodeCM, qm31R]
      ring
    · change decodeM b = _
      rw [hdb, hdb2]
      simp [QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul, decodeCM, qm31R]
      ring

#print axioms mul_by_r_decode

      commit sumRow channel mutBack updated) := by
  simp [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelGeneratedStep.generatedChannelUpdate,
    commit, bind_assoc_eq]

/-- Exact execution of one generated channel-loop body, parameterized only by
its checked array reads. The later traversal theorem discharges these reads
from the fixed-size arrays and the iterator's channel index. -/
theorem runStep_success
    (left : PreparedArray) (sums : Sums) (index : Std.Usize)
    (right : ComponentArray) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (pqm : field.PreparedQm31Multiplier)
    (leftRow rightRow : Array field.M31 3#usize)
    (leftWord rightWord : field.M31)
    (sumRow : Array U64 3#usize) (acc : U64)
    (mutBack : Array U64 3#usize → Sums)
    (hleft0 : Array.index_usize left index = .ok pqm)
    (hleft1 : Array.index_usize pqm.components component = .ok leftRow)
    (hleft2 : Array.index_usize leftRow channel = .ok leftWord)
    (hright0 : Array.index_usize right component = .ok rightRow)
    (hright1 : Array.index_usize rightRow channel = .ok rightWord)
    (hsums0 : Array.index_usize sums component = .ok sumRow)
    (hsums1 : Array.index_usize sumRow channel = .ok acc)
    (hmut : Array.index_mut_usize sums component = .ok (sumRow, mutBack))
    (hleftCanonical : leftWord.val < P) (hrightCanonical : rightWord.val < P)
    (hacc : acc.val ≤ 2 * (P - 1) ^ 2)
    (hchannel : channel.val < 3) :
    ∃ updated : U64, ∃ out : Sums,
      AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelGeneratedStep.generatedChannelUpdate leftWord rightWord acc = .ok updated ∧
      AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelLoopStep.runStep left sums index right component channel = .ok out ∧
      updated.val = acc.val + leftWord.val * rightWord.val ∧
      out = mutBack (sumRow.set channel updated) := by
  obtain ⟨updated, hupd, hvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelGeneratedStep.generatedChannelUpdate_success
      leftWord rightWord acc hleftCanonical hrightCanonical hacc
  have hgen : (do
      let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 leftWord)
      let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 rightWord)
      let i2 ← i * i1
      acc + i2) = .ok updated := by
    change AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelGeneratedStep.generatedChannelUpdate
      leftWord rightWord acc = .ok updated at hupd
    simpa [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelGeneratedStep.generatedChannelUpdate] using hupd
  have harray : ∃ rowOut : Array U64 3#usize,
      Array.update sumRow channel updated = .ok rowOut ∧
      rowOut = sumRow.set channel updated := by
    apply WP.spec_imp_exists
    apply Array.update_spec
    simpa [sumRow.property] using hchannel
  obtain ⟨rowOut, harrayRun, harraySet⟩ := harray
  refine ⟨updated, mutBack rowOut, hupd, ?_, hvalue, ?_⟩
  · rw [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelLoopStep.runStep]
    simp only [hleft0, hleft1, hleft2, hright0, hright1, hsums0, hsums1, hmut, bind_tc_ok]
    change (do
      let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 leftWord)
      let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U64 rightWord)
      let i2 ← i * i1
      let updated ← acc + i2
      commit sumRow channel mutBack updated) = .ok (mutBack rowOut)
    rw [inlineScalar_bind, hupd]
    simp [commit, harrayRun]

  · rw [harraySet]

#print axioms runStep_success
end AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelRunStepExact

namespace AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelNestedSet

abbrev U64 := UScalar UScalarTy.U64

open AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelArraySet

theorem cell_nested_set (a : Sums) (component channel c j : Usize)
    (row : Array U64 3#usize) (updated : U64)
    (hcomp : component.val < 3) (hchannel : channel.val < 3)
    (hc : c.val < 3) (hj : j.val < 3)
    (hrow : row = at3 a component hcomp) :
    at3 (at3 (a.set component (row.set channel updated)) c hc) j hj =
      if c.val = component.val then
        if j.val = channel.val then updated else at3 (at3 a component hcomp) j hj
      else at3 (at3 a c hc) j hj := by
  have houterSet := at3_set a component c (row.set channel updated) hcomp hc
  rw [houterSet]
  by_cases houter : c.val = component.val
  · simp only [if_pos houter]
    have hinnerSet := at3_set row channel j updated hchannel hj
    rw [hinnerSet]
    by_cases hinner : j.val = channel.val
    · simp only [if_pos hinner]
    · simp only [if_neg hinner, hrow]
  · simp only [if_neg houter]

import AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelNestedSet

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelUpdateInvariantV2
open Aeneas.Std
abbrev U64 := UScalar UScalarTy.U64
abbrev at3 {α : Type} (a : Array α 3#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 3) : α :=
  AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelArraySet.at3 a i hi

abbrev Sums := Array (Array U64 3#usize) 3#usize

def sumCell (sums : Sums) (component channel : Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : U64 :=
  at3 (at3 sums component hc) channel hch

def updateComponent (sums : Sums) (component channel : Usize)
    (updated : U64) (hc : component.val < 3) : Sums :=
  sums.set component ((at3 sums component hc).set channel updated)

/-- The nested setter changes exactly the current cell. This pure invariant
step is independent of the generated iterator and is used by its fuel proof. -/
theorem update_invariants
    (sums initial : Sums) (component channel : Usize) (updated : U64)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hchannel : channel.val < 3)
    (product : (ch : Usize) → ch.val < 3 → Nat)
    (hcurrent : sumCell sums component channel hc hchannel =
      sumCell initial component channel hc hchannel)
    (hupdated : updated.val = (sumCell sums component channel hc hchannel).val + product channel hchannel)
    (hprocessed : ∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3), ch.val < channel.val →
      (sumCell sums component ch hc hch).val =
        (sumCell initial component ch hc hch).val + product ch hch)
    (hremaining : ∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3), channel.val ≤ ch.val →
      sumCell sums component ch hc hch = sumCell initial component ch hc hch)
    (hframe : ∀ (c : Usize) (hcc : c.val < 3), c.val ≠ component.val →
      ∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3),
        sumCell sums c ch hcc hch = sumCell initial c ch hcc hch) :
    (∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3), ch.val < channel.val + 1 →
      (sumCell (updateComponent sums component channel updated hc)
        component ch hc hch).val =
        (sumCell initial component ch hc hch).val + product ch hch) ∧
    (∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3), channel.val + 1 ≤ ch.val →
      sumCell (updateComponent sums component channel updated hc)
        component ch hc hch = sumCell initial component ch hc hch) ∧
    (∀ (c : Usize) (hcc : c.val < 3), c.val ≠ component.val →
      ∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3),
        sumCell (updateComponent sums component channel updated hc)
          c ch hcc hch = sumCell initial c ch hcc hch) := by
  have hselected : ∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3),
      sumCell (updateComponent sums component channel updated hc) component ch hc hch =
        if ch.val = channel.val then updated else sumCell sums component ch hc hch := by
    intro ch hch
    have hnest := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelNestedSet.cell_nested_set
      sums component channel component ch (at3 sums component hc) updated
      hc hchannel hc hch rfl
    simpa [sumCell, updateComponent] using hnest
  have hother : ∀ (c : Usize) (hcc : c.val < 3), c.val ≠ component.val →
      ∀ (ch : Usize) (hch : ch.val < 3),
        sumCell (updateComponent sums component channel updated hc) c ch hcc hch =
          sumCell sums c ch hcc hch := by
    intro c hcc hne ch hch
    have hnest := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelNestedSet.cell_nested_set
      sums component channel c ch (at3 sums component hc) updated
      hc hchannel hcc hch rfl
    simpa [sumCell, updateComponent, hne] using hnest
  constructor
  · intro ch hch hbound
    by_cases heq : ch.val = channel.val
    · have hchEq : ch = channel := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq heq
      subst ch
      have hsame := hselected channel hchannel
      rw [if_pos rfl] at hsame
      calc
        (sumCell (updateComponent sums component channel updated hc) component channel hc hchannel).val = updated.val :=
          congrArg (fun x : U64 => x.val) hsame
        _ = (sumCell sums component channel hc hchannel).val + product channel hchannel := hupdated
        _ = (sumCell initial component channel hc hchannel).val + product channel hchannel := by rw [hcurrent]
    · have hbefore : ch.val < channel.val := by omega
      rw [hselected, if_neg heq]
      exact hprocessed ch hch hbefore
  · constructor
    · intro ch hch hbound
      have hne : ch.val ≠ channel.val := by omega
      rw [hselected, if_neg hne]
      exact hremaining ch hch (by omega)
    · intro c hcc hne ch hch
      rw [hother c hcc hne ch hch]
      exact hframe c hcc hne ch hch

#print axioms update_invariants
end AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelUpdateInvariantV2

AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBoun:
import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedIndexComponentsCanonical

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev P : Nat := 2147483647
abbrev Q : Nat := (P - 1) ^ 2
abbrev PreparedArray := Array field.PreparedQm31Multiplier 3#usize
abbrev Components := Array (Array field.M31 3#usize) 3#usize

def uFin (i : Fin 3) : Std.Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)

theorem uFin_val (i : Fin 3) : (uFin i).val = i.val := by
  exact UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq (by scalar_tac)

private def at3 {α : Type} (a : Array α 3#usize) (i : Std.Usize) (hi : i.val < 3) : α :=
  AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelRunStepLocal.at3 a i hi

private def leftCell (left : PreparedArray) (index component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hi : index.val < 3) (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : field.M31 :=
  at3 (at3 (at3 left index hi).components component hc) channel hch

private def tableCell (table : Components) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : field.M31 :=
  at3 (at3 table component hc) channel hch

def product (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (index : Fin 3) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : Nat :=
  (leftCell left (uFin index) component channel (by rw [uFin_val]; exact index.isLt) hc hch).val *
    (tableCell (tables index) component channel hc hch).val

def prefixProduct (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (count : Nat) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : Nat :=
  Nat.rec 0
    (fun n acc => acc + product left tables ⟨n % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ component channel hc hch)
    count

theorem product_le (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (hleft : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (c ch : Std.Usize) (hc : c.val < 3) (hch : ch.val < 3),
      (leftCell left (uFin i) c ch (by rw [uFin_val]; exact i.isLt) hc hch).val < P)
    (htable : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (c ch : Std.Usize) (hc : c.val < 3) (hch : ch.val < 3),
      (tableCell (tables i) c ch hc hch).val < P)
    (i : Fin 3) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) :
    product left tables i component channel hc hch ≤ Q := by
  unfold product
  have hl := hleft i component channel hc hch
  have hr := htable i component channel hc hch
  have hl' : (leftCell left (uFin i) component channel
      (by rw [uFin_val]; exact i.isLt) hc hch).val ≤ P - 1 := by omega
  have hr' : (tableCell (tables i) component channel hc hch).val ≤ P - 1 := by omega
  have hmul := Nat.mul_le_mul hl' hr'
  nlinarith [hmul]

theorem prefixProduct_succ (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (count : Nat) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) :
    prefixProduct left tables (count + 1) component channel hc hch =
      prefixProduct left tables count component channel hc hch +
        product left tables ⟨count % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ component channel hc hch := by
  simp [prefixProduct]

theorem prefixProduct_le (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (hleft : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (c ch : Std.Usize) (hc : c.val < 3) (hch : ch.val < 3),
      (leftCell left (uFin i) c ch (by rw [uFin_val]; exact i.isLt) hc hch).val < P)
    (htable : ∀ (i : Fin 3) (c ch : Std.Usize) (hc : c.val < 3) (hch : ch.val < 3),
      (tableCell (tables i) c ch hc hch).val < P)
    (count : Nat) (component channel : Std.Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) :
    prefixProduct left tables count component channel hc hch ≤ count * Q := by
  induction count with
  | zero => simp [prefixProduct]
  | succ n ih =>
      have hp := product_le left tables hleft htable
        ⟨n % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ component channel hc hch
      calc
        prefixProduct left tables (n + 1) component channel hc hch =
            prefixProduct left tables n component channel hc hch +
              product left tables ⟨n % 3, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩ component channel hc hch :=
          prefixProduct_succ left tables n component channel hc hch
        _ ≤ n * Q + Q := Nat.add_le_add ih hp
        _ = (n + 1) * Q := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]

#print axioms product_le
#print axioms prefixProduct_succ
#print axioms prefixProduct_le
end AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds

private theorem component_cell_canonical (a : Component) (x : CM)

    subst ch
