    subst ch
    simpa [at3, heq, Array.make] using hscan

theorem prepared_cells_canonical (p : Prepared) (x : QM)
    (hx : CanonicalQM x) (hp : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor p x) :
    ∀ (c ch : Usize) (hc : c.val < 3) (hch : ch.val < 3),
      (at3 (at3 p.components c hc) ch hch).val < P := by
  rcases hp with ⟨t,a,b,d,ht,htcan,ha,hb,hd,hcomponents⟩
  intro c ch hc hch
  have hcases : c.val = 0 ∨ c.val = 1 ∨ c.val = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with h0 | h1 | h2
  · have hc' : c = 0#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h0
    subst c
    simpa [at3, hcomponents, Array.make] using
      component_cell_canonical a x.c0 hx.1 ha ch hch
  · have hc' : c = 1#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h1
    subst c
    simpa [at3, hcomponents, Array.make] using
      component_cell_canonical b x.c1 hx.2 hb ch hch
  · have hc' : c = 2#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq h2
    subst c
    simpa [at3, hcomponents, Array.make] using
      component_cell_canonical d t htcan hd ch hch

#print axioms prepared_cells_canonical
end AspisR1PoseidonPreparedStateCells
AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCells:
import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast
import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedLeftCellValues
import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedTableCellValues
import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedSum3DecodedWithBuild
import ExtractedMaskPreparedState

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCells
open Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev M := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact
abbrev CMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev PreparedArray := Array Prepared 3#usize
abbrev RightArray := Array QM 3#usize
abbrev Components := Array (Array field.M31 3#usize) 3#usize
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM

private def leftAt (left : PreparedArray) (i : Fin 3) : Prepared :=
  left.val[(AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i).val]'(by
    have hu := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val i
    simpa [left.property, hu] using i.isLt)

private def rightAt (right : RightArray) (i : Fin 3) : QM :=
  right.val[(AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i).val]'(by
    have hu := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val i
    simpa [right.property, hu] using i.isLt)

private def at3 {α : Type} (a : Array α 3#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 3) : α :=
  AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelRunStepLocal.at3 a i hi

private def leftCell (left : PreparedArray) (index component channel : Usize)
    (hi : index.val < 3) (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : field.M31 :=
  at3 (at3 (at3 left index hi).components component hc) channel hch

private def tableCell (table : Components) (component channel : Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : field.M31 :=
  at3 (at3 table component hc) channel hch

def rightBuilder (q : QM) : Result Components := do
  let rightSum ← field.CM31.add q.c0 q.c1
  let m0 ← field.M31.add q.c0.a q.c0.b
  let m1 ← field.M31.add q.c1.a q.c1.b
  let m2 ← field.M31.add rightSum.a rightSum.b
  ok (Array.make 3#usize [
    (Array.make 3#usize [q.c0.a,q.c0.b,m0] : Array field.M31 3#usize),
    (Array.make 3#usize [q.c1.a,q.c1.b,m1] : Array field.M31 3#usize),
    (Array.make 3#usize [rightSum.a,rightSum.b,m2] : Array field.M31 3#usize)] : Components)

theorem product_cells (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (right : RightArray) (i : Fin 3) (x : QM)
    (hprepared : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor (leftAt left i) x)
    (hx : CanonicalQM x)
    (hq : CanonicalQM (rightAt right i))
    (hbuild : rightBuilder (rightAt right i) = .ok (tables i)) :
    let u := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i
    let p := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product
    ((p left tables i 0#usize 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c0.a.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 0#usize 1#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c0.b.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c0.b.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 0#usize 2#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c0.a.val : M) + (x.c0.b.val : M)) *
        ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val + (rightAt right i).c0.b.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 1#usize 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c1.a.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c1.a.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 1#usize 1#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c1.b.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 1#usize 2#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c1.a.val : M) + (x.c1.b.val : M)) *
        ((rightAt right i).c1.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 2#usize 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c0.a.val : M) + (x.c1.a.val : M)) *
        ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.a.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 2#usize 1#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c0.b.val : M) + (x.c1.b.val : M)) *
        ((rightAt right i).c0.b.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) ∧
    ((p left tables i 2#usize 2#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (((x.c0.a.val : M) + (x.c0.b.val : M)) +
        (x.c1.a.val : M) + (x.c1.b.val : M)) *
      (((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) + (rightAt right i).c0.b.val +
        (rightAt right i).c1.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val) := by
  dsimp
  obtain ⟨t,s0,s1,s2,hsum,l00,l01,l02,l10,l11,l12,l20,l21,l22,hs0,hs1,hs2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedLeftCellValues.left_cells left i x hprepared
  obtain ⟨rs,m0,m1,m2,hrsum,hm0,hm1,hm2,r00,r01,r02,r10,r11,r12,r20,r21,r22⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedTableCellValues.table_cells (rightAt right i) hq (tables i) hbuild
  have hs0' : (s0.val : M) = (x.c0.a.val : M) + (x.c0.b.val : M) := by
    rw [hs0, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_add]
  have hs1' : (s1.val : M) = (x.c1.a.val : M) + (x.c1.b.val : M) := by
    rw [hs1, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_add]
  have hs2' : (s2.val : M) = (t.a.val : M) + (t.b.val : M) := by
    rw [hs2, ZMod.natCast_mod, Nat.cast_add]
  have hr0' : (m0.val : M) = ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) + ((rightAt right i).c0.b.val : M) := by
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hvval⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.m31_add_decode
      (rightAt right i).c0.a (rightAt right i).c0.b hq.1.1 hq.1.2
    have heq : v = m0 := Result.ok.inj (hv.symm.trans hm0)
    rw [← heq]
    exact hvval
  have hr1' : (m1.val : M) = ((rightAt right i).c1.a.val : M) + ((rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) := by
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hvval⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.m31_add_decode
      (rightAt right i).c1.a (rightAt right i).c1.b hq.2.1 hq.2.2
    have heq : v = m1 := Result.ok.inj (hv.symm.trans hm1)
    rw [← heq]
    exact hvval
  obtain ⟨t'', ht'', htval⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.cm_add_decode
    x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  have htEq' : t'' = t := Result.ok.inj (ht''.symm.trans hsum)
  have htDecode : AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.decodeCM t =
      AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.decodeCM x.c0 +
        AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.decodeCM x.c1 := by
    rw [← htEq']
    exact htval
  have htA : (t.a.val : M) = (x.c0.a.val : M) + (x.c1.a.val : M) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : CMExact => z.re) htDecode
    exact h
  have htB : (t.b.val : M) = (x.c0.b.val : M) + (x.c1.b.val : M) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : CMExact => z.im) htDecode
    exact h
  obtain ⟨rs',hrs',hrscan,_,_⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.current_cm_add_mod
    (rightAt right i).c0 (rightAt right i).c1 hq.1 hq.2
  have hrsEq : rs' = rs := Result.ok.inj (hrs'.symm.trans hrsum)
  have hrsCan : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalCM rs := by
    simpa [hrsEq] using hrscan
  have hrsDecode : AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.decodeCM rs =
      AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.decodeCM (rightAt right i).c0 +
        AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.decodeCM (rightAt right i).c1 := by
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hvval⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.cm_add_decode
      (rightAt right i).c0 (rightAt right i).c1 hq.1 hq.2
    have heq : v = rs := Result.ok.inj (hv.symm.trans hrsum)
    rw [← heq]
    exact hvval
  have hrsA : (rs.a.val : M) = ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) + ((rightAt right i).c1.a.val : M) := by
    exact congrArg (fun z : CMExact => z.re) hrsDecode
  have hrsB : (rs.b.val : M) = ((rightAt right i).c0.b.val : M) + ((rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) := by
    exact congrArg (fun z : CMExact => z.im) hrsDecode
  have hr2' : (m2.val : M) = (rs.a.val : M) + (rs.b.val : M) := by
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hvval⟩ := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedFieldArithmetic.m31_add_decode
      rs.a rs.b hrsCan.1 hrsCan.2
    have heq : v = m2 := Result.ok.inj (hv.symm.trans hm2)
    rw [← heq]
    exact hvval
  have hleftTotal : (s2.val : M) =
      ((x.c0.a.val : M) + x.c0.b.val) + x.c1.a.val + x.c1.b.val := by
    rw [hs2', htA, htB]
    ring
  have hrightTotal : (m2.val : M) =
      (((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) + (rightAt right i).c0.b.val) +
        (rightAt right i).c1.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val := by
    rw [hr2', hrsA, hrsB]
    ring
  have hp00 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 0#usize 0#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c0.a.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) := by
    apply AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
    · change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 0#usize 0#usize _ _ _ = _
      exact l00
    · change tableCell (tables i) 0#usize 0#usize _ _ = _
      exact r00
  have hp01 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 0#usize 1#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c0.b.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c0.b.val : M) := by
    apply AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
    · change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 0#usize 1#usize _ _ _ = _
      exact l01
    · change tableCell (tables i) 0#usize 1#usize _ _ = _
      exact r01
  have hp02 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 0#usize 2#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c0.a.val : M) + x.c0.b.val) *
        ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val + (rightAt right i).c0.b.val : M) := by
    calc
      _ = (s0.val : M) * (m0.val : M) := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
        left tables i 0#usize 2#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) s0 m0
        (by change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 0#usize 2#usize _ _ _ = _; exact l02)
        (by change tableCell (tables i) 0#usize 2#usize _ _ = _; exact r02)
      _ = _ := by rw [hs0', hr0']
  have hp10 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 1#usize 0#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c1.a.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c1.a.val : M) := by
    apply AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
    · change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 1#usize 0#usize _ _ _ = _
      exact l10
    · change tableCell (tables i) 1#usize 0#usize _ _ = _
      exact r10
  have hp11 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 1#usize 1#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (x.c1.b.val : M) * ((rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) := by
    apply AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
    · change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 1#usize 1#usize _ _ _ = _
      exact l11
    · change tableCell (tables i) 1#usize 1#usize _ _ = _
      exact r11
  have hp12 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 1#usize 2#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c1.a.val : M) + x.c1.b.val) *
        ((rightAt right i).c1.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) := by
    calc
      _ = (s1.val : M) * (m1.val : M) := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
        left tables i 1#usize 2#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) s1 m1
        (by change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 1#usize 2#usize _ _ _ = _; exact l12)
        (by change tableCell (tables i) 1#usize 2#usize _ _ = _; exact r12)
      _ = _ := by rw [hs1', hr1']
  have hp20 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 2#usize 0#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c0.a.val : M) + x.c1.a.val) *
        ((rightAt right i).c0.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.a.val : M) := by
    calc
      _ = (t.a.val : M) * (rs.a.val : M) := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
        left tables i 2#usize 0#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) t.a rs.a
        (by change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 2#usize 0#usize _ _ _ = _; exact l20)
        (by change tableCell (tables i) 2#usize 0#usize _ _ = _; exact r20)
      _ = _ := by rw [htA, hrsA]
  have hp21 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 2#usize 1#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      ((x.c0.b.val : M) + x.c1.b.val) *
        ((rightAt right i).c0.b.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val : M) := by
    calc
      _ = (t.b.val : M) * (rs.b.val : M) := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
        left tables i 2#usize 1#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) t.b rs.b
        (by change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 2#usize 1#usize _ _ _ = _; exact l21)
        (by change tableCell (tables i) 2#usize 1#usize _ _ = _; exact r21)
      _ = _ := by rw [htB, hrsB]
  have hp22 : ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i 2#usize 2#usize
      (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) : Nat) : M) =
      (((x.c0.a.val : M) + x.c0.b.val) + x.c1.a.val + x.c1.b.val) *
      (((rightAt right i).c0.a.val : M) + (rightAt right i).c0.b.val +
        (rightAt right i).c1.a.val + (rightAt right i).c1.b.val) := by
    calc
      _ = (s2.val : M) * (m2.val : M) := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast.product_cast_eq
        left tables i 2#usize 2#usize (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) s2 m2
        (by change leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 2#usize 2#usize _ _ _ = _; exact l22)
        (by change tableCell (tables i) 2#usize 2#usize _ _ = _; exact r22)
      _ = _ := by rw [hleftTotal, hrightTotal]
  exact ⟨hp00,hp01,hp02,hp10,hp11,hp12,hp20,hp21,hp22⟩

#print axioms product_cells
end AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCells

import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast
open Aeneas.Std AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev M := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact
abbrev PreparedArray := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.PreparedArray
abbrev Components := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.Components
abbrev M31 := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.M31

private def at3 {α : Type} (a : Array α 3#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 3) : α :=
  AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelRunStepLocal.at3 a i hi

private def leftCell (left : PreparedArray) (index component channel : Usize)
    (hi : index.val < 3) (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : M31 :=
  at3 (at3 (at3 left index hi).components component hc) channel hch

private def tableCell (table : Components) (component channel : Usize)
    (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : M31 :=
  at3 (at3 table component hc) channel hch

 theorem product_cast_eq (left : PreparedArray) (tables : Fin 3 → Components)
    (i : Fin 3) (c ch : Usize) (hc : c.val < 3) (hch : ch.val < 3)
    (a b : M31)
    (hleft : leftCell left
      (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) c ch
      (by rw [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val]; exact i.isLt) hc hch = a)
    (hright : tableCell (tables i) c ch hc hch = b) :
    ((AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product left tables i c ch hc hch : Nat) : M) =
      (a.val : M) * (b.val : M) := by
  unfold AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.product
  rw [Nat.cast_mul]
  change ((leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) c ch
      (by rw [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val]; exact i.isLt) hc hch).val *
    (tableCell (tables i) c ch hc hch).val : M) = (a.val : M) * (b.val : M)
  rw [hleft, hright]

#print axioms product_cast_eq
end AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedProductCast

import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedInputCellValues
import AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelArraySpecs
import AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedLeftCellValues
open Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev PreparedArray := Array Prepared 3#usize
abbrev M31 := field.M31

private def at3 {α : Type} (a : Array α 3#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 3) : α :=
  AspisR1PoseidonPreparedChannelRunStepLocal.at3 a i hi

private def leftCell (left : PreparedArray) (index component channel : Usize)
    (hi : index.val < 3) (hc : component.val < 3) (hch : channel.val < 3) : M31 :=
  at3 (at3 (at3 left index hi).components component hc) channel hch

private def leftAt (left : PreparedArray) (i : Fin 3) : Prepared :=
  left.val[(AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i).val]'(by
    have hu := AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val i
    simpa [left.property, hu] using i.isLt)

theorem left_cells (left : PreparedArray) (i : Fin 3) (x : QM)
    (hprepared : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor (leftAt left i) x) :
    ∃ t s0 s1 s2,
      field.CM31.add x.c0 x.c1 = .ok t ∧
      leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 0#usize 0#usize
        (by rw [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val]; exact i.isLt)
        (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) = x.c0.a ∧
      leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 0#usize 1#usize
        (by rw [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val]; exact i.isLt)
        (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) = x.c0.b ∧
      leftCell left (AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin i) 0#usize 2#usize
        (by rw [AspisR1PoseidonPreparedIndexProductBounds.uFin_val]; exact i.isLt)

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedConverterDecodedProducts
open Aeneas.Std AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev M := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact
abbrev CMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact
abbrev QMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

private def rowModel := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedChannelRowValue.rowModel
private def decodeQM := AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedKaratsubaValue.decodeQM

theorem converter_decoded_products (out : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31)
    (r00 r01 r02 r10 r11 r12 r20 r21 r22 : U64)
    (x0 x1 x2 y0 y1 y2 : QMExact)
    (hdecoded : decodeQM out =
      ⟨rowModel r00 r01 r02 + (⟨2,1⟩ : CMExact) * rowModel r10 r11 r12,
        rowModel r20 r21 r22 - rowModel r00 r01 r02 - rowModel r10 r11 r12⟩)
    (h0 : rowModel r00 r01 r02 = x0.re*y0.re + x1.re*y1.re + x2.re*y2.re)
    (h1 : rowModel r10 r11 r12 = x0.im*y0.im + x1.im*y1.im + x2.im*y2.im)
    (h2 : rowModel r20 r21 r22 = (x0.re+x0.im)*(y0.re+y0.im) +
      (x1.re+x1.im)*(y1.re+y1.im) + (x2.re+x2.im)*(y2.re+y2.im)) :
    decodeQM out = x0*y0 + x1*y1 + x2*y2 := by
  rw [hdecoded, h0, h1, h2]
  have hR : (⟨2,1⟩ : CMExact) = AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.qm31R := by rfl
  rw [hR]
  exact AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedSum3ProductAlgebra.sum3_qm_products
    x0.re x0.im x1.re x1.im x2.re x2.im
    y0.re y0.im y1.re y1.im y2.re y2.im

#print axioms converter_decoded_products

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedSum3ProductAlgebra
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev CMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact
abbrev QMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

private theorem qm_re_mul (x y : QMExact) :
    (x * y).re = x.re * y.re + qm31R * (x.im * y.im) := by
  calc
    (x * y).re = x.re * y.re + qm31R * x.im * y.im := QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul x y
    _ = x.re * y.re + qm31R * (x.im * y.im) := by ring

private theorem qm_im_mul (x y : QMExact) :
    (x * y).im = x.re * y.im + x.im * y.re + 0 * (x.im * y.im) := by
  simpa [QMExact] using (QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul x y)

theorem sum3_qm_products (x00 x01 x10 x11 x20 x21 y00 y01 y10 y11 y20 y21 : CMExact) :
    (⟨x00*y00 + x10*y10 + x20*y20 +
          qm31R * (x01*y01 + x11*y11 + x21*y21),
      (x00+x01)*(y00+y01) + (x10+x11)*(y10+y11) + (x20+x21)*(y20+y21) -
          (x00*y00 + x10*y10 + x20*y20) - (x01*y01 + x11*y11 + x21*y21)⟩ : QMExact) =
      (⟨x00,x01⟩ : QMExact) * ⟨y00,y01⟩ +
      (⟨x10,x11⟩ : QMExact) * ⟨y10,y11⟩ +
      (⟨x20,x21⟩ : QMExact) * ⟨y20,y21⟩ := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_add, qm_re_mul]
    ring
  · simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.im_add, qm_im_mul]
    ring

#print axioms sum3_qm_products
end AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedSum3ProductAlgebra

private theorem qm_im_mul (x y : QMExact) :
    (x * y).im = x.re * y.im + x.im * y.re + 0 * (x.im * y.im) := by
  simpa [QMExact] using (QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul x y)

abbrev CMExact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact

/-- The Karatsuba row decoder is exactly multiplication in the quadratic
extension when its three channels are the two diagonal products and their
pairwise-sum product. -/
theorem rowModel_mul (a b c d : M) (r0 r1 r2 : U64)
    (h0 : (r0.val : M) = a * c)
    (h1 : (r1.val : M) = b * d)
    (h2 : (r2.val : M) = (a + b) * (c + d)) :
    AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedChannelRowValue.rowModel r0 r1 r2 =
      (⟨a * c - b * d, a * d + b * c⟩ : CMExact) := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · change (r0.val : M) - (r1.val : M) = a * c - b * d
    rw [h0, h1]
  · change (r2.val : M) - (r0.val : M) - (r1.val : M) = a * d + b * c
    rw [h2, h0, h1]
    ring

#print axioms rowModel_mul
end AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedChannelRowProduct

    (a0 b0 a1 b1 a2 b2 c0 d0 c1 d1 c2 d2 : M)
    (h0 : (r0.val : M) = a0*c0 + a1*c1 + a2*c2)
    (h1 : (r1.val : M) = b0*d0 + b1*d1 + b2*d2)
    (h2 : (r2.val : M) = (a0+b0)*(c0+d0) + (a1+b1)*(c1+d1) +
      (a2+b2)*(c2+d2)) :
    AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedChannelRowValue.rowModel r0 r1 r2 =
      (⟨a0,b0⟩ : CMExact) * ⟨c0,d0⟩ +
      (⟨a1,b1⟩ : CMExact) * ⟨c1,d1⟩ +
      (⟨a2,b2⟩ : CMExact) * ⟨c2,d2⟩ := by

    AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedChannelRowValue.rowModel r0 r1 r2 =
        (⟨a0*c0-b0*d0, (a0+b0)*(c0+d0)-a0*c0-b0*d0⟩ : CMExact) +
        ⟨a1*c1-b1*d1, (a1+b1)*(c1+d1)-a1*c1-b1*d1⟩ +
        ⟨a2*c2-b2*d2, (a2+b2)*(c2+d2)-a2*c2-b2*d2⟩ := by

        (r2.val : M) - (r0.val : M) - (r1.val : M)⟩ : CMExact) = _
      rw [h0, h1, h2]
      exact AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedRowSumAlgebra.rowModel_sum3
        (a0*c0) (a1*c1) (a2*c2) (b0*d0) (b1*d1) (b2*d2)
        ((a0+b0)*(c0+d0)) ((a1+b1)*(c1+d1)) ((a2+b2)*(c2+d2))
    _ = _ := by
      rw [AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedKaratsubaRowAlgebra.karatsuba_row_mul,
        AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedKaratsubaRowAlgebra.karatsuba_row_mul,
        AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedKaratsubaRowAlgebra.karatsuba_row_mul]

import ExtractedMaskPreparedState

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedStateUnique
open Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev CM := field.CM31
abbrev M31 := field.M31
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev Component := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.Component
abbrev ComponentFor := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.ComponentFor
abbrev PreparedFor := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor

private theorem componentFor_coords (a : Component) (x : CM)
    (h : ComponentFor a x) : a.val[0]'(by scalar_tac) = x.a ∧ a.val[1]'(by scalar_tac) = x.b := by
  rcases h with ⟨s, ha, _, _⟩
  constructor
  · have h0 := congrArg (fun z : Component => z.val[0]'(by scalar_tac)) ha
    simpa [Array.make] using h0
  · have h1 := congrArg (fun z : Component => z.val[1]'(by scalar_tac)) ha
    simpa [Array.make] using h1

theorem preparedFor_unique (p : Prepared) (x y : QM)
    (hx : PreparedFor p x) (hy : PreparedFor p y) : x = y := by
  rcases hx with ⟨t,a,b,c, ht, htc, hpa,hpb,hpc,harr⟩
  rcases hy with ⟨t',a',b',c', ht', htc', hpa',hpb',hpc',harr'⟩
  have houter : Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c] = Array.make 3#usize [a',b',c'] :=
    harr.symm.trans harr'
  have ha : a = a' := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : Array Component 3#usize => z.val[0]'(by scalar_tac)) houter
    simpa [Array.make] using h
  have hb : b = b' := by
    have h := congrArg (fun z : Array Component 3#usize => z.val[1]'(by scalar_tac)) houter
    simpa [Array.make] using h
  have h0 := componentFor_coords a x.c0 hpa
  have h0' := componentFor_coords a' y.c0 hpa'
  have h1 := componentFor_coords b x.c1 hpb
  have h1' := componentFor_coords b' y.c1 hpb'
  have hxa : x.c0.a = y.c0.a := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : Component => z.val[0]'(by scalar_tac)) ha
    exact h0.1.symm.trans (this.trans h0'.1)
  have hxb : x.c0.b = y.c0.b := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : Component => z.val[1]'(by scalar_tac)) ha
    exact h0.2.symm.trans (this.trans h0'.2)
  have hya : x.c1.a = y.c1.a := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : Component => z.val[0]'(by scalar_tac)) hb
    exact h1.1.symm.trans (this.trans h1'.1)
  have hyb : x.c1.b = y.c1.b := by
    have := congrArg (fun z : Component => z.val[1]'(by scalar_tac)) hb
    exact h1.2.symm.trans (this.trans h1'.2)
  cases x with
  | mk xc0 xc1 =>
    cases y with
    | mk yc0 yc1 =>
      simp only [field.QM31] at hxa hxb hya hyb
      cases xc0 with
      | mk xa xb =>
        cases yc0 with
        | mk ya yb =>
          cases xc1 with
          | mk xc xd =>
            cases yc1 with
            | mk yc yd =>
              simp_all

#print axioms preparedFor_unique
end AspisR1.PoseidonPreparedStateUnique

import AspisR1.PoseidonResidualPacking
import PoseidonResidualFieldTransport
import ExtractedMaskSemanticBridgeConcrete

/-! The already-checked selector/preparation/output dataflow computes the
retained R0P scalar residual, provided its three incoming round arrays have
their specified models. These premises name the remaining caller boundary;
no source success or packing injectivity is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointResidualModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SumHighInnerLoop
abbrev Exact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev State := Array field.QM31 16#usize
abbrev Packed := Array field.QM31 4#usize
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
abbrev lane := AspisR1.PoseidonResidualPacking.lane
abbrev iBasis := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.iBasis
abbrev uBasis := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.uBasis

def decodedState (state : State) : Fin 16 → Exact := fun j =>
  Decode (state.val[j.val]'(by simpa [state.property] using j.isLt))
def decodedOpenings (o : Openings) : R0P.Openings Exact :=
  ⟨decodedState o.z,decodedState o.succ_z,decodedState o.xor12_z⟩

theorem packedGroup_eq (state : State) (group : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.packedGroup state group =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun j => decodedState state (lane group j)) := by
  rfl

theorem scalar_group_pack {K : Type} [Field K]
    (o : R0P.Openings K) (block i u : K) (low : Fin 16 → K) (group : Fin 4) :
    block *
      (low 0 * (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => o.succ (lane group j)) -
          R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => R0P.poseidonLeadingPair o.z o.xor12 (lane group j))) +
        AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow low *
          (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => o.succ (lane group j)) -
            R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low (lane group j))) +
        AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow low *
          (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => o.succ (lane group j)) -
            R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low (lane group j)))) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => R0P.poseidonScalarResidual o block low (lane group j)) := by
  simpa only [R0P.poseidonScalarResidual,
    AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow,
    AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow,zero_add] using
      AspisR1.PoseidonResidualPacking.weighted_pack i u block (low 0)
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow low)
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow low)
        (fun j => o.succ (lane group j))
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonLeadingPair o.z o.xor12 (lane group j))
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low (lane group j))
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low (lane group j))

theorem same_point_model_eq (o : Openings) (point : Array field.QM31 10#usize)
    (internalArray : State) (leading full : Packed)
    (hleading : ∀ g : Fin 4, Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 leading g) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun j =>
        R0P.poseidonLeadingPair (decodedOpenings o).z (decodedOpenings o).xor12 (lane g j)))
    (hfull : ∀ g : Fin 4, Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 full g) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun j =>
        R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair (decodedOpenings o).z
          (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) (lane g j)))
    (hinternal : ∀ j : Fin 16, decodedState internalArray j =
      R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair (decodedOpenings o).z
        (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) j)
    (group : Fin 4) :
    AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray.model o point internalArray leading full group =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula iBasis uBasis (fun j =>
        R0P.poseidonScalarResidual (decodedOpenings o)
          (R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 (by omega))
          (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) (lane group j)) := by
  have hint : decodedState internalArray =
      R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair (decodedOpenings o).z
        (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) := funext hinternal
  unfold AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray.model
  have hdecode : AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray.Decode = Decode := rfl
  have hselector : AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray.pointSelector = pointSelector := rfl
  rw [hdecode,hselector,hleading group,hfull group]
  simp only [packedGroup_eq,hint]
  have hsucc : decodedState o.succ_z = (decodedOpenings o).succ := rfl
  rw [hsucc]
  rw [← scalar_group_pack (K := Exact) (decodedOpenings o)
    (R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 (by omega)) iBasis uBasis
    (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) group]

#print axioms packedGroup_eq
#print axioms scalar_group_pack
#print axioms same_point_model_eq
end AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointResidualModel
AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray:
import AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact
import AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs

/-! Factored selector/preparation/output dataflow. The intervening source
leading/full/internal evaluations remain separate obligations. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SumHighInnerLoop
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev Decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev Exact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev PreparedFor := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

def at3 (a : Array QM 3#usize) (i : Fin 3) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)
def prepAt3 (a : Array Prepared 3#usize) (i : Fin 3) : Prepared :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)
def lowAt (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

def source (openings : Openings) (selectors : Selectors)
    (internalArray : Array QM 16#usize) (leading full : Array QM 4#usize) :
    Result (Array QM 4#usize) := do
  let (ops,weightsPrepared,blockPrepared) ← AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs.source selectors
  array_from_fn_copy 4#usize field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy
    AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.Callback field.QM31.ZERO
    (openings,internalArray,blockPrepared,weightsPrepared,leading,full)

def model (openings : Openings) (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (internalArray : Array QM 16#usize) (leading full : Array QM 4#usize) (i : Fin 4) : Exact :=
  R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 (by omega) *
    (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) 0 *
        (AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.packedGroup openings.succ_z i -
          Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 leading i)) +
      AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) *
        (AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.packedGroup openings.succ_z i -
          Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 full i)) +
      AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow (R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point)) *
        (AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.packedGroup openings.succ_z i -
          AspisR1.PoseidonGroupSliceModel.packedGroup internalArray i))

/-- All selector, low-weight, multiplier and pack-input equations are derived
from source calls on the same boxed point and actual arrays. -/
theorem source_success
    (openings : Openings) (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (internalArray : Array QM 16#usize) (leading full : Array QM 4#usize)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hsucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z) (hinternal : CanonicalArray internalArray)
    (hleading : CanonicalArray leading) (hfull : CanonicalArray full) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 4#usize, source openings selectors internalArray leading full = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧ ∀ i : Fin 4,
        Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 out i) =
          model openings point internalArray leading full i := by
  obtain ⟨ops,hops,hblockCan,hlocalCan,hlocals,hblockModel,hlowModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.boxed_success point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow,rawWeights,weightsPrepared,hweights,hraw,
    hleadingCan,hfullCan,hinternalCan,hp0,hp1,hp2,hleadingDec,hfullDec,hinternalDec⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonActualPreparedWeights.source_success ops.«local» hlocalCan
  subst rawWeights
  let weights : Array QM 3#usize := Array.make 3#usize [leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow]
  obtain ⟨blockPrepared,hblockNew,hblockPrepared⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.current_prepared_new ops.block hblockCan
  have hcanonWeights : ∀ i : Fin 3, Canonical (at3 weights i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;> simp [at3,weights,Array.make,hleadingCan,hfullCan,hinternalCan]
  change PreparedFor (prepAt3 weightsPrepared 0) leadingLow at hp0
  change PreparedFor (prepAt3 weightsPrepared 1) fullLow at hp1
  change PreparedFor (prepAt3 weightsPrepared 2) internalLow at hp2
  simp only [prepAt3,show (0 : Fin 3).val = 0 from rfl] at hp0
  simp only [prepAt3,show (1 : Fin 3).val = 1 from rfl] at hp1
  simp only [prepAt3,show (2 : Fin 3).val = 2 from rfl] at hp2
  have hpreparedWeights : ∀ i : Fin 3, PreparedFor (prepAt3 weightsPrepared i) (at3 weights i) := by
    intro i
    fin_cases i
    · simpa only [prepAt3,at3,weights,Array.make,List.getElem_cons_zero] using hp0
    · simpa only [prepAt3,at3,weights,Array.make,List.getElem_cons_succ,List.getElem_cons_zero] using hp1
    · simpa only [prepAt3,at3,weights,Array.make,List.getElem_cons_succ,List.getElem_cons_zero] using hp2
  have hleadingAll : ∀ (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4), Canonical
      (leading.val[i.val]'(by simpa [leading.property] using hi)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact hleading ⟨i.val,by simpa using hi⟩
  have hfullAll : ∀ (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4), Canonical
      (full.val[i.val]'(by simpa [full.property] using hi)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact hfull ⟨i.val,by simpa using hi⟩
  obtain ⟨out,harray,houtCan,houtModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.source_success openings internalArray
      blockPrepared ops.block weightsPrepared weights leading full
      hblockCan hblockPrepared hcanonWeights hpreparedWeights hsucc hinternal hleadingAll hfullAll
  have hinputs : AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs.source selectors =
      .ok (ops,weightsPrepared,blockPrepared) := by
    simp only [AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs.source,hops,bind_tc_ok,hweights,hblockNew]
  have hlow : (fun j : Fin 16 => Decode (lowAt ops.«local» j)) =
      R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) := by
    funext j
    have hj : j.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using j.isLt
    have h := hlowModel j
    dsimp only [AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray,
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedAt] at h
    rw [dif_pos hj] at h
    change Decode (lowAt ops.«local» j) = R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) j at h
    exact h
  change Decode leadingLow = Decode (lowAt ops.«local» 0) at hleadingDec
  change Decode fullLow = AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow
    (fun j => Decode (lowAt ops.«local» j)) at hfullDec
  change Decode internalLow = AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow
    (fun j => Decode (lowAt ops.«local» j)) at hinternalDec
  have hleadingModel : Decode leadingLow = R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) 0 := by
    rw [hleadingDec]
    exact congrFun hlow 0
  rw [hlow] at hfullDec hinternalDec
  change Decode ops.block = R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 (by omega) at hblockModel
  refine ⟨out,?_,houtCan,?_⟩
  · simpa only [source,hinputs,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair,AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.run] using harray
  · intro i
    have hmodel := houtModel i
    change _ = AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.model openings internalArray ops.block
      (Array.make 3#usize [leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow]) leading full i at hmodel
    rw [AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.model_three] at hmodel
    change Decode (AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.cell4 out i) =
      Decode ops.block * (Decode leadingLow * _ + Decode fullLow * _ + Decode internalLow * _) at hmodel
    rw [hblockModel,hleadingModel,hfullDec,hinternalDec] at hmodel
    have hdecodeFn : AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.Decode = Decode := rfl
    rw [hdecodeFn] at hmodel
    unfold model
    refine hmodel.trans ?_
    apply congrArg₂ (fun (a b : Exact) => a * b)
    · apply congrArg (fun (h : 0 + 57 ≤ 64) =>
        R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 h)
      exact Subsingleton.elim _ _
    · rfl

#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.PoseidonSamePointArray
AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs:
import AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource
import AspisR1.PoseidonActualPreparedWeights

/-! Same-point source selector/preparation dataflow. These factored calls form
only the selector and multiplier inputs; the intervening leading/full/internal
source evaluations and the enclosing projected oracle remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SumHighInnerLoop
abbrev Prepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev PreparedFor := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor
abbrev SelectorOutput := AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.Output
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

def lowAt (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)
def preparedAt (a : Array Prepared 3#usize) (i : Fin 3) : Prepared :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

def source (selectors : Selectors) :
    Result (SelectorOutput × Array Prepared 3#usize × Prepared) := do
  let ops ← AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.source selectors
  let weights ← AspisR1.PoseidonActualPreparedWeights.source ops.«local»
  let block ← field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new ops.block
  .ok (ops, weights, block)

/-- Actual boxed selectors derive all prepared-state invariants, rather than
assuming multiplier tables or unrelated low selector equations. -/
theorem boxed_source_success
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ (ops : SelectorOutput) (weights : Array Prepared 3#usize) (block : Prepared)
      (leadingLow fullLow internalLow : QM),
      source selectors = .ok (ops, weights, block) ∧
      AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.source selectors = .ok ops ∧
      Canonical ops.block ∧ CanonicalArray ops.«local» ∧ ops.«local» = selectors.low ∧
      PreparedFor block ops.block ∧
      PreparedFor (preparedAt weights 0) leadingLow ∧
      PreparedFor (preparedAt weights 1) fullLow ∧
      PreparedFor (preparedAt weights 2) internalLow ∧
      decode leadingLow = decode (lowAt ops.«local» 0) ∧
      decode fullLow = AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow
        (fun i => decode (lowAt ops.«local» i)) ∧
      decode internalLow = AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow
        (fun i => decode (lowAt ops.«local» i)) ∧
      decode ops.block = R0P.g2SumHigh (pointSelector point) 0 57 (by omega) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray ops.«local» i.val =
        R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) i := by
  obtain ⟨ops,hops,hblockCan,hlocalCan,hlocals,hblockModel,hlowModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonSelectorsSource.boxed_success point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow,rawWeights,weights,hweights,hraw,
    hleading,hfull,hinternal,hp0,hp1,hp2,hleadingDec,hfullDec,hinternalDec⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PoseidonActualPreparedWeights.source_success ops.«local» hlocalCan
  obtain ⟨block,hnew,hprepared⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.current_prepared_new ops.block hblockCan
  refine ⟨ops,weights,block,leadingLow,fullLow,internalLow,?_,hops,
    hblockCan,hlocalCan,hlocals,hprepared,hp0,hp1,hp2,
    hleadingDec,hfullDec,hinternalDec,hblockModel,hlowModel⟩
  simp only [source,hops,bind_tc_ok,hweights,hnew]

#print axioms boxed_source_success
end
end AspisR1.PoseidonBoxedPreparedInputs
AspisR1.PoseidonResidualPacking:
import R0P.Poseidon
import AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold

/-! Symbolic packing only: all nonlinear round functions stay opaque. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonResidualPacking
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem weighted_pack (i u block leadingWeight fullWeight internalWeight : K)
    (target leading full internal : Fin 4 → K) :
    block *
      (leadingWeight * (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u target - R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u leading) +
        fullWeight * (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u target - R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u full) +
        internalWeight * (R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u target - R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u internal)) =
      R0P.poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => block *
        (leadingWeight * (target j - leading j) + fullWeight * (target j - full j) +
          internalWeight * (target j - internal j))) := by
  unfold R0P.poseidonPackingFormula
  ring

def lane (group limb : Fin 4) : Fin 16 :=
  ⟨4 * group.val + limb.val,by have := group.isLt; have := limb.isLt; omega⟩

/-- The weighted three-branch packed formula is precisely the existing R0P
scalar residual packed in the original four-consecutive-lane order. -/
theorem poseidon_scalar_group_pack {F : Subfield K} (B : R0P.PackBasis F)
    (o : R0P.Openings K) (block : K) (low : Fin 16 → K) (group : Fin 4) :
    block *
      (low 0 *
          (R0P.pack4 B (fun j => o.succ (lane group j)) -
            R0P.pack4 B (fun j => R0P.poseidonLeadingPair o.z o.xor12 (lane group j))) +
        AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow low *
          (R0P.pack4 B (fun j => o.succ (lane group j)) -
            R0P.pack4 B (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low (lane group j))) +
        AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow low *
          (R0P.pack4 B (fun j => o.succ (lane group j)) -
            R0P.pack4 B (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low (lane group j)))) =
      R0P.pack4 B (fun j => R0P.poseidonScalarResidual o block low (lane group j)) := by
  simpa only [R0P.pack4,R0P.poseidonScalarResidual,
    AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow,
    AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow,zero_add,
    R0P.poseidonPackingFormula] using
      weighted_pack B.i B.u block (low 0)
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.fullLow low)
        (AspisR1.PoseidonExplicitLowWeightFold.internalLow low)
        (fun j => o.succ (lane group j))
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonLeadingPair o.z o.xor12 (lane group j))
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low (lane group j))
        (fun j => R0P.poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low (lane group j))

#print axioms weighted_pack
#print axioms poseidon_scalar_group_pack
end AspisR1.PoseidonResidualPacking
PoseidonResidualFieldTransport:
import PoseidonPairMap
import PathFamilyFieldTransport

/-! Transport the existing unrandomized Poseidon family, preserving its
three branches and ordered selector folds. This does not replace the relation
or claim that a packed zero is an unpacked zero. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonResidualFieldTransport
open R0P
open AspisR1.PoseidonMap
open AspisR1.PoseidonPairMap
open AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport (mapOpenings)
variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem map_packingFormula (i u : K) (values : Fin 4 → K) :
    f (poseidonPackingFormula i u values) =
      poseidonPackingFormula (f i) (f u) (fun j => f (values j)) := by
  simp only [poseidonPackingFormula,map_add,map_mul]

theorem map_scalarResidual (o : Openings K) (block : K)
    (low : Fin 16 → K) (lane : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonScalarResidual o block low lane) =
      poseidonScalarResidual (mapOpenings f o) (f block) (mapState f low) lane := by
  have hfull : f (([1,9,10] : List (Fin 16)).foldl (fun sum row => sum + low row) 0) =
      ([1,9,10] : List (Fin 16)).foldl (fun sum row => sum + f (low row)) 0 := by
    simp only [List.foldl_cons,List.foldl_nil,map_add,map_zero]
  have hinternal : f ((List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 => low ⟨i.val+2,by omega⟩)).foldl (·+·) 0) =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 7 => f (low ⟨i.val+2,by omega⟩))).foldl (·+·) 0 := by
    simp only [map_foldl_add,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def,map_zero]
  have hleading : f (poseidonLeadingPair o.z o.xor12 lane) =
      poseidonLeadingPair (mapState f o.z) (mapState f o.xor12) lane :=
    congrFun (map_poseidonLeadingPair f o.z o.xor12) lane
  have hfullPair : f (poseidonInterpolatedFullPair o.z low lane) =
      poseidonInterpolatedFullPair (mapState f o.z) (mapState f low) lane :=
    congrFun (map_poseidonInterpolatedFullPair f o.z low) lane
  have hinternalPair : f (poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair o.z low lane) =
      poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair (mapState f o.z) (mapState f low) lane :=
    congrFun (map_poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair f o.z low) lane
  unfold poseidonScalarResidual
  simp only [map_mul,map_add,map_sub,map_zero,hfull,hinternal,
    hleading,hfullPair,hinternalPair,mapOpenings,mapState]
  all_goals rfl

theorem map_packed_scalarResidual (o : Openings K) (block i u : K)
    (low : Fin 16 → K) (lanes : Fin 4 → Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonPackingFormula i u (fun j => poseidonScalarResidual o block low (lanes j))) =
      poseidonPackingFormula (f i) (f u) (fun j =>
        poseidonScalarResidual (mapOpenings f o) (f block) (mapState f low) (lanes j)) := by
  simp only [map_packingFormula,map_scalarResidual]

theorem map_family (pub : Public K) (pub' : Public L)
    (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K) :
    ((poseidonScalarFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).map f =
      (poseidonScalarFamily (K := L)).residuals pub' (mapOpenings f o)
        (fun i => f (sel i)) := by
  have hlow : mapState f (g2Low sel) = g2Low (fun i => f (sel i)) := by
    funext i
    exact AspisR1.PathFamilyFieldTransport.map_low f sel i
  simp only [poseidonScalarFamily,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def]
  congr 1
  funext lane
  rw [map_scalarResidual,AspisR1.PathFamilyFieldTransport.map_sumHigh,hlow]

#print axioms map_packingFormula
#print axioms map_scalarResidual
#print axioms map_packed_scalarResidual
#print axioms map_family
end AspisR1.PoseidonResidualFieldTransport
PoseidonPairMap:
import PoseidonMap

/-! Extend the maintained scalar naturality lemmas only at the three pair
boundaries used by the projected caller. All round and matrix functions remain
opaque; constant and ordered-fold transport reuse PoseidonMap. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PoseidonPairMap
open R0P AspisR1.PoseidonMap
variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

theorem map_poseidonLeadingPair (state absorption : State K) :
    mapState f (poseidonLeadingPair state absorption) =
      poseidonLeadingPair (mapState f state) (mapState f absorption) := by
  unfold poseidonLeadingPair
  rw [map_poseidonFullRound,map_poseidonFullRound,map_poseidonExternalLinear]
  have hinput : mapState f (fun lane =>
      if lane.val < 8 then state lane + absorption lane else state lane) =
      (fun lane => if lane.val < 8 then
        mapState f state lane + mapState f absorption lane else mapState f state lane) := by
    funext lane
    by_cases h : lane.val < 8 <;> simp only [mapState,h,ite_true,ite_false,map_add]
  rw [hinput]
  have hc0 : mapState f (poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) 0) =
      poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) 0 := funext (map_poseidonExternalInitial f 0)
  have hc1 : mapState f (poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) 1) =
      poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) 1 := funext (map_poseidonExternalInitial f 1)
  rw [hc0,hc1]

theorem map_poseidonInterpolatedFullPair (state low : State K) :
    mapState f (poseidonInterpolatedFullPair state low) =
      poseidonInterpolatedFullPair (mapState f state) (mapState f low) := by
  unfold poseidonInterpolatedFullPair
  rw [map_poseidonFullRound,map_poseidonFullRound]
  have hconstant (a b c : Fin 4) :
      mapState f (fun lane =>
        (low 1 * poseidonExternalInitial a lane + low 9 * poseidonExternalFinal b lane) +
          low 10 * poseidonExternalFinal c lane) =
      (fun lane =>
        (mapState f low 1 * poseidonExternalInitial a lane +
          mapState f low 9 * poseidonExternalFinal b lane) +
          mapState f low 10 * poseidonExternalFinal c lane) := by
    funext lane
    simp only [mapState,map_add,map_mul,map_poseidonExternalInitial,map_poseidonExternalFinal]
  rw [hconstant 2 0 2,hconstant 3 1 3]

theorem map_poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair (state low : State K) :
    mapState f (poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair state low) =
      poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair (mapState f state) (mapState f low) := by
  unfold poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair
  rw [map_poseidonInternalRound,map_poseidonInternalRound]
  simp only [map_foldl_add,List.map_ofFn,Function.comp_def,map_zero,map_mul,
    map_poseidonInternalConstants,mapState]

#print axioms map_poseidonLeadingPair
#print axioms map_poseidonInterpolatedFullPair
#print axioms map_poseidonInterpolatedInternalPair
end AspisR1.PoseidonPairMap
PoseidonMap:
import R0P.Semantics

/-! Field-homomorphism naturality for the scalar Poseidon model. These lemmas
are purely algebraic: no field characteristic, constant correspondence, or
finite-field computation is assumed. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PoseidonMap

open R0P

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L] (f : K →+* L)

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

abbrev State (K : Type) := Fin 16 → K
abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

def mapState (s : State K) : State L := fun i => f (s i)
def mapDigest (d : Digest K) : Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

theorem map_poseidonPow5 (x : K) :
    f (poseidonPow5 x) = poseidonPow5 (f x) := by
  simp [poseidonPow5]

theorem map_poseidonMat4 (s : Fin 4 → K) (i : Fin 4) :
    f (poseidonMat4 s i) = poseidonMat4 (fun i => f (s i)) i := by
  fin_cases i <;> simp [poseidonMat4, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonExternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonExternalLinear s) =
      poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonExternalLinear, mapState]
  simp_rw [map_add, map_zero, map_poseidonMat4]

theorem map_foldl_add (xs : List K) (init : K) :
    f (xs.foldl (· + ·) init) = (xs.map f).foldl (· + ·) (f init) := by
  induction xs generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.foldl_cons, List.map_cons]
      rw [ih, map_add]

theorem map_poseidonInternalLinear (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalLinear s) =
      poseidonInternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  funext i
  dsimp only [poseidonInternalLinear, mapState]
  have hxs : (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => s j.succ)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun j : Fin 15 => f (s j.succ)) := by
    simp
  by_cases hi : i.val = 0
  · simp only [dif_pos hi, map_sub]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]
  · simp only [dif_neg hi, map_add, map_mul, map_natCast]
    rw [map_foldl_add, hxs, map_zero]

theorem map_poseidonFullRound (s c : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c) =
      poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c) := by
  unfold poseidonFullRound
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun lane => poseidonPow5 (s lane + c lane)) =
        (fun lane => poseidonPow5
          (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s lane + mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c lane)) := by
    funext i
    simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonInternalRound (s : State K) c :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c) =
      poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c) := by
  unfold poseidonInternalRound
  rw [map_poseidonInternalLinear]
  have hinput :
      mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun i =>
        if i = 0 then poseidonPow5 (s 0 + c) else s i) =
      (fun i => if i = 0 then poseidonPow5
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s 0 + f c)
        else mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s i) := by
    funext i
    by_cases hi : i = 0
    · subst i
      simp [mapState, map_add, map_poseidonPow5]
    · simp [mapState, hi]
  rw [hinput]

theorem map_poseidonExternalInitial (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonExternalFinal (r : Fin 4) (i : Fin 16) :
    f (poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r i) =
      poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r i := by
  fin_cases r <;> fin_cases i <;> exact map_natCast f _

theorem map_poseidonInternalConstants (r : Fin 14) :
    f (poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r) =
      poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r := by
  fin_cases r <;> exact map_natCast f _

private theorem map_fullRoundFold (cs : List (State K)) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
      (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
        (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonFullRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonFullRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (poseidonFullRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s)
                (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f c)) := by rw [map_poseidonFullRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f)).foldl poseidonFullRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

private theorem map_internalRoundFold (cs : List K) (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
      (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  induction cs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons c cs ih =>
      calc
        mapState (K := K) (L := L) f ((c :: cs).foldl poseidonInternalRound s) =
            mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (cs.foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := rfl
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonInternalRound s c)) := ih _
        _ = (cs.map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (poseidonInternalRound (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) (f c)) := by
                rw [map_poseidonInternalRound]
        _ = ((c :: cs).map f).foldl poseidonInternalRound
              (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := rfl

theorem map_poseidonPermutation (s : State K) :
    mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation s) =
      poseidonPermutation (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s) := by
  unfold poseidonPermutation
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).foldl
        poseidonFullRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).foldl
          poseidonInternalRound
          ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).foldl
            poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear s)))) =
    (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r)).foldl
      poseidonFullRound
      ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r)).foldl
        poseidonInternalRound
        ((List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r)).foldl
          poseidonFullRound (poseidonExternalLinear (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f s))))
  have hi : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalInitial (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalInitial f r))
  have hc : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := K) r)).map f =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 14 => poseidonInternalConstants (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact map_poseidonInternalConstants f r)
  have hf : (List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := K) r)).map
      (mapState (K := K) (L := L) f) =
      List.ofFn (fun r : Fin 4 => poseidonExternalFinal (K := L) r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    exact congrArg List.ofFn (by
      funext r
      exact funext (map_poseidonExternalFinal f r))
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hf]
  rw [map_internalRoundFold, hc]
  rw [map_fullRoundFold, hi]
  rw [map_poseidonExternalLinear]

theorem map_nodeCompress (a b : Digest K) :
    mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f (nodeCompress a b) =
      nodeCompress (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f a)
        (mapDigest (K := K) (L := L) f b) := by
  change (fun i : Fin 8 => f (poseidonPermutation (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩)) = _
  have hinput : mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (fun l =>
      if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
      else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
      else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩) =
    (fun l => if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
      else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
      else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)) := by
    funext l
    dsimp only [mapState]
    split_ifs with hlow hlast
    · rfl
    · rw [map_sub]
      exact congrArg (fun z : L => f (b 7) - z) (map_natCast f 1051521018)
    · rfl
  funext i
  let inK : State K := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then a ⟨l.val, h⟩
    else if l.val = 15 then b 7 - (1051521018 : K)
    else b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩
  let inL : State L := fun l =>
    if h : l.val < 8 then f (a ⟨l.val, h⟩)
    else if l.val = 15 then f (b 7) - (1051521018 : L)
    else f (b ⟨l.val - 8, by omega⟩)
  change mapState (K := K) (L := L) f (poseidonPermutation inK)
      ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ = poseidonPermutation inL ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  rw [congrFun (map_poseidonPermutation f inK) ⟨i.val, by omega⟩]
  rw [hinput]

#print axioms map_poseidonPow5
#print axioms map_poseidonMat4
#print axioms map_poseidonExternalLinear
#print axioms map_poseidonInternalLinear
#print axioms map_poseidonFullRound
#print axioms map_poseidonInternalRound
#print axioms map_poseidonExternalInitial
#print axioms map_poseidonExternalFinal
#print axioms map_poseidonInternalConstants
#print axioms map_poseidonPermutation
#print axioms map_nodeCompress

end AspisR1.PoseidonMap
PathFamilyFieldTransport:
import ValueFamilyFieldTransport
import R0P.Path

/-! Exact transport of the retained path selector and residual family.
The high/low marginal sums and contiguous source residual lists are preserved. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathFamilyFieldTransport
open AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport
variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]

theorem map_high (g : K →+* L) (sel : R0P.Sel K) (h : Fin 64) :
    g (R0P.g2High sel h) = R0P.g2High (fun i => g (sel i)) h := by
  simp only [R0P.g2High, map_sum]

theorem map_low (g : K →+* L) (sel : R0P.Sel K) (l : Fin 16) :
    g (R0P.g2Low sel l) = R0P.g2Low (fun i => g (sel i)) l := by
  simp only [R0P.g2Low, map_sum]

theorem map_sumHigh (g : K →+* L) (sel : R0P.Sel K)
    (start count : Nat) (bound : start + count ≤ 64) :
    g (R0P.g2SumHigh sel start count bound) =
      R0P.g2SumHigh (fun i => g (sel i)) start count bound := by
  simp only [R0P.g2SumHigh, R0P.g2_fold_add, zero_add, List.sum_ofFn,
    map_sum, map_high]

theorem map_selector (g : K →+* L) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    g (R0P.pathSelector sel) = R0P.pathSelector (fun i => g (sel i)) := by
  simp only [R0P.pathSelector, map_mul, map_add, map_sumHigh, map_low]

theorem map_lanes (g : K →+* L) (selector : K) (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.pathLanes selector o).map g =
      R0P.pathLanes (g selector) (mapOpenings g o) := by
  simp only [R0P.pathLanes, List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
    List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def, map_mul, map_sub, map_one, mapOpenings]

theorem map_family (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (pub' : R0P.Public L)
    (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    ((R0P.pathFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).map g =
      (R0P.pathFamily (K := L)).residuals pub' (mapOpenings g o)
        (fun i => g (sel i)) := by
  simp only [R0P.pathFamily, map_lanes, map_selector]

#print axioms map_high
#print axioms map_low
#print axioms map_sumHigh
#print axioms map_selector
#print axioms map_lanes
#print axioms map_family
end AspisR1.PathFamilyFieldTransport
ValueFamilyFieldTransport:
import R0P.Value

/-! Field transport for the retained value relation. This connects the exact
QM31 source residual equations to the WideExact residual list through the
already proved ring homomorphism, without normalizing field elements. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport

variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]

def mapOpenings (g : K →+* L) (o : R0P.Openings K) : R0P.Openings L :=
  ⟨fun i => g (o.z i), fun i => g (o.succ i), fun i => g (o.xor12 i)⟩

theorem map_reconstruct (g : K →+* L) (view : Fin 16 → K) :
    g (R0P.valueReconstruct10 view) =
      R0P.valueReconstruct10 (fun i => g (view i)) := by
  simp only [R0P.valueReconstruct10, map_add]

theorem map_range (g : K →+* L) (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.valueRange o).map g = R0P.valueRange (mapOpenings g o) := by
  simp only [R0P.valueRange, List.map_append, List.map_ofFn,
    List.map_cons, List.map_nil, Function.comp_def, map_sub, map_pow,
    map_add, map_mul, map_ofNat, map_reconstruct, mapOpenings]

/-- The public argument is irrelevant to this family, so any public values
on either side may be used. All selector and opening cells are transported. -/
theorem map_family (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (pub' : R0P.Public L)
    (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    ((R0P.valueFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).map g =
      (R0P.valueFamily (K := L)).residuals pub' (mapOpenings g o)
        (fun i => g (sel i)) := by
  simp only [R0P.valueFamily]
  rw [← map_range g o]
  simp [List.map_append, List.map_map, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
    Function.comp_def, map_mul, map_add, map_zero, map_sub, mapOpenings]

#print axioms map_reconstruct
#print axioms map_range
#print axioms map_family
end AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport

/-! Importable source-cut declaration for the actual projected evaluator QName.
This file does not import or overwrite the monolithic Funs/Types cache. It
retains the candidate wrapper's call order and uses the generated closure#2
callback constant at the final `core.array.from_fn` call. The parent Funs SHA
f1e258... is still an external source pin; this is a focused declaration slice,
not a replay of that full extraction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev ProjectedOpenings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev ProjectedSelectors := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonSelectors
abbrev ProjectedQM := field.QM31
abbrev ProjectedPrepared := field.PreparedQm31Multiplier

/-- Literal projected-evaluator declaration slice: explicit ZERO-based lows,
packed helper call order, prepared-weight construction, and generated closure#2
callback. The Rust source excerpt pin is the explicit-low-fold extraction. -/
def state_only_poseidon.evaluate_state_only_poseidon_oracle_projected
    (openings : ProjectedOpenings) (selectors : ProjectedSelectors) :
    Result (Array ProjectedQM 4#usize) := do
  let leadingLow ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 0#usize
  let q ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 1#usize
  let q1 ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ZERO q
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 9#usize
  let q3 ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
  let q4 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 10#usize
  let fullLow ← field.QM31.add q3 q4
  let q5 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 2#usize
  let q6 ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ZERO q5
  let q7 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 3#usize
  let q8 ← field.QM31.add q6 q7
  let q9 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 4#usize
  let q10 ← field.QM31.add q8 q9
  let q11 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 5#usize
  let q12 ← field.QM31.add q10 q11
  let q13 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 6#usize
  let q14 ← field.QM31.add q12 q13
  let q15 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 7#usize
  let q16 ← field.QM31.add q14 q15
  let q17 ← Array.index_usize selectors.local 8#usize
  let internalLow ← field.QM31.add q16 q17
  let leading ← state_only_poseidon.leading_pair_packed openings
  let full ← state_only_poseidon.interpolated_full_pair_packed openings.z selectors.local
  let internal ← state_only_poseidon.interpolated_internal_pair openings.z selectors.local
  let prepared_weights ←
    core.array.Array.map
      (BuiltinFnMut ProjectedQM ProjectedPrepared)
      (Array.make 3#usize [leadingLow, fullLow, internalLow])
      (field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new)
  let prepared_block ← field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new selectors.block
  array_from_fn_copy 4#usize field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy
    AspisR1.PoseidonClosure2ArrayExact.Callback field.QM31.ZERO
    ((openings, internal, prepared_block, prepared_weights, leading, full) :
      AspisR1PoseidonProjectedClosure2Source.state_only_poseidon.evaluate_state_only_poseidon_oracle_projected.closure_2)

theorem evaluator_qname_eq_unfactored
    (openings : ProjectedOpenings) (selectors : ProjectedSelectors) :
    state_only_poseidon.evaluate_state_only_poseidon_oracle_projected openings selectors =
      AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_projected_source_unfactored
        openings selectors := by
  simp only [state_only_poseidon.evaluate_state_only_poseidon_oracle_projected,
    AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_projected_source_unfactored]
  simp [AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedCallbackSource.candidate_array]
  rw [← AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedCallbackSource.candidate_callback_matches_closure2]
  all_goals (intros; rfl)

theorem evaluator_qname_eq_factored
    (openings : ProjectedOpenings) (selectors : ProjectedSelectors) :
    state_only_poseidon.evaluate_state_only_poseidon_oracle_projected openings selectors =
      AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_projected_source
        openings selectors := by
  calc
    _ = AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_projected_source_unfactored
        openings selectors := evaluator_qname_eq_unfactored openings selectors
    _ = AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_projected_source
        openings selectors :=
      AspisR1.PoseidonCandidateProjectedWrapperFactor.candidate_wrapper_factor_exact
        openings selectors

#print axioms evaluator_qname_eq_factored

theorem run_success (point zc : Arr) (s : Statement) (claims : Claims)

    (hclaims : CanonicalArray claims)

    (htheta : Canonical theta) (hmu : Canonical mu)
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (hash : H) (c1 : Array U8 32#usize)
    (outTranscript : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (hprep : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.public_transcript D
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s)
      hash c1 = .ok (.Ok outTranscript)) :
    ∃ (z : Array QM 16#usize) (mask : Arr) (g terminal : QM),
      run (copyFromStatement s) claims point lambda chi theta zc mu =
        .ok (.Ok (terminal,z,mask,g)) ∧ Canonical terminal ∧
      decode terminal = R0P.SemSource.terminalValue (exactPublic (copyFromStatement s))
        (decode lambda) (decode chi) (decode theta) (decode mu)
        (AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint zc) TerminalLaneModel53.Basis
        (TerminalClaimModel53.claims claims) (AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.modelPoint point) := by
  obtain ⟨openings,selectors,mask,helper,composition,g,active,
    hz,hsucc,hxor,hbox,hhelper,hcomposition,hcompCan,hgCan,hactiveCan,hactiveValue,hvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.CompositionDetailed53.run_success point s claims lambda chi theta

  obtain ⟨terminal,hterminal,hterminalCan,hterminalValue⟩ :=

theorem outer_sound (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hsnapshot : ∀ j : Fin 20, DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.property] using j.isLt))) :
    DigestWrapperComposition.OuterSound point selectors public1 openings := by
  intro initial hinitial
  obtain ⟨middle, hm, hcm, hvm⟩ :=
    AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Fuel.public_loop_success public1 point selectors openings
      initial rfl hpoint hbox hz hsnapshot hinitial
  exact ⟨middle, hm, hcm, hvm⟩

/-- Complete actual source execution and all24 retained lane equations.
No outer-loop, branch, family or intermediate operation success is assumed. -/

    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z) (hsucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hxor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (ha : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.anchor)
    (hn : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.nullifier)
    (hc : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.change)
    (hr : ∀ recipient, public1.recipient = some recipient → DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical recipient)
    (hsnapshot : ∀ j : Fin 20, DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (hroot : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root)
    (hfrontier : ∀ j : Fin 20, DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (hasset : public1.asset_id.val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hamount : (AspisR1.ScalarSuffixExecution.amountValue public1).val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P) :
    ∃ out,
      AspisR1SemanticPackedBoundedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_packed
        public1 openings selectors = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 24, f (decoded out j) =
        R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k => R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt (SemanticPackedSixFamilies.publicWide public1)
          (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings)) (fun i => f (pointSelector point i))
          (4*j.val+k.val)) := by
  exact SemanticPackedSixFamilies.actual_semantic_packed_of_outer point selectors public1 openings
    hpoint hbox hz hsucc hxor ha hn hc hr hroot hfrontier hasset hamount
    (outer_sound point selectors public1 openings hpoint hbox hz hsnapshot)

#print axioms outer_sound
#print axioms actual_semantic_packed
end

/-! Full semantic_packed caller with shared proved helper owners. The digest
callee is the explicit bounded implementation candidate; full modified-Rust
re-extraction and release correspondence remain separate. -/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1SemanticPackedBoundedCandidate
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

def pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_packed
  (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
  (openings : state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings)
  (selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) :
  Result (Array field.QM31 24#usize)
  := do
  let packed := Array.repeat 24#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  let packed1 ←
    AspisR1ScheduleEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_schedule_lanes packed public1
      openings selectors
  let packed2 ←
    AspisR1PathEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_path_lanes packed1 openings
      selectors
  let packed3 ←
    AspisR1ValueLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes packed2 openings
      selectors
  let packed4 ←
    pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_occupancy_lanes packed3 public1
      openings selectors
  let a ←
    AspisR1DigestWrapperBoundedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.public_digest_lanes public1 openings
      selectors
  let packed5 ←
    AspisR1PreweightedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_preweighted packed4 84#usize a
  let q ← Array.index_usize openings.z 1#usize
  let q1 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 public1.asset_id
  let asset_difference ← field.QM31.sub q q1
  let i ← 2#usize * 16#usize
  let i1 ← i + 12#usize
  let q2 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i1
  let input_asset ← field.QM31.mul q2 asset_difference
  let i2 ← 31#usize * 16#usize
  let i3 ← i2 + 12#usize
  let q3 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i3
  let output_scalar ← field.QM31.mul q3 asset_difference
  let i4 ← 28#usize * 16#usize
  let i5 ← i4 + 12#usize
  let q4 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i5
  let private_transfer_term ← field.QM31.mul q4 asset_difference
  let withdrawal_amount_value ←
    lift (core.option.Option.unwrap_or public1.withdrawal_amount 0#u32)
  let i6 ←
    16#usize * pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.VALUE_AUXILIARY_BLOCK
  let i7 ← i6 + 2#usize
  let q5 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i7
  let q6 ← Array.index_usize openings.z 10#usize
  let q7 ←
    pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 withdrawal_amount_value
  let q8 ← field.QM31.sub q6 q7
  let withdrawal_term ← field.QM31.mul q5 q8
  let b := core.option.Option.is_some public1.withdrawal_amount
  let scalars ←
    AspisR1ScalarCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.scalar_lanes public1.variant b
      input_asset output_scalar private_transfer_term withdrawal_term
  AspisR1PreweightedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_preweighted packed5 92#usize
    scalars

end AspisR1SemanticPackedBoundedCandidate

/-! The actual first four family calls in semantic_packed, starting at the
source's zero array. All success/canonicality/model premises are discharged. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPackedPrefix
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Semantic
