abbrev Public := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev exactOpenings := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

def zero : Array QM 24#usize := Array.repeat 24#usize field.QM31.ZERO

theorem zero_canonical : CanonicalArray zero := by
  intro j
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
    ((List.replicate 24 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by simpa using j.isLt))
  rw [List.getElem_replicate]
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_canonical

theorem zero_decoded (j : Fin 24) : decoded zero j = 0 := by
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    ((List.replicate 24 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by simpa using j.isLt)) = 0
  rw [List.getElem_replicate]
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_decode

def run (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings) (selectors : Selectors) : Result (Array QM 24#usize) := do
  let packed1 ← AspisR1ScheduleEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_schedule_lanes
    zero public1 openings selectors
  let packed2 ← AspisR1PathEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_path_lanes
    packed1 openings selectors
  let packed3 ← AspisR1ValueLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes
    packed2 openings selectors
  pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_occupancy_lanes packed3 public1 openings selectors

@[irreducible] def familyContribution (family : R0P.Family Wide) (start : Nat)
    (pub : R0P.Public Wide) (o : R0P.Openings Wide) (sel : R0P.Sel Wide) (j : Fin 24) : Wide :=
  R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k : Fin 4 => selectList start (family.residuals pub o sel) (4*j.val+k.val))

@[irreducible] def model (pub : R0P.Public Wide) (o : R0P.Openings Wide)
    (sel : R0P.Sel Wide) (j : Fin 24) : Wide :=
  ((familyContribution R0P.scheduleFamily 0 pub o sel j + familyContribution R0P.pathFamily 32 pub o sel j) +
    familyContribution R0P.valueFamily 49 pub o sel j) + familyContribution R0P.occupancyFamily 0 pub o sel j

attribute [local irreducible] AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
  R0P.scheduleFamily R0P.pathFamily R0P.valueFamily R0P.occupancyFamily R0P.pack4
  AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList.selectList

theorem source_success (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings) (pub : R0P.Public Wide)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z) (hsucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hxor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (hv : pub.variant = (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1).variant) :
    ∃ out, run public1 openings selectors = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 24, f (decoded out j) =
        model pub (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings)) (fun i => f (pointSelector point i)) j := by
  obtain ⟨packed1, h1, hc1, hm1⟩ := AspisR1.ScheduleCompletePacking.actual_enclosing_scheduleFamily
    point selectors zero public1 openings pub hpoint hbox zero_canonical hz hv
  obtain ⟨packed2, h2, hc2, hm2⟩ := AspisR1.PathLaneEnclosingBridge.actual_enclosing_pathFamily
    point selectors packed1 openings pub hpoint hbox hc1 hz hsucc
  obtain ⟨packed3, h3, hc3, hm3⟩ := AspisR1.ValueLaneEnclosingBridge.actual_enclosing_valueFamily
    point selectors packed2 openings (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1) pub
    hpoint hbox hc2 hz hsucc hxor
  obtain ⟨out, h4, hc4, hm4⟩ := AspisR1.OccupancyCompletePacking.boxed_add_occupancy_lanes_success
    packed3 public1 openings point selectors pub hc3 hz hpoint hbox hv
  have hfamily := AspisR1.OccupancyCompletePacking.wideOccupancyFamily_residuals_eq pub
    (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings)) (fun i => f (pointSelector point i))
  rw [hfamily] at hm4
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hc4, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, h1, bind_tc_ok, h2, h3, h4]
  · intro j
    unfold model familyContribution
    rw [hm4 j, hm3 j, hm2 j, hm1 j, zero_decoded, map_zero, zero_add]

#print axioms zero_canonical
#print axioms zero_decoded
#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.SemanticPackedPrefix

/-! The complete actual schedule caller contributes its32 retained residuals
to all24 packed cells, after the already-proved exact field embedding. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ScheduleCompletePacking
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate

abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev exactOpenings := AspisR1.ScheduleProgram.exactOpenings
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.ScheduleProgram.pointSelector
abbrev modelVariant := AspisR1.ScheduleProgram.modelVariant
abbrev exactCell := AspisR1.AbsorptionCallback.sourceCell
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

theorem mapped_initial_list {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]
    (g : K →+* L) (v : R0P.Variant) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    (List.ofFn (R0P.scheduleInitial v o sel)).map g =
      List.ofFn (R0P.scheduleInitial v (mapOpenings g o) (fun i => g (sel i))) := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  exact congrArg List.ofFn (funext (fun i => AspisR1.ScheduleFamilyFieldTransport.map_initial g v o sel i))

theorem mapped_absorption_list {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]
    (g : K →+* L) (v : R0P.Variant) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    (List.ofFn (R0P.scheduleAbsorption v o sel)).map g =
      List.ofFn (R0P.scheduleAbsorption v (mapOpenings g o) (fun i => g (sel i))) := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  exact congrArg List.ofFn (funext (fun i => AspisR1.ScheduleFamilyFieldTransport.map_absorption g v o sel i))

theorem arrayVector_list_map (a : Array QM 16#usize) :
    List.ofFn (arrayVector a) =
      (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 16 => decode (exactCell a i))).map f := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  rfl

theorem arrays_to_wide_family
    (initial absorption : Array QM 16#usize)
    (v : R0P.Variant) (o : R0P.Openings AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact)
    (sel : R0P.Sel AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact) (pub : R0P.Public Wide)
    (hv : pub.variant = v)
    (hi : ∀ i : Fin 16, decode (exactCell initial i) = R0P.scheduleInitial v o sel i)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin 16, decode (exactCell absorption i) = R0P.scheduleAbsorption v o sel i) :
    List.ofFn (arrayVector initial) ++ List.ofFn (arrayVector absorption) =
      (R0P.scheduleFamily (K := Wide)).residuals pub (mapOpenings f o) (fun i => f (sel i)) := by
  have hiFn : (fun i : Fin 16 => decode (exactCell initial i)) = R0P.scheduleInitial v o sel := funext hi
  have haFn : (fun i : Fin 16 => decode (exactCell absorption i)) = R0P.scheduleAbsorption v o sel := funext ha
  rw [arrayVector_list_map, arrayVector_list_map, hiFn, haFn]
  have hInitial := mapped_initial_list f v o sel
  have hAbsorption := mapped_absorption_list f v o sel
  have hBoth := congrArg₂ (fun a b : List Wide => a ++ b) hInitial hAbsorption
  simpa only [R0P.scheduleFamily, hv] using hBoth

def run (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings) (selectors : Selectors) :
    Result (Array QM 24#usize) := do
  let (initial, absorption) ← AspisR1ScheduleEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_initial_and_absorption
    public1 openings selectors
  AspisR1.SchedulePacking.run packed initial absorption

theorem enclosing_eq_run (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings) (selectors : Selectors) :
    AspisR1ScheduleEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_schedule_lanes
      packed public1 openings selectors = run packed public1 openings selectors := by
  unfold AspisR1ScheduleEnclosingCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_schedule_lanes
    run AspisR1.SchedulePacking.run

/-! Actual path-selector prefix: bounded high-range summation, four checked
low-array reads, three additions and multiplication, on the same boxed point. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathSelectorPrefix
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SumHighInnerLoop
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
abbrev lowAt (selectors : Selectors) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray selectors.low

private theorem index_ok {α : Type} {N : Usize}
    (a : Array α N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

theorem readLow_success (selectors : Selectors) (index : Usize)
    (hindex : index.val < 16) (hlow : CanonicalArray selectors.low) :
    ∃ q, Array.index_usize selectors.low index = .ok q ∧ Canonical q ∧
      decode q = lowAt selectors index.val := by
  let q := selectors.low.val[index.val]'(by simpa [selectors.low.property] using hindex)
  refine ⟨q, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact index_ok selectors.low index (by simpa using hindex)
  · exact hlow ⟨index.val, by simpa using hindex⟩
  · have hiBound : index.val < (16#usize).val := by scalar_tac
    simp only [lowAt, AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedArray,
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decodedAt, dif_pos hiBound,
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.decode]
    rfl

def runLow (selectors : Selectors) : Result QM := do
  let q1 ← Array.index_usize selectors.low 1#usize
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize selectors.low 5#usize
  let q3 ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
  let q4 ← Array.index_usize selectors.low 9#usize
  let q5 ← field.QM31.add q3 q4
  let q6 ← Array.index_usize selectors.low 13#usize
  field.QM31.add q5 q6

theorem low_success (selectors : Selectors) (hlow : CanonicalArray selectors.low) :
    ∃ out, runLow selectors = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out = ((lowAt selectors 1 + lowAt selectors 5) + lowAt selectors 9) + lowAt selectors 13 := by
  obtain ⟨q1, hr1, hc1, hv1⟩ := readLow_success selectors 1#usize (by scalar_tac) hlow
  obtain ⟨q2, hr2, hc2, hv2⟩ := readLow_success selectors 5#usize (by scalar_tac) hlow
  obtain ⟨q3, hr3, hc3, hv3⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q1 q2 hc1 hc2
  obtain ⟨q4, hr4, hc4, hv4⟩ := readLow_success selectors 9#usize (by scalar_tac) hlow
  obtain ⟨q5, hr5, hc5, hv5⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q3 q4 hc3 hc4
  obtain ⟨q6, hr6, hc6, hv6⟩ := readLow_success selectors 13#usize (by scalar_tac) hlow
  obtain ⟨out, hr7, hc7, hv7⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q5 q6 hc5 hc6
  have h1 : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  have h5 : (5#usize).val = 5 := by scalar_tac
  have h9 : (9#usize).val = 9 := by scalar_tac
  have h13 : (13#usize).val = 13 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [h1, h5, h9, h13] at hv1 hv2 hv4 hv6
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hc7, ?_⟩
  · simp only [runLow, hr1, bind_tc_ok, hr2, hr3, hr4, hr5, hr6, hr7]
  · rw [hv7, hv5, hv3, hv1, hv2, hv4, hv6]

def lowModel {K : Type} [Field K] (sel : R0P.Sel K) : K :=
  ((R0P.g2Low sel 1 + R0P.g2Low sel 5) + R0P.g2Low sel 9) + R0P.g2Low sel 13

theorem boxed_low_success
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ out, runLow selectors = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out = lowModel (pointSelector point) := by
  obtain ⟨_hhigh, hlow, _hhighModel, hlowModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.boxed_marginals point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ := low_success selectors hlow
  refine ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  change decode out = ((lowAt selectors 1 + lowAt selectors 5) +
    lowAt selectors 9) + lowAt selectors 13 at hmodel
  have h1 := hlowModel (1 : Fin 16)
  have h5 := hlowModel (5 : Fin 16)
  have h9 := hlowModel (9 : Fin 16)
  have h13 := hlowModel (13 : Fin 16)
  change lowAt selectors 1 = _ at h1
  change lowAt selectors 5 = _ at h5
  change lowAt selectors 9 = _ at h9
  change lowAt selectors 13 = _ at h13
  unfold lowModel
  exact hmodel.trans (by rw [h1, h5, h9, h13])

def run (selectors : Selectors) : Result QM := do
  let high ← AspisR1SumHighCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.sum_high selectors
    (AspisR1.SumHighSingleRange.singleton AspisR1.SumHighBoxedModel.pathRange)
  let low ← runLow selectors
  field.QM31.mul high low

theorem pathSelector_model {K : Type} [Field K] (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    R0P.g2SumHigh sel 57 6 (by omega) * lowModel sel = R0P.pathSelector sel := by
  unfold R0P.pathSelector lowModel
  rfl

attribute [local irreducible] R0P.g2Low R0P.g2High R0P.g2SumHigh

theorem boxed_path_selector
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ out, run selectors = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out = R0P.pathSelector (pointSelector point) := by
  obtain ⟨high, hhigh, hchigh, hvhigh⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SumHighBoxedModel.boxed_path_sum point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨low, hlow, hclow, hvlow⟩ := boxed_low_success point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨out, hmul, hcanonical, hvalue⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact high low hchigh hclow
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, hhigh, bind_tc_ok, hlow, hmul]
  · rw [hvalue, hvhigh, hvlow]
    exact pathSelector_model (pointSelector point)

#print axioms readLow_success
#print axioms low_success
#print axioms boxed_low_success
#print axioms pathSelector_model
#print axioms boxed_path_selector
end
end AspisR1.PathSelectorPrefix

/-! Actual source initial-array constructor segment: prepare full, add rate,
prepare the sum, then build16 lanes with the existing stable array helper. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InitialArrayExecution
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.AbsorptionCallback
open AspisR1.InitialArrayCallback
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev callbackInst := AspisR1InitialCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_initial_and_absorption.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31

def run (full rate : QM) (openings : Openings) : Result (Array QM 16#usize) := do
  let pFull ← field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new full
  let total ← field.QM31.add full rate
  let pTotal ← field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new total
  array_from_fn_copy 16#usize field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy callbackInst
    field.QM31.ZERO (pTotal, openings, pFull)

theorem source_success (full rate : QM) (openings : Openings)
    (hf : Canonical full) (hr : Canonical rate)
    (ho : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell openings.z i)) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 16#usize, run full rate openings = .ok out ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell out i)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, decode (sourceCell out i) =
        (if i.val < 8 then decode full + decode rate else decode full) *
          decode (sourceCell openings.z i) := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨pFull, hpFull, hpreparedFull⟩ := current_prepared_new full hf
  obtain ⟨total, htotal, hctotal, hvtotal⟩ := current_qm_add_exact full rate hf hr
  obtain ⟨pTotal, hpTotal, hpreparedTotal⟩ := current_prepared_new total hctotal
  have hcallbacks : ∀ i : Fin 16, ∃ out,
      AspisR1.InitialArrayCallback.call (pTotal, openings, pFull)
        (UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)) = .ok (out, (pTotal, openings, pFull)) ∧
      Canonical out ∧ decode out =
        (if i.val < 8 then decode total else decode full) * decode (sourceCell openings.z i) := by
    intro i
    let idx : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)
    have hidx : idx.val = i.val := by scalar_tac
    have hbound : idx.val < 16 := by rw [hidx]; exact i.isLt
    obtain ⟨out, hr, hc, hv⟩ := AspisR1.InitialArrayCallback.callback_success total full pTotal pFull
      openings idx hbound hctotal hf hpreparedTotal hpreparedFull ho
    have hfin : (⟨idx.val, hbound⟩ : Fin 16) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      exact hidx
    rw [hfin, hidx] at hv
    exact ⟨out, hr, hc, hv⟩
  choose values hcall hcanonical hmodel using hcallbacks
  let value : Nat → QM := fun i => if hi : i < 16 then values ⟨i, hi⟩ else field.QM31.ZERO
  have hstable : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < (16#usize).val →
      callbackInst.call_mut (pTotal, openings, pFull) i =
        .ok (value i.val, (pTotal, openings, pFull)) := by
    intro i hi
    have h : i.val < 16 := by simpa using hi
    have heq : UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac) = i := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      rfl
    have hc := hcall ⟨i.val, h⟩
    rw [heq] at hc
    simpa only [value, dif_pos h] using hc
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout⟩ := array_from_fn_copy_stable 16#usize
    field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy callbackInst field.QM31.ZERO
    (pTotal, openings, pFull) value hstable
  have hcell : ∀ i : Fin 16, sourceCell out i = values i := by
    intro i
    have hi : i.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using i.isLt
    have hh := hout i.val hi
    simpa only [sourceCell, value, dif_pos i.isLt] using hh
  refine ⟨out, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, hpFull, bind_tc_ok, htotal, hpTotal, hrun]
  · intro i
    rw [hcell]
    exact hcanonical i
  · intro i
    rw [hcell, hmodel, hvtotal]

#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.InitialArrayExecution

abbrev call := AspisR1InitialCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_initial_and_absorption.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut

theorem callback_success (fullOrRate full : QM) (pOrRate pFull : Prepared)
    (openings : Openings) (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 16)
    (hOrRate : Canonical fullOrRate) (hFull : Canonical full)
    (hpOrRate : PreparedFor pOrRate fullOrRate) (hpFull : PreparedFor pFull full)

  obtain ⟨q, hq, hvq⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec openings.z lane hb)
  have hcurrent : q = current := by
    simpa [current, sourceCell] using hvq
  rw [hcurrent] at hq
  have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by scalar_tac
  by_cases hlt : lane.val < 8
  · obtain ⟨out, hmul, hco, hvo⟩ := prepared_mul_exact pOrRate fullOrRate current hOrRate hc hpOrRate

    · simp only [call,

    · simpa only [hlt, if_true] using hvo
  · obtain ⟨out, hmul, hco, hvo⟩ := prepared_mul_exact pFull full current hFull hc hpFull
    refine ⟨out, ?_, hco, ?_⟩
    · simp only [call,
        AspisR1InitialCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_initial_and_absorption.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut,
        AspisR1InitialCandidate.poseidon2.RATE, UScalar.lt_equiv, h8, hlt, if_false,
        hq, bind_tc_ok, hmul]

/-! Checked execution of the actual absorption callback. The exact source
association is retained in each of its three branches. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AbsorptionCallback
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev Closure := AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.absorption_lanes_literal.closure
abbrev call := AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.absorption_lanes_literal.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut

def blocksRun (fixed two eight nodes : QM) (lane : Usize) : Result QM :=
  if lane < 2#usize then .ok fixed
  else if lane < 8#usize then field.QM31.add fixed two
  else do
    let a ← field.QM31.add fixed two
    let b ← field.QM31.add a eight
    field.QM31.add b nodes

def blocksModel (fixed two eight nodes : ExactQM) (lane : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if lane < 2 then fixed else if lane < 8 then fixed + two else ((fixed + two) + eight) + nodes

theorem blocks_success (fixed two eight nodes : QM) (lane : Usize)
    (hf : Canonical fixed) (ht : Canonical two) (he : Canonical eight) (hn : Canonical nodes) :
    ∃ out, blocksRun fixed two eight nodes lane = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out = blocksModel (decode fixed) (decode two) (decode eight) (decode nodes) lane.val := by
  have h2 : (2#usize).val = 2 := by scalar_tac
  have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by scalar_tac
  by_cases hsmall : lane.val < 2
  · refine ⟨fixed, ?_, hf, ?_⟩
    · simp only [blocksRun, UScalar.lt_equiv, h2, hsmall, if_true]
    · simp only [blocksModel, hsmall, if_true]
  · obtain ⟨a, ha, hca, hva⟩ := current_qm_add_exact fixed two hf ht
    by_cases hmid : lane.val < 8
    · refine ⟨a, ?_, hca, ?_⟩
      · simp only [blocksRun, UScalar.lt_equiv, h2, h8, hsmall, hmid, if_false, if_true, ha]
      · simpa only [blocksModel, hsmall, hmid, if_false, if_true] using hva
    · obtain ⟨b, hb, hcb, hvb⟩ := current_qm_add_exact a eight hca he
      obtain ⟨out, ho, hco, hvo⟩ := current_qm_add_exact b nodes hcb hn
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hco, ?_⟩
      · simp only [blocksRun, UScalar.lt_equiv, h2, h8, hsmall, hmid, if_false, ha, bind_tc_ok, hb, ho]
      · rw [hvo, hvb, hva]
        simp only [blocksModel, hsmall, hmid, if_false]

private theorem index_success {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hb : i.val < a.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  obtain ⟨q, hread, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec a i hb)
  rw [hread]
  congr 1

private theorem bind_if {α β : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p]
    (a b : Result α) (f : α → Result β) :
    ((if p then a else b) >>= f) = (if p then a >>= f else b >>= f) := by
  split_ifs <;> rfl

def sourceCell (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

theorem callback_success (low fixed two eight nodes : QM)
    (openings : Array QM 16#usize) (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 16)
    (hl : Canonical low) (hf : Canonical fixed) (ht : Canonical two)
    (he : Canonical eight) (hn : Canonical nodes)
    (ho : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell openings i)) :
    ∃ out, call (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings) lane =
        .ok (out, (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings)) ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out = decode low *
        blocksModel (decode fixed) (decode two) (decode eight) (decode nodes) lane.val *
        decode (sourceCell openings ⟨lane.val, hlane⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨blocks, hb, hcb, hvb⟩ := blocks_success fixed two eight nodes lane hf ht he hn
  obtain ⟨scale, hs, hcs, hvs⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact low blocks hl hcb
  let cell := sourceCell openings ⟨lane.val, hlane⟩
  have hread : Array.index_usize openings lane = .ok cell :=
    index_success openings lane (by simpa using hlane)
  have hc : Canonical cell := ho ⟨lane.val, hlane⟩
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hco, hvo⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact scale cell hcs hc
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hco, ?_⟩
  · have hbind := congrArg (fun r : Result QM => do
      let b ← r
      let s ← field.QM31.mul low b
      let x ← Array.index_usize openings lane
      let y ← field.QM31.mul s x
      .ok (y, (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings))) hb
    simp only [blocksRun, bind_if, bind_assoc, bind_tc_ok, hs, hread, hout] at hbind
    simpa only [call,
      AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.absorption_lanes_literal.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut,
      AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.poseidon2.RATE,
      AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.absorption_lanes_literal.closure,
      bind_tc_ok, hs, hread, hout] using hbind
  · rw [hvo, hvs, hvb]

#print axioms blocks_success
#print axioms callback_success
end
end AspisR1.AbsorptionCallback
InitialArrayWrites:
import InitialArrayExecution
import EqualityValueAdapter

/-! The actual schedule's two checked subtracting writes at RATE and RATE+1.
The frame lemma reuses the set/read proof shape already checked for path lanes. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InitialArrayWrites
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.AbsorptionCallback
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev RATE := AspisR1InitialCandidate.poseidon2.RATE

theorem read16_success (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 16)
    (ha : ∀ j : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell a j)) :
    ∃ q, Array.index_usize a i = .ok q ∧ Canonical q ∧
      q = sourceCell a ⟨i.val, hi⟩ := by
  have hb : i.val < a.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  obtain ⟨q, hread, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec a i hb)
  have hv : q = sourceCell a ⟨i.val, hi⟩ := by simpa [sourceCell] using hvalue
  refine ⟨q, hread, ?_, hv⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact ha ⟨i.val, hi⟩

private theorem sourceCell_set (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (j : Fin 16) :
    sourceCell (a.set i x) j = if j.val = i.val then x else sourceCell a j := by
  unfold sourceCell
  by_cases heq : j.val = i.val
  · simp [heq, Array.set_val_eq]
  · have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := Ne.symm heq
    simp [Array.set_val_eq, List.getElem_set_ne, hne, heq]

theorem update16_success (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 16)
    (ha : ∀ j : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell a j)) (hx : Canonical x) :
    ∃ out, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell out j)) ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 16, sourceCell out j = if j.val = i.val then x else sourceCell a j := by
  have hb : i.val < a.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  obtain ⟨out, hupdate, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i x hb)
  have hframe : ∀ j : Fin 16,
      sourceCell out j = if j.val = i.val then x else sourceCell a j := by
    intro j
    rw [hset]
    exact sourceCell_set a i x j
  refine ⟨out, hupdate, ?_, hframe⟩
  intro j
  rw [hframe]
  split_ifs
  · exact hx
  · exact ha j

def run (initial : Array QM 16#usize) (low domain length : QM) : Result (Array QM 16#usize) := do
  let current ← Array.index_usize initial RATE
  let subtract ← field.QM31.mul low domain
  let difference ← field.QM31.sub current subtract
  let initial1 ← Array.update initial RATE difference
  let i ← RATE + 1#usize
  let current1 ← Array.index_usize initial1 i
  let subtract1 ← field.QM31.mul low length
  let difference1 ← field.QM31.sub current1 subtract1
  Array.update initial1 i difference1

theorem source_success (initial : Array QM 16#usize) (low domain length : QM)
    (ha : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell initial i))
    (hl : Canonical low) (hd : Canonical domain) (hlen : Canonical length) :
    ∃ out, run initial low domain length = .ok out ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell out i)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, decode (sourceCell out i) =
        if i.val = 8 then decode (sourceCell initial i) - decode low * decode domain
        else if i.val = 9 then decode (sourceCell initial i) - decode low * decode length
        else decode (sourceCell initial i) := by
  have hRATE : RATE.val = 8 := by unfold RATE AspisR1InitialCandidate.poseidon2.RATE; scalar_tac
  have hRateBound : RATE.val < 16 := by rw [hRATE]; omega
  have hFinRate : (⟨RATE.val, hRateBound⟩ : Fin 16) = 8 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hRATE
  obtain ⟨current, hread, hccurrent, hvcurrent⟩ := read16_success initial RATE hRateBound ha
  rw [hFinRate] at hvcurrent
  obtain ⟨subtract, hmul, hcsubtract, hvsubtract⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact low domain hl hd
  obtain ⟨difference, hsub, hcdifference, hvdifference⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact current subtract hccurrent hcsubtract
  obtain ⟨initial1, hupdate, hcinitial1, hframe1⟩ :=
    update16_success initial RATE difference hRateBound ha hcdifference
  simp only [hRATE] at hframe1
  have hAddSpec : (RATE + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ i => i.val = RATE.val + (1#usize).val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    rw [hRATE]
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨idx, hadd, hidx⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hAddSpec
  have hidx9 : idx.val = 9 := by
    have h1 : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [hRATE, h1] using hidx
  have hIdxBound : idx.val < 16 := by rw [hidx9]; omega
  have hFinIdx : (⟨idx.val, hIdxBound⟩ : Fin 16) = 9 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact hidx9
  obtain ⟨current1, hread1, hccurrent1, hvcurrent1⟩ :=
    read16_success initial1 idx hIdxBound hcinitial1
  rw [hFinIdx] at hvcurrent1
  have hunchanged9 : sourceCell initial1 (9 : Fin 16) = sourceCell initial (9 : Fin 16) := by
    simpa using hframe1 (9 : Fin 16)
  rw [hunchanged9] at hvcurrent1
  obtain ⟨subtract1, hmul1, hcsubtract1, hvsubtract1⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact low length hl hlen
  obtain ⟨difference1, hsub1, hcdifference1, hvdifference1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact current1 subtract1 hccurrent1 hcsubtract1
  obtain ⟨out, hupdate1, hcout, hframe2⟩ :=
    update16_success initial1 idx difference1 hIdxBound hcinitial1 hcdifference1
  simp only [hidx9] at hframe2
  change decode difference = decode current - decode subtract at hvdifference
  change decode difference1 = decode current1 - decode subtract1 at hvdifference1
  have hvalue8 : decode difference = decode (sourceCell initial (8 : Fin 16)) - decode low * decode domain := by
    rw [hvdifference, hvcurrent, hvsubtract]
  have hvalue9 : decode difference1 = decode (sourceCell initial (9 : Fin 16)) - decode low * decode length := by
    rw [hvdifference1, hvcurrent1, hvsubtract1]
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcout, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, hread, bind_tc_ok, hmul, hsub, hupdate, hadd, hread1, hmul1, hsub1, hupdate1]
  · intro i
    rw [hframe2]
    by_cases hi9 : i.val = 9
    · have hi8 : ¬ i.val = 8 := by omega
      have heq : i = (9 : Fin 16) := Fin.ext hi9
      subst i
      simpa using hvalue9
    · rw [if_neg hi9, hframe1]
      by_cases hi8 : i.val = 8
      · have heq : i = (8 : Fin 16) := Fin.ext hi8
        subst i
        simpa using hvalue8
      · simp only [hi8, hi9, if_false]

#print axioms read16_success
#print axioms update16_success
#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.InitialArrayWrites
ScheduleDomainToModel:
import ScheduleDomainArithmetic
import InitialSelectorPrefix

/-! Interpret the checked source domain/length chains with the retained
schedule coefficients, using structural base-field embedding identities. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ScheduleDomainToModel
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev Registers := AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers

def domainModel {K : Type} [Field K] (p : Registers K) : K :=
  (p.high0 * 1095958529 + ((p.high1 + p.high30) + p.transfer) * 1095958531) + p.high25 * 1095958530

def lengthModel {K : Type} [Field K] (p : Registers K) : K :=
  (p.high0 * 8 + ((p.high1 + p.high30) + p.transfer) * 18) + p.high25 * 16

theorem source_constant_embeddings :
    scalarEmbedding AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.owner = (1095958529 : ExactQM) ∧
    scalarEmbedding AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.note = (1095958531 : ExactQM) ∧
    scalarEmbedding AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.nullifier = (1095958530 : ExactQM) ∧
    scalarEmbedding 8#u32 = (8 : ExactQM) ∧
    scalarEmbedding 18#u32 = (18 : ExactQM) ∧
    scalarEmbedding 16#u32 = (16 : ExactQM) := by
  have ho : AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.owner.val = 1095958529 := by
    unfold AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.owner AspisR1ScheduleDomainCandidate.spend.DOMAIN_OWNER_KEY
    scalar_tac
  have hn : AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.note.val = 1095958531 := by
    unfold AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.note AspisR1ScheduleDomainCandidate.spend.DOMAIN_NOTE
    scalar_tac
  have hnull : AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.nullifier.val = 1095958530 := by
    unfold AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.nullifier AspisR1ScheduleDomainCandidate.spend.DOMAIN_NULLIFIER
    scalar_tac
  have h8 : (8#u32).val = 8 := by scalar_tac
  have h18 : (18#u32).val = 18 := by scalar_tac
  have h16 : (16#u32).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.scalarEmbedding_nat, ho, hn, hnull, h8, h18, h16, Nat.cast_ofNat, and_true]

theorem source_success (p : Registers QM)
    (hc : AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.canonicalRegisters p) :
    ∃ domain length,
      AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.run p.high0 p.high1 p.high25 p.high30 p.transfer = .ok (domain, length) ∧
      Canonical domain ∧ Canonical length ∧
      decode domain = domainModel (AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters p) ∧
      decode length = lengthModel (AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters p) := by
  rcases hc with ⟨_hc0, hc1, _hc25, hc30, _hcnodes, hct, _hcfixed, _hcEight, _hcTwo, _hclow, _hcfull, _hcrate⟩
  obtain ⟨domain, length, hrun, hcd, hcl, hvd, hvl⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ScheduleDomainArithmetic.source_success p.high0 p.high1 p.high25 p.high30 p.transfer hc1 hc30 hct
  rcases source_constant_embeddings with ⟨ho, hn, hnull, h8, h18, h16⟩
  refine ⟨domain, length, hrun, hcd, hcl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [domainModel, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, ho, hn, hnull] using hvd
  · simpa only [lengthModel, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, h8, h18, h16] using hvl

#print axioms source_constant_embeddings
#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.ScheduleDomainToModel

import InitialSelectorPrefix
import AbsorptionLiteralExecution

/-! Actual remaining absorption-selector source chain, with the same boxed
point and already-derived prefix registers. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AbsorptionSelectorSetup
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SumHighInnerLoop
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev Prefix := AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers QM
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

structure Registers (T : Type) where
  low : T
  fixed : T
  two : T
  eight : T
  nodes : T

def decodeRegisters (r : Registers QM) : Registers ExactQM where
  low := decode r.low
  fixed := decode r.fixed
  two := decode r.two
  eight := decode r.eight
  nodes := decode r.nodes

def canonicalRegisters (r : Registers QM) : Prop :=
  Canonical r.low ∧ Canonical r.fixed ∧ Canonical r.two ∧ Canonical r.eight ∧ Canonical r.nodes

def model {K : Type} [Field K] (v : R0P.Variant) (sel : R0P.Sel K) : Registers K :=
  let h := R0P.g2High sel
  let p := AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model v sel
  { low := R0P.g2Low sel 12, fixed := p.fixed,
    two := (h 3 + h 32) + p.privateTwo,
    eight := ((((((h 0 + h 1) + h 2) + h 25) + h 26) + h 30) + h 31) + p.privateEight,
    nodes := p.nodes }

def run (p : Prefix) (selectors : Selectors) : Result (Registers QM) := do
  let q28 ← field.QM31.add p.high0 p.high1
  let h2 ← Array.index_usize selectors.high 2#usize
  let q30 ← field.QM31.add q28 h2
  let q31 ← field.QM31.add q30 p.high25
  let h26 ← Array.index_usize selectors.high 26#usize
  let q33 ← field.QM31.add q31 h26
  let q34 ← field.QM31.add q33 p.high30
  let h31 ← Array.index_usize selectors.high 31#usize
  let eight ← field.QM31.add q34 h31
  let h3 ← Array.index_usize selectors.high 3#usize
  let h32 ← Array.index_usize selectors.high 32#usize
  let two ← field.QM31.add h3 h32
  let eight1 ← field.QM31.add eight p.privateEight
  let two1 ← field.QM31.add two p.privateTwo
  let low ← Array.index_usize selectors.low 12#usize
  .ok { low := low, fixed := p.fixed, two := two1, eight := eight1, nodes := p.nodes }

attribute [local irreducible] R0P.g2High R0P.g2Low R0P.g2SumHigh R0P.scheduleNodes

theorem source_success (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (v : R0P.Variant) (p : Prefix)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hc : AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.canonicalRegisters p)
    (hm : AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters p =
      AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model v (pointSelector point)) :
    ∃ out, run p selectors = .ok out ∧ canonicalRegisters out ∧
      decodeRegisters out = model v (pointSelector point) := by
  rcases hc with ⟨hc0, hc1, hc25, hc30, hcnodes, hct, hcfixed, hcEight, hcTwo, hclow0, hcfull, hcrate⟩
  obtain ⟨hhigh, hlow, hhighModel, hlowModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.boxed_marginals point selectors hpoint hbox
  have hp_high0 := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.high0 hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_high0
  have hp_high1 := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.high1 hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_high1
  have hp_high25 := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.high25 hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_high25
  have hp_high30 := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.high30 hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_high30
  have hp_nodes := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.nodes hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_nodes
  have hp_fixed := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.fixed hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_fixed
  have hp_privateEight := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.privateEight hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_privateEight
  have hp_privateTwo := congrArg AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.Registers.privateTwo hm
  simp only [AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.decodeRegisters, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model] at hp_privateTwo
  obtain ⟨h2, hr2, hc2, hv2⟩ := readHigh_success selectors 2#usize (by scalar_tac) hhigh
  have hn2 : (2#usize).val = 2 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hn2] at hv2
  have hm2 := hhighModel (2 : Fin 64)
  change highAt selectors 2 = R0P.g2High (pointSelector point) 2 at hm2
  have hd2 := hv2.trans hm2
  obtain ⟨h26, hr26, hc26, hv26⟩ := readHigh_success selectors 26#usize (by scalar_tac) hhigh
  have hn26 : (26#usize).val = 26 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hn26] at hv26
  have hm26 := hhighModel (26 : Fin 64)
  change highAt selectors 26 = R0P.g2High (pointSelector point) 26 at hm26
  have hd26 := hv26.trans hm26
  obtain ⟨h31, hr31, hc31, hv31⟩ := readHigh_success selectors 31#usize (by scalar_tac) hhigh
  have hn31 : (31#usize).val = 31 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hn31] at hv31
  have hm31 := hhighModel (31 : Fin 64)
  change highAt selectors 31 = R0P.g2High (pointSelector point) 31 at hm31
  have hd31 := hv31.trans hm31
  obtain ⟨h3, hr3, hc3, hv3⟩ := readHigh_success selectors 3#usize (by scalar_tac) hhigh
  have hn3 : (3#usize).val = 3 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hn3] at hv3
  have hm3 := hhighModel (3 : Fin 64)
  change highAt selectors 3 = R0P.g2High (pointSelector point) 3 at hm3
  have hd3 := hv3.trans hm3
  obtain ⟨h32, hr32, hc32, hv32⟩ := readHigh_success selectors 32#usize (by scalar_tac) hhigh
  have hn32 : (32#usize).val = 32 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hn32] at hv32
  have hm32 := hhighModel (32 : Fin 64)
  change highAt selectors 32 = R0P.g2High (pointSelector point) 32 at hm32
  have hd32 := hv32.trans hm32
  obtain ⟨q28, hrq28, hcq28, hvq28⟩ := current_qm_add_exact p.high0 p.high1 hc0 hc1
  obtain ⟨q30, hrq30, hcq30, hvq30⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q28 h2 hcq28 hc2
  obtain ⟨q31, hrq31, hcq31, hvq31⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q30 p.high25 hcq30 hc25
  obtain ⟨q33, hrq33, hcq33, hvq33⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q31 h26 hcq31 hc26
  obtain ⟨q34, hrq34, hcq34, hvq34⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q33 p.high30 hcq33 hc30
  obtain ⟨eight, hreight, hceight, hveight⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q34 h31 hcq34 hc31
  obtain ⟨two, hrtwo, hctwo, hvtwo⟩ := current_qm_add_exact h3 h32 hc3 hc32
  obtain ⟨eight1, hreight1, hceight1, hveight1⟩ := current_qm_add_exact eight p.privateEight hceight hcEight
  obtain ⟨two1, hrtwo1, hctwo1, hvtwo1⟩ := current_qm_add_exact two p.privateTwo hctwo hcTwo
  obtain ⟨low, hrlow, hclow, hvlow⟩ := AspisR1.PathSelectorPrefix.readLow_success selectors 12#usize (by scalar_tac) hlow
  have hn12 : (12#usize).val = 12 := by scalar_tac
  simp only [hn12] at hvlow
  have hmLow := hlowModel (12 : Fin 16)
  change AspisR1.PathSelectorPrefix.lowAt selectors 12 = R0P.g2Low (pointSelector point) 12 at hmLow
  have hdLow := hvlow.trans hmLow
  refine ⟨{ low := low, fixed := p.fixed, two := two1, eight := eight1, nodes := p.nodes }, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, hrq28, bind_tc_ok, hr2, hrq30, hrq31, hr26, hrq33, hrq34,
      hr31, hreight, hr3, hr32, hrtwo, hreight1, hrtwo1, hrlow]
  · exact ⟨hclow, hcfixed, hctwo1, hceight1, hcnodes⟩
  · simp only [decodeRegisters, model, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model]
    rw [hvtwo1, hveight1, hvtwo, hveight, hvq34, hvq33, hvq31, hvq30, hvq28,
      hp_high0, hp_high1, hp_high25, hp_high30, hp_nodes, hp_fixed,
      hp_privateEight, hp_privateTwo, hd2, hd26, hd31, hd3, hd32, hdLow]

#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.AbsorptionSelectorSetup
AbsorptionLiteralExecution:
import AbsorptionCallback
import ArrayFromFnCopyStable

/-! Execution and every output of the complete source absorption array,
reusing the existing stable-capture array loop theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AbsorptionLiteralExecution
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.AbsorptionCallback
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
abbrev source := AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.absorption_lanes_literal
abbrev callbackInst := AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.absorption_lanes_literal.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31

theorem source_success (low fixed two eight nodes : QM)
    (openings : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hl : Canonical low) (hf : Canonical fixed) (ht : Canonical two)
    (he : Canonical eight) (hn : Canonical nodes)
    (ho : ∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell openings i)) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 16#usize,
      source low fixed two eight nodes openings = .ok out ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 16, Canonical (sourceCell out i)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 16, decode (sourceCell out i) =
        R0P.scheduleAbsorptionLiteral (decode low) (decode fixed) (decode two)
          (decode eight) (decode nodes) (fun j => decode (sourceCell openings j)) i := by
  classical
  have hcallbacks : ∀ i : Fin 16, ∃ out,
      call (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings)
          (UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)) =
          .ok (out, (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings)) ∧ Canonical out ∧
        decode out = decode low *
          blocksModel (decode fixed) (decode two) (decode eight) (decode nodes) i.val *
          decode (sourceCell openings i) := by
    intro i
    let idx : Usize := UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac)
    have hidx : idx.val = i.val := by scalar_tac
    have hbound : idx.val < 16 := by rw [hidx]; exact i.isLt
    obtain ⟨out, hr, hc, hv⟩ := callback_success low fixed two eight nodes openings
      idx hbound hl hf ht he hn ho
    have hfin : (⟨idx.val, hbound⟩ : Fin 16) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      exact hidx
    rw [hfin, hidx] at hv
    exact ⟨out, hr, hc, hv⟩
  choose values hcall hcanonical hmodel using hcallbacks
  let value : Nat → QM := fun i => if hi : i < 16 then values ⟨i, hi⟩ else field.QM31.ZERO
  have hstable : ∀ i : Usize, i.val < (16#usize).val →
      callbackInst.call_mut (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings) i =
        .ok (value i.val, (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings)) := by
    intro i hi
    have h : i.val < 16 := by simpa using hi
    have heq : UScalar.ofNatCore i.val (by scalar_tac) = i := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      rfl
    have hc := hcall ⟨i.val, h⟩
    rw [heq] at hc
    simpa only [value, dif_pos h] using hc
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout⟩ := array_from_fn_copy_stable 16#usize
    field.QM31.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy callbackInst field.QM31.ZERO
    (fixed, two, eight, nodes, low, openings) value hstable
  have hcell : ∀ i : Fin 16, sourceCell out i = values i := by
    intro i
    have hi : i.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using i.isLt
    have hh := hout i.val hi
    simpa only [sourceCell, value, dif_pos i.isLt] using hh
  refine ⟨out, hrun, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [hcell]
    exact hcanonical i
  · intro i
    rw [hcell, hmodel]
    unfold R0P.scheduleAbsorptionLiteral blocksModel
    rfl

#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.AbsorptionLiteralExecution
ScheduleInitialModel:
import ScheduleDomainToModel
import AbsorptionSelectorSetup

/-! Generic identities between the source-program component models and the
retained schedule relation. These do not expand any selector sum or field. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ScheduleInitialModel
open AspisR1.ScheduleDomainToModel
variable {K : Type} [Field K]
attribute [local irreducible] R0P.g2High R0P.g2Low R0P.g2SumHigh R0P.scheduleNodes

def baseValue (p : Registers K) (z : Fin 16 → K) (i : Fin 16) : K :=
  (if i.val < 8 then p.full + p.rate else p.full) * z i

def initialValue (p : Registers K) (z : Fin 16 → K) (i : Fin 16) : K :=
  if i.val = 8 then baseValue p z i - p.low0 * domainModel p
  else if i.val = 9 then baseValue p z i - p.low0 * lengthModel p
  else baseValue p z i

theorem initialValue_eq_schedule (v : R0P.Variant) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) (i : Fin 16) :
    initialValue (AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model v sel) o.z i = R0P.scheduleInitial v o sel i := by
  have h8 : i = (8 : Fin 16) ↔ i.val = 8 := by
    constructor
    · intro h; subst i; rfl
    · intro h; apply Fin.ext; exact h
  have h9 : i = (9 : Fin 16) ↔ i.val = 9 := by
    constructor
    · intro h; subst i; rfl
    · intro h; apply Fin.ext; exact h
  cases v <;>
    dsimp only [initialValue, baseValue, domainModel, lengthModel,
      AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model, R0P.scheduleInitial, R0P.scheduleVariantSelectors] <;>
    simp only [h8, h9, ite_mul]

theorem absorptionValue_eq_schedule (v : R0P.Variant) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) (i : Fin 16) :
    let p := AspisR1.AbsorptionSelectorSetup.model v sel
    R0P.scheduleAbsorptionLiteral p.low p.fixed p.two p.eight p.nodes o.z i =
      R0P.scheduleAbsorption v o sel i := by
  cases v <;>
    dsimp only [AspisR1.AbsorptionSelectorSetup.model, AspisR1.InitialSelectorPrefix.model,
      R0P.scheduleAbsorption, R0P.scheduleVariantSelectors]

#print axioms initialValue_eq_schedule
#print axioms absorptionValue_eq_schedule
end AspisR1.ScheduleInitialModel
SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues:
import SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning
import R0P.Value

/-! Concrete zero-initialized composition of the three actual preprocessing
loops. The conclusion states each of the 30 populated cells against decoded
opening-array indices; the separate three-cell conservation tail is handled
by `ValueConservationTail`. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalArray {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a

def exactOpenings (openings : Openings) : R0P.Openings ExactQM where
  z := fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    (openings.z.val[i.val]'(by simpa [openings.z.property] using i.isLt))
  succ := fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    (openings.succ_z.val[i.val]'(by simpa [openings.succ_z.property] using i.isLt))
  xor12 := fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    (openings.xor12_z.val[i.val]'(by simpa [openings.xor12_z.property] using i.isLt))

private theorem zero_decode :
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode field.QM31.ZERO = (0 : ExactQM) := by
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode field.QM31.ZERO = (0 : ExactQM)
  ext <;> simp [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode, field.QM31.ZERO]

private theorem castAdd_value (i : Fin 10) : (i.castAdd 6).val = i.val := rfl

/-- Actual loop0/1/2 execution on the source zero range populates exactly the
three ten-cell model blocks. The theorem exposes every cell value without
unfolding the generated loops beyond the symbolic interval invariants. -/
theorem preprocessing_range_values
    (openings : Openings)
    (hopenZ : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hopenSucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z) :
    ∃ range1 range2 range3,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0
        openings (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize = .ok (openings, range1) ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1
        openings range1 0#usize = .ok (openings, range2) ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop2
        openings range2 0#usize = .ok (openings, range3) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 10,
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell range3 ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6) ^ 2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 10,
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell range3 ⟨10 + i.val, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6) ^ 2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 10,
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell range3 ⟨20 + i.val, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6) ^ 2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 33, 30 ≤ j.val →
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell range3 j = 0) := by
  let initial : Array QM 33#usize := Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  have hspan0 : (0#usize).val + 10 = 10 := rfl
  obtain ⟨range1, hrun0, h0first, h0rest⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.loop0_interval
      10 openings initial initial 0#usize hspan0
      (by intro j hj; omega)
      (by intro j hj; rfl) hopenZ
  obtain ⟨range2, hrun1, h1prefix, h1middle, h1rest⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.loop1_interval
      10 openings range1 range1 0#usize hspan0
      (by intro j hj; rfl)
      (by intro j hjlo hjhi; omega)
      (by intro j hj; rfl) hopenSucc
  obtain ⟨range3, hrun2, h2prefix, h2middle, h2rest⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.loop2_interval
      10 openings range2 range2 0#usize hspan0
      (by intro j hj; rfl)
      (by intro j hjlo hjhi; omega)
      (by intro j hj; rfl) hopenXor
  have hzrange : ∀ j : Fin 33,
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell initial j = 0 := by
    intro j
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
      ((List.replicate 33 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by
        simpa [initial, Array.repeat_val] using j.isLt)) = 0
    rw [List.getElem_replicate]
    exact zero_decode
  refine ⟨range1, range2, range3, hrun0, hrun1, hrun2, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    have hi : i.val < 10 := i.isLt
    let j : Fin 33 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
    have hj20 : j.val < 20 := by simpa [j] using Nat.lt_trans hi (by decide : 10 < 20)
    have h := h2prefix j hj20
    rw [h1prefix j hi] at h
    rw [h0first j hi] at h
    simpa [j, exactOpenings, castAdd_value,
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.squareMinus, pow_two] using h
  · intro i
    have hj : 10 + i.val < 20 := by omega
    let j : Fin 33 := ⟨10 + i.val, by omega⟩
    have h := h2prefix j (by simpa [j] using hj)
    rw [h1middle j (by simp [j]) (by simpa [j] using hj)] at h
    simpa [j, exactOpenings, castAdd_value,
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.squareMinus, pow_two] using h
  · intro i
    have hj : 20 + i.val < 30 := by omega
    let j : Fin 33 := ⟨20 + i.val, by omega⟩
    have h := h2middle j (by simp [j]) (by simpa [j] using hj)
    simpa [j, exactOpenings, castAdd_value,
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.squareMinus, pow_two] using h
  · intro j hj
    rw [h2rest j (by omega)]
    rw [h1rest j (by omega)]
    rw [h0rest j (by omega)]
    exact hzrange j

#print axioms preprocessing_range_values
end AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues
SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning:
import SelectorValueLanePreprocessExecution
import SelectorValueLanePreprocessReconstruct
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/-! Source-to-model meaning of the three preprocessing loops.  This file
states the finite interval invariant at array indices, so a later caller can
use the same Fin value in the semantic `castAdd 6` coordinates. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev Loop0 := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0
abbrev Loop1 := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1
abbrev Loop2 := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop2

def cell (a : Array QM 33#usize) (j : Fin 33) : ExactQM :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt))

def squareMinus (a : Array QM 16#usize) (j : Fin 10) : ExactQM :=
  let x := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    (a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using (by omega : j.val < 16)))
  x * x - x

private theorem cell_set_eq (a : Array QM 33#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 33) (j : Fin 33) (hij : j.val = i.val) :
    cell (a.set i x) j = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x := by
  have hget := Array.getElem_Nat_set_eq a i j.val x (by simpa using j.isLt) hij.symm
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode ((a.set i x)[j.val]) =
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x
  rw [hget]

private theorem cell_set_ne (a : Array QM 33#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (j : Fin 33) (hij : j.val ≠ i.val) : cell (a.set i x) j = cell a j := by
  have hget := Array.getElem_Nat_set_ne a i j.val x (by simpa using j.isLt) hij.symm
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode ((a.set i x)[j.val]) =
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (a[j.val])
  rw [hget]

private theorem square_sub_value (x : QM) (hx : Canonical x) :
    ∃ y : QM, field.QM31.square x = .ok y ∧ Canonical y ∧
      ∃ z : QM, field.QM31.sub y x = .ok z ∧ Canonical z ∧
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode z =
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x)^2 -
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x := by
  obtain ⟨y, hsq, hy, hsqval⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31SquareExact.current_qm_square_exact x hx
  obtain ⟨z, hsub, hz, hsubval⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact y x hy hx
  refine ⟨y, hsq, hy, z, hsub, hz, ?_⟩
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode y =
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x * AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x at hsqval
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode z =
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode y - AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x at hsubval
  rw [hsubval, hsqval, pow_two]

private theorem index16_get {a : Array QM 16#usize} {i : Usize}
    (hi : i.val < 10) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using (Nat.lt_trans hi (by decide)))) := by
  have h16 : i.val < 16 := Nat.lt_trans hi (by decide)
  have hb : i.val < a.length := by
    simpa [a.property] using h16
  obtain ⟨q, hread, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec a i hb)
  rw [hread]
  congr 1

/-- Loop 0's generated writes have the exact square-minus-input value on the
processed prefix and preserve the unprocessed suffix.  The `fuel` interval
starts at `index`; no concrete recurrence unrolling is used. -/
theorem loop0_interval
    (fuel : Nat) (openings : Openings)
    (initial range : Array QM 33#usize) (index : Usize)
    (hspan : index.val + fuel = 10)
    (hprefix : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : j.val < index.val),
      cell range j = squareMinus openings.z ⟨j.val, by omega⟩)
    (hsuffix : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : index.val ≤ j.val), cell range j = cell initial j)
    (hopen : CanonicalArray openings.z) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 33#usize,
      Loop0 openings range index = .ok (openings, out) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : j.val < 10), cell out j = squareMinus openings.z ⟨j.val, by omega⟩) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : 10 ≤ j.val), cell out j = cell initial j) := by
  induction fuel generalizing index range with
  | zero =>
      have hindex : index.val = 10 := by omega
      have hstop : ¬ index < 10#usize := by scalar_tac
      refine ⟨range, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0 openings range index = .ok (openings, range)
        rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0.eq_def]
        simp only [if_neg hstop]
      · intro j hj
        have hj' : j.val < index.val := by rw [hindex]; exact hj
        exact hprefix j hj'
      · intro j hj
        exact hsuffix j (by omega)
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hi : index.val < 10 := by omega
      have hlt : index < 10#usize := by scalar_tac
      have hread := index16_get (a := openings.z) hi
      have hq : Canonical (openings.z.val[index.val]'(by
          simpa [openings.z.property] using (by omega : index.val < 16))) := by
        exact hopen ⟨index.val, by simpa [openings.z.property] using (by omega : index.val < 16)⟩
      obtain ⟨q1, hsq, hq1, q2, hsub, hq2, hvalue⟩ :=
        square_sub_value _ hq
      obtain ⟨range1, hupdate, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (Array.update_spec range index q2 (by simpa [range.property] using (by omega : index.val < 33)))
      obtain ⟨index1, hadd, hindex1⟩ :=
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessExecution.increment_success index hi
      have hprefix1 : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : j.val < index1.val),
          cell range1 j = squareMinus openings.z ⟨j.val, by omega⟩ := by
        intro j hj
        have hj10 : j.val < 10 := by rw [hindex1] at hj; omega
        by_cases hji : j.val = index.val
        · rw [hset]
          rw [cell_set_eq range index q2 (by omega) j hji]
          simpa [squareMinus, hji, pow_two] using hvalue
        · have hjlt : j.val < index.val := by omega
          rw [hset]
          rw [cell_set_ne range index q2 j hji]
          exact hprefix j hjlt
      have hsuffix1 : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : index1.val ≤ j.val), cell range1 j = cell initial j := by
        intro j hj
        have hnot : j.val ≠ index.val := by
          intro heq
          rw [heq, hindex1] at hj
          omega
        rw [hset]
        rw [cell_set_ne range index q2 j hnot]
        exact hsuffix j (by omega)
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hfinalPre, hfinalPost⟩ :=
        ih range1 index1 (by omega) hprefix1 hsuffix1
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hfinalPre, hfinalPost⟩
      change pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0 openings range index = .ok (openings, out)
      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0.eq_def]
      simp only [if_pos hlt, hread, hsq, hsub, hupdate, bind_tc_ok]
      change (do
        let index1 ← UScalar.add index 1#usize
        pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0 openings range1 index1) =
        .ok (openings, out)
      rw [hadd, bind_tc_ok]
      exact hrun

/-- Loop 1 writes the second ten-cell block, preserving the first block and
the suffix while assigning the same square-minus-input expression. -/
theorem loop1_interval
    (fuel : Nat) (openings : Openings)
    (initial range : Array QM 33#usize) (index : Usize)
    (hspan : index.val + fuel = 10)
    (hprefix : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : j.val < 10), cell range j = cell initial j)
    (hprocessed : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hlo : 10 ≤ j.val) (hhi : j.val < 10 + index.val),
      cell range j = squareMinus openings.succ_z ⟨j.val - 10, by omega⟩)
    (hsuffix : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : 10 + index.val ≤ j.val), cell range j = cell initial j)
    (hopen : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 33#usize,
      Loop1 openings range index = .ok (openings, out) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : j.val < 10), cell out j = cell initial j) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin 33) (hlo : 10 ≤ j.val) (hhi : j.val < 20),
        cell out j = squareMinus openings.succ_z ⟨j.val - 10, by omega⟩) ∧
      (∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : 20 ≤ j.val), cell out j = cell initial j) := by
  -- The induction mirrors `loop0_interval`; source destination is `10 + index`.
  -- Detailed body is kept explicit so the generated checked offset is visible.
  induction fuel generalizing index range with
  | zero =>
      have hindex : index.val = 10 := by omega
      have hstop : ¬ index < 10#usize := by scalar_tac
      refine ⟨range, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · change pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1 openings range index = .ok (openings, range)
        rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1.eq_def]
        simp only [if_neg hstop]
      · intro j hj; exact hprefix j hj
      · intro j hj1 hj2
        have hj2' : j.val < 10 + index.val := by rw [hindex]; exact hj2
        exact hprocessed j hj1 hj2'
      · intro j hj
        have hj' : 10 + index.val ≤ j.val := by rw [hindex]; exact hj
        exact hsuffix j hj' 
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hi : index.val < 10 := by omega
      have hlt : index < 10#usize := by scalar_tac

      have hq : Canonical (openings.succ_z.val[index.val]'(by

        exact hopen ⟨index.val, by simpa [openings.succ_z.property] using (by omega : index.val < 16)⟩
      obtain ⟨q1, hsq, hq1, q2, hsub, hq2, hvalue⟩ :=
        square_sub_value _ hq
      have haddOffsetSpec : (10#usize + index : Result Usize)
          ⦃ dest => dest.val = 10 + index.val ⦄ := by
        apply UScalar.add_spec
        scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨dest, hoffset, hdest⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists haddOffsetSpec
      obtain ⟨range1, hupdate, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (Array.update_spec range dest q2 (by

        intro j hj

        rw [cell_set_ne range dest q2 j (by rw [hdest]; omega)]

      have hprocessed1 : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hjlo : 10 ≤ j.val) (hjhi : j.val < 10 + index1.val),
          cell range1 j = squareMinus openings.succ_z ⟨j.val - 10, by omega⟩ := by
        intro j hjlo hjhi
        have hj10 : j.val - 10 < 10 := by rw [hindex1] at hjhi; omega
        by_cases hji : j.val = dest.val
        · rw [hset]
          rw [cell_set_eq range dest q2 (by omega) j hji]
          have hjindex : j.val - 10 = index.val := by rw [hji, hdest]; omega
          simpa [squareMinus, hjindex, pow_two] using hvalue
        · have hjold : j.val < 10 + index.val := by omega
          rw [hset]
          rw [cell_set_ne range dest q2 j hji]
          exact hprocessed j hjlo hjold
      have hsuffix1 : ∀ (j : Fin 33) (hj : 10 + index1.val ≤ j.val),

        intro j hj
        have hji : j.val ≠ dest.val := by
          intro heq
          rw [heq, hdest, hindex1] at hj
          omega
        rw [hset]
        rw [cell_set_ne range dest q2 j hji]
        exact hsuffix j (by omega)
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hfinalPrefix, hfinalProcessed, hfinalSuffix⟩ :=
        ih range1 index1 (by omega) hprefix1 hprocessed1 hsuffix1
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hfinalPrefix, hfinalProcessed, hfinalSuffix⟩
      change pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1 openings range index = .ok (openings, out)
      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1.eq_def]
      simp only [if_pos hlt, hread, hsq, hsub, hoffset, hupdate, bind_tc_ok]
      change (do
        let index1 ← UScalar.add index 1#usize
        pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1 openings range1 index1) =
        .ok (openings, out)
      rw [hadd, bind_tc_ok]
      exact hrun

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {N : Usize}
    (a : Array α N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem index10_usize_ok {α : Type} {N : Usize}
    (a : Array α N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) :=
  index_usize_ok a i hi

theorem increment_success (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 10) :
    ∃ i1 : Usize, UScalar.add i 1#usize = .ok i1 ∧ i1.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have hspec : (i + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ z => z.val = i.val + 1 ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i1, hrun, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
  change UScalar.add i 1#usize = .ok i1 at hrun
  exact ⟨i1, hrun, hval⟩

    (fuel : Nat) (openings : Openings) (range : Array QM 33#usize)

  induction fuel generalizing index range with

      refine ⟨openings, range, ?_, rfl⟩

      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0.eq_def]
      simp only [if_neg hstop]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hindex : index.val < 10 := by omega
      have hlt : index < 10#usize := by scalar_tac
      have hindex16 : index.val < 16 := Nat.lt_trans hindex (by decide)
      have hread : Array.index_usize openings.z index =
          .ok (openings.z.val[index.val]'(by simpa [openings.z.property] using
            hindex16)) :=
        index_usize_ok openings.z index hindex16
      have hq : Canonical (openings.z.val[index.val]'(by

        hopen ⟨index.val, by simpa [openings.z.property] using

      obtain ⟨q1, hsq, hq1, _hsqv⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31SquareExact.current_qm_square_exact
          (openings.z.val[index.val]'(by simpa [openings.z.property] using
            hindex16)) hq
      obtain ⟨q2, hsub, _hq2, _hsubv⟩ :=
        AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact q1
          (openings.z.val[index.val]'(by simpa [openings.z.property] using
            hindex16)) hq1 hq
      obtain ⟨range1, hupdate, _hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
        (Array.update_spec range index q2 (by
          have hb : index.val < 33 := by omega
          simpa [range.property] using hb))
      obtain ⟨index1, hadd, hindex1⟩ := increment_success index hindex
      obtain ⟨outOpen, outRange, hrun, hopenOut⟩ :=
        ih range1 index1 (by omega)
      refine ⟨outOpen, outRange, ?_, hopenOut⟩

      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0.eq_def]

        .ok (outOpen, outRange)
      rw [hadd, bind_tc_ok]
      exact hrun

/-- The actual sequence of three generated loops succeeds from zero and
preserves the opening record, while deriving the final range canonicality. -/
theorem preprocessing_success_canonical
    (openings : Openings)
    (hopenZ : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hopenSucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z) :
    ∃ openings3 range1 range2 range3,
      Loop0 openings (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize =
        .ok (openings3, range1) ∧
      Loop1 openings3 range1 0#usize = .ok (openings3, range2) ∧
      Loop2 openings3 range2 0#usize = .ok (openings3, range3) ∧
      openings3 = openings ∧ CanonicalArray range3 := by
  have hzeroIndex : (0#usize).val = 0 := by rfl
  have hspan0 : (0#usize).val + 10 = 10 := by rw [hzeroIndex]
  obtain ⟨openings1, range1, h0, ho1⟩ :=
    loop0_success_fuel 10 openings (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO)
      0#usize hspan0 hopenZ
  have h0' : Loop0 openings (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize =
      .ok (openings, range1) := by simpa [ho1] using h0
  obtain ⟨openings2, range2, h1, ho2⟩ :=
    loop1_success_fuel 10 openings range1 0#usize hspan0 hopenSucc
  have h1' : Loop1 openings1 range1 0#usize = .ok (openings2, range2) := by
    simpa [ho1] using h1
  have h1'' : Loop1 openings range1 0#usize = .ok (openings, range2) := by
    simpa [ho2] using h1
  obtain ⟨openings3, range3, h2, ho3⟩ :=
    loop2_success_fuel 10 openings range2 0#usize hspan0 hopenXor
  have h2' : Loop2 openings2 range2 0#usize = .ok (openings3, range3) := by
    simpa [ho2] using h2
  have h2'' : Loop2 openings range2 0#usize = .ok (openings, range3) := by
    simpa [ho3] using h2
  have hzero : CanonicalArray (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO) :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessZeroInit.zero_range_canonical

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

private def cellAt (view : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Nat) : QM :=
  if h : i < 16 then view.val[i]'(by simpa [view.property] using h)
  else field.QM31.ZERO

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem sub_one_success (i : Usize) (hi : 0 < i.val) :
    ∃ i1 : Usize, UScalar.sub i 1#usize = .ok i1 ∧ i1.val = i.val - 1 := by
  have hle : (1#usize).val ≤ i.val := by
    norm_num
    omega
  obtain ⟨i1, hrun, hval⟩ := sub_success i 1#usize hle
  exact ⟨i1, hrun, by simpa using hval⟩

/-- The generated loop at index `n` always succeeds on canonical inputs and
refines the checked symbolic recurrence. -/
theorem reconstruct_10_loop_success
    (view : Array QM 16#usize) (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (acc : QM)
    (hi : i.val = n) (hn : n ≤ 9)
    (hacc : Canonical acc)
    (hview : ∀ j, j ≤ 9 → Canonical (cellAt view j)) :
    ∃ out, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10_loop
      view acc i = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧ decode out =
        AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexModel.reconstructIndexed
          (fun j => decode (cellAt view j)) n (decode acc) := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i acc with
  | h n ih =>
      by_cases hpositive : 0 < n
      · have hgt : i > 0#usize := by
          change (0#usize : Usize) < i
          rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]
          simpa [hi] using hpositive
        obtain ⟨i1, hsub, hsubVal⟩ := sub_one_success i (by simpa [hi] using hpositive)
        have hreadBound : i1.val < 16 := by omega
        have hread : Array.index_usize view i1 =
            .ok (view.val[i1.val]'(by simpa [view.property] using hreadBound)) :=
          index_usize_ok view i1 hreadBound
        let q := cellAt view i1.val
        have hqEq : q = view.val[i1.val]'(by simpa [view.property] using hreadBound) := by
          simp [q, cellAt, hreadBound]
        have hreadQ : Array.index_usize view i1 = .ok q := by
          rw [hread, ← hqEq]
        have hq : Canonical q := by
          simpa [q] using hview i1.val (by omega)
        obtain ⟨double, hdoubleRun, hdoubleCan, hdoubleDec⟩ :=
          current_qm_add_exact acc acc hacc hacc
        obtain ⟨sum, hsumRun, hsumCan, hsumDec⟩ :=
          current_qm_add_exact double q hdoubleCan hq
        have hn1 : n - 1 < n := by omega
        have hi1 : i1.val = n - 1 := by omega
        obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanon, hdecode⟩ :=
          ih (n - 1) hn1 i1 sum hi1 (by omega) hsumCan
        refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanon, ?_⟩
        · rw [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10_loop.eq_def]
          simp only [if_pos hgt]
          change (do
            let i1 ← UScalar.sub i 1#usize
            let q ← field.QM31.add acc acc
            let q1 ← view.index_usize i1
            let acc1 ← field.QM31.add q q1
            AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10_loop
              view acc1 i1) = .ok out
          have hreadQ' : view.index_usize i1 = .ok q := by
            change Array.index_usize view i1 = .ok q
            exact hreadQ
          simp only [hsub, bind_tc_ok, hdoubleRun, bind_tc_ok,
            hreadQ', bind_tc_ok, hsumRun, bind_tc_ok]
          exact hrun
        · calc
            decode out = reconstructIndexed (fun j => decode (cellAt view j)) (n - 1) (decode sum) := hdecode
            _ = reconstructIndexed (fun j => decode (cellAt view j)) ((n - 1) + 1)
                  (decode acc) := by
                  rw [hsumDec, hdoubleDec]
                  have hqDecode : decode q = decode (cellAt view (n - 1)) := by
                    have hcell : n - 1 < 16 := by omega
                    simp [q, hi1, cellAt, hcell]
                  rw [hqDecode]
                  rfl
            _ = reconstructIndexed (fun j => decode (cellAt view j)) n (decode acc) := by
                  have hidx : (n - 1) + 1 = n := by omega
                  rw [hidx]
      · have hn0 : n = 0 := by omega
        have hnot : ¬ i > 0#usize := by
          change ¬ (0#usize : Usize) < i
          rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]
          simp [hi, hn0]
        refine ⟨acc, ?_, hacc, ?_⟩
        · rw [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10_loop.eq_def]
          simp only [if_neg hnot]
        · simp [AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexModel.reconstructIndexed, hn0]

/-- The generated wrapper reads cell 9 and invokes the generated loop at 9;
this yields the retained ten-cell value reconstruction theorem. -/
theorem reconstruct_10_success
    (view : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hcanonical : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray view) :
    ∃ out, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10
      view = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧ decode out =
      R0P.valueReconstruct10
        (fun i : Fin 16 => decode (view.val[i.val]'(by
          simpa [view.property] using i.isLt))) := by
  have hread := index_usize_ok view 9#usize (by decide)
  have hacc : Canonical (view.val[9]'(by simpa [view.property] using show 9 < 16 by decide)) :=
    hcanonical ⟨9, by simpa [view.property] using (show 9 < 16 by decide)⟩
  have hview : ∀ j, j ≤ 9 → Canonical (cellAt view j) := by
    intro j hj
    have hj16 : j < 16 := by omega
    have hcell := hcanonical ⟨j, by simpa [view.property] using hj16⟩
    simpa [cellAt, hj16] using hcell
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtCanonical, hdecode⟩ :=
    reconstruct_10_loop_success view 9 9#usize
      (view.val[9]'(by simpa [view.property] using show 9 < 16 by decide)) rfl
      (by omega) hacc hview
  refine ⟨out, ?_, houtCanonical, ?_⟩
  · rw [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10]
    simp only [hread, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hrun
  · calc
      decode out = reconstructIndexed (fun j => decode (cellAt view j)) 9
          (decode (view.val[9]'(by simpa [view.property] using show 9 < 16 by decide))) := hdecode
      _ = R0P.valueReconstruct10
          (fun i : Fin 16 => decode (view.val[i.val]'(by
            simpa [view.property] using i.isLt))) := by
            simpa [cellAt] using reconstructIndexed_nine_eq_valueReconstruct10
              (fun i : Nat => decode (cellAt view i))

#print axioms reconstruct_10_loop_success
#print axioms reconstruct_10_success
end AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexedSource

/-! A symbolic success/canonicality invariant for the candidate reverse-index
loop, using the exact checked QM31 addition contract at every step. -/

namespace AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexedCanonical

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM

def checkedReconstructIndexed (view : Nat → QM) : Nat → QM → Result QM
  | 0, acc => .ok acc
  | n + 1, acc => do
      let doubled ← field.QM31.add acc acc
      let next ← field.QM31.add doubled (view n)
      checkedReconstructIndexed view n next

theorem checkedReconstructIndexed_success_canonical
    (view : Nat → QM) (n : Nat) (acc out : QM)
    (hacc : Canonical acc)
    (hview : ∀ i, i < n → Canonical (view i))
    (hrun : checkedReconstructIndexed view n acc = .ok out) :
    Canonical out ∧
    decode out =
      AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexModel.reconstructIndexed
        (fun i => decode (view i)) n (decode acc) := by
  induction n generalizing acc out with
  | zero =>
      have hEq : acc = out := by simpa [checkedReconstructIndexed] using hrun
      subst out
      exact ⟨hacc, rfl⟩
  | succ n ih =>
      have hbit : Canonical (view n) := hview n (by omega)
      obtain ⟨doubled, hdoubleRun, hdoubleCanonical, hdoubleDecode⟩ :=
        current_qm_add_exact acc acc hacc hacc
      obtain ⟨next, hnextRun, hnextCanonical, hnextDecode⟩ :=
        current_qm_add_exact doubled (view n) hdoubleCanonical hbit
      have hrun' := hrun
      change (do
        let doubled' ← field.QM31.add acc acc
        let next' ← field.QM31.add doubled' (view n)
        checkedReconstructIndexed view n next') = .ok out at hrun'
      simp only [hdoubleRun, bind_tc_ok, hnextRun, bind_tc_ok] at hrun'
      obtain ⟨houtCanonical, houtDecode⟩ :=
        ih next out hnextCanonical (by intro i hi; exact hview i (by omega)) hrun' 
      refine ⟨houtCanonical, ?_⟩
      calc
        decode out =
            AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexModel.reconstructIndexed
              (fun i => decode (view i)) n (decode next) := houtDecode
        _ = AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexModel.reconstructIndexed
              (fun i => decode (view i)) n
                (decode acc + decode acc + decode (view n)) := by
              rw [hnextDecode, hdoubleDecode]
        _ = AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexModel.reconstructIndexed
              (fun i => decode (view i)) (n + 1) (decode acc) := rfl
