/-- Concatenation preserves the original coordinates of each finite vector. -/
def appendVector {K : Type} {n m : Nat} (a : Fin n → K) (b : Fin m → K) : Fin (n+m) → K :=
  fun i => if h : i.val < n then a ⟨i.val, h⟩ else b ⟨i.val-n, by omega⟩

def selectVector {K : Type} [Zero K] {n : Nat}
    (start : Nat) (a : Fin n → K) (index : Nat) : K :=
  if h : start ≤ index ∧ index < start+n then a ⟨index-start, by omega⟩ else 0

theorem selectVector_append {K : Type} [AddZeroClass K] {n m : Nat}
    (start index : Nat) (a : Fin n → K) (b : Fin m → K) :
    selectVector start (appendVector a b) index =
      selectVector start a index + selectVector (start+n) b index := by
  by_cases hbefore : index < start
  · unfold selectVector
    rw [dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega), zero_add]
  · by_cases hfirst : index < start+n
    · unfold selectVector
      rw [dif_pos (by omega), dif_pos (by omega), dif_neg (by omega), add_zero]
      unfold appendVector
      rw [dif_pos (by change index-start < n; omega)]
    · by_cases hsecond : index < start+(n+m)
      · unfold selectVector
        rw [dif_pos (by omega), dif_neg (by omega), dif_pos (by omega), zero_add]
        unfold appendVector
        rw [dif_neg (by change ¬ index-start < n; omega)]
        congr 1
        apply Fin.ext
        change (index-start)-n = index-(start+n)
        omega
      · unfold selectVector
        rw [dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega), dif_neg (by omega), zero_add]

theorem pack4_selectVector_append {K : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}
    (B : R0P.PackBasis F) {n m : Nat} (start group : Nat)
    (a : Fin n → K) (b : Fin m → K) :
    R0P.pack4 B (fun j => selectVector start (appendVector a b) (4*group+j.val)) =
      R0P.pack4 B (fun j => selectVector start a (4*group+j.val)) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun j => selectVector (start+n) b (4*group+j.val)) := by
  rw [← AspisR1.ValueLanePackedComposition.pack_add]
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact selectVector_append start (4*group+j.val) a b

#print axioms selectVector_append
#print axioms pack4_selectVector_append

  have hb : decode (cell openings.z bitIndex) = (exactOpenings openings).z 0 := rfl
  have hs : read16 openings.succ_z (8 + i.val) = (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.natAdd 8) :=

  have hz : read16 openings.z (1 + i.val) =
      (exactOpenings openings).z (i.addNat 1 |>.castLE (by omega)) := by
    have hindex : ((i.addNat 1 |>.castLE (by omega)) : Fin 16).val = 1 + i.val := by
      change i.val + 1 = 1 + i.val

    simpa only [hindex] using read_z openings (i.addNat 1 |>.castLE (by omega))

    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]

def bitIndex : Fin (16#usize).val := ⟨0, by scalar_tac⟩

private theorem index_ok {α : Type} {N : Usize}
    (a : Array α N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

def runPrefix (selector : QM) (openings : Openings) : Result (QM × Array QM 17#usize) := do
  let bit ← Array.index_usize openings.z 0#usize
  let residual ← AspisR1.PathLaneArithmetic.booleanResidual selector bit
  let path ← Array.update (Array.repeat 17#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize residual
  .ok (bit, path)

    AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal
      selector openings = (do
        let (bit, path) ← runPrefix selector openings
        AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop
          { start := 0#usize, «end» := AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS }
          selector openings.z openings.succ_z bit path) := by
  simp only [AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal,
    runPrefix, AspisR1.PathLaneArithmetic.booleanResidual, bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

private theorem set_canonical {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjOld : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hjOld := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

    (hs : Canonical selector) (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z) :
    ∃ bit path, runPrefix selector openings = .ok (bit, path) ∧
      bit = cell openings.z bitIndex ∧ Canonical bit ∧ CanonicalArray path ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 17, decode (cell path j) =
        if j.val = 0 then decode selector * (decode bit * (decode bit - 1)) else 0 := by
  let bit := cell openings.z bitIndex
  have hb : Canonical bit := hz bitIndex
  have hread : Array.index_usize openings.z 0#usize = .ok bit := by
    have hzeroVal : (0#usize).val = 0 := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [bit, cell, bitIndex, hzeroVal] using
      index_ok openings.z 0#usize (by scalar_tac)
  obtain ⟨residual, hresidual, hcresidual, hvresidual⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PathLaneArithmetic.booleanResidual_success selector bit hs hb
  let zero := Array.repeat 17#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  have hzero : CanonicalArray zero := by
    intro j
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
      ((List.replicate 17 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by
        simpa [Array.repeat_val] using j.isLt))
    rw [List.getElem_replicate]
    exact zero_canonical
  obtain ⟨path, hwrite, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec zero 0#usize residual (by simp [zero, Array.repeat]))
  have hcanonical : CanonicalArray path := by
    rw [hset]
    exact set_canonical zero 0#usize residual hzero hcresidual
  refine ⟨bit, path, ?_, rfl, hb, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  · change Array.update (Array.repeat 17#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize residual = .ok path at hwrite
    simp only [runPrefix, hread, bind_tc_ok, hresidual, hwrite]
  · intro j
    rw [hset]
    by_cases hj : j.val = 0
    · have hself : cell (zero.set 0#usize residual) j = residual := by
        simp [cell, Array.set_val_eq, hj]
      rw [hself, if_pos hj]
      exact hvresidual
    · have hframe : cell (zero.set 0#usize residual) j = cell zero j := by
        simp [cell, Array.set_val_eq, List.getElem_set_ne, Ne.symm hj]
      rw [hframe, if_neg hj]
      have hzj : cell zero j = field.QM31.ZERO := by
        change (List.replicate 17 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by
          simpa [Array.repeat_val] using j.isLt) = field.QM31.ZERO
        rw [List.getElem_replicate]
      rw [hzj, zero_decode]

#print axioms generated_wrapper_eq
#print axioms prefix_success
end

PathLaneSourceStep:
import PathLaneGeneratedSlice
import PathLaneArithmetic
import PreweightedGroupUpdate

/-! The literal path loop's actual checked reads, arithmetic and two writes.
The source loop factors through this step by a definitional theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathLaneSourceStep
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

def cell {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Fin N.val) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

def runStep (lane : Usize) (selector : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize)
    (bit : QM) (path : Array QM 17#usize) : Result (Array QM 17#usize) := do
  let i ← 1#usize + lane
  let current ← Array.index_usize a i
  let q ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE bit
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul selector q
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize a1 lane
  let q3 ← field.QM31.sub q2 current
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul q1 q3
  let path1 ← Array.update path i q4
  let q5 ← field.QM31.mul selector bit
  let i1 ← AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.poseidon2.RATE + lane
  let q6 ← Array.index_usize a1 i1
  let q7 ← field.QM31.sub q6 current
  let q8 ← field.QM31.mul q5 q7
  let i2 ← 1#usize + AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS
  let i3 ← i2 + lane
  Array.update path1 i3 q8

theorem generated_loop_step
    (iter : core.ops.range.Range Usize) (selector : QM)
    (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize) (bit : QM) (path : Array QM 17#usize) :
    AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop
      iter selector a a1 bit path = (do
        let (o, iter1) ← core.iter.range.IteratorRange.next core.iter.range.StepUsize iter
        match o with
        | none => .ok path
        | some lane =>
          let path1 ← runStep lane selector a a1 bit path
          AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop
            iter1 selector a a1 bit path1) := by
  rw [AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop.eq_def]
  simp only [runStep, bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

private theorem index_ok {α : Type} {N : Usize}
    (a : Array α N) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem set_canonical {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjOld : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hjOld := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem cell_set {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (j : Fin N.val) :
    cell (a.set i x) j = if j.val = i.val then x else cell a j := by
  unfold cell
  by_cases heq : j.val = i.val
  · simp [heq, Array.set_val_eq]
  · have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := Ne.symm heq
    simp [Array.set_val_eq, List.getElem_set_ne, hne, heq]

theorem runStep_success
    (lane : Usize) (selector : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize)
    (bit : QM) (path : Array QM 17#usize)
    (hlane : lane.val < 8) (hs : Canonical selector) (hb : Canonical bit)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (ha1 : CanonicalArray a1) (hp : CanonicalArray path) :
    ∃ out, runStep lane selector a a1 bit path = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 17, decode (cell out j) =
        if j.val = 1 + lane.val then
          decode selector * (1 - decode bit) *
            (decode (cell a1 ⟨lane.val, by change lane.val < 16; omega⟩) -
              decode (cell a ⟨1 + lane.val, by change 1 + lane.val < 16; omega⟩))
        else if j.val = 9 + lane.val then
          decode selector * decode bit *
            (decode (cell a1 ⟨8 + lane.val, by change 8 + lane.val < 16; omega⟩) -
              decode (cell a ⟨1 + lane.val, by change 1 + lane.val < 16; omega⟩))
        else decode (cell path j) := by
  have hs1 : (1#usize + lane : Result Usize) ⦃ r => r.val = 1 + lane.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  have hs8 : (8#usize + lane : Result Usize) ⦃ r => r.val = 8 + lane.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  have hs9 : (9#usize + lane : Result Usize) ⦃ r => r.val = 9 + lane.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hiv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs1
  obtain ⟨i1, hi1, hi1v⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs8
  obtain ⟨i3, hi3, hi3v⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs9
  have hadd18 : (1#usize + 8#usize : Result Usize) = .ok 9#usize := by
    have hspec : (1#usize + 8#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ r => r.val = 9 ⦄ := by
      apply UScalar.add_spec
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨r, hr, hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
    have heq : r = 9#usize := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq; simpa using hv
    simpa only [heq] using hr
  have hib : i.val < 16 := by omega
  have hi1b : i1.val < 16 := by omega
  let current := cell a ⟨i.val, by change i.val < 16; exact hib⟩
  let left := cell a1 ⟨lane.val, by change lane.val < 16; omega⟩
  let right := cell a1 ⟨i1.val, by change i1.val < 16; exact hi1b⟩
  have hcurrent : Canonical current := ha ⟨i.val, by simpa [a.property] using hib⟩
  have hleft : Canonical left := ha1 ⟨lane.val, by simpa [a1.property] using (show lane.val < 16 by omega)⟩
  have hright : Canonical right := ha1 ⟨i1.val, by simpa [a1.property] using hi1b⟩
  have hreadCurrent : Array.index_usize a i = .ok current := index_ok a i (by simpa using hib)
  have hreadLeft : Array.index_usize a1 lane = .ok left := index_ok a1 lane (by change lane.val < 16; omega)
  have hreadRight : Array.index_usize a1 i1 = .ok right := index_ok a1 i1 (by simpa using hi1b)
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hcq, hvq⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact field.QM31.ONE bit one_canonical hb
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hcq1, hvq1⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector q hs hcq
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, hcq3, hvq3⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact left current hleft hcurrent
  obtain ⟨q4, hq4, hcq4, hvq4⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact q1 q3 hcq1 hcq3
  obtain ⟨path1, hwrite1, hset1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec path i q4 (by simpa [path.property] using (show i.val < 17 by omega)))
  have hcpath1 : CanonicalArray path1 := by rw [hset1]; exact set_canonical path i q4 hp hcq4
  obtain ⟨q5, hq5, hcq5, hvq5⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector bit hs hb
  obtain ⟨q7, hq7, hcq7, hvq7⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact right current hright hcurrent
  obtain ⟨q8, hq8, hcq8, hvq8⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact q5 q7 hcq5 hcq7
  obtain ⟨out, hwrite2, hset2⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec path1 i3 q8 (by simpa [path1.property] using (show i3.val < 17 by omega)))
  have hcout : CanonicalArray out := by rw [hset2]; exact set_canonical path1 i3 q8 hcpath1 hcq8
  have hleftValue : decode q4 = decode selector * (1 - decode bit) * (decode left - decode current) := by
    change decode q = decode field.QM31.ONE - decode bit at hvq
    change decode q3 = decode left - decode current at hvq3
    rw [hvq4, hvq1, hvq, one_decode, hvq3]
  have hrightValue : decode q8 = decode selector * decode bit * (decode right - decode current) := by
    change decode q7 = decode right - decode current at hvq7
    rw [hvq8, hvq5, hvq7]
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcout, ?_⟩
  · simp only [runStep, AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.poseidon2.RATE, AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS, hi,
      bind_tc_ok, hreadCurrent, hq, hq1, hreadLeft, hq3, hq4, hwrite1,
      hq5, hi1, hreadRight, hq7, hq8, hadd18, hi3, hwrite2]
  · intro j
    rw [hset2, cell_set, hset1, cell_set]
    have hneq : i.val ≠ i3.val := by omega
    by_cases hj : j.val = i.val
    · have hj3 : j.val ≠ i3.val := by omega
      have hji : j.val = 1 + lane.val := by omega
      simp only [if_pos hj, if_neg hj3, if_pos hji]
      simpa only [hiv, hi1v, current, left, cell] using hleftValue
    · by_cases hj3 : j.val = i3.val
      · have hji : j.val ≠ 1 + lane.val := by omega
        have hji3 : j.val = 9 + lane.val := by omega
        simp only [if_neg hj, if_pos hj3, if_neg hji, if_pos hji3]
        simpa only [hiv, hi1v, hi3v, current, right, cell] using hrightValue
      · have hji : j.val ≠ 1 + lane.val := by omega
        have hji3 : j.val ≠ 9 + lane.val := by omega
        simp only [if_neg hj, if_neg hj3, if_neg hji, if_neg hji3]

#print axioms generated_loop_step
#print axioms runStep_success
end
end AspisR1.PathLaneSourceStep

import EqualityValueAdapter
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import ExtractedMaskConstants

/-! The literal path constraints' checked operation chains. These lemmas
retain the exact association and source calls; neither field success nor a
residual equality is supplied as a premise. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathLaneArithmetic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM

def booleanResidual (selector bit : QM) : Result QM := do
  let q ← field.QM31.sub bit field.QM31.ONE
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul bit q
  field.QM31.mul selector q1

def pathPair (selector bit current left right : QM) : Result (QM × QM) := do
  let q ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE bit
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul selector q
  let q3 ← field.QM31.sub left current
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul q1 q3
  let q5 ← field.QM31.mul selector bit
  let q7 ← field.QM31.sub right current
  let q8 ← field.QM31.mul q5 q7
  .ok (q4, q8)

theorem booleanResidual_success (selector bit : QM)
    (hs : Canonical selector) (hb : Canonical bit) :
    ∃ out, booleanResidual selector bit = .ok out ∧ Canonical out ∧
      decode out = decode selector * (decode bit * (decode bit - 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hcq, hvq⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact bit field.QM31.ONE hb one_canonical
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hcq1, hvq1⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact bit q hb hcq
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hcout, hvout⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector q1 hs hcq1
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcout, ?_⟩
  · simp only [booleanResidual, hq, bind_tc_ok, hq1, hout]
  · change decode q = decode bit - decode field.QM31.ONE at hvq
    rw [hvout, hvq1, hvq, one_decode]

theorem pathPair_success (selector bit current left right : QM)
    (hs : Canonical selector) (hb : Canonical bit)
    (hc : Canonical current) (hl : Canonical left) (hr : Canonical right) :
    ∃ outLeft outRight,
      pathPair selector bit current left right = .ok (outLeft, outRight) ∧
      Canonical outLeft ∧ Canonical outRight ∧
      decode outLeft = decode selector * (1 - decode bit) * (decode left - decode current) ∧
      decode outRight = decode selector * decode bit * (decode right - decode current) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hcq, hvq⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact field.QM31.ONE bit one_canonical hb
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hcq1, hvq1⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector q hs hcq
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, hcq3, hvq3⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact left current hl hc
  obtain ⟨q4, hq4, hcq4, hvq4⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact q1 q3 hcq1 hcq3
  obtain ⟨q5, hq5, hcq5, hvq5⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector bit hs hb
  obtain ⟨q7, hq7, hcq7, hvq7⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact right current hr hc
  obtain ⟨q8, hq8, hcq8, hvq8⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact q5 q7 hcq5 hcq7
  refine ⟨q4, q8, ?_, hcq4, hcq8, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [pathPair, hq, bind_tc_ok, hq1, hq3, hq4, hq5, hq7, hq8]
  · change decode q = decode field.QM31.ONE - decode bit at hvq
    change decode q3 = decode left - decode current at hvq3
    rw [hvq4, hvq1, hvq, one_decode, hvq3]
  · change decode q7 = decode right - decode current at hvq7
    rw [hvq8, hvq5, hvq7]

#print axioms booleanResidual_success
#print axioms pathPair_success
end AspisR1.PathLaneArithmetic
PathLaneSourceLoop:
import PathLaneSourceStep
import OccupancyRangeTraversal

/-! Symbolic source-loop induction for the eight paired path updates.
The finite state model avoids reducing concrete field recurrences. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathLaneSourceLoop
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PathLaneSourceStep
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev State := Fin 17 → ExactQM
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev Loop := AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop

def read16 (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if h : i < 16 then decode (cell a ⟨i, by simpa using h⟩) else 0

def decoded (path : Array QM 17#usize) : State := fun j => decode (cell path j)

def left (selector bit : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize) (lane : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  decode selector * (1 - decode bit) * (read16 a1 lane - read16 a (1 + lane))

def right (selector bit : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize) (lane : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  decode selector * decode bit * (read16 a1 (8 + lane) - read16 a (1 + lane))

def step (selector bit : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize) (lane : Nat) (s : State) : State :=
  fun j => if j.val = 1 + lane then left selector bit a a1 lane
    else if j.val = 9 + lane then right selector bit a a1 lane else s j

def applySteps (selector bit : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize) : Nat → Nat → State → State
  | 0, _, s => s
  | n + 1, lane, s => applySteps selector bit a a1 n (lane + 1)
      (step selector bit a a1 lane s)

theorem runStep_model
    (lane : Usize) (selector : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize)
    (bit : QM) (path : Array QM 17#usize)
    (hlane : lane.val < 8) (hs : Canonical selector) (hb : Canonical bit)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (ha1 : CanonicalArray a1) (hp : CanonicalArray path) :
    ∃ out, runStep lane selector a a1 bit path = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      decoded out = step selector bit a a1 lane.val (decoded path) := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hvalues⟩ :=
    runStep_success lane selector a a1 bit path hlane hs hb ha ha1 hp
  refine ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  funext j
  have h0 : lane.val < 16 := by omega
  have h1 : 1 + lane.val < 16 := by omega
  have h8 : 8 + lane.val < 16 := by omega
  simpa only [decoded, step, left, right, read16, dif_pos h0, dif_pos h1, dif_pos h8]
    using hvalues j

theorem loop_model
    (fuel : Nat) (iter : Range) (selector : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize)
    (bit : QM) (path : Array QM 17#usize)
    (hend : iter.end.val = 8) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = 8)
    (hs : Canonical selector) (hb : Canonical bit)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (ha1 : CanonicalArray a1) (hp : CanonicalArray path) :
    ∃ out, Loop iter selector a a1 bit path = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      decoded out = applySteps selector bit a a1 fuel iter.start.val (decoded path) := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter path with
  | zero =>
      have hdone : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
      refine ⟨path, ?_, hp, rfl⟩
      change AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop
        iter selector a a1 bit path = .ok path
      rw [AspisR1.PathLaneSourceStep.generated_loop_step, AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hdone]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
      have hlane : iter.start.val < 8 := by omega
      obtain ⟨iter1, hnext, hstart1, hend1, _hbound⟩ :=
        AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
      obtain ⟨path1, hstep, hcanonical1, hmodel1⟩ :=
        runStep_model iter.start selector a a1 bit path hlane hs hb ha ha1 hp
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hmodel⟩ :=
        ih iter1 path1 (by simpa only [hend1] using hend) (by omega) hcanonical1
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanonical, ?_⟩
      · change AspisR1PathLaneCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.path_lanes_literal_loop
          iter selector a a1 bit path = .ok out
        rw [AspisR1.PathLaneSourceStep.generated_loop_step]
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, hstep, hrun]
      · rw [hmodel, hstart1, hmodel1]
        rfl

#print axioms runStep_model
#print axioms loop_model
end
end AspisR1.PathLaneSourceLoop
PathLaneLoopMeaning:
import PathLaneSourceLoop

/-! Closed form for disjoint paired path writes. This symbolic lemma replaces
any normalization of the eight-step source recurrence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathLaneLoopMeaning
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PathLaneSourceStep
open AspisR1.PathLaneSourceLoop

private def leftWritten (start count j : Nat) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ j ∧ j < 9 ∧ start ≤ j - 1 ∧ j - 1 < start + count
private def rightWritten (start count j : Nat) : Prop :=
  9 ≤ j ∧ j < 17 ∧ start ≤ j - 9 ∧ j - 9 < start + count

/-- Each traversed lane writes two distinct cells, and no later iteration
can overwrite them. The proof is symbolic in both start and count. -/
theorem applySteps_cell
    (selector bit : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize)
    (count start : Nat) (s : State) (hbound : start + count ≤ 8) (j : Fin 17) :
    applySteps selector bit a a1 count start s j =
      if leftWritten start count j.val then left selector bit a a1 (j.val - 1)
      else if rightWritten start count j.val then right selector bit a a1 (j.val - 9)
      else s j := by
  classical
  induction count generalizing start s with
  | zero =>
      have hl : ¬ leftWritten start 0 j.val := by unfold leftWritten; omega
      have hr : ¬ rightWritten start 0 j.val := by unfold rightWritten; omega
      simp only [applySteps, if_neg hl, if_neg hr]
  | succ count ih =>
      rw [applySteps, ih (start + 1) (step selector bit a a1 start s) (by omega)]
      by_cases hl : leftWritten (start + 1) count j.val
      · have hL : leftWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
          unfold leftWritten at *; omega
        simp only [if_pos hl, if_pos hL]
      · by_cases hr : rightWritten (start + 1) count j.val
        · have hR : rightWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
            unfold rightWritten at *; omega
          have hL : ¬ leftWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
            unfold leftWritten rightWritten at *; omega
          simp only [if_neg hl, if_pos hr, if_neg hL, if_pos hR]
        · simp only [if_neg hl, if_neg hr, step]
          by_cases hj : j.val = 1 + start
          · have hL : leftWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
              unfold leftWritten; omega
            have hindex : j.val - 1 = start := by omega
            simp only [if_pos hj, if_pos hL, hindex]
          · by_cases hjR : j.val = 9 + start
            · have hL : ¬ leftWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
                unfold leftWritten; omega
              have hR : rightWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
                unfold rightWritten; omega
              have hindex : j.val - 9 = start := by omega
              simp only [if_neg hj, if_pos hjR, if_neg hL, if_pos hR, hindex]
            · have hL : ¬ leftWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
                unfold leftWritten at *; omega
              have hR : ¬ rightWritten start (count + 1) j.val := by
                unfold rightWritten at *; omega
              simp only [if_neg hj, if_neg hjR, if_neg hL, if_neg hR]

/-- The complete loop preserves cell0 and writes exactly the eight left and
right residuals; no field recurrence or concrete loop is unfolded. -/
theorem applySteps_from_zero
    (selector bit : QM) (a a1 : Array QM 16#usize) (s : State) :
    (applySteps selector bit a a1 8 0 s) 0 = s 0 ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 8, (applySteps selector bit a a1 8 0 s)
      ⟨1 + i.val, by omega⟩ = left selector bit a a1 i.val) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin 8, (applySteps selector bit a a1 8 0 s)
      ⟨9 + i.val, by omega⟩ = right selector bit a a1 i.val) := by
  constructor
  · rw [applySteps_cell selector bit a a1 8 0 s (by omega) 0]
    simp [leftWritten, rightWritten]
  · constructor
    · intro i
      rw [applySteps_cell selector bit a a1 8 0 s (by omega)]
      have hl : leftWritten 0 8 (1 + i.val) := by unfold leftWritten; have := i.isLt; omega
      simp only [if_pos hl]
      congr 1
      omega
    · intro i
      rw [applySteps_cell selector bit a a1 8 0 s (by omega)]
      have hl : ¬ leftWritten 0 8 (9 + i.val) := by unfold leftWritten; omega
      have hr : rightWritten 0 8 (9 + i.val) := by unfold rightWritten; have := i.isLt; omega
      simp only [if_neg hl, if_pos hr]
      congr 1
      omega

#print axioms applySteps_cell
#print axioms applySteps_from_zero
end
end AspisR1.PathLaneLoopMeaning

import R0P.Path

/-! Pointwise residual-list facts for the retained 1+8+8 path family. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PathLaneListFacts
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem bit_cell (q : K) (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.pathLanes q o)[0]'(by simp [R0P.pathLanes]) = q * (o.z 0 * (o.z 0 - 1)) := by
  simp [R0P.pathLanes]

theorem left_cell (q : K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (i : Fin 8) :
    (R0P.pathLanes q o)[1 + i.val]'(by simp [R0P.pathLanes]; omega) =
      q * (1 - o.z 0) *
        (o.succ (i.castAdd 8) - o.z (i.addNat 1 |>.castLE (by omega))) := by
  have h9 : 1 + i.val < 1 + 8 := by omega
  have hn1 : ¬ 1 + i.val < 1 := by omega
  simp only [R0P.pathLanes, List.getElem_append, List.length_append,
    List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.length_ofFn, dif_pos h9,
    dif_neg hn1, List.getElem_ofFn]
  have hsub : 1 + i.val - 1 = i.val := by omega
  have hi : (⟨1 + i.val - 1, by omega⟩ : Fin 8) = i := Fin.ext hsub
  rw [hi]

theorem right_cell (q : K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (i : Fin 8) :
    (R0P.pathLanes q o)[9 + i.val]'(by simp [R0P.pathLanes]; omega) =
      q * o.z 0 *
        (o.succ (i.natAdd 8) - o.z (i.addNat 1 |>.castLE (by omega))) := by
  have hn9 : ¬ 9 + i.val < 1 + 8 := by omega
  have hn1 : ¬ 9 + i.val < 1 := by omega
  simp only [R0P.pathLanes, List.getElem_append, List.length_append,
    List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.length_ofFn, dif_neg hn9,
    dif_neg hn1, List.getElem_ofFn]
  have hsub : 9 + i.val - (1 + 8) = i.val := by omega
  have hi : (⟨9 + i.val - (1 + 8), by omega⟩ : Fin 8) = i := Fin.ext hsub
  rw [hi]

#print axioms bit_cell
#print axioms left_cell
#print axioms right_cell
end AspisR1.PathLaneListFacts

/-! The conservation array constructed by the actual source is exactly the
two-entry residual-list tail. Together with the weighted range list this
discharges the full value-family residual identification. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ConservationResidualIdentification
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess

open AspisR1.SelectorConservationTail
open AspisR1.ValueLaneExactResidualBridge

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

theorem same_boxed_source_residual_list
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (z succ : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point =
      .ok selectors)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hz : CanonicalArray z)
    (hsucc : CanonicalArray succ) :
    ∃ selector r0 r1 : QM, ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      AspisR1.SelectorConservationSourceIndex.run selectors packed z succ = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧ CanonicalArray (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) ∧
      decoded out = (fun j => decoded packed j +
        groupValue (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) 82 j.val) ∧
      decode selector = pointSelector point 1014 ∧
      List.ofFn (exactVector (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1])) =
        [pointSelector point 1014 *
          ((decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt z 0) -
            decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt z 1)) -
              decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt z 2)),
         pointSelector point 1014 *
          (decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt succ 0) -
            decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt succ 1))] := by
  obtain ⟨selector, r0, r1, out, hrun, hout, harray, hmodel, hselector, hv0, hv1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorConservationSourceIndex.same_boxed_source_tail
      point selectors packed z succ hpoint hbox hpacked hz hsucc
  refine ⟨selector, r0, r1, out, hrun, hout, harray, hmodel, hselector, ?_⟩
  change [decode r0, decode r1] = _
  rw [hv0, hv1]

theorem exactResiduals_of_components
    (range : Array QM 33#usize) (conservation : Array QM 2#usize)
    (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (o : R0P.Openings ExactQM) (sel : R0P.Sel ExactQM)
    (hrange : List.ofFn (exactVector range) =
      (R0P.valueRange o).map (fun r =>
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.valueFamilyCoefficientFor sel * r))
    (hconservation : List.ofFn (exactVector conservation) =
      [sel 1014 * ((o.z 0-o.z 1)-o.z 2), sel 1014 * (o.succ 0-o.succ 1)]) :
    exactResiduals range conservation =
      (R0P.valueFamily (K := ExactQM)).residuals pub o sel := by
  rw [exactResiduals, hrange, hconservation]
  exact (AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.valueFamily_uses_rangeCoefficient_for
    sel pub o).symm

#print axioms same_boxed_source_residual_list
#print axioms exactResiduals_of_components
end

import SelectorConservationTail

/-! Checked source index arithmetic for the conservation selector. This
removes the implicit assumption that the Rust expression 16*63+6 returns
the intended selector row before the conservation-tail proof is applied. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorConservationSourceIndex
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SelectorConservationTail
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM

def selectorIndex : Result Usize := do
  let base ← 16#usize * pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.VALUE_AUXILIARY_BLOCK
  base + 6#usize

theorem selectorIndex_success : selectorIndex = .ok 1014#usize := by
  have hmul : (16#usize *
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.VALUE_AUXILIARY_BLOCK : Result Usize)
      ⦃ x => x.val = 16*63 ⦄ := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.VALUE_AUXILIARY_BLOCK
    apply Usize.mul_spec
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨base, hbase, hbval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hmul
  have hadd : (base + 6#usize : Result Usize) ⦃ x => x.val = base.val+6 ⦄ := by
    apply Usize.add_spec
    rw [hbval]
    scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨row, hrow, hrval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hadd
  have heq : row = 1014#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [hrval, hbval]
    scalar_tac
  unfold selectorIndex
  simp only [hbase, bind_tc_ok, hrow, heq]

def run (selectors : Selectors) (packed : Array QM 24#usize)
    (z succ : Array QM 16#usize) : Result (Array QM 24#usize) := do
  let index ← selectorIndex
  let selector ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors index
  AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.run packed selector z succ

theorem run_eq_tail (selectors : Selectors) (packed : Array QM 24#usize)
    (z succ : Array QM 16#usize) (selector : QM)
    (hrow : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors 1014#usize =
      .ok selector) :
    run selectors packed z succ = AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.run packed selector z succ := by
  simp only [run, selectorIndex_success, bind_tc_ok, hrow]

theorem same_boxed_source_tail
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (z succ : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point =
      .ok selectors)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hz : CanonicalArray z)
    (hsucc : CanonicalArray succ) :
    ∃ selector r0 r1 : QM, ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      run selectors packed z succ = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      CanonicalArray (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) ∧
      decoded out = (fun j => decoded packed j +
        groupValue (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) 82 j.val) ∧
      decode selector = pointSelector point 1014 ∧
      decode r0 = pointSelector point 1014 *
        ((decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt z 0) -
          decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt z 1)) -
            decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt z 2)) ∧
      decode r1 = pointSelector point 1014 *
        (decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt succ 0) -
          decode (AspisR1.ValueConservationTail.cellAt succ 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨selector, r0, r1, out, hrow, _hselector, hvalue, htail,
    hout, harray, hmodel, hv0, hv1⟩ :=
    same_boxed_conservation_tail point selectors packed z succ hpoint hbox hpacked hz hsucc
  exact ⟨selector, r0, r1, out,
    (run_eq_tail selectors packed z succ selector hrow).trans htail,
    hout, harray, hmodel, hvalue, hv0, hv1⟩

#print axioms selectorIndex_success
#print axioms run_eq_tail
#print axioms same_boxed_source_tail
end AspisR1.SelectorConservationSourceIndex

/-! The conservation selector and arithmetic tail use the same actual boxed
point as the range selector. The generated row call and all subsequent reads,
field operations and packing succeed from canonical inputs. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorConservationTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ValueConservationTail

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM

theorem same_boxed_conservation_selector
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point =
      .ok selectors) :
    ∃ selector : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors 1014#usize =
        .ok selector ∧ Canonical selector ∧
      decode selector = pointSelector point 1014 := by
  obtain ⟨selectors', selector, hbox', hrow, hcanonical, hvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorRowCall.boxed_row_matches_ten_factor point hpoint
      1014#usize (by scalar_tac)
  have hsame : selectors' = selectors := Result.ok.inj (hbox'.symm.trans hbox)
  subst selectors'
  refine ⟨selector, hrow, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  have h1014 : (1014#usize).val = 1014 := by scalar_tac
  change decode selector = AspisV8.SelectedSelectorExpansion.tensorProduct
    (AspisR1.SelectorAtPointModel.exactPoint point) 10 1014
  simpa only [h1014] using hvalue

theorem same_boxed_conservation_tail
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (z succ : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point =
      .ok selectors)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hz : CanonicalArray z)
    (hsucc : CanonicalArray succ) :
    ∃ selector r0 r1 : QM, ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors 1014#usize =
        .ok selector ∧ Canonical selector ∧
      decode selector = pointSelector point 1014 ∧
      run packed selector z succ = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      CanonicalArray (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) ∧
      decoded out = (fun j => decoded packed j +
        groupValue (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) 82 j.val) ∧
      decode r0 = pointSelector point 1014 *
        ((decode (cellAt z 0) - decode (cellAt z 1)) - decode (cellAt z 2)) ∧
      decode r1 = pointSelector point 1014 *
        (decode (cellAt succ 0) - decode (cellAt succ 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨selector, hrow, hselector, hvalue⟩ :=
    same_boxed_conservation_selector point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨r0, r1, out, hrun, hout, harray, hmodel, hv0, hv1⟩ :=
    run_success packed selector z succ hpacked hselector hz hsucc
  refine ⟨selector, r0, r1, out, hrow, hselector, hvalue, hrun, hout,
    harray, hmodel, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hvalue] using hv0
  · simpa only [hvalue] using hv1

#print axioms same_boxed_conservation_selector
#print axioms same_boxed_conservation_tail
end AspisR1.SelectorConservationTail
ValueConservationTail:
import ValueConservationArithmetic
import PreweightedWrapperModel

/-! Factored exact conservation-tail expression from the generated
add_value_lanes body, after its conservation selector is obtained. The reads,
arithmetic and final packed-array call are all discharged by source contracts;
selector construction and the enclosing caller remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ValueConservationTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM

def cellAt (a : Array QM 16#usize) (j : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

def run (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (selector : QM)
    (z succ : Array QM 16#usize) : Result (Array QM 24#usize) := do
  let q15 ← Array.index_usize z 0#usize
  let q16 ← Array.index_usize z 1#usize
  let q17 ← field.QM31.sub q15 q16
  let q18 ← Array.index_usize z 2#usize
  let q19 ← field.QM31.sub q17 q18
  let q20 ← field.QM31.mul selector q19
  let q21 ← Array.index_usize succ 0#usize
  let q22 ← Array.index_usize succ 1#usize
  let q23 ← field.QM31.sub q21 q22
  let q24 ← field.QM31.mul selector q23
  AspisR1PreweightedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_preweighted
    packed 82#usize (Array.make 2#usize [q20, q24])

private theorem index_ok (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Usize) (j : Fin 16)
    (hij : i.val = j.val) : Array.index_usize a i = .ok (cellAt a j) := by
  have hb : i.val < a.length := by rw [hij]; simpa using j.isLt
  obtain ⟨q, hread, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec a i hb)
  rw [hread]
  congr 1
  rw [hvalue]
  simp only [cellAt, hij]

theorem run_success (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (selector : QM)
    (z succ : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hz : CanonicalArray z) (hsucc : CanonicalArray succ) :
    ∃ r0 r1 : QM, ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      run packed selector z succ = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      CanonicalArray (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) ∧
      decoded out = (fun j => decoded packed j +
        groupValue (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) 82 j.val) ∧
      decode r0 = decode selector *
        ((decode (cellAt z 0) - decode (cellAt z 1)) - decode (cellAt z 2)) ∧
      decode r1 = decode selector * (decode (cellAt succ 0) - decode (cellAt succ 1)) := by
  have hcz (j : Fin 16) : Canonical (cellAt z j) := hz j
  have hcs (j : Fin 16) : Canonical (cellAt succ j) := hsucc j
  obtain ⟨d01, d012, r0, ds, r1, hd01, hd012, hr0, hds, hr1, harray, hv0, hv1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ValueConservationArithmetic.conservation_success selector
      (cellAt z 0) (cellAt z 1) (cellAt z 2) (cellAt succ 0) (cellAt succ 1)
      hselector (hcz 0) (hcz 1) (hcz 2) (hcs 0) (hcs 1)
  obtain ⟨out, hpack, hcanon, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PreweightedWrapperModel.add_preweighted_model packed 82#usize
      (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) (by decide) (by decide) hpacked harray
  refine ⟨r0, r1, out, ?_, hcanon, harray, hmodel, hv0, hv1⟩
  have hz0 := index_ok z 0#usize 0 rfl
  have hz1 := index_ok z 1#usize 1 rfl
  have hz2 := index_ok z 2#usize 2 rfl
  have hs0 := index_ok succ 0#usize 0 rfl
  have hs1 := index_ok succ 1#usize 1 rfl
  unfold run
  simp only [hz0, hz1, hz2, hs0, hs1, hd01, hd012, hr0, hds, hr1,
    bind_tc_ok, hpack]

#print axioms run_success
end AspisR1.ValueConservationTail
ValueConservationArithmetic:
import EqualityValueAdapter
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import SelectorExpansionCorrectness

/-! Concrete checked field-operation chain in the conservation tail of
add_value_lanes. Array reads and selector construction are separate caller
steps; no desired residual or operation-success equation is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ValueConservationArithmetic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM

theorem conservation_success
    (selector z0 z1 z2 s0 s1 : QM)
    (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hz0 : Canonical z0) (hz1 : Canonical z1) (hz2 : Canonical z2)
    (hs0 : Canonical s0) (hs1 : Canonical s1) :
    ∃ d01 d012 r0 ds r1 : QM,
      field.QM31.sub z0 z1 = .ok d01 ∧
      field.QM31.sub d01 z2 = .ok d012 ∧
      field.QM31.mul selector d012 = .ok r0 ∧
      field.QM31.sub s0 s1 = .ok ds ∧
      field.QM31.mul selector ds = .ok r1 ∧
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray
        (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) ∧
      decode r0 = decode selector * ((decode z0 - decode z1) - decode z2) ∧
      decode r1 = decode selector * (decode s0 - decode s1) := by
  obtain ⟨d01, hd01, hc01, hv01⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact z0 z1 hz0 hz1
  obtain ⟨d012, hd012, hc012, hv012⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact d01 z2 hc01 hz2
  obtain ⟨r0, hr0, hc0, hv0⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector d012 hselector hc012
  obtain ⟨ds, hds, hcs, hvs⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact s0 s1 hs0 hs1
  obtain ⟨r1, hr1, hc1, hv1⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact selector ds hselector hcs
  have harray : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray
      (Array.make 2#usize [r0, r1]) := by
    intro j
    fin_cases j
    · exact hc0
    · exact hc1
  refine ⟨d01, d012, r0, ds, r1, hd01, hd012, hr0, hds, hr1, harray, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change decode d01 = decode z0 - decode z1 at hv01
    change decode d012 = decode d01 - decode z2 at hv012
    rw [hv0, hv012, hv01]
  · change decode ds = decode s0 - decode s1 at hvs
    rw [hv1, hvs]

#print axioms conservation_success
end AspisR1.ValueConservationArithmetic
ValueLaneExactResidualBridge:
import ValueLaneResidualList
import ValueFamilyFieldTransport

/-! Instantiation of the packed source result from exact-QM31 residual
identification. The only remaining semantic premise concerns the source's
constructed residuals, not successful packing or field transport. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ValueLaneExactResidualBridge
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.PreweightedClosureSuccess
open AspisR1.PreweightedGroupUpdate
open AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Semantic
open AspisR1.ValueLaneSourceVector
open AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList
open AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport

abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

def exactVector {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) : Fin N.val → ExactQM :=
  fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt))

def exactResiduals (range : Array QM 33#usize) (conservation : Array QM 2#usize) :
    List ExactQM := List.ofFn (exactVector range) ++ List.ofFn (exactVector conservation)

theorem arrayVector_list (N : Usize) (a : Array QM N) :
    List.ofFn (arrayVector a) = (List.ofFn (exactVector a)).map f := by
  rw [List.map_ofFn]
  rfl

theorem residuals_map (range : Array QM 33#usize) (conservation : Array QM 2#usize) :
    sourceResiduals range conservation = (exactResiduals range conservation).map f := by
  simp only [sourceResiduals, exactResiduals, List.map_append, arrayVector_list]

theorem residuals_valueFamily (range : Array QM 33#usize)
    (conservation : Array QM 2#usize)
    (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (pub' : R0P.Public Wide)
    (o : R0P.Openings ExactQM) (sel : R0P.Sel ExactQM)
    (hexact : exactResiduals range conservation =
      (R0P.valueFamily (K := ExactQM)).residuals pub o sel) :
    sourceResiduals range conservation =
      (R0P.valueFamily (K := Wide)).residuals pub' (mapOpenings f o)
        (fun i => f (sel i)) := by
  rw [residuals_map, hexact]
  exact map_family f pub pub' o sel

theorem run_exact_valueFamily (packed : Array QM 24#usize)
    (range : Array QM 33#usize) (conservation : Array QM 2#usize)
    (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (pub' : R0P.Public Wide)
    (o : R0P.Openings ExactQM) (sel : R0P.Sel ExactQM)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hrange : CanonicalArray range)
    (hconservation : CanonicalArray conservation)
    (hexact : exactResiduals range conservation =
      (R0P.valueFamily (K := ExactQM)).residuals pub o sel) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      AspisR1.ValueLanePackedComposition.run packed range conservation = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 24,
        f (decoded out j) = f (decoded packed j) +
          R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k : Fin 4 =>
            selectList 49 ((R0P.valueFamily (K := Wide)).residuals pub'
              (mapOpenings f o) (fun i => f (sel i))) (4*j.val+k.val)) := by
  exact run_valueFamily packed range conservation pub' (mapOpenings f o)
    (fun i => f (sel i)) hpacked hrange hconservation
    (residuals_valueFamily range conservation pub pub' o sel hexact)

#print axioms arrayVector_list
#print axioms residuals_map
#print axioms residuals_valueFamily
#print axioms run_exact_valueFamily
end
end AspisR1.ValueLaneExactResidualBridge
ValueLaneRangeSelectorRun:
import SelectorValueLaneModelComposition

/-! The actual source range-selector prefix, including map output reads and
the checked field-addition chain, for the same boxed selectors used later by
the conservation tail. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ValueLaneRangeSelectorRun
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a

def run (selectors : Selectors) : Result QM := do
  let values ← core.array.Array.map
    pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneMap.selectorIndices selectors
  let q0 ← Array.index_usize values 0#usize
  let q1 ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ZERO q0
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize values 1#usize
  let q3 ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
  let q4 ← Array.index_usize values 2#usize
  field.QM31.add q3 q4

theorem same_boxed_range_selector
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ selector : QM,
      run selectors = .ok selector ∧ Canonical selector ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector =
        AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.valueFamilyRangeCoefficient point := by
  obtain ⟨selectors', q0, q2, q4, selector, hbox', _hc0, _hc2, _hc4,
    hmap, hadd, hcanonical, hvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.generated_value_selector_is_valueFamily_coefficient
      point hpoint
  have heq : selectors' = selectors := Result.ok.inj (hbox'.symm.trans hbox)
  subst selectors'
  refine ⟨selector, ?_, hcanonical, hvalue⟩
  have hread0 : Array.index_usize
      (⟨[q0, q2, q4], by rfl⟩ : Array QM 3#usize) 0#usize = .ok q0 := by rfl
  have hread1 : Array.index_usize
      (⟨[q0, q2, q4], by rfl⟩ : Array QM 3#usize) 1#usize = .ok q2 := by rfl
  have hread2 : Array.index_usize
      (⟨[q0, q2, q4], by rfl⟩ : Array QM 3#usize) 2#usize = .ok q4 := by rfl

SelectorValueLaneRangeConstruction:
import SelectorValueLaneRangeListCorrespondence
import SelectorValueLaneIndexedLoop3
import SelectorValueLaneModelComposition
import ValueLaneExactResidualBridge
import R0P.Value

/-! The actual source range construction is factored after its exact prefix:
zero allocation, the three source preprocessing loops, reconstruction, checked
scales, reads and tail writes. The final indexed loop multiplies every cell by
the selector computed from the same boxed point. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneRangeConstruction

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev Loop3 := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop3
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) : Prop :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev exactVector (a : Array QM 33#usize) :=
  AspisR1.ValueLaneExactResidualBridge.exactVector a
abbrev exactOpenings := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings

/-- The complete source range stage after `range_selector` is computed. -/
def rangeConstruction (openings : Openings) (rangeSelector : QM) :
    Result (Array QM 33#usize) := do
  let range ← AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues.rangePrefixConstruction openings
  Loop3 rangeSelector range 0#usize

/-- The exact source result, canonicality, and weighted residual-list meaning
for the same selector used by the generated range loop. -/
theorem rangeConstruction_weighted_list
    (openings : Openings) (rangeSelector : QM)
    (hopenZ : AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hopenSucc : AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (hselector : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM rangeSelector) :
    ∃ preweighted : Array QM 33#usize,
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues.rangePrefixConstruction openings = .ok preweighted ∧
      ∃ out : Array QM 33#usize,
        rangeConstruction openings rangeSelector = .ok out ∧
        CanonicalArray out ∧
        List.ofFn (exactVector out) =
          (R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings)).map
            (fun r => decode rangeSelector * r) := by
  obtain ⟨preweighted, hpreCanonical, hpreRun, hpreList⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneRangeListCorrespondence.generated_range_list_eq_valueRange
      openings hopenZ hopenSucc hopenXor
  obtain ⟨out, hloop, houtCanonical, hvalues⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneIndexedLoop3.add_value_lanes_loop3_from_zero
      rangeSelector preweighted hselector hpreCanonical
  have hrun : rangeConstruction openings rangeSelector = .ok out := by
    simp only [rangeConstruction, hpreRun, hloop, bind_tc_ok]
  have hpreExact : List.ofFn (exactVector preweighted) =
      R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings) := by
    change List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 33 =>
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell preweighted i) = _
    exact hpreList
  have hweighted : List.ofFn (exactVector out) =
      (List.ofFn (exactVector preweighted)).map
        (fun r => decode rangeSelector * r) := by
    rw [List.map_ofFn]
    congr 1
    funext i
    change decode (out.val[i.val]'(by simpa [out.property] using i.isLt)) =
      decode rangeSelector *
        decode (preweighted.val[i.val]'(by simpa [preweighted.property] using i.isLt))
    have hvaluesi := hvalues i
    rw [AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneIndexedLoop3.cellAt_eq_getElem out i,
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneIndexedLoop3.cellAt_eq_getElem preweighted i] at hvaluesi
    exact hvaluesi
  rw [hpreExact] at hweighted
  exact ⟨preweighted, hpreRun, out, hrun, houtCanonical, hweighted⟩

/-- Instantiate the exact range-list theorem with the generated boxed-point
selector map and its left-to-right two-add sum. -/
theorem boxed_point_rangeConstruction_weighted_list
    (openings : Openings) (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hopenZ : AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hopenSucc : AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point) :
    ∃ selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors,
      ∃ q0 q2 q4 rangeSelector : QM,
        ∃ preweighted : Array QM 33#usize,
          ∃ out : Array QM 33#usize,
            pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
            pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
              selectors 0#usize = .ok (q0, selectors) ∧
            pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
              selectors 2#usize = .ok (q2, selectors) ∧
            pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
              selectors 4#usize = .ok (q4, selectors) ∧
            core.array.Array.map
              pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31
              AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneMap.selectorIndices selectors =
                .ok ⟨[q0, q2, q4], by rfl⟩ ∧
            (do
              let q1 ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ZERO q0
              let q3 ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
              field.QM31.add q3 q4) = .ok rangeSelector ∧
            AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues.rangePrefixConstruction openings =
              .ok preweighted ∧
            rangeConstruction openings rangeSelector = .ok out ∧
            CanonicalArray out ∧
            List.ofFn (exactVector out) =
              (R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings)).map
                (fun r => decode rangeSelector * r) := by
  obtain ⟨selectors,q0,q2,q4,rangeSelector,hbox,hc0,hc2,hc4,hmap,hadd,
      hselector,hdecode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.generated_value_selector_is_valueFamily_coefficient
      point hpoint
  obtain ⟨preweighted,hpreRun,out,hrun,hout,hlist⟩ :=
    rangeConstruction_weighted_list openings rangeSelector
      hopenZ hopenSucc hopenXor hselector
  exact ⟨selectors,q0,q2,q4,rangeSelector,preweighted,out,
    hbox,hc0,hc2,hc4,hmap,hadd,hpreRun,hrun,hout,hlist⟩

#print axioms rangeConstruction_weighted_list
#print axioms boxed_point_rangeConstruction_weighted_list

SelectorValueLaneRangeListCorrespondence:
import SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues
import SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts
import R0P.Value

/-! The source-produced 33-cell array is identified with the exact
`R0P.valueRange` list. This is the range-side endpoint consumed by the
residual-list and packing bridges. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneRangeListCorrespondence

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev cell := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell
abbrev exactOpenings := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings

theorem generated_range_list_eq_valueRange
    (openings : Openings)
    (hopenZ : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hopenSucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z) :
    ∃ range6 : Array QM 33#usize,
      CanonicalArray range6 ∧
      AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues.rangePrefixConstruction openings =
        .ok range6 ∧
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 33 => cell range6 i) =
        R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings) := by
  obtain ⟨r1, r2, r3, reconstructed, q11, q12, q13, q14,
    r4, r5, range6, h0, h1, h2, hq12, hu30, hu31, hu32,
    hconstruction, hfirst, hsecond, hthird, h30, h31, h32,
    hq12value, hcanonical⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues.generated_full_range_values
      openings hopenZ hopenSucc hopenXor
  refine ⟨range6, hcanonical, hconstruction, ?_⟩
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [R0P.valueRange]
  · intro n hleft hright
    have hn : n < 33 := by simpa [R0P.valueRange] using hright
    rw [List.getElem_ofFn]
    by_cases h0n : n < 10
    · let i : Fin 10 := ⟨n, h0n⟩
      have harray : cell range6 ⟨n, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6)^2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6) := by
        simpa [i] using hfirst i
      have hlist := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts.first_block
        (exactOpenings openings) i
      have hlistn : (R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings))[n]'hright =
          (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6)^2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6) := by
        simpa [i] using hlist
      exact harray.trans hlistn.symm
    · by_cases h1n : n < 20
      · have hn10 : 10 ≤ n := by omega
        let i : Fin 10 := ⟨n - 10, by omega⟩
        have hi : 10 + i.val = n := by simp [i, hn10]
        have harray : cell range6 ⟨n, by omega⟩ =
            (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6)^2 -
              (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6) := by
          have hidx : (⟨n, by omega⟩ : Fin 33) = ⟨10 + i.val, by omega⟩ :=
            Fin.ext hi.symm
          rw [hidx]
          exact hsecond i
        have hlist := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts.second_block
          (exactOpenings openings) i
        have hlistn : (R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings))[n]'hright =
            (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6)^2 -
              (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6) := by
          simpa only [hi] using hlist
        exact harray.trans hlistn.symm
      · by_cases h2n : n < 30
        · have hn20 : 20 ≤ n := by omega
          let i : Fin 10 := ⟨n - 20, by omega⟩
          have hi : 20 + i.val = n := by simp [i, hn20]
          have harray : cell range6 ⟨n, by omega⟩ =
              (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6)^2 -
                (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6) := by
            have hidx : (⟨n, by omega⟩ : Fin 33) = ⟨20 + i.val, by omega⟩ :=
              Fin.ext hi.symm
            rw [hidx]
            exact hthird i
          have hlist := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts.third_block
            (exactOpenings openings) i
          have hlistn : (R0P.valueRange (exactOpenings openings))[n]'hright =
              (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6)^2 -
                (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6) := by
            simpa only [hi] using hlist
          exact harray.trans hlistn.symm
        · have hn30 : 30 ≤ n := by omega
          have hle : n ≤ 32 := by omega
          interval_cases n
          · have htail :=
              AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts.reconstruction_tail
                (exactOpenings openings)
            have h30' : cell range6 ⟨30, by decide⟩ =
                AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q12 := by
              change cell range6 ⟨30, by decide⟩ =
                AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q12 at h30
              exact h30
            have hz10 : AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues.exactZ10 openings =
                (exactOpenings openings).z ⟨10, by decide⟩ := rfl
            have hzmodel : AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.z =
                R0P.valueReconstruct10 (exactOpenings openings).z := by rfl
            have hsuccmodel : AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.succ_z =
                R0P.valueReconstruct10 (exactOpenings openings).succ := by rfl
            have hxormodel : AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.xor12_z =
                R0P.valueReconstruct10 (exactOpenings openings).xor12 := by rfl
            have hscale10 : AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.scale10 =
                AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailConstants.scale10 := rfl
            have hscale20 : AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.scale20 =
                AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailConstants.scale20 := rfl
            have hscales := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailConstants.source_shift_embeddings
            have harray : cell range6 ⟨30, by decide⟩ =
                (exactOpenings openings).z ⟨10, by decide⟩ -
                  (R0P.valueReconstruct10 (exactOpenings openings).z +
                    R0P.valueReconstruct10 (exactOpenings openings).succ * 1024 +
                    R0P.valueReconstruct10 (exactOpenings openings).xor12 * 1048576) := by
              rw [h30', hq12value, hz10, hzmodel, hsuccmodel, hxormodel,
                hscale10, hscale20, hscales.1, hscales.2]
            exact harray.trans htail.symm
          · have htail :=
              AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts.succ_tail
                (exactOpenings openings)
            exact h31.trans htail.symm
          · have htail :=
              AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts.xor_tail
                (exactOpenings openings)
            exact h32.trans htail.symm

#print axioms generated_range_list_eq_valueRange
end AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneRangeListCorrespondence

import SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues
import SelectorValueLaneTailExecution
import SelectorValueLanePreprocessCanonical

/-! The actual source first populates the first 30 cells in three loops and
then writes the reconstruction/coordinate tail at 30–32. This composes those
two source contracts into a full 33-cell decoded range statement. The separate
conservation residuals and start-82 packing remain in `ValueConservationTail`.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneFullRangeValues

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalArray {N : Usize} (a : Array QM N) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev cell := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessMeaning.cell
abbrev exactOpenings := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings

/-- The exact decoded coordinate read used in the source tail. Naming this
coordinate keeps the output contract compact while exposing its model index. -/
def exactZ10 (openings : Openings) : ExactQM :=
  (exactOpenings openings).z ⟨10, by decide⟩


/-- Exact source prefix through the three tail writes, before selector
weighting. This exposes the actual monadic result, not just its final cells. -/
def rangePrefixConstruction (openings : Openings) : Result (Array QM 33#usize) := do
  let range0 := Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  let (openings1, range1) ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0
    openings range0 0#usize
  let (openings2, range2) ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1
    openings1 range1 0#usize
  let (openings3, range3) ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop2
    openings2 range2 0#usize
  AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.tailConstruction openings3 range3

private theorem cell_set_ne (a : Array QM 33#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (j : Fin 33) (hij : j.val ≠ i.val) : cell (a.set i x) j = cell a j := by
  have hget := Array.getElem_Nat_set_ne a i j.val x (by simpa using j.isLt) hij.symm
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode ((a.set i x)[j.val]) =
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (a[j.val])
  exact congrArg AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode hget

private theorem cell_set_eq (a : Array QM 33#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (j : Fin 33) (hij : j.val = i.val) : cell (a.set i x) j =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x := by
  have hget := Array.getElem_Nat_set_eq a i j.val x (by simpa using j.isLt) hij.symm
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode ((a.set i x)[j.val]) =
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode x
  exact congrArg AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode hget

private theorem update_result_set (a : Array QM 33#usize) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < 33) (out : Array QM 33#usize)
    (hupdate : Array.update a i x = .ok out) : out = a.set i x := by
  have hi' : i.val < a.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  obtain ⟨out', hrun, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i x hi')
  have hout : out' = out := Result.ok.inj (hrun.symm.trans hupdate)
  simpa [hout] using hset

private theorem index10_ok {a : Array QM 16#usize} :
    Array.index_usize a 10#usize = .ok (a.val[10]'(by
      simpa [a.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16))) := by
  have hb : (10#usize).val < a.length := by
    simpa [a.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)
  obtain ⟨q, hread, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec a 10#usize hb)
  rw [hread]
  congr 1

/-- Full generated preprocessing plus the actual three tail writes. Cells
0–29 agree with `R0P.valueRange`'s three ten-cell blocks at the same `Fin`
indices; cells 30–32 agree with the generated reconstruction and coordinate
reads. -/
theorem generated_full_range_values
    (openings : Openings)
    (hopenZ : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hopenSucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z) :
    ∃ range1 range2 range3 reconstructed q11 q12 q13 q14 range4 range5 range6,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop0
        openings (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize = .ok (openings, range1) ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop1
        openings range1 0#usize = .ok (openings, range2) ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop2
        openings range2 0#usize = .ok (openings, range3) ∧
      field.QM31.sub q11 reconstructed = .ok q12 ∧
      Array.update range3 30#usize q12 = .ok range4 ∧
      Array.update range4 31#usize q13 = .ok range5 ∧
      Array.update range5 32#usize q14 = .ok range6 ∧
      rangePrefixConstruction openings = .ok range6 ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 10,
        cell range6 ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6) ^ 2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).z (i.castAdd 6)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 10,
        cell range6 ⟨10 + i.val, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6) ^ 2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).succ (i.castAdd 6)) ∧
      (∀ i : Fin 10,
        cell range6 ⟨20 + i.val, by omega⟩ =
          (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6) ^ 2 -
            (exactOpenings openings).xor12 (i.castAdd 6)) ∧
      cell range6 ⟨30, by omega⟩ = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q12 ∧
      cell range6 ⟨31, by omega⟩ = (exactOpenings openings).succ 10 ∧
      cell range6 ⟨32, by omega⟩ = (exactOpenings openings).xor12 10 ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q12 =
        exactZ10 openings -
          (AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.z +
            AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.succ_z *
              AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding
                AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.scale10 +
            AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.xor12_z *
              AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding
                AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.scale20) ∧
      CanonicalArray range6 := by
  obtain ⟨range1, range2, range3, h0, h1, h2,
    hfirst, hsecond, hthird, hpad⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.preprocessing_range_values
      openings hopenZ hopenSucc hopenXor
  have hzero : CanonicalArray (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO) :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessZeroInit.zero_range_canonical
  have hcanonical : CanonicalArray range3 :=
    (AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessCanonical.three_preprocessing_loops_preserve_canonicality
      openings (Array.repeat 33#usize field.QM31.ZERO)
      openings openings openings range1 range2 range3
      hopenZ hopenSucc hopenXor hzero h0 h1 h2).2
  obtain ⟨q5, q6, q7, q8, q9, q10, reconstructed, q11, q12, q13, q14,
    range4, range5, range6, hq5, hq5c, hq6, hq6c, hq7, hq7c, hq8, hq8c,
    hq9, hq9c, hq10, hq10c, hrec, hrecc, hread11, hq11c, hq12, hq12c,
    hupdate30, hread13, hq13c, hupdate31, hread14, hq14c, hupdate32,
    hrange6, hshift10, hshift20, hq12value, htailConstruction⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.generated_tail_execution
      openings range3 hopenZ hopenSucc hopenXor hcanonical
  have hset30 := update_result_set range3 30#usize q12 (by scalar_tac) range4 hupdate30
  have hset31 := update_result_set range4 31#usize q13 (by scalar_tac) range5 hupdate31
  have hset32 := update_result_set range5 32#usize q14 (by scalar_tac) range6 hupdate32
  have hq13val : q13 = openings.succ_z.val[10]'(by
      simpa [openings.succ_z.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)) :=
    Result.ok.inj (hread13.symm.trans (index10_ok (a := openings.succ_z)))
  have hq14val : q14 = openings.xor12_z.val[10]'(by
      simpa [openings.xor12_z.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)) :=
    Result.ok.inj (hread14.symm.trans (index10_ok (a := openings.xor12_z)))
  have hq11idx : q11 = openings.z.val[10]'(by
      simpa [openings.z.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)) :=
    Result.ok.inj (hread11.symm.trans (index10_ok (a := openings.z)))
  have hq11exact : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q11 =
      exactZ10 openings := by
    rw [hq11idx]
    rfl
  have hq12value'' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q12 =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q11 -
        (AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.z +
         AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.reconstructModel openings.succ_z *
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution.scale10 +

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailExecution

noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31

def decodedOpening (a : Array QM 16#usize) : Fin 16 → ExactQM :=

def reconstructModel (a : Array QM 16#usize) : ExactQM :=

def scale10 : M31 := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailConstants.scale10
def scale20 : M31 := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailConstants.scale20

/-- The actual source tail after preprocessing: three reverse reconstructions,
checked shifts, field operations, and the three array writes. -/
def tailConstruction (openings : Openings) (range3 : Array QM 33#usize) :
    Result (Array QM 33#usize) := do
  let q5 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10 openings.z
  let q6 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10 openings.succ_z
  let i ← (1#u32 <<< 10#i32 : Result U32)

  let q8 ← field.QM31.add q5 q7
  let q9 ← AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10 openings.xor12_z
  let i1 ← (1#u32 <<< 20#i32 : Result U32)

  let range5 ← Array.update range4 31#usize q13
  let q14 ← Array.index_usize openings.xor12_z 10#usize
  Array.update range5 32#usize q14

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {N : Usize}

  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

    (hopenXor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)

      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.reconstruct_10

      Array.index_usize openings.z 10#usize = .ok q11 ∧ Canonical q11 ∧
      field.QM31.sub q11 reconstructed = .ok q12 ∧ Canonical q12 ∧

      Array.index_usize openings.succ_z 10#usize = .ok q13 ∧ Canonical q13 ∧
      Array.update range4 31#usize q13 = .ok range5 ∧
      Array.index_usize openings.xor12_z 10#usize = .ok q14 ∧ Canonical q14 ∧
      Array.update range5 32#usize q14 = .ok range6 ∧ CanonicalArray range6 ∧
      (1#u32 <<< 10#i32 : Result U32) = .ok scale10 ∧
      (1#u32 <<< 20#i32 : Result U32) = .ok scale20 ∧
      decode q12 = decode q11 -

            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding scale20) ∧

  obtain ⟨q6, hq6, hq6can, hq6dec⟩ :=

    AspisR1.SelectorReconstructIndexedSource.reconstruct_10_success openings.xor12_z hopenXor
  obtain ⟨q7, hq7, hq7can, hq7dec⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.current_qm_mul_m31_exact q6 scale10

  obtain ⟨q10, hq10, hq10can, hq10dec⟩ :=

  obtain ⟨reconstructed, hrec, hreccan, hrecdec⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q8 q10 hq8can hq10can
  have hread11 : Array.index_usize openings.z 10#usize =

/-! Exact values returned by the two checked U32 shifts in the candidate
reconstruction tail, and their embeddings into the retained exact field. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailConstants

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std WP

abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.QM31Exact

def scale10 : M31 := 1024#u32
def scale20 : M31 := 1048576#u32

theorem shift10_success : (1#u32 <<< 10#i32 : Result U32) = .ok scale10 := by
  have htoNat : (10#i32).toNat = 10 := by rfl
  have hspec := UScalar.ShiftLeft_IScalar_spec (1#u32) (10#i32)
    (UScalar.size UScalarTy.U32) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) rfl
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
  have hout : out.val = 1024 := by
    rw [hvalue.1]
    rw [htoNat]
    rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    norm_num [UScalar.val, IScalar.toNat, U32.size, U32.numBits,
      UScalarTy.U32_numBits_eq]
  have heq : out = scale10 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hout
  rw [hrun, heq]

theorem shift20_success : (1#u32 <<< 20#i32 : Result U32) = .ok scale20 := by
  have htoNat : (20#i32).toNat = 20 := by rfl
  have hspec := UScalar.ShiftLeft_IScalar_spec (1#u32) (20#i32)
    (UScalar.size UScalarTy.U32) (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) rfl
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
  have hout : out.val = 1048576 := by
    rw [hvalue.1]
    rw [htoNat]
    rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    norm_num [UScalar.val, IScalar.toNat, U32.size, U32.numBits,
      UScalarTy.U32_numBits_eq]
  have heq : out = scale20 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hout
  rw [hrun, heq]

theorem source_shift_embeddings :
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding scale10 = (1024 : ExactQM) ∧
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding scale20 = (1048576 : ExactQM) := by
  constructor
  · ext <;> norm_num [scale10, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact,
      QuadraticAlgebra.re_ofNat, QuadraticAlgebra.im_ofNat]
  · ext <;> norm_num [scale20, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskScalarExact.scalarEmbedding,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.CM31Exact,
      AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact,
      QuadraticAlgebra.re_ofNat, QuadraticAlgebra.im_ofNat]

namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailWritesCanonical

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness

abbrev QM := field.QM31

abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) : Prop :=
