private theorem array_index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjOld : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hjOld := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem update_success_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n)
    (i : Usize) (x : QM) (result : Array QM n)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x)
    (hbound : i.val < a.length)
    (hrun : Array.update a i x = .ok result) : CanonicalArray result := by
  obtain ⟨updated, hspec, hset⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i x hbound)
  have heq : updated = result := Result.ok.inj (hspec.symm.trans hrun)
  rw [← heq, hset]
  exact set_canonical a i x ha hx

theorem tail_three_updates_canonical
    (openings : Openings) (range3 range4 range5 range6 : Array QM 33#usize)
    (q8 q13 q14 : QM)
    (hopenSucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hopenXor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (hrange3 : CanonicalArray range3)
    (hq8 : Canonical q8)
    (hupdate30 : Array.update range3 30#usize q8 = .ok range4)
    (hread13 : Array.index_usize openings.succ_z 10#usize = .ok q13)
    (hupdate31 : Array.update range4 31#usize q13 = .ok range5)
    (hread14 : Array.index_usize openings.xor12_z 10#usize = .ok q14)
    (hupdate32 : Array.update range5 32#usize q14 = .ok range6) :
    CanonicalArray range6 := by
  have hread13' := array_index_usize_ok openings.succ_z 10#usize (by scalar_tac)
  have hq13eq : q13 = openings.succ_z.val[10]'(by
      simpa [openings.succ_z.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)) :=
    Result.ok.inj (hread13.symm.trans hread13')
  have hq13 : Canonical q13 := by
    rw [hq13eq]
    exact hopenSucc ⟨10, by simpa [openings.succ_z.property] using
      (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)⟩
  have hread14' := array_index_usize_ok openings.xor12_z 10#usize (by scalar_tac)
  have hq14eq : q14 = openings.xor12_z.val[10]'(by
      simpa [openings.xor12_z.property] using (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)) :=
    Result.ok.inj (hread14.symm.trans hread14')
  have hq14 : Canonical q14 := by
    rw [hq14eq]
    exact hopenXor ⟨10, by simpa [openings.xor12_z.property] using
      (by scalar_tac : (10#usize).val < 16)⟩
  have hrange4 : CanonicalArray range4 :=
    update_success_canonical range3 30#usize q8 range4 hrange3 hq8 (by scalar_tac) hupdate30
  have hrange5 : CanonicalArray range5 :=
    update_success_canonical range4 31#usize q13 range5 hrange4 hq13 (by scalar_tac) hupdate31
  exact update_success_canonical range5 32#usize q14 range6 hrange5 hq14
    (by scalar_tac) hupdate32

#print axioms tail_three_updates_canonical
end AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneTailWritesCanonical
SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts:
import R0P.Value

/-! Pointwise lookup facts for the retained 33-cell value-range list. These
are the list-side counterpart to the generated source array contracts and do
not unfold reconstruction recurrences. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem first_block (o : R0P.Openings K) (i : Fin 10) :
    (R0P.valueRange o)[i.val]'(by simp [R0P.valueRange]; omega) =
      (o.z (i.castAdd 6))^2 - o.z (i.castAdd 6) := by
  have h20 : i.val < 10 + 10 := by omega
  have h30 : i.val < 10 + 10 + 10 := by omega
  simp only [R0P.valueRange, List.getElem_append, List.length_append,
    List.length_ofFn, List.getElem_ofFn, dif_pos h30, dif_pos h20,
    dif_pos i.isLt]

theorem second_block (o : R0P.Openings K) (i : Fin 10) :
    (R0P.valueRange o)[10 + i.val]'(by simp [R0P.valueRange]; omega) =
      (o.succ (i.castAdd 6))^2 - o.succ (i.castAdd 6) := by
  have h20 : 10 + i.val < 10 + 10 := by omega
  have h30 : 10 + i.val < 10 + 10 + 10 := by omega
  have hn10 : ¬ 10 + i.val < 10 := by omega
  simp only [R0P.valueRange, List.getElem_append, List.length_append,
    List.length_ofFn, List.getElem_ofFn, dif_pos h30, dif_pos h20,
    dif_neg hn10]
  have hsub : 10 + i.val - 10 = i.val := by omega
  have hindex : (⟨10 + i.val - 10, by omega⟩ : Fin 10) = i := Fin.ext hsub
  rw [hindex]

theorem third_block (o : R0P.Openings K) (i : Fin 10) :
    (R0P.valueRange o)[20 + i.val]'(by simp [R0P.valueRange]; omega) =
      (o.xor12 (i.castAdd 6))^2 - o.xor12 (i.castAdd 6) := by
  have h30 : 20 + i.val < 10 + 10 + 10 := by omega
  have hn20 : ¬ 20 + i.val < 10 + 10 := by omega
  have hn10 : ¬ 20 + i.val < 10 := by omega
  simp only [R0P.valueRange, List.getElem_append, List.length_append,
    List.length_ofFn, List.getElem_ofFn, dif_pos h30, dif_neg hn20,
    dif_neg hn10]
  have hsub : 20 + i.val - (10 + 10) = i.val := by omega
  have hindex : (⟨20 + i.val - (10 + 10), by omega⟩ : Fin 10) = i := Fin.ext hsub
  rw [hindex]

theorem reconstruction_tail (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.valueRange o)[30]'(by simp [R0P.valueRange]) =
      o.z 10 - ((R0P.valueReconstruct10 o.z +
        R0P.valueReconstruct10 o.succ * (1024 : K)) +
        R0P.valueReconstruct10 o.xor12 * (1048576 : K)) := by
  simp [R0P.valueRange]

theorem succ_tail (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.valueRange o)[31]'(by simp [R0P.valueRange]) = o.succ 10 := by
  simp [R0P.valueRange]

theorem xor_tail (o : R0P.Openings K) :
    (R0P.valueRange o)[32]'(by simp [R0P.valueRange]) = o.xor12 10 := by
  simp [R0P.valueRange]

#print axioms second_block
#print axioms third_block
#print axioms reconstruction_tail
#print axioms succ_tail
#print axioms xor_tail
end AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneValueRangeListFacts

import SelectorValueLaneIndexedSlice
import SelectorReconstructIndexedSource
import SelectorExpansionCorrectness
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import ExtractedMaskReducerOps

/-! Source proof for the candidate v3 indexed `add_value_lanes_loop3`: each
cell from the starting index through 32 is multiplied by the fixed selector;
earlier cells are preserved. Success and canonicality are derived from the
actual generated calls, not assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneIndexedLoop3

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev Loop3 := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop3

private def cellAt (a : Array QM 33#usize) (j : Nat) : QM :=
  if h : j < 33 then a.val[j]'(by simpa [a.property] using h)
  else field.QM31.ZERO

/-- The loop's Nat-indexed view is the ordinary Array cell at every valid
33-cell index. This exposes the exact observation used by the output-list map. -/
theorem cellAt_eq_getElem (a : Array QM 33#usize) (j : Fin 33) :
    cellAt a j.val = a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt) := by
  simp [cellAt, j.isLt]

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem update_success {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (x : α) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ out : Array α n, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  exact ⟨out, hr, hs⟩

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a)
    (hx : Canonical x) : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hj0 : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj0
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hj0 := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem cellAt_set {a : Array QM 33#usize} {i : Usize} {x : QM}
    (hi : i.val < 33) (j : Nat) :
    cellAt (a.set i x) j = if j = i.val then x else cellAt a j := by
  by_cases hj : j < 33
  · by_cases hEq : j = i.val
    · subst j
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq]
    · have hne : i.val ≠ j := Ne.symm hEq
      have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hjA : j < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hcell := List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j) hne hjSet
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hEq, hcell, hjA]
  · have hne : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hne]

private theorem small_usize_bound (n : Nat) (hn : n < 1024) :
    n < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
  rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
  have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
  omega

private theorem increment_success (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 33) :
    ∃ i1 : Usize, (i + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok i1 ∧ i1.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have hbound : i.val + 1 < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    apply small_usize_bound
    omega
  obtain ⟨i1, hrun, hval⟩ := tryMk_success (ty := .Usize) (i.val + 1) hbound
  have hresult : (i + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok i1 := by
    change UScalar.add i 1#usize = .ok i1
    simpa [UScalar.add] using hrun
  exact ⟨i1, hresult, hval⟩

/-- At fuel `fuel`, the indexed generated loop returns a canonical array and
implements the exact prefix-preserving pointwise multiplication equation. -/
theorem add_value_lanes_loop3_success_fuel
    (selector : QM) (range : Array QM 33#usize) (i : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : i.val + fuel = 33)
    (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hrange : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray range) :
    ∃ out, Loop3 selector range i = .ok out ∧
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 33, decode (cellAt out j.val) =
        if j.val < i.val then decode (cellAt range j.val)
        else decode selector * decode (cellAt range j.val) := by
  induction fuel generalizing range i with
  | zero =>
      have hi : i.val = 33 := by omega
      have hstop : ¬ i < 33#usize := by
        rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]
        simp [hi]
      refine ⟨range, ?_, hrange, ?_⟩
      · change AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop3
          selector range i = .ok range
        rw [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop3.eq_def]
        simp only [if_neg hstop]
      · intro j
        have hj : j.val < 33 := j.isLt
        simp [hi, hj, cellAt]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hbound : i.val < 33 := by omega
      have hlt : i < 33#usize := by
        apply (UScalar.lt_equiv i 33#usize).2
        exact hbound
      let q := cellAt range i.val
      have hqEq : q = range.val[i.val]'(by simpa [range.property] using hbound) := by
        simp [q, cellAt, hbound]
      have hread : Array.index_usize range i = .ok q := by
        rw [index_usize_ok range i hbound, ← hqEq]
      have hq : Canonical q := by
        simpa [q, cellAt, hbound] using
          hrange ⟨i.val, by simpa [range.property] using hbound⟩
      obtain ⟨product, hmul, hproduct, hproductDecode⟩ :=
        current_qm_mul_exact selector q hselector hq
      have hupdateBound : i.val < (33#usize).val := by
        simpa using hbound
      obtain ⟨range1, hupdate, hset⟩ := update_success range i product hupdateBound
      have hrange1 : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray range1 := by
        rw [hset]
        exact set_canonical range i product hrange hproduct
      obtain ⟨i1, hinc, hincVal⟩ := increment_success i hbound
      have hspan1 : i1.val + fuel = 33 := by omega
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtCanonical, hvalues⟩ :=
        ih range1 i1 hspan1 hrange1
      refine ⟨out, ?_, houtCanonical, ?_⟩
      · change AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop3
          selector range i = .ok out
        rw [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbeIndexed.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_value_lanes_loop3.eq_def]
        simp only [if_pos hlt, hread, bind_tc_ok, hmul, bind_tc_ok,
          hupdate, bind_tc_ok, hinc, bind_tc_ok]
        exact hrun
      · intro j
        have hvaluesj := hvalues j
        rw [hvaluesj]
        rw [hset]
        rw [cellAt_set hbound j.val]
        by_cases hj : j.val < i.val
        · have hj1 : j.val < i1.val := by omega
          have hne : j.val ≠ i.val := by omega
          simp [hj, hj1, hne]
        · by_cases heq : j.val = i.val
          · have hj1 : j.val < i1.val := by omega
            have hnot : ¬ i1.val ≤ j.val := by omega
            have hcell : cellAt range j.val = q := by simp [q, heq]
            rw [hcell]
            by_cases hle : i1.val ≤ j.val
            · exact (hnot hle).elim
            · simp [hj, hj1, heq, hle, hproductDecode]
              intro hle'
              omega
          · have hi1 : i1.val ≤ j.val := by omega
            have hne : j.val ≠ i.val := heq
            simp [hj, hne, hi1]

/-- The generated 33-cell wrapper case needed by the terminal composition. -/
theorem add_value_lanes_loop3_from_zero
    (selector : QM) (range : Array QM 33#usize)
    (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hrange : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray range) :
    ∃ out, Loop3 selector range 0#usize = .ok out ∧
      AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 33, decode (cellAt out j.val) =
        decode selector * decode (cellAt range j.val) := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, hvalues⟩ :=
    add_value_lanes_loop3_success_fuel selector range 0#usize 33 (by norm_num)
      hselector hrange
  refine ⟨out, hrun, hcanonical, ?_⟩
  intro j
  simpa using hvalues j

#print axioms cellAt_eq_getElem
#print axioms add_value_lanes_loop3_success_fuel
#print axioms add_value_lanes_loop3_from_zero
end AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneIndexedLoop3

/-! Connect the actual occupancy packer to the retained family at the same
boxed point. Row success and selector-array semantics are derived, never
supplied as premises. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OccupancyCompletePacking
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev Wide := AspisWideTower.WideExact

@[irreducible] def wideOccupancyFamily : R0P.Family Wide :=

private theorem occupancyLiteral_is_family {K : Type} [Field K]
    (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral (sel (63*16+9)) (sel (63*16+10))

theorem wideOccupancyFamily_residuals_eq (pub : R0P.Public Wide)
    (o : R0P.Openings Wide) (sel : R0P.Sel Wide) :
    wideOccupancyFamily.residuals pub o sel =
      (R0P.occupancyFamily (K := Wide)).residuals pub o sel := by
  unfold wideOccupancyFamily
  rfl

private theorem openingMap_z (openings : Openings) :
    (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings)).z = fun i =>
      f (decode (openings.z.val[i.val]'
        (by simpa [openings.z.property] using i.isLt))) := by
  funext i
  rfl

private theorem pointSelector_input (point : Array QM 10#usize) :

private theorem pointSelector_output (point : Array QM 10#usize) :
    pointSelector point ⟨1018, by norm_num⟩ =
      pointSelector point ⟨63*16+10, by omega⟩ := by
  congr 1

theorem boxed_add_occupancy_lanes_success
    (packed : Array QM 24#usize)
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (openings : Openings) (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (pub : R0P.Public Wide)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hvariant : pub.variant =
      AspisR1.OccupancyExpectedBridge.modelVariant public1.variant) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 24#usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_occupancy_lanes
        packed public1 openings selectors = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 24,
        f (decoded out j) = f (decoded packed j) +
          R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k : Fin 4 =>
            AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList.selectList 0
              (wideOccupancyFamily.residuals pub
                (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings))
                (fun i => f (pointSelector point i)))
              (4*j.val+k.val))) := by
  obtain ⟨hhigh, hlow, _, _⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SelectorMarginalModel.boxed_marginals point selectors hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨input, output, expected, occupancy, out,
      hinput, houtput, hexpected, hliteral, hcanOcc, hpack, hcanOut, hparent, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.OccupancyActualPacking.add_occupancy_lanes_success
      packed public1 openings selectors hpacked hhigh hlow hopened
  obtain ⟨inputPoint, hinputPoint, hinputCan, hinputModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SameBoxedRowExact.row_success point selectors
      1017#usize (by norm_num) hpoint hbox
  obtain ⟨outputPoint, houtputPoint, houtputCan, houtputModel⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SameBoxedRowExact.row_success point selectors
      1018#usize (by norm_num) hpoint hbox
  have hinputEq : input = inputPoint := by
    have hrow : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors
        1017#usize = .ok input := by simpa [AspisR1.OccupancyEntryRows.inputRow] using hinput
    exact Result.ok.inj (hrow.symm.trans hinputPoint)
  have houtputEq : output = outputPoint := by
    have hrow : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors
        1018#usize = .ok output := by simpa [AspisR1.OccupancyEntryRows.outputRow] using houtput
    exact Result.ok.inj (hrow.symm.trans houtputPoint)
  have hdecodeInput : decode input = pointSelector point ⟨1017, by norm_num⟩ := by
    rw [hinputEq]
    exact hinputModel
  have hdecodeOutput : decode output = pointSelector point ⟨1018, by norm_num⟩ := by
    rw [houtputEq]
    exact houtputModel
  have hfamily :
      R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral
          (f (decode input)) (f (decode output))
          (R0P.occupancyExpected
            (AspisR1.OccupancyExpectedBridge.modelVariant public1.variant))
          (fun i => f (decode
            (openings.z.val[i.val]'
              (by simpa [openings.z.property] using i.isLt)))) =
        wideOccupancyFamily.residuals pub
          (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings))
          (fun i => f (pointSelector point i)) := by
    calc

/-! Actual source prefix for occupancy cells 0, 1 and 2. It executes the

canonical inputs. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OccupancyLiteralPrefixReadsV2

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

private theorem bound16 (i : Nat) : i < 16 → i < (16#usize).val := by
  intro hi
  have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
  omega

private theorem bound12 (i : Nat) : i < 12 → i < (12#usize).val := by
  intro hi
  have h12 : (12#usize).val = 12 := by scalar_tac
  omega

private def get16 (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using (bound16 i.val i.isLt))

private def get12 (a : Array QM 12#usize) (i : Fin 12) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using (bound12 i.val i.isLt))

def prefixRun (input output : QM) (opened : Array QM 16#usize) :
    Result (QM × QM × QM × QM × Array QM 12#usize) := do
  let occupied ← Array.index_usize opened 0#usize
  let inverse ← Array.index_usize opened 1#usize
  let oneMinus ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE occupied
  let occupancy := Array.repeat 12#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  let both ← field.QM31.add input output
  let q ← field.QM31.sub occupied field.QM31.ONE
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul occupied q
  let q2 ← field.QM31.mul both q1
  let occupancy1 ← Array.update occupancy 0#usize q2
  let q3 ← Array.index_usize opened 9#usize
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul q3 inverse
  let q5 ← field.QM31.sub q4 occupied
  let q6 ← field.QM31.mul both q5
  let occupancy2 ← Array.update occupancy1 1#usize q6
  let q7 ← field.QM31.mul oneMinus inverse
  let q8 ← field.QM31.mul both q7
  let occupancy3 ← Array.update occupancy2 2#usize q8
  .ok (occupied, oneMinus, both, q8, occupancy3)

private theorem index_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize} (a : Array α n) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjOld : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hjOld := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem zero_array_canonical :
    CanonicalArray (Array.repeat 12#usize field.QM31.ZERO) := by
  intro j
  change Canonical ((List.replicate 12 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by
    simpa [Array.repeat_val] using j.isLt))
  rw [List.getElem_replicate]
  exact zero_canonical

private theorem update_ok {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ out, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  exact WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))

theorem prefix_success (input output : QM) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hin : Canonical input) (hout : Canonical output)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened) :
    ∃ occupied oneMinus both q8 : QM, ∃ out : Array QM 12#usize,
      prefixRun input output opened = .ok (occupied, oneMinus, both, q8, out) ∧
      Canonical occupied ∧ Canonical oneMinus ∧ Canonical both ∧ Canonical q8 ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      decode both = decode input + decode output ∧
      decode (get12 out ⟨0, by decide⟩) =
        (decode input + decode output) * (decode (get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩) *
          (decode (get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩) - 1)) ∧
      decode (get12 out ⟨1, by decide⟩) =
        (decode input + decode output) *
          (decode (get16 opened ⟨9, by decide⟩) * decode (get16 opened ⟨1, by decide⟩) -
            decode (get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩)) ∧
      decode (get12 out ⟨2, by decide⟩) =
        (decode input + decode output) * (decode oneMinus * decode (get16 opened ⟨1, by decide⟩)) ∧
      occupied = get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩ ∧
      decode oneMinus = 1 - decode (get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩) := by
  have hz0 : Canonical field.QM31.ZERO := zero_canonical
  have ho0 : (0#usize).val = 0 := by scalar_tac
  have ho1 : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  have ho9 : (9#usize).val = 9 := by scalar_tac
  have hb0 : (0#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  have hb1 : (1#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  have hb9 : (9#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  let occupied := get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩
  let inverse := get16 opened ⟨1, by decide⟩
  let nine := get16 opened ⟨9, by decide⟩
  have hread0 : Array.index_usize opened 0#usize = .ok occupied := by
    simpa [occupied, get16] using index_ok opened 0#usize hb0
  have hread1 : Array.index_usize opened 1#usize = .ok inverse := by
    simpa [inverse, get16] using index_ok opened 1#usize hb1
  have hread9 : Array.index_usize opened 9#usize = .ok nine := by
    simpa [nine, get16] using index_ok opened 9#usize hb9
  have hocc : Canonical occupied := hopened ⟨0, by simpa [opened.property] using hb0⟩
  have hinv : Canonical inverse := hopened ⟨1, by simpa [opened.property] using hb1⟩
  have hnine : Canonical nine := hopened ⟨9, by simpa [opened.property] using hb9⟩
  obtain ⟨oneMinus, hone, hcanOneMinus, honeVal⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact field.QM31.ONE occupied one_canonical hocc
  obtain ⟨both, hboth, hcanBoth, hbothVal⟩ := current_qm_add_exact input output hin hout
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hcanQ, hqVal⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact occupied field.QM31.ONE hocc one_canonical
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hcanQ1, hq1Val⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact occupied q hocc hcanQ
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, hcanQ2, hq2Val⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact both q1 hcanBoth hcanQ1
  obtain ⟨a1, ha1, hset1⟩ := update_ok (Array.repeat 12#usize field.QM31.ZERO) 0#usize q2 (by decide)
  have hcanA1 : CanonicalArray a1 := by rw [hset1]; exact set_canonical _ _ _ zero_array_canonical hcanQ2
  obtain ⟨q4, hq4, hcanQ4, hq4Val⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact nine inverse hnine hinv
  obtain ⟨q5, hq5, hcanQ5, hq5Val⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact q4 occupied hcanQ4 hocc
  obtain ⟨q6, hq6, hcanQ6, hq6Val⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact both q5 hcanBoth hcanQ5
  obtain ⟨a2, ha2, hset2⟩ := update_ok a1 1#usize q6 (by decide)
  have hcanA2 : CanonicalArray a2 := by rw [hset2]; exact set_canonical _ _ _ hcanA1 hcanQ6
  obtain ⟨q7, hq7, hcanQ7, hq7Val⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact oneMinus inverse hcanOneMinus hinv
  obtain ⟨q8, hq8, hcanQ8, hq8Val⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact both q7 hcanBoth hcanQ7
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hset3⟩ := update_ok a2 2#usize q8 (by decide)
  have hone' : field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE occupied = .ok oneMinus := hone
  have hboth' : field.QM31.add input output = .ok both := hboth
  have hq' : field.QM31.sub occupied field.QM31.ONE = .ok q := hq
  have hq1' : field.QM31.mul occupied q = .ok q1 := hq1
  have hq4' : field.QM31.mul nine inverse = .ok q4 := hq4
  have hq7' : field.QM31.mul oneMinus inverse = .ok q7 := hq7
  have hoccGet : occupied = get16 opened ⟨0, by decide⟩ := rfl
  have hinvGet : inverse = get16 opened ⟨1, by decide⟩ := rfl
  have hnineGet : nine = get16 opened ⟨9, by decide⟩ := rfl
  have hqVal' : decode q = decode occupied - decode field.QM31.ONE := by
    change AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode q =
      AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode occupied -
        AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode field.QM31.ONE at hqVal
    simpa only [AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode] using hqVal
  have hq5Val' : decode q5 = decode q4 - decode occupied := by
    change AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode q5 =
      AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode q4 - AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode occupied at hq5Val
    simpa only [AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode] using hq5Val
  have honeVal' : decode oneMinus = decode field.QM31.ONE - decode occupied := by
    change AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode oneMinus =
      AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode field.QM31.ONE -
        AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode occupied at honeVal
    simpa only [AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode] using honeVal
  have hcanOut : CanonicalArray out := by
    rw [hset3]
    exact set_canonical a2 2#usize q8 hcanA2 hcanQ8
  have hcell0 : get12 out ⟨0, by decide⟩ = q2 := by
    unfold get12
    rw [hset3, hset2, hset1]
    simp [Array.set_val_eq]
  have hcell1 : get12 out ⟨1, by decide⟩ = q6 := by
    unfold get12
    rw [hset3, hset2]
    simp [Array.set_val_eq, hset1]
  have hcell2 : get12 out ⟨2, by decide⟩ = q8 := by
    unfold get12
    rw [hset3]
    simp [Array.set_val_eq]
  refine ⟨occupied, oneMinus, both, q8, out, ?_, hocc, hcanOneMinus, hcanBoth, hcanQ8,
    hcanOut, hbothVal, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have ha1' : Array.update (Array.repeat 12#usize field.QM31.ZERO)
        0#usize q2 = .ok a1 := ha1
    have ha2' : Array.update a1 1#usize q6 = .ok a2 := ha2
    have hout' : Array.update a2 2#usize q8 = .ok out := hout
    change (do
      let occupied ← Array.index_usize opened 0#usize
      let inverse ← Array.index_usize opened 1#usize
      let oneMinus ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE occupied
      let occupancy := Array.repeat 12#usize field.QM31.ZERO
      let both ← field.QM31.add input output
      let q ← field.QM31.sub occupied field.QM31.ONE
      let q1 ← field.QM31.mul occupied q
      let q2 ← field.QM31.mul both q1
      let occupancy1 ← Array.update occupancy 0#usize q2
      let q3 ← Array.index_usize opened 9#usize
      let q4 ← field.QM31.mul q3 inverse
      let q5 ← field.QM31.sub q4 occupied
      let q6 ← field.QM31.mul both q5
      let occupancy2 ← Array.update occupancy1 1#usize q6
      let q7 ← field.QM31.mul oneMinus inverse
      let q8 ← field.QM31.mul both q7
      let occupancy3 ← Array.update occupancy2 2#usize q8
      .ok (occupied, oneMinus, both, q8, occupancy3)) = .ok (occupied, oneMinus, both, q8, out)
    simp only [hread0, hread1, bind_tc_ok, hone', hboth', hq', hq1', hq2,
      ha1', hread9, hq4', hq5, hq6, ha2', hq7', hq8, hout']
  · rw [hcell0, hq2Val, hq1Val, hqVal', hbothVal, hoccGet, one_decode]
  · rw [hcell1, hq6Val, hq5Val', hq4Val, hbothVal, hnineGet, hinvGet, hoccGet]
  · rw [hcell2, hq8Val, hq7Val, hbothVal, hinvGet]
  · rfl
  · rw [honeVal', one_decode, hoccGet]

#print axioms prefix_success

end

import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/-! Source proof for the eight-lane generated occupancy iterator. The result
array's exact successful execution, canonicality, and indexed decoded cells
are derived from the generated loop, its Aeneas range iterator, and the pinned
QM31 multiplication theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OccupancyLiteralLoop

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) := AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev Loop := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.occupancy_lanes_literal_loop

def cellAt (a : Array QM 12#usize) (j : Nat) : QM :=
  if h : j < 12 then a.val[j]'(by simpa [a.property] using h)
  else field.QM31.ZERO

def openedCell (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (j : Nat) : QM :=
  (opened.val[j]?).getD field.QM31.ZERO

def laneValue (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (oneMinus both : QM) (j : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode both *
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode oneMinus *
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (openedCell opened (j - 1)))

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem usize_add_result (a b : Usize) (hsum : a.val + b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    ∃ c : Usize, UScalar.add a b = .ok c ∧ c.val = a.val + b.val := by
  have hchecked : (a + b : Result Usize) ⦃ z => z.val = a.val + b.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hsum
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hval⟩
  change (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok c
  exact hc

private theorem update_success {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize)
    (x : QM) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ out : Array QM n, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  exact ⟨out, hr, hs⟩

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hj0 : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj0
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hj0 := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem cellAt_set {a : Array QM 12#usize} {i : Usize} {x : QM}
    (hi : i.val < 12) (j : Nat) :
    cellAt (a.set i x) j = if j = i.val then x else cellAt a j := by
  by_cases hj : j < 12
  · by_cases hEq : j = i.val
    · subst j
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq]
    · have hne : i.val ≠ j := Ne.symm hEq
      have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hjA : j < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hcell := List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j) hne hjSet
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hEq, hcell, hjA]
  · have hne : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hne]

private theorem small_usize_bound (n : Nat) (hn : n < 32) :
    n < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
  rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
  have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
  omega

private theorem offset_add (k : Nat) (hk : k < 4) (lane : Usize) (hlane : lane.val < 8) :
    ∃ out : Usize,
      UScalar.add (k#usize) lane = .ok out ∧ out.val = k + lane.val := by
  have hb : k + lane.val < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    apply small_usize_bound
    omega
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hval⟩ := tryMk_success (ty := .Usize) (k + lane.val) hb
  have hk : (k#usize).val = k := by scalar_tac
  refine ⟨out, ?_, ?_⟩
  · change UScalar.add (k#usize) lane = .ok out
    simpa [UScalar.add] using hrun
  · simpa [hk] using hval

/-- A fuel-indexed theorem for the exact source iterator. `hprefix` records
only cells already processed before this invocation, so recursive calls do
not assume the desired terminal vector. -/
theorem loop_success_fuel
    (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (oneMinus both : QM)
    (initial : Array QM 12#usize) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (hend : iter.end.val = 8) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = 8)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened) (honeMinus : Canonical oneMinus)
    (hboth : Canonical both) (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial)
    (hprefix : ∀ j : Fin 12, 3 ≤ j.val → j.val < 3 + iter.start.val →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) = laneValue opened oneMinus both j.val) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 12#usize,
      Loop iter opened oneMinus initial both = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 12,
        if 3 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < 11 then
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) = laneValue opened oneMinus both j.val
        else AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val)) := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter initial with
  | zero =>
      have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
      have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
      have hstart : iter.start.val = 8 := by omega
      refine ⟨initial, ?_, hinitial, ?_⟩
      · change pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.occupancy_lanes_literal_loop
          iter opened oneMinus initial both = .ok initial
        rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.occupancy_lanes_literal_loop.eq_def]
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
      · intro j
        by_cases hj : 3 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < 11
        · have hproc : j.val < 3 + iter.start.val := by omega
          simpa [hj] using hprefix j (by omega) hproc
        · simp [hj]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
      have hlane : iter.start.val < 8 := by omega
      obtain ⟨iter1, hnext, hstart1, hend1, _⟩ :=
        AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
      have hend1' : iter1.end.val = 8 := by rw [hend1, hend]
      have hspan1 : iter1.start.val + fuel = 8 := by omega
      let lane := iter.start
      have hidx : lane.val = iter.start.val := rfl
      obtain ⟨i, hi, hiv⟩ := offset_add 2 (by decide) lane (by simpa [lane] using hlane)
      obtain ⟨i1, hi1, hi1v⟩ := offset_add 3 (by decide) lane (by simpa [lane] using hlane)
      have h16U : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
      have h12U : (12#usize).val = 12 := by scalar_tac
      have hiBound : i.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hiv, h16U]; omega
      have hi1Bound : i1.val < 12 := by rw [hi1v]; omega
      have hi1BoundU : i1.val < (12#usize).val := by simpa [h12U] using hi1Bound
      have hread : Array.index_usize opened i =
          .ok (opened.val[i.val]'(by simpa [opened.property] using hiBound)) :=
        index_usize_ok opened i hiBound
      let q := opened.val[i.val]'(by simpa [opened.property] using hiBound)
      have hqcan : Canonical q := by
        apply hopened ⟨i.val, hiBound⟩
      obtain ⟨q1, hmul1, hq1can, hq1val⟩ :=
        current_qm_mul_exact oneMinus q honeMinus hqcan
      have hmul1' : field.QM31.mul oneMinus
          (opened.val[i.val]'(by simpa [opened.property] using hiBound)) = .ok q1 := by
        simpa [q] using hmul1
      obtain ⟨q2, hmul2, hq2can, hq2val⟩ :=
        current_qm_mul_exact both q1 hboth hq1can
      obtain ⟨updated, hupdate, hset⟩ := update_success initial i1 q2 hi1BoundU
      have hupdatedCan : CanonicalArray updated := by
        rw [hset]
        exact set_canonical initial i1 q2 hinitial hq2can
      have hqcell : openedCell opened (3 + lane.val - 1) = q := by
        have hidxEq : 3 + lane.val - 1 = i.val := by rw [hiv]; omega
        have hltI : i.val < opened.val.length := by simpa [opened.property] using hiBound
        have hget : opened.val[i.val]? = some q := by
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hltI]
        unfold openedCell
        rw [hidxEq, hget]
        rfl
      have hq2model : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q2 = laneValue opened oneMinus both (3 + lane.val) := by
        rw [hq2val, hq1val]
        simp only [laneValue, hqcell]
      have hprefix1 : ∀ j : Fin 12, 3 ≤ j.val → j.val < 3 + iter1.start.val →
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt updated j.val) = laneValue opened oneMinus both j.val := by
        intro j hjlo hjhi
        by_cases heq : j.val = 3 + lane.val
        · have hEqI1 : j.val = i1.val := by rw [hi1v]; simpa [lane] using heq
          have hcell : cellAt updated j.val = q2 := by
            rw [hset, cellAt_set hi1Bound, if_pos hEqI1]
          rw [hcell, heq]
          exact hq2model
        · have hold : j.val < 3 + iter.start.val := by omega
          have hNeI1 : j.val ≠ i1.val := by
            intro h
            apply heq
            calc
              j.val = i1.val := h
              _ = 3 + lane.val := hi1v
          have hcell : cellAt updated j.val = cellAt initial j.val := by
            rw [hset, cellAt_set hi1Bound, if_neg hNeI1]
          rw [hcell]
          exact hprefix j hjlo hold
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtcan, hvalues⟩ :=
        ih updated iter1 hend1' hspan1 hupdatedCan hprefix1
      have hvaluesOriginal : ∀ j : Fin 12,
          if 3 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < 11 then
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) = laneValue opened oneMinus both j.val
          else AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) =
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) := by
        intro j
        by_cases hj : 3 ≤ j.val ∧ j.val < 11
        · simpa [hj] using hvalues j
        · have hneq : j.val ≠ i1.val := by
            intro h
            apply hj
            constructor
            · rw [h, hi1v]
              omega
            · rw [h, hi1v]
              have hl : lane.val < 8 := by simpa [lane] using hlane
              omega
          have hunchanged : cellAt updated j.val = cellAt initial j.val := by
            rw [hset, cellAt_set hi1Bound, if_neg hneq]
          have hval := hvalues j
          simp only [if_neg hj] at hval
          have hcalc : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) =
              AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) := by
            calc
              AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) =
                  AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt updated j.val) := hval
              _ = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) :=
                congrArg AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode hunchanged
          simpa [hj] using hcalc
      refine ⟨out, ?_, houtcan, hvaluesOriginal⟩
      · change pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.occupancy_lanes_literal_loop
          iter opened oneMinus initial both = .ok out
        rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.occupancy_lanes_literal_loop.eq_def]
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
        change (do
          let i ← (UScalar.add 2#usize lane : Result Usize)
          let q ← Array.index_usize opened i
          let q1 ← field.QM31.mul oneMinus q
          let q2 ← field.QM31.mul both q1
          let i1 ← (UScalar.add 3#usize lane : Result Usize)
          let a ← Array.update initial i1 q2
          pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.occupancy_lanes_literal_loop
            iter1 opened oneMinus a both) = .ok out
        simp only [hi, bind_tc_ok, hread, bind_tc_ok, hmul1', bind_tc_ok,
          hmul2, bind_tc_ok, hi1, bind_tc_ok, hupdate, bind_tc_ok]
        exact hrun

#print axioms loop_success_fuel
end AspisR1.OccupancyLiteralLoop

import OccupancyGeneratedSlice
import OccupancyExpectedBridge
import R0P.Occupancy
import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
import ExtractedMaskConstants
import EqualityValueAdapter
import SelectorExpansionCorrectness

/-! Actual checked occupancy lane-11 arithmetic and update, following the
generated eight-lane loop. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OccupancyLiteralTail
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Canonical := CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

private theorem bound16 (i : Nat) : i < 16 → i < (16#usize).val := by
  intro hi
  have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
  omega

private theorem bound12 (i : Nat) : i < 12 → i < (12#usize).val := by
  intro hi
  have h12 : (12#usize).val = 12 := by scalar_tac
  omega

private def get16 (a : Array QM 16#usize) (i : Fin 16) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using (bound16 i.val i.isLt))

private def get12 (a : Array QM 12#usize) (i : Fin 12) : QM :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using (bound12 i.val i.isLt))

def tailRun (input output : QM) (expected : field.M31)
    (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (occupied oneMinus : QM)
    (occupancy : Array QM 12#usize) : Result (Array QM 12#usize) := do
  let q9 ← Array.index_usize opened 10#usize
  let q10 ← field.QM31.mul q9 oneMinus
  let q11 ← field.QM31.mul input q10
  let q12 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 expected
  let q13 ← field.QM31.sub occupied q12
  let q14 ← field.QM31.mul output q13
  let q15 ← field.QM31.add q11 q14
  Array.update occupancy 11#usize q15

private theorem index_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize} (a : Array α n) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjOld : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hjOld := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem update_ok {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ out, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  exact WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))

theorem tail_success (input output : QM) (expected : field.M31)
    (variant : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.CompiledVariant)
    (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (occupied oneMinus : QM)
    (occupancy : Array QM 12#usize)
    (hin : Canonical input) (hout : Canonical output)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened) (hoccupied : Canonical occupied)
    (honeMinus : Canonical oneMinus) (hoccupancy : CanonicalArray occupancy)
    (honeMinusValue : decode oneMinus = 1 - decode occupied)
    (hexpected : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.variant_expected_output variant = .ok expected) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 12#usize,
      tailRun input output expected opened occupied oneMinus occupancy = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      decode (get12 out ⟨11, by decide⟩) =
        decode input * (decode (get16 opened ⟨10, by decide⟩) * (1 - decode occupied)) +
        decode output * (decode occupied - R0P.occupancyExpected
          (AspisR1.OccupancyExpectedBridge.modelVariant variant)) ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 12, j.val ≠ 11 → get12 out j = get12 occupancy j) := by
  have h10b : (10#usize).val < (16#usize).val := by scalar_tac
  have hread10 := index_ok opened 10#usize h10b
  let z10 := get16 opened ⟨10, by decide⟩
  have hz10 : Canonical z10 := hopened ⟨10, by simpa [opened.property] using h10b⟩
  have hq10read : Array.index_usize opened 10#usize = .ok z10 := by
    simpa [z10, get16] using hread10
  obtain ⟨expectedM31, q12, hexp, hlift, hq12can, hq12decode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.OccupancyExpectedBridge.variant_expected_lift_exact variant
  have hexpectedM31 : expectedM31 = expected := Result.ok.inj (hexp.symm.trans hexpected)
  subst expectedM31
  obtain ⟨q10, hmul10, hq10can, hq10decode⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact z10 oneMinus hz10 honeMinus
  obtain ⟨q11, hmul11, hq11can, hq11decode⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact input q10 hin hq10can
  obtain ⟨q13, hsub13, hq13can, hq13decode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact occupied q12 hoccupied hq12can
  obtain ⟨q14, hmul14, hq14can, hq14decode⟩ := current_qm_mul_exact output q13 hout hq13can
  obtain ⟨q15, hadd15, hq15can, hq15decode⟩ := current_qm_add_exact q11 q14 hq11can hq14can
  obtain ⟨out, hupdate, hset⟩ := update_ok occupancy 11#usize q15 (by decide)
  have hcanOut : CanonicalArray out := by
    rw [hset]
    exact set_canonical occupancy 11#usize q15 hoccupancy hq15can
  have hcell : get12 out ⟨11, by decide⟩ = q15 := by
    unfold get12
    rw [hset]
    simp [Array.set_val_eq]
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcanOut, ?_⟩
  · simp only [tailRun, hq10read, bind_tc_ok, hmul10, hmul11, hlift,
      hsub13, hmul14, hadd15, hupdate]
  · constructor
    · have hq13decode' : decode q13 = decode occupied - decode q12 := by
        change AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode q13 =
          AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode occupied - AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode q12 at hq13decode
        simpa only [AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode] using hq13decode

        hq13decode', hq12decode, honeMinusValue]
    · intro j hj
      unfold get12
      rw [hset]
      have hne : (11#usize).val ≠ j.val := by
        intro heq
        apply hj
        have h11 : (11#usize).val = 11 := by scalar_tac
        omega
      have hbound : j.val < occupancy.val.length := by
        simpa [occupancy.property] using (bound12 j.val j.isLt)
      have hboundSet : j.val < (occupancy.val.set (11#usize).val q15).length := by
        simpa using hbound
      simpa [Array.set_val_eq] using
        (List.getElem_set_ne (l := occupancy.val) (i := (11#usize).val)
          (j := j.val) hne hboundSet)

#print axioms tail_success

        (sel 508 * (o.z 1 - pub.assetId))
        (sel 460 * (o.z 1 - pub.assetId))

    (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings) (pub : R0P.Public Wide)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hp : CanonicalArray packed) (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hasset : public1.asset_id.val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hamount : (AspisR1.ScalarSuffixExecution.amountValue public1).val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)

    (ha : pub.assetId = f (exactPublic public1).assetId)
    (hw : pub.withdrawalAmount = (exactPublic public1).withdrawalAmount.map f) :
    ∃ out, AspisR1ScalarSuffixCandidate.scalar_suffix packed public1 openings selectors = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧ ∀ j : Fin 24,

        R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k : Fin 4 => selectList 92
          ((R0P.assetFamily (K := Wide)).residuals pub

  obtain ⟨values, hvalues, hcValues, hvValues⟩ := AspisR1.ScalarSuffixExecution.source_values
    point selectors public1 openings hpoint hbox hz hasset hamount
  have hfamily : values.val.map decode =
      (R0P.assetFamily (K := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact)).residuals

  have hwide := AspisR1.AssetFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f (exactPublic public1) pub

    packed 92#usize values _ (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) hp hcValues hresiduals

  · rw [suffix_eq_values]
    simp only [hvalues, bind_tc_ok, hpack]
  · have hstart : (92#usize).val = 92 := by scalar_tac
    rw [hstart] at hvOut
    exact hvOut

import DigestFixedPrefix

/-! Exact initial straight-line cut of the sealed candidate public_digest_lanes.
The sole source-body renaming is the already-proved binding helper owner. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.Source
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

/-- Exact source cut; the enclosing loop and suffix are deliberately excluded. -/
def exactPrefix
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (openings : state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings)
    (selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) :
    Result (Array field.QM31 8#usize) := do
  let digests := Array.repeat 8#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  let i ← 56#usize * 16#usize
  let i1 ← i + 11#usize
  let q ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i1
  let digests1 ←
    AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding digests q
      openings.z 0#usize public1.anchor false
  let i2 ← 26#usize * 16#usize
  let i3 ← i2 + 11#usize
  let q1 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i3
  let digests2 ←
    AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding digests1 q1
      openings.z 0#usize public1.nullifier false
  let digests3 ←
    match public1.recipient with
    | none => ok digests2
    | some recipient =>
      do
      let i4 ← 29#usize * 16#usize
      let i5 ← i4 + 11#usize
      let q2 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i5
      AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding digests2 q2
        openings.z 0#usize recipient false
  let i4 ← 32#usize * 16#usize
  let i5 ← i4 + 11#usize
  let q2 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i5
  let digests4 ←
    AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding digests3 q2
      openings.z 0#usize public1.change false
  ok digests4

private theorem result_right_identity {α : Type} (x : Result α) :
    (do let y ← x; Result.ok y) = x := by
  cases x <;> rfl

/-- Factoring the repeated fragment does not change prefix execution or errors. -/
theorem exactPrefix_eq_factored
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (openings : state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings)
    (selectors : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) :
    exactPrefix public1 openings selectors =
      AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.fixedPrefix public1 openings.z selectors := by
  simp only [exactPrefix, AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.fixedPrefix,
    AspisR1.DigestFixedBinding.bindBlock, AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.zero, bind_assoc_eq,
    bind_tc_ok, result_right_identity]
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms exactPrefix_eq_factored
end AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.Source

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact
open AspisR1.DigestFixedBinding
abbrev Public := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic
abbrev DigestWordsCanonical (d : Array M31 8#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 8, (d.val[j.val]'(by simpa [d.property] using j.isLt)).val <
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P

def zero : Array QM 8#usize := Array.repeat 8#usize field.QM31.ZERO

theorem zero_canonical : CanonicalArray zero := by
  intro j
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
    ((List.replicate 8 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by simpa using j.isLt))
  rw [List.getElem_replicate]
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_canonical

theorem zero_decoded : decoded zero = (fun _ => 0) := by
  funext j
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt zero j.val) = 0
  unfold cellAt
  rw [dif_pos j.isLt]
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
    ((List.replicate 8 field.QM31.ZERO)[j.val]'(by simpa using j.isLt)) = 0
  rw [List.getElem_replicate]
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_decode

/-- The first four bindings of the actual wrapper, factored only at the
repeated checked-row/binding fragment. The recipient presence branch is kept. -/
def fixedPrefix (public1 : Public) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (selectors : Selectors) : Result (Array QM 8#usize) := do
  let d1 ← bindBlock zero opened selectors 56#usize public1.anchor
  let d2 ← bindBlock d1 opened selectors 26#usize public1.nullifier
  let d3 ← match public1.recipient with
    | none => .ok d2
    | some recipient => bindBlock d2 opened selectors 29#usize recipient
  bindBlock d3 opened selectors 32#usize public1.change

@[irreducible] def step (point : Array QM 10#usize) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (block : Fin 64) (target : Array M31 8#usize) (acc : R0P.Digest ExactQM) :
    R0P.Digest ExactQM :=
  R0P.digestAddBinding acc (pointSelector point ⟨block.val * 16 + 11, by omega⟩)
    (openedModel opened) 0 (SemanticPublicModel.digest target)

@[irreducible] def model (point : Array QM 10#usize) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (public1 : Public) : R0P.Digest ExactQM :=
  let d1 := step point opened 56 public1.anchor (fun _ => 0)
  let d2 := step point opened 26 public1.nullifier d1
  let d3 := match public1.recipient with
    | none => d2
    | some recipient => step point opened 29 recipient d2
  step point opened 32 public1.change d3

attribute [local irreducible] R0P.digestAddBinding
  AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

theorem source_success (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (public1 : Public) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened)
    (ha : DigestWordsCanonical public1.anchor)
    (hn : DigestWordsCanonical public1.nullifier)
    (hc : DigestWordsCanonical public1.change)
    (hr : ∀ recipient, public1.recipient = some recipient → DigestWordsCanonical recipient) :
    ∃ out, fixedPrefix public1 opened selectors = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      decoded out = model point opened public1 := by
  obtain ⟨d1, h1, hc1, hv1⟩ := bindBlock_success point selectors zero opened 56#usize
    public1.anchor (by decide) hpoint hbox zero_canonical hopened ha
  have h1m : decoded d1 = step point opened 56 public1.anchor (fun _ => 0) := by
    unfold step
    funext j
    rw [hv1 j, zero_decoded]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨d2, h2, hc2, hv2⟩ := bindBlock_success point selectors d1 opened 26#usize
    public1.nullifier (by decide) hpoint hbox hc1 hopened hn
  have h2m : decoded d2 = step point opened 26 public1.nullifier (decoded d1) := by
    unfold step
    exact funext hv2
  rw [h1m] at h2m
  cases hrec : public1.recipient with
  | none =>
    obtain ⟨out, ho, hco, hvo⟩ := bindBlock_success point selectors d2 opened 32#usize
      public1.change (by decide) hpoint hbox hc2 hopened hc
    refine ⟨out, ?_, hco, ?_⟩
    · unfold fixedPrefix
      rw [h1]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [h2]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, hrec]
      exact ho
    · rw [model]
      simp only [hrec]
      have hm : decoded out = step point opened 32 public1.change (decoded d2) := by
        unfold step
        exact funext hvo
      rw [h2m] at hm
      exact hm
  | some recipient =>
    obtain ⟨d3, h3, hc3, hv3⟩ := bindBlock_success point selectors d2 opened 29#usize
      recipient (by decide) hpoint hbox hc2 hopened (hr recipient hrec)
    have h3m : decoded d3 = step point opened 29 recipient (decoded d2) := by
      unfold step
      exact funext hv3
    rw [h2m] at h3m
    obtain ⟨out, ho, hco, hvo⟩ := bindBlock_success point selectors d3 opened 32#usize
      public1.change (by decide) hpoint hbox hc3 hopened hc
    refine ⟨out, ?_, hco, ?_⟩
    · unfold fixedPrefix
      rw [h1]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [h2]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, hrec]
      rw [h3]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      exact ho
    · rw [model]
      simp only [hrec]
      have hm : decoded out = step point opened 32 public1.change (decoded d3) := by
        unfold step
        exact funext hvo
      rw [h3m] at hm
      exact hm

#print axioms zero_canonical
#print axioms zero_decoded
#print axioms source_success
end
end AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix

abbrev QM := field.QM31

def cellAt (a : Array QM 8#usize) (j : Nat) : QM :=
  if h : j < 8 then a.val[j]'(by simpa [a.property] using h)
  else field.QM31.ZERO

def expectedAt (a : Array M31 8#usize) (j : Nat) : M31 :=

        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P
    else (expected.val[j]'(by simpa [expected.property] using h)).val

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem update_success {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize)
    (x : QM) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    ∃ out : Array QM n, Array.update a i x = .ok out ∧ out = a.set i x := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hs⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec a i x (by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  exact ⟨out, hr, hs⟩

private theorem set_canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (ha : CanonicalArray a) (hx : Canonical x) : CanonicalArray (a.set i x) := by
  intro j
  have hj0 : j.val < a.val.length := by simpa using j.isLt
  have hjSet : j.val < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa using hj0
  change Canonical ((a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet)
  by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = x := by
      have hself := List.getElem_set_self (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (a := x)
        (by simpa [heq] using hjSet)
      simpa [heq] using hself
    rw [hcell]
    exact hx
  · have hcell : (a.val.set i.val x)[j.val]'hjSet = a.val[j.val]'hj0 := by
      simpa using (List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j.val)
        heq hjSet)
    rw [hcell]
    exact ha j

private theorem cellAt_set {a : Array QM 8#usize} {i : Usize} {x : QM}
    (hi : i.val < 8) (j : Nat) :
    cellAt (a.set i x) j = if j = i.val then x else cellAt a j := by
  by_cases hj : j < 8
  · by_cases hEq : j = i.val
    · subst j
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq]
    · have hne : i.val ≠ j := Ne.symm hEq
      have hjSet : j < (a.val.set i.val x).length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hjA : j < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hj
      have hcell := List.getElem_set_ne (l := a.val) (i := i.val) (j := j) hne hjSet
      simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hEq, hcell, hjA]
  · have hne : j ≠ i.val := by omega
    simp [cellAt, hj, Array.set_val_eq, hne]

private theorem offset_add (a b : Usize) (hsum : a.val + b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    ∃ c : Usize, (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok c ∧ c.val = a.val + b.val := by
  have hchecked : (a + b : Result Usize) ⦃ z => z.val = a.val + b.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hsum
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hval⟩
  change (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok c
  exact hc

/-- Exact success, canonicality and all eight decoded output cells for the
production `add_digest_binding_loop`. `hprefix` is only the processed-prefix
invariant; the caller starts at lane zero with it vacuous. -/
theorem loop_success_fuel
    (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (selector : QM)
    (initial base : Array QM 8#usize) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (start : Usize) (expected : Array M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool)
    (hend : iter.end.val = 8) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = 8)
    (hstart : start.val + 8 ≤ 16)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened) (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial) (hbase : CanonicalArray base)
    (hexpected : ∀ j : Fin 8, (expected.val[j.val]'(by simpa [expected.property] using j.isLt)).val <
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P)
    (hprefix : ∀ j : Fin 8, j.val < iter.start.val →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt base j.val) =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) +
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
            laneValue opened start expected rightTweak j.val)
    (hunchanged : ∀ j : Fin 8, iter.start.val ≤ j.val →
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt base j.val) =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val)) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 8#usize,
      add_digest_binding_loop iter base selector opened start expected rightTweak = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 8,
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) =
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) +
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
              laneValue opened start expected rightTweak j.val := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter base with
  | zero =>
      have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
      have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
      have hiter : iter.start.val = 8 := by omega
      refine ⟨base, ?_, hbase, ?_⟩
      · change add_digest_binding_loop iter base selector opened start expected rightTweak = .ok base
        rw [add_digest_binding_loop.eq_def]
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
      · intro j
        have hj : j.val < iter.start.val := by omega
        exact hprefix j hj
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
      have hlane : iter.start.val < 8 := by omega
      obtain ⟨iter1, hnext, hiter1, hend1, _⟩ :=
        AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
      have hend1' : iter1.end.val = 8 := by rw [hend1, hend]
      have hspan1 : iter1.start.val + fuel = 8 := by omega

      have hbaseIndex : lane.val < (8#usize).val := by simpa using hlane8
      have houtread := index_usize_ok base lane hbaseIndex
      have hexpectIndex := index_usize_ok expected lane hbaseIndex
      let old := base.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [base.property] using hbaseIndex)
      let expectedLane := expected.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [expected.property] using hbaseIndex)
      have holdCanonical : Canonical old := hbase ⟨lane.val,hbaseIndex⟩
      have hexpectCanonical : expectedLane.val < AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P := by
        simpa [expectedLane] using hexpected ⟨lane.val,hbaseIndex⟩
      obtain ⟨target, htarget, htargetCanonical, htargetValue⟩ :=
        targetAfterLane_success lane expectedLane rightTweak hlane8 hexpectCanonical
      have hstartLaneBound : start.val + lane.val ≤ Usize.max := by
        have hb : start.val + lane.val < 16 := by omega
        have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
        omega
      obtain ⟨openedIndex, hoffset, hoffsetVal⟩ := offset_add start lane hstartLaneBound
      have hopenBound : openedIndex.val < (16#usize).val := by
        have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
        rw [hoffsetVal,h16]
        omega
      have hopenread := index_usize_ok opened openedIndex hopenBound
      let openedLane := opened.val[openedIndex.val]'(by simpa [opened.property] using hopenBound)
      have hopenCanonical : Canonical openedLane := hopened ⟨openedIndex.val,hopenBound⟩
      have htargetEq :
          target.val = targetValue expected rightTweak lane.val := by
        simp [targetValue, lane, expectedLane, htargetValue, hlane8]
      obtain ⟨lifted,difference,scaled,updated,hlift,hsub,hmul,hadd,hupdatedCanonical,hformula⟩ :=
        lane_arithmetic_exact old selector openedLane target holdCanonical hselector hopenCanonical
          (by simpa [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P,AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P] using htargetCanonical)
      obtain ⟨out, hupdate, hset⟩ := update_success base lane updated hlane8
      have houtCanonical : CanonicalArray out := by
        rw [hset]
        exact set_canonical base lane updated hbase hupdatedCanonical
      have hopenedCell : openedAt opened (start.val + lane.val) = openedLane := by
        have hidx : openedIndex.val = start.val + lane.val := hoffsetVal
        have hlt : openedIndex.val < opened.val.length := by simpa [opened.property] using hopenBound
        have hget : opened.val[openedIndex.val]? = some openedLane := by
          rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hlt]
        rw [← hidx]
        simp [openedAt, hget]
      have holdInitial : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old =
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial lane.val) := by
        have hu := hunchanged ⟨lane.val, by simpa [lane] using hlane⟩ (by simp [lane])
        have hc : cellAt base lane.val = old := by simp [cellAt,old,hlane8]
        rw [hc] at hu
        exact hu

            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial lane.val) +
              AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
                laneValue opened start expected rightTweak lane.val := by
        unfold laneValue
        rw [hopenedCell]
        have hformula' := hformula
        rw [htargetEq] at hformula'
        rw [holdInitial] at hformula'
        exact hformula' 
      have hprefix1 : ∀ j : Fin 8, j.val < iter1.start.val →
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) =
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) +
              AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
                laneValue opened start expected rightTweak j.val := by
        intro j hj
        by_cases heq : j.val = lane.val
        · have hjEq : j = ⟨lane.val, hlane8⟩ := Fin.ext heq
          have hcell : cellAt out lane.val = updated := by
            rw [hset,cellAt_set hlane8,if_pos rfl]
          have holdcell : cellAt base lane.val = old := by simp [cellAt,old,hlane8]
          rw [hjEq, hcell]
          exact hformulaLane
        · have hjOld : j.val < iter.start.val := by omega
          have hne : j.val ≠ lane.val := by simpa [lane] using heq
          have hcell : cellAt out j.val = cellAt base j.val := by
            rw [hset,cellAt_set hlane8,if_neg hne]
          rw [hcell]
          have hp := hprefix j hjOld
          exact hp
      have hunchanged1 : ∀ j : Fin 8, iter1.start.val ≤ j.val →
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out j.val) =
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt initial j.val) := by
        intro j hj
        have hne : j.val ≠ lane.val := by omega
        have hcell : cellAt out j.val = cellAt base j.val := by
          rw [hset,cellAt_set hlane8,if_neg hne]
        rw [hcell]
        exact hunchanged j (by omega)

        ih out iter1 hend1' hspan1 houtCanonical hprefix1 hunchanged1
      have hbaseRead : Array.index_usize base iter.start = .ok old := by
        simpa [lane, old] using houtread
      have hexpectRead : Array.index_usize expected iter.start = .ok expectedLane := by
        simpa [lane, expectedLane] using hexpectIndex
      have hoffsetRead : (start + iter.start : Result Usize) = .ok openedIndex := by
        simpa [lane] using hoffset
      refine ⟨final, ?_, hfinalCanonical, ?_⟩
      · let nextLoop : Range → Array QM 8#usize → Result (Array QM 8#usize) :=
          fun nextIter nextOut =>
            add_digest_binding_loop nextIter nextOut selector opened start expected rightTweak
        have hstep := ImportUnionDigestStep.step_success nextLoop iter1 lane base selector

          difference scaled updated openedIndex out final hexpectIndex htarget houtread
          hoffset hopenread hlift hsub hmul hadd hupdate hloop
        have hraw := (ImportUnionDigestStep.rawStep_eq_step nextLoop iter1 lane base
          selector opened start expected rightTweak).trans hstep
        change add_digest_binding_loop iter base selector opened start expected rightTweak = .ok final
        rw [add_digest_binding_loop.eq_def]
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
        change ImportUnionDigestStep.rawStep nextLoop iter1 lane base selector opened
          start expected rightTweak = .ok final
        exact hraw
      · exact hfinalValues

/-! Symbolic lane-step normalization. The continuation is a parameter, so kernel
checking this straight-line composition cannot unfold the recursive loop. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace ImportUnionDigestStep
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.Exact

abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
abbrev Output := Array field.QM31 8#usize

def rawStep (nextLoop : Range → Output → Result Output) (iter1 : Range)
    (lane : Usize) (base : Output) (selector : field.QM31)
    (opened : Array field.QM31 16#usize) (start : Usize)
    (expected : Array field.M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool) : Result Output := do
  let target ← Array.index_usize expected lane
  let (iter2, target1) ←
    if rightTweak then do
      let i ← lane + 1#usize
      let m ← if i = poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS then
        field.M31.add target poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK
        else Result.ok target
      Result.ok (iter1, m)
    else Result.ok (iter1, target)
  let q ← Array.index_usize base lane
  let i ← start + lane
  let q1 ← Array.index_usize opened i
  let q2 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 target1
  let q3 ← field.QM31.sub q1 q2
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul selector q3
  let q5 ← field.QM31.add q q4
  let a ← Array.update base lane q5
  nextLoop iter2 a

def step (nextLoop : Range → Output → Result Output) (iter1 : Range)
    (lane : Usize) (base : Output) (selector : field.QM31)
    (opened : Array field.QM31 16#usize) (start : Usize)
    (expected : Array field.M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool) : Result Output := do
  let target ← Array.index_usize expected lane
  let target1 ← targetAfterLane lane target rightTweak
  let q ← Array.index_usize base lane
  let i ← start + lane
  let q1 ← Array.index_usize opened i
  let q2 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 target1
  let q3 ← field.QM31.sub q1 q2
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul selector q3
  let q5 ← field.QM31.add q q4
  let a ← Array.update base lane q5
  nextLoop iter1 a

theorem rawStep_eq_step (nextLoop : Range → Output → Result Output) (iter1 : Range)
    (lane : Usize) (base : Output) (selector : field.QM31)
    (opened : Array field.QM31 16#usize) (start : Usize)
    (expected : Array field.M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool) :
    rawStep nextLoop iter1 lane base selector opened start expected rightTweak =
      step nextLoop iter1 lane base selector opened start expected rightTweak := by
  have uncurry_as_projections {α β γ : Type} (f : α → β → γ) :
      Aeneas.Std.uncurry f = fun p : α × β => f p.1 p.2 := by
    funext p
    rcases p with ⟨a, b⟩
    exact Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair f a b
  cases rightTweak <;>
    simp only [rawStep, step, targetAfterLane, Bool.false_eq_true, ite_false,
      ite_true, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq, uncurry_as_projections]

theorem step_success (nextLoop : Range → Output → Result Output) (iter1 : Range)
    (lane : Usize) (base : Output) (selector : field.QM31)
    (opened : Array field.QM31 16#usize) (start : Usize)
    (expected : Array field.M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool)
    (expectedLane target : field.M31) (old openedLane lifted difference scaled updated : field.QM31)
    (openedIndex : Usize) (out final : Output)
    (hexpected : Array.index_usize expected lane = Result.ok expectedLane)
    (htarget : targetAfterLane lane expectedLane rightTweak = Result.ok target)
    (hbase : Array.index_usize base lane = Result.ok old)
    (hoffset : (start + lane : Result Usize) = Result.ok openedIndex)
    (hopened : Array.index_usize opened openedIndex = Result.ok openedLane)
    (hlift : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 target = Result.ok lifted)
    (hsub : field.QM31.sub openedLane lifted = Result.ok difference)
    (hmul : field.QM31.mul selector difference = Result.ok scaled)
    (hadd : field.QM31.add old scaled = Result.ok updated)
    (hupdate : Array.update base lane updated = Result.ok out)
    (hcontinue : nextLoop iter1 out = Result.ok final) :
    step nextLoop iter1 lane base selector opened start expected rightTweak = Result.ok final := by
  simp only [step, hexpected, htarget, hbase, hoffset, hopened, hlift, hsub,
    hmul, hadd, hupdate, hcontinue, bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms rawStep_eq_step
#print axioms step_success
end ImportUnionDigestStep

namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.Exact

open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

abbrev QM := field.QM31

abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact
