/-- One exact source lane of `add_digest_binding`: after lifting the selected
M31 target, the current QM31 sub/mul/add chain succeeds, remains canonical,
and denotes the displayed tower expression. -/
theorem lane_arithmetic_exact
    (old selector opened : QM) (target : M31)
    (hold : Canonical old) (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hopened : Canonical opened) (htarget : target.val < AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P) :
    ∃ lifted difference scaled updated,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31 target = .ok lifted ∧
      field.QM31.sub opened lifted = .ok difference ∧
      field.QM31.mul selector difference = .ok scaled ∧
      field.QM31.add old scaled = .ok updated ∧
      Canonical updated ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode updated =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old +
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
            (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode opened - (target.val : ExactQM)) := by
  obtain ⟨lifted, hlift, hliftCanonical, hliftDecode⟩ :=
    AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.lift_source_exact target (by
      simpa [AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P,
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P] using htarget)
  obtain ⟨difference, hsub, hdifferenceCanonical, hdifference⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact opened lifted hopened hliftCanonical
  obtain ⟨scaled, hmul, hscaledCanonical, hscaled⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact selector difference
      hselector hdifferenceCanonical
  obtain ⟨updated, hadd, hupdatedCanonical, hupdated⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact old scaled
      hold hscaledCanonical
  refine ⟨lifted, difference, scaled, updated, hlift, hsub, hmul, hadd,
    hupdatedCanonical, ?_⟩
  have hdifference' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode difference =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode opened -
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode lifted := by
    simpa [AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode] using hdifference
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode updated =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old +
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode opened - (target.val : ExactQM))
  calc
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode updated =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old +
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode scaled := hupdated
    _ = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old +
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode difference) := by rw [hscaled]
    _ = AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old +
          (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector *
            (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode opened - (target.val : ExactQM))) := by
      rw [hdifference', hliftDecode]


/-- The exact source right-tweak sub-block at one digest lane. -/
def targetAfterLane (lane : Usize) (expected : M31) (rightTweak : Bool) :
    Result M31 := do
  if rightTweak then do
    let i ← lane + 1#usize
    if i = poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS then
      field.M31.add expected poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK
    else ok expected
  else ok expected

theorem targetAfterLane_success
    (lane : Usize) (expected : M31) (rightTweak : Bool)
    (hlane : lane.val < 8)
    (hexpected : expected.val < AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P) :
    ∃ target, targetAfterLane lane expected rightTweak = .ok target ∧
      target.val < AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P ∧
      target.val = if rightTweak = true ∧ lane.val = 7 then
        (expected.val + poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK.val) %
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P
      else expected.val := by
  by_cases hright : rightTweak
  · have hspec : (lane + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃i => i.val = lane.val + 1⦄ := by
      apply UScalar.add_spec
      scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨i, hadd, hi⟩ := Aeneas.Std.WP.spec_imp_exists hspec
    by_cases heq : i = poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS
    · have hlaneEq : lane.val = 7 := by
        have hi' : i.val = 8 := by simpa [poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS] using congrArg (fun x : Usize => x.val) heq
        omega
      have htweak : poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK.val <
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P := by
        norm_num [poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK,
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P,
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P]
      obtain ⟨target, htarget, hvalue, hcanon⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.current_add_mod expected
          poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK hexpected htweak
      refine ⟨target, ?_, hcanon, ?_⟩
      · simp [targetAfterLane, hright, hadd, heq, htarget]
      · simp [hright, hlaneEq, hvalue]
    · refine ⟨expected, ?_, hexpected, ?_⟩
      · simp [targetAfterLane, hright, hadd, heq]
      · have hnot : lane.val ≠ 7 := by
          intro h7
          apply heq
          apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
          simp [hi, h7, poseidon2.DIGEST_ELEMS]
        simp [hright, hnot]
  · exact ⟨expected, by simp [targetAfterLane, hright], hexpected, by simp [hright]⟩

#print axioms targetAfterLane_success

import TerminalDigestFrontierModel

/-! Generic field-level decomposition of the retained complete digest model.
No concrete extension-field reduction or numerical certificate is used. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.DigestModelDecomposition
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

abbrev foldStep (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K)
    (acc : R0P.Digest K) (key : R0P.DigestKey) : R0P.Digest K :=
  R0P.digestAddBinding acc (sel (R0P.digestRow pub key)) o.z
    (R0P.digestStart pub key) (R0P.digestTarget pub key)

def prefixKeys (pub : R0P.Public K) : List R0P.DigestKey :=
  [.anchor, .nullifier] ++
    (match pub.recipient with | none => [] | some _ => [.recipient]) ++ [.change]

def suffixKeys (pub : R0P.Public K) : List R0P.DigestKey :=
  [.nextRoot] ++ (if R0P.digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20 then [.carry] else [])

def prefixFold (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  (prefixKeys pub).foldl (foldStep pub o sel) (fun _ => 0)

def suffixFold (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K)
    (acc : R0P.Digest K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  (suffixKeys pub).foldl (foldStep pub o sel) acc

/-- The recursive twenty-level model is the original ordered frontier fold. -/
theorem frontier_twenty_eq_fold (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) (acc : R0P.Digest K) :
    AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierPrefix pub o sel 20 acc =
      AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.publicFrontierFold pub o sel acc := by
  rfl

/-- The original complete model contains exactly prefix, frontier and suffix,
including both optional branches in their original positions. -/
theorem complete_decomposition (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    R0P.publicDigestLanes pub o sel =
      suffixFold pub o sel
        (AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierPrefix pub o sel 20
          (prefixFold pub o sel)) := by
  rw [frontier_twenty_eq_fold]
  unfold R0P.publicDigestLanes R0P.digestKeys suffixFold prefixFold prefixKeys suffixKeys
    AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.publicFrontierFold
    AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierKeys foldStep
  simp only [List.foldl_append]
  rfl

#print axioms frontier_twenty_eq_fold
#print axioms complete_decomposition
end AspisR1.DigestModelDecomposition
TerminalDigestFrontierModel:
import R0P.Digest

/-! Symbolic model for the actual outer twenty-level digest loop.  This keeps
frontier accumulation recursive rather than evaluating 160 field cells. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model
abbrev Digest (K : Type) := R0P.Digest K
abbrev Public (K : Type) := R0P.Public K
abbrev Openings (K : Type) := R0P.Openings K
abbrev Sel (K : Type) := R0P.Sel K

def frontierStep {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K)
    (acc : Digest K) (level : Fin 20) : Digest K :=
  R0P.digestAddBinding acc (sel (R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level))) o.z
    (R0P.digestStart pub (.frontier level)) (R0P.digestTarget pub (.frontier level))

def frontierPrefix {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K) :
    Nat → Digest K → Digest K
  | 0, acc => acc
  | n + 1, acc =>
      frontierStep pub o sel (frontierPrefix pub o sel n acc)
        ⟨n % 20, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)⟩

theorem frontierPrefix_zero {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K)
    (acc : Digest K) : frontierPrefix pub o sel 0 acc = acc := rfl

theorem frontierPrefix_succ {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K)
    (n : Nat) (acc : Digest K) (hn : n < 20) :
    frontierPrefix pub o sel (n+1) acc =
      frontierStep pub o sel (frontierPrefix pub o sel n acc) ⟨n, hn⟩ := by
  simp only [frontierPrefix, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hn]

def frontierKeys : List (R0P.DigestKey) := List.ofFn R0P.DigestKey.frontier

def publicFrontierFold {K : Type} [Field K] (pub : Public K) (o : Openings K) (sel : Sel K) (acc : Digest K) : Digest K :=
  frontierKeys.foldl (fun state key =>
    R0P.digestAddBinding state (sel (R0P.digestRow pub key)) o.z
      (R0P.digestStart pub key) (R0P.digestTarget pub key)) acc

#print axioms frontierPrefix_succ
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model

def run (initial : Array QM 8#usize) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (selectors : Selectors) (public1 : Public) : Result (Array QM 8#usize) := do
  let d1 ← bindBlock initial opened selectors 53#usize
    public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root
  let carry ← AspisBoundedControl.bounded_carry public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
  if carry < 20#usize then
    let block ← 33#usize + carry
    let base ← block * 16#usize
    let row ← base + 11#usize
    let q ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors row
    let expected ← Array.index_usize public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier carry
    AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding d1 q opened 0#usize expected false
  else .ok d1

    (public1 : Public) (initial : R0P.Digest ExactQM) : R0P.Digest ExactQM :=

  if hc : R0P.digestCarry public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val < 20 then

        R0P.digestCarry public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val]'(by
          simpa [public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.property] using hc)) d1
  else d1

  AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

    (initial : Array QM 8#usize) (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (public1 : Public)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial) (hopened : CanonicalArray opened)
    (hroot : DigestWordsCanonical public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root)
    (hfrontier : ∀ j : Fin 20, DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.property] using j.isLt))) :
    ∃ out, run initial opened selectors public1 = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧

  obtain ⟨d1, h1, hc1, hv1⟩ := bindBlock_success point selectors initial opened 53#usize
    public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root (by decide)

  have h1m : decoded d1 = step point opened 53
      public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root (decoded initial) := by
    unfold step
    exact funext hv1

import BoundedControlSource
import BoundedControlArithmetic
import R0P.Digest
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisBoundedControl.Carry
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisBoundedControl Arithmetic

/-- Fuel is proof-only: the executable candidate still has its actual loop.
The invariant fixes precisely the unobserved suffix of the twenty low bits. -/
theorem loop_success (fuel : Nat) (index : Std.U64) (carry : Std.Usize)
    (hinv : carry.val + fuel = 20) :
    ∃ out : Std.Usize, bounded_carry_loop index carry = .ok out ∧
      out.val = carry.val + R0P.digestTrailingOnes fuel index.val := by
  induction fuel generalizing index carry with
  | zero =>
    have hc : ¬ carry < 20#usize := by change ¬ carry.val < 20; omega
    refine ⟨carry, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [bounded_carry_loop.eq_def, if_neg hc]
    · simp only [R0P.digestTrailingOnes, Nat.add_zero]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hcval : carry.val < 20 := by omega
    have hc : carry < 20#usize := by exact hcval
    by_cases hz : (index.val &&& 1) = 0
    · have hb := (low_bit_zero_iff index).mpr hz
      refine ⟨carry, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [bounded_carry_loop.eq_def, if_pos hc]
        change (if (index &&& 1#u64) = 0#u64 then (Result.ok carry : Result Std.Usize) else _) = .ok carry
        rw [if_pos hb]
      · simp only [R0P.digestTrailingOnes, if_pos hz, Nat.add_zero]
    · have hb : ¬ (index &&& 1#u64) = 0#u64 := by
        intro h; exact hz ((low_bit_zero_iff index).mp h)
      let index1 := Std.U64.wrapping_shr index 1#u32
      let carry1 := Std.Usize.wrapping_add carry 1#usize
      have hcarry : carry1.val = carry.val + 1 := increment_value carry hcval
      have hindex : index1.val = index.val >>> 1 := shift_one_value index
      obtain ⟨out, hout, hval⟩ := ih index1 carry1 (by omega)
      refine ⟨out, ?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [bounded_carry_loop.eq_def, if_pos hc]
        change (if (index &&& 1#u64) = 0#u64 then (Result.ok carry : Result Std.Usize) else
          bounded_carry_loop index1 carry1) = .ok out
        rw [if_neg hb]
        exact hout
      · rw [hval, hcarry, hindex]
        simp only [R0P.digestTrailingOnes, if_neg hz]
        omega

/-- Exact source execution returns the existing model's carry, for every u64.
There is no intrinsic-result or independently supplied carry premise. -/
theorem bounded_carry_is_digestCarry (index : Std.U64) :
    ∃ out : Std.Usize, bounded_carry index = .ok out ∧
      out.val = R0P.digestCarry index.val ∧ out.val ≤ 20 := by
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hval⟩ := loop_success 20 index 0#usize (by rfl)
  have hzero : (0#usize).val = 0 := by rfl
  rw [hzero, Nat.zero_add] at hval
  refine ⟨out, hout, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hval
  · have hbound := R0P.digest_carry_le index.val
    change out.val = R0P.digestCarry index.val at hval
    omega

#print axioms loop_success
#print axioms bounded_carry_is_digestCarry
end AspisBoundedControl.Carry
BoundedControlArithmetic:
import Aeneas
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisBoundedControl.Arithmetic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

/-- The low-bit primitive itself agrees with the natural-number model. -/
theorem low_bit_value (index : Std.U64) :
    (index &&& (1#u64)).val = index.val &&& 1 := by
  change (index.bv &&& (1#u64).bv).toNat = index.val &&& 1
  rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
  rfl

theorem low_bit_zero_iff (index : Std.U64) :
    (index &&& (1#u64)) = 0#u64 ↔ (index.val &&& 1) = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val h
    rw [low_bit_value] at hv
    exact hv
  · intro h
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [low_bit_value]
    exact h

/-- The bounded candidate's shift is an ordinary one-bit unsigned shift. -/
theorem shift_one_value (index : Std.U64) :
    (Std.U64.wrapping_shr index 1#u32).val = index.val >>> 1 := by
  change (Std.U64.wrapping_shr index 1#u32).bv.toNat = index.val >>> 1
  rw [Std.U64.wrapping_shr_bv_eq]
  change (index.bv.ushiftRight 1).toNat = index.val >>> 1
  exact BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight index.bv 1

/-- Below the twenty-level bound the source increment cannot wrap. -/
theorem increment_value (carry : Std.Usize) (h : carry.val < 20) :
    (Std.Usize.wrapping_add carry 1#usize).val = carry.val + 1 := by
  rw [Std.Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have hsize : 20 < UScalar.size .Usize := by
    simp only [UScalar.size, UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq]
    rcases System.Platform.numBits_eq with hn | hn <;> rw [hn] <;> norm_num
  have hsmall : carry.val + (1#usize).val < UScalar.size .Usize := by
    change carry.val + 1 < UScalar.size .Usize
    omega
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsmall

/-- A single fixed shift, independent of amount or loop values. -/
theorem amount_limit :
    Std.U32.wrapping_shl 1#u32 30#u32 = 1073741824#u32 := by rfl

#print axioms low_bit_value
#print axioms low_bit_zero_iff
#print axioms shift_one_value
#print axioms increment_value
#print axioms amount_limit
end AspisBoundedControl.Arithmetic

open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Semantic
open AspisR1.ValueLaneSourceVector
open AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList
open AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport
abbrev Public := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev exactOpenings := AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
abbrev exactPublic := AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic
abbrev digestDecoded := AspisR1.DigestFixedBinding.decoded
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

theorem decoded_array_list (values : Array QM 8#usize) :
    values.val.map decode = List.ofFn (digestDecoded values) := by
  have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by scalar_tac
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_map, List.length_ofFn, values.property, h8]
  · intro n hn hm
    have hn8 : n < 8 := by simpa only [List.length_map, values.property, h8] using hn
    simp only [List.getElem_map, List.getElem_ofFn, digestDecoded,
      AspisR1.DigestFixedBinding.decoded,
      AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact.cellAt, dif_pos hn8]

theorem mapped_digest_list (values : Array QM 8#usize) (public1 : Public)
    (openings : Openings) (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (hvalues : digestDecoded values = R0P.publicDigestLanes (exactPublic public1)
      (exactOpenings openings) (pointSelector point)) :
    List.ofFn (arrayVector values) =
      (R0P.digestFamily (K := Wide)).residuals (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f (exactPublic public1))
        (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings)) (fun i => f (pointSelector point i)) := by
  have hbase : values.val.map decode =
      (R0P.digestFamily (K := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact)).residuals
        (exactPublic public1) (exactOpenings openings) (pointSelector point) := by
    rw [decoded_array_list, hvalues]
    rfl
  exact (AspisR1.ScalarSuffixPacking.array_mapped_list values).trans
    ((congrArg (List.map f) hbase).trans
      (DigestFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f (exactPublic public1)
        (exactOpenings openings) (pointSelector point)))

def run (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (selectors : Selectors) : Result (Array QM 24#usize) := do
  let values ← DigestWrapperComposition.wrapper public1 openings selectors
  AspisR1PreweightedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.add_preweighted
    packed 84#usize values

attribute [local irreducible] R0P.digestFamily R0P.pack4
  AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector
  AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList.selectList

/-- Actual digest call and slot84 packing, with the outer-loop obligation
explicit until its independent source proof instantiates it. -/
theorem actual_digest_contribution (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (packed : Array QM 24#usize) (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hpacked : CanonicalArray packed) (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (ha : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.anchor)
    (hn : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.nullifier)
    (hc : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.change)
    (hr : ∀ recipient, public1.recipient = some recipient → DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical recipient)
    (hroot : DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root)
    (hfrontier : ∀ j : Fin 20, DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (houter : DigestWrapperComposition.OuterSound point selectors public1 openings) :
    ∃ out, run packed public1 openings selectors = .ok out ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 24, f (decoded out j) = f (decoded packed j) +
        R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k : Fin 4 => selectList 84
          ((R0P.digestFamily (K := Wide)).residuals
            (SpendDataMap.mapPublic f (exactPublic public1))
            (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings)) (fun i => f (pointSelector point i)))
          (4*j.val+k.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨values, hvalues, hcValues, hvValues⟩ :=
    DigestWrapperComposition.source_success_of_outer point selectors public1 openings
      hpoint hbox hz ha hn hc hr hroot hfrontier houter
  have hresiduals := mapped_digest_list values public1 openings point hvValues
  obtain ⟨out, hpack, hcOut, hvOut⟩ :=
    AspisR1.PreweightedListSemantic.add_preweighted_residual_list
      packed 84#usize values _ (by scalar_tac) (by scalar_tac) hpacked hcValues hresiduals
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcOut, ?_⟩
  · unfold run
    rw [hvalues]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact hpack
  · have hstart : (84#usize).val = 84 := by scalar_tac
    rw [hstart] at hvOut
    exact hvOut

#print axioms decoded_array_list
#print axioms mapped_digest_list
#print axioms actual_digest_contribution
end
end AspisR1.DigestPackedContribution
DigestFamilyFieldTransport:
import R1SpendDataMap
import ValueFamilyFieldTransport
import R0P.Digest

/-! Reuse the existing public/opening maps to transport the entire ordered
digest family through a field homomorphism. This is independent of concrete
field representations and keeps modular target preprocessing in Nat. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.DigestFamilyFieldTransport
open AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport
variable {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]

 theorem map_keys (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) :
    R0P.digestKeys (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) = R0P.digestKeys pub := by
  cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
    simp only [R0P.digestKeys, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hr, Option.map]

 theorem map_row (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (key : R0P.DigestKey) :
    R0P.digestRow (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) key = R0P.digestRow pub key := by
  cases key <;> rfl

 theorem map_start (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (key : R0P.DigestKey) :
    R0P.digestStart (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) key = R0P.digestStart pub key := by
  cases key <;> rfl

 theorem map_empty_root_target (g : K →+* L) (level : Fin 20) (j : Fin 8) :
    g (R0P.emptyRootRightTarget level j : K) =
      (R0P.emptyRootRightTarget level j : L) := by
  unfold R0P.emptyRootRightTarget
  split_ifs <;> simp only [map_natCast]

 theorem map_target (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (key : R0P.DigestKey) :
    (fun j => g (R0P.digestTarget pub key j)) =
      R0P.digestTarget (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) key := by
  funext j
  cases key with
  | anchor => rfl
  | nullifier => rfl
  | change => rfl
  | nextRoot => rfl
  | recipient =>
    cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
      simp only [R0P.digestTarget, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, hr,
        Option.map, Option.getD, SpendDataMap.digest, map_zero]
  | frontier level =>
    by_cases hb : R0P.digestBitZero pub level
    · simpa only [R0P.digestTarget, R0P.digestBitZero, SpendDataMap.mapPublic,
        if_pos hb] using map_empty_root_target g level j
    · simp only [R0P.digestTarget, R0P.digestBitZero, SpendDataMap.mapPublic,
        if_neg hb, SpendDataMap.digest]
  | carry =>
    by_cases hc : R0P.digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20
    · simp only [R0P.digestTarget, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, dif_pos hc, SpendDataMap.digest]
    · simp only [R0P.digestTarget, SpendDataMap.mapPublic, dif_neg hc, map_zero]

 theorem map_binding (g : K →+* L) (acc : R0P.Digest K) (q : K)
    (opened : Fin 16 → K) (start : Fin 9) (target : R0P.Digest K) :
    (fun j => g (R0P.digestAddBinding acc q opened start target j)) =
      R0P.digestAddBinding (fun j => g (acc j)) (g q) (fun j => g (opened j)) start
        (fun j => g (target j)) := by
  funext j
  simp only [R0P.digestAddBinding, map_add, map_mul, map_sub]

 theorem map_fold (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) (keys : List R0P.DigestKey) (initial : R0P.Digest K) :
    (fun j => g ((keys.foldl (fun acc key =>
      R0P.digestAddBinding acc (sel (R0P.digestRow pub key)) o.z
        (R0P.digestStart pub key) (R0P.digestTarget pub key)) initial) j)) =
      keys.foldl (fun acc key => R0P.digestAddBinding acc
        (g (sel (R0P.digestRow (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) key))) (mapOpenings g o).z
        (R0P.digestStart (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) key)
        (R0P.digestTarget (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) key)) (fun j => g (initial j)) := by
  induction keys generalizing initial with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons key keys ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [ih, map_binding, map_target, map_row, map_start]
    rfl

 theorem map_public_digest (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    (fun j => g (R0P.publicDigestLanes pub o sel j)) =
      R0P.publicDigestLanes (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub) (mapOpenings g o)
        (fun i => g (sel i)) := by
  unfold R0P.publicDigestLanes
  rw [map_keys, map_fold]
  simp only [map_zero]

 theorem map_family (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K)
    (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    ((R0P.digestFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).map g =
      (R0P.digestFamily (K := L)).residuals (SpendDataMap.mapPublic g pub)
        (mapOpenings g o) (fun i => g (sel i)) := by
  simp only [R0P.digestFamily, List.map_ofFn]
  rw [← map_public_digest]
  rfl

#print axioms map_empty_root_target
#print axioms map_target
#print axioms map_binding
#print axioms map_fold
#print axioms map_public_digest
#print axioms map_family
end AspisR1.DigestFamilyFieldTransport
R1SpendDataMap:
import R1SpendRelation

/-! Explicit coordinate maps for spend data. These definitions work for an
arbitrary scalar function, including the base-coordinate projection. They
do not assert preservation of the spend equations by an arbitrary function. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendDataMap

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy SpendRelation
variable {K L M : Type}

def digest (f : K → L) (d : R0P.Digest K) : R0P.Digest L := fun i => f (d i)

def path (f : K → L) (p : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) :
    Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest L := fun i => ((p i).1, digest f (p i).2)

def pair (f : K → L) (p : PairLeaf K) : PairLeaf L :=
  { firstCommitment := digest f p.firstCommitment
    secondOccupied := f p.secondOccupied
    secondCommitment := digest f p.secondCommitment
    secondOccupancyInverse := f p.secondOccupancyInverse }

def witness (f : K → L) (w : Witness K) : Witness L :=
  { inputValue := w.inputValue
    outputValue := w.outputValue
    changeValue := w.changeValue
    sk := digest f w.sk
    salt := digest f w.salt
    path := path f w.path
    pair := pair f w.pair
    recipientOwner := digest f w.recipientOwner
    recipientSalt := digest f w.recipientSalt
    changeOwner := digest f w.changeOwner
    changeSalt := digest f w.changeSalt }

def mapPublic (f : K → L) (p : Public K) : Public L :=
  { variant := p.variant
    anchor := digest f p.anchor
    nullifier := digest f p.nullifier
    assetId := f p.assetId
    recipient := p.recipient.map (digest f)
    change := digest f p.change
    withdrawalAmount := p.withdrawalAmount.map f
    nextPairIndex := p.nextPairIndex
    snapshotFrontier := fun i => digest f (p.snapshotFrontier i)
    nextRoot := digest f p.nextRoot
    nextFrontier := fun i => digest f (p.nextFrontier i) }

theorem witness_id (w : Witness K) : witness id w = w := by
  cases w
  rfl

theorem witness_comp (f : K → L) (g : L → M) (w : Witness K) :
    witness g (witness f w) = witness (g ∘ f) w := by
  rfl

theorem mapPublic_id (p : Public K) : mapPublic id p = p := by
  rcases p with ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
  cases recipient <;> cases amount <;> rfl

theorem mapPublic_comp (f : K → L) (g : L → M) (p : Public K) :
    mapPublic g (mapPublic f p) = mapPublic (g ∘ f) p := by
  rcases p with ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
  cases recipient <;> cases amount <;> rfl

#print axioms witness_id
#print axioms witness_comp
#print axioms mapPublic_id
#print axioms mapPublic_comp
end AspisR1.SpendDataMap
SpendRelation:
import R1InputWitnessCheck
import PublicOptionShape
import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
import R1SpendAppendBinding

/-! An explicit witness and decidable semantic spend relation. The concrete
witness field is M31; the generic version supports the existing algebraic
extraction proofs. This is not a byte parser or a Rust refinement theorem.
Values are bounded nonnegative integers, as in the production value theorem;
the honest pair-forest builder's stronger positivity contract is separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelation

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

structure Witness (K : Type) where
  inputValue : Fin (2^30)
  outputValue : Fin (2^30)
  changeValue : Fin (2^30)
  sk : R0P.Digest K
  salt : R0P.Digest K
  path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K
  pair : PairLeaf K
  recipientOwner : R0P.Digest K
  recipientSalt : R0P.Digest K
  changeOwner : R0P.Digest K
  changeSalt : R0P.Digest K

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def recipientCommitment (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  noteCommitment w.recipientOwner (w.outputValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.recipientSalt

def changeCommitment (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : R0P.Digest K :=
  noteCommitment w.changeOwner (w.changeValue.val : K) pub.assetId w.changeSalt

def variantOutput (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient = some (recipientCommitment pub w)
  | .withdrawal => pub.withdrawalAmount = some (w.outputValue.val : K)

def Rspend (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Prop :=
  PublicOptionShape.canonical pub ∧
    InputWitnessCore.Relation pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt w.path w.pair ∧
    w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val ∧
    pub.change = changeCommitment pub w ∧
    variantOutput pub w ∧ AppendBinding pub

def variantOutputCheck (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Bool :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer =>
      match pub.recipient with
      | none => false
      | some recipient => InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck recipient (recipientCommitment pub w)
  | .withdrawal =>
      match pub.withdrawalAmount with
      | none => false
      | some amount => decide (amount = (w.outputValue.val : K))

def check (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) : Bool :=
  PublicOptionShape.check pub &&
    InputWitnessCheck.check pub (w.inputValue.val : K) w.sk w.salt w.path w.pair &&
    decide (w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val) &&
    InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck pub.change (changeCommitment pub w) &&
    variantOutputCheck pub w && appendCheck pub

/-- The concrete relation uses canonical M31 field elements for every key,
salt, path digest, pair coordinate and output owner. -/
abbrev Wspend := Witness AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact

def checkM31 (pub : Public AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact) (w : Wspend) : Bool :=
  check pub w

theorem variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    variantOutputCheck pub w = true ↔ variantOutput pub w := by
  cases hv : pub.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
      cases hr : pub.recipient <;>
        simp [variantOutputCheck, variantOutput, hv, hr,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]
  | withdrawal =>
      cases ha : pub.withdrawalAmount <;>
        simp [variantOutputCheck, variantOutput, hv, ha]

theorem check_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) :
    check pub w = true ↔ Rspend pub w := by
  simp only [check, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq,
    PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff, InputWitnessCheck.check_eq_true_iff,
    InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff, variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff,
    appendCheck_eq_true_iff, Rspend, and_assoc]

theorem input_note_extracted (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (A : Trace K)
    (hvalue : A 10 1008 = (w.inputValue.val : K)) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    R0P.InputNoteExtracted pub A := by
  refine ⟨w.sk, w.salt, w.path, h.2.1.nullifier, ?_⟩
  rw [hvalue]
  exact h.2.1.membership

theorem integer_bounds (pub : Public K) (w : Witness K) (h : Rspend pub w) :
    w.inputValue.val < 2^30 ∧ w.outputValue.val < 2^30 ∧ w.changeValue.val < 2^30 ∧
      w.inputValue.val = w.outputValue.val + w.changeValue.val :=
  ⟨w.inputValue.isLt, w.outputValue.isLt, w.changeValue.isLt, h.2.2.1⟩

#print axioms input_note_extracted
#print axioms integer_bounds
#print axioms variantOutputCheck_eq_true_iff
#print axioms check_eq_true_iff
end AspisR1.SpendRelation
R1InputWitnessCheck:
import R1InputWitnessCore

/-! Executable decision procedure for exactly `InputWitnessCore.Relation`.
This is a generic checker for the abstract field model; it makes no concrete
Rust/source correspondence claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputWitnessCheck

open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

/-- Executable universal check over the eight digest lanes. -/
def allFin8 (p : Fin 8 → Bool) : Bool := (List.ofFn p).all id

theorem allFin8_eq_true_iff (p : Fin 8 → Bool) :
    allFin8 p = true ↔ ∀ i, p i = true := by
  change (List.ofFn p).all id = true ↔ ∀ i, p i = true
  rw [List.all_eq_true]
  constructor
  · intro h i
    simpa using h (p i) (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)
  · intro h x hx
    obtain ⟨i, rfl⟩ := List.mem_ofFn.mp hx
    simpa using h i

/-- Equality of two eight-limb digests by eight pointwise equality checks. -/
def digestEqCheck (left right : R0P.Digest K) : Bool :=
  allFin8 (fun lane => decide (left lane = right lane))

theorem digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff (left right : R0P.Digest K) :
    digestEqCheck left right = true ↔ left = right := by
  rw [digestEqCheck, allFin8_eq_true_iff]
  constructor
  · intro h
    funext lane
    exact of_decide_eq_true (h lane)
  · intro h lane
    exact decide_eq_true (congrFun h lane)

/-- The four finite checks spelling out `PairLeaf.Valid`. -/
def pairValidCheck (pair : PairLeaf K) : Bool :=
  decide (pair.secondOccupied * (pair.secondOccupied - 1) = 0) &&
    decide (pair.secondSentinel * pair.secondOccupancyInverse = pair.secondOccupied) &&
    decide ((1 - pair.secondOccupied) * pair.secondOccupancyInverse = 0) &&
    allFin8 (fun lane =>
      decide ((1 - pair.secondOccupied) * pair.secondCommitment lane = 0))

theorem pairValidCheck_eq_true_iff (pair : PairLeaf K) :
    pairValidCheck pair = true ↔ pair.Valid := by
  unfold pairValidCheck PairLeaf.Valid PairLeaf.secondSentinel
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq, allFin8_eq_true_iff]
  simp only [and_assoc]

/-- Bool checker expanding all six fields of `InputWitnessCore.Relation`. -/
def check (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K) : Bool :=
  pairValidCheck pair &&
    decide (pair.selectedOccupied (path 0).1 = 1) &&
    digestEqCheck (pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1)
      (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) &&
    digestEqCheck (path 0).2
      (if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment) &&
    digestEqCheck pub.nullifier (nullifierHash sk salt) &&
    digestEqCheck pub.anchor
      (merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path)

theorem check_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K) :
    check pub value sk salt path pair = true ↔
      InputWitnessCore.Relation pub value sk salt path pair := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [check, Bool.and_eq_true, pairValidCheck_eq_true_iff,
      digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_eq] at h
    rcases h with ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨hvalid, hspend⟩, hcommitment⟩, hsibling⟩,
      hnullifier⟩, hmembership⟩
    exact ⟨hvalid, hspend, hcommitment, hsibling, hnullifier, hmembership⟩
  · intro h
    simp only [check, Bool.and_eq_true, pairValidCheck_eq_true_iff,
      digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff, decide_eq_true_eq]
    exact ⟨⟨⟨⟨⟨h.valid, h.spendable⟩, h.commitment⟩, h.sibling⟩,
      h.nullifier⟩, h.membership⟩

#print axioms allFin8_eq_true_iff
#print axioms digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff
#print axioms pairValidCheck_eq_true_iff
#print axioms check_eq_true_iff

end AspisR1.InputWitnessCheck
R1InputWitnessCore:
import R1InputPairSelection

/-! One input relation with ownership, nullifier, occupied pair selection,
and a 24-level membership path. The pair's other commitment is the first
path sibling, so pair validity cannot be attached to an unrelated pair. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputWitnessCore
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] nodeCompress poseidonPermutation

structure Relation (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K) : Prop where
  valid : pair.Valid
  spendable : pair.SelectedSlotIsSpendable (path 0).1
  commitment : pair.selectedCommitment (path 0).1 =
    noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt
  sibling : (path 0).2 = if (path 0).1 then pair.firstCommitment else pair.secondCommitment
  nullifier : pub.nullifier = nullifierHash sk salt
  membership : pub.anchor =
    merkleRoot (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) path

theorem trace_sibling (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    (tracePath A 0).2 = if (tracePath A 0).1 then
      (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment else (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment := by
  classical
  rw [InputPairSelection.path_bit]
  by_cases hz : A 0 913 = 0
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    change (tracePath A 0).2 = (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment
    have hp : (tracePath A 0).2 = fun i : Fin 8 => A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 914 := by
      unfold tracePath
      change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).2 = _
      rw [if_pos hz]
      rfl
    rw [hp]
    funext i
    exact (InputPairSelection.right_path pub A hb i).symm
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    change (tracePath A 0).2 = (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment
    have hp : (tracePath A 0).2 = fun i : Fin 8 => A (i.castAdd 21) 914 := by
      unfold tracePath
      change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).2 = _
      rw [if_neg hz]
      rfl
    rw [hp]
    funext i
    exact (InputPairSelection.left_path pub A hb i).symm

/-- The first membership step hashes this exact ordered valid pair. -/
theorem pair_head (pub : Public K) (value : K) (sk salt : R0P.Digest K)
    (path : Fin 24 → Bool × R0P.Digest K) (pair : PairLeaf K)
    (h : Relation pub value sk salt path pair) :
    merkleStep (noteCommitment (ownerKey sk) value pub.assetId salt) (path 0).1 (path 0).2 =
      nodeCompress pair.firstCommitment pair.secondCommitment := by
  rw [← h.commitment, h.sibling]
  cases hb : (path 0).1 <;> simp only [PairLeaf.selectedCommitment, merkleStep,
    Bool.false_eq_true, if_false, if_true]

#print axioms trace_sibling
#print axioms pair_head
end AspisR1.InputWitnessCore

/-! The occupied slot is the same commitment carried by the input-note hash
block. The equality is derived from the path gates and literal copy links. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputPairSelection
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

open Classical in
theorem path_bit (A : Trace K) :
    (tracePath A 0).1 = if A 0 913 = 0 then false else true := by
  classical
  unfold tracePath
  change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).1 = _
  split <;> rfl

theorem left_path (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (i : Fin 8) : (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment i = A (i.castAdd 21) 914 := by
  exact ((copy_path_cells_of_balance pub A hb 0).1 i).symm

theorem right_path (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (i : Fin 8) : (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment i = A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 914 := by
  have h := (copy_path_cells_of_balance pub A hb 0).2.1 i
  change A ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ 914 = A ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ 64 +
    (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) at h
  simp only [Nat.add_comm i.val 8] at h
  exact (InputPairCopyLinks.right_cells pub A hb i).trans h.symm

theorem selected_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hp : Holds pathFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    (InputPair.leaf A).selectedCommitment (tracePath A 0).1 = OutputNotes.output A 3 := by
  classical
  have hpath := (path_holds_iff pub A).mp hp 913 (pathBaseRow_mem 0)
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, hcurrent⟩ := copy_input_note_cells_of_balance pub A hb
  rw [path_bit]
  by_cases hz : A 0 913 = 0
  · rw [if_pos hz]
    change (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment = OutputNotes.output A 3
    funext i
    rw [left_path pub A hb i]
    have h := hpath.2.1 i
    rw [hz] at h
    have he : A (i.castAdd 21) 914 = A ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ 913 := by
      rw [show succRow (913 : Fin 1024) = 914 by decide] at h
      simpa only [sub_zero, one_mul, sub_eq_zero, Fin.castAdd, Fin.castLE, Fin.addNat] using h
    exact he.trans (hcurrent i).symm
  · rw [if_neg hz]
    change (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment = OutputNotes.output A 3
    funext i
    rw [right_path pub A hb i]
    have h := hpath.2.2 i
    have he : A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 914 = A ⟨i.val + 1, by omega⟩ 913 :=
      sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp h).resolve_left hz)
    exact he.trans (hcurrent i).symm

structure Facts (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) : Prop where
  valid : (InputPair.leaf A).Valid
  pair : OutputNotes.output A 4 =
    nodeCompress (InputPair.leaf A).firstCommitment (InputPair.leaf A).secondCommitment
  selected : (InputPair.leaf A).selectedCommitment (tracePath A 0).1 = OutputNotes.output A 3
  spendable : (InputPair.leaf A).SelectedSlotIsSpendable (tracePath A 0).1

theorem of_production (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (lam chi : K)
    (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) : Facts pub A := by
  exact ⟨InputPair.leaf_valid pub A h.1.2.1,
    InputPair.pair_output pub A h.1.2.2.2.1 h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1 h.2,
    selected_output pub A h.1.2.2.2.2.1 h.2,
    InputPair.selected_spendable pub A h.1.2.1 h.2⟩

#print axioms selected_output
#print axioms of_production
end AspisR1.InputPairSelection

/-! The input pair and the occupancy of the slot selected by the literal
trace path. This does not yet strengthen the existential input-note witness
with a complete authenticated pair/forest relation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.InputPair
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] nodeCompress poseidonPermutation

def leaf (A : Trace K) : PairLeaf K where
  firstCommitment := AppendNode.left A 4
  secondOccupied := A 0 1017
  secondCommitment := fun i => A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1017
  secondOccupancyInverse := A 1 1017

theorem leaf_valid (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) : (leaf A).Valid := by
  have h := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.1 1017 (Or.inl rfl)
  exact ⟨h.1, sub_eq_zero.mp h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩

theorem pair_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    OutputNotes.output A 4 = nodeCompress (leaf A).firstCommitment (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
  rw [AppendNode.node_step pub A hs hpo 4 (nodeBlock_node 0)]
  have hr : AppendNode.right A 4 = (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
    funext i
    exact (InputPairCopyLinks.right_cells pub A hb i).symm
  rw [hr]
  rfl

/-- The path's first side bit selects an occupied slot. The copy link binds
that very bit to the input occupancy gate, rather than assuming spendability. -/
theorem selected_spendable (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    (leaf A).SelectedSlotIsSpendable (tracePath A 0).1 := by
  classical
  have hbit := InputPairCopyLinks.selected_bit pub A hb
  have hg := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.2.1
  rw [← hbit] at hg
  by_cases hz : A 0 913 = 0
  · have hp : (tracePath A 0).1 = false := by
      simp only [tracePath, pathBaseRow]
      change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).1 = false
      rw [if_pos hz]
    rw [hp]
    exact first_slot_is_spendable (leaf A)
  · have hp : (tracePath A 0).1 = true := by
      simp only [tracePath, pathBaseRow]
      change ((if A 0 913 = 0 then _ else _) : Bool × R0P.Digest K).1 = true
      rw [if_neg hz]
    rw [hp, second_slot_spendable_iff]
    have hz' : 1 - A 0 1017 = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hg).resolve_left hz
    exact (sub_eq_zero.mp hz').symm

theorem empty_second_rejected (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A)
    (hempty : (leaf A).secondOccupied = 0) : (tracePath A 0).1 = false := by
  have hs := selected_spendable pub A ho hb
  cases hp : (tracePath A 0).1 with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    rw [hp, second_slot_spendable_iff, hempty] at hs
    exact (zero_ne_one hs).elim

#print axioms leaf_valid
#print axioms pair_output
#print axioms selected_spendable
#print axioms empty_second_rejected
end AspisR1.InputPair

/-! The append leaf is the ordered output pair, with the existing algebraic
occupancy relation. Transfers append recipient/change; withdrawals append
change/zero. This derives the pair from gates and public digest bindings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendPair
open R0P AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def leaf (A : Trace K) : PairLeaf K where
  firstCommitment := AppendNode.left A 33
  secondOccupied := A 0 1018
  secondCommitment := fun i => A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1018
  secondOccupancyInverse := A 1 1018

theorem leaf_valid (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) : (leaf A).Valid := by
  have h := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.1 1018 (Or.inr rfl)
  exact ⟨h.1, sub_eq_zero.mp h.2.1, h.2.2.1, h.2.2.2⟩

theorem pair_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress (leaf A).firstCommitment (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
  rw [AppendNode.node_step pub A hs hpo 33 (by right; constructor <;> decide)]
  have hr : AppendNode.right A 33 = (leaf A).secondCommitment := by
    funext i
    exact (PairCopyLinks.right_cells pub A hb i).symm
  rw [hr]
  rfl

theorem transfer_first (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (recipient : R0P.Digest K)
    (hpresent : pub.recipient = some recipient) : (leaf A).firstCommitment = recipient := by
  funext i
  exact (PairCopyLinks.first_transfer pub A hb hv i).symm.trans
    ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.1 recipient hpresent i)

theorem transfer_second (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) : (leaf A).secondCommitment = pub.change := by
  funext i
  exact (PairCopyLinks.second_transfer pub A hb hv i).symm.trans
    ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.1 i)

theorem withdrawal_first (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) : (leaf A).firstCommitment = pub.change := by
  funext i
  exact (PairCopyLinks.first_withdrawal pub A hb hv i).symm.trans
    ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.1 i)

theorem withdrawal_second (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) :
    (leaf A).secondCommitment = fun _ => 0 := by
  apply valid_empty_second_commitment_zero (leaf A) (leaf_valid pub A ho)
  have h := (occupancy_holds_iff pub A).mp ho |>.2.2
  simpa only [leaf, hv] using h

theorem transfer_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (hv : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (recipient : R0P.Digest K)
    (hpresent : pub.recipient = some recipient) :
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress recipient pub.change := by
  rw [pair_output pub A hs hpo hb, transfer_first pub A hb hd hv recipient hpresent,
    transfer_second pub A hb hd hv]

theorem withdrawal_output (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A)
    (ho : Holds occupancyFamily pub A) (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal) :
    OutputNotes.output A 33 = nodeCompress pub.change (fun _ => 0) := by
  rw [pair_output pub A hs hpo hb, withdrawal_first pub A hb hd hv,
    withdrawal_second pub A ho hv]

#print axioms leaf_valid
#print axioms transfer_output
#print axioms withdrawal_output
end AspisR1.AppendPair

import R1OutputNotes

/-! Symbolic node-compression and frozen-target untweaking interfaces. These
derive a hash node from the existing schedule/Poseidon gates. They neither
evaluate Poseidon nor assert that the frozen empty-root table is recursively
generated by that permutation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendNode
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

def left (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K := OutputNotes.chunk A block
def right (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K := fun i =>
  poseidonState A block 0 ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ +
    if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0

theorem rate_zero (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57)
    (hn : ScheduleNode block.val) (i : Fin 8) :
    poseidonState A block 0 (i.castAdd 8) = 0 := by
  have hdiv : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val / 16 = block.val := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) / 16 = block.val
    omega
  have hmod : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val % 16 = 0 := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) % 16 = 0
    omega
  exact ((schedule_holds_iff pub A).mp hs).2.1 _ hmod (by rwa [hdiv]) i

theorem node_step (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (block : Fin 57) (hn : ScheduleNode block.val) :
    OutputNotes.output A block = nodeCompress (left A block) (right A block) := by
  unfold OutputNotes.output nodeCompress
  rw [poseidon_scalar_holds_output pub A hpo block]
  apply congrArg digestOf
  apply congrArg poseidonPermutation
  funext lane
  by_cases hlow : lane.val < 8
  · rw [dif_pos hlow]
    have hz := rate_zero pub A hs block hn ⟨lane.val, hlow⟩
    change poseidonState A block 0 lane = 0 at hz
    change (if lane.val < 8 then
      poseidonState A block 0 lane + poseidonState A block 12 lane
      else poseidonState A block 0 lane) = _
    rw [if_pos hlow, hz, zero_add]
    rfl
  · rw [dif_neg hlow]
    change (if lane.val < 8 then
      poseidonState A block 0 lane + poseidonState A block 12 lane
      else poseidonState A block 0 lane) = _
    rw [if_neg hlow]
    by_cases h15 : lane.val = 15
    · rw [if_pos h15]
      have he : lane = 15 := Fin.ext h15
      subst lane
      change poseidonState A block 0 15 =
        poseidonState A block 0 15 + (1051521018 : K) - 1051521018
      ring
    · rw [if_neg h15]
      unfold right
      simp only [Fin.val_mk, if_neg (show ¬ lane.val - 8 = 7 from by omega), add_zero]
      apply congrArg (poseidonState A block 0)
      apply Fin.ext
      change lane.val = 8 + (lane.val - 8)
      omega

/-- Subtracting the characteristic before casting preserves the field value.
The branch comparison alone supplies the Nat-subtraction side condition. -/
theorem cast_reduce_once (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (n : Nat) :
    ((if prime ≤ n then n - prime else n : Nat) : K) = (n : K) := by
  by_cases h : prime ≤ n
  · rw [if_pos h, Nat.cast_sub h, CharP.cast_eq_zero K prime, sub_zero]
  · rw [if_neg h]

def frozenEmpty (level : Fin 21) : Digest K := fun i => (emptyRootsNat level i : K)

/-- The source's reduced right-target tweak and the registry's inverse tweak
cancel in characteristic 2^31-1. No empty-root recurrence premise is used. -/
theorem empty_target_untweak (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2^31-1) (level : Fin 20) (i : Fin 8) :
    emptyRootRightTarget (K := K) level i +
      (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) = frozenEmpty level.castSucc i := by
  unfold emptyRootRightTarget frozenEmpty
  by_cases hi : i.val = 7
  · rw [if_pos (by omega : i.val + 1 = 8), if_pos hi]
    change ((if 0x7fff_ffff ≤ emptyRootsNat level.castSucc i + 0x4153_1005
      then emptyRootsNat level.castSucc i + 0x4153_1005 - 0x7fff_ffff
      else emptyRootsNat level.castSucc i + 0x4153_1005 : Nat) : K) + 1051521018 = _
    have hp : prime = 0x7fff_ffff := by omega
    rw [← hp, cast_reduce_once prime, Nat.cast_add]
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat]
    have ht : (0x4153_1005 : K) + 1051521018 = 0 := by
      have hsum : (0x4153_1005 : Nat) + 1051521018 = prime := by omega
      calc
        (0x4153_1005 : K) + 1051521018 =
            (((0x4153_1005 : Nat) + 1051521018 : Nat) : K) := by
              norm_num only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_ofNat]
        _ = (prime : K) := congrArg (fun n : Nat => (n : K)) hsum
        _ = 0 := CharP.cast_eq_zero K prime
    rw [add_assoc, ht, add_zero]
  · rw [if_neg (by omega : ¬ i.val + 1 = 8), if_neg hi, add_zero]

#print axioms node_step
#print axioms empty_target_untweak
end AspisR1.AppendNode
R1OutputNotes:
import R1OutputCopyLinks
import R0P.Semantics
import R0P.Asset

/-! Output-note extraction from the existing production families. The block
composition follows R0P.Extraction's input-note proof, keeping the permutation
opaque. Recipient extraction is explicitly private-transfer-only and public
recipient binding additionally requires the matching Option to be present.
No ownership of either output key or append transition is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OutputNotes
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

attribute [local irreducible] poseidonPermutation

def chunk (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K :=
  digestOf (poseidonState A block 12)

def output (A : Trace K) (block : Fin 57) : Digest K :=
  digestOf (poseidonState A block 11)

/-- The six salt limbs in the middle chunk, then two in the final chunk. -/
def salt (A : Trace K) (middle last : Fin 57) : Digest K := fun i =>
  if h : i.val < 6 then chunk A middle ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩
  else chunk A last ⟨i.val - 6, by omega⟩

theorem block_step (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57) :
    poseidonState A block 11 = spongeStep (poseidonState A block 0) (chunk A block) := by
  rw [poseidon_scalar_holds_output pub A hpo block]
  unfold spongeStep
  apply congrArg poseidonPermutation
  funext lane
  simp only [poseidonAbsorbedInput, absorb, chunk, digestOf, poseidonState]
  split_ifs <;> rfl

theorem initial (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57)
    (hf : ScheduleFull pub.variant block.val) :
    poseidonState A block 0 = scheduleTarget pub.variant block.val := by
  have hdiv : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val / 16 = block.val := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) / 16 = block.val
    omega
  have hmod : (poseidonBlockRow block 0).val % 16 = 0 := by
    change (16 * block.val + 0) % 16 = 0
    omega
  funext lane
  have hh := ((schedule_holds_iff pub A).mp hs).1 _ hmod (by rwa [hdiv]) lane
  simpa only [hdiv] using hh

theorem last_padding (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (block : Fin 57)
    (hb : block.val = 29 ∨ block.val = 32) (i : Fin 8) (hi : 2 ≤ i.val) :
    chunk A block i = 0 := by
  have hdiv : (poseidonBlockRow block 12).val / 16 = block.val := by
    change (16 * block.val + 12) / 16 = block.val
    omega
  have hmod : (poseidonBlockRow block 12).val % 16 = 12 := by
    change (16 * block.val + 12) % 16 = 12
    omega
  have hz := (schedule_holds_iff pub A).mp hs |>.2.2
    (poseidonBlockRow block 12) hmod (i.castAdd 8) (by
      rw [hdiv]
      change ScheduleAbsorbs pub.variant block.val i.val
      simp only [ScheduleAbsorbs, if_neg (show ¬ i.val < 2 from by omega),
        if_pos i.isLt]
      rcases hb with hb | hb
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl hb))
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hb))
  exact hz

theorem middle_chunk (A : Trace K) (middle last : Fin 57) (value asset : K)
    (hv : chunk A middle 0 = value) (ha : chunk A middle 1 = asset) :
    chunk A middle = fun i : Fin 8 =>
      if i.val = 0 then value else if i.val = 1 then asset
      else salt A middle last ⟨i.val - 2, by omega⟩ := by
  funext i
  by_cases h0 : i.val = 0
  · rw [if_pos h0]
    have he : i = 0 := Fin.ext h0
    subst i
    exact hv
  · rw [if_neg h0]
    by_cases h1 : i.val = 1
    · rw [if_pos h1]
      have he : i = 1 := Fin.ext h1
      subst i
      exact ha
    · rw [if_neg h1]
      unfold salt
      rw [dif_pos (by omega : i.val - 2 < 6)]
      exact congrArg (chunk A middle) (Fin.ext (by
        change i.val = i.val - 2 + 2
        omega))

theorem last_chunk (A : Trace K) (middle last : Fin 57)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 8, 2 ≤ i.val → chunk A last i = 0) :
    chunk A last = fun i : Fin 8 =>
      if h : i.val < 2 then salt A middle last ⟨i.val + 6, by omega⟩ else 0 := by
  funext i
  by_cases hi : i.val < 2
  · rw [dif_pos hi]
    unfold salt
    rw [dif_neg (by omega : ¬ i.val + 6 < 6)]
    exact congrArg (chunk A last) (Fin.ext (by
      change i.val = i.val + 6 - 6
      omega))
  · rw [dif_neg hi]
    exact hz i (by omega)

/-- A symbolic three-block hash composition; it does not evaluate Poseidon. -/
theorem note_of_blocks (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (first middle last : Fin 57)
    (value asset : K)
    (hinit : poseidonState A first 0 = spongeInit 0x4153_0003 18)
    (h01 : poseidonState A middle 0 = poseidonState A first 11)
    (h12 : poseidonState A last 0 = poseidonState A middle 11)
    (hv : chunk A middle 0 = value) (ha : chunk A middle 1 = asset)
    (hz : ∀ i : Fin 8, 2 ≤ i.val → chunk A last i = 0) :
    output A last = noteCommitment (chunk A first) value asset (salt A middle last) := by
  unfold noteCommitment output
  rw [block_step pub A hpo last, h12, block_step pub A hpo middle,
    h01, block_step pub A hpo first, hinit,
    middle_chunk A middle last value asset hv ha, last_chunk A middle last hz]

theorem change_hash (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A) (ha : Holds assetFamily pub A)
    (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    output A 32 = noteCommitment (chunk A 30) (A 10 1012) pub.assetId (salt A 31 32) := by
  obtain ⟨hc01, hc12, hv⟩ := OutputCopyLinks.change_cells pub A hb
  apply note_of_blocks pub A hpo 30 31 32
  · rw [initial pub A hs 30 (by right; right; right; left; rfl)]
    funext lane
    simp [scheduleTarget, spongeInit]
  · funext lane; exact (hc01 lane).symm
  · funext lane; exact (hc12 lane).symm
  · exact hv

AspisFormal.Pool.V7PairLeafOccupancy:
import Mathlib.Tactic

/-!
# Algebraic occupancy for V7 Pool pair leaves

The Pool pair leaf never represents an empty slot by asking that a particular
digest have no preimage.  The first slot is occupied by construction.  The
second slot carries a field-valued occupancy bit and a zero-test witness for a
fixed sentinel limb of its commitment.  The constraints make occupancy zero
exactly when that sentinel is zero; an empty slot additionally forces every
commitment limb to zero.  Spending a selected slot separately requires its
occupancy value to equal one.

The pair-tree leaf is the ordinary lowest internal node of a depth-21 note
tree: its one-permutation compression input is the ordered pair of complete
eight-limb commitments.  Occupancy is not squeezed into an already-full hash
lane.  Instead it is a function of the fully committed second digest.  An
honest second output whose sentinel happens to be zero must resample its note
salt; this is a liveness rejection event, not an assumption that zero has no
preimage.  Collision resistance of Poseidon compression is deliberately
outside this algebraic file.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

abbrev Digest (K : Type) := Fin 8 → K

/-- One transaction appends one pair.  Slot zero is always occupied; slot one
is present exactly when `secondOccupied = 1`. -/
structure PairLeaf (K : Type) where
  firstCommitment : Digest K
  secondOccupied : K
  secondCommitment : Digest K
  secondOccupancyInverse : K

/-- The last M31 limb is the fixed zero-test sentinel.  Any fixed limb would
work; pinning lane seven makes the encoding and source bridge unambiguous. -/
def PairLeaf.secondSentinel {K : Type} (leaf : PairLeaf K) : K :=
  leaf.secondCommitment ⟨7, by decide⟩

/-- Exact algebraic validity constraints for a pair leaf. -/
def PairLeaf.Valid {K : Type} [CommRing K] (leaf : PairLeaf K) : Prop :=
  leaf.secondOccupied * (leaf.secondOccupied - 1) = 0 ∧
    leaf.secondSentinel * leaf.secondOccupancyInverse =
      leaf.secondOccupied ∧
    (1 - leaf.secondOccupied) * leaf.secondOccupancyInverse = 0 ∧
    ∀ lane, (1 - leaf.secondOccupied) * leaf.secondCommitment lane = 0

/-- The occupancy value selected by a private membership witness. -/
def PairLeaf.selectedOccupied {K : Type} [OfNat K 1]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool) : K :=
  if secondSlot then leaf.secondOccupied else 1

/-- The commitment selected by the same private side bit. -/
def PairLeaf.selectedCommitment {K : Type}
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool) : Digest K :=
  if secondSlot then leaf.secondCommitment else leaf.firstCommitment

/-- The relation-level spend gate.  Membership in the pair hash is not enough:
the privately selected slot must also be occupied. -/
def PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable {K : Type} [OfNat K 1]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool) : Prop :=
  leaf.selectedOccupied secondSlot = 1

theorem selected_spendable_implies_occupied_one
    {K : Type} [OfNat K 1] (leaf : PairLeaf K) (secondSlot : Bool)
    (spendable : leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable secondSlot) :
    leaf.selectedOccupied secondSlot = 1 :=
  spendable

theorem first_slot_is_spendable
    {K : Type} [OfNat K 1] (leaf : PairLeaf K) :
    leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable false := by
  simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied]

theorem second_slot_spendable_iff
    {K : Type} [OfNat K 1] (leaf : PairLeaf K) :
    leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable true ↔ leaf.secondOccupied = 1 := by
  simp [PairLeaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable, PairLeaf.selectedOccupied]

/-- A canonical empty second slot is rejected by the spend gate by an exact
field inequality, not by a preimage-resistance claim. -/
theorem canonical_empty_second_slot_not_spendable
    {K : Type} [Semiring K] [Nontrivial K]
    (first : Digest K) :
    let leaf : PairLeaf K := ⟨first, 0, fun _ => 0, 0⟩
    ¬ leaf.SelectedSlotIsSpendable true := by
  intro leaf
  change ¬ (0 : K) = 1
  exact zero_ne_one

/-- Booleanity gives the intended exhaustive occupied/empty cases over any
integral domain. -/
theorem valid_second_occupied_cases
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid) :
    leaf.secondOccupied = 0 ∨ leaf.secondOccupied = 1 := by
  rcases eq_zero_or_eq_zero_of_mul_eq_zero valid.1 with zero | one
  · exact Or.inl zero
  · exact Or.inr (sub_eq_zero.mp one)

/-- In the empty case the commitment is algebraically the canonical all-zero
digest. -/
theorem valid_empty_second_commitment_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid)
    (empty : leaf.secondOccupied = 0) :
    leaf.secondCommitment = fun _ => 0 := by
  funext lane
  have constrained := valid.2.2.2 lane
  simpa [empty] using constrained

theorem valid_empty_second_inverse_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid)
    (empty : leaf.secondOccupied = 0) :
    leaf.secondOccupancyInverse = 0 := by
  have constrained := valid.2.2.1
  simpa [empty] using constrained

/-- Occupancy one algebraically certifies a nonzero sentinel. -/
theorem valid_occupied_second_sentinel_ne_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [Nontrivial K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid)
    (occupied : leaf.secondOccupied = 1) :
    leaf.secondSentinel ≠ 0 := by
  intro zero
  have inverse := valid.2.1
  simp [zero, occupied] at inverse

/-- The bit is not free metadata: validity makes it the exact zero test of the
committed sentinel limb. -/
theorem valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K]
    (leaf : PairLeaf K) (valid : leaf.Valid) :
    leaf.secondOccupied = 0 ↔ leaf.secondSentinel = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro empty
    have allZero := valid_empty_second_commitment_zero leaf valid empty
    simp [PairLeaf.secondSentinel, allZero]
  · intro zero
    have inverse := valid.2.1
    rw [zero, zero_mul] at inverse
    exact inverse.symm

/-- A single-output append has an algebraically empty second slot. -/
def singleOutputPair {K : Type} [Zero K]
    (commitment : Digest K) : PairLeaf K :=
  ⟨commitment, 0, fun _ => 0, 0⟩

/-- A private transfer has two algebraically occupied slots. -/
def twoOutputPair {K : Type} [One K]
    (recipient change : Digest K) (sentinelInverse : K) : PairLeaf K :=
  ⟨recipient, 1, change, sentinelInverse⟩

theorem singleOutputPair_valid
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] (commitment : Digest K) :
    (singleOutputPair commitment).Valid := by
  constructor <;> simp [singleOutputPair]

theorem twoOutputPair_valid
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] (recipient change : Digest K)
    (sentinelInverse : K)
    (inverseCorrect : change ⟨7, by decide⟩ * sentinelInverse = 1) :
    (twoOutputPair recipient change sentinelInverse).Valid := by
  refine ⟨by simp [twoOutputPair], ?_, by simp [twoOutputPair], ?_⟩
  · simpa [twoOutputPair, PairLeaf.secondSentinel] using inverseCorrect
  · intro lane
    simp [twoOutputPair]

/-- The exact one-permutation preimage.  This is also the ordinary ordered
input to the lowest internal-node compression in the depth-21 note tree. -/
def PairLeaf.compressionPreimage {K : Type} (leaf : PairLeaf K) :
    Digest K × Digest K :=
  (leaf.firstCommitment, leaf.secondCommitment)

/-- Two valid witnesses for the same committed second digest cannot disagree
about whether the slot is empty. -/
theorem valid_same_second_commitment_same_occupancy
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K] [Nontrivial K]
    (left right : PairLeaf K) (leftValid : left.Valid)
    (rightValid : right.Valid)
    (sameSecond : left.secondCommitment = right.secondCommitment) :
    left.secondOccupied = right.secondOccupied := by
  rcases valid_second_occupied_cases left leftValid with leftEmpty | leftOccupied
  · have leftSentinel : left.secondSentinel = 0 :=
      (valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero left leftValid).mp leftEmpty
    have rightSentinel : right.secondSentinel = 0 := by
      simpa [PairLeaf.secondSentinel, sameSecond] using leftSentinel
    exact leftEmpty.trans
      ((valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero right rightValid).mpr
        rightSentinel).symm
  · rcases valid_second_occupied_cases right rightValid with rightEmpty | rightOccupied
    · have rightSentinel : right.secondSentinel = 0 :=
        (valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero right rightValid).mp rightEmpty
      have leftSentinel : left.secondSentinel = 0 := by
        simpa [PairLeaf.secondSentinel, sameSecond] using rightSentinel
      exact False.elim
        ((valid_occupied_second_sentinel_ne_zero left leftValid leftOccupied)
          leftSentinel)
    · exact leftOccupied.trans rightOccupied.symm

theorem valid_same_compression_preimage_same_occupancy
    {K : Type} [CommRing K] [NoZeroDivisors K] [Nontrivial K]
    (left right : PairLeaf K) (leftValid : left.Valid)
    (rightValid : right.Valid)
    (sameInput : left.compressionPreimage = right.compressionPreimage) :
    left.secondOccupied = right.secondOccupied := by
  exact valid_same_second_commitment_same_occupancy left right leftValid rightValid
    (congrArg Prod.snd sameInput)

#print axioms selected_spendable_implies_occupied_one
#print axioms canonical_empty_second_slot_not_spendable
#print axioms valid_second_occupied_cases
#print axioms valid_empty_second_commitment_zero
#print axioms valid_empty_second_inverse_zero
#print axioms valid_occupied_second_sentinel_ne_zero
#print axioms valid_second_occupied_zero_iff_sentinel_zero
#print axioms singleOutputPair_valid
#print axioms twoOutputPair_valid
#print axioms valid_same_compression_preimage_same_occupancy

end AspisPool.V7PairLeafOccupancy

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.InputPairCopyLinks

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def copyAfterAt (i : Fin 118) : CopyLink :=
  copyLinksAfterPositivity.get ⟨i.val, by
    have hlen : copyLinksAfterPositivity.length = 118 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt⟩

private theorem copy_after_mem (i : Fin 118) : copyAfterAt i ∈ copyLinks := by
  have hm : copyAfterAt i ∈ copyLinksAfterPositivity := List.get_mem _ _
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hm)

private theorem balance_pattern_funcs (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0) :
    copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) := by
  change (copyProducerTuple A link).2 = (copyConsumerTuple A link).2
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (hb link hmem hw)

private theorem copyPattern6_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern6 o = fun i => if i.val = 0 then o 0 else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern6]

private theorem copyPattern7_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern7 o = fun i => if i.val = 0 then o 10 else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern7]

private theorem copyPattern10_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) : copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 o = fun i =>
    if h : i.val < 8 then
      o ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ + (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)
    else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern10]

private theorem copyPattern11_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern11 o = fun i =>
      if h : i.val < 8 then o ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩ else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern11]

private theorem copyPatterns6 : copyPatterns 6 = copyPattern6 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns7 : copyPatterns 7 = copyPattern7 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns10 : copyPatterns 10 = copyPattern10 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns11 : copyPatterns 11 = copyPattern11 := rfl

private theorem after0_spec :
    copyAfterAt 0 = ⟨1124073490, 0, 0, ⟨64, 0, 10⟩, ⟨1017, 0, 11⟩⟩ := rfl

private theorem after1_spec :
    copyAfterAt 1 = ⟨1124073491, 0, 0, ⟨913, 0, 6⟩, ⟨1017, 1, 7⟩⟩ := rfl

theorem selected_bit (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    A 0 913 = A 10 1017 := by
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 1) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after1_spec]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 1) (copy_after_mem 1) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern6 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 913) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern7 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 1017) := by
    simpa only [after1_spec, copyPatterns6, copyPatterns7] using hpat
  have hzero := congrFun hpat' (0 : Fin 16)
  have hleft :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (0 : Fin 16) : Fin 29) = 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  have hright :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (10 : Fin 16) : Fin 29) = 10 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    rfl
  simpa only [copyPattern6_tuple, copyPattern7_tuple, Fin.val_zero,
    if_pos rfl, if_true, hleft, hright] using hzero

theorem right_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8,
      A ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ 1017 =
        A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ 64 +
          (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) := by
  intro i
  have hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) (copyAfterAt 0) pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0 := by
    simp [copyLinkWeight, after0_spec]
  have hpat := balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb (copyAfterAt 0) (copy_after_mem 0) hw
  have hpat' :
      copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 64) =
        copyPatternTuple copyPattern11 (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) 1017) := by
    simpa only [after0_spec, copyPatterns10, copyPatterns11] using hpat
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, by omega⟩
  have hj : j.val < 8 := i.isLt
  have hi := congrFun hpat' j
  have hindex2 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨2 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [j]
    omega
  have hindex8 :
      (Fin.castLE (by omega) (⟨j.val + 8, by omega⟩ : Fin 16) : Fin 29) =
        ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp [j]
    omega
  simpa only [copyPattern10_tuple, copyPattern11_tuple, j, Fin.val_mk,
    if_pos hj, dif_pos hj, hindex2, hindex8] using hi.symm

#print axioms selected_bit
#print axioms right_cells

end AspisR1.InputPairCopyLinks

import R1SpendValues
import R1OutputNotes
import R0P.SemAssembly

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SpendSemantics

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- Production value, input-note extraction, and output-note bindings. This
statement does not include a public append update, public `Option` shape,
strict output positivity, ROM condition, Rust correspondence, or privacy claim. -/
structure NoteFacts (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) : Prop where
  values : SpendValues.BoundedBalanced A
  input : InputNoteExtracted pub A
  change : pub.change =
    noteCommitment (OutputNotes.chunk A 30) (A 10 1012) pub.assetId (OutputNotes.salt A 31 32)
  recipient : pub.variant = .privateTransfer →
    ∀ r : Digest K, pub.recipient = some r →
      r = noteCommitment (OutputNotes.chunk A 27) (A 10 1010) pub.assetId
        (OutputNotes.salt A 28 29)
  withdrawal : pub.variant = .withdrawal →
    ∀ amount, pub.withdrawalAmount = some amount → A 10 1010 = amount

theorem of_production (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2 ^ 31 - 1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (lam chi : K) (h : ProductionHolds pub lam chi A ∧ CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    NoteFacts pub A := by
  have values := SpendValues.of_value_balance prime hprime pub A h.1.1 h.2
  have input := semantic_extraction pub A lam chi h (extraction_step pub lam chi A)
  have hasset : Holds assetFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.1
  have hschedule : Holds scheduleFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.1
  have hdigest : Holds digestFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hposeidon : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A := h.1.2.2.2.2.2.2.1
  have hassetFacts := (asset_holds_iff pub A).mp hasset
  refine ⟨values, input,
    OutputNotes.change_public pub A hschedule hasset hdigest hposeidon h.2,
    ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro hvariant r hpresent
    exact OutputNotes.recipient_public pub A hvariant r hpresent
      hschedule hasset hdigest hposeidon h.2
  · exact hassetFacts.2.2.2

#print axioms of_production

end AspisR1.SpendSemantics

import R0P.PositivityChain
import R0P.Asset

/-! Reuse of the production value rows and copy registry. The three bounded
natural values balance as integers because their possible sum is below the
characteristic. This does not assume the research-only positive family and
does not claim either output value is strictly positive. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SpendValues

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def BoundedBalanced (A : Trace K) : Prop :=
  ∃ v0 v1 v2 : Nat,
    v0 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v1 < 2 ^ 30 ∧ v2 < 2 ^ 30 ∧
    v0 = v1 + v2 ∧
    A 10 1008 = (v0 : K) ∧ A 10 1010 = (v1 : K) ∧ A 10 1012 = (v2 : K)

theorem of_value_balance (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime]
    (hprime : prime = 2 ^ 31 - 1) (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hv : Holds valueFamily pub A) (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    BoundedBalanced A := by
  obtain ⟨_, hcons0, hcons1⟩ := (value_holds_iff pub A).mp hv
  obtain ⟨hc0, hc1, hc2, hc3⟩ := positivity_copy_cells pub A hb
  obtain ⟨v0, hv0, e0⟩ := valueRow_nat A 1008
    (valueRow_of_holds pub A hv 1008 (Or.inl rfl))
  obtain ⟨v1, hv1, e1⟩ := valueRow_nat A 1010
    (valueRow_of_holds pub A hv 1010 (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)))
  obtain ⟨v2, hv2, e2⟩ := valueRow_nat A 1012
    (valueRow_of_holds pub A hv 1012 (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)))
  have a0 : A 0 1014 = (v0 : K) := hc0.symm.trans e0
  have a1 : A 1 1014 = (v1 : K) := hc1.symm.trans e1
  have a2 : A 1 1015 = (v2 : K) := hc2.symm.trans e2
  have hfield : ((v0 : Nat) : K) = ((v1 + v2 : Nat) : K) := by
    push_cast
    rw [← a0, ← a1, ← a2, hcons0, hc3, hcons1]
  have hmod := (CharP.natCast_eq_natCast K prime).mp hfield
  have hbalance : v0 = v1 + v2 := by
    subst hprime
    exact Nat.ModEq.eq_of_lt_of_lt hmod (by omega) (by omega)
  exact ⟨v0, v1, v2, hv0, hv1, hv2, hbalance, e0, e1, e2⟩

#print axioms of_value_balance

end AspisR1.SpendValues
