import R0P.Core

/-! A small executable predicate for the option/variant shape represented by
`R0P.Public`. This does not parse Rust bytes and does not impose value bounds. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PublicOptionShape

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def canonical (pub : Public K) : Prop :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient.isSome = true ∧ pub.withdrawalAmount = none
  | .withdrawal => pub.recipient.isNone = true ∧ pub.withdrawalAmount.isSome = true ∧
      pub.withdrawalAmount ≠ some 0

def check (pub : Public K) : Bool :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient.isSome && pub.withdrawalAmount.isNone
  | .withdrawal => pub.recipient.isNone && pub.withdrawalAmount.isSome &&
      pub.withdrawalAmount != some 0

theorem check_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) : check pub = true ↔ canonical pub := by
  cases hv : pub.variant <;> simp [check, canonical, hv, and_assoc]

theorem private_transfer_shape (pub : Public K)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .privateTransfer) (hcanonical : canonical pub) :
    ∃ recipient, pub.recipient = some recipient ∧ pub.withdrawalAmount = none := by
  unfold canonical at hcanonical
  rw [hvariant] at hcanonical
  obtain ⟨hrecipient, hwithdrawal⟩ := hcanonical
  obtain ⟨recipient, h⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hrecipient
  exact ⟨recipient, h, hwithdrawal⟩

theorem withdrawal_shape (pub : Public K)
    (hvariant : pub.variant = .withdrawal) (hcanonical : canonical pub) :
    ∃ amount, amount ≠ 0 ∧ pub.withdrawalAmount = some amount ∧ pub.recipient = none := by
  unfold canonical at hcanonical
  rw [hvariant] at hcanonical
  obtain ⟨hrecipient, hamount, hnonzero⟩ := hcanonical
  obtain ⟨amount, h⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp hamount
  have hne : amount ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    apply hnonzero
    simp [h, hz]
  exact ⟨amount, hne, h, Option.isNone_iff_eq_none.mp hrecipient⟩

theorem private_transfer_updated_canonical (pub : Public K) (recipient : Digest K) :
    canonical {
      variant := .privateTransfer
      anchor := pub.anchor
      nullifier := pub.nullifier
      assetId := pub.assetId
      recipient := some recipient
      change := pub.change
      withdrawalAmount := none
      nextPairIndex := pub.nextPairIndex
      snapshotFrontier := pub.snapshotFrontier
      nextRoot := pub.nextRoot
      nextFrontier := pub.nextFrontier
    } := by
  simp [canonical]

theorem withdrawal_updated_canonical (pub : Public K) (amount : K) (hamount : amount ≠ 0) :
    canonical {
      variant := .withdrawal
      anchor := pub.anchor
      nullifier := pub.nullifier
      assetId := pub.assetId
      recipient := none
      change := pub.change
      withdrawalAmount := some amount
      nextPairIndex := pub.nextPairIndex
      snapshotFrontier := pub.snapshotFrontier
      nextRoot := pub.nextRoot
      nextFrontier := pub.nextFrontier
    } := by
  simp [canonical, hamount]

#print axioms check_eq_true_iff
#print axioms private_transfer_shape
#print axioms withdrawal_shape
#print axioms private_transfer_updated_canonical
#print axioms withdrawal_updated_canonical

end AspisR1.PublicOptionShape

import R1InputWitnessCheck
import R1AppendPath

/-! Public output-pair, new-root and carry-frontier binding required by J1.R2.
The recurrence is the circuit's literal frozen-table recurrence. Non-carry
frontier validation and the chronological tree invariant are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SpendRelation
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [DecidableEq K]

def outputPair (pub : Public K) : Option (Digest K) :=
  match pub.variant with
  | .privateTransfer => pub.recipient.map (fun r => nodeCompress r pub.change)
  | .withdrawal => some (nodeCompress pub.change (fun _ => 0))

def AppendBinding (pub : Public K) : Prop :=
  ∃ pair, outputPair pub = some pair ∧
    pub.nextRoot = AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair 20 ∧
    ∀ hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20,
      pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
        AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex)

def appendCheck (pub : Public K) : Bool :=
  match outputPair pub with
  | none => false
  | some pair =>
      InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck pub.nextRoot (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair 20) &&
        if hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20 then
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck
            (pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩)
            (AppendPath.pathPrefix pub pair (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex))
        else true

theorem appendCheck_eq_true_iff (pub : Public K) :
    appendCheck pub = true ↔ AppendBinding pub := by
  cases hp : outputPair pub with
  | none => simp [appendCheck, AppendBinding, hp]
  | some pair =>
      by_cases hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20
      · simp [appendCheck, AppendBinding, hp, hc,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]
      · simp [appendCheck, AppendBinding, hp, hc,
          InputWitnessCheck.digestEqCheck_eq_true_iff]

#print axioms appendCheck_eq_true_iff
end AspisR1.SpendRelation
R1AppendPath:
import R1AppendNode
import R1AppendCopyLinks
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bitwise

/-! The twenty literal append gates determine a public root and carry node.
The recurrence uses the frozen empty-root table exactly as the gates do;
its equality with recursively generated empty roots is a separate obligation.
No exclusion of the full-tree last insertion is introduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.AppendPath
open R0P
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def block (level : Fin 21) : Fin 57 := ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩

theorem block_succ (level : Fin 20) :
    block level.succ = ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 33 + (level.val + 1) = 34 + level.val
  omega

theorem bit_zero_or_one (n : Nat) : n &&& 1 = 0 ∨ n &&& 1 = 1 := by
  have h : n &&& 1 = (n.testBit 0).toNat := by simpa using Nat.and_two_pow n 0
  rw [h]
  cases n.testBit 0 <;> simp

def step (pub : Public K) (level : Fin 20) (cur : Digest K) : Digest K :=
  if digestBitZero pub level then nodeCompress cur (AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc)
  else nodeCompress (pub.snapshotFrontier level) cur

def pathPrefix (pub : Public K) (leaf : Digest K) : Nat → Digest K
  | 0 => leaf
  | n+1 => if h : n < 20 then step pub ⟨n, h⟩ (pathPrefix pub leaf n)
    else pathPrefix pub leaf n

theorem gate_step (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (level : Fin 20) :
    OutputNotes.output A (block level.succ) =
      step pub level (OutputNotes.output A (block level.castSucc)) := by
  have hnode : ScheduleNode (block level.succ).val := by
    right
    dsimp [block]
    omega
  rw [AppendNode.node_step pub A hs hpo (block level.succ) hnode]
  have hcopy := AppendCopyLinks.append_cells pub A hb level
  have hbound := (digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.2.1 level
  unfold step
  by_cases hzero : digestBitZero pub level
  · rw [if_pos hzero]
    have hl : AppendNode.left A (block level.succ) =
        OutputNotes.output A (block level.castSucc) := by
      rw [block_succ]
      funext i
      exact (hcopy.1 hzero i).symm
    have hr : AppendNode.right A (block level.succ) =
        AppendNode.frozenEmpty level.castSucc := by
      rw [block_succ]
      funext i
      have he := hbound.1 hzero i
      change A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ (g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 0) +
        (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0) = _
      rw [he]
      exact AppendNode.empty_target_untweak prime hprime level i
    rw [hl, hr]
  · rw [if_neg hzero]
    have hone : ((pub.nextPairIndex >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 1 :=
      (bit_zero_or_one (pub.nextPairIndex >>> level.val)).resolve_left hzero
    have hl : AppendNode.left A (block level.succ) = pub.snapshotFrontier level := by
      rw [block_succ]
      funext i
      exact hbound.2 hzero i
    have hr : AppendNode.right A (block level.succ) =
        OutputNotes.output A (block level.castSucc) := by
      rw [block_succ]
      funext i
      exact (hcopy.2 hone i).symm
    rw [hl, hr]

theorem prefix_output (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (n : Nat) (hn : n ≤ 20) :
    pathPrefix pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) n = OutputNotes.output A (block ⟨n, by omega⟩) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn' : n < 20 := by omega
    rw [pathPrefix, dif_pos hn', ih (by omega)]
    exact (gate_step prime hprime pub A hs hd hpo hb ⟨n, hn'⟩).symm

theorem next_root (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) :
    pub.nextRoot = pathPrefix pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) 20 := by
  rw [prefix_output prime hprime pub A hs hd hpo hb 20 (by omega)]
  funext i
  exact ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.2.2.1 i).symm

theorem next_frontier_carry (prime : Nat) [CharP K prime] (hprime : prime = 2^31-1)
    (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K) (hs : Holds scheduleFamily pub A)
    (hd : Holds digestFamily pub A) (hpo : Holds poseidonScalarFamily pub A)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (hc : digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex < 20) :
    pub.nextFrontier ⟨digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex, hc⟩ =
      pathPrefix pub (OutputNotes.output A 33) (digestCarry pub.nextPairIndex) := by
  rw [prefix_output prime hprime pub A hs hd hpo hb _ (digest_carry_le pub.nextPairIndex)]
  funext i
  exact ((digest_holds_iff pub A).mp hd |>.2.2.2.2.2.2 hc i).symm

#print axioms gate_step
#print axioms next_root
#print axioms next_frontier_carry
end AspisR1.AppendPath
R1AppendCopyLinks:
import R0P.CopyInputLinks
import R0P.Digest

/-! Mechanical projection of the two append-continuation copy-link families.
The result records only the literal copy-link consequences under their
source-declared bit weights. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.AppendCopyLinks

open R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def afterAt (i : Fin 118) : CopyLink :=
  copyLinksAfterPositivity.get ⟨i.val, by
    have hlen : copyLinksAfterPositivity.length = 118 := rfl
    rw [hlen]
    exact i.isLt⟩

private theorem after_mem (i : Fin 118) : afterAt i ∈ copyLinks := by
  have hm : afterAt i ∈ copyLinksAfterPositivity := List.get_mem _ _
  exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inr hm)

private theorem link_balance_pattern_funcs (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (link : CopyLink) (hmem : link ∈ copyLinks)
    (hw : copyLinkWeight (K := K) link pub.nextPairIndex pub.variant ≠ 0) :
    copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.producer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.producer.row) =
      copyPatternTuple (copyPatterns link.consumer.pattern)
        (fun c => A (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) link.consumer.row) := by
  change (copyProducerTuple A link).2 = (copyConsumerTuple A link).2
  exact congrArg Prod.snd (hb link hmem hw)

private theorem copyPattern1_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern1 o = fun i => if i.val < 8 then o i else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern1]

private theorem copyPattern10_tuple (o : Fin 16 → K) :
    copyPatternTuple copyPattern10 o = fun i =>
      if h : i.val < 8 then
        o ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ + (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)
      else 0 := by
  funext i
  fin_cases i <;> simp [copyPatternTuple, copyPattern10]

private theorem copyPatterns1 : copyPatterns 1 = copyPattern1 := rfl
private theorem copyPatterns10 : copyPatterns 10 = copyPattern10 := rfl

private theorem leftSpec (level : Fin 20) :
    afterAt ⟨6 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨1124073496 + 2 * level.val, 3, level.val,
        ⟨⟨539 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 0, 1⟩,
        ⟨⟨556 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 0, 1⟩⟩ := by
  fin_cases level <;> rfl

private theorem rightSpec (level : Fin 20) :
    afterAt ⟨7 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨1124073497 + 2 * level.val, 4, level.val,
        ⟨⟨539 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 1, 1⟩,
        ⟨⟨544 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩, 0, 10⟩⟩ := by
  fin_cases level <;> rfl

private theorem leftRow (level : Fin 20) :
    g2Row ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩ 11 =
      (⟨539 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 16 * (33 + level.val) + 11 = 539 + 16 * level.val
  omega

private theorem rightRow12 (level : Fin 20) :
    g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 12 =
      (⟨556 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 16 * (34 + level.val) + 12 = 556 + 16 * level.val
  omega

private theorem rightRow0 (level : Fin 20) :
    g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 0 =
      (⟨544 + 16 * level.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 1024) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change 16 * (34 + level.val) + 0 = 544 + 16 * level.val
  omega

private theorem castLE_fin8 (i : Fin 8) :
    Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) (i.castAdd 8) = i.castAdd 21 := by
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

private theorem castLE_fin8_shift (i : Fin 8) :
    Fin.castLE (by omega : 16 ≤ 29) ⟨i.val + 8, by omega⟩ =
      ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change i.val + 8 = 8 + i.val
  omega

/-- The append continuation cells selected by the zero/one branch weights in
the exact `copyLinksAfterPositivity` registry entries. -/
theorem append_cells (pub : Public K) (A : Trace K)
    (hb : CopyLinkBalance pub A) (level : Fin 20) :
    ((((pub.nextPairIndex >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 0) →
      ∀ i : Fin 8,
        A (i.castAdd 21) (g2Row ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩ 11) =
          A (i.castAdd 21) (g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 12)) ∧
    ((((pub.nextPairIndex >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 1) →
      ∀ i : Fin 8,
        A (i.castAdd 21) (g2Row ⟨33 + level.val, by omega⟩ 11) =
          A ⟨8 + i.val, by omega⟩ (g2Row ⟨34 + level.val, by omega⟩ 0) +
            (if i.val = 7 then (1051521018 : K) else 0)) := by
  constructor
  · intro hbit i
    have hlink := link_balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb
      (afterAt ⟨6 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩)
      (after_mem _)
      (by simp [copyLinkWeight, leftSpec, hbit])
    have hi := congrFun hlink (i.castAdd 8)
    simpa only [leftSpec, copyPatterns1, copyPattern1_tuple,
      Fin.val_castAdd, if_pos i.isLt, castLE_fin8,
      leftRow, rightRow12] using hi
  · intro hbit i
    have hlink := link_balance_pattern_funcs pub A hb
      (afterAt ⟨7 + 2 * level.val, by omega⟩)
      (after_mem _)
      (by simp [copyLinkWeight, rightSpec, hbit])
    have hi := congrFun hlink (i.castAdd 8)
    simp only [rightSpec, copyPatterns1, copyPatterns10,
      copyPattern1_tuple, copyPattern10_tuple, Fin.val_castAdd,
      if_pos i.isLt, dif_pos i.isLt, castLE_fin8, castLE_fin8_shift] at hi
    rw [leftRow, rightRow0]
    convert hi using 1
    congr 1 <;> norm_num

#print axioms append_cells

end AspisR1.AppendCopyLinks

import SemanticPackedIntervalAssembly
import R0P.SemDecision

/-! Connect the six source packing contributions to the existing arbitrary-
point scalarLaneAt used by the retained terminal soundness theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPackedFamilyAssembly
open AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList
open AspisR1.SemanticPackedIntervalAssembly
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem family_lengths (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) :
    ((R0P.scheduleFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).length = 32 ∧
    ((R0P.pathFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).length = 17 ∧
    ((R0P.valueFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).length = 35 ∧
    ((R0P.occupancyFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).length = 12 ∧
    ((R0P.digestFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).length = 8 ∧
    ((R0P.assetFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).length = 2 := by
  simp only [R0P.scheduleFamily, R0P.pathFamily, R0P.pathLanes, R0P.valueFamily,
    R0P.valueRange, R0P.occupancyFamily, R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral, R0P.digestFamily,
    R0P.assetFamily, R0P.assetScalarLanes, List.length_append, List.length_ofFn,
    List.length_cons, List.length_nil, List.length_map]
  all_goals decide

theorem slot_eq_scalarLaneAt (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K)
    (index : Nat) :
    slot ((R0P.scheduleFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel)
      ((R0P.pathFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel)
      ((R0P.valueFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel)
      ((R0P.occupancyFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel)
      ((R0P.digestFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel)
      ((R0P.assetFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) index =
      R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt pub o sel index := rfl

theorem packed_family_contributions {F : Subfield K} (B : R0P.PackBasis F)
    (pub : R0P.Public K) (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K) (group : Nat) :
    (((((R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 0 ((R0P.scheduleFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) (4*group+k.val)) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 32 ((R0P.pathFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 49 ((R0P.valueFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 0 ((R0P.occupancyFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 84 ((R0P.digestFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 92 ((R0P.assetFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel) (4*group+k.val))) =
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt pub o sel (4*group+k.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨hs,hp,hv,ho,hd,ha⟩ := family_lengths pub o sel
  exact pack_intervals B _ _ _ _ _ _ hs hp hv ho hd ha group

#print axioms family_lengths
#print axioms slot_eq_scalarLaneAt
#print axioms packed_family_contributions
end AspisR1.SemanticPackedFamilyAssembly
SemanticPackedIntervalAssembly:
import ValueLaneResidualList
import ValueLanePackedComposition

/-! Symbolic assembly of the six source family intervals, including the
schedule/occupancy overlap and the two final zero padding slots. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPackedIntervalAssembly
open AspisR1.ValueLaneResidualList

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem selectList_getD (start index : Nat) (xs : List K) (hstart : start ≤ index) :
    selectList start xs index = xs.getD (index-start) 0 := by
  by_cases hi : index-start < xs.length
  · rw [selectList, dif_pos (by omega), List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hi]
  · rw [selectList, dif_neg (by omega), List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD,
      List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega), Option.getD_none]

theorem selectList_before (start index : Nat) (xs : List K) (hi : index < start) :
    selectList start xs index = 0 := by
  rw [selectList, dif_neg (by omega)]

theorem selectList_after (start index : Nat) (xs : List K) (hi : start+xs.length ≤ index) :
    selectList start xs index = 0 := by
  rw [selectList, dif_neg (by omega)]

def slot (schedule path value occupancy digest asset : List K) (index : Nat) : K :=
  if index < 12 then schedule.getD index 0 + occupancy.getD index 0
  else if index < 32 then schedule.getD index 0
  else if index < 49 then path.getD (index-32) 0
  else if index < 84 then value.getD (index-49) 0
  else if index < 92 then digest.getD (index-84) 0
  else if index < 94 then asset.getD (index-92) 0
  else 0

theorem intervals_eq_slot (schedule path value occupancy digest asset : List K)
    (hs : schedule.length = 32) (hp : path.length = 17) (hv : value.length = 35)
    (ho : occupancy.length = 12) (hd : digest.length = 8) (ha : asset.length = 2)
    (index : Nat) :
    (((((selectList 0 schedule index + selectList 32 path index) + selectList 49 value index) +
      selectList 0 occupancy index) + selectList 84 digest index) + selectList 92 asset index) =
      slot schedule path value occupancy digest asset index := by
  by_cases h12 : index < 12
  · simp only [slot, if_pos h12, selectList_getD 0 index schedule (by omega),
      selectList_before 32 index path (by omega), selectList_before 49 index value (by omega),
      selectList_getD 0 index occupancy (by omega), selectList_before 84 index digest (by omega),
      selectList_before 92 index asset (by omega), Nat.sub_zero, add_zero]
  · by_cases h32 : index < 32
    · simp only [slot, if_neg h12, if_pos h32, selectList_getD 0 index schedule (by omega),
        selectList_before 32 index path (by omega), selectList_before 49 index value (by omega),
        selectList_after 0 index occupancy (by omega), selectList_before 84 index digest (by omega),
        selectList_before 92 index asset (by omega), Nat.sub_zero, add_zero]
    · by_cases h49 : index < 49
      · simp only [slot, if_neg h12, if_neg h32, if_pos h49,
          selectList_after 0 index schedule (by omega), selectList_getD 32 index path (by omega),
          selectList_before 49 index value (by omega), selectList_after 0 index occupancy (by omega),
          selectList_before 84 index digest (by omega), selectList_before 92 index asset (by omega),
          add_zero, zero_add]
      · by_cases h84 : index < 84
        · simp only [slot, if_neg h12, if_neg h32, if_neg h49, if_pos h84,
            selectList_after 0 index schedule (by omega), selectList_after 32 index path (by omega),
            selectList_getD 49 index value (by omega), selectList_after 0 index occupancy (by omega),
            selectList_before 84 index digest (by omega), selectList_before 92 index asset (by omega),
            add_zero, zero_add]
        · by_cases h92 : index < 92
          · simp only [slot, if_neg h12, if_neg h32, if_neg h49, if_neg h84, if_pos h92,
              selectList_after 0 index schedule (by omega), selectList_after 32 index path (by omega),
              selectList_after 49 index value (by omega), selectList_after 0 index occupancy (by omega),
              selectList_getD 84 index digest (by omega), selectList_before 92 index asset (by omega),
              add_zero, zero_add]
          · by_cases h94 : index < 94
            · simp only [slot, if_neg h12, if_neg h32, if_neg h49, if_neg h84, if_neg h92, if_pos h94,
                selectList_after 0 index schedule (by omega), selectList_after 32 index path (by omega),
                selectList_after 49 index value (by omega), selectList_after 0 index occupancy (by omega),
                selectList_after 84 index digest (by omega), selectList_getD 92 index asset (by omega),
                add_zero, zero_add]
            · simp only [slot, if_neg h12, if_neg h32, if_neg h49, if_neg h84, if_neg h92, if_neg h94,
                selectList_after 0 index schedule (by omega), selectList_after 32 index path (by omega),
                selectList_after 49 index value (by omega), selectList_after 0 index occupancy (by omega),
                selectList_after 84 index digest (by omega), selectList_after 92 index asset (by omega),
                add_zero]

theorem pack_intervals {F : Subfield K} (B : R0P.PackBasis F)
    (schedule path value occupancy digest asset : List K)
    (hs : schedule.length = 32) (hp : path.length = 17) (hv : value.length = 35)
    (ho : occupancy.length = 12) (hd : digest.length = 8) (ha : asset.length = 2)
    (group : Nat) :
    (((((R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 0 schedule (4*group+k.val)) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 32 path (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 49 value (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 0 occupancy (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 84 digest (4*group+k.val))) +
      R0P.pack4 B (fun k => selectList 92 asset (4*group+k.val))) =
    R0P.pack4 B (fun k => slot schedule path value occupancy digest asset (4*group+k.val)) := by
  simp only [← AspisR1.ValueLanePackedComposition.pack_add]
  congr 1
  funext k
  exact intervals_eq_slot schedule path value occupancy digest asset hs hp hv ho hd ha _

#print axioms selectList_getD
#print axioms intervals_eq_slot
#print axioms pack_intervals
end AspisR1.SemanticPackedIntervalAssembly
TerminalDigestPublicLoopFuel:
import TerminalDigestPublicBranchRun
import OccupancyRangeTraversal
import TerminalDigestFrontierModel

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Fuel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Usize := UScalar UScalarTy.Usize
abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev Snapshot := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1
abbrev Openings := state_only_poseidon.StateOnlyPoseidonOpenings
abbrev Range := core.ops.range.Range Usize
private theorem bind_if {α β : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p]
    (a b : Result α) (f : α → Result β) :
    ((if p then a else b) >>= f) = (if p then a >>= f else b >>= f) := by
  split_ifs <;> rfl

private def decodedDigest (a : Array QM 8#usize) : R0P.Digest ExactQM :=
  fun j => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt a j.val)

/-- Bounded fuel theorem for the exact candidate source outer loop. Each
recursive step is the actual generated iterator step and actual branch body;
the model tracks the exact twenty-level frontier fold. -/
theorem loop_success_fuel
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors) (source : Snapshot)
    (openings : Openings) (iter : Range) (fuel : Nat)
    (base digests : Array QM 8#usize)
    (hend : iter.end.val = 20) (hspan : iter.start.val + fuel = 20)
    (hsource : source = public1.transition.live_snapshot)
    (hpoint : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray openings.z)
    (hfrontierCanonical : ∀ k : Fin 20,
      AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.TargetActual.CanonicalM31
        (source.frontier.val[k.val]'(by
          simpa [source.frontier.property] using k.isLt)))
    (hbase : CanonicalArray base) (hdigests : CanonicalArray digests)
    (hmodel : decodedDigest digests =
      AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierPrefix
        (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
        (AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings openings)
        (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
        iter.start.val (decodedDigest base)) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 8#usize,
      AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop
        iter openings.z selectors digests source = .ok (out, source) ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      decodedDigest out = AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierPrefix
        (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
        (AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings openings)
        (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
        20 (decodedDigest base) := by
  induction fuel generalizing iter digests with
  | zero =>
      have hstop : iter.start.val ≥ iter.end.val := by omega
      have hstart : iter.start.val = 20 := by omega
      have hnext := AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_done iter hstop
      refine ⟨digests, ?_, hdigests, ?_⟩
      · change AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop
          iter openings.z selectors digests source = .ok (digests, source)
        rw [AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop.eq_def]
        simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
      · rw [hstart] at hmodel
        simpa using hmodel
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hlt : iter.start.val < iter.end.val := by omega
      have hlevel : iter.start.val < 20 := by omega
      obtain ⟨iter1, hnext, hstart1, hend1, _⟩ :=
        AspisR1.OccupancyRangeTraversal.next_step iter hlt
      have hend1' : iter1.end.val = 20 := by rw [hend1, hend]
      have hspan1 : iter1.start.val + fuel = 20 := by omega
      obtain ⟨middle, hbranch, hmiddleCan, hstep⟩ :=
        AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchRun.run_success public1 point selectors source
          iter.start hlevel openings digests hsource hpoint hbox hopened hdigests hfrontierCanonical
      have hmodel1 : decodedDigest middle =
          AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierPrefix
            (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
            (AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings openings)
            (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
            iter1.start.val (decodedDigest base) := by
        rw [hstart1]
        rw [AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierPrefix_succ
          (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
          (AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings openings)
          (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
          iter.start.val (decodedDigest base) hlevel]
        rw [← hmodel]
        exact hstep
      obtain ⟨out, hrec, houtCan, houtModel⟩ :=
        ih iter1 middle hend1' hspan1 hmiddleCan hmodel1
      have hcontinue0 := congrArg
        (fun result : Result (Array QM 8#usize) => do
          let d ← result
          AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop
            iter1 openings.z selectors d source) hbranch
      have hcontinue : (do
          let d ← AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchRun.run
            iter.start source openings.z selectors digests
          AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop
            iter1 openings.z selectors d source) = .ok (out, source) := by
        calc
          _ = (do
            let d ← .ok middle
            AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop
              iter1 openings.z selectors d source) := hcontinue0
          _ = .ok (out, source) := by simpa only [bind_tc_ok] using hrec
        rfl
      refine ⟨out, ?_, houtCan, houtModel⟩
      change AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop
        iter openings.z selectors digests source = .ok (out, source)
      rw [AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Source.public_digest_lanes_loop.eq_def]
      simp only [hnext, bind_tc_ok, Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
      simpa only [AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchRun.run,

  let block ← 34#usize + level

      digests q a AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.poseidon2.RATE a1 true
  else
    let i2 ← block * 16#usize
    let i3 ← i2 + 12#usize
    let q ← pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors i3
    let a1 ← Array.index_usize source.frontier level
    AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding
      digests q a 0#usize a1 false

    (hfrontierCanonical : ∀ k : Fin 20, TargetActual.CanonicalM31

        (AspisR1.SelectorValueLanePreprocessRangeValues.exactOpenings openings)

    have hbranch : (true = true) ↔ R0P.digestBitZero

      simpa using hbitZero
    have hactual :

    have hrate : AspisR1AbsorptionCandidate.poseidon2.RATE.val = 8 := by

        (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)

/-- The literal generated `next_pair_index >>> level` and `&&& 1` values
select precisely the retained exact-public frontier branch. -/
theorem live_snapshot_branch
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < 20) :
    ∃ shifted bit : U64,
      (public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index >>> level) = .ok shifted ∧
      lift (shifted &&& (1#u64)) = .ok bit ∧
      (bit = 0#u64 ↔ R0P.digestBitZero
        (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
        ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩) := by
  have hlevel64 : level.val < UScalarTy.U64.numBits := by
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le hlevel (by decide)
  obtain ⟨shifted, hshift, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
      level hlevel64)
  obtain ⟨bit, hbit, _⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.and_spec shifted (1#u64))
  refine ⟨shifted, bit, hshift, hbit, ?_⟩
  change bit = 0#u64 ↔
    ((public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 0
  exact AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchBits.shifted_low_bit_zero_iff
    public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index level hlevel64
    shifted hshift bit hbit

import Aeneas.Std
import Mathlib.Tactic

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchBits
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
abbrev U64 := UScalar UScalarTy.U64
abbrev Usize := UScalar UScalarTy.Usize

/-- The actual `>>>` then `&&& 1` operations in the frontier loop select the
same zero branch as the retained natural-number model. -/
theorem shifted_low_bit_zero_iff
    (index : U64) (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < UScalarTy.U64.numBits)
    (shifted : U64) (hshift : (index >>> level) = .ok shifted)
    (bit : U64) (hbit : lift (shifted &&& (1#u64)) = .ok bit) :
    bit = 0#u64 ↔ ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) = 0 := by
  obtain ⟨shifted', hshift', hshiftSpec⟩ :=
    WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec index level hlevel)
  have heq : shifted' = shifted := Result.ok.inj (hshift'.symm.trans hshift)
  subst shifted'
  obtain ⟨bit', hbit', hbitSpec⟩ :=
    WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.and_spec shifted (1#u64))
  have hbeq : bit' = bit := Result.ok.inj (hbit'.symm.trans hbit)
  subst bit'
  have hOne : (1#u64).val = 1 := by
    norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  have hbitValue : bit.val = ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) := by
    calc
      bit.val = bit.bv.toNat := rfl
      _ = ((index.bv >>> level.val) &&& (1#u64).bv).toNat := by
        rw [hbitSpec.2, hshiftSpec.2]
      _ = ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) := by
        rw [BitVec.toNat_and, BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight]
        simp only [UScalar.bv_toNat, hOne]
  have hzeroVal : (0#u64).val = 0 := by simp [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg UScalar.val h
    rw [hzeroVal, hbitValue] at hv
    exact hv
  · intro h
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rw [hbitValue, hzeroVal]
    exact h

#print axioms shifted_low_bit_zero_iff
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchBits

private def decodedDigest (a : Array QM 8#usize) : R0P.Digest ExactQM :=
  fun j => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt a j.val)

private def decodedOpenings (a : Array QM 16#usize) : Fin 16 → ExactQM :=
  fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (openedAt a i.val)

/-- One actual candidate `add_digest_binding` invocation at the computed
frontier row is successful/canonical and implements the exact retained
frontier-step model. The caller proves the source row arithmetic, start, and
selected target from the actual branch operands. -/
theorem binding_call
    (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (o : R0P.Openings ExactQM)
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (level : Fin 20) (row : Usize) (bitZero : Prop) [Decidable bitZero]
    (initial : Array QM 8#usize) (opened : Array QM 16#usize)
    (start : Usize) (expected : Array M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool)
    (hrowBound : row.val < 1024)
    (hrow : row.val = (34 + level.val) * 16 + if bitZero then 0 else 12)
    (hbitZero : bitZero ↔ R0P.digestBitZero pub level)
    (hright : rightTweak = true ↔ bitZero)
    (hstartVal : start.val = if rightTweak then 8 else 0)
    (hpoint : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened) (hexpected : ∀ j : Fin 8,
      (expected.val[j.val]'(by simpa [expected.property] using j.isLt)).val <
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P)
    (hopenedModel : decodedOpenings opened = o.z)
    (htargetModel : ∀ j : Fin 8,
      (targetValue expected rightTweak j.val : ExactQM) =
        R0P.digestTarget pub (.frontier level) j) :
    ∃ (q : QM) (out : Array QM 8#usize),
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors row = .ok q ∧
      Canonical q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q =
        (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
          (R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level)) ∧
      AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding
        initial q opened start expected rightTweak = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      decodedDigest out = AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierStep
        pub o (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
        (decodedDigest initial) level := by
  have hrowModel := AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Row.frontier_source_row
    pub point selectors level row bitZero hrowBound hrow hbitZero hpoint hbox
  have hstartLt : start.val < 9 := by
    by_cases hr : rightTweak
    · have hs : start.val = 8 := by simpa [hr] using hstartVal
      rw [hs]
      omega
    · have hs : start.val = 0 := by simpa [hr] using hstartVal
      rw [hs]
      omega
  have hstartModel : (⟨start.val, hstartLt⟩ : Fin 9) = R0P.digestStart pub (.frontier level) := by
    apply Fin.ext
    by_cases hr : rightTweak
    · have hb : bitZero := (hright.mp hr)
      have hm : R0P.digestBitZero pub level := hbitZero.mp hb
      have hs : start.val = 8 := by simpa [hr] using hstartVal
      simp only [R0P.digestStart]
      rw [if_pos hm]
      exact hs
    · have hb : ¬ bitZero := by
        intro hz
        exact hr (hright.mpr hz)
      have hm : ¬ R0P.digestBitZero pub level := (not_congr hbitZero).mp hb
      have hs : start.val = 0 := by simpa [hr] using hstartVal
      simp only [R0P.digestStart]
      rw [if_neg hm]
      exact hs
  obtain ⟨q, hrowRun, hqcan, hrowValue⟩ := hrowModel
  have hrowValue' : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q =
      (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
        (R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level)) := hrowValue
  have hstartBound : start.val + 8 ≤ 16 := by
    by_cases hr : rightTweak
    · have hs : start.val = 8 := by simpa [hr] using hstartVal
      rw [hs]
    · have hs : start.val = 0 := by simpa [hr] using hstartVal
      rw [hs]
      omega
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtcan, hmodel⟩ :=
    AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.binding_is_frontier_step
      pub o (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
      level initial q opened start expected rightTweak
      hstartBound hinitial hqcan hopened hexpected hrowValue' hopenedModel hstartModel htargetModel
  have hmodel' : decodedDigest out = AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierStep
      pub o (fun i => AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector point i)
        (decodedDigest initial) level := by
    exact hmodel
  exact ⟨q, out, hrowRun, hqcan, hrowValue', hrun, houtcan, hmodel'⟩

#print axioms binding_call
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.BranchCall

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Row

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Usize := UScalar UScalarTy.Usize

abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev pointSelector := AspisR1.SelectorValueLaneModelComposition.pointSelector

/-- A checked source row whose address is `16*(34+level)` or that address
plus twelve is exactly the retained model row for the corresponding branch. -/
theorem row_address (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (level : Fin 20)
    (row : Usize) (bitZero : Prop) [Decidable bitZero]
    (hrowBound : row.val < 1024)
    (hrow : row.val = (34 + level.val) * 16 + if bitZero then 0 else 12)
    (hbit : bitZero ↔ R0P.digestBitZero pub level) :
    (⟨row.val, hrowBound⟩ : Fin 1024) =
      R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [R0P.digestRow, R0P.g2Row]
  have hoff : (if bitZero then 0 else 12) =
      (if R0P.digestBitZero pub level then 0 else 12) := by
    by_cases hb : bitZero
    · simp [hb, hbit.mp hb]
    · have hnot : ¬ R0P.digestBitZero pub level := (not_congr hbit).mp hb
      simp [hb, hnot]
  rw [hrow, hoff]
  split_ifs <;> norm_num <;> omega

/-- Actual checked selector-row call at the source-derived row, with its
decoded value identified against the same boxed ten-factor point selector. -/
theorem source_row
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors) (row : Usize)
    (hrow : row.val < 1024)
    (hpoint : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ q, pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors row = .ok q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q = pointSelector point ⟨row.val, hrow⟩ :=
  AspisR1.SameBoxedRowExact.row_success point selectors row hrow hpoint hbox

/-- The actual row operation at either frontier branch's computed address is
the exact selector input consumed by `frontierStep`. -/
theorem frontier_source_row
    (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (selectors : Selectors) (level : Fin 20) (row : Usize)
    (bitZero : Prop) [Decidable bitZero]
    (hrowBound : row.val < 1024)
    (hrow : row.val = (34 + level.val) * 16 + if bitZero then 0 else 12)
    (hbit : bitZero ↔ R0P.digestBitZero pub level)
    (hpoint : AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    ∃ q, pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.row selectors row = .ok q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM q ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode q =
        pointSelector point (R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level)) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hrun, hcan, hdecode⟩ := source_row point selectors row hrowBound hpoint hbox
  refine ⟨q, hrun, hcan, ?_⟩
  have haddress := row_address pub level row bitZero hrowBound hrow hbit
  exact hdecode.trans (congrArg (pointSelector point) haddress)

#print axioms row_address
#print axioms source_row
#print axioms frontier_source_row
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Row

/-! A single successful digest binding equals one retained frontier fold
step, once its exact row, opened view, target, and start are identified. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev M31 := field.M31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact.ExactQM
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact.Canonical
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.SelectorExpansionCorrectness.canonicalArray a
abbrev WideDigest := R0P.Digest ExactQM

private def arrayDigest (a : Array QM 8#usize) : WideDigest :=
  fun j => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt a j.val)

private def openedModel (a : Array QM 16#usize) : Fin 16 → ExactQM :=
  fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (openedAt a i.val)

/-- Actual eight-lane source binding update, expressed as the model's
`digestAddBinding` at a given key. -/
theorem binding_is_frontier_step
    (pub : R0P.Public ExactQM) (o : R0P.Openings ExactQM)
    (sel : R0P.Sel ExactQM) (level : Fin 20)
    (initial : Array QM 8#usize) (selector : QM)
    (opened : Array QM 16#usize) (start : Usize)
    (expected : Array M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool)
    (hstart : start.val + 8 ≤ 16)
    (hinitial : CanonicalArray initial) (hselector : Canonical selector)
    (hopened : CanonicalArray opened)
    (hexpected : ∀ j : Fin 8,
      (expected.val[j.val]'(by simpa [expected.property] using j.isLt)).val <
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P)
    (hrow : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector =
      sel (R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level)))
    (hopenedModel : openedModel opened = o.z)
    (hstartModel : (⟨start.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 9) =
      R0P.digestStart pub (.frontier level))
    (htargetModel : ∀ j : Fin 8,
      (targetValue expected rightTweak j.val : ExactQM) =
        R0P.digestTarget pub (.frontier level) j) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 8#usize,
      AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.add_digest_binding
        initial selector opened start expected rightTweak = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      arrayDigest out = AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.Model.frontierStep
        pub o sel (arrayDigest initial) level := by
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hcanon, hvalues⟩ :=
    AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.R0PBridge.add_digest_binding_is_r0p
      initial selector opened start expected rightTweak hstart hinitial hselector
      hopened hexpected
  refine ⟨out, hrun, hcanon, ?_⟩
  funext lane
  have hvalues' := hvalues lane
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out lane.val) =
    R0P.digestAddBinding (arrayDigest initial)
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode selector) (openedModel opened)
      (⟨start.val, by omega⟩ : Fin 9)
      (fun j : Fin 8 => (targetValue expected rightTweak j.val : ExactQM)) lane at hvalues'
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cellAt out lane.val) =
    R0P.digestAddBinding (arrayDigest initial)
      (sel (R0P.digestRow pub (.frontier level))) o.z
      (R0P.digestStart pub (.frontier level))
      (fun j : Fin 8 => R0P.digestTarget pub (.frontier level) j) lane
  rw [hvalues', hrow, hstartModel, hopenedModel]
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact htargetModel j

#print axioms binding_is_frontier_step
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.TargetActual
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact
abbrev M31 := field.M31
abbrev Usize := UScalar UScalarTy.Usize
abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalM31 (a : Array M31 8#usize) :=
  ∀ lane : Fin 8, (a.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using lane.isLt)).val <
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P

/-- Derive the branch target and canonical M31 input from the exact source
operand: empty_root on the true branch, or the live snapshot frontier read on
the false branch. -/
theorem source_target
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (source : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < 20)
    (hsource : source = public1.transition.live_snapshot)
    (expected : Array M31 8#usize) (rightTweak : Bool)
    (hbranch : rightTweak = true ↔ R0P.digestBitZero
      (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1) ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩)
    (hfrontierCanonical : ∀ k : Fin 20, CanonicalM31
      (source.frontier.val[k.val]'(by
        simpa [source.frontier.property] using k.isLt)))
    (hactual : (if rightTweak then
        AspisR1EmptyRootCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.empty_root level
      else Array.index_usize source.frontier level) = .ok expected) :
    CanonicalM31 expected ∧
      ∀ lane : Fin 8,
        (targetValue expected rightTweak lane.val : ExactQM) =
          R0P.digestTarget (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
            (.frontier ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩) lane := by
  by_cases hr : rightTweak
  · have hroot := AspisR1.EmptyRootBindingModel.source_right_target level hlevel
    rcases hroot with ⟨root, hrootRun, hrootCan, hrootTarget⟩
    have hactual' :
        AspisR1EmptyRootCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.empty_root level =
          .ok expected := by
      simpa [hr] using hactual
    have heq : expected = root := Result.ok.inj (hactual'.symm.trans hrootRun)
    subst expected
    constructor
    · exact hrootCan
    · intro lane
      have hbit := hbranch.mp hr
      rw [R0P.digestTarget, if_pos hbit]
      simpa [hr] using hrootTarget lane
  · have hfalse : rightTweak = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hr
    have hread : Array.index_usize source.frontier level = .ok expected := by
      simpa [hfalse] using hactual
    have hnotbit : ¬ R0P.digestBitZero
        (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1) ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ := by
      intro hb
      exact hr (hbranch.mpr hb)
    have hsize : (20#usize).val = 20 := by scalar_tac
    have hbound : level.val < (20#usize).val := by simpa [hsize] using hlevel
    have hlen : level.val < source.frontier.length := by
      simpa [source.frontier.property] using hbound
    obtain ⟨q, hreadQ, hqvalue⟩ :=
      WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec source.frontier level hlen)
    have heq : expected = q := Result.ok.inj (hread.symm.trans hreadQ)
    subst expected
    have hqEq : q = source.frontier.val[level.val]'(by
        simpa [source.frontier.property] using hbound) := by
      simpa using hqvalue
    have hcanonical : CanonicalM31 q := by
      intro lane
      rw [hqEq]
      exact hfrontierCanonical ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ lane
    constructor
    · exact hcanonical
    · intro lane
      simpa [hfalse] using
        (AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.FrontierTarget.source_frontier_target
          public1 source level hlevel hsource q hreadQ hnotbit lane)

#print axioms source_target
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.TargetActual

private theorem index_success {N : Usize} {α : Type} (a : Array α N)
    (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < N.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hb : i.val < a.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  obtain ⟨q, hread, hvalue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec a i hb)
  rw [hread]

snapshot frontier word, without unfolding or evaluating any frontier cells. -/
theorem source_frontier_target
    (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.SemanticPublic)
    (source : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < 20)
    (hsource : source = public1.transition.live_snapshot)
    (expected : Array M31 8#usize)
    (hread : Array.index_usize source.frontier level = .ok expected)
    (hnotbit : ¬ R0P.digestBitZero
      (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1) ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩)
    (lane : Fin 8) :
    (AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact.targetValue expected false lane.val : ExactQM) =
      R0P.digestTarget (AspisR1.SemanticPublicModel.exactPublic public1)
        (.frontier ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩) lane := by
  have hsize : (20#usize).val = 20 := by scalar_tac
  have hb : level.val < (20#usize).val := by simpa [hsize] using hlevel
  have hget := index_success source.frontier level hb
  have hval : expected = source.frontier.val[level.val]'(by simpa [source.frontier.property] using hb) := by
    exact Result.ok.inj (hread.symm.trans hget)
  subst expected
  simp only [AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact.targetValue,
    dif_pos lane.isLt, Bool.false_eq_true, false_and, if_false,
    R0P.digestTarget, hnotbit]
  rw [hsource]
  rfl

import EmptyRootTableFacts
import AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.R0PBridge

/-! Actual empty-root source target, canonical word bounds and agreement with
the frozen right-tweaked R0P target. All arithmetic here is symbolic Nat data. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.EmptyRootBindingModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.EmptyRootExecution
open AspisR1.EmptyRootTableFacts
open AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.LoopExact
abbrev P := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P

theorem add_mod_once (n t p : Nat) (hn : n < p) (ht : t < p) :
    (n+t)%p = if n+t ≥ p then n+t-p else n+t := by
  by_cases h : n+t ≥ p
  · rw [if_pos h, Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod h, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
  · rw [if_neg h, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

theorem source_root_canonical (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < 21) :
    ∃ root : Array field.M31 8#usize,
      source level = .ok root ∧
      (∀ lane : Fin 8, (root.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [root.property] using lane.isLt)).val < P) ∧
      ∀ lane : Fin 8, (root.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [root.property] using lane.isLt)).val =
        R0P.emptyRootsNat ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ lane := by
  refine ⟨row level hlevel, source_success level hlevel, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro lane
    exact table_canonical ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ lane
  · intro lane
    exact table_values ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ lane

theorem right_target_matches {K : Type} [Field K]
    (expected : Array field.M31 8#usize) (level : Fin 20)
    (hvalues : ∀ lane : Fin 8,
      (expected.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [expected.property] using lane.isLt)).val =
        R0P.emptyRootsNat level.castSucc lane) (lane : Fin 8) :
    (targetValue expected true lane.val : K) = R0P.emptyRootRightTarget level lane := by
  have htweak : AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK.val =
      0x4153_1005 := by
    norm_num [AspisR1TerminalDigestBindingCandidate.poseidon2.MERKLE_NODE_COMPRESSION_V3_TWEAK]
  have htweakBound : 0x4153_1005 < P := by
    norm_num [P, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P]
  have hP : P = 0x7fff_ffff := by
    norm_num [P, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.P, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P]
  have hmod := add_mod_once (R0P.emptyRootsNat level.castSucc lane) 0x4153_1005 P
    (old_table_bound level.castSucc lane) htweakBound
  simp only [targetValue, dif_pos lane.isLt, eq_self_iff_true, true_and, hvalues lane, htweak]
  unfold R0P.emptyRootRightTarget
  by_cases h7 : lane.val = 7
  · have hlast : lane.val + 1 = 8 := by omega
    simp only [if_pos h7, if_pos hlast]
    rw [hmod, hP]
  · have hlast : lane.val + 1 ≠ 8 := by omega
    simp only [if_neg h7, if_neg hlast]

theorem source_right_target (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < 20) :
    ∃ root : Array field.M31 8#usize,
      source level = .ok root ∧
      (∀ lane : Fin 8, (root.val[lane.val]'(by simpa [root.property] using lane.isLt)).val < P) ∧
      ∀ lane : Fin 8, (targetValue root true lane.val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact) =
        R0P.emptyRootRightTarget ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ lane := by
  obtain ⟨root, hsource, hc, hv⟩ := source_root_canonical level (by omega)
  refine ⟨root, hsource, hc, ?_⟩
  intro lane
  exact right_target_matches root ⟨level.val, hlevel⟩ hv lane

#print axioms add_mod_once
#print axioms source_root_canonical
#print axioms right_target_matches
#print axioms source_right_target
end AspisR1.EmptyRootBindingModel

  (table.val[level.val]'(by simpa [table.property] using level.isLt)).val[lane.val]'(by

      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskM31AddSub.P]

import TerminalDigestPublicLoopSource
import Aeneas.Std

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.RowAddressOps
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev Usize := UScalar UScalarTy.Usize

private theorem small_max (n : Nat) (hn : n < 2048) : n ≤ Usize.max := by
  have hpow : n < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  have hsucc : n < Usize.max + 1 := by
    simpa only [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, Usize.max_succ_eq_pow] using hpow
  omega

private theorem add_exact (a b : Usize) (hbound : a.val + b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    ∃ out : Usize, (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok out ∧ out.val = a.val + b.val := by
  have hchecked : (a + b : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = a.val + b.val⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hbound
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  exact ⟨out, hrun, hval⟩

private theorem mul_exact (a b : Usize) (hbound : a.val * b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    ∃ out : Usize, (a * b : Result Usize) = .ok out ∧ out.val = a.val * b.val := by
  have hchecked : (a * b : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = a.val * b.val⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.mul_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hbound
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  exact ⟨out, hrun, hval⟩

/-- The outer digest loop's literal checked row-address operations always
succeed for a bounded frontier level, with exact natural row formulas. -/
theorem source_row_addresses (level : Usize) (hlevel : level.val < 20) :
    ∃ block base plus : Usize,
      (34#usize + level : Result Usize) = .ok block ∧
      block.val = 34 + level.val ∧
      (block * 16#usize : Result Usize) = .ok base ∧
      base.val = (34 + level.val) * 16 ∧
      (base + 12#usize : Result Usize) = .ok plus ∧
      plus.val = (34 + level.val) * 16 + 12 := by
  have h34 : (34#usize).val = 34 := by scalar_tac
  have h16 : (16#usize).val = 16 := by scalar_tac
  have h12 : (12#usize).val = 12 := by scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨block, hblock, hvblock⟩ := add_exact (34#usize) level (by
    have hb := small_max (34 + level.val) (by omega)
    simpa [h34] using hb)
  obtain ⟨base, hbase, hvbase⟩ := mul_exact block (16#usize) (by
    have hb := small_max ((34 + level.val) * 16) (by omega)
    simpa [hvblock, h16] using hb)
  obtain ⟨plus, hplus, hvplus⟩ := add_exact base (12#usize) (by
    have hb := small_max ((34 + level.val) * 16 + 12) (by omega)
    simpa [hvbase, hvblock, h16, h12] using hb)
  refine ⟨block, base, plus, hblock, ?_, hbase, ?_, hplus, ?_⟩
  · calc
      block.val = (34#usize).val + level.val := hvblock
      _ = 34 + level.val := by rw [h34]
  · calc
      base.val = block.val * (16#usize).val := hvbase
      _ = (34 + level.val) * 16 := by rw [hvblock, h16, h34]
  · calc
      plus.val = base.val + (12#usize).val := hvplus
      _ = (34 + level.val) * 16 + 12 := by rw [hvbase, hvblock, h16, h12, h34]

#print axioms source_row_addresses
end AspisR1TerminalDigestPublicLoop.RowAddressOps

private def digestEntry (d : Array M31 8#usize) (i : Fin 8) : M31 :=

private def frontierEntry (f : Array (Array M31 8#usize) 20#usize)

/-- Direct input contract consumed by the retained fixed-prefix and wrapper
suffix proofs: every digest row is canonical in the exact candidate carrier. -/
def DigestInputsCanonical (p : Public) : Prop :=
  AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical p.anchor ∧
  AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical p.nullifier ∧

        deployment_domain := t.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
        sequence := t.live_snapshot.sequence
        next_pair_index := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
        current_root := t.live_snapshot.current_root
        frontier := t.live_snapshot.frontier }
    candidate_afterstate :=
      { next_pair_index := t.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
        next_root := t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
        next_frontier := t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier } }

theorem from_to_transition (t : Transition) :
    fromTransition (toTransition t) = t := by
  cases t with
  | mk live after => cases live; cases after; rfl

theorem to_from_transition (t : Whole431.Transition) :
    toTransition (fromTransition t) = t := by
  cases t with
  | mk live after => cases live; cases after; rfl

/-- The eight transfer fields are copied without choosing a byte-derived value. -/
def toTransfer (p : Transfer) : Whole431.Transfer :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id
    recipient_commitment := p.recipient_commitment
    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

/-- This fixed projection matches the variant/borrow expression in `first`.
That source observation is not a theorem about execution of `first`. -/
def toSerializer : Statement → Whole431.Public
  | .PrivateTransfer c p => .Transfer (toTransfer p) (toTransition c.lane_transition)
  | .Withdrawal c p => .Withdrawal (PublicBridge.toSerializer p)
      (toTransition c.lane_transition)

theorem transfer_projection (c : Common) (p : Transfer) :
    toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p) =
      .Transfer (toTransfer p) (toTransition c.lane_transition) := rfl

theorem withdrawal_projection (c : Common) (p : CallerBridge.Public) :
    toSerializer (.Withdrawal c p) =
      .Withdrawal (PublicBridge.toSerializer p) (toTransition c.lane_transition) := rfl

def projectRaw (s : Statement) : PublicSourceRaw.Public :=
  ExtractedPublicCheckedBridge432.projectRaw (toSerializer s)

/-- Computed from the fixed source-carrier projection, not from serialized bytes. -/
def computedPublic (s : Statement) : Option (R0P.Public SemanticPublicWire.M31) :=
  (PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw s)).map SemanticPublicWire.toPublic

/-- Transfer has no withdrawal amount guard; reuse the existing serializer
refinement and codec agreement without a new transfer-validator model. -/
theorem transfer_serializer_parsePublic (c : Common) (p : Transfer)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p)) = ok (.Ok semantic)) :
    ∃ wire, PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw (.PrivateTransfer c p)) = some wire ∧
      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  have hraw := RawBridge431.extracted_refines_core
    (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p)) (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte)
    ⟨semantic, hs, rfl⟩
  have hguard : PublicRawAmountGuard.PaymentAmountGuard
      (RawBridge431.project (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p))) := by
    trivial
  obtain ⟨wire, hw, hd⟩ := PublicRawAmountGuardAgreement.decoded_of_guarded_core_success
    (RawBridge431.project (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p)))
    (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) hraw hguard
  exact ⟨wire, hw, PublicCodecAgreement.parsePublic_of_decode _ _ hd⟩

/-- Both ASF8 variants. The same decoded statement fixes every serializer
argument, including the full lane transition. `hd` and `hs` remain actual
computation premises; neither is replaced by an assumed validation predicate. -/
theorem decoder_serializer_parsePublic (asf8 : Slice U8) (s : Statement)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hd : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      asf8 = ok (.Ok s))
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok semantic)) :
    ∃ wire, PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw s) = some wire ∧
      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  cases s with
  | PrivateTransfer c p => exact transfer_serializer_parsePublic c p semantic hs
  | Withdrawal c p =>
    exact PublicBridge.decoder_serializer_parsePublic asf8 c p
      (toTransition c.lane_transition) semantic hd hs

/-- Equality with the computed fixed projection requires no `hbind` premise.
This computed value has not yet been identified with an actual caller input. -/
theorem decoder_serializer_eq_computed (asf8 : Slice U8) (s : Statement)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hd : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      asf8 = ok (.Ok s))
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok semantic)) :
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
      computedPublic s := by
  obtain ⟨wire, hw, hp⟩ := decoder_serializer_parsePublic asf8 s semantic hd hs
  simpa only [computedPublic, hw, Option.map_some] using hp

#print axioms from_to_transition
#print axioms to_from_transition
#print axioms transfer_projection
#print axioms withdrawal_projection
#print axioms transfer_serializer_parsePublic
#print axioms decoder_serializer_parsePublic
#print axioms decoder_serializer_eq_computed

import R1PublicByteCodec
import R1PublicIndexListCodec
import R1SemanticPublicWire
import R1PublicByteCodecLaws
import R1SemanticPublicByteBinding
import R1SemanticPublicWireSurjective

/-! Agreement between the compositional public codec and the existing
variant-indexed public wire model. These are Lean representation equalities;
source-parser refinement remains separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PublicCodecAgreement

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

private theorem append_ofFn4 (lo hi : Fin 4 → Byte) :
    List.ofFn lo ++ List.ofFn hi =
      List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 8 =>
        if h : i.val < 4 then lo ⟨i.val, h⟩ else hi ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp
  · intro i hleft hright
    have hi8 : i < 8 := by simpa using hright
    by_cases h : i < 4 <;> simp [h]

theorem u64_emit_eq_index_encode (x : AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.Index) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.u64Codec.emit x =
      AspisR1.PublicIndexListCodec.encode x := by
  let halves := AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.u64Equiv.symm x
  have hsplit := append_ofFn4
    (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.1)
    (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.2)
  have hlow : halves.1.val = x.val % RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount := rfl
  have hhigh : halves.2.val = x.val / RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount := rfl
  change (List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.1) ++
      List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.2)) =
    List.ofFn (AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode x)
  rw [hsplit]
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  by_cases h : i.val < 4
  · simp only [AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode, dif_pos h]
    change RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.1 ⟨i.val, h⟩ =
      RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE
        ⟨x.val % RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount, by
          exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount])⟩
        ⟨i.val, h⟩
    rfl
  · simp only [AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode, dif_neg h]
    change RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE halves.2 ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩ =
      RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE
        ⟨x.val / RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount, by
          have hx := x.isLt
          norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount] at hx ⊢
          omega⟩
        ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩
    rfl

theorem encode_toPublic_eq_wire_encode (w : AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.Wire) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encode (AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic w) =
      some (AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.encode w) := by
  cases w with
  | transfer common recipient =>
      simp [AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encode,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicFieldsEquiv,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.toFields,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.fieldsCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.transport,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.pair,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.fixed,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.option,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.variantCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.digestCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.m31Codec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.frontierCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFields,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic_index_bound,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.encode,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.header,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes,
        u64_emit_eq_index_encode]
      rfl
  | withdrawal common amount =>
      simp [AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encode,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.publicFieldsEquiv,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.toFields,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.fieldsCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.transport,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.pair,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.fixed,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.PrefixCodec.option,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.variantCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.digestCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.m31Codec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.frontierCodec,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.PublicByteCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFields,
        AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic_index_bound,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.toPublic,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.encode,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.header,
        AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes,
        u64_emit_eq_index_encode]
      rfl

/-- Encoding checks only the u64 index bound. In particular, malformed option
shapes and zero withdrawals can be emitted, although checked parsing rejects
them. The wire carrier's total encoder has a smaller input type. -/
theorem encode_none_iff (pub : PublicByteCodec.BasePublic) :
    PublicByteCodec.encode pub = none ↔ ¬ pub.nextPairIndex < 2 ^ 64 := by
  unfold PublicByteCodec.encode
  split
  next hi =>
    constructor
    · intro h
      cases h
    · intro hn
      exact False.elim (hn hi)
  next hi =>
    exact ⟨fun _ => hi, fun _ => rfl⟩

theorem encode_exists_iff (pub : PublicByteCodec.BasePublic) :
    (∃ bytes, PublicByteCodec.encode pub = some bytes) ↔ pub.nextPairIndex < 2 ^ 64 := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨bytes, h⟩
    exact PublicByteCodec.encode_success_bound pub bytes h
  · intro hi
    exact ⟨PublicByteCodec.publicCodec.emit ⟨pub, hi⟩, by
      simp only [PublicByteCodec.encode, dif_pos hi]⟩

/-- Every public value and byte list is covered. The live checked wire parser
accepts exactly a compositional encoding whose option shape is canonical. -/
theorem parsePublic_eq_some_iff (bytes : PublicByteCodec.Bytes)
    (pub : PublicByteCodec.BasePublic) :
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic bytes = some pub ↔
      PublicByteCodec.encode pub = some bytes ∧ PublicOptionShape.canonical pub := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨wire, hw, hb⟩ := SemanticPublicByteBinding.parsed_exact_bytes bytes pub h
    refine ⟨?_, SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic_canonical bytes pub h⟩
    rw [← hw, encode_toPublic_eq_wire_encode, hb]
  · rintro ⟨he, hc⟩
    obtain ⟨wire, hw⟩ := SemanticPublicWireSurjective.exists_wire pub hc
      (PublicByteCodec.encode_success_bound pub bytes he)
    have hs : PublicByteCodec.encode (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) = some bytes := by
      simpa only [hw] using he
    have hb : SemanticPublicWire.encode wire = bytes :=
      Option.some.inj ((encode_toPublic_eq_wire_encode wire).symm.trans hs)
    have hwc : PublicOptionShape.canonical (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
      simpa only [hw] using hc
    rw [← hb, SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.parsePublic_encode wire hwc, hw]

theorem encode_eq_some_iff_parsePublic (pub : PublicByteCodec.BasePublic)
    (bytes : PublicByteCodec.Bytes) (hc : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub) :
    PublicByteCodec.encode pub = some bytes ↔
      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic bytes = some pub := by
  exact ⟨fun he => (parsePublic_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mpr ⟨he, hc⟩,
    fun hp => ((parsePublic_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mp hp).1⟩

/-- All-byte agreement includes every malformed, truncated and trailing input.
It compares checked parsers, so the common zero-withdrawal rejection is retained. -/
theorem decode_eq_parsePublic (bytes : PublicByteCodec.Bytes) :
    PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic bytes := by
  apply Option.ext
  intro pub
  rw [PublicByteCodec.decode_eq_some_iff, parsePublic_eq_some_iff,
    PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff]

/-- Directly supplies the live hpub premise without changing its consumer. -/
theorem parsePublic_of_decode (bytes : PublicByteCodec.Bytes)
    (pub : PublicByteCodec.BasePublic)
    (h : PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = some pub) :
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic bytes = some pub := by
  rw [← decode_eq_parsePublic]
  exact h

/-- Raw wire decoding permits zero: it is the checked parsers that reject it. -/
theorem zero_withdrawal_raw_decode (c : SemanticPublicWire.Common) :
    SemanticPublicWire.decode (SemanticPublicWire.encode (.withdrawal c 0)) =
      some (.withdrawal c 0) :=
  SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.decode_encode (.withdrawal c 0)

theorem zero_withdrawal_checked_reject (c : SemanticPublicWire.Common) :
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (SemanticPublicWire.encode (.withdrawal c 0)) = none ∧
      PublicByteCodec.decode (SemanticPublicWire.encode (.withdrawal c 0)) = none := by
  have hp : SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic
      (SemanticPublicWire.encode (.withdrawal c 0)) = none := by
    simp [SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic, SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.decode_encode,
      SemanticPublicWire.toPublic, PublicOptionShape.check]
  exact ⟨hp, by rw [decode_eq_parsePublic, hp]⟩

#print axioms u64_emit_eq_index_encode
#print axioms encode_toPublic_eq_wire_encode
#print axioms encode_none_iff
#print axioms encode_exists_iff
#print axioms parsePublic_eq_some_iff
#print axioms encode_eq_some_iff_parsePublic
#print axioms decode_eq_parsePublic
#print axioms parsePublic_of_decode
#print axioms zero_withdrawal_raw_decode
#print axioms zero_withdrawal_checked_reject

end AspisR1.PublicCodecAgreement
