import R1ExactLeafFieldCodec
import R1FixedWidthDecoder
import PublicOptionShape

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PublicByteCodec

open R0P AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

abbrev Byte := RetainedFieldByteCodec.Byte
abbrev Bytes := List Byte
abbrev BasePublic := Public M31Exact
abbrev U64 := Fin (2^64)
abbrev Frontier := Fin 20 → Digest M31Exact
abbrev WirePublic := { pub : BasePublic // pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64 }

structure PrefixCodec (A : Type) where
  emit : A → Bytes
  parse : Bytes → Option (A × Bytes)

namespace PrefixCodec
variable {A B : Type}

structure Lawful (c : PrefixCodec A) : Prop where
  round : ∀ a rest, c.parse (c.emit a ++ rest) = some (a, rest)
  back : ∀ bytes a rest, c.parse bytes = some (a, rest) → c.emit a ++ rest = bytes

def fixed (n : Nat) (emit : A → Bytes) (decode : Bytes → Option A) : PrefixCodec A where
  emit := emit
  parse bytes := (decode (bytes.take n)).map fun a => (a, bytes.drop n)

def pair (c : PrefixCodec A) (d : PrefixCodec B) : PrefixCodec (A × B) where
  emit ab := c.emit ab.1 ++ d.emit ab.2
  parse bytes := do
    let (a, mid) ← c.parse bytes
    let (b, rest) ← d.parse mid
    pure ((a, b), rest)

def transport (e : A ≃ B) (c : PrefixCodec A) : PrefixCodec B where
  emit b := c.emit (e.symm b)
  parse bytes := (c.parse bytes).map fun ar => (e ar.1, ar.2)

def option (c : PrefixCodec A) : PrefixCodec (Option A) where
  emit
    | none => [0]
    | some a => 1 :: c.emit a
  parse
    | [] => none
    | tag :: tail =>
        if tag = 0 then some (none, tail)
        else if tag = 1 then (c.parse tail).map fun ar => (some ar.1, ar.2)
        else none

end PrefixCodec

def variantCodec : PrefixCodec Variant where
  emit
    | .privateTransfer => [0]
    | .withdrawal => [1]
  parse
    | [] => none
    | tag :: tail =>
        if tag = 0 then some (.privateTransfer, tail)
        else if tag = 1 then some (.withdrawal, tail)
        else none

def encodeU32 (x : RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord) : Bytes :=
  List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE x)

def decodeU32 (bytes : Bytes) : Option RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord :=
  (RetainedFieldByteCodec.fixedBytes? 4 bytes).map RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeWordLE

def u32Codec : PrefixCodec RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed 4 encodeU32 decodeU32

-- First component is low u32; second component is high u32.
def u64Equiv :
    (RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord × RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord) ≃ U64 where
  toFun p := ⟨p.1.val + RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount * p.2.val, by
    have h0 := p.1.isLt
    have h1 := p.2.isLt
    norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount] at *
    omega⟩
  invFun n :=
    (⟨n.val % RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount,
      Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount])⟩,
     ⟨n.val / RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount, by
       have hn := n.isLt
       norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount] at *
       omega⟩)
  left_inv := by
    rintro ⟨lo, hi⟩
    have hlo := lo.isLt
    have hhi := hi.isLt
    apply Prod.ext
    · apply Fin.ext
      change (lo.val + RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount * hi.val) %
        RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount = lo.val
      norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount] at *
      omega
    · apply Fin.ext
      change (lo.val + RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount * hi.val) /
        RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount = hi.val
      norm_num [RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount] at *
      omega
  right_inv := by
    intro n
    apply Fin.ext
    change n.val % RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount +
      RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount * (n.val / RetainedFieldByteCodec.rawWordCount) = n.val
    exact Nat.mod_add_div _ _

def u64Codec : PrefixCodec U64 :=
  PrefixCodec.transport u64Equiv (PrefixCodec.pair u32Codec u32Codec)

def m31Codec : PrefixCodec M31Exact :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed 4 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31

def encodeDigest (d : Digest M31Exact) : Bytes :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.encode ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 d

def decodeDigest (bytes : Bytes) : Option (Digest M31Exact) :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.decode ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 4 8 bytes

def digestCodec : PrefixCodec (Digest M31Exact) :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed 32 encodeDigest decodeDigest

def encodeFrontier (f : Frontier) : Bytes := FixedWidthDecoder.encode encodeDigest f

def decodeFrontier (bytes : Bytes) : Option Frontier :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.decode decodeDigest 32 20 bytes

def frontierCodec : PrefixCodec Frontier :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed 640 encodeFrontier decodeFrontier

-- Exactly the R0P.Public declaration order, with the Nat index bounded to u64.
abbrev Fields :=
  Variant × Digest M31Exact × Digest M31Exact × M31Exact ×
    Option (Digest M31Exact) × Digest M31Exact × Option M31Exact × U64 ×
    Frontier × Digest M31Exact × Frontier

def toFields (p : WirePublic) : Fields :=
  ⟨p.val.variant, p.val.anchor, p.val.nullifier, p.val.assetId,
    p.val.recipient, p.val.change, p.val.withdrawalAmount,
    ⟨p.val.nextPairIndex, p.property⟩, p.val.snapshotFrontier,
    p.val.nextRoot, p.val.nextFrontier⟩

def fromFields : Fields → WirePublic
  | ⟨variant, anchor, nullifier, assetId, recipient, change, amount,
      index, frontier, root, next⟩ =>
      ⟨{ variant := variant, anchor := anchor, nullifier := nullifier,
          assetId := assetId, recipient := recipient, change := change,
          withdrawalAmount := amount, nextPairIndex := index.val,
          snapshotFrontier := frontier, nextRoot := root, nextFrontier := next },
        index.isLt⟩

def publicFieldsEquiv : WirePublic ≃ Fields where
  toFun := toFields
  invFun := fromFields
  left_inv := by
    rintro ⟨p, hp⟩
    cases p
    rfl
  right_inv := by
    rintro ⟨v, a, n, asset, recipient, change, amount, index, frontier, root, next⟩
    rfl

def fieldsCodec : PrefixCodec Fields :=
  PrefixCodec.pair variantCodec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair digestCodec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair digestCodec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair m31Codec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair (PrefixCodec.option digestCodec) <|
  PrefixCodec.pair digestCodec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair (PrefixCodec.option m31Codec) <|
  PrefixCodec.pair u64Codec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair frontierCodec <|
  PrefixCodec.pair digestCodec frontierCodec

def publicCodec : PrefixCodec WirePublic :=
  PrefixCodec.transport publicFieldsEquiv.symm fieldsCodec

def encode (pub : BasePublic) : Option Bytes :=
  if h : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64 then some (publicCodec.emit ⟨pub, h⟩) else none

def parseRaw (bytes : Bytes) : Option BasePublic := do
  let (pub, rest) ← publicCodec.parse bytes
  if rest = [] then some pub.val else none

def decode (bytes : Bytes) : Option BasePublic := do
  let pub ← parseRaw bytes
  if PublicOptionShape.check pub = true then some pub else none

end AspisR1.PublicByteCodec

import R1ListFieldCodec
import R1RetainedFieldByteCodec
import R1RetainedExactLimbCodec

/-! Exact-tower wrappers around the existing V5 list-backed M31/QM31 codecs.
This file composes mathematical codec identities only; it states no current
Rust parser or R1 source correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
open AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec

abbrev Byte := AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.Byte
abbrev M31Exact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact
abbrev QM31Exact := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

/-- Four-byte little-endian encoding of one exact M31 element. -/
def encodeM31 (x : M31Exact) : List Byte :=
  AspisR1.ListFieldCodec.encodeM31Bytes (m31ResidueEquiv.symm x)

/-- Strict exact-length, canonical decoder for one M31 element. -/
def decodeM31 (bytes : List Byte) : Option M31Exact :=
  (AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeM31Bytes bytes).map m31ResidueEquiv

  · rename_i hlen

    subst n
    have hf : f = xs.get := by

      exact (congrFun hfun i).symm

    exact List.ofFn_get xs

    subst value

import Mathlib.Tactic

/-! Verbatim retained byte and field codec declarations. Their source pins and the only permitted namespace qualification replacement are checked by tools/retain-field-byte-codec.py. This is a retained model interface, not a new source correspondence proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

abbrev rawCandidateCount : Nat := 2 ^ 31
abbrev rawWordCount : Nat := 2 ^ 32
abbrev m31Modulus : Nat := rawCandidateCount - 1
abbrev RawWord := Fin rawWordCount
abbrev M31Value := Fin m31Modulus
abbrev qm31LimbCount : Nat := 4
abbrev QM31Limbs := Fin qm31LimbCount → M31Value

abbrev Byte := Fin 256
abbrev WordBytes := Fin 4 → Byte
abbrev QM31Bytes := Fin 16 → Byte

private def byteMod (n : Nat) : Byte :=
  ⟨n % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)⟩

/-- Four little-endian bytes of one mathematical `u32`. -/
def encodeWordLE (word : RawWord) : WordBytes :=
  ![byteMod word,
    byteMod ((word : Nat) / 256),
    byteMod ((word : Nat) / 65536),
    byteMod ((word : Nat) / 16777216)]

/-- Reassemble four little-endian bytes into one mathematical `u32`. -/
def decodeWordLE (bytes : WordBytes) : RawWord :=
  ⟨(bytes 0 : Nat) + 256 * (bytes 1 : Nat) +
      65536 * (bytes 2 : Nat) + 16777216 * (bytes 3 : Nat), by
    have h0 := (bytes 0).isLt
    have h1 := (bytes 1).isLt
    have h2 := (bytes 2).isLt
    have h3 := (bytes 3).isLt
    norm_num [rawWordCount] at *
    omega⟩

/-- The mathematical `u32` little-endian codec round trips exactly. -/
theorem decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE (word : RawWord) :
    decodeWordLE (encodeWordLE word) = word := by
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [decodeWordLE, encodeWordLE, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
    Matrix.cons_val_one, Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.cons_val_three,
    Fin.val_mk, byteMod]
  have hword := word.isLt
  norm_num [rawWordCount] at hword ⊢
  omega

/-- Canonically embed one accepted M31 residue in a mathematical `u32`. -/
def m31AsRawWord (value : M31Value) : RawWord :=
  ⟨value, lt_trans value.isLt (by
    norm_num [m31Modulus, rawCandidateCount, rawWordCount])⟩

def encodeM31LE (value : M31Value) : WordBytes :=
  encodeWordLE (m31AsRawWord value)

/-- Canonical Rust-style M31 decoder: reject a `u32` at or above `P`. -/
def decodeM31LE (bytes : WordBytes) : Option M31Value :=
  let word := decodeWordLE bytes
  if h : (word : Nat) < m31Modulus then some ⟨word, h⟩ else none

theorem decodeM31LE_encodeM31LE (value : M31Value) :
    decodeM31LE (encodeM31LE value) = some value := by
  have hround : decodeWordLE (encodeM31LE value) = m31AsRawWord value :=
    decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE _
  have hlt : ((decodeWordLE (encodeM31LE value) : RawWord) : Nat) < m31Modulus := by
    rw [hround]
    exact value.isLt
  unfold decodeM31LE
  rw [dif_pos hlt]
  apply congrArg some
  apply Fin.ext
  calc
    ((decodeWordLE (encodeM31LE value) : RawWord) : Nat) =
        (m31AsRawWord value : Nat) := congrArg Fin.val hround
    _ = (value : Nat) := rfl

/-- Byte offset `byte + 4*limb`.  Thus limbs `0,1,2,3` occupy byte ranges
`0..4`, `4..8`, `8..12`, `12..16`, exactly Rust's
`(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` order. -/
def limbByteIndex (limb byte : Fin 4) : Fin 16 :=
  finProdFinEquiv (limb, byte)

@[simp] theorem limbByteIndex_val (limb byte : Fin 4) :
    (limbByteIndex limb byte : Nat) = (byte : Nat) + 4 * (limb : Nat) := rfl

/-- Encode four limbs consecutively in the pinned tower order. -/
def encodeQM31LE (limbs : QM31Limbs) : QM31Bytes :=
  fun offset =>
    let position : Fin 4 × Fin 4 := finProdFinEquiv.symm offset
    encodeM31LE (limbs position.1) position.2

/-- Extract the four bytes belonging to one pinned limb. -/
def qm31LimbBytes (bytes : QM31Bytes) (limb : Fin 4) : WordBytes :=
  fun byte => bytes (limbByteIndex limb byte)

@[simp] theorem qm31LimbBytes_encodeQM31LE (limbs : QM31Limbs) (limb : Fin 4) :
    qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb = encodeM31LE (limbs limb) := by
  funext byte
  simp [qm31LimbBytes, encodeQM31LE, limbByteIndex]

/-- Decode four consecutive canonical M31 words.  Any noncanonical limb is
rejected, just as `QM31::from_le_bytes` rejects through its nested M31
decoders. -/
def decodeQM31LE (bytes : QM31Bytes) : Option QM31Limbs :=
  if h : ∀ limb, ((decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes bytes limb) : RawWord) : Nat) <
      m31Modulus then
    some (fun limb => ⟨decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes bytes limb), h limb⟩)
  else none

/-- The exact `(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` 16-byte codec round trip. -/
theorem decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE (limbs : QM31Limbs) :
    decodeQM31LE (encodeQM31LE limbs) = some limbs := by
  have hword (limb : Fin 4) :
      decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb) =
        m31AsRawWord (limbs limb) := by
    rw [qm31LimbBytes_encodeQM31LE]
    exact decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE _
  have hlt : ∀ limb,
      ((decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb) : RawWord) : Nat) <
        m31Modulus := by
    intro limb
    rw [hword]
    exact (limbs limb).isLt
  unfold decodeQM31LE
  rw [dif_pos hlt]
  apply congrArg some
  funext limb
  apply Fin.ext
  calc
    ((decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes (encodeQM31LE limbs) limb) : RawWord) : Nat) =
        (m31AsRawWord (limbs limb) : Nat) := congrArg Fin.val (hword limb)
    _ = (limbs limb : Nat) := rfl

theorem encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE (wordBytes : WordBytes) :
    encodeWordLE (decodeWordLE wordBytes) = wordBytes := by
  have injective : Function.Injective encodeWordLE :=
    Function.LeftInverse.injective decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE
  have sameCard : Fintype.card RawWord = Fintype.card WordBytes := by
    simp [RawWord, WordBytes, rawWordCount]
  have surjective : Function.Surjective encodeWordLE :=
    ((Fintype.bijective_iff_injective_and_card encodeWordLE).2
      ⟨injective, sameCard⟩).2
  obtain ⟨word, encoded⟩ := surjective wordBytes
  rw [← encoded, decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE]

/-- Successful canonical four-limb decoding determines every input byte. -/

theorem encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE
    (encoded : AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.QM31Bytes)
    (limbs : QM31Limbs) (decoded : decodeQM31LE encoded = some limbs) :
    encodeQM31LE limbs = encoded := by
  unfold decodeQM31LE at decoded
  split at decoded
  next canonical =>
    have limbsEq := Option.some.inj decoded
    rw [← limbsEq]
    funext offset
    let position : Fin 4 × Fin 4 := finProdFinEquiv.symm offset
    have rawEq :
        m31AsRawWord
            ⟨decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes encoded position.1),
              canonical position.1⟩ =
          decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes encoded position.1) := by
      apply Fin.ext
      rfl
    change encodeM31LE
        ⟨decodeWordLE (qm31LimbBytes encoded position.1),
          canonical position.1⟩ position.2 = encoded offset
    rw [encodeM31LE, rawEq, encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE]
    change encoded (limbByteIndex position.1 position.2) = encoded offset
    congr 1
    exact (finProdFinEquiv (m := 4) (n := 4)).apply_symm_apply offset
  next noncanonical => simp at decoded

/-- A successful Tag-73 canonical decode round-trips to the literal runtime
bytes, not merely to an extension-field value with the same cardinality. -/

def fixedBytes? (width : Nat) (bytes : List Byte) :
    Option (Fin width -> Byte) :=
  if h : bytes.length = width then
    some fun index => bytes.get ⟨index, by omega⟩
  else none

def byteSlice (bytes : List Byte) (offset width : Nat) : List Byte :=
  (bytes.drop offset).take width

def decodeM31Bytes (bytes : List Byte) :=
  (fixedBytes? 4 bytes).bind
    AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeM31LE

def decodeQM31Bytes (bytes : List Byte) :=
  (fixedBytes? 16 bytes).bind
    AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeQM31LE

#print axioms decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE

#print axioms decodeM31LE_encodeM31LE

#print axioms decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE

#print axioms encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE

#print axioms encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE

#print axioms decodeQM31Bytes

end AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

/-! ## Literal tower coordinates -/

/-- Exact canonical-residue equivalence.  Unlike `Fintype.equivOfCardEq`,
this is the standard ring equivalence `Fin P ≃ ZMod P`. -/
def m31ResidueEquiv : M31Value ≃+* M31Exact := ZMod.finEquiv P

/-- Four canonical M31 residues in Rust field order. -/
def limbsToQM31Exact (x : QM31Limbs) : QM31Exact :=
  ⟨⟨m31ResidueEquiv (x 0), m31ResidueEquiv (x 1)⟩,
   ⟨m31ResidueEquiv (x 2), m31ResidueEquiv (x 3)⟩⟩

/-- Recover the four canonical residues in `(c0.a,c0.b,c1.a,c1.b)` order. -/
def qm31ExactToLimbs (x : QM31Exact) : QM31Limbs :=
  ![m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.re.re,
    m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.re.im,
    m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.im.re,
    m31ResidueEquiv.symm x.im.im]

@[simp] theorem qm31ExactToLimbs_limbsToQM31Exact (x : QM31Limbs) :
    qm31ExactToLimbs (limbsToQM31Exact x) = x := by
  funext j
  fin_cases j
  · simp [qm31ExactToLimbs, limbsToQM31Exact]
  · simp [qm31ExactToLimbs, limbsToQM31Exact]
  · exact congrArg x (Fin.ext rfl)
  · exact congrArg x (Fin.ext rfl)

@[simp] theorem limbsToQM31Exact_qm31ExactToLimbs (x : QM31Exact) :
    limbsToQM31Exact (qm31ExactToLimbs x) = x := by
  ext <;> simp [qm31ExactToLimbs, limbsToQM31Exact]

def qm31ExactLimbEquiv : QM31Limbs ≃ QM31Exact where
  toFun := limbsToQM31Exact
  invFun := qm31ExactToLimbs
  left_inv := qm31ExactToLimbs_limbsToQM31Exact
  right_inv := limbsToQM31Exact_qm31ExactToLimbs

@[simp] theorem qm31ExactLimbEquiv_apply (x : QM31Limbs) :
    qm31ExactLimbEquiv x = limbsToQM31Exact x := rfl

@[simp] theorem qm31ExactLimbEquiv_symm_apply (x : QM31Exact) :
    qm31ExactLimbEquiv.symm x = qm31ExactToLimbs x := rfl

import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! Structural encoder/decoder facts for fixed-width list encodings. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder

def decode {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (k : Nat) :
    (n : Nat) → List B → Option (Fin n → A)
  | 0, bytes => if bytes.length = 0 then some Fin.elim0 else none
  | n + 1, bytes => do
      let head ← d (bytes.take k)
      let tail ← decode d k n (bytes.drop k)
      pure (Fin.cons head tail)

def encode {B A : Type} (f : A → List B) {n : Nat} (xs : Fin n → A) : List B :=
  (List.ofFn xs).flatMap f

theorem decode_encode {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (f : A → List B)
    (k n : Nat) (xs : Fin n → A)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (f a).length = k)
    (hround : ∀ a, d (f a) = some a) :
    decode d k n (encode f xs) = some xs := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hxs : xs = Fin.elim0 := by
        funext i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
      simp [decode, encode, hxs]
  | succ n ih =>
      let tail : Fin n → A := fun i => xs i.succ
      have hcons : Fin.cons (xs 0) tail = xs := by
        funext i
        exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
      have henc : encode f xs = f (xs 0) ++ encode f tail := by
        simp [encode, tail, List.ofFn_succ, List.flatMap_cons]
      have htail := ih tail
      rw [henc]
      simp only [decode]
      rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen (xs 0)]),
        List.take_of_length_le (by rw [hlen (xs 0)])]
      simp only [hround]
      rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen (xs 0)]),
        List.drop_of_length_le (by rw [hlen (xs 0)]), List.nil_append, htail]
      exact congrArg some hcons

theorem encode_of_decode {B A : Type} (d : List B → Option A) (f : A → List B)
    (k n : Nat) (bytes : List B) (xs : Fin n → A)
    (hsuccess : decode d k n bytes = some xs)
    (hback : ∀ bs a, d bs = some a → f a = bs) :
    encode f xs = bytes := by
  induction n generalizing bytes with
  | zero =>
      cases bytes with
      | nil => rfl
      | cons b bs => simp [decode] at hsuccess
  | succ n ih =>
      cases hhead : d (bytes.take k) with
      | none => simp [decode, hhead] at hsuccess
      | some head =>
          cases htail : decode d k n (bytes.drop k) with
          | none => simp [decode, hhead, htail] at hsuccess
          | some tail =>
              have hxs : Fin.cons head tail = xs := by
                simpa [decode, hhead, htail] using hsuccess
              have htailenc : encode f tail = bytes.drop k :=
                ih (bytes.drop k) tail htail
              have henc : encode f xs = f head ++ encode f tail := by
                rw [← hxs]
                simp [encode, List.ofFn_succ, List.flatMap_cons]
              rw [henc, hback (bytes.take k) head hhead, htailenc]
              exact List.take_append_drop k bytes

#print axioms decode_encode
#print axioms encode_of_decode

end AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder

    (List.ofFn (PublicIndexCodec.encode x))).map PublicIndexCodec.decode = some x
  rw [ListFieldCodec.fixedBytes?_ofFn]
