        _ = bytes := ListFieldCodec.fixedBytes?_sound 8 bytes wordBytes hfixed

end AspisR1.PublicIndexListCodec

#print axioms AspisR1.PublicIndexListCodec.encode_length8
#print axioms AspisR1.PublicIndexListCodec.decode_encode
#print axioms AspisR1.PublicIndexListCodec.encode_of_decode
R1PublicIndexCodec:
import R1RetainedFieldByteCodec

/-! A mathematical little-endian codec for a 64-bit public index, assembled
from the retained 32-bit word codec. This is a representation lemma only; it
does not establish a Rust extraction or caller-width correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

abbrev Index := Fin (2 ^ 64)
abbrev IndexBytes := Fin 8 → Byte

private def lowWordBytes (bytes : IndexBytes) : WordBytes :=
  fun i => bytes ⟨i.val, by omega⟩

private def highWordBytes (bytes : IndexBytes) : WordBytes :=
  fun i => bytes ⟨i.val + 4, by omega⟩

private def lowWord (x : Index) : RawWord :=
  ⟨x.val % 2 ^ 32, by
    exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by norm_num)⟩

private def highWord (x : Index) : RawWord :=
  ⟨x.val / 2 ^ 32, by
    have hx := x.isLt
    norm_num at hx ⊢
    omega⟩

/-- Eight little-endian bytes, with the low word followed by the high word. -/
def encode (x : Index) : IndexBytes := fun i =>
  if h : i.val < 4 then
    encodeWordLE (lowWord x) ⟨i.val, h⟩
  else
    encodeWordLE (highWord x) ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩

/-- Interpret eight little-endian bytes as a bounded 64-bit index. -/
def decode (bytes : IndexBytes) : Index :=
  ⟨(decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)).val +
      2 ^ 32 * (decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)).val, by
    have hlo := (decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)).isLt
    have hhi := (decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)).isLt
    norm_num [rawWordCount] at hlo hhi ⊢
    omega⟩

theorem decode_val (bytes : IndexBytes) :
    (decode bytes).val = (decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)).val +
      2 ^ 32 * (decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)).val := rfl

theorem decode_encode (x : Index) : decode (encode x) = x := by
  apply Fin.ext
  rw [decode_val]
  have hlow : lowWordBytes (encode x) = encodeWordLE (lowWord x) := by
    funext i
    simp [lowWordBytes, encode, i.isLt]
  have hhigh : highWordBytes (encode x) = encodeWordLE (highWord x) := by
    funext i
    simp [highWordBytes, encode]
  rw [hlow, hhigh, decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE, decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE]
  change x.val % 2 ^ 32 + 2 ^ 32 * (x.val / 2 ^ 32) = x.val
  have hdiv := Nat.mod_add_div x.val (2 ^ 32)
  norm_num at hdiv
  exact hdiv

private theorem decode_lowWord (bytes : IndexBytes) :
    lowWord (decode bytes) = decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (decode bytes).val % 2 ^ 32 = (decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)).val
  rw [decode_val]
  have hlo := (decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)).isLt
  norm_num [rawWordCount] at hlo ⊢
  omega

private theorem decode_highWord (bytes : IndexBytes) :
    highWord (decode bytes) = decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes) := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (decode bytes).val / 2 ^ 32 = (decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)).val
  rw [decode_val]
  have hlo := (decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)).isLt
  have hhi := (decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)).isLt
  norm_num [rawWordCount] at hlo hhi ⊢
  omega

theorem encode_decode (bytes : IndexBytes) : encode (decode bytes) = bytes := by
  funext i
  by_cases h : i.val < 4
  · simp only [encode, dif_pos h]
    rw [decode_lowWord]
    have hidx : (⟨i.val, h⟩ : Fin 4) = ⟨i.val, by omega⟩ := rfl
    rw [hidx]
    have hround := encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE (lowWordBytes bytes)
    exact congrArg (fun b : WordBytes => b ⟨i.val, by omega⟩) hround
  · simp only [encode, dif_neg h]
    rw [decode_highWord]
    have hround := encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)
    have hbytes := congrArg (fun b : WordBytes => b ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩) hround
    change encodeWordLE (decodeWordLE (highWordBytes bytes)) ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩ =
      bytes ⟨i.val - 4 + 4, by omega⟩ at hbytes
    have hidx : (⟨i.val - 4 + 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 8) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      simp
      omega
    rw [hidx] at hbytes
    exact hbytes

end AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec

#print axioms AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.decode_val
#print axioms AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.decode_encode
#print axioms AspisR1.PublicIndexCodec.encode_decode
R1SemanticPublicWire:
import R1PublicFieldBlockCodec
import R1PublicIndexListCodec
import R1PublicByteCursor
import PublicOptionShape

/-! Executable model of the source's section-9 semantic-public layout.
The ASF8 envelope, account binding, and Rust refinement are separate.
This wire carrier fixes the two variants' option shape and bounds the index
to its eight-byte representation; withdrawal nonzero is checked separately. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire

abbrev Byte := ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte
abbrev M31 := ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact
abbrev Digest := PublicFieldBlockCodec.Digest
abbrev Frontier := PublicFieldBlockCodec.Frontier

structure Common where
  anchor : Digest
  nullifier : Digest
  assetId : M31
  change : Digest
  nextPairIndex : PublicIndexCodec.Index
  snapshotFrontier : Frontier
  nextRoot : Digest
  nextFrontier : Frontier

inductive Wire
  | transfer (common : Common) (recipient : Digest)
  | withdrawal (common : Common) (amount : M31)

def toPublic : Wire → R0P.Public M31
  | .transfer c recipient =>
      ⟨.privateTransfer, c.anchor, c.nullifier, c.assetId, some recipient,
        c.change, none, c.nextPairIndex.val, c.snapshotFrontier, c.nextRoot, c.nextFrontier⟩
  | .withdrawal c amount =>
      ⟨.withdrawal, c.anchor, c.nullifier, c.assetId, none,
        c.change, some amount, c.nextPairIndex.val, c.snapshotFrontier, c.nextRoot, c.nextFrontier⟩

def header (c : Common) : List Byte :=
  PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.anchor ++
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.nullifier ++ ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 c.assetId

def afterBytes (c : Common) : List Byte :=
  PublicIndexListCodec.encode c.nextPairIndex ++
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier c.snapshotFrontier ++
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.nextRoot ++
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier c.nextFrontier

def encode : Wire → List Byte
  | .transfer c recipient =>
      [0] ++ header c ++ [1] ++ PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest recipient ++
        PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change ++ [0] ++ afterBytes c
  | .withdrawal c amount =>
      [1] ++ header c ++ [0] ++ PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change ++
        [1] ++ ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 amount ++ afterBytes c

def expect (tag : Byte) : List Byte → Option (List Byte)
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => if x = tag then some xs else none

def readDigest := PublicByteCursor.read 32 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest
def readField := PublicByteCursor.read 4 ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31
def readIndex := PublicByteCursor.read 8 PublicIndexListCodec.decode
def readFrontier := PublicByteCursor.read 640 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier

/-- Read the common suffix and reject trailing bytes. -/
def decodeAfter (anchor nullifier : Digest) (assetId : M31) (change : Digest)
    (bytes : List Byte) : Option Common := do
  let (index, rest) ← readIndex bytes
  let (snapshot, rest) ← readFrontier rest
  let (root, rest) ← readDigest rest
  let (frontier, rest) ← readFrontier rest
  if rest.isEmpty then
    some ⟨anchor, nullifier, assetId, change, index, snapshot, root, frontier⟩
  else none

def decodeTransfer (bytes : List Byte) : Option Wire := do
  let (anchor, rest) ← readDigest bytes
  let (nullifier, rest) ← readDigest rest
  let (asset, rest) ← readField rest
  let rest ← expect 1 rest
  let (recipient, rest) ← readDigest rest
  let (change, rest) ← readDigest rest
  let rest ← expect 0 rest
  let c ← decodeAfter anchor nullifier asset change rest
  some (.transfer c recipient)

def decodeWithdrawal (bytes : List Byte) : Option Wire := do
  let (anchor, rest) ← readDigest bytes
  let (nullifier, rest) ← readDigest rest
  let (asset, rest) ← readField rest
  let rest ← expect 0 rest
  let (change, rest) ← readDigest rest
  let rest ← expect 1 rest
  let (amount, rest) ← readField rest
  let c ← decodeAfter anchor nullifier asset change rest
  some (.withdrawal c amount)

def decode : List Byte → Option Wire
  | [] => none
  | tag :: rest =>
      if tag = 0 then decodeTransfer rest
      else if tag = 1 then decodeWithdrawal rest else none

def parsePublic (bytes : List Byte) : Option (R0P.Public M31) := do
  let wire ← decode bytes
  let pub := toPublic wire
  if PublicOptionShape.check pub then some pub else none

theorem parsePublic_canonical (bytes : List Byte) (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (h : parsePublic bytes = some pub) : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub := by
  cases hd : decode bytes with
  | none => simp [parsePublic, hd] at h
  | some wire =>
      simp only [parsePublic, hd] at h
      change (if PublicOptionShape.check (toPublic wire) = true
        then some (toPublic wire) else none) = some pub at h
      split at h
      next hc =>
        have hp := Option.some.inj h
        exact hp ▸ (PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff (toPublic wire)).mp hc
      next hc => contradiction

theorem toPublic_index_bound (wire : Wire) :
    (toPublic wire).nextPairIndex < 2^64 := by
  cases wire with
  | transfer c recipient => exact c.nextPairIndex.isLt
  | withdrawal c amount => exact c.nextPairIndex.isLt

#print axioms parsePublic_canonical
#print axioms toPublic_index_bound
end AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire
R1PublicFieldBlockCodec:
import R1ExactLeafFieldCodec
import R1FixedWidthDecoder

/-! Fixed-width sequences of exact M31 values used by the public index,
digest, and frontier models. This is a mathematical codec composition and
does not assert a Rust source correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec

open AspisR1.ExactLeafFieldCodec
open AspisR1.FixedWidthDecoder

abbrev Byte := ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte
abbrev M31 := ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact
abbrev Digest := Fin 8 → M31
abbrev Frontier := Fin 20 → Digest

def encodeFields {n : Nat} (xs : Fin n → M31) : List Byte :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.encode ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 xs

def decodeFields (n : Nat) (bytes : List Byte) : Option (Fin n → M31) :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.decode ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 4 n bytes

theorem encodeFields_length {n : Nat} (xs : Fin n → M31) :
    (encodeFields xs).length = 4 * n := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
      have hxs : xs = Fin.elim0 := by
        funext i
        exact Fin.elim0 i
      simp [encodeFields, FixedWidthDecoder.encode, hxs]
  | succ n ih =>
      let tail : Fin n → M31 := fun i => xs i.succ
      have hcons : Fin.cons (xs 0) tail = xs := by
        funext i
        exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
      have henc : encodeFields xs = encodeM31 (xs 0) ++ encodeFields tail := by
        unfold encodeFields FixedWidthDecoder.encode
        rw [← hcons]
        simp [tail, List.ofFn_succ, List.flatMap_cons]
      rw [henc, List.length_append, ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length, ih tail]
      omega

theorem decodeFields_encodeFields {n : Nat} (xs : Fin n → M31) :
    decodeFields n (encodeFields xs) = some xs := by
  exact FixedWidthDecoder.decode_encode ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 4 n xs
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31_encodeM31

theorem encodeFields_of_decodeFields {n : Nat} (bytes : List Byte)
    (xs : Fin n → M31) (h : decodeFields n bytes = some xs) :
    encodeFields xs = bytes := by
  exact FixedWidthDecoder.encode_of_decode ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 4 n bytes xs h
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_of_decodeM31

def encodeDigest (digest : Digest) : List Byte := encodeFields digest

def decodeDigest (bytes : List Byte) : Option Digest := decodeFields 8 bytes

theorem encodeDigest_length (digest : Digest) :
    (encodeDigest digest).length = 32 := by
  simpa [encodeDigest] using (encodeFields_length digest)

theorem decodeDigest_encodeDigest (digest : Digest) :
    decodeDigest (encodeDigest digest) = some digest :=
  decodeFields_encodeFields digest

theorem encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest (bytes : List Byte) (digest : Digest)
    (h : decodeDigest bytes = some digest) : encodeDigest digest = bytes :=
  encodeFields_of_decodeFields bytes digest h

def encodeFrontier (frontier : Frontier) : List Byte :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.encode encodeDigest frontier

def decodeFrontier (bytes : List Byte) : Option Frontier :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.decode decodeDigest 32 20 bytes

theorem encodeFrontier_length (frontier : Frontier) :
    (encodeFrontier frontier).length = 640 := by
  unfold encodeFrontier FixedWidthDecoder.encode
  simp [List.length_flatMap, List.length_ofFn, encodeDigest_length]

theorem decodeFrontier_encodeFrontier (frontier : Frontier) :
    decodeFrontier (encodeFrontier frontier) = some frontier := by
  exact FixedWidthDecoder.decode_encode decodeDigest encodeDigest 32 20 frontier
    encodeDigest_length decodeDigest_encodeDigest

theorem encodeFrontier_of_decodeFrontier (bytes : List Byte) (frontier : Frontier)
    (h : decodeFrontier bytes = some frontier) : encodeFrontier frontier = bytes := by
  exact FixedWidthDecoder.encode_of_decode decodeDigest encodeDigest 32 20 bytes frontier h
    encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest

#print axioms encodeFields_length
#print axioms decodeFields_encodeFields
#print axioms encodeFields_of_decodeFields
#print axioms encodeDigest_length
#print axioms decodeDigest_encodeDigest
#print axioms encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest
#print axioms encodeFrontier_length
#print axioms decodeFrontier_encodeFrontier
#print axioms encodeFrontier_of_decodeFrontier

end AspisR1.PublicFieldBlockCodec
R1PublicByteCursor:
import Mathlib.Data.List.OfFn

/-! A small list cursor for public byte codecs. It describes a mathematical
prefix decode and leaves source parsing correspondence to separate results. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.PublicByteCursor

abbrev Byte := Fin 256

def read {A : Type} (n : Nat) (decode : List Byte → Option A)
    (bytes : List Byte) : Option (A × List Byte) :=
  (decode (bytes.take n)).map (fun a => (a, bytes.drop n))

theorem read_encoded {A : Type} (n : Nat) (decode : List Byte → Option A)
    (encode : A → List Byte) (a : A) (tail : List Byte)
    (hlen : ∀ x, (encode x).length = n)
    (hround : ∀ x, decode (encode x) = some x) :
    read n decode (encode a ++ tail) = some (a, tail) := by
  have htake : (encode a ++ tail).take n = encode a := by
    rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen a]),
      List.take_of_length_le (by rw [hlen a])]
  have hdrop : (encode a ++ tail).drop n = tail := by
    rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen a]),
      List.drop_of_length_le (by rw [hlen a]), List.nil_append]
  simp [read, htake, hdrop, hround a]

theorem read_sound {A : Type} (n : Nat) (decode : List Byte → Option A)
    (encode : A → List Byte) (bytes : List Byte) (a : A) (rest : List Byte)
    (hback : ∀ bs x, decode bs = some x → encode x = bs)
    (hread : read n decode bytes = some (a, rest)) :
    bytes = encode a ++ rest := by
  unfold read at hread
  cases hd : decode (bytes.take n) with
  | none => simp [hd] at hread
  | some value =>
      have hpair : (value, bytes.drop n) = (a, rest) := by
        simpa [hd] using hread
      have hvalue : value = a := congrArg Prod.fst hpair
      have hrest : bytes.drop n = rest := congrArg Prod.snd hpair
      have hdecode : decode (bytes.take n) = some a := by
        simpa [hvalue] using hd
      have henc := hback (bytes.take n) a hdecode
      calc
        bytes = bytes.take n ++ bytes.drop n := (List.take_append_drop n bytes).symm
        _ = encode a ++ bytes.drop n := by rw [← henc]
        _ = encode a ++ rest := by rw [hrest]

#print axioms read_encoded
#print axioms read_sound

end AspisR1.PublicByteCursor
R1PublicByteCodecLaws:
import R1PublicByteCodec

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PublicByteCodec
open R0P AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

namespace PrefixCodec
variable {A B : Type}

theorem fixed_lawful (n : Nat) (emit : A → Bytes) (dec : Bytes → Option A)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (emit a).length = n)
    (hround : ∀ a, dec (emit a) = some a)
    (hback : ∀ bytes a, dec bytes = some a → emit a = bytes) :
    Lawful (fixed n emit dec) := by
  constructor
  · intro a rest
    have ht : (emit a ++ rest).take n = emit a := by
      rw [List.take_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen a]),
        List.take_of_length_le (by rw [hlen a])]
    have hd : (emit a ++ rest).drop n = rest := by
      rw [List.drop_append_of_le_length (by rw [hlen a]),
        List.drop_of_length_le (by rw [hlen a]), List.nil_append]
    simp only [fixed, ht, hd, hround, Option.map_some]
  · intro bytes a rest h
    change (dec (bytes.take n)).map (fun x => (x, bytes.drop n)) = some (a, rest) at h
    cases hd : dec (bytes.take n) with
    | none => simp [hd] at h
    | some x =>
        have hp : (x, bytes.drop n) = (a, rest) := by simpa [hd] using h
        have hx : x = a := congrArg Prod.fst hp
        have hr : bytes.drop n = rest := congrArg Prod.snd hp
        calc
          emit a ++ rest = bytes.take n ++ bytes.drop n := by
            rw [← hx, ← hr, hback (bytes.take n) x hd]
          _ = bytes := List.take_append_drop n bytes

theorem pair_lawful (c : PrefixCodec A) (d : PrefixCodec B)
    (hc : Lawful c) (hd : Lawful d) : Lawful (pair c d) := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, b⟩ rest
    simp [pair, List.append_assoc, hc.round, hd.round]
  · rintro bytes ⟨a, b⟩ rest h
    cases hc0 : c.parse bytes with
    | none => simp [pair, hc0] at h
    | some ar =>
        rcases ar with ⟨a', mid⟩
        cases hd0 : d.parse mid with
        | none => simp [pair, hc0, hd0] at h
        | some br =>
            rcases br with ⟨b', last⟩
            have heq : ((a', b'), last) = ((a, b), rest) := by
              simpa [pair, hc0, hd0] using h
            have ha : a' = a := congrArg (fun z : (A × B) × Bytes => z.1.1) heq
            have hb : b' = b := congrArg (fun z : (A × B) × Bytes => z.1.2) heq
            have hr : last = rest := congrArg (fun z : (A × B) × Bytes => z.2) heq
            change (c.emit a ++ d.emit b) ++ rest = bytes
            rw [← ha, ← hb, ← hr, List.append_assoc, hd.back mid b' last hd0]
            exact hc.back bytes a' mid hc0

theorem transport_lawful (e : A ≃ B) (c : PrefixCodec A)
    (hc : Lawful c) : Lawful (transport e c) := by
  constructor
  · intro b rest
    simp [transport, hc.round]
  · intro bytes b rest h
    cases hp : c.parse bytes with
    | none => simp [transport, hp] at h
    | some ar =>
        rcases ar with ⟨a, tail⟩
        have heq : (e a, tail) = (b, rest) := by simpa [transport, hp] using h
        have hb : e a = b := congrArg Prod.fst heq
        have hr := congrArg Prod.snd heq
        dsimp only at hr
        change c.emit (e.symm b) ++ rest = bytes
        rw [← hb, e.symm_apply_apply, ← hr]
        exact hc.back bytes a tail hp

theorem option_lawful (c : PrefixCodec A) (hc : Lawful c) :
    Lawful (option c) := by
  constructor
  · intro oa rest
    cases oa <;> simp [option, hc.round]
  · intro bytes oa rest h
    cases bytes with
    | nil => simp [option] at h
    | cons tag tail =>
        by_cases h0 : tag = 0
        · have heq : (none, tail) = (oa, rest) := by
            simpa [option, h0] using h
          have ho := congrArg Prod.fst heq
          dsimp only at ho
          have hr := congrArg Prod.snd heq
          dsimp only at hr
          rw [← ho, ← hr]
          simp [option, h0]
        · by_cases h1 : tag = 1
          · cases hp : c.parse tail with
            | none => simp [option, h0, h1, hp] at h
            | some ar =>
                rcases ar with ⟨a, last⟩
                have heq : (some a, last) = (oa, rest) := by
                  simpa [option, h0, h1, hp] using h
                have ho := congrArg Prod.fst heq
                dsimp only at ho
                have hr := congrArg Prod.snd heq
                dsimp only at hr
                rw [← ho, ← hr]
                change (1 :: c.emit a) ++ last = tag :: tail
                simpa only [List.cons_append, h1] using
                  congrArg (List.cons (1 : Byte)) (hc.back tail a last hp)
          · simp [option, h0, h1] at h

theorem fixed_short (n : Nat) (emit : A → Bytes) (dec : Bytes → Option A)
    (hlen : ∀ a, (emit a).length = n)
    (hback : ∀ bytes a, dec bytes = some a → emit a = bytes)
    (bytes : Bytes) (hshort : bytes.length < n) :
    (fixed n emit dec).parse bytes = none := by
  cases hd : dec (bytes.take n) with
  | none => simp [fixed, hd]
  | some a =>
      have hb := hback (bytes.take n) a hd
      have heq : n = min n bytes.length := by
        simpa [hlen, List.length_take] using congrArg List.length hb
      omega

theorem option_invalid_tag (c : PrefixCodec A) (tag : Byte) (tail : Bytes)
    (h0 : tag ≠ 0) (h1 : tag ≠ 1) :
    (option c).parse (tag :: tail) = none := by
  simp [option, h0, h1]

theorem pair_left_failure (c : PrefixCodec A) (d : PrefixCodec B)
    (bytes : Bytes) (h : c.parse bytes = none) :
    (pair c d).parse bytes = none := by simp [pair, h]

theorem pair_right_failure (c : PrefixCodec A) (d : PrefixCodec B)
    (bytes mid : Bytes) (a : A) (hc : c.parse bytes = some (a, mid))
    (hd : d.parse mid = none) :
    (pair c d).parse bytes = none := by simp [pair, hc, hd]

end PrefixCodec

theorem variant_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful variantCodec := by
  constructor
  · intro v rest
    cases v <;> simp [variantCodec]
  · intro bytes v rest h
    cases bytes with
    | nil => simp [variantCodec] at h
    | cons tag tail =>
        by_cases h0 : tag = 0
        · have heq : (Variant.privateTransfer, tail) = (v, rest) := by
            simpa [variantCodec, h0] using h
          have hv := congrArg Prod.fst heq
          dsimp only at hv
          have hr := congrArg Prod.snd heq
          dsimp only at hr
          rw [← hv, ← hr]
          simp [variantCodec, h0]
        · by_cases h1 : tag = 1
          · have heq : (Variant.withdrawal, tail) = (v, rest) := by
              simpa [variantCodec, h0, h1] using h
            have hv := congrArg Prod.fst heq
            dsimp only at hv
            have hr := congrArg Prod.snd heq
            dsimp only at hr
            rw [← hv, ← hr]
            simp [variantCodec, h1]
          · simp [variantCodec, h0, h1] at h

theorem variant_invalid_tag (tag : Byte) (tail : Bytes)
    (h0 : tag ≠ 0) (h1 : tag ≠ 1) : variantCodec.parse (tag :: tail) = none := by
  simp [variantCodec, h0, h1]

theorem encodeU32_length (x : RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord) :
    (encodeU32 x).length = 4 := by simp [encodeU32]

theorem decodeU32_encode (x : RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord) :
    decodeU32 (encodeU32 x) = some x := by
  change (RetainedFieldByteCodec.fixedBytes? 4 (List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE x))).map RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeWordLE = some x
  rw [ListFieldCodec.fixedBytes?_ofFn, Option.map_some, RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeWordLE_encodeWordLE]

theorem encodeU32_of_decode (bytes : Bytes) (x : RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord)
    (h : decodeU32 bytes = some x) : encodeU32 x = bytes := by
  cases hf : RetainedFieldByteCodec.fixedBytes? 4 bytes with
  | none => simp [decodeU32, hf] at h
  | some word =>
      have hw : RetainedFieldByteCodec.decodeWordLE word = x := by
        simpa [decodeU32, hf] using h
      calc
        encodeU32 x = List.ofFn word := by
          rw [← hw, encodeU32, RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE_decodeWordLE]
        _ = bytes := ListFieldCodec.fixedBytes?_sound 4 bytes word hf

theorem u32_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful u32Codec :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed_lawful 4 encodeU32 decodeU32
    encodeU32_length decodeU32_encode encodeU32_of_decode

theorem u64_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful u64Codec :=
  PrefixCodec.transport_lawful u64Equiv (PrefixCodec.pair u32Codec u32Codec)
    (PrefixCodec.pair_lawful u32Codec u32Codec u32_lawful u32_lawful)

theorem u64_emit_length (x : U64) : (u64Codec.emit x).length = 8 := by
  change (encodeU32 (u64Equiv.symm x).1 ++ encodeU32 (u64Equiv.symm x).2).length = 8
  simp [encodeU32_length]

theorem m31_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful m31Codec :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed_lawful 4 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31_encodeM31
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_of_decodeM31

theorem encodeDigest_length (d : Digest M31Exact) : (encodeDigest d).length = 32 := by
  unfold encodeDigest FixedWidthDecoder.encode
  simp [List.length_flatMap, List.length_ofFn, ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length]

theorem decodeDigest_encode (d : Digest M31Exact) : decodeDigest (encodeDigest d) = some d :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.decode_encode ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31
    4 8 d ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31_encodeM31

theorem encodeDigest_of_decode (bytes : Bytes) (d : Digest M31Exact)
    (h : decodeDigest bytes = some d) : encodeDigest d = bytes :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.encode_of_decode ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31
    4 8 bytes d h ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_of_decodeM31

theorem digest_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful digestCodec :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed_lawful 32 encodeDigest decodeDigest
    encodeDigest_length decodeDigest_encode encodeDigest_of_decode

theorem encodeFrontier_length (f : Frontier) : (encodeFrontier f).length = 640 := by
  unfold encodeFrontier FixedWidthDecoder.encode
  simp [List.length_flatMap, List.length_ofFn, encodeDigest_length]

theorem decodeFrontier_encode (f : Frontier) : decodeFrontier (encodeFrontier f) = some f :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.decode_encode decodeDigest encodeDigest 32 20 f
    encodeDigest_length decodeDigest_encode

theorem encodeFrontier_of_decode (bytes : Bytes) (f : Frontier)
    (h : decodeFrontier bytes = some f) : encodeFrontier f = bytes :=
  FixedWidthDecoder.encode_of_decode decodeDigest encodeDigest 32 20 bytes f h
    encodeDigest_of_decode

theorem frontier_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful frontierCodec :=
  PrefixCodec.fixed_lawful 640 encodeFrontier decodeFrontier
    encodeFrontier_length decodeFrontier_encode encodeFrontier_of_decode

theorem fields_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful fieldsCodec := by
  unfold fieldsCodec
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ variant_lawful
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ digest_lawful
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ digest_lawful
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ m31_lawful
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ (PrefixCodec.option_lawful _ digest_lawful)
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ digest_lawful
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ (PrefixCodec.option_lawful _ m31_lawful)
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ u64_lawful
  apply PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ frontier_lawful
  exact PrefixCodec.pair_lawful _ _ digest_lawful frontier_lawful

theorem public_lawful : PrefixCodec.Lawful publicCodec :=
  PrefixCodec.transport_lawful publicFieldsEquiv.symm fieldsCodec fields_lawful

theorem parseRaw_emit_suffix (pub : WirePublic) (rest : Bytes) :
    parseRaw (publicCodec.emit pub ++ rest) =
      if rest = [] then some pub.val else none := by
  simp [parseRaw, public_lawful.round]

theorem parseRaw_emit (pub : WirePublic) : parseRaw (publicCodec.emit pub) = some pub.val := by
  simpa using parseRaw_emit_suffix pub []

theorem encode_success_bound (pub : BasePublic) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : encode pub = some bytes) : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64 := by
  unfold encode at h
  split at h
  · assumption
  · simp at h

theorem parseRaw_eq_some_iff (bytes : Bytes) (pub : BasePublic) :
    parseRaw bytes = some pub ↔ encode pub = some bytes := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    unfold parseRaw at h
    cases hp : publicCodec.parse bytes with
    | none => simp [hp] at h
    | some qr =>
        rcases qr with ⟨q, rest⟩
        by_cases hr : rest = []
        · have hv : q.val = pub := by simpa [hp, hr] using h
          have hb : publicCodec.emit q = bytes := by
            simpa [hr] using public_lawful.back bytes q rest hp
          have hi : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64 := by rw [← hv]; exact q.property
          have hq : (⟨pub, hi⟩ : WirePublic) = q := Subtype.ext hv.symm
          simp only [encode, dif_pos hi, hq, hb]
        · simp [hp, hr] at h
  · intro h
    unfold encode at h
    split at h
    next hi =>
      have hb : publicCodec.emit (⟨pub, hi⟩ : WirePublic) = bytes := Option.some.inj h
      rw [← hb]
      exact parseRaw_emit ⟨pub, hi⟩
    next hi => simp at h

theorem decode_eq_some_iff (bytes : Bytes) (pub : BasePublic) :
    decode bytes = some pub ↔
      encode pub = some bytes ∧ PublicOptionShape.check pub = true := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    cases hp : parseRaw bytes with
    | none => simp [decode, hp] at h
    | some q =>
        by_cases hc : PublicOptionShape.check q = true
        · have hq : q = pub := by simpa [decode, hp, hc] using h
          subst q
          exact ⟨(parseRaw_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mp hp, hc⟩
        · simp [decode, hp, hc] at h
  · rintro ⟨he, hc⟩
    have hp := (parseRaw_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mpr he
    simp [decode, hp, hc]

theorem decode_of_encode (pub : BasePublic) (bytes : Bytes)
    (he : encode pub = some bytes) (hc : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub) :
    decode bytes = some pub :=
  (decode_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mpr
    ⟨he, (PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff pub).mpr hc⟩

theorem encode_of_decode (bytes : Bytes) (pub : BasePublic)
    (h : decode bytes = some pub) : encode pub = some bytes :=
  ((decode_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mp h).1

theorem decode_canonical (bytes : Bytes) (pub : BasePublic)
    (h : decode bytes = some pub) : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub :=
  (PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff pub).mp ((decode_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mp h).2

theorem decode_index_lt (bytes : Bytes) (pub : BasePublic)
    (h : decode bytes = some pub) : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64 :=
  encode_success_bound pub bytes (encode_of_decode bytes pub h)

theorem roundtrip (pub : BasePublic) (hi : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64)
    (hc : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub) :
    ∃ bytes, encode pub = some bytes ∧ decode bytes = some pub := by
  have he : encode pub = some (publicCodec.emit (⟨pub, hi⟩ : WirePublic)) := by
    simp only [encode, dif_pos hi]
  exact ⟨_, he, decode_of_encode pub _ he hc⟩

theorem parseRaw_trailing (pub : WirePublic) (rest : Bytes) (hne : rest ≠ []) :
    parseRaw (publicCodec.emit pub ++ rest) = none := by
  rw [parseRaw_emit_suffix, if_neg hne]

theorem decode_trailing (pub : WirePublic) (rest : Bytes) (hne : rest ≠ []) :
    decode (publicCodec.emit pub ++ rest) = none := by
  simp [decode, parseRaw_trailing pub rest hne]

theorem parseRaw_strict_prefix (pub : WirePublic) (preBytes suffix : Bytes)
    (he : publicCodec.emit pub = preBytes ++ suffix) (hne : suffix ≠ []) :
    parseRaw preBytes = none := by
  cases hr : parseRaw preBytes with
  | none => rfl
  | some q =>
      have hq := (parseRaw_eq_some_iff preBytes q).mp hr
      have hi := encode_success_bound q preBytes hq
      let wq : WirePublic := ⟨q, hi⟩
      have heq : publicCodec.emit wq = preBytes := by
        simpa only [encode, dif_pos hi, Option.some.injEq] using hq
      have hp : publicCodec.parse (publicCodec.emit pub) = some (pub, []) := by
        simpa using public_lawful.round pub []
      have hqp : publicCodec.parse (publicCodec.emit pub) = some (wq, suffix) := by
        rw [he, ← heq]
        exact public_lawful.round wq suffix
      have hs : (pub, []) = (wq, suffix) := Option.some.inj (hp.symm.trans hqp)
      exact False.elim (hne (congrArg Prod.snd hs).symm)

theorem parseRaw_truncated (pub : WirePublic) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n < (publicCodec.emit pub).length) :
    parseRaw ((publicCodec.emit pub).take n) = none := by
  apply parseRaw_strict_prefix pub _ ((publicCodec.emit pub).drop n)
    (List.take_append_drop n (publicCodec.emit pub)).symm
  intro hz
  have hl := congrArg List.length hz
  simp only [List.length_drop, List.length_nil] at hl
  omega

theorem decode_truncated (pub : WirePublic) (n : Nat)
    (hn : n < (publicCodec.emit pub).length) :
    decode ((publicCodec.emit pub).take n) = none := by
  simp [decode, parseRaw_truncated pub n hn]

theorem parseRaw_bad_variant (tag : Byte) (tail : Bytes)
    (h0 : tag ≠ 0) (h1 : tag ≠ 1) : parseRaw (tag :: tail) = none := by
  have hb := variant_invalid_tag tag tail h0 h1
  simp [parseRaw, publicCodec, PrefixCodec.transport, fieldsCodec, PrefixCodec.pair, hb]

theorem parseRaw_bad_recipient_tag
    (v : Variant) (anchor nullifier : Digest M31Exact) (asset : M31Exact)
    (tag : Byte) (tail : Bytes) (h0 : tag ≠ 0) (h1 : tag ≠ 1) :
    parseRaw (variantCodec.emit v ++ digestCodec.emit anchor ++
      digestCodec.emit nullifier ++ m31Codec.emit asset ++ (tag :: tail)) = none := by
  have hb := PrefixCodec.option_invalid_tag digestCodec tag tail h0 h1
  simp [parseRaw, publicCodec, PrefixCodec.transport, fieldsCodec, PrefixCodec.pair,
    List.append_assoc, variant_lawful.round, digest_lawful.round, m31_lawful.round, hb]

theorem parseRaw_bad_amount_tag
    (v : Variant) (anchor nullifier : Digest M31Exact) (asset : M31Exact)
    (recipient : Option (Digest M31Exact)) (change : Digest M31Exact)
    (tag : Byte) (tail : Bytes) (h0 : tag ≠ 0) (h1 : tag ≠ 1) :
    parseRaw (variantCodec.emit v ++ digestCodec.emit anchor ++
      digestCodec.emit nullifier ++ m31Codec.emit asset ++
      (PrefixCodec.option digestCodec).emit recipient ++ digestCodec.emit change ++
      (tag :: tail)) = none := by
  have ho := PrefixCodec.option_lawful digestCodec digest_lawful
  have hb := PrefixCodec.option_invalid_tag m31Codec tag tail h0 h1
  simp [parseRaw, publicCodec, PrefixCodec.transport, fieldsCodec, PrefixCodec.pair,
    List.append_assoc, variant_lawful.round, digest_lawful.round, m31_lawful.round,
    ho.round, hb]

theorem decode_zero_withdrawal (bytes : Bytes) (pub : BasePublic)
    (hp : parseRaw bytes = some pub) (hv : pub.variant = .withdrawal)
    (ha : pub.withdrawalAmount = some 0) : decode bytes = none := by
  have hc : PublicOptionShape.check pub = false := by
    simp [PublicOptionShape.check, hv, ha]
  simp [decode, hp, hc]

theorem encode_unique (bytes : Bytes) (p q : BasePublic)
    (hp : encode p = some bytes) (hq : encode q = some bytes) : p = q := by
  have h1 := (parseRaw_eq_some_iff bytes p).mpr hp
  have h2 := (parseRaw_eq_some_iff bytes q).mpr hq
  exact Option.some.inj (h1.symm.trans h2)

#print axioms PrefixCodec.fixed_lawful
#print axioms PrefixCodec.pair_lawful
#print axioms PrefixCodec.transport_lawful
#print axioms PrefixCodec.option_lawful
#print axioms u32_lawful
#print axioms u64_lawful
#print axioms digest_lawful
#print axioms frontier_lawful
#print axioms public_lawful
#print axioms parseRaw_eq_some_iff
#print axioms decode_eq_some_iff
#print axioms roundtrip
#print axioms parseRaw_trailing
#print axioms parseRaw_truncated
#print axioms parseRaw_bad_variant
#print axioms parseRaw_bad_recipient_tag
#print axioms parseRaw_bad_amount_tag
#print axioms decode_zero_withdrawal
#print axioms encode_unique
end AspisR1.PublicByteCodec
R1SemanticPublicByteBinding:
import R1SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip
import R1SemanticPublicWireSound
import R1SemanticPublicWireInjective

/-! Model-level binding of the complete section-9 semantic public bytes.
This does not identify an ASF8 decoder or the Rust serializer with the model. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPublicByteBinding
open SemanticPublicWire

theorem parsed_wire (bytes : List Byte) (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (h : parsePublic bytes = some pub) :
    ∃ wire, decode bytes = some wire ∧ toPublic wire = pub := by
  cases hd : decode bytes with
  | none => simp [parsePublic, hd] at h
  | some wire =>
      simp only [parsePublic, hd] at h
      change (if PublicOptionShape.check (toPublic wire) = true
        then some (toPublic wire) else none) = some pub at h
      split at h
      next hc => exact ⟨wire, rfl, Option.some.inj h⟩
      next hc => contradiction

theorem parsed_index_bound (bytes : List Byte) (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (h : parsePublic bytes = some pub) : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64 := by
  obtain ⟨wire, _, hw⟩ := parsed_wire bytes pub h
  rw [← hw]
  exact toPublic_index_bound wire

theorem parsed_exact_bytes (bytes : List Byte) (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (h : parsePublic bytes = some pub) :
    ∃ wire, toPublic wire = pub ∧ encode wire = bytes := by
  obtain ⟨wire, hd, hw⟩ := parsed_wire bytes pub h
  exact ⟨wire, hw, SemanticPublicWireSound.encode_of_decode bytes wire hd⟩

theorem bytes_unique (left right : List Byte) (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (hl : parsePublic left = some pub) (hr : parsePublic right = some pub) :
    left = right := by
  obtain ⟨wl, hpl, hel⟩ := parsed_exact_bytes left pub hl
  obtain ⟨wr, hpr, her⟩ := parsed_exact_bytes right pub hr
  have hw : wl = wr := SemanticPublicWireInjective.toPublic_injective (hpl.trans hpr.symm)
  exact hel.symm.trans ((congrArg encode hw).trans her)

theorem parsed_length (bytes : List Byte) (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (h : parsePublic bytes = some pub) :
    bytes.length = if pub.variant = .privateTransfer then 1455 else 1427 := by
  obtain ⟨wire, hp, he⟩ := parsed_exact_bytes bytes pub h
  rw [← he, ← hp, SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.encode_length]
  cases wire <;> simp [toPublic]

#print axioms parsed_wire
#print axioms parsed_index_bound
#print axioms parsed_exact_bytes
#print axioms bytes_unique
#print axioms parsed_length
end AspisR1.SemanticPublicByteBinding
R1SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip:
import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! Round trips for the mathematical section-9 wire model. These facts do not
establish a Rust/source or account-binding correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip

open AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire

private theorem readDigest_append (d : SemanticPublicWire.Digest)
    (tail : List SemanticPublicWire.Byte) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read 32 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest
      (PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest d ++ tail) = some (d, tail) :=
  AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read_encoded 32 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest d tail
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_length
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest_encodeDigest

private theorem readField_append (x : SemanticPublicWire.M31)
    (tail : List SemanticPublicWire.Byte) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read 4 ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31
      (ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 x ++ tail) = some (x, tail) :=
  AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read_encoded 4 ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 x tail ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31_encodeM31

private theorem readIndex_append (i : PublicIndexCodec.Index)
    (tail : List SemanticPublicWire.Byte) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read 8 PublicIndexListCodec.decode
      (PublicIndexListCodec.encode i ++ tail) = some (i, tail) :=
  AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read_encoded 8 PublicIndexListCodec.decode
    PublicIndexListCodec.encode i tail PublicIndexListCodec.encode_length8
    PublicIndexListCodec.decode_encode

private theorem readFrontier_append (f : SemanticPublicWire.Frontier)
    (tail : List SemanticPublicWire.Byte) :
    AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read 640 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier
      (PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier f ++ tail) = some (f, tail) :=
  AspisR1.PublicByteCursor.read_encoded 640 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier f tail
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier_length
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier_encodeFrontier

private theorem decodeAfter_afterBytes (c : Common) :
    SemanticPublicWire.decodeAfter c.anchor c.nullifier c.assetId c.change
      (SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes c) = some c := by
  have hlast : PublicByteCursor.read 640 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier
      (PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier c.nextFrontier) = some (c.nextFrontier, []) := by
    simpa only [List.append_nil] using readFrontier_append c.nextFrontier []
  simp [SemanticPublicWire.decodeAfter, SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes,
    SemanticPublicWire.readIndex, SemanticPublicWire.readFrontier,
    SemanticPublicWire.readDigest,
    List.append_assoc, readIndex_append,
    readFrontier_append, readDigest_append, hlast]

private theorem decodeTransfer_encoded (c : Common) (recipient : Digest) :
    SemanticPublicWire.decodeTransfer
      (SemanticPublicWire.header c ++ [1] ++
        PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest recipient ++
        PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change ++ [0] ++
        SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes c) = some (.transfer c recipient) := by
  simp [SemanticPublicWire.decodeTransfer, SemanticPublicWire.header,
    SemanticPublicWire.readDigest, SemanticPublicWire.readField,
    List.append_assoc, readDigest_append, readField_append,
    decodeAfter_afterBytes, SemanticPublicWire.expect]

private theorem decodeWithdrawal_encoded (c : Common) (amount : M31) :
    SemanticPublicWire.decodeWithdrawal
      (SemanticPublicWire.header c ++ [0] ++
        PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change ++ [1] ++
        ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 amount ++ SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes c) =
      some (.withdrawal c amount) := by
  simp [SemanticPublicWire.decodeWithdrawal, SemanticPublicWire.header,
    SemanticPublicWire.readDigest, SemanticPublicWire.readField,
    List.append_assoc, readDigest_append, readField_append,
    decodeAfter_afterBytes, SemanticPublicWire.expect]

theorem decode_encode (wire : Wire) : SemanticPublicWire.decode (encode wire) = some wire := by
  cases wire with
  | transfer c recipient =>
      simpa only [SemanticPublicWire.encode, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
        SemanticPublicWire.decode, if_pos, Fin.zero_ne_one, if_false] using
        decodeTransfer_encoded c recipient
  | withdrawal c amount =>
      simpa only [SemanticPublicWire.encode, List.singleton_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,
        SemanticPublicWire.decode, if_pos, show (1 : Byte) ≠ 0 by decide, if_false] using
        decodeWithdrawal_encoded c amount

private theorem header_length (c : Common) :
    (SemanticPublicWire.header c).length = 68 := by
  simp [SemanticPublicWire.header, PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_length,
    ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length]

private theorem afterBytes_length (c : Common) :
    (SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes c).length = 1320 := by
  simp [SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes, PublicIndexListCodec.encode_length8,
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier_length,
    PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_length]

theorem encode_length (wire : Wire) :
    (encode wire).length =
      match wire with
      | .transfer _ _ => 1455
      | .withdrawal _ _ => 1427 := by
  cases wire with
  | transfer c recipient =>
      simp [SemanticPublicWire.encode, header_length, afterBytes_length,
        PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_length]
  | withdrawal c amount =>
      simp [SemanticPublicWire.encode, header_length, afterBytes_length,
        PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_length,
        ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_length]

theorem parsePublic_encode (wire : Wire)
    (hcanonical : PublicOptionShape.canonical (toPublic wire)) :
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (encode wire) = some (toPublic wire) := by
  have hcheck : PublicOptionShape.check (toPublic wire) = true :=
    (PublicOptionShape.check_eq_true_iff (toPublic wire)).2 hcanonical
  simp [SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic, decode_encode, hcheck]

end AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip

#print axioms AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.decode_encode
#print axioms AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.encode_length
#print axioms AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireRoundTrip.parsePublic_encode
R1SemanticPublicWireSound:
import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! A successful mathematical wire decode reconstructs the exact input list.
The theorem is about the Lean codec only; source-parser correspondence is a
separate obligation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireSound

open AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire

private theorem expect_sound (tag : Byte) (bytes rest : List Byte)
    (h : expect tag bytes = some rest) : bytes = tag :: rest := by
  cases bytes with
  | nil => simp [expect] at h
  | cons head tail =>
      by_cases hh : head = tag
      · simp [expect, hh] at h
        subst head
        subst rest
        rfl
      · simp [expect, hh] at h

theorem decodeAfter_sound (anchor nullifier : Digest) (assetId : M31)
    (change : Digest) (bytes : List Byte) (c : Common)
    (h : decodeAfter anchor nullifier assetId change bytes = some c) :
    c.anchor = anchor ∧ c.nullifier = nullifier ∧ c.assetId = assetId ∧
      c.change = change ∧ bytes = afterBytes c := by
  unfold decodeAfter at h
  cases hi : readIndex bytes with
  | none => simp [hi] at h
  | some ip =>
      rcases ip with ⟨index, rest1⟩
      simp [hi] at h
      cases hs : readFrontier rest1 with
      | none => simp [hs] at h
      | some sp =>
          rcases sp with ⟨snapshot, rest2⟩
          simp [hs] at h
          cases hr : readDigest rest2 with
          | none => simp [hr] at h
          | some rp =>
              rcases rp with ⟨root, rest3⟩
              simp [hr] at h
              cases hf : readFrontier rest3 with
              | none => simp [hf] at h
              | some fp =>
                  rcases fp with ⟨frontier, rest4⟩
                  simp [hf] at h
                  cases rest4 with
                  | nil =>
                      simp at h
                      have hc : c = ⟨anchor, nullifier, assetId, change,
                          index, snapshot, root, frontier⟩ := h.symm
                      have hiBytes : bytes = PublicIndexListCodec.encode index ++ rest1 :=
                        PublicByteCursor.read_sound 8 PublicIndexListCodec.decode
                          PublicIndexListCodec.encode bytes index rest1
                          (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicIndexListCodec.encode_of_decode bs x hx)
                          hi
                      have hsBytes : rest1 = PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier snapshot ++ rest2 :=
                        PublicByteCursor.read_sound 640 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier
                          PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier rest1 snapshot rest2
                          (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier_of_decodeFrontier bs x hx)
                          hs
                      have hrBytes : rest2 = PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest root ++ rest3 :=
                        PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest
                          PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest rest2 root rest3
                          (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx)
                          hr
                      have hfBytes : rest3 = PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier frontier ++ [] :=
                        PublicByteCursor.read_sound 640 PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeFrontier
                          PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier rest3 frontier []
                          (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier_of_decodeFrontier bs x hx)
                          hf
                      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
                      · simpa [hc] using (show anchor = anchor from rfl).symm
                      · simpa [hc] using (show nullifier = nullifier from rfl).symm
                      · simpa [hc] using (show assetId = assetId from rfl).symm
                      · simpa [hc] using (show change = change from rfl).symm
                      · rw [hiBytes, hsBytes, hrBytes, hfBytes]
                        simp [afterBytes, hc, List.append_assoc]
                  | cons byte tail => simp at h

private theorem decodeTransfer_sound (bytes : List Byte) (wire : Wire)
    (h : decodeTransfer bytes = some wire) :
    ∃ c recipient, wire = .transfer c recipient ∧ encode wire = 0 :: bytes := by
  unfold decodeTransfer at h
  cases ha : readDigest bytes with
  | none => simp [ha] at h
  | some ap =>
      rcases ap with ⟨anchor, rest1⟩
      simp [ha] at h
      cases hn : readDigest rest1 with
      | none => simp [hn] at h
      | some np =>
          rcases np with ⟨nullifier, rest2⟩
          simp [hn] at h
          cases hx : readField rest2 with
          | none => simp [hx] at h
          | some xp =>
              rcases xp with ⟨asset, rest3⟩
              simp [hx] at h
              cases ht : expect 1 rest3 with
              | none => simp [ht] at h
              | some rest4 =>
                  simp [ht] at h
                  cases hr : readDigest rest4 with
                  | none => simp [hr] at h
                  | some rp =>
                      rcases rp with ⟨recipientRead, rest5⟩
                      simp [hr] at h
                      cases hc : readDigest rest5 with
                      | none => simp [hc] at h
                      | some cp =>
                          rcases cp with ⟨changeRead, rest6⟩
                          simp [hc] at h
                          cases hz : expect 0 rest6 with
                          | none => simp [hz] at h
                          | some rest7 =>
                              simp [hz] at h
                              cases haft : decodeAfter anchor nullifier asset changeRead rest7 with
                              | none => simp [haft] at h
                              | some decoded =>
                                  simp [haft] at h
                                  cases wire with
                                  | transfer c recipient =>
                                    have hparts : decoded = c ∧ recipientRead = recipient := by
                                      simpa using h
                                    rcases hparts with ⟨hdecoded, hrecipient⟩
                                    subst decoded
                                    subst recipientRead
                                    rcases decodeAfter_sound anchor nullifier asset changeRead rest7 c haft with
                                      ⟨hanchor, hnullifier, hasset, hchange, hafter⟩
                                    have hAnchorBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      bytes anchor rest1
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) ha
                                    have hNullifierBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      rest1 nullifier rest2
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) hn
                                    have hAssetBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 4
                                      ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31
                                      rest2 asset rest3
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_of_decodeM31 bs x hx) hx
                                    have hRecipientBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      rest4 recipient rest5
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) hr
                                    have hChangeBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      rest5 changeRead rest6
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) hc
                                    have hSep1 : rest3 = 1 :: rest4 := expect_sound 1 rest3 rest4 ht
                                    have hSep0 : rest6 = 0 :: rest7 := expect_sound 0 rest6 rest7 hz
                                    have hrest : bytes = header c ++ [1] ++
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest recipient ++
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change ++ [0] ++ afterBytes c := by
                                      rw [hAnchorBytes, hNullifierBytes, hAssetBytes, hSep1,
                                        hRecipientBytes, hChangeBytes, hSep0, hafter]
                                      rw [← hanchor, ← hnullifier, ← hasset, ← hchange]
                                      simp only [header, List.append_assoc]
                                      simp only [List.singleton_append]
                                    refine ⟨c, recipient, rfl, ?_⟩
                                    simpa [encode] using
                                      (congrArg (fun xs : List Byte => 0 :: xs) hrest).symm
                                  | withdrawal c amount => cases h

private theorem decodeWithdrawal_sound (bytes : List Byte) (wire : Wire)
    (h : decodeWithdrawal bytes = some wire) :
    ∃ c amount, wire = .withdrawal c amount ∧ encode wire = 1 :: bytes := by
  unfold decodeWithdrawal at h
  cases ha : readDigest bytes with
  | none => simp [ha] at h
  | some ap =>
      rcases ap with ⟨anchor, rest1⟩
      simp [ha] at h
      cases hn : readDigest rest1 with
      | none => simp [hn] at h
      | some np =>
          rcases np with ⟨nullifier, rest2⟩
          simp [hn] at h
          cases hx : readField rest2 with
          | none => simp [hx] at h
          | some xp =>
              rcases xp with ⟨asset, rest3⟩
              simp [hx] at h
              cases hz : expect 0 rest3 with
              | none => simp [hz] at h
              | some rest4 =>
                  simp [hz] at h
                  cases hc : readDigest rest4 with
                  | none => simp [hc] at h
                  | some cp =>
                      rcases cp with ⟨changeRead, rest5⟩
                      simp [hc] at h
                      cases ht : expect 1 rest5 with
                      | none => simp [ht] at h
                      | some rest6 =>
                          simp [ht] at h
                          cases hm : readField rest6 with
                          | none => simp [hm] at h
                          | some mp =>
                              rcases mp with ⟨amountRead, rest7⟩
                              simp [hm] at h
                              cases haFt : decodeAfter anchor nullifier asset changeRead rest7 with
                              | none => simp [haFt] at h
                              | some decoded =>
                                  simp [haFt] at h
                                  cases wire with
                                  | withdrawal c amount =>
                                    have hparts : decoded = c ∧ amountRead = amount := by
                                      simpa using h
                                    rcases hparts with ⟨hdecoded, hamount⟩
                                    subst decoded
                                    subst amountRead
                                    rcases decodeAfter_sound anchor nullifier asset changeRead rest7 c haFt with
                                      ⟨hanchor, hnullifier, hasset, hchange, hafter⟩
                                    have hAnchorBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      bytes anchor rest1
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) ha
                                    have hNullifierBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      rest1 nullifier rest2
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) hn
                                    have hAssetBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 4
                                      ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31
                                      rest2 asset rest3
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_of_decodeM31 bs x hx) hx
                                    have hChangeBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 32
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.decodeDigest PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest
                                      rest4 changeRead rest5
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest_of_decodeDigest bs x hx) hc
                                    have hAmountBytes := PublicByteCursor.read_sound 4
                                      ExactLeafFieldCodec.decodeM31 ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31
                                      rest6 amount rest7
                                      (by intro bs x hx; exact ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31_of_decodeM31 bs x hx) hm
                                    have hSep0 : rest3 = 0 :: rest4 := expect_sound 0 rest3 rest4 hz
                                    have hSep1 : rest5 = 1 :: rest6 := expect_sound 1 rest5 rest6 ht
                                    have hrest : bytes = header c ++ [0] ++
                                      PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change ++ [1] ++
                                      ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 amount ++ afterBytes c := by
                                      rw [hAnchorBytes, hNullifierBytes, hAssetBytes, hSep0,
                                        hChangeBytes, hSep1, hAmountBytes, hafter]
                                      rw [← hanchor, ← hnullifier, ← hasset, ← hchange]
                                      simp only [header, List.append_assoc]
                                      simp only [List.singleton_append]
                                    refine ⟨c, amount, rfl, ?_⟩
                                    simpa [encode] using
                                      (congrArg (fun xs : List Byte => 1 :: xs) hrest).symm
                                  | transfer c recipient => cases h

theorem encode_of_decode (bytes : List Byte) (wire : Wire)
    (h : decode bytes = some wire) : encode wire = bytes := by
  cases bytes with
  | nil => simp [decode] at h
  | cons tag rest =>
      change (if tag = 0 then decodeTransfer rest
        else if tag = 1 then decodeWithdrawal rest else none) = some wire at h
      by_cases hzero : tag = 0
      · simp [hzero] at h
        obtain ⟨c, recipient, hwire, hbody⟩ := decodeTransfer_sound rest wire h
        rw [hwire]
        have hbody' : encode (.transfer c recipient) = 0 :: rest := by
          simpa [hwire] using hbody
        simpa [hzero] using hbody'
      · by_cases hone : tag = 1
        · simp [hone] at h
          obtain ⟨c, amount, hwire, hbody⟩ := decodeWithdrawal_sound rest wire h
          rw [hwire]
          have hbody' : encode (.withdrawal c amount) = 1 :: rest := by
            simpa [hwire] using hbody
          simpa [hzero, hone] using hbody'
        · simp [hzero, hone] at h

#print axioms decodeAfter_sound
#print axioms encode_of_decode
end AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireSound

import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! Injectivity of the semantic carrier-to-model projection.  This is a
field-preservation fact about the Lean representation; it does not identify
the carrier with a Rust parser or wire encoding. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireInjective

open AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire

private theorem transfer_common_eq {c c' : Common} {r r' : Digest}
    (h : toPublic (.transfer c r) = toPublic (.transfer c' r')) : c = c' := by
  cases c with
  | mk anchor nullifier assetId change nextPairIndex snapshotFrontier nextRoot nextFrontier =>
    cases c' with
    | mk anchor' nullifier' assetId' change' nextPairIndex' snapshotFrontier' nextRoot' nextFrontier' =>
      have hAnchor : anchor = anchor' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.anchor) h
      have hNullifier : nullifier = nullifier' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nullifier) h
      have hAsset : assetId = assetId' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.assetId) h
      have hChange : change = change' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.change) h
      have hIndexVal : nextPairIndex.val = nextPairIndex'.val := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nextPairIndex) h
      have hIndex : nextPairIndex = nextPairIndex' := Fin.ext hIndexVal
      have hSnapshot : snapshotFrontier = snapshotFrontier' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.snapshotFrontier) h
      have hRoot : nextRoot = nextRoot' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nextRoot) h
      have hFrontier : nextFrontier = nextFrontier' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nextFrontier) h
      subst anchor'
      subst nullifier'
      subst assetId'
      subst change'
      subst nextPairIndex'
      subst snapshotFrontier'
      subst nextRoot'
      subst nextFrontier'
      rfl

private theorem withdrawal_common_eq {c c' : Common} {a a' : M31}
    (h : toPublic (.withdrawal c a) = toPublic (.withdrawal c' a')) : c = c' := by
  cases c with
  | mk anchor nullifier assetId change nextPairIndex snapshotFrontier nextRoot nextFrontier =>
    cases c' with
    | mk anchor' nullifier' assetId' change' nextPairIndex' snapshotFrontier' nextRoot' nextFrontier' =>
      have hAnchor : anchor = anchor' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.anchor) h
      have hNullifier : nullifier = nullifier' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nullifier) h
      have hAsset : assetId = assetId' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.assetId) h
      have hChange : change = change' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.change) h
      have hIndexVal : nextPairIndex.val = nextPairIndex'.val := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nextPairIndex) h
      have hIndex : nextPairIndex = nextPairIndex' := Fin.ext hIndexVal
      have hSnapshot : snapshotFrontier = snapshotFrontier' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.snapshotFrontier) h
      have hRoot : nextRoot = nextRoot' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nextRoot) h
      have hFrontier : nextFrontier = nextFrontier' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.nextFrontier) h
      subst anchor'
      subst nullifier'
      subst assetId'
      subst change'
      subst nextPairIndex'
      subst snapshotFrontier'
      subst nextRoot'
      subst nextFrontier'
      rfl

theorem toPublic_injective : Function.Injective toPublic := by
  intro w w' h
  cases w with
  | transfer c recipient =>
    cases w' with
    | transfer c' recipient' =>
      have hc : c = c' := transfer_common_eq h
      have hr : recipient = recipient' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.recipient) h
      subst c'
      subst recipient'
      rfl
    | withdrawal c' amount' =>
      have hv := congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.variant) h
      simp [toPublic] at hv
  | withdrawal c amount =>
    cases w' with
    | transfer c' recipient' =>
      have hv := congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.variant) h
      simp [toPublic] at hv
    | withdrawal c' amount' =>
      have hc : c = c' := withdrawal_common_eq h
      have ha : amount = amount' := by
        simpa [toPublic] using congrArg (fun p : R0P.Public M31 => p.withdrawalAmount) h
      subst c'
      subst amount'
      rfl

#print axioms toPublic_injective
end AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireInjective
R1SemanticPublicWireSurjective:
import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! Canonical public-model records have a typed wire-carrier representative.
This constructs a model value only; it does not assert any source parser or
serializer correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireSurjective

open AspisR1.SemanticPublicWire

theorem exists_wire (pub : R0P.Public M31)
    (hc : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub)
    (hi : pub.nextPairIndex < 2^64) :
    ∃ wire : Wire, toPublic wire = pub := by
  cases pub with
  | mk variant anchor nullifier assetId recipient change withdrawalAmount
      nextPairIndex snapshotFrontier nextRoot nextFrontier =>
    cases hv : variant with
    | privateTransfer =>
        obtain ⟨recipientValue, hrecipient, hwithdrawal⟩ :=
          PublicOptionShape.private_transfer_shape _ hv hc
        change recipient = some recipientValue at hrecipient
        change withdrawalAmount = none at hwithdrawal
        subst recipient
        subst withdrawalAmount
        let common : Common := {
          anchor := anchor
          nullifier := nullifier
          assetId := assetId
          change := change
          nextPairIndex := ⟨nextPairIndex, hi⟩
          snapshotFrontier := snapshotFrontier
          nextRoot := nextRoot
          nextFrontier := nextFrontier
        }
        exact ⟨.transfer common recipientValue, by simp [toPublic, common, hv]⟩
    | withdrawal =>
        obtain ⟨amount, hnonzero, hwithdrawal, hrecipient⟩ :=
          PublicOptionShape.withdrawal_shape _ hv hc
        change withdrawalAmount = some amount at hwithdrawal
        change recipient = none at hrecipient
        subst recipient
        subst withdrawalAmount
        let common : Common := {
          anchor := anchor
          nullifier := nullifier
          assetId := assetId
          change := change
          nextPairIndex := ⟨nextPairIndex, hi⟩
          snapshotFrontier := snapshotFrontier
          nextRoot := nextRoot
          nextFrontier := nextFrontier
        }
        exact ⟨.withdrawal common amount, by simp [toPublic, common, hv]⟩

#print axioms exists_wire
end AspisR1.SemanticPublicWireSurjective

/-! Successful ASF8 decoding supplies actual same-public ASWP encoder success.
The separate semantic serializer success is explicit on the fixed nine-field
carrier and supplied transition. The parser conclusion concerns semantic bytes,
not the original ASF8 bytes; no caller/account/custody or Rust preservation
claim is made. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1 AspisR1PublicSerializer
namespace AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBridge

def toSerializer (p : CallerBridge.Public) : WithdrawalCarrier431.SerializerPublic :=
  AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.Carrier.toSerializer (CallerBridge.toCaller p)

def projectRaw (p : CallerBridge.Public) (t : Whole431.Transition) :
    PublicSourceRaw.Public :=
  AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.CallerPublic.projectRaw (CallerBridge.toCaller p) t

theorem decoder_serializer_parsePublic
    (asf8 : Slice U8)
    (c : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1)
    (p : CallerBridge.Public) (t : Whole431.Transition)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hd : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      asf8 = ok (.Ok (.Withdrawal c p)))
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes

      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  obtain ⟨pay, he⟩ := CallerBridge.decoder_success_encoder asf8 c p hd
  exact AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.CallerPublic.encoder_serializer_parsePublic
    (CallerBridge.toCaller p) pay t semantic he hs

import ExtractedWithdrawalCallerSuccess
import ExtractedDecoderWithdrawalSuccess

/-! Fixed all-nine-field transport between the actual decoder extraction and
the standalone ASWP extraction. The original generated computations are related
without assuming validator or encoder agreement. Caller reachability, accounts,
and the separate semantic serializer remain outside this statement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1TerminalDecoder.CallerBridge
abbrev Public := AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev CallerPublic := AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev DecoderError := AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError
abbrev CallerError := AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError

def toCaller (p : Public) : CallerPublic :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id
    amount := p.amount
    destination_token_account := p.destination_token_account
    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

def fromCaller (p : CallerPublic) : Public :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id
    amount := p.amount
    destination_token_account := p.destination_token_account
    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

theorem from_to (p : Public) : fromCaller (toCaller p) = p := by cases p; rfl
theorem to_from (p : CallerPublic) : toCaller (fromCaller p) = p := by cases p; rfl

def toError : DecoderError → CallerError
  | .WrongLength => .WrongLength
  | .WrongMagic => .WrongMagic
  | .WrongVersion => .WrongVersion
  | .WrongTransitionKind => .WrongTransitionKind
  | .WrongDigestEncoding => .WrongDigestEncoding
  | .NonZeroReserved => .NonZeroReserved
  | .ZeroRequiredBinding => .ZeroRequiredBinding
  | .InvalidAnchorSequence => .InvalidAnchorSequence
  | .NonCanonicalDigest => .NonCanonicalDigest
  | .NonCanonicalAssetId => .NonCanonicalAssetId
  | .InvalidWithdrawalAmount => .InvalidWithdrawalAmount
  | .InvalidDestination => .InvalidDestination
  | .InvalidEnvelope => .InvalidEnvelope
  | .EnvelopeMismatch => .EnvelopeMismatch

def mapOutcome {α : Type} : Result (core.result.Result α DecoderError) →
    Result (core.result.Result α CallerError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok a)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (toError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

private theorem map_bind {α β : Type} (m : Result α)
    (k : α → Result (core.result.Result β DecoderError)) :
    mapOutcome (do let a ← m; k a) = (do let a ← m; mapOutcome (k a)) := by
  cases m <;> rfl

private theorem bind_congr {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k l : α → Result β)
    (h : ∀ x, k x = l x) :
    (do let x ← m; k x) = (do let x ← m; l x) := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact h x
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl

private theorem bind_pair_congr {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k l : α × β → Result γ) (h : ∀ a b, k (a, b) = l (a, b)) :
    (do let x ← m; k x) = (do let x ← m; l x) := by
  apply bind_congr
  intro x
  cases x with
  | mk a b => exact h a b

private theorem map_ite {α : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p]
    (x y : Result (core.result.Result α DecoderError)) :
    mapOutcome (if p then x else y) = if p then mapOutcome x else mapOutcome y := by
  split <;> rfl

private theorem map_ok {α : Type} (a : α) :
    mapOutcome (ok (.Ok a)) = ok (.Ok a) := rfl

private theorem map_err {α : Type} (e : DecoderError) :
    mapOutcome (ok (core.result.Result.Err (T := α) e)) = ok (.Err (toError e)) := rfl

def toCommon (p : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1) :
    AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1 :=
  { pool := p.pool, deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain,
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence, anchor_root := p.anchor_root,
    nullifier := p.nullifier, asset_id := p.asset_id }

theorem digest_eq (d : Array U32 8#usize) :

/-- ASWP success supplies the actual payment-helper success required by the
existing extracted serializer-to-live-parser bridge. -/
theorem encoder_serializer_parsePublic
    (p : Carrier.Public) (aswp : Array U8 216#usize)
    (t : Whole431.Transition) (out : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (he : pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 p =

    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes

      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (out.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =

  exact ExtractedPublicCheckedBridge432.validated_source_parsePublic
    (Carrier.toSerializer p) t out (Carrier.encoder_success_helper p aswp he) hs

/-- This equality is the remaining binding obligation for a separately supplied
public. It is not inferred from encoder success or from the ASWP bytes. -/
theorem encoder_serializer_supplied_public
    (p : Carrier.Public) (aswp : Array U8 216#usize)
    (t : Whole431.Transition) (out : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (he : pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 p =
      ok (.Ok aswp))
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (.Withdrawal (Carrier.toSerializer p) t) = ok (.Ok out))
    (wire : SemanticPublicWire.Wire)
    (hw : PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw p t) = some wire)
    (supplied : R0P.Public SemanticPublicWire.M31)

    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (out.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) = some supplied := by

  have hwire : wire' = wire := Option.some.inj (hw'.symm.trans hw)
  rw [hwire, ← hbind] at hp
  exact hp

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.Carrier

    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id

    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

theorem from_to (p : Public) : fromValidator (toValidator p) = p := by cases p; rfl
theorem to_from (p : ValidationPublic) : toValidator (fromValidator p) = p := by cases p; rfl

def toSerializer (p : Public) : AspisR1PublicSerializer.WithdrawalCarrier431.SerializerPublic := AspisR1PublicSerializer.WithdrawalCarrier431.fromValidator (toValidator p)

theorem serializer_validator (p : Public) : AspisR1PublicSerializer.WithdrawalCarrier431.toValidator (toSerializer p) = toValidator p :=

def toError : CallerError → ValidationError
  | .WrongLength => .WrongLength
  | .WrongMagic => .WrongMagic
  | .WrongVersion => .WrongVersion
  | .WrongTransitionKind => .WrongTransitionKind
  | .WrongDigestEncoding => .WrongDigestEncoding
  | .NonZeroReserved => .NonZeroReserved
  | .ZeroRequiredBinding => .ZeroRequiredBinding
  | .InvalidAnchorSequence => .InvalidAnchorSequence
  | .NonCanonicalDigest => .NonCanonicalDigest

  | .InvalidWithdrawalAmount => .InvalidWithdrawalAmount
  | .InvalidDestination => .InvalidDestination

def mapOutcome {α : Type} : Result (core.result.Result α CallerError) →
    Result (core.result.Result α ValidationError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok a)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (toError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

private theorem map_bind {α β : Type} (m : Result α)

    mapOutcome (do let a ← m; k a) = (do let a ← m; mapOutcome (k a)) := by
  cases m <;> rfl

private theorem map_ite {α : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p]
    (x y : Result (core.result.Result α CallerError)) :
    mapOutcome (if p then x else y) = if p then mapOutcome x else mapOutcome y := by
  split <;> rfl

private theorem map_ok {α : Type} (a : α) :
    mapOutcome (ok (.Ok a)) = ok (.Ok a) := rfl

private theorem map_err {α : Type} (e : CallerError) :

    AspisR1WithdrawalCaller.pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1
