/-! Fixed fieldwise projection from the actual extracted source carriers to
PublicRawCore, with successful byte agreement. This is a Lean 4.31 theorem;
checking the shared core separately under 4.32 does not merge the kernels or
supply a Rust runtime/extraction theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1

namespace AspisR1PublicSerializer.RawBridge431
open FieldsRefinement431
open Whole431

def rawByte (x : Std.U8) : PublicRawCore.Byte := x.bv.toFin

def rawWord (x : Field) : PublicRawCore.Word := x.bv.toFin

def rawIndex (x : Std.U64) : PublicRawCore.Index := x.bv.toFin

def projectDigest (d : Array Field 8#usize) : PublicRawCore.Digest := fun i =>
  rawWord (d.val[i.val]'(by simpa [d.property] using i.isLt))

def projectFrontier (f : Frontier431.Frontier) : PublicRawCore.Frontier := fun l =>
  projectDigest (f.val[l.val]'(by simpa [f.property] using l.isLt))

/-- The source fields copied here are fixed, including live rather than
candidate next_pair_index. Omitted source metadata is not silently bound. -/
def projectCommon (anchor nullifier : Array Field 8#usize) (asset : Field)
    (change : Array Field 8#usize) (t : Transition) : PublicRawCore.Common :=
  { anchor := projectDigest anchor
    nullifier := projectDigest nullifier
    assetId := rawWord asset
    change := projectDigest change
    nextPairIndex := rawIndex t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
    snapshotFrontier := projectFrontier t.live_snapshot.frontier
    nextRoot := projectDigest t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
    nextFrontier := projectFrontier t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier }

def project : Public → PublicRawCore.Public
  | .Transfer p t => .transfer
    (projectCommon p.anchor_root p.nullifier p.asset_id p.change_commitment t)
    (projectDigest p.recipient_commitment)
  | .Withdrawal p t => .withdrawal
    (projectCommon p.anchor_root p.nullifier p.asset_id p.change_commitment t)
    (rawWord p.amount)

theorem rawWord_val (x : Field) : (rawWord x).val = x.val := rfl

theorem rawByte_val (x : Std.U8) : (rawByte x).val = x.val := rfl

theorem rawIndex_val (x : Std.U64) : (rawIndex x).val = x.val := rfl

theorem wordBytes_agree (x : Field) :
    (wordBytes x).map rawByte = PublicRawCore.wordBytes (rawWord x) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [List.length_map, wordBytes_length, PublicRawCore.wordBytes,
      List.length_ofFn]
  · intro i hi hj
    have hi4 : i < 4 := by simpa only [List.length_map, wordBytes_length] using hi
    have cases4 : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 := by omega
    rcases cases4 with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      apply Fin.ext <;>
      simp [wordBytes, PublicRawCore.wordBytes, PublicRawCore.wordByte,
        PublicRawCore.byteMod, rawByte, rawWord, core.num.U32.to_le_bytes,
        BitVec.toLEBytes, BitVec.toNat_setWidth, BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight,
        Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] <;> omega

theorem indexBytes_agree (x : Std.U64) :
    (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes x).val.map rawByte = PublicRawCore.indexBytes (rawIndex x) := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp [core.num.U64.to_le_bytes, PublicRawCore.indexBytes]
  · intro i hi hj
    have hi8 : i < 8 := by
      simpa [core.num.U64.to_le_bytes] using hi
    have cases8 : i = 0 ∨ i = 1 ∨ i = 2 ∨ i = 3 ∨ i = 4 ∨ i = 5 ∨ i = 6 ∨ i = 7 := by
      omega
    rcases cases8 with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;>
      apply Fin.ext <;>
      simp [PublicRawCore.indexBytes, PublicRawCore.indexByte,
        PublicRawCore.lowWord, PublicRawCore.highWord, PublicRawCore.wordByte,
        PublicRawCore.byteMod, rawByte, rawIndex, core.num.U64.to_le_bytes,
        BitVec.toLEBytes, BitVec.toNat_setWidth, BitVec.toNat_ushiftRight,
        Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow] <;> omega

/-- Symbolic enumeration: no concrete digest or frontier entries are reduced. -/
theorem ofFn_map_getElem {α β : Type} (xs : List α) (n : Nat)
    (hlen : xs.length = n) (f : α → β) :
    List.ofFn (fun i : Fin n => f (xs[i.val]'(by omega))) = xs.map f := by
  subst n
  simpa only [List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using
    congrArg (List.map f) (List.ofFn_getElem (xs := xs))

theorem projectDigest_words (d : Array Field 8#usize) :
    PublicRawCore.digestWords (projectDigest d) = d.val.map rawWord := by
  exact ofFn_map_getElem d.val 8 (by simpa using d.property) rawWord

theorem rows_eq_ofFn (f : Frontier431.Frontier) :
    Frontier431.rows f = List.ofFn (Frontier431.row f) := by
  simp only [Frontier431.rows, List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero]
  rfl

theorem frontierWords_agree (f : Frontier431.Frontier) :
    ((Frontier431.rows f).flatMap (fun s => s.val)).map rawWord =
      PublicRawCore.frontierWords (projectFrontier f) := by
  rw [rows_eq_ofFn, List.map_flatMap]
  simp only [PublicRawCore.frontierWords, List.flatMap_def, List.map_ofFn,
    Function.comp_def]
  apply congrArg List.flatten
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  exact (projectDigest_words (f.val[i.val]'(by simpa [f.property] using i.isLt))).symm

theorem encodeWords_agree (xs : List Field) :
    (encodeWords xs).map rawByte = PublicRawCore.encodeWords (xs.map rawWord) := by
  simp only [encodeWords, PublicRawCore.encodeWords, List.map_flatMap, List.flatMap_map]
  exact congrArg (fun f => xs.flatMap f) (funext wordBytes_agree)

theorem core_encodeWords_append (xs ys : List PublicRawCore.Word) :
    PublicRawCore.encodeWords (xs ++ ys) =
      PublicRawCore.encodeWords xs ++ PublicRawCore.encodeWords ys := by
  exact List.flatMap_append

theorem rawByte_zero : rawByte 0#u8 = (0 : PublicRawCore.Byte) := rfl

theorem rawByte_one : rawByte 1#u8 = (1 : PublicRawCore.Byte) := rfl

theorem project_words (p : Public) :
    ((sourceSteps p).flatMap stepWords).map rawWord = PublicRawCore.words (project p) := by
  cases p <;>
    simp only [sourceSteps, tailSteps, stepWords, project, projectCommon,
      List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil,
      List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_nil,
      PublicRawCore.words, PublicRawCore.headerWords, PublicRawCore.afterWords,
      projectDigest_words, ← frontierWords_agree, single, Array.to_slice, Array.make,
      List.append_assoc]

theorem project_bytes (p : Public) :
    ((sourceSteps p).flatMap stepBytes).map rawByte = PublicRawCore.encode (project p) := by
  cases p <;>
    simp only [sourceSteps, tailSteps, stepBytes, project, projectCommon,
      List.flatMap_append, List.flatMap_cons, List.flatMap_nil,
      List.map_append, List.map_cons, List.map_nil, List.nil_append, List.append_nil,
      encodeWords_agree, indexBytes_agree, frontierWords_agree,
      PublicRawCore.encode, PublicRawCore.afterBytes, PublicRawCore.headerWords,
      PublicRawCore.afterWords, core_encodeWords_append, projectDigest_words,
      single, Array.to_slice, Array.make, rawByte_zero, rawByte_one, List.append_assoc]

/-- Actual extracted success refines the fixed pure raw serializer. No field is
chosen from the output and no allocation/capacity premise is added. -/
theorem source_success_raw (p : Public) (out : ByteVec)
    (h : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes p = ok (.Ok out)) :
    PublicRawCore.serialize (project p) = some (out.val.map rawByte) := by
  have hs := Whole431.source_success p out h
  have hc : PublicRawCore.Canonical (project p) := by
    intro x hx
    rw [← project_words] at hx
    obtain ⟨y, hy, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hx
    exact hs.1 y hy
  have hb : out.val.map rawByte = PublicRawCore.encode (project p) := by
    rw [hs.2]
    exact project_bytes p
  simp only [PublicRawCore.serialize, if_pos hc, hb]

/-- This relation names the extracted Lean computation, not concrete Rust
runtime semantics. Its byte conversion and input projection are fixed above. -/
def ExtractedReturns (p : Public) (bytes : PublicRawCore.Bytes) : Prop :=
  ∃ out, pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes p = ok (.Ok out) ∧
    out.val.map rawByte = bytes

theorem extracted_refines_core (p : Public) (bytes : PublicRawCore.Bytes)
    (h : ExtractedReturns p bytes) : PublicRawCore.serialize (project p) = some bytes := by
  obtain ⟨out, hs, rfl⟩ := h
  exact source_success_raw p out hs

#print axioms indexBytes_agree

#print axioms rows_eq_ofFn
#print axioms frontierWords_agree
#print axioms encodeWords_agree
#print axioms project_words
#print axioms project_bytes

import PublicSerializerFrontier431

/-! Successful-return refinement of the actual extracted public_bytes entry.
The finite instruction list is only a factoring device: source_eq_program
connects it by equality to the generated definition for both source variants.
No Rust runtime, allocator-success or cross-toolchain integration claim. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace AspisR1PublicSerializer.Whole431
open FieldsRefinement431 Success431 Frontier431
open pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal
open pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes

abbrev Public := r0.Public
abbrev Transfer := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev Transition := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1
abbrev Output := core.result.Result ByteVec PublicError

inductive Step where
  | byte : Std.U8 → Step
  | words : Slice Field → Step
  | frontier : Frontier → Step
  | index : Std.U64 → Step

def stepWords : Step → List Field
  | .byte _ => []
  | .words s => s.val
  | .frontier f => (rows f).flatMap (fun s => s.val)
  | .index _ => []

def stepBytes : Step → List Std.U8
  | .byte b => [b]
  | .words s => encodeWords s.val
  | .frontier f => encodeWords ((rows f).flatMap (fun s => s.val))
  | .index n => (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n).val

def nextPublic (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))
    (k : ByteVec → Result Output) : Result Output := do
  let (r, out) ← m
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | .Continue _ => k out
  | .Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      ByteVec (core.convert.FromSame PublicError) residual

def program : List Step → ByteVec → Result Output
  | [], out => ok (.Ok out)
  | .byte b :: ss, out => do
    let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.push out b
    program ss out1
  | .words s :: ss, out => nextPublic (fields out s) (program ss)
  | .frontier f :: ss, out => nextPublic (frontier out f) (program ss)
  | .index n :: ss, out => do
    let out1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 out
      (Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n))
    program ss out1

theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

theorem push_success (out out' : ByteVec) (b : Std.U8)
    (h : alloc.vec.Vec.push out b = ok out') :
    out'.val = out.val ++ [b] := by
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.push at h
  dsimp only at h
  split at h
  · have heq := Result.ok.inj h
    rw [← heq]
    change out.val.concat b = out.val ++ [b]
    exact List.concat_eq_append
  · cases h

theorem nextPublic_success (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))
    (k : ByteVec → Result Output) (out' : ByteVec)
    (h : nextPublic m k = ok (.Ok out')) :
    ∃ out, m = ok (.Ok (), out) ∧ k out = ok (.Ok out') := by
  cases m with
  | fail e => simp [nextPublic] at h
  | div => simp [nextPublic] at h
  | ok r =>
    rcases r with ⟨status, out⟩
    cases status with
    | Err e =>
      simp [nextPublic, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual] at h
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      exact ⟨out, rfl, by simpa [nextPublic,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] using h⟩

theorem program_success (ss : List Step) (out out' : ByteVec)
    (h : program ss out = ok (.Ok out')) :
    canonical (ss.flatMap stepWords) ∧
      out'.val = out.val ++ ss.flatMap stepBytes := by
  induction ss generalizing out with
  | nil =>
    have heq : out = out' := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
    subst out'
    simp [canonical]
  | cons s ss ih =>
    cases s with
    | byte b =>
      obtain ⟨out1, hp, hr⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      have hb := push_success out out1 b hp
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, stepBytes, List.nil_append,
        hb, List.append_assoc] using hi
    | index n =>
      obtain ⟨out1, he, hr⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      have hb := extend_success out out1
        (Array.to_slice (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n)) he
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      change out1.val = out.val ++ (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes n).val at hb
      simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, stepBytes, List.nil_append,
        hb, List.append_assoc] using hi
    | words s =>
      obtain ⟨out1, hf, hr⟩ := nextPublic_success _ _ _ h
      have hf := fields_success out out1 s hf
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, List.mem_append] at hx
        exact hx.elim (hf.1 x) (hi.1 x)
      · simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepBytes, hf.2, List.append_assoc] using hi.2
    | frontier f =>
      obtain ⟨out1, hf, hr⟩ := nextPublic_success _ _ _ h
      have hf := frontier_success out out1 f hf
      have hi := ih out1 hr
      constructor
      · intro x hx
        simp only [List.flatMap_cons, stepWords, List.mem_append] at hx
        exact hx.elim (hf.1 x) (hi.1 x)
      · simpa only [List.flatMap_cons, stepBytes, hf.2, List.append_assoc] using hi.2

def single (x : Field) : Slice Field := Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [x])

def tailSteps (t : Transition) : List Step :=
  [.index t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index,
   .frontier t.live_snapshot.frontier,
   .words (Array.to_slice t.candidate_afterstate.next_root),
   .frontier t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier]

def sourceSteps : Public → List Step
  | .Transfer p t =>
    [.byte 0#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.anchor_root),
     .words (Array.to_slice p.nullifier), .words (single p.asset_id),
     .byte 1#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.recipient_commitment),
     .words (Array.to_slice p.change_commitment), .byte 0#u8] ++ tailSteps t
  | .Withdrawal p t =>
    [.byte 1#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.anchor_root),
     .words (Array.to_slice p.nullifier), .words (single p.asset_id),
     .byte 0#u8, .words (Array.to_slice p.change_commitment),
     .byte 1#u8, .words (single p.amount)] ++ tailSteps t

theorem source_eq_program (p : Public) :
    r0.Public.public_bytes p = program (sourceSteps p) (alloc.vec.Vec.new Std.U8) := by
  cases p <;> rfl

/-- Actual generated entry-point success determines all bytes and proves every
serialized field word canonical. There is no capacity/allocator premise. -/
theorem source_success (p : Public) (out : ByteVec)
    (h : r0.Public.public_bytes p = ok (.Ok out)) :
    canonical ((sourceSteps p).flatMap stepWords) ∧
      out.val = (sourceSteps p).flatMap stepBytes := by
  rw [source_eq_program] at h
  have hs := program_success _ _ out h
  simpa only [alloc.vec.Vec.new, List.nil_append] using hs

#print axioms bind_success
#print axioms push_success
#print axioms nextPublic_success
#print axioms program_success
#print axioms source_eq_program
#print axioms source_success

end AspisR1PublicSerializer.Whole431

/-! Composition against the actual generated twenty-row frontier function.

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow

namespace AspisR1PublicSerializer.Frontier431
open FieldsRefinement431 Success431
open pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes

abbrev Frontier := Array (Array Field 8#usize) 20#usize

def thenCheck (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))
    (k : ByteVec → Result (Status × ByteVec)) : Result (Status × ByteVec) := do
  let (r, out) ← m
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | .Continue _ => k out
  | .Break residual =>
    let r' ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      Unit (core.convert.FromSame PublicError) residual
    ok (r', out)

theorem thenCheck_success (m : Result (Status × ByteVec))
    (k : ByteVec → Result (Status × ByteVec)) (out' : ByteVec)
    (h : thenCheck m k = ok (.Ok (), out')) :
    ∃ out, m = ok (.Ok (), out) ∧ k out = ok (.Ok (), out') := by
  cases m with
  | fail e => simp [thenCheck] at h
  | div => simp [thenCheck] at h
  | ok r =>
    rcases r with ⟨status, out⟩
    cases status with
    | Err e =>
      simp [thenCheck, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame] at h
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      exact ⟨out, rfl, by simpa [thenCheck,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] using h⟩

def chain : List (Slice Field) → ByteVec → Result (Status × ByteVec)
  | [], out => ok (.Ok (), out)
  | s :: ss, out => thenCheck (fields out s) (chain ss)

theorem chain_success (ss : List (Slice Field)) (out out' : ByteVec)
    (h : chain ss out = ok (.Ok (), out')) :
    canonical (ss.flatMap (fun s => s.val)) ∧
      out'.val = out.val ++ encodeWords (ss.flatMap (fun s => s.val)) := by
  induction ss generalizing out with
  | nil =>
    have heq : out = out' := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj h)
    subst out'
    simp [canonical, encodeWords]
  | cons s ss ih =>
    obtain ⟨out1, hf, ht⟩ := thenCheck_success _ _ out' h
    have hs := fields_success out out1 s hf
    have hss := ih out1 ht
    constructor
    · intro x hx
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, List.mem_append] at hx
      exact hx.elim (hs.1 x) (hss.1 x)
    · rw [hss.2, hs.2]
      simp only [List.flatMap_cons, encodeWords, List.flatMap_append, List.append_assoc]

def row (values : Frontier) (i : Fin 20) : Slice Field :=
  Array.to_slice (values.val[i.val]'(by simpa [values.property] using i.isLt))

theorem index20 (values : Frontier) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 20) :
    Array.index_usize values i = ok (values.val[i.val]'(by
      simpa [values.property] using hi)) := by
  obtain ⟨x, hx, heq⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.index_usize_spec values i (by simpa [Array.length, values.property] using hi))
  simpa only [heq] using hx

def rows (values : Frontier) : List (Slice Field) :=
  [ row values ⟨0, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨1, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨2, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨3, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨4, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨5, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨6, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨7, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨8, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨9, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨10, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨11, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨12, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨13, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨14, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨15, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨16, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨17, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨18, by decide⟩,
    row values ⟨19, by decide⟩ ]

theorem frontier_eq_chain (out : ByteVec) (values : Frontier) :
    frontier out values = chain (rows values) out := by
  have h0 := index20 values 0#usize (by decide)
  have h1 := index20 values 1#usize (by decide)
  have h2 := index20 values 2#usize (by decide)
  have h3 := index20 values 3#usize (by decide)
  have h4 := index20 values 4#usize (by decide)
  have h5 := index20 values 5#usize (by decide)
  have h6 := index20 values 6#usize (by decide)
  have h7 := index20 values 7#usize (by decide)
  have h8 := index20 values 8#usize (by decide)
  have h9 := index20 values 9#usize (by decide)
  have h10 := index20 values 10#usize (by decide)
  have h11 := index20 values 11#usize (by decide)
  have h12 := index20 values 12#usize (by decide)
  have h13 := index20 values 13#usize (by decide)
  have h14 := index20 values 14#usize (by decide)

import Std

/-! Pure raw public serialization shared as identical source text by separate
Lean 4.31 and 4.32 checks. No Aeneas, M31 or algebra dependency. Separate checks
do not establish cross-version kernel integration or Rust runtime semantics. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PublicRawCore

abbrev Byte := Fin 256
abbrev Bytes := List Byte
abbrev Word := Fin (2 ^ 32)
abbrev Index := Fin (2 ^ 64)
abbrev Digest := Fin 8 → Word
abbrev Frontier := Fin 20 → Digest

def byteMod (n : Nat) : Byte := ⟨n % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

/-- Exactly four little-endian bytes, enumerated by a sized function. -/
def wordByte (x : Word) (i : Fin 4) : Byte :=
  byteMod (x.val / 256 ^ i.val)

def wordBytes (x : Word) : Bytes := List.ofFn (wordByte x)

def lowWord (x : Index) : Word :=
  ⟨x.val % 2 ^ 32, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩

def highWord (x : Index) : Word :=
  ⟨x.val / 2 ^ 32, by have hx := x.isLt; omega⟩

/-- Match the retained index codec's low-word/high-word split exactly. -/
def indexByte (x : Index) (i : Fin 8) : Byte :=
  if h : i.val < 4 then wordByte (lowWord x) ⟨i.val, h⟩
  else wordByte (highWord x) ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩

def indexBytes (x : Index) : Bytes := List.ofFn (indexByte x)

structure Common where
  anchor : Digest
  nullifier : Digest
  assetId : Word
  change : Digest
  nextPairIndex : Index
  snapshotFrontier : Frontier
  nextRoot : Digest
  nextFrontier : Frontier

inductive Public where
  | transfer : Common → Digest → Public
  | withdrawal : Common → Word → Public

def digestWords (d : Digest) : List Word := List.ofFn d

def frontierWords (f : Frontier) : List Word :=
  (List.ofFn f).flatMap digestWords

def headerWords (c : Common) : List Word :=
  digestWords c.anchor ++ digestWords c.nullifier ++ [c.assetId]

def afterWords (c : Common) : List Word :=
  frontierWords c.snapshotFrontier ++ digestWords c.nextRoot ++ frontierWords c.nextFrontier

/-- Serialized field words in source order; the U64 index is not an M31 word. -/
def words : Public → List Word
  | .transfer c recipient =>
    headerWords c ++ digestWords recipient ++ digestWords c.change ++ afterWords c
  | .withdrawal c amount =>
    headerWords c ++ digestWords c.change ++ [amount] ++ afterWords c

def Canonical (p : Public) : Prop := ∀ x ∈ words p, x.val < 2147483647

instance (p : Public) : Decidable (Canonical p) :=
  List.decidableBAll (fun x : Word => x.val < 2147483647) (words p)

def encodeWords (xs : List Word) : Bytes := xs.flatMap wordBytes

def afterBytes (c : Common) : Bytes :=
  indexBytes c.nextPairIndex ++ encodeWords (afterWords c)

/-- Total literal encoding; serialize adds the field-canonicality guard. -/
def encode : Public → Bytes
  | .transfer c recipient =>
    [0] ++ encodeWords (headerWords c) ++ [1] ++
      encodeWords (digestWords recipient) ++ encodeWords (digestWords c.change) ++
      [0] ++ afterBytes c
  | .withdrawal c amount =>
    [1] ++ encodeWords (headerWords c) ++ [0] ++ encodeWords (digestWords c.change) ++
      [1] ++ encodeWords [amount] ++ afterBytes c

def serialize (p : Public) : Option Bytes :=
  if Canonical p then some (encode p) else none

end AspisR1.PublicRawCore

    digest_is_canonical (Array.make 8#usize [a0, a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7]) =
      ok (decide (a0.val < 2147483647 ∧ a1.val < 2147483647 ∧

        a4.val < 2147483647 ∧ a5.val < 2147483647 ∧

  simp only [digest_is_canonical, Array.index_usize, Array.make]
  by_cases h0 : a0.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, aspis_core.field.P]
  by_cases h1 : a1.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, h1, aspis_core.field.P]
  by_cases h2 : a2.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, h1, h2, aspis_core.field.P]
  by_cases h3 : a3.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, h1, h2, h3, aspis_core.field.P]
  by_cases h4 : a4.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, aspis_core.field.P]
  by_cases h5 : a5.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, aspis_core.field.P]
  by_cases h6 : a6.val < 2147483647
  case neg => simp [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, aspis_core.field.P]
  simp [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6, aspis_core.field.P]

/-- Every coordinate of an arbitrary fixed-width digest is canonical exactly
when the actual generated predicate returns true. -/
theorem digest_success_iff (d : Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize) :
    digest_is_canonical d = ok true ↔
      ∀ a ∈ d.val, a.val < 2147483647 := by
  rcases d with ⟨xs, hlen⟩
  change xs.length = 8 at hlen
  cases xs with
  | nil => simp at hlen
  | cons a0 xs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp at hlen
      | cons a1 xs =>
          cases xs with
          | nil => simp at hlen
          | cons a2 xs =>
              cases xs with
              | nil => simp at hlen
              | cons a3 xs =>
                  cases xs with
                  | nil => simp at hlen
                  | cons a4 xs =>
                      cases xs with
                      | nil => simp at hlen
                      | cons a5 xs =>
                          cases xs with
                          | nil => simp at hlen
                          | cons a6 xs =>
                              cases xs with
                              | nil => simp at hlen
                              | cons a7 xs =>
                                  have hz : xs = [] := List.length_eq_zero_iff.mp (by simpa using hlen)
                                  subst xs
                                  change digest_is_canonical (Array.make 8#usize [a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7]) = ok true ↔ _
                                  rw [digest_make]
                                  simp

    (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨i, rfl⟩)

theorem digests_success (ds : List Digest) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : digests ds = some bytes) :
    ∀ d ∈ ds, ∀ i, fieldCanonical (d i) := by
  induction ds generalizing bytes with
  | nil => simp
  | cons d ds ih =>
      cases hd : digestBytes d with
      | none => simp [digests, hd] at h
      | some head =>
          cases ht : digests ds with
          | none => simp [digests, hd, ht] at h
          | some tail =>
              intro e he i
              rcases List.mem_cons.mp he with hed | he
              · subst e
                exact digestBytes_success d head hd i
              · exact ih tail ht e he i

theorem frontierBytes_success (f : Frontier) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : frontierBytes f = some bytes) :
    ∀ l i, fieldCanonical (f l i) := by
  intro l i
  exact digests_success (List.ofFn f) bytes h (f l)
    (List.mem_ofFn.mpr ⟨l, rfl⟩) i

theorem header_success (c : Common) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : header c = some bytes) :
    (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.anchor i)) ∧
    (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.nullifier i)) ∧ fieldCanonical c.assetId := by
  cases ha : digestBytes c.anchor with
  | none => simp [header, ha] at h
  | some anchor =>
      cases hn : digestBytes c.nullifier with
      | none => simp [header, ha, hn] at h
      | some nullifier =>
          cases hx : fields [c.assetId] with
          | none => simp [header, ha, hn, hx] at h
          | some asset =>
              exact ⟨digestBytes_success c.anchor anchor ha,
                digestBytes_success c.nullifier nullifier hn,
                fields_success [c.assetId] asset hx c.assetId (by simp)⟩

theorem afterBytes_success (c : Common) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : afterBytes c = some bytes) :
    (∀ l i, fieldCanonical (c.snapshotFrontier l i)) ∧
    (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.nextRoot i)) ∧
    (∀ l i, fieldCanonical (c.nextFrontier l i)) := by
  cases hs : frontierBytes c.snapshotFrontier with
  | none => simp [afterBytes, hs] at h
  | some snapshot =>
      cases hr : digestBytes c.nextRoot with
      | none => simp [afterBytes, hs, hr] at h
      | some root =>
          cases hn : frontierBytes c.nextFrontier with
          | none => simp [afterBytes, hs, hr, hn] at h
          | some next =>
              exact ⟨frontierBytes_success c.snapshotFrontier snapshot hs,
                digestBytes_success c.nextRoot root hr,
                frontierBytes_success c.nextFrontier next hn⟩

theorem serialize_success_canonical (p : Public) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : serialize p = some bytes) : Canonical p := by
  cases p with
  | transfer c recipient =>
      cases hh : header c with
      | none => simp [serialize, hh] at h
      | some hd =>
          cases hr : digestBytes recipient with
          | none => simp [serialize, hh, hr] at h
          | some recipientBytes =>
              cases hc : digestBytes c.change with
              | none => simp [serialize, hh, hr, hc] at h
              | some change =>
                  cases ha : afterBytes c with
                  | none => simp [serialize, hh, hr, hc, ha] at h
                  | some after =>
                      obtain ⟨hanchor, hnullifier, hasset⟩ := header_success c hd hh
                      obtain ⟨hsnapshot, hroot, hnext⟩ := afterBytes_success c after ha
                      exact ⟨⟨hanchor, hnullifier, hasset,
                        digestBytes_success c.change change hc,
                        hsnapshot, hroot, hnext⟩,
                        digestBytes_success recipient recipientBytes hr⟩
  | withdrawal c amount =>
      cases hh : header c with
      | none => simp [serialize, hh] at h
      | some hd =>
          cases hc : digestBytes c.change with
          | none => simp [serialize, hh, hc] at h
          | some change =>
              cases hm : fields [amount] with
              | none => simp [serialize, hh, hc, hm] at h
              | some amountBytes =>
                  cases ha : afterBytes c with
                  | none => simp [serialize, hh, hc, hm, ha] at h
                  | some after =>
                      obtain ⟨hanchor, hnullifier, hasset⟩ := header_success c hd hh
                      obtain ⟨hsnapshot, hroot, hnext⟩ := afterBytes_success c after ha
                      exact ⟨⟨hanchor, hnullifier, hasset,
                        digestBytes_success c.change change hc,
                        hsnapshot, hroot, hnext⟩,
                        fields_success [amount] amountBytes hm amount (by simp)⟩

theorem toWire_of_serialize (p : Public) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : serialize p = some bytes) :
    ∃ wire, toWire p = some wire ∧
      PublicByteCodec.encode (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) = some bytes := by
  have hc := serialize_success_canonical p bytes h
  have hm : toWire p = some (mapPublic p hc) := by simp [toWire, hc]
  refine ⟨mapPublic p hc, hm, ?_⟩
  exact PublicSourceRawMap.encode_of_serialize p _ bytes h ⟨_, hm, rfl⟩

theorem decode_of_serialize (p : Public) (bytes : Bytes)
    (h : serialize p = some bytes) (hn : NonzeroWithdrawal p) :
    ∃ wire, toWire p = some wire ∧
      PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  obtain ⟨wire, hw, _⟩ := toWire_of_serialize p bytes h
  exact ⟨wire, hw, PublicSourceRawMap.decode_of_serialize p _ bytes h
    ⟨wire, hw, rfl⟩ hn⟩

#print axioms serialize_success_canonical
#print axioms toWire_of_serialize
#print axioms decode_of_serialize

end AspisR1.PublicSourceRawSuccess

import R1PublicSourceRaw
import R1PublicCodecAgreement
import R1PublicByteCodecLaws

/-! Concrete raw-u32 mapping and serializer-model
agreement. No theorem in this module identifies handwritten `serialize` with
Rust execution. The source boundary is explicit in PublicSourceBoundary. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PublicSourceRawMap

open PublicSourceRaw

theorem rawField_canonical (x : M31) : fieldCanonical (rawField x) :=
  (RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv.symm x).isLt

theorem rawField_mapField (x : Word) (h : fieldCanonical x) :
    rawField (mapField x h) = x := by
  rw [rawField, mapField, RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv.symm_apply_apply]
  apply Fin.ext
  rfl

theorem rawField_zero : rawField (0 : M31) = 0 := by
  apply Fin.ext
  change (RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv.symm (0 : M31)).val = 0
  letI : NeZero RetainedFieldByteCodec.m31Modulus := ⟨by decide⟩
  exact congrArg Fin.val (map_zero RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv.symm)

theorem mapField_ne_zero (x : Word) (h : fieldCanonical x) (hn : x.val ≠ 0) :
    mapField x h ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  have hx : x = 0 := by
    simpa only [rawField_mapField, rawField_zero] using congrArg rawField hz
  exact hn (congrArg Fin.val hx)

theorem rawDigest_map (d : Digest) (h : ∀ i, fieldCanonical (d i)) :
    rawDigest (fun i => mapField (d i) (h i)) = d := by
  funext i
  exact rawField_mapField (d i) (h i)

theorem rawFrontier_map (f : Frontier) (h : ∀ l i, fieldCanonical (f l i)) :
    rawFrontier (fun l i => mapField (f l i) (h l i)) = f := by
  funext l i
  exact rawField_mapField (f l i) (h l i)

theorem rawCommon_mapCommon (c : Common) (h : commonCanonical c) :
    rawCommon (mapCommon c h) = c := by
  cases c
  simp only [rawCommon, mapCommon, rawDigest_map, rawFrontier_map, rawField_mapField]

theorem rawPublic_mapPublic (p : Public) (h : Canonical p) :
    rawPublic (mapPublic p h) = p := by
  cases p <;>
    simp only [mapPublic, rawPublic, rawCommon_mapCommon, rawDigest_map, rawField_mapField]

theorem toWire_reifies (p : Public) (wire : SemanticPublicWire.Wire)
    (h : toWire p = some wire) : rawPublic wire = p := by
  unfold toWire at h
  split at h
  next hc =>
    have hw := Option.some.inj h
    rw [← hw]
    exact rawPublic_mapPublic p hc
  next hc => simp at h

theorem wordBytes_rawField (x : M31) : wordBytes (rawField x) = ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 x :=
  rfl

theorem fields_rawFields (xs : List M31) :
    fields (xs.map rawField) = some (xs.flatMap ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp only [List.map_cons, fields, if_pos (rawField_canonical x), ih,
        Option.map_some, List.flatMap_cons, wordBytes_rawField]

theorem fields_rawField (x : M31) : fields [rawField x] = some (ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31 x) := by
  simpa using fields_rawFields [x]

theorem digestBytes_rawDigest (d : SemanticPublicWire.Digest) :
    digestBytes (rawDigest d) = some (PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest d) := by
  change fields (List.ofFn (fun i => rawField (d i))) =
    some ((List.ofFn d).flatMap ExactLeafFieldCodec.encodeM31)
  simpa only [List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using fields_rawFields (List.ofFn d)

theorem digests_rawDigests (ds : List SemanticPublicWire.Digest) :
    digests (ds.map rawDigest) = some (ds.flatMap PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest) := by
  induction ds with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d ds ih =>
      simp [digests, digestBytes_rawDigest, ih]

theorem frontierBytes_rawFrontier (f : SemanticPublicWire.Frontier) :
    frontierBytes (rawFrontier f) = some (PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeFrontier f) := by
  change digests (List.ofFn (fun l => rawDigest (f l))) =
    some ((List.ofFn f).flatMap PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest)
  simpa only [List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def] using digests_rawDigests (List.ofFn f)

theorem header_rawCommon (c : SemanticPublicWire.Common) :
    header (rawCommon c) = some (SemanticPublicWire.header c) := by
  simp [header, rawCommon, digestBytes_rawDigest, fields_rawField, SemanticPublicWire.header]

theorem afterBytes_rawCommon (c : SemanticPublicWire.Common) :
    afterBytes (rawCommon c) = some (SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes c) := by
  simp [afterBytes, rawCommon, frontierBytes_rawFrontier, digestBytes_rawDigest,
    SemanticPublicWire.afterBytes]

theorem changeBytes_rawCommon (c : SemanticPublicWire.Common) :
    digestBytes (rawCommon c).change = some (PublicFieldBlockCodec.encodeDigest c.change) :=
  digestBytes_rawDigest c.change

theorem serialize_rawPublic (wire : SemanticPublicWire.Wire) :
    serialize (rawPublic wire) = some (SemanticPublicWire.encode wire) := by
  cases wire <;> simp [serialize, rawPublic, header_rawCommon, digestBytes_rawDigest,
    fields_rawField, afterBytes_rawCommon, changeBytes_rawCommon, SemanticPublicWire.encode]

theorem serialize_of_toWire (p : Public) (wire : SemanticPublicWire.Wire)
    (h : toWire p = some wire) : serialize p = some (SemanticPublicWire.encode wire) := by
  rw [← toWire_reifies p wire h]
  exact serialize_rawPublic wire

theorem mapPublic_canonical (p : Public) (hc : Canonical p)
    (hn : NonzeroWithdrawal p) : PublicOptionShape.canonical (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic (mapPublic p hc)) := by
  cases p with
  | transfer c recipient =>
      simp [mapPublic, SemanticPublicWire.toPublic, PublicOptionShape.canonical]
  | withdrawal c amount =>
      have hm := mapField_ne_zero amount hc.2 hn
      simp [mapPublic, SemanticPublicWire.toPublic, PublicOptionShape.canonical, hm]

theorem mapped_canonical (p : Public) (wire : SemanticPublicWire.Wire)
    (h : toWire p = some wire) (hn : NonzeroWithdrawal p) :
    PublicOptionShape.canonical (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  unfold toWire at h
  split at h
  next hc =>
    have hw := Option.some.inj h
    rw [← hw]
    exact mapPublic_canonical p hc hn
  next hc => simp at h

theorem nonzero_of_payment_guard (p : Public) (h : PaymentAmountGuard p) : NonzeroWithdrawal p := by
  cases p with
  | transfer c recipient => trivial
  | withdrawal c amount => exact Nat.ne_of_gt h.1

/-- Concrete relation on every serialized coordinate, independent of bytes. -/
def RustPublicRel (source : Public) (pub : R0P.Public M31) : Prop :=
  ∃ wire, toWire source = some wire ∧ SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire = pub

theorem encode_of_serialize (source : Public) (pub : R0P.Public M31) (bytes : Bytes)
    (hser : serialize source = some bytes) (hrel : RustPublicRel source pub) :
    PublicByteCodec.encode pub = some bytes := by
  obtain ⟨wire, hmap, hpub⟩ := hrel
  have hb : SemanticPublicWire.encode wire = bytes :=
    Option.some.inj ((serialize_of_toWire source wire hmap).symm.trans hser)
  rw [← hpub, ← hb]
  exact PublicCodecAgreement.encode_toPublic_eq_wire_encode wire

theorem decode_of_serialize (source : Public) (pub : R0P.Public M31) (bytes : Bytes)
    (hser : serialize source = some bytes) (hrel : RustPublicRel source pub)
    (hn : NonzeroWithdrawal source) : PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = some pub := by
  have hc : PublicOptionShape.canonical pub := by
    obtain ⟨wire, hmap, hpub⟩ := hrel
    rw [← hpub]
    exact mapped_canonical source wire hmap hn
  exact PublicByteCodec.decode_of_encode pub bytes (encode_of_serialize source pub bytes hser hrel) hc

#print axioms rawField_mapField
#print axioms toWire_reifies
#print axioms serialize_rawPublic
#print axioms serialize_of_toWire
#print axioms mapped_canonical
#print axioms encode_of_serialize
#print axioms decode_of_serialize
end AspisR1.PublicSourceRawMap

import R1SemanticPublicWire

/-! A raw-u32 shadow of the serialized projection
of Rust `r0::Public`, with the actual field dimensions, canonical-limb guard,
and check order. This is handwritten source-facing semantics, NOT extracted
Rust. A separate source-refinement premise is required to use it for Rust.
Allocation failures, outer ASF8 parsing, and omitted Pool fields are outside
this model. Only successful source results will be transported. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PublicSourceRaw

abbrev Byte := ExactLeafFieldCodec.Byte
abbrev Bytes := List Byte
abbrev Word := RetainedFieldByteCodec.RawWord
abbrev M31 := ExactLeafFieldCodec.M31Exact
abbrev Digest := Fin 8 → Word
abbrev Frontier := Fin 20 → Digest

structure Common where
  anchor : Digest
  nullifier : Digest
  assetId : Word
  change : Digest
  nextPairIndex : PublicIndexCodec.Index
  snapshotFrontier : Frontier
  nextRoot : Digest
  nextFrontier : Frontier

/-- Source constructors fix option shape, but not withdrawal nonzero. -/
inductive Public
  | transfer (common : Common) (recipient : Digest)
  | withdrawal (common : Common) (amount : Word)

def fieldCanonical (x : Word) : Prop := x.val < RetainedFieldByteCodec.m31Modulus

def commonCanonical (c : Common) : Prop :=
  (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.anchor i)) ∧
  (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.nullifier i)) ∧ fieldCanonical c.assetId ∧
  (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.change i)) ∧
  (∀ l i, fieldCanonical (c.snapshotFrontier l i)) ∧
  (∀ i, fieldCanonical (c.nextRoot i)) ∧
  (∀ l i, fieldCanonical (c.nextFrontier l i))

def Canonical : Public → Prop
  | .transfer c recipient => commonCanonical c ∧ ∀ i, fieldCanonical (recipient i)
  | .withdrawal c amount => commonCanonical c ∧ fieldCanonical amount

instance (x : Word) : Decidable (fieldCanonical x) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (x.val < RetainedFieldByteCodec.m31Modulus))

instance (c : Common) : Decidable (commonCanonical c) := by
  unfold commonCanonical
  infer_instance

instance (p : Public) : Decidable (Canonical p) := by
  cases p <;> unfold Canonical <;> infer_instance

def mapField (x : Word) (h : fieldCanonical x) : M31 :=
  RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv ⟨x.val, h⟩

def mapCommon (c : Common) (h : commonCanonical c) : SemanticPublicWire.Common :=
  { anchor := fun i => mapField (c.anchor i) (h.1 i)
    nullifier := fun i => mapField (c.nullifier i) (h.2.1 i)
    assetId := mapField c.assetId h.2.2.1
    change := fun i => mapField (c.change i) (h.2.2.2.1 i)
    nextPairIndex := c.nextPairIndex
    snapshotFrontier := fun l i => mapField (c.snapshotFrontier l i) (h.2.2.2.2.1 l i)
    nextRoot := fun i => mapField (c.nextRoot i) (h.2.2.2.2.2.1 i)
    nextFrontier := fun l i => mapField (c.nextFrontier l i) (h.2.2.2.2.2.2 l i) }

def mapPublic (p : Public) (h : Canonical p) : SemanticPublicWire.Wire :=
  match p with
  | .transfer c recipient =>
      .transfer (mapCommon c h.1) (fun i => mapField (recipient i) (h.2 i))
  | .withdrawal c amount => .withdrawal (mapCommon c h.1) (mapField amount h.2)

/-- Executable guarded mapping; no invalid limb is silently reduced modulo P. -/
def toWire (p : Public) : Option SemanticPublicWire.Wire :=
  if h : Canonical p then some (mapPublic p h) else none

def rawField (x : M31) : Word :=
  RetainedFieldByteCodec.m31AsRawWord (RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv.symm x)

def rawDigest (d : SemanticPublicWire.Digest) : Digest := fun i => rawField (d i)

def rawFrontier (f : SemanticPublicWire.Frontier) : Frontier :=
  fun l => rawDigest (f l)

def rawCommon (c : SemanticPublicWire.Common) : Common :=
  { anchor := rawDigest c.anchor
    nullifier := rawDigest c.nullifier
    assetId := rawField c.assetId
    change := rawDigest c.change
    nextPairIndex := c.nextPairIndex
    snapshotFrontier := rawFrontier c.snapshotFrontier
    nextRoot := rawDigest c.nextRoot
    nextFrontier := rawFrontier c.nextFrontier }

def rawPublic : SemanticPublicWire.Wire → Public
  | .transfer c recipient => .transfer (rawCommon c) (rawDigest recipient)
  | .withdrawal c amount => .withdrawal (rawCommon c) (rawField amount)

def wordBytes (x : Word) : Bytes := List.ofFn (RetainedFieldByteCodec.encodeWordLE x)

/-- Source `fields` loop: reject before appending each noncanonical u32. -/
def fields : List Word → Option Bytes
  | [] => some []
  | x :: xs =>
      if fieldCanonical x then (fields xs).map (fun tail => wordBytes x ++ tail)
      else none

def digestBytes (d : Digest) : Option Bytes := fields (List.ofFn d)

/-- The source visits frontier levels in array order, then their eight limbs. -/
def digests : List Digest → Option Bytes
  | [] => some []
  | d :: ds => do
      let head ← digestBytes d
      let tail ← digests ds
      pure (head ++ tail)

def frontierBytes (f : Frontier) : Option Bytes := digests (List.ofFn f)

def header (c : Common) : Option Bytes := do
  let anchor ← digestBytes c.anchor
  let nullifier ← digestBytes c.nullifier
  let asset ← fields [c.assetId]
  pure (anchor ++ nullifier ++ asset)

def afterBytes (c : Common) : Option Bytes := do
  let snapshot ← frontierBytes c.snapshotFrontier
  let root ← digestBytes c.nextRoot
  let next ← frontierBytes c.nextFrontier
  pure (PublicIndexListCodec.encode c.nextPairIndex ++ snapshot ++ root ++ next)

/-- Allocation-free successful-result model of the literal source serializer.
Every Option.none here represents its `Error::Public` guard; it is not an
Aeneas execution result and says nothing about panic/allocation traces. -/
def serialize : Public → Option Bytes
  | .transfer c recipient => do
      let hd ← header c
      let recipientBytes ← digestBytes recipient
      let change ← digestBytes c.change
      let after ← afterBytes c
      pure ([0] ++ hd ++ [1] ++ recipientBytes ++ change ++ [0] ++ after)
  | .withdrawal c amount => do
      let hd ← header c
      let change ← digestBytes c.change
      let amountBytes ← fields [amount]
      let after ← afterBytes c
      pure ([1] ++ hd ++ [0] ++ change ++ [1] ++ amountBytes ++ after)

/-- Exactly the additional option-shape fact needed by the checked parser. -/
def NonzeroWithdrawal : Public → Prop
  | .transfer _ _ => True
  | .withdrawal _ amount => amount.val ≠ 0

/-- The amount clause of the source payment validator, not its other guards. -/
def PaymentAmountGuard : Public → Prop
  | .transfer _ _ => True
  | .withdrawal _ amount => 0 < amount.val ∧ amount.val < 2^30

#print axioms serialize
#print axioms toWire
end AspisR1.PublicSourceRaw

import R1PublicSourceRawSuccess

/-! Explicit remaining current-source boundary.
`sourceReturns` must describe a successful evaluation of the pinned current
Rust `r0::Public::public_bytes`, with its byte conversion fixed; `project`
must copy the actual source coordinates into PublicSourceRaw.Public.
Neither that semantics nor its refinement proof is supplied here.

The contracts below are propositions passed as theorem hypotheses, not
axioms or evidence that the current Rust serializer has been extracted.
They only transport successful results and make no equivalence claim about
panic/allocation/rejection traces, Pool/ASF8 parsing, or omitted metadata. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.PublicSourceBoundary

open PublicSourceRaw

variable {Source : Type}

/-- The unresolved source theorem: actual successful bytes equal this
fixed raw-u32 model's bytes. Both the source semantics and coordinate
projection must be tied to the current Rust, not chosen to fit a result. -/
def SourceSerializerRefines (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public) : Prop :=
  ∀ source bytes, sourceReturns source bytes → serialize (project source) = some bytes

/-- Only the amount consequence of actual successful source validation.
This is not a definition of validation or a proof of any other payment guard. -/
def SourceValidationAmountGuard (validated : Source → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public) : Prop :=
  ∀ source, validated source → PaymentAmountGuard (project source)

theorem mapped_of_source_success (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public)
    (hrefine : SourceSerializerRefines sourceReturns project)
    (source : Source) (bytes : Bytes) (hsource : sourceReturns source bytes) :
    ∃ wire, toWire (project source) = some wire ∧
      PublicByteCodec.encode (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) = some bytes := by
  exact PublicSourceRawSuccess.toWire_of_serialize (project source) bytes
    (hrefine source bytes hsource)

theorem encode_of_source_success (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public)
    (hrefine : SourceSerializerRefines sourceReturns project)
    (source : Source) (bytes : Bytes) (hsource : sourceReturns source bytes)
    (pub : R0P.Public M31) (hrel : PublicSourceRawMap.RustPublicRel (project source) pub) :
    PublicByteCodec.encode pub = some bytes := by
  exact PublicSourceRawMap.encode_of_serialize (project source) pub bytes
    (hrefine source bytes hsource) hrel

/-- Syntactic decoding does not require withdrawal nonzero. -/
theorem parseRaw_of_source_success (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public)
    (hrefine : SourceSerializerRefines sourceReturns project)
    (source : Source) (bytes : Bytes) (hsource : sourceReturns source bytes)
    (pub : R0P.Public M31) (hrel : PublicSourceRawMap.RustPublicRel (project source) pub) :
    PublicByteCodec.parseRaw bytes = some pub := by
  exact (PublicByteCodec.parseRaw_eq_some_iff bytes pub).mpr
    (encode_of_source_success sourceReturns project hrefine source bytes hsource pub hrel)

theorem decode_of_source_success (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public)
    (hrefine : SourceSerializerRefines sourceReturns project)
    (source : Source) (bytes : Bytes) (hsource : sourceReturns source bytes)
    (pub : R0P.Public M31) (hrel : PublicSourceRawMap.RustPublicRel (project source) pub)
    (hnonzero : NonzeroWithdrawal (project source)) :
    PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = some pub := by
  exact PublicSourceRawMap.decode_of_serialize (project source) pub bytes
    (hrefine source bytes hsource) hrel hnonzero

theorem decoded_of_source_success (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (project : Source → Public)
    (hrefine : SourceSerializerRefines sourceReturns project)
    (source : Source) (bytes : Bytes) (hsource : sourceReturns source bytes)
    (hnonzero : NonzeroWithdrawal (project source)) :
    ∃ wire, toWire (project source) = some wire ∧
      PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  exact PublicSourceRawSuccess.decode_of_serialize (project source) bytes
    (hrefine source bytes hsource) hnonzero

theorem decoded_of_validated_source_success (sourceReturns : Source → Bytes → Prop)
    (validated : Source → Prop) (project : Source → Public)
    (hrefine : SourceSerializerRefines sourceReturns project)
    (hguard : SourceValidationAmountGuard validated project)
    (source : Source) (bytes : Bytes) (hsource : sourceReturns source bytes)
    (hvalidated : validated source) :
    ∃ wire, toWire (project source) = some wire ∧
      PublicByteCodec.decode bytes = some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  exact decoded_of_source_success sourceReturns project hrefine source bytes hsource
    (PublicSourceRawMap.nonzero_of_payment_guard (project source)
      (hguard source hvalidated))

consumed by composition_parts_loop0.  The source poseidon array and copy seed

set_option autoImplicit false

/-- Exact-field image of the existing four-basis-coordinate expression. -/
def exactPack4 (v : Fin 4 → ExactQM) : ExactQM :=
  v 0 + AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.iQM * v 1 +
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.uQM * v 2 +
      (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.iQM *
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.uQM) * v 3

def exactScalarLane (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (index : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt (exactPublic public1) (exactOpenings openings)
    (fun i => pointSelector point i) index

def semanticLane24 (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (i : Fin 24) : ExactQM :=
  exactPack4 (fun k => exactScalarLane public1 openings point (4*i.val+k.val))

private theorem list_getD_map {K L : Type} [NonAssocSemiring K] [NonAssocSemiring L]
    (g : K →+* L) (xs : List K) (i : Nat) :
    g (xs.getD i 0) = (xs.map g).getD i 0 := by
  induction xs generalizing i with
  | nil => simp
  | cons x xs ih =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp
      | succ n =>
          change g (xs.getD n 0) = (xs.map g).getD n 0
          exact ih n

private theorem map_occupancyLanesLiteral {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]
    (g : K →+* L) (input output expected : K) (opened : Fin 16 → K) :
    (R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral input output expected opened).map g =
      R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral (g input) (g output) (g expected)
        (fun i => g (opened i)) := by
  simp [R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral, List.map_ofFn, Function.comp_def,
    map_add, map_sub, map_mul, map_one]

private theorem map_occupancyFamily {K L : Type} [Field K] [Field L]
    (g : K →+* L) (pub : R0P.Public K) (pub' : R0P.Public L)
    (o : R0P.Openings K) (sel : R0P.Sel K)
    (hv : pub'.variant = pub.variant) :
    ((R0P.occupancyFamily (K := K)).residuals pub o sel).map g =
      (R0P.occupancyFamily (K := L)).residuals pub' (mapOpenings g o)
        (fun i => g (sel i)) := by
  change (R0P.occupancyLanesLiteral (sel (63*16+9)) (sel (63*16+10))
      (R0P.occupancyExpected pub.variant) o.z).map g = _
  rw [map_occupancyLanesLiteral]
  have he : g (R0P.occupancyExpected pub.variant) =
      R0P.occupancyExpected pub'.variant := by
    rw [← hv]
    cases pub'.variant <;> simp [R0P.occupancyExpected]
  rw [he]
  rfl

private theorem scalarLane_map (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (index : Nat) :
    f (exactScalarLane public1 openings point index) =
      R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt
        (AspisR1.SemanticPackedSixFamilies.publicWide public1)
        (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings))
        (fun i => f (pointSelector point i)) index := by
  let pe := exactPublic public1
  let pw := AspisR1.SemanticPackedSixFamilies.publicWide public1
  let oe := exactOpenings openings
  let se : R0P.Sel ExactQM := fun i => pointSelector point i
  have hv : pw.variant = pe.variant := rfl
  have ha : pw.assetId = f pe.assetId := rfl
  have hw : pw.withdrawalAmount = pe.withdrawalAmount.map f := rfl
  have hsch := AspisR1.ScheduleFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f pe pw oe se hv
  have hocc := map_occupancyFamily f pe pw oe se hv
  have hpath := AspisR1.PathFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f pe pw oe se
  have hvalue := AspisR1.ValueFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f pe pw oe se
  have hdigest := AspisR1.DigestFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f pe oe se
  have hasset := AspisR1.AssetFamilyFieldTransport.map_family f pe pw oe se hv ha hw
  have hmapPub : AspisR1.SpendDataMap.mapPublic f pe = pw := rfl
  unfold exactScalarLane
  change f (R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt pe oe se index) = _
  unfold R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt
  by_cases h12 : index < 12
  · simp only [if_pos h12, map_add]
    rw [list_getD_map, hsch, list_getD_map, hocc]
  · simp only [if_neg h12]
    by_cases h32 : index < 32
    · simp only [if_pos h32]
      rw [list_getD_map, hsch]
    · simp only [if_neg h32]
      by_cases h49 : index < 49
      · simp only [if_pos h49]
        rw [list_getD_map, hpath]
      · simp only [if_neg h49]
        by_cases h84 : index < 84
        · simp only [if_pos h84]
          rw [list_getD_map, hvalue]
        · simp only [if_neg h84]
          by_cases h92 : index < 92
          · simp only [if_pos h92]
            rw [list_getD_map, hdigest, hmapPub]
          · simp only [if_neg h92]
            by_cases h94 : index < 94
            · simp only [if_pos h94]
              rw [list_getD_map, hasset]
            · simp only [if_neg h94, map_zero]

private theorem exactPack4_maps (v : Fin 4 → ExactQM) :
    f (exactPack4 v) = R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k => f (v k)) := by
  have hi : f AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.iBasis = PackB.i := by
    have hbase : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.iBasis =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement 1 := rfl
    rw [hbase]
    have h := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskSemanticBridgeConcrete.basisCompatible
      (1 : Fin 4)
    change f (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement 1) =
      R0P.Mask.towerBasis PackB 1 at h
    simpa [R0P.Mask.towerBasis,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement] using h
  have hu : f AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.uBasis = PackB.u := by
    have hbase : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.uBasis =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement 2 := rfl
    rw [hbase]
    have h := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskSemanticBridgeConcrete.basisCompatible
      (2 : Fin 4)
    change f (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement 2) =
      R0P.Mask.towerBasis PackB 2 at h
    simpa [R0P.Mask.towerBasis,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerBasisExact.basisElement] using h
  change f (v 0 +
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.iBasis * v 1 +
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.uBasis * v 2 +
    (AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.iBasis *
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQmPackBase4Arithmetic.uBasis) * v 3) = _
  simp only [map_add, map_mul, hi, hu, R0P.pack4]

/-- Convert any retained six-family packed equations into exact-field 24-cell
coefficients. This is reusable for arrays supplied by the preparation prelude;
it does not rerun the source loop. -/
theorem coefficients_of_packed_equations
    (semantic : Array QM 24#usize) (point : Array QM 10#usize)
    (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (hpacked : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      f (AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel.decoded semantic i) =
        R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k =>
          R0P.SemSource.scalarLaneAt
            (AspisR1.SemanticPackedSixFamilies.publicWide public1)
            (mapOpenings f (exactOpenings openings))
            (fun j => f (pointSelector point j)) (4*i.val+k.val))) :
    ∀ i : Fin 24, AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel.decoded semantic i =
      semanticLane24 public1 openings point i := by
  intro i
  have hcell := hpacked i
  have hmap : f (semanticLane24 public1 openings point i) =
      R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k => f (exactScalarLane public1 openings point
        (4*i.val+k.val))) := by
    exact exactPack4_maps (fun k => exactScalarLane public1 openings point (4*i.val+k.val))
  have hwide' : f (AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel.decoded semantic i) =
      R0P.pack4 PackB (fun k => f (exactScalarLane public1 openings point
        (4*i.val+k.val))) := by
    simpa only [exactPublic, exactOpenings, pointSelector, scalarLane_map] using hcell
  exact f.injective (hwide'.trans hmap.symm)

/-- Exact coefficient interpretation of the actual semantic_packed result.
This removes the 24-cell array-to-model premise needed by the Horner fold. -/
theorem actual_semantic_coefficients
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z) (hsucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hxor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (ha : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.anchor)
    (hn : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.nullifier)
    (hc : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.change)
    (hr : ∀ recipient, public1.recipient = some recipient → AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical recipient)
    (hsnapshot : ∀ j : Fin 20, AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (hroot : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root)
    (hfrontier : ∀ j : Fin 20, AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (hasset : public1.asset_id.val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hamount : (AspisR1.ScalarSuffixExecution.amountValue public1).val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P) :
    ∃ semantic : Array QM 24#usize,
      AspisR1SemanticPackedBoundedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_packed
        public1 openings selectors = .ok semantic ∧ CanonicalArray semantic ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 24, AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel.decoded semantic i =
        semanticLane24 public1 openings point i := by
  obtain ⟨semantic, hrun, hcan, hwide⟩ :=
    AspisR1.SemanticPackedOuterClosed.actual_semantic_packed point selectors public1 openings
      hpoint hbox hz hsucc hxor ha hn hc hr hsnapshot hroot hfrontier hasset hamount
  refine ⟨semantic, hrun, hcan, ?_⟩
  exact coefficients_of_packed_equations semantic point public1 openings hwide

/-- The combined coefficient vector retains the independently sourced first
four Poseidon lanes, the proved semantic block, and the caller's copy seed. -/
def lanesFromModels (poseidonModel : Fin 4 → ExactQM)
    (semanticLane : Fin 24 → ExactQM) (copyModel : ExactQM) : Fin 29 → ExactQM := fun i =>
  if h0 : i.val < 4 then poseidonModel ⟨i.val, h0⟩
  else if h28 : i.val < 28 then semanticLane ⟨i.val - 4, by omega⟩
  else copyModel

/-- The exact actual-source semantic coefficients remove `hsemantic` from the
old fold theorem.  The remaining poseidon/copy canonicality and source-value
facts are parameters of these actual caller outputs, not loop assumptions. -/
theorem prepared_folds_actual_semantic
    (point : Array QM 10#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (public1 : Public) (openings : Openings)
    (poseidon : Array QM 4#usize) (theta copySeed : QM)
    (poseidonModel : Fin 4 → ExactQM) (copyModel : ExactQM)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors)
    (hz : CanonicalArray openings.z) (hsucc : CanonicalArray openings.succ_z)
    (hxor : CanonicalArray openings.xor12_z)
    (ha : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.anchor)
    (hn : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.nullifier)
    (hc : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.change)
    (hr : ∀ recipient, public1.recipient = some recipient → AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical recipient)
    (hsnapshot : ∀ j : Fin 20, AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.live_snapshot.frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (hroot : AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root)
    (hfrontier : ∀ j : Fin 20, AspisR1.DigestFixedPrefix.DigestWordsCanonical
      (public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.val[j.val]'(by
        simpa [public1.transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier.property] using j.isLt)))
    (hasset : public1.asset_id.val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hamount : (AspisR1.ScalarSuffixExecution.amountValue public1).val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (htheta : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM theta)
    (hcopy : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM copySeed)
    (hposeidon : ∀ i : Fin 4, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
      (poseidon.val[i.val]'(by simpa [poseidon.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hcopyModel : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode copySeed = copyModel)
    (hposeidonModel : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
        (poseidon.val[i.val]'(by simpa [poseidon.property] using i.isLt)) =
          poseidonModel i) :
    ∃ semantic : Array QM 24#usize, ∃ prepared : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.PreparedQm31Multiplier,
      ∃ middle out : QM,
      AspisR1SemanticPackedBoundedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_packed
        public1 openings selectors = .ok semantic ∧
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new theta = .ok prepared ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.composition_parts_loop0
        (AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial.reverseRange 24#usize) semantic prepared copySeed = .ok middle ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.composition_parts_loop1
        (AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial.reverseRange 4#usize) poseidon prepared middle = .ok out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out =
        ∑ i : Fin 29, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode theta ^ i.val *
          (lanesFromModels poseidonModel (fun j => semanticLane24 public1 openings point j) copyModel) i := by
  obtain ⟨semantic, hsemanticRun, hsemanticCan, hcoeff⟩ :=
    actual_semantic_coefficients point selectors public1 openings hpoint hbox hz hsucc hxor
      ha hn hc hr hsnapshot hroot hfrontier hasset hamount
  have hsemanticCanonical := hsemanticCan
  let lane : Fin 29 → ExactQM :=
    lanesFromModels poseidonModel (fun j => semanticLane24 public1 openings point j) copyModel
  have hsemantic : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient24 semantic i.val =
        lane (Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) := by
    intro i
    have hcoeff' : AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient24 semantic i.val =
        semanticLane24 public1 openings point i := by
      simpa [AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient24,
        AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel.decoded, i.isLt] using hcoeff i
    rw [hcoeff']
    let shifted := Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)
    have hv : shifted.val = 4 + i.val := by simp [shifted]
    have hlt0 : ¬ shifted.val < 4 := by rw [hv]; omega
    have hlt28 : shifted.val < 28 := by rw [hv]; omega
    have hidx : (⟨shifted.val - 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 24) = i := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change shifted.val - 4 = i.val
      omega
    change semanticLane24 public1 openings point i =
      lanesFromModels poseidonModel
        (fun j => semanticLane24 public1 openings point j) copyModel shifted
    simp only [lanesFromModels, dif_neg hlt0, dif_pos hlt28]
    exact congrArg (fun j : Fin 24 => semanticLane24 public1 openings point j) hidx.symm
  have hposeidonLane : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient4 poseidon i.val =
        lane (Fin.castAdd 25 i) := by
    intro i
    have hcoeff' : AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient4 poseidon i.val =
        poseidonModel i := by
      simpa [AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient4, i.isLt]
        using hposeidonModel i
    rw [hcoeff']
    simp [lane, lanesFromModels]
  have hcopyLane : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode copySeed = lane 28 := by
    simpa [lane, lanesFromModels] using hcopyModel
  obtain ⟨prepared, middle, out, hnew, hfirst, hsecond, hout, hsum⟩ :=
    AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial.prepared_folds_eq_lane_sum semantic poseidon theta copySeed
      lane htheta hcopy hsemanticCan hposeidon hsemantic hposeidonLane hcopyLane
  refine ⟨semantic, prepared, middle, out, hsemanticRun, hnew, hfirst, hsecond, hout, ?_⟩
  exact hsum

#print axioms coefficients_of_packed_equations
#print axioms actual_semantic_coefficients
#print axioms prepared_folds_actual_semantic
end

TerminalCompositionPolynomial:
import CompositionPartsLoopAdapter
import TerminalHornerModel

/-! Actual candidate prepared constructor and both recursive folds, composed
with the existing 29-coefficient model. Array-to-lane correspondence remains
explicit and is NOT established by this theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter
open scoped BigOperators

abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

def reverseRange (n : Usize) : ReverseRange :=
  ⟨{ start := 0#usize, «end» := n }⟩

/-- Inputs are actual fixed arrays and a copy seed. Their canonicality and
pointwise identification with semantic coefficients are caller obligations.
The multiplier constructor, both complete loops and output canonicality are
derived here; no success equation for any of those operations is assumed. -/
theorem prepared_folds_eq_lane_sum
    (semantic : Array QM 24#usize) (poseidon : Array QM 4#usize)
    (theta seed : QM) (lanes : Fin 29 → ExactQM)
    (htheta : CanonicalQM theta) (hseed : CanonicalQM seed)
    (hsemanticCanonical : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      CanonicalQM (semantic.val[i.val]'(by simpa [semantic.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hposeidonCanonical : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      CanonicalQM (poseidon.val[i.val]'(by simpa [poseidon.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hsemantic : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      coefficient24 semantic i.val = lanes (Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)))
    (hposeidon : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      coefficient4 poseidon i.val = lanes (Fin.castAdd 25 i))
    (hcopy : decode seed = lanes 28) :
    ∃ prepared : Prepared, ∃ middle out : QM,
      field.PreparedQm31Multiplier.new theta = .ok prepared ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.composition_parts_loop0
        (reverseRange 24#usize) semantic prepared seed = .ok middle ∧
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.composition_parts_loop1
        (reverseRange 4#usize) poseidon prepared middle = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalQM out ∧
      decode out = ∑ i : Fin 29, decode theta ^ i.val * lanes i := by
  obtain ⟨prepared, hnew, hprepared⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.current_prepared_new theta htheta
  obtain ⟨middle, hfirst, hmiddle, hfirstValue⟩ :=
    composition_parts_loop0_horner_model semantic prepared theta seed
      (reverseRange 24#usize) 24 rfl rfl (by omega)
      htheta hprepared hsemanticCanonical hseed
  obtain ⟨out, hsecond, hout, hsecondValue⟩ :=
    composition_parts_loop1_horner_model poseidon prepared theta middle
      (reverseRange 4#usize) 4 rfl rfl (by omega)
      htheta hprepared hposeidonCanonical hmiddle
  refine ⟨prepared, middle, out, hnew, hfirst, hsecond, hout, ?_⟩
  change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = _
  rw [hsecondValue, hfirstValue,
    AspisR1.TerminalHornerModel.actual_model_eq_seeded,
    AspisR1.TerminalHornerModel.actual_model_eq_seeded]
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTerminalHorner.composeGroups_eq_lane_sum
    (decode theta) (decode seed)
    (fun i : Fin 24 => coefficient24 semantic i.val)
    (fun i : Fin 4 => coefficient4 poseidon i.val)
    lanes hposeidon hsemantic hcopy

#print axioms prepared_folds_eq_lane_sum
end AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial

import CompositionPartsLoopSlice
import ExtractedMaskHornerPolynomial

/-! Proof adapter for the exact generated candidate loop declarations in
`CompositionPartsLoopSlice`. The declarations themselves are not renamed or
rewritten. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange

abbrev QM := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.QM31
abbrev Prepared := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.field.PreparedQm31Multiplier
abbrev ReverseRange := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReverseRange.ReverseRange
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
abbrev PreparedFor := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskPreparedState.PreparedFor

def coefficient24 (a : Array QM 24#usize) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if hi : i < 24 then
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
      (a.val[i]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi))
  else 0

def coefficient4 (a : Array QM 4#usize) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if hi : i < 4 then
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

ExtractedMaskTerminalHorner:
import TerminalHornerCore

/-!
Pure adapter for the generated two reverse-Horner folds.  This is only the
finite-field fold algebra; it does not assert that generated arrays equal the
R0P poseidon/semantic/copy lane sources.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTerminalHorner
open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def seededHorner (theta seed : K) (cs : List K) : K :=
  cs.reverse.foldl (fun out c => out * theta + c) seed

theorem seededHorner_eq_source (theta seed : K) (cs : List K) :
    seededHorner theta seed cs =
      seed * theta ^ cs.length + AspisR1.TerminalHornerCore.sourceMixHorner theta cs := by
  induction cs with
  | nil => simp [seededHorner, AspisR1.TerminalHornerCore.sourceMixHorner]
  | cons c cs ih =>
      have hstep : seededHorner theta seed (c :: cs) =
          seededHorner theta seed cs * theta + c := by
        simp [seededHorner, List.reverse_cons, List.foldl_append]
      rw [hstep, ih, AspisR1.TerminalHornerCore.sourceMixHorner_cons,
        List.length_cons, pow_succ]
      ring

theorem seededHorner_eq_sum (n : Nat) (cs : Fin n → K) (theta seed : K) :
    seededHorner theta seed (List.ofFn cs) =
      seed * theta ^ n + ∑ i, cs i * theta ^ i.val := by
  rw [seededHorner_eq_source, List.length_ofFn,
    AspisR1.TerminalHornerCore.sourceMixHorner_eq_sum]

/-- Exact model for loop0 then loop1: source order is 24 semantic entries,
then four poseidon entries, with the copy residual as the initial seed. -/
def composeGroups (theta seed : K) (semantic : Fin 24 → K)
    (poseidon : Fin 4 → K) : K :=
  seededHorner theta (seededHorner theta seed (List.ofFn semantic))
    (List.ofFn poseidon)

theorem composeGroups_eq (theta seed : K) (semantic : Fin 24 → K)
    (poseidon : Fin 4 → K) :
    composeGroups theta seed semantic poseidon =
      seed * theta ^ 28 +
        (∑ i : Fin 24, semantic i * theta ^ (i.val + 4)) +
        (∑ j : Fin 4, poseidon j * theta ^ j.val) := by
  rw [composeGroups, seededHorner_eq_sum, seededHorner_eq_sum]
  have hshift :
      (∑ i : Fin 24, semantic i * theta ^ i.val) * theta ^ 4 =
        ∑ i : Fin 24, semantic i * theta ^ (i.val + 4) := by
    rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [pow_add]
    ring
  rw [add_mul, hshift]
  have hpower : theta ^ 24 * theta ^ 4 = theta ^ 28 := by
    rw [← pow_add]
  rw [mul_assoc, hpower]

/-- Recombine the source fold groups into the 29 coefficients used by the
terminal model. The hypotheses expose, rather than assume away, the separate
array-to-lane source obligations. -/
theorem composeGroups_eq_lane_sum (theta seed : K)
    (semantic : Fin 24 → K) (poseidon : Fin 4 → K) (lanes : Fin 29 → K)
    (hposeidon : ∀ i : Fin 4, poseidon i = lanes (Fin.castAdd 25 i))
    (hsemantic : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      semantic i = lanes (Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)))
    (hcopy : seed = lanes 28) :
    composeGroups theta seed semantic poseidon =
      ∑ i : Fin 29, theta ^ i.val * lanes i := by
  have hsplit : (∑ i : Fin 29, theta ^ i.val * lanes i) =
      (∑ i : Fin 4, theta ^ i.val * poseidon i) +
        ((∑ i : Fin 24, theta ^ (4 + i.val) * semantic i) +
          theta ^ 28 * seed) := by
    rw [Fin.sum_univ_add (a := 4) (b := 25)]
    congr 1
    · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro i hi
      rw [hposeidon]
      rfl
    · rw [Fin.sum_univ_add (a := 24) (b := 1)]
      congr 1
      · apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        rw [hsemantic]
        rfl
      · rw [Fin.sum_univ_one]
        rw [hcopy]
        rfl
  rw [hsplit, composeGroups_eq]
  have hsemantic_sum :
      (∑ i : Fin 24, semantic i * theta ^ (i.val + 4)) =
        ∑ i : Fin 24, theta ^ (4 + i.val) * semantic i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    rw [Nat.add_comm i.val 4, mul_comm]
  have hposeidon_sum :
      (∑ i : Fin 4, poseidon i * theta ^ i.val) =
        ∑ i : Fin 4, theta ^ i.val * poseidon i := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    exact mul_comm _ _
  rw [hsemantic_sum, hposeidon_sum]
  ring

#print axioms seededHorner_eq_source
#print axioms seededHorner_eq_sum
#print axioms composeGroups_eq
#print axioms composeGroups_eq_lane_sum

end AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTerminalHorner

import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Roots

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.TerminalHornerCore
open scoped BigOperators
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

def sourceMixHorner (x : F) (cs : List F) : F :=
  cs.reverse.foldl (fun out c => out*x+c) 0

theorem sourceMixHorner_cons (x c : F) (cs : List F) :
    sourceMixHorner x (c::cs) = sourceMixHorner x cs * x + c := by
  simp [sourceMixHorner, List.reverse_cons, List.foldl_append]

theorem sourceMixHorner_eq_sum (n : ℕ) (cs : Fin n → F) (x : F) :
    sourceMixHorner x (List.ofFn cs) = ∑ i, cs i * x^i.val := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [sourceMixHorner]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [List.ofFn_succ, sourceMixHorner_cons, ih]
    simp only [Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.val_zero, pow_zero, mul_one, Fin.val_succ, pow_succ]
    simp only [← mul_assoc, ← Finset.sum_mul]
    exact add_comm _ _

#print axioms sourceMixHorner_cons
#print axioms sourceMixHorner_eq_sum

theorem poseidon_slot (p : Fin 4 → ExactQM) (s : Fin 24 → ExactQM) (c : ExactQM)
    (i : Fin 4) : lanesFromModels p s c (Fin.castAdd 25 i) = p i := by
  simp only [lanesFromModels, Fin.val_castAdd, i.isLt, ↓reduceDIte]

theorem semantic_slot (p : Fin 4 → ExactQM) (s : Fin 24 → ExactQM) (c : ExactQM)
    (i : Fin 24) : lanesFromModels p s c (Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) = s i := by
  have h0 : ¬ (4 + i.val < 4) := by omega
  have h28 : 4 + i.val < 28 := by omega
  simp only [lanesFromModels, Fin.val_natAdd, Fin.val_castAdd, dif_neg h0, dif_pos h28]
  have hidx : (⟨4 + i.val - 4, by omega⟩ : Fin 24) = i := by
    apply Fin.ext
    exact Nat.add_sub_cancel_left 4 i.val
  exact congrArg s hidx

theorem copy_slot (p : Fin 4 → ExactQM) (s : Fin 24 → ExactQM) (c : ExactQM) :
    lanesFromModels p s c 28 = c := by
  simp [lanesFromModels]

#print axioms poseidon_slot
#print axioms semantic_slot
#print axioms copy_slot
end AspisR1.CompositionCoefficientSlots
