/-- Exact source execution of both active-mask loops, with no selector-domain
assumption. The result decodes to the retained seven-coordinate basis model. -/
theorem active_mask_basis_success
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (hhigh : CanonicalArray self.high) (hlow : CanonicalArray self.low) :
    ∃ out : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis self = .ok out ∧
      CanonicalQM out ∧ decode out = R0P.activeMaskBasisModel (modelSelectors self) := by
  let zeroHigh := Array.repeat 7#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  have hzeroHigh : CanonicalArray zeroHigh := by
    simpa [zeroHigh] using AspisR1.ArrayZeroExact.repeat_zero_canonical
  have hinitial0 : ∀ j : Fin 7, decode
      (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.cell zeroHigh j) =
        loop0Prefix self j 0 := by
    intro j
    change AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.decodedCells zeroHigh j = _
    rw [AspisR1.ArrayZeroExact.repeat_zero_decoded]
    simp [loop0Prefix,
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.prefixValue]
  obtain ⟨highSums, hloop0, hhighSums, hprefix⟩ :=
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModelFuel.loop0_success_fuel_prefix
      self zeroHigh 0#usize 64 (by decide) hhigh hzeroHigh hinitial0
  have hloop1Initial : decode field.QM31.ZERO =
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1Fuel.prefixValue
        self highSums 0 := by
    simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1Fuel.prefixValue,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_decode]
  obtain ⟨out, hloop1, hout, hresult⟩ :=
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1Fuel.loop1_success_fuel_prefix
      self highSums field.QM31.ZERO 0#usize 7 (by decide)
      hhighSums hlow (by simpa using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.zero_canonical)
      hloop1Initial
  have hprefixSum : decode out =
      ∑ j : Fin 7,
        decode (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1FiniteModel.cell highSums j) *
          AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1Step.LowSumMeaning
            (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1Step.LowSumModel self)
            (R0P.activeMaskBasisMasks j) := by
    change AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = _
    rw [hresult]
    change AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1FiniteModel.prefixValue
      self highSums 7 = _
    rw [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1FiniteModel.prefixValue_seven_eq_finset_sum]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro j hj
    rfl
  have hhighGrouped : ∀ j : Fin 7,
      decode (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1FiniteModel.cell highSums j) =
        R0P.activeMaskGroupedHigh (modelSelectors self).high j := by
    intro j
    have hcell :
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModelFuel.cell highSums j =
          AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1FiniteModel.cell highSums j := rfl
    calc
      decode (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1FiniteModel.cell highSums j) =
          decode (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModelFuel.cell highSums j) :=
        congrArg decode hcell.symm
      _ = AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.prefixValue self j 64 := hprefix j
      _ = R0P.activeMaskGroupedHigh
          (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop0Grouped.decodedHigh self) j :=
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop0Grouped.loop0_prefix_is_grouped_high self j
      _ = R0P.activeMaskGroupedHigh (modelSelectors self).high j := by
        rw [sourceHigh_eq_modelHigh]
  have hmodel : decode out = R0P.activeMaskBasisModel (modelSelectors self) := by
    rw [hprefixSum]
    simp_rw [hhighGrouped]
    rw [sourceLow_eq_modelLow]
    rfl
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hout, ?_⟩
  · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis]
    rw [hloop0]
    change pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1
      self highSums field.QM31.ZERO 0#usize = .ok out
    exact hloop1
  · rw [hmodel]

#print axioms active_mask_basis_success

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray a

def cell {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (j : Fin n.val) : QM :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

private theorem body_done
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (sums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize)
    (hge : 64 ≤ block.val) :
    pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
      self sums block = .ok (.done (self, sums)) := by
  have hnotVal : ¬ block.val < 64 := by omega
  have hlen : Slice.len (Array.to_slice
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS) = 64#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simp [Slice.len, Slice.length, Array.to_slice,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS]
  simp [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body,
    lift, hlen, hnotVal]

theorem loop0_success_fuel_prefix
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (sums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : block.val + fuel = 64)
    (hself : CanonicalArray self.high) (hsums : CanonicalArray sums)
    (hinv : ∀ j : Fin 7,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cell sums j) =
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.prefixValue self j block.val) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 7#usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0
        self sums block = .ok (self, out) ∧ CanonicalArray out ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 7,
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cell out j) =
          AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.prefixValue self j 64) := by
  induction fuel generalizing block sums with
  | zero =>
      have hblock : block.val = 64 := by omega
      have hbody := body_done self sums block (by omega)
      change pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
        self sums block = .ok (.done (self, sums)) at hbody
      refine ⟨sums, ?_, hsums, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0,
          loop.eq_def]
        dsimp only
        rw [hbody]
      · intro j
        simpa [hblock] using hinv j
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hblock : block.val < 64 := by omega
      obtain ⟨coordinate, hcoordinate, updated, block1, hbody, hinc,
        hupdatedCanonical, hinv1⟩ :=
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.loop0_body_step_prefix
          self sums block hblock hself hsums hinv
      have hinc' : (block + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok block1 := by
        change UScalar.add block 1#usize = .ok block1
        exact hinc
      have haddSpec := UScalar.add_equiv block (1#usize)
      rw [hinc'] at haddSpec
      simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at haddSpec
      have hblock1 : block1.val = block.val + 1 := haddSpec.2.1
      have hspan1 : block1.val + fuel = 64 := by omega
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtCanonical, houtInv⟩ :=
        ih (sums := updated) (block := block1) (hspan := hspan1)
          (hsums := hupdatedCanonical) (hinv := by
            intro j
            simpa [hblock1, cell,
              AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel.cell] using hinv1 j)
      refine ⟨out, ?_, houtCanonical, houtInv⟩
      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0,
        loop.eq_def]
      dsimp only
      rw [hbody]
      exact hrun

#print axioms loop0_success_fuel_prefix
end AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModelFuel

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray a

def cell {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (j : Fin n.val) : QM :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

def prefixContribution
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) (j : Fin 7) (n : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if hn : n < 64 then
    if (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
          (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks ⟨n, hn⟩)).val = j.val then
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
        (self.high.val[n]'(by simpa [self.high.property] using hn))
    else 0
  else 0

def prefixValue
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) (j : Fin 7) : Nat → ExactQM
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => prefixValue self j n + prefixContribution self j n

theorem prefixValue_succ
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) (j : Fin 7) (n : Nat) :
    prefixValue self j (n + 1) = prefixValue self j n + prefixContribution self j n := rfl

private theorem cell_set {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (i : Usize) (x : QM)
    (j : Fin n.val) :
    cell (a.set i x) j = if j.val = i.val then x else cell a j := by
  unfold cell
  by_cases heq : j.val = i.val
  · simp [heq, Array.set_val_eq]
  · have hne : i.val ≠ j.val := Ne.symm heq
    simp [Array.set_val_eq, List.getElem_set_ne, hne, heq]

theorem loop0_body_step_prefix
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (sums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize) (hblock : block.val < 64)
    (hself : CanonicalArray self.high) (hsums : CanonicalArray sums)
    (hinv : ∀ j : Fin 7, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cell sums j) =
      prefixValue self j block.val) :
    ∃ coordinate : Usize, ∃ hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7,
      ∃ updated : Array QM 7#usize, ∃ block1 : Usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
        self sums block = .ok (.cont (updated, block1)) ∧
      UScalar.add block 1#usize = .ok block1 ∧
      CanonicalArray updated ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 7, AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cell updated j) =
        prefixValue self j (block.val + 1)) := by
  obtain ⟨coordinate, hcoordinate, hcoordModel, added, updated, block1,
    hbody, hinc, hadd, haddCanonical, hupdatedCanonical, hset⟩ :=
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopStepModel.loop0_body_step_model
        self sums block hblock hself hsums
  let jcoord : Fin 7 := ⟨coordinate.val, hcoordinate⟩
  let old : QM := sums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
    simpa [sums.property] using hcoordinate)
  let highCell : QM := self.high.val[block.val]'(by
    simpa [self.high.property] using hblock)
  have hold : CanonicalQM old := hsums jcoord
  have hhigh : CanonicalQM highCell := hself ⟨block.val, by
    simpa [self.high.property] using hblock⟩
  obtain ⟨added', hadd', _, hdecodeAdd⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact old highCell hold hhigh
  have haddedEq : added = added' := Result.ok.inj (hadd.symm.trans hadd')
  have hdecode : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode added =
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old +
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode highCell := by
    rw [haddedEq]
    exact hdecodeAdd
  have hcoordVal : (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
      (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks ⟨block.val, hblock⟩)).val = coordinate.val := by
    exact congrArg (fun x : Usize => x.val) hcoordModel.symm
  refine ⟨coordinate, hcoordinate, updated, block1, hbody, hinc,
    hupdatedCanonical, ?_⟩
  intro j
  have hcell : cell sums jcoord = old := rfl
  rw [hset, cell_set]
  by_cases heq : j.val = coordinate.val
  · have hj : j = jcoord := Fin.ext heq
    subst j
    rw [if_pos rfl, hdecode]
    have hdecodeOld : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode old =
        prefixValue self jcoord block.val := by
      rw [← hcell]
      exact hinv jcoord
    rw [hdecodeOld, prefixValue_succ]
    have hcoordJ : (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
        (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks ⟨block.val, hblock⟩)).val = jcoord.val := by
      simpa [jcoord] using hcoordVal
    simp [prefixContribution, hblock, hcoordJ, highCell]
  · rw [if_neg heq]
    have hmodelNot : (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
        (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks ⟨block.val, hblock⟩)).val ≠ j.val := by
      intro heqModel
      apply heq
      exact heqModel.symm.trans hcoordVal
    rw [hinv j]
    simp [prefixValue, prefixContribution, hblock, hmodelNot]

#print axioms loop0_body_step_prefix
end AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopModel

def cellAt (a : Array QM 7#usize) (j : Fin 7) : QM :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

def generatedCoordinateMatch (mask : Std.U16) : Result Usize :=
  match mask with
  | 6144#uscalar => ok 0#usize
  | 6145#uscalar => ok 1#usize
  | 4097#uscalar => ok 2#usize
  | 2048#uscalar => ok 3#usize
  | 2049#uscalar => ok 4#usize
  | 26214#uscalar => ok 5#usize
  | 1749#uscalar => ok 6#usize
  | _ => fail Error.panic

private theorem generated_match_of_member
    (mask : Std.U16) (coordinate : Usize)
    (hmember : mask = 6144#u16 ∨ mask = 6145#u16 ∨ mask = 4097#u16 ∨
      mask = 2048#u16 ∨ mask = 2049#u16 ∨ mask = 26214#u16 ∨
      mask = 1749#u16)
    (hmatch : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate mask =
      .ok coordinate) : generatedCoordinateMatch mask = .ok coordinate := by
  rcases hmember with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
  · have hc : coordinate = 0#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h0] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h0, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 1#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h1] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h1, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 2#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h2] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h2, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 3#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h3] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h3, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 4#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h4] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h4, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 5#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h5] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h5, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 6#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h6] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h6, hc]
    rfl

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem usize_add_result (a b : Usize) (hsum : a.val + b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    ∃ c : Usize, UScalar.add a b = .ok c ∧ c.val = a.val + b.val := by
  have hchecked : (a + b : Result Usize) ⦃ z => z.val = a.val + b.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hsum
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hval⟩
  change (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok c
  exact hc

/-- Exact successful body step for the generated high-coordinate loop.  It
records the actual checked field addition and array update, not merely their
mathematical specification. -/
theorem loop0_body_step_model
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize)
    (hblock : block.val < 64)
    (hself : CanonicalArray self.high)
    (hsums : CanonicalArray highSums) :
    ∃ coordinate : Usize, ∃ hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7,
      coordinate = AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
        (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks ⟨block.val, hblock⟩) ∧
      ∃ added : QM, ∃ updated : Array QM 7#usize, ∃ block1 : Usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
        self highSums block = .ok (.cont (updated, block1)) ∧
      UScalar.add block 1#usize = .ok block1 ∧
      field.QM31.add
        (highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
          simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate))
        (self.high.val[block.val]'(by
          simpa [self.high.property] using hblock)) = .ok added ∧
      CanonicalQM added ∧
      CanonicalArray updated ∧
      updated = highSums.set coordinate added := by
  let row : Fin 64 := ⟨block.val, hblock⟩
  let mask := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.sourceMask row
  let coordinate := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
    (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks row)
  have h64 : (64#usize).val = 64 := by scalar_tac
  have h7 : (7#usize).val = 7 := by scalar_tac
  have hblockU : block.val < (64#usize).val := by simpa [h64] using hblock
  have hmaskread : Array.index_usize
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS block = .ok mask := by
    have h := index_usize_ok
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS block hblockU
    simpa [mask, row, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.sourceMask] using h
  have hmaskMatch := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.source_match_coordinate row
  have hmatch : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate mask = .ok coordinate := by
    simpa [mask, coordinate] using hmaskMatch
  have hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7 := by
    rcases AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.source_mask_member row with
      hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask
    all_goals
      have htable := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.source_mask_table row
      have hcopy : R0P.copyActiveRowMasks row =
          (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.sourceMask row).val :=
        htable.symm
      have hnum := congrArg UScalar.val hmask
      rw [hnum] at hcopy
      simp [coordinate,
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate,
        hcopy]
  have hcoordinateU : coordinate.val < (7#usize).val := by simpa [h7] using hcoordinate
  have hsumsLen : highSums.length = (7#usize).val := by
    simpa [highSums.property]
  have hcoordinateArray : coordinate.val < highSums.length := by
    rw [hsumsLen]
    exact hcoordinateU
  let old := highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
    simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinateU)
  let highCell := self.high.val[block.val]'(by
    simpa [self.high.property] using hblockU)
  have hold : Array.index_usize highSums coordinate = .ok old := by
    exact index_usize_ok highSums coordinate hcoordinateU
  have hhighCell : Array.index_usize self.high block = .ok highCell := by
    exact index_usize_ok self.high block hblockU
  have holdCanonical : CanonicalQM old := by
    apply hsums ⟨coordinate.val, hcoordinateU⟩
  have hhighCanonical : CanonicalQM highCell := by
    apply hself ⟨block.val, hblockU⟩
  obtain ⟨added, hadd, haddCanonical, _haddValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact old highCell
      holdCanonical hhighCanonical
  obtain ⟨updated, hupdate, hupdatedCanonical, _hframe⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.update_success highSums coordinate added
      hcoordinateU hsums haddCanonical
  have hset : updated = highSums.set coordinate added := by
    obtain ⟨updated', hupdate', hset'⟩ :=
      WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.update_spec highSums coordinate added hcoordinateArray)
    have heq : updated = updated' := Result.ok.inj (hupdate.symm.trans hupdate')
    rw [heq]
    exact hset'
  have hincBound : block.val + 1 ≤ Usize.max := by
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  obtain ⟨block1, hinc, _hincval⟩ := usize_add_result block 1#usize hincBound
  have hlen : Slice.len (Array.to_slice
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS) = 64#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simp [Slice.len, Slice.length, Array.to_slice,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS]
  have hlt : block < Slice.len (Array.to_slice
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS) := by
    rw [hlen]
    scalar_tac
  have hsourceLt : block < 64#usize := by
    rw [← hlen]
    exact hlt
  have hinc' : (block + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok block1 := by
    change UScalar.add block 1#usize = .ok block1
    exact hinc
  have hmember : mask = 6144#u16 ∨ mask = 6145#u16 ∨ mask = 4097#u16 ∨
      mask = 2048#u16 ∨ mask = 2049#u16 ∨ mask = 26214#u16 ∨ mask = 1749#u16 := by
    simpa [mask] using
      AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.source_mask_member row
  have hmatchBody : generatedCoordinateMatch mask = .ok coordinate :=
    generated_match_of_member mask coordinate hmember hmatch
  refine ⟨coordinate, hcoordinate, rfl, added, updated, block1, ?_, hinc, hadd,
    haddCanonical, hupdatedCanonical, hset⟩
  · simp only [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body,
      lift, bind_tc_ok, hlen, if_pos hsourceLt, hmaskread, bind_tc_ok]
    change (do
      let c ← generatedCoordinateMatch mask
      let q ← Array.index_usize highSums c
      let q1 ← Array.index_usize self.high block
      let q2 ← field.QM31.add q q1
      let a ← Array.update highSums c q2
      let block1' ← block + 1#usize
      ok (ControlFlow.cont (a, block1'))) = ok (ControlFlow.cont (updated, block1))
    simp only [hmatchBody, bind_tc_ok, hold, bind_tc_ok,
      hhighCell, bind_tc_ok, hadd, bind_tc_ok, hupdate, bind_tc_ok, hinc']

CopyActiveMaskBasisRegroup:
import R0P.Copy
import CopyActiveMaskBasisFacts

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

/-- The seven constant masks in the frozen 64-block active schedule. -/
def activeMaskBasisMasks : Fin 7 → Nat := ![6144, 6145, 4097, 2048, 2049, 26214, 1749]

def activeMaskCoordinate (mask : Nat) : Fin 7 :=
  match mask with
  | 6144 => 0
  | 6145 => 1
  | 4097 => 2
  | 2048 => 3
  | 2049 => 4
  | 26214 => 5
  | 1749 => 6
  | _ => 0

def activeMaskLowSum (low : Fin 16 → K) (mask : Nat) : K :=
  match mask with
  | 6144 => low 11 + low 12
  | 6145 => low 0 + low 11 + low 12
  | 4097 => low 0 + low 12
  | 2048 => low 11
  | 2049 => low 0 + low 11
  | 26214 => low 1 + low 2 + low 5 + low 6 + low 9 + low 10 + low 13 + low 14
  | 1749 => low 0 + low 2 + low 4 + low 6 + low 7 + low 9 + low 10
  | _ => 0

def activeMaskGroupedHigh (high : Fin 64 → K) (coord : Fin 7) : K :=
  ∑ block : Fin 64,
    if activeMaskCoordinate (copyActiveRowMasks block) = coord then high block else 0

def activeMaskBasisModel (s : CopySelectors K) : K :=
  ∑ coord : Fin 7,
    activeMaskGroupedHigh s.high coord * activeMaskLowSum s.low (activeMaskBasisMasks coord)

private theorem active_masks_are_basis_members (block : Fin 64) :
    copyActiveRowMasks block = 6144 ∨ copyActiveRowMasks block = 6145 ∨
    copyActiveRowMasks block = 4097 ∨ copyActiveRowMasks block = 2048 ∨
    copyActiveRowMasks block = 2049 ∨ copyActiveRowMasks block = 26214 ∨
    copyActiveRowMasks block = 1749 := by
  fin_cases block <;> decide

private theorem active_mask_has_coordinate (block : Fin 64) :
    activeMaskBasisMasks (activeMaskCoordinate (copyActiveRowMasks block)) =
      copyActiveRowMasks block := by
  rcases active_masks_are_basis_members block with h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
    simp [activeMaskCoordinate, activeMaskBasisMasks, h]

private theorem active_mask_low_sum_correct (low : Fin 16 → K) (mask : Nat)
    (hm : mask = 6144 ∨ mask = 6145 ∨ mask = 4097 ∨ mask = 2048 ∨
      mask = 2049 ∨ mask = 26214 ∨ mask = 1749) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 low mask = activeMaskLowSum low mask := by
  rcases hm with h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst mask <;>
    simp [activeMaskLowSum, copy_selector_mask_sum_6144,
      copy_selector_mask_sum_6145, copy_selector_mask_sum_4097,
      copy_selector_mask_sum_2048, copy_selector_mask_sum_2049,
      copy_selector_mask_sum_26214, copy_selector_mask_sum_1749]

/-- Finite-sum regrouping identity: terms may be grouped by any finite key.
This is the algebraic bridge from block-order accumulation to seven mask
coordinates; no selector-domain premise is required. -/
theorem finset_sum_regroup_by_key {α β : Type} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq β] (key : α → β) (term : α → K) (weight : β → K) :
    (∑ a : α, term a * weight (key a)) =
      ∑ b : β, (∑ a : α, if key a = b then term a else 0) * weight b := by
  classical
  calc
    (∑ a : α, term a * weight (key a)) =
        ∑ a : α, ∑ b : β, (if key a = b then term a else 0) * weight b := by
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro a ha
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single (key a)]
      · simp
      · intro b hb hba
        by_cases heq : key a = b
        · exact False.elim (hba heq.symm)
        · simp [heq]
      · intro hnot
        exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_univ _))
    _ = ∑ b : β, ∑ a : α, (if key a = b then term a else 0) * weight b := by
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ = ∑ b : β, (∑ a : α, if key a = b then term a else 0) * weight b := by
      simp_rw [← Finset.sum_mul]

def activeMaskContribution (s : CopySelectors K) (block : Fin 64) : K :=
  if copyActiveRowMasks block ≠ 0 then
    s.high block * copySelectorMaskSum16 s.low (copyActiveRowMasks block) else 0

private theorem active_mask_fold_add {α : Type} (xs : List α) (f : α → K) (a : K) :
    xs.foldl (fun acc x => acc + f x) a = a + (xs.map f).sum := by
  induction xs generalizing a with
  | nil => simp only [List.foldl_nil, List.map_nil, List.sum_nil, add_zero]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons, ih, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc]

private theorem active_literal_as_sum (s : CopySelectors K) :
    copyActiveLiteral s = ∑ block : Fin 64, activeMaskContribution s block := by
  unfold copyActiveLiteral
  have hstep :
      (fun (sum : K) (block : Fin 64) =>
        if copyActiveRowMasks block ≠ 0 then
          sum + s.high block * copySelectorMaskSum16 s.low (copyActiveRowMasks block)
        else sum) =
      (fun sum block => sum + activeMaskContribution s block) := by
    funext sum block
    by_cases h : copyActiveRowMasks block ≠ 0 <;> simp [activeMaskContribution, h]
  rw [hstep, active_mask_fold_add, zero_add, List.map_ofFn, List.sum_ofFn]
  rfl

/-- The grouped seven-mask field formula equals the literal selector evaluation
for every pair of selector vectors, including arbitrary off-domain values. -/
theorem copy_active_literal_eq_active_mask_basis (s : CopySelectors K) :
    copyActiveLiteral s = activeMaskBasisModel s := by
  rw [active_literal_as_sum]
  have hnonzero (block : Fin 64) : copyActiveRowMasks block ≠ 0 := by
    rcases active_masks_are_basis_members block with h | h | h | h | h | h | h <;>
      simp [h]
  have hlow (block : Fin 64) :
      copySelectorMaskSum16 s.low (copyActiveRowMasks block) =
        activeMaskLowSum s.low (activeMaskBasisMasks
          (activeMaskCoordinate (copyActiveRowMasks block))) := by
    rw [active_mask_has_coordinate block]
    apply active_mask_low_sum_correct
    exact active_masks_are_basis_members block
  simp only [activeMaskContribution, if_pos (hnonzero _), hlow]
  simpa [activeMaskBasisModel, activeMaskGroupedHigh] using
    (finset_sum_regroup_by_key
      (key := fun block : Fin 64 => activeMaskCoordinate (copyActiveRowMasks block))
      (term := s.high) (weight := fun coord =>
        activeMaskLowSum s.low (activeMaskBasisMasks coord)))

#print axioms copy_active_literal_eq_active_mask_basis
#print axioms finset_sum_regroup_by_key

end R0P

import R0P.Copy

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

private def activeBits16 : List (Fin 16) :=
  List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 16 => i)

theorem active_bits_6144 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (6144 : Nat).testBit i.val) = [11, 12] := by
  decide

theorem active_bits_6145 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (6145 : Nat).testBit i.val) = [0, 11, 12] := by
  decide

theorem active_bits_4097 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (4097 : Nat).testBit i.val) = [0, 12] := by
  decide

theorem active_bits_2048 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (2048 : Nat).testBit i.val) = [11] := by
  decide

theorem active_bits_2049 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (2049 : Nat).testBit i.val) = [0, 11] := by
  decide

theorem active_bits_26214 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (26214 : Nat).testBit i.val) =
      [1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10, 13, 14] := by
  decide

theorem active_bits_1749 :
    activeBits16.filter (fun i => (1749 : Nat).testBit i.val) =
      [0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10] := by
  decide

private theorem mask_sum_of_bits (v : Fin 16 → K) (mask : Nat)
    (indices : List (Fin 16))
    (hbits : activeBits16.filter (fun i => mask.testBit i.val) = indices)
    (hsmall : indices.length ≤ 8) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v mask =
      indices.foldl (fun sum i => sum + v i) 0 := by
  have hbits' : (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 16 => i)).filter
      (fun i : Fin 16 => mask.testBit i.val) = indices := by
    simpa only [activeBits16] using hbits
  have hnot : ¬ indices.length > 8 := by omega
  unfold copySelectorMaskSum16
  simp only [hbits', hnot, if_false]

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_6144 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 6144 = v 11 + v 12 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 6144 [11, 12] active_bits_6144 (by decide)
  simpa using h

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_6145 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 6145 = v 0 + v 11 + v 12 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 6145 [0, 11, 12] active_bits_6145 (by decide)
  simpa using h

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_4097 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 4097 = v 0 + v 12 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 4097 [0, 12] active_bits_4097 (by decide)
  simpa using h

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_2048 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 2048 = v 11 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 2048 [11] active_bits_2048 (by decide)
  simpa using h

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_2049 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 2049 = v 0 + v 11 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 2049 [0, 11] active_bits_2049 (by decide)
  simpa using h

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_26214 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 26214 =
      v 1 + v 2 + v 5 + v 6 + v 9 + v 10 + v 13 + v 14 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 26214 [1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10, 13, 14]
    active_bits_26214 (by decide)
  simpa using h

theorem copy_selector_mask_sum_1749 (v : Fin 16 → K) :
    copySelectorMaskSum16 v 1749 =
      v 0 + v 2 + v 4 + v 6 + v 7 + v 9 + v 10 := by
  have h := mask_sum_of_bits v 1749 [0, 2, 4, 6, 7, 9, 10]
    active_bits_1749 (by decide)
  simpa using h

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
namespace AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFuel

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray a
abbrev LoopState := (Array QM 7#usize) × Usize

def loopBody (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (state : LoopState) :
    Result (ControlFlow LoopState
      (pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors × Array QM 7#usize)) :=
  pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
    self state.1 state.2

private theorem body_done
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (sums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize)
    (hge : 64 ≤ block.val) :
    loopBody self (sums, block) = .ok (.done (self, sums)) := by
  have h64 : (64#usize).val = 64 := rfl
  have hnotVal : ¬ block.val < 64 := by omega
  have hlen : Slice.len (Array.to_slice
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS) = 64#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simp [Slice.len, Slice.length, Array.to_slice,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS]
  unfold loopBody
  simp [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body,
    lift, hlen, hnotVal]

set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
theorem loop0_success_fuel
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (sums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : block.val + fuel = 64)
    (hself : CanonicalArray self.high) (hsums : CanonicalArray sums) :
    ∃ out : Array QM 7#usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0
        self sums block = .ok (self, out) ∧ CanonicalArray out := by
  induction fuel generalizing block sums with
  | zero =>
      have hblock : block.val = 64 := by omega
      have hbody := body_done self sums block (by omega)
      change pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
        self sums block = .ok (.done (self, sums)) at hbody
      refine ⟨sums, ?_, hsums⟩
      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0,
        loop.eq_def]
      dsimp only
      rw [hbody]
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hblock : block.val < 64 := by omega
      obtain ⟨coordinate, hcoordinate, added, updated, block1,
        hbody, hinc, hadd, haddCanonical, hupdatedCanonical, hset⟩ :=
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopStep.loop0_body_step
          self sums block hblock hself hsums
      change pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
        self sums block = .ok (.cont (updated, block1)) at hbody
      have hinc' : (block + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok block1 := by
        change UScalar.add block 1#usize = .ok block1
        exact hinc
      have haddSpec := UScalar.add_equiv block (1#usize)
      rw [hinc'] at haddSpec
      simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at haddSpec
      have hblock1 : block1.val = block.val + 1 := haddSpec.2.1
      have hspan1 : block1.val + fuel = 64 := by omega
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout⟩ := ih
        (sums := updated) (block := block1) (hspan := hspan1)
        (hsums := hupdatedCanonical)
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hout⟩
      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0,
        loop.eq_def]
      dsimp only
      rw [hbody]
      exact hrun

#print axioms loop0_success_fuel
end AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFuel

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
namespace AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopStep

abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray a

def cellAt (a : Array QM 7#usize) (j : Fin 7) : QM :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

def generatedCoordinateMatch (mask : Std.U16) : Result Usize :=
  match mask with
  | 6144#uscalar => ok 0#usize
  | 6145#uscalar => ok 1#usize
  | 4097#uscalar => ok 2#usize
  | 2048#uscalar => ok 3#usize
  | 2049#uscalar => ok 4#usize
  | 26214#uscalar => ok 5#usize
  | 1749#uscalar => ok 6#usize
  | _ => fail Error.panic

private theorem generated_match_of_member
    (mask : Std.U16) (coordinate : Usize)
    (hmember : mask = 6144#u16 ∨ mask = 6145#u16 ∨ mask = 4097#u16 ∨
      mask = 2048#u16 ∨ mask = 2049#u16 ∨ mask = 26214#u16 ∨
      mask = 1749#u16)
    (hmatch : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate mask =
      .ok coordinate) : generatedCoordinateMatch mask = .ok coordinate := by
  rcases hmember with h0 | h1 | h2 | h3 | h4 | h5 | h6
  · have hc : coordinate = 0#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h0] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h0, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 1#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h1] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h1, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 2#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h2] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h2, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 3#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h3] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h3, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 4#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h4] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h4, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 5#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h5] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h5, hc]
    rfl
  · have hc : coordinate = 6#usize := by
      have hh := hmatch
      simp [AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate, h6] at hh
      exact (Result.ok.inj hh).symm
    rw [h6, hc]
    rfl

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

private theorem usize_add_result (a b : Usize) (hsum : a.val + b.val ≤ Usize.max) :
    ∃ c : Usize, UScalar.add a b = .ok c ∧ c.val = a.val + b.val := by
  have hchecked : (a + b : Result Usize) ⦃ z => z.val = a.val + b.val ⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hsum
  obtain ⟨c, hc, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hchecked
  refine ⟨c, ?_, hval⟩
  change (a + b : Result Usize) = .ok c
  exact hc

/-- Exact successful body step for the generated high-coordinate loop.  It
records the actual checked field addition and array update, not merely their
mathematical specification. -/
theorem loop0_body_step
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) (block : Usize)
    (hblock : block.val < 64)
    (hself : CanonicalArray self.high)
    (hsums : CanonicalArray highSums) :
    ∃ coordinate : Usize, ∃ hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7,
      ∃ added : QM, ∃ updated : Array QM 7#usize, ∃ block1 : Usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop0.body
        self highSums block = .ok (.cont (updated, block1)) ∧
      UScalar.add block 1#usize = .ok block1 ∧
      field.QM31.add
        (highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
          simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate))
        (self.high.val[block.val]'(by
          simpa [self.high.property] using hblock)) = .ok added ∧
      CanonicalQM added ∧
      CanonicalArray updated ∧
      updated = highSums.set coordinate added := by
  let row : Fin 64 := ⟨block.val, hblock⟩
  let mask := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.sourceMask row
  let coordinate := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate
    (R0P.copyActiveRowMasks row)
  have h64 : (64#usize).val = 64 := by scalar_tac
  have h7 : (7#usize).val = 7 := by scalar_tac
  have hblockU : block.val < (64#usize).val := by simpa [h64] using hblock
  have hmaskread : Array.index_usize
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS block = .ok mask := by
    have h := index_usize_ok
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.constants.ACTIVE_ROW_MASKS block hblockU
    simpa [mask, row, AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.sourceMask] using h
  have hmaskMatch := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.source_match_coordinate row
  have hmatch : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.matchCoordinate mask = .ok coordinate := by
    simpa [mask, coordinate] using hmaskMatch
  have hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7 := by
    rcases AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.source_mask_member row with
      hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask | hmask
    all_goals
      have htable := AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.source_mask_table row
      have hcopy : R0P.copyActiveRowMasks row =
          (AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopProof.sourceMask row).val :=
        htable.symm
      have hnum := congrArg UScalar.val hmask
      rw [hnum] at hcopy
      simp [coordinate,
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoopFacts.modelCoordinate,
        hcopy]
  have hcoordinateU : coordinate.val < (7#usize).val := by simpa [h7] using hcoordinate
  have hsumsLen : highSums.length = (7#usize).val := by
    simpa [highSums.property]
  have hcoordinateArray : coordinate.val < highSums.length := by
    rw [hsumsLen]
    exact hcoordinateU
  let old := highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
    simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinateU)
  let highCell := self.high.val[block.val]'(by
    simpa [self.high.property] using hblockU)
  have hold : Array.index_usize highSums coordinate = .ok old := by
    exact index_usize_ok highSums coordinate hcoordinateU
  have hhighCell : Array.index_usize self.high block = .ok highCell := by
    exact index_usize_ok self.high block hblockU
  have holdCanonical : CanonicalQM old := by
    apply hsums ⟨coordinate.val, hcoordinateU⟩
  have hhighCanonical : CanonicalQM highCell := by
    apply hself ⟨block.val, hblockU⟩
  obtain ⟨added, hadd, haddCanonical, _haddValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact old highCell
      holdCanonical hhighCanonical
  obtain ⟨updated, hupdate, hupdatedCanonical, _hframe⟩ :=

private theorem prefixValue_eq_range

def cell {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) (j : Fin n.val) : QM :=
  a.val[j.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using j.isLt)

def term (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) (i : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if hi : i < 7 then
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (cell highSums ⟨i, by simpa [highSums.property] using hi⟩) *
      LowSumMeaning (LowSumModel self) (R0P.activeMaskBasisMasks ⟨i, hi⟩)
  else 0

def prefixValue (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) : Nat → ExactQM
  | 0 => 0
  | n + 1 => prefixValue self highSums n + term self highSums n

theorem loop1_success_fuel_prefix
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) (sum : QM) (coordinate : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : coordinate.val + fuel = 7)
    (hhigh : CanonicalArray highSums) (hlow : CanonicalArray self.low)
    (hsum : CanonicalQM sum)
    (hinv : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode sum =
      prefixValue self highSums coordinate.val) :
    ∃ out : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1
        self highSums sum coordinate = .ok out ∧ CanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = prefixValue self highSums 7 := by
  induction fuel generalizing coordinate sum with
  | zero =>
      have hcoordinate : coordinate.val = 7 := by omega
      have hlen : Slice.len (Array.to_slice
          pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis.MASKS) = 7#usize := by
        apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
        simp [Slice.len, Slice.length, Array.to_slice,
          pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis.MASKS]
      have h7val : (7#usize).val = 7 := rfl
      have hnotVal : ¬ coordinate.val < 7 := by omega
      have hnot : ¬ coordinate < 7#usize := by
        intro hc
        have hlt := (UScalar.lt_equiv coordinate 7#usize).1 hc
        omega
      have hbody : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1.body
          self highSums sum coordinate = .ok (.done sum) := by
        simp [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1.body,
          lift, hlen, hnot, hnotVal, h7val]
      refine ⟨sum, ?_, hsum, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1, loop.eq_def]
        dsimp only
        rw [hbody]
      · simpa [hcoordinate, prefixValue] using hinv
  | succ fuel ih =>
      have hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7 := by omega
      obtain ⟨_lowSum, sum1, coordinate1, hbody, _hlowRun, hinc,
          _hlowCanonical, hsum1Canonical, hsum1Value⟩ :=
        AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1Step.loop1_body_step
          self highSums sum coordinate hcoordinate hhigh hlow hsum
      have hinc' : (coordinate + 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok coordinate1 := by
        change UScalar.add coordinate 1#usize = .ok coordinate1
        exact hinc
      have haddSpec := UScalar.add_equiv coordinate (1#usize)
      rw [hinc'] at haddSpec
      simp only [Result.ok.injEq] at haddSpec
      have hcoordinate1 : coordinate1.val = coordinate.val + 1 := haddSpec.2.1
      have hspan1 : coordinate1.val + fuel = 7 := by omega
      have hprefix1 : prefixValue self highSums coordinate1.val =
          prefixValue self highSums coordinate.val + term self highSums coordinate.val := by
        rw [hcoordinate1]
        rfl
      have hinv1 : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode sum1 =
          prefixValue self highSums coordinate1.val := by
        rw [hsum1Value, hinv, hprefix1]
        have hterm : term self highSums coordinate.val =
            AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
                (cell highSums ⟨coordinate.val, by
                  simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate⟩) *
              LowSumMeaning (LowSumModel self)
                (R0P.activeMaskBasisMasks ⟨coordinate.val, hcoordinate⟩) := by
          simp [term, hcoordinate]
        rw [hterm]
        have hcell : cell highSums ⟨coordinate.val, by
            simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate⟩ =
            highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
              simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate) := rfl
        rw [← hcell]
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, houtCanonical, houtValue⟩ :=
        ih (coordinate := coordinate1) (sum := sum1) (hspan := hspan1)
          (hsum := hsum1Canonical) (hinv := hinv1)
      refine ⟨out, ?_, houtCanonical, houtValue⟩
      rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1, loop.eq_def]
      dsimp only
      rw [hbody]
      exact hrun

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

def rebasedBody (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) (sum : QM) (coordinate : Usize) := do
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice
    pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis.MASKS)
  let i := Slice.len s
  if coordinate < i then
    let low_sum ← LowSum self coordinate
    let q ← Array.index_usize highSums coordinate
    let q1 ← field.QM31.mul q low_sum
    let sum1 ← field.QM31.add sum q1
    let coordinate1 ← coordinate + 1#usize
    ok (cont (sum1, coordinate1))
  else ok (done sum)

theorem loop1_body_step
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (highSums : Array QM 7#usize) (sum : QM) (coordinate : Usize)
    (hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7)
    (hhighSums : CanonicalArray highSums) (hlow : CanonicalArray self.low)
    (hsum : CanonicalQM sum) :
    ∃ lowSum : QM, ∃ sum1 : QM, ∃ coordinate1 : Usize,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1.body
        self highSums sum coordinate = .ok (.cont (sum1, coordinate1)) ∧
      LowSum self coordinate = .ok lowSum ∧
      UScalar.add coordinate 1#usize = .ok coordinate1 ∧
      CanonicalQM lowSum ∧ CanonicalQM sum1 ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode sum1 =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode sum +
          AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
            (highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
              simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate)) *
            LowSumMeaning (LowSumModel self)
              (R0P.activeMaskBasisMasks ⟨coordinate.val, hcoordinate⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨lowValue, hlowRun, hlowCanonical, hlowValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1SourceLow.sourceLowSum_success
      self coordinate hcoordinate hlow
  let highCell := highSums.val[coordinate.val]'(by
    simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate)
  have hhighRead : Array.index_usize highSums coordinate = .ok highCell := by
    exact index_usize_ok highSums coordinate hcoordinate
  have hhighCanonical : CanonicalQM highCell := by
    exact hhighSums ⟨coordinate.val, by
      simpa [highSums.property] using hcoordinate⟩
  obtain ⟨product, hmul, hproductCanonical, hproductValue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact highCell lowValue
      hhighCanonical hlowCanonical
  obtain ⟨sum1, hadd, hsum1Canonical, hsum1Value⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact sum product hsum hproductCanonical
  have hcoordinateBound : coordinate.val + (1#usize).val ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
  have hincSpec : (coordinate + 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = coordinate.val + (1#usize).val⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq] using hcoordinateBound
  obtain ⟨coordinate1, hinc, hcoordinate1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hincSpec
  have hlen : Slice.len (Array.to_slice
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis.MASKS) = 7#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simp [Slice.len, Slice.length, Array.to_slice,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis.MASKS]
  have hlt : coordinate < 7#usize := by
    apply (UScalar.lt_equiv coordinate 7#usize).2
    simpa using hcoordinate
  have hbodyEq : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1.body
      self highSums sum coordinate = rebasedBody self highSums sum coordinate := rfl
  have hbody : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.active_mask_basis_loop1.body
      self highSums sum coordinate = .ok (.cont (sum1, coordinate1)) := by
    rw [hbodyEq]
    simp only [rebasedBody, lift, hlen, if_pos hlt, hlowRun, hhighRead, hmul, hadd,
      hinc, bind_tc_ok]
  refine ⟨lowValue, sum1, coordinate1, hbody, hlowRun, hinc,
    hlowCanonical, hsum1Canonical, ?_⟩
  rw [hsum1Value, hproductValue, hlowValue]

    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (coordinate : Usize) (hcoordinate : coordinate.val < 7)
    (hlow : AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1LowSum.CanonicalArray self.low) :

abbrev LowIndex := {i : Usize // i.val < 16}

def lowCell (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (i : LowIndex) : QM :=
  self.low.val[i.val.val]'(by simpa [self.low.property] using i.property)

def lowItemsValue (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (items : List LowIndex) : ExactQM :=
  (items.map fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (lowCell self i)).sum

private theorem index_usize_ok {α : Type} {n : Usize}
    (a : Array α n) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < n.val) :
    Array.index_usize a i = .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  have hidx : i.val < a.val.length := by simpa [a.property] using hi
  unfold Array.index_usize
  change (match a.val[i.val]? with
    | none => Result.fail Error.arrayOutOfBounds
    | some x => Result.ok x) = Result.ok (a.val[i.val]'hidx)
  rw [List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]

def lowSumFrom
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (acc : QM) : List LowIndex → Result QM
  | [] => .ok acc
  | i :: is => do
      let x ← Array.index_usize self.low i.val
      let q ← field.QM31.add acc x
      lowSumFrom self q is

def lowSum
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors) :
    List LowIndex → Result QM
  | [] => .fail Error.panic
  | i :: is => do
      let x ← Array.index_usize self.low i.val
      lowSumFrom self x is

def lowItems (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (items : List LowIndex) : List ExactQM :=
  items.map fun i => AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode (lowCell self i)

private theorem lowSumFrom_exact
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (acc : QM) (items : List LowIndex)
    (hacc : CanonicalQM acc) (hlow : CanonicalArray self.low) :
    ∃ out : QM, lowSumFrom self acc items = .ok out ∧ CanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out =
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode acc + (lowItems self items).sum := by
  induction items generalizing acc with
  | nil =>
      refine ⟨acc, rfl, hacc, ?_⟩
      simp [lowItems]
  | cons i is ih =>
      have hread := index_usize_ok self.low i.val i.property
      let x := lowCell self i
      have hx : CanonicalQM x := hlow ⟨i.val.val, by
        simpa [self.low.property] using i.property⟩
      obtain ⟨q, hq, hqcan, hqdecode⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact acc x hacc hx
      have hread' : Array.index_usize self.low i.val = .ok x := by
        simpa [x, lowCell] using hread
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout, hdecode⟩ := ih q hqcan
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hout, ?_⟩
      · simp only [lowSumFrom, hread', hq, bind_tc_ok]
        exact hrun
      · rw [hdecode, hqdecode]
        simp [lowItems, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, add_assoc, x, lowCell]

theorem lowSum_exact
    (self : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors)
    (items : List LowIndex) (hitems : items ≠ [])
    (hlow : CanonicalArray self.low) :
    ∃ out : QM, lowSum self items = .ok out ∧ CanonicalQM out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode out = (lowItems self items).sum := by
  cases items with
  | nil => contradiction
  | cons i is =>
      let x := lowCell self i
      have hx : CanonicalQM x := hlow ⟨i.val.val, by
        simpa [self.low.property] using i.property⟩
      have hread := index_usize_ok self.low i.val i.property
      have hread' : Array.index_usize self.low i.val = .ok x := by
        simpa [x, lowCell] using hread
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout, hdecode⟩ := lowSumFrom_exact self x is hx hlow
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hout, ?_⟩
      · simp only [lowSum, hread', bind_tc_ok]
        exact hrun
      · rw [hdecode]
        simp [lowItems, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, x, lowCell]

#print axioms lowSum_exact
end AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisLoop1LowSum

namespace AspisR1.CopyPatternLoopFuel
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.CopyPatternLimbExact AspisR1.CopyPatternLoopFactor
open AspisR1.CopyPatternFoldModel

theorem pattern_loop_success_fuel (openings powers : Array QM 16#usize)
    (limb : Usize) (pattern : Pattern) (value : QM) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : limb.val + fuel = 16)
    (hcolumns : ∀ j : Fin 16, (cell pattern.columns j).val < 16)
    (hoffsets : ∀ j : Fin 16, (cell pattern.offsets j).val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hopenings : AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray openings)
    (hpowers : AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray powers)
    (hvalue : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM value) :
    ∃ out, Loop openings powers limb pattern value = .ok (16#usize,out) ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM out ∧
      decode out = remaining (modelPattern pattern hcolumns)
        (decodedCells openings) (decodedCells powers) limb.val (decode value) := by
  have hwidth : Width.val = 16 := by
    unfold Width AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH
    scalar_tac
  induction fuel generalizing limb value with
  | zero =>
    have hlimb : limb.val = 16 := by omega
    have hstop : ¬ limb < Width := by change ¬ limb.val < Width.val; omega
    have hlimbEq : limb = 16#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      simpa using hlimb
    refine ⟨value,?_,hvalue,?_⟩
    · unfold Loop
      rw [AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.pattern_values_literal_loop1_loop0.eq_def,
        if_neg hstop,hlimbEq]
    · rw [hlimb,remaining_end]
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hlimb : limb.val < 16 := by omega
    have hlt : limb < Width := by change limb.val < Width.val; omega
    obtain ⟨value1,hrun,hcvalue1,hvvalue1⟩ :=
      limb_success openings powers limb pattern value hlimb hcolumns hoffsets hopenings hpowers hvalue
    obtain ⟨limb1,hnext,hnextValue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Usize.add_spec (x := limb) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
    have hnextVal : limb1.val = limb.val + 1 := by simpa using hnextValue
    have hspan1 : limb1.val + fuel = 16 := by omega
    obtain ⟨out,hrec,hcout,hvout⟩ := ih limb1 value1 hspan1 hcvalue1
    refine ⟨out,?_,hcout,?_⟩
    · rw [loop_step_eq openings powers limb pattern value hlt]
      simp only [hrun,hnext,bind_tc_ok]
      exact hrec
    · rw [remaining_step (modelPattern pattern hcolumns)
        (decodedCells openings) (decodedCells powers) ⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩ (decode value)]
      simpa only [hnextVal,hvvalue1] using hvout

#print axioms pattern_loop_success_fuel

import AspisR1.CopyPatternInnerSource
import AspisR1.CopyPatternFoldModel
import CopyEndpointExact

/-! One actual pattern lane: bounded reads, scalar lift and checked field arithmetic.
The model descriptor comes from these same source arrays. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyPatternLimbExact
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Pattern := AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CompiledPoolV1PairForestPattern
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev decodedCells {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) := AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.decodedCells a

def cell {α : Type} {n : Usize} (a : Array α n) (i : Fin n.val) : α :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt)

def modelPattern (pattern : Pattern)
    (hcolumns : ∀ j : Fin 16, (cell pattern.columns j).val < 16) : R0P.CopyPattern :=
  { kinds := fun j => (cell pattern.kinds j).val,
    columns := fun j => ⟨(cell pattern.columns j).val,hcolumns j⟩,
    offsets := fun j => (cell pattern.offsets j).val }

def runLimb (openings powers : Array QM 16#usize) (limb : Usize)
    (pattern : Pattern) (value : QM) : Result QM := do
  let kind ← Array.index_usize pattern.kinds limb
  if kind = 1#u8 then
    let column ← Array.index_usize pattern.columns limb
    let index ← lift (core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from column)
    let q ← Array.index_usize openings index
    let offset ← Array.index_usize pattern.offsets limb
    let lifted ← AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.lift_m31 offset
    let source ← field.QM31.add q lifted
    let power ← Array.index_usize powers limb
    let product ← field.QM31.mul power source
    field.QM31.add value product
  else ok value

theorem limb_success (openings powers : Array QM 16#usize) (limb : Usize)
    (pattern : Pattern) (value : QM) (hlimb : limb.val < 16)
    (hcolumns : ∀ j : Fin 16, (cell pattern.columns j).val < 16)
    (hoffsets : ∀ j : Fin 16, (cell pattern.offsets j).val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hopenings : CanonicalArray openings) (hpowers : CanonicalArray powers)
    (hvalue : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM value) :
    ∃ out, runLimb openings powers limb pattern value = .ok out ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM out ∧
      decode out = AspisR1.CopyPatternFoldModel.step (modelPattern pattern hcolumns)
        (decodedCells openings) (decodedCells powers) (decode value) ⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩ := by
  let j : Fin 16 := ⟨limb.val,hlimb⟩
  have hb : limb.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using hlimb
  have hk : Array.index_usize pattern.kinds limb = .ok (cell pattern.kinds j) := by
    exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok pattern.kinds limb hb
  by_cases hkind : cell pattern.kinds j = 1#u8
  · have hkindVal : (cell pattern.kinds j).val = 1 := by rw [hkind]; rfl
    let column := cell pattern.columns j
    let index := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from column
    let columnFin : Fin 16 := ⟨column.val,hcolumns j⟩
    have hindex : index.val = column.val := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from_val_eq column
    have hib : index.val < (16#usize).val := by rw [hindex]; exact hcolumns j
    have hcolumn : Array.index_usize pattern.columns limb = .ok column :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok pattern.columns limb hb
    have hread : Array.index_usize openings index = .ok (cells openings columnFin) := by
      simpa [cells,columnFin,hindex] using
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok openings index hib
    have hoffset : Array.index_usize pattern.offsets limb = .ok (cell pattern.offsets j) :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok pattern.offsets limb hb
    have hpower : Array.index_usize powers limb = .ok (cells powers j) :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok powers limb hb
    obtain ⟨lifted,hlift,hclift,hvlift⟩ :=
      AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.lift_source_exact (cell pattern.offsets j) (hoffsets j)
    have hcopyLift : AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.lift_m31
        (cell pattern.offsets j) = .ok lifted := by
      simpa only [AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.lift_m31,
        AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.field.CM31.from_m31,
        AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.field.QM31.from_cm31,
        AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.field.CM31.ZERO,
        AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.field.M31.ZERO,
        pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.lift_m31,
        field.CM31.from_m31,field.QM31.from_cm31,field.CM31.ZERO,field.M31.ZERO,
        bind_tc_ok] using hlift
    change decode lifted = ((cell pattern.offsets j).val : ExactQM) at hvlift
    obtain ⟨source,hsource,hcsource,hvsource⟩ :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact
        (cells openings columnFin) lifted (hopenings columnFin) hclift
    change decode source = decode (cells openings columnFin) + decode lifted at hvsource
    obtain ⟨product,hproduct,hcproduct,hvproduct⟩ :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact
        (cells powers j) source (hpowers j) hcsource
    change decode product = decode (cells powers j) * decode source at hvproduct
    obtain ⟨out,hout,hcout,hvout⟩ :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact value product hvalue hcproduct
    change decode out = decode value + decode product at hvout
    refine ⟨out,?_,hcout,?_⟩
    · dsimp only [index] at hread
      simp only [runLimb,hk,hkind,if_pos,hcolumn,lift,hread,hoffset,hcopyLift,
        hsource,hpower,hproduct,hout,bind_tc_ok]
    · change decode out = if (cell pattern.kinds j).val = 1 then
        decode value + decode (cells powers j) *
          (decode (cells openings columnFin) + ((cell pattern.offsets j).val : ExactQM))
        else decode value
      rw [if_pos hkindVal,hvout,hvproduct,hvsource,hvlift]
  · have hkindVal : (cell pattern.kinds j).val ≠ 1 := by
      intro he
      apply hkind
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      exact he
    refine ⟨value,?_,hvalue,?_⟩
    · simp only [runLimb,hk,if_neg hkind,bind_tc_ok]
    · change decode value = if (cell pattern.kinds j).val = 1 then _ else decode value
      rw [if_neg hkindVal]

#print axioms limb_success
end
end AspisR1.CopyPatternLimbExact

import R0P.Copy

/-! Symbolic traversal equations for the retained sixteen-lane pattern fold. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyPatternFoldModel
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def lanes : List (Fin 16) := List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 16 => i)

def step (pattern : R0P.CopyPattern) (openings powers : Fin 16 → K)
    (value : K) (limb : Fin 16) : K :=
  if pattern.kinds limb = 1 then
    value + powers limb * (openings (pattern.columns limb) + (pattern.offsets limb : K))
  else value

def remaining (pattern : R0P.CopyPattern) (openings powers : Fin 16 → K)
    (cursor : Nat) (value : K) : K :=
  (lanes.drop cursor).foldl (step pattern openings powers) value

theorem lanes_length : lanes.length = 16 := by simp [lanes]

theorem lanes_getElem (i : Fin 16) : lanes[i.val]'(by rw [lanes_length]; exact i.isLt) = i := by
  simp only [lanes, List.getElem_ofFn]

theorem remaining_end (pattern : R0P.CopyPattern) (openings powers : Fin 16 → K)
    (value : K) : remaining pattern openings powers 16 value = value := by
  unfold remaining
  have hdrop : lanes.drop 16 = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_iff.mpr (by rw [lanes_length])
  rw [hdrop]
  rfl

theorem remaining_step (pattern : R0P.CopyPattern) (openings powers : Fin 16 → K)
    (cursor : Fin 16) (value : K) :
    remaining pattern openings powers cursor.val value =
      remaining pattern openings powers (cursor.val + 1)
        (step pattern openings powers value cursor) := by
  unfold remaining
  have hi : cursor.val < lanes.length := by rw [lanes_length]; exact cursor.isLt
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi, lanes_getElem cursor]
  rfl

theorem remaining_zero (openings : Fin 16 → K) (lambda : K) (index : Fin 14) :
    remaining (R0P.copyPatterns index) openings (R0P.copyPowers lambda) 0 0 =
      R0P.copyPatternValuesLiteral openings lambda index := by rfl

#print axioms lanes_length
#print axioms lanes_getElem
#print axioms remaining_end
#print axioms remaining_step
#print axioms remaining_zero
end AspisR1.CopyPatternFoldModel

theorem group_first {A B C : Type} (read : Result A)
    (step : A → Result B) (next : B → Result C) :
    (do let a ← read; let b ← step a; next b) =

import AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerSource
import AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerModel

import ExtractedMaskQM31Exact

/-! Exact symbolic traversal of the source16-power initialization loop. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerLoop
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerModel
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode
abbrev Loop := AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.pattern_values_literal_loop0
abbrev Width := AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH

theorem powers_loop_success_fuel (lambda : QM) (powers : Array QM 16#usize)
    (power : QM) (limb : Usize) (fuel : Nat)
    (hspan : limb.val + fuel = 16)
    (hlambda : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM lambda)
    (hpowers : CanonicalArray powers)
    (hpower : AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM power)
    (hvalue : decode power = powerAt (decode lambda) limb.val)
    (hprefix : ∀ j : Fin (16#usize).val, j.val < limb.val →
      decode (cells powers j) = powerAt (decode lambda) j.val) :
    ∃ out, Loop lambda powers power limb = .ok (out,16#usize) ∧
      CanonicalArray out ∧
      ∀ j : Fin (16#usize).val,
        decode (cells out j) = powerAt (decode lambda) j.val := by
  have hwidth : Width.val = 16 := by
    unfold Width AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.poseidon2.POSEIDON2_WIDTH
    scalar_tac
  induction fuel generalizing powers power limb with
  | zero =>
    have hlimb : limb.val = 16 := by omega
    have hstop : ¬ limb < Width := by
      change ¬ limb.val < Width.val
      omega
    have hlimbEq : limb = 16#usize := by
      apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
      simpa using hlimb
    refine ⟨powers,?_,hpowers,?_⟩
    · unfold Loop
      rw [AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.pattern_values_literal_loop0.eq_def,
        if_neg hstop, hlimbEq]
    · intro j
      exact hprefix j (by have hj := j.isLt; simp only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] at hj; omega)
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hlimb : limb.val < 16 := by omega
    have hbound : limb.val < (16#usize).val := by simpa using hlimb
    have hlt : limb < Width := by
      change limb.val < Width.val
      omega
    obtain ⟨updated,hupdate,hcupdated,hframe⟩ :=
      update_success powers limb power hbound hpowers hpower
    obtain ⟨power1,hmul,hcpower1,hvpower1⟩ :=
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact power lambda hpower hlambda
    change decode power1 = decode power * decode lambda at hvpower1
    obtain ⟨limb1,hnext,hnextValue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Usize.add_spec (x := limb) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
    have hnextVal : limb1.val = limb.val + 1 := by simpa using hnextValue
    have hspan1 : limb1.val + fuel = 16 := by omega
    have hvpower : decode power1 = powerAt (decode lambda) limb1.val := by
      rw [hvpower1,hvalue,hnextVal,powerAt_succ]
    let pos : Fin (16#usize).val := ⟨limb.val,hbound⟩
    have hprefix1 : ∀ j : Fin (16#usize).val, j.val < limb1.val →
        decode (cells updated j) = powerAt (decode lambda) j.val := by
      intro j hj
      change decode (cells updated j) = _
      rw [hframe]
      by_cases he : j = (⟨limb.val,hbound⟩ : Fin (16#usize).val)
      · subst j
        simpa [Function.update] using hvalue
      · have hne : j.val ≠ limb.val := by
          intro hv
          apply he
          apply Fin.ext
          exact hv
        have hjOld : j.val < limb.val := by omega
        simpa [Function.update, he] using hprefix j hjOld
    obtain ⟨out,hrec,hcout,hout⟩ :=
      ih updated power1 limb1 hspan1 hcupdated hcpower1 hvpower hprefix1
    refine ⟨out,?_,hcout,hout⟩
    unfold Loop
    rw [AspisR1CopyPatternCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.pattern_values_literal_loop0.eq_def]
    simp only [hlt, if_pos, hupdate, hmul, hnext, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hrec

#print axioms powers_loop_success_fuel
end
end AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerLoop

import R0P.Copy

/-! Symbolic recurrence of the already retained iterative Copy powers.
The loop proof uses this recurrence directly, never a concrete power. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerModel
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def powerAt (lambda : K) (limb : Nat) : K :=
  (List.range limb).foldl (fun power _ => power * lambda) lambda

theorem powerAt_zero (lambda : K) : powerAt lambda 0 = lambda := by rfl

theorem powerAt_succ (lambda : K) (limb : Nat) :
    powerAt lambda (limb + 1) = powerAt lambda limb * lambda := by
  unfold powerAt
  rw [List.range_succ, List.foldl_append]
  rfl

theorem retained_copyPowers (lambda : K) (limb : Fin 16) :
    R0P.copyPowers lambda limb = powerAt lambda limb.val := by rfl

#print axioms powerAt_zero
#print axioms powerAt_succ
#print axioms retained_copyPowers
end AspisR1.CopyPatternPowerModel

/-! Actual full Copy loop traversal. The only loop measure is the remaining
number of literal registry records; source arithmetic/updates come from the
proved same-record step, and the model is a symbolic suffix fold. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyLinkLoopFuel
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact AspisR1.CopyLinkStepExact
open AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact AspisR1.CopyRegistryModel
open AspisR1.CopyLinkLoopFactor AspisR1.CopyLinkLoopModel
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors
abbrev CanonicalArray {n : Usize} (a : Array QM n) :=
  AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact.CanonicalArray a

/-- The actual recursive source loop succeeds and agrees with the full
remaining registry fold, with no per-link execution or canonicality premises. -/
theorem loop_success_fuel (selectors : Selectors) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (patterns : Array QM 14#usize) (pv pw cv cw : Array QM 2#usize)
    (cursor : Usize) (fuel : Nat) (hspan : cursor.val + fuel = 136)
    (hpatterns : CanonicalArray patterns)
    (hhigh : CanonicalArray selectors.high) (hlow : CanonicalArray selectors.low)
    (hpv : CanonicalArray pv) (hpw : CanonicalArray pw)
    (hcv : CanonicalArray cv) (hcw : CanonicalArray cw) :
    ∃ pvOut pwOut cvOut cwOut,
      loopFn selectors index variant patterns pv pw cv cw cursor =
        .ok (pvOut,pwOut,cvOut,cwOut) ∧
      CanonicalArray pvOut ∧ CanonicalArray pwOut ∧
      CanonicalArray cvOut ∧ CanonicalArray cwOut ∧
      modelRow pvOut pwOut cvOut cwOut =
        remaining index.val (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns)
          (modelSelectors selectors) cursor.val (modelRow pv pw cv cw) := by
  have hcount : count.val = 136 := by
    unfold count AspisR1CopyLinkLoopCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_COPY_TERMINAL_LINKS_V1
    scalar_tac
  induction fuel generalizing cursor pv pw cv cw with
  | zero =>
    have hcursor : cursor.val = 136 := by omega
    have hstop : ¬ cursor < count := by
      change ¬ cursor.val < count.val
      omega
    refine ⟨pv,pw,cv,cw,?_,hpv,hpw,hcv,hcw,?_⟩
    · unfold loopFn
      rw [AspisR1CopyLinkLoopCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.evaluate_with_selectors_loop.eq_def]
      simp [hstop]
    · rw [hcursor]
      exact (remaining_end index.val (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns)
        (modelSelectors selectors) (modelRow pv pw cv cw)).symm
  | succ fuel ih =>
    have hcursor : cursor.val < 136 := by omega
    have hlt : cursor < count := by
      change cursor.val < count.val
      omega
    let pos : Fin 136 := ⟨cursor.val,hcursor⟩
    let link := rawAt pos
    have hread : Array.index_usize registry cursor = .ok link := by
      simpa [link, rawAt, pos] using
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok registry cursor
          (by simpa using hcursor)
    have hmem : link ∈ registry.val := by
      exact List.getElem_mem _
    obtain ⟨htag,hkind,hlevel,hb⟩ := AspisR1.CopyRegistryBounds.member_bounds link hmem
    obtain ⟨pv1,pw1,cv1,cw1,hstep,hcpv,hcpw,hccv,hccw,hmodel⟩ :=
      step_success link index variant patterns selectors pv pw cv cw
        hkind hlevel hb htag hpatterns hhigh hlow hpv hpw hcv hcw
    have hmodelLink : modelLink link hkind hb = modelAt pos := by rfl
    rw [hmodelLink] at hmodel
    obtain ⟨cursor1,hnext,hnextValue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (Usize.add_spec (x := cursor) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
    have hnextVal : cursor1.val = cursor.val + 1 := by simpa using hnextValue
    have hspan1 : cursor1.val + fuel = 136 := by omega
    obtain ⟨pvOut,pwOut,cvOut,cwOut,hrec,hcpvOut,hcpwOut,hccvOut,hccwOut,hrecModel⟩ :=
      ih pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1 cursor1 hspan1 hcpv hcpw hccv hccw
    refine ⟨pvOut,pwOut,cvOut,cwOut,?_,hcpvOut,hcpwOut,hccvOut,hccwOut,?_⟩
    · rw [loop_step_eq selectors index variant patterns pv pw cv cw cursor link hlt hread]
      simp only [hstep, bind_tc_ok, hnext]
      exact hrec
    · calc
        modelRow pvOut pwOut cvOut cwOut =
          remaining index.val (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns)
            (modelSelectors selectors) cursor1.val (modelRow pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1) := hrecModel
        _ = remaining index.val (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns)
            (modelSelectors selectors) (cursor.val + 1)
            (modelStep (modelRow pv pw cv cw) (modelAt pos) index.val
              (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors)) := by
          rw [hnextVal, hmodel]
        _ = remaining index.val (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns)
            (modelSelectors selectors) cursor.val (modelRow pv pw cv cw) :=
          (remaining_step index.val (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns)
            (modelSelectors selectors) pos (modelRow pv pw cv cw)).symm

/-- The complete136-link loop from source cursor0 equals the retained
registry fold, for the same input arrays, patterns, selectors, index and variant. -/
theorem loop_success (selectors : Selectors) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (patterns : Array QM 14#usize) (pv pw cv cw : Array QM 2#usize)
    (hpatterns : CanonicalArray patterns)
    (hhigh : CanonicalArray selectors.high) (hlow : CanonicalArray selectors.low)
    (hpv : CanonicalArray pv) (hpw : CanonicalArray pw)
    (hcv : CanonicalArray cv) (hcw : CanonicalArray cw) :
    ∃ pvOut pwOut cvOut cwOut,
      loopFn selectors index variant patterns pv pw cv cw 0#usize =
        .ok (pvOut,pwOut,cvOut,cwOut) ∧
      CanonicalArray pvOut ∧ CanonicalArray pwOut ∧
      CanonicalArray cvOut ∧ CanonicalArray cwOut ∧
      modelRow pvOut pwOut cvOut cwOut =
        R0P.copyLinks.foldl
          (fun acc link => modelStep acc link index.val (modelVariant variant)
            (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors)) (modelRow pv pw cv cw) := by
  obtain ⟨pvOut,pwOut,cvOut,cwOut,hr,hpvOut,hpwOut,hcvOut,hcwOut,hmodel⟩ :=
    loop_success_fuel selectors index variant patterns pv pw cv cw 0#usize 136
      (by scalar_tac) hpatterns hhigh hlow hpv hpw hcv hcw
  refine ⟨pvOut,pwOut,cvOut,cwOut,hr,hpvOut,hpwOut,hcvOut,hcwOut,?_⟩
  have hz : (0#usize : Usize).val = 0 := by scalar_tac
  rw [hz, remaining_zero] at hmodel
  exact hmodel

#print axioms loop_success
#print axioms loop_success_fuel
end

theorem loop_step_eq (selectors : Selectors) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (patterns : Array QM 14#usize) (pv pw cv cw : Array QM 2#usize)
    (cursor : Usize) (link : Raw)
    (hlt : cursor < count) (hread : Array.index_usize registry cursor = .ok link) :
    loopFn selectors index variant patterns pv pw cv cw cursor = (do
      let (pv1,pw1,cv1,cw1) ← runStep link index variant patterns selectors pv pw cv cw
      let cursor1 ← cursor + 1#usize
      loopFn selectors index variant patterns pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1 cursor1) := by
  unfold loopFn
  rw [AspisR1CopyLinkLoopCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.evaluate_with_selectors_loop.eq_def]
  simp only [hlt, if_pos, hread, bind_tc_ok]
  exact AspisR1.ResultPairSequence.three_pair_bind
    (weightFn link index variant)
    (fun weight => AspisR1CopyEndpointCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.accumulate_endpoint
      pv pw link.producer link.tag weight patterns selectors)
    (fun weight => AspisR1CopyEndpointCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.accumulate_endpoint
      cv cw link.consumer link.tag weight patterns selectors)
    (fun pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1 => do
      let cursor1 ← cursor + 1#usize
      loopFn selectors index variant patterns pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1 cursor1)

#print axioms loop_step_eq

  let other1 := read_discriminant other

@[global_simps, irreducible] def field.M31.ONE : field.M31 := 1#u32

def pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
  (link : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CompiledPoolV1PairForestLink)
  (append_index : Std.U64)
  (variant :
  pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1) :
  Result field.M31

        variant
        pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.PrivateTransfer

        variant
        pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.Withdrawal
