import ExtractedMaskReducerOps
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Bitwise

/-! Checked source shift/mask/cast and one-minus-bit used by link_weight.
Reuse existing unsigned-scalar and narrowing lemmas; no generated data. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyLinkBitArithmetic
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

theorem shifted_bit_success (index : U64) (level : U8)
    (hlevel : level.val < 64) :
    ∃ shifted : U64, ∃ bit : U64, ∃ out : U32,
      (index >>> level) = .ok shifted ∧
      lift (shifted &&& 1#u64) = .ok bit ∧
      lift (UScalar.cast .U32 bit) = .ok out ∧
      out.val = ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) ∧ out.val ≤ 1 := by
  have hlevel' : level.val < UScalarTy.U64.numBits := by simpa using hlevel
  obtain ⟨shifted, hshift, hshiftValue⟩ :=
    WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec index level hlevel')
  let bit := shifted &&& 1#u64
  let out := UScalar.cast .U32 bit
  have hone : (1#u64).val = 1 := by norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  have hbit : bit.val = ((index.val >>> level.val) &&& 1) := by
    dsimp only [bit]
    rw [UScalar.val_and, hshiftValue.1, hone]
  have hbitBound : bit.val ≤ 1 := by
    rw [hbit]
    exact Nat.and_le_right
  have hcast : out.val = bit.val := by
    exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.narrow_exact bit (by omega)
  refine ⟨shifted, bit, out, hshift, rfl, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hcast.trans hbit
  · omega

theorem one_minus_bit_success (bit : U32) (hbit : bit.val ≤ 1) :
    ∃ out : U32, (1#u32 - bit : Result U32) = .ok out ∧
      out.val = 1 - bit.val ∧ out.val ≤ 1 := by
  have hone : (1#u32).val = 1 := by norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  have hsafe : bit.val ≤ (1#u32).val := by rw [hone]; exact hbit
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hv⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.sub_success (1#u32) bit hsafe
  refine ⟨out, hr, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simpa only [hone] using hv
  · have hout : out.val = 1 - bit.val := by simpa only [hone] using hv
    rw [hout]
    exact Nat.sub_le _ _

#print axioms shifted_bit_success
#print axioms one_minus_bit_success
end AspisR1.CopyLinkBitArithmetic

import CopyLinkWeightExact

/-! One literal Copy link body, composing source weight and both endpoints.
The following step is the exact monadic fragment in the sealed source loop;
the enclosing registry read, increment and recursive continuation remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyLinkStepExact
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact
open AspisR1.ArrayUpdateCanonicalExact
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Selectors := pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors

def runStep (link : Raw) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (patterns : Array QM 14#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (pv pw cv cw : Array QM 2#usize) :
    Result (Array QM 2#usize × Array QM 2#usize × Array QM 2#usize × Array QM 2#usize) := do
  let weight ← weightFn link index variant
  let (pv1,pw1) ←
    AspisR1CopyEndpointCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.accumulate_endpoint
      pv pw link.producer link.tag weight patterns selectors
  let (cv1,cw1) ←
    AspisR1CopyEndpointCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.accumulate_endpoint
      cv cw link.consumer link.tag weight patterns selectors
  ok (pv1,pw1,cv1,cw1)

def modelRow (pv pw cv cw : Array QM 2#usize) : R0P.CopyRowExtension ExactQM :=
  ⟨decodedCells pv, decodedCells pw, decodedCells cv, decodedCells cw⟩

def modelStep (row : R0P.CopyRowExtension ExactQM) (link : R0P.CopyLink)
    (index : Nat) (variant : R0P.Variant)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → ExactQM) (selectors : R0P.CopySelectors ExactQM) :
    R0P.CopyRowExtension ExactQM :=
  let weight := R0P.copyLinkWeight link index variant
  let producer := R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint row.producerValues row.producerWeights
    link.producer link.tag weight patterns selectors
  let consumer := R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint row.consumerValues row.consumerWeights
    link.consumer link.tag weight patterns selectors
  ⟨producer.1, producer.2, consumer.1, consumer.2⟩

theorem step_success (link : Raw) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (patterns : Array QM 14#usize) (selectors : Selectors)
    (pv pw cv cw : Array QM 2#usize)
    (hkind : link.weight_kind.val < 5) (hlevel : link.weight_level.val < 64)
    (hb : EndpointBounds link) (htag : link.tag.val < AspisR1.TerminalLiftM31Exact.P)
    (hpatterns : CanonicalArray patterns)
    (hhigh : CanonicalArray selectors.high) (hlow : CanonicalArray selectors.low)
    (hpv : CanonicalArray pv) (hpw : CanonicalArray pw)
    (hcv : CanonicalArray cv) (hcw : CanonicalArray cw) :
    ∃ pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1,
      runStep link index variant patterns selectors pv pw cv cw = .ok (pv1,pw1,cv1,cw1) ∧
      CanonicalArray pv1 ∧ CanonicalArray pw1 ∧ CanonicalArray cv1 ∧ CanonicalArray cw1 ∧
      modelRow pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1 =
        modelStep (modelRow pv pw cv cw) (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val
          (modelVariant variant) (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors) := by
  obtain ⟨weight, hw, hbit, hweight⟩ := link_weight_exact link index variant hkind hlevel hb
  obtain ⟨pv1, pw1, hprod, hcpv, hcpw, hvprod⟩ :=
    endpoint_success pv pw link.producer link.tag weight patterns selectors
      hpv hpw hpatterns hhigh hlow hb.producerRow hb.producerSlot hb.producerPattern htag
  obtain ⟨cv1, cw1, hcons, hccv, hccw, hvcons⟩ :=
    endpoint_success cv cw link.consumer link.tag weight patterns selectors
      hcv hcw hpatterns hhigh hlow hb.consumerRow hb.consumerSlot hb.consumerPattern htag
  rw [hweight] at hvprod hvcons
  refine ⟨pv1,pw1,cv1,cw1,?_,hcpv,hcpw,hccv,hccw,?_⟩
  · simp only [runStep, hw, hprod, hcons, bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  · change modelRow pv1 pw1 cv1 cw1 =
      { producerValues := (R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint (decodedCells pv) (decodedCells pw)
          (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelEndpoint link.producer hb.producerRow hb.producerSlot hb.producerPattern)
          link.tag.val (R0P.copyLinkWeight (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val (modelVariant variant))
          (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors)).1,
        producerWeights := (R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint (decodedCells pv) (decodedCells pw)
          (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelEndpoint link.producer hb.producerRow hb.producerSlot hb.producerPattern)
          link.tag.val (R0P.copyLinkWeight (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val (modelVariant variant))
          (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors)).2,
        consumerValues := (R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint (decodedCells cv) (decodedCells cw)
          (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelEndpoint link.consumer hb.consumerRow hb.consumerSlot hb.consumerPattern)
          link.tag.val (R0P.copyLinkWeight (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val (modelVariant variant))
          (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors)).1,
        consumerWeights := (R0P.copyAccumulateEndpoint (decodedCells cv) (decodedCells cw)
          (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelEndpoint link.consumer hb.consumerRow hb.consumerSlot hb.consumerPattern)
          link.tag.val (R0P.copyLinkWeight (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val (modelVariant variant))
          (decodedCells patterns) (modelSelectors selectors)).2 }
    rw [←hvprod, ←hvcons]
    rfl

#print axioms step_success
end
end AspisR1.CopyLinkStepExact

import CopyLinkWeightSource
import CopyEndpointExact

/-! Actual checked Copy link weights, from source descriptor and public index. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev Raw := AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CompiledPoolV1PairForestLink
abbrev Variant := AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev weightFn := AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight

def modelVariant : Variant → R0P.Variant
  | .PrivateTransfer => .privateTransfer
  | .Withdrawal => .withdrawal

def weightNat (link : Raw) (index : U64) (variant : Variant) : Nat :=
  match link.weight_kind.val with
  | 0 => 1
  | 1 => match variant with | .PrivateTransfer => 1 | .Withdrawal => 0
  | 2 => match variant with | .PrivateTransfer => 0 | .Withdrawal => 1
  | 3 => 1 - ((index.val >>> link.weight_level.val) &&& 1)
  | _ => (index.val >>> link.weight_level.val) &&& 1

private theorem kind_eq (kind : U8) (n : Nat) (hn : n < 256)
    (h : kind.val = n) : kind = @UScalar.ofNatCore .U8 n (by simpa using hn) := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  simpa only [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using h

private theorem different_discriminants :
    AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.PrivateTransfer.read_discriminant ≠
    AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.Withdrawal.read_discriminant := by
  change (0#isize : Isize) ≠ 1#isize
  intro he
  have hv := congrArg IScalar.val he
  have hzero : (0#isize : Isize).val = 0 := by scalar_tac
  have hone : (1#isize : Isize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [hzero, hone] at hv
  omega

/-- The actual source weight is a canonical bit and equals the descriptor's
retained natural-number weight. Every shift, mask, cast and subtraction succeeds. -/
theorem link_weight_success (link : Raw) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (hkind : link.weight_kind.val < 5) (hlevel : link.weight_level.val < 64) :
    ∃ out : field.M31, weightFn link index variant = .ok out ∧
      out.val = weightNat link index variant ∧ out.val ≤ 1 := by
  have hcases : link.weight_kind.val = 0 ∨ link.weight_kind.val = 1 ∨
      link.weight_kind.val = 2 ∨ link.weight_kind.val = 3 ∨ link.weight_kind.val = 4 := by omega
  rcases hcases with hk | hk | hk | hk | hk
  · have he : link.weight_kind = 0#u8 := kind_eq _ 0 (by omega) hk
    refine ⟨1#u32, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp [weightFn, AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight,
        he, AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.field.M31.ONE, UScalar.ofNat, UScalar.ofNatCore]
    · simp [weightNat, hk, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    · norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  · have he : link.weight_kind = 1#u8 := kind_eq _ 1 (by omega) hk
    cases variant with
    | PrivateTransfer =>
      refine ⟨1#u32, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold weightFn AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
        rw [he]
        simp [UScalar.ofNatCore,
          AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.eq,
          different_discriminants, Ne.symm different_discriminants,
          core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from, lift, bind_tc_ok]
      · simp only [weightNat, hk]
        rfl
      · norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    | Withdrawal =>
      refine ⟨0#u32, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold weightFn AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
        rw [he]
        simp [UScalar.ofNatCore,
          AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.eq,
          different_discriminants, Ne.symm different_discriminants,
          core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from, lift, bind_tc_ok]
      · simp only [weightNat, hk]
        rfl
      · norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  · have he : link.weight_kind = 2#u8 := kind_eq _ 2 (by omega) hk
    cases variant with
    | PrivateTransfer =>
      refine ⟨0#u32, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold weightFn AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
        rw [he]
        simp [UScalar.ofNatCore,
          AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.eq,
          different_discriminants, Ne.symm different_discriminants,
          core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from, lift, bind_tc_ok]
      · simp only [weightNat, hk]
        rfl
      · norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    | Withdrawal =>
      refine ⟨1#u32, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · unfold weightFn AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
        rw [he]
        simp [UScalar.ofNatCore,
          AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.PoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPoolV1PairForestCompiledVariantV1.eq,
          different_discriminants, Ne.symm different_discriminants,
          core.convert.num.FromU32Bool.from, lift, bind_tc_ok]
      · simp only [weightNat, hk]
        rfl
      · norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  · have he : link.weight_kind = 3#u8 := kind_eq _ 3 (by omega) hk
    obtain ⟨shifted, bit, out, hs, hb, hc, hv, hbit⟩ :=
      AspisR1.CopyLinkBitArithmetic.shifted_bit_success index link.weight_level hlevel
    obtain ⟨complement, hcomplement, hvcomplement, hbound⟩ :=
      AspisR1.CopyLinkBitArithmetic.one_minus_bit_success out hbit
    refine ⟨complement, ?_, ?_, hbound⟩
    · unfold weightFn AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
      rw [he]
      change (do
        let shifted ← index >>> link.weight_level
        let bit ← lift (shifted &&& 1#u64)
        let out ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 bit)
        let result ← 1#u32 - out
        ok result) = .ok complement
      simp only [hs, hb, hc, hcomplement, bind_tc_ok]
    · simpa [weightNat, hk, hv] using hvcomplement
  · have he : link.weight_kind = 4#u8 := kind_eq _ 4 (by omega) hk
    obtain ⟨shifted, bit, out, hs, hb, hc, hv, hbit⟩ :=
      AspisR1.CopyLinkBitArithmetic.shifted_bit_success index link.weight_level hlevel
    refine ⟨out, ?_, ?_, hbit⟩
    · unfold weightFn AspisR1CopyLinkWeightCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.link_weight
      rw [he]
      change (do
        let shifted ← index >>> link.weight_level
        let bit ← lift (shifted &&& 1#u64)
        let out ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 bit)
        ok out) = .ok out
      simp only [hs, hb, hc, bind_tc_ok]
    · simpa [weightNat, hk] using hv

structure EndpointBounds (link : Raw) : Prop where
  producerRow : link.producer.row.val < 1024
  producerSlot : link.producer.slot.val < 2
  producerPattern : link.producer.pattern.val < 14
  consumerRow : link.consumer.row.val < 1024
  consumerSlot : link.consumer.slot.val < 2
  consumerPattern : link.consumer.pattern.val < 14

def modelLink (link : Raw) (hkind : link.weight_kind.val < 5)
    (hb : EndpointBounds link) : R0P.CopyLink :=
  { tag := link.tag.val,
    weightKind := ⟨link.weight_kind.val, hkind⟩,
    weightLevel := link.weight_level.val,
    producer := AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelEndpoint link.producer
      hb.producerRow hb.producerSlot hb.producerPattern,
    consumer := AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelEndpoint link.consumer
      hb.consumerRow hb.consumerSlot hb.consumerPattern }

theorem weightNat_model (link : Raw) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (hkind : link.weight_kind.val < 5) (hb : EndpointBounds link) :
    (weightNat link index variant : ExactQM) =
      R0P.copyLinkWeight (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val (modelVariant variant) := by
  have hcases : link.weight_kind.val = 0 ∨ link.weight_kind.val = 1 ∨
      link.weight_kind.val = 2 ∨ link.weight_kind.val = 3 ∨ link.weight_kind.val = 4 := by omega
  rcases hcases with hk | hk | hk | hk | hk <;> cases variant <;>
    simp [weightNat, R0P.copyLinkWeight, modelLink, modelVariant, hk]

/-- The returned scalar is the weight of the full model link computed from
this very source descriptor; no independent model link or weight is supplied. -/
theorem link_weight_exact (link : Raw) (index : U64) (variant : Variant)
    (hkind : link.weight_kind.val < 5) (hlevel : link.weight_level.val < 64)
    (hb : EndpointBounds link) :
    ∃ out : field.M31, weightFn link index variant = .ok out ∧
      out.val ≤ 1 ∧
      (out.val : ExactQM) =
        R0P.copyLinkWeight (modelLink link hkind hb) index.val (modelVariant variant) := by
  obtain ⟨out, hr, hv, hbit⟩ := link_weight_success link index variant hkind hlevel
  refine ⟨out, hr, hbit, ?_⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact weightNat_model link index variant hkind hb

#print axioms link_weight_success
#print axioms weightNat_model
#print axioms link_weight_exact
end
end AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact

import Aeneas.Std

/-! Generic tuple-bind sequencing. Proved on Result constructors before
instantiating generated array types; no scalar literal proof is normalized. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ResultPairSequence
open Aeneas.Std Result

theorem three_pair_bind {A B C D E F : Type}
    (w : Result A) (p : A → Result (B × C)) (q : A → Result (D × E))
    (k : B → C → D → E → Result F) :
    (do
      let value ← w
      let (b,c) ← p value
      let (d,e) ← q value
      k b c d e) = (do
      let (b,c,d,e) ← (do
        let value ← w
        let (b,c) ← p value
        let (d,e) ← q value
        ok (b,c,d,e))
      k b c d e) := by
  cases w with
  | fail err => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok value =>
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    cases hp : p value with
    | fail err => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok pair =>
      rcases pair with ⟨b,c⟩
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      cases hq : q value with
      | fail err => rfl
      | div => rfl
      | ok pair =>
        rcases pair with ⟨d,e⟩
        rfl

#print axioms three_pair_bind
end AspisR1.ResultPairSequence

record, field value or source loop is unfolded by the traversal model. -/

namespace AspisR1.CopyLinkLoopModel
noncomputable section
open AspisR1.CopyRegistryModel AspisR1.CopyLinkStepExact
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev Row := R0P.CopyRowExtension ExactQM

def remaining (index : Nat) (variant : R0P.Variant)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → ExactQM) (selectors : R0P.CopySelectors ExactQM)
    (cursor : Nat) (row : Row) : Row :=
  (modelRegistry.drop cursor).foldl
    (fun acc link => modelStep acc link index variant patterns selectors) row

theorem remaining_end (index : Nat) (variant : R0P.Variant)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → ExactQM) (selectors : R0P.CopySelectors ExactQM) (row : Row) :
    remaining index variant patterns selectors 136 row = row := by
  unfold remaining
  rw [← modelRegistry_length, List.drop_length]
  rfl

theorem remaining_step (index : Nat) (variant : R0P.Variant)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → ExactQM) (selectors : R0P.CopySelectors ExactQM)
    (cursor : Fin 136) (row : Row) :
    remaining index variant patterns selectors cursor.val row =
      remaining index variant patterns selectors (cursor.val + 1)
        (modelStep row (modelAt cursor) index variant patterns selectors) := by
  unfold remaining
  have hi : cursor.val < modelRegistry.length := by
    rw [modelRegistry_length]
    exact cursor.isLt
  rw [List.drop_eq_getElem_cons hi, modelRegistry_getElem cursor]
  rfl

theorem remaining_zero (index : Nat) (variant : R0P.Variant)
    (patterns : Fin 14 → ExactQM) (selectors : R0P.CopySelectors ExactQM) (row : Row) :
    remaining index variant patterns selectors 0 row =
      R0P.copyLinks.foldl
        (fun acc link => modelStep acc link index variant patterns selectors) row := by
  unfold remaining
  rw [List.drop_zero, model_registry_exact]

#print axioms remaining_end
#print axioms remaining_step
#print axioms remaining_zero
end

noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Row := AspisR1CopyResidualCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CopyRowExtension

abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact

def cell (xs : Array QM 2#usize) (i : Fin 2) : QM :=

def modelRow (row : Row) : R0P.CopyRowExtension ExactQM :=

   fun i => decode (cell row.producer_weights i),
   fun i => decode (cell row.consumer_values i),
   fun i => decode (cell row.consumer_weights i)⟩
private theorem read_two_0 (xs : Array QM 2#usize) :
    Array.index_usize xs 0#usize = .ok (cell xs 0) := by
  simpa [cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    xs 0#usize (by norm_num)
private theorem read_two_1 (xs : Array QM 2#usize) :

  simpa [cell] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    xs 1#usize (by norm_num)
private theorem read_four_0 (a b c d : QM) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize = .ok a := by
  simpa [Array.make] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 0#usize (by norm_num)
private theorem read_four_1 (a b c d : QM) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize = .ok b := by
  simpa [Array.make] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 1#usize (by norm_num)
private theorem read_four_2 (a b c d : QM) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize = .ok c := by
  simpa [Array.make] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 2#usize (by norm_num)
private theorem read_four_3 (a b c d : QM) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize = .ok d := by
  simpa [Array.make] using AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d]) 3#usize (by norm_num)
/-- Canonical row cells, helper and challenge suffice for actual source
success and the exact retained Copy residual polynomial. Pattern/link and
active-mask production remain enclosing-caller obligations. -/
theorem copy_residual_exact (row : Row) (helper chi : QM)
    (hpv : ∀ i : Fin 2, CanonicalQM (cell row.producer_values i))
    (hpw : ∀ i : Fin 2, CanonicalQM (cell row.producer_weights i))
    (hcv : ∀ i : Fin 2, CanonicalQM (cell row.consumer_values i))
    (hcw : ∀ i : Fin 2, CanonicalQM (cell row.consumer_weights i))
    (hhelper : CanonicalQM helper) (hchi : CanonicalQM chi) :
    ∃ out,
      AspisR1CopyResidualCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.copy_residual
        row helper chi = .ok out ∧ CanonicalQM out ∧
      decode out = R0P.copyResidual (modelRow row) (decode helper) (decode chi) := by
  let p0 := cell row.producer_values 0
  have hcp0 : CanonicalQM p0 := hpv 0
  let p1 := cell row.producer_values 1
  have hcp1 : CanonicalQM p1 := hpv 1
  let c0 := cell row.consumer_values 0
  have hcc0 : CanonicalQM c0 := hcv 0
  let c1 := cell row.consumer_values 1
  have hcc1 : CanonicalQM c1 := hcv 1
  let pw0 := cell row.producer_weights 0
  have hcpw0 : CanonicalQM pw0 := hpw 0
  let pw1 := cell row.producer_weights 1
  have hcpw1 : CanonicalQM pw1 := hpw 1
  let cw0 := cell row.consumer_weights 0
  have hccw0 : CanonicalQM cw0 := hcw 0
  let cw1 := cell row.consumer_weights 1
  have hccw1 : CanonicalQM cw1 := hcw 1
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, hcq1, hvq1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact chi p0 hchi hcp0
  change decode q1 = decode chi - decode p0 at hvq1
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, hcq3, hvq3⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact chi p1 hchi hcp1
  change decode q3 = decode chi - decode p1 at hvq3
  obtain ⟨q5, hq5, hcq5, hvq5⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact chi c0 hchi hcc0
  change decode q5 = decode chi - decode c0 at hvq5
  obtain ⟨q7, hq7, hcq7, hvq7⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact chi c1 hchi hcc1
  change decode q7 = decode chi - decode c1 at hvq7
  obtain ⟨producer_denominator, hproducer_denominator, hcproducer_denominator, hvproducer_denominator⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact q1 q3 hcq1 hcq3
  change decode producer_denominator = decode q1 * decode q3 at hvproducer_denominator
  obtain ⟨consumer_denominator, hconsumer_denominator, hcconsumer_denominator, hvconsumer_denominator⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact q5 q7 hcq5 hcq7
  change decode consumer_denominator = decode q5 * decode q7 at hvconsumer_denominator
  obtain ⟨q13, hq13, hcq13, hvq13⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact pw0 q3 hcpw0 hcq3
  change decode q13 = decode pw0 * decode q3 at hvq13
  obtain ⟨q15, hq15, hcq15, hvq15⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact pw1 q1 hcpw1 hcq1
  change decode q15 = decode pw1 * decode q1 at hvq15
  obtain ⟨producer_numerator, hproducer_numerator, hcproducer_numerator, hvproducer_numerator⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q13 q15 hcq13 hcq15
  change decode producer_numerator = decode q13 + decode q15 at hvproducer_numerator
  obtain ⟨q17, hq17, hcq17, hvq17⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact cw0 q7 hccw0 hcq7
  change decode q17 = decode cw0 * decode q7 at hvq17
  obtain ⟨q19, hq19, hcq19, hvq19⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact cw1 q5 hccw1 hcq5
  change decode q19 = decode cw1 * decode q5 at hvq19
  obtain ⟨consumer_numerator, hconsumer_numerator, hcconsumer_numerator, hvconsumer_numerator⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q17 q19 hcq17 hcq19
  change decode consumer_numerator = decode q17 + decode q19 at hvconsumer_numerator
  obtain ⟨q20, hq20, hcq20, hvq20⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact helper consumer_denominator hhelper hcconsumer_denominator
  change decode q20 = decode helper * decode consumer_denominator at hvq20
  obtain ⟨q21, hq21, hcq21, hvq21⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q20 consumer_numerator hcq20 hcconsumer_numerator
  change decode q21 = decode q20 + decode consumer_numerator at hvq21
  obtain ⟨q22, hq22, hcq22, hvq22⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact producer_denominator q21 hcproducer_denominator hcq21
  change decode q22 = decode producer_denominator * decode q21 at hvq22
  obtain ⟨q23, hq23, hcq23, hvq23⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact consumer_denominator producer_numerator hcconsumer_denominator hcproducer_numerator
  change decode q23 = decode consumer_denominator * decode producer_numerator at hvq23
  obtain ⟨out, hout, hcout, hvout⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact q22 q23 hcq22 hcq23
  change decode out = decode q22 - decode q23 at hvout
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hcout, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1CopyResidualCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.copy_residual,
      read_two_0, read_two_1, read_four_0, read_four_1, read_four_2, read_four_3, p0, p1, c0, c1, pw0, pw1, cw0, cw1, hq1, hq3, hq5, hq7, hproducer_denominator, hconsumer_denominator, hq13, hq15, hproducer_numerator, hq17, hq19, hconsumer_numerator, hq20, hq21, hq22, hq23, hout, bind_tc_ok]
  · change decode out =
      (decode chi - decode p0) * (decode chi - decode p1) *
        (decode helper * ((decode chi - decode c0) * (decode chi - decode c1)) +
          (decode cw0 * (decode chi - decode c1) + decode cw1 * (decode chi - decode c0))) -
      ((decode chi - decode c0) * (decode chi - decode c1)) *
        (decode pw0 * (decode chi - decode p1) + decode pw1 * (decode chi - decode p0))
    rw [hvout, hvq23, hvq22, hvq21, hvq20, hvconsumer_numerator, hvq19, hvq17, hvproducer_numerator, hvq15, hvq13, hvconsumer_denominator, hvproducer_denominator, hvq7, hvq5, hvq3, hvq1]

#print axioms copy_residual_exact
end

/-! Exact generated copy-residual function and row carrier. Source cut only;
pattern/link accumulation and whole evaluate_with_selectors are separate. -/

namespace AspisR1CopyResidualCandidate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe

structure pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CopyRowExtension where
  producer_values : Array field.QM31 2#usize
  producer_weights : Array field.QM31 2#usize
  consumer_values : Array field.QM31 2#usize
  consumer_weights : Array field.QM31 2#usize

def pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.copy_residual
  (row : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.CopyRowExtension)
  (helper : field.QM31) (chi : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  let q ← Array.index_usize row.producer_values 0#usize
  let q1 ← field.QM31.sub chi q
  let q2 ← Array.index_usize row.producer_values 1#usize
  let q3 ← field.QM31.sub chi q2
  let q4 ← Array.index_usize row.consumer_values 0#usize
  let q5 ← field.QM31.sub chi q4
  let q6 ← Array.index_usize row.consumer_values 1#usize
  let q7 ← field.QM31.sub chi q6
  let q8 ← Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [ q1, q3, q5, q7 ]) 0#usize
  let q9 ← Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [ q1, q3, q5, q7 ]) 1#usize
  let producer_denominator ← field.QM31.mul q8 q9
  let q10 ← Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [ q1, q3, q5, q7 ]) 2#usize
  let q11 ← Array.index_usize (Array.make 4#usize [ q1, q3, q5, q7 ]) 3#usize
  let consumer_denominator ← field.QM31.mul q10 q11
  let q12 ← Array.index_usize row.producer_weights 0#usize
  let q13 ← field.QM31.mul q12 q9
  let q14 ← Array.index_usize row.producer_weights 1#usize
  let q15 ← field.QM31.mul q14 q8
  let producer_numerator ← field.QM31.add q13 q15
  let q16 ← Array.index_usize row.consumer_weights 0#usize
  let q17 ← field.QM31.mul q16 q11
  let q18 ← Array.index_usize row.consumer_weights 1#usize
  let q19 ← field.QM31.mul q18 q10
  let consumer_numerator ← field.QM31.add q17 q19
  let q20 ← field.QM31.mul helper consumer_denominator
  let q21 ← field.QM31.add q20 consumer_numerator
  let q22 ← field.QM31.mul producer_denominator q21
  let q23 ← field.QM31.mul consumer_denominator producer_numerator
  field.QM31.sub q22 q23

import Aeneas.Std

/-! Packing a successful four-tuple before its continuation, proved before
instantiating source array types and their dependent numeral evidence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ResultPackSequence
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem bind_packed_four {A B C D E F : Type} (result : Result (A × B × C × D))
    (pack : A → B → C → D → E) (next : E → Result F) :
    (do let (a,b,c,d) ← result; next (pack a b c d)) =
      (do let e ← (do let (a,b,c,d) ← result; ok (pack a b c d)); next e) := by
  cases result with
  | fail err => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok tuple => rcases tuple with ⟨a,b,c,d⟩; rfl

theorem first_bind_packed_four {A B C D E F G : Type} (first : Result A)
    (rest : A → Result (B × C × D × E)) (pack : B → C → D → E → F)
    (next : F → Result G) :
    (do let a ← first; let (b,c,d,e) ← rest a; next (pack b c d e)) =
      (do let f ← (do let a ← first; let (b,c,d,e) ← rest a; ok (pack b c d e)); next f) := by
  cases first with
  | fail err => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok a =>
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    exact bind_packed_four (rest a) pack next

#print axioms bind_packed_four
#print axioms first_bind_packed_four
end AspisR1.ResultPackSequence

/-! The exact post-copy caller tail executes both retained Horner folds and
returns the selected q cell. The old polynomial theorem supplies the folds;
this adapter checks the actual source slice/reverse constructors and final read. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CompositionPartsTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter
open scoped BigOperators
abbrev CanonicalQM := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskTowerAdd.CanonicalQM
abbrev ExactQM := AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.QM31Exact
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

private theorem array_slice_len {α : Type} {n : Usize} (xs : Array α n) :
    Slice.len (Array.to_slice xs) = n := by
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  simpa [Slice.len, Slice.length, Array.to_slice] using xs.property

/-- Source tail result from the actual coefficient arrays. No multiplier,
loop success or selected-cell success is assumed. The semantic/Poseidon
coefficient equations are source/model obligations of the enclosing caller. -/
theorem tail_success
    (semantic : Array QM 24#usize) (poseidon : Array QM 4#usize)
    (theta seed active : QM) (claims : Array QM 84#usize)
    (a : Array QM 16#usize) (mask_only : Array QM 10#usize) (h1_z : QM)
    (lanes : Fin 29 → ExactQM)
    (htheta : CanonicalQM theta) (hseed : CanonicalQM seed)
    (hsemanticCanonical : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      CanonicalQM (semantic.val[i.val]'(by simpa [semantic.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hposeidonCanonical : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      CanonicalQM (poseidon.val[i.val]'(by simpa [poseidon.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hclaims : ∀ i : Fin 84,
      CanonicalQM (claims.val[i.val]'(by simpa [claims.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hsemantic : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      coefficient24 semantic i.val = lanes (Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)))
    (hposeidon : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      coefficient4 poseidon i.val = lanes (Fin.castAdd 25 i))
    (hcopy : decode seed = lanes 28) :
    ∃ out q,
      run semantic poseidon theta seed active claims a mask_only h1_z =
        .ok (core.result.Result.Ok (out, a, mask_only, q, h1_z, active)) ∧
      CanonicalQM out ∧ CanonicalQM q ∧
      q = claims.val[27]'(by simpa [claims.property] using (show 27 < 84 by omega)) ∧
      decode out = ∑ i : Fin 29, decode theta ^ i.val * lanes i := by
  obtain ⟨prepared, middle, out, hnew, hfirst, hsecond, hcanonical, hvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial.prepared_folds_eq_lane_sum
      semantic poseidon theta seed lanes htheta hseed hsemanticCanonical
      hposeidonCanonical hsemantic hposeidon hcopy
  obtain ⟨q, hq, hqvalue, hqcanonical⟩ := selected_claim_success claims 0#usize 27#usize
    (by norm_num) (by norm_num) hclaims
  refine ⟨out, q, ?_, hcanonical, hqcanonical, ?_, hvalue⟩
  · simp only [run, hnew, bind_tc_ok, lift, array_slice_len,
      core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.rev.trait_default,
      core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.rev.default]
    change (do
      let composition ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.composition_parts_loop0
        (AspisR1.TerminalCompositionPolynomial.reverseRange 24#usize) semantic prepared seed

private theorem usize_add_eq_ok (a b out : Usize)

    UScalar.add a b = .ok out := by

  congr 1
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [hxval]
  exact hval

row-major index `point*28+column`; per-cell canonicality is inherited from the
actual caller-provided array. -/
theorem selected_claim_success
    (claims : Array field.QM31 84#usize) (point column : Std.Usize)
    (hp : point.val < 3) (hc : column.val < 28)
    (hcanonical : ∀ j : Fin 84,

      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.selected_claim claims point column = .ok q ∧

    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.tryMk_success

    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (point.val * (28#usize).val) = .ok i1
    simpa [hi1val] using hi1

    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.tryMk_success

row-major cell with quotient/remainder by 28. -/
theorem terminal_flat_call_mut_success
    (c : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.terminal_qm31.closure)
    (flat : Std.Usize) (hflat : flat.val < 84)

            have h29p : (29#usize : Std.Usize).val = 29 := by scalar_tac
            rw [((c.val[p.val]'(by
              have h3p : (3#usize : Std.Usize).val = 3 := by scalar_tac
              rw [c.property, h3p]
              exact p.isLt)).property), h29p]
            omega))) :
    ∃ q : field.QM31,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.terminal_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut
        c flat = .ok (q, c) ∧
      let row := c.val[(flat.val / 28)]' (by
        have hquot : flat.val / 28 < 3 := by omega

    simpa [HMod.hMod] using hmodWp
  have hrow : row.val < 3 := by rw [hdivVal, h28]; omega
  have hcol : col.val < 28 := by rw [hmodVal, h28]; exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have hvquot : row.val = flat.val / 28 := by simpa [h28] using hdivVal
  have hvrem : col.val = flat.val % 28 := by simpa [h28] using hmodVal
  have hquot : flat.val / 28 < 3 := by calc
    flat.val / 28 = row.val := hvquot.symm
    _ < 3 := hrow
  have hrem : flat.val % 28 < 28 := by calc
    flat.val % 28 = col.val := hvrem.symm
    _ < 28 := hcol
  have h3 : (3#usize : Std.Usize).val = 3 := by scalar_tac
  have h29 : (29#usize : Std.Usize).val = 29 := by scalar_tac
  have hrowRead := @AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok
    (Array field.QM31 29#usize) (3#usize) c row (by
    rw [h3]
    exact hrow)

    field.QM31 (29#usize) r col (by
    rw [h29]
    omega)

    have hb : flat.val % 28 < (29#usize).val := by rw [h29]; omega

    have h3q : (3#usize : Std.Usize).val = 3 := by scalar_tac
    rw [c.property, h3q]

    dsimp [r, rowResult]
    congr 1
  refine ⟨rowResult.val[flat.val % 28]'(by
    have hb : flat.val % 28 < (29#usize).val := by rw [h29]; omega
    simpa [rowResult.property] using hb), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.terminal_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleUsizeQM31.call_mut,
      hdiv, hmodWp, bind_tc_ok]

        have hb : flat.val % 28 < (29#usize).val := by rw [h29]; omega
        simpa [rowResult.property] using hb), c)
    rw [hcolRead]
    congr 1
    simpa [hr, hvrem]

    (openings : Openings) (poseidon : Array QM 4#usize)
    (poseidonModel : Fin 4 → ExactQM)

    (hclaims : CanonicalArray claims)

    (hchi : CanonicalQM chi) (htheta : CanonicalQM theta)
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (hash : H) (c1 : Array U8 32#usize)
    (outTranscript : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (hprep : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.public_transcript D
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s)
      hash c1 = Result.ok (.Ok outTranscript)) :

      pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors ∧
      AspisR1SemanticPackedBoundedCandidate.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.semantic_packed

      decode copy.active = R0P.copyActiveLiteral (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelSelectors selectors) ∧
      decode out = ∑ i : Fin 29, decode theta ^ i.val *
        lanesFromModels poseidonModel
          (semanticLane24 (copyFromStatement s) openings point)
          (R0P.copyEvaluateWithSelectors
            (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.decodedCells openings.z) (decode helper)
            (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelSelectors selectors) (decode lambda) (decode chi)
            index.val (AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact.modelVariant variant)).1 i := by

    AspisR1.SelectorRowSemantic.boxed_row_products point hpoint

    AspisR1.PreparedSemanticCoefficients.actual_coefficients point selectors s openings

    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.ActiveMaskBasisEvaluatorClosed.evaluate_success

  let seed := (R0P.copyEvaluateWithSelectors
    (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.decodedCells openings.z) (decode helper)
    (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelSelectors selectors) (decode lambda) (decode chi)
    index.val (AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact.modelVariant variant)).1
  let lanes := lanesFromModels poseidonModel
    (semanticLane24 (copyFromStatement s) openings point) seed
  have hsem : ∀ i : Fin 24,
      AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient24 semantic i.val =
        lanes (Fin.natAdd 4 (Fin.castAdd 1 i)) := by
    intro i
    have hcell : AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient24 semantic i.val =
        semanticLane24 (copyFromStatement s) openings point i := by
      simpa only [AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient24,
        AspisR1.PreweightedLoopModel.decoded, i.isLt, ↓reduceDIte] using hsemanticValue i
    exact hcell.trans (AspisR1.CompositionCoefficientSlots.semantic_slot
      poseidonModel (semanticLane24 (copyFromStatement s) openings point) seed i).symm
  have hpos : ∀ i : Fin 4,
      AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient4 poseidon i.val =
        lanes (Fin.castAdd 25 i) := by
    intro i
    have hcell : AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient4 poseidon i.val =
        poseidonModel i := by
      simpa only [AspisR1.TerminalCompositionLoopAdapter.coefficient4,i.isLt, ↓reduceDIte]
        using hposeidonValue i
    exact hcell.trans (AspisR1.CompositionCoefficientSlots.poseidon_slot
      poseidonModel (semanticLane24 (copyFromStatement s) openings point) seed i).symm
  have hseed : decode copy.residual = lanes 28 := by
    have hvalue : decode copy.residual = seed := congrArg Prod.fst hcopyValue
    exact hvalue.trans (AspisR1.CompositionCoefficientSlots.copy_slot
      poseidonModel (semanticLane24 (copyFromStatement s) openings point) seed).symm
  obtain ⟨out,q,htail,hout,hq,hqcell,hvalue⟩ :=
    AspisR1.CompositionPartsTail.tail_success semantic poseidon theta copy.residual copy.active
      claims openings.z maskOnly helper lanes htheta hcopyCan hsemanticCan hposeidon
      hclaims hsem hpos hseed
  refine ⟨selectors,semantic,copy,out,q,hbox,hsemanticRun,hcopyRun,htail,hout,hq,hactiveCan,?_,hvalue⟩
  simpa only [R0P.copyEvaluateWithSelectors] using congrArg Prod.snd hcopyValue

#print axioms components_and_tail

    (hprep : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.public_transcript D
      (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s)

        .ok (.Ok (terminal,openings.z,mask,g)) ∧

          (AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop.decodedArray point) *
          (∑ i : Fin 29, decode theta ^ i.val *
            lanesFromModels (PoseidonCallable53.model point openings selectors)

                (AspisR1.CopyLinkWeightExact.modelVariant

    AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe.selected_claim_success claims 0#usize 26#usize

  refine ⟨openings,selectors,mask,helper,composition,g,active,terminal,

  · simp only [TerminalPartsArithmeticExact.decode,CompositionCallable53.decode,decode]

    rw [hterminalValue,hvalue]

#print axioms run_success
end

/-! Exact arithmetic of the source `terminal_parts` suffix, after its
composition call has returned. This retains the actual selected-carrier
operations and reuses the checked equality-value loop. The composition call,
public wrapper and production-source instantiation remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.TerminalPartsArithmeticExact
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
abbrev QM := field.QM31
abbrev Arr := Array QM 10#usize
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev decode := AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.decode

/-- Source arithmetic sequence, with the already-unwrapped composition
result supplied explicitly. No field operation is replaced by its model. -/
def run (zerocheck_point point : Arr) (composition h1_z copy_active mu : QM) :
    Result QM := do
  let q ← pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value zerocheck_point point
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul q composition
  let q2 ← field.QM31.mul mu h1_z
  let q3 ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul mu mu
  let q5 ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE copy_active
  let q6 ← field.QM31.mul q5 h1_z
  let q7 ← field.QM31.mul q4 q6
  field.QM31.add q3 q7

theorem run_exact (zerocheck_point point : Arr)
    (composition h1_z copy_active mu : QM)
    (hzc : ∀ i : Fin 10, Canonical
      (zerocheck_point.val[i.val]'(by simpa [zerocheck_point.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hpoint : ∀ i : Fin 10, Canonical
      (point.val[i.val]'(by simpa [point.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hc : Canonical composition) (hh : Canonical h1_z)
    (ha : Canonical copy_active) (hm : Canonical mu) :
    ∃ out, run zerocheck_point point composition h1_z copy_active mu = ok out ∧
      Canonical out ∧
      decode out =
        R0P.SemSource.eqValue
          (AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop.decodedArray zerocheck_point)
          (AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop.decodedArray point) * decode composition +
        decode mu * decode h1_z +
        (decode mu * decode mu) * ((1 - decode copy_active) * decode h1_z) := by
  obtain ⟨q, hq, cq, vq⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop.equality_value_success zerocheck_point point hzc hpoint
  obtain ⟨q1, hq1, cq1, vq1⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact q composition cq hc
  obtain ⟨q2, hq2, cq2, vq2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact mu h1_z hm hh
  obtain ⟨q3, hq3, cq3, vq3⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q1 q2 cq1 cq2
  obtain ⟨q4, hq4, cq4, vq4⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact mu mu hm hm
  obtain ⟨q5, hq5, cq5, vq5⟩ :=
    AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.current_qm_sub_exact field.QM31.ONE copy_active
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.one_canonical ha
  obtain ⟨q6, hq6, cq6, vq6⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact q5 h1_z cq5 hh
  obtain ⟨q7, hq7, cq7, vq7⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact q4 q6 cq4 cq6
  obtain ⟨out, hout, cout, vout⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_add_exact q3 q7 cq3 cq7
  refine ⟨out, ?_, cout, ?_⟩
  · simp only [run, hq, hq1, hq2, hq3, hq4, hq5, hq6, hq7, hout, bind_tc_ok]
  · simp only [decode, AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode] at vq vq5 ⊢
    rw [vout, vq3, vq1, vq2, vq7, vq4, vq6, vq5,
      AspisR1.ExtractedMaskConstants.one_decode, vq]

import EqualityValueAdapter
import EqualityValueProduct
import ExtractedMaskHornerStep
import R0P.SemDecision

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1SelectedMaskProbe
open AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter

abbrev QM := AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.QM
abbrev ExactQM := AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.ExactQM
abbrev Canonical := AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.Canonical
abbrev Arr := Aeneas.Std.Array QM 10#usize

def factorAt (left right : Arr) (i : Fin 10) : ExactQM :=
  factor (decode (left.val[i.val]'(by simpa [left.property] using i.isLt)))
    (decode (right.val[i.val]'(by simpa [right.property] using i.isLt)))

def suffixProduct (left right : Arr) (k : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  ∏ i : Fin (10 - k), factorAt left right ⟨k + i.val, by omega⟩

private def factorNat (left right : Arr) (j : Nat) : ExactQM :=
  if h : j < 10 then factorAt left right ⟨j, h⟩ else 1

private theorem suffixProduct_eq_nat (left right : Arr) (k : Nat) :
    suffixProduct left right k =
      ∏ i : Fin (10 - k), factorNat left right (k + i.val) := by
  unfold suffixProduct
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  have hj : k + i.val < 10 := by omega
  simp [factorNat, hj]

theorem suffixProduct_step (left right : Arr) (k : Nat) (hk : k < 10) :
    suffixProduct left right k =
      factorAt left right ⟨k, hk⟩ * suffixProduct left right (k + 1) := by
  rw [suffixProduct_eq_nat left right k]
  rw [suffixProduct_eq_nat left right (k + 1)]
  have hsize : 10 - k = (10 - (k + 1)) + 1 := by omega
  rw [hsize, Fin.prod_univ_succ]
  simp only [Fin.val_zero, Nat.add_zero]
  have hfirst : factorNat left right k = factorAt left right ⟨k, hk⟩ := by
    simp [factorNat, hk]
  rw [hfirst]
  congr 1
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [Fin.val_succ]
  have hindex : k + (i.val + 1) = k + 1 + i.val := by omega
  rw [hindex]

private theorem array_index_usize_ok (a : Arr) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val < (10#usize : Usize).val) :
    Array.index_usize a i =
      .ok (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using hi)) := by
  exact AspisR1.ExtractedMaskHornerStep.array_index_usize_ok a i hi

theorem loop_fuel_success (left right : Arr) (acc : QM) (index : Usize)
    (n : Nat) (hfuel : index.val + n = 10)
    (hacc : Canonical acc)
    (hleft : ∀ i : Fin 10,
      Canonical (left.val[i.val]'(by simpa [left.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hright : ∀ i : Fin 10,
      Canonical (right.val[i.val]'(by simpa [right.property] using i.isLt))) :
    ∃ out : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value_loop
          left right acc index = .ok out ∧
      Canonical out ∧
      decode out = decode acc * suffixProduct left right index.val := by
  induction n generalizing index acc with
  | zero =>
      have hindex : index.val = 10 := by omega
      have hlen : (Slice.len (Array.to_slice left)).val = 10 := by
        rw [Slice.len_val, Array.length_to_slice]
        rfl
      have hstop : ¬ index < Slice.len (Array.to_slice left) := by
        rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]
        rw [hindex, hlen]
        omega
      refine ⟨acc, ?_, hacc, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value_loop]
        simp only [Aeneas.Std.lift, bind_tc_ok]
        rw [if_neg hstop]
      · have hzero : 10 - index.val = 0 := by omega
        rw [suffixProduct_eq_nat left right index.val, hzero,
          Fin.prod_univ_zero]
        simp
  | succ n ih =>
      have hindex_lt : index.val < 10 := by omega
      have hlen : (Slice.len (Array.to_slice left)).val = 10 := by
        rw [Slice.len_val, Array.length_to_slice]
        rfl
      have hguard : index < Slice.len (Array.to_slice left) := by
        rw [UScalar.lt_equiv]
        simpa [hlen] using hindex_lt
      let iLeft := left.val[index.val]'(by simpa [left.property] using hindex_lt)
      let iRight := right.val[index.val]'(by simpa [right.property] using hindex_lt)
      have hgetLeft : Array.index_usize left index = .ok iLeft := by
        exact array_index_usize_ok left index (by simpa using hindex_lt)
      have hgetRight : Array.index_usize right index = .ok iRight := by
        exact array_index_usize_ok right index (by simpa using hindex_lt)
      have hleftCanon : Canonical iLeft := by
        apply hleft ⟨index.val, by omega⟩
      have hrightCanon : Canonical iRight := by
        apply hright ⟨index.val, by omega⟩
      obtain ⟨f, hf, hfcanon, hfvalue⟩ :=
        equality_factor_call iLeft iRight hleftCanon hrightCanon
      obtain ⟨acc1, hmul, hacc1, hmulvalue⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskQM31Exact.current_qm_mul_exact acc f hacc hfcanon
      have hsum : index.val + (1#usize : Usize).val <
          2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
        scalar_tac
      obtain ⟨index1, hinc, hincval⟩ :=
        AspisR1.ExtractedMaskReducerOps.tryMk_success
          (ty := .Usize) (index.val + (1#usize : Usize).val) hsum
      have hinc' : (index + 1#usize : Result Usize) = Result.ok index1 := by
        change UScalar.add index (1#usize) = Result.ok index1
        change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (index.val + (1#usize).val) = Result.ok index1
        exact hinc
      have hone : (1#usize : Usize).val = 1 := by rfl
      have hindex1 : index1.val + n = 10 := by
        rw [hincval, hone]
        omega
      obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout, hvalue⟩ :=
        ih acc1 index1 hindex1 hacc1
      refine ⟨out, ?_, hout, ?_⟩
      · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value_loop]
        simp only [Aeneas.Std.lift, bind_tc_ok]
        rw [if_pos hguard]
        simp only [hgetLeft, hgetRight, hf, hmul, hinc', bind_tc_ok]
        exact hrun
      · have hfactor : decode f = factorAt left right ⟨index.val, by omega⟩ := by
          simpa [factorAt, iLeft, iRight, decode] using hfvalue
        have hvalue' : decode out =
            decode acc1 * suffixProduct left right (index.val + 1) := by
          simpa [hincval, hone] using hvalue
        have hmulvalue' : decode acc1 = decode acc * decode f := by
          simpa only [AspisR1.EqualityValueAdapter.decode] using hmulvalue
        rw [hvalue', hmulvalue', hfactor]
        rw [suffixProduct_step left right index.val (by omega)]
        ring

theorem suffixProduct_one_eq_fin9 (left right : Arr) :
    suffixProduct left right 1 =
      ∏ i : Fin 9, factorAt left right i.succ := by
  unfold suffixProduct
  apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  congr 1
  apply Fin.ext
  simp only [Fin.val_succ]
  omega

def decodedArray (a : Arr) : Fin 10 → ExactQM := fun i =>
  decode (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa [a.property] using i.isLt))

/-- Success and exact finite-product refinement for the actual generated
    wrapper. The only input obligations are canonicality of the ten cells;
    the generated wrapper itself supplies the initial factor and loop index. -/
theorem equality_value_success (left right : Arr)
    (hleft : ∀ i : Fin 10,
      Canonical (left.val[i.val]'(by simpa [left.property] using i.isLt)))
    (hright : ∀ i : Fin 10,
      Canonical (right.val[i.val]'(by simpa [right.property] using i.isLt))) :
    ∃ out : QM,
      pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value left right = .ok out ∧
      Canonical out ∧
      decode out = R0P.SemSource.eqValue (decodedArray left) (decodedArray right) := by
  let q := left.val[0]'(by simpa [left.property])
  let q1 := right.val[0]'(by simpa [right.property])
  have hq : Array.index_usize left 0#usize = .ok q := by
    exact array_index_usize_ok left 0#usize (by simp)
  have hq1 : Array.index_usize right 0#usize = .ok q1 := by
    exact array_index_usize_ok right 0#usize (by simp)
  have hqcan : Canonical q := hleft ⟨0, by omega⟩
  have hq1can : Canonical q1 := hright ⟨0, by omega⟩
  obtain ⟨product, hfactor, hproduct, hfactorValue⟩ :=
    equality_factor_call q q1 hqcan hq1can
  have hloop := loop_fuel_success left right product 1#usize 9 (by decide)
    hproduct hleft hright
  obtain ⟨out, hrun, hout, hvalue⟩ := hloop
  refine ⟨out, ?_, hout, ?_⟩
  · rw [pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.equality_value]
    simp only [hq, hq1, hfactor, bind_tc_ok]
    exact hrun
  · have honeval : (1#usize : Usize).val = 1 := by decide
    have hvalue' : decode out = decode product * suffixProduct left right 1 := by
      simpa [honeval] using hvalue
    have hinitial : decode product = factorAt left right ⟨0, by omega⟩ := by
      simpa [factorAt, q, q1, decode] using hfactorValue
    rw [hvalue', hinitial, suffixProduct_one_eq_fin9]
    rw [eqValue_split_initial]
    have hfirst : factorAt left right ⟨0, by omega⟩ =
        factor (decodedArray left 0) (decodedArray right 0) := by
      rfl
    rw [hfirst]
    congr 1

#print axioms AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop.loop_fuel_success
#print axioms AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop.equality_value_success

end AspisR1.EqualityValueLoop

    (decode helper) (AspisR1.CopyEndpointExact.modelSelectors selectors)
    (decode lambda) (decode chi) public1.transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val

    (selectors : Selectors) (helper lambda chi : QM)
    (hpoint : CanonicalArray point)
    (hbox : pool_v1.pair_forest_copy_terminal.Selectors.boxed_at_point point = .ok selectors) :
    copyValue public1 openings selectors helper lambda chi =

        (pointSelector point)).getD 0 0 := by

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitQBasis51
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
abbrev F := (algebraMap M31Exact QM31Exact).fieldRange

def i : QM31Exact := ⟨ProverCommitTower50.ci,0⟩
def u : QM31Exact := ⟨0,1⟩

theorem base_coordinates (a : M31Exact) :
    algebraMap M31Exact QM31Exact a=⟨⟨a,0⟩,0⟩ := by
  have he : algebraMap M31Exact QM31Exact=
      (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact).comp (algebraMap M31Exact CM31Exact) := Subsingleton.elim _ _
  rw [he]
  rfl

def basis : R0P.PackBasis F := by
  refine ⟨i,u,?_⟩
  intro a b c d ha hb hc hd hs
  obtain ⟨a₀,rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp ha
  obtain ⟨b₀,rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hb
  obtain ⟨c₀,rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hc
  obtain ⟨d₀,rfl⟩ := RingHom.mem_fieldRange.mp hd
  have h0 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.re.re) hs
  have h1 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.re.im) hs
  have h2 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.im.re) hs
  have h3 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.im.im) hs
  simp only [base_coordinates] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  dsimp [i,u,ProverCommitTower50.ci] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_one,QuadraticAlgebra.im_one,zero_mul,mul_zero,zero_add,add_zero,one_mul,mul_one] at h0 h1 h2 h3
  simp [h0,h1,h2,h3]

theorem basis_i : basis.i=⟨ProverCommitTower50.ci,0⟩ := rfl
theorem basis_u : basis.u=⟨0,1⟩ := rfl

#print axioms base_coordinates
#print axioms basis
#print axioms basis_i
#print axioms basis_u
end R1Z.ProverCommitQBasis51

  · change (⟨0,1⟩ : QM31Exact)=B.u

    rw [hi,hu]
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul]

import R1Z.ProverCommitNativeQ48
/-! Current optimized multiplication by the four tower basis elements. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTower50
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode)

def ci : CM31Exact := ⟨0,1⟩
def basis (j : Fin 4) : QM31Exact := ![1,⟨ci,0⟩,⟨0,1⟩,⟨0,ci⟩] j

theorem cm_i (x : Old.C) (hx : ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical x) :
    ∃ z : Old.C, tower50.cm_i (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x)=ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source z) ∧
      ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical z ∧ ProverCommitNativeC49.value z=ci*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hda⟩ := ProverCommitNativeNeg49.neg_word x.b hx.2
  refine ⟨⟨a,x.a⟩,?_,⟨hca,hx.1⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [tower50.cm_i,ProverCommitNativeC49.source,ProverCommitRelease47.convC,fromC,ha,bind_tc_ok]
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change (a.val : M31Exact)=_
      rw [hda]
      simp [ci,QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,ProverCommitNativeC49.value,ProverCommitMulU48.decodeC]
    · change (x.a.val : M31Exact)=_
      simp [ci,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,ProverCommitNativeC49.value,ProverCommitMulU48.decodeC]

theorem mul (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (j : Fin 4) (word : U8) (hw : word.val=j.val) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, tower50.mul (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x) word=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=basis j*decode x := by
  have hre : (decode x).re=ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0 := rfl
  have him : (decode x).im=ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1 := rfl
  fin_cases j
  · have he : word=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨x,?_,hx,?_⟩
    · rw [he,tower50.mul];rfl
    · change decode x=(1:QM31Exact)*decode x
      rw [one_mul]
  · have he : word=1#u8 := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hda⟩ := cm_i x.c0 hx.1
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hdb⟩ := cm_i x.c1 hx.2
    refine ⟨⟨a,b⟩,?_,⟨hca,hcb⟩,?_⟩
    · rw [he,tower50.mul]
      change (do
        let a ← tower50.cm_i (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0)
        let b ← tower50.cm_i (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
        ok ({c0:=a,c1:=b} : field.QM31))=_
      rw [ha];simp only [bind_tc_ok,hb];rfl
    · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
      · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value a=_
        rw [hda];simp [basis,QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,hre,him]
      · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value b=_
        rw [hdb];simp [basis,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,hre,him]
  · have he : word=2#u8 := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hda⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.mul_r x.c1 hx.2
    have ha' : reconstruction.mul_r (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)=ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source a) := ha
    refine ⟨⟨a,x.c0⟩,?_,⟨hca,hx.1⟩,?_⟩
    · rw [he,tower50.mul]
      change (do
        let a ← reconstruction.mul_r (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
        ok ({c0:=a,c1:=ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0} : field.QM31))=_
      rw [ha'];rfl
    · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
      · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value a=_
        rw [hda];simp [basis,QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,hre,him]
      · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0=_
        simp [basis,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,hre,him]
  · have he : word=3#u8 := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨r,hr,hcr,hdr⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.mul_r x.c1 hx.2
    have hr' : reconstruction.mul_r (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)=ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source r) := hr
    obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hda⟩ := cm_i r hcr
    obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hdb⟩ := cm_i x.c0 hx.1
    refine ⟨⟨a,b⟩,?_,⟨hca,hcb⟩,?_⟩
    · rw [he,tower50.mul]
      change (do
        let r ← reconstruction.mul_r (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
        let a ← tower50.cm_i r
        let b ← tower50.cm_i (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0)
        ok ({c0:=a,c1:=b} : field.QM31))=_
      rw [hr'];simp only [bind_tc_ok,ha,hb];rfl
    · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
      · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value a=_
        rw [hda,hdr];simp [basis,QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,hre,him];ring
      · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value b=_
        rw [hdb];simp [basis,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul,hre,him]

#print axioms cm_i
#print axioms mul
end R1Z.ProverCommitTower50

def sparse_scan50.one (x : field.QM31) : Result Bool := do
  let i := x.c0.a
  if i = 1#u32
  then
    let i1 := x.c0.b
    if i1 = 0#u32
    then

  let i := x.c0.b

    if i1 = 0#u32

    let value ← Array.index_usize point i1
    let i2 ← lift (core.num.Usize.wrapping_shl prev 1#u32)
    let b ← sparse_scan50.one value
    let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromUsizeBool.from b)

def sparse50.factor

/-! Extracted counter owner, with identical arithmetic callees rebound to the

callee declaration body byte-for-byte. No external template is installed. -/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def field.M31.neg (self : field.M31) : Result field.M31 := do
  if self = 0#u32
  then ok 0#u32
  else let i ← lift (Std.U32.wrapping_sub field.P self)
       ok i

def field.M31.is_zero (self : field.M31) : Result Bool := do
  ok (self = 0#u32)

def field.CM31.neg (self : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  let m ← field.M31.neg self.a
  let m1 ← field.M31.neg self.b
  ok { a := m, b := m1 }

def field.CM31.square (self : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  let i := self.a
  let i1 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i4 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i1 i3)
  let i5 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i6 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from field.P)
  let i7 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_add i5 i6)
  let i8 ← lift (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i9 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_sub i7 i8)
  let i10 ← lift (Std.U64.wrapping_mul i4 i9)
  let m ← field.M31.reduce_u64 i10
  let m1 ← field.M31.mul self.a self.b
  let m2 ← field.M31.double m1
  ok { a := m, b := m2 }

def field.CM31.double (self : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  field.CM31.add self self

def field.CM31.is_zero (self : field.CM31) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← field.M31.is_zero self.a
  if b
  then field.M31.is_zero self.b
  else ok false

def field.QM31.square (self : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let c0_square ← field.CM31.square self.c0
  let c1_square ← field.CM31.square self.c1
  let c ← field.mul_by_r c1_square
  let c1 ← field.CM31.add c0_square c
  let c2 ← field.CM31.mul self.c0 self.c1
  let c3 ← field.CM31.double c2
  ok { c0 := c1, c1 := c3 }

def field.QM31.is_zero (self : field.QM31) : Result Bool := do
  let b ← field.CM31.is_zero self.c0
  if b
  then field.CM31.is_zero self.c1
  else ok false

def kernels.square (x : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  field.QM31.square x

def kernels.power
  (base : field.QM31) (exp : Std.U8) (acc : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  if exp = 0#u8
  then ok acc
  else
    let i ← lift (exp &&& 1#u8)
    let next ← if i != 0#u8
                 then field.QM31.mul acc base
                 else ok acc
    let q ← field.QM31.square base
    let i1 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_shr exp 1#u32)
    kernels.power q i1 next
partial_fixpoint

def kernels.inverse_c (x : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  let m ← field.M31.mul x.a x.a
  let m1 ← field.M31.mul x.b x.b
  let norm ← field.M31.add m m1
  let inv_norm ← inverse_ref norm
  let m2 ← field.M31.mul x.a inv_norm
  let m3 ← field.M31.neg x.b
  let m4 ← field.M31.mul m3 inv_norm
  ok { a := m2, b := m4 }

def kernels.mul_r (x : field.CM31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  let two_a ← field.M31.double x.a
  let real ← field.M31.sub two_a x.b
  let two_b ← field.M31.double x.b
  let imag ← field.M31.add x.a two_b
  ok { a := real, b := imag }

def kernels.inverse_q (x : field.QM31) : Result (Option field.QM31) := do
  let b ← field.QM31.is_zero x
  if b
  then ok none
  else
    let c ← field.CM31.square x.c0
    let c1 ← field.CM31.square x.c1
    let c2 ← kernels.mul_r c1
    let norm ← field.CM31.sub c c2
    let ni ← kernels.inverse_c norm
    let c3 ← field.CM31.mul x.c0 ni
    let c4 ← field.CM31.neg x.c1

/-! Reuses the prior GeneratedMulByR and GeneratedQM31Products proof routes
for current extracted functions. This proves canonical modular word formulas,
not the verifier caller or the decoded exact-field correspondence. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Mul

open Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev P : Nat := ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.P
abbrev WordPair := Nat × Nat

def addWords (x y : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  ((x.1 + y.1) % P, (x.2 + y.2) % P)

def subWords (x y : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  ((x.1 + P - y.1) % P, (x.2 + P - y.2) % P)

def mulWords (x y : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  (((x.1 * y.1) % P + P - (x.2 * y.2) % P) % P,
   ((((x.1 + x.2) * (y.1 + y.2)) % P + P -
       (x.1 * y.1) % P) % P + P - (x.2 * y.2) % P) % P)

def rWords (x : WordPair) : WordPair :=
  (((x.1 + x.1) % P + P - x.2) % P,
   (x.1 + (x.2 + x.2) % P) % P)

def qmMulWords (x y : WordPair × WordPair) :=
  let m0 := mulWords x.1 y.1
  let m1 := mulWords x.2 y.2
  (addWords m0 (rWords m1),
   subWords (subWords (mulWords (addWords x.1 x.2)
     (addWords y.1 y.2)) m0) m1)

private def wordsCM (x : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31) : WordPair :=
  (x.a.val, x.b.val)

def wordsQM (x : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.QM31) :
    WordPair × WordPair :=
  (wordsCM x.c0, wordsCM x.c1)

private theorem cm_add_words
    (x y : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.add x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = addWords (wordsCM x) (wordsCM y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ez, cz, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.current_cm_add_mod x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, ez, cz, Prod.ext va vb⟩

private theorem cm_sub_words
    (x y : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.sub x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = subWords (wordsCM x) (wordsCM y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ez, cz, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.current_cm_sub_mod x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, ez, cz, Prod.ext va vb⟩

private theorem cm_mul_words
    (x y : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = mulWords (wordsCM x) (wordsCM y) := by
  obtain ⟨z, ez, cz, va, vb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul.current_mul_words x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z, ez, cz, Prod.ext va vb⟩

private theorem cm_r_words
    (x : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM x) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.mul_by_r x = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM z ∧
      wordsCM z = rWords (wordsCM x) := by
  obtain ⟨a2, ea2, va2, ca2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a x.a hx.1 hx.1
  obtain ⟨a, ea, va, ca⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod a2 x.b ca2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b2, eb2, vb2, cb2⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.b x.b hx.2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b, eb, vb, cb⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_add_mod x.a b2 hx.1 cb2
  refine ⟨⟨a, b⟩, ?_, ⟨ca, cb⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.mul_by_r,
      AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.double,
      ea2, ea, eb2, eb, bind_tc_ok]
  · change (a.val, b.val) = rWords (wordsCM x)
    simp only [rWords, wordsCM]
    exact Prod.ext (by simpa only [va2] using va)
      (by simpa only [vb2] using vb)

theorem current_qm_mul_words
    (x y : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.QM31)
    (hx : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalQM x)
    (hy : AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalQM y) :
    ∃ z, AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.QM31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalQM z ∧
      wordsQM z = qmMulWords (wordsQM x) (wordsQM y) := by
  obtain ⟨m0, e0, c0, v0⟩ := cm_mul_words x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨m1, e1, c1, v1⟩ := cm_mul_words x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  obtain ⟨a, ea, ca, va⟩ := cm_add_words x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b, eb, cb, vb⟩ := cm_add_words y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨m2, e2, c2, v2⟩ := cm_mul_words a b ca cb
  obtain ⟨r, er, cr, vr⟩ := cm_r_words m1 c1
  obtain ⟨lo, el, cl, vl⟩ := cm_add_words m0 r c0 cr
  obtain ⟨d, ed, cd, vd⟩ := cm_sub_words m2 m0 c2 c0
  obtain ⟨hi, eh, ch, vh⟩ := cm_sub_words d m1 cd c1
  refine ⟨⟨lo, hi⟩, ?_, ⟨cl, ch⟩, ?_⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.QM31.mul,
      e0, e1, ea, eb, e2, er, el, ed, eh, bind_tc_ok]
  · change (wordsCM lo, wordsCM hi) = _
    rw [vl, vh, vd, vr, v2, va, vb, v0, v1]
    rfl

#print axioms current_qm_mul_words

end AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Mul

/-!
Symbolic port of the old CM31 cross-operand and current multiplication proof to
freshly extracted field functions using the full Aeneas runtime.  No projected
runtime declarations are imported or introduced here.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul

open Aeneas.Std Result Error
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducerOps
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd

abbrev CM := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31
abbrev M31 := AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31

def realWord (a b c d : Nat) := ((a*c)%P + P - (b*d)%P)%P

def imagWord (a b c d : Nat) :=
  ((((a+b)*(c+d))%P + P - (a*c)%P)%P + P - (b*d)%P)%P

theorem widen_value (x : M31) :
    (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x).val = x.val := by
  change (x.bv.setWidth 64).toNat = x.bv.toNat
  apply BitVec.toNat_setWidth_of_le
  decide

def crossOperand (a b c d : M31) : Result U64 := do
  let left ← UScalar.add (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a)
    (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b)
  let right ← UScalar.add (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c)
    (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from d)
  UScalar.mul left right

theorem crossOperand_success (a b c d : M31)
    (ha : a.val < 2147483647) (hb : b.val < 2147483647)
    (hc : c.val < 2147483647) (hd : d.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ product : U64, crossOperand a b c d = .ok product ∧
      product.val = (a.val+b.val)*(c.val+d.val) := by
  have hab : a.val + b.val < 2^32 := by omega
  have hcd : c.val + d.val < 2^32 := by omega
  have hleft :
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from a).val +
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from b).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [widen_value, widen_value]
    omega
  have hright :
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from c).val +
      (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from d).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [widen_value, widen_value]
    omega
  obtain ⟨left, hl, hvl⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducerOps.add_success _ _ hleft
  obtain ⟨right, hr, hvr⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducerOps.add_success _ _ hright
  rw [widen_value, widen_value] at hvl hvr
  have hprod : left.val * right.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hvl, hvr]
    calc
      (a.val + b.val) * (c.val + d.val) < (2^32) * (2^32) :=
        Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt hab hcd
      _ = 2^64 := by norm_num
  obtain ⟨product, hp, hvp⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducerOps.mul_success left right hprod
  refine ⟨product, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [crossOperand, hl, hr, bind_tc_ok, hp]
  · simpa only [hvl, hvr] using hvp

/-- The source-shaped cross-operand fragment used by current `field.CM31.mul`.
The surrounding two M31 products and following reductions remain separate. -/
def generatedCrossFragment (self rhs : CM) : Result U64 := do
  let i := self.a
  let i1 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i)
  let i2 := self.b
  let i3 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i2)
  let i4 ← i1 + i3
  let i5 := rhs.a
  let i6 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i5)
  let i7 := rhs.b
  let i8 ← lift (Aeneas.Std.core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from i7)
  let i9 ← i6 + i8
  let i10 ← i4 * i9
  .ok i10

private theorem bind_return_word (r : Result U64) :
    (do let x ← r; .ok x) = r := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem generatedCrossFragment_eq (self rhs : CM) :
    generatedCrossFragment self rhs = crossOperand self.a self.b rhs.a rhs.b := by
  simp only [generatedCrossFragment, crossOperand, Aeneas.Std.lift,
    bind_tc_ok, bind_return_word]
  rfl

theorem generatedCrossFragment_success (self rhs : CM)
    (ha : self.a.val < 2147483647) (hb : self.b.val < 2147483647)
    (hc : rhs.a.val < 2147483647) (hd : rhs.b.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ product : U64, generatedCrossFragment self rhs = .ok product ∧
      product.val = (self.a.val+self.b.val)*(rhs.a.val+rhs.b.val) := by
  rw [generatedCrossFragment_eq]
  exact crossOperand_success _ _ _ _ ha hb hc hd

theorem generated_mul_graph (x y : CM) :
    AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.mul x y = (do
      let m0 ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul x.a y.a
      let m1 ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul x.b y.b
      let product ← generatedCrossFragment x y
      let m2 ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.reduce_u64 product
      let low ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub m0 m1
      let high0 ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub m2 m0
      let high ← AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.sub high0 m1
      Result.ok ⟨low, high⟩) := by
  simp only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.mul,
    generatedCrossFragment, lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq]

theorem current_mul_words (x y : CM)
    (hx : CanonicalCM x) (hy : CanonicalCM y) :
    ∃ z : CM,
      AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.CM31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      CanonicalCM z ∧
      z.a.val = realWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val ∧
      z.b.val = imagWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val := by
  obtain ⟨m0, h0, hv0, hc0⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod x.a y.a
  obtain ⟨m1, h1, hv1, hc1⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_mul_mod x.b y.b
  obtain ⟨product, hp, hvp⟩ := generatedCrossFragment_success x y hx.1 hx.2 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨m2, h2, hv2, hc2⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer.current_wrapper_mod product
  rw [hvp] at hv2
  obtain ⟨low, hl, hvl, hcl⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m0 m1 hc0 hc1
  obtain ⟨high0, hh0, hvh0, hch0⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod m2 m0 hc2 hc0
  obtain ⟨high, hh, hvh, hch⟩ := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.current_sub_mod high0 m1 hch0 hc1
  refine ⟨⟨low, high⟩, ?_, ⟨hcl, hch⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [generated_mul_graph]
    simp only [h0, h1, hp, h2, hl, hh0, hh, bind_tc_ok]
  · simpa only [realWord, hv0, hv1] using hvl
  · simpa only [imagWord, hvh0, hv2, hv0, hv1] using hvh

#print axioms widen_value
#print axioms crossOperand_success
#print axioms generatedCrossFragment_eq
#print axioms generatedCrossFragment_success
#print axioms generated_mul_graph
#print axioms current_mul_words

end AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentCM31Mul

import ExtractedCurrentReducerOps
