/-! Reuses the symbolic reducer execution proof over the actual full Aeneas
runtime, then identifies it with freshly extracted current Rust functions.
No source caller canonicality or whole-verifier refinement is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentReducer
open Aeneas.Std ExtractedCurrentReducerOps AspisV8R17.RawReducer

def mask32 : U32 := UScalar.ofNatCore P (by decide)
def mask64 : U64 := UScalar.cast .U64 mask32

theorem mask32_value : mask32.val = P := rfl
theorem mask64_value : mask64.val = P := rfl

def foldExecution (x : U64) : Result U64 := do
  let high ← UScalar.shiftRight x 31
  UScalar.add (UScalar.and x mask64) high

theorem foldExecution_success (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U64, foldExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = foldBits x.val := by
  obtain ⟨high, hs, hv⟩ := shift_success x 31 (by decide)
  have hand : (UScalar.and x mask64).val = x.val &&& P := by
    rw [and_value, mask64_value]
  have hsum : (UScalar.and x mask64).val + high.val < 2^64 := by
    rw [hand, hv]
    have bound := first_fold_lt x.val x.bv.isLt
    change (x.val &&& P) + (x.val >>> 31) < 10737418240 at bound
    omega
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := add_success _ _ hsum
  refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [foldExecution, hs, bind_tc_ok, hy]
  · simpa only [hand, hv, foldBits] using hyv

def reduceExecution (x : U64) : Result U32 := do
  let first ← foldExecution x
  let second ← foldExecution first
  let narrowed := UScalar.cast .U32 second
  if P ≤ narrowed.val then UScalar.sub narrowed mask32 else .ok narrowed

theorem reduceExecution_success (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U32, reduceExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = rawReduceU64 x.val := by
  obtain ⟨first, hf, hfv⟩ := foldExecution_success x
  obtain ⟨second, hs, hsv⟩ := foldExecution_success first
  rw [hfv] at hsv
  have narrow : (UScalar.cast .U32 second).val = foldBits (foldBits x.val) := by
    rw [narrow_exact, hsv]
    rw [hsv]
    exact second_fold_lt_two_pow32 x.val x.bv.isLt
  have raw : rawReduceU64 x.val = condSubP (foldBits (foldBits x.val)) := by
    rw [rawReduceU64, second_fold_cast_exact x.val x.bv.isLt]
  by_cases h : P ≤ (UScalar.cast .U32 second).val
  · obtain ⟨y, hy, hyv⟩ := sub_success (UScalar.cast .U32 second) mask32
      (by simpa only [mask32_value] using h)
    refine ⟨y, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [reduceExecution, hf, hs, bind_tc_ok, h, if_pos, hy]
    · rw [raw, condSubP, ← narrow, if_pos h]
      simpa only [mask32_value] using hyv
  · refine ⟨UScalar.cast .U32 second, ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [reduceExecution, hf, hs, bind_tc_ok, h, if_false]
    · rw [raw, condSubP, ← narrow, if_neg h]

theorem reduceExecution_canonical (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U32, reduceExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = rawReduceU64 x.val ∧ y.val < P := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hv⟩ := reduceExecution_success x
  refine ⟨y, hy, hv, ?_⟩
  rw [hv]
  exact rawReduceU64_canonical x.val x.bv.isLt

#print axioms foldExecution_success
theorem reduceExecution_mod (x : U64) :
    ∃ y : U32, reduceExecution x = .ok y ∧ y.val = x.val % P ∧ y.val < P := by
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hv, hc⟩ := reduceExecution_canonical x
  exact ⟨y, hy, hv.trans (rawReduceU64_eq_mod_nat x.val x.bv.isLt), hc⟩

#print axioms reduceExecution_success
#print axioms reduceExecution_canonical
#print axioms reduceExecution_mod


/-- Actual extracted current reducer equals the symbolic execution above. -/
theorem current_reducer_eq (x : U64) :
    AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.reduce_u64 x = reduceExecution x := by
  simp only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.reduce_u64,
    AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.P, reduceExecution,
    foldExecution, mask64, mask32, lift, bind_tc_ok, bind_assoc_eq]
  rfl

theorem current_reduce_mod (x : U64) :
    ∃ z : U32, AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.reduce_u64 x = .ok z ∧
      z.val = x.val % P ∧ z.val < P := by
  rw [current_reducer_eq]
  exact reduceExecution_mod x

theorem cast_widen_value (x : U32) : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by
  rw [cast_value]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h := x.bv.isLt
  change x.val < 2^32 at h
  change x.val < 2^64
  omega

/-- Every pair of stored U32 inputs fits the widening product; no canonical
input premise is needed for multiplication itself. -/
theorem current_mul_mod (x y : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31) :
    ∃ z : AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31,
      AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul x y = .ok z ∧
      z.val = (x.val*y.val) % P ∧ z.val < P := by
  have hproduct : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val * (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val < 2^64 := by
    rw [cast_widen_value, cast_widen_value]
    have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt x.bv.isLt y.bv.isLt
    exact h
  obtain ⟨product, hp, hv⟩ := mul_success _ _ hproduct
  rw [cast_widen_value, cast_widen_value] at hv
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzm, hzc⟩ := current_reduce_mod product
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, hzc⟩
  · simp only [AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul, lift, bind_tc_ok]

def low (cell : Cell) : Bytes := (List.ofFn cell).take 16

  · simp only [h,if_false,false_and]

    induction cs with

/-! Byte publication control. Codec and multiproof calls remain explicit
results, including errors; no success law for those callees is postulated.

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPublish43
abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
inductive Error where
  | semantic | parse | merkle | transcript
  deriving DecidableEq

structure QueryParts where
  c1 : Bytes
  c2 : Bytes
  salt1 : Bytes
  salt2 : Bytes
  folded : Bytes
  saltf : Bytes

def queryStep (out : Bytes) (p : QueryParts) : Bytes :=
  out ++ p.c1 ++ p.c2 ++ p.salt1 ++ p.salt2 ++ p.folded ++ p.saltf

def queryBytes (p : QueryParts) : Bytes :=
  p.c1 ++ p.c2 ++ p.salt1 ++ p.salt2 ++ p.folded ++ p.saltf

theorem query_step (out : Bytes) (p : QueryParts) :
    queryStep out p = out ++ queryBytes p := by
  simp only [queryStep,queryBytes,List.append_assoc]

def queries : List QueryParts → Bytes → Bytes
  | [],out => out
  | p::ps,out => queries ps (queryStep out p)

theorem query_loop (ps : List QueryParts) (out : Bytes) :
    ps.foldl queryStep out = queries ps out := by
  induction ps generalizing out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons p ps ih => exact ih _

theorem query_exact (ps : List QueryParts) (out : Bytes) :
    queries ps out = out ++ (ps.map queryBytes).flatten := by
  induction ps generalizing out with
  | nil => simp only [queries,List.map_nil,List.flatten_nil,List.append_nil]
  | cons p ps ih =>
    rw [queries,ih,query_step]
    simp only [List.map_cons,List.flatten_cons,List.append_assoc]

structure Slot where
  nodes : Except Error Bytes
  cap : Nat

def appendSlot (out : Bytes) (slot : Slot) : Except Error Bytes := do
  let nodes ← slot.nodes
  if nodes.length > slot.cap then .error .parse
  else .ok (out ++ nodes ++ List.replicate (slot.cap-nodes.length) 0)

theorem slot_length (out : Bytes) (slot : Slot) (result : Bytes)
    (ok : appendSlot out slot = .ok result) : result.length=out.length+slot.cap := by
  unfold appendSlot at ok
  cases hn : slot.nodes with
  | error e => simp only [hn,bind,Except.bind] at ok; cases ok
  | ok nodes =>
    simp only [hn,bind,Except.bind] at ok
    split at ok
    · cases ok
    · cases ok
      simp only [List.length_append,List.length_replicate]
      omega

def slots : List Slot → Bytes → Except Error Bytes
  | [],out => .ok out
  | s::ss,out => (appendSlot out s).bind (slots ss)

def slotLoop (ss : List Slot) (out : Bytes) : Except Error Bytes :=
  ss.foldl (fun result slot => result.bind (fun bytes => appendSlot bytes slot)) (.ok out)

theorem slots_loop (ss : List Slot) (out : Bytes) : slotLoop ss out = slots ss out := by
  have aux : ∀ ss (initial : Except Error Bytes),
      ss.foldl (fun result slot => result.bind (fun bytes => appendSlot bytes slot)) initial =
        initial.bind (slots ss) := by
    intro ss
    induction ss with
    | nil => intro initial; cases initial <;> rfl
    | cons s ss ih =>
      intro initial
      cases initial with
      | error e => exact ih (.error e)
      | ok bytes => exact ih (appendSlot bytes s)
  exact aux ss (.ok out)

theorem slots_length (ss : List Slot) (out result : Bytes)

    result.length=out.length+(ss.map Slot.cap).sum := by
  induction ss generalizing out with
  | nil => cases ok; simp only [List.map_nil,List.sum_nil,Nat.add_zero]
  | cons s ss ih =>
    simp only [slots] at ok
    cases hs : appendSlot out s with
    | error e => simp only [hs,Except.bind] at ok; cases ok
    | ok next =>
      simp only [hs,Except.bind] at ok
      have hlen := slot_length out s next hs
      have htail := ih next ok
      simp only [List.map_cons,List.sum_cons]
      omega

/-- Both byte-length guards and every prior node error survive unchanged. -/
def assemble (front : Except Error Bytes) (ps : List QueryParts)
    (ss : List Slot) (offNodes proofBytes : Nat) : Except Error Bytes := do
  let front ← front
  let out := queries ps front
  if out.length ≠ offNodes then .error .parse else do
    let out ← slots ss out
    if out.length ≠ proofBytes then .error .parse else .ok out

def assembleLoop (front : Except Error Bytes) (ps : List QueryParts)
    (ss : List Slot) (offNodes proofBytes : Nat) : Except Error Bytes := do
  let front ← front
  let out := ps.foldl queryStep front
  if out.length ≠ offNodes then .error .parse else do
    let out ← slotLoop ss out
    if out.length ≠ proofBytes then .error .parse else .ok out

theorem assemble_loop (front : Except Error Bytes) (ps : List QueryParts)
    (ss : List Slot) (offNodes proofBytes : Nat) :
    assembleLoop front ps ss offNodes proofBytes = assemble front ps ss offNodes proofBytes := by
  simp only [assembleLoop,assemble,query_loop,slots_loop]

/-- Finalisation follows the native order: replay, transcript guard, Merkle
collision guard, then first-conflict ordered merge. Errors contain no proof. -/
def finish {Table : Type} (proof : Except Error Bytes) (replay : Except Error Bool)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) : Except Error (Bytes × Table) := do
  let proof ← proof
  let agrees ← replay
  if !agrees then .error .transcript else
    if collision then .error .merkle else do
      let table ← merge
      .ok (proof,table)

theorem proof_error {Table : Type} (e : Error) (replay : Except Error Bool)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.error e) replay collision merge = .error e := rfl

theorem replay_error {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes) (e : Error)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.error e) collision merge = .error e := rfl

theorem replay_disagreement {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes)
    (collision : Bool) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.ok false) collision merge = .error .transcript := rfl

theorem merkle_collision {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes) (merge : Except Error Table) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.ok true) true merge = .error .merkle := rfl

theorem merge_error {Table : Type} (proof : Bytes) (e : Error) :
    finish (.ok proof) (.ok true) false (.error e : Except Error Table) = .error e := rfl

#print axioms query_step
#print axioms query_loop
#print axioms query_exact
#print axioms slot_length
#print axioms slots_loop
#print axioms slots_length
#print axioms assemble_loop
#print axioms proof_error
#print axioms replay_error
#print axioms replay_disagreement
#print axioms merkle_collision
#print axioms merge_error
end R1Z.ProverCommitPublish43

/-! Publication loop denotations over the D145 map interface. No Rust caller
law is added to TrustedStd. Callbacks below are pure and can encode arbitrary

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPublication33
open ProverCommitTrustedStd24
variable {Key Value State Thread Slot Output Query : Type}
variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

def folded (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (key : Query → Key)
    (make : Key → Value) : List Query → State → State × List Bool
  | [], s => (s, [])
  | q::qs, s =>
    let step := map.entry_or_insert_with s (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
    let rest := folded map key make qs step.1
    (rest.1, step.2.2 :: rest.2)

/-- The shipped for-loop's left fold records callback calls in query order.
The recursive owner is over the remaining owned query list. -/
def foldedLoop (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (key : Query → Key)
    (make : Key → Value) (qs : List Query) (s : State) : State × List Bool :=
  qs.foldl (fun acc q =>
    let step := map.entry_or_insert_with acc.1 (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
    (step.1, acc.2 ++ [step.2.2])) (s, [])

theorem folded_loop_rec (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (key : Query → Key)
    (make : Key → Value) (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    foldedLoop map key make qs s = folded map key make qs s := by
  have aux : ∀ qs s log,
      qs.foldl (fun (acc : State × List Bool) q =>
        let step := map.entry_or_insert_with acc.1 (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
        (step.1, acc.2 ++ [step.2.2])) (s,log) =
      ((folded map key make qs s).1, log ++ (folded map key make qs s).2) := by
    intro qs
    induction qs with
    | nil => intros; simp only [List.foldl_nil,folded,List.append_nil]
    | cons q qs ih =>
      intro s log
      simp only [List.foldl_cons,ih,folded,List.append_assoc,List.singleton_append]
  exact aux qs s []

variable [DecidableEq Thread]
variable (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
  (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output))
  (trusted : TrustedStd map tls thread schedule)
include trusted

/-- Universal duplicate/laziness transport uses precisely D145's one std field.
No bound on query count, table size, keys or values. -/
theorem folded_decode (key : Query → Key) (make : Key → Value)
    (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    (map.decode (folded map key make qs s).1, (folded map key make qs s).2) =
      folded modelMap key make qs (map.decode s) := by
  induction qs generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons q qs ih =>
    have step := trusted.btree_entry_or_insert_with s (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))
    have rest := ih (map.entry_or_insert_with s (key q) (fun _ => make (key q))).1
    cases found : (map.decode s)[key q]? with
    | none =>
      simp only [found] at step
      have hs := congrArg Prod.fst step
      have hc := congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) step
      simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] at hs hc
      rw [hs] at rest
      simp only [folded,modelMap,found]
      rw [hc]
      exact congrArg (fun p => (p.1,true::p.2)) rest
    | some v =>
      simp only [found] at step
      have hs := congrArg Prod.fst step
      have hc := congrArg (fun p => p.2.2) step
      simp only [Prod.fst, Prod.snd] at hs hc
      rw [hs] at rest
      simp only [folded,modelMap,found]
      rw [hc]
      exact congrArg (fun p => (p.1,false::p.2)) rest

/-- Native-loop denotation, recursive reference and invocation trace coincide
through the named standard-library boundary. -/
theorem folded_loop_decode (key : Query → Key) (make : Key → Value)
    (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    (map.decode (foldedLoop map key make qs s).1, (foldedLoop map key make qs s).2) =
      folded modelMap key make qs (map.decode s) := by
  rw [folded_loop_rec]
  exact folded_decode map tls thread schedule trusted key make qs s

/-- Iteration consumers get the exact sorted sequence, including its order.

coin stream remains a separate source boundary. -/
theorem ordered_consumer {Acc : Type} (step : Acc → Key × Value → Acc)
    (s : State) (initial : Acc) :
    (map.entries s).foldl step initial = (map.decode s).toList.foldl step initial := by
  rw [trusted.btree_iter_ordered]

/-- Query publication repeats the lookup for every query, retaining repeats.
The result is a list of optional values so misses are not silently excluded. -/
theorem query_answers (key : Query → Key) (qs : List Query) (s : State) :
    qs.map (fun q => map.get s (key q)) =
      qs.map (fun q => (map.decode s)[key q]?) := by
  exact List.map_congr_left (fun _ _ => trusted.btree_get _ _)

#print axioms ordered_consumer

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTrustedStd24
variable {Key Value MapState Thread Slot Output : Type}
variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

/-- Ascending distinct natural keys: the used BTreeSet<usize> image. -/
def ascendingDistinct (input : List Nat) : List Nat := input.toFinset.sort (· ≤ ·)

/-- The used successful ordered-map API. Allocation failure remains in P6;
this API does not assert an allocator's totality or identify raw pointers. -/
structure MapAPI (Key Value MapState : Type) (cmp : Key → Key → Ordering) where
  decode : MapState → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp
  empty : MapState
  insert : MapState → Key → Value → MapState × Option Value
  get : MapState → Key → Option Value
  entries : MapState → List (Key × Value)
  /-- Returned bool records callback invocation; hit does not evaluate it.
  The publication callee is pure field evaluation, with no mutable effects. -/
  entry_or_insert_with : MapState → Key → (Unit → Value) → MapState × Value × Bool
  /-- Native BTreeSet::from_iter followed by consuming ascending iteration.
  The natural carrier denotes source usize keys, not arbitrary field values. -/
  set_from_iter : List Nat → List Nat
  /-- Successful native observer, in the natural image of usize. -/
  len : MapState → Nat
  /-- slice::sort and Vec::dedup on the used natural image of u32 indices. -/
  slice_sort : List Nat → List Nat
  vec_dedup : List Nat → List Nat

/-- One live TLS key, with thread/key lifetime fixed for the invocation.
Different keys must be instantiated separately, without type-erased casts. -/
structure TLSAPI (Thread Slot Output : Type) where
  access : Thread → ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output →
    (Thread → Slot) → (Thread → Slot) × Output

/-- Explicit named trust list: std BTreeMap insert/get/iter, BTreeSet collect/iter, and live-key
single-thread TLS. Only the designated schedule is assumed single-threaded;
map operation laws quantify over every map state and key, including repeats. -/
structure TrustedStd [DecidableEq Thread]
    (map : MapAPI Key Value MapState cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
    (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output)) : Prop where
  btree_empty : map.decode map.empty = ∅
  btree_insert_state : ∀ s k v, map.decode (map.insert s k v).1 = (map.decode s).insert k v
  btree_insert_previous : ∀ s k v, (map.insert s k v).2 = (map.decode s)[k]?
  btree_get : ∀ s k, map.get s k = (map.decode s)[k]?
  btree_iter_ordered : ∀ s, map.entries s = (map.decode s).toList
  /-- D145's one added trusted std operation. Existing value is retained on a
  hit with no callback; a miss calls once, inserts and returns its result. -/
  btree_entry_or_insert_with : ∀ s k make,
    let result := map.entry_or_insert_with s k make
    (map.decode result.1, result.2) =
      match (map.decode s)[k]? with
      | some v => (map.decode s, v, false)
      | none => let v := make (); ((map.decode s).insert k v, v, true)
  /-- D156: exactly one additional library law. Collection and iteration
  have no user callbacks and consume no application coins. -/
  btree_set_from_iter_ordered : ∀ input, map.set_from_iter input = ascendingDistinct input
  /-- D157: cardinality, with no truncation in the usize image. -/
  btree_len : ∀ s, map.len s = (map.decode s).toList.length
  /-- D157: ascending stable sort for the used scalar keys. -/
  slice_sort_ascending : ∀ xs, map.slice_sort xs = xs.mergeSort (· ≤ ·)
  /-- D157: remove consecutive duplicates; callers sort first. -/
  vec_dedup_adjacent : ∀ xs, map.vec_dedup xs = xs.destutter (· ≠ ·)
  tls_live_key : ∀ t f store, tls.access t f store = ProverCommitTLS23.native t f store
  tls_single_thread : ProverCommitTLS23.SingleThreaded thread schedule

variable [DecidableEq Thread]
variable (map : MapAPI Key Value MapState cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
  (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output))
  (trusted : TrustedStd map tls thread schedule)

include trusted

/-- Universal write induction now consumes exactly the named trusted list. -/
theorem writes (entries : List (Key × Value)) (state : MapState) :
    (map.decode (ProverCommitTreeOps23.runWrites map.insert state entries).1,
      (ProverCommitTreeOps23.runWrites map.insert state entries).2) =
    ProverCommitTreeOps23.runWrites ProverCommitTreeOps23.treeInsert (map.decode state) entries :=
  ProverCommitTreeOps23.writes_decode map.decode map.insert
    trusted.btree_insert_state trusted.btree_insert_previous entries state

theorem lookup [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value] (state : MapState) (key : Key) :
    map.get state key = ProverCommitTable20.lookup (map.decode state).toList key :=
  ProverCommitTreeOps23.get_decode map.decode map.get trusted.btree_get state key

/-- Exact iterator order and remaining suffix, including exhaustion. -/
theorem iteration (state : MapState) (n : Nat) :
    ProverCommitTreeOps23.iterSteps n (map.entries state) =
      ((map.decode state).toList.take n,(map.decode state).toList.drop n) := by
  rw [trusted.btree_iter_ordered,ProverCommitTreeOps23.iterSteps_spec]

omit trusted

def tlsRun (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output) (store : Thread → Slot) :
    List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output) → (Thread → Slot) × List Output
  | [] => (store,[])
  | (t,f)::tail =>
    let step := tls.access t f store
    let rest := tlsRun tls step.1 tail
    (rest.1,step.2::rest.2)

include trusted

theorem tls_run_native (store : Thread → Slot)
    (calls : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output)) :
    tlsRun tls store calls = ProverCommitTLS23.nativeRun store calls := by
  induction calls generalizing store with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨t,f⟩
    simp only [tlsRun,ProverCommitTLS23.nativeRun,trusted.tls_live_key,ih]

theorem tls_schedule (store : Thread → Slot) :
    ((tlsRun tls store schedule).1 thread,(tlsRun tls store schedule).2) =
      ProverCommitTLS23.singleRun (store thread) (schedule.map Prod.snd) := by
  rw [tls_run_native map tls thread schedule trusted]
  exact ProverCommitTLS23.schedule_simulates thread schedule trusted.tls_single_thread store

omit trusted

/-- Satisfiability witness in the mathematical std model, with a real empty
schedule. This does not manufacture evidence about the compiled Rust API. -/
def modelMap : MapAPI Key Value (Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) cmp where
  decode := id
  empty := ∅
  insert := ProverCommitTreeOps23.treeInsert
  get := fun s k => s[k]?
  entries := Std.TreeMap.toList
  entry_or_insert_with := fun s k make =>
    match s[k]? with
    | some v => (s,v,false)
    | none => let v := make (); (s.insert k v,v,true)
  set_from_iter := ascendingDistinct
  len := fun s => s.toList.length
  slice_sort := fun xs => xs.mergeSort (· ≤ ·)
  vec_dedup := fun xs => xs.destutter (· ≠ ·)

def modelTLS : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output where
  access := ProverCommitTLS23.native

theorem model_consistent (t : Thread) :
    TrustedStd (modelMap (Key := Key) (Value := Value) (cmp := cmp))
      (modelTLS (Thread := Thread) (Slot := Slot) (Output := Output)) t [] := by
  refine ⟨rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ _ => rfl,
    fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ => rfl, fun _ _ _ => rfl, ?_⟩
  intro entry h
  exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil h)

#print axioms writes
#print axioms lookup
#print axioms iteration
#print axioms tls_run_native
#print axioms tls_schedule
#print axioms model_consistent
end R1Z.ProverCommitTrustedStd24
R1Z.ProverCommitTreeOps23:
import R1Z.ProverCommitTreeMap22
/-! Operation-level specification for source map gates. The induction below
is conditional on universal insert/get contracts; bounded Rust gates alone
do not supply those contracts for arbitrary tree height. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTreeOps23
variable {Key Value State : Type} {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering}
  [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

def treeInsert (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) (value : Value) :
    Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp × Option Value := (tree.insert key value,tree[key]?)

def runWrites (insert : State → Key → Value → State × Option Value)
    (state : State) : List (Key × Value) → State × List (Option Value)
  | [] => (state,[])
  | (key,value)::tail =>
    let step := insert state key value
    let rest := runWrites insert step.1 tail
    (rest.1,step.2::rest.2)

/-- Arbitrary write schedules, including repeats: the final map and the
entire sequence of previous answers follow from the two insert obligations.
These obligations are explicit named hypotheses, not a Rust source instance. -/
theorem writes_decode (decode : State → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp)
    (insert : State → Key → Value → State × Option Value)
    (insert_state : ∀ s key value, decode (insert s key value).1 = (decode s).insert key value)
    (insert_previous : ∀ s key value, (insert s key value).2 = (decode s)[key]?)
    (schedule : List (Key × Value)) (state : State) :
    (decode (runWrites insert state schedule).1,(runWrites insert state schedule).2) =
      runWrites treeInsert (decode state) schedule := by
  induction schedule generalizing state with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,value⟩
    have rest := ih (insert state key value).1
    rw [insert_state] at rest
    simp only [runWrites,treeInsert]
    rw [insert_previous]
    exact congrArg (fun p => (p.1,(decode state)[key]?::p.2)) rest

/-- Exact get specification, composed with the existing universal list model. -/
theorem get_decode [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]
    (decode : State → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (get : State → Key → Option Value)
    (get_spec : ∀ s key, get s key = (decode s)[key]?) (state : State) (key : Key) :
    get state key = ProverCommitTable20.lookup (decode state).toList key := by
  rw [get_spec,ProverCommitTreeMap22.lookup_toList]

/-- Iterator specification preserves the unconsumed suffix, rather than only
membership of returned entries. The Rust cursor representation is separate. -/
def iterSteps {Entry : Type} : Nat → List Entry → List Entry × List Entry
  | 0, entries => ([],entries)
  | _+1, [] => ([],[])
  | n+1, entry::tail =>
    let rest := iterSteps n tail
    (entry::rest.1,rest.2)

theorem iterSteps_spec {Entry : Type} (n : Nat) (entries : List Entry) :
    iterSteps n entries = (entries.take n,entries.drop n) := by
  induction n generalizing entries with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    cases entries with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons entry tail => simp only [iterSteps,ih,List.take_succ_cons,List.drop_succ_cons]

theorem tree_iteration (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (n : Nat) :
    (iterSteps n tree.toList).1 ++ (iterSteps n tree.toList).2 = tree.toList := by
  rw [iterSteps_spec]
  exact List.take_append_drop n tree.toList

#print axioms writes_decode
#print axioms get_decode
#print axioms iterSteps_spec
#print axioms tree_iteration
end R1Z.ProverCommitTreeOps23
R1Z.ProverCommitTreeMap22:
import Std.Data.TreeMap.Lemmas
import R1Z.ProverCommitTablePrefix21
/-! Universal Lean Std.TreeMap transport to the retained list-table model.
This is a standard-library model theorem, not an identification of the
Rust allocator/tree implementation with Lean's tree representation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTreeMap22
open ProverCommitTable20
variable {Key Value : Type} [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]

/-- Membership graph suffices even without an explicit uniqueness premise:
all duplicate keys, if present, necessarily carry the same value. -/
theorem lookup_of_graph (entries : List (Key × Value)) (key : Key) (value : Option Value)
    (graph : ∀ v, (key,v) ∈ entries ↔ value = some v) : lookup entries key = value := by
  induction entries with
  | nil =>
    cases value with
    | none => rfl
    | some v => exact False.elim (List.not_mem_nil ((graph v).mpr rfl))
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨a,b⟩
    by_cases same : a=key
    · subst a
      have hv := (graph b).mp (List.mem_cons_self ..)
      simp only [lookup,ite_true]
      exact hv.symm
    · simp only [lookup,if_neg same]
      apply ih
      intro v
      rw [← graph v]
      simp only [List.mem_cons,Prod.mk.injEq]
      constructor
      · exact Or.inr
      · rintro (⟨he,_⟩ | ht)
        · exact False.elim (same he.symm)
        · exact ht

variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]

theorem lookup_toList (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) :
    lookup tree.toList key = tree[key]? := by
  exact lookup_of_graph _ _ _ (fun v => Std.TreeMap.mem_toList_iff_getElem?_eq_some)

/-- Every finite tree size and every key; insert, overwrite and miss all
have the identical observable lookup law. -/
theorem insert_lookup (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key query : Key) (answer : Value) :
    lookup (tree.insert key answer).toList query =
      lookup (ProverCommitTable20.insert tree.toList key answer false).1 query := by
  rw [lookup_toList,Std.TreeMap.getElem?_insert,ProverCommitTable20.insert_lookup,lookup_toList]
  simp only [Std.LawfulEqCmp.compare_eq_iff_eq]

def program (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) (answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp × Bool :=
  (tree.insert key answer, collision || conflict tree[key]? answer)

theorem program_collision (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key)
    (answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    (program tree key answer collision).2 =
      (ProverCommitTable20.insert tree.toList key answer collision).2 := by
  rw [ProverCommitTable20.insert_collision,lookup_toList]
  rfl

/-- Enumeration preserves exactly the published key/value graph. -/
theorem enumerated (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (key : Key) (value : Value) :
    (key,value) ∈ tree.toList ↔ lookup tree.toList key = some value := by
  rw [lookup_toList]
  exact Std.TreeMap.mem_toList_iff_getElem?_eq_some

def writes (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (collision : Bool) :
    List (Key × Value) → Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp × Bool
  | [] => (tree,collision)
  | (key,answer)::tail =>
      let next := program tree key answer collision
      writes next.1 next.2 tail

/-- Extensional table relation and sticky collision are preserved over every
finite source write schedule, including repeated keys and arbitrary prefixes. -/
theorem writes_transport (entries table : List (Key × Value))
    (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) (collision : Bool)
    (related : ∀ key, lookup table key = tree[key]?) :
    (∀ query, lookup (ProverCommitTable20.writes table collision entries).1 query =
      (writes tree collision entries).1[query]?) ∧
    (ProverCommitTable20.writes table collision entries).2 =
      (writes tree collision entries).2 := by
  induction entries generalizing tree table collision with
  | nil => exact ⟨related,rfl⟩
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,answer⟩
    have rel : ∀ query, lookup (ProverCommitTable20.insert table key answer collision).1 query =
        (tree.insert key answer)[query]? := by
      intro query
      rw [ProverCommitTable20.insert_lookup,Std.TreeMap.getElem?_insert,related]
      simp only [Std.LawfulEqCmp.compare_eq_iff_eq]
    have flag : (ProverCommitTable20.insert table key answer collision).2 =
        (collision || conflict tree[key]? answer) := by
      rw [ProverCommitTable20.insert_collision,related]
    simpa only [writes,program,ProverCommitTable20.writes,flag] using
      ih (ProverCommitTable20.insert table key answer collision).1
        (tree.insert key answer) (collision || conflict tree[key]? answer) rel

theorem enumeration_order (tree : Std.TreeMap Key Value cmp) :
    tree.toList.Pairwise (fun a b => cmp a.1 b.1 = .lt) :=
  Std.TreeMap.ordered_keys_toList

#print axioms writes_transport
#print axioms enumeration_order

#print axioms lookup_of_graph
#print axioms lookup_toList
#print axioms insert_lookup
#print axioms program_collision
#print axioms enumerated
end R1Z.ProverCommitTreeMap22
R1Z.ProverCommitTablePrefix21:
import R1Z.ProverCommitTable20
/-! Arbitrary finite prefixes for the single-entry programming gate.
No finite key space or fixed table length is assumed. This module does not
identify std::BTreeMap with the owned entry representation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTablePrefix21
open ProverCommitTable20
variable {Key Value : Type} [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]

theorem lookup_append (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key : Key) :
    lookup (pre++suffix) key = (lookup pre key).orElse (fun _ => lookup suffix key) := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    simp only [List.cons_append,lookup]
    by_cases h : k=key
    · simp only [h,if_true,Option.orElse_some]
    · simp only [h,if_false,ih]

/-- A pre without a matching key is retained verbatim, with no collision
update. This is the induction boundary consumed by a single ProverCommitTable20.insert step. -/
theorem insert_append_miss (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key : Key) (answer : Value)
    (collision : Bool) (miss : lookup pre key=none) :
    ProverCommitTable20.insert (pre++suffix) key answer collision =
      let out := ProverCommitTable20.insert suffix key answer collision
      (pre++out.1,out.2) := by
  induction pre with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases h : k=key
    · simp only [lookup,h,if_true] at miss
      cases miss
    · simp only [lookup,h,if_false] at miss
      simp only [List.cons_append,ProverCommitTable20.insert,h,if_false,ih miss]

/-- Exact overwrite at one entry after any missed pre. The entire suffix
and the original key are retained, and the collision flag is sticky. -/
theorem overwrite_after_prefix (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key : Key)
    (previous answer : Value) (collision : Bool) (miss : lookup pre key=none) :
    ProverCommitTable20.insert (pre++(key,previous)::suffix) key answer collision =
      (pre++(key,answer)::suffix,collision || decide (previous≠answer)) := by
  rw [insert_append_miss pre ((key,previous)::suffix) key answer collision miss]
  simp only [ProverCommitTable20.insert,if_true]

/-- The symbolic pre in the single-entry gate is exactly first-hit lookup;
its summary also accounts for hits before the selected entry. -/
theorem entry_collision (pre suffix : Table Key Value) (key address : Key)
    (previous answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    (ProverCommitTable20.insert (pre++(key,previous)::suffix) address answer collision).2 =
      (collision || conflict ((lookup pre address).orElse
        (fun _ => if key=address then some previous else lookup suffix address)) answer) := by
  rw [insert_collision,lookup_append]
  rfl

#print axioms lookup_append
#print axioms insert_append_miss
#print axioms overwrite_after_prefix
#print axioms entry_collision
end R1Z.ProverCommitTablePrefix21
R1Z.ProverCommitTable20:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorInsert19
/-! Per-entry programming semantics. The source BTreeMap return-value boundary
and owned Vec/List transport remain distinct from this finite induction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitTable20
variable {Key Value : Type} [DecidableEq Key] [DecidableEq Value]
abbrev Table (Key Value : Type) := List (Key × Value)

def lookup (table : Table Key Value) (key : Key) : Option Value :=
  match table with
  | [] => none
  | (k,v)::tail => if k=key then some v else lookup tail key

def conflict (old : Option Value) (answer : Value) : Bool :=
  match old with
  | none => false
  | some previous => decide (previous≠answer)

def insert (table : Table Key Value) (key : Key) (answer : Value) (collision : Bool) :
    Table Key Value × Bool :=
  match table with
  | [] => ([(key,answer)],collision)
  | (k,v)::tail =>
    if k=key then ((k,answer)::tail,collision || decide (v≠answer))
    else let out := insert tail key answer collision
         ((k,v)::out.1,out.2)

/-- The collision branch is needed only for the first matching table entry.
No key uniqueness assumption is necessary for first-match lookup. -/
theorem insert_collision (table : Table Key Value) (key : Key) (answer : Value)
    (collision : Bool) :
    (insert table key answer collision).2 = (collision || conflict (lookup table key) answer) := by
  induction table with
  | nil => simp only [insert,lookup,conflict,Bool.or_false]
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases same : k=key
    · simp only [insert,lookup,same,if_true,conflict]
    · simp only [insert,lookup,same,if_false,ih]

/-- Every individual address gets the overwritten answer or its prior lookup.
This is a finite entry induction, not an enumeration of keys or byte tables. -/
theorem insert_lookup (table : Table Key Value) (key query : Key) (answer : Value)
    (collision : Bool) :
    lookup (insert table key answer collision).1 query =
      if key=query then some answer else lookup table query := by
  induction table with
  | nil => simp only [insert,lookup]
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨k,v⟩
    by_cases same : k=key
    · subst k
      simp only [insert,if_true,lookup]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
    · simp only [insert,same,if_false,lookup,ih]
      by_cases hit : k=query
      · have miss : key≠query := by intro h;exact same (hit.trans h.symm)
        simp only [hit,if_true,miss,if_false]
      · simp only [hit,if_false]

def writes (table : Table Key Value) (collision : Bool) : List (Key × Value) →
    Table Key Value × Bool
  | [] => (table,collision)
  | (key,answer)::tail =>
    let next := insert table key answer collision
    writes next.1 next.2 tail

def oracleWrites (oracle : Key → Option Value) : List (Key × Value) → Key → Option Value
  | [] => oracle
  | (key,answer)::tail => oracleWrites (fun query => if key=query then some answer else oracle query) tail

/-- Complete finite write sequence: repeated addresses retain last-write
semantics. Applying any common fallback preserves every unprogrammed answer. -/
theorem writes_lookup (entries table : Table Key Value) (collision : Bool) (query : Key) :
    lookup (writes table collision entries).1 query = oracleWrites (lookup table) entries query := by
  induction entries generalizing table collision with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,answer⟩
    simp only [writes,oracleWrites]
    rw [ih]
    have lookupEq : lookup (insert table key answer collision).1 =
        (fun query => if key=query then some answer else lookup table query) := by
      funext q
      exact insert_lookup table key q answer collision
    rw [lookupEq]

theorem collision_sticky (table : Table Key Value) (entries : Table Key Value) :
    (writes table true entries).2=true := by
  induction entries generalizing table with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons entry tail ih =>
    rcases entry with ⟨key,answer⟩
    simp only [writes,insert_collision,Bool.true_or]
    exact ih _

#print axioms insert_collision
#print axioms insert_lookup
#print axioms writes_lookup
#print axioms collision_sticky
end R1Z.ProverCommitTable20
R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorInsert19:
import AspisR1SimulatorInsert19.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSimulatorInsert19
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1SimulatorInsert19
abbrev Bytes := alloc.vec.Vec U8
abbrev Answer := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Entry := Bytes × Answer
abbrev Table := alloc.vec.Vec Entry

def finite (table : Table) (index : Usize) (address : Bytes) (answer : Answer)
    (collision : Bool) : Nat → Result (Table × Bool)
  | 0 => do
    let after ← alloc.vec.Vec.push table (address,answer)
    ok (after,collision)
  | remaining+1 => do
    let pair ← alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Entry) table index
    let (key,previous) ← (BuiltinClone Entry).clone pair
    let same ← alloc.vec.partial_eq.PartialEqVec.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 key address
    if same then
      let (_,back) ← alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Entry) table index
      let after := back (key,answer)
      if collision then ok (after,true) else do
        let conflict ← core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8 previous answer
        ok (after,conflict)
    else finite table (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize) address answer collision remaining

theorem increment (table : Table) (index : Usize) (bound : index.val < table.length) :
    (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize).val = index.val+1 := by
  rw [Usize.wrapping_add_val_eq]
  have one : (1#usize).val = 1 := by scalar_tac
  rw [one]
  have hsize := (alloc.vec.Vec.len table).hSize
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.len_val] at hsize
  exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)

/-- Exact finite reference schedule, retaining overwrite conflicts, original
sticky collision state, all scalar/byte errors and partially retained tables. -/
theorem extracted_finite (table : Table) (index : Usize) (address : Bytes)
    (answer : Answer) (collision : Bool) (remaining : Nat)
    (count : index.val+remaining = table.length) :
    sim.owned19.insert table index address answer collision =
      finite table index address answer collision remaining := by
  induction remaining generalizing index with
  | zero =>
    have stop : index = alloc.vec.Vec.len table := by scalar_tac
    rw [sim.owned19.insert]
    simp only [stop,if_true,finite]
  | succ n ih =>
    have more : index ≠ alloc.vec.Vec.len table := by scalar_tac
    rw [sim.owned19.insert]
    simp only [more,if_false,finite]
    cases hp : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice Entry) table index with
    | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
    | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
    | ok pair =>
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      cases hc : (BuiltinClone Entry).clone pair with
      | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
      | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
      | ok pair =>
        rcases pair with ⟨key,previous⟩
        simp only [bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry_apply_pair]
        cases he : alloc.vec.partial_eq.PartialEqVec.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 key address with
        | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail]
        | div => simp only [bind_tc_div]
        | ok same =>
          simp only [bind_tc_ok]
          cases same with
          | true => rfl
          | false =>
            simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok]
            exact ih (Usize.wrapping_add index 1#usize)
              (by rw [increment table index (by omega)]; omega)

def native (thread : Thread) (f : Access Value Output) (store : Thread → Value) :

the source has already overwritten its local entry, then discards the attempt.

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitMerge33

variable {Key Value State Thread Slot Output : Type}
variable {cmp : Key → Key → Ordering} [Std.TransCmp cmp] [Std.LawfulEqCmp cmp]
variable [DecidableEq Value]

def step (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (s : State) (entry : Key × Value) : Option State :=
  let next := map.insert s entry.1 entry.2
  match next.2 with
  | none => some next.1
  | some old => if old = entry.2 then some next.1 else none

def recursive (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) : List (Key × Value) → State → Option State
  | [], s => some s
  | entry::tail, s => (step map s entry).bind (recursive map tail)

def loop (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (entries : List (Key × Value))
    (s : State) : Option State :=
  entries.foldl (fun acc entry => acc.bind (fun state => step map state entry)) (some s)

    (entries : List (Key × Value)) (s : State) : loop map entries s = recursive map entries s := by

      entries.foldl (fun acc entry => acc.bind (fun state => step map state entry)) initial =
        initial.bind (recursive map entries) := by
    intro entries
    induction entries with
    | nil => intro initial; cases initial <;> rfl
    | cons entry tail ih =>
      intro initial
      cases initial with
      | none => simpa only [List.foldl_cons,Option.bind_none] using ih none
      | some state =>
        simp only [List.foldl_cons,Option.bind_some,ih,recursive]
  exact aux entries (some s)

variable [DecidableEq Thread]
variable (map : MapAPI Key Value State cmp) (tls : TLSAPI Thread Slot Output)
  (thread : Thread) (schedule : List (Thread × ProverCommitTLS23.Access Slot Output))
  (trusted : TrustedStd map tls thread schedule)

    (step map s entry).map map.decode = step modelMap (map.decode s) entry := by
  simp only [step,trusted.btree_insert_previous,modelMap,ProverCommitTreeOps23.treeInsert]

    · simp only [if_pos equal,Option.map_some,trusted.btree_insert_state]
    · simp only [if_neg equal,Option.map_none]

/-- Arbitrary ordered transcript inputs, keys and table sizes. Both failure
and successful exact final state pass through the two existing insert fields. -/

    | none =>

      rw [← hs]
      rfl
    | some next =>
      simp only [found,Option.map_some] at hs
      rw [← hs]
      exact ih next

    (loop map (map.entries transcript) s).map map.decode =

  rw [loop_recursive,recursive_decode map tls thread schedule trusted,

#print axioms recursive_decode
#print axioms native_ordered_loop_decode

/-! A strict byte-model codec for two consecutive 16-byte QM31 encodings.
This file reuses the existing strict QM31 decoder and does not claim source
parser correspondence or any arithmetic property of a wide field. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

abbrev WideBytes := Fin 32 → Byte
abbrev WideLimbs := QM31Limbs × QM31Limbs

def lowBytes (bytes : WideBytes) : QM31Bytes :=
  fun i => bytes (Fin.castAdd 16 i)

def highBytes (bytes : WideBytes) : QM31Bytes :=
  fun i => bytes (Fin.natAdd 16 i)

def encodeWideLE (limbs : WideLimbs) : WideBytes :=
  Fin.append (encodeQM31LE limbs.1) (encodeQM31LE limbs.2)

def decodeWideLE (bytes : WideBytes) : Option WideLimbs := do
  let lo ← decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes)
  let hi ← decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes)
  some (lo, hi)

theorem decodeWideLE_encodeWideLE (limbs : WideLimbs) :
    decodeWideLE (encodeWideLE limbs) = some limbs := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  have hlo : lowBytes (encodeWideLE (lo, hi)) = encodeQM31LE lo := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.append_left _ _ _
  have hhi : highBytes (encodeWideLE (lo, hi)) = encodeQM31LE hi := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.append_right _ _ _
  simp [decodeWideLE, hlo, hhi, decodeQM31LE_encodeQM31LE]

theorem successful_halves (bytes : WideBytes) (limbs : WideLimbs)
    (h : decodeWideLE bytes = some limbs) :
    decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes) = some limbs.1 ∧
      decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes) = some limbs.2 := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  unfold decodeWideLE at h
  cases hlo : decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes) <;>
    cases hhi : decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes) <;>
    simp_all

theorem encodeWideLE_of_decodeWideLE (bytes : WideBytes) (limbs : WideLimbs)
    (h : decodeWideLE bytes = some limbs) :
    encodeWideLE limbs = bytes := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  obtain ⟨hlo, hhi⟩ := successful_halves bytes (lo, hi) h
  have hlo' := encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE (lowBytes bytes) lo hlo
  have hhi' := encodeQM31LE_of_decodeQM31LE (highBytes bytes) hi hhi
  funext i
  by_cases hlow : i.val < 16
  · let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val, hlow⟩
    have hi' : i = Fin.castAdd 16 j := Fin.ext rfl
    rw [hi']
    change Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi)
        (Fin.castAdd 16 j) = bytes (Fin.castAdd 16 j)
    calc
      Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi) (Fin.castAdd 16 j) =
          encodeQM31LE lo j := Fin.append_left _ _ _
      _ = bytes (Fin.castAdd 16 j) := congrFun hlo' j
  · let j : Fin 16 := ⟨i.val - 16, by omega⟩
    have hi' : i = Fin.natAdd 16 j := by
      apply Fin.ext
      change (i : Nat) = 16 + (j : Nat)
      dsimp [j]
      omega
    rw [hi']
    change Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi)
        (Fin.natAdd 16 j) = bytes (Fin.natAdd 16 j)
    calc
      Fin.append (encodeQM31LE lo) (encodeQM31LE hi) (Fin.natAdd 16 j) =
          encodeQM31LE hi j := Fin.append_right _ _ _
      _ = bytes (Fin.natAdd 16 j) := congrFun hhi' j

#print axioms decodeWideLE_encodeWideLE
#print axioms encodeWideLE_of_decodeWideLE
#print axioms successful_halves

end AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec

import R1StrictWideByteCodec
import R1RetainedExactLimbCodec
import R0C.ModuloField

/-! Bridge pairs of retained canonical QM31 limbs to the existing exact wide
field representation and its eight-digit model. This is representation
plumbing only; it makes no claim about a Rust wide-field parser. -/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.WideExactLimbCodec

open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
open AspisWideTower

abbrev WideLimbs := AspisR1.StrictWideByteCodec.WideLimbs

def pairToExact (limbs : WideLimbs) : WideExact :=
  ⟨AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv limbs.1,
   AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv limbs.2⟩

def pairExactEquiv : WideLimbs ≃ WideExact :=
  (Equiv.prodCongr
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv).trans
      (QuadraticAlgebra.equivProd wideU 0).symm

theorem pairExactEquiv_apply (limbs : WideLimbs) :
    pairExactEquiv limbs = pairToExact limbs := rfl

theorem pairExactEquiv_injective : Function.Injective pairExactEquiv :=
  pairExactEquiv.injective

@[simp] private theorem residueEquiv_natCast (x : M31Value) :
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.m31ResidueEquiv x =
      (x.val : M31Exact) := by
  apply ZMod.val_injective P
  change x.val = (x.val : ZMod P).val
  rw [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt x.isLt]

private theorem retained_qm31_eq_tupleFieldEquiv (limbs : QM31Limbs) :
    AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv limbs =
      AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv
        (fun i : Fin 4 => ⟨(limbs i).val, by
          have h := (limbs i).isLt
          norm_num [m31Modulus, rawCandidateCount, rawWordCount,
            AspisV8R19.R445InitialBlockRejectionLaw.modulus] at h ⊢
          exact h⟩) := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]
    · simp [AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.qm31ExactLimbEquiv,
        AspisR1.RetainedExactLimbCodec.limbsToQM31Exact,
        residueEquiv_natCast,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleFieldEquiv,
        AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple.tupleField,
        AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode.decode4]

theorem pairToExact_eq_digitsField (limbs : WideLimbs) :
    pairToExact limbs =
      R0C.ModuloField.digitsField (Fin.append limbs.1 limbs.2) := by
  rcases limbs with ⟨lo, hi⟩
  have hsplit : R0C.ModuloField.splitDigits (Fin.append lo hi) = (lo, hi) := by
    apply Prod.ext <;> funext i
    · exact Fin.append_left _ _ _
    · exact Fin.append_right _ _ _
  have hlo := retained_qm31_eq_tupleFieldEquiv lo
  have hhi := retained_qm31_eq_tupleFieldEquiv hi
  -- The eight-digit formula is the product of the two existing four-limb
  -- coordinate maps; `splitDigits` is its literal append inverse.
  unfold R0C.ModuloField.digitsField
  simp only [Equiv.trans_apply]
  rw [hsplit]
  change pairToExact (lo, hi) = _
  unfold pairToExact
  rw [hlo, hhi]
  rfl

#print axioms pairExactEquiv_apply
#print axioms pairExactEquiv_injective
#print axioms pairToExact_eq_digitsField

end AspisR1.WideExactLimbCodec
R0C.ModuloField:
import R0C.ModuloCounting
import AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple
import WideTower
import AspisFormal.CircleGroupOrder
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

/-! Proposed 32-byte rejection-free field sampler. See FS_LOG before use.
This does not replace the retained canonical-limb retry implementation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0C.ModuloField
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames
open AspisV8R19.R599CanonicalFieldTuple AspisV8R19.SamplerFieldDecode
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open AspisWideTower AspisCircleGroupOrder
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- All 32 bytes, with byte zero least significant. -/
def blockRank : State ≃ Fin (256^32) := finFunctionFinEquiv

theorem blockRank_value (s : State) :
    (blockRank s).val = ∑ i : Fin 32, (s i).val * 256^i.val :=
  finFunctionFinEquiv_apply s

def splitDigits : (Fin 8 → Fin P) ≃ (Fin 4 → Fin P) × (Fin 4 → Fin P) where
  toFun x := (fun i => x (Fin.castAdd 4 i), fun i => x (Fin.natAdd 4 i))
  invFun x := Fin.append x.1 x.2
  left_inv := by intro x; funext i; fin_cases i <;> rfl
  right_inv := by
    intro x
    apply Prod.ext <;> funext i <;> fin_cases i <;> rfl

/-- R599's four-limb decoder in each tower coordinate. -/
def digitsField : (Fin 8 → Fin P) ≃ WideExact :=
  splitDigits.trans ((Equiv.prodCongr tupleFieldEquiv tupleFieldEquiv).trans
    (QuadraticAlgebra.equivProd wideU 0).symm)

theorem digitsField_apply (x : Fin 8 → Fin P) :
    digitsField x = ⟨decode4 (x 0).val (x 1).val (x 2).val (x 3).val,
      decode4 (x 4).val (x 5).val (x 6).val (x 7).val⟩ := rfl

/-- Base-P positional rank, not the field's natural-number cast. -/
def fieldRank : Fin (P^8) ≃ WideExact := finFunctionFinEquiv.symm.trans digitsField

theorem fieldRank_zero : fieldRank 0 = 0 := by
  have hz : (finFunctionFinEquiv (fun _ : Fin 8 => (0 : Fin P))) = 0 := by
    apply Fin.ext
    simp
  rw [fieldRank, Equiv.trans_apply, ← hz, Equiv.symm_apply_apply]
  rfl

def positiveRanks (n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) : Fin (n-1) ≃ {x : Fin n // x ≠ ⟨0, hn⟩} where
  toFun x := ⟨⟨x.val+1, by omega⟩, by intro h; have := congrArg Fin.val h; simp at this⟩
  invFun x := ⟨x.val.val-1, by
    have hne : x.val.val ≠ 0 := fun h => x.property (Fin.ext h)
    have := x.val.isLt
    omega⟩
  left_inv := by intro x; apply Fin.ext; simp
  right_inv := by
    intro x
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Fin.ext
    have hne : x.val.val ≠ 0 := fun h => x.property (Fin.ext h)
    simp only
    omega

def nonzeroRank : Fin (P^8-1) ≃ {x : WideExact // x ≠ 0} :=
  (positiveRanks (P^8) (by norm_num [P])).trans
    (fieldRank.subtypeEquiv (by
      intro x
      have he : fieldRank x = 0 ↔ x = 0 := by
        rw [← fieldRank_zero, Equiv.apply_eq_iff_eq]
      exact not_congr he.symm))

def ordinary (s : State) : WideExact :=
  fieldRank (ModuloCounting.reduce (by norm_num [P]) (blockRank s))

def gammaNZ (s : State) : {x : WideExact // x ≠ 0} :=
  nonzeroRank (ModuloCounting.reduce (by norm_num [P]) (blockRank s))

def gamma (s : State) : WideExact := (gammaNZ s).val

theorem gamma_ne_zero (s : State) : gamma s ≠ 0 := (gammaNZ s).property

theorem ordinary_mass (y : WideExact) :
    mean (fun s => indicator (ordinary s = y)) ≤
      1 / (P^8 : ℚ) + 1 / (256^32 : ℚ) := by
  simpa only [ordinary, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    ModuloCounting.encoded_mass_slack (by positivity : 0 < 256^32)
      (by norm_num [P] : 0 < P^8) blockRank fieldRank y

theorem gamma_mass (y : {x : WideExact // x ≠ 0}) :
    mean (fun s => indicator (gammaNZ s = y)) ≤
      1 / ((P^8-1 : Nat) : ℚ) + 1 / (256^32 : ℚ) := by
  simpa only [gammaNZ, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using
    ModuloCounting.encoded_mass_slack (by positivity : 0 < 256^32)
      (by norm_num [P] : 0 < P^8-1) blockRank nonzeroRank y

/-- The exact quotient part of the fiber bound is 256 for both codomains. -/
theorem quotients : 256^32 / P^8 = 256 ∧ 256^32 / (P^8-1) = 256 := by
  norm_num [P]

theorem ordinary_mass_257 (y : WideExact) :
    mean (fun s => indicator (ordinary s = y)) ≤ 257 / (256^32 : ℚ) := by
  have h := ModuloCounting.encoded_mass_le (by norm_num [P] : 0 < P^8)
    blockRank fieldRank y
  simpa only [ordinary, quotients.1, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using h

theorem gamma_mass_257 (y : WideExact) :
    mean (fun s => indicator (gamma s = y)) ≤ 257 / (256^32 : ℚ) := by
  by_cases hy : y = 0
  · subst y
    have he (s : State) : indicator (gamma s = 0) = 0 := by
      simp only [indicator, if_neg (gamma_ne_zero s)]
    exact (mean_congr he).le.trans (by rw [mean_const]; positivity)
  · have he (s : State) : gamma s = y ↔ gammaNZ s = ⟨y,hy⟩ :=
      ⟨fun h => Subtype.ext h, fun h => congrArg Subtype.val h⟩
    have hm := ModuloCounting.encoded_mass_le (by norm_num [P] : 0 < P^8-1)
      blockRank nonzeroRank ⟨y,hy⟩
    have hm' : mean (fun s => indicator (gammaNZ s = ⟨y,hy⟩)) ≤
        257 / (256^32 : ℚ) := by
      simpa only [gammaNZ, quotients.2, Nat.reduceAdd, Nat.cast_pow, Nat.cast_ofNat] using hm
    exact (mean_congr (fun s => FS.indicator_iff (he s))).le.trans hm'

theorem ordinary_event (bad : Finset WideExact) :
    mean (fun s => indicator (ordinary s ∈ bad)) ≤ bad.card * (257 / (256^32 : ℚ)) :=
  ModuloCounting.event_mass_le ordinary _ ordinary_mass_257 bad

theorem gamma_event (bad : Finset WideExact) :
    mean (fun s => indicator (gamma s ∈ bad)) ≤ bad.card * (257 / (256^32 : ℚ)) :=
  ModuloCounting.event_mass_le gamma _ gamma_mass_257 bad

#print axioms blockRank_value
#print axioms digitsField_apply
#print axioms fieldRank_zero
#print axioms gamma_ne_zero
#print axioms ordinary_mass
#print axioms gamma_mass
#print axioms quotients
#print axioms ordinary_mass_257
#print axioms gamma_mass_257
#print axioms ordinary_event
#print axioms gamma_event
end
end R0C.ModuloField
R0C.ModuloCounting:
import R0C.Counting
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith

/-! Balanced reduction bounds, proved before any concrete byte/field instance.
The input and output encodings are equivalences, not distribution hypotheses.
No existing sampler law or Fiat-Shamir interface is redefined here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0C.ModuloCounting
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def reduce {B n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n) (x : Fin B) : Fin n :=
  ⟨x.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩

/-- A residue fiber injects into the possible quotient values. -/
theorem fiber_card_le (B n : Nat) (hn : 0 < n) (y : Fin n) :
    Fintype.card {x : Fin B // reduce hn x = y} ≤ B / n + 1 := by
  let f : {x : Fin B // reduce hn x = y} → Fin (B / n + 1) :=
    fun x => ⟨x.val.val / n, Nat.lt_succ_of_le
      (Nat.div_le_div_right (Nat.le_of_lt x.val.isLt))⟩
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x z h
    apply Subtype.ext
    apply Fin.ext
    have hd : x.val.val / n = z.val.val / n := congrArg Fin.val h
    have hx : x.val.val % n = y.val := congrArg Fin.val x.property
    have hz : z.val.val % n = y.val := congrArg Fin.val z.property
    calc
      x.val.val = x.val.val % n + n * (x.val.val / n) := (Nat.mod_add_div _ _).symm
      _ = z.val.val % n + n * (z.val.val / n) := by rw [hx, hz, hd]
      _ = z.val.val := Nat.mod_add_div _ _
  simpa using Fintype.card_le_of_injective f hf

/-- Changing either encoding preserves the fiber count. -/
theorem encoded_mass_le {A E : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype E]
    {B n : Nat} (hn : 0 < n)
    (input : A ≃ Fin B) (output : Fin n ≃ E) (y : E) :
    mean (fun a => indicator (output (reduce hn (input a)) = y)) ≤
      ((B / n + 1 : Nat) : ℚ) / B := by
  rw [Counting.mean_indicator_card]
  have hc : Fintype.card A = B := (Fintype.card_congr input).trans (Fintype.card_fin B)
  rw [hc]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have he : {a : A // output (reduce hn (input a)) = y} ≃
      {x : Fin B // reduce hn x = output.symm y} :=
    input.subtypeEquiv (fun a => output.apply_eq_iff_eq_symm_apply)
  have h := (Fintype.card_congr he).le.trans (fiber_card_le B n hn (output.symm y))
  exact_mod_cast h

theorem quotient_bound (B n : Nat) (hB : 0 < B) (hn : 0 < n) :
    ((B / n + 1 : Nat) : ℚ) / B ≤ 1 / (n : ℚ) + 1 / (B : ℚ) := by
  have hBq : (0 : ℚ) < B := by exact_mod_cast hB
  have hnq : (0 : ℚ) < n := by exact_mod_cast hn
  have hd : (B / n : Nat) * n ≤ B := Nat.div_mul_le_self B n
  have hdq : (B / n : Nat) * (n : ℚ) ≤ B := by exact_mod_cast hd
  rw [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
  apply (div_le_iff₀ hBq).mpr
  apply (mul_le_mul_iff_left₀ hnq).mp
  field_simp
  nlinarith

theorem encoded_mass_slack {A E : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype E]
    {B n : Nat} (hB : 0 < B) (hn : 0 < n)
    (input : A ≃ Fin B) (output : Fin n ≃ E) (y : E) :
    mean (fun a => indicator (output (reduce hn (input a)) = y)) ≤
      1 / (n : ℚ) + 1 / (B : ℚ) :=
  (encoded_mass_le hn input output y).trans (quotient_bound B n hB hn)

/-- Event bounds are obtained by summing atom bounds, with no independence
assumption between the output coordinates. -/
theorem event_mass_le {A E : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype E]
    (f : A → E) (c : ℚ) (h : ∀ y, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = y)) ≤ c)
    (bad : Finset E) :
    mean (fun a => indicator (f a ∈ bad)) ≤ bad.card * c := by
  classical
  have he (a : A) : indicator (f a ∈ bad) = ∑ y ∈ bad, indicator (f a = y) := by
    simp [indicator, eq_comm]
  simp_rw [he]
  simp only [mean]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  calc
    _ = ∑ y ∈ bad, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = y)) := by simp only [mean, Finset.sum_div]
    _ ≤ ∑ _y ∈ bad, c := Finset.sum_le_sum (fun y _ => h y)
    _ = bad.card * c := by simp

#print axioms fiber_card_le
#print axioms encoded_mass_slack
#print axioms event_mass_le
end
end R0C.ModuloCounting
R0C.Counting:
import FS2.Statement

/-! Finite counting over abstract types. Never unfold a concrete byte-state
universe in a term to be unified. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0C.Counting
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open scoped BigOperators
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {A B : Type} [Fintype A] [Fintype B]

theorem mean_indicator_card (p : A → Prop) :
    mean (fun a => indicator (p a)) =
      (Fintype.card {a // p a} : ℚ) / Fintype.card A := by
  simp only [mean, indicator, Finset.sum_boole, Fintype.card_subtype]

theorem point_mass_sum [Nonempty A] (f : A → B) :
    (∑ b, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = b))) = 1 := by
  classical
  simp only [mean, ← Finset.sum_div]
  rw [Finset.sum_comm]
  simp only [indicator]
  simp

theorem uniform_of_point_mass_le [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] (f : A → B)
    (h : ∀ b, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = b)) ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card B : ℚ)) :
    ∀ b, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = b)) = 1 / (Fintype.card B : ℚ) := by
  have hc : (Fintype.card B : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have he : (∑ b, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = b))) =
      ∑ _b : B, (1 / (Fintype.card B : ℚ)) := by
    rw [point_mass_sum]
    simp [hc]
  exact fun b => (Finset.sum_eq_sum_iff_of_le (fun b _ => h b)).mp he b (Finset.mem_univ b)

/-- A total deterministic map with ideal point-mass upper bounds forces the
output cardinality to divide the input cardinality. -/
theorem card_dvd_of_point_mass_le [Nonempty A] [Nonempty B] (f : A → B)
    (h : ∀ b, mean (fun a => indicator (f a = b)) ≤ 1 / (Fintype.card B : ℚ)) :
    Fintype.card B ∣ Fintype.card A := by
  classical
  let b : B := Classical.arbitrary B
  have he := uniform_of_point_mass_le f h b
  rw [mean_indicator_card] at he
  have ha : (Fintype.card A : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hb : (Fintype.card B : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast Fintype.card_ne_zero
  have hm : (Fintype.card A : ℚ) =
      (Fintype.card B : ℚ) * (Fintype.card {a // f a = b} : ℚ) := by
    have hcross := (div_eq_div_iff ha hb).mp he
    linarith
  refine ⟨Fintype.card {a // f a = b}, ?_⟩
  exact_mod_cast hm

/-- Adding one exceptional output increases an ideal uniform-event bound by
at most one atom. This is about the ideal finite law, not a byte sampler. -/
theorem mean_or_eq_le [Nonempty A] (p : A → Prop) (a0 : A) :
    mean (fun a => indicator (p a ∨ a = a0)) ≤
      (Fintype.card {a // p a} + 1 : ℚ) / Fintype.card A := by
  classical
  rw [mean_indicator_card, Fintype.card_subtype, Fintype.card_subtype]
  have hset : (Finset.univ.filter fun a => p a ∨ a = a0) =
      (Finset.univ.filter p) ∪ {a0} := by ext a; simp [or_comm]
  rw [hset]
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  exact_mod_cast (Finset.card_union_le (Finset.univ.filter p) {a0}).trans (by simp)

#print axioms mean_indicator_card
#print axioms uniform_of_point_mass_le
#print axioms card_dvd_of_point_mass_le

def tupleField (x : Fin 4 → Fin modulus) : QM31Exact :=

def fieldTuple (q : QM31Exact) : Fin 4 → Fin modulus :=
  ![⟨q.re.re.val, ZMod.val_lt q.re.re⟩,
    ⟨q.re.im.val, ZMod.val_lt q.re.im⟩,
    ⟨q.im.re.val, ZMod.val_lt q.im.re⟩,
    ⟨q.im.im.val, ZMod.val_lt q.im.im⟩]

  toFun := tupleField
  invFun := fieldTuple
  left_inv := by
    intro x
    funext i
    fin_cases i <;> apply Fin.ext <;>
      simp [fieldTuple, tupleField, decode4, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt]
  right_inv := by
    intro q
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
      · simp [tupleField, fieldTuple, decode4]
      · simp [tupleField, fieldTuple, decode4]
    · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
      · simp [tupleField, fieldTuple, decode4]
      · simp [tupleField, fieldTuple, decode4]

  apply List.ext_getElem (by simp)
  intro n hn1 hn2
  have hn : n < 4 := by simpa using hn1
  interval_cases n <;> simp

  rw [ofFn_four_values]
  rfl

    (hcan : ∀ a ∈ xs, a < modulus) (x : Fin 4 → Fin modulus) :
    SamplerFieldDecode.decode xs = tupleField x ↔

  obtain ⟨a,b,c,d,hxs⟩ : ∃ a b c d, xs = [a,b,c,d] :=
    ⟨_,_,_,_,List.eq_getElem_of_length_eq_four xs hlen⟩

  constructor
  · intro h
    change decode4 a b c d = tupleField x at h
    have h0 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.re.re) h
    have h1 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.re.im) h
    have h2 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.im.re) h
    have h3 := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.im.im) h
    simp only [tupleField, decode4] at h0 h1 h2 h3
    have hn0 : a = (x 0).val := by
      have := congrArg ZMod.val h0
      simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (hcan a (by simp)), ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (x 0).isLt] using this
    have hn1 : b = (x 1).val := by
      have := congrArg ZMod.val h1
      simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (hcan b (by simp)), ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (x 1).isLt] using this
    have hn2 : c = (x 2).val := by
      have := congrArg ZMod.val h2
      simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (hcan c (by simp)), ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (x 2).isLt] using this
    have hn3 : d = (x 3).val := by
      have := congrArg ZMod.val h3
      simpa only [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (hcan d (by simp)), ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt (x 3).isLt] using this
    subst a; subst b; subst c; subst d
    exact (ofFn_four_values x).symm
  · intro h
    rw [h]
    exact listDecode_tuple x

    (hcan : ∀ a ∈ xs, a < modulus) (x : Fin 4 → Fin modulus) :
    SamplerFieldDecode.decode xs = tupleField x ↔

def decode4 (a b c d : Nat) : QM31Exact := ⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩
def decode : List Nat → QM31Exact
  | [a,b,c,d] => decode4 a b c d

theorem canonical_cast_zero (a : Nat) (ha : a < P) :
    (a : M31Exact) = 0 ↔ a = 0 := by

  · intro h
    have hv := congrArg ZMod.val h
    simpa [ZMod.val_natCast_of_lt ha] using hv
  · intro h; simp [h]

theorem decode4_im_zero (a b c d : Nat) (hc : c < P) (hd : d < P) :
    (decode4 a b c d).im = 0 ↔ c = 0 ∧ d = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(canonical_cast_zero c hc).mp (congrArg (fun x : CM31Exact => x.re) h),
      (canonical_cast_zero d hd).mp (congrArg (fun x : CM31Exact => x.im) h)⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl,rfl⟩; rfl

    (hc : c < P) (hd : d < P) :
    decode4 a b c d = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0 ∧ c = 0 ∧ d = 0 := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact ⟨(canonical_cast_zero a ha).mp (congrArg (fun x : QM31Exact => x.re.re) h),
      (canonical_cast_zero b hb).mp (congrArg (fun x : QM31Exact => x.re.im) h),
      (canonical_cast_zero c hc).mp (congrArg (fun x : QM31Exact => x.im.re) h),
      (canonical_cast_zero d hd).mp (congrArg (fun x : QM31Exact => x.im.im) h)⟩
  · rintro ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩; rfl

/-! Literal cap-three nonzero/OOD wrapper policies. Error constructors are
kept separate where Rust separates them, not turned into successful defaults. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.SamplerWrapperPolicies
open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep MemoizedProgramLaw BoundedSamplerWrapper

inductive Error where
  | challengeExhausted
  | subfieldExhausted
  | parameterExhausted
  deriving DecidableEq, Repr

def nonzeroAccept (xs : List Nat) : Option (List Nat) :=
  if xs = [0,0,0,0] then none else some xs

def oodAccept : List Nat → Option (List Nat)
  | [a,b,c,d] => if c = 0 ∧ d = 0 then none else some [a,b,c,d]
  | _ => none

def nonzeroProgram (s : State) :=
  program nonzeroAccept Error.challengeExhausted Error.challengeExhausted 3 s
def nonzeroRun (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) :=
  run nonzeroAccept Error.challengeExhausted Error.challengeExhausted H 3 s
def oodProgram (s : State) :=
  program oodAccept Error.challengeExhausted Error.subfieldExhausted 3 s
def oodRun (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) :=
  run oodAccept Error.challengeExhausted Error.subfieldExhausted H 3 s

theorem nonzero_exact (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) :
    eval H (nonzeroProgram s) = nonzeroRun H s := exact_run _ _ _ H 3 s
theorem ood_exact (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) :
    eval H (oodProgram s) = oodRun H s := exact_run _ _ _ H 3 s
theorem nonzero_law (s : State) :
    SamplerOracleLaws.CorrectLaw (nonzeroProgram s) (fun H => nonzeroRun H s) :=
  oracle_law _ _ _ 3 s
theorem ood_law (s : State) :
    SamplerOracleLaws.CorrectLaw (oodProgram s) (fun H => oodRun H s) :=
  oracle_law _ _ _ 3 s

theorem nonzero_policy (xs ys : List Nat) (h : nonzeroAccept xs = some ys) :
    xs = ys ∧ ys ≠ [0,0,0,0] := by
  by_cases hz : xs = [0,0,0,0]
  · simp [nonzeroAccept,hz] at h
  · have he : xs = ys := by simpa [nonzeroAccept,hz] using h
    exact ⟨he,he ▸ hz⟩

theorem ood_policy (xs ys : List Nat) (h : oodAccept xs = some ys) :
    xs = ys ∧ ∃ a b c d, ys = [a,b,c,d] ∧ ¬ (c = 0 ∧ d = 0) := by
  unfold oodAccept at h
  split at h
  · rename_i a b c d
    by_cases hz : c = 0 ∧ d = 0
    · simp [hz] at h
    · have he : [a,b,c,d] = ys := by simpa [hz] using h
      exact ⟨he,a,b,c,d,he.symm,hz⟩
  · simp at h

theorem nonzero_result (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) (ys : List Nat)
    (h : (nonzeroRun H s).2.1 = .ok ys) :
    ys.length = 4 ∧ (∀ a ∈ ys, a < 2147483647) ∧ ys ≠ [0,0,0,0] := by
  obtain ⟨xs,hlen,hcan,ha⟩ := successful_image _ _ _ H 3 s ys h

  exact ⟨hlen,hcan,hne⟩

theorem ood_result (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) (ys : List Nat)
    (h : (oodRun H s).2.1 = .ok ys) :
    (∀ a ∈ ys, a < 2147483647) ∧ ∃ a b c d,

  obtain ⟨xs,_,hcan,ha⟩ := successful_image _ _ _ H 3 s ys h
  obtain ⟨rfl,hw⟩ := ood_policy xs ys ha
  exact ⟨hcan,hw⟩

import AspisV8R19.SamplerOracleLaws
import AspisV8R19.QM31SamplerInvariants

/-! Bounded source-shaped outer retries. Inner exhaustion is propagated at
once; a rejected successful draw retains its advanced state. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.BoundedSamplerWrapper
open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep MemoizedProgramLaw OracleProgramOps
open QM31SamplerInvariants SamplerOracleLaws
variable {O E : Type}

def program (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E) :
    Nat → State → Program Bytes State (Except E O × State)
  | 0,s => .done (.error outer,s)
  | n+1,s => bind (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun r =>
      match r.1 with
      | none => .done (.error inner,r.2)
      | some xs => match accept xs with
        | some y => .done (.ok y,r.2)
        | none => program accept inner outer n r.2)

def run (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E) (H : Bytes → State) :
    Nat → State → View Bytes State (Except E O × State)
  | 0,s => ([],(.error outer,s))
  | n+1,s =>
      let r := QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s
      match r.2.1 with
      | none => (r.1,(.error inner,r.2.2))
      | some xs => match accept xs with
        | some y => (r.1,(.ok y,r.2.2))
        | none =>
            let tail := run accept inner outer H n r.2.2
            (r.1 ++ tail.1,tail.2)

theorem exact_run (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (s : State) :
    eval H (program accept inner outer n s) = run accept inner outer H n s := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [program,eval_bind,QM31SamplerProgram.challenge_exact,run]
      cases h : (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.1 with
      | none => simp [h,eval]
      | some xs => cases ha : accept xs <;> simp [h,ha,ih,eval]

theorem oracle_law (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (n : Nat) (s : State) :
    CorrectLaw (program accept inner outer n s) (fun H => run accept inner outer H n s) :=
  law_of_exact _ _ (fun H => exact_run accept inner outer H n s)

theorem zero_no_reads (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (H : Bytes → State) (s : State) :
    run accept inner outer H 0 s = ([],(.error outer,s)) := rfl

theorem inner_error_stops (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (s : State)
    (h : (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.1 = none) :
    run accept inner outer H (n+1) s =
      ((QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).1,
       (.error inner,(QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.2)) := by simp [run,h]

theorem accepted_stops (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (s : State) (xs : List Nat) (y : O)
    (h : (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.1 = some xs)
    (ha : accept xs = some y) :
    run accept inner outer H (n+1) s =
      ((QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).1,
       (.ok y,(QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.2)) := by simp [run,h,ha]

theorem rejected_retains_trace (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (s : State) (xs : List Nat)
    (h : (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.1 = some xs)
    (ha : accept xs = none) :
    run accept inner outer H (n+1) s =
      ((QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).1 ++
        (run accept inner outer H n (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.2).1,
       (run accept inner outer H n (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.2).2) := by
  simp [run,h,ha]

theorem successful_image (accept : List Nat → Option O) (inner outer : E)
    (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (s : State) (y : O)
    (h : (run accept inner outer H n s).2.1 = .ok y) :
    ∃ xs, xs.length = 4 ∧ (∀ a ∈ xs, a < 2147483647) ∧ accept xs = some y := by
  induction n generalizing s with
  | zero => simp [run] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      cases hr : (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s).2.1 with
      | none => simp [run,hr] at h
      | some xs =>
          cases ha : accept xs with
          | none => apply ih _; simpa [run,hr,ha] using h
          | some z =>
              have hz : z = y := by simpa [run,hr,ha] using h
              subst z
              have hc := challenge_four_canonical_limbs H s xs hr
              exact ⟨xs,hc.1,hc.2,ha⟩

#print axioms oracle_law
#print axioms zero_no_reads

#print axioms accepted_stops
#print axioms rejected_retains_trace
#print axioms successful_image

/-! Exact memoized-oracle laws for the compiled source-shaped samplers.
This does not assert independent field challenges conditional on later roots,
nor replace SHA by a uniform oracle as a computational-security theorem. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.SamplerOracleLaws
open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep SourceOraclePrograms
open MemoizedProgramLaw OracleFiniteSupport OracleResampling

def CorrectLaw {O : Type} (p : Program Bytes State O) (run : (Bytes → State) → View Bytes State O) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fallback : State) (observe : View Bytes State O → ℚ),
    mean (fun H : {i // i ∈ support p} → State =>
      observe (run (extend (support p) H fallback))) =
      lazyMean p (fun _ => none) observe

theorem law_of_exact {O : Type} (p : Program Bytes State O)
    (run : (Bytes → State) → View Bytes State O) (exactRun : ∀ H, eval H p = run H) :
    CorrectLaw p run := by
  intro fallback observe
  have h := byte_program_law p fallback observe
  simpa only [exactRun] using h

theorem qm31_law (s : State) :
    CorrectLaw (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun H => QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s) :=
  law_of_exact (QM31SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun H => QM31SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s)
    (fun H => QM31SamplerProgram.challenge_exact H s)

theorem q22_law (s : State) :
    CorrectLaw (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun H => Q22SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s) :=
  law_of_exact (Q22SamplerProgram.challengeProgram s) (fun H => Q22SamplerProgram.challengeRun H s)
    (fun H => Q22SamplerProgram.challenge_exact H s)
