import AspisV8R19.SamplerWords

/-! Source-shaped bounded QM31 sampling. The cursor is shared across the four
limbs; each limb resets its own eight-attempt budget. A new top-level call
always squeezes a new block and discards the prior call's unused suffix. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.QM31SamplerProgram
open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep SourceOraclePrograms SamplerWords
open MemoizedProgramLaw OracleProgramOps

structure Cursor where
  state : State
  block : State
  index : Fin 9

def readProgram (c : Cursor) : Program Bytes State (Nat × Cursor) :=
  if h : c.index.val = 8 then
    bind (squeezeProgram c.state) (fun p =>
      .done (word p.1 0,⟨p.2,p.1,1⟩))
  else .done (word c.block ⟨c.index.val,by have := c.index.isLt; omega⟩,
    ⟨c.state,c.block,⟨c.index.val+1,by have := c.index.isLt; omega⟩⟩)

def readRun (H : Bytes → State) (c : Cursor) : View Bytes State (Nat × Cursor) :=
  if h : c.index.val = 8 then
    let p := step H c.state
    (calls H c.state,(word p.1 0,⟨p.2,p.1,1⟩))
  else ([],(word c.block ⟨c.index.val,by have := c.index.isLt; omega⟩,
    ⟨c.state,c.block,⟨c.index.val+1,by have := c.index.isLt; omega⟩⟩))

theorem read_exact (H : Bytes → State) (c : Cursor) :
    eval H (readProgram c) = readRun H c := by
  by_cases h : c.index.val = 8 <;>
    simp [readProgram,readRun,h,eval_bind,squeeze_eval,eval]

theorem read_call_count (H : Bytes → State) (c : Cursor) :
    (readRun H c).1.length = if c.index.val = 8 then 2 else 0 := by
  by_cases h : c.index.val = 8 <;> simp [readRun,h,calls]

def limbProgram : Nat → Cursor → Program Bytes State (Option Nat × Cursor)
  | 0,c => .done (none,c)
  | n+1,c => bind (readProgram c) (fun r =>
      if masked 31 r.1 = 2147483647 then limbProgram n r.2
      else .done (some (masked 31 r.1),r.2))

def limbRun (H : Bytes → State) : Nat → Cursor → View Bytes State (Option Nat × Cursor)
  | 0,c => ([],(none,c))
  | n+1,c =>
      let r := readRun H c
      if masked 31 r.2.1 = 2147483647 then
        let tail := limbRun H n r.2.2
        (r.1 ++ tail.1,tail.2)
      else (r.1,(some (masked 31 r.2.1),r.2.2))

theorem limb_exact (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (c : Cursor) :
    eval H (limbProgram n c) = limbRun H n c := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [limbProgram,eval_bind,read_exact,limbRun]
      split_ifs <;> simp [ih,eval]

theorem accepted_limb_canonical (H : Bytes → State) (n : Nat) (c : Cursor)
    (a : Nat) (h : (limbRun H n c).2.1 = some a) : a < 2147483647 := by
  induction n generalizing c with
  | zero => simp [limbRun] at h
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [limbRun] at h
      split_ifs at h with reject
      · exact ih _ h
      · have ha : masked 31 (readRun H c).2.1 = a := Option.some.inj h
        have hb := masked_bound 31 (readRun H c).2.1
        change masked 31 (readRun H c).2.1 < 2147483648 at hb
        omega

def limbsProgram : Nat → Cursor → Program Bytes State (Option (List Nat) × Cursor)
  | 0,c => .done (some [],c)
  | n+1,c => bind (limbProgram 8 c) (fun r => match r.1 with
      | none => .done (none,r.2)
      | some a => bind (limbsProgram n r.2) (fun tail =>
          .done (tail.1.map (a::·),tail.2)))

    eval H (challengeProgram s) = challengeRun H s := by
  simp [challengeProgram,challengeRun,eval_bind,squeeze_eval,limbs_exact,eval]

namespace AspisV8R15.ExactTowerChord
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase

def cm31Subfield : Subfield QM31Exact :=
  (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact).fieldRange

theorem mem_cm31_iff (z : QM31Exact) : z ∈ cm31Subfield ↔ z.im = 0 := by
  change (∃ a : CM31Exact, algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact a = z) ↔ _
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
    rfl
  · intro h
    refine ⟨z.re, ?_⟩
    ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.algebraMap_eq, h]

theorem two_ne_zero : (2 : QM31Exact) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have hh := congrArg (fun z : QM31Exact => z.re.re) h
  change (2 : M31Exact) = 0 at hh
  have hn : (2 : M31Exact) ≠ 0 := by
    change ¬ ((2 : ℕ) : ZMod P) = 0
    rw [ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff]
    decide
  exact hn hh

/-- The source's rejected `c1 == 0` parameters correspond exactly to the
CM31 subfield. No caller-supplied abstract field or subfield remains here. -/
theorem chord_nonzero (t u : QM31Exact) (x y : CM31Exact)
    (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0)
    (htu : u ≠ t) (htim : t.im ≠ 0) (huim : u.im ≠ 0)
    (hc : x^2+y^2=1) :
    chord t u (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact x)
      (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact y) ≠ 0 := by
  apply subfield_circle_nonzero cm31Subfield t u _ _ two_ne_zero ht hu htu
  · exact fun h => htim ((mem_cm31_iff t).mp h)
  · exact fun h => huim ((mem_cm31_iff u).mp h)
  · exact (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact).mem_fieldRange_self x
  · exact (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact).mem_fieldRange_self y
  · have h := congrArg (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact) hc
    simpa only [map_add, map_pow, map_one] using h

    (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0)
    (hpoints : (px t, py t) ≠ (px u, py u))
    (htim : t.im ≠ 0) (huim : u.im ≠ 0) (hc : x^2+y^2=1) :
    chord t u (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact x)
      (algebraMap CM31Exact QM31Exact y) ≠ 0 := by
  apply chord_nonzero t u x y ht hu _ htim huim hc
  intro h
  apply hpoints
  rw [h]

import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Mathlib.Tactic.LinearCombination
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Subfield.Basic

/-! Algebra of the literal source OOD chord. No probability assumptions. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R15.CircleChord
variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

def px (t : F) : F := (1 - t^2) / (1 + t^2)
def py (t : F) : F := 2*t / (1 + t^2)
def chord (t u x y : F) : F :=
  px t * py u - py t * px u + (py t - py u)*x + (px u - px t)*y

theorem rational_factor (t u r : F)
    (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0) (hr : 1+r^2 ≠ 0) :
    chord t u (px r) (py r) =
      4*(u-t)*(r-t)*(r-u) / ((1+t^2)*(1+u^2)*(1+r^2)) := by
  unfold chord px py
  field_simp
  ring

theorem exceptional_factor (t u : F)
    (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0) :
    chord t u (-1) 0 = 4*(u-t) / ((1+t^2)*(1+u^2)) := by
  unfold chord px py
  field_simp
  ring

theorem rational_nonzero (t u r : F) (h4 : (4 : F) ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0) (hr : 1+r^2 ≠ 0)
    (htu : u ≠ t) (hrt : r ≠ t) (hru : r ≠ u) :
    chord t u (px r) (py r) ≠ 0 := by
  rw [rational_factor t u r ht hu hr]
  exact div_ne_zero
    (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h4 (sub_ne_zero.mpr htu))
      (sub_ne_zero.mpr hrt)) (sub_ne_zero.mpr hru))
    (mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero ht hu) hr)

theorem exceptional_nonzero (t u : F) (h4 : (4 : F) ≠ 0)
    (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0) (htu : u ≠ t) :
    chord t u (-1) 0 ≠ 0 := by
  rw [exceptional_factor t u ht hu]
  exact div_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero h4 (sub_ne_zero.mpr htu)) (mul_ne_zero ht hu)

theorem recover_denom (x y : F) (hx : 1+x ≠ 0)
    (hc : x^2+y^2=1) : 1+(y/(1+x))^2 = 2/(1+x) := by
  field_simp
  linear_combination hc

theorem recover_point (x y : F) (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0)
    (hx : 1+x ≠ 0) (hc : x^2+y^2=1) :
    px (y/(1+x)) = x ∧ py (y/(1+x)) = y := by
  unfold px py
  rw [recover_denom x y hx hc]
  constructor
  · field_simp
    linear_combination -hc
  · field_simp

/-- Every circle point in a subfield avoids the chord through two distinct
finite rational points whose parameters lie outside that subfield. -/
theorem subfield_circle_nonzero (S : Subfield F) (t u x y : F)
    (h2 : (2 : F) ≠ 0) (ht : 1+t^2 ≠ 0) (hu : 1+u^2 ≠ 0)
    (htu : u ≠ t) (htS : t ∉ S) (huS : u ∉ S)
    (hxS : x ∈ S) (hyS : y ∈ S) (hc : x^2+y^2=1) :
    chord t u x y ≠ 0 := by
  have h4 : (4 : F) ≠ 0 := by
    have he : (4 : F) = 2*2 := by ring
    rw [he]
    exact mul_ne_zero h2 h2
  by_cases hx : 1+x=0
  · have hxe : x = -1 := by linear_combination hx
    have hy2 : y^2 = 0 := by
      rw [hxe] at hc
      linear_combination hc
    have hye : y = 0 := by
      have hh : y*y = 0 := by simpa only [pow_two] using hy2
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hh).elim id id
    rw [hxe, hye]
    exact exceptional_nonzero t u h4 ht hu htu
  · have hrS : y/(1+x) ∈ S := S.div_mem hyS (S.add_mem S.one_mem hxS)
    have hrt : y/(1+x) ≠ t := by
      intro h
      exact htS (h ▸ hrS)
    have hru : y/(1+x) ≠ u := by
      intro h
      exact huS (h ▸ hrS)
    have hr : 1+(y/(1+x))^2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [recover_denom x y hx hc]
      exact div_ne_zero h2 hx
    have hp := recover_point x y h2 hx hc
    have hn := rational_nonzero t u (y/(1+x)) h4 ht hu hr htu hrt hru
    rw [hp.1, hp.2] at hn
    exact hn

#print axioms subfield_circle_nonzero
#print axioms recover_point
#print axioms rational_factor
#print axioms exceptional_factor
#print axioms rational_nonzero
#print axioms exceptional_nonzero
end AspisV8R15.CircleChord

AspisV8R19.R443BoundedRejectionMass:
import AspisV8R19.R442RejectionAlphabet
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R443BoundedRejectionMass
open OracleResampling
noncomputable section

variable {p : Nat}

abbrev Tape (p n : Nat) := Fin n → Option (Fin p)

def splitTape (p n : Nat) : Tape p (n+1) ≃ (Option (Fin p) × Tape p n) where
  toFun t := (t 0, fun i => t i.succ)
  invFun q := Fin.cases q.1 q.2
  left_inv t := by
    funext i
    exact Fin.cases rfl (fun _ => rfl) i
  right_inv q := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · rfl
    · funext i; rfl

def run : (n : Nat) → Tape p n → Option (Fin p)
  | 0, _ => none
  | n+1, t => match t 0 with
    | none => run n (fun i => t i.succ)
    | some a => some a

theorem mean_option (f : Option (Fin p) → ℚ) :
    mean f = (f none + ∑ a : Fin p, f (some a)) / (p+1 : ℚ) := by
  simp [mean, Fintype.sum_option, Fintype.card_option]

theorem mean_step (n : Nat) (f : Option (Fin p) → ℚ) :
    mean (fun t : Tape p (n+1) => f (run (n+1) t)) =
      (mean (fun t : Tape p n => f (run n t)) + ∑ a : Fin p, f (some a)) /
        (p+1 : ℚ) := by
  let g : Option (Fin p) → ℚ := fun w => match w with
    | none => mean (fun t : Tape p n => f (run n t))
    | some a => f (some a)
  calc
    _ = mean (fun q : Option (Fin p) × Tape p n =>
          f (run (n+1) ((splitTape p n).symm q))) :=
      (mean_equiv (splitTape p n).symm
        (fun t : Tape p (n+1) => f (run (n+1) t))).symm
    _ = mean (fun w : Option (Fin p) => mean (fun t : Tape p n =>
          f (run (n+1) ((splitTape p n).symm (w,t))))) :=
      mean_prod (fun (w : Option (Fin p)) (t : Tape p n) =>
        f (run (n+1) ((splitTape p n).symm (w,t))))
    _ = mean g := by
      apply mean_congr
      intro w
      cases w with
      | none => rfl
      | some a => exact mean_const (f (some a))
    _ = _ := mean_option g

def failureMass (p n : Nat) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun t : Tape p n => if run n t = none then 1 else 0)

def valueMass (p n : Nat) (a : Fin p) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun t : Tape p n => if run n t = some a then 1 else 0)

theorem failure_mass (p n : Nat) :
    failureMass p n = (1 / (p+1 : ℚ)) ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [failureMass, run, mean_const]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [failureMass, mean_step n (fun x => if x = none then (1 : ℚ) else 0)]
    simp only [Option.some_ne_none, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
    change failureMass p n / (p+1 : ℚ) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ]
    ring

theorem value_mass (p n : Nat) (a : Fin p) :
    valueMass p n a = (1 - (1 / (p+1 : ℚ)) ^ n) / p := by
  have hp : (p : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show p ≠ 0 by have := a.isLt; omega)
  have hm : (p+1 : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by positivity
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [valueMass, run, mean_const]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [valueMass, mean_step n (fun x => if x = some a then (1 : ℚ) else 0)]
    simp only [Option.some.injEq]
    rw [Finset.sum_ite_eq']
    simp only [Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
    change (valueMass p n a + 1) / (p+1 : ℚ) = _
    rw [ih, pow_succ]
    field_simp
    ring

#print axioms mean_step
#print axioms failure_mass
#print axioms value_mass
end

import AspisV8R19.R421UniformMasked31Block

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R442RejectionAlphabet

def alphabetDecode (p : Nat) (w : Fin (p + 1)) : Option (Fin p) :=
  if h : w.val < p then some ⟨w.val, h⟩ else none

def alphabetEncode (p : Nat) : Option (Fin p) → Fin (p + 1)
  | none => ⟨p, by omega⟩
  | some a => a.castSucc

/-- The accepted alphabet has `p` values and one explicit rejection sentinel. -/
def alphabetEquiv (p : Nat) : Fin (p + 1) ≃ Option (Fin p) where
  toFun := alphabetDecode p
  invFun := alphabetEncode p
  left_inv w := by
    apply Fin.ext
    by_cases h : w.val < p
    · simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode, h]
    · have hp : w.val = p := by omega
      simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode, h, hp]
  right_inv o := by
    cases o with
    | none =>
        simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode]
    | some a =>
        simp [alphabetDecode, alphabetEncode, a.isLt]

/-- Return the first accepted value, skipping rejection sentinels. -/
def firstAccepted {p : Nat} : List (Option (Fin p)) → Option (Fin p)
  | [] => none
  | none :: xs => firstAccepted xs
  | some a :: _ => some a

theorem firstAccepted_map {p : Nat} (σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin p))
    (xs : List (Option (Fin p))) :
    firstAccepted (xs.map (Option.map σ)) =
      Option.map σ (firstAccepted xs) := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons head tail ih =>
      cases head with
      | none => exact ih
      | some a => rfl

#print axioms alphabetEquiv
#print axioms firstAccepted_map

end AspisV8R19.R442RejectionAlphabet

/-!
Uniformity of the source's masked 31-bit word block under the uniform 32-byte
tape model. This draft only transports a finite mean along explicit
bijections; it does not assert independence or freshness for a shared oracle.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisV8R19.R421UniformMasked31Block

open DuplexFrames SourceDuplexStep SamplerWords OracleResampling
open R406SamplerWordDistribution
noncomputable section

/-- Split a 32-bit word into its high bit and low 31 bits. -/
def splitWord31Equiv : Fin (2^32) ≃ (Fin 2 × Fin (2^31)) :=
  (finProdFinEquiv (m := 2) (n := 2^31)).symm

def distribute31 : (Fin 8 → Fin 2 × Fin (2^31)) ≃
    ((Fin 8 → Fin 2) × (Fin 8 → Fin (2^31))) where
  toFun f := (fun j => (f j).1, fun j => (f j).2)
  invFun p j := (p.1 j, p.2 j)
  left_inv _ := rfl
  right_inv _ := rfl

def splitBlock31Equiv : State ≃
    ((Fin 8 → Fin 2) × (Fin 8 → Fin (2^31))) :=
  (blockWordEquiv.trans (Equiv.piCongrRight (fun _ => splitWord31Equiv))).trans distribute31

theorem masked31_value (block : State) (j : Fin 8) :
    ((splitBlock31Equiv block).2 j).val = masked 31 (word block j) := by
  change (blockWordEquiv block j).val % 2^31 = _
  rw [word_value, masked_eq_mod]

theorem words31_value (block : State) :
    words 31 block = List.ofFn (fun j => ((splitBlock31Equiv block).2 j).val) := by
  unfold words
  congr 1
  funext j
  exact (masked31_value block j).symm

theorem uniform_masked31_block (f : List Nat → ℚ) :
    mean (fun out : State => f (words 31 out)) =
      mean (fun x : Fin 8 → Fin (2^31) =>
        f (List.ofFn (fun j => (x j).val))) := by
  simp_rw [words31_value]
  rw [mean_equiv splitBlock31Equiv
    (fun p => f (List.ofFn (fun j => (p.2 j).val)))]
  rw [mean_prod (fun (_ : Fin 8 → Fin 2) (x : Fin 8 → Fin (2^31)) =>
    f (List.ofFn (fun j => (x j).val)))]
  exact mean_const _

#print axioms masked31_value
#print axioms words31_value
#print axioms uniform_masked31_block

end
end AspisV8R19.R421UniformMasked31Block

    ∃ q : field.QM31, sampler.qm31_sample block = .ok q ∧ Canonical (toR72QM q) := by

  have hw : sampler.qm31_sample block = .ok (fromPublicQM qpub) := by

    rfl

    RawCircleSampleActualSamplerCanonicalV1.successful_sample_toR72_canonical
      block (fromPublicQM qpub) hw⟩

    `.ok`; its exact behavior is the retained R72 source execution. -/
theorem mapper_result_total (q : field.QM31)
    (hq : Canonical (toR72QM q)) :

      circle.secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter q = .ok r := by

  cases hr : AspisR72Sampler.circle.secure_ood_circle_point_from_parameter
      (toR72QM q) with
  | fail e =>
      rw [hr] at hsource
      cases hsource
  | div =>
      rw [hr] at hsource
      cases hsource

          rfl

          rw [RawCircleSampleEmittedWrapperLaw.secure_circle_eq_r72, hr]
          rfl

    the retained R0P circle, without assuming success of its QM31 sampler or
    mapper calls. -/

    (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (row : r0_transcript.CircleRow) :

      | Second =>

/-- Canonicality of the actual wrapper sampler output follows from the
    existing byte-sampler proof, transported through the wrapper's explicit
    four-coordinate copy into the R72 representation. -/
theorem successful_sample_toR72_canonical
    (block : Array Std.U8 32#usize) (q : field.QM31)
    (h : sampler.qm31_sample block = ok q) :
    Canonical (toR72QM q) := by
  have heq := RawCircleSampleEmittedWrapperLaw.sampler_qm31_sample_eq_public block
  cases hp : AspisR1PublicPreparation.sampler.qm31_sample block with
  | ok qpub =>
      have hw : sampler.qm31_sample block = ok (fromPublicQM qpub) := by
        rw [heq, hp]
        rfl
      have hq : q = fromPublicQM qpub := Result.ok.inj (h.symm.trans hw)
      subst q
      obtain ⟨q0, h0, hc0, _⟩ := AspisR1PublicPreparation.SamplerTransport.sample_total block
      have heq : qpub = q0 := Result.ok.inj (hp.symm.trans h0)
      subst qpub
      have hc := hc0
      change CanonicalCM (toCurrent (toOld q0)).c0 ∧
        CanonicalCM (toCurrent (toOld q0)).c1 at hc
      rcases hc with ⟨⟨h00, h01⟩, ⟨h10, h11⟩⟩
      change (toR72QM (fromPublicQM q0)).c0.a.val <
          AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P ∧
        (toR72QM (fromPublicQM q0)).c0.b.val <
          AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P ∧
        (toR72QM (fromPublicQM q0)).c1.a.val <
          AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P ∧
        (toR72QM (fromPublicQM q0)).c1.b.val <
          AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P
      simpa [toR72QM, toR72CM, fromPublicQM,
        AspisR1PublicPreparation.SamplerTransport.toOld, AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier.toCurrent,
        AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalCM, AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.CanonicalQM, AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.P, AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentM31AddSub.P, AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.P] using
        And.intro h00 (And.intro h01 (And.intro h10 h11))
  | fail e =>
      simp only [heq, hp, bind_tc_fail] at h
      cases h
  | div =>
      simp only [heq, hp, bind_tc_div] at h
      cases h

      simp [machineProcess, numeral, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hr, Nat.div_eq_of_lt hr]

      have hrem := machineStep_remainder_toNat digit hr

        rw [hquotChunk, hremChunk]
        simpa [Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.mod_add_div chunk P).symm
      have htailR : (machineProcess next digits).1.toNat = tailInput % P := by
        simpa [tailInput, hnext] using htail.1
      have htailQ : numeral B ((machineProcess next digits).2.map UInt32.toNat) =

        simpa [Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.mod_add_div tailInput P).symm

              (P * (tailInput / P) + tailInput % P) := by
                exact congrArg (fun t => P * (step.1.toNat * B ^ digits.length) + t)

      have hquotTotal : total / P = totalQuotient := by
        apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
        · rw [htotalDiv]

          _ = (P * totalQuotient + tailInput % P) - P * totalQuotient := by
            rw [htotalDiv]

    Nat.shiftLeft r n ||| d = r * 2 ^ n + d := by

      change (r <<< n) + d = r * 2 ^ n + d

    Nat.shiftLeft r 32 ||| d < 2 ^ 63 := by

  exact dividend_lt_two63 hr (by simpa [B] using hd)

theorem modelExpr_lt_two63 {r d : Nat} (hr : r < P) (hd : d < 2 ^ 32) :

  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt

    calc

    change Nat.shiftLeft r.toNat 32 < 2 ^ 64
    exact hshift

  unfold machineWord

/-! Concrete Nat bounds for the sampler's chosen radix and modulus.
These lemmas do not identify Nat operations with Rust machine operations. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds

def P : Nat := 2^31 - 1
def B : Nat := 2^32

theorem P_pos : 0 < P := by norm_num [P]
theorem B_pos : 0 < B := by norm_num [B]

theorem P_times_B_lt_two63 : P * B < 2^63 := by norm_num [P, B]

/-- The multiply-add in one radix digit is strictly below the signed-bit
boundary, so it also fits in an unsigned 64-bit word. -/
theorem dividend_lt_two63 {r digit : Nat} (hr : r < P) (hdigit : digit < B) :
    r * B + digit < 2^63 := by
  have hstep := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.dividend_lt_mul
    (radix := B) (divisor := P) (remainder := r) (digit := digit)
    B_pos P_pos hr hdigit
  exact lt_trans hstep P_times_B_lt_two63

/-- One base-P long-division quotient is a single radix digit. -/
theorem dividend_quotient_lt_B {r digit : Nat} (hr : r < P) (hdigit : digit < B) :
    (r * B + digit) / P < B := by
  simpa [AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.dividend, B, P] using
    (AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.quotient_lt_radix
      (radix := B) (divisor := P) (remainder := r) (digit := digit)
      B_pos P_pos hr hdigit)

theorem dividend_remainder_lt_P {r digit : Nat} :
    (r * B + digit) % P < P := by
  simpa [AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.dividend, B, P] using
    (AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.remainder_lt_divisor
      (radix := B) (divisor := P) (remainder := r) (digit := digit) P_pos)

/-- Since a 256-bit input is less than 257 blocks of size P^8, its quotient
by P^8 is at most 256. -/
theorem rank_div_P8_le_256 {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2^256) : x / P^8 ≤ 256 := by
  have hP8 : 0 < P^8 := by norm_num [P]
  have h257 : x / P^8 < 257 := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hP8).2
    calc
      x < 2^256 := hx
      _ < 257 * P^8 := by norm_num [P]
  omega

theorem rank_quotient_plus_one_le_257 {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2^256) :
    x / P^8 + 1 ≤ 257 := by
  have h := rank_div_P8_le_256 hx
  omega

theorem two_le_P8 : 2 ≤ P^8 := by norm_num [P]

theorem rank_div_P8_lt_P8_sub_one {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2^256) :
    x / P^8 < P^8 - 1 := by
  have hquot := rank_div_P8_le_256 hx
  have hlarge : 257 < P^8 := by norm_num [P]
  omega

theorem two_fifty_seven_lt_P : 257 < P := by norm_num [P]

/-- A digit plus the largest accumulator addend still fits in one u32. -/
theorem digit_addend_lt_B {digit addend : Nat}
    (hdigit : digit < P) (haddend : addend ≤ 257) : digit + addend < B := by
  have hcap : P + 257 < B := by norm_num [P, B]
  omega

/-- Adding at most 257 to a base-P digit creates at most one carry. -/
theorem digit_addend_quotient_le_one {digit addend : Nat}
    (hdigit : digit < P) (haddend : addend ≤ 257) :
    (digit + addend) / P ≤ 1 := by
  have hP : 0 < P := P_pos
  have htwoP : digit + addend < 2 * P := by
    have hcap : P + 257 < 2 * P := by norm_num [P]
    omega
  have hquot : (digit + addend) / P < 2 := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hP).2
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using htwoP
  omega

/-- The ordinary subsequent carry addend is included in the general bound. -/
theorem digit_carry_quotient_le_one {digit carry : Nat}
    (hdigit : digit < P) (hcarry : carry ≤ 1) :
    (digit + carry) / P ≤ 1 := by
  apply digit_addend_quotient_le_one hdigit
  omega

#print axioms rank_quotient_plus_one_le_257

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring

/-! Arithmetic facts for a high-to-low base-radix long-division pass.
This file makes no claim about a Rust implementation, fixed-width machine
arithmetic, or a probability distribution. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision

/-- One long-division pass over a single radix digit. -/
def dividend (radix remainder digit : Nat) : Nat := remainder * radix + digit

theorem dividend_lt_mul {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (hremainder : remainder < divisor) (hdigit : digit < radix) :
    dividend radix remainder digit < divisor * radix := by
  dsimp [dividend]
  calc
    remainder * radix + digit < remainder * radix + radix :=
      Nat.add_lt_add_left hdigit _
    _ = (remainder + 1) * radix := by rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul]
    _ ≤ divisor * radix :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_right radix (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hremainder)

theorem quotient_lt_radix {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (hremainder : remainder < divisor) (hdigit : digit < radix) :
    dividend radix remainder digit / divisor < radix := by
  apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hdivisor).2
  have h := dividend_lt_mul hradix hdivisor hremainder hdigit
  simpa [dividend, Nat.mul_comm] using h

theorem remainder_lt_divisor {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat}
    (hdivisor : 0 < divisor) :
    dividend radix remainder digit % divisor < divisor :=
  Nat.mod_lt _ hdivisor

theorem dividend_eq_division {radix divisor remainder digit : Nat} :
    dividend radix remainder digit =
      divisor * (dividend radix remainder digit / divisor) +
        dividend radix remainder digit % divisor := by
  dsimp [dividend]
  simpa [Nat.add_comm, Nat.mul_comm] using
    (Nat.mod_add_div (remainder * radix + digit) divisor).symm

/-- Accumulated quotient, current remainder, and the value of the processed
prefix. -/
structure State where
  quotient : Nat
  remainder : Nat
  processedValue : Nat
  deriving Repr, DecidableEq

def initialState : State := ⟨0, 0, 0⟩

/-- Append one digit to the processed prefix and update the quotient/remainder. -/
def longDivisionStep (radix divisor : Nat) (state : State) (digit : Nat) : State :=
  let n := dividend radix state.remainder digit
  ⟨state.quotient * radix + n / divisor,
    n % divisor,
    state.processedValue * radix + digit⟩

theorem step_preserves_invariant {radix divisor : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (state : State) (digit : Nat)
    (hinvariant : state.processedValue =
      divisor * state.quotient + state.remainder)
    (hremainder : state.remainder < divisor)
    (hdigit : digit < radix) :
    let next := longDivisionStep radix divisor state digit
    next.processedValue = divisor * next.quotient + next.remainder ∧
      next.remainder < divisor := by
  dsimp [longDivisionStep]
  let n := dividend radix state.remainder digit
  have hdivision := dividend_eq_division (radix := radix) (divisor := divisor)
    (remainder := state.remainder) (digit := digit)
  have hdivision' : n = divisor * (n / divisor) + n % divisor := by
    simpa [n] using hdivision
  constructor
  · rw [hinvariant]
    calc
      (divisor * state.quotient + state.remainder) * radix + digit
          = divisor * state.quotient * radix + n := by
              dsimp [n, dividend]
              ring
      _ = divisor * state.quotient * radix +
            (divisor * (n / divisor) + n % divisor) :=
              congrArg (fun x => divisor * state.quotient * radix + x) hdivision'
      _ = divisor * (state.quotient * radix + n / divisor) + n % divisor := by ring
  · exact remainder_lt_divisor (radix := radix) (divisor := divisor)
      (remainder := state.remainder) (digit := digit) hdivisor

/-- Repeatedly process a digit list from its most-significant end. -/
def process (radix divisor : Nat) : State → List Nat → State
  | state, [] => state
  | state, digit :: digits =>
      process radix divisor (longDivisionStep radix divisor state digit) digits

theorem process_preserves_invariant {radix divisor : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (digits : List Nat) (state : State)
    (hinvariant : state.processedValue =
      divisor * state.quotient + state.remainder)
    (hremainder : state.remainder < divisor)
    (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < radix) :
    let finalState := process radix divisor state digits
    finalState.processedValue = divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder ∧
      finalState.remainder < divisor := by
  induction digits generalizing state with
  | nil =>
      simpa [process] using And.intro hinvariant hremainder
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      have hdigit : digit < radix := hdigits digit (by simp)
      have htail : ∀ x ∈ digits, x < radix := by
        intro x hx
        exact hdigits x (by simp [hx])
      have hstep := step_preserves_invariant hradix hdivisor state digit
        hinvariant hremainder hdigit
      simpa [process] using
        ih (state := longDivisionStep radix divisor state digit)
          hstep.1 hstep.2 htail

theorem initialState_process_correct {radix divisor : Nat}
    (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < radix) :
    let finalState := process radix divisor initialState digits
    finalState.processedValue = divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder ∧
      finalState.remainder < divisor := by
  apply process_preserves_invariant hradix hdivisor digits initialState
  · rfl
  · exact hdivisor
  · exact hdigits

#print axioms dividend_lt_mul
#print axioms quotient_lt_radix
#print axioms dividend_eq_division
#print axioms step_preserves_invariant
#print axioms process_preserves_invariant
#print axioms initialState_process_correct

end AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision
R1SamplerPass:
import R1SamplerLongDivision
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! The long-division state follows the high-to-low numeral fold.  The results
are arithmetic abstractions and do not identify any source implementation. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerPass

/-- The value of a high-to-low list of radix digits. -/
def numeral (radix : Nat) (digits : List Nat) : Nat :=
  digits.foldl (fun a d => a * radix + d) 0

theorem process_processedValue (radix divisor : Nat) (state : AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.State)
    (digits : List Nat) :
    (AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process radix divisor state digits).processedValue =
      digits.foldl (fun a d => a * radix + d) state.processedValue := by
  induction digits generalizing state with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      simpa [AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process,
        AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.longDivisionStep] using
        (ih (state := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.longDivisionStep
          radix divisor state digit))

theorem initialState_process_quotient_remainder
    {radix divisor : Nat} (hradix : 0 < radix) (hdivisor : 0 < divisor)
    (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < radix) :
    let finalState := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process radix divisor
      AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
    finalState.quotient = numeral radix digits / divisor ∧
      finalState.remainder = numeral radix digits % divisor := by
  let finalState := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process radix divisor
    AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
  have hcorrect := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState_process_correct
    hradix hdivisor digits hdigits
  have hfold := process_processedValue radix divisor
    AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
  have hnum : numeral radix digits =
      divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder := by
    change numeral radix digits = divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder
    have hpv : finalState.processedValue = numeral radix digits := by
      simpa [finalState, numeral, AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState] using hfold
    rw [← hpv]
    exact hcorrect.1
  have hrem : finalState.remainder < divisor := hcorrect.2
  have hquotient : numeral radix digits / divisor = finalState.quotient := by
    apply Nat.div_eq_of_lt_le
    · rw [hnum]
      calc
        finalState.quotient * divisor = divisor * finalState.quotient :=
          Nat.mul_comm _ _
        _ ≤ divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder := Nat.le_add_right _ _
    · rw [hnum]
      calc
        divisor * finalState.quotient + finalState.remainder <
            divisor * finalState.quotient + divisor :=
          Nat.add_lt_add_left hrem _
        _ = (finalState.quotient + 1) * divisor := by
          rw [Nat.add_mul, one_mul, Nat.mul_comm finalState.quotient divisor]
  have hmod : numeral radix digits % divisor = finalState.remainder := by
    have h := Nat.mod_add_div (numeral radix digits) divisor
    rw [hquotient] at h
    conv_rhs at h => rw [hnum]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm divisor finalState.quotient] at h
    omega
  exact ⟨hquotient.symm, hmod.symm⟩

#print axioms process_processedValue
#print axioms initialState_process_quotient_remainder

end AspisR1.SamplerPass
ExtractedQM31SamplerBytes:
import AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.Funs

/-!
Actual byte-assembly loop of the extracted QM31 sampler. The target words use
exactly the primitive U32 little-endian decoder called by the generated body.
No byte-rank model or division theorem is introduced here.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerBytes
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex

abbrev Block := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Words := Array U32 8#usize

def byteAt (block : Block) (i : Fin 32) : U8 :=
  block.val[i.val]'(by have := block.property; change block.val.length = 32 at this; omega)

def byteWord (block : Block) (j : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize
    [byteAt block ⟨4 * j.val, by omega⟩,
     byteAt block ⟨4 * j.val + 1, by omega⟩,
     byteAt block ⟨4 * j.val + 2, by omega⟩,
     byteAt block ⟨4 * j.val + 3, by omega⟩])

def byteWords (block : Block) : Words :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (byteWord block), by simp⟩

def wordAt (rank : Words) (j : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  rank.val[j.val]'(by have := rank.property; change rank.val.length = 8 at this; omega)

theorem wordAt_byteWords (block : Block) (j : Fin 8) :
    wordAt (byteWords block) j = byteWord block j := by
  simp only [wordAt, byteWords, List.getElem_ofFn]

private theorem index32 (block : Block) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 32) :
    Array.index_usize block i = ok (byteAt block ⟨i.val, hi⟩) := by
  have hb : i.val < block.length := by
    have := block.property
    change block.val.length = 32 at this
    change i.val < block.val.length
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec block i hb)
  simpa only [byteAt] using hx.trans (congrArg Result.ok hval)

/-- One actual iteration succeeds with exactly the source word and next index. -/
theorem body_step (block : Block) (rank : Words) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 8) :
    ∃ next : Usize,
      sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body block rank i =
        ok (cont (rank.set i (byteWord block ⟨i.val, hi⟩), next)) ∧
      next.val = i.val + 1 := by
  have hguard : i < 8#usize := by scalar_tac
  have hmax : 32 ≤ Usize.max := by scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨start, hmul, hstart⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.mul_spec (x := 4#usize) (y := i) (by scalar_tac))
  have hs : start.val = 4 * i.val := by simpa using hstart
  obtain ⟨p1, ha1, hp1⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x := start) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨p2, ha2, hp2⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x := start) (y := 2#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨p3, ha3, hp3⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x := start) (y := 3#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  have hv1 : p1.val = 4 * i.val + 1 := by simpa [hs] using hp1
  have hv2 : p2.val = 4 * i.val + 2 := by simpa [hs] using hp2
  have hv3 : p3.val = 4 * i.val + 3 := by simpa [hs] using hp3
  have hidx0 := index32 block start (by omega)
  have hidx1 := index32 block p1 (by omega)
  have hidx2 := index32 block p2 (by omega)
  have hidx3 := index32 block p3 (by omega)
  have hib : i.val < rank.length := by
    have := rank.property
    change rank.val.length = 8 at this
    change i.val < rank.val.length
    omega
  obtain ⟨rank', hup, hrank⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec rank i (byteWord block ⟨i.val, hi⟩) hib)
  have hu : Array.update rank i (byteWord block ⟨i.val, hi⟩) =
      ok (rank.set i (byteWord block ⟨i.val, hi⟩)) :=
    hup.trans (congrArg Result.ok hrank)
  obtain ⟨next, hn, hnext⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (Usize.add_spec (x := i) (y := 1#usize) (by scalar_tac))
  refine ⟨next, ?_, by simpa using hnext⟩
  simp only [sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body, if_pos hguard, hmul,
    bind_tc_ok, hidx0, ha1, hidx1, ha2, hidx2, ha3, hidx3, lift]
  have hw : core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize
      [byteAt block ⟨start.val, by omega⟩,
       byteAt block ⟨p1.val, by omega⟩,
       byteAt block ⟨p2.val, by omega⟩,
       byteAt block ⟨p3.val, by omega⟩]) = byteWord block ⟨i.val, hi⟩ := by
    simp only [byteWord, hs, hv1, hv2, hv3]
  rw [hw, hu]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, hn]


/-- Every position already visited has its exact source word. -/
def PrefixCorrect (block : Block) (rank : Words) (i : Usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 8, j.val < i.val → wordAt rank j = byteWord block j

theorem wordAt_set (rank : Words) (i : Usize) (x : U32) (j : Fin 8) :
    wordAt (rank.set i x) j = if i.val = j.val then x else wordAt rank j := by
  simp only [wordAt, Aeneas.Std.Array.set_val_eq, List.getElem_set]

private theorem words_eq_of_all (block : Block) (rank : Words)
    (h : ∀ j : Fin 8, wordAt rank j = byteWord block j) :
    rank = byteWords block := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem (by rw [rank.property, (byteWords block).property])
  intro n hn hm
  have hn8 : n < 8 := by
    have := rank.property
    change rank.val.length = 8 at this
    omega
  exact (h ⟨n, hn8⟩).trans (wordAt_byteWords block ⟨n, hn8⟩).symm

/-- Totality from a bounded index and correct already-visited coordinates.
The measure is the number of remaining source words, not a concrete unroll. -/
theorem loop0_correct (block : Block) (rank : Words) (i : Usize)
    (hi : i.val ≤ 8) (hp : PrefixCorrect block rank i) :
    sampler.qm31_digits_loop0 block rank i = ok (byteWords block) := by
  have hs : WP.spec (sampler.qm31_digits_loop0 block rank i)
      (fun result => result = byteWords block) := by
    unfold sampler.qm31_digits_loop0
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat
      (fun s : Words × Usize => 8 - s.2.val)
      (fun s => s.2.val ≤ 8 ∧ PrefixCorrect block s.1 s.2)
      (fun result : Words => result = byteWords block)
      (fun s : Words × Usize => sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body block s.1 s.2)
      (rank, i) ?_ ⟨hi, hp⟩
    rintro ⟨rank, i⟩ ⟨hi, hp⟩
    change i.val ≤ 8 at hi
    change ∀ j : Fin 8, j.val < i.val → wordAt rank j = byteWord block j at hp
    by_cases hlt : i.val < 8
    · obtain ⟨next, hbody, hnext⟩ := body_step block rank i hlt
      rw [hbody, WP.spec_ok]
      change (next.val ≤ 8 ∧
        PrefixCorrect block (rank.set i (byteWord block ⟨i.val, hlt⟩)) next) ∧
        8 - next.val < 8 - i.val
      refine ⟨⟨by omega, ?_⟩, by omega⟩
      intro j hj
      rw [wordAt_set]
      by_cases heq : i.val = j.val
      · rw [if_pos heq]
        exact congrArg (byteWord block) (Fin.ext heq)
      · rw [if_neg heq]
        exact hp j (by omega)
    · have hguard : ¬ i < 8#usize := by scalar_tac
      simp only [sampler.qm31_digits_loop0.body, if_neg hguard, WP.spec_ok]
      apply words_eq_of_all
      intro j
      exact hp j (by omega)
  obtain ⟨result, hresult, heq⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs
  exact hresult.trans (congrArg Result.ok heq)

/-- The actual initial assembly loop overwrites all eight coordinates. -/
theorem loop0_total (block : Block) (rank : Words) :
    sampler.qm31_digits_loop0 block rank 0#usize = ok (byteWords block) := by
  apply loop0_correct block rank 0#usize (by decide)
  intro j hj
  have hzero : (0#usize).val = 0 := by decide
  omega

theorem assemble_total (block : Block) :
    sampler.qm31_digits_loop0 block (Array.repeat 8#usize 0#u32) 0#usize =
      ok (byteWords block) := loop0_total block _

#print axioms wordAt_byteWords
#print axioms body_step
#print axioms wordAt_set
#print axioms loop0_correct
#print axioms loop0_total
#print axioms assemble_total

end AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerBytes

import R1SamplerWordPass
import R1SamplerNatModel

/-! Iterate the already checked bounded word-division pass. The returned
remainders are Nat values of the UInt64 machine results. This connects the
word arithmetic model to the existing low-digit model, not to an extracted
Rust loop or its array/index execution. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerRepeatedPass
open SamplerMachineBounds SamplerWordPass SamplerPass

def wordValue (words : List UInt32) : Nat :=
  numeral B (words.map UInt32.toNat)

def run : Nat → List UInt32 → List Nat × List UInt32
  | 0, words => ([], words)
  | n + 1, words =>
      let step := machineProcess 0 words
      let tail := run n step.2
      (step.1.toNat :: tail.1, tail.2)

private theorem step_facts (words : List UInt32) :
    (machineProcess 0 words).1.toNat = wordValue words % P ∧
      wordValue (machineProcess 0 words).2 = wordValue words / P := by
  have h := machineProcess_correct (0 : UInt64) words (by norm_num [P])
  simpa [wordValue] using h

theorem run_digits (n : Nat) (words : List UInt32) :
    (run n words).1 = SamplerNatModel.lowDigits P n (wordValue words) := by
  induction n generalizing words with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [run, SamplerNatModel.lowDigits]
      rw [ih, (step_facts words).1, (step_facts words).2]

theorem run_remaining (n : Nat) (words : List UInt32) :
    wordValue (run n words).2 = wordValue words / P^n := by
  induction n generalizing words with
  | zero => simp [run]
  | succ n ih =>
      simp only [run]
      rw [ih, (step_facts words).2, Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul, pow_succ]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm P (P^n)]

theorem run_digits_value (n : Nat) (words : List UInt32) :
    SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue P (run n words).1 = wordValue words % P^n := by
  rw [run_digits, SamplerNatModel.lowDigits_value,
    SamplerDigits.lowValue_eq_mod_pow P_pos]

theorem run_digits_canonical (n : Nat) (words : List UInt32) :
    ∀ d ∈ (run n words).1, d < P := by
  rw [run_digits]
  exact SamplerNatModel.lowDigits_canonical P_pos n (wordValue words)

#print axioms run_digits
#print axioms run_remaining
#print axioms run_digits_value
#print axioms run_digits_canonical
end AspisR1.SamplerRepeatedPass
R1SamplerNatModel:
import R1SamplerAddBridge
import R1SamplerMachineBounds
import R1SamplerPass
import R1SamplerRanking

/-! The sampler's chosen 4/8-digit algorithms as Nat/list models. The modulo
laws and parameter bounds are conclusions, not premises. This does not prove
byte packing, fixed-width operations, field-tuple decoding, or Rust refinement. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerNatModel
open AspisR1.SamplerDigits AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits AspisR1.SamplerAddBridge
open AspisR1.SamplerArithmetic AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds

/-- Repeated low-digit extraction by quotient and remainder. -/
def lowDigits (p : Nat) : Nat → Nat → List Nat
  | 0, _ => []
  | n + 1, x => x % p :: lowDigits p n (x / p)

theorem lowDigits_length (p n x : Nat) : (lowDigits p n x).length = n := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [lowDigits, ih]

theorem lowDigits_canonical {p : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (n x : Nat) :
    ∀ d ∈ lowDigits p n x, d < p := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [lowDigits]
  | succ n ih =>
    intro d hd
    simp only [lowDigits, List.mem_cons] at hd
    rcases hd with rfl | hd
    · exact Nat.mod_lt _ hp
    · exact ih _ d hd

theorem lowDigits_value (p n x : Nat) :
    digitsValue p (lowDigits p n x) = lowValue p n x := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp only [lowDigits, digitsValue, lowValue, ih]

def qm31Digits (x : Nat) : List Nat := lowDigits P 4 x
def ordinaryDigits (x : Nat) : List Nat := lowDigits P 8 x
def gammaDigits (x : Nat) : List Nat :=
  endAround P (x / P ^ 8) (ordinaryDigits x)

theorem qm31Digits_value (x : Nat) :
    digitsValue P (qm31Digits x) = x % P ^ 4 := by
  rw [qm31Digits, lowDigits_value, lowValue_eq_mod_pow P_pos]

theorem ordinaryDigits_value (x : Nat) :
    digitsValue P (ordinaryDigits x) = x % P ^ 8 := by
  rw [ordinaryDigits, lowDigits_value, lowValue_eq_mod_pow P_pos]

/-- The explicit low-digit tuple ranks to the same remainder as the list
algorithm, using the checked finite positional equivalence. -/
theorem qm31Digits_positionalRank (x : Nat) :
    (AspisR1.SamplerRanking.digitsRank P 4
      (AspisR1.SamplerRanking.canonicalDigits P 4 x P_pos)).val =
      digitsValue P (qm31Digits x) := by
  rw [AspisR1.SamplerRanking.canonicalDigits_eq_rank_symm,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (qm31Digits_value x).symm

theorem ordinaryDigits_positionalRank (x : Nat) :
    (AspisR1.SamplerRanking.digitsRank P 8
      (AspisR1.SamplerRanking.canonicalDigits P 8 x P_pos)).val =
      digitsValue P (ordinaryDigits x) := by
  rw [AspisR1.SamplerRanking.canonicalDigits_eq_rank_symm,
    Equiv.apply_symm_apply]
  exact (ordinaryDigits_value x).symm

theorem gammaDigits_value {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2 ^ 256) :
    digitsValue P (gammaDigits x) = x % (P ^ 8 - 1) + 1 := by
  have hlen : (ordinaryDigits x).length = 8 := lowDigits_length P 8 x
  have hv := endAround_value P_pos (ordinaryDigits x)
    (lowDigits_canonical P_pos 8 x)
    (by rw [hlen]; exact two_le_P8)
    (by rw [hlen]; exact rank_div_P8_lt_P8_sub_one hx)
  rw [hlen, ordinaryDigits, lowDigits_value] at hv
  change digitsValue P (gammaDigits x) = _ at hv
  rw [hv]
  exact (gammaRank_eq_mod P_pos two_le_P8 (rank_div_P8_lt_P8_sub_one hx)).1

theorem gammaDigits_value_bounds {x : Nat} (hx : x < 2 ^ 256) :
    0 < digitsValue P (gammaDigits x) ∧
      digitsValue P (gammaDigits x) < P ^ 8 := by
  rw [gammaDigits_value hx]
  have hmod := Nat.mod_lt x (show 0 < P ^ 8 - 1 by have := two_le_P8; omega)
  omega

theorem gammaDigits_canonical (x : Nat) :
    (gammaDigits x).length = 8 ∧ ∀ d ∈ gammaDigits x, d < P := by
  unfold gammaDigits endAround
  dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact ⟨by rw [addDigits_length]; exact lowDigits_length P 8 x,
      addDigits_output_digits_lt P _ _ P_pos⟩
  · exact ⟨by rw [addDigits_length, addDigits_length]; exact lowDigits_length P 8 x,
      addDigits_output_digits_lt P _ _ P_pos⟩

/-- Each long-division pass of the Nat state model computes the quotient and
remainder used by lowDigits, when given the high-to-low radix-2^32 word list. -/
theorem radix32_pass (digits : List Nat) (hcan : ∀ d ∈ digits, d < B) :
    let state := AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.process B P
      AspisR1.SamplerLongDivision.initialState digits
    state.quotient = AspisR1.SamplerPass.numeral B digits / P ∧
      state.remainder = AspisR1.SamplerPass.numeral B digits % P :=
  AspisR1.SamplerPass.initialState_process_quotient_remainder B_pos P_pos digits hcan

#print axioms lowDigits_length
#print axioms lowDigits_canonical
#print axioms lowDigits_value
#print axioms qm31Digits_value
#print axioms ordinaryDigits_value
#print axioms qm31Digits_positionalRank
#print axioms ordinaryDigits_positionalRank
#print axioms gammaDigits_value
#print axioms gammaDigits_value_bounds
#print axioms gammaDigits_canonical
#print axioms radix32_pass
end AspisR1.SamplerNatModel
R1SamplerAddBridge:
import R1SamplerAddDigits
import R1SamplerArithmetic

/-! Connect the explicit digit-add recursion to positional modular arithmetic.
This is a Nat algorithm model; no Rust/fixed-width correspondence is asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerAddBridge
open AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits AspisR1.SamplerCarry

theorem digitsValue_lt_pow {p : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (digits : List Nat)
    (hcan : ∀ d ∈ digits, d < p) : digitsValue p digits < p ^ digits.length := by
  induction digits with
  | nil => simp [digitsValue]
  | cons d ds ih =>
    have hd : d < p := hcan d (by simp)
    have ht : digitsValue p ds < p ^ ds.length :=
      ih (fun a ha => hcan a (by simp [ha]))
    have hprod := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p (Nat.succ_le_of_lt ht)
    simp only [List.length_cons, digitsValue, pow_succ]
    rw [Nat.mul_succ] at hprod
    rw [Nat.mul_comm (p ^ ds.length) p]
    omega

theorem addDigits_mod_div {p : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat) :
    digitsValue p (addDigits p addend digits).1 =
        (digitsValue p digits + addend) % p ^ digits.length ∧
      (addDigits p addend digits).2 =
        (digitsValue p digits + addend) / p ^ digits.length := by
  have hb := digitsValue_lt_pow hp (addDigits p addend digits).1
    (addDigits_output_digits_lt p addend digits hp)
  rw [addDigits_length] at hb
  have hv := addDigits_value_conservation p addend digits
  constructor
  · rw [← hv, Nat.add_mod]
    simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb]
  · rw [← hv, Nat.add_mul_div_left _ _ (Nat.pow_pos hp)]
    simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hb]

/-- The source-shaped end-around carry algorithm at the level of lists of
natural-number digits. -/
def endAround (p q : Nat) (digits : List Nat) : List Nat :=
  let first := addDigits p (q + 1) digits
  if first.2 = 0 then first.1 else (addDigits p 1 first.1).1

theorem endAround_value {p q : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) (digits : List Nat)
    (hcan : ∀ d ∈ digits, d < p)
    (hN : 2 ≤ p ^ digits.length) (hq : q < p ^ digits.length - 1) :
    digitsValue p (endAround p q digits) =
      carryResult (p ^ digits.length) q (digitsValue p digits) := by
  let N := p ^ digits.length
  let r := digitsValue p digits
  have hr : r < N := digitsValue_lt_pow hp digits hcan
  have hfirst := addDigits_mod_div hp (q + 1) digits
  have hsecond := addDigits_mod_div hp 1 (addDigits p (q + 1) digits).1
  rw [addDigits_length] at hsecond
  have hsum : r + q + 1 < 2 * N := by dsimp [N] at *; omega
  unfold endAround
  by_cases hs : r + q + 1 < N
  · have hzero : (addDigits p (q + 1) digits).2 = 0 := by
      rw [hfirst.2]
      exact Nat.div_eq_of_lt (by simpa [r, N, Nat.add_assoc] using hs)
    rw [if_pos hzero, hfirst.1]
    change (r + (q + 1)) % N = carryResult N q r
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    simp only [carryResult, if_pos hs]
    omega
  · have hge : N ≤ r + q + 1 := by omega
    have hnonzero : (addDigits p (q + 1) digits).2 ≠ 0 := by
      rw [hfirst.2]
      have hpos : 0 < (r + q + 1) / N := Nat.div_pos hge (by dsimp [N]; omega)
      simpa [r, N, Nat.add_assoc] using Nat.ne_of_gt hpos
    rw [if_neg hnonzero, hsecond.1, hfirst.1]
    change ((r + (q + 1)) % N + 1) % N = carryResult N q r
    have hsub : r + (q + 1) - N < N := by omega
    have hmod : (r + (q + 1)) % N = r + (q + 1) - N := by
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod (by omega), Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsub]
    rw [hmod]
    have hlast : r + (q + 1) - N + 1 < N := by
      simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using wrapped_result_lt hN hq hr hge
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlast]
    simp only [carryResult, if_neg hs]
    omega

#print axioms digitsValue_lt_pow
#print axioms addDigits_mod_div
#print axioms endAround_value
end AspisR1.SamplerAddBridge

import R1SamplerLongDivision
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Pure Nat model of a little-endian base-p digit carry pass. It does not
model mutation, fixed-width arithmetic, or Rust source operations. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits

/-- Little-endian positional value: the head digit is the least significant. -/
def digitsValue (p : Nat) : List Nat → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | digit :: digits => digit + p * digitsValue p digits

/-- Add an addend to the low-endian digit list, returning the final carry. -/
def addDigits (p addend : Nat) : List Nat → List Nat × Nat
  | [] => ([], addend)
  | digit :: digits =>
      let s := digit + addend
      let (out, carry) := addDigits p (s / p) digits
      (s % p :: out, carry)

theorem addDigits_length (p addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat) :
    (addDigits p addend digits).1.length = digits.length := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simp [addDigits]
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      simp [addDigits, ih]

theorem addDigits_value_conservation (p addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat) :
    digitsValue p (addDigits p addend digits).1 +
        p ^ digits.length * (addDigits p addend digits).2 =
      digitsValue p digits + addend := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simp [addDigits, digitsValue]
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      have hih := ih (addend := (digit + addend) / p)
      have hdivision : (digit + addend) % p + p * ((digit + addend) / p) =
          digit + addend := Nat.mod_add_div (digit + addend) p
      simp only [List.length_cons, addDigits, digitsValue]
      calc
        (digit + addend) % p +
              p * digitsValue p (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).1 +
              p ^ (digits.length + 1) * (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).2
            = (digit + addend) % p + p *
                (digitsValue p (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).1 +
                  p ^ digits.length * (addDigits p ((digit + addend) / p) digits).2) := by
                rw [pow_succ]
                ring
        _ = (digit + addend) % p + p *
              (digitsValue p digits + (digit + addend) / p) := by rw [hih]
        _ = p * digitsValue p digits +
              ((digit + addend) % p + p * ((digit + addend) / p)) := by ring
        _ = p * digitsValue p digits + (digit + addend) := by rw [hdivision]
        _ = digitsValue p (digit :: digits) + addend := by
              simp [digitsValue]
              ring

theorem addDigits_output_digits_lt (p addend : Nat) (digits : List Nat)
    (hp : 0 < p) :
    ∀ digit ∈ (addDigits p addend digits).1, digit < p := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simp [addDigits]
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      intro outputDigit hmem
      simp only [addDigits, List.mem_cons] at hmem
      rcases hmem with hhead | htail
      · simpa [hhead] using Nat.mod_lt (digit + addend) hp
      · exact ih (addend := (digit + addend) / p) outputDigit htail

theorem final_carry_le_one_of_addend_le_one {p addend : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ digit ∈ digits, digit < p)
    (haddend : addend ≤ 1) :
    (addDigits p addend digits).2 ≤ 1 := by
  induction digits generalizing addend with
  | nil => simpa [addDigits] using haddend
  | cons digit digits ih =>
      have hdigit : digit < p := hdigits digit (by simp)
      have hsum : digit + addend < 2 * p := by omega
      have hquot : (digit + addend) / p < 2 := by
        apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < p)).2
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hsum
      have hquot_le : (digit + addend) / p ≤ 1 := by omega
      have htail : ∀ x ∈ digits, x < p := by
        intro x hx
        exact hdigits x (by simp [hx])
      simpa [addDigits] using ih (addend := (digit + addend) / p) htail hquot_le

theorem final_carry_le_one_nonempty {p addend digit : Nat}
    (hp : 2 ≤ p) (haddend : addend < p) (hdigit : digit < p)
    (digits : List Nat) (hdigits : ∀ x ∈ digits, x < p) :
    (addDigits p addend (digit :: digits)).2 ≤ 1 := by
  have hsum : digit + addend < 2 * p := by omega
  have hquot : (digit + addend) / p < 2 := by
    apply (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul (by omega : 0 < p)).2
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using hsum
  have hquot_le : (digit + addend) / p ≤ 1 := by omega
  simpa [addDigits] using
    final_carry_le_one_of_addend_le_one hp digits hdigits hquot_le

#print axioms addDigits_length
#print axioms addDigits_value_conservation
#print axioms addDigits_output_digits_lt
#print axioms final_carry_le_one_of_addend_le_one
#print axioms final_carry_le_one_nonempty

end AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits
R1SamplerArithmetic:
import R1SamplerCarry
import R1SamplerDigits

/-! Composition of the repeated-digit and carry arithmetic models. These
identities do not identify a Rust loop, a fixed-width word, or a byte encoding.
The remaining quotient bound is explicit and is discharged separately for
the 256-bit input and eight M31 digits. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerArithmetic

open AspisR1.SamplerCarry AspisR1.SamplerDigits

/-- Arithmetic result before decoding the ordinary field tuple. -/
def ordinaryRank (p n x : Nat) : Nat := lowValue p n x

/-- Arithmetic result of adding the remaining quotient and applying the
single end-around carry used by the nonzero sampler. -/
def gammaRank (p n x : Nat) : Nat :=
  carryResult (p ^ n) (x / p ^ n) (lowValue p n x)

theorem ordinaryRank_eq_mod {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    ordinaryRank p n x = x % p ^ n :=
  lowValue_eq_mod_pow hp

theorem gammaRank_eq_mod {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hN : 2 ≤ p ^ n) (hq : x / p ^ n < p ^ n - 1) :
    gammaRank p n x = x % (p ^ n - 1) + 1 ∧
      0 < gammaRank p n x ∧ gammaRank p n x < p ^ n := by
  have hdecomp : (x / p ^ n) * p ^ n + lowValue p n x = x := by
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.add_comm] using
      (lowValue_decomposition (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp).symm
  have h := carry_modular_identity hN hq
    (lowValue_lt_pow (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp)
  rw [hdecomp] at h
  exact h

/-- The extra increment in the carry branch cannot wrap again. -/
theorem gammaRank_no_second_wrap {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p)
    (hN : 2 ≤ p ^ n) (hq : x / p ^ n < p ^ n - 1)
    (hwrap : p ^ n ≤ lowValue p n x + x / p ^ n + 1) :
    lowValue p n x + x / p ^ n + 1 - p ^ n + 1 < p ^ n :=
  wrapped_result_lt hN hq (lowValue_lt_pow hp) hwrap

#print axioms ordinaryRank_eq_mod
#print axioms gammaRank_eq_mod
#print axioms gammaRank_no_second_wrap

end AspisR1.SamplerArithmetic
R1SamplerCarry:
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Symbolic arithmetic for the sampler's conditional carry/reduction step.
These lemmas do not identify Rust digits or loop behavior, and make no
sampling, probability, or security claim. -/

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.SamplerCarry

/-- The carry branch returns `s` below the limit and otherwise subtracts the
modulus and adds one. -/
def carryResult (N q r : Nat) : Nat :=
  let s := r + q + 1
  if s < N then s else s - N + 1

theorem carry_modular_identity {N q r : Nat}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hq : q < N - 1) (hr : r < N) :
    carryResult N q r = ((q * N + r) % (N - 1)) + 1 ∧
      0 < carryResult N q r ∧ carryResult N q r < N := by
  have hsum : q + r < 2 * (N - 1) := by omega
  have hmod : (q * N + r) % (N - 1) = (q + r) % (N - 1) := by
    have hN' : N = (N - 1) + 1 := by omega
    have hprod : q * N = q * (N - 1) + q := by
      calc
        q * N = q * ((N - 1) + 1) := congrArg (fun x => q * x) hN'
        _ = q * (N - 1) + q := by rw [Nat.mul_add]; simp
    have hsumEq : q * N + r = q * (N - 1) + (q + r) := by
      rw [hprod]
      omega
    calc
      (q * N + r) % (N - 1) =
          (q * (N - 1) + (q + r)) % (N - 1) := by
        rw [hsumEq]
      _ = ((q * (N - 1)) % (N - 1) + (q + r) % (N - 1)) % (N - 1) := by
        rw [Nat.add_mod]
      _ = (q + r) % (N - 1) := by simp
  have hformula : carryResult N q r = ((q * N + r) % (N - 1)) + 1 := by
    dsimp [carryResult]
    by_cases hs : r + q + 1 < N
    · rw [if_pos hs, hmod]
      have hlt : q + r < N - 1 := by omega
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlt]
      omega
    · rw [if_neg hs, hmod]
      have hge : N - 1 ≤ q + r := by omega
      have hsub_lt : q + r - (N - 1) < N - 1 := by omega
      have hsub_mod : (q + r) % (N - 1) = q + r - (N - 1) := by
        have hdecomp : q + r = (N - 1) + (q + r - (N - 1)) := by omega
        rw [hdecomp, Nat.add_mod]
        simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsub_lt]
      rw [hsub_mod]
      omega
  refine ⟨hformula, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hformula]
    omega
  · rw [hformula]
    have hmod_lt : (q * N + r) % (N - 1) < N - 1 :=
      Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
    omega

/-- In the wrapped branch, subtracting the limit and then adding one still
leaves a value below `N`; there is no second carry. -/
theorem wrapped_result_lt {N q r : Nat}
    (hN : 2 ≤ N) (hq : q < N - 1) (hr : r < N)
    (hwrap : N ≤ r + q + 1) :
    r + q + 1 - N + 1 < N := by
  have hsum : q + r < 2 * (N - 1) := by omega
  omega

#print axioms carry_modular_identity
#print axioms wrapped_result_lt

end AspisR1.SamplerCarry

import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Symbolic base-`p` low-digit arithmetic.  These results do not identify a
Rust implementation, machine-word behavior, or a probability distribution. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerDigits

/-- The low `n` radix-`p` digits of `x`, defined by repeated quotient/remainder. -/
def lowValue (p : Nat) : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, x => x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p)

theorem lowValue_decomposition {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    x = lowValue p n x + p ^ n * (x / p ^ n) := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [lowValue]
  | succ n ih =>
      change x = (x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p)) +
        p ^ (n + 1) * (x / p ^ (n + 1))
      have hdiv := ih (x := x / p)
      have hmod : x = x % p + p * (x / p) := by
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.mod_add_div x p).symm
      have hquot : (x / p) / p ^ n = x / (p ^ n * p) := by
        simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using (Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul x p (p ^ n))
      rw [hquot] at hdiv
      calc
        x = x % p + p * (x / p) := hmod
        _ = x % p + p * (lowValue p n (x / p) +
              p ^ n * (x / (p ^ n * p))) :=
                congrArg (fun y => x % p + p * y) hdiv
        _ = (x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p)) +
              p ^ (n + 1) * (x / p ^ (n + 1)) := by
                rw [Nat.pow_succ]
                rw [Nat.mul_comm (p ^ n) p]
                ring

theorem lowValue_lt_pow {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lowValue p n x < p ^ n := by
  induction n generalizing x with
  | zero => simp [lowValue]
  | succ n ih =>
      change x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p) < p ^ (n + 1)
      have hmod : x % p < p := Nat.mod_lt _ hp
      have hlow : lowValue p n (x / p) < p ^ n := ih (x := x / p)
      have hmod' : x % p + 1 ≤ p := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hmod
      have hprod : p * lowValue p n (x / p) + p ≤ p * p ^ n := by
        have h := Nat.mul_le_mul_left p (Nat.succ_le_of_lt hlow)
        rw [Nat.mul_succ] at h
        exact h
      calc
        x % p + p * lowValue p n (x / p) < p * p ^ n := by omega
        _ = p ^ (n + 1) := by rw [Nat.pow_succ, Nat.mul_comm]

theorem lowValue_eq_mod_pow {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    lowValue p n x = x % p ^ n := by
  have hdecomp := lowValue_decomposition (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp
  have hlow := lowValue_lt_pow (p := p) (n := n) (x := x) hp
  have hmod :
      (lowValue p n x + p ^ n * (x / p ^ n)) % p ^ n = lowValue p n x := by
    rw [Nat.add_mod]
    simp
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hlow
  calc
    lowValue p n x =
        (lowValue p n x + p ^ n * (x / p ^ n)) % p ^ n := hmod.symm
    _ = x % p ^ n := (congrArg (fun y : Nat => y % p ^ n) hdecomp).symm

#print axioms lowValue_decomposition
#print axioms lowValue_lt_pow
#print axioms lowValue_eq_mod_pow

end AspisR1.SamplerDigits

import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerRanking

def digitsRank (p n : Nat) : (Fin n → Fin p) ≃ Fin (p ^ n) :=
  finFunctionFinEquiv

private theorem pow_pos_nat {p n : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) : 0 < p ^ n := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact Nat.mul_pos ih hp

theorem digitsRank_symm_apply_val {p n : Nat} (_hp : 0 < p)
    (x : Fin (p ^ n)) (i : Fin n) :
    ((digitsRank p n).symm x i).val = x.val / p ^ i.val % p := by
  simp [digitsRank]

theorem digitsRank_value {p n : Nat} (f : Fin n → Fin p) :
    (digitsRank p n f).val = ∑ i : Fin n, (f i).val * p ^ i.val := by
  exact finFunctionFinEquiv_apply f

def canonicalDigits (p n x : Nat) (hp : 0 < p) : Fin n → Fin p :=
  fun i => ⟨x / p ^ i.val % p, Nat.mod_lt _ hp⟩

theorem canonicalDigits_eq_rank_symm {p n x : Nat} (hp : 0 < p) :
    canonicalDigits p n x hp =
      (digitsRank p n).symm ⟨x % p ^ n, Nat.mod_lt _ (pow_pos_nat hp)⟩ := by
  funext i
  apply Fin.ext
  change x / p ^ i.val % p = _
  rw [digitsRank_symm_apply_val hp]
  have hle : i.val ≤ n := Nat.le_of_lt i.is_lt
  have hsum : i.val + (n - i.val) = n := Nat.add_sub_of_le hle
  have hpow : p ^ i.val * p ^ (n - i.val) = p ^ n := by
    rw [← Nat.pow_add, hsum]
  have hquot : x % p ^ n / p ^ i.val =
      x / p ^ i.val % p ^ (n - i.val) := by
    rw [← hpow]
    exact Nat.mod_mul_right_div_self x (p ^ i.val) (p ^ (n - i.val))
  have htail : 0 < n - i.val := Nat.sub_pos_of_lt i.is_lt
  have hdvd : p ∣ p ^ (n - i.val) := by
    rcases Nat.exists_eq_succ_of_ne_zero (Nat.ne_of_gt htail) with ⟨k, hk⟩
    rw [hk, pow_succ]
    exact ⟨p ^ k, by rw [Nat.mul_comm]⟩
  rw [hquot, Nat.mod_mod_of_dvd _ hdvd]

#print axioms digitsRank_symm_apply_val
#print axioms digitsRank_value
#print axioms canonicalDigits_eq_rank_symm

end AspisR1.SamplerRanking
ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier:
import AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.Funs
import ExtractedCurrentQM31Equality

/-!
Fixed field-copy bridge from the extracted index sampler to the unchanged
current QM31 carrier. The wrapper theorem unfolds the actual generated
qm31_sample body, conditional on actual qm31_digits success. It supplies no
digit-loop, byte-rank, transcript, or Rust-call reachability premise by fiat.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerCarrier

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev SamplerQM := AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.field.QM31
abbrev CurrentQM := AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Equality.CurrentQM
abbrev CurrentCanonicalQM :=
  AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Equality.CurrentCanonicalQM
abbrev Digits := Array U32 4#usize

/-- Copy every coordinate, in the source c0.a/c0.b/c1.a/c1.b order. -/
def toCurrent (x : SamplerQM) : CurrentQM :=
  ⟨⟨x.c0.a, x.c0.b⟩, ⟨x.c1.a, x.c1.b⟩⟩

def fromCurrent (x : CurrentQM) : SamplerQM :=
  ⟨⟨x.c0.a, x.c0.b⟩, ⟨x.c1.a, x.c1.b⟩⟩

@[simp] theorem fromCurrent_toCurrent (x : SamplerQM) :
    fromCurrent (toCurrent x) = x := by
  cases x with
  | mk c0 c1 => cases c0; cases c1; rfl

@[simp] theorem toCurrent_fromCurrent (x : CurrentQM) :
    toCurrent (fromCurrent x) = x := by
  cases x with
  | mk c0 c1 => cases c0; cases c1; rfl

theorem toCurrent_injective : Function.Injective toCurrent := by
  intro x y h
  simpa only [fromCurrent_toCurrent] using congrArg fromCurrent h

theorem toCurrent_coordinates (x : SamplerQM) :
    (toCurrent x).c0.a = x.c0.a ∧ (toCurrent x).c0.b = x.c0.b ∧
    (toCurrent x).c1.a = x.c1.a ∧ (toCurrent x).c1.b = x.c1.b :=
  ⟨rfl, rfl, rfl, rfl⟩

/-- A proved-bounded read; no default value is inserted. -/
def digit (ds : Digits) (i : Fin 4) : U32 :=
  ds.val[i.val]'(by have := ds.property; change ds.val.length = 4 at this; omega)

def packed (ds : Digits) : SamplerQM :=
  ⟨⟨digit ds 0, digit ds 1⟩, ⟨digit ds 2, digit ds 3⟩⟩

def DigitsCanonical (ds : Digits) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 4, (digit ds i).val < 2147483647

private theorem index_four (ds : Digits) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val < 4) :
    Array.index_usize ds i = ok (digit ds ⟨i.val, hi⟩) := by
  have hb : i.val < ds.length := by
    have := ds.property
    change ds.val.length = 4 at this
    change i.val < ds.val.length
    omega
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists (Array.index_usize_spec ds i hb)
  simpa only [digit] using hx.trans (congrArg Result.ok hval)

/-- Four actual bounded indices and both actual CM31.new calls are discharged. -/
theorem qm31_sample_of_digits (block : Array U8 32#usize) (ds : Digits)
    (h : AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_digits block = ok ds) :
    AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample block = ok (packed ds) := by
  have h0 := index_four ds 0#usize (by decide)
  have h1 := index_four ds 1#usize (by decide)
  have h2 := index_four ds 2#usize (by decide)
  have h3 := index_four ds 3#usize (by decide)
  have e0 : (⟨(0#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 0 := by decide
  have e1 : (⟨(1#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 1 := by decide
  have e2 : (⟨(2#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 2 := by decide
  have e3 : (⟨(3#usize).val, by decide⟩ : Fin 4) = 3 := by decide
  simpa only [AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample, h, bind_tc_ok,
    h0, h1, h2, h3, e0, e1, e2, e3,
    AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.field.CM31.new, packed]

theorem packed_current_canonical (ds : Digits) (h : DigitsCanonical ds) :
    CurrentCanonicalQM (toCurrent (packed ds)) :=
  ⟨⟨h 0, h 1⟩, ⟨h 2, h 3⟩⟩

theorem packed_current_coordinates (ds : Digits) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.wordsQM (toCurrent (packed ds)) =
      (((digit ds 0).val, (digit ds 1).val),
       ((digit ds 2).val, (digit ds 3).val)) := rfl

/-- Compose an actual digits result with this fixed carrier map. -/
theorem qm31_sample_current (block : Array U8 32#usize) (ds : Digits)
    (h : AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_digits block = ok ds)
    (hc : DigitsCanonical ds) :
    ∃ q : SamplerQM,
      AspisR1Qm31SamplerIndex.sampler.qm31_sample block = ok q ∧
      toCurrent q = toCurrent (packed ds) ∧ CurrentCanonicalQM (toCurrent q) :=
  ⟨packed ds, qm31_sample_of_digits block ds h, rfl,
    packed_current_canonical ds hc⟩

/-- Reuse the current exact-tower equality theorem, with canonicality explicit. -/
theorem decode_toCurrent_eq_iff (x y : SamplerQM)
    (hx : CurrentCanonicalQM (toCurrent x))
    (hy : CurrentCanonicalQM (toCurrent y)) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode (toCurrent x) =
      AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact.decode (toCurrent y) ↔ x = y := by
  rw [AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Equality.decode_eq_iff _ _ hx hy]
  exact toCurrent_injective.eq_iff

#print axioms fromCurrent_toCurrent
#print axioms toCurrent_fromCurrent
#print axioms toCurrent_injective

identities for a fixed 32-byte Aeneas array. These are arithmetic/model
identities only; they do not assert the Rust sampler loop or a source-level
sampler correspondence. -/

namespace AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds
open AspisR1.SamplerBytePass
open AspisR1.SamplerRepeatedPass
open AspisR1.SamplerNatModel

def rank (b : Array U8 32#usize) : Nat :=

/-- The eight decoded bytes words, interpreted by the existing high-to-low
base-`B` numeral, equal the positional rank of the source-shaped 32 bytes. -/
theorem word_value (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    SamplerRepeatedPass.wordValue (SamplerBytePass.digits b) = rank b := by
  unfold SamplerRepeatedPass.wordValue
  rw [SamplerBytePass.digits_values]
  exact SamplerBlockRank.word_numeral_eq_rank
    (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b)

/-- Every repeated pass over the decoded words agrees with the Nat low-digit
model at the block-rank value. -/
theorem run_bytes (n : Nat) (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    (SamplerRepeatedPass.run n (SamplerBytePass.digits b)).1 =
      SamplerNatModel.lowDigits P n (rank b) := by
  rw [SamplerRepeatedPass.run_digits, word_value]

theorem run4_bytes (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    (SamplerRepeatedPass.run 4 (SamplerBytePass.digits b)).1 =
      SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits (rank b) := by
  simpa [SamplerNatModel.qm31Digits] using run_bytes 4 b

theorem run8_bytes (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    (SamplerRepeatedPass.run 8 (SamplerBytePass.digits b)).1 =
      SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits (rank b) := by
  simpa [SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits] using run_bytes 8 b

theorem remaining8_value (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    SamplerRepeatedPass.wordValue
        (SamplerRepeatedPass.run 8 (SamplerBytePass.digits b)).2 =
      rank b / P ^ 8 := by
  rw [SamplerRepeatedPass.run_remaining, word_value]

/-- End-around carry applied to the eight machine-model remainders and their
remaining quotient, written as the explicit `Nat` digit model. -/
def gammaBytes (b : Array U8 32#usize) : List Nat :=
  SamplerAddBridge.endAround P
    (SamplerRepeatedPass.wordValue
      (SamplerRepeatedPass.run 8 (SamplerBytePass.digits b)).2)
    (SamplerRepeatedPass.run 8 (SamplerBytePass.digits b)).1

theorem gammaBytes_eq_gammaDigits (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    gammaBytes b = SamplerNatModel.gammaDigits (rank b) := by
  unfold gammaBytes SamplerNatModel.gammaDigits SamplerNatModel.ordinaryDigits
  rw [remaining8_value, run8_bytes]
  rfl

theorem rank_lt (b : Array U8 32#usize) : rank b < 2 ^ 256 := by
  have h := (R0C.ModuloField.blockRank
    (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b)).isLt
  have hpow : 256 ^ 32 = 2 ^ 256 := by norm_num
  calc
    rank b < 256 ^ 32 := h
    _ = 2 ^ 256 := hpow

/-- The byte-derived end-around digit value has the same mathematical value
as the existing gamma Nat model. -/
theorem gammaBytes_value (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    SamplerAddDigits.digitsValue P (gammaBytes b) =
      rank b % (P ^ 8 - 1) + 1 := by
  rw [gammaBytes_eq_gammaDigits]
  exact SamplerNatModel.gammaDigits_value (rank_lt b)

/-! A positional identity for the sampler's eight little-endian U32 words.
This is arithmetic/model plumbing only; it does not identify a Rust sampler
execution or probability law. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.SamplerBlockRank

open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.SamplerWords

/-- The reversed eight-word numeral is exactly the positional rank of all 32
state bytes, using the existing four-byte word-value lemma. -/
theorem word_numeral_eq_rank (s : State) :
    AspisR1.SamplerPass.numeral (2^32)
      ((List.ofFn fun j : Fin 8 => AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word s j).reverse) =
      (R0C.ModuloField.blockRank s).val := by
  rw [R0C.ModuloField.blockRank_value]
  simp only [AspisR1.SamplerPass.numeral, List.ofFn_succ, List.ofFn_zero,
    List.reverse_cons, List.reverse_nil, List.append_nil, List.cons_append,
    List.nil_append, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil,
    AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word, Fin.sum_univ_succ, Fin.sum_univ_zero,
    Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ]
  -- The two expansions enumerate the same positions using different Fin
  -- constructors: the block-rank sum uses `Fin.mk`, while repeated `Fin.sum`
  -- expansion leaves nested `Fin.succ` indices. Normalize those constructors
  -- before asking ring to compare the 32 symbolic byte coefficients.
  simp only [Fin.succ]
  norm_num
  <;> ring

/-- The eight decoded little-endian words in the order consumed by the
high-to-low arithmetic pass. This definition records only the decoded source
digits; it does not assert an equivalence with a Rust sampler loop. -/
def digits (b : Array U8 32#usize) : List UInt32 :=
  (List.ofFn fun j : Fin 8 => UInt32.ofNat
    ((core.num.U32.from_le_bytes
      (four b (4 * j.val) (by omega))).val)).reverse

theorem digits_length (b : Array U8 32#usize) : (digits b).length = 8 := by
  simp [digits]

theorem digits_values (b : Array U8 32#usize) :
    (digits b).map UInt32.toNat =
      (List.ofFn fun j : Fin 8 =>
        AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word
          (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b) j).reverse := by
  simp only [digits, List.map_reverse, List.map_ofFn]
  apply congrArg List.reverse
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext j
  exact AspisR1.SamplerByteWord.decodedArray_word_toNat b j

/-- The machine arithmetic pass on the eight decoded source words has the
same quotient and remainder equations as the general word-list theorem, with
the source words expressed as a reversed list of decoded Nat values. This is
not a theorem about the old sampler loop or `blockRank`. -/
theorem machineProcess_bytes_correct (r : UInt64) (b : Array U8 32#usize)
    (hr : r.toNat < P) :
    let output := machineProcess r (digits b)
    output.1.toNat =
        (r.toNat * B ^ 8 + numeral B
          ((List.ofFn fun j : Fin 8 =>
            AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word
              (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b) j).reverse)) % P ∧
      numeral B (output.2.map UInt32.toNat) =
        (r.toNat * B ^ 8 + numeral B
          ((List.ofFn fun j : Fin 8 =>
            AspisV8R19.SamplerWords.word
              (AspisV8R19.SqueezeOracleBridge.decodeState b) j).reverse)) / P := by
  simpa only [digits_length, digits_values] using
    (AspisR1.SamplerWordPass.machineProcess_correct r (digits b) hr)

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std AspisR72Sampler SamplerWordRead SqueezeOracleBridge

theorem byte_cons (b : BitVec 8) (l : List (BitVec 8)) :
    (BitVec.fromLEBytes (b::l)).toNat = (BitVec.fromLEBytes l).toNat*256+b.toNat := by
  have he : BitVec.fromLEBytes (b::l) =
      ((BitVec.fromLEBytes l) ++ b).setWidth (8*(b::l).length) := by
    rw [BitVec.setWidth_append_eq_shiftLeft_setWidth_or]
    change _ ||| _ = _ ||| _
    exact BitVec.or_comm _ _
  rw [he,BitVec.toNat_setWidth]
  have hb : ((BitVec.fromLEBytes l) ++ b).toNat < 2^(8*(b::l).length) := by
    have h := ((BitVec.fromLEBytes l) ++ b).isLt
    simpa only [List.length_cons,Nat.mul_add,Nat.mul_one] using h
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hb,BitVec.toNat_append,
    ← Nat.shiftLeft_add_eq_or_of_lt b.isLt, Nat.shiftLeft_eq]

theorem four_bytes (a b c d : U8) :
    (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (Array.make 4#usize [a,b,c,d])).val =
      a.val+256*b.val+65536*c.val+16777216*d.val := by
  change (BitVec.fromLEBytes [a.bv,b.bv,c.bv,d.bv]).toNat = _
  simp only [byte_cons]
  change (((0*256+d.val)*256+c.val)*256+b.val)*256+a.val = _

    (four (encodeState s) (4*j.val) (by omega)).val =
      [encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val,by omega⟩),
       encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val+1,by omega⟩),
       encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val+2,by omega⟩),
       encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val+3,by omega⟩)] := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · have h := (four (encodeState s) (4*j.val) (by omega)).property
    exact h
  · intro i hi hj
    have hi4 : i < 4 := by simpa using hj
    simp only [four,List.getElem_take,List.getElem_drop,encodeState,bytes,
      List.getElem_map,List.getElem_ofFn]
    interval_cases i <;> rfl

theorem source_word (s : State) (j : Fin 8) :
    (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (four (encodeState s) (4*j.val) (by omega))).val =
      SamplerWords.word s j := by
  have ha : four (encodeState s) (4*j.val) (by omega) =
      Array.make 4#usize [encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val,by omega⟩),
        encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val+1,by omega⟩),encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val+2,by omega⟩),
        encodeByte (s ⟨4*j.val+3,by omega⟩)] := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact four_contents s j
  rw [ha,four_bytes]
  rfl

theorem source_mask (word : U32) :

  change (word.bv &&& field.P.bv).toNat = _
  rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
  simp only [SamplerWords.source31_mask,field.P]
  rfl
