open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def field.CM31.mul_m31
  (self : field.CM31) (rhs : field.M31) : Result field.CM31 := do
  let m ← field.M31.mul self.a rhs
  let m1 ← field.M31.mul self.b rhs
  ok { a := m, b := m1 }

def field.QM31.mul_m31
  (self : field.QM31) (rhs : field.M31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let c ← field.CM31.mul_m31 self.c0 rhs
  let c1 ← field.CM31.mul_m31 self.c1 rhs

def field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31
  (self : field.wide_exact.WideExact) (rhs : field.M31) :
  Result field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  let i ← rhs % field.P
  let q ← field.QM31.mul_m31 self.c0 i
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 self.c1 i
  ok { c0 := q, c1 := q1 }

def scalar

  Result field.wide_exact.WideExact
  := do
  field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul_m31 x y

def dual_cell
  (h : Array field.wide_exact.WideExact 4#usize)
  (alpha : field.wide_exact.WideExact) :
  Result field.wide_exact.WideExact

  simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.norm_def]

  obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hvb⟩ := ProverCommitNativeSquare49.square x.c1 hx.2

    rw [hvn,hva,hvr,hvb,norm_value]
    change ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0-qm31R*(ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1)=ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0-qm31R*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1

    intro he;apply hn

  obtain ⟨ni,hni,hcni,hvni⟩ := ProverCommitNativeCInverse49.inverse n hcn nonzero
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,hclo,hvlo⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.mul x.c0 ni hx.1 hcni

  · rw [kernels.inverse_q,zero_test]

      let lo ← field.CM31.mul (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0) ni
      let nb ← field.CM31.neg (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
      let hi ← field.CM31.mul nb ni
      ok (some ({c0:=lo,c1:=hi} : field.QM31)))=ok _
    simp only [ha,hb,hr',hnn,hni,hlo,hnb,hhi,bind_tc_ok]
    rfl
  · rw [hnorm] at hvni
    apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value lo=_
      rw [hvlo,hvni,QuadraticAlgebra.re_inv]

      change ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0*(QuadraticAlgebra.norm (decode x))⁻¹=(QuadraticAlgebra.norm (decode x))⁻¹*ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0

open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open ProverCommitSparsePredicate50 (rawOne)

theorem append_val (x : Usize) (b : Bool) (hx : x.val<512) :
    ((core.num.Usize.wrapping_shl x 1#u32) ||| core.convert.num.FromUsizeBool.from b).val=Nat.bit b x.val := by
  let bv := core.convert.num.FromUsizeBool.from b
  have hb : bv.val=b.toNat := by cases b <;> rfl
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hzv,hzb⟩ := ProverCommitSparseAddress50.row x bv 1#u8 (by decide) hx
    (by rw [hb];cases b <;> decide)
  have he : ((core.num.Usize.wrapping_shl x 1#u32) ||| bv)=z := by
    apply Result.ok.inj
    exact hz
  rw [he,hzv,Nat.bit_val]
  change x.val*2+bv.val=2*x.val+b.toNat
  rw [hb,Nat.mul_comm x.val 2]

theorem suffix (p : Nat → Old.Q) (n : Nat) (left : U8) (hl : left.val=n)
    (start : Usize) (bound : start.val+n≤10) :
    ∃ z : Usize, sparse_scan50.suffix (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) start left=ok z ∧
      z.val=R0P.rowCode n (fun i => rawOne (p (start.val+i.val))) ∧ z.val<2^n := by
  induction n generalizing left with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨0#usize,?_,rfl,?_⟩
    · rw [sparse_scan50.suffix,hz];rfl
    · change 0<1;omega
  | succ n ih =>
    have hz : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    obtain ⟨prev,hprev,hprevv,hprevb⟩ := ih _ hdec (by omega)
    let cast := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    have hcast : cast.val=n := by scalar_tac
    have hidx : (core.num.Usize.wrapping_add start cast).val=start.val+n := by
      change (Usize.wrapping_add start cast).val=_
      rw [ProverCommitBasisFillValue47.add_val _ _ (by rw [hcast];omega),hcast]
    let z := (core.num.Usize.wrapping_shl prev 1#u32) ||| core.convert.num.FromUsizeBool.from (rawOne (p (start.val+n)))
    have hprevsmall : prev.val<512 := by
      have hp : 2^n≤2^9 := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
      omega
    have hval : z.val=R0P.rowCode (n+1) (fun i => rawOne (p (start.val+i.val))) := by
      rw [append_val prev _ hprevsmall,hprevv,R0P.rowCode]
      rfl
    refine ⟨z,?_,hval,?_⟩
    · rw [sparse_scan50.suffix]
      simp only [hz,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok,hprev]
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index 10#usize p _ (by change _<10;rw [hidx];omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hidx,ProverCommitSparsePredicate50.one_result]
      rfl
    · rw [hval]
      exact R0P.rowCode_lt _ _

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSparseAddress50
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47

theorem bound (pref suffix n : Nat) (hn : n≤10) (hp : pref<2^(10-n)) (hs : suffix<2^n) :
    pref*2^n+suffix<1024 := by
  calc
    _ < (pref+1)*2^n := by rw [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul];omega
    _ ≤ 2^(10-n)*2^n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    _ = 1024 := by rw [←pow_add,Nat.sub_add_cancel hn];decide

theorem row (pref suffix : Usize) (trailing : U8) (hn : trailing.val≤10)
    (hp : pref.val<2^(10-trailing.val)) (hs : suffix.val<2^trailing.val) :
    ∃ z : Usize, sparse50.row pref trailing suffix=ok z ∧
      z.val=pref.val*2^trailing.val+suffix.val ∧ z.val<1024 := by
  let s := core.convert.num.FromU32U8.from trailing
  let z := (core.num.Usize.wrapping_shl pref s) ||| suffix
  have hcast : s.val=trailing.val := by scalar_tac
  have hbound := bound pref.val suffix.val trailing.val hn hp hs
  have hpartial : pref.val*2^trailing.val<UScalar.size .Usize := by
    have := ProverCommitPairCounter47.usize_large
    omega
  have hval : z.val=pref.val*2^trailing.val+suffix.val := by
    change ((pref.bv <<< (s.val%UScalarTy.Usize.numBits)) ||| suffix.bv).toNat=_
    rw [BitVec.toNat_or,BitVec.toNat_shiftLeft,hcast]
    have bits : 32≤UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := System.Platform.le_numBits
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show trailing.val<UScalarTy.Usize.numBits by omega)]
    rw [Nat.shiftLeft_eq]
    have hmod : pref.val*2^trailing.val<2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
      simpa only [UScalar.size_def] using hpartial
    change (pref.val*2^trailing.val%2^UScalarTy.Usize.numBits) ||| suffix.val=_
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hmod]
    rw [Nat.mul_comm pref.val (2^trailing.val),←Nat.two_pow_add_eq_or_of_lt hs pref.val]
  refine ⟨z,?_,hval,?_⟩
  · rw [sparse50.row];rfl
  · rw [hval];exact hbound

import R1Z.ProverCommitSampleBits49
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Pi
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.Card
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Pi
/-! Big-endian enumeration is a bijection, so the source's integer traversal
has exactly the model's Boolean-tail sum. No finite cube is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitBooleanEnum49
open scoped BigOperators

def tail (n : Nat) (a : Fin (2^n)) (i : Fin n) : Bool := a.val.testBit (n-1-i.val)

theorem injective (n : Nat) : Function.Injective (tail n) := by
  intro a b h
  apply Fin.ext
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  by_cases hi : i<n
  · have hv := congrFun h (⟨n-1-i,by omega⟩ : Fin n)
    have he : n-1-(n-1-i)=i := by omega
    simpa only [tail,he] using hv
  · have hp : 2^n≤2^i := Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) (by omega)
    rw [Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le a.isLt hp),
      Nat.testBit_lt_two_pow (lt_of_lt_of_le b.isLt hp)]

theorem bijective (n : Nat) : Function.Bijective (tail n) := by
  refine ⟨injective n,?_⟩
  by_contra hn
  have hc := Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective (tail n) (injective n) hn
  simp only [Fintype.card_fin,Fintype.card_fun,Fintype.card_bool] at hc
  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _ hc)

def equiv (n : Nat) : Fin (2^n) ≃ (Fin n → Bool) := Equiv.ofBijective (tail n) (bijective n)

theorem sum_tail {K : Type} [AddCommMonoid K] (n : Nat) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) :
    (∑ a : Fin (2^n), f (tail n a))=∑ b : Fin n → Bool, f b :=
  Equiv.sum_comp (equiv n) f

theorem bit_tail (n : Nat) (a : Fin (2^n)) (word : Aeneas.Std.Usize)
    (hw : word.val=a.val) (i : Fin n) :
    ProverCommitSampleBits49.bit word n i.val=tail n a i := by
  rw [ProverCommitSampleBits49.bit,hw,tail,Nat.testBit_eq_decide_div_mod_eq]
  by_cases h : (a.val / 2^(n-1-i.val))%2=0
  · simp only [h];rfl
  · have h1 : (a.val / 2^(n-1-i.val))%2=1 := by omega
    simp only [h1];rfl

#print axioms injective
#print axioms bijective
#print axioms sum_tail
#print axioms bit_tail
end R1Z.ProverCommitBooleanEnum49

/-! Complete ordered sparse weighted-column sum. This theorem does not
assume a weight-array or returned-sum image. Scanner and pruning remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSparseSum50
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open scoped BigOperators

def weight (p : Nat → QM31Exact) (width pref : Nat) : QM31Exact :=
  ∏ i : Fin width, if pref.testBit (width-1-i.val) then p i.val else 1-p i.val

def term (p col : Nat → Old.Q) (width trailing suffix pref : Nat) : QM31Exact :=
  weight (fun i => decode (p i)) width pref*decode (col (pref*2^trailing+suffix))

def total (p col : Nat → Old.Q) (width trailing suffix : Nat) : Nat → Nat → QM31Exact
 | 0,_ => 0
 | n+1,pref => term p col width trailing suffix pref+total p col width trailing suffix n (pref+1)

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source weight term total

theorem sum (p col : Nat → Old.Q)
    (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i)) (hc : ∀ j, j<1024 → Canonical (col j))
    (width trailing : U8) (hwidth : width.val+trailing.val=10)
    (suffix pref : Usize) (hs : suffix.val<2^trailing.val)
    (n : Nat) (left : U16) (hleft : left.val=n) (bound : pref.val+n≤2^width.val)

def factorValue (p : Nat → Old.Q) (pref : Usize) (w i : Nat) : QM31Exact :=

def product (p : Nat → Old.Q) (pref : Usize) (w : Nat) : Nat → Nat → QM31Exact

theorem weight (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))

      decode z=decode acc*product p pref width.val n i.val := by
  induction n generalizing i left acc with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨acc,?_,hacc,?_⟩
    · rw [sparse50.weight,hz];rfl
    · rw [product,mul_one]

    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by

    have hinc : (core.num.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val=i.val+1 := by

      simpa only [show (1#usize).val=1 from rfl] using

    obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ih _ _ hdec (by rw [hinc];omega) next hcnext

import R0P.Zerocheck
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Pi
/-! Boolean-suffix pruning as a symbolic finite-product identity. No cube
or 1024-entry concrete universe is evaluated. Native bit/address binding is separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSparse50
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def weight {I : Type} [Fintype I] (p : I → K) (b : I → Bool) : K :=
  ∏ i, if b i then p i else 1-p i

theorem eqwB_product (n : Nat) (p : Fin n → K) (b : Fin n → Bool) :
    R0P.Sumcheck.eqwB n p b=weight p b := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [R0P.Sumcheck.eqwB,weight]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [R0P.Sumcheck.eqwB,ih]
    simp only [weight,Fin.prod_univ_succ,Fin.tail]

theorem boolean_weight {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I] (s b : I → Bool) :
    weight (fun i => if s i then (1:K) else 0) b=if b=s then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  by_cases h : b=s
  · subst b
    rw [if_pos rfl]
    unfold weight
    apply Finset.prod_eq_one
    intro i hi
    cases hsi : s i <;> simp [hsi]
  · rw [if_neg h]
    obtain ⟨i,hi⟩ : ∃ i, b i≠s i := Function.ne_iff.mp h
    apply Finset.prod_eq_zero (Finset.mem_univ i)
    cases hb : b i <;> cases hs : s i <;> simp_all

theorem prune {I J : Type} [Fintype I] [Fintype J] [DecidableEq I] [DecidableEq J]
    (p : I → K) (suffix : J → Bool) (f : (I → Bool) → (J → Bool) → K) :
    (∑ a : I → Bool, ∑ b : J → Bool,
      weight p a*weight (fun j => if suffix j then (1:K) else 0) b*f a b)=
      ∑ a : I → Bool, weight p a*f a suffix := by
  classical
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  simp only [boolean_weight]
  simp

#print axioms eqwB_product
#print axioms boolean_weight
#print axioms prune
end R1Z.ProverCommitSparse50

def sparse (p col : Nat → K) (m n suffix : Nat) : K :=
  ∑ a : Fin (2^m), ProverCommitSparse50.weight (fun i : Fin m => p i.val) (tail m a)*

    funext i
    refine Fin.addCases (fun j => ?_) (fun j => ?_) i
    · rw [Fin.append_left];rfl
    · rw [Fin.append_right];exact hs j

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSparseEnum50
open ProverCommitBooleanEnum49 ProverCommitSparseConcat50
open scoped BigOperators

theorem injective (m n : Nat) : Function.Injective (fun ab : Fin (2^m) × Fin (2^n) => concat m n ab.1 ab.2) := by
  intro a b h
  apply Prod.ext
  · apply ProverCommitBooleanEnum49.injective m
    funext i
    have hh := congrArg (fun r => tail (m+n) r (i.castAdd n)) h
    simpa only [high] using hh
  · apply ProverCommitBooleanEnum49.injective n
    funext i
    have hh := congrArg (fun r => tail (m+n) r (i.natAdd m)) h
    simpa only [low] using hh

theorem bijective (m n : Nat) : Function.Bijective (fun ab : Fin (2^m) × Fin (2^n) => concat m n ab.1 ab.2) := by

  by_contra hn
  have hc := Fintype.card_lt_of_injective_not_surjective _ (injective m n) hn
  simp only [Fintype.card_prod,Fintype.card_fin,←pow_add] at hc
  exact (Nat.lt_irrefl _) hc

def equiv (m n : Nat) : Fin (2^m) × Fin (2^n) ≃ Fin (2^(m+n)) :=
  Equiv.ofBijective _ (bijective m n)

theorem sum_concat {K : Type} [AddCommMonoid K] (m n : Nat) (f : Fin (2^(m+n)) → K) :
    (∑ r, f r)=∑ a : Fin (2^m), ∑ b : Fin (2^n), f (concat m n a b) := by
  rw [←Equiv.sum_comp (equiv m n) f,Fintype.sum_prod_type]
  rfl

    ProverCommitSparse50.weight (Fin.append p q) (Fin.append a b)=
      ProverCommitSparse50.weight p a*ProverCommitSparse50.weight q b := by
  simp only [ProverCommitSparse50.weight,Fin.prod_univ_add,Fin.append_left,Fin.append_right]

theorem prune {K : Type} [Field K] (m n : Nat) (p : Fin m → K)
    (suffix : Fin (2^n)) (f : Fin (2^(m+n)) → K) :

  simp_rw [bits,append_weight,ProverCommitSparse50.boolean_weight]
  have he (b : Fin (2^n)) : tail n b=tail n suffix ↔ b=suffix := (ProverCommitBooleanEnum49.injective n).eq_iff
  simp only [he]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro a ha
  simp

/-! Native prefix/suffix row formula decodes to exactly appended Boolean bits. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSparseConcat50
open ProverCommitBooleanEnum49

theorem bound (m n a b : Nat) (ha : a<2^m) (hb : b<2^n) :

    _ < (a+1)*2^n := by rw [Nat.add_mul,Nat.one_mul];omega
    _ ≤ 2^m*2^n := Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (by omega)
    _ = _ := (pow_add 2 m n).symm

def concat (m n : Nat) (a : Fin (2^m)) (b : Fin (2^n)) : Fin (2^(m+n)) :=
  ⟨a.val*2^n+b.val,bound m n a.val b.val a.isLt b.isLt⟩

theorem high (m n : Nat) (a : Fin (2^m)) (b : Fin (2^n)) (i : Fin m) :
    tail (m+n) (concat m n a b) (i.castAdd n)=tail m a i := by
  unfold tail concat
  simp only [Fin.val_mk,Fin.val_castAdd]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm a.val (2^n),Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add a.val b.isLt]
  rw [if_neg (by have := i.isLt;omega)]
  congr 1
  have := i.isLt
  omega

theorem low (m n : Nat) (a : Fin (2^m)) (b : Fin (2^n)) (i : Fin n) :
    tail (m+n) (concat m n a b) (i.natAdd m)=tail n b i := by
  unfold tail concat
  simp only [Fin.val_mk,Fin.val_natAdd]
  rw [Nat.mul_comm a.val (2^n),Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add a.val b.isLt]
  rw [if_pos (by have := i.isLt;omega)]
  congr 1
  omega

theorem bits (m n : Nat) (a : Fin (2^m)) (b : Fin (2^n)) :
    tail (m+n) (concat m n a b)=Fin.append (tail m a) (tail n b) := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.addCases (fun i => ?_) (fun i => ?_) i
  · rw [Fin.append_left,high]
  · rw [Fin.append_right,low]

def reverse : Fin 10 ≃ Fin 10 where
  toFun := fun i => ⟨9-i.val,by have := i.isLt;omega⟩
  invFun := fun i => ⟨9-i.val,by have := i.isLt;omega⟩
  left_inv := by intro i;apply Fin.ext;dsimp;have := i.isLt;omega

  unfold ProverCommitSparse50.weight

      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hidx,hrem]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hv,index e idx (by rw [hidx];exact hib)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error

namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def mask_coeff51.go
  (input : Array field.QM31 26#usize) (exponents : Array Std.U8 26#usize)
  (left : Std.U8) (out : Array field.QM31 27#usize) :
  Result (Array field.QM31 27#usize)
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok out
  else

    let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i)
    let q ← Array.index_usize input i1
    let i2 ← i % 4#u8

    let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i)
    let i4 ← Array.index_usize exponents i3
    let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize i4)
    let out1 ← Array.update out i5 v
    let i6 ← lift (core.num.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    mask_coeff51.go input exponents i6 out1
partial_fixpoint

def mask_coeff51.eval
  (input : Array field.QM31 26#usize) (exponents : Array Std.U8 26#usize) :
  Result (Array field.QM31 27#usize)
  := do
  let a := Array.repeat 27#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  mask_coeff51.go input exponents 26#u8 a

def word (i : Nat) : U8 := UScalar.ofNatCore (if h : i<26 then exponent i else 0) (by

  split_ifs with h
  · exact lt_trans (bound ⟨i,h⟩) (by decide)
  · decide)

theorem word_value (i : Nat) (hi : i<26) : (word i).val=exponent i := by
  simp only [word,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq,dif_pos hi]

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitNativeQ48.source ProverCommitQArray48.array
  ProverCommitMaskPolynomial50.polynomial ProverCommitWriteMath51.polynomial

    (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<26 → Canonical (p i)) :

    dsimp only [target]

    dsimp only [target]

    intro i

def input (c1 : Fin 16 → K) (mo : Fin 10 → K) (i : Fin 26) : K :=

    intro i _
    have h : ¬16+i.val<16 := by omega
    have hmod : (16+i.val)%4=i.val%4 := by omega
    have hval : (Fin.natAdd 16 i).val=16+i.val := rfl

import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.BigOperators
/-! Symbolic overwrite invariant: untouched cells and scheduled cells suffice. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWriteMath51
open scoped BigOperators
open ProverCommitMaskWrites51
variable {K : Type}

theorem fill_eq (e : Nat → Nat) (v t : Nat → K)
    (hv : ∀ i, i < 26 → v i=t (e i)) (n : Nat) (hn : n≤26)
    (q : Nat → K)
    (hq : ∀ k, (∀ i, 26 - n ≤ i → i < 26 → e i ≠ k) → q k=t k) :
    fill e v n q=t := by
  induction n generalizing q with
  | zero =>
    funext k
    exact hq k (by intro i hi hb;omega)
  | succ n ih =>
    change fill e v n (Function.update q (e (26-(n+1))) (v (26-(n+1))))=t
    apply ih (by omega)
    intro k hk
    by_cases h : k=e (26-(n+1))
    · rw [h,Function.update_self,hv _ (by omega)]
    · rw [Function.update_of_ne h]
      apply hq k
      intro i hi hib
      by_cases hstart : i=26-(n+1)
      · rw [hstart];exact Ne.symm h
      · exact hk i (by omega) hib

section Field
variable [Field K]

def polynomial (e : Fin 26 → Nat) (v : Fin 26 → K) : Polynomial K :=
  ∑ i, Polynomial.monomial (e i) (v i)

theorem coeff_at (e : Fin 26 → Nat) (v : Fin 26 → K)
    (he : Function.Injective e) (i : Fin 26) :
    (polynomial e v).coeff (e i)=v i := by
  classical
  simp only [polynomial,Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,Polynomial.coeff_monomial]
  have h (j : Fin 26) : e j=e i ↔ j=i := he.eq_iff
  simp only [h,Finset.sum_ite_eq',Finset.mem_univ,if_true]

theorem coeff_outside (e : Fin 26 → Nat) (v : Fin 26 → K)
    (k : Nat) (hk : ∀ i, e i ≠ k) :
    (polynomial e v).coeff k=0 := by
  simp only [polynomial,Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,Polynomial.coeff_monomial,hk,if_false,Finset.sum_const_zero]
end Field

#print axioms fill_eq
#print axioms coeff_at
#print axioms coeff_outside
end R1Z.ProverCommitWriteMath51

    dsimp only [R0P.Mask.maskFactors,R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis]

import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.BigOperators
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Basic
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega
/-! Symbolic polynomial shape for interpolation basis multiplication.
The bound is arbitrary; no concrete coefficient table is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitInterpolationPoly48
open Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K : Type} [CommRing K]

def poly (n : Nat) (f : Nat → K) : K[X] := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, monomial k (f k)

theorem coeff (n k : Nat) (f : Nat → K) :
    (poly n f).coeff k=if k < n then f k else 0 := by
  simp [poly,Polynomial.finsetSum_coeff,Polynomial.coeff_monomial,eq_comm]

theorem mul_coeff (n k : Nat) (f : Nat → K) (j : K) :
    ((X-C j)*poly n f).coeff k=
      (if k=0 then 0 else if k-1 < n then f (k-1) else 0)-
        (if k < n then f k else 0)*j := by
  rw [sub_mul,Polynomial.coeff_sub,Polynomial.coeff_C_mul]
  cases k with
  | zero => simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul_zero,coeff,if_true];ring
  | succ k =>
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul,coeff,if_neg (Nat.succ_ne_zero k),Nat.add_sub_cancel]
    ring

/-- The last input coefficient is zero, so multiplication by X-j fits in
n coefficients. The law includes every coefficient above the array bound. -/
theorem mul_shape (n : Nat) (positive : 0 < n) (f g : Nat → K) (j : K)
    (highest : f (n-1)=0)
    (hg : ∀ k, k < n → g k=(if k=0 then 0 else f (k-1))-f k*j) :
    poly n g=(X-C j)*poly n f := by
  ext k
  rw [coeff,mul_coeff]
  by_cases hk : k < n
  · have hp : k-1 < n := by omega
    rw [if_pos hk,if_pos hk,hg k hk,if_pos hp]
  · have hk0 : k≠0 := by omega
    rw [if_neg hk,if_neg hk,if_neg hk0]
    by_cases he : k=n
    · subst k
      rw [if_pos (by omega),highest]
      simp only [zero_mul,sub_zero]
    · rw [if_neg (by omega)]
      simp only [zero_mul,sub_zero]

#print axioms coeff
#print axioms mul_coeff
#print axioms mul_shape

callee declaration body byte-for-byte. No external template is installed. -/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def linear50.go
  (point : Array field.QM31 10#usize) (left : Std.U8) (suffix : field.QM31)
  (weighted : field.QM31) :
  Result (field.QM31 × field.QM31)
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok (suffix, weighted)
  else
    let n ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from n)
    let q ← Array.index_usize point i
    let next ← field.QM31.add suffix q
    let weighted1 ←
      if n = 0#u8
      then ok weighted
      else field.QM31.add weighted next
    linear50.go point n next weighted1
partial_fixpoint

def linear50.eval
  (point : Array field.QM31 10#usize) : Result (field.QM31 × field.QM31) := do
  let (suffix, weighted) ←
    linear50.go point 10#u8 field.QM31.ZERO field.QM31.ZERO
  let q ← field.QM31.mul_m31 suffix 3#u32
  let q1 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 weighted 22#u32
  let q2 ← field.QM31.add q q1
  let q3 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 suffix 275#u32
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 weighted 150#u32
  let q5 ← field.QM31.add q3 q4
  ok (q2, q5)

def linear50.power26 (x : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let x2 ← field.QM31.square x
  let x4 ← field.QM31.square x2
  let x8 ← field.QM31.square x4
  let x16 ← field.QM31.square x8
  let q ← field.QM31.mul x16 x8
  field.QM31.mul q x2

end AspisR1ProducerRelease47

section Algebra
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

theorem form0 (p : Nat → K) :
    ProverCommitLinearMath50.sum p 10*3+ProverCommitLinearMath50.weighted p 10*22=
      R0P.Mask.maskLinear 0 (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) := by

  simp only [Nat.cast_zero,mul_zero,add_zero] at h

theorem form16 (p : Nat → K) :
    ProverCommitLinearMath50.sum p 10*275+ProverCommitLinearMath50.weighted p 10*150=
      R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) := by
  rw [←ProverCommitLinearMath50.form p 16]
  push_cast
  ring

theorem chain (x : K) : (x^16*x^8)*x^2=x^26 := by ring
end Algebra

theorem forms (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i)) :
    ∃ a b : Old.Q, linear50.eval (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p)=
      ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a,ProverCommitNativeQ48.source b) ∧
      Canonical a ∧ Canonical b ∧
      decode a=R0P.Mask.maskLinear 0 (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (p i.val)) ∧
      decode b=R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (p i.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨s,w,hgo,hcs,hcw,hvalues⟩ := ProverCommitLinearLoop50.go p hp 10 10#u8 rfl (by decide)
    zero zero zero_canonical zero_canonical
  rw [ProverCommitLinearMath50.stats_value,zero_decode] at hvalues
  have hvs : decode s=ProverCommitLinearMath50.sum (fun i => decode (p i)) 10 := by
    simpa only [zero_add] using congrArg Prod.fst hvalues
  have hvw : decode w=ProverCommitLinearMath50.weighted (fun i => decode (p i)) 10 := by
    simpa only [mul_zero,zero_add] using congrArg Prod.snd hvalues
  obtain ⟨s3,hs3,hcs3,hvs3⟩ := ProverCommitScale50.scale s 3#u32
  obtain ⟨w22,hw22,hcw22,hvw22⟩ := ProverCommitScale50.scale w 22#u32
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hva⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add s3 w22 hcs3 hcw22
  obtain ⟨s275,hs275,hcs275,hvs275⟩ := ProverCommitScale50.scale s 275#u32
  obtain ⟨w150,hw150,hcw150,hvw150⟩ := ProverCommitScale50.scale w 150#u32
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hvb⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add s275 w150 hcs275 hcw150

  · rw [linear50.eval,ProverCommitQArray48.source_zero,hgo]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    change (do
      let q ← field.QM31.mul_m31 (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source s) 3#u32
      let q1 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source w) 22#u32
      let q2 ← field.QM31.add q q1
      let q3 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source s) 275#u32
      let q4 ← field.QM31.mul_m31 (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source w) 150#u32
      let q5 ← field.QM31.add q3 q4

    rw [hw22];simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [ha];simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hs275];simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hw150];simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hb];rfl
  · rw [hva,hvs3,hvw22,hvs,hvw]
    exact form0 _
  · rw [hvb,hvs275,hvw150,hvs,hvw]
    exact form16 _

theorem power26 (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, linear50.power26 (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=(decode x)^26 := by
  obtain ⟨x2,h2,hc2,hv2⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQSquare49.square x hx
  obtain ⟨x4,h4,hc4,hv4⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQSquare49.square x2 hc2
  obtain ⟨x8,h8,hc8,hv8⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQSquare49.square x4 hc4
  obtain ⟨x16,h16,hc16,hv16⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQSquare49.square x8 hc8
  obtain ⟨x24,h24,hc24,hv24⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul x16 x8 hc16 hc8
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul x24 x2 hc24 hc2
  have h2' : decode x2=(decode x)^2 := by rw [hv2,pow_two]
  have h4' : decode x4=(decode x)^4 := by rw [hv4,h2'];ring
  have h8' : decode x8=(decode x)^8 := by rw [hv8,h4'];ring
  have h16' : decode x16=(decode x)^16 := by rw [hv16,h8'];ring
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · simp only [linear50.power26,h2,h4,h8,h16,h24,hz,bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [hdz,hv24,h16',h8',h2']
    exact chain _

theorem go (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    (n : Nat) (left : U8) (hl : left.val=n) (bound : n≤10)
    (s w : Old.Q) (hs : Canonical s) (hw : Canonical w) :
    ∃ a b : Old.Q, linear50.go (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) left
      (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source s) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source w)=
        ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a,ProverCommitNativeQ48.source b) ∧
      Canonical a ∧ Canonical b ∧
      (decode a,decode b)=ProverCommitLinearMath50.stats (fun i => decode (p i)) n (decode s) (decode w) := by
  induction n generalizing left s w with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨s,w,?_,hs,hw,?_⟩
    · rw [linear50.go,hz];rfl
    · rw [ProverCommitLinearMath50.stats]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    let idx := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    have hidx : idx.val=n := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨next,hnext,hcnext,hdnext⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add s (p n) hs (hp _ (by omega))
    have hweighted : ∃ v : Old.Q,
        (if U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8=0#u8 then ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source w)
          else field.QM31.add (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source w) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source next))=

      by_cases hn0 : n=0

        exact ⟨w,by rw [if_pos hz],hw,by rw [if_pos hn0]⟩
      · have hz : U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
        obtain ⟨v,hv,hcv,hdv⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add w next hw hcnext
        exact ⟨v,by rw [if_neg hz];exact hv,hcv,by rw [if_neg hn0];exact hdv⟩
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hcv,hdv⟩ := hweighted
    obtain ⟨a,b,hab,hca,hcb,hdab⟩ := ih _ hdec (by omega) next v hcnext hcv
    refine ⟨a,b,?_,hca,hcb,?_⟩
    · rw [linear50.go]
      simp only [hn,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index 10#usize p idx (by change idx.val<10;rw [hidx];omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hidx,hnext]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,hv]
      exact hab
    · rw [hdab,ProverCommitLinearMath50.stats,hdv,hdnext]

import R0P.MaskValue
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Basic
/-! Symbolic sufficient statistics for the optimized selected-mask forms. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitLinearMath50
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def sum (p : Nat → K) : Nat → K
 | 0 => 0
 | n+1 => sum p n+p n

def weighted (p : Nat → K) : Nat → K
 | 0 => 0
 | n+1 => weighted p n+(n:K)*p n

def stats (p : Nat → K) : Nat → K → K → K × K
 | 0,s,w => (s,w)
 | n+1,s,w => stats p n (s+p n) (if n=0 then w else w+(s+p n))

theorem stats_value (p : Nat → K) (n : Nat) (s w : K) :
    stats p n s w=(s+sum p n,w+((n-1:Nat):K)*s+weighted p n) := by
  induction n generalizing s w with
  | zero => simp [stats,sum,weighted]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [stats,ih]
    cases n with
    | zero => simp [sum,weighted]
    | succ n =>
      simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel,Nat.succ_ne_zero,if_false,sum,weighted,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
      apply Prod.ext <;> dsimp <;> ring

theorem sum_fin (p : Nat → K) (n : Nat) : sum p n=∑ i : Fin n, p i.val := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [sum]
  | succ n ih => rw [sum,ih,Fin.sum_univ_castSucc];rfl

theorem weighted_fin (p : Nat → K) (n : Nat) : weighted p n=∑ i : Fin n, (i.val:K)*p i.val := by
  induction n with
  | zero => simp [weighted]
  | succ n ih => rw [weighted,ih,Fin.sum_univ_castSucc];rfl

theorem form (p : Nat → K) (family : Nat) :
    (3+17*(family:K))*sum p 10+(22+8*(family:K))*weighted p 10=
      R0P.Mask.maskLinear family (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) := by
  rw [sum_fin,weighted_fin,R0P.Mask.maskLinear,Finset.mul_sum,Finset.mul_sum,←Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_mul,Nat.cast_ofNat]
  ring

#print axioms stats_value
#print axioms sum_fin
#print axioms weighted_fin
#print axioms form
end R1Z.ProverCommitLinearMath50

/-! Complete degree-26 prepared Horner value for arbitrary canonical input

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitMaskHorner50
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)

theorem go (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ i, i<27 → Canonical (q i)) (x : QM31Exact)
    (a : Nat → Nat → U32)
    (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ((a i.val j.val).val : AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase.M31Exact)=
      ProverCommitChannelAlgebra49.components x i j)
    (n : Nat) (left : U8) (hl : left.val=n) (hn : n≤27)
    (acc : Old.Q) (hacc : Canonical acc) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, mask_horner50.go (ProverCommitQArray48.array 27#usize q)
      (ProverCommitPrepared50.matrix a) left (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source acc)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=decode acc*x^n+(ProverCommitInterpolationPoly48.poly n (fun i => decode (q i))).eval x := by
  induction n generalizing left acc with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨acc,?_,hacc,?_⟩
    · rw [mask_horner50.go,hz];rfl
    · simp only [pow_zero,mul_one,ProverCommitInterpolationPoly48.poly,
        Finset.range_zero,Finset.sum_empty,Polynomial.eval_zero,add_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hz : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    let idx := core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    have hidx : idx.val=n := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨p,hp,hcp,hdp⟩ := ProverCommitPrepared50.mul a x acc hacc ha
    obtain ⟨next,hnext,hcnext,hdnext⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add p (q n) hcp (hq _ (by omega))
    obtain ⟨z,hz0,hcz,hdz⟩ := ih _ hdec (by omega) next hcnext
    refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
    · rw [mask_horner50.go]
      simp only [hz,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok,hp]
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index 27#usize q idx (by change idx.val<27;rw [hidx];omega)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hidx,hnext]
      exact hz0
    · rw [hdz,hdnext,hdp,ProverCommitHornerMath50.eval_succ,pow_succ]
      ring

theorem exact_result (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ i, i<27 → Canonical (q i))
    (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, mask_horner50.eval (ProverCommitQArray48.array 27#usize q) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x)=
      ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧ Canonical z ∧
      decode z=(ProverCommitInterpolationPoly48.poly 27 (fun i => decode (q i))).eval (decode x) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hva⟩ := ProverCommitPrepared50.prepare x hx
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := go q hq (decode x) a hva 26 26#u8 rfl (by decide) (q 26) (hq _ (by decide))
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · rw [mask_horner50.eval,ha]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index 27#usize q 26#usize (by decide)]
    exact hz
  · rw [hdz]
    exact ProverCommitHornerMath50.top (fun i => decode (q i)) (decode x) 26

#print axioms go

end R1Z.ProverCommitMaskHorner50

previously proved release extraction. bind-counter.py checks every reused
callee declaration body byte-for-byte. No external template is installed. -/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def mask_horner50.go
  (q : Array field.QM31 27#usize)
  (prepared : Array (Array field.M31 3#usize) 3#usize) (left : Std.U8)
  (acc : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok acc
  else
    let n ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    let q1 ← prepared50.mul prepared acc
    let i ← lift (core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from n)
    let q2 ← Array.index_usize q i
    let value ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
    mask_horner50.go q prepared n value
partial_fixpoint

def mask_horner50.eval
  (q : Array field.QM31 27#usize) (x : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let prepared ← prepared50.prepare x
  let q1 ← Array.index_usize q 26#usize
  mask_horner50.go q prepared 26#u8 q1

end AspisR1ProducerRelease47

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPrepared50

def matrix (a : Nat → Nat → U32) :=
  ProverCommitArray49.array 3#usize (fun i => ProverCommitArray49.array 3#usize (a i))

theorem prepare_eq (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) :
    prepared50.prepare (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x)=dot50.prepare (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hcs,hvs⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.add x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hva⟩ := ProverCommitPrepare50.cm x.c0 hx.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hvb⟩ := ProverCommitPrepare50.cm x.c1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hcc,hvc⟩ := ProverCommitPrepare50.cm s hcs
  change (do
    let a ← dot50.prepare_c (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0)
    let b ← dot50.prepare_c (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
    let s ← field.CM31.add (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0) (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
    let c ← dot50.prepare_c s
    ok (Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c]))=(do
    let s ← field.CM31.add (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0) (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
    let a ← dot50.prepare_c (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0)
    let b ← dot50.prepare_c (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
    let c ← dot50.prepare_c s
    ok (Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c]))
  simp only [hs,ha,hb,hc,bind_tc_ok]

theorem prepare (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) :

      (∀ i j, i<3 → j<3 → (a i j).val<AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) ∧
      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ((a i.val j.val).val : M31Exact)=components (decode x) i j) := by
  rw [prepare_eq x hx]
  exact ProverCommitPrepare50.q x hx

theorem combine (a b c : Old.C)
    (ha : ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical a) (hb : ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical b)
    (hc : ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical c) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, prepared50.combine (ProverCommitNativeC49.source a) (ProverCommitNativeC49.source b)
      (ProverCommitNativeC49.source c)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧ Canonical z ∧
      decode z=⟨ProverCommitNativeC49.value a+qm31R*ProverCommitNativeC49.value b,
        ProverCommitNativeC49.value c-ProverCommitNativeC49.value a-ProverCommitNativeC49.value b⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hcr,hvr⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.mul_r b hb
  have hr' : reconstruction.mul_r (ProverCommitNativeC49.source b)=ok (ProverCommitNativeC49.source r) := hr
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,hclo,hvlo⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.add a r ha hcr
  obtain ⟨t,ht,hct,hvt⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.sub c a hc ha
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,hchi,hvhi⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.sub t b hct hb
  refine ⟨⟨lo,hi⟩,?_,⟨hclo,hchi⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [prepared50.combine,hr',hlo,ht,hhi,bind_tc_ok];rfl
  · apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext
    · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value lo=_
      rw [hvlo,hvr]
    · change ProverCommitNativeC49.value hi=_
      rw [hvhi,hvt]

theorem karatsuba (x y : QM31Exact) :
    (⟨x.re*y.re+qm31R*(x.im*y.im),
      (x.re+x.im)*(y.re+y.im)-x.re*y.re-x.im*y.im⟩ : QM31Exact)=x*y := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [QuadraticAlgebra.re_mul,QuadraticAlgebra.im_mul] <;> ring

theorem mul (a : Nat → Nat → U32) (x : QM31Exact) (y : Old.Q)
    (hy : Canonical y)
    (ha : ∀ i j : Fin 3, ((a i.val j.val).val : M31Exact)=components x i j) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, prepared50.mul (matrix a) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=x*decode y := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hcs,hvs⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.add y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨m0,hm0,hc0,hv0⟩ := ProverCommitPreparedCM50.cm (a 0) x.re y.c0 hy.1 (ha 0)
  obtain ⟨m1,hm1,hc1,hv1⟩ := ProverCommitPreparedCM50.cm (a 1) x.im y.c1 hy.2 (ha 1)
  obtain ⟨m2,hm2,hc2,hv2⟩ := ProverCommitPreparedCM50.cm (a 2) (x.re+x.im) s hcs (ha 2)
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := combine m0 m1 m2 hc0 hc1 hc2
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · change (do
      let a0 ← Array.index_usize (matrix a) 0#usize
      let m0 ← prepared50.cm a0 (ProverCommitNativeC49.source y.c0)
      let a1 ← Array.index_usize (matrix a) 1#usize
      let m1 ← prepared50.cm a1 (ProverCommitNativeC49.source y.c1)
      let a2 ← Array.index_usize (matrix a) 2#usize
      let s ← field.CM31.add (ProverCommitNativeC49.source y.c0) (ProverCommitNativeC49.source y.c1)
      let m2 ← prepared50.cm a2 s
      prepared50.combine m0 m1 m2)=_
    simp only [matrix,ProverCommitArray49.index 3#usize _ 0#usize (by decide),
      ProverCommitArray49.index 3#usize _ 1#usize (by decide),
      ProverCommitArray49.index 3#usize _ 2#usize (by decide),
      show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl,show (1#usize).val=1 from rfl,show (2#usize).val=2 from rfl,
      hm0,hm1,hs,hm2,hz,bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [hdz,hv0,hv1,hv2,hvs]
    exact karatsuba x (decode y)

theorem caller (x y : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, (do
      let a ← prepared50.prepare (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x)
      prepared50.mul a (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y))=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=decode x*decode y := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hva⟩ := prepare x hx
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := mul a (decode x) y hy hva
  exact ⟨z,by rw [ha];exact hz,hcz,hdz⟩

#print axioms prepare_eq
#print axioms prepare
#print axioms combine
#print axioms karatsuba
#print axioms mul
#print axioms caller
end R1Z.ProverCommitPrepared50

theorem cm (a : Nat → U32) (x : CM31Exact) (y : Old.C)

  rfl

theorem cm (x : Old.C) (hx : ProverCommitNativeC49.Canonical x) :

  · intro j hj
    unfold triple
    split <;> rename_i h
    · exact hx.1
    · split
      · exact hx.2
      · exact hcz
  · intro j
    fin_cases j
    · rfl
    · rfl
    · exact hdz

      (∀ i j : Fin 3, ((a i.val j.val).val : M31Exact)=components (decode x) i j) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hcs,hvs⟩ := ProverCommitNativeC49.add x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hva⟩ := cm x.c0 hx.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hvb⟩ := cm x.c1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hcc,hvc⟩ := cm s hcs
  refine ⟨triple a b c,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · change (do
      let z ← field.CM31.add (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0) (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
      let a ← dot50.prepare_c (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c0)
      let b ← dot50.prepare_c (ProverCommitNativeC49.source x.c1)
      let c ← dot50.prepare_c z
      ok (Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c]))=_
    rw [hs];simp only [bind_tc_ok,ha,hb,hc]
    exact congrArg Result.ok (triple_array _ _ _)
  · intro i j hi hj
    unfold triple
    split
    · exact hca j hj
    · split
      · exact hcb j hj
      · exact hcc j hj
  · intro i j
    fin_cases i
    · exact hva j
    · exact hvb j
    · change ((c j.val).val : M31Exact)=cmComponents
        (ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c0+ProverCommitNativeC49.value x.c1) j
      exact (hvc j).trans (congrArg (fun z => cmComponents z j) hvs)

import AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Tactic.Ring.Basic
/-! Symbolic linear reconstruction of the nine Karatsuba channels. This is
algebra only; native component construction/reconstruction still need binding. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitChannelAlgebra49
open scoped BigOperators
abbrev C (M : Type) [CommRing M] := QuadraticAlgebra M (-1) 0

def R (M : Type) [CommRing M] : C M := ⟨2,1⟩
abbrev Q (M : Type) [CommRing M] := QuadraticAlgebra (C M) (R M) 0
abbrev Data (M : Type) := Fin 3 → Fin 3 → M
variable {M : Type} [CommRing M]

def fromCM (s : Fin 3 → M) : C M := ⟨s 0-s 1,s 2-s 0-s 1⟩

def reconstruct (s : Data M) : Q M :=
  ⟨fromCM (s 0)+R M*fromCM (s 1),fromCM (s 2)-fromCM (s 0)-fromCM (s 1)⟩

def cmComponents (x : C M) : Fin 3 → M := ![x.re,x.im,x.re+x.im]

def components (x : Q M) : Data M := ![cmComponents x.re,cmComponents x.im,cmComponents (x.re+x.im)]

def channels (x y : Q M) : Data M := fun i j => components x i j*components y i j

theorem reconstruct_product (x y : Q M) : reconstruct (channels x y)=x*y := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;>
    simp [reconstruct,fromCM,channels,components,cmComponents,R] <;> ring

theorem reconstruct_zero : reconstruct (0 : Data M)=0 := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> simp [reconstruct,fromCM,R]

theorem reconstruct_add (s t : Data M) : reconstruct (s+t)=reconstruct s+reconstruct t := by
  apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;> apply QuadraticAlgebra.ext <;>
    simp only [QuadraticAlgebra.re_add,QuadraticAlgebra.im_add] <;>
    simp [reconstruct,fromCM,R] <;> ring

def hom : Data M →+ Q M where
  toFun := reconstruct
  map_zero' := reconstruct_zero
  map_add' := reconstruct_add

theorem reconstruct_sum_products {I : Type} [Fintype I] (x y : I → Q M) :
    reconstruct (fun c h => ∑ i : I, components (x i) c h*components (y i) c h)=∑ i : I, x i*y i := by
  have hdata : (fun c h => ∑ i : I, components (x i) c h*components (y i) c h)=∑ i : I, channels (x i) (y i) := by
    funext c h
    simp only [Finset.sum_apply,channels]
  rw [hdata]
  change hom (∑ i : I, channels (x i) (y i))=_
  rw [map_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  exact reconstruct_product (x i) (y i)

#print axioms reconstruct_product
#print axioms reconstruct_zero
#print axioms reconstruct_add
#print axioms reconstruct_sum_products
end R1Z.ProverCommitChannelAlgebra49

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitRadix50

def blocks (f : Nat → K) (x : K) : Nat → K

    (ProverCommitInterpolationPoly48.poly n f).eval x=∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k*x^k := by
  simp [ProverCommitInterpolationPoly48.poly,Polynomial.eval_finset_sum,Polynomial.eval_monomial]

  rw [block]
  simp only [pow_add,pow_mul]

  | succ n ih =>

    (∑ c : Fin 10, (MaskedProtocol.maskFactors B a).maskOnly c •
      claimsLinear a 0 ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩) + extraLinear π a 28

theorem maskLinear_apply (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (a : Fin 10 → K) (t : Trace K) :
    maskLinear π B a t = MaskedProtocol.maskValue B
      (fun c => honestClaims t a 0 (Fin.castLE (by omega) c))
      (fun c => honestClaims t a 0 ⟨16+c.val, by omega⟩) (honestClaims t a 0 27) a + R0P.Mask.honestExtra π t a 28 := by
  simp only [maskLinear, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, claimsLinear_apply, extraLinear_apply, MaskedProtocol.maskValue]

def rounds (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) : PointFunction K →ₗ[K] K[X] :=
  (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun k : Fin 28 => (k.val : K))).comp
    (LinearMap.pi fun k => ∑ tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool,
      LinearMap.proj (roundPoint ch j (k.val : K) tail))

theorem rounds_apply (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (f : PointFunction K) :
    rounds ch j f = Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun k : Fin 28 => (k.val : K))
      (fun k => ∑ tail : Fin (9-j.val) → Bool, f (roundPoint ch j (k.val : K) tail)) := by
  unfold rounds
  rw [LinearMap.comp_apply]
  congr 1
  funext k
  simp only [LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]

/-- All mask contributions, including the round masks, and all direct linear
observations. This map does not read the instance or either tape. -/
def L (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Trace K →ₗ[K] Payload K Bat :=
  LinearMap.pi fun coord => match coord with
  | .maskSum => ∑ bits : Fin 10 → Bool, maskLinear π B (fun i => if bits i then 1 else 0)
  | .semanticCoeff j i => (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val).comp
      ((rounds ch j).comp (LinearMap.pi (maskLinear π B)))
  | coord => (LinearMap.proj coord).comp (linearPayload π ch)

abbrev RoundPayload (K : Type) := Fin 10 → Fin 28 → K

def roundInclusion : RoundPayload K →ₗ[K] Payload K Bat :=
  LinearMap.pi fun coord => match coord with
  | .semanticCoeff j i => (LinearMap.proj i : (Fin 28 → K) →ₗ[K] K).comp
      (LinearMap.proj j : RoundPayload K →ₗ[K] (Fin 28 → K))
  | _ => 0

def originalRounds (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) : RoundPayload K := fun j i =>
  (rounds ch j (fun a => ch.sem 14 * terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)
    (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B (honestClaims t a) a)).coeff i.val

def O (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) : Payload K Bat :=
  roundInclusion (originalRounds pub B ch t)

def actual (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : T K F) : Trace K :=
  applyAff B (prepare pub (applyEligible t r.2.2) ch) (aff r)

def payload (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : T K F) : Payload K Bat :=
  run π pub B (applyEligible t r.2.2) ch (aff r)

theorem L_round (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K)
    (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    L (Bat := Bat) π B ch t (.semanticCoeff j i) = (rounds ch j (fun a => maskLinear π B a t)).coeff i.val := rfl

theorem O_round (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K)
    (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch t (.semanticCoeff j i) = originalRounds pub B ch t j i := rfl

attribute [local irreducible] prepare helper applyAff traceAffine batchLinear
  quotientLinear openingWeights honestClaims MaskedProtocol.terminalZ MaskedProtocol.maskValue
  claimsLinear dotLinear relationLinear

private theorem run_split_maskSum (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.maskSum) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.maskSum) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.maskSum) := by
  let u := applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply,
    maskLinear_apply, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

private theorem run_split_semanticCoeff (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.semanticCoeff j i) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.semanticCoeff j i) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.semanticCoeff j i) := by
  let u := applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r
  simp only [Pi.add_apply, L_round, O_round]
  change _ = (rounds ch j (fun a => maskLinear π B a u)).coeff i.val +
    (rounds ch j (fun a => ch.sem 14 * terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1)
      (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B (honestClaims u a) a)).coeff i.val
  rw [← Polynomial.coeff_add, ← map_add]
  simp only [rounds_apply, Pi.add_apply, maskLinear_apply, run, MaskedProtocol.terminalZ, u]

private theorem run_split_pointClaim (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.pointClaim j c) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.pointClaim j c) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.pointClaim j c) := by
  let u := applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, linearPayload, claimsLinear_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

private theorem run_split_extraClaim (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) (c : Fin 29) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.extraClaim c) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.extraClaim c) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.extraClaim c) := by
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, linearPayload, extraLinear_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

private theorem run_split_ood (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) (j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 29) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.ood j c) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.ood j c) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.ood j c) := by
  let u := applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, linearPayload, coeffsLinear_apply, oodLinear_apply, Pi.add_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
  rfl

private theorem run_split_inactiveSum (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.inactiveSum) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.inactiveSum) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.inactiveSum) := by
  let u := applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, linearPayload, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
    dotLinear, smul_eq_mul, AspisR0.LinearDual.dot, Pi.add_apply,
    LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

private theorem run_split_bat (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) (b : Bat) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.bat b) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.bat b) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.bat b) := by
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, linearPayload, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]

private theorem run_split_opened (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) (q : Fin 262144) (s : Fin 4) (c : Fin 29) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r (.opened q s c) = L (Bat := Bat) π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.opened q s c) +
      O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) (.opened q s c) := by
  let u := applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r
  simp only [run, L, O, roundInclusion, LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    LinearMap.proj_apply, linearPayload, Pi.add_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, add_zero]
  split_ifs <;> simp only [LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply,
    AspisWide.Agreement.exactInitialLinear_apply, LinearMap.zero_apply, coeffsLinear_apply]
  rfl

/-- Componentwise equality to the existing honest view, without layout assumptions. -/
theorem run_split (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : AffTape K F) :
    run (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch r = L π B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) +
      O pub B ch (applyAff B (prepare pub t ch) r) := by
  funext coord
  cases coord with
  | maskSum => exact run_split_maskSum π pub B t ch r
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact run_split_semanticCoeff π pub B t ch r j i
  | pointClaim j c => exact run_split_pointClaim π pub B t ch r j c
  | extraClaim c => exact run_split_extraClaim π pub B t ch r c
  | ood j c => exact run_split_ood π pub B t ch r j c
  | inactiveSum => exact run_split_inactiveSum π pub B t ch r
  | opened q s c => exact run_split_opened π pub B t ch r q s c
  | bat b => exact run_split_bat π pub B t ch r b

theorem actual_add_pure (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (n : N K F) :
    actual pub B t ch (m,n) = actual pub B t ch (0,n) + pureTrace B m := by
  have ha : aff (m,n) = aff (0,n) + pureAff m := by
    change aff (m,n) = aff (0,n) + aff (m,0)
    rw [← map_add]
    congr 1
    simp
  simp only [actual, applyAff_eq_base_add, ha, map_add, pureTrace, LinearMap.comp_apply,
    add_assoc]

theorem claim_add_pure (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (m : M K F)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 16 ∨ c.val = 26) :
    honestClaims (t + pureTrace B m) a j c = honestClaims t a j c := by
  have he : (t + pureTrace B m) c = t c := by
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, pureTrace_fixed B m c hc, add_zero]
  simp only [honestClaims, he]

/-- The actual terminal never reads G, D, or any mask-only column. -/
theorem terminal_add_pure (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (a : Fin 10 → K) :
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims (t + pureTrace B m) a) a =
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims t a) a := by
  have hs (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 16) := claim_add_pure B t m a j
    (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) (Or.inl c.isLt)
  have hh := claim_add_pure B t m a 0 26 (Or.inr rfl)
  simp only [terminalValue, hs, hh]

theorem O_add_pure (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) :
    O (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (t + pureTrace B m) = O pub B ch t := by
  apply congrArg roundInclusion
  funext j i
  apply congrArg (fun f : PointFunction K => (rounds ch j f).coeff i.val)
  funext a
  rw [terminal_add_pure]

/-- Common slope: independent of the honest instance and all of N. -/
def pureLinear (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : M K F →ₗ[F] Payload K Bat :=
  ((L π B ch).restrictScalars F).comp (pureTrace B)

theorem M_pure (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (m : M K F) (n : N K F) :
    payload (Bat := Bat) π pub B t ch (m,n) = payload π pub B t ch (0,n) + pureLinear π B ch m := by
  simp only [payload, run_split]
  change L π B ch (actual pub B t ch (m,n)) + O pub B ch (actual pub B t ch (m,n)) =
    L π B ch (actual pub B t ch (0,n)) + O pub B ch (actual pub B t ch (0,n)) + _
  rw [actual_add_pure, map_add, O_add_pure]
  change _ = _ + L π B ch (pureTrace B m)
  abel

#print axioms run_split
#print axioms terminal_add_pure
#print axioms M_pure
end R0Z.PayloadSplit

import R0Z.JointView

/-! D12. G is pure: SemDecision.terminalValue reads only columns 0..15
and H1 (26); Mask.maskValue reads G with a point-only coefficient.
The product below is the binary vector-space direct sum, retaining every
raw coordinate, including overwritten and unused samples. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.Partition
open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K : Type} [Field K] {F : Subfield K}

abbrev ExtTape (F : Type) := Fin 1024 × Fin 4 → F
abbrev M (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) :=
  (Fin 10 × Fin 1024 → F) × ExtTape F × ExtTape F
abbrev N (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) :=
  ExtTape F × EligibleNoise K F
abbrev T (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) := M K F × N K F

/-- Old extension slots are G, H1, D, in that order. -/
def aff : T K F →ₗ[F] AffTape K F where
  toFun t := Sum.elim t.1.1 (fun p =>
    if p.1 = 0 then t.1.2.1 p.2 else if p.1 = 1 then t.2.1 p.2 else t.1.2.2 p.2)
  map_add' p q := by
    funext c
    cases c with
    | inl p => rfl
    | inr p =>
      simp only [Pi.add_apply, Sum.elim_inr]
      split_ifs <;> rfl
  map_smul' a p := by
    funext c
    cases c with
    | inl p => rfl
    | inr p =>
      simp only [Pi.smul_apply, Sum.elim_inr]
      split_ifs <;> rfl


/-- A coordinate permutation, not a change of the honest tape law. -/
def equiv : T K F ≃ₗ[F] JointView.Tape K F where
  toFun t := (aff t, t.2.2)
  invFun t := ((fun p => t.1 (.inl p),
    (fun p => t.1 (.inr (0,p))), fun p => t.1 (.inr (2,p))),
    (fun p => t.1 (.inr (1,p))), t.2)
  left_inv t := by
    rcases t with ⟨⟨a,g,d⟩,h,e⟩
    rfl
  right_inv t := by
    refine Prod.ext ?_ rfl
    funext c
    cases c with
    | inl p => rfl
    | inr p =>
      rcases p with ⟨i,p⟩
      fin_cases i <;> rfl
  map_add' p q := Prod.ext (map_add aff p q) rfl
  map_smul' a p := Prod.ext (map_smul aff a p) rfl

def inlM : M K F →ₗ[F] T K F := LinearMap.inl F _ _
def inrN : N K F →ₗ[F] T K F := LinearMap.inr F _ _
def pureAff : M K F →ₗ[F] AffTape K F := aff.comp inlM
def pureTrace (B : PackBasis F) : M K F →ₗ[F] Trace K :=
  (traceLinear B).comp pureAff

attribute [local irreducible] copyInactiveRows

theorem extension_pure_zero (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (s : Fin 1024) :
    extensionAff B 1 s (pureAff m) = 0 := by
  change (0 : K) + B.i * 0 + B.u * 0 + (B.i * B.u) * 0 = 0
  ring

/-- Keep the finite set abstract while proving evaluation of the zero family. -/
theorem balance_zero_generic {I : Type} [DecidableEq I] (S : Finset I)
    (d r : I) (f : I → AffTape K F →ₗ[F] K) (p : AffTape K F)
    (hz : ∀ s, f s p = 0) :
    (if r = d then -(∑ s ∈ S, f s) else f r) p = 0 := by
  by_cases hr : r = d
  · rw [if_pos hr, LinearMap.neg_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply]
    simp only [hz, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero]
  · rw [if_neg hr]
    exact hz r

theorem padding_pure_zero (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (r : Fin 1024) :
    balanceAff 0 (fun s => if CopyActiveRow s then 0 else extensionAff B 1 s) r
      (pureAff m) = 0 := by
  apply balance_zero_generic
  intro s
  by_cases hs : CopyActiveRow s
  · rw [if_pos hs]; rfl
  · rw [if_neg hs]; exact extension_pure_zero B m s

/-- Pure tape coordinates never change semantic cells or H1. -/
theorem pureTrace_fixed (B : PackBasis F) (m : M K F) (c : Fin 29)
    (hc : c.val < 16 ∨ c.val = 26) : pureTrace B m c = 0 := by
  funext r
  rcases hc with hc | hc
  · change (traceLinear B (pureAff m)) c r = 0
    simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_pos hc, LinearMap.zero_apply]
  · have h16 : ¬c.val < 16 := by omega
    have h26 : ¬c.val < 26 := by omega
    change (traceLinear B (pureAff m)) c r = 0
    simp only [traceLinear, LinearMap.pi_apply, if_neg h16, dif_neg h26, if_pos hc]
    exact padding_pure_zero B m r

#print axioms equiv
#print axioms pureTrace_fixed
end R0Z.Partition

import R0Z.ZkStatement

/-! D11's joint uniform tape and current privacy experiment. The binary
direct sum of the two vector spaces is represented by their product, with
LinearMap.inl/inr as its injections; it is not a choice of one summand.
No affine decomposition or image hypothesis is installed in this interface. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.JointView
open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev HonestProver := ZkStatement.HonestProver
abbrev HonestInstance {K : Type} (h : HonestProver K) := h.Instance
abbrev Statement := ZkStatement.Statement
abbrev Challenges := HonestView.Challenges
abbrev View := ZkStatement.View
abbrev Payload := HonestView.Payload

abbrev Tape (K : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) :=
  AffTape K F × EligibleNoise K F

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

def payload (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Tape K F) : Payload K Bat :=
  HonestView.run h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) t.2) ch t.1

def view (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Tape K F) : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch, payload h B x w ch t)

def c (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K) : Payload K Bat :=
  payload h B x w ch (0, 0)

def InLanguage (h : HonestProver K) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : HonestInstance h, h.public w = x.1

/-- Choose only an instance for the public statement. Both noise tapes are
sampled by the simulator, just as in the honest joint-tape experiment. -/
def simulator (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  view h B outputs x (Classical.choose hx) ch

def HVZK_perfect (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : HonestInstance h) ch, h.public w = x.1 →
    EqualLaws (view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simulator h B outputs x hx ch)

/-- Exact correspondence with the accepted Z3 view; only the location of
eligible noise in the experiment changes. -/
theorem view_eq_z3 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : AffTape K F) (e : EligibleNoise K F) :
    view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch (r,e) = ZkStatement.view h B outputs x (w,e) ch r := rfl

#print axioms view_eq_z3
#print axioms HVZK_perfect
end R0Z.JointView

/-! Historical Z1 interface retained under `Z1`, including the unchanged
FS/ROM distinguishing experiment. It is not the current privacy statement.

Z1: open privacy obligations for the 31-round interactive R0 model.

This file supplies data interfaces and goals, not an honest prover, simulator,
mask-image premise, error budget, or FS compiler theorem. `SourceData` is the
same interface used by SemD3Glue.sourceData; its paymentWitness is reused
literally. See ../../LOG.md for the source/public-view audit and lead decisions.

message. Failure (including q22's empty set) is retained in public outputs.
A source caller that stops before completing these rows needs an explicit

namespace R0Z.ZkStatement.Z1
noncomputable section

abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
abbrev Round := Fin 31
abbrev ChallengePrefix (C : Type) (i : Round) := Fin i.val → C
abbrev Rows (M C : Type) (n : Nat) := Fin n → M × C

/-- Explicit allowed outputs from Phase 0. Bytes are uninstantiated encodings,
not assertions that any two historical/current formats coincide. Events retain

  researchNonces : List Bytes
  proofBytes : Bytes
  openingRecords : List Bytes
  sharedLeafSalts : List Bytes
  authenticationFrontiers : List Bytes
  serializedLengths : List Nat
  lifecycleEvents : List Bytes
  visibleAttemptCount : Option Nat
  outcome : Outcome

/-- Every model message and public challenge, including the terminal message.
`Statement` is TypedContext in the R0 instance: full words are not hidden by
replacing them with roots. The public byte projection is an additional field. -/
structure PublicView (Statement M C : Type) where
  statement : Statement
  rounds : Rows M C 31
  finalMessage : M
  outputs : PublicOutputs

/-- No laws/proofs in the honest-prover interface. Per-round messages have
access only to challenges strictly before that round. Salts/seeds/retry tapes
are represented by `rand`; their concrete distribution is not chosen here. -/
structure HonestProver (Statement M C : Type) where
  witness : Type
  rand : Type
  messages : Statement → witness → rand → (i : Round) → ChallengePrefix C i → M
  finish : Statement → witness → rand → Rows M C 31 → M × PublicOutputs
  valid : Statement → witness → Prop

/-- Finite-tape presentation of the model's sampler operations. `Internal`
can retain duplex state while `project` exposes the challenge value. `draw`
is data; its correspondence to the actual samplers is a GOAL in HVZK.
No uniform-field, freshness, successful-sampling, or FS law is assumed. -/
structure ModelSamplers (Statement M C Internal I A Coins : Type) where
  samp : Nat → FS.Prefix Statement M Internal → M → FS2.Sampler I A Internal
  draw : Round → FS.Prefix Statement M Internal → M → Coins → Internal
  project : Internal → C

variable {X M C Internal I A Coins : Type}

/-- Equality with the model's fresh-answer sampler law at every prefix.
The read trace is discarded; the internal challenge/state output is retained.
This is interactive sampling, not a shared memoized random-oracle execution. -/
def SamplerLaw [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A] [Fintype A] [Nonempty A]
    [Fintype Coins] [Nonempty Coins]
    (v : ModelSamplers X M C Internal I A Coins) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Round) (p : FS.Prefix X M Internal) (m : M) (test : Internal → ℚ),
    R0Z.mean (fun r => test (v.draw i p m r)) =
      AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw.independentMean (v.samp i.val p m).toProgram
        (fun result => test result.2)

/-- A fresh verifier tape for each of the 31 rounds. -/
abbrev VerifierTape (Coins : Type) := Round → Coins

/-- Structural recursion on round count only; never on rows, states or traces.
The prover cannot inspect the current/future verifier tape. -/
def honestRows (h : HonestProver X M C)
    (v : ModelSamplers X M C Internal I A Coins)
    (x : X) (w : h.witness) (r : h.rand) (tape : VerifierTape Coins) :
    (n : Nat) → n ≤ 31 → Rows M Internal n
  | 0, _ => Fin.elim0
  | n + 1, hn =>
    let prev := honestRows h v x w r tape n (by omega)
    let i : Round := ⟨n, by omega⟩
    let m := h.messages x w r i (fun j => v.project (prev j).2)
    let c := v.draw i ⟨x, List.ofFn prev⟩ m (tape i)
    Fin.snoc prev (m, c)

/-- Honest view as a function of prover coins and independent verifier coins.
There is no success filter, and the statement (including W) is retained. -/
def honestView (h : HonestProver X M C)
    (v : ModelSamplers X M C Internal I A Coins)
    (x : X) (w : h.witness) (tape : h.rand × VerifierTape Coins) : PublicView X M C :=
  let rs := honestRows h v x w tape.1 tape.2 31 (Nat.le_refl 31)
  let publicRows : Rows M C 31 := fun i => ((rs i).1, v.project (rs i).2)
  let final := h.finish x w tape.1 publicRows
  ⟨x, publicRows, final.1, final.2⟩

/-- Offline honest-verifier simulator. It receives the public statement and
finite tapes, never a witness. No efficiency or ROM-programming claim is made. -/
structure Simulator (Statement M C Coins : Type) where
  simRand : Type
  simulate : Statement → simRand → VerifierTape Coins → PublicView Statement M C

/-- Open HVZK target. Alignment and sampler-law equalities are goals, never
premises smuggled into a security theorem. For the source instance, `valid`
MUST equal sourceData.paymentWitness. Epsilon is symbolic; equality in law can
later discharge the distance goal via dist_zero_of_equalLaws. -/
def HVZK (h : HonestProver X M C) (paymentWitness : X → h.witness → Prop)
    (v : ModelSamplers X M C Internal I A Coins) (sim : Simulator X M C Coins)
    [Fintype h.rand] [Nonempty h.rand] [Fintype sim.simRand] [Nonempty sim.simRand]
    [Fintype Coins] [Nonempty Coins] [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A]
    [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] (epsilon_zk : ℚ) : Prop :=
  h.valid = paymentWitness ∧ SamplerLaw v ∧
    ∀ (x : X) (w : h.witness), paymentWitness x w →
      R0Z.dist (honestView h v x w)
        (fun tape : sim.simRand × VerifierTape Coins => sim.simulate x tape.1 tape.2)
        ≤ epsilon_zk

/-- FS/ROM observer view adds only the observer's own queries and full 256-bit
answers, not the honest prover's private hash-input log. -/
structure ROMView (Statement M C : Type) where
  publicView : PublicView Statement M C
  observerOracle : List (Bytes × (Fin 32 → UInt8))

/-- Future FS/ROM experiment/compiler operations, all data. The adversary class,
query caps, encodings, memoization/programming policy and concrete compiler are
lead decisions. Both sides receive the SAME honest prover / simulator objects
used by HVZK. No compiler correctness or computational assumption is a field. -/
structure FSExperiments (Statement M C Coins : Type) where
  adversary : Type
  realRand : Type
  idealRand : Type
  real : (h : HonestProver Statement M C) → adversary → Statement →
    h.witness → realRand → ROMView Statement M C
  ideal : Simulator Statement M C Coins → adversary → Statement →
    idealRand → ROMView Statement M C
  observe : adversary → ROMView Statement M C → Bool

/-- Separate, unproved FS/ROM distinguishing-advantage target. No implication
from interactive HVZK is asserted; the exact games/adversary class remain data.
In particular this does not select a seed assumption or a query budget. -/
def ZK_FS (h : HonestProver X M C) (paymentWitness : X → h.witness → Prop)
    (sim : Simulator X M C Coins) (fs : FSExperiments X M C Coins)
    [Fintype fs.realRand] [Nonempty fs.realRand]
    [Fintype fs.idealRand] [Nonempty fs.idealRand] (epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.adversary) (x : X) (w : h.witness), paymentWitness x w →
    |R0Z.mean (fun r => if fs.observe adv (fs.real h adv x w r) then 1 else 0) -
      R0Z.mean (fun r => if fs.observe adv (fs.ideal sim adv x r) then 1 else 0)|
      ≤ epsilon_fs

/-! Exact R0 type aliases; no clone of TypedContext, SemMsg, Msg or Chal. -/
abbrev Statement (K : Type) [Field K] (Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K) :=
  R0P.SemSource.TypedContext K Sfield
abbrev Msg (K : Type) [Field K] := R0C.SemStatement.Msg K K (R0P.SemSource.SemMsg K)
abbrev Chal (K : Type) [Field K] := R0C.SemStatement.Chal K K

/-- Like SemStatement.Obligations: only operations/data and structural typeclass
instances are parameters. There is no assumed privacy, sampler law, mask-image
condition or computational assumption. Passing SemD3Glue.sourceData (or its
field-generic sourceDataWithFallback) reuses its paymentWitness literally. -/
def Obligations {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}
    (h : HonestProver (Statement K Sfield) (Msg K) (Chal K))
    (s : R0C.SemStatement.SourceData (K := K) (E := K)
      (Statement K Sfield) (R0P.SemSource.SemMsg K) h.witness Sfield)
    (v : ModelSamplers (Statement K Sfield) (Msg K) (Chal K) Internal I A Coins)
    (sim : Simulator (Statement K Sfield) (Msg K) (Chal K) Coins)
    (fs : FSExperiments (Statement K Sfield) (Msg K) (Chal K) Coins)
    [Fintype h.rand] [Nonempty h.rand] [Fintype sim.simRand] [Nonempty sim.simRand]
    [Fintype Coins] [Nonempty Coins] [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A]
    [Fintype A] [Nonempty A] [Fintype fs.realRand] [Nonempty fs.realRand]
    [Fintype fs.idealRand] [Nonempty fs.idealRand]
    (epsilon_zk epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  HVZK h s.paymentWitness v sim epsilon_zk ∧ ZK_FS h s.paymentWitness sim fs epsilon_fs

/-- Honest operations separated from their relation: this constructor installs
sourceData.paymentWitness directly, rather than asking for it as a premise. -/
structure ProverOperations (Statement M C W R : Type) where
  messages : Statement → W → R → (i : Round) → ChallengePrefix C i → M
  finish : Statement → W → R → Rows M C 31 → M × PublicOutputs

abbrev proverForSource {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield K}
    {W R : Type}
    (s : R0C.SemStatement.SourceData (K := K) (E := K)
      (Statement K Sfield) (R0P.SemSource.SemMsg K) W Sfield)
    (ops : ProverOperations (Statement K Sfield) (Msg K) (Chal K) W R) :
    HonestProver (Statement K Sfield) (Msg K) (Chal K) where
  witness := W
  rand := R
  messages := ops.messages
  finish := ops.finish
  valid := s.paymentWitness

open R0P.SemD3Glue AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

/-- The actual combined sampler, with only a finite-tape realizer left open.
No replacement protocol or independently uniform field challenge is installed.
Its retained duplex state is internal; every challenge value is public. -/
def combinedSamplers {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield SemE} {L : Nat}
    (p : FS2.Duplex.Params (Msg SemE) (Chal SemE) L)
    (draw : Round → FS.Prefix (Statement SemE Sfield) (Msg SemE)
      (FS2.Duplex.Chal (Chal SemE)) → Msg SemE → Coins → FS2.Duplex.Chal (Chal SemE)) :
    ModelSamplers (Statement SemE Sfield) (Msg SemE) (Chal SemE)
      (FS2.Duplex.Chal (Chal SemE)) (FS2.Duplex.Addr L) State Coins where
  samp := combinedSampler p
  draw := draw
  project := Prod.fst

/-- Concrete connection to the same reference model as combinedProtocol.
The field-generic Obligations above remains available. Here witness = Trace,
valid = sourceData.paymentWitness and samp = combinedProtocol.samp by definition.
The encoding/decoder parameters p are precisely the soundness model's data;
freezing its concrete decoder identities is not a privacy assumption. -/
def R0Obligations {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield SemE} {L : Nat} {R : Type}
    (B : R0P.PackBasis (Sfield 0))
    (p : FS2.Duplex.Params (Msg SemE) (Chal SemE) L)
    (ops : ProverOperations (Statement SemE Sfield) (Msg SemE) (Chal SemE) (R0P.Trace SemE) R)
    (draw : Round → FS.Prefix (Statement SemE Sfield) (Msg SemE)
      (FS2.Duplex.Chal (Chal SemE)) → Msg SemE → Coins → FS2.Duplex.Chal (Chal SemE))
    (sim : Simulator (Statement SemE Sfield) (Msg SemE) (Chal SemE) Coins)
    (fs : FSExperiments (Statement SemE Sfield) (Msg SemE) (Chal SemE) Coins)
    [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] [Fintype Coins] [Nonempty Coins]
    [Fintype sim.simRand] [Nonempty sim.simRand]
    [Fintype fs.realRand] [Nonempty fs.realRand]
    [Fintype fs.idealRand] [Nonempty fs.idealRand]
    (epsilon_zk epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  Obligations (proverForSource (sourceData B) ops) (sourceData B)
    (combinedSamplers p draw) sim fs epsilon_zk epsilon_fs
