namespace R0Z.ZkStatement
noncomputable section
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView Polynomial
open AspisWide.InitialEncoder AspisWide.Agreement AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/- Finiteness of the payload cells, used only inside the proofs of the law
theorems (AffineLaw and AbsorptionLaw take `[Fintype V]` for the payload space).
R1-0: derived here for every `Bat` with `[Fintype Bat]`; `R0Bat` is finite, so the
law theorems instantiate at the R0 instance. -/
deriving instance Fintype for PayloadCell
deriving instance Fintype for R0Z.R0Batched.R0Bat

abbrev Statement (K CommitHandle : Type) := Public K × CommitHandle
abbrev Challenges (K : Type) [Field K] := HonestView.Challenges K
abbrev Payload (K Bat : Type) := HonestView.Payload K Bat

/-- The transfer-instance builder is deliberately uninstantiated. No relation,
affinity, mask-image, privacy or completeness fact is a structure field. -/
structure HonestProver (K : Type) where
  Instance : Type
  transport : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024
  «public» : Instance → Public K
  build : Instance → Trace K

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

abbrev HonestInstance (h : HonestProver K) (F : Subfield K) :=
  h.Instance × EligibleNoise K F

def «public» (h : HonestProver K) (w : HonestInstance h F) : Public K := h.public w.1

def build (h : HonestProver K) (w : HonestInstance h F) : Trace K :=
  applyEligible (h.build w.1) w.2

/-- Handles are nominal names derived from the public commitment namespace.
All auxiliary outputs/encodings are public data, parameterised only by x,ch.
Their source byte/account refinement is D7, outside this interactive model. -/
structure Meta (K CommitHandle Aux : Type) [Field K] where
  statement : Statement K CommitHandle
  challenges : Challenges K
  handles : Fin 2 → CommitHandle × Fin 2
  publicOutputs : Aux

abbrev View (K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type) [Field K] := Meta K CommitHandle Aux × Payload K Bat

/-- The type itself excludes any dependency on instance, eligible noise or tape. -/
def metadata (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ch : Challenges K) : Meta K CommitHandle Aux :=
  ⟨x, ch, fun i => (x.2, i), outputs x ch⟩

def payload (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K) : AffTape K F → Payload K Bat :=
  HonestView.run h.transport x.1 B (build h w) ch

def view (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : AffTape K F) : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  (metadata outputs x ch, payload h B x w ch r)

/-- A and b are payload-valued: Meta has no fictitious vector-space instance. -/
def A (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K) : AffTape K F →ₗ[F] Payload K Bat :=
  (payloadAffine h.transport x.1 B (build h w) ch).linear

def b (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K) : Payload K Bat := payload h B x w ch 0

theorem payload_affine (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : AffTape K F) : payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch r = b h B x w ch + A h B x w ch r := by
  simp only [payload, b, A, HonestView.run_eq_payloadAffine]
  have he := congrFun (AffineMap.decomp (payloadAffine (Bat := Bat) h.transport x.1 B (build h w) ch)) r
  exact he.trans (add_comm _ _)

/-- Actual trace affinity is established by MaskLayout, and the only nonlinear
semantic operation in the fixed instance is split by ViewAffine.originalAt_affine.
All later evaluations, sums, interpolation, encoding and opening maps are linear. -/
theorem view_affine (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : AffTape K F) : view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch r =
      (metadata outputs x ch, b h B x w ch + A h B x w ch r) := by
  exact congrArg (fun p => (metadata outputs x ch, p)) (payload_affine h B x w ch r)

/-- Historical D4′/D4″ statement, superseded by lead decision D11. Kept with
its accepted Z3 theorem; D11's joint-tape experiment is in R0Z.JointView.
This old definition quantifies over augmented instances (w,e). The public
comparison uses x.1 because x.2 is the ideal public handle namespace. -/
def MaskImage (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ w w' ch, «public» h w = x.1 → «public» h w' = x.1 →
    LinearMap.range (A (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = LinearMap.range (A (Bat := Bat) h B x w' ch) ∧
    b (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - b h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h B x w ch)

def InLanguage (h : HonestProver K) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∃ w : HonestInstance h F, «public» h w = x.1

/-- Classical choice is used only for a statement in the language. Outside it
all privacy quantifiers are vacuous; no default witness is assumed. -/
def simulator (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage (F := F) h x) (ch : Challenges K) :
    AffTape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  view h B outputs x (Classical.choose hx) ch

/-- The real ideal-tape experiment includes independent eligible noise. -/
def honestLawRun (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (tape : EligibleNoise K F × AffTape K F) : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  view h B outputs x (w, tape.1) ch tape.2

def HVZK_conditional (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage (F := F) h x) w ch, «public» h w = x.1 →
    EqualLaws (view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simulator h B outputs x hx ch)

/-- D8, epsilon = 0: equality of laws of the complete (metadata,payload) pair.
Challenges are fixed first and universally quantified, not conditioned good. -/
def HVZK_perfect (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage (F := F) h x) (w : h.Instance) ch, h.public w = x.1 →
    EqualLaws (honestLawRun (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simulator h B outputs x hx ch)

/-- General distance notation is retained; the target used here is exactly 0. -/
def HVZK (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage (F := F) h x) (w : h.Instance) ch, h.public w = x.1 →
    dist (honestLawRun (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simulator h B outputs x hx ch) ≤ epsilon

/-- D2's relation is literally sourceData.paymentWitness (SemD3Glue:98,111).
This is an obligation on the uninstantiated builder, not a witness premise. -/
def Completeness (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : HonestInstance h F) ch r, «public» h w = x.1 →
    InputNoteExtracted x.1 (applyAff B (prepare x.1 (build h w) ch) r)

def Obligations (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  MaskImage (Bat := Bat) h B x ∧ Completeness h B x

/-- Word-valued outputs belong to the prover; View has no trace or whole word. -/
structure ProverOutput (K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type) [Field K] where
  W : Fin 29 → InitialWord K
  C2 : Fin 2 → InitialWord K
  disclosed : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat

def proverOutput (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : AffTape K F) : ProverOutput K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  let t := applyAff B (prepare x.1 (build h w) ch) r
  ⟨fun c => if c.val = 26 ∨ c.val = 27 then 0 else exactInitialEncoder (coeffsOf h.transport t c),
    fun j => exactInitialEncoder (coeffsOf h.transport t (if j.val = 0 then 26 else 27)),
    view h B outputs x w ch r⟩

inductive IdealSemMsg (K CommitHandle : Type) [Field K]
  | none
  | c2 (handle : CommitHandle × Fin 2)
  | maskSum (s : K)
  | roundPoly (p : K[X])

abbrev Msg (K CommitHandle : Type) [Field K] :=
  R0C.SemStatement.Msg K K (IdealSemMsg K CommitHandle)
abbrev Chal (K : Type) [Field K] := MaskedProtocol.Chal K

def coefficientPolynomial {n : Nat} (p : Fin n → K) : K[X] :=
  ∑ i : Fin n, monomial i.val (p i)

/-- The actual 32-row schedule, with only the ideal C2 word-to-handle projection
changed from the soundness outer message tags. Repeated disclosures use the
same payload coordinates; query openings are the final response projection. -/
def messages (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (p : Payload K R0Z.R0Batched.R0Bat) (i : Fin 32) :
    Msg K CommitHandle :=
  match MaskedProtocol.schedule i with
  | .lambda | .chi | .zerocheck _ | .mu => .semantic .none
  | .c2Theta => .semantic (.c2 (x.2, 1))
  | .maskSumEta => .semantic (.maskSum (p .maskSum))
  | .sumcheck j => .semantic (.roundPoly (coefficientPolynomial (fun k => p (.semanticCoeff j k))))
  | .circle j => if j.val = 0 then .beforeZ0 (fun j c => p (.pointClaim j c))
      else .beforeZ1 (fun c => p (.ood 0 c))
  | .opening j => if j.val = 0 then .opening (.values (fun c z => p (.ood z c)))
      else if j.val = 1 then .opening (.scalar (p .inactiveSum))
      else if j.val = 2 then .opening .unit
      else if j.val = 3 then .opening (.poly (coefficientPolynomial (fun k => p (.bat (.openingCoeff k)))))
      else .opening (.final (fun k => p (.bat (.finalCoeff k))))

def honestMessages (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : HonestInstance h F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (r : AffTape K F) (i : Fin 32) : Msg K CommitHandle :=
  messages x (payload (Bat := R0Z.R0Batched.R0Bat) h B x w ch r) i

/-- The nullary opening tag is accompanied by exactly the query-gated symbols
in Payload.opened; it never includes the rest of the committed words. -/
def finalMessage : Msg K CommitHandle := .opening .opening

def challengeAt (ch : Challenges K) (i : Fin 32) : Chal K :=
  if h : i.val < 25 then .semantic (ch.sem ⟨i.val, h⟩)
  else if h : i.val < 27 then .circle (ch.circle ⟨i.val-25, by omega⟩)
  else if h : i.val < 31 then .opening (.field (ch.opening ⟨i.val-27, by omega⟩))
  else .opening (.set ch.queries)

#print axioms view_affine
#print axioms MaskImage
#print axioms HVZK_perfect
#print axioms Completeness
#print axioms Obligations
#print axioms proverOutput
#print axioms messages
end

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]

/-- R0's batched cells: opening-relation and final-fold coefficients. -/
inductive R0Bat
  | openingCoeff (coefficient : Fin 7)
  | finalCoeff (coefficient : Fin 256)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The pre-refactor R0 read of the batched block (HonestView, former
`linearPayload` branches `.openingCoeff`/`.finalCoeff`). -/
def r0Read (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) : Trace K →ₗ[K] (R0Bat → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun b => match b with
  | .openingCoeff i => (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val).comp
      ((relationLinear (openingWeights π ch)).comp (batchLinear π ch))
  | .finalCoeff i => (LinearMap.proj i).comp ((foldLinear (ch.opening 3)).comp (batchLinear π ch))

instance instBatchedLayer : BatchedLayer K R0Bat where
  read := r0Read

/-- R0 payload cells, as before the refactor. -/
abbrev R0Payload (K : Type) := Payload K R0Bat

attribute [local irreducible] batchLinear openingWeights relationLinear

/-- The former `run` branch `.openingCoeff i`. -/
theorem read_openingCoeff (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 7) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (R0Bat.openingCoeff i) =
      (roundPolynomial (batchLinear π ch t) (openingWeights π ch)).coeff i.val := by
  change (Polynomial.lcoeff K i.val) (relationLinear (openingWeights π ch) (batchLinear π ch t)) = _
  rw [Polynomial.lcoeff_apply, relationLinear_apply]

/-- The former `run` branch `.finalCoeff i`. -/
theorem read_finalCoeff (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (i : Fin 256) :
    BatchedLayer.read π ch t (R0Bat.finalCoeff i) =
      foldMessage (ch.opening 3) (batchLinear π ch t) i := by
  change foldLinear (ch.opening 3) (batchLinear π ch t) i = _
  rw [foldLinear_apply]

#print axioms r0Read
#print axioms read_openingCoeff
#print axioms read_finalCoeff
end R0Z.R0Batched

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCoefficients51
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitNativeQ48.source ProverCommitQArray48.array

theorem cell (p : Nat → Old.Q) (j : Usize) :
    coefficients51.cell (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize p) j=
      ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source (p (AspisR1.rowNat j.val))) := by
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hvr⟩ := ProverCommitInactiveRow49.row_exact j
  rw [coefficients51.cell,hr]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ r (by rw [hvr];exact AspisR1.rowNat_lt j.val),hvr]

theorem go (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<1024 → Canonical (p i))
    (n : Nat) (left : U16) (hl : left.val=n) (hn : n≤1024)
    (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ k, k<1024 → Canonical (q k)) :
    ∃ z : Nat → Old.Q,
      coefficients51.go (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize p) left
        (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize q)=ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize z) ∧
      (∀ k, k<1024 → Canonical (z k)) ∧
      ∀ k, k<1024 → decode (z k)=if 1024 - n ≤ k then decode (p (AspisR1.rowNat k)) else decode (q k) := by
  induction n generalizing left q with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u16 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨q,?_,hq,?_⟩
    · rw [coefficients51.go,hz];rfl
    · intro k hk;rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hne : left≠0#u16 := by scalar_tac
    let i := U16.wrapping_sub 1024#u16 left
    have hi : i.val=1024-(n+1) := by
      dsimp only [i]
      rw [U16.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      have hs : UScalar.size .U16=65536 := by rw [UScalar.size_def];decide
      rw [hs]
      change (1024+(65536-left.val))%65536=1024-(n+1)
      rw [hl];omega
    have hib : i.val<1024 := by omega
    have hdec : (U16.wrapping_sub left 1#u16).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitPairCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    let idx := UScalar.cast .Usize i
    have hidx : idx.val=i.val := by scalar_tac
    let v := p (AspisR1.rowNat i.val)
    have hcv : Canonical v := hp _ (AspisR1.rowNat_lt _)
    let next := Function.update q i.val v
    have hcnext : ∀ k, k<1024 → Canonical (next k) := by
      intro k hk
      dsimp only [next]
      by_cases h : k=i.val
      · subst k;rw [Function.update_self];exact hcv
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne h];exact hq k hk
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ih _ hdec (by omega) next hcnext
    refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
    · rw [coefficients51.go]
      simp only [hne,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      change (do
        let cell ← coefficients51.cell (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize p) idx
        let out ← Array.update (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize q) idx cell
        coefficients51.go (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize p) (U16.wrapping_sub left 1#u16) out)=_
      rw [cell]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,hidx]
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.update _ _ idx (by rw [hidx];exact hib),hidx]
      exact hz
    · intro k hk
      rw [hdz k hk]
      by_cases htail : 1024 - n ≤ k
      · rw [if_pos htail,if_pos (by omega)]
      · rw [if_neg htail]
        by_cases hstart : k=i.val
        · rw [hstart,if_pos (by omega)]
          dsimp only [next]
          rw [Function.update_self]
        · have hbefore : ¬1024-(n+1)≤k := by omega
          rw [if_neg hbefore]
          exact congrArg decode (Function.update_of_ne hstart _ _)

theorem exact_result (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<1024 → Canonical (p i)) :
    ∃ z : Nat → Old.Q,
      coefficients51.eval (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize p)=ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize z) ∧
      (∀ k, k<1024 → Canonical (z k)) ∧
      ∀ k, k<1024 → decode (z k)=decode (p (AspisR1.rowNat k)) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := go p hp 1024 1024#u16 rfl (by decide)
    (fun _ => zero) (fun _ _ => zero_canonical)
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · rw [coefficients51.eval,ProverCommitQArray48.repeat_zero]
    exact hz
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [Nat.sub_self,Nat.zero_le,if_true] using hdz k hk

#print axioms cell
#print axioms go
#print axioms exact_result
end R1Z.ProverCommitCoefficients51

theorem rem_value (x d : Usize) (hd : d.val≠0) :
    ∃ z : Usize, x%d=ok z ∧ z.val=x.val%d.val := by
  exact WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec x hd)

  obtain ⟨d,hd,hvd⟩ := rem_value j 4#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨e0,he0,hve0⟩ := div_value j 4#usize (by decide)
  obtain ⟨e,he,hve⟩ := rem_value e0 4#usize (by decide)

  have hlb : b.val<4 := by rw [hvb];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have hlc : c.val<4 := by rw [hvc];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have hld : d.val<4 := by rw [hvd];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
  have hle : e.val<4 := by rw [hve];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)

import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! The natural-number arithmetic model of the R1 D18 digit permutation.
This file says nothing about the Rust bitwise implementation or semantic
correspondence. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1

/-- Five base-four digits reordered by τ = [3,4,2,0,1]. -/
def rowNat (j : Nat) : Nat :=
  64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) + 16 * ((j / 16) % 4) +
    ((j / 64) % 4) + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4)

theorem rowNat_lt (j : Nat) : rowNat j < 1024 := by
  have h0 : j % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h1 : (j / 4) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h2 : (j / 16) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h3 : (j / 64) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h4 : (j / 256) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  unfold rowNat
  omega

/-- Reconstruct a number below 4^5 from its five radix-four digits. -/
theorem radix4_reconstruct (j : Nat) (hj : j < 1024) :
    j = j % 4 + 4 * ((j / 4) % 4) + 16 * ((j / 16) % 4) +
      64 * ((j / 64) % 4) + 256 * ((j / 256) % 4) := by
  have h0 : j % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h1 : (j / 4) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h2 : (j / 16) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h3 : (j / 64) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  have h4 : (j / 256) % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
  omega

/-- Extract the five digits from a bounded radix-four expansion. The quotient
equations are supplied explicitly so arithmetic automation never has to infer
identities between nested divisions. -/
theorem radix4_digit_extract (n a b c d e : Nat)
    (hexpand : n = a + 4 * b + 16 * c + 64 * d + 256 * e)
    (ha : a < 4) (hb : b < 4) (hc : c < 4) (hd : d < 4) (he : e < 4) :
    n % 4 = a ∧ (n / 4) % 4 = b ∧ (n / 16) % 4 = c ∧
      (n / 64) % 4 = d ∧ (n / 256) % 4 = e := by
  have h0 : n % 4 + 4 * (n / 4) = n := Nat.mod_add_div n 4
  have h1 : (n / 4) % 4 + 4 * ((n / 4) / 4) = n / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div (n / 4) 4
  have h2 : ((n / 4) / 4) % 4 + 4 * (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) = (n / 4) / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div ((n / 4) / 4) 4
  have h3 : (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 +
      4 * ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) = ((n / 4) / 4) / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) 4
  have h4 : ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 +
      4 * (((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) = (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4 :=
    Nat.mod_add_div ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) 4
  have hmod4 : (n / 16) % 4 = ((n / 4) / 4) % 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul n 4 4]
  have hmod64 : (n / 64) % 4 = (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul n 4 16]
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul (n / 4) 4 4]
  have hmod256 : (n / 256) % 4 = ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 := by
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul n 4 64]
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul (n / 4) 4 16]
    rw [← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul ((n / 4) / 4) 4 4]
  have hfirst : n % 4 = a := by omega
  have hsecond : (n / 4) % 4 = b := by omega
  have hthird : ((n / 4) / 4) % 4 = c := by omega
  have hfourth : (((n / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 = d := by omega
  have hfifth : ((((n / 4) / 4) / 4) / 4) % 4 = e := by omega
  exact ⟨hfirst, hsecond, hmod4 ▸ hthird, hmod64 ▸ hfourth, hmod256 ▸ hfifth⟩

/-- Output digit 0 is input digit 3. -/
theorem rowNat_digit0 (j : Nat) :
    rowNat j % 4 = (j / 64) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.1

/-- Output digit 1 is input digit 4. -/
theorem rowNat_digit1 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 4) % 4 = (j / 256) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.1

/-- Output digit 2 is input digit 2. -/
theorem rowNat_digit2 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 16) % 4 = (j / 16) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.2.1

/-- Output digit 3 is input digit 0. -/
theorem rowNat_digit3 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 64) % 4 = j % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.2.2.1

/-- Output digit 4 is input digit 1. -/
theorem rowNat_digit4 (j : Nat) :
    (rowNat j / 256) % 4 = (j / 4) % 4 := by
  have hrep : rowNat j = (j / 64) % 4 + 4 * ((j / 256) % 4) +
      16 * ((j / 16) % 4) + 64 * (j % 4) + 256 * ((j / 4) % 4) := by
    unfold rowNat
    omega
  have hx := radix4_digit_extract (rowNat j) ((j / 64) % 4)
    ((j / 256) % 4) ((j / 16) % 4) (j % 4) ((j / 4) % 4) hrep
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)) (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
    (Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega))
  exact hx.2.2.2.2

/-- τ is an involution: the digit permutation swaps 0↔3 and 1↔4. -/
theorem rowNat_involutive (j : Nat) (hj : j < 1024) :
    rowNat (rowNat j) = j := by
  have h0 := rowNat_digit0 j
  have h1 := rowNat_digit1 j
  have h2 := rowNat_digit2 j
  have h3 := rowNat_digit3 j
  have h4 := rowNat_digit4 j
  have hrec := radix4_reconstruct j hj
  change 64 * (rowNat j % 4) + 256 * ((rowNat j / 4) % 4) +
      16 * ((rowNat j / 16) % 4) + ((rowNat j / 64) % 4) +
      4 * ((rowNat j / 256) % 4) = j
  rw [h0, h1, h2, h3, h4]
  omega

def row (j : Fin 1024) : Fin 1024 :=
  ⟨rowNat j.val, rowNat_lt j.val⟩

theorem row_involutive (j : Fin 1024) : row (row j) = j := by
  apply Fin.ext
  exact rowNat_involutive j.val j.isLt

/-- The arithmetic row permutation is represented by an equivalence whose
inverse is itself. This is only the natural-number model. -/
def rowEquiv : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024 where
  toFun := row
  invFun := row
  left_inv := row_involutive
  right_inv := row_involutive

#print axioms rowNat_lt
#print axioms radix4_reconstruct
#print axioms rowNat_digit0
#print axioms rowNat_digit1
#print axioms rowNat_digit2
#print axioms rowNat_digit3
#print axioms rowNat_digit4
#print axioms rowNat_involutive
#print axioms row_involutive
#print axioms rowEquiv

end AspisR1

 | n+1 => polynomial q offset x n+decode (q (offset+n))*x^n

theorem horner_value (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ j, j < 1024 → Canonical (q j))
    (offset : Usize) (n : Nat) (left : U8) (hleft : left.val=n)
    (bound : offset.val+n ≤ 1024) (small : n ≤ 28)
    (x s : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hs : Canonical s) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, horner (sourceArray q) offset left (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x)
        (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source s)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=decode s*(decode x)^n+polynomial q offset.val (decode x) n := by
  induction n generalizing left s with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨s,?_,hs,?_⟩
    · rw [horner,hz];rfl
    · rw [polynomial,pow_zero,mul_one,add_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    have hcast : (UScalar.cast .Usize (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)).val=n := by scalar_tac
    have hidx : (Usize.wrapping_add offset (UScalar.cast .Usize (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8))).val=offset.val+n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisFillValue47.add_val _ _ (by rw [hcast];omega),hcast]

    obtain ⟨next,hnext,hcnext,hdnext⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add product (q (offset.val+n)) hcprod (hq _ (by omega))
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ih _ hdec (by omega) (by omega) next hcnext
    refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
    · rw [horner]
      simp only [hn,if_false,lift,hprod,bind_tc_ok]
      rw [index q _ (by rw [hidx];omega)]
      simp only [hidx,hnext,bind_tc_ok]
      exact hz
    · rw [hdz,hdnext,hdprod,polynomial,pow_succ]
      ring

theorem source_zero : field.QM31.ZERO=ProverCommitNativeQ48.source zero := by
  simp only [field.QM31.ZERO,ProverCommitNativeQ48.source,ProverCommitRelease47.convQ,
    ProverCommitRelease47.convC,fromQ,fromC,zero]

    (a b : Old.Q) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) :

        ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧ Canonical z ∧
      decode z=polynomial q 0 (decode a) 28+polynomial q 28 (decode b) 28 := by
  obtain ⟨left,hl,hcl,hdl⟩ := horner_value q hq 0#usize 28 28#u8 rfl (by scalar_tac) (by omega) a zero ha zero_canonical
  obtain ⟨right,hr,hcr,hdr⟩ := horner_value q hq 28#usize 28 28#u8 rfl (by scalar_tac) (by omega) b zero hb zero_canonical
  obtain ⟨first,hfirst,hcfirst,hdfirst⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add zero left zero_canonical hcl
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.add first right hcfirst hcr
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · simp only [extra,source_zero,hl,hr,hfirst,hz,bind_tc_ok]
  · rw [hdz,hdfirst,hdl,hdr]
    simp only [zero_decode,zero_mul,zero_add,show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl,
      show (28#usize).val=28 from rfl]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def horner
  (q : Array field.QM31 1024#usize) (offset : Std.Usize) (left : Std.U8)
  (x : field.QM31) (sum : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok sum
  else
    let j ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    let q1 ← field.QM31.mul sum x
    let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .Usize j)
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add offset i)
    let q2 ← Array.index_usize q i1
    let next ← field.QM31.add q1 q2
    let i2 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    horner q offset i2 x next
partial_fixpoint

def extra
  (q : Array field.QM31 1024#usize) (a : field.QM31) (b : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  let left ← horner q 0#usize 28#u8 a field.QM31.ZERO
  let right ← horner q 28#usize 28#u8 b field.QM31.ZERO
  let q1 ← field.QM31.add field.QM31.ZERO left
  field.QM31.add q1 right

end AspisR1ProducerRelease47

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitClaims53
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitSuccessorPoint49 (decoded)
open R0P.SemSource

def trace (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) : R0P.Trace QM31Exact := fun l j => decode (c l.val j.val)

theorem value_model (p a : Nat → Old.Q) (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (r : Fin 3) (l : Fin 29)
    (hpoint : toR0 (decoded a)=openingPoints (decoded p) r) :
    ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.value a c l.val=honestClaims (trace c) (decoded p) r l := by
  change AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (toR0 (decoded a)))
    (fun j : Fin 1024 => decode (c l.val j.val))=_
  rw [hpoint]
  rfl

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source
  ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.columns ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.value

theorem exact_result (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (hc : ∀ l, l<29 → ∀ j, j<1024 → Canonical (c l j)) :
    ∃ q : Fin 3 → Nat → Old.Q,
      claims53.all (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) (ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.columns c)=
        ok (Array.make 3#usize [ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize (q 0),
          ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize (q 1),ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize (q 2)]) ∧
      (∀ r i, i<29 → Canonical (q r i)) ∧
      ∀ r : Fin 3, ∀ l : Fin 29, decode (q r l.val)=honestClaims (trace c) (decoded p) r l := by
  obtain ⟨s,a,hpoints,hcs,hca,hmodel⟩ := ProverCommitStatementPoints49.points_exact p hp
  obtain ⟨q0,h0,hc0,hd0⟩ := ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.exact_result p hp c hc
  obtain ⟨q1,h1,hc1,hd1⟩ := ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.exact_result s hcs c hc
  obtain ⟨q2,h2,hc2,hd2⟩ := ProverCommitClaimsColumn53.exact_result a hca c hc
  refine ⟨![q0,q1,q2],?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [claims53.all,hpoints,bind_tc_ok,
      ProverCommitRawSource49.index3_0,ProverCommitRawSource49.index3_1,ProverCommitRawSource49.index3_2,
      h0,h1,h2]
    rfl
  · intro r i hi
    fin_cases r
    · exact hc0 i hi
    · exact hc1 i hi
    · exact hc2 i hi
  · intro r l
    fin_cases r
    · exact (hd0 l.val l.isLt).trans (value_model p p c 0 l (hmodel 0))
    · exact (hd1 l.val l.isLt).trans (value_model p s c 1 l (hmodel 1))
    · exact (hd2 l.val l.isLt).trans (value_model p a c 2 l (hmodel 2))

open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)

def columns (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) : Array (Array field.QM31 1024#usize) 29#usize :=
  ⟨List.ofFn (fun i : Fin 29 => ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize (c i.val)),by simp only [List.length_ofFn];rfl⟩

theorem index (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (i : Usize) (hi : i.val<29) :
    Array.index_usize (columns c) i=ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 1024#usize (c i.val)) := by
  rw [ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok _ _ hi]
  simp only [columns,List.getElem_ofFn]

def value (p : Nat → Old.Q) (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (i : Nat) : QM31Exact :=
  AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
    (AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (R0P.SemSource.toR0 (fun j : Fin 10 => decode (p j.val))))
    (fun j : Fin 1024 => decode (c i j.val))

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitNativeQ48.source ProverCommitQArray48.array columns value

theorem go (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (hc : ∀ i, i<29 → ∀ j, j<1024 → Canonical (c i j))
    (n : Nat) (left : U8) (hl : left.val=n) (hn : n≤29)
    (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ k, k<29 → Canonical (q k)) :
    ∃ z : Nat → Old.Q,
      claims53.go (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) (columns c) left
        (ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize q)=ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize z) ∧
      (∀ k, k<29 → Canonical (z k)) ∧
      ∀ k, k<29 → decode (z k)=if 29-n≤k then value p c k else decode (q k) := by
  induction n generalizing left q with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨q,?_,hq,?_⟩
    · rw [claims53.go,hz];rfl
    · intro k hk;rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hne : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    let i := U8.wrapping_sub 29#u8 left
    have hi : i.val=29-(n+1) := by
      dsimp only [i]
      rw [U8.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      have hs : UScalar.size .U8=256 := by rw [UScalar.size_def];decide
      rw [hs]
      change (29+(256-left.val))%256=29-(n+1)
      rw [hl];omega
    have hib : i.val<29 := by omega
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    let idx := UScalar.cast .Usize i
    have hidx : idx.val=i.val := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨v,hv,hcv,hdv⟩ := ProverCommitMle50.model_result p (c i.val) hp (hc _ hib)
    let next := Function.update q i.val v
    have hcnext : ∀ k, k<29 → Canonical (next k) := by
      intro k hk
      dsimp only [next]
      by_cases h : k=i.val
      · subst k;rw [Function.update_self];exact hcv
      · rw [Function.update_of_ne h];exact hq k hk
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ih _ hdec (by omega) next hcnext
    refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
    · rw [claims53.go]
      simp only [hne,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      change (do
        let col ← Array.index_usize (columns c) idx
        let cell ← mle50.mle (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) col
        let out ← Array.update (ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize q) idx cell
        claims53.go (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) (columns c) (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8) out)=_
      rw [index c idx (by rw [hidx];exact hib)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,hidx,hv]
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.update _ _ idx (by rw [hidx];exact hib),hidx]
      exact hz
    · intro k hk
      rw [hdz k hk]
      by_cases htail : 29-n≤k
      · rw [if_pos htail,if_pos (by omega)]
      · rw [if_neg htail]
        by_cases hstart : k=i.val
        · rw [hstart,if_pos (by omega)]
          dsimp only [next]
          rw [Function.update_self]
          simpa only [value] using hdv
        · have hbefore : ¬29-(n+1)≤k := by omega
          rw [if_neg hbefore]
          exact congrArg decode (Function.update_of_ne hstart _ _)

theorem exact_result (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    (c : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (hc : ∀ i, i<29 → ∀ j, j<1024 → Canonical (c i j)) :
    ∃ z : Nat → Old.Q,
      claims53.eval (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) (columns c)=
        ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 29#usize z) ∧
      (∀ k, k<29 → Canonical (z k)) ∧ ∀ k, k<29 → decode (z k)=value p c k := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := go p hp c hc 29 29#u8 rfl (by decide)
    (fun _ => zero) (fun _ _ => zero_canonical)
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · rw [claims53.eval,ProverCommitQArray48.repeat_zero]
    exact hz
  · intro k hk
    simpa only [Nat.sub_self,Nat.zero_le,if_true] using hdz k hk

#print axioms index
#print axioms go
#print axioms exact_result
end R1Z.ProverCommitClaimsColumn53

def claims53.go

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitRawSource49

open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)

theorem index3_0 {A : Type} (a b c : A) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c]) 0#usize=ok a := by
  rw [ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok _ _ (by decide)]
  rfl

theorem index3_1 {A : Type} (a b c : A) :

  rw [ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok _ _ (by decide)]
  rfl

theorem index3_2 {A : Type} (a b c : A) :
    Array.index_usize (Array.make 3#usize [a,b,c]) 2#usize=ok c := by
  rw [ProverCommitArrayIndex25.array_index_usize_ok _ _ (by decide)]
  rfl

def run (p : Array field.QM31 10#usize) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : field.QM31) (j : Usize) :
    Result (Array field.QM31 7#usize) := do
  let pts ← points.all p
  let p0 ← Array.index_usize pts 0#usize
  let p1 ← Array.index_usize pts 1#usize
  let p2 ← Array.index_usize pts 2#usize
  let a8 ← Array.index_usize p 8#usize
  let a9 ← Array.index_usize p 9#usize
  ProverCommitRawValues49.run p0 p1 p2 a8 a9 x0 y0 x1 y1 j

def model (a : Fin 10 → QM31Exact) (x0 y0 x1 y1 : QM31Exact) (j : Fin 1024) : Fin 7 → QM31Exact :=
  ![AspisR0.Opening.indicator R0P.copyInactiveRows (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints a 0) (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints a 1) (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (openingPoints a 2) (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    libraWeight a j,
    ProverCommitEval47.messageEval (Pi.single j 1) x0 y0,
    ProverCommitEval47.messageEval (Pi.single j 1) x1 y1]

theorem exact_result (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))
    (x0 y0 x1 y1 : Old.Q) (hx0 : Canonical x0) (hy0 : Canonical y0)
    (hx1 : Canonical x1) (hy1 : Canonical y1) (j : Usize) (hj : j.val<1024) :
    ∃ out : Nat → Old.Q,
      run (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x0)
        (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y0) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x1) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y1) j=
        ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 7#usize out) ∧
      (∀ k, k<7 → Canonical (out k)) ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 7, decode (out k.val)=model (decoded p) (decode x0) (decode y0) (decode x1) (decode y1) ⟨j.val,hj⟩ k := by
  obtain ⟨s,a,hpoints,hcs,hca,hmodel⟩ := ProverCommitStatementPoints49.points_exact p hp
  let ps : Fin 3 → Nat → Old.Q := ![p,s,a]
  have hc : ∀ k i, i<10 → Canonical (ps k i) := by
    intro k i hi
    fin_cases k
    · exact hp i hi
    · exact hcs i hi
    · exact hca i hi
  obtain ⟨out,hout,hcout,hdout⟩ := ProverCommitRawValues49.exact_result ps hc (p 8) (p 9) x0 y0 x1 y1
    (hp 8 (by decide)) (hp 9 (by decide)) hx0 hy0 hx1 hy1 j hj
  have hm : ProverCommitRawValues49.model ps (p 8) (p 9) x0 y0 x1 y1 ⟨j.val,hj⟩=
      model (decoded p) (decode x0) (decode y0) (decode x1) (decode y1) ⟨j.val,hj⟩ := by
    unfold ProverCommitRawValues49.model model
    have h0 : ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (ps 0 i.val))=openingPoints (decoded p) 0 := hmodel 0
    have h1 : ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (ps 1 i.val))=openingPoints (decoded p) 1 := hmodel 1
    have h2 : ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (ps 2 i.val))=openingPoints (decoded p) 2 := hmodel 2
    rw [h0,h1,h2]
    rfl
  refine ⟨out,?_,hcout,fun k => (hdout k).trans (congrFun hm k)⟩
  · simp only [run,hpoints,bind_tc_ok,index3_0,index3_1,index3_2,
      ProverCommitQArray48.index 10#usize p 8#usize (by decide),ProverCommitQArray48.index 10#usize p 9#usize (by decide)]
    exact hout

open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitStoredCaller49

open ProverCommitRawVector49 (values)

def run (p0 p1 p2 : Array field.QM31 10#usize) (a8 a9 x0 y0 x1 y1 : field.QM31)
    (j : Usize) : Result (Array field.QM31 7#usize) := do
  let a ← ProverCommitInactiveOutput49.run j
  let b ← point p0 j
  let c ← point p1 j
  let d ← point p2 j
  let e ← extras.libra (Array.make 2#usize [a8,a9]) j
  let f ← circle x0 y0 j
  let g ← circle x1 y1 j
  ok (Array.make 7#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g])

def model (p : Fin 3 → Nat → Old.Q) (a8 a9 x0 y0 x1 y1 : Old.Q) (j : Fin 1024) : Fin 7 → QM31Exact :=
  ![AspisR0.Opening.indicator R0P.copyInactiveRows (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i => decode (p 0 i.val))) (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i => decode (p 1 i.val))) (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight (ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i => decode (p 2 i.val))) (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm j),
    (if j.val<28 then decode a8^j.val else if j.val<56 then decode a9^(j.val-28) else 0),
    ProverCommitEval47.messageEval (Pi.single j 1) (decode x0) (decode y0),
    ProverCommitEval47.messageEval (Pi.single j 1) (decode x1) (decode y1)]

theorem exact_result (p : Fin 3 → Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ k i, i<10 → Canonical (p k i))
    (a8 a9 x0 y0 x1 y1 : Old.Q) (ha8 : Canonical a8) (ha9 : Canonical a9)
    (hx0 : Canonical x0) (hy0 : Canonical y0) (hx1 : Canonical x1) (hy1 : Canonical y1)
    (j : Usize) (hj : j.val<1024) :
    ∃ out : Nat → Old.Q,
      run (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize (p 0)) (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize (p 1))
        (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize (p 2)) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a8) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a9)
        (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x0) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y0) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x1) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y1) j=
        ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 7#usize out) ∧
      (∀ k, k<7 → Canonical (out k)) ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 7, decode (out k.val)=model p a8 a9 x0 y0 x1 y1 ⟨j.val,hj⟩ k := by
  obtain ⟨h0,hc0,hv0⟩ := ProverCommitInactiveOutput49.exact_result j hj
  obtain ⟨b,hb,hcb,hvb⟩ := point_exact (p 0) (hp 0) j hj
  obtain ⟨c,hc,hcc,hvc⟩ := point_exact (p 1) (hp 1) j hj
  obtain ⟨d,hd,hcd,hvd⟩ := point_exact (p 2) (hp 2) j hj
  obtain ⟨e,he,hce,hve⟩ := ProverCommitLibra49.exact_result a8 a9 ha8 ha9 j
  obtain ⟨f,hf,hcf,hvf⟩ := circle_exact x0 y0 hx0 hy0 j hj
  obtain ⟨g,hg,hcg,hvg⟩ := circle_exact x1 y1 hx1 hy1 j hj
  let out := values (ProverCommitInactiveModel49.raw j) b c d e f g
  refine ⟨out,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · have ha : ProverCommitQArray48.array 2#usize (ProverCommitLibra49.entries a8 a9)=
        Array.make 2#usize [ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a8,ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a9] := by
      apply Subtype.ext;rfl
    unfold ProverCommitLibra49.run at he
    rw [ha] at he
    simp only [run,h0,hb,hc,hd,he,hf,hg,bind_tc_ok]
    exact congrArg Result.ok (ProverCommitRawVector49.array_values _ _ _ _ _ _ _).symm
  · intro k hk
    exact ProverCommitRawVector49.canonical _ _ _ _ _ _ _ hc0 hcb hcc hcd hce hcf hcg k
  · intro k
    dsimp only [out]
    rw [ProverCommitRawVector49.map_values decode (ProverCommitInactiveModel49.raw j) b c d e f g k]
    simp only [hv0,hvb,hvc,hvd,hve,hvf,hvg]
    rfl

#print axioms exact_result
end R1Z.ProverCommitRawValues49

/-! The actual initialized point/circle matrices feed the actual stored

noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStoredCaller49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47

theorem array_congr (size : Usize) (a b : Nat → Old.Q) (h : ∀ i, i<size.val → a i=b i) :
    ProverCommitQArray48.array size a=ProverCommitQArray48.array size b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext i
  rw [h i.val i.isLt]

def point (p : Array field.QM31 10#usize) (j : Usize) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let rows ← point_rows.all p
  stored.product rows j 0#usize 5#u8 field.QM31.ONE

theorem point_exact (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i)) (j : Usize) (hj : j.val<1024) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, point (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) j=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight
        (ProverCommitPointWeight49.reverse (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (p i.val)))
        (AspisR1.rowEquiv.symm ⟨j.val,hj⟩) := by
  obtain ⟨rows,hrows,hcrows,heq⟩ := ProverCommitPointRowsOutput49.all p hp
  have harr : ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize (selected rows j)=
      ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize
        (ProverCommitPointWeight49.selected (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) (fun i => hp i.val i.isLt) ⟨j.val,hj⟩) := by
    apply array_congr
    intro i hi
    change i<5 at hi
    rw [selected,heq ⟨i,hi⟩]
    simp only [ProverCommitPointRows49.target,ProverCommitPointWeight49.selected,Fin.val_mk,dif_pos hi]
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ProverCommitPointWeight49.point_raw_exact
    (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) (fun i => hp i.val i.isLt) ⟨j.val,hj⟩
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,hdz⟩
  rw [point,hrows]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [binding rows j 5 0#usize 5#u8 rfl (by decide),harr]
  exact hz

def circle (x y : field.QM31) (j : Usize) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let rows ← factors.circle_rows x y
  stored.product rows j 0#usize 5#u8 field.QM31.ONE

theorem circle_exact (x y : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) (j : Usize) (hj : j.val<1024) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, circle (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y) j=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=ProverCommitEval47.messageEval (Pi.single (⟨j.val,hj⟩ : Fin 1024) 1) (decode x) (decode y) := by
  have hr := (ProverCommitCircleWeight49.rows_spec x y hx hy).1
  have harr : ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize (selected (ProverCommitCircleWeight49.rows x y hx hy) j)=
      ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize (ProverCommitCircleWeight49.selected x y hx hy ⟨j.val,hj⟩) := by
    apply array_congr
    intro i hi
    change i<5 at hi
    simp only [selected,ProverCommitCircleWeight49.selected,dif_pos hi]
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz,_⟩ := ProverCommitCircleCaller49.raw_message x y hx hy ⟨j.val,hj⟩
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,hdz⟩
  rw [circle,hr]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [binding _ j 5 0#usize 5#u8 rfl (by decide),harr]
  exact hz

#print axioms array_congr
#print axioms point_exact
#print axioms circle_exact
end R1Z.ProverCommitStoredCaller49

import AspisR1ProducerRelease47.Stored49
import R1Z.ProverCommitCircleRows49
import R1Z.ProverCommitWeightDigit49
import R1Z.ProverCommitFactorProduct49
/-! Actual stored matrix reads and source shift/mask digits feed the already
proved five-factor product. No factor-array image is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStoredProduct49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open ProverCommitCircleRows49

def selected (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (j : Usize) (d : Nat) : Old.Q :=
  rows d ((j.val/4^d)%4)

theorem matrix_index (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<5) :
    Array.index_usize (matrix rows) d=ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize (rows d.val)) := by
  rw [matrix,ProverCommitArray49.index _ _ _ hd]

attribute [local irreducible] matrix ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source

theorem binding (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (j : Usize) (n : Nat)
    (d : Usize) (left : U8) (hleft : left.val=n) (bound : d.val+n≤5) (acc : field.QM31) :
    stored.product (matrix rows) j d left acc=
      factors.product (ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize (selected rows j)) d left acc := by
  induction n generalizing d left acc with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    rw [stored.product,factors.product,hz];rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have hd : d.val<5 := by omega
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    have hinc : (Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize).val=d.val+1 := by
      simpa only [show (1#usize).val=1 from rfl] using
        ProverCommitBasisFillValue47.add_val d 1#usize (by change d.val+1<2048;omega)
    let digit := (Usize.wrapping_shr j (UScalar.cast .U32 (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize d))) &&& 3#usize
    have hdigit : digit.val=(j.val/4^d.val)%4 := ProverCommitWeightDigit49.digit j d hd
    have hdigitbound : digit.val<4 := by rw [hdigit];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
    have ht : ∀ a, stored.product (matrix rows) j (Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize) (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8) a=
        factors.product (ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize (selected rows j)) (Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize) (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8) a :=
      fun a => ih _ _ hdec (by rw [hinc];omega) a
    rw [stored.product,factors.product]
    simp only [hn,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok,matrix_index rows d hd]
    change (do
      let q ← Array.index_usize (ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize (rows d.val)) digit
      let next ← field.QM31.mul acc q
      stored.product (matrix rows) j (Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize) (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8) next)=_
    rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ hdigitbound,ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ hd]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,ht,selected,hdigit]

#print axioms matrix_index
#print axioms binding
end R1Z.ProverCommitStoredProduct49

import AspisR1ProducerRelease47.Basis
/-! Extracted counter owner, with identical arithmetic callees rebound to the
previously proved release extraction. bind-counter.py checks every reused
callee declaration body byte-for-byte. No external template is installed. -/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def stored.product
  (rows : Array (Array field.QM31 4#usize) 5#usize) (j : Std.Usize)
  (d : Std.Usize) (left : Std.U8) (acc : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok acc
  else
    let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize d)
    let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i)
    let i2 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_shr j i1)
    let digit ← lift (i2 &&& 3#usize)
    let a ← Array.index_usize rows d
    let q ← Array.index_usize a digit
    let next ← field.QM31.mul acc q
    let i3 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize)
    let i4 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    stored.product rows j i3 i4 next
partial_fixpoint

end AspisR1ProducerRelease47

def matrix (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) : Array (Array field.QM31 4#usize) 5#usize :=
  ProverCommitArray49.array 5#usize (fun i => ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize (rows i))

theorem matrix_update (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q) (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<5) (row : Nat → Old.Q) :
    Array.update (matrix rows) d (ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize row)=
      ok (matrix (Function.update rows d.val row)) := by
  rw [matrix,ProverCommitArray49.update 5#usize _ d hd]
  apply congrArg Result.ok
  unfold matrix
  congr 1
  funext i
  by_cases he : i=d.val
  · subst i;simp only [Function.update_self]
  · simp only [Function.update_of_ne he]

theorem zero_matrix : Array.repeat 5#usize (Array.repeat 4#usize field.QM31.ZERO)=matrix (fun _ _ => zero) := by
  rw [ProverCommitQArray48.repeat_zero]
  apply Subtype.ext
  simp only [Array.repeat,matrix,ProverCommitArray49.array,List.ofFn_const]

theorem line_exact (x y : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :

  · intro k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [ProverCommitFactors49.quad,one_decode,hdxy]

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error

namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def factors.line
  (x : field.QM31) (y : field.QM31) : Result (Array field.QM31 4#usize) := do
  let q ← field.QM31.mul x y
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ field.QM31.ONE, x, y, q ])

def factors.lines
  (out : Array (Array field.QM31 4#usize) 5#usize) (d : Std.Usize)
  (left : Std.U8) (x : field.QM31) :
  Result (Array (Array field.QM31 4#usize) 5#usize)
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok out
  else
    let y ← factors.double x
    let a ← factors.line x y
    let out1 ← Array.update out d a
    let next ← factors.double y
    let i ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize)
    let i1 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    factors.lines out1 i i1 next

  (x : field.QM31) (y : field.QM31) :
  Result (Array (Array field.QM31 4#usize) 5#usize)
  := do
  let a := Array.repeat 4#usize field.QM31.ZERO
  let out := Array.repeat 5#usize a
  let a1 ← factors.circle x y
  let out1 ← Array.update out 0#usize a1
  let q ← factors.double x
  factors.lines out1 1#usize 4#u8 q

import AspisR1ProducerRelease47.Basis
/-! Extracted counter owner, with identical arithmetic callees rebound to the
previously proved release extraction. bind-counter.py checks every reused
callee declaration body byte-for-byte. No external template is installed. -/
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow Error
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1ProducerRelease47
def factors.point
  (a : field.QM31) (b : field.QM31) : Result (Array field.QM31 4#usize) := do
  let q ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE a
  let q1 ← field.QM31.sub field.QM31.ONE b
  let q2 ← field.QM31.mul q q1
  let q3 ← field.QM31.mul a q1
  let q4 ← field.QM31.mul q b
  let q5 ← field.QM31.mul a b
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ q2, q3, q4, q5 ])

def factors.circle
  (x : field.QM31) (y : field.QM31) : Result (Array field.QM31 4#usize) := do
  let q ← field.QM31.mul x y
  ok (Array.make 4#usize [ field.QM31.ONE, y, x, q ])

def factors.double (x : field.QM31) : Result field.QM31 := do
  let q ← field.QM31.mul x x
  let q1 ← field.QM31.add q q
  field.QM31.sub q1 field.QM31.ONE

def factors.product
  (q : Array field.QM31 5#usize) (i : Std.Usize) (left : Std.U8)
  (s : field.QM31) :
  Result field.QM31
  := do
  if left = 0#u8
  then ok s
  else
    let q1 ← Array.index_usize q i
    let next ← field.QM31.mul s q1
    let i1 ← lift (Std.Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize)
    let i2 ← lift (Std.U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8)
    factors.product q i1 i2 next
partial_fixpoint

end AspisR1ProducerRelease47

import AspisR1ProducerRelease47.Factors49
import R1Z.ProverCommitQArray48
import R1Z.ProverCommitSampleTail49
import R1Z.ProverCommitPointTensor49
import AspisFormal.V5FriNaturalBasisRadix4
/-! Canonical source-owned point and circle factor cells. No constructor or
geometric row correspondence is assumed by these arithmetic laws. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFactors49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open ProverCommitSubtraction47 (one one_canonical one_decode)
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)

def quad (a b c d : Old.Q) (k : Nat) : Old.Q :=
  if k=0 then a else if k=1 then b else if k=2 then c else d

theorem quad_array (a b c d : Old.Q) :
    Array.make 4#usize [ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a,ProverCommitNativeQ48.source b,
        ProverCommitNativeQ48.source c,ProverCommitNativeQ48.source d]=
      ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize (quad a b c d) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

theorem quad_canonical (a b c d : Old.Q) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b)
    (hc : Canonical c) (hd : Canonical d) (k : Nat) : Canonical (quad a b c d k) := by
  unfold quad
  split
  · exact ha
  · split
    · exact hb
    · split
      · exact hc
      · exact hd

theorem point_exact (a b : Old.Q) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) :
    ∃ out : Nat → Old.Q, factors.point (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source b)=
      ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize out) ∧
      (∀ k, k<4 → Canonical (out k)) ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 4, decode (out k.val)=ProverCommitPointTensor49.pairFactor (decode a) (decode b) k.val := by
  obtain ⟨na,hna,hcna,hdna⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.sub one a one_canonical ha
  obtain ⟨nb,hnb,hcnb,hdnb⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.sub one b one_canonical hb
  obtain ⟨p0,hp0,hcp0,hdp0⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul na nb hcna hcnb
  obtain ⟨p1,hp1,hcp1,hdp1⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul a nb ha hcnb
  obtain ⟨p2,hp2,hcp2,hdp2⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul na b hcna hb
  obtain ⟨p3,hp3,hcp3,hdp3⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul a b ha hb
  refine ⟨quad p0 p1 p2 p3,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [factors.point,ProverCommitSampleTail49.source_one,hna,hnb,hp0,hp1,hp2,hp3,
      bind_tc_ok,quad_array]
  · intro k hk
    exact quad_canonical _ _ _ _ hcp0 hcp1 hcp2 hcp3 k
  · intro k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [quad,ProverCommitPointTensor49.pairFactor,hdp0,hdp1,hdp2,hdp3,hdna,hdnb,one_decode]

theorem circle_exact (x y : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x) (hy : Canonical y) :
    ∃ out : Nat → Old.Q, factors.circle (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source y)=
      ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize out) ∧
      (∀ k, k<4 → Canonical (out k)) ∧
      ∀ k : Fin 4, decode (out k.val)=![1,decode y,decode x,decode x*decode y] k := by
  obtain ⟨xy,hxy,hcxy,hdxy⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul x y hx hy
  refine ⟨quad one y x xy,?_,?_,?_⟩

  · intro k hk
    exact quad_canonical _ _ _ _ one_canonical hy hx hcxy k
  · intro k
    fin_cases k <;> simp [quad,one_decode,hdxy]

    ∃ z : Old.Q, factors.double (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source x)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧

R1Z.ProverCommitPointTensor49:
import D18Transport
import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Fin
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.Basic
import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum
import Lean.Elab.Tactic.Omega

/-! Arithmetic equivalence between the ten binary row factors and the five
radix-four tensor factors. This is a model-level identity only. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPointTensor49
open AspisR1

open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def d18Tau (d : Fin 5) : Fin 5 :=
  ⟨if d.val = 0 then 3 else if d.val = 3 then 0 else
    if d.val = 1 then 4 else if d.val = 4 then 1 else 2,
    by fin_cases d <;> norm_num⟩

theorem d18Tau_involutive (d : Fin 5) : d18Tau (d18Tau d) = d := by
  apply Fin.ext
  fin_cases d <;> norm_num [d18Tau]

def d18BitIndexEquiv : (Fin 5 × Fin 2) ≃ Fin 10 :=
  { toFun := fun x => ⟨x.2.val + 2 * (d18Tau x.1).val, by
      have hu := x.2.isLt
      have ht := (d18Tau x.1).isLt
      omega⟩
    invFun := fun b =>
      (d18Tau ⟨b.val / 2, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩,
        ⟨b.val % 2, Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)⟩)
    left_inv := by
      rintro ⟨d, u⟩
      apply Prod.ext
      · apply Fin.ext
        have hquot : (u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) / 2 = (d18Tau d).val := by
          have hu := u.isLt
          omega
        change (d18Tau ⟨(u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) / 2, by omega⟩).val = d.val
        have qfin : (⟨(u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) / 2, by omega⟩ : Fin 5) =
            d18Tau d := Fin.ext hquot
        rw [qfin]
        exact congrArg Fin.val (d18Tau_involutive d)
      · apply Fin.ext
        have hu := u.isLt
        change (u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) % 2 = u.val
        omega
    right_inv := by
      intro b
      apply Fin.ext
      have hquot : b.val / 2 < 5 := by have := b.isLt; omega
      change b.val % 2 + 2 *
        (d18Tau (d18Tau ⟨b.val / 2, hquot⟩)).val = b.val
      rw [d18Tau_involutive]
      exact Nat.mod_add_div b.val 2 }

@[simp] theorem d18BitIndexEquiv_val (d : Fin 5) (u : Fin 2) :
    (d18BitIndexEquiv (d, u)).val = u.val + 2 * (d18Tau d).val := rfl

def pairFactor (a b : K) (s : Nat) : K :=
  (if s % 2 = 0 then 1 - a else a) *
    (if s / 2 = 0 then 1 - b else b)

def rowPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) : K :=
  ∏ b : Fin 10, if rowNat j.val / 2 ^ b.val % 2 = 0 then
    1 - p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩
    else p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩

def tensorPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) : K :=
  ∏ d : Fin 5, pairFactor
    (p ⟨9 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
    (p ⟨8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
    ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4)

private theorem mod4_digit_bit (q : Nat) (u : Fin 2) :
    q / 2 ^ u.val % 2 = (q % 4 / 2 ^ u.val) % 2 := by
  fin_cases u
  · norm_num
  · norm_num
    have hsplit : q % 4 + 4 * (q / 4) = q := Nat.mod_add_div q 4
    have hr : q % 4 < 4 := Nat.mod_lt q (by omega)
    omega

private theorem radix4_digit_bit (n k : Nat) (u : Fin 2) :
    n / 2 ^ (2 * k + u.val) % 2 =
      ((n / 4 ^ k) % 4 / 2 ^ u.val) % 2 := by
  have hpow : 2 ^ (2 * k + u.val) = 4 ^ k * 2 ^ u.val := by
    fin_cases u <;> norm_num [pow_add, pow_mul]
  rw [hpow, ← Nat.div_div_eq_div_mul]
  exact mod4_digit_bit (n / 4 ^ k) u

private theorem rowBit_eq_digitBit (j : Nat) (d : Fin 5) (u : Fin 2) :
    rowNat j / 2 ^ (2 * (d18Tau d).val + u.val) % 2 =
      (((j / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) / 2 ^ u.val) % 2 := by
  have hrow := radix4_digit_bit (rowNat j) (d18Tau d).val u
  have hdigit : (rowNat j / 4 ^ (d18Tau d).val) % 4 =
      (j / 4 ^ d.val) % 4 := by
    fin_cases d <;>
      norm_num [d18Tau, rowNat_digit0, rowNat_digit1, rowNat_digit2,
        rowNat_digit3, rowNat_digit4]
  exact hrow.trans (congrArg (fun x : Nat => (x / 2 ^ u.val) % 2) hdigit)

theorem rowPoint_eq_tensorPoint (p : Fin 10 → K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    rowPoint p j = tensorPoint p j := by
  unfold rowPoint tensorPoint
  calc
    (∏ b : Fin 10, if rowNat j.val / 2 ^ b.val % 2 = 0 then
        1 - p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩
        else p ⟨9 - b.val, by have := b.isLt; omega⟩) =
      ∏ x : Fin 5 × Fin 2,
        if rowNat j.val / 2 ^ (d18BitIndexEquiv x).val % 2 = 0 then
          1 - p ⟨9 - (d18BitIndexEquiv x).val, by
            have := (d18BitIndexEquiv x).isLt; omega⟩
        else p ⟨9 - (d18BitIndexEquiv x).val, by
          have := (d18BitIndexEquiv x).isLt; omega⟩ := by
            symm
            apply Fintype.prod_equiv d18BitIndexEquiv
            intro x
            rfl
    _ = ∏ d : Fin 5, pairFactor
        (p ⟨9 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
        (p ⟨8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩)
        ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) := by
      rw [Fintype.prod_prod_type]
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro d hd
      rw [Fin.prod_univ_two]
      have hbit0 := rowBit_eq_digitBit j.val d 0
      have hbit1 := rowBit_eq_digitBit j.val d 1
      simp only [d18BitIndexEquiv_val, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one,
        Nat.zero_add] at ⊢
      have hbit0' : rowNat j.val / 2 ^ (2 * (d18Tau d).val) % 2 =
          ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) % 2 := by
        simpa using hbit0
      have hbit1' : rowNat j.val / 2 ^ (1 + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) % 2 =
          ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4 / 2) % 2 := by
        simpa [Nat.add_comm] using hbit1
      rw [hbit0', hbit1']
      have hp1 : (⟨9 - (1 + 2 * (d18Tau d).val), by
          have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩ : Fin 10) =
          ⟨8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val, by have := (d18Tau d).isLt; omega⟩ := by
        have ht := (d18Tau d).isLt
        apply Fin.ext
        change 9 - (1 + 2 * (d18Tau d).val) = 8 - 2 * (d18Tau d).val
        omega
      rw [hp1]
      simp only [pairFactor]
      have hslt : ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) < 4 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      have hhalf : ((j.val / 4 ^ d.val) % 4) / 2 < 2 := by omega
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hhalf]

#print axioms d18Tau_involutive
#print axioms rowBit_eq_digitBit
#print axioms mod4_digit_bit
#print axioms radix4_digit_bit
#print axioms rowPoint_eq_tensorPoint

end R1Z.ProverCommitPointTensor49

/-! Source shift/mask indices of the five weight factors are the model's
radix-four digits, for every stored index. No table is enumerated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitWeightDigit49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

theorem shift_mask (j : Usize) (s : U32) (small : s.val<32) :
    ((Usize.wrapping_shr j s) &&& 3#usize).val=(j.val/2^s.val)%4 := by
  change ((j.bv.ushiftRight (s.val%UScalarTy.Usize.numBits)) &&& (3#usize).bv).toNat=_
  simp only [BitVec.toNat_and]
  have bits : 32≤UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := System.Platform.le_numBits
  rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (show s.val<UScalarTy.Usize.numBits by omega)]
  change (j.val >>> s.val) &&& 3=_
  rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod _ 2

theorem digit (j : Usize) (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<5) :
    ((Usize.wrapping_shr j (UScalar.cast .U32 (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize d))) &&& 3#usize).val=
      (j.val/4^d.val)%4 := by
  have hm : (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize d).val=2*d.val := by
    rw [Usize.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
    have hsize : 1024<UScalar.size .Usize := by
      rw [UScalar.size_def]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 1024<2^32) (Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by decide) System.Platform.le_numBits)
    change (2*d.val)%UScalar.size .Usize=2*d.val
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hcast : (UScalar.cast .U32 (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize d)).val=2*d.val := by scalar_tac
  rw [shift_mask _ _ (by rw [hcast];omega),hcast,pow_mul]
  rfl

#print axioms shift_mask
#print axioms digit
end R1Z.ProverCommitWeightDigit49

import R1Z.ProverCommitFactors49

/-! All five native raw-product factors, composed by owned-loop induction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitFactorProduct49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open scoped BigOperators

def product (q : Nat → Old.Q) : Nat → Nat → QM31Exact
 | 0,_ => 1
 | n+1,i => decode (q i)*product q n (i+1)

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source

theorem product_value (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ i, i<5 → Canonical (q i))
    (n : Nat) (i : Usize) (left : U8) (hleft : left.val=n) (bound : i.val+n≤5)
    (s : Old.Q) (hs : Canonical s) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, factors.product (ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize q) i left
      (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source s)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=decode s*product q n i.val := by
  induction n generalizing i left s with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨s,?_,hs,?_⟩
    · rw [factors.product,hz];rfl
    · rw [product,mul_one]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have ht : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    have hi : (Usize.wrapping_add i 1#usize).val=i.val+1 := by
      simpa only [show (1#usize).val=1 from rfl] using
        ProverCommitBasisFillValue47.add_val i 1#usize (by change i.val+1<2048;omega)
    obtain ⟨next,hnext,hcnext,hdnext⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul s (q i.val) hs (hq _ (by omega))
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := ih _ _ ht (by rw [hi];omega) next hcnext
    refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
    · rw [factors.product]
      simp only [hn,if_false,ProverCommitQArray48.index 5#usize q i (by change i.val<5;omega),
        hnext,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      exact hz
    · rw [hdz,hdnext,hi,product];ring

theorem product_fin (q : Nat → Old.Q) (n i : Nat) :
    product q n i=∏ j : Fin n, decode (q (i+j.val)) := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => simp only [product,Fin.prod_univ_zero]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [product,ih]
    simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ,Fin.val_zero,Fin.val_succ,Nat.add_zero,
      Nat.add_assoc,Nat.add_left_comm,Nat.add_comm]

theorem raw_exact (q : Nat → Old.Q) (hq : ∀ i, i<5 → Canonical (q i)) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, factors.product (ProverCommitQArray48.array 5#usize q) 0#usize 5#u8 field.QM31.ONE=
      ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧ Canonical z ∧
      decode z=∏ d : Fin 5, decode (q d.val) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := product_value q hq 5 0#usize 5#u8 rfl (by decide)
    ProverCommitSubtraction47.one ProverCommitSubtraction47.one_canonical
  refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
  · rw [ProverCommitSampleTail49.source_one]
    exact hz
  · simpa only [ProverCommitSubtraction47.one_decode,one_mul,product_fin,
      show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl,Nat.zero_add] using hdz

#print axioms product_value

end R1Z.ProverCommitFactorProduct49

namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPointRowsOutput49

import R1Z.ProverCommitPointRowIndex49
import R1Z.ProverCommitCircleRows49
/-! Complete owned point-factor fill, retaining raw row identities for the
subsequent stored-factor lookup. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPointRows49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open ProverCommitCircleRows49
open ProverCommitPointRowIndex49

variable (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ i, i<10 → Canonical (p i))

def target (d : Nat) : Nat → Old.Q :=
  if h : d<5 then ProverCommitPointWeight49.row (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) (fun i => hp i.val i.isLt) ⟨d,h⟩
  else fun _ => zero

theorem target_canonical (d k : Nat) (hd : d<5) (hk : k<4) : Canonical (target p hp d k) := by
  rw [target,dif_pos hd]
  exact (ProverCommitPointWeight49.row_spec (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) (fun i => hp i.val i.isLt) ⟨d,hd⟩).2.1 k hk

theorem step (d : Usize) (hd : d.val<5) :
    (do
      let t ← Array.index_usize point_rows.TAU d
      let a ← Array.index_usize (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p)
        (Usize.wrapping_sub 9#usize (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize t))
      let b ← Array.index_usize (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p)
        (Usize.wrapping_sub 8#usize (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize t))
      factors.point a b)=ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 4#usize (target p hp d.val)) := by
  have hc := coordinates d hd
  have hab := (ProverCommitPointWeight49.a ⟨d.val,hd⟩).isLt
  have hbb := (ProverCommitPointWeight49.b ⟨d.val,hd⟩).isLt
  rw [tau_index d hd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ (by rw [hc.1];exact hab)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ (by rw [hc.2];exact hbb)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [hc.1,hc.2,target,dif_pos hd]
  exact (ProverCommitPointWeight49.row_spec (fun i : Fin 10 => p i.val) (fun i => hp i.val i.isLt) ⟨d.val,hd⟩).1

attribute [local irreducible] matrix target ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source

theorem fill (n : Nat) (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q)
    (hrows : ∀ i k, i<5 → k<4 → Canonical (rows i k))
    (d : Usize) (left : U8) (hleft : left.val=n) (bound : d.val+n ≤ 5) :
    ∃ out : Nat → Nat → Old.Q,
      point_rows.fill (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) (matrix rows) d left=ok (matrix out) ∧
      (∀ i k, i<5 → k<4 → Canonical (out i k)) ∧
      ∀ i : Fin 5, out i.val=if d.val ≤ i.val ∧ i.val<d.val+n then target p hp i.val else rows i.val := by
  induction n generalizing rows d left with
  | zero =>
    have hz : left=0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨rows,?_,hrows,?_⟩
    · rw [point_rows.fill,hz];rfl
    · intro i;rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  | succ n ih =>
    have hn : left≠0#u8 := by scalar_tac
    have hd : d.val<5 := by omega
    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega
    have hinc : (Usize.wrapping_add d 1#usize).val=d.val+1 := by
      simpa only [show (1#usize).val=1 from rfl] using
        ProverCommitBasisFillValue47.add_val d 1#usize (by change d.val+1<2048;omega)
    let changed := Function.update rows d.val (target p hp d.val)
    have hc : ∀ i k, i<5 → k<4 → Canonical (changed i k) := by
      intro i k hi hk
      by_cases he : i=d.val
      · subst i;simpa only [changed,Function.update_self] using target_canonical p hp d.val k hd hk
      · simpa only [changed,Function.update_of_ne he] using hrows i k hi hk
    obtain ⟨out,hout,hcout,heq⟩ := ih changed hc _ _ hdec (by rw [hinc];omega)
    refine ⟨out,?_,hcout,?_⟩
    · have hs := step p hp d hd
      rw [point_rows.fill]
      simp only [hn,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      simp only [tau_index d hd,bind_tc_ok] at hs ⊢
      have coords := coordinates d hd
      have ha : (Usize.wrapping_sub 9#usize (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize (tau d.val))).val<10 := by rw [coords.1];exact (ProverCommitPointWeight49.a ⟨d.val,hd⟩).isLt
      have hb : (Usize.wrapping_sub 8#usize (Usize.wrapping_mul 2#usize (tau d.val))).val<10 := by rw [coords.2];exact (ProverCommitPointWeight49.b ⟨d.val,hd⟩).isLt
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ ha] at hs ⊢
      simp only [bind_tc_ok] at hs ⊢
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ hb] at hs ⊢
      simp only [bind_tc_ok] at hs ⊢
      rw [hs]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [matrix_update rows d hd (target p hp d.val)]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      exact hout
    · intro i
      rw [heq,hinc]
      by_cases he : i.val=d.val
      · rw [if_neg (by omega),if_pos (by omega)]
        simp only [changed,he,Function.update_self]
      · by_cases ht : d.val+1 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val<d.val+1+n
        · rw [if_pos ht,if_pos (by omega)]
        · rw [if_neg ht,if_neg (by omega)]
          simp only [changed,Function.update_of_ne he]

#print axioms target_canonical
#print axioms step
#print axioms fill
end R1Z.ProverCommitPointRows49

import AspisR1ProducerRelease47.PointRows49
import R1Z.ProverCommitPointWeight49
import R1Z.ProverCommitArray49
import R1Z.ProverCommitInactiveRow49
/-! The literal point-factor permutation table and its source coordinate
arithmetic. Only five scalar entries are inspected. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPointRowIndex49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPointTensor49

def tau (i : Nat) : Usize :=
  if i=0 then 3#usize else if i=1 then 4#usize else if i=2 then 2#usize
  else if i=3 then 0#usize else 1#usize

theorem tau_array : point_rows.TAU=ProverCommitArray49.array 5#usize tau := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  rfl

attribute [local irreducible] matrix ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source

theorem fill_value (base : QM31Exact) (rows : Nat → Nat → Old.Q)
    (hcrows : ∀ d k, d<5 → k<4 → Canonical (rows d k))
    (n : Nat) (d : Usize) (left : U8) (hleft : left.val=n)
    (positive : 1≤d.val) (bound : d.val+n≤5) (x : Old.Q) (hx : Canonical x)

    · rw [factors.lines,hz];rfl
    · intro i k;rw [if_neg (by omega)]

    have hdec : (U8.wrapping_sub left 1#u8).val=n := by
      rw [ProverCommitBasisCounter47.sub_one left (by omega)];omega

      rw [hdnext,hyval,←AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.doubledFactor_add,hinc]
      congr 1 <;> omega
    let changed := Function.update rows d.val row
    have hcchanged : ∀ i k, i<5 → k<4 → Canonical (changed i k) := by
      intro i k hi hk
      by_cases he : i=d.val
      · subst i;simpa only [changed,Function.update_self] using hcrow k hk
      · simpa only [changed,Function.update_of_ne he] using hcrows i k hi hk

      rw [hdrow k,hxd,hyval]

      simp only [hnext,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      exact hout

      rw [hdout,hinc]
      by_cases he : i.val=d.val
      · rw [if_neg (by omega),if_pos (by omega)]
        simp only [changed,he,Function.update_self,hrval]
      · by_cases ht : d.val+1 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val<d.val+1+n

        · rw [if_neg ht,if_neg (by omega)]

theorem circle_four (x y : F) (n : Nat) (k : Fin 4) :

  have hd1 : (4 * n + 1) / 2 = 2 * n := by omega
  have hd2 : (4 * n + 2) / 2 = 2 * n + 1 := by omega
  have hd3 : (4 * n + 3) / 2 = 2 * n + 1 := by omega
  have hm0 : (4 * n) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hm1 : (4 * n + 1) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  have hm2 : (4 * n + 2) % 2 = 0 := by omega
  have hm3 : (4 * n + 3) % 2 = 1 := by omega
  fin_cases k <;> simp [circleWeight, hd0, hd1, hd2, hd3, hm0, hm1, hm2, hm3,

    AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.naturalLineValue_two_mul_add_one,

variable {F : Type*} [Field F]

def T4 (x : F) : F := doubledFactor x 2

def radixFactor (x : F) (slot : Fin 4) : F :=
  ![1, x, doubledFactor x 1, x * doubledFactor x 1] slot

def firstFactor (x y : F) (slot : Fin 4) : F := ![1, y, x, x * y] slot

theorem naturalLineValue_zero (x : F) : naturalLineValue x 0 = 1 := by
  simp [AspisCircleTensorBinding.naturalLineValue]

theorem naturalLineValue_radix4_digit (x : F) (j : Nat) :
    naturalLineValue x j =
      naturalLineValue (doubledFactor x 2) (j / 4) *
        radixFactor x ⟨j % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ := by
  have hj : j = 4 * (j / 4) + j % 4 := by omega
  calc
    naturalLineValue x j =
        naturalLineValue x (4 * (j / 4) + j % 4) := by
          exact congrArg (naturalLineValue x) hj
    _ = naturalLineValue (doubledFactor x 2) (j / 4) *
          radixFactor x ⟨j % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ := by
      simpa [radixFactor] using
        (AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.naturalLineValue_four_mul_add x (j / 4)
          ⟨j % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩)

theorem circleWeight_base4 (x y : F) (j : Fin 1024) :
    R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y j.val =
      firstFactor x y ⟨j.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ *
      radixFactor (doubledFactor x 1)
        ⟨(j.val / 4) % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ *
      radixFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor x 1) 2)
        ⟨(j.val / 16) % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ *
      radixFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor x 1) 2) 2)
        ⟨(j.val / 64) % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ *
      radixFactor
        (doubledFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor x 1) 2) 2) 2)
        ⟨(j.val / 256) % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ := by
  have hcircle := R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49.circle_four x y (j.val / 4)
    ⟨j.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩
  have hj : j.val = 4 * (j.val / 4) + j.val % 4 := by omega
  have hdiv1 : (j.val / 4) / 4 = j.val / 16 := by omega
  have hdiv2 : (j.val / 16) / 4 = j.val / 64 := by omega
  have hdiv3 : (j.val / 64) / 4 = j.val / 256 := by omega
  have hdiv4 : (j.val / 256) / 4 = j.val / 1024 := by omega
  have hzero : j.val / 1024 = 0 := by omega
  have h1 := naturalLineValue_radix4_digit (doubledFactor x 1) (j.val / 4)
  have h2 := naturalLineValue_radix4_digit
    (doubledFactor (doubledFactor x 1) 2) (j.val / 16)
  have h3 := naturalLineValue_radix4_digit
    (doubledFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor x 1) 2) 2) (j.val / 64)
  have h4 := naturalLineValue_radix4_digit
    (doubledFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor (doubledFactor x 1) 2) 2) 2)
    (j.val / 256)
  have hbase :
      R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y j.val =
        naturalLineValue (doubledFactor x 1) (j.val / 4) *
          firstFactor x y ⟨j.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ := by
    calc
      R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y j.val =
          R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y
            (4 * (j.val / 4) + j.val % 4) :=
        congrArg (R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y) hj
      _ = naturalLineValue (doubledFactor x 1) (j.val / 4) *
            firstFactor x y ⟨j.val % 4, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ := by
        simpa [firstFactor] using hcircle
  rw [hbase, h1, hdiv1, h2, hdiv2, h3, hdiv3, h4, hdiv4,
    hzero, naturalLineValue_zero]
  ring

#print axioms naturalLineValue_radix4_digit
#print axioms circleWeight_base4

end R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49
