/-! Generic symbolic five-factor product. Field operations and doubling factors
remain opaque, avoiding reduction of the concrete quadratic-tower carrier. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCircleProduct49
open scoped BigOperators
open AspisCircleTensorBinding
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def model (x y : K) (d : Nat) (k : Fin 4) : K :=
  if d=0 then ![1,y,x,x*y] k else
    ![1,doubledFactor x (2*d-1),doubledFactor x (2*d),doubledFactor x (2*d-1)*doubledFactor x (2*d)] k

theorem product_five {M : Type} [CommMonoid M] (f : Fin 5 → M) :
    (∏ d : Fin 5, f d)=f 0*(f 1*(f 2*(f 3*(f 4*1)))) := by
  simp only [Fin.prod_univ_succ,Fin.prod_univ_zero]
  rfl

theorem model_zero (x y : K) (k : Fin 4) : model x y 0 k=ProverCommitCircleModel49.firstFactor x y k := rfl

theorem model_row (x y : K) (d : Nat) (hd : 0<d) (k : Fin 4) :
    model x y d k=ProverCommitCircleModel49.radixFactor (doubledFactor x (2*d-1)) k := by
  rw [model,if_neg (by omega)]
  unfold ProverCommitCircleModel49.radixFactor
  rw [←AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.doubledFactor_add]
  have he : 2*d-1+1=2*d := by omega
  rw [he]

attribute [local irreducible] model doubledFactor ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight
  ProverCommitCircleModel49.firstFactor ProverCommitCircleModel49.radixFactor

theorem model_product (x y : K) (j : Fin 1024) :
    (∏ d : Fin 5, model x y d.val ⟨(j.val/4^d.val)%4,Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩)=
      ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y j.val := by
  rw [product_five,ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight_base4]
  simp only [show (0:Fin 5).val=0 from rfl,show (1:Fin 5).val=1 from rfl,
    show (2:Fin 5).val=2 from rfl,show (3:Fin 5).val=3 from rfl,show (4:Fin 5).val=4 from rfl,
    show (4^0:Nat)=1 from rfl,show (4^1:Nat)=4 from rfl,show (4^2:Nat)=16 from rfl,
    show (4^3:Nat)=64 from rfl,show (4^4:Nat)=256 from rfl,Nat.div_one]
  change model x y 0 ⟨j.val%4,by omega⟩ *
    (model x y 1 ⟨j.val/4%4,by omega⟩ *
    (model x y 2 ⟨j.val/16%4,by omega⟩ *
    (model x y 3 ⟨j.val/64%4,by omega⟩ *
    (model x y 4 ⟨j.val/256%4,by omega⟩ * 1))))=_
  rw [model_zero,model_row x y 1 (by omega),model_row x y 2 (by omega),
    model_row x y 3 (by omega),model_row x y 4 (by omega)]
  simp only [←AspisV5FriNaturalBasisRadix4.doubledFactor_add,mul_one]
  ac_rfl

#print axioms product_five
#print axioms model_zero
#print axioms model_row
#print axioms model_product
end R1Z.ProverCommitCircleProduct49

import R1Z.ProverCommitCircleModel49

/-! The circle raw coefficient row is the model evaluator on a basis vector.
Only the unique matching pair index is selected; no 512-term cube is reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitCircleFunctional49
open AspisCircleTensorBinding
open scoped BigOperators
variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def part (q : Fin 1024 → K) (x : K) (s : Fin 2) : K :=
  ∑ i : Fin 512, q ⟨2*i.val+s.val,by have := i.isLt;have := s.isLt;omega⟩ * naturalLineValue x i.val

theorem single_part (j : Fin 1024) (x : K) (s : Fin 2) :
    part (Pi.single j 1) x s=if j.val%2=s.val then naturalLineValue x (j.val/2) else 0 := by
  let i : Fin 512 := ⟨j.val/2,by have := j.isLt;omega⟩
  by_cases hs : j.val%2=s.val
  · rw [if_pos hs,part]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single i]
    · have he : (⟨2*i.val+s.val,by have := i.isLt;have := s.isLt;omega⟩ : Fin 1024)=j := by
        apply Fin.ext
        change 2*(j.val/2)+s.val=j.val
        omega
      rw [he,Pi.single_eq_same,one_mul]
    · intro k hk hki
      have he : (⟨2*k.val+s.val,by have := k.isLt;have := s.isLt;omega⟩ : Fin 1024)≠j := by
        intro he
        have hval := congrArg Fin.val he
        change 2*k.val+s.val=j.val at hval
        apply hki
        apply Fin.ext
        change k.val=j.val/2
        omega
      rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne he,zero_mul]
    · intro hi
      exact (hi (Finset.mem_univ i)).elim
  · rw [if_neg hs,part]
    apply Finset.sum_eq_zero
    intro i hi
    have he : (⟨2*i.val+s.val,by have := i.isLt;have := s.isLt;omega⟩ : Fin 1024)≠j := by
      intro he
      have hval := congrArg Fin.val he
      change 2*i.val+s.val=j.val at hval
      have hslt := s.isLt
      apply hs
      omega
    rw [Pi.single_eq_of_ne he,zero_mul]

theorem pair_parts (q : Fin 1024 → K) (x : K) :
    ProverCommitEval47.pairEval q x=(part q x 0,part q x 1) := rfl

attribute [local irreducible] part ProverCommitEval47.pairEval

theorem message_single (j : Fin 1024) (x y : K) :
    ProverCommitEval47.messageEval (Pi.single j 1) x y=ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight x y j.val := by
  rw [ProverCommitEval47.messageEval,pair_parts]
  change part (Pi.single j 1) x 0+y*part (Pi.single j 1) x 1=_
  rw [single_part,single_part]
  unfold ProverCommitCircleModel49.circleWeight
  by_cases h : j.val%2=0
  · simp only [h,show (0:Fin 2).val=0 from rfl,show (1:Fin 2).val=1 from rfl,
      if_true,if_neg (by decide : (0:Nat)≠1),mul_zero,add_zero,mul_one]
  · have ho : j.val%2=1 := by omega
    simp only [ho,show (0:Fin 2).val=0 from rfl,show (1:Fin 2).val=1 from rfl,
      if_true,if_neg (by decide : (1:Nat)≠0),zero_add]
    ring

#print axioms single_part
#print axioms pair_parts
#print axioms message_single
end R1Z.ProverCommitCircleFunctional49

import R1Z.ProverCommitValueRange47
import R0.Chord
/-! Natural-basis evaluator and its payload meaning. These are exact-field
identities, not a certificate that a native loop implements this evaluator. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitEval47
open ProverCommitValueRange47
open AspisCircleTensorBinding AspisR0.Chord
open AspisV5FriConcreteEncoderApplicability AspisV5FriInitialCircleEncoderIdentity
open scoped BigOperators

variable {K : Type} [Field K]

def pairEval (q : Fin 1024 → K) (x : K) : K × K :=
  (∑ i : Fin 512, q ⟨2*i.val,by omega⟩ * naturalLineValue x i.val,
   ∑ i : Fin 512, q ⟨2*i.val+1,by omega⟩ * naturalLineValue x i.val)

def messageEval (q : Fin 1024 → K) (x y : K) : K :=
  (pairEval q x).1 + y * (pairEval q x).2

/-- The natural-basis dot products match the retained model's polynomial
semantics at every point, not just stored/domain points. -/
theorem message_model [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K] [NeZero (2 : K)]
    [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K]
    (q : Fin 1024 → K) (z : AspisR0.ChordGeometry.Point K) :
    messageEval q z.1.1 z.1.2 = evalMessage q z := by
  unfold messageEval pairEval evalMessage initialP0 initialP1
  rw [naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by decide),
      naturalCoefficientPolynomial_eval_eq_sum (by decide)]
  simp only [evenCoefficients,oddCoefficients]

/-- The same recurrence as basis::double, transported through the embedding. -/
theorem doubled_embed (x : Q) (n : Nat) :
    doubledFactor (embed x) n = embed (doubledFactor x n) := by
  induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [doubledFactor,ih]
    simp only [embed,doubledFactor,map_sub,map_mul,map_pow,map_ofNat,map_one]

theorem natural_embed (x : Q) (n : Nat) :
    naturalLineValue (embed x) n = embed (naturalLineValue x n) := by
  unfold naturalLineValue
  simp only [doubled_embed]
  simp only [embed,map_prod]

theorem pair_embed (q : Fin 1024 → Q) (x : Q) :
    pairEval (fun i => embed (q i)) (embed x) =
      (embed (pairEval q x).1,embed (pairEval q x).2) := by
  unfold pairEval
  simp only [natural_embed]
  simp only [embed,map_sum,map_mul]

theorem message_embed (q : Fin 1024 → Q) (x y : Q) :
    messageEval (fun i => embed (q i)) (embed x) (embed y) =
      embed (messageEval q x y) := by
  unfold messageEval
  rw [pair_embed]
  simp only [embed,map_add,map_mul]

theorem message_range (q : Fin 1024 → Q) (x y : Q) :
    InQM (messageEval (fun i => embed (q i)) (embed x) (embed y)) :=
  ⟨messageEval q x y,message_embed q x y⟩

/-- Field-by-field y1 range; lane ordering and number are explicit. No
canonical-value premise, decoder success, or source success is required. -/
def y1 (coefficients : Fin 29 → Fin 1024 → Q) (x y : Q) : Fin 29 → E :=
  fun lane => messageEval (fun i => embed (coefficients lane i)) (embed x) (embed y)

theorem y1_range (coefficients : Fin 29 → Fin 1024 → Q) (x y : Q) (lane : Fin 29) :
    InQM (y1 coefficients x y lane) := message_range _ _ _

theorem y1_decode (coefficients : Fin 29 → Fin 1024 → Q) (x y : Q) (lane : Fin 29) :
    AspisR1.FoldedLeafCodec.decodeWide
      ((List.ofFn (bytes (y1 coefficients x y lane))).map UInt8.toFin) =
        some (y1 coefficients x y lane) := bytes_decode _

theorem y1_compact (coefficients : Fin 29 → Fin 1024 → Q) (x y : Q) (lane : Fin 29)
    (out : ProverCommitPublish43.Bytes) :
    ProverCommitCompact43.cell (bytes (y1 coefficients x y lane)) out =
      .ok (out ++ ProverCommitCompact43.low (bytes (y1 coefficients x y lane))) :=
  range_compact _ (y1_range _ _ _ _) out

#print axioms message_model
#print axioms doubled_embed
#print axioms natural_embed
#print axioms pair_embed
#print axioms message_embed
#print axioms message_range
#print axioms y1_range
#print axioms y1_decode
#print axioms y1_compact
end R1Z.ProverCommitEval47

import AspisR1ProducerRelease47.KernelCallers49
import R1Z.ProverCommitNativePower49
import R1Z.ProverCommitSampleTail49
import R1Z.ProverCommitInactiveRow49
import R0P.SemView
/-! The complete raw Libra column, including both geometric runs and its
zero suffix. The source coefficient power is not supplied as a hypothesis. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitLibra49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitSubtraction47 (one one_canonical)

def entries (a b : Old.Q) : Nat → Old.Q := fun k => if k=0 then a else b

def run (a b : Old.Q) (j : Usize) : Result field.QM31 :=
  extras.libra (ProverCommitQArray48.array 2#usize (entries a b)) j

theorem exact_result (a b : Old.Q) (ha : Canonical a) (hb : Canonical b) (j : Usize) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, run a b j=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧ Canonical z ∧
      decode z=(if j.val<28 then decode a^j.val
        else if j.val<56 then decode b^(j.val-28) else 0) := by
  by_cases hj : j.val<56
  · have hs : j<56#usize := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨side,hside,hvside⟩ := ProverCommitInactiveRow49.div_value j 28#usize (by decide)
    obtain ⟨ex,hex,hvex⟩ := ProverCommitInactiveRow49.rem_value j 28#usize (by decide)
    change side.val=j.val/28 at hvside
    change ex.val=j.val%28 at hvex
    have sidebound : side.val<2 := by omega
    have castval : (UScalar.cast .U8 ex).val=j.val%28 := by
      have exbound : ex.val<28 := by rw [hvex];exact Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      scalar_tac
    have hcan : Canonical (entries a b side.val) := by
      unfold entries;split <;> assumption
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hvz⟩ := ProverCommitNativePower49.power _ _ castval (entries a b side.val) one hcan one_canonical
    refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
    · rw [run,extras.libra,if_pos hs]
      simp only [hside,bind_tc_ok]
      rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ sidebound]
      simp only [hex,ProverCommitSampleTail49.source_one,lift,bind_tc_ok]
      exact hz
    · rw [hvz,ProverCommitSubtraction47.one_decode,one_mul]
      by_cases hsmall : j.val<28
      · have hside0 : side.val=0 := by omega
        simp only [entries,hside0,if_true,if_pos hsmall,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hsmall]
      · have hside1 : side.val=1 := by omega
        have hmod : j.val%28=j.val-28 := by omega
        simp only [entries,hside1,if_neg (by decide : (1:Nat)≠0),if_neg hsmall,if_pos hj,hmod]
  · have hs : ¬j<56#usize := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨zero,?_,zero_canonical,?_⟩
    · rw [run,extras.libra,if_neg hs,ProverCommitQArray48.source_zero]
    · simp only [zero_decode,if_neg hj,if_neg (by omega : ¬j.val<28)]

theorem model (alpha : Fin 10 → QM31Exact) (a b z : Old.Q) (j : Fin 1024)
    (ha : decode a=alpha 8) (hb : decode b=alpha 9)
    (hz : decode z=(if j.val<28 then decode a^j.val else if j.val<56 then decode b^(j.val-28) else 0)) :
    decode z=R0P.SemSource.libraWeight alpha j := by
  rw [hz,ha,hb]
  rfl

theorem caller (alpha : Fin 10 → Old.Q) (hc : ∀ i, Canonical (alpha i))
    (j : Usize) (hj : j.val<1024) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, run (alpha 8) (alpha 9) j=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=R0P.SemSource.libraWeight (fun i => decode (alpha i)) ⟨j.val,hj⟩ := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hcz,hdz⟩ := exact_result (alpha 8) (alpha 9) (hc 8) (hc 9) j
  exact ⟨z,hz,hcz,model (fun i => decode (alpha i)) _ _ z ⟨j.val,hj⟩ rfl rfl hdz⟩

#print axioms exact_result
#print axioms model
#print axioms caller

def extras.half : Result field.QM31 := do

R1Z.ProverCommitNativePower49:
import R1Z.ProverCommitPowerStep49
/-! Induction on the shrinking exponent of the actual owned power reference. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitNativePower49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode)

theorem power (n : Nat) (exp : U8) (he : exp.val=n) (base acc : Old.Q)
    (hb : Canonical base) (ha : Canonical acc) :
    ∃ z : Old.Q, kernels.power (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source base) exp (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source acc)=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source z) ∧
      Canonical z ∧ decode z=decode acc*decode base^n := by
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing exp base acc with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases hn : n=0
    · have hz : exp=0#u8 := by apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa only [he,hn,show (0#u8).val=0 from rfl]
      refine ⟨acc,?_,ha,?_⟩
      · rw [kernels.power,hz];rfl
      · simp only [hn,pow_zero,mul_one]
    · have hz : exp≠0#u8 := by intro h0;have hv := congrArg (fun a : U8 => a.val) h0;change exp.val=0 at hv;omega
      have hlt : n/2<n := Nat.div_lt_self (by omega) (by decide)
      have hs : (U8.wrapping_shr exp 1#u32).val=n/2 := by rw [ProverCommitPowerStep49.shift,he]
      obtain ⟨sq,hsq,hcsq,hvsq⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQSquare49.square base hb
      have next : ∃ a : Old.Q,
          (if ((exp &&& 1#u8) != 0#u8) then
             field.QM31.mul (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source acc) (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source base)
           else ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source acc))=ok (ProverCommitNativeQ48.source a) ∧
          Canonical a ∧ decode a=(if n%2≠0 then decode acc*decode base else decode acc) := by
        rw [ProverCommitPowerStep49.condition,he]
        by_cases hmod : n%2≠0
        · obtain ⟨a,hm,hca,hva⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.mul acc base ha hb
          exact ⟨a,by simp [hmod,hm],hca,by simp [hmod,hva]⟩
        · exact ⟨acc,by simp only [hmod,decide_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false],ha,by simp only [hmod,if_false]⟩
      obtain ⟨a,hm,hca,hva⟩ := next
      obtain ⟨z,hr,hcz,hvz⟩ := ih (n/2) hlt _ hs sq a hcsq hca
      refine ⟨z,?_,hcz,?_⟩
      · rw [kernels.power]
        simp only [hz,if_false,lift,bind_tc_ok,hm,hsq]
        exact hr
      · rw [hvz,hva,hvsq]
        exact ProverCommitPowerStep49.step _ _ n

#print axioms power
end R1Z.ProverCommitNativePower49

import R1Z.ProverCommitNativeQSquare49
/-! Symbolic exponent recurrence and the source U8 cursor's parity/shift. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitPowerStep49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

theorem shift (x : U8) : (U8.wrapping_shr x 1#u32).val=x.val/2 := by
  change (x.val >>> 1)=_
  rw [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]

theorem bit (x : U8) : (x &&& 1#u8).val=x.val%2 := by
  change (x.bv &&& (1#u8).bv).toNat=_
  rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod _ 1

theorem condition (x : U8) : ((x &&& 1#u8) != 0#u8)=decide (x.val%2≠0) := by
  have hz : (x &&& 1#u8)=0#u8 ↔ x.val%2=0 := by
    constructor
    · intro h;have hv := congrArg (fun a : U8 => a.val) h;simpa only [bit,show (0#u8).val=0 from rfl] using hv
    · intro h;apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq;simpa only [bit,show (0#u8).val=0 from rfl] using h
  by_cases h : (x &&& 1#u8)=0#u8
  · have hm := hz.mp h
    simp [h,hm]
  · have hm : x.val%2≠0 := fun h0 => h (hz.mpr h0)
    simp [h,hm]

theorem step {K : Type*} [CommMonoid K] (base acc : K) (n : Nat) :
    (if n%2≠0 then acc*base else acc)*(base*base)^(n/2)=acc*base^n := by
  have hn := Nat.mod_add_div n 2
  have hr := Nat.mod_lt n (by decide : 0<2)
  rw [←pow_two,←pow_mul]
  by_cases h : n%2=0
  · simp only [h,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false]
    congr 1
    congr 1
    omega
  · have hm : n%2=1 := by omega
    simp only [h,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true]
    have he : n=2*(n/2)+1 := by omega
    calc
      _ = acc*(base^(2*(n/2))*base) := by ac_rfl
      _ = _ := by rw [←pow_succ,←he]

#print axioms shift
#print axioms bit
#print axioms condition
#print axioms step
end R1Z.ProverCommitPowerStep49

including both toggles and the complete successor carry loop. -/

noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitStatementPoints49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open ProverCommitSubtraction47 (one one_canonical one_decode)
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitSuccessorPoint49
open R0P.SemSource

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source

theorem absorption_exact (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ k, k<10 → Canonical (p k)) :
    ∃ z : Nat → Old.Q, points.absorption (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p)=
      ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize z) ∧
      (∀ k, k<10 → Canonical (z k)) ∧ decoded z=xor12Point (decoded p) := by
  obtain ⟨p7,h7,hc7,hd7⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.sub one (p 7) one_canonical (hp _ (by omega))
  obtain ⟨p6,h6,hc6,hd6⟩ := ProverCommitNativeQ48.sub one (p 6) one_canonical (hp _ (by omega))
  let z := Function.update (Function.update p 7 p7) 6 p6
  refine ⟨z,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [points.absorption,ProverCommitQArray48.index 10#usize p 7#usize (by decide)]
    simp only [ProverCommitSampleTail49.source_one,show (7#usize).val=7 from rfl,h7,bind_tc_ok]
    rw [ProverCommitQArray48.update 10#usize p 7#usize (by decide)]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,show (7#usize).val=7 from rfl]
    rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index 10#usize _ 6#usize (by decide)]
    simp only [show (6#usize).val=6 from rfl,Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (6:Nat)≠7),h6,bind_tc_ok]
    exact ProverCommitQArray48.update 10#usize _ 6#usize (by decide) p6
  · intro k hk
    by_cases h6 : k=6
    · subst k;simpa only [z,Function.update_self] using hc6
    · by_cases h7 : k=7
      · subst k;simpa only [z,Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (7:Nat)≠6),Function.update_self] using hc7
      · simpa only [z,Function.update_of_ne h6,Function.update_of_ne h7] using hp k hk
  · funext k
    change decode (z k.val)=_
    unfold xor12Point
    by_cases h6 : k.val=6
    · rw [if_pos (Or.inr h6)]
      simp only [z,h6,Function.update_self,hd6,one_decode,decoded]
    · by_cases h7 : k.val=7
      · rw [if_pos (Or.inl h7)]
        simp only [z,h7,Function.update_of_ne (by decide : (7:Nat)≠6),Function.update_self,hd7,one_decode,decoded]
      · rw [if_neg (by tauto)]
        simp only [z,Function.update_of_ne h6,Function.update_of_ne h7,decoded]

theorem points_exact (p : Nat → Old.Q) (hp : ∀ k, k<10 → Canonical (p k)) :
    ∃ s a : Nat → Old.Q,
      points.all (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p)=ok (Array.make 3#usize
        [ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p,ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize s,
         ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize a]) ∧

      ∀ i : Fin 3, toR0 (decoded (![p,s,a] i))=openingPoints (decoded p) i := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hcs,hds⟩ := successor_exact p hp
  obtain ⟨a,ha,hca,hda⟩ := absorption_exact p hp
  refine ⟨s,a,?_,hcs,hca,?_⟩
  · simp only [points.all,hs,ha,bind_tc_ok]
  · intro i
    fin_cases i
    · rfl
    · change toR0 (decoded s)=toR0 (successorPoint (decoded p))
      rw [hds]
    · change toR0 (decoded a)=toR0 (xor12Point (decoded p))
      rw [hda]

#print axioms absorption_exact
#print axioms points_exact
end R1Z.ProverCommitStatementPoints49

import R0Z.RefPayload
import R0Z.PureRounds
/-! The simulator's unshifted semantic function, initial/chain/terminal
guards, and original-round contribution in the existing payload model.
Source oracle and tape provenance are not assumed discharged here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSemanticModel55
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.SemDegree R0P.Sumcheck
open R0Z.HonestView R0Z.PayloadSplit R0Z.Shift R0Z.RefPayload
open Polynomial
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

def oracle (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) : PointFunction K :=
  fun a => maskLinear pi B a t+fOrig pub B ch 0 a

theorem degree (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) : VDeg 10 (fun _ => 27) (oracle pi pub B ch t) := by
  exact vdeg_add (maskLinear_vdeg pi B t) (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch 0)

theorem original_rounds (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (r : Fin 10) :
    rounds ch r (oracle pi pub B ch t)=rounds ch r (fun a => maskLinear pi B a t)+
      rounds ch r (fOrig pub B ch 0) := by
  exact map_add (rounds ch r) _ _

theorem initial_guard (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    (rounds ch 0 (oracle pi pub B ch t)).eval 0+
      (rounds ch 0 (oracle pi pub B ch t)).eval 1=
      bsumB 10 (fun b => maskLinear pi B (ofBool b) t)+S0 pub B ch := by
  rw [original_rounds,eval_add,eval_add]
  rw [show (rounds ch 0 (fun a => maskLinear pi B a t)).eval 0+
        (rounds ch 0 (fOrig pub B ch 0)).eval 0+
        ((rounds ch 0 (fun a => maskLinear pi B a t)).eval 1+
        (rounds ch 0 (fOrig pub B ch 0)).eval 1)=
      ((rounds ch 0 (fun a => maskLinear pi B a t)).eval 0+
        (rounds ch 0 (fun a => maskLinear pi B a t)).eval 1)+
      ((rounds ch 0 (fOrig pub B ch 0)).eval 0+
        (rounds ch 0 (fOrig pub B ch 0)).eval 1) by ring]
  rw [R0Z.Chain.rounds_initial ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg pi B t),
    R0Z.Chain.rounds_initial ch _ (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch 0)]
  rfl

theorem chain_guard (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) (r : Fin 9) :
    (rounds ch r.succ (oracle pi pub B ch t)).eval 0+
      (rounds ch r.succ (oracle pi pub B ch t)).eval 1=
      (rounds ch r.castSucc (oracle pi pub B ch t)).eval (alpha ch r.castSucc) :=
  R0Z.Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (degree pi pub B ch t) r

theorem terminal_guard (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    (rounds ch 9 (oracle pi pub B ch t)).eval (alpha ch 9)=
      maskLinear pi B (alpha ch) t+fOrig pub B ch 0 (alpha ch) :=
  eval_rounds_nine ch _ (degree pi pub B ch t)

theorem original_image (pi : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    originalOf pub B ch (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch+L pi B ch t)=
      fOrig pub B ch t (alpha ch) := by
  have hclaims : (fun (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) => (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch+L (Bat := Bat) pi B ch t) (.pointClaim j c))=
      honestClaims t (alpha ch) := by
    funext j c
    rw [Pi.add_apply,refPayload_cell pub B ch (.pointClaim j c)
      (by intro r i he;cases he) (by intro he;cases he),zero_add]
    simp only [L,LinearMap.pi_apply,LinearMap.comp_apply,LinearMap.proj_apply,
      linearPayload,claimsLinear_apply]
  unfold originalOf fOrig
  rw [hclaims]

#print axioms degree
#print axioms original_rounds
#print axioms initial_guard
#print axioms chain_guard
#print axioms terminal_guard
#print axioms original_image
end R1Z.ProverCommitSemanticModel55
R0Z.RefPayload:
import R0Z.IIPrimeResidual

/-! ZF2 (zf1/DESIGN-ZF2-SIMULATOR.txt §3.2, §5.1): the public reference
payload and the explicit simulator, generic in the batched layer.

* `refPayload pub B ch`: `cTilde`'s formula (`cTilde_eq`) at the zero payload
  trace (`L 0 = 0`), plus `S₀ = Σ_b fOrig(0)(b)` in the `.maskSum` cell.  It is
  a function of `(pub, B, ch)` only.
* Its silent values: `ι = 0`, `.inactiveSum = 0`, `Φ₀ = 0` (α₉ ≠ ½), the chain
  equalities, round cells in `K₄` (under `TerminalClosed`), zero on every cell
  other than the round cells and `.maskSum`.
* `simE π B outputs x ch t = (metadata, Ψ_ch (refPayload + A_ch (equiv⁻¹ t)))`:
  no instance, no choice.
* `equalLaws_simE_of`: given clause (i′) for `w` and
  `cTilde w − refPayload ∈ range A_ch`, the honest view of `w` at `ch` and
  `simE … ch` have equal laws (the proof of `hvzk_on_of` with the chosen
  witness replaced by `refPayload`).

No challenge predicate is asserted here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.RefPayload
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12
  R0Z.Shift R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### The reference payload -/

/-- The payload with `s` at `.maskSum` and `0` elsewhere. -/
def msCell (s : K) : Payload K Bat := fun cell => match cell with
  | .maskSum => s
  | _ => 0

theorem msCell_maskSum (s : K) : msCell (Bat := Bat) s .maskSum = s := rfl
theorem msCell_semanticCoeff (s : K) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.semanticCoeff j i) = 0 := rfl
theorem msCell_pointClaim (s : K) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := rfl
theorem msCell_extraClaim (s : K) (c : Fin 29) : msCell (Bat := Bat) s (.extraClaim c) = 0 := rfl

/-- The direction coefficient of the zero payload trace. -/
def k0 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  fOrig pub B ch 0 (alpha ch) * (alpha ch 9 - 1/2)⁻¹

/-- The Boolean sum of the original terminal at the zero payload trace. -/
def S0 (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch 0 (ofBool b))

/-- The public reference payload (design §3.2). -/
def refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Payload K Bat :=
  PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch 0) - k0 pub B ch • dir +
    msCell (S0 pub B ch)

/-! ### Silent values -/

theorem roundPoly_msCell (j : Fin 10) (s : K) : Chain.roundPoly j (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_apply]
  simp only [msCell_semanticCoeff, monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem iota_msCell (s : K) : HonestValid.iota (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = -s := by
  simp only [HonestValid.iota_apply, roundPoly_msCell, msCell_maskSum, eval_zero, zero_add,
    zero_sub]

theorem iota_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    HonestValid.iota (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch) = 0 := by
  rw [refPayload, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, HonestValid.iota_originalRounds, HonestValid.iota_dir,
    iota_msCell, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  unfold S0
  ring

/-- Every cell other than the round cells and `.maskSum` is zero. -/
theorem refPayload_cell (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (cell : PayloadCell Bat) (hc : ∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) (hm : cell ≠ .maskSum) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch cell = 0 := by
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact absurd rfl (hc j i)
  | maskSum => exact absurd rfl hm
  | pointClaim j c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | extraClaim c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | ood j c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | inactiveSum => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | opened q s c => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring
  | bat b => show (0 : K) - k0 pub B ch * 0 + 0 = 0; ring

theorem inactive_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch .inactiveSum = 0 :=
  refPayload_cell pub B ch .inactiveSum (by intro _ _ h; cases h) (by intro h; cases h)

theorem Phi0_msCell (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (s : K) :
    Phi0 B ch (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
  have hr : round9Poly (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
    rw [round9Poly_apply]
    simp only [msCell_semanticCoeff, monomial_zero_right, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  have hc : claimMask B (alpha ch) (msCell (Bat := Bat) s) = 0 := by
    simp only [claimMask, LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply,
      proj_apply, msCell_pointClaim, msCell_extraClaim, smul_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero, add_zero]
  simp only [Phi0, LinearMap.sub_apply, evalRound9_apply, hr, hc, eval_zero, sub_zero]

theorem Phi0_refPayload (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1/2) : Phi0 B ch (refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch) = 0 := by
  rw [refPayload, map_add, map_sub, map_smul, Phi0_roundInclusion, evalRound9_originalRounds,
    Phi0_dir, Phi0_msCell, smul_eq_mul, add_zero]
  unfold k0
  have hne : alpha ch 9 - 1/2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hhalf
  rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, mul_one, sub_self]

theorem msCell_mem_chainEqs (ch : Challenges K) (s : K) :
    msCell (Bat := Bat) s ∈ IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [IIPrimeResidual.mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  simp only [roundPoly_msCell, eval_zero, add_zero]

theorem refPayload_mem_chainEqs (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch ∈ IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch :=
  (IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).add_mem
    ((IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).sub_mem
      (IIPrimeResidual.originalRounds_mem_chainEqs pub B ch 0)
      ((IIPrimeResidual.ChainEqs ch).smul_mem _ (IIPrimeResidual.dir_mem_chainEqs ch)))
    (msCell_mem_chainEqs ch _)

/-- `k₀ ∈ K₄` from `TerminalClosed` (the zero trace has zero claims). -/
theorem k0_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hT : K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) pub B ch) :
    k0 pub B ch ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have ha : ∀ i, alpha ch i ∈ K4 B hB := K4Values.alpha_mem _ ch hsem
  have h0 : ∀ c r, (0 : Trace K) c r ∈ K4 B hB := fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  unfold k0 fOrig
  refine (K4 B hB).mul_mem ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j c =>
    K4Values.honestClaims_mem _ _ h0 _ ha j c) ha)) ?_
  exact (K4 B hB).inv_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem (ha 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB))

/-- The round cells of `refPayload` lie in `K₄`. -/
theorem refPayload_round_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hT : K4Values.TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) pub B ch) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    refPayload (Bat := Bat) pub B ch (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  show PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch 0 j i -
      k0 pub B ch * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) + 0 ∈ K4 B hB
  exact (K4 B hB).add_mem ((K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (K4Values.originalRounds_mem _ pub B ch hsem hT 0 (fun _ _ => (K4 B hB).zero_mem) j i)
    ((K4 B hB).mul_mem (k0_mem B hB pub ch hsem hT) (K4Values.dirCoeff_mem B hB j i)))
    (K4 B hB).zero_mem

/-! ### The explicit simulator -/

/-- ZF2's simulator: the shifted reference coset at a uniform tape.  Its
arguments are public; there is no instance and no choice. -/
def simE (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (ch : Challenges K) (t : JointView.Tape K F) :
    JointView.View K CommitHandle Aux Bat :=
  (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch,
    shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A π B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t)))

attribute [local irreducible] JointView.payload A g

/-- Clause (i′) for `w` and the reference coset give equal laws of the honest
view and `simE`. -/
theorem equalLaws_simE_of [Fintype Bat] (h : JointView.HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : JointView.Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hi : ∀ n, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM))
    (hz : cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - refPayload x.1 B ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)) :
    EqualLaws (JointView.view (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x w ch) (simE h.transport B outputs x ch) := by
  have hlaw := payload_law_on h B x w ch hi
  have hlinear := AffineLaw.equal_laws_of_mask_image (A h.transport B ch) (A h.transport B ch)
    (cTilde h B x w ch) (refPayload x.1 B ch) rfl hz
  have hshift := equalLaws_comp (shift x.1 B ch) hlinear
  have hpart : EqualLaws (D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
      (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch t)) := by
    intro v
    exact (hlaw v).trans (hshift v)
  have hold : EqualLaws (JointView.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
      (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t))) := by
    refine AbsorptionLaw.equal_laws_of_equiv Partition.equiv.toEquiv _ _ ?_
    have hg : ∀ r : T K F, Partition.equiv.symm (Partition.equiv.toEquiv r) = r :=
      fun r => Partition.equiv.symm_apply_apply r
    simp only [hg]
    unfold R0Z.D12.payload at hpart
    exact hpart
  have hp := AffineLaw.equal_laws_const_pair (JointView.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch)
    (fun t => shift x.1 B ch (refPayload x.1 B ch + A h.transport B ch (Partition.equiv.symm t)))
    (ZkStatement.metadata outputs x ch) hold
  unfold JointView.view simE
  exact hp

/-! J15 (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.3–2.4; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4 J15-R1), the

* `laneOf_actual_zero` (row-1023 lemma for J0b, LOG D36.4): the production

  tape change no lane (TerminalEligible.lanes_eligible, openings_applyAff).
* Lane facts of the payload trace: F-valued semantic lanes, zero lanes
  16..25, 27, 28.
* `cTilde_eq`, `Phi0_cTilde` (R4): `cTilde = L u + O u − k • dir` with
  `k = fOrig u(α)·(α₉ − ½)⁻¹`, and `Φ₀(cTilde) = 0` when `α₉ ≠ ½`.
* `ChainEqs` (R6): the nine boundary-chain equalities as a K-submodule; it
  contains every `L τ`, every original-round inclusion, `dir`, all of `A`
  and every `cTilde`.  `roundProjection_mem_chainT0` turns it, with the
  terminal equation, into `ChainT0`.
* `maskLinear_mem`, `L_round_mem` (R7): the round cells of `L τ` lie in any
  subfield containing `B.i`, `B.u`, the challenges and the trace values.
* `mask_lift_of` (§2.4, generic linear algebra): a payload with zero own and
  inactive cells, zero initial-sum defect, `Chain_T0₄` round part and batched
  part in a subspace `B0` is a mask-tape image, given (Q′), `bat(ker own) ≤ B0`
  and `B0 ≤ bat(ker own ⊓ ker R)` (BReach).

No conjunct of any challenge predicate is asserted here. -/

namespace R0Z.IIPrimeResidual

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Lanes of the payload trace -/

/-- Row-1023 lemma (LOG D36.4): the lanes of the payload trace equal those of
the prepared instance, for every `λ, χ`.  Row 1023 is read by `rowOpenings`
(at rows 1023, 1022 and 1011), but no lane value changes under the
rebalancing (`lanes_eligible`; copy endpoints are `Protected`, row ≠ 1023). -/
theorem laneOf_actual_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (lam chi : K) :
    laneOf (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) pub lam chi B = laneOf (prepare pub t ch) pub lam chi B := by
  have h0 : (Sum.elim 0 (aff (0 : T K F)) : MaskTape K F) = 0 := by
    rw [map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F))]
    funext z
    cases z <;> rfl
  funext i bits
  rw [laneOf_eq_laneAt, laneOf_eq_laneAt]
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.openings_applyAff, R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1_applyAff, h0,
    R0Z.TerminalEligible.h1Padding_zero, Pi.zero_apply, add_zero,
    R0Z.TerminalEligible.prepare_eligible, R0Z.TerminalEligible.lanes_eligible]

/-- The semantic lanes of the payload trace of a base-typed instance are F-valued. -/
theorem actual_sem_mem (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hF : BaseTyped F t) (l : Fin 29) (hl : l.val < 16) (s : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l s ∈ F := by
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual applyAff
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hl]
  unfold prepare
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_neg (by omega)]
  unfold applyEligible
  try dsimp only
  rw [if_pos hl]
  refine R0Z.K4Values.balance_mem F 1023 _ (fun s' => ?_) s
  refine F.add_mem (hF l (by omega) s') ?_
  unfold semanticNoise
  split_ifs
  · exact Subtype.mem _
  · exact F.zero_mem

/-- Lanes 16..25, 27, 28 of the payload trace are zero. -/
theorem actual_other_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (hl : ¬ (l.val < 16 ∨ l.val = 26)) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l = 0 := by
  have he : PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 =
      traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) + traceLinear B (aff (0 : T K F)) :=
    applyAff_eq_base_add B (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) (aff (0 : T K F))
  rw [he, map_zero (aff (K := K) (F := F)), map_zero (traceLinear B), add_zero]
  funext s
  simp only [traceBase, hl, ↓reduceIte, Pi.zero_apply]

/-! ### `cTilde` and Φ₀ (R4) -/

/-- The direction coefficient `k = fOrig u(α)·(α₉ − ½)⁻¹`. -/
def kOf (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) : K :=
  fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (alpha ch) * (alpha ch 9 - 1/2)⁻¹

theorem cTilde_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.roundInclusion
          (PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0)) -
        kOf h B x w ch • dir := by
  unfold cTilde kOf
  rw [originalOf_c]
  rw [show (c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = _ from R0Z.HonestValid.c_eq h B x w ch]
  all_goals rfl

/-- (R4): `Φ₀(cTilde) = 0` off `α₉ = ½`. -/
theorem Phi0_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1/2) :
    Phi0 B ch (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = 0 := by
  rw [cTilde_eq, map_sub, map_add, Phi0_L, Phi0_roundInclusion, evalRound9_originalRounds,
    map_smul, Phi0_dir, smul_eq_mul, zero_add]
  unfold kOf
  have hne : alpha ch 9 - 1/2 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hhalf
  rw [mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ hne, mul_one, sub_self]

/-! ### The chain equalities (R6) -/

/-- The nine boundary-chain equalities of the ten rounds. -/
def ChainEqs (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule K (Payload K Bat) :=
  ⨅ j : Fin 9, LinearMap.ker
    (Chain.evalRound j.succ 0 + Chain.evalRound j.succ 1 - Chain.evalRound j.castSucc (alpha ch j.castSucc))

theorem mem_chainEqs_iff (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    v ∈ ChainEqs ch ↔ ∀ j : Fin 9, (Chain.roundPoly j.succ v).eval 0 + (Chain.roundPoly j.succ v).eval 1 =
      (Chain.roundPoly j.castSucc v).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc) := by
  simp only [ChainEqs, Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker, LinearMap.add_apply,
    LinearMap.sub_apply, Chain.evalRound_apply, sub_eq_zero]

theorem initialChain0_le (ch : Challenges K) :
    Chain.InitialChain0 (Bat := Bat) ch ≤ ChainEqs ch := inf_le_right

theorem L_mem_chainEqs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  rw [PureRounds.roundPoly_L, PureRounds.roundPoly_L]
  exact Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg π B τ) j

theorem originalRounds_mem_chainEqs (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : Trace K) :
    PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t) ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [mem_chainEqs_iff]
  intro j
  rw [Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds, Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds]
  exact Chain.rounds_chain ch _ (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch t) j

theorem dir_mem_chainEqs (ch : Challenges K) : (dir : Payload K Bat) ∈ ChainEqs ch :=
  initialChain0_le ch (Chain.dir_mem_initialChain0 ch)

theorem A_mem_chainEqs (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact L_mem_chainEqs π B ch _

theorem cTilde_mem_chainEqs (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch ∈ ChainEqs ch := by
  rw [cTilde_eq]
  exact (ChainEqs ch).sub_mem
    ((ChainEqs ch).add_mem (L_mem_chainEqs _ B ch _) (originalRounds_mem_chainEqs x.1 B ch _))
    ((ChainEqs ch).smul_mem _ (dir_mem_chainEqs ch))

theorem roundPoly_roundProjection (v : Payload K Bat) (j : Fin 10) :
    Chain.roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat)
      (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) v)) = Chain.roundPoly j v :=
  (Chain.roundPoly_roundInclusion j _).trans (Chain.roundPoly_apply j v).symm

/-- The chain equalities and the terminal equation give `ChainT0`. -/
theorem roundProjection_mem_chainT0 (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) (hv : v ∈ ChainEqs ch)
    (h9 : (Chain.roundPoly 9 v).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0) :
    R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) v ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0 (Bat := Bat) ch := by
  rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_chainT0_iff]
  simp only [roundPoly_roundProjection]
  exact ⟨(mem_chainEqs_iff ch v).1 hv, h9⟩

/-! ### Round cells in a subfield (R7) -/

theorem maskLinear_mem (S : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) (τ : Trace K)
    (hτ : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ S) : PayloadSplit.maskLinear π B a τ ∈ S := by
  rw [PayloadSplit.maskLinear_apply]
  have hcl := fun j c => R0Z.K4Values.honestClaims_mem S τ hτ a ha j c
  have hml : ∀ fam : ℕ, R0P.Mask.maskLinear fam a ∈ S :=
    fun fam => sum_mem fun j _ => S.mul_mem (natCast_mem S _) (ha j)
  have htb : ∀ j, R0P.Mask.towerBasis B j ∈ S := by
    intro j
    unfold R0P.Mask.towerBasis
    split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact hi
    · exact hu
    · exact S.mul_mem hi hu
  refine S.add_mem ?_ ?_
  · unfold R0P.Mask.maskValue
    refine S.add_mem (S.add_mem (sum_mem fun c _ => S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))
      (S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))) (sum_mem fun c _ => S.mul_mem ?_ (hcl _ _))
    · show R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis B _ _ ∈ S
      exact S.mul_mem (htb _) (S.pow_mem (hml 0) _)
    · show 1 + R0P.Mask.maskLinear 16 a ^ 26 ∈ S
      exact S.add_mem S.one_mem (S.pow_mem (hml 16) _)
    · show R0P.Mask.mulTowerBasis B _ _ ∈ S
      exact S.mul_mem (htb _) (S.pow_mem (hml 0) _)
  · unfold R0P.Mask.honestExtra AspisR0.RoundNormalization.dot
    refine sum_mem fun j _ => S.mul_mem ?_ ?_
    · unfold R0P.Mask.libraWeight R0P.SemSource.libraWeight
      split_ifs
      · exact S.pow_mem (ha 8) _
      · exact S.pow_mem (ha 9) _
      · exact S.zero_mem
    · unfold coeffsOf
      exact hτ _ _

theorem L_round_mem (S : Subfield K) (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F)
    (hi : B.i ∈ S) (hu : B.u ∈ S) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (τ : Trace K) (hτ : ∀ c r, τ c r ∈ S) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ (.semanticCoeff j i) ∈ S := by
  rw [PayloadSplit.L_round, PayloadSplit.rounds_apply]
  exact R0Z.K4Values.interpolate_coeff_mem S _ (fun k => sum_mem fun tail _ =>
    maskLinear_mem S π B hi hu _ (R0Z.K4Values.roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail) τ hτ) i.val

/-! ### Round-only payloads -/

/-- A difference of round inclusions and a multiple of `dir` vanishes off the
round cells. -/
theorem roundOnly_cell (p p' : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) (k : K) (cell : PayloadCell Bat)
    (hc : ∀ j i, cell ≠ .semanticCoeff j i) :
    (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p - PayloadSplit.roundInclusion p' - k • dir :
      Payload K Bat) cell = 0 := by
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i => exact absurd rfl (hc j i)
  | maskSum => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | pointClaim j c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | extraClaim c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | ood j c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | inactiveSum => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | opened q s c => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring
  | bat b => show (0 : K) - 0 - k * 0 = 0; ring

/-! ### The mask lift (DESIGN-ii-prime §2.4) -/

theorem nonRound_pointClaim (v : Payload K Bat) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    nonRound (F := F) v (.pointClaim j c) = v (.pointClaim j c) := rfl

theorem nonRound_inactiveSum (v : Payload K Bat) :
    nonRound (F := F) v .inactiveSum = v .inactiveSum := rfl

theorem nonRound_extraClaim (v : Payload K Bat) (c : Fin 29) :
    nonRound (F := F) v (.extraClaim c) = v (.extraClaim c) := rfl

/-- `mask_lift`, generic in the batched block and in the relation space `B0`. -/
theorem mask_lift_of (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (ch : Challenges K) (B0 : Submodule F (Bat → K))
    (hQ : R0Z.SilentReduction.QPrime (Bat := Bat) π B hB ch)
    (hown : (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
      (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ≤ B0)
    (hR : B0 ≤ (LinearMap.ker (R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch) ⊓
      LinearMap.ker (R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch)).map
        (R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch))
    (Y : Payload K Bat)
    (hclaim : ∀ j c, Y (.pointClaim j c) = 0) (hextra : ∀ c, Y (.extraClaim c) = 0)
    (hood : ∀ j c, Y (.ood j c) = 0) (hopen : ∀ q s c, Y (.opened q s c) = 0)
    (hia : Y .inactiveSum = 0) (hinit : R0Z.HonestValid.iota Y = 0)
    (hT : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.ChainT0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch)
    (hb : R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y ∈ B0) :
    Y ∈ LinearMap.range ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM) := by
  obtain ⟨x0, hx0, hRx0⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hQ hT)
  have hbx0 : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch x0 ∈ B0 :=
    hown (Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hx0)
  obtain ⟨y, hy, hby⟩ := Submodule.mem_map.1 (hR (B0.sub_mem hb hbx0))
  obtain ⟨hyo, hyR⟩ := Submodule.mem_inf.1 hy
  have hown_m : R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) = 0 := by
    rw [map_add, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hx0, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyo, add_zero]
  have hR_m : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) =
      R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y := by
    rw [map_add, hRx0, LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hyR, add_zero]
  have hbat_m : R0Z.SilentReduction.batMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y) =
      R0Z.SilentReduction.batRead (F := F) Y := by
    rw [map_add, hby]
    abel
  have hproj : R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y)) =
      R0Z.Z4Maps.roundProjection (F := F) Y := hR_m
  refine ⟨x0 + y, ?_⟩
  apply R0Z.SilentReduction.payload_ext (F := F)
  · funext cell
    cases cell with
    | semanticCoeff j i => rfl
    | maskSum =>
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) .maskSum = Y .maskSum
      rw [R0Z.SilentReduction.ms_pure_eq_initial,
        R0Z.SilentReduction.roundPoly_eq_of_roundProjection hproj 0]
      have hi := hinit
      rw [R0Z.HonestValid.iota_apply] at hi
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp hi
    | pointClaim j c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.pointClaim j c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.pointClaim j c)
      rw [nonRound_pointClaim, nonRound_pointClaim, h1, hclaim j c]
    | extraClaim c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.extraClaim c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.extraClaim c)
      rw [nonRound_extraClaim, nonRound_extraClaim, h1, hextra c]
    | ood j c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.ood j c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.ood j c)
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.ood j c) = Y (.ood j c)
      rw [h1, hood j c]
    | inactiveSum =>
      rw [nonRound_inactiveSum, nonRound_inactiveSum,
        R0Z.SilentReduction.ia_pure_zero (Bat := Bat) π B ch (x0 + y), hia]
    | opened q s c =>
      have h1 : (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.opened q s c) = 0 := by
        simpa only [R0Z.SilentReduction.ownMap, R0Z.SilentReduction.ownProj, LinearMap.comp_apply,
          LinearMap.pi_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply, Pi.zero_apply] using congrFun hown_m (.opened q s c)
      show (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM (x0 + y) (.opened q s c) = Y (.opened q s c)
      rw [h1, hopen q s c]
    | bat b =>
      exact congrFun hbat_m b
  · exact hproj

/-! J0 (DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4, §1.5, §4; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.5; LOG D24.1):
the validity restriction for clause (ii′).

* `HonestValid pub B t ch`: at the payload trace `u = actual pub B t ch 0`,
  every production lane vanishes on the Boolean rows and the two H1 helper
  sums (all rows, inactive rows) are zero.  It reads only the semantic layer,
  so it is the same for every batched block `Bat`.
* `HonestProver.restrict h V`: the prover on the instances satisfying `V`.
  `MaskImageOn`, `hvzk_on_of` and the FsAbort theorems are generic in the
  prover, so they apply verbatim to `h.restrict V` (corollaries below).
* `iota` (initial sum minus `.maskSum`) and `.inactiveSum` vanish on the
  whole tape image `A`; on `cTilde` they equal the Boolean sum of the original
  terminal and γ²⁶ times the inactive helper sum, and both are zero for a
  valid instance (`iota_cTilde_zero`, `inactive_cTilde_zero`).
* `not_iiPrime_witness`: two witnesses with different `iota (cTilde ·)` are
  never related by `range A` (the §1.4 obstruction, as an implication).

Builder completeness (honest builds are `HonestValid`) is J0b and is not
asserted here.  No row set is enumerated: the only concrete evaluation is the
membership of row 1023 in the inactive set, one entry of a 64-entry table. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.ZkStatement.HonestProver

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: the prover restricted to the instances satisfying `V`. -/
def restrict {K : Type} (h : HonestProver K) (V : h.Instance → Prop) : HonestProver K :=
  ⟨{w // V w}, h.transport, fun w => h.public w.1, fun w => h.build w.1⟩

end R0Z.ZkStatement.HonestProver

  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Row 1023 is copy-inactive (DESIGN-ii-prime P6) -/

/-- One entry of the 64-entry mask table: `copyActiveRowMasks 63 = 1749`,
whose bit 15 is clear. -/
theorem inactive_1023 : (1023 : Fin 1024) ∈ copyInactiveRows := by
  rw [R0Z.TerminalEligible.mem_inactive]
  have h63 : copyActiveRowMasks 63 = 1749 := by unfold copyActiveRowMasks; rfl
  change ¬ (copyActiveRowMasks 63).testBit 15 = true
  rw [h63]
  decide

attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

/-! ### The validity predicate and the restricted prover -/

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: validity of the payload trace `u = actual pub B t ch 0`
at the semantic challenges `λ = ch.sem 0`, `χ = ch.sem 1`. -/
def HonestValid (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K) : Prop :=
  (∀ i b, laneOf (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0) ∧
  (∑ r, PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 26 r = 0) ∧
  (∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 26 r = 0)

/-- DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §3.5: valid for every challenge satisfying `P`. -/
def ValidOn (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : h.Instance → Prop :=
  fun w => ∀ ch, P ch → HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: clause (ii′) for valid witnesses. -/
def IIPrimeValid (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w w', h.public w = x.1 → h.public w' = x.1 →
    HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch → HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w') ch →
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)

section Restrict
variable (h : HonestProver K) (V : h.Instance → Prop)

theorem restrict_public (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) :
    (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).public w = h.public w.1 := rfl

theorem restrict_build (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) :
    (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).build w = h.build w.1 := rfl

theorem restrict_transport :
    (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).transport = h.transport := rfl

theorem sRem_restrict (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F) :
    sRem (Bat := Bat) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x w ch n = sRem h B x w.1 ch n := rfl

theorem cTilde_restrict (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V).Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x w ch = cTilde h B x w.1 ch := rfl

theorem inLanguage_restrict (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    JointView.InLanguage (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) x ↔ ∃ w, V w ∧ h.public w = x.1 :=
  ⟨fun ⟨w, hw⟩ => ⟨w.1, w.2, hw⟩, fun ⟨w, hv, hw⟩ => ⟨⟨w, hv⟩, hw⟩⟩

/-- `MaskImageOn` of the restricted prover, unfolded: both clauses on the
instances satisfying `V`. -/
theorem maskImageOn_restrict_iff (P : Challenges K → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x ↔
      (∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w n, V w → h.public w = x.1 →
        sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM)) ∧
      (∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w w', V w → V w' → h.public w = x.1 → h.public w' = x.1 →
        cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∈ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch)) :=
  ⟨fun hm => ⟨fun ch hP w n hv hw => hm.1 ch hP ⟨w, hv⟩ n hw,
      fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => hm.2 ch hP ⟨w, hv⟩ ⟨w', hv'⟩ hw hw'⟩,
    fun hm => ⟨fun ch hP w n hw => hm.1 ch hP w.1 n w.2 hw,
      fun ch hP w w' hw hw' => hm.2 ch hP w.1 w'.1 w.2 w'.2 hw hw'⟩⟩

end Restrict

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §2.5 composition: clause (i′) for all witnesses and the
valid form of (ii′) give `MaskImageOn` for the prover restricted to `ValidOn`. -/
theorem maskImageOn_restrict_of (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (hi : ∀ ch, P ch → ∀ w n, h.public w = x.1 →
      sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ LinearMap.range ((A h.transport B ch).comp inlM))
    (hii : IIPrimeValid (Bat := Bat) P h B x) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h (ValidOn P h B x)) B x :=
  (maskImageOn_restrict_iff h (ValidOn P h B x) P B x).2
    ⟨fun ch hP w n _ hw => hi ch hP w n hw,
      fun ch hP w w' hv hv' hw hw' => hii ch hP w w' hw hw' (hv ch hP) (hv' ch hP)⟩

/-- `hvzk_on_of` applied verbatim to the restricted prover. -/
theorem hvzk_on_restrict [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x →
      HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs x :=
  hvzk_on_of P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs x

/-- ZF1-abort Theorem A applied verbatim to the restricted prover. -/
theorem zkfs_restrict_abort [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FsStatement.FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]

    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (ab : FsAbort.AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ)
    (hm : MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B x)
    (hr : FsAbort.AbortReductionWith P (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs ab x
      ε_real ε_ideal) :
    FsStatement.ZK_FS (ZkStatement.HonestProver.restrict h V) B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal) :=
  FsAbort.zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort P _ B outputs fs x
    (hvzk_on_restrict P h V B outputs x hm) ab ε_real ε_ideal hr

/-- ZF1-abort Theorem B applied verbatim to the restricted prover. -/
theorem zkfs_restrict_abort_terms [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (V : h.Instance → Prop) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FsStatement.FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)

    (h0 : 0 ≤ ε_hit) (h1 : 0 ≤ ε_coll) (h2 : 0 ≤ ε_prog)

/-! ### The initial-sum functional ι -/

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime (O1): `ι v = p₀(0) + p₀(1) − v.maskSum`. -/
def iota : Payload K Bat →ₗ[K] K :=
  Chain.evalRound 0 0 + Chain.evalRound 0 1 - Shift.proj .maskSum

theorem iota_apply (v : Payload K Bat) :
    iota v = (Chain.roundPoly 0 v).eval 0 + (Chain.roundPoly 0 v).eval 1 - v .maskSum := by
  simp only [iota, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.add_apply, Chain.evalRound_apply, Shift.proj_apply]

/-- ι vanishes on `L τ` for every trace (rounds_initial with maskLinear_vdeg). -/
theorem iota_L (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (τ : Trace K) :
    iota (PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ) = 0 := by
  rw [iota_apply, PureRounds.roundPoly_L, Chain.rounds_initial ch _ (maskLinear_vdeg π B τ),
    Chain.bsumB_eq_sum, PureRounds.L_maskSum]
  exact sub_self _

/-- ι vanishes on the whole tape image. -/
theorem iota_A (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    iota (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t) = 0 := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact iota_L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t)

theorem iota_originalRounds (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (u : Trace K) :
    iota (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch u)) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b)) := by
  have h0 : PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat)
      (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch u) .maskSum = 0 := rfl
  rw [iota_apply, Chain.roundPoly_originalRounds, Chain.rounds_initial ch _ (vdeg_fOrig pub B ch u),
    h0, sub_zero]

theorem iota_dir : iota (dir : Payload K Bat) = 0 := by
  have hm : (dir : Payload K Bat) .maskSum = 0 := rfl
  have h09 : (0 : Fin 10) ≠ 9 := by decide
  simp only [iota_apply, Chain.roundPoly_dir, h09, ↓reduceIte, eval_zero, hm, add_zero, sub_zero]

/-! ### The zero-tape payload -/

/-- `c = L u + O u` at `u = actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0` (D12's `hc`). -/
theorem c_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    JointView.c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.O x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) := by
  have hs : D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch 0 =
      PayloadSplit.L h.transport B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) +
        PayloadSplit.O x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) :=
    PayloadSplit.run_split h.transport x.1 B (applyEligible (h.build w) (0 : T K F).2.2) ch
      (aff (0 : T K F))
  have hz : D12.payload (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch 0 = JointView.c h B x w ch :=
    congrArg (JointView.payload h B x w ch) (map_zero Partition.equiv)
  exact hz.symm.trans hs

theorem iota_c (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    iota (JointView.c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (ofBool b)) := by
  rw [c_eq, map_add, iota_L, zero_add]
  exact iota_originalRounds x.1 B ch _

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4 (O1) on `cTilde`. -/
theorem iota_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) (ofBool b)) := by
  unfold cTilde
  rw [map_sub, map_smul, iota_dir, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact iota_c h B x w ch

/-! ### The Boolean sum of the original terminal at a valid trace -/

/-- The 14 pre-sumcheck challenges read from `ch.sem` (λ, χ, θ, zc, μ). -/
def preOf (ch : Challenges K) : Fin 14 → K := fun i => ch.sem ⟨i.val, by omega⟩

/-- `fOrig`'s terminal arguments are exactly `virtualPoly`'s at `preOf ch`. -/
theorem fOrig_eq_virtualPoly (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (u : Trace K) (a : Fin 10 → K) :
    fOrig pub B ch u a = ch.sem 14 * virtualPoly pub B u (preOf ch) a := rfl

theorem fOrig_ofBool (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (u : Trace K)
    (h1 : ∀ i b, laneOf u pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0) (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b) = ch.sem 14 * (ch.sem 13 * u 26 (rowOf b) +
      ch.sem 13 ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) *
        u 26 (rowOf b))) := by
  rw [fOrig_eq_virtualPoly, honestRows pub B u (preOf ch) b]
  have hl : lanesComp (preOf ch 2) (laneOf u pub (preOf ch 0) (preOf ch 1) B) b = 0 := by
    unfold lanesComp
    exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun i _ => by
      rw [show laneOf u pub (preOf ch 0) (preOf ch 1) B i b = 0 from h1 i b, mul_zero])
  rw [hl, mul_zero, zero_add]
  rfl

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: with the lanes zero and both helper sums zero, the
Boolean sum of the original terminal vanishes (honestRows, lane_h1_sum,
lane_inactive_sum). -/
theorem bsum_fOrig_zero_of (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (u : Trace K)
    (h1 : ∀ i b, laneOf u pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B i b = 0)
    (h2 : ∑ r, u 26 r = 0) (h3 : ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, u 26 r = 0) :
    bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b)) = 0 := by
  have hs : (fun b => fOrig pub B ch u (ofBool b)) = fun b => ch.sem 14 * (ch.sem 13 * u 26 (rowOf b) +
      ch.sem 13 ^ 2 * ((1 - copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel (rowOf b)))) *
        u 26 (rowOf b))) := funext (fOrig_ofBool pub B ch u h1)
  rw [hs, bsumB_smul, bsumB_add, bsumB_smul, bsumB_smul, lane_h1_sum, lane_inactive_sum, h2, h3]
  simp only [mul_zero, add_zero]

theorem bsum_fOrig_zero (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hv : HonestValid pub B t ch) :
    bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0) (ofBool b)) = 0 :=
  bsum_fOrig_zero_of pub B ch _ hv.1 hv.2.1 hv.2.2

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.5: ι vanishes on `cTilde` of a valid instance. -/
theorem iota_cTilde_zero (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hv : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) :
    iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) = 0 :=
  (iota_cTilde h B x w ch).trans (bsum_fOrig_zero x.1 B (h.build w) ch hv)

/-! ### The inactive sum -/

theorem dot_indicator (v : Fin 1024 → K) :
    dotLinear (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows) v = ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, v r := by
  unfold dotLinear
  rw [LinearMap.sum_apply]
  simp only [LinearMap.smul_apply, LinearMap.proj_apply]
  have hi (i : Fin 1024) :
      (AspisR0.Opening.indicator copyInactiveRows i : K) • v i =
      if i ∈ copyInactiveRows then v i else 0 := by
    unfold AspisR0.Opening.indicator
    by_cases hm : i ∈ copyInactiveRows
    · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte, one_smul]
    · simp only [hm, ↓reduceIte, zero_smul]
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => hi i), Finset.sum_ite_mem, Finset.univ_inter]

/-- If every lane of `τ` sums to zero over the inactive rows, so does `L τ`. -/
theorem inactive_L_zero (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (τ : Trace K) (hτ : ∀ l, ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, τ l r = 0) :
    PayloadSplit.L (Bat := Bat) π B ch τ .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  rw [SilentReduction.L_inactiveSum, SilentReduction.linearPayload_inactiveSum]
  exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun l _ => by rw [dot_indicator, hτ l, mul_zero])

/-- Each semantic column of `applyEligible` is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem applyEligible_inactive_sum (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (l : Fin 29)
    (hl : l.val < 16) : ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, applyEligible t e l r = 0 := by
  simp only [applyEligible, hl, ↓reduceIte]
  unfold balance
  exact SilentReduction.balance_sum_generic copyInactiveRows 1023 _ _ inactive_1023
    (fun s => t l s + semanticNoise (Sum.elim e 0) l s)

/-- Every lane of the eligible-noise trace is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem eligible_inactive_sum (e : EligibleNoise K F) (l : Fin 29) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, JointTrace.eligibleLinear e l r = 0 := by
  by_cases hl : l.val < 16
  · simp only [JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, hl, ↓reduceIte]
    unfold balance
    exact SilentReduction.balance_sum_generic copyInactiveRows 1023 _ _ inactive_1023
      (fun s => semanticNoise (Sum.elim e 0) l s)
  · simp only [JointTrace.eligibleLinear_apply, hl, ↓reduceIte, Finset.sum_const_zero]

/-- Every lane of the tape trace is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem tape_inactive_sum (B : PackBasis F) (t : T K F) (l : Fin 29) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, JointTrace.tapeLinear B t l r = 0 := by
  have he (r : Fin 1024) : JointTrace.tapeLinear B t l r =
      JointTrace.eligibleLinear t.2.2 l r + traceLinear B (aff t) l r := rfl
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => he r), Finset.sum_add_distrib, eligible_inactive_sum,
    SilentReduction.traceLinear_inactive_sum, add_zero]

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4 (O2): `.inactiveSum` vanishes on the whole tape image. -/
theorem inactive_A (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) (t : T K F) :
    A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  have hA : A (Bat := Bat) π B ch t = PayloadSplit.L π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) := rfl
  rw [hA]
  exact inactive_L_zero (Bat := Bat) π B ch (JointTrace.tapeLinear B t) (tape_inactive_sum B t)

/-- Every lane other than H1 of the payload trace is balanced over the inactive rows. -/
theorem actual_inactive_sum (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K) (ch : Challenges K)
    (l : Fin 29) (hl : l.val ≠ 26) :
    ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 l r = 0 := by
  have he : PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch 0 =
      traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) + traceLinear B (aff (0 : T K F)) :=
    applyAff_eq_base_add B (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) (aff (0 : T K F))
  rw [he]
  simp only [Pi.add_apply]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, SilentReduction.traceLinear_inactive_sum, add_zero]
  by_cases h16 : l.val < 16
  · have hb (r : Fin 1024) : traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) l r =
        applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2 l r := by
      simp only [traceBase, prepare, h16, hl, true_or, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => hb r)]
    exact applyEligible_inactive_sum t _ l h16
  · have hb (r : Fin 1024) : traceBase (prepare pub (applyEligible t (0 : T K F).2.2) ch) l r = 0 := by
      simp only [traceBase, h16, hl, or_self, ↓reduceIte]
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun r _ => hb r), Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem inactive_c (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    JointView.c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum = ch.opening 0 ^ (26 : Fin 29).val *
      ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 26 r := by
  have hO : PayloadSplit.O (Bat := Bat) x.1 B ch
      (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0) .inactiveSum = 0 := rfl
  rw [c_eq, Pi.add_apply, hO, add_zero, SilentReduction.L_inactiveSum,
    SilentReduction.linearPayload_inactiveSum, Finset.sum_eq_single (26 : Fin 29)]
  · rw [dot_indicator]
  · intro l _ hl
    rw [dot_indicator, actual_inactive_sum _ _ _ _ l (fun he => hl (Fin.ext he)), mul_zero]
  · intro hn
    exact absurd (Finset.mem_univ _) hn

/-- DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4 (O2) on `cTilde`. -/
theorem inactive_cTilde (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum = ch.opening 0 ^ (26 : Fin 29).val *
      ∑ r ∈ copyInactiveRows, PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0 26 r := by
  have hd : (dir : Payload K Bat) .inactiveSum = 0 := rfl
  unfold cTilde
  rw [Pi.sub_apply, Pi.smul_apply, hd, smul_zero, sub_zero]
  exact inactive_c h B x w ch

theorem inactive_cTilde_zero (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (hv : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  rw [inactive_cTilde, hv.2.2, mul_zero]

/-- (R2)/(R3) of DESIGN-ii-prime §2.3 for the (★) difference of two valid witnesses. -/
theorem iota_inactive_diff_zero (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w w' : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hv : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w) ch) (hv' : HonestValid x.1 B (h.build w') ch) :
    iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch) = 0 ∧
      (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch : Payload K Bat) .inactiveSum = 0 := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [map_sub, iota_cTilde_zero h B x w ch hv, iota_cTilde_zero h B x w' ch hv', sub_zero]
  · rw [Pi.sub_apply, inactive_cTilde_zero h B x w ch hv, inactive_cTilde_zero h B x w' ch hv',
      sub_zero]

/-! ### The obstruction (DESIGN-ii-prime §1.4) -/

/-- Unequal ι-values are never related by the tape image: clause (ii′) without
a validity premise fails for any prover with two such instances. -/
theorem not_iiPrime_witness (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w w' : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hne : iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch) ≠ iota (cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w' ch)) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∉ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  apply hne
  have h0 := iota_A (Bat := Bat) h.transport B ch t
  rw [ht, map_sub] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0

/-- The same for unequal inactive sums. -/
theorem not_iiPrime_inactive (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w w' : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K)
    (hne : cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch .inactiveSum ≠ cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w' ch .inactiveSum) :
    cTilde (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - cTilde h B x w' ch ∉ LinearMap.range (A h.transport B ch) := by
  rintro ⟨t, ht⟩
  apply hne
  have h0 := inactive_A (Bat := Bat) h.transport B ch t
  rw [ht, Pi.sub_apply] at h0
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp h0
