import R0Z.Shift
import R0Z.TerminalEligible

/-! T2b-1: honest round identities and the terminal-zero chain submodule.
This proves only membership of the remainder, not a mask-image inclusion. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.Chain
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.SemDegree R0P.Sumcheck R0Z.MaskLayout
  R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift R0Z.TerminalEligible Polynomial
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-- Leading Boolean coordinate and tail; no cube is enumerated. -/
def boolConsEquiv (n : Nat) : (Bool × (Fin n → Bool)) ≃ (Fin (n+1) → Bool) where
  toFun p := Fin.cons p.1 p.2
  invFun b := (b 0, Fin.tail b)
  left_inv p := by cases p; simp only [Fin.cons_zero, Fin.tail_cons]
  right_inv b := Fin.cons_self_tail b

theorem bsumB_eq_sum (n : Nat) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) : bsumB n f = ∑ b, f b := by
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    rw [bsumB, Fintype.sum_unique]
    congr 1
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [bsumB, ih, ih]
    have he : (∑ b : Fin (n+1) → Bool, f b) =
        ∑ p : Bool × (Fin n → Bool), f (Fin.cons p.1 p.2) := by
      exact (Fintype.sum_equiv (boolConsEquiv n)
        (fun p => f (Fin.cons p.1 p.2)) f (fun _ => rfl)).symm
    rw [he, Fintype.sum_prod_type, Fintype.sum_bool]
    exact add_comm _ _

theorem sum_cons_cast (n m : Nat) (h : n = m+1) (f : (Fin n → Bool) → K) :
    (∑ b, f b) =
      (∑ b : Fin m → Bool, f (fun i => Fin.cons (n := m) (α := fun _ => Bool) false b (Fin.cast h i))) +
      ∑ b : Fin m → Bool, f (fun i => Fin.cons (n := m) (α := fun _ => Bool) true b (Fin.cast h i)) := by
  subst n
  rw [← bsumB_eq_sum, bsumB, bsumB_eq_sum, bsumB_eq_sum]
  rfl

theorem roundPoint_zero (ch : Challenges K) (z : K) (tail : Fin 9 → Bool) :
    roundPoint ch 0 z tail = Fin.cons z (ofBool tail) := by
  funext i
  refine Fin.cases ?_ (fun k => ?_) i
  · simp only [roundPoint, Fin.val_zero, Nat.lt_irrefl, ↓reduceDIte, Fin.cons_zero]
  · simp only [roundPoint, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_zero, Nat.not_lt_zero, Nat.add_one_ne_zero,
      ↓reduceDIte, Nat.sub_zero, Nat.add_sub_cancel, Fin.cons_succ, ofBool]

theorem roundPoint_cons (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 9) (b : Bool)
    (tail : Fin (9-j.succ.val) → Bool) :
    roundPoint ch j.castSucc (alpha ch j.castSucc)
      (fun i => Fin.cons (n := 9-j.succ.val) (α := fun _ => Bool) b tail (Fin.cast (by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]; omega) i)) =
    roundPoint ch j.succ (if b then 1 else 0) tail := by
  funext i
  have hj : j.castSucc.val = j.val := rfl
  have hj' : j.succ.val = j.val+1 := rfl
  by_cases hlo : i.val < j.val
  · simp only [roundPoint, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, dif_pos hlo,
      dif_pos (show i.val < j.val+1 by omega)]
  · by_cases he : i.val = j.val
    · have hij : i = j.castSucc := Fin.ext he
      subst i
      simp only [roundPoint, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, Nat.lt_irrefl,
        ↓reduceDIte, Nat.lt_succ_self]
    · by_cases hn : i.val = j.val+1
      · simp only [roundPoint, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, dif_neg hlo, dif_neg he,
          dif_neg (show ¬i.val < j.val+1 by omega), dif_pos hn]
        have hz : (Fin.cast (by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]; omega)
            (⟨i.val-j.val-1, by omega⟩ : Fin (9-j.castSucc.val)) : Fin ((9-j.succ.val)+1)) = 0 := by
          apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_mk]; omega
        exact congrArg (fun x : Bool => if x then (1 : K) else 0)
          ((congrArg (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Bool) b tail) hz).trans (Fin.cons_zero _ _))
      · have hgt : j.val+1 < i.val := by omega
        simp only [roundPoint, Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ, dif_neg hlo, dif_neg he,
          dif_neg (show ¬i.val < j.val+1 by omega), dif_neg hn]
        have hs : (Fin.cast (by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]; omega)
            (⟨i.val-j.val-1, by omega⟩ : Fin (9-j.castSucc.val)) : Fin ((9-j.succ.val)+1)) =
            (⟨i.val-(j.val+1)-1, by simp only [Fin.val_succ]; omega⟩ : Fin (9-j.succ.val)).succ := by
          apply Fin.ext; simp only [Fin.val_cast, Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_succ, Fin.val_mk]; omega
        exact congrArg (fun x : Bool => if x then (1 : K) else 0)
          ((congrArg (Fin.cons (α := fun _ => Bool) b tail) hs).trans (Fin.cons_succ _ _ _))

/-- Lemma B, with its T2b-1′ Boolean-domain composition. -/
theorem rounds_initial (ch : Challenges K) (f : PayloadSplit.PointFunction K)
    (hf : VDeg 10 (fun _ => 27) f) :
    (PayloadSplit.rounds ch 0 f).eval 0 + (PayloadSplit.rounds ch 0 f).eval 1 =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => f (ofBool b)) := by
  rw [rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch 0 f hf, rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch 0 f hf]
  change (∑ tail : Fin 9 → Bool, f (roundPoint ch 0 0 tail)) +
    (∑ tail : Fin 9 → Bool, f (roundPoint ch 0 1 tail)) = _
  simp only [roundPoint_zero]
  rw [bsumB, bsumB_eq_sum, bsumB_eq_sum]
  simp only [ofBool_cons, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

theorem rounds_chain (ch : Challenges K) (f : PayloadSplit.PointFunction K)
    (hf : VDeg 10 (fun _ => 27) f) (j : Fin 9) :
    (PayloadSplit.rounds ch j.succ f).eval 0 + (PayloadSplit.rounds ch j.succ f).eval 1 =
      (PayloadSplit.rounds ch j.castSucc f).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc) := by
  rw [rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch j.succ f hf, rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch j.succ f hf,
    rounds_eval_of_vdeg ch j.castSucc f hf]
  rw [sum_cons_cast (9-j.castSucc.val) (9-j.succ.val)
    (by simp only [Fin.val_castSucc, Fin.val_succ]; omega)]
  simp only [roundPoint_cons, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte]

/-! ### The four K-linear constraints -/

/-- Polynomial read from round j's 28 coefficient cells. -/
def roundPoly (j : Fin 10) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[K] K[X] :=
  ∑ i : Fin 28, (monomial i.val).comp (proj (.semanticCoeff j i))

theorem roundPoly_apply (j : Fin 10) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    roundPoly j v = ∑ i : Fin 28, monomial i.val (v (.semanticCoeff j i)) := by
  simp only [roundPoly, LinearMap.sum_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, proj_apply]

theorem roundPoly_nine : roundPoly (K := K) (Bat := Bat) 9 = round9Poly := rfl

def evalRound (j : Fin 10) (z : K) : Payload K Bat →ₗ[K] K := (Polynomial.leval z).comp (roundPoly j)

theorem evalRound_apply (j : Fin 10) (z : K) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    evalRound j z v = (roundPoly j v).eval z := rfl

/-- The existing nonround projection over K, before restriction to F. -/
def nonRoundK : Payload K Bat →ₗ[K] Payload K Bat :=
  LinearMap.pi fun coord => match coord with
  | .semanticCoeff _ _ => 0
  | coord => (LinearMap.proj coord : Payload K Bat →ₗ[K] K)

theorem nonRoundK_apply (v : Payload K Bat) : nonRoundK v = nonRound (F := F) v := by
  funext coord
  cases coord <;> rfl

/-- Round-only, initial-zero and boundary-chain constraints, before the
terminal value is imposed. This auxiliary space contains `dir`. -/
def InitialChain0 (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule K (Payload K Bat) :=
  (LinearMap.ker nonRoundK ⊓ LinearMap.ker (evalRound 0 0 + evalRound 0 1)) ⊓
    ⨅ j : Fin 9, LinearMap.ker
      (evalRound j.succ 0 + evalRound j.succ 1 - evalRound j.castSucc (alpha ch j.castSucc))

/-- The chain space is a K-submodule: all four conditions are kernels of
K-linear maps. Its explicit membership statement is `mem_chain0_iff`. -/
def Chain0 (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule K (Payload K Bat) :=
  InitialChain0 ch ⊓ LinearMap.ker (evalRound 9 (alpha ch 9))

theorem mem_initialChain0_iff (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    v ∈ InitialChain0 ch ↔ nonRound (F := F) v = 0 ∧
      (roundPoly 0 v).eval 0 + (roundPoly 0 v).eval 1 = 0 ∧
      ∀ j : Fin 9, (roundPoly j.succ v).eval 0 + (roundPoly j.succ v).eval 1 =
        (roundPoly j.castSucc v).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc) := by
  simp only [InitialChain0, Submodule.mem_inf, Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker,
    LinearMap.add_apply, LinearMap.sub_apply, evalRound_apply, nonRoundK_apply (F := F), sub_eq_zero]
  tauto

theorem mem_chain0_iff (ch : Challenges K) (v : Payload K Bat) :
    v ∈ Chain0 ch ↔ nonRound (F := F) v = 0 ∧
      (roundPoly 0 v).eval 0 + (roundPoly 0 v).eval 1 = 0 ∧
      (∀ j : Fin 9, (roundPoly j.succ v).eval 0 + (roundPoly j.succ v).eval 1 =
        (roundPoly j.castSucc v).eval (alpha ch j.castSucc)) ∧
      (roundPoly 9 v).eval (alpha ch 9) = 0 := by
  simp only [Chain0, Submodule.mem_inf, mem_initialChain0_iff (F := F), LinearMap.mem_ker,
    evalRound_apply]
  tauto

theorem roundPoly_roundInclusion (j : Fin 10) (p : PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K) :
    roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p) = ∑ i : Fin 28, monomial i.val (p j i) := by
  rw [roundPoly_apply]
  rfl

theorem roundPoly_rounds (ch : Challenges K) (j : Fin 10) (f : PayloadSplit.PointFunction K) :
    roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (fun k i => (PayloadSplit.rounds ch k f).coeff i.val)) =
      PayloadSplit.rounds ch j f := by
  rw [roundPoly_roundInclusion]
  exact sum_monomial_coeff _ (rounds_natDegree_lt ch j f)

theorem roundPoly_originalRounds (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K)
    (t : Trace K) (j : Fin 10) :
    roundPoly j (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t)) =
      PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fOrig pub B ch t) := by
  rw [originalRounds_eq, roundPoly_rounds]

theorem roundPoly_dir (j : Fin 10) :
    roundPoly j (dir : Payload K Bat) = if j = 9 then X - C (1/2 : K) else 0 := by
  unfold dir
  rw [roundPoly_roundInclusion]
  by_cases hj : j = 9
  · simp only [if_pos hj]
    exact sum_monomial_coeff _ (by rw [natDegree_X_sub_C]; norm_num)
  · simp only [if_neg hj, map_zero, Finset.sum_const_zero]

theorem two_ne_zero : (2 : K) ≠ 0 := by
  intro h
  have he : (⟨2, by omega⟩ : Fin 28) = ⟨0, by omega⟩ :=
    nodes_injOn (K := K) (by simp) (by simp)
      (by simpa only [Fin.val_mk, Nat.cast_ofNat, Nat.cast_zero] using h)
  have hv := congrArg Fin.val he
  norm_num at hv

theorem dir_mem_initialChain0 (ch : Challenges K) : (dir : Payload K Bat) ∈ InitialChain0 ch := by
  rw [mem_initialChain0_iff (F := (⊥ : Subfield K))]
  refine ⟨nonRound_dir, ?_, ?_⟩
  · simp only [roundPoly_dir, show (0 : Fin 10) ≠ 9 from by decide, if_false,
      eval_zero, add_zero]
  · intro j
    have hj : j.castSucc ≠ (9 : Fin 10) := by
      intro h
      have he := congrArg Fin.val h
      change j.val = 9 at he
      omega
    rw [roundPoly_dir, roundPoly_dir, if_neg hj, eval_zero]
    by_cases hn : j.succ = (9 : Fin 10)
    · rw [if_pos hn]
      simp only [eval_sub, eval_X, eval_C]
      field_simp [two_ne_zero (K := K)] <;> ring
    · rw [if_neg hn, eval_zero, eval_zero, add_zero]


/-! ### Initial sum and remainder membership -/

/-- Eligible C1 noise leaves every prepared terminal row fixed. Affine H1
padding contributes only the balanced term from Lemma C, whose sum is zero.
The eta factor occurs once, inside `fOrig`. -/
theorem original_bsum_actual (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (r : T K F) :
    bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch r) (ofBool b)) =
      bsumB 10 (fun b => fOrig pub B ch (prepare pub t ch) (ofBool b)) := by
  have he (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
      fOrig pub B ch (PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch r) (ofBool b) =
      fOrig pub B ch (prepare pub t ch) (ofBool b) +
        (ch.sem 14 * (ch.sem 13 + ch.sem 13 ^ 2)) *
          h1Padding B (Sum.elim 0 (aff r)) (rowOf b) := by
    unfold fOrig PayloadSplit.actual
    rw [terminal_applyAff, terminal_row_eligible]
    ring
  simp_rw [he]
  rw [bsumB_add, bsumB_smul, h1Padding_bsumB, mul_zero, add_zero]

theorem roundPoly_g (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F) (j : Fin 10) :
    roundPoly j (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) (g h B x w ch n)) =
      PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (0,n))) -
      PayloadSplit.rounds ch j (fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0)) := by
  have hg : roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) (g h B x w ch n) =
      PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch
        (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (0,n))) -
      PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (PayloadSplit.originalRounds x.1 B ch
        (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch 0)) := map_sub PayloadSplit.roundInclusion _ _
  rw [hg, map_sub, roundPoly_originalRounds, roundPoly_originalRounds]

theorem g_mem_initialChain0 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F) :
    roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) (g h B x w ch n) ∈ InitialChain0 ch := by
  rw [mem_initialChain0_iff (F := F)]
  refine ⟨nonRound_roundInclusion _, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [roundPoly_g]
    simp only [eval_sub]
    have hn := rounds_initial ch _
      (vdeg_fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (0,n)))
    have hz := rounds_initial ch _
      (vdeg_fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (0 : T K F)))
    rw [original_bsum_actual] at hn hz
    linear_combination hn - hz
  · intro j
    rw [roundPoly_g, roundPoly_g]
    simp only [eval_sub]
    have hn := rounds_chain ch _
      (vdeg_fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (0,n))) j
    have hz := rounds_chain ch _
      (vdeg_fOrig x.1 B ch (PayloadSplit.actual x.1 B (h.build w) ch (0 : T K F))) j
    linear_combination hn - hz

/-- T2b-1: only the final-coordinate half collision must be excluded.
No mask-image premise, witness-validity premise or stronger Good assumption. -/
theorem sRem_mem_chain0 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F) (hgood : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1/2) :
    sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ Chain0 ch := by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · exact (InitialChain0 ch).sub_mem (g_mem_initialChain0 h B x w ch n)
      ((InitialChain0 ch).smul_mem _ (dir_mem_initialChain0 ch))
  · change evalRound9 ch (sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n) = 0
    have hm : claimMask B (alpha ch) (sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n) = 0 := by
      unfold sRem
      have hr : claimMask B (alpha ch) (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) (g h B x w ch n)) = 0 := by
        change claimMask B (alpha ch) (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) (g h B x w ch n)) = 0
        exact claimMask_roundInclusion B (alpha ch) _
      rw [map_sub, map_smul, hr, claimMask_dir, smul_zero, sub_zero]
    have hp := Phi0_sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n hgood
    simpa only [Phi0, LinearMap.sub_apply, hm, sub_zero] using hp

#print axioms sRem_mem_chain0

#print axioms rounds_initial
#print axioms rounds_chain
end R0Z.Chain
R0Z.TerminalEligible:
import R0P.SemHonest
import R0Z.HelperInvariant

/-! T2b-1: Boolean-row invariance under eligible C1 noise, and the exact
zero-sum H1-padding correction. All row sums and registries stay symbolic. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.TerminalEligible
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.Sumcheck R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows
variable {K : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}

/-- A protected semantic cell survives both noise and balancing. -/
theorem cell_eligible (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : r ≠ 1023) (he : ¬ eligible c r) : applyEligible t e c r = t c r := by
  unfold applyEligible
  split_ifs with hc
  · simp only [balance, if_neg hr, semanticNoise, dif_neg he, add_zero]
  · rfl

theorem cell_low (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : r.val < 912) (hl : r.val % 16 < 13) : applyEligible t e c r = t c r := by
  apply cell_eligible t e c r
  · intro h; subst r; norm_num at hr
  · unfold eligible
    omega

/-! ### Reads protected by the per-family selectors -/

theorem schedule_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : scheduleFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      scheduleFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  unfold scheduleFamily
  apply congrArg₂ List.append <;> apply congrArg List.ofFn <;> funext c
  · rw [schedule_initial_row, schedule_initial_row]
    split_ifs with hl hf hn
    · rw [cell_low t e _ r (by unfold ScheduleFull at hf; omega) (by omega)]
    · rw [cell_low t e _ r (by unfold ScheduleNode at hn; omega) (by omega)]
    · rfl
    · rfl
  · rw [schedule_absorption_row, schedule_absorption_row]
    split_ifs with ha
    · apply cell_low t e _ r
      · have hb : r.val / 16 < 57 := by
          have hh := ha.2
          unfold ScheduleAbsorbs at hh
          split_ifs at hh <;> omega
        omega
      · omega
    · rfl

theorem digest_row_low (pub : Public K) (key : DigestKey) :
    (digestRow pub key).val < 912 ∧ (digestRow pub key).val % 16 < 13 := by
  have hc := digest_carry_le pub.nextPairIndex
  cases key <;> simp only [digestRow, g2Row, Fin.val_mk]
  all_goals first | omega | (split_ifs <;> (try dsimp only) <;> omega)

theorem digest_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : digestFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      digestFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  unfold digestFamily
  apply congrArg List.ofFn
  funext lane
  simp only [publicDigestLanes, digest_fold_eq]
  congr 1
  apply congrArg List.sum
  apply List.map_congr_left
  intro key _
  by_cases hr : digestRow pub key = r
  · subst r
    simp only [rowOpenings]
    rw [cell_low t e _ _ (digest_row_low pub key).1 (digest_row_low pub key).2]
  · rw [rowSel_ne r _ hr, zero_mul, zero_mul]

/-- The forest path support supplies a literal `forestPathUsed` witness. -/
theorem forest_used (r : Fin 1024) (hr : PathRow r) (c : Fin 29)
    (hc : c.val ≤ 8) : forestPathUsed c.val r.val := by
  rcases hr with ⟨hh, hb, hl⟩
  rcases hl with hl | hl | hl | hl
  all_goals
    refine ⟨⟨4 * (r.val / 16 - 57) + (r.val % 16 - 1) / 4, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only
    left
    constructor <;> omega

theorem forest_succ_used (r : Fin 1024) (hr : PathRow r) (c : Fin 29) :
    forestPathUsed c.val (succRow r).val := by
  rcases hr with ⟨hh, hb, hl⟩
  rcases hl with hl | hl | hl | hl
  all_goals
    refine ⟨⟨4 * (r.val / 16 - 57) + (r.val % 16 - 1) / 4, by omega⟩, ?_⟩
    dsimp only [succRow]
    right
    omega

theorem cell_forest (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : 912 ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < 1008) (hu : forestPathUsed c.val r.val) :
    applyEligible t e c r = t c r := by
  apply cell_eligible t e c r
  · intro h; subst r; norm_num at hr
  · simp only [eligible, if_pos hr.2, hu, not_true_eq_false, and_false, or_false]
    omega

theorem path_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : pathFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      pathFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  simp only [pathFamily, path_selector_row]
  by_cases hr : PathRow r
  · have hz (c : Fin 16) (hc : c.val ≤ 8) :
        (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).z c = (rowOpenings t r).z c := by
      apply cell_forest
      · unfold PathRow at hr; omega
      · exact forest_used r hr _ hc
    have hs : (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).succ = (rowOpenings t r).succ := by
      funext c
      apply cell_forest
      · unfold PathRow succRow at *; dsimp only; omega
      · exact forest_succ_used r hr _
    have h0 := hz 0 (by norm_num)
    have hi (i : Fin 8) := hz (i.addNat 1 |>.castLE (by omega)) (by simp only [Fin.val_castLE, Fin.val_addNat]; omega)
    simp only [pathLanes, h0, hs, hi]
  · simp only [if_neg hr, pathLanes, zero_mul]

/-- Congruence of a fold uses only entries actually in its list. -/
private theorem fold_congr {I V : Type} (xs : List I) (f g : V → I → V)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ xs, ∀ v, f v i = g v i) (v : V) : xs.foldl f v = xs.foldl g v := by
  induction xs generalizing v with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons i xs ih =>
    simp only [List.foldl_cons]
    rw [h i List.mem_cons_self v]
    exact ih (fun j hj => h j (List.mem_cons_of_mem i hj)) _

private theorem selector_row (b r : Fin 1024) :
    copySelectorRow (copySelectors (rowSel (K := K) b)) r = rowSel b r := by
  simp only [copySelectorRow, copySelectors, g2_high_row, g2_low_row, rowSel]
  by_cases hr : r = b
  · subst r; simp
  · have hp : ¬ (r.val / 16 = b.val / 16 ∧ r.val % 16 = b.val % 16) := by
      intro h; apply hr; apply Fin.ext; omega
    by_cases hh : r.val / 16 = b.val / 16
    · have hl : r.val % 16 ≠ b.val % 16 := fun h => hp ⟨hh,h⟩
      simp only [if_pos hh, if_neg hl, if_neg hr, mul_zero]
    · simp only [if_neg hh, if_neg hr, zero_mul]

theorem copy_endpoint_eligible (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (lam : K)
    (r : Fin 1024) (ep : CopyEndpoint) (hp : HelperInvariant.Protected ep)
    (values weights : Fin 2 → K) (tag : Nat) (weight : K) :
    copyAccumulateEndpoint values weights ep tag weight
      (copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).z lam) (copySelectors (rowSel r)) =
    copyAccumulateEndpoint values weights ep tag weight
      (copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings t r).z lam) (copySelectors (rowSel r)) := by
  unfold copyAccumulateEndpoint
  rw [selector_row]
  by_cases hr : ep.row = r
  · subst r
    have he : copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) ep.row).z lam ep.pattern =
        copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings t ep.row).z lam ep.pattern := by
      unfold copyPatternValuesLiteral
      apply fold_congr
      intro i _ v
      by_cases hi : (copyPatterns ep.pattern).kinds i = 1
      · simp only [if_pos hi, rowOpenings, HelperInvariant.protected_cell t e ep hp i hi]
      · simp only [if_neg hi]
    rw [he]
  · rw [rowSel_ne _ _ hr]
    simp only [zero_mul]

/-- Copy includes every LogUp and positivity endpoint in the protected registry. -/
theorem copy_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (lam chi : K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r)
      (applyEligible t e 26 r) (rowSel r) =
    copyFamily.residuals pub lam chi (rowOpenings t r) (t 26 r) (rowSel r) := by
  have he (row : CopyRowExtension K) (link : CopyLink) (hl : link ∈ copyLinks) :
      copyAccumulateRow pub (copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).z lam)
        (copySelectors (rowSel r)) row link =
      copyAccumulateRow pub (copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings t r).z lam)
        (copySelectors (rowSel r)) row link := by
    dsimp only [copyAccumulateRow]
    rw [copy_endpoint_eligible t e lam r link.producer (HelperInvariant.protected_registry link hl).1,
      copy_endpoint_eligible t e lam r link.consumer (HelperInvariant.protected_registry link hl).2]
  have hf := fold_congr copyLinks
    (copyAccumulateRow pub (copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).z lam)
      (copySelectors (rowSel r)))
    (copyAccumulateRow pub (copyPatternValuesLiteral (rowOpenings t r).z lam) (copySelectors (rowSel r)))
    (fun link hl row => he row link hl) ⟨fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0, fun _ => 0⟩
  unfold copyFamily copyEvaluateWithSelectors
  change [copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel r)) * copyResidual
    (copyLinks.foldl (copyAccumulateRow pub _ _) _) (t 26 r) chi] =
    [copyActiveLiteral (copySelectors (rowSel r)) * copyResidual
    (copyLinks.foldl (copyAccumulateRow pub _ _) _) (t 26 r) chi]
  rw [hf]

private theorem poseidon_inactive (o : Openings K) (block : K) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : 11 ≤ r.val % 16) (lane : Fin 16) :
    poseidonScalarResidual o block (g2Low (rowSel r)) lane = 0 := by
  have h0 : g2Low (rowSel (K := K) r) 0 = 0 := by rw [g2_low_row, if_neg (by omega)]
  have h1 : g2Low (rowSel (K := K) r) 1 = 0 := by rw [g2_low_row, if_neg (by omega)]
  have h9 : g2Low (rowSel (K := K) r) 9 = 0 := by rw [g2_low_row, if_neg (by omega)]
  have h10 : g2Low (rowSel (K := K) r) 10 = 0 := by rw [g2_low_row, if_neg (by omega)]
  have hi : (fun i : Fin 7 => g2Low (rowSel (K := K) r) ⟨i.val + 2, by omega⟩) = fun _ => 0 := by
    funext i
    rw [g2_low_row, if_neg (by dsimp only; omega)]
  simp only [poseidonScalarResidual, h0, h1, h9, h10, hi, g2_fold_add,
    List.sum_ofFn, Finset.sum_const_zero, List.foldl_cons, List.foldl_nil,
    zero_add, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_zero]

theorem poseidon_eligible (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (e : EligibleNoise K F) (r : Fin 1024) :
    (poseidonPackedFamily B).residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      (poseidonPackedFamily B).residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  have he (lane : Fin 16) :
      poseidonScalarResidual (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (g2SumHigh (rowSel r) 0 57 (by omega))
        (g2Low (rowSel r)) lane =
      poseidonScalarResidual (rowOpenings t r) (g2SumHigh (rowSel r) 0 57 (by omega))
        (g2Low (rowSel r)) lane := by
    by_cases hb : r.val / 16 < 57
    · by_cases hl : r.val % 16 < 11
      · have hz : (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).z = (rowOpenings t r).z := by
          funext c
          exact cell_low t e _ r (by omega) (by omega)
        have hs : (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).succ = (rowOpenings t r).succ := by
          funext c
          apply cell_low
          · dsimp only [succRow]; omega
          · dsimp only [succRow]; omega
        unfold poseidonScalarResidual
        rw [hz, hs]
        by_cases h0 : r.val % 16 = 0
        · have hdiv : (xor12Row r).val / 16 = r.val / 16 := by
            change (r.val ^^^ 12) / 2^4 = r.val / 16
            rw [Nat.xor_div_two_pow]
            simp
          have hmod : (xor12Row r).val % 16 = 12 := by
            change (r.val ^^^ 12) % 2^4 = 12
            rw [Nat.xor_mod_two_pow]
            simp only [show 2^4 = (16 : Nat) from rfl, h0]
            rfl
          have hx : (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).xor12 = (rowOpenings t r).xor12 := by
            funext c
            exact cell_low t e _ _ (by omega) (by omega)
          rw [hx]
        · have hz0 : g2Low (rowSel (K := K) r) 0 = 0 := by rw [g2_low_row, if_neg (by omega)]
          rw [hz0]
          simp only [zero_mul]
      · rw [poseidon_inactive _ _ r (by omega), poseidon_inactive _ _ r (by omega)]
    · rw [g2_sum_high_row, if_neg (by omega)]
      simp only [poseidonScalarResidual, zero_mul]
  simp only [poseidonPackedFamily, he]

/-- The translated auxiliary region is protected precisely where the literal
`pairAuxUsed` predicate says it is used. -/
theorem cell_aux (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : 1008 ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < 1023) (hu : pairAuxUsed c.val (r.val - 48)) :
    applyEligible t e c r = t c r := by
  apply cell_eligible t e c r
  · intro h; subst r; norm_num at hr
  · simp only [eligible, if_neg (by omega : ¬r.val < 1008), hu,
      not_true_eq_false, and_false, or_false]
    omega

/-- Three value records: current, successor and xor12, columns 0 through 10. -/
theorem cell_value (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024)
    (v : Fin 3) (hc : c.val ≤ 10)
    (hr : r.val = 1008 + 2*v.val ∨ r.val = 1009 + 2*v.val ∨ r.val = (1008 + 2*v.val) ^^^ 12) :
    applyEligible t e c r = t c r := by
  have hx0 : (1008 : Nat) ^^^ 12 = 1020 := rfl
  have hx1 : (1010 : Nat) ^^^ 12 = 1022 := rfl
  have hx2 : (1012 : Nat) ^^^ 12 = 1016 := rfl
  have hy0 : (960 : Nat) ^^^ 12 = 972 := rfl
  have hy1 : (962 : Nat) ^^^ 12 = 974 := rfl
  have hy2 : (964 : Nat) ^^^ 12 = 968 := rfl
  have ht : 1008 ≤ r.val ∧ r.val < 1023 := by
    fin_cases v <;> norm_num only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_ofNat, hx0, hx1, hx2] at hr <;> omega
  apply cell_aux t e c r ht
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨v, ?_, hc⟩)⟩
  fin_cases v <;> norm_num only [Fin.val_zero, Fin.val_one, Fin.val_ofNat, hx0, hx1, hx2, hy0, hy1, hy2] at hr ⊢ <;> omega

/-- Conservation and occupancy read exactly these auxiliary cells. -/
theorem cell_aux_tail (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : (r.val = 1014 ∧ c.val < 3) ∨ (r.val = 1015 ∧ c.val < 2) ∨
      (r.val = 1017 ∧ c.val ≤ 10) ∨ (r.val = 1018 ∧ c.val < 10)) :
    applyEligible t e c r = t c r := by
  apply cell_aux t e c r (by omega)
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, by omega, Or.inr (Or.inr ?_)⟩
  omega

private theorem valueRange_congr (o p : Openings K)
    (hz : ∀ c : Fin 16, c.val ≤ 10 → o.z c = p.z c)
    (hs : ∀ c : Fin 16, c.val ≤ 10 → o.succ c = p.succ c)
    (hx : ∀ c : Fin 16, c.val ≤ 10 → o.xor12 c = p.xor12 c) : valueRange o = valueRange p := by
  have he (u v : Fin 16 → K) (h : ∀ c : Fin 16, c.val ≤ 10 → u c = v c) :
      valueReconstruct10 u = valueReconstruct10 v := by
    simp only [valueReconstruct10, h 0 (by norm_num), h 1 (by norm_num), h 2 (by norm_num),
      h 3 (by norm_num), h 4 (by norm_num), h 5 (by norm_num), h 6 (by norm_num),
      h 7 (by norm_num), h 8 (by norm_num), h 9 (by norm_num)]
  have hz' (i : Fin 10) := hz (i.castAdd 6) (by simp only [Fin.val_castAdd]; omega)
  have hs' (i : Fin 10) := hs (i.castAdd 6) (by simp only [Fin.val_castAdd]; omega)
  have hx' (i : Fin 10) := hx (i.castAdd 6) (by simp only [Fin.val_castAdd]; omega)
  simp only [valueRange, hz', hs', hx', he _ _ hz, he _ _ hs, he _ _ hx,
    hz 10 (by norm_num), hs 10 (by norm_num), hx 10 (by norm_num)]

theorem value_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : valueFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      valueFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  have hv (v : Fin 3) (hr : r.val = 1008 + 2*v.val) :
      valueRange (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) = valueRange (rowOpenings t r) := by
    apply valueRange_congr
    · intro c hc
      exact cell_value t e _ r v hc (Or.inl hr)
    · intro c hc
      apply cell_value t e _ (succRow r) v hc
      right; left
      dsimp only [succRow]
      omega
    · intro c hc
      apply cell_value t e _ (xor12Row r) v hc
      right; right
      dsimp only [xor12Row]
      rw [hr]
  change (valueRange (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r)).map
      (fun x => (((0 + rowSel r 1008) + rowSel r 1010) + rowSel r 1012) * x) ++
      [rowSel r 1014 * ((applyEligible t e 0 r - applyEligible t e 1 r) - applyEligible t e 2 r),
       rowSel r 1014 * (applyEligible t e 0 (succRow r) - applyEligible t e 1 (succRow r))] =
    (valueRange (rowOpenings t r)).map
      (fun x => (((0 + rowSel r 1008) + rowSel r 1010) + rowSel r 1012) * x) ++
      [rowSel r 1014 * ((t 0 r - t 1 r) - t 2 r), rowSel r 1014 * (t 0 (succRow r) - t 1 (succRow r))]
  apply congrArg₂ List.append
  · by_cases hr : r = 1008 ∨ r = 1010 ∨ r = 1012
    · rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl
      · rw [hv 0 rfl]
      · rw [hv 1 rfl]
      · rw [hv 2 rfl]
    · have h0 : (1008 : Fin 1024) ≠ r := by tauto
      have h2 : (1010 : Fin 1024) ≠ r := by tauto
      have h4 : (1012 : Fin 1024) ≠ r := by tauto
      simp only [rowSel_ne _ _ h0, rowSel_ne _ _ h2, rowSel_ne _ _ h4, zero_add, zero_mul]
      simp only [valueRange, List.map_append, List.map_ofFn, List.map_cons, List.map_nil,
        Function.comp_def]
  · by_cases hr : (1014 : Fin 1024) = r
    · subst r
      have hz (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 3) : applyEligible t e c 1014 = t c 1014 :=
        cell_aux_tail t e c 1014 (Or.inl ⟨rfl,hc⟩)
      have hs (c : Fin 29) (hc : c.val < 2) : applyEligible t e c 1015 = t c 1015 :=
        cell_aux_tail t e c 1015 (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl,hc⟩))
      norm_num only [rowOpenings, Fin.castLE, show succRow 1014 = 1015 from rfl,
        hz 0 (by norm_num), hz 1 (by norm_num), hz 2 (by norm_num),
        hs 0 (by norm_num), hs 1 (by norm_num)]
    · simp only [rowSel_ne _ _ hr, zero_mul]

theorem occupancy_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : occupancyFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      occupancyFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  change occupancyLanesLiteral (rowSel r 1017) (rowSel r 1018) (occupancyExpected pub.variant)
      (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r).z =
    occupancyLanesLiteral (rowSel r 1017) (rowSel r 1018) (occupancyExpected pub.variant) (rowOpenings t r).z
  by_cases hi : (1017 : Fin 1024) = r
  · subst r
    have hc (c : Fin 16) (h : c.val ≤ 10) :
        (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) 1017).z c = (rowOpenings t 1017).z c :=
      cell_aux_tail t e _ 1017 (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl ⟨rfl,h⟩)))
    have hl (i : Fin 8) := hc ⟨2+i.val, by omega⟩ (by dsimp only; omega)
    simp only [occupancyLanesLiteral,
      hc 0 (by norm_num), hc 1 (by norm_num), hc 9 (by norm_num), hc 10 (by norm_num), hl]
  · by_cases ho : (1018 : Fin 1024) = r
    · subst r
      have hc (c : Fin 16) (h : c.val < 10) :
          (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) 1018).z c = (rowOpenings t 1018).z c :=
        cell_aux_tail t e _ 1018 (Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr ⟨rfl,h⟩)))
      have hl (i : Fin 8) := hc ⟨2+i.val, by omega⟩ (by dsimp only; omega)
      simp only [occupancyLanesLiteral, rowSel_ne _ _ hi, zero_mul,
        hc 0 (by norm_num), hc 1 (by norm_num), hc 9 (by norm_num), hl]
    · simp only [occupancyLanesLiteral, rowSel_ne _ _ hi, rowSel_ne _ _ ho, zero_add, zero_mul]

private theorem selected_difference (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F) (c : Fin 29)
    (k r : Fin 1024) (v : K) (hk : applyEligible t e c k = t c k) :
    rowSel r k * (applyEligible t e c r - v) = rowSel r k * (t c r - v) := by
  by_cases hr : k = r
  · subst r; rw [hk]
  · rw [rowSel_ne _ _ hr, zero_mul, zero_mul]

theorem asset_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : assetFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (rowSel r) =
      assetFamily.residuals pub (rowOpenings t r) (rowSel r) := by
  have h44 := selected_difference t e 1 44 r pub.assetId (cell_low t e 1 44 (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have h508 := selected_difference t e 1 508 r pub.assetId (cell_low t e 1 508 (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have h460 := selected_difference t e 1 460 r pub.assetId (cell_low t e 1 460 (by norm_num) (by norm_num))
  have h1010 := selected_difference t e 10 1010 r (pub.withdrawalAmount.getD 0)
    (cell_value t e 10 1010 1 (by norm_num) (Or.inl rfl))
  change assetScalarLanes pub.variant pub.withdrawalAmount.isSome
      (rowSel r 44 * (applyEligible t e 1 r - pub.assetId))
      (rowSel r 508 * (applyEligible t e 1 r - pub.assetId))
      (rowSel r 460 * (applyEligible t e 1 r - pub.assetId))
      (rowSel r 1010 * (applyEligible t e 10 r - pub.withdrawalAmount.getD 0)) =
    assetScalarLanes pub.variant pub.withdrawalAmount.isSome
      (rowSel r 44 * (t 1 r - pub.assetId)) (rowSel r 508 * (t 1 r - pub.assetId))
      (rowSel r 460 * (t 1 r - pub.assetId)) (rowSel r 1010 * (t 10 r - pub.withdrawalAmount.getD 0))
  rw [h44, h508, h460, h1010]

/-- Membership only unfolds the filter, never its row universe. -/
theorem mem_inactive (r : Fin 1024) : r ∈ copyInactiveRows ↔ ¬ CopyActiveRow r := by
  rw [copyInactiveRows, Finset.mem_filter]
  simp only [Finset.mem_univ, true_and]

theorem zero_inactive : ¬ CopyActiveRow 0 := by
  have h0 : copyActiveRowMasks 0 = 6144 := by unfold copyActiveRowMasks; rfl
  change ¬ (copyActiveRowMasks 0).testBit 0 = true
  rw [h0]
  decide

theorem padding_active (B : PackBasis F) (tape : MaskTape K F) (r : Fin 1024)
    (hr : CopyActiveRow r) : h1Padding B tape r = 0 := by
  have hn : r ≠ 0 := fun h => zero_inactive (h ▸ hr)
  simp only [h1Padding, balance, if_neg hn, if_pos hr]

/-- The cancellation is generic in the index type and support set. -/
private theorem sum_balanced {I : Type} [Fintype I] [DecidableEq I]
    (S : Finset I) (d : I) (w : I → K) (hw : ∀ r, r ∉ S → w r = 0) :
    (∑ r, if r = d then -(∑ s ∈ S.erase d, w s) else w r) = 0 := by
  have hs : (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase d, w r) = ∑ r ∈ S.erase d, w r := by
    symm
    apply Finset.sum_subset
    · intro r hr
      exact Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp hr).1, Finset.mem_univ r⟩
    · intro r hr hn
      apply hw r
      intro hm
      exact hn (Finset.mem_erase.mpr ⟨(Finset.mem_erase.mp hr).1, hm⟩)
  rw [← Finset.sum_erase_add _ _ (Finset.mem_univ d)]
  rw [if_pos rfl]
  have he : (∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase d,
      if r = d then -(∑ s ∈ S.erase d, w s) else w r) =
        ∑ r ∈ Finset.univ.erase d, w r := by
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro r hr
    exact if_neg (Finset.mem_erase.mp hr).1
  rw [he, hs, add_neg_cancel]

theorem h1Padding_sum (B : PackBasis F) (tape : MaskTape K F) :
    ∑ r : Fin 1024, h1Padding B tape r = 0 := by
  apply sum_balanced copyInactiveRows 0
    (fun r => if CopyActiveRow r then 0 else extensionRaw B tape 1 r)
  intro r hr
  have ha : CopyActiveRow r := by
    by_contra hn
    exact hr ((mem_inactive r).mpr hn)
  exact if_pos ha

theorem h1Padding_bsumB (B : PackBasis F) (tape : MaskTape K F) :
    bsumB 10 (fun b => h1Padding B tape (rowOf b)) = 0 := by
  rw [bsumB_rowOf, h1Padding_sum]

theorem h1Padding_zero (B : PackBasis F) : h1Padding B (0 : MaskTape K F) = 0 := by
  have he (r : Fin 1024) : extensionRaw B (0 : MaskTape K F) 1 r = 0 := by
    simp only [extensionRaw, pack4, Pi.zero_apply, ZeroMemClass.coe_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
  funext r
  simp only [h1Padding, he, ite_self, balance, Finset.sum_const_zero, neg_zero,
    Pi.zero_apply, ite_self]

theorem openings_applyAff (B : PackBasis F) (u : Trace K) (tape : AffTape K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : rowOpenings (applyAff B u tape) r = rowOpenings u r := by
  have hc (c : Fin 16) (s : Fin 1024) :
      applyAff B u tape (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) s = u (Fin.castLE (by omega) c) s := by
    simp only [applyAff, Fin.val_castLE, if_pos c.isLt]
  simp only [rowOpenings, hc]

theorem h1_applyAff (B : PackBasis F) (u : Trace K) (tape : AffTape K F)
    (r : Fin 1024) : applyAff B u tape 26 r = u 26 r + h1Padding B (Sum.elim 0 tape) r := by
  rfl

/-- At an inactive row every lane is independent of H1. -/
theorem lanes_inactive (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (u v : Trace K)
    (lam chi : K) (r : Fin 1024) (hr : ¬ CopyActiveRow r)
    (ho : rowOpenings u r = rowOpenings v r) :
    laneAt pub lam chi B (rowOpenings u r) (u 26 r) (rowSel r) =
      laneAt pub lam chi B (rowOpenings v r) (v 26 r) (rowSel r) := by
  funext i
  unfold laneAt
  split_ifs
  · rw [ho]
  · rw [ho]
  · rw [copy_inactive_residuals pub lam chi u r hr,
      copy_inactive_residuals pub lam chi v r hr]

theorem terminal_applyAff (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (u : Trace K)
    (tape : AffTape K F) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims (applyAff B u tape) (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) =
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims u (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) +
      (ch.sem 13 + ch.sem 13 ^ 2) * h1Padding B (Sum.elim 0 tape) (rowOf b) := by
  have ho := openings_applyAff B u tape (rowOf b)
  have hl : laneAt pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B
      (rowOpenings (applyAff B u tape) (rowOf b)) (applyAff B u tape 26 (rowOf b))
      (rowSel (rowOf b)) =
      laneAt pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) B (rowOpenings u (rowOf b)) (u 26 (rowOf b))
        (rowSel (rowOf b)) := by
    by_cases ha : CopyActiveRow (rowOf b)
    · rw [ho, h1_applyAff, padding_active B _ _ ha, add_zero]
    · exact lanes_inactive pub B _ u _ _ _ ha ho
  simp only [terminalValue, honestClaims_ofBool, selAt_ofBool]
  change eqValue (zc ch) (ofBool b) *
      (∑ i : Fin 29, ch.sem 2 ^ i.val * laneAt pub _ _ B
        (rowOpenings (applyAff B u tape) (rowOf b)) (applyAff B u tape 26 (rowOf b)) _ i) +
      ch.sem 13 * applyAff B u tape 26 (rowOf b) +
      ch.sem 13 * ch.sem 13 * ((1 - activeAt (ofBool b)) * applyAff B u tape 26 (rowOf b)) = _
  rw [hl, h1_applyAff]
  simp only [rowOpenings]
  by_cases ha : CopyActiveRow (rowOf b)
  · rw [padding_active B _ _ ha]
    ring
  · rw [activeAt_ofBool, copy_active_row, if_neg ha]
    ring

/-- Per-family audit assembled in the terminal's actual lane order. -/
theorem lanes_eligible (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (e : EligibleNoise K F) (lam chi : K) (r : Fin 1024) :
    laneAt pub lam chi B (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) r) (applyEligible t e 26 r) (rowSel r) =
      laneAt pub lam chi B (rowOpenings t r) (t 26 r) (rowSel r) := by
  funext i
  simp only [laneAt, scalarLaneAt, poseidon_eligible, schedule_eligible,
    occupancy_eligible, path_eligible, value_eligible, digest_eligible, asset_eligible,
    copy_eligible]

/-- The stronger row fact needs no honesty premise on the trace. -/
theorem terminal_eligible (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (e : EligibleNoise K F) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims (applyEligible t e) (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) =
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims t (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) := by
  simp only [terminalValue, honestClaims_ofBool, selAt_ofBool]
  change eqValue (zc ch) (ofBool b) *
      (∑ i : Fin 29, ch.sem 2 ^ i.val * laneAt pub _ _ B
        (rowOpenings (applyEligible t e) (rowOf b)) (applyEligible t e 26 (rowOf b)) _ i) +
      ch.sem 13 * applyEligible t e 26 (rowOf b) +
      ch.sem 13 * ch.sem 13 * ((1 - activeAt (ofBool b)) * applyEligible t e 26 (rowOf b)) = _
  rw [lanes_eligible]
  rfl

theorem prepare_eligible (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K) (e : EligibleNoise K F)
    (ch : Challenges K) :
    prepare pub (applyEligible t e) ch = applyEligible (prepare pub t ch) e := by
  funext c r
  by_cases hc : c.val = 26
  · have h16 : ¬c.val < 16 := by omega
    simp only [prepare, if_pos hc, HelperInvariant.helper_eligible]
    simp only [applyEligible, if_neg h16, prepare, if_pos hc]
  · simp only [prepare, if_neg hc, applyEligible]

/-- Lemma A, exactly the prepared-trace statement fixed by T2b-1. -/
theorem terminal_row_eligible (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (t : Trace K)
    (e : EligibleNoise K F) (ch : Challenges K) (b : Fin 10 → Bool) :
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims (prepare pub (applyEligible t e) ch) (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) =
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B
      (honestClaims (prepare pub t ch) (ofBool b)) (ofBool b) := by
  rw [prepare_eligible, terminal_eligible]

#print axioms terminal_row_eligible

#print axioms terminal_applyAff
#print axioms h1Padding_bsumB
end R0Z.TerminalEligible
R0Z.Z4Maps:
import R0Z.D12
import R0Z.Shift

/-! Z4 opening move only: observation maps and unproved surjectivity targets.
The targets below are propositions, not asserted theorems or certificates.
No rank computation or unrestricted ambient-surjectivity claim is made. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.Z4Maps
open R0P R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

def roundProjection : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K :=
  LinearMap.pi fun j => LinearMap.pi fun i => LinearMap.proj (.semanticCoeff j i)

/-- A ∘ inl_M observed on the round-polynomial component. -/
def roundMaskMap (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    M K F →ₗ[F] PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K :=
  roundProjection.comp ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM)

/-- (i) requires zero change to every non-round disclosure. Projection alone
would forget that requirement, so its lift must lie in this kernel. -/
def silentMasks (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : Submodule F (M K F) :=
  LinearMap.ker (nonRound.comp ((A (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp inlM))

def silentRoundMaskMap (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    silentMasks (Bat := Bat) π B ch →ₗ[F] PayloadSplit.RoundPayload K :=
  (roundMaskMap (Bat := Bat) π B ch).comp (silentMasks π B ch).subtype

inductive C1Cell
  | point (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 16)
  | ood (j : Fin 2) (c : Fin 16)
  | opened (q : Fin 262144) (s : Fin 4) (c : Fin 16)
  deriving DecidableEq, Fintype

/-- Exactly the semantic C1 claims and query-gated openings. -/
def c1Projection : Payload K Bat →ₗ[F] (C1Cell → K) :=
  LinearMap.pi fun coord => match coord with
  | .point j c => LinearMap.proj (.pointClaim j (Fin.castLE (by omega) c))
  | .ood j c => LinearMap.proj (.ood j (Fin.castLE (by omega) c))
  | .opened q s c => LinearMap.proj (.opened q s (Fin.castLE (by omega) c))

/-- Full joint tape observed in the C1 components that the pure masks cannot hide. -/
def c1Map (π : Fin 1024 ≃ Fin 1024) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) : T K F →ₗ[F] (C1Cell → K) :=
  c1Projection.comp (A (Bat := Bat) π B ch)

/-- Z4 lemma statement for (i′) on `Good`, including the zero-complement
constraint: the target is the round projection of D14's remainder s(w,n) after
Ψ_ch, not the entire ambient array. -/
def roundMask_surjectivity (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ ch, Good ch → ∀ w n, h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ m : silentMasks (Bat := Bat) h.transport B ch,
      silentRoundMaskMap h.transport B ch m = roundProjection (F := F) (sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n)

/-- Z4 encoder-restriction lemma statement needed for (ii) beyond the mask
lanes. This is the C1 part only: a proof still needs a compatible lift for the
remaining components before it can establish full-payload clause (ii′). Its C1
projection does not see `dir`, so only the `Good` restriction is added. -/
def c1_surjectivity (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : Prop :=
  ∀ ch, Good ch → ∀ w w', h.public w = x.1 → h.public w' = x.1 →
    c1Projection (F := F) (c (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch - c h B x w' ch) ∈ LinearMap.range (c1Map (Bat := Bat) h.transport B ch)

#print roundMask_surjectivity
#print c1_surjectivity
#print axioms roundMaskMap
#print axioms silentRoundMaskMap
#print axioms c1Map
end R0Z.Z4Maps
R0Z.FsAbort:
import R0Z.FsGood

/-! ZF1-abort (D29): honest-prover rejection on a public challenge predicate.
The prover retries with fresh coins until the drawn challenge satisfies `P`,
up to a cap `N`, and publishes only the accepted attempt (or the failure
output). The middle experiments then pass only `P`-challenges to the view
and the simulator, so `HVZK_on P` makes them equal: no `badMass P` term.
The remaining error is the abort-aware ROM reduction, split into named
identical-until-bad events (discarded-point hits, prover-address
collisions, programming failures) whose bounds are payload facts and enter
as hypotheses. The core (`retryTest`, `retry_means_eq`) is generic in the
coin, tape and view types. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsAbort
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift R0Z.FsGood
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-! ### Generic core: uniform means -/

theorem mean_equiv {R S : Type} [Fintype R] [Fintype S] (e : R ≃ S) (f : R → ℚ) :
    mean f = mean (fun s => f (e.symm s)) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Fintype.card_congr e]
  congr 1
  exact Fintype.sum_equiv e f (fun s => f (e.symm s)) (fun r => by simp)

theorem mean_const {R : Type} [Fintype R] [Nonempty R] (c : ℚ) :
    mean (fun _ : R => c) = c := by
  unfold mean
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul]
  have h : (Fintype.card R : ℚ) ≠ 0 := Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr Fintype.card_ne_zero
  field_simp

/-- A test of one coordinate of an independent tuple has the coordinate's mean:
the other attempts' tapes are marginalised out. -/
theorem mean_eval {N : Nat} {T : Type} [Fintype T] [Nonempty T] (k : Fin N) (g : T → ℚ) :
    mean (fun ts : Fin N → T => g (ts k)) = mean g := by
  rw [mean_equiv (Equiv.funSplitAt k T)]
  have hk : ∀ p : T × ({j // j ≠ k} → T), ((Equiv.funSplitAt k T).symm p) k = p.1 := by
    intro p
    have he := congrArg Prod.fst ((Equiv.funSplitAt k T).apply_symm_apply p)
    exact he
  simp only [hk]
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product]
  simp only [mean_const]

theorem mean_add' {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) :
    mean (fun r => f r + g r) = mean f + mean g := by
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_add_distrib, add_div]

/-! ### Generic core: the retry loop -/

/-- The least attempt whose coins satisfy `Pd`, or `none` (failure exit). -/
def firstGood {C : Type} (Pd : C → Prop) {N : Nat} (c : Fin N → C) : Option (Fin N) :=
  if h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun k => Pd (c k))).Nonempty then
    some ((Finset.univ.filter (fun k => Pd (c k))).min' h)
  else none

theorem firstGood_spec {C : Type} (Pd : C → Prop) {N : Nat} (c : Fin N → C) (k : Fin N)
    (hk : firstGood Pd c = some k) : Pd (c k) := by
  unfold firstGood at hk
  by_cases h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => Pd (c j))).Nonempty
  · rw [dif_pos h] at hk
    have he := Option.some.inj hk
    have hm := Finset.min'_mem _ h
    rw [he] at hm
    exact (Finset.mem_filter.mp hm).2
  · rw [dif_neg h] at hk
    cases hk

theorem firstGood_least {C : Type} (Pd : C → Prop) {N : Nat} (c : Fin N → C) (k : Fin N)
    (hk : firstGood Pd c = some k) (j : Fin N) (hj : Pd (c j)) : k ≤ j := by
  unfold firstGood at hk
  by_cases h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun i => Pd (c i))).Nonempty
  · rw [dif_pos h] at hk
    rw [← Option.some.inj hk]
    exact Finset.min'_le _ j (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hj⟩)
  · rw [dif_neg h] at hk
    cases hk

theorem firstGood_none {C : Type} (Pd : C → Prop) {N : Nat} (c : Fin N → C)
    (hn : firstGood Pd c = none) (k : Fin N) : ¬ Pd (c k) := by
  intro hk
  unfold firstGood at hn
  have h : (Finset.univ.filter (fun j => Pd (c j))).Nonempty :=
    ⟨k, Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_univ _, hk⟩⟩
  rw [dif_pos h] at hn
  cases hn

/-- Observer bit of the retry loop: attempt coins `ct.1`, attempt tapes `ct.2`.
Only the accepted attempt's tape and published value reach `ext`; `ext` and
`fail` may read every attempt's coins. -/
def retryTest {C T V : Type} (N : Nat) (Pd : C → Prop) (pub : C → T → V)
    (ext : (Fin N → C) → Fin N → V → ℚ) (fail : (Fin N → C) → ℚ) :
    (Fin N → C) × (Fin N → T) → ℚ :=
  fun ct => match firstGood Pd ct.1 with
    | none => fail ct.1
    | some k => ext ct.1 k (pub (ct.1 k) (ct.2 k))

theorem retryTest_bounds {C T V : Type} (N : Nat) (Pd : C → Prop) (pub : C → T → V)
    (ext : (Fin N → C) → Fin N → V → ℚ) (fail : (Fin N → C) → ℚ)
    (he : ∀ c k v, 0 ≤ ext c k v ∧ ext c k v ≤ 1) (hf : ∀ c, 0 ≤ fail c ∧ fail c ≤ 1)
    (ct : (Fin N → C) × (Fin N → T)) :
    0 ≤ retryTest N Pd pub ext fail ct ∧ retryTest N Pd pub ext fail ct ≤ 1 := by
  unfold retryTest
  split
  · exact hf _
  · exact he _ _ _

/-- The abort-aware middle step: if the published values agree in law on every
accepted coin, the retry loops have equal means. No mass of rejected coins. -/
theorem retry_means_eq {C T V : Type} [Fintype C] [Fintype T] [Nonempty T] (N : Nat)
    (Pd : C → Prop) (pub₁ pub₂ : C → T → V)
    (ext : (Fin N → C) → Fin N → V → ℚ) (fail : (Fin N → C) → ℚ)
    (hEq : ∀ c, Pd c → EqualLaws (pub₁ c) (pub₂ c)) :
    mean (retryTest N Pd pub₁ ext fail) = mean (retryTest N Pd pub₂ ext fail) := by
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, LawTransport.mean_product]
  apply congrArg mean
  funext c
  rcases hk : firstGood Pd c with _ | k
  · simp only [retryTest, hk]
  · simp only [retryTest, hk]
    exact (mean_eval k (fun t => ext c k (pub₁ (c k) t))).trans
      ((LawTransport.mean_eq_of_equalLaws _ _ (ext c k)
        (hEq _ (firstGood_spec Pd c k hk))).trans
        (mean_eval k (fun t => ext c k (pub₂ (c k) t))).symm)

/-! ### Generic core: identical until bad -/

def eventMass {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E : S → Prop) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun s => if E s then 1 else 0)

theorem eventMass_or_le {S : Type} [Fintype S] (E E' : S → Prop) :
    eventMass (fun s => E s ∨ E' s) ≤ eventMass E + eventMass E' := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [← mean_add']
  apply mean_le_mean
  intro s
  by_cases h1 : E s <;> by_cases h2 : E' s <;> simp [h1, h2]

theorem until_bad {S : Type} [Fintype S] (f g : S → ℚ)
    (hf : ∀ s, 0 ≤ f s ∧ f s ≤ 1) (hg : ∀ s, 0 ≤ g s ∧ g s ≤ 1)
    (E : S → Prop) (hagree : ∀ s, ¬ E s → f s = g s) :
    |mean f - mean g| ≤ eventMass E := by
  unfold eventMass
  rw [mean_sub]
  refine (abs_mean_le _).trans (mean_le_mean _ _ ?_)
  intro s
  by_cases hE : E s
  · rw [if_pos hE]
    have h1 := hf s
    have h2 := hg s
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith [h1.1, h1.2, h2.1, h2.2]
  · rw [if_neg hE, hagree s hE, sub_self, abs_zero]

/-- A finite common space carrying uniform maps to two finite uniform spaces. -/
structure Coupling (R M : Type) [Fintype R] [Fintype M] where
  S : Type
  finS : Fintype S
  nonemptyS : Nonempty S
  toR : S → R
  toM : S → M
  meanR : ∀ f : R → ℚ, @mean S finS (fun s => f (toR s)) = mean f
  meanM : ∀ f : M → ℚ, @mean S finS (fun s => f (toM s)) = mean f

attribute [instance] Coupling.finS Coupling.nonemptyS

/-! ### The R0Z specialisation -/

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-- Per-attempt bridge coins, a cap `N`, and the extension/failure outputs.
`extend` receives all attempts' coins and the accepted index. -/
structure AbortBridge (K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv : Type) [Field K] where
  Coins : Type
  finiteCoins : Fintype Coins
  nonemptyCoins : Nonempty Coins
  N : Nat
  draw : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → Coins → Challenges K
  extend : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → (Fin N → Coins) → Fin N →
    View K CommitHandle Aux Bat → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  fail : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → (Fin N → Coins) → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat

attribute [instance] AbortBridge.finiteCoins AbortBridge.nonemptyCoins

/-- Host attempt 3501: `Fintype (Tape K F)` is found but not under `Fin n → ·`;
naming it lets the Pi instance close. It is definitionally the inferred one. -/
instance tapeFintype : Fintype (Tape K F) := inferInstance

def middleRealAbort (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin))
    (fun coin t => view h B outputs x w (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

def middleIdealAbort (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) :
    (Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F) → ℚ :=
  retryTest ab.N (fun coin => P (ab.draw adv x coin))
    (fun coin t => simulator h B outputs x hx (ab.draw adv x coin) t)
    (fun c k v => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)))
    (fun c => bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)))

/-- The middle experiments agree exactly under `HVZK_on P`. -/
theorem middleAbort_means_eq (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x) :
    mean (middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w) =
      mean (middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx) := by
  haveI : Nonempty (Tape K F) := ⟨(0, 0)⟩
  exact retry_means_eq ab.N _ _ _ _ _ (fun coin hc => hh hx w (ab.draw adv x coin) hc hw)

/-- The abort-aware reduction certificate for a specified abort bridge. -/
def AbortReductionWith (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ ε_real ∧ 0 ≤ ε_ideal ∧
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
      mean (middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w)| ≤ ε_real ∧
    |mean (middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx) -
      mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ ε_ideal

/-- Theorem A: HVZK on `P` plus the abort-aware reduction; no bad-mass term. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ)
    (hr : AbortReductionWith P h B outputs fs ab x ε_real ε_ideal) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal) := by
  intro hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨_, _, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, hideal⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  have hmid := middleAbort_means_eq P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx w hw hh
  rw [hmid] at hreal
  exact (abs_sub_le _ _ _).trans (add_le_add hreal hideal)

theorem hvzk_on_mono (P Q : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hPQ : ∀ ch, P ch → Q ch)
    (hq : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) Q h B outputs x) : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x :=
  fun hx w ch hp hw => hq hx w ch (hPQ ch hp) hw

/-- Mask image on `Good`, rejection on any `P` implying `Good`. -/
theorem zkfs_of_maskImageOn_abort [Fintype Bat] (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hPG : ∀ ch, P ch → Good ch)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) Good h B x → AbortReductionWith P h B outputs fs ab x ε_real ε_ideal →
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal) :=
  fun hm hr => zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort P h B outputs fs x
    (hvzk_on_mono P Good h B outputs x hPG (hvzk_on_good h B outputs x hm)) ab ε_real ε_ideal hr

/-! ### The named oracle-programming terms -/

/-- Real side: outside the discarded-point hit `Hit` and the prover-address
collision `Coll`, the real retrying game and the middle game agree. -/
def RealAbortCoupling (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.RealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_hit ε_coll : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.RealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (Hit Coll : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ Hit s → ¬ Coll s →
        realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s) =
          middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s)) ∧
      eventMass Hit ≤ ε_hit ∧ eventMass Coll ≤ ε_coll

/-- Ideal side: outside the programming failure `Prog`, the middle game and
the rejection-sampling ideal game agree. -/
def IdealAbortCoupling (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) [Fintype fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_prog : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary),
    ∃ (cp : Coupling fs.IdealRand ((Fin ab.N → ab.Coins) × (Fin ab.N → Tape K F)))
      (Prog : cp.S → Prop),
      (∀ s, ¬ Prog s →
        middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s) =
          idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s)) ∧
      eventMass Prog ≤ ε_prog

theorem abortReduction_of_couplings (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog : ℚ)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ε_hit) (h1 : 0 ≤ ε_coll) (h2 : 0 ≤ ε_prog)
    (hreal : RealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll)
    (hideal : IdealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ε_prog) :
    AbortReductionWith P h B outputs fs ab x (ε_hit + ε_coll) ε_prog := by
  refine ⟨by linarith, h2, ?_⟩
  intro hx adv w hw
  have hbit : ∀ c k v, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.extend adv x c k v)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ _ _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  have hfail : ∀ c, 0 ≤ bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ∧
      bit (fs.observe adv (ab.fail adv x c)) ≤ 1 :=
    fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩
  constructor
  · obtain ⟨cp, Hit, Coll, hag, hH, hC⟩ := hreal adv w hw
    rw [← cp.meanR (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w),
      ← cp.meanM (middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w)]
    have hb := until_bad (fun s => realTest h B outputs fs adv x w (cp.toR s))
      (fun s => middleRealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x w (cp.toM s))
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
      (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
      (fun s => Hit s ∨ Coll s)
      (fun s hs => hag s (fun hh => hs (Or.inl hh)) (fun hh => hs (Or.inr hh)))
    have ho := eventMass_or_le Hit Coll
    linarith
  · obtain ⟨cp, Prog, hag, hP⟩ := hideal hx adv
    rw [← cp.meanR (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx),
      ← cp.meanM (middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx)]
    have hb := until_bad (fun s => middleIdealAbort P h B outputs fs ab adv x hx (cp.toM s))
      (fun s => idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx (cp.toR s))
      (fun s => retryTest_bounds _ _ _ _ _ hbit hfail _)
      (fun _ => ⟨bit_nonneg _, bit_le_one _⟩)
      Prog hag
    linarith

/-- Theorem B: ZK_FS for the retrying prover with error equal to the three
named oracle-programming terms. No `badMass P` and no failure-exit term. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort_terms (P : Challenges K → Prop) (h : HonestProver K)
    (B : PackBasis F) (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (ab : AbortBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog : ℚ)
    (h0 : 0 ≤ ε_hit) (h1 : 0 ≤ ε_coll) (h2 : 0 ≤ ε_prog)
    (hreal : RealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll)
    (hideal : IdealAbortCoupling P h B outputs fs ab x ε_prog) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_hit + ε_coll + ε_prog) :=
  zkfs_of_hvzk_on_abort P h B outputs fs x hh ab (ε_hit + ε_coll) ε_prog
    (abortReduction_of_couplings P h B outputs fs ab x ε_hit ε_coll ε_prog h0 h1 h2 hreal hideal)

/-! D17.2 item 9: the FS ledger term of statistical HVZK. The middle
experiments agree exactly on the coins whose drawn challenge satisfies `P`,
and differ by at most one on the rest because the observer bit is 0/1-valued.
`badMass P` is that remaining mass; identifying it with `21/|K_α|` is ZF1's
obligation and needs the FS draw's alpha-row law, which is not chosen here. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsGood
open R0P R0Z.JointView R0Z.FsStatement R0Z.Shift
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ### Elementary facts about finite uniform means -/

theorem mean_sub {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) :
    mean f - mean g = mean (fun r => f r - g r) := by
  simp only [mean, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, sub_div]

theorem abs_mean_le {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) :
    |mean f| ≤ mean (fun r => |f r|) := by
  unfold mean
  rw [abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℚ) (Fintype.card R))]
  exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_le_mean {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f g : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, f r ≤ g r) :
    mean f ≤ mean g :=
  div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (Finset.sum_le_sum (fun r _ => h r)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_nonneg {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, 0 ≤ f r) : 0 ≤ mean f :=
  div_nonneg (Finset.sum_nonneg (fun r _ => h r)) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)

theorem mean_le_one {R : Type} [Fintype R] (f : R → ℚ) (h : ∀ r, f r ≤ 1) : mean f ≤ 1 := by
  unfold mean
  apply div_le_one_of_le₀ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
  have hs := Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul Finset.univ f 1 (fun r _ => h r)
  simpa only [Finset.card_univ, nsmul_eq_mul, mul_one] using hs

theorem bit_nonneg (b : Bool) : 0 ≤ bit b := by
  unfold bit
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

theorem bit_le_one (b : Bool) : bit b ≤ 1 := by
  unfold bit
  split_ifs <;> norm_num

/-! ### The ledger term -/

/-- The mass of bridge coins whose drawn challenge fails `P`. -/
def badMass {Adv : Type} (P : Challenges K → Prop) (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv)
    (adv : Adv) (x : Statement K CommitHandle) : ℚ :=
  mean (fun coin => if P (bridge.draw adv x coin) then 0 else 1)

/-- `middle_means_eq` on the good coins; a difference of at most one elsewhere. -/
theorem middle_means_close (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) (P : Challenges K → Prop) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x) :
    |mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w) -
      mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx)| ≤ badMass P bridge adv x := by
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, LawTransport.mean_product, mean_sub]
  refine (abs_mean_le _).trans (mean_le_mean _ _ ?_)
  intro coin
  by_cases hP : P (bridge.draw adv x coin)
  · rw [if_pos hP]
    have heq : mean (fun r => middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w (coin, r)) =
        mean (fun r => middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx (coin, r)) :=
      LawTransport.mean_eq_of_equalLaws _ _
        (fun v => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x coin v)))
        (hh hx w (bridge.draw adv x coin) hP hw)
    simp only [heq, sub_self, abs_zero, le_refl]
  · rw [if_neg hP]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ mean (fun r => middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w (coin, r)) :=
      mean_nonneg _ (fun r => bit_nonneg _)
    have h2 : mean (fun r => middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w (coin, r)) ≤ 1 :=
      mean_le_one _ (fun r => bit_le_one _)
    have h3 : 0 ≤ mean (fun r => middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx (coin, r)) :=
      mean_nonneg _ (fun r => bit_nonneg _)
    have h4 : mean (fun r => middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx (coin, r)) ≤ 1 :=
      mean_le_one _ (fun r => bit_le_one _)
    rw [abs_sub_le_iff]
    constructor <;> linarith

/-- D20′.3: statistical HVZK on `P` composed using the specified bridge's bad mass. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_on_bridge (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (P : Challenges K → Prop) (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal ε_bad : ℚ)
    (hr : ROMReductionWith h B outputs fs bridge x ε_real ε_ideal)
    (hmass : ∀ adv, badMass P bridge adv x ≤ ε_bad) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal + ε_bad) := by
  intro hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨_, _, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, hideal⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  have hmid := middle_means_close h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx w hw P hh
  have hbad := hmass adv
  have t1 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  have t2 := abs_sub_le (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w))
    (mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  linarith

/-- D20′.3: mask image on `Good` composed with the specified bridge's reduction and bad mass. -/
theorem zkfs_of_maskImageOn_good_bridge [Fintype Bat] (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (ε_real ε_ideal ε_bad : ℚ) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) Good h B x → ROMReductionWith h B outputs fs bridge x ε_real ε_ideal →
    (∀ adv, badMass Good bridge adv x ≤ ε_bad) →
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (ε_real + ε_ideal + ε_bad) :=
  fun hm hr hmass => zkfs_of_hvzk_on_bridge h B outputs fs x Good
    (hvzk_on_good h B outputs x hm) bridge ε_real ε_ideal ε_bad hr hmass

/-- D17.2 item 9: statistical HVZK on `P` composed with a ROM reduction;
superseded by the `_bridge` forms (D20′.3). -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_on (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (P : Challenges K → Prop) (epsilon_fs epsilon_bad : ℚ)
    (hh : HVZK_on (Bat := Bat) P h B outputs x) (hr : ROMReduction h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs)
    (hmass : ∀ (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary),
      badMass P bridge adv x ≤ epsilon_bad) :
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (epsilon_fs + epsilon_bad) := by
  intro hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨bridge, er, ei, _, _, hsum, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hreal, hideal⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  have hmid := middle_means_close h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx w hw P hh
  have hbad := hmass bridge adv
  have t1 := abs_sub_le (mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w))
    (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  have t2 := abs_sub_le (mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w))
    (mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx)) (mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx))
  linarith

/-- The Lean form of "statistical HVZK with the 21/|K_α| term": perfect on `Good`
plus one named ledger term; superseded by the `_bridge` forms (D20′.3). -/
theorem zkfs_of_maskImageOn_good [Fintype Bat] (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs epsilon_bad : ℚ) :
    MaskImageOn (Bat := Bat) Good h B x → ROMReduction h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs →
    (∀ (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary),
      badMass Good bridge adv x ≤ epsilon_bad) →
    ZK_FS h B outputs fs x (epsilon_fs + epsilon_bad) :=
  fun hm hr hmass => zkfs_of_hvzk_on h B outputs fs x Good epsilon_fs epsilon_bad
    (hvzk_on_good h B outputs x hm) hr hmass
