R0Z.FsStatement:
import R0Z.JointView
import R0Z.LawTransport

/-! D11's adopted FS interface. The current 32-round view and a Boolean
observer replace the historical Z1 types. ROMReduction is an explicit open
obligation about the real games, not an instance supplied by this module.
No oracle programming policy, query bound, or numerical error is chosen. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R0Z.FsStatement
open R0P R0Z.JointView
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

abbrev Bytes := List UInt8
abbrev OracleAnswer := Fin 32 → UInt8

/-- Full public model view plus the observer's own query/answer transcript.
The honest prover's private oracle-input log is not a public field. -/
structure ROMView (K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type) [Field K] where
  disclosed : View K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  observerOracle : List (Bytes × OracleAnswer)

structure FSExperiments (K CommitHandle Aux Bat : Type) [Field K] (F : Subfield K) where
  Adversary : Type
  RealRand : Type
  IdealRand : Type
  real : (h : HonestProver K) → PackBasis F →
    (Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux) → Adversary →
    Statement K CommitHandle → h.Instance → RealRand → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  ideal : (Challenges K → Tape K F → View K CommitHandle Aux Bat) → Adversary →
    Statement K CommitHandle → IdealRand → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat
  observe : Adversary → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat → Bool

variable {K CommitHandle Aux : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [HonestView.BatchedLayer K Bat]

def bit (b : Bool) : ℚ := if b then 1 else 0

def realTest (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) : fs.RealRand → ℚ :=
  fun r => bit (fs.observe adv (fs.real h B outputs adv x w r))

def idealTest (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) : fs.IdealRand → ℚ :=
  fun r => bit (fs.observe adv (fs.ideal (simulator h B outputs x hx) adv x r))

/-- Adopted distinguishing-advantage target. Epsilon remains symbolic;
neither HVZK nor a ROM reduction is a premise of this definition. -/
def ZK_FS (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) - mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ epsilon_fs

/-- Data for a common randomized extension of the two interactive views.
Its coins include the instance-independent challenge draw and any observer
randomness. Their product with Tape expresses independence from prover coins. -/
structure ROMBridge (K CommitHandle Aux Bat Adv : Type) [Field K] where
  Coins : Type
  finiteCoins : Fintype Coins
  nonemptyCoins : Nonempty Coins
  draw : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → Coins → Challenges K
  extend : Adv → Statement K CommitHandle → Coins →
    View K CommitHandle Aux Bat → ROMView K CommitHandle Aux Bat

attribute [instance] ROMBridge.finiteCoins ROMBridge.nonemptyCoins

def middleReal (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) : bridge.Coins × Tape K F → ℚ :=
  fun t => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x t.1
    (view h B outputs x w (bridge.draw adv x t.1) t.2)))

def middleIdeal (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) : bridge.Coins × Tape K F → ℚ :=
  fun t => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x t.1
    (simulator h B outputs x hx (bridge.draw adv x t.1) t.2)))

/-- ZF1's substantive obligation: exhibit a common extension and prove both
real-game comparison bounds. All commitment, programming, seed, abort, and
source errors must be justified in these bounds; no such proof is supplied. -/
def ROMReduction (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary,
    ∃ epsilon_real epsilon_ideal : ℚ,
      0 ≤ epsilon_real ∧ 0 ≤ epsilon_ideal ∧ epsilon_real + epsilon_ideal ≤ epsilon_fs ∧
      ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
        |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
          mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)| ≤ epsilon_real ∧
        |mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx) -
          mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ epsilon_ideal

/-- D20′.3: the two real-game comparison bounds for a specified bridge. -/
def ROMReductionWith (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε_real ε_ideal : ℚ) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ ε_real ∧ 0 ≤ ε_ideal ∧
  ∀ (hx : InLanguage h x) (adv : fs.Adversary) (w : h.Instance), h.public w = x.1 →
    |mean (realTest h B outputs fs adv x w) -
      mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w)| ≤ ε_real ∧
    |mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx) -
      mean (idealTest h B outputs fs adv x hx)| ≤ ε_ideal

/-- The original reduction existentially packages a bridge and its two bounds. -/
theorem romReduction_iff (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (ε : ℚ) :
    ROMReduction h B outputs fs x ε ↔
      ∃ bridge ε_real ε_ideal,
        ROMReductionWith h B outputs fs bridge x ε_real ε_ideal ∧ ε_real + ε_ideal ≤ ε := by
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, hr, hi, hsum, hb⟩
    exact ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, ⟨hr, hi, hb⟩, hsum⟩
  · rintro ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, ⟨hr, hi, hb⟩, hsum⟩
    exact ⟨bridge, ε_real, ε_ideal, hr, hi, hsum, hb⟩

theorem middle_means_eq (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    (bridge : ROMBridge K CommitHandle Aux Bat fs.Adversary) (adv : fs.Adversary)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (hx : InLanguage h x) (w : h.Instance)
    (hw : h.public w = x.1) (hh : HVZK_perfect (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x) :
    mean (middleReal h B outputs fs bridge adv x w) =
      mean (middleIdeal h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx) := by
  rw [LawTransport.mean_product, LawTransport.mean_product]
  apply congrArg mean
  funext coin
  exact LawTransport.mean_eq_of_equalLaws _ _
    (fun v => bit (fs.observe adv (bridge.extend adv x coin v)))
    (hh hx w (bridge.draw adv x coin) hw)

/-- Only the composition is discharged. ZF1 still requires an actual
ROMReduction certificate for the chosen games and their symbolic ledger. -/
theorem zkfs_of_hvzk_perfect (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (outputs : Statement K CommitHandle → Challenges K → Aux)
    (fs : FSExperiments K CommitHandle Aux Bat F)
    [Fintype fs.RealRand] [Nonempty fs.RealRand]
    [Fintype fs.IdealRand] [Nonempty fs.IdealRand]
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (epsilon_fs : ℚ) :
    HVZK_perfect (Bat := Bat) h B outputs x → ROMReduction h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs →
      ZK_FS h B outputs fs x epsilon_fs := by
  intro hh hr hx adv w hw
  obtain ⟨bridge, er, ei, _, _, hsum, hb⟩ := hr
  obtain ⟨hr, hi⟩ := hb hx adv w hw
  rw [middle_means_eq h B outputs fs bridge adv x hx w hw hh] at hr
  exact (abs_sub_le _ _ _).trans ((add_le_add hr hi).trans hsum)

#print axioms ZK_FS
#print axioms ROMReduction
#print axioms ROMReductionWith
#print axioms romReduction_iff
#print axioms middle_means_eq
#print axioms zkfs_of_hvzk_perfect
end R0Z.FsStatement

import R0Z.SilentReduction

/-! J2 / J2-R1 (DESIGN-T2b-2b §5 J2; DESIGN-R1-PRIVACY-MODEL §4 J2-R1):
`sRem ∈ Chain0K4`, stated once for every batched layer `Bat` (R0 and R1).

The remainder `sRem` is supported on the ten round arrays; its cells are the
coefficient differences `g` of the original-terminal round polynomials of two
actual traces, minus a multiple of the direction `X − ½`.  This module proves:

* `interpolate_mem`: Lagrange interpolation on the nodes `0, …, 27` with values
  in a subfield `S` has every coefficient in `S`;
* `actual_mem`: every cell of an actual (masked, prepared) trace lies in `K₄`
  when the instance is base-typed and `λ, χ ∈ K₄` (the H1 helper column
  included, `helper_mem`);
* `honestClaims_mem`, `roundPoint_mem`, `originalRounds_mem`, `g_mem`;
* `sRem_mem_K4` and `sRem_mem_chain0K4`.

One closure fact about the R0P terminal is NOT proved here and enters as the
named premise `TerminalClosed S pub B ch`: the terminal value
`terminalValue pub λ χ θ μ zc B y a` lies in `S` whenever the claims `y` and
the point `a` do.  It is a pure field-closure property of the ported
constraint families (`laneAt`: Poseidon, schedule, occupancy, path, value,
digest, asset, copy), given the challenges in `S` and the public statement in
the base field. -/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

namespace R0Z.K4Values

open scoped BigOperators
open R0P R0P.SemSource R0Z.MaskLayout R0Z.HonestView R0Z.Partition R0Z.D12 R0Z.Shift
  R0Z.K4 Polynomial

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
attribute [local irreducible] copyLinks copyPatterns copyActiveRowMasks copyInactiveRows

variable {K CommitHandle : Type} [Field K] [Fintype K] [DecidableEq K]
  [Algebra (ZMod AspisCircleGroupOrder.P) K] {F : Subfield K}
  {Bat : Type} [BatchedLayer K Bat]

/-! ## Polynomials with coefficients in a subfield -/

/-- Polynomials all of whose coefficients lie in `S`. -/
def coeffRing (S : Subfield K) : Subring K[X] where
  carrier := {p | ∀ n, p.coeff n ∈ S}
  mul_mem' := by
    intro p q hp hq n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_mul]
    exact sum_mem fun x _ => S.mul_mem (hp _) (hq _)
  one_mem' := by
    intro n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_one]
    split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  add_mem' := by
    intro p q hp hq n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_add]
    exact S.add_mem (hp n) (hq n)
  zero_mem' := by
    intro n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  neg_mem' := by
    intro p hp n
    rw [Polynomial.coeff_neg]
    exact S.neg_mem (hp n)

theorem C_mem_coeffRing (S : Subfield K) {c : K} (hc : c ∈ S) : C c ∈ coeffRing S := by
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_C]
  split_ifs
  · exact hc
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem X_mem_coeffRing (S : Subfield K) : (X : K[X]) ∈ coeffRing S := by
  intro n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_X]
  split_ifs
  · exact S.one_mem
  · exact S.zero_mem

/-- Interpolation on the 28 natural nodes keeps coefficients in `S`. -/
theorem interpolate_mem (S : Subfield K) (v : Fin 28 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) :
    Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i : Fin 28 => (i.val : K)) v ∈ coeffRing S := by
  rw [Lagrange.interpolate_apply]
  refine sum_mem fun i _ => (coeffRing S).mul_mem (C_mem_coeffRing S (hv i)) ?_
  unfold Lagrange.basis
  refine prod_mem fun j _ => ?_
  unfold Lagrange.basisDivisor
  exact (coeffRing S).mul_mem
    (C_mem_coeffRing S (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem (natCast_mem S _) (natCast_mem S _))))
    ((coeffRing S).sub_mem (X_mem_coeffRing S) (C_mem_coeffRing S (natCast_mem S _)))

theorem interpolate_coeff_mem (S : Subfield K) (v : Fin 28 → K) (hv : ∀ i, v i ∈ S) (d : ℕ) :
    (Lagrange.interpolate Finset.univ (fun i : Fin 28 => (i.val : K)) v).coeff d ∈ S :=
  interpolate_mem S v hv d

/-! ## Points and claims -/

theorem alpha_mem (S : Subfield K) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (i : Fin 10) : alpha ch i ∈ S := hsem _

theorem roundPoint_mem (S : Subfield K) (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S)
    (j : Fin 10) (k : ℕ) (tail : Fin (9 - j.val) → Bool) (i : Fin 10) :
    roundPoint ch j (k : K) tail i ∈ S := by
  unfold roundPoint
  split_ifs
  · exact alpha_mem S ch hsem i
  · exact natCast_mem S k
  · exact S.one_mem
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem eqWeight_mem (S : Subfield K) (p : Fin 10 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ S) (r : Fin 1024) :
    AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight p r ∈ S := by
  unfold AspisR0.Opening.eqWeight
  refine prod_mem fun b _ => ?_
  split_ifs
  · exact S.sub_mem S.one_mem (hp b)
  · exact hp b

theorem succCarry_mem (S : Subfield K) (p : Fin 10 → K) (hp : ∀ i, p i ∈ S) :
    ∀ k, succCarry p k ∈ S
  | 0 => S.one_mem
  | k + 1 => by
    unfold succCarry
    refine S.mul_mem ?_ (succCarry_mem S p hp k)
    split_ifs
    · exact hp _
    · exact S.zero_mem

theorem openingPoints_mem (S : Subfield K) (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S)
    (j : Fin 3) (i : Fin 10) : openingPoints a j i ∈ S := by
  match j with
  | 0 => exact ha _
  | 1 =>
    show successorPoint a ⟨9 - i.val, by omega⟩ ∈ S
    unfold successorPoint
    have hc := succCarry_mem S a ha (9 - (9 - i.val))
    exact S.sub_mem (S.add_mem (ha _) hc)
      (S.add_mem (S.mul_mem (ha _) hc) (S.mul_mem (ha _) hc))
  | 2 =>
    show xor12Point a ⟨9 - i.val, by omega⟩ ∈ S
    unfold xor12Point
    split_ifs
    · exact S.sub_mem S.one_mem (ha _)
    · exact ha _

theorem honestClaims_mem (S : Subfield K) (t : Trace K) (ht : ∀ c r, t c r ∈ S)
    (a : Fin 10 → K) (ha : ∀ i, a i ∈ S) (j : Fin 3) (c : Fin 29) :
    honestClaims t a j c ∈ S := by
  unfold honestClaims AspisR0.LinearDual.dot
  exact sum_mem fun r _ =>
    S.mul_mem (eqWeight_mem S _ (openingPoints_mem S a ha j) r) (ht c r)

/-! ## The H1 helper column -/

theorem copyLinkWeight_mem (S : Subfield K) (link : CopyLink) (n : ℕ) (v : Variant) :
    copyLinkWeight (K := K) link n v ∈ S := by
  unfold copyLinkWeight
  split
  · exact S.one_mem
  · split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  · split_ifs
    · exact S.one_mem
    · exact S.zero_mem
  · exact natCast_mem S _
  · exact natCast_mem S _

theorem copyTupleValue_mem (S : Subfield K) (t : Trace K)
    (ht : ∀ c r, c.val < 16 → t c r ∈ S) (lam : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (tag : ℕ)
    (ep : CopyEndpoint) : copyTupleValue lam (copyEndpointTuple t tag ep) ∈ S := by
  unfold copyTupleValue copyEndpointTuple copyPatternTuple
  refine S.add_mem (natCast_mem S tag) (sum_mem fun i _ => S.mul_mem (S.pow_mem hlam _) ?_)
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact S.add_mem (ht _ _ (by simp only [Fin.val_castLE]; exact Fin.isLt _)) (natCast_mem S _)
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem copyRowValues_mem (S : Subfield K) (t : Trace K)
    (ht : ∀ c r, c.val < 16 → t c r ∈ S) (lam : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (b : Fin 1024)
    (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (slot : Fin 2) :
    copyRowValues t lam b endpoint slot ∈ S := by
  unfold copyRowValues
  refine list_sum_mem fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨link, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact copyTupleValue_mem S t ht lam hlam _ _
  · exact S.zero_mem

theorem copyRowWeights_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (b : Fin 1024)
    (endpoint : CopyLink → CopyEndpoint) (slot : Fin 2) :
    copyRowWeights pub b endpoint slot ∈ S := by
  unfold copyRowWeights
  refine list_sum_mem fun x hx => ?_
  obtain ⟨link, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.1 hx
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs
  · exact copyLinkWeight_mem S _ _ _
  · exact S.zero_mem

/-- The H1 helper (logup reciprocals) stays in `S`. -/
theorem helper_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (ht : ∀ c r, c.val < 16 → t c r ∈ S) (lam chi : K) (hlam : lam ∈ S) (hchi : chi ∈ S)
    (r : Fin 1024) : helper pub t lam chi r ∈ S := by
  unfold helper
  try dsimp only
  refine S.sub_mem (sum_mem fun s _ => S.mul_mem (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem hchi ?_)) ?_)
    (sum_mem fun s _ => S.mul_mem (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem hchi ?_)) ?_)
  · exact copyRowValues_mem S t ht lam hlam r _ s
  · exact copyRowWeights_mem S pub r _ s
  · exact copyRowValues_mem S t ht lam hlam r _ s
  · exact copyRowWeights_mem S pub r _ s

/-! ## The actual trace -/

theorem balance_mem (S : Subfield K) (dep : Fin 1024) (word : Fin 1024 → K)
    (hw : ∀ s, word s ∈ S) (r : Fin 1024) : balance dep word r ∈ S := by
  unfold balance
  split_ifs
  · exact S.neg_mem (sum_mem fun s _ => hw s)
  · exact hw r

/-- Every cell of an actual trace lies in `K₄`: base-typed semantic lanes and
F-valued noise, K₄-packed G/H1/D limbs, and the helper column. -/
theorem actual_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (pub : Public K) (t : Trace K)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hF : BaseTyped F t) (hlam : ch.sem 0 ∈ K4 B hB)
    (hchi : ch.sem 1 ∈ K4 B hB) (r : T K F) (c : Fin 29) (s : Fin 1024) :
    PayloadSplit.actual pub B t ch r c s ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have hFK : ∀ x : F, (x : K) ∈ K4 B hB := fun x => F_le_K4 B hB x.2
  have hE : ∀ (c' : Fin 29) (s' : Fin 1024), c'.val < 16 →
      applyEligible t r.2.2 c' s' ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro c' s' hc'
    unfold applyEligible
    rw [if_pos hc']
    refine balance_mem _ 1023 _ (fun s'' => ?_) s'
    try dsimp only
    refine (K4 B hB).add_mem (F_le_K4 B hB (hF c' (by omega) s'')) ?_
    unfold semanticNoise
    split_ifs
    · exact hFK _
    · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  have hext : ∀ (lane : Fin 3) (q : Fin 1024),
      extensionRaw B (Sum.elim (0 : EligibleNoise K F) (aff r)) lane q ∈ K4 B hB := by
    intro lane q
    exact pack4_mem_K4 B hB _ (fun j => Subtype.mem _)
  unfold PayloadSplit.actual applyAff
  try dsimp only
  split_ifs with h1 h2 h3 h4
  · unfold prepare
    rw [if_neg (by omega)]
    exact hE c s h1
  · unfold maskOnlyColumns
    exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hFK _) s
  · refine (K4 B hB).add_mem ?_ ?_
    · unfold prepare
      rw [if_pos h3]
      exact helper_mem _ pub _ hE _ _ hlam hchi s
    · unfold h1Padding
      refine balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => ?_) s
      try dsimp only
      split_ifs
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
      · exact hext 1 q
  · exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hext 0 q) s
  · unfold dWord
    exact balance_mem _ 0 _ (fun q => hext 2 q) s

/-! ## Original round polynomials and the remainder -/

/-- The missing field-closure fact about the R0P terminal (see the header). -/
def TerminalClosed (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F) (ch : Challenges K) :
    Prop :=
  ∀ (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → K) (a : Fin 10 → K), (∀ j c, y j c ∈ S) → (∀ i, a i ∈ S) →
    terminalValue pub (ch.sem 0) (ch.sem 1) (ch.sem 2) (ch.sem 13) (zc ch) B y a ∈ S

theorem originalRounds_mem (S : Subfield K) (pub : Public K) (B : PackBasis F)
    (ch : Challenges K) (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ S) (hT : TerminalClosed S pub B ch)
    (t : Trace K) (ht : ∀ c r, t c r ∈ S) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    PayloadSplit.originalRounds pub B ch t j i ∈ S := by
  unfold PayloadSplit.originalRounds
  rw [PayloadSplit.rounds_apply]
  refine interpolate_coeff_mem S _ (fun k => sum_mem fun tail _ => ?_) i.val
  refine S.mul_mem (hsem 14) (hT _ _ (fun j' c => ?_) (roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail))
  exact honestClaims_mem S t ht _ (roundPoint_mem S ch hsem j k.val tail) j' c

theorem g_mem (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    g h B x w ch n j i ∈ K4 B hB := by
  have hact := fun r => actual_mem B hB x.1 (h.build w) ch hF (hsem 0) (hsem 1) r
  exact (K4 B hB).sub_mem
    (originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT _ (hact _) j i)
    (originalRounds_mem _ x.1 B ch hsem hT _ (hact _) j i)

theorem dirCoeff_mem (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B) (j : Fin 10) (i : Fin 28) :
    (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) ∈ K4 B hB := by
  split_ifs
  · rw [Polynomial.coeff_sub, Polynomial.coeff_X, Polynomial.coeff_C]
    refine (K4 B hB).sub_mem ?_ ?_
    · split_ifs
      · exact (K4 B hB).one_mem
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
    · split_ifs
      · exact half_mem_K4 B hB
      · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem
  · exact (K4 B hB).zero_mem

/-- J2: every cell of `sRem` lies in `K₄`. -/
theorem sRem_mem_K4 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) :
    ∀ cell, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n cell ∈ K4 B hB := by
  set S := K4 B hB with hS
  let p := g h B x w ch n
  let coef : K := Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) * (alpha ch 9 - 1 / 2)⁻¹
  have hcell : ∀ cell, sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n cell =
      PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p cell - coef * dir (K := K) (Bat := Bat) cell :=
    fun cell => rfl
  have hphi : Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) ∈ S := by
    have e : Phi0 B ch (roundInclusion (F := F) (Bat := Bat) p) =
        evalRound9 ch (PayloadSplit.roundInclusion (Bat := Bat) p) :=
      Phi0_roundInclusion B ch p
    rw [e, evalRound9_roundInclusion, Polynomial.eval_finsetSum]
    refine sum_mem fun i _ => ?_
    rw [Polynomial.eval_monomial]
    exact S.mul_mem (g_mem h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT 9 i)
      (S.pow_mem (alpha_mem S ch hsem 9) _)
  have hcoef : coef ∈ S :=
    S.mul_mem hphi (S.inv_mem (S.sub_mem (alpha_mem S ch hsem 9) (half_mem_K4 B hB)))
  intro cell
  rw [hcell]
  cases cell with
  | semanticCoeff j i =>
    show p j i - coef * (if j = 9 then (X - C (1 / 2 : K)).coeff i.val else 0) ∈ S
    exact S.sub_mem (g_mem h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT j i)
      (S.mul_mem hcoef (dirCoeff_mem B hB j i))
  | maskSum =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | pointClaim j c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | extraClaim c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | ood j c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | inactiveSum =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | opened q s c =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem
  | bat b =>
    show (0 : K) - coef * 0 ∈ S
    rw [mul_zero, sub_zero]
    exact S.zero_mem

/-- J2 / J2-R1: `sRem ∈ Chain0₄` for every batched layer (R0 and R1), given
`SemK4`, a base-typed instance, `α₉ ≠ ½`, and `TerminalClosed`. -/
theorem sRem_mem_chain0K4 (h : HonestProver K) (B : PackBasis F) (hB : PackField B)
    (x : Statement K CommitHandle) (w : h.Instance) (ch : Challenges K) (n : N K F)
    (hsem : ∀ i, ch.sem i ∈ K4 B hB) (hF : BaseTyped F (h.build w))
    (hT : TerminalClosed (K4 B hB) x.1 B ch) (hhalf : alpha ch 9 ≠ 1 / 2) :
    sRem (Bat := Bat) h B x w ch n ∈ R0Z.SilentReduction.Chain0K4 (Bat := Bat) B hB ch :=
  (R0Z.SilentReduction.mem_chain0K4_iff B hB ch _).2
    ⟨R0Z.Chain.sRem_mem_chain0 h B x w ch n hhalf, sRem_mem_K4 h B hB x w ch n hsem hF hT⟩

R1Z.ProverCommitChallengePrefix55:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSampleModel49
/-! Semantic challenge positions and round-prefix preservation, including
source sample/tail writes before the next alpha assignment. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitChallengePrefix55
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open R0Z.HonestView

def withSemantic (ch : Challenges QM31Exact) (sem : Nat → Old.Q) : Challenges QM31Exact :=
  {ch with sem := fun i => decode (sem i.val)}

def Prefix (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 10, i.val<r → decode (p i.val)=decode (sem (15+i.val))

theorem alpha_source (ch : Challenges QM31Exact) (sem : Nat → Old.Q) (i : Fin 10) :
    alpha (withSemantic ch sem) i=decode (sem (15+i.val)) := rfl

theorem initial (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) : Prefix sem p 0 := by
  intro i hi;omega

theorem model_prefix (ch : Challenges QM31Exact) (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Fin 10)
    (hp : Prefix sem p r.val) :
    ∀ i : Fin 10, i.val<r.val → decode (p i.val)=alpha (withSemantic ch sem) i := hp

def nextPoint (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Nat) (a : Usize) (sample : U32) : Nat → Old.Q :=
  Function.update (ProverCommitSamplePoint49.point p r a sample) r (sem (15+r))

theorem preserved (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Fin 10) (hp : Prefix sem p r.val)
    (a : Usize) (sample : U32) : Prefix sem (nextPoint sem p r.val a sample) (r.val+1) := by
  intro i hi
  by_cases he : i.val=r.val
  · simp only [nextPoint,he,Function.update_self]
  · have hpre : i.val<r.val := by omega
    rw [nextPoint,Function.update_of_ne he,
      ProverCommitSamplePoint49.point_decode p r.val r.isLt a sample i.val i.isLt,if_pos hpre]
    exact hp i hpre

def advance (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (r rem a : Usize) (left : U8) (sample : U32) := do
  let point ← owned.sample (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) r sample
  let point ← owned.tail point r rem a 0#usize left
  let alpha ← Array.index_usize (ProverCommitQArray48.array 25#usize sem)
    (Usize.wrapping_add 15#usize r)
  Array.update point r alpha

attribute [local irreducible] ProverCommitQArray48.array ProverCommitNativeQ48.source

theorem source_advance (sem p : Nat → Old.Q) (r rem a : Usize) (left : U8) (sample : U32)
    (hr : r.val<10) (hrem : rem.val=9-r.val) (hleft : left.val=9-r.val) :
    advance sem p r rem a left sample=
      ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize (nextPoint sem p r.val a sample)) := by
  have hidx : (Usize.wrapping_add 15#usize r).val=15+r.val := by
    simpa only [show (15#usize).val=15 from rfl] using
      ProverCommitBasisFillValue47.add_val 15#usize r (by change 15+r.val<2048;omega)
  have hp := ProverCommitSamplePoint49.point_result p r rem a left hr hrem hleft sample
  unfold advance
  rw [←bind_assoc,hp]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ProverCommitQArray48.index _ _ _ (by rw [hidx];change 15+r.val<25;omega)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,hidx]
  exact ProverCommitQArray48.update 10#usize _ r hr (sem (15+r.val))

#print axioms alpha_source
#print axioms initial
#print axioms model_prefix
#print axioms preserved
#print axioms source_advance
end R1Z.ProverCommitChallengePrefix55
R1Z.ProverCommitSampleModel49:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSamplePoint49
import R1Z.ProverCommitBooleanEnum49
import R0Z.HonestView
/-! Native-owned sample points equal the existing semantic model's roundPoint.
The challenge hprefix is explicit, and assignment order is transported by a
proved bijection rather than assuming sample-array equality. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSampleModel49
open Aeneas.Std
open ProverCommitPrimitive47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitSamplePoint49 ProverCommitBooleanEnum49
open R0P R0P.Sumcheck R0P.SemSource R0Z.HonestView
open scoped BigOperators

theorem point_model (ch : Challenges QM31Exact) (p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Fin 10)
    (hprefix : ∀ i : Fin 10, i.val<r.val → decode (p i.val)=R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch i)
    (a : Fin (2^(9-r.val))) (word : Usize) (hw : word.val=a.val) (sample : U32) :
    (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (point p r.val word sample i.val))=
      R0Z.HonestView.roundPoint ch r (sample.val : QM31Exact) (tail (9-r.val) a) := by
  funext i
  rw [point_decode p r.val r.isLt word sample i.val i.isLt]
  unfold R0Z.HonestView.roundPoint
  by_cases hpre : i.val<r.val
  · rw [dif_pos hpre,if_pos hpre]
    exact hprefix i hpre
  · by_cases he : i.val=r.val
    · simp only [dif_neg hpre,dif_pos he,if_neg hpre,if_pos he]
    · simp only [dif_neg hpre,dif_neg he,if_neg hpre,if_neg he]
      rw [bit_tail (9-r.val) a word hw ⟨i.val-r.val-1,by omega⟩]

theorem sum_points (ch : Challenges QM31Exact) (p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Fin 10)
    (hprefix : ∀ i : Fin 10, i.val<r.val → decode (p i.val)=R0Z.HonestView.alpha ch i)
    (words : Fin (2^(9-r.val)) → Usize) (hw : ∀ a, (words a).val=a.val)
    (sample : U32) (f : (Fin 10 → QM31Exact) → QM31Exact) :
    (∑ a : Fin (2^(9-r.val)), f (fun i : Fin 10 => decode (point p r.val (words a) sample i.val)))=
      ∑ b : Fin (9-r.val) → Bool, f (R0Z.HonestView.roundPoint ch r (sample.val : QM31Exact) b) := by
  simp_rw [point_model ch p r hprefix _ _ (hw _) sample]
  exact sum_tail (K := QM31Exact) (9-r.val) (fun b => f (R0Z.HonestView.roundPoint ch r (sample.val : QM31Exact) b))

#print axioms point_model
#print axioms sum_points
end R1Z.ProverCommitSampleModel49
R1Z.ProverCommitSamplePoint49:
import R1Z.ProverCommitSampleTail49
/-! The owned prefix/sample/tail point, with a decoded big-endian formula.
No semantic oracle implementation or success is assumed by these point laws. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace R1Z.ProverCommitSamplePoint49
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1ProducerRelease47
open ProverCommitPrimitive47 ProverCommitSubfieldOps47
open AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentQM31Exact (decode QM31Exact)
open ProverCommitSampleTail49

def word (sample : U32) : Old.Q := ⟨⟨sample,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩

theorem word_decode (sample : U32) : decode (word sample)=(sample.val : QM31Exact) := by rfl

theorem word_canonical (sample : U32) (h : sample.val<28) : Canonical (word sample) := by
  change (sample.val<AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.P ∧ (0#u32).val<AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.P) ∧
    ((0#u32).val<AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.P ∧ (0#u32).val<AspisR1.ExtractedCurrentTowerAdd.P)
  refine ⟨⟨?_,by decide⟩,⟨by decide,by decide⟩⟩
  change sample.val<2147483647
  omega

theorem sample_value (p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Usize) (hr : r.val<10) (sample : U32) :
    owned.sample (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) r sample=
      ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize (Function.update p r.val (word sample))) := by
  simp only [owned.sample,field.CM31.from_m31,field.QM31.from_cm31,
    field.M31.ZERO,field.CM31.ZERO,bind_tc_ok]
  exact ProverCommitQArray48.update 10#usize p r hr (word sample)

def point (p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Nat) (a : Usize) (sample : U32) : Nat → Old.Q :=
  values (9-r) (Function.update p r (word sample)) r (9-r) a 0

theorem point_decode (p : Nat → Old.Q) (r : Nat) (hr : r<10) (a : Usize)
    (sample : U32) (k : Nat) (hk : k<10) :
    decode (point p r a sample k)=
      if k<r then decode (p k) else if k=r then (sample.val : QM31Exact)
      else if ProverCommitSampleBits49.bit a (9-r) (k-r-1) then 1 else 0 := by
  rw [point,values_at]
  by_cases hpre : k<r
  · rw [if_neg (by omega),Function.update_of_ne (by omega : k≠r),if_pos hpre]
  · by_cases he : k=r
    · subst k
      rw [if_neg (by omega),Function.update_self,word_decode,if_neg (by omega),if_pos rfl]
    · rw [if_pos (by omega),if_neg hpre,if_neg he]
      unfold qbit
      split <;> simp only [ProverCommitSubtraction47.one_decode,zero_decode]

theorem point_result (p : Nat → Old.Q) (r rem a : Usize) (left : U8)
    (hr : r.val<10) (hrem : rem.val=9-r.val) (hleft : left.val=9-r.val)
    (sample : U32) :
    (do
      let p ← owned.sample (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize p) r sample
      owned.tail p r rem a 0#usize left)=
      ok (ProverCommitQArray48.array 10#usize (point p r.val a sample)) := by
  rw [sample_value p r hr sample]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [tail_value (9-r.val) _ _ _ _ _ _ hleft hr hrem (by change 0+(9-r.val)≤rem.val;omega)]
  simp only [point,hrem,show (0#usize).val=0 from rfl]

#print axioms word_decode
#print axioms word_canonical
#print axioms sample_value
#print axioms point_decode
#print axioms point_result
end R1Z.ProverCommitSamplePoint49
